text.body:
%\ edC, p.1 {pratyāhārasūtrāṇi}
jayanti te sadā santaḥ sarvathā yair upārjitam| guṇānāṃ sumahad vṛndaṃ doṣāṇāṃ ca vimārjanam||1||
anyataḥ sāram ādāya kṛtaiṣā kāśikā yathā| vṛttis tasyā yathāśakti kriyate pañjikā tathā||2||
vṛttāv ityādi| atha kimarthaḥ kāśikārambhe 'sya ślokasyopanyāsaḥ| tasyām agauravaparihārārtho gauravapratipādanārthaś ca| atra hy asati prāg anyāsu vṛttiṣu racitāsu paścād iyaṃ raciteti punaruktatādoṣaṃ sambhāvayatāṃ tasyām agauravaṃ syān na tu gauravam|
asmiṃs tu sati na bhavaty eṣa doṣaḥ| yasmād anena sa viśeṣas tasyā ākhyāyate samyagaśeṣaśabdavyutpattihetuḥ yasmin sati punaruktatādoṣasambhāvanāgauravahetur na bhavati| gauravaṃ cotpadyate| sa punar viśeṣo vṛttyādiṣu viprakīrṇasya tantrasya yaḥ sārasaṃgrahas tadyuktatā| na cāsau prācyāsu vṛttiṣu sambhavatīti kutaḥ punaruktatādoṣasambhāvanā| tasyāṃ cāsatyāṃ nāgauravaṃ bhavati; kiṃ tarhi pūrvoktād viśeṣād gauravam eva| tatra ca vṛttiḥ paṇinipraṇītānāṃ sūtrāṇāṃ vivaraṇaṃ cūllibhaṭṭinallūrādiviracitam| %\(edC, p.2 begins with sūtrāṇām) bhāṣyaṃ kātyāyanapraṇītānāṃ vākyānāṃ vivaraṇaṃ patañjalipraṇītam| tatheti samuccaye| dhātunāmapārāyaṇādiṣu cety arthaḥ| athavā sādṛśye| yathā vṛttyādau viprakīrṇasya tantrasya sārasaṃgrahaḥ kriyate tathā dhātunāmapārāyaṇādiṣv iti yāvat|| dhātavo bhūvādayaḥ| nāmāni prātipadikāni| teṣāṃ pāraṃ paryyantaṃ niṣṭhāmayante gacchanti yābhyāṃ śāstrābhyāṃ te dhātunāmapārāyaṇe| pārāyaṇaśabdaḥ pratyekam abhisambadhyate| dhātupārāyaṇaṃ nāmapārāyaṇañ ceti| te ādī yeṣām iti bahuvrīhiḥ| ādiśabdena śikṣādīnāṃ grahaṇam| viprakīrṇasyeti| vikṣiptasya vistāritasyety arthaḥ| tantrasya vyākaraṇaśāstrasyety arthaḥ| tad dhi tantram iva tantram| dairghyeṇa prasāritāḥ tantavas tantram ity ucyante| %P3 starting from tiraścīnasya yathā tadanekasya tiraścīnasya tantor anugrāhakaṃ tathedam apy anekasya lakṣyasyeti| etad asya tantreṇa sādharmyam| athavā tantryante vyutpādyante śabda aneneti tantraṃ vyākaraṇam| anekārthatvād dhātūnāṃ tattrikuṭumbadhāraṇa ity eṣa dhātur atra vyutpādane varttate| athavā siddhāntaḥ| tantraṃ pradhāne siddhanta ity amaraḥ| sārasaṃgraha iti| sāraśabdo 'yaṃ napuṃsakaliṅgo nyāyād anapete varttate| tathā ca arddharcādiṣu (2.4.31) vakṣyati sāraśabda utkarṣe puṃliṅgo nyāyād anapete napuṃsaka iti| samak samantād vā gṛhyate lakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇañ ca aneneti saṃgrahaḥ| grahavṛdṛniścigamaś ceti (3.3.58) karaṇe 'pi| sārañ ca asau saṃgrahaś ceti sāra saṃgrahaḥ| sa punar ayam eva kāśikākhyo vṛttiviśeṣaḥ| atra sāraśabdena nirdoṣatodbhāvitā| na hi sadoṣasya śāstrasya nyāyād anapetatvam upapadyate| nyāyena tasya bodhyamānatvāt| % \edC, p.3 begins with tasya bodhyamānatvāt saṃgrahaśabdena api guṇavattā khyāpyate| na hy anyathā samyak sarvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣyañ ca anena śakyate saṃgrahītum| ke punar atra guṇāḥ| iṣṭyupasaṃkhyānavattvam| śuddhagaṇatvam| vivṛtagūḍhasūtrārthatvam| vyutpannarūpasiddhitvañ ca| tathā ca vakṣyati śāstrānte iṣṭyupasaṃkhyānavatī śuddhagaṇā vivṛtagūḍhasūtrārthā| vyutpannarūpasiddhir vṛttir iyaṃ kāśikā nāma|| 1|| iti
athavā saṃgrahaśabdo 'yaṃ bhāvasādhanaḥ| saṃgrahaṇaṃ saṃgrahaḥ saṃkṣepaḥ śāstrabhedena viprakīrṇasya tantrasya piṇḍīkṛtyaikatra avasthāpanam iti yāvat| sāraśabdas tu pradhānavacanaḥ| yāvatā granthasandarbheṇa paripūrṇatā śabdavyutpatter bhavati sa sāraḥ| %% śabdavyuttpatter \edC (typo) sārasya saṃgrahaḥ sārasaṃgrahaḥ| tasya karaṇaṃ sukhodgrahaṇārtham| ekatra hi vyavasthitasya sukaram udgrahaṇaṃ bhavati| duṣkaran tu viprakīrṇasya| sāragrahaṇaṃ parikarabandhanirāsārtham| sa hi tasyopakārakatvād aṅgam apradhānam| itaras tu tenaivopakāryatvād aṅgi pradhānam|
athetyādi| athaśabdo 'dhikārārthaḥ| adhikāraḥ prastāvaḥ| śabdānuśāsanaśāstraṃ prastūyata ity amum artham athaśabdo dyotayati| śabdānuśāsanam ity etāvati hy abhihite saṃdehaḥ syāt kiṃ śabdānuśāsanam ārabhyate paṭhyate śrūyate veti| athaśabdaprayoge tv arthāntaravyavacchedena prastūyata ity eṣo 'rtho niścīyate| anuśiṣyante saṃskriyante vyutpādyante 'nena śabdā ity anuśāsanam| śabdānām anuśāsanaṃ śabdānuśāsanam| atra kecic codayanti---ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi ityanena atra(2.3.66) ṣaṣṭhī| tataś ca karmaṇi cetyanena(2.2.14) samāsapradhiṣedhena bhavitavyam iti| etac ca ayuktam| yatra hy ubhayoḥ prāptis tatra anena karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate| kva cobhayoḥ prāptiḥ| yatra sāmarthyaprāptam ubhayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇor upādānam| yathāścaryo gavāṃ doho 'śikṣitena agopālakeneti| evaṃ nāma durdohānāṃ gavām aśikṣitena agopālakena doha ity āścaryabhūto 'tra gavāṃ dohaḥ pratipādayitum iṣṭaḥ| sa ca yadi durdohānāṃ gavām upādānaṃ kriyate 'śikṣitasya agopālakasya ca kartur evaṃ śakyaḥ pratipādayitum āścaryaśabdaḥ| %\(edC, p.4 begins with durdohāṇāṃ) na anyatheti sāmarthyaprāptam ubhayor upādānam| śabdānuśāsanam ityatra tu śabdānām idam anuśāsanaṃ na arthānām ityetāvato 'rthasya vivakṣitatvāt tasya ācāryasya kartur upādānam antareṇa api pratipādayituṃ śakyatvād ācāryopādānam akiñcitkaram| tasmān nātrāsti dvayor api kartṛkarmaṇoḥ sāmarthyaprāptam upādānam| tataś cobhayaprāptir api nāsty eva| asatyāñ ca tasyāṃ nobhayaprāptau karmaṇi ityanena ṣaṣṭhī| kena tarhi? kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti ityanena (2.3.65)| tataś cedhmapravraścanavat samāso bhaviṣyati| athavā śeṣalakṣaṇaiveyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīty acodyam etat| vyākaraṇasya cedam anvarthaṃ nāma śabdānuśāsanam iti| atas tenaiva sūcitatvāt prayojanasya anabhidhānam| yena hi śabdā anuśiṣyante tasya taduddeśe pravṛttiḥ| yasya ca yad uddiśya pravṛttis tat tasya prayojanaṃ bhavati| tad etad uktaṃ bhavati| śabdānuśiṣṭir asya prayojanam iti| etac ca sākṣāt prayojanam| pāramparyeṇa tu vedarakṣaṇādīni prayojanāni bhāṣyād avadhāryāṇi| sambandhas tu sādhyasādhanabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| śabdānuśiṣṭeḥ sādhyāyā vyākaraṇasya sādhanasya ca yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sa prayojana evāntarbhūtaḥ| keṣāṃ śabdānām iti| kathaṃ punar anuśāsane guṇībhūtānāṃ śabdānāṃ kiṃśabdena pratyavamarśo bhavati? naiṣa doṣaḥ| pradhāne hy antarbhūtasya apy upasarjanasya buddhyā pravibhajya kiṃśabdena pratyavamarśo dṛṣṭaḥ| yathā rājapuruṣo 'yam| kasya rājña iti| kaḥ punar atra praṣṭur abhiprāyaḥ| evaṃ manyate śabdānuśāsanam ityatra śabdaśabdaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ| na ca sāmānyaśabdaḥ prakaraṇādirahito viśeṣe vartitum utsahate| santi ca samudraghoṣādayo 'pi bahavaḥ śabdāḥ| atas teṣām api vyutpādanaṃ prāpnotīti| iha tu vyākaraṇaṃ prastutam| tac ca vedāṅgam| aṅgañ copakārakaṃ bhavati| evañ ca tad vedasyopakārakaṃ bhavati| yadi tenaiva vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ saṃskriyante laukikāś ca tadupakāriṇaḥ| vaidikopakāritvaṃ tu laukikānām| tais tadarthasya ākhyānāt| tasmāc chabdānuśāsanādhikārād viśiṣṭā eva atra śabdā vyutpādayitum abhīṣṭāḥ| na tu samudraghoṣādayo 'pi| tathāvidhaśabdavyutpādane hi vyākaraṇasya avedāṅgatāpi syād iti manyamāna āha laukikānām ityādi| loke viditā laukikāḥ| tatra vidita ity anuvartamāne lokasarvalokāṭ ṭhañ (5.1.44) iti ṭhañ| %(edC, p.5 begins with @lokāṭ) athavā loke bhavā laukikāḥ| adhyātmāditvāṭ ṭhañ(4.3.60, \Vart) evaṃ vaidikāḥ| vaidikānāṃ laukikebhyaḥ pṛthag upādānaṃ prādhānyakhyāpanārtham| yathā brāhmaṇā āyātā vaśiṣṭho 'py āyāta iti| atra brāhmaṇatvād eva vaśiṣṭhasya apy āgamane siddhe prādhānyakhyāpanārthaṃ tasya pṛthag upādānam|
prādhānyakhyāpanan tu vaidikānāṃ yatnena apabhraṃśanirāsārtham| teṣāṃ hy apabhraṃśe yājñe karmaṇi mahān pratyavāyo dṛṣṭo helayo helaya iti|
athavā ye lokayātrāhetavo bhāṣāśabdās tair eva laukikatvaṃ prasiddham iti vaidikānāṃ pṛthag upādānam| tatra laukikā aniyatavarṇānupūrvikā gaur aśvaḥ puruṣo hastītyevamādayaḥ| vaidikās tu niyatānupūrvikāḥ śanno devīr abhiṣṭaya ityevamādayaḥ| iha hy anvākhyāne pratipadapāṭho 'bhyupeyaḥ| tasyāpi trayaḥ prakārāḥ| śabdāpaśabdobhayopadeśabhedena| ānantyāc ca śabdānāṃ sa sarvathāpy asambhavaḥ| evaṃ hi śrūyate bṛhaspatiḥ kilendrāya divyaṃ varṣahasraṃ pratipadavihitānāṃ śabdānāṃ pārāyaṇaṃ provāca na cāntaṃ jagāmeti| tadīdṛśe vaktary adhyetary adhyayanakāle ca nāntagamanam abhūd yasya tasya kuto 'dyatve bhaviṣyati svalpāyuṣi prajāyām| na cānyo 'bhyupāyo 'stīti manyamāna āha katham ityādi| katham anuśāsanam| na kenacit prakāreṇa śabdānāṃ vyākaraṇam anuśāsanam ityarthaḥ| athavā bhāvasādhano 'tra anuśāsanaśabdaḥ| anuśiṣṭir anuśāsanaṃ saṃskāraḥ| na kathañ cic chabdānāṃ saṃskāraḥ saṃbhavati iti yāvad yenālpenaiva prayatnena mahataḥ śabdaughān pratipadyate| tad upāyāntaraṃ darśayitum āha prakṛtyādivibhāgaparikalpanayetyādi| pratyayāt prathamaṃ kriyata iti prakṛtiḥ| prakṛtir ādir yeṣāṃ te prakṛtyādayaḥ| ādiśabdaḥ pratyayādīnāṃ parigrahāya| teṣāṃ vibhāgo 'saṃkīrṇarūpatā| tasya kalpanā parikalpikayā buddhyā parikalpanam| tathā parikalpanayā śabdānām anuśāsanam vyākaraṇam anuśiṣṭir vā| hetāv iyaṃ tṛtīyā| na hi tayā vinā vyākaraṇam anuśāsanaṃ bhavati| nāpi tena vinā anuśiṣṭiḥ śabdānāṃ śakyate karttum| parikalpanayetyanenaitat pratipādayati| kalpanāmātraṃ prakṛtyādivibhāgaparamārthavastupratyastamite(?) prakṛtyādivibhāgaḥ samudāya eva kasyacid arthasya vācaka iti| sāmānyaviśeṣavatā lakṣaṇeneti| karaṇa eṣā tṛtīyā| sāmānyañ ca viśeṣaś ca sāmānyaviśeṣau tau yasmin lakṣaṇe stas tat sāmānyaviśeṣaval lakṣaṇam| %(edC, p.6 begins with yasmil) tatrotsargalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyavat| yathā karmaṇyaṇ iti(3.2.1)| tatra hi dhātor ityetat karmaṇi ityetac ca sāmānyam| apavāda lakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣavat| yathā āto'nupasarge kaḥ (3.2.3) iti| atra ata ityetad anupasarga iti ca viśeṣaḥ.| tatra sāmanyavatā lakṣaṇena prakṛtyādivibhāgaparikalpanayā kumbhakāraḥ kāṇḍalāvaḥ śaralāva ityevamādikaṃ mahāntaṃ śabdaughaṃ pratipadyate| viśeṣavatā tu pārṣṇitro godaḥ kambalada ityevamādikam| evam anyatra api veditavyam| athetyādi| evaṃ manyate| śabdānuśāsanam adhikṛtam| tatra yena śabdā anuśiṣyante tasyaivopadeśo yuktaḥ| na caiṣām upadeśena kasyacic chabdasya saṃskāraḥ kriyate| tataś ca aprastutābhidhānam iti praśnasya abhiprāyaḥ| varṇānām iti| varṇā akārādayaḥ| teṣām ādyuccaraṇam upadeśaḥ| pratyāhārārtha iti| pratyāharaḥ aiuṇ ityevamādiko viśiṣṭānupūrvīko viśiṣṭānubandhakaś ca akṣara samāmnāyaḥ pratyāhriyante saṃkṣipyante varṇā asminn iti kṛtvā| sa yathā syād ityevamartho varṇānām upadeśaḥ| syād etat| tasyāpi prakṛtānupayogitvāt tadavastha evaiṣa doṣa ityata āha pratyāhāro lāghavenetyādi| laghor bhāvo lāghavam| tat punar alpaprayāsaḥ| alpaprayāsasadhyaṃ hi vastv alpaprayatnayogāl laghūcyate| tena laghavena śāstrasya ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho 'ṇaḥ(6.3.111) ityevamādeḥ pravṛttyartho 'bhinirvṛttyartha ityarthaḥ| sati hi pratyāhāra ādir antyena(1.1.71) sahetetyetat pravarttate| tatpravṛttau ca akārādīnāṃ aṇ ityevamādikāḥ saṃjñāḥ sidhyanti| tataś ca yatra akārādīnāṃ grahaṇam iṣṭaṃ tatra aṇ ityevamādikayaiva saṃjñayā bahavo 'pi te nirdiśyanta iti lāghavena śāstrasya abhinirvṛttir bhavati| tasmiṃś ca asati ādir antena (1.1.71) sahetetyevamādeḥ śāstrasya pravṛttir na syāt| ādyantayor abhāvāt| na hy asati sanniveśaviśeṣe tāv upapadyete| asatyāñ ca tatpravṛttau pūrvoktāḥ saṃjñā na syuḥ| tataś ca yatra yatra sūtre 'kārādīnāṃ yāvatāṃ grahaṇam iṣṭaṃ tatra te tāvantaḥ svarūpeṇaiva nirdiśyerann iti lāghavena śāstrasya pravṛttir na syāt| tadevaṃ prakṛtasyaiva alpaprayāsena niṣpādanārthatvān na bhavati pūrvadoṣāvasaraḥ| 1|AIUṇ| atha kasmād iha ādguṇa(6.1..87)ādikaṃ ackāryaṃ na bhavati? plutapragṛhyā ac iti(6.1.125) prakṛtibhāvāt| %(\edc, p.7 begins with acīti) pragṛhyatvaṃ tu teṣāṃ nipāta ekājanāṅ(1.1.14) iti pragṛhyasaṃjñāvidhānāt| nipātatvan tu cādiṣu pāṭhāt| ata eva nipātatvād arthavatve anarthavatve cotpannāyā vibhakteḥ śravaṇaṃ na bhavati| iha anarthavatve vibhaktyutpattir anarthakasya api nipātasya prātipadikasaṃjñopasaṃkhyānād veditavyā| anena krameṇeti| anayā ānupūrvyā| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam ayam eva krama āśrīyate| na kramāntaram| tad ucyate| iha aṇgrahaṇena trayāṇām apy eṣām akārādīnāṃ grahaṇam iṣyate| iṇgrahaṇe tv akārasya grahaṇaṃ neṣyate| uṇgrahaṇe punarakārekārayor dvayor api| etac ca kramāntarāśrayaṇe na sampadyata ity eṣv evaṃ krama āśrīyate| varṇāt kāra (3.3.108, vā) iti kārapratyayasyopasaṃkhyānād iha ca tad akaraṇān naite varṇā api tu tacchāyānukāriṇo 'nya eva sandhyakṣarādivarṇaikadeśā iti kasyacid āśaṅkā syāt| atas tan nirākaraṇāya āha varṇān iti| kārapratyayas tu rogākhyāyāṃ ṇvul(3.3.108) bahulam ityatropasaṃkhyāyate| tena bahulavacanāt saty api varṇatve na bhavati iti bhāvaḥ| ṇakārasya pūrvottaravarṇāntaḥpātitvān madhyabhāvaḥ| na antyatvam| ata itsaṃjñayā na bhavitavyam| athāpi kathañcid anyatvaṃ syāt? evamapi vakṣyamāṇena nyāyena apradhānatvād yathā tatra ackāryaṃ asya na bhavatit tathetsaṃjñāpi na bhaved iti yasya bhrāntiḥ syāt taṃ praty anta ity uktam iti ca| yadyapi pūrvottaravarṇāpekṣayā asya madhyamabhāvas tathāpi pūrvavarṇāpekṣayā antyatvam asty eva| sati ca tasminn apradhānasya api itsaṃjñayā bhavitavyam| upadeśasāmarthyāt| anyathā hi tadupadeśavaiyarthyaṃ syāt| ādirantena(1.1.71) sahetetyanena aṇ ityevamādikāḥ saṃjña yathā syur ityevamartho ṇakārādīnām anubandhānām upadeśaḥ| sa ca tadartho 'satyām itsaṃjñāyāṃ na syād ity abhiprāyaḥ| tasyetyādi| eketi sahārthayoge tṛtīyā| tasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| tasya ṇakārasya pradeśavākyeṣu saṃjñipratyāyanārthaṃ ekenaiva akāreṇa sahopādānāṃ bhavati| sa hy akārādīnāṃ varṇānām akārasahita eva saṃjñā na kevalaḥ| nāpi varṇāntarasahitaḥ| tasmāt pratyāyanārthaṃ tenaiva sahopādīyate| na kevalo nāpi varṇāntarasahitaḥ| anye tv āhuḥ| tasyeti karttari ṣaṣṭhī| ekeneti ca sahayoge tṛtīyā| tena ayam arthaḥ| ādivarṇasahito ṇakāro 'nyeṣāṃ madhyapātināṃ varṇānāṃ grāhako bhavaty ādivarṇasya ceti| apara āhuḥ| %(\edC, p.8 begins with āhuḥ) anekārthatvād dhātūnāṃ gṛhṇādir atroccaraṇe varttate grahaṇavatā prātipadikeneti yathā| tena ayam arthaḥ| tasyaikena sahoccaraṇaṃ bhavati iti| atheṇaḥ(8.3.78) ṣīdhvam ityatrekāreṇa asya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati iti kuto 'vasitam? aciśnudhātubhruvāṃ (6.4.77)yvor iti ikārokārayoḥ saṃsṛjya nirdeśāt| yadi ikāreṇa asya grahaṇaṃ syāt tato lāghavārtham iṇ ityeva nirdiśet| yvor iti saṃsṛjya nirdeśe 'rdhacatasro mātrā bhavanti| iṇ iti nirdeśe tisraḥ| tatra laghīyasā nyāsena siddhe yad garīyāṃsaṃ prayatnam ārabhate tato jñāyate na asya ṇakārasyekāreṇa grahaṇaṃ bhavati iti| iha tarhi kṛvāpājimisvadisādhyaśūbhya uṇ (uṇādi, 1.1) ṇity ukāreṇa grahaṇaṃ kasmān na bhavati| ukārād anyasya grāhyasya abhāvāt| tasya ca svarūpeṇaiva nirdeśāt| hrasvam avarṇam ityādi| prayujyata iti prayogo dhātvādiḥ| tatra hrasvam avarṇaṃ prayoge saṃvṛtam| saṃvṛtaguṇayogāt saṃvṛtam| yathā śuklaguṇayogāt śuklaḥ paṭa iti| dīrghaplutayos tu vivṛtatvam iti| vivṛtaguṇayogitvam ity arthaḥ| tathā ca āhuḥ śikṣākārā vivṛtakaraṇāḥ svarās tebhya e,o vivṛtatarau| tabhyām api ai, au| etābhyām apy ākāraḥ saṃvṛto 'kāra iti| teṣām ityādi| teṣāṃ hrasvādīnāṃ tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam( 1.1.9) iti savarṇa saṃjñā yathā syād ityevamartham iha śāstre hrasvo 'kāro vivṛtaguṇo 'bhyupagamyate| anyathā hi bhinnatvāt prayatnasya asati sāvarṇye daṇḍāḍhakam ityādāv akaḥ savarṇe dīrgha iti(6.1.101)dīrghatvaṃ na syāt| nanu ca satyapi vivṛtatvapratijñānenaiva hrasvaplutayor akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti tasmin karttavye plutasya asiddhatvāt| naiṣa doṣaḥ| siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣv iti svarasandhiṣu plutasya siddhatvāt| itarathā hi plutapragṛhyā(6.1.125)aci iti prakṛtibhāvavidhānam anarthakaṃ syāt| atra ca yadyapi vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyata ityuktaṃ tathāpi teṣāṃ sāvarṇyaprasiddhyarthaṃ iti vacanād vivṛtatara iti gamyate| na hi vivṛtasya vivṛtatareṇa sāvarṇyam upapadyate| prayatnabhedāt| vivṛtatvapratijñānasāmarthyād vā| avivṛtatarasya api vivṛtatareṇa sāvarṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati| yadīhetyetāvad evocyeta tadā pratyāsatteḥ prakṛtatvāc ca akṣarasamāmnāyika eva vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyata iti vijñayeta| na dhātuprātipadikapratyayanipātasthaḥ| tataḥ prayatnabhedād asati sāvarṇye ākṣarasamāmnāyikena tasya agrahaṇād actvaṃ na syāt| %(\edC, begins with prayatnabhedāt) tasmiṃś ca asati śāmyati ityatra acparibhāṣānupasthānāt sthānino 'karasya actvābhāvāc(7.3.74)chamām aṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani iti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt| dṛṣad iti atra prādipadikasya anta udātto bhavatīti antodātātvaṃ na syāt tasya ajdharmatvāt| nāyaka iti| atra pratyāyasya akārasya anactvāt tatrāyādāśo na syāt| avanamati ityatra nipātā ādyudāttā upasargāś ca abhivarjjam ity ādyudāttatvaṃ na syāt| kiñca anuvṛttinirdeśasthena akāreṇa asati sāvarṇye dīrghasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ? asya(7.4.32) cvāv itīhaiva syād ītvaṃ śuklībhavati iti| mālībhavati ityatra tu na syāt| yasyeti(6.4.148)ceti ihaiva syād akāralopaḥ dākṣiḥ plākṣir iti| vālākir ityatra tu na syāt| tasmād yāvat kiñcid avarṇamātram iha śāstre tasya sarvasya vivṛtatvaṃ pratijñāyata iti pradarśanārthaṃ śāstragrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| nanu ca satyapi sāvarṇye naiva anuvṛttinirdeśasthena akāreṇa savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ sidhyati| anaṇtvāt| na hy anuvṛttinirdeśe ye 'kārādayas te 'ṇaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? ye akṣarasamāmnāye| jātipakṣāśrayād adoṣa iti cet? na| jātipakṣe grahaṇakaśāstrasya pratyākhyānāt naiṣa doṣaḥ| iha hi vyaktiṣu dvayam asti| sādṛśyaṃ bhedaś ca| tatra kadācit kiñcit prādhānyena vivakṣyate| yadā sādṛśyaṃ vivakṣyate tadā tasya bhāgasya sadṛśasya sarvāsu vyaktiṣu samānatvāt aśeṣavyaktyākṣepo bhavati| bhedasya aparāmṛṣṭatvāt| soyaṃ pratyāhāre sadṛśabhāgaḥ pradhāna upadeśa iti sarvāsām avarṇavyaktīnāṃ anuvṛttinirdeśasthānām aṇtvam upapadyate| kaḥ punar asya sādṛśasya avarṇajāteś ca viśeṣaḥ? ayam asti viśeṣaḥ| etac ca sādṛśyaṃ hrasvāsv eva avarṇavyaktiṣu varttate| na dīrghaplutāsu| avarṇajātis tu dīrghaplutāsv api varttate| iti gatam etat| atha katham etad avagamyate akāra iha śāstre vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyata ityata āha tasyetyādi| yadi pūrvaṃ vivṛto akāro na pratijñāyeta tatas tasya aprayogārtham a a ityanena(8.4.68)pratyāpattiṃ na kuryyāt| svarūpād dhi pracyutasya punas tatprāptiḥ pratyāpattiḥ| sā katham avicalitasvarūpasyaivopapadyate? athavā yadi vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyate tadā tasya śāstrasya parisamāptāv api tathābhūtasyaiva prayogaḥ syād iti pūrvapakṣam āśaṅkya āha tasyetyādi| %\(edC, p.10 ) arthaśabdo nivṛttivacanaḥ| yathā maśakārtho dhūma iti| tasya vivṛtasya prayoganivṛttir yathā syād ityarthaḥ| athavārthaśabdaḥ prayojanavacanaḥ| tasyetyanena saṃvṛtaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| prayogo 'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| kriyaviśeṣaṇatvān napuṃsakatvam| tadetad uktaṃ bhavati| tāsya saṃvṛtasya svarūpāt pracyutasya prayoganimittaṃ pratyāpattiḥ kariṣyate yataḥ śāstraparisamāptau tato na bhavati tathābhūtasyāiva ayaṃ prayoga iti|
2|ṛḷḳ| tasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati tribhir iti| kathaṃ tribhir grahaṇaṃ labhyate| yadi samudāyānubandhaḥ avayavānubandho na| atha ca 'vayavānubandho na tadā samudāyānubandha ityekenaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt| naiṣa doṣaḥ| pratijñayā tv anubandhānāṃ vyavahāraḥ| pratijñā tu pauruṣeyī| puruṣaś cobhayatra pratijñānaṃ kurvan na viramati| virodhābhāvāt| na hi samudāyānubandhatā avayavānubandhapratijñayā virudhyate| itarayā na cetareti| tasmād yuktam uktaṃ tribhir grahaṇaṃ bhavati iti| evaṃ sarvvatra yojanīyam| iha śāstre varṇānām upadeśaḥ prayojanavaśāt| ḷkāropadeśasya na kiñcit prayojanaṃ sambhavati ityabhiprāyeṇāha akārādayo varṇā iti| prayujyata iti prayogo dhātvādiḥ| ananyatrabhāvo viṣayārthaḥ| pracuraḥ prabhūtaḥ prayogo viṣayo yeṣām iti bahuvrīhiḥ| athavā prayuktiḥ prayoga uccāraṇam| tasya viṣaya iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tasya pracuraśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ| teṣāṃ sujñānaṃ upadeśe prayojanam iti| sukhena jñāyata iti sujñānam| etac ca prayojanaṃ kimartham? ḷkārasyaivopadeśe prayojanaṃ pṛcchyata iti asya vacanasya avakāśanirāsārtham uktam| yadi hy etan nocyeta ḷkārasyaiva tu kevalaṃ prayojanaṃ pṛcchyeta iti tadā syād asya vacanasya avakāśaḥ| ḷkāras tu ḳḷpistha eva prayujyata iti| tuśabdo 'kāradibhyo viśeṣārthaḥ| syād etat| ḳḷpisambhandhinas tasya yāny ackāryyāṇi tadartham upadeśaḥ karttavya ityata āha ḳḷpeścetyādi| yady asiddhatvaṃ tataḥ kim ityāha tatra ṛkāra evetyādi| latvavidhānād yāni ityādi| latvaṃ vidhīyate yena śāstreṇa tallatvavidhānam| karaṇe lyuṭ| athavā bhāve vidhirvidhānam| %\(edC, p.11 begins with bhāve) latvasya vidhānam iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tataḥ parāṇi ityādi| etena latvasya teṣu siddhatvaṃ darśayati| pūrvvatra hi param asiddham| na tu parasmin pūrvam| kḷptaśikha iti| kḷptā śikhā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| atra guroranṛta ityādinā( 8.2.86) pluto vidhīyate| sa cācaśce(1.2.28)tyevaṃ sthāninam upasthāpayati| ḷkārasya akṣv anupadeśād asaty actve sa na syāt| prakḷpta iti| atra nipātā ādyudāttā upasargāś ca abhivarjam iti praśabdākāra udātto bhavati| ḷkāro 'pi dhātusvareṇa udātta eva| niṣṭhāpratyayasvare kṛte anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam iti (6.1.158) paścāt sonudātto bhavati| kugatiprādaya iti (2.2.10) samāse kṛte samāsāntodāttatve prasakte gatiranantara iti (6.2.49) pūrvapadaprakṛtibhāvena praśabda evodāttaḥ| tasmāt parasya ḷkārasya udāttādanudāttasya svarita iti (8.4.66)svaritatvaṃ vidhīyate| tadasati actve na syāt| tasya ajdharmatvāt| kḷptaḥ kḷptavān iti| anaci ceti( 8.4.47) aca uttarasya yaror dvivacanaṃ vidhīyate| tadapy anactve na syāt| yaduktaṃ kḷpistha eva prayujyata iti tad vighaṭayan prayojanāntaraṃ darśayitum āha yaccetyādi| sādhuśabdoccaraṇaśakter anyā śaktiḥ aśaktiḥ| tato jātam aśaktijam| tadanukaraṇasya api sādhutvam iṣyata iti| arthabhedena śabdāntaratvāt| śiṣṭaprayuktvāc ca| tad anyasādhuśabdavat| nanu ca anukāryyasya asādhutvād anukaraṇasya asādhutvena bhāvyam| prakṛtivad anukaraṇaṃ bhavati iti vacanāt| naitad asti| śāstrīyā hi tatra prakṛtir āśrīyate| prakṛtivad iti ca śāstranibandhanam eva kāryyam atidiśyate| na ca aśakijam asādhuśabdarūpaṃ śāstrīyā prakṛtiḥ| nāpy apaśabdatvaṃ śāstranibandhanaṃ kāryyam| na hi śakyaṃ vyākaraṇena apy apaśabdatvam ākhyātum| tasya sādhuśabdasaṃskārāyaiva pravṛttatvāt| tasmād apaśabdasya apy anukaraṇaṃ sādhv eva| tatra tatsthasya api ḷkārasya ackāryyāṇi na syuḥ yady akṣu tasyopadeśo na syāt|kumāryy ḷtaka iti| atra actve sati ḷkārasya tatra parato yaṇādeśo bhavati| nanu ca iko yaṇaci ityatra(6.1.77) saṃkhyātānudeśo 'pi ḷkāropadeśasya prayojanam upapadyata eva| asati ḷkāropadeśe trayaḥ sthāninaś catvāraś ca ādeśāḥ syur iti vaiṣamyāt saṃkhyātānudeśo na syāt| %\(edC, p.12 begins with saṃkhyātānudeśo) tasmāt saṃkhyātānudeśo 'pi tasya yuktaṃ prayojanam| na caitad asti| mā bhūt saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ| asatyapi tasmin sthānentaratama(1.1.50) iti paribhāṣayā vyavasthā bhaviṣyati| itsaṃjñā tarhy aparaṃ prayojanam| upadeśe hy asati gamḷ sṛpḷ gatāv ityādiṣu upadeśe 'jānunāsika iti itsaṃjñā(1.3.2)na syāt| tasyāṃ ca asatyāṃ puṣādidyutādyḷditaḥparasmaipadeśv iti(3.1.55) aṅ na syāt| naitad asti| asaty apy upadeśe asmād eva ḷdito dhātor aṅvidhānād itsaṃjñā vidhāsyate iti na akṣu prayojanam upadeśasya| tasmāt pūrvoktāny eva prayojanāni| tāni ca ṛkāraḷkārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñā vaktavyetyetad anāśrityoktāni| atra hy āśrite saty asatyapi ḷkāropadeśe aṇudit savarṇasya ceti ṛkāreṇa gṛhyamāṇena ḷkārasya grahaṇād eva sidhyanti|
3|EOṅ| atra pūrvāṃś ceti noktam| pūrvair asya grahaṇāsambhavāt| atha ṣidbhidādibhyo 'ṅ ityatra akāreṇa asya kasmād grahaṇaṃ na bhavati? tatra kecid āhuḥ| ādirantyena sahetetyatra(1.1.71) aṇuditsavarṇasya capratyaya(1.1.67) ityato apratyayagrahaṇam anuvarttate| tena ayam arthaḥ sampadyate| ādir antyena grāhako bhavati na cet pratyayo bhavati iti| pratyayaś ca ayam| tena grāhako na bhavati| evañ ca suptiṅantaṃ(1.4.14) padam ityādāv api pratyayo grāhako na syāt| tasmād anabhidhānād iha pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ na bhavati iti veditavyam| abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavanti| na ca ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ iti(3.3.104) akārādipratyayotpattau vivakṣitārthābhidhānaṃ bhavati| iha tarhi śāsa idaṅhaloḥ(6.4.34)| ṛdṛśoraṅi guṇa iti(7.4.16) ca akāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ kasmān na bhavati? ciṇsadṛśasya caṅsadṛśasya ca aṅo grahaṇāt| śāsa idaṅhalor ityatra hi bhañjeśca(6.4.33)ciṇi iti anuvarttate| ṛdṛśoraṅi ityatra api ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasva iti(7.4.1)| ato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena caṅgrahaṇam anuvarttate| tena caṅgrahaṇena samānādikaraṇena aṅ viśeṣyate| caṅyaṅi iti na ca aṅ caṅ bhavati| ativilakṣaṇatvāt| tatra sāmarthyād iva artho gamyate| %\(edC, p.13 begins with sāmarthyād) parapadārtheṣu hi prayujyamānāḥ śabdā antareṇa api ivaśabdaprayogam iva arthaṃ gamayanti| yathā agnir māṇavako gaur vāhīka iti| tena ayam artho bhavati| caṅīva aṅīti caṅsadṛśo 'ṅ ityarthaḥ| kaś ca caṅsadṛśo 'ṅ? yaś cleḥ sthāne vihitaḥ| tathā ca clisthānikasyaiva aṅo grahaṇaṃ sampadyate| na tu pratyāhārasya| evaṃ śāsa idaṅhalor ityatra api ciṇgrahaṇena aṅi viśeṣyamāṇe clisthānikasyaiva aṅo grahaṇaṃ veditavyam| iha tarhi sani ca iṅaśceti|(2.4.48) parimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhya(3.3.21) iṅaśceti ca kasmād ikāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ na bhavati| pūrvatra tāvan na bhavati| iko jhal iti(1.2.9) kittvavidhānāt| pratyāhāre hy etasmin sani gamyādeśavidhānād igantatvabhāve guṇasya aprāptyā kitvavidhānam anarthakaṃ syāt| pūrvatra tāvan na bhavati| yadi hi syād ika iti kakāreṇaiva pratyāhāraṃ kuryyat| na hy aṅantād dhātoḥ parasya sanaḥ sambhavo 'sti yataḥ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ ṅakāreṇa arthavad bhavati| paratra api na bhavati| vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| tadhā hi ikārāntebhyaḥ erac ity acā bhavitavyam| ukārāntebhyo 'pi ṛdor ab ity apā| ḷkārāntā na santy eva| ejantānāṃ prāg eva pratyayotpatter ādeca upadeśe'śiti(6.1.45) ity ātvena bhavitavyam| atas te 'pi pratyayavidhānakāle na santy eveti| ṛkāra eka eva avaśiṣyate| tato yadi ghañvidhitsitaḥ apārthakaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt| ur ityeva brūyāt| krīṅjīṇāṃ(6.1.48)ṇāv ityatrāpi krīṇātijayatyoḥ pṛthag upādānād ikāreṇa grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| ikārāntānāṃ madhye tayor eva yathā syād iti niyamārthaṃ pṛthag upādānam iti cet? na| evamapi kakareṇaiva pratyāhāraṃ kuryyāt| ejantānām ātvasya sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddhatvāt| iṅdhāryyoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇītyatra api(3.2.130)dhārayatinā dhātunā sāhacaryyād iṅ iti dhātor grahaṇam| na pratyāhārasyeti veditavyam|
4| AIAUC | iha ādirantena sahetetyanena sūtreṇa akārādīnām aj ityeṣā saṃjñā vidhīyate| sā ca yathā ikārādīnāṃ bhavati tathā ṇakārādīnām apy anubaddhānāṃ syāt| %\(edC, p.14 begins with syāt) teṣām api tatropadeśāt| tataś ca tayā pradeśāntare iko yaṇaci ityevamādau teṣu prātipadikeṣu yathā dadhyatretyādau yaṇādeśo bhavati tathā dadhiṇakārīyati iyādāv api syād ityabhiprāyeṇa āha pratyāhāretyādi| katham ajgrahaṇeṣu neti karyyam iti śeṣaḥ| aj ityasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ pradeśavākyeṣu grahaṇāni uccāraṇāni ajgrahaṇāni| teṣu satsu ṇakārādīnāṃ katham ackāryyaṃ na bhavet| bhaved evetyarthaḥ| ācārād iti| ācaraṇam ācāraḥ ācāryyapravṛttiḥ| tato jñāpakān na bhavati| yad ayam uṇādayo bahulam| tṛṣimṛṣikṛśeḥ kāśyapasya| ṅamo hrasvādaci ṅamuṇ nityam| ṅasiṅasoś ceti ṇakārādiṣu parato yaṇādeśaṃ na karoti tato jñāpayati| satyām apy acsaṃjñāyām ackāryyāṇi na bhavanti iti| athavā aj ityeṣaiva saṃjñaiṣāṃ na bhavati ityeṣaḥ artho 'nayā ācāryyapravṛttyā jñāpyate| yadi hi saṃjñā syāt ācāryyas teṣv ackāryyāṇi kuryyāt| evaṃ jñāpakena saṃjñā 'bhāvaṃ pratipādya idānīṃ nyāyena pratipādayitum āha apradhānatvād iti| aṇityevamādikāḥ saṃjñāḥ praṇetuṃ tadrūpapratipādanāya anubandhā uccāryyante| tataś ca parārtham upādīyamānatvād aprādhānyam anubhavanti| itare tu svārtham upādīyanta iti teṣāṃ prādhānyam| tena teṣām eva aj iti eṣā saṃjñā bhavati| na anubandhānām| pradhānāpradhānasannidhau hi pradhānam eva kāryyeṇa sambandham anubhavati| netarat| tadhā ca āha bhāṣyakāraḥ| pradhāne kāryyasaṃpratyayāt siddham iti| yadyevam akārasya apy eṣā saṃjñā na syāt| saṃjñāpratipādane tasyāpy aṅgabhāvo 'sty eva| svasya ca rūpasyety anuvṛttisāmarthyāt tasya bhavati ity adoṣaḥ| etena anantaroktena kāraṇadvayena saṃjñāvidhānakāle 'nubandhānāṃ sannidhānam abhyupetya saṃjñāyā abhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ| idānīṃ tatra asannihitatvād eva sā na bhaviṣyati iti pratipādayitum āha lopaś cetyādi| balavān eva balavattaraḥ| svārthe eva tarap| alpāctaram iti yathā| anubandhā hi itsaṃjñakāḥ| tena teṣām acsaṃjñāyāḥ prāg eva tasya lopa iti lopena bhavitavyam| tasya balavattvāt| tad asatāṃ teṣāṃ kutaḥ saṃjñā? tasyāñ ca asatyāṃ kutojgrahaṇeṣv ackāryasya sambhavaḥ? balavattvaṃ tu lopasya paratvān nityatvāc ca| saṃjñāśāstrād dhi lopaśāstraṃ param| atas tasyāpi paratvam| %edC, p.15 kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvān nityatvam| kṛtāyām api saṃjñāyāṃ lopena bhavitavyam| akṛtāyām api| na tu lope kṛte saṃjñā bhavati| saṃjñinām asattvāt| yadevaṃ yathājantaḥpātināṃ ṇakārādīnām anubandhānāṃ pradhamaṃ lopo bhavati tathā cakārasya api syāt| tataś ca aj iti saṃjñā na niṣpadyate| vacanasāmarthyāt tasya prāglopo na bhaviṣyati| alupte 'pi vā tasmin bhūtapūrveṇa tena sahitaḥ akāraḥ saṃjñā bhaviṣyati| ajantaḥpatināṃ tu luptānāṃ ṇakārādīnāṃ na arhati saṃjñā bhavitum| ikārādiṣu sāvākāśatvāt| ihaite akārādayo varṇā anekāvayavā iṣyante| tasyādita udāttam ardhahrasvam(1.2.32)eco'pragṛhyasya adūrādhūte pūrvasya ardhasyāduttarasyedutau iti vacanāt(8.2.107)| santi ca keṣāṃcit kecid avayavā varṇāntarasarūpāḥ| tad yadhā ṛkāre rephaḥ| ḷkāre lakāraḥ| ekāre ca aikāre ca akārekārau| okāre ca aukāre ca akārokārau| dīrgheṣv ākārādiṣu hrasvākārādayaḥ| tatra ya ete ṛkārādivarṇānām avayavās te kiṃ varṇagrahaṇena gṛhyeran na vā? tatra pūrvasmin kalpe agne iha vāyo udakam ity akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti| praṇīya ālūyeti hrasvā"rayas tuk| evamādayo anyepy asmin pakṣe doṣāḥ prasajanti| te ca bhāṣyād avadhāryaḥ| itaratra tu nuḍvidhilādeśavināmeṣu ṛkāragrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| nuḍvidhau tavāt| ṛdhu vṛddhau liṭ| ānṛdhatuḥ| ānṛdhur ityatra ṛkāre rephasya halgrahaṇena agrahaṇāt dvihaltvābhāve tasmānnuḍ dvihala(7.4.71) iti nuḍ na prāpnoti| lādeśavidhau kḷptaḥ kḷptavān rephasya kṛpo ro la iti (8.2.18) latvaṃ na sidhyati| vināmavidhau mātr.ṛṇāṃ pitṛṛṇām iti ṇatvaṃ na syād ityata āha varṇeṣv ityādi| varṇeṣu ṛkārādiṣu| varṇaikadeśā iti rephādaya iti| varṇātmabhūtatvajñāpanārtham ekadeśā ity uktam| etad uktaṃ bhavati| varṇānām ātmabhūtā ekadeśā varṇaikadeśā iti| yadi hy ekadeśā ityetāvad ucyeta tataḥ kasyacid bhrāntiḥ syāt| arthāntarabhūtā evaite ekadeśā iti| varṇaikadeśāstūryyādayo pi santi iti tad vyavacchedārtham āha| varṇāntarasamānākṛtaya iti| varṇāntaravat samānākṛtir yeṣāṃ te varṇāntarasamānākṛtayaḥ avayavāḥ| tato'nyairvvarṇair anavayavabhūtais tulyākṛtaya ityarthaḥ| teṣv iti| varṇaikadeśeṣu| tatkāryyam iti| varṇāntarakāryyam akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvādi| %\edC, p.16 kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na bhavati ityāha| tacchāyānukārino hi ityādi| tacchāyā tadākāraḥ| varṇāntarāṇām akārādīnām ākāramātram| te'nukurvanti| tattulyarūpatvāt| na tu ta eva| na hi tadākārānukāritvamātreṇaiva tattvaṃ bhavati| tadhā hi gavi gavayāvayavānukāriṇo 'vayavāḥ santi| na ca teṣāṃ tatsvabhāvatā| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ te ta eva na bhavanti ityāha pṛthag ityādi| prayatnaḥ prayatanaṃ sthānakaraṇavyāpāraḥ| varṇāntarahetoḥ prayatnāt pṛthag anyena prakāreṇa yaṃ nirvarttyaṃ niṣpādyaṃ varṇam ācāryyā icchanti| tadete varṇā avayavāḥ| yadi varṇāḥ syuḥ prayatnāntaranirvarttyāḥ syuḥ| na caivam| tathā hi samudāyārtho yaḥ prayatnaḥ tenaiva te niṣpādyante| tadevam agrahaṇakapakṣam āśrayataiva grahaṇakapakṣabhāvino ye doṣās teṣāṃ prasaṅgaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ| nanu ca grahaṇakapakṣopi bhāṣye vyavasthāpitaḥ| tadanuṣaṅgiṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ parihārāt| tat kasmāt sa parityaktaḥ| bahupratividheyatvāt agrahaṇakapakṣe tv alpaṃ pratividheyam| ataḥ sa eva vṛttikāreṇa āśritaḥ| yadi tarhi na gṛhyante nuḍādividhiṣu ṛkāragrahaṇaṃ karttavyatayā sthitameva ityata āha nuḍvidhilādeśavināmeṣv ityādi| nuḍādividhiṣu yac codyam āpatati ṛkāraviṣaye tasya pratividhānaṃ karttavyam ityarthaḥ| tatra nuḍvidhau tāvat ṛkārastho rephaḥ halgrahaṇena gṛhyate| tena atrāpi dvihalo'ṅgasya nuḍ bhavati| ānṛdhatuḥ| ānṛdhur iti| etat svayam eva vṛttikāreṇa pratipādanaṃ kṛtam| atha kim ayam ṛkārastho repho varṇātmakaḥ? netyāha| idānīm eva hy uktam| tacchayānukāriṇo hi te na punas ta eveti| ye tarhi hakārādayo varṇā akṣarasamāmnāye upadiṣṭās te kiṃ varṇātmakāḥ? netyāha| tathā hi hayavaraḍityādau vakṣyati ityetān varṇān upadiśyeti| atha katham idānīṃ varṇātmanāṃ halāṃ grahaṇena ṛkārasthasya api avarṇātmano rephasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati? dvihalgrahaṇasāmarthyād ity abhiprāyaḥ| tatra hi tasmān nuḍ ityetāvad eva vaktavyam| na caivam ucyamāne āṭatur āṭur ityādāv api prasaṅgo bhavati| aśnoteścetyasya (7.4.72) niyamārthatvāt| advihalo yadi bhavati tadāśnoter eva| na anyasyeti| aśnātinivṛttyarthaṃ tad iti cet? vārttam etat| yadi hy etāvat prayojanaṃ syāt nāśna ityevaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ kuryyāt| tadevam antareṇāpi dvihalgrahaṇam| %\(edC, p.17 begins with dvihalgrahaṇam) siddhe yad dvihalgrahaṇaṃ karoti tasyaitat prayojanam| dvihalchāyānukāriṇo hi yathā syād iti| yasyapy eko mukhyo hal aparo 'vayavas tat samānākṛtitvād upacāreṇa hal vyapadeśārhaḥ| tasy api yathā syād ityevamarthaḥ| etec ca kathaṃ labhyate? yadi hal ityeṣā śrutis tatra halchāyānukāriṇyām api ṛkārasthāyāṃ rephavyaktau varttate| na anyathā| tasmād dvihalgrahaṇena ṛkārastho repho'pi gṛhyate| anyathā dvihalgrahaṇam anarthakaṃ syāt| repha iti paraprasiddhyā tatroktam| varṇagrahaṇvādināṃ hi ṛkārabhāgo 'pi repha iti prasiddhaḥ| sādṛśyād evam uktam| bhavati hi sādṛśyād tasminn api tadvyapadeśaḥ| yathāgniḥ māṇavaka iti| athavā rādipha ityatra (3.3.108 vā) varṇāt kāra (3.3.108 vā)(?) ityato varṇād iti na anuvarttate| tena avarṇātmakād api rād ipho bhavati| bahulavacanād vā| ata eva ḷkārasthāl lakārasarūpād avayavād avarṇātmano pi kārapratyayo bhavati iti veditavyam| lādeśavidhāv api ra iti sāmānyam upādīyate| tena yaḥ kevalo rephaḥ yaś ca ṛkārasthaḥ tayor dvayor api grahaṇam| la ityapi sāmānyam eva| tato .yaṃ kevalasya rephasya sthāne kevala eva lakāra ādeśo vidhīyate| ṛkārasya apy ekadeśavikāradvāreṇa ḷkāraḥ| tathā ca luṭi ca kḷpa (1.3.93) ityevamādayo nirdeśā upapadyante iti| etat kṛpo ro la (8.2.18) ityatra svayameva vṛttikṛtā pratipāditam| ra iti sāmānyam upādīyata iti| varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtaṃ bhedam utsṛjya yat sāmānyam avarṇātmikāyāṃ varṇātmikāyāñ ca rephavyaktau varttate| yatas tayoḥ varṇatvāvarṇatvabhedabhinnayor api ra iti śabdapratyayau abhinnau bhavataḥ| tāv upādīyete| na tu varṇātmikaiva rephavyaktiḥ| teneti| sāmānyopādānena dvayor api grahaṇaṃ bhavati iti| tasya sāmānyasya dvayor api sadbhāvāt| la ityapi sāmānyam eveti| upādīyate ity apekṣate| atrāpi yaś ca kevalo lakāraḥ yaś ca ḷkārasthaḥ tayor dvayor api grahaṇaṃ ityetad vaktavyaṃ syāt| pūrvvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvān noktam| tato.yam ityādi| yata evaṃ dvayor api rephalakārayor grahaṇaṃ tasmāt kevalasya rephasya sthāne lakāro'yam ādeśaḥ vidhīyate| antaratamatvād ṛkārasya api ḷkāraḥ| nanu ca satyapi dvayor api grahaṇe ṛkārasya sthāne ḷkāro bhavati ityetat kuto labhyate? na hi ṛkārastho repha ṛkāro bhavati| %\(edC, p.18 begins with labhyate) kiṃ tarhi? tadavayavaḥ| nāpi ḷkārastho lakāraḥ ḷkāro bhavati? kiṃ tarhi? tadavayavaḥ| tatra dvayor api grahaṇe sati ṛkārasthasya api rephasya ḷkārastho lakāraḥ varṇaikadeśatayā antaratamo bhavati ityeṣo 'rtho labhyate| na tu ṛkārasya hi sthāne ḷkāro bhavati ityetasya codyasya apākaraṇārthaṃ ekade" savikāradvāreṇety uktam| tadekadeśaṛkārasya avayavo rephas tasya vikāra ḷkārāvayavo lakāraḥ| athavā ekadeśaḥ| athavā ekadeśaḷkārastho lakāraḥ| sa eva vikāraḥ| ṛkārasthasya rephasya sa eva ekadeśavikāraḥ| dvāraṃ mukham upāya iti yāvat| tena samastasyaiva ṛkārasya sthāne samasta eva ḷkāra ādeśo vidhīyate| yadi hi ṛkāraḷkārābhyāṃ tatsthayoś ca rephalakārayoḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ sambhavet tadā ṛkāraikadeśasya rephasya kevalasya ḷkāraikadeśo lakāraḥ kevalaḥ śakyate vidhātum| na ca tayos tataḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ sambhavati| tasmād yathoktena prakāreṇa ṛkārasya ḷkārādeśo vidhīyate| anantaroktasya arthasya dṛḍhīkaraṇāya tathā cetyāder upanyāsaḥ| yata evam ekadeśadvāreṇa ṛkārasya sthāne ḷkāra ādeśo vidhīyate| evañ ca sati luṭi ca kḷpa ityevamādayo (1.3.93) nirdeśā upapadyante| na anyathā| ādiśabdena ṛdupadhāc cākḷpicvṛtoḥ (3.1.110)| tāsi ca kḷpa (7.2.90) ityetayor nirdeśayor grahaṇam| vināmavidhāv api ṛvarṇācceti vaktavyam ityuktvā raśrutisāmānyanirdeśād vā siddham| avarṇabhaktyā ca vyavadhāne ṇatvaṃ bhavati iti kṣubhnādiṣu nṛnamanatṛpnotigrahaṇaṃ ṇatvapratiṣedhārthaṃ draṣṭavyam| athavā ṛvarṇād api ṇatvaṃ bhavati ityetadeva tena jñāpyata iti vṛttikṛtā svayam eva prativihitam| raśrutisāmānyanirdeśāt siddham iti| ra iti śrutiḥ rarūpalabdhir yasya sa śrutiḥ rephaḥ| tasya kevalasya ṛkārasthasya ca varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtabhedaṃ parityajya yat sāmānyaṃ rephamātraṃ tad iha nirdiśyate| na tu varṇātmikaiva rephavyaktiḥ| tena siddhaṃ tisṛṇām| catasṛṇām| mātṛṛṇām| pitṛṛṇām ityādāv api ṇatvam| ṛkāre 'pi tasya raśrutisāmānyasya vidyamānatvāt| syād etat ṛkāre trayo varṇāvayavāḥ| tanmadhye repho 'rdhamātrātmā| tatra raśrutisāmānyasya nirdeśenaiva sidhyati| yāsau rephāt parā 'varṇabhaktis tayā vyavadhānād ityasya codyasya parihārāya uttaro jñāpakagranthaḥ| %\(edC, p.19 begins with tayā) yad ayaṃ kṣubhnādiṣu ṇatvapradhiṣedhāya nṛnamanaśabdaṃ tṛpnotiśabdañ ca paḍhati tenaitaj jñāpyate 'varṇabhāgavyavadhāne 'pi ṇatvaṃ bhavati iti| anyathā hi tatra tayoḥ pāḍho 'narthakaḥ syāt| prāptyabhāvāt| prāptipūrvakatvāc ca pratiṣedhānām| yadyapi varṇātmikaiva rephavyaktir nirdiśyate tathāpi siddham iti darśayitum āha athavetyādi| pūrvasūtropāttād raśrutisāmānyanirdeśāt parayā 'varṇabhaktyā vyavahitād api ṇatvaṃ bhavati iti jñāpitam| idānīṃ tu sūtrānupātād ṛkārād avyavahitād evety eṣa viśeṣaḥ| apare tu sarvāṇy etāni pratividhānāni varṇaikadeśagrahaṇapakṣam āśritya vihitāni ity ācakṣate| etac ca asamyak| yaṃ hi pakṣam āśritya nuḍvidhilādeśavināmeṣu ṛkāre pratividhātavyam ityuktaṃ tatraiva pratividhātuṃ yuktam| anyathā hy agrahaṇakapakṣam abhyupetya grahaṇakapakṣe 'pi pratividhānaṃ kurvatā vṛttikāreṇa akauśalam eva kevalam ātmanaḥ prakaṭitaṃ syāt|
5|HAYAVARAṭ|
tasya grahaṇaṃ bhavaty ekena śaśchoṭi(8.4.63)ityakāreṇeti| atra śaśchoṭi ityetat pradeśavākyopalakṣaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| evaṃjātīyakeṣu nirdeśeṣv akāreṇa grahaṇaṃ bhavati| na tu varṇāntareṇetyatra ayam artho 'bhipretaḥ| na tv atraiva sūtre akāreṇa grahaṇaṃ bhavati iti| aṭkupyvāṅnuṃvyavāye.pi iti(8.4.2) dīrghādaṭi(8.3.9) ityatra apy akāreṇa grahaṇasyeṣṭatvāt| atha luṅlaṅlṛṅkṣvaḍudātta(6.4.71) ityatrāpy akāreṇa grahaṇaṃ kasmān na bhavati| prāksitādaḍvyavāye'pi iti(8.3.63) vacanāt| pratyāhāre hy etasminn akārādīnāṃ yo 'nyatamas tena alontyaparibhāṣayāṅgāntarasya bhavitavyam| pratyekam aṭsaṃjñakatvāt| pratyekam eva akārādīnām ādeśatvāt| tathā ca antyagrahaṇena grahaṇād aḍvyavadhānaṃ nopapadyate| atha pratyekamapy asaṃjñakatve samastānām apy ādeśabhāvaḥ prakalpyeta| evam anekāltvāt sarvādeśaḥ syāt| tathā ca sthāny api sakāro na syād iti kasya kena vyavadhānān mūrdhanyo bhaved abhyaṣuṇod ityatra? athārddhadhātukasyeḍvalāde(7.2.35)r ityatrekāreṇa asya grahaṇaṃ kasmān na bhavati? tatra vidita iti ceti(5.1.43) nirdeśāt| %\(edC, p.20 begins with iti ceti) pratyāhāre hy etasmin nādeḥ parasyeti (1.1.54) ikārādīnām anyatamas takārasya ādeśaḥ syāt| tathā ca viditam iti rūpaṃ nopapadyate| atha dīdhīvevīṭām (1.1.6) ityatrāpi ikarreṇa grahaṇaṃ kasmān na bhavati? jayati sambhavaty avaharati ityevamādi(4.4.2, 5.1.52) nirdeśāt| pratyāhāre hy etasmin guṇapratiṣedhād evamādayo nirdeśā na sambhaveyuḥ| yakārāt parasya rephasyopadeśe sati yo doṣas tam udbhāvayitukāma āha ayamityādi| paropadeśas tu valyantarbhāvāj jīveradānuk jīradānuḥ| godhāyā ḍhrak (4.1.129) gaudhera ityatra lopo vyorvalīti vyor lopo yathā syāt| ralgrahaṇe ca vakārasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūd ityevamarthaś ca| yadi hi vakārāt pūrvo repha upadiśyeta ralo vyupadhāddhalādeḥ saṃś ceti(1.2.26) devitvā dideviṣati ityatra kittvaṃ vā syāt| nanu ca kriyamāṇe 'pi rasya yakārāt paropadeśe prāpnoty eva vakārasya ralgrahaṇena grahaṇam| jaśām api madhye tasyopadeśāt| naitad asti| ubhayorbhinnaguṇaniṣpādyatvād bhedasya siddhatvāt| yathoktam| pṛthakprayatnanirvartyaṃ varṇam icchantīti| antaḥsthātveneṣatpṛṣṭakaraṇatvād itarasya ca sparśatvena spṛṣṭakaraṇatvāt| ayañ ca dantyoṣṭhyo vakāraḥ| yas tu jabagaḍadaś iṣyate sa oṣṭhyo veditavyaḥ| nanu ca vakāreṇa vyavadhānān na ayaṃ yakārāt paraḥ| kiṃ tarhi? vakārāt para iti tat kim ucyate yakārāt para iti? vyavadhāne'pi paraśabdo varttate| yathā bālyāt paraṃ vṛddhatvam ity adoṣaḥ| atra yauvanena vyavahite'pi vṛddhabhāve paraśabdasya vṛttiḥ| yadi yakārāt para upadiśyate tataḥ kim ityāha tasya yargrahaṇenetyādi| yar ityasyāḥ saṃjñāyā grahaṇenoccaraṇena| tathā yay ityasyāḥ saṃjñāyā grahaṇenoccharaṇenetyarthaḥ| athavā yarāṃ saṃjñināṃ grahaṇenopādānena| yayāṃ saṃjñināṃ grahaṇenopādānenetyarthaḥ| grahaṇe sati iti upādāne sati| tadgrahaṇena tu tadgrahaṇam| tasya api tatsaṃjñakatvāt| tadantarbhāvāt ca| svarnayati ityatra ṛṭuraṣā mūrdhanyā iti tulyasthānatvād rephasya nakāre pare parasavarṇo ṇakārādeśo bhavati| viśeṣānabhidhānāt| nanu caivaṃ sati sthānentaratamaparibhāṣā bādhyeta| na hi rephasya antaratamo ṇakāraḥ| prayatnabhedāt| naitad asti| vyaktiḥ padārtha ityetad dhi darśanam āśritya codyate| %\(edC, p.21 begins with darśanamāśritya) tena sthānentaratamaparibhāṣayā bādhā na āśaṅkanīyā| yatra hy antaratamo'nantaratamaś ca vidyate tatra tasyā vyāpāraḥ| na ceha antaratamo'sti yasmād vyaktau padārthe pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pravarttate| ānantyāt tu sarvāṇi lakṣaṇāni noccāryyante| tatra yad etadviṣayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tat prayatnabhedād anantaratame'pi ṇakāre yadi na pravarttate tadā tasya vaiyarthyam eva syāt| tasmāj jātau padārthe iyaṃ paribhāṣā veditavyā| na tu dravye| madrahradabhadrahrada iti| aco hakārād uttaro'yaṃ rephaḥ yar bhavati iti dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti| aco rahābhyāṃ dve(8.4.46) ityatra yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko(8.4.45) vetyato yar ity anuvarttate| tatra dvirvacane sati dvayoḥ rephayoḥ śravaṇaṃ syāt| ro rītyekasya(8.3.14) lopo bhaviṣyati iti cet? na| lope karttavye dvirvacanasya assiddhatvāt| halo yamāṃ yami lopa(8.4.64) ityanena tarhy ekasya lopo bhaviṣyati| siddhaṃ hy asmillope dvirvacanam| evamapi pakṣe dvayoḥ rephayoḥ śravaṇaṃ prasajyeta| tatra hi jhayo ho'nyatarasyām ityato(8.4.62)'nyatarasya aḍgrahaṇam anuvarttate| athāpi tan na anuvartteta evamapi dvirvacanavidhānasāmarthyāl lopo na bhaviṣyati| anyathā hi dvirvacanavidhānam anarthakaṃ syāt| kuṇḍaṃ ratheneti| anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇa(8.4.58) iti tadanyasya parasavarṇasya asambhavād rephasya repha eva parasavarṇaḥ syāt| rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇā na santi iti repho'pi rephasya savarṇo na bhavati ityetac ca na āśaṅkanīyam| varṇāntarāpekṣayā tad uktam| varṇāntarāṇāṃ yathāyogam atulyasthānaprayatnatvāt| rephavyaktīnāṃ tu parasparāpekṣayā sāvarṇyam astyeva| tulyasthānaprayatnatvāt| anye tu yayi rephe anusvārasya parasavarṇo ṇakāraḥ syāt| tulyasthānatvād iti varṇayanti| etac ca ayuktam| na hi sthānamātratulyatayā savarṇo bhavati| kiṃ tarhi? tulyasthānatayā tulyaprayatnatayā ca| na ca rephasya ṇakāras tulyaprayatnaḥ|rephasyeṣatpṛṣṭatvāt|ṇakārasya ca spṛṣṭatvāt| evaṃ vyaktipadārtham āśritya pareṇa codite jātipadārtham āśritya parihāraṃ vaktukāma āha|naiṣa doṣa ityādi| ākṛtāv iti| jātāv ityarthaḥ| keṣāñcij jātiḥ padārthaḥ| keṣāñcid dravyam| pāṇines tu ubhayam| lakṣyānurodhāt| tat kvacit kiñcid āśrīyate| %\(edC, p.22 begins with kiñcid) tatra jātau padārtha āśrīyamāṇe jātir eva śabdena abhidhīyate| nāntarīyakatvāt tu tadādhārā vyakatayaḥ pratīyante| jāter ādhāram antareṇa pratyetum aśakyatvāt| etasmin darśane tasyās tu jāteḥ sthānitvam ādeśatvaṃ paratvam avyavahitatvam ityādayo dharmāḥ śabdasaṃskāropayogino vyaktidvārakāḥ| tena yaronunāsike'nunāsiko(8.4.45)vetyevamādilakṣaṇaṃ pravarttamānaṃ jātimatīṣu vyaktiṣu eva pravarttate| tatra pravṛtter jātau pravṛttaṃ bhavati| na ca tāsu vyaktiṣu jātiṃ prati kāsāñcid āsattir viprakarśo vā yataḥ kvacideva pravartteta| na sarvatra| sambandhasya aviśiṣṭatvāt| tasmāt tatra pravarttamānaṃ yatra vacanānantareṇa nyāyena vā na bādhyeta tatra sarvatraiva pravarttate| evañ ca pravṛttaṃ samudāye pravṛttaṃ bhavati| sakṛd iti ekavāram| na punaḥ punaḥ| sakṛtpravṛttyaiva lakṣaṇasya ca caritārthatvāt| etasmin darśane yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vetyetal lakṣaṇaṃ kathaṃ pravartteta? kim aviśeṣeṇa sarveṣv eva jātimatsu padārtheṣu pravarttate? uta viśeṣeṇa keṣucid eva? yady aviśeṣeṇa syāt sa doṣas tadavastha eva| atha viśeṣeṇa vācyas tarhi saviśeṣa ityata āha yaro'nunāsika ityādi| etena sthānentaratamaparibhāṣāyā upasthānāt tadvaśena antaratameṣv eva pravarttate| na anyeṣv iti darśayati tadanenetyādi| yata eva antaratameṣv eva pravarttate tasmād anena lakṣaṇena gakārādīnaṃ ye'ntaratamāḥ sthānaguṇābhyāṃ ubhābhyām api te ṅakārādayo'nunāsikā vihitāḥa| yathāsvam iti| yathātmīyam iti| ye yeṣām antaratamās te teṣāṃ vihitā ityarthaḥ| gakārādīnām iti| ādiśabdena jakārādīnāṃ grahaṇam| ṅakārādaya ityatrāpi ādiśabdena ñakādayo'nunāsikā gṛhyante| tatra sthānato guṇataś ca antaratamāḥ| tadyathā gajaḍadabānāṃ yathākramaṃ ṅañaṇanamāḥ| tathā hi akuhavisarjanīyāḥ kaṇṭhyā iti gakāraṅakārayos tulyaṃ kaṇṭhaḥ sthānam| icuyaśās tālavyā iti jakārañakārayos tālu| ṛṭuraṣā mūrdhanyā iti ḍakāraṇakārayor mūrdhā| ḷtulasā dantyā iti dakāranakārayor dantaḥ| upūpadhmānīyā oṣṭhyā iti bakāramakārayor oṣṭhaḥ| guṇastu sarveṣām evaiṣāṃ tulyaḥ| spṛṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ sparśāṇām iti vacanāt| kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ| %\(edC, p.23 begins with ye tu) ye tu na sthānato nāpi guṇata iti| antaratamā ity apekṣate| te sarve nivarttitā ityanena vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| avidhānam evaiṣāṃ nivarttanam| sthānamātreṇa guṇamātreṇa veti| tatrāpy antaratamā ity apekṣate| pūrvavac ca sambandhaḥ| tatra nāpi sthānato nāpi guṇato'ntaratamā anunāsikāḥ| te yathā gajaḍānām| yavalāḥ sānunāsikā niranunāsikāś cāpi| te teṣāṃ sthānaguṇābhyām anantaratamā eva| sānunāsikagrahaṇaṃ tu yaro'nunāsike ityādau (8.4.45) sūtre'nunāsikasyādeśatvenopādānāt| tatra gakārayakārayor yathākramaṃ kaṇṭhatālusthānatvāt sthānata āntaratamyaṃ nāsti| jakāralakārayos tāludantasthānatvāt| ḍakāravakārayor yathākramaṃ mūrdhadantaoṣṭhasthānatvāt| guṇato'pi teṣāṃ nāsty āntaratamyam| gakārādīnāṃ spṛṣṭakaraṇatvāt| yakārādīnām īṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇatvāt| īṣatspṛṣṭaṃ karaṇam antaḥsthānām iti vacanāt| antasthā yaralavāḥ| sthānamātreṇa antaratamā anunāsikāḥ| tad yathā jadabānāṃ [yah lah vāh?] sānunāsikāḥ| atra jakārasya yakāras tulyasthānam| tayos tālusthānatvāt| dakārasya lakāraḥ| tayor dantasthānatvāt| bakārasya vakāraḥ| ubhayor oṣṭhasthānatvāt| yadyapi antaḥsthasya vakārasya dantāḥ sthānam adhikaṃ tathāpi yatra tayos tulyasthānam oṣṭhaḥ tatkṛtam āntaratamyam astyeva| ukāraukāravat| ukārasya oṣṭhasthānam| okārasyatu kaṇṭho'pi| o au kaṇṭhoṣṭhāv iti vacanāt| tathāpi yat tayos tulyaṃ sthānaṃ oṣṭhas tatkṛtam āntaratamyaṃ bhavatyeva| yathā ca tayor ekasya sthānādhikye'pi āntaratamyaṃ tathā bakāravakārayor api| guṇamātreṇa antaratamāḥ yathā jabaḍānāṃ ṅaṇanāḥ| sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭatāguṇatvāt| sthānatas teṣām āntaratamyaṃ nāsti| jabaḍānāṃ yathākramaṃ tālvoṣṭhamūrdhasthānatvāt| ṅaṇanānān tu kaṇṭhamūrdhadantasthānatvāt| itītyādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yata evaṃ sthānaguṇābhyāṃ ye'ntaratamās ta eva anena vihitā anye tu sarve nivarttitāḥ tasmāt sthānamātreṇa antaratamo rephasya ṇakāro na bhavati| sthānamātreṇa antaratamatvaṃ cobhayor mūrdhasthānatvāt| guṇatas tv āntaratamyaṃ nāsti| spṛṣṭatādiguṇabhedāc ca| rephasya yarantarbhāve sati iti| yarkāryyaprāpter ayaṃ hetuḥ| yarkāryaṃ prāptam iti dvirvvacanam ityarthaḥ| tad dhi yarantarbhāvād rephasya prāpnoti yathānyeṣāṃ yarām| %\(edC, p.24 begins with bhāvād) tad ityādi| rephasya dvirvacanaṃ prati nimittabhāvaḥ sākṣācchiṣṭaḥ pratyakṣavihitaḥ| aco rahābhām iti (8.4.46) sākṣād rephaṃ nimittatvenopādāya dvirvacanavidhānāt| yarkāryan tu yarantarbhāvād anumitam| pratyakṣānumitayoś ca pratyakṣaṃ balīya iti sākṣād vihitena nimittabhāvena rephasya dvirvacanaṃ bādhyate| tad yathā brāhmaṇā bhojyantām| māḍharakauṇḍinyau pariveviṣṭām iti| atra hi sākṣād vihitena pariveṣaṇaṃ prati sādhanabhāvena māḍharakauṇḍinyayor brāhmaṇatvād yo'numito bhojanaṃ prati sādhanabhāvaḥ sa bādhyate| yadyevaṃ dadhyudakādiṣu doṣaḥ| iko yaṇaci ityatra hy ajantarbhāvādiko yaṇādeśaṃ prati nimittabhāvo'numīyamānaḥ| yaṇādeśas tu sākṣācchiṣṭaḥ| ika iti sākṣād ikaṃ kāryyiṇam upādāya vidhānāt| tataś ca sākṣācchiṣṭena tena nimittabhāva iko bādhyate| tatra vyakteḥ padārthasya āśritatvād adoṣaḥ| vyaktau padārthe pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pravarttata ityuktam| tatra yadi yaṇādeśena nimittabhāva iko bādhyeta yad dadhyudakādiviṣayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vaiyyarthyaṃ syāt| tasmān mā bhūd eṣa doṣa iti lakṣaṇasāmarthyān nimittabhāvo na bādhyate| iha punar jātiḥ padārtha āśritaḥ| tatra jāter ekatvād acorahābhyām iti lakṣaṇam apy ekameva| tac ca arkkaḥ markka ityādau caritārtham| ato yadyapi madrahradādau dvirvacanaṃ na vidadhāti yathāpi na bhavati vaiyarthyaprasaṅga iti na dvir ucyate| repha iti| itikaraṇena anantaroktasya arthasya dvirvacanābhāvaṃ prati hetubhāvo dyotyate| anusvārasyetyādi| na kevalaṃ yaro'nunāsike (8.4.45) anunāsiko vetyetad antaratamaṃ sakṛd eva pravarttamānaṃ vidadhāti api tv anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇa (8.4.58) ityetad api ityapiśabdasya arthaḥ| syād etat| yadyapy antaratamaṃ vidadhāti tathāpi bhavitavyam eva atra repheṇa parasavarṇena| tasyāpy antaratamatvād ityata āha na cetyādi| na ca rephasya savarṇo'stīti sambandhaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭo nāsti? anusvārāntaratamaḥ|anusvārasya sadṛśatama ityarthaḥ| iti hetor na bhavati kuṇḍaṃ rathenetyatra parasavarṇaḥ| kathaṃ punar anusvārāntaratamaḥ| savarṇo rephasya nāsti? ucyate| rephasya repha eva savarṇaḥ| na anyo varṇaḥ| sa ca anusvārasya antaratamo na bhavati| sthānabhedād guṇabhedāc ca| rephasya hi mūrdhā sthānam| anusvārasya punar anusvārayamā nāsikyā iti vacanād nāsikā| %\(edC, p.25 begins with punaranusvāra@) guṇo'pi rephasyeṣatspṛṣṭatā| anusvārasya tu sa nāsti| antaḥsthānām eva hy ayam asādhāraṇo guṇa iṣyate| na anyeṣām| yadyapi vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā antaḥsthā hakārānusvārau ca yamau ca tṛtīyacaturthau nāsikyāś ca saṃvṛtakaṇṭhā nādānupradānāghoṣavantaś ceti bāhyaprayatnākhyena guṇena saṃvṛtakaṇṭhatvādinā anusvārāntaratamo rephaḥ savarṇaḥ sambhavati tathāpi na guṇamātreṇāntaratamam etal lakṣaṇaṃ parasavarṇaṃ vidhātum utsahate| yatra sthānato guṇataś ca antaratamās tatra anusvārasya parasavarṇāḥ santi| śaṅkitaḥ kuṇṭhita ityatra caritārthatvāt| atra sthānato'py anusvārasya nāsikāsthānasya ṅaṇāv antaratamau| tayor api nāsikāsthānatvāt| ñamaṅaṇanāḥ svasthānā nāsikāsthānāś ceti vacanāt| guṇato'pi| teṣāṃ pūrvoktair anusvāraguṇair anugatatvāt| yathā tṛtīyās tathā pañcamā iti vacanāt| anena hi vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā ityādinā granthena ye 'nusvārasādhāraṇā vargatṛtīyānāṃ gakārādīnāṃ guṇā uktās te ṅakārādīnāṃ nirdiśyante| guṇamātreṇa apy antaratamaṃ vidadhyād rephaṃ yady asakṛt pravarttate tat| mā bhūt punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttir apārthiketi kṛtvā| na ca asakṛt pravarttata ityuktam| uraḥ keṇetyādi| uraḥ kāyati| uraḥ pāti| kai gai śabde| pā rakṣaṇe| ity abhyām āto'nupasarge kaḥ (3.2.3)| āto lopa iṭi cetyākāra (6.4.64) lopaḥ| upapadasamāsaḥ| subluk| sasajuṣo (8.2.66) ruḥ| tasya kharavasānayor visarjanīyaḥ (8.3.15)| kupvoḥ =ka=pau ceti (8.3.37) yathāyogaṃ visarjanīyāv upadhmānīyajihvāmūlīyau|

ayaṃ ṇakāro dvir badhyate| pūrvataś caivaṃ parataś caivam| tatreṇgrahaṇeṣv aṇgrahaṇeṣu ca saṃdeho bhavati| kiṃ pūrveṇa syuḥ preṇa veti| atas tad apanayanārtham āha| iṇgrahaṇāni ityādi| tatra yathā sarvvāṇi iṇgrahaṇāni pareṇa ṇakāreṇa gṛhyante tathā aiuṇ ityatra pratipāditam| aṇgrahaṇāni tu yāni pareṇa api sambhāvyante tāni pūrveṇa pratipādyāni| kāni punas tāni? ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ (6.3.11)| %\(edC, p.26 begins with pūrvasya) ke'ṇaḥ (7.4.13)| aṇo'pragṛhyasya anunāsikaḥ (8.4.57) uraṇ raparaḥ (1.1.51)| ityeteṣu sūtreṣu yāny aṇgrahaṇāni| tatra pūrvasmiṃs tāvat sūtre dṛḍhādiṣu vṛḍhaśabdapāṭho jñāpako na pareṇa aṇgrahaṇam iti| yadi hi pareṇa syād vṛḍha iti rūpaṃ na syāt| tataś ca dṛḍhādiṣu vṛḍha iti pāṭho nopapadyate| vṛha udyama ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ ḍhatvadhatvaḍhalopeṣu kṛteṣu vṛḍha iti rūpaṃ bhavati| kiñ ca dīrghaśrutyā tatra acaś ceti (1.2.28) sannidhāpite saty aca eva dīrghatvena bhavitavyam| tathā ca yadi pareṇa antaḥpātinām apy acāṃ dīrghatvam abhimataṃ syād asandehārtham ajgrahaṇam eva kuryyat| athavā tadapi na kuryyāt| acaś cetyasmād eva (1.2.28) sarvācāṃ dīrghatvasiddheḥ| tasmād aṇgrahaṇasāmarthyāt pūrveṇa aṇgrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| ke'ṇa (7.4.13) ityanenāpi ke parato halām aṇām asambhavād acām eva hrasvo vidhīyate| tatra yadi sarveṣām acāṃ hrasvatvam abhīṣṭaṃ syād asandehārtham ajgrahaṇam eva kuryyāt| athavā tadapi na kuryyat| hrasvagrahaṇenopasthāpitād acaścetyasmādeva abhilaṣitārthasiddheḥ| tṛtīyena api sūtreṇa padāntasya aṇo anunāsiko vidhīyate| na ca padāntā halo'ṇaḥ santi ity acām eva anunāsiko vidheyaḥ| tatra yadi sarveṣām acām anunāsiko vidhitsitaḥ syād asandehārtham ajgrahaṇam eva kuryyāt| athavā tadapi na kuryyāt| aca eva hi pragṛhyasaṃjñā bhavanti| na halaḥ| tatra nañiva yuktanyāyena pragṛhyapratiṣedhāt tatsadṛśasya aca eva kāryyaṃ vijñāsyate| tasmāt tatrāpi aṇgrahaṇasāmarthyāt pūrveṇaiva aṇgrahaṇam pratīyate| uraṇ rapara (1.1.51) ityatrāpi hotṛpraśāstṛṛṇām(?) iti (6.4.11) nirdeśo jñāpayati neha pareṇa aṇgrahaṇam iti| pareṇa aṇgrahaṇe sati nāmīti raparo dīrghaḥ syāt| tathā ca praśāstṛṛṇām iti nirdeśo na syāt| kiñca na ca rephād anyaṛkārasya sthāne halo'ṇaḥ kvacic chastre vidhīyante| tathā hi iko yaṇaci iti rephaḥ syāt| na ca ṛkārasya sthāne karttrartham ityādau rephe rephapare arephapare vā vihite kaścid viśeṣaḥ| kṛte hi rapare tatraikasya rephasya ro rīti (8.3.14) lopena bhavitavyam| tasmād etad apy aṇgrahaṇaṃ pareṇa ṇakāreṇa bhavad ajartham eva syāt| tatra yadi sarveṣām acāṃ sthāne vidhīyamānānāṃ raparatvam iṣṭaṃ syād asandehārtham ajgrahaṇam eva kuryyāt| %(\edC, p.27 begins with yadi sarveṣām) tadevam etadgrahaṇaṃ pūrvaeṇaiva ṇakāreṇa bhavati iti niścīyate| aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyaya (1.1.69) ityekam aneneti| atra ca urṛd iti(7.4.7) ṛkārasya taparakaraṇaṃ liṅgam| tad dhi ṛkāreṇa savarṇānām grahaṇe sati acīkṛtad ityatra dīrghasya sthānina āntaratamyād dīrgho mā bhūd ityevamarthaṃ kriyate| yadi ca aṇudid ityādau pūrveṇa ṇakāreṇa aṇgrahaṇaṃ syāt tadā ṛkāro'naṇtvāt savarṇānāṃ grāhako na syāt| tataś ca dīrghasya api sthānino yathāśrutena hrasvenaiva bhavitavyam iti taparakaraṇaṃ na kuryyāt| vyāvarttyabhāvāt| kṛtañ ca| tato gamyate pareṇa ṇakāreṇa aṇgrahaṇam iti| nanu ca satyapi pareṇa ṇakāreṇa aṇgrahaṇe ur ṛd ityatra (7.4.7) naiva savarṇānām ṛkāro grāhaka upapadyate| bhāvyamānatvāt| bhāvyamānena aṇā savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ neti pratiṣedhāt| naitad asti| vakṣyati hi tatra na ca ayaṃ bhāvyamāno'ṇ| kiṃ tarhi? ādeśāntaranivṛttyarthaṃ svarūpam eva abhyanujñāyata iti| acīkṛtad ityatra kṛṛta saṃśabdane| curādi ṇic| luṅ| cleḥ ṇiśrītyādinā caṅ| urṛt (7.4.7) iti ṛṛkārasya ṛkāraḥ| ṇilopaḥ (6.4.51)| caṅi(6.1.11) iti dvirvacanam| urat(7.4.66) iti atvam| halādiḥ śeṣaḥ(7.4.60)| sanval laghuni(7.4.93) iti ītvam| dīrgho laghor( 7.4.94) iti dīrghatvam| atha kimartham ajgrahaṇam evaitan na kriyata iti? yatra kṛte sandeha eva bhavati iti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam? naivaṃ śakyam ityata āha antaḥsthānām api hi ityādi| antaḥsthā dviprabhedā rephavarjitāḥ| sānunāsikā niranunāsikāś ceti vacanāt| yavalāḥ sānunāsikaniranunāsikabhedena dviprakārāḥ| te pratyāhāre'pi niranunāsikā vā upadiśyeran sānunāsikā vā? yadi niranunāsikāḥ sa*yyyantetyādāv anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇa(8.4.58) ity āntaratamyāt sānunāsikeṣu yakārādiṣu parasavarṇeṣu kṛteṣu teṣāṃ pratyāhāre 'nupadeśāt yartvaṃ nāsti ity anaci ca (8.4.47) iti yaro dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ na syāt| aṇgrahaṇe tu saty aṇ savarṇān gṛhṇāti ityeteṣām api dvirvacanaṃ sidhyati| nanu ca kṛte'pi dvirvacane halo yamāṃ yami lopa(8.4.64) ityekasya lopavidhānāt trayāṇām yakārāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ na sambhavaty eva| %\(edC, p.28 begins with yamāṃ yami) tat kiṃ dvirvacanārthena prayatnena? naitad asti| pākṣiko hi sa lopaḥ| jhayo ho'nyatarasyām (8.4.62) ity anyatarasyāṃ grahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tatra yasmin pakṣe lopo nāsti tatra trayāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ bhavatyeva| atha sānunāsikā upadiśyeran pratyāhāre'nusvārasya parasavarṇatvaṃ niranunāsike parato na syāt| yayāṃ madhye teṣām asanniveśāt| hakārādiṣv ityādi| pratijñānunāsikyāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ| yatrecchanti tatrānunāsikyaṃ pratijānate| na anyatra| lakāre ca tair akārasya tat pratijñāyate| na hakārādiṣu| itsaṃjñaka iti| upadeśe'janunāsika it( 1.3.2) iti itsaṃjñāvidhānāt tenetyādinā anunāsikapratijñāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati| ṛkāraḷkārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñopasaṃkhyānād ṛkāro gṛhyamāṇo ḷkāram api gṛhṇāti| tata urṇ rapara iti| yathā ṛkārasya aṇ śiṣyamāṇo raparo bhavati evaṃ ḷkārasya api bhava*l laparaś ceṣyate| tasmād anunāsikaḥ pratijñāyate| tena ādirantena sahete(1.1.71)ti uraṇ rapara(1.1.51) ityatra ra iti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ bhavati| rephāt prabhṛtyā laṇo 'kārāt| tasmiṃś ca sati ṛkārasya aṇ raparaḥ bhavati| ḷkārasya tu lapara iti| tatas tavalkāra ityādyupapannaṃ bhavati|
7| JñAMAṅAṇANAM |
tasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati tribhir iti| atha sṛjidṛśorjhaly am akiti( 6.1.58) ityatrāpy asyākāreṇa grahaṇaṃ kasmān na bhavati? sākṣād draṣṭari (5.2.91) iti nirdeśāt| pratyāhāre hy etasminn akārādyādeśavidhānād draṣṭṛśabdo na sidhyet| iha tarhi bhrasjo ropadhayo ram anyatarasyām(6.4.47) iti repheṇa kasmān na bhavati? atha ram ayam upātto na tvam ityeṣa kuto niścayaḥ? tulyā hi saṃhitā| tatra bhavitavyaṃ sandehena| kim ayaṃ ram ? āhosvid am iti| vyākhyānān niścaya iti cet? yadi tarhi vyākhyānasya niścayahetutvam abhyupeyate tata eva atra ca anyatra ca sarvatraivaṃjātīyake saṃdehaviṣaye niścayo bhaviṣyati iti kim anyair ativistaragranthakāribhir hetubhir hetubhir upanyastaiḥ prayojanam? yas tu manyate bhrasjo ropadhayo ram ityatra vyavasthitavibhāṣayā pratyāhārasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati iti sa idaṃ syād vacanīyaḥ| %\(edC, p.29 begins with niścayo) kim anena anyatarasyāṃ grahaṇena raṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpyate?anyatarasyāṃ raṃ gṛhyata iti| atha vidhānam anyatarasyāṃ ram vidhīyata iti? yadi raṃgrahaṇaṃ tato rephasyaivedaṃ svarūpeṇa makārānubandhavato grahaṇam| na pratyāhārasyeti labhyate? etadvyavasthitavibhāṣayā ramāgamas tu vikalpena na syāt| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya ramgrahaṇavikalpe caritārthatvāt| na hi dvitīyam anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam asti| yena vidhānaṃ vikalpyeta| itaratra tu pakṣe sidhyati pākṣikaṃ vidhānam| kiṃ tu yat tad abhimataṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣayā rephasyaivedaṃ makārānubandhavataḥ svarūpeṇa grahaṇaṃ na pratyāhārasyeti tan nopapadyate| ekatvād anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya| tasya vidhānavikalpenaivopayuktatvāt| kiñca kutaś ca ayam adhyavasāyo vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam iti? vyākhyānād iti cet? kim idānīṃ pāramparyyāśrayaṇena? vyākhyānād eva naivaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati iti yat kiñcid etat| ñakāreṇa api pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ asya dṛśyata iti| yadyevaṃ kimarthaṃ tribhir ityuktam? ñamantāḍḍa(1) ityatra pratyāhārasya nāvaśyaṃ grahaṇam iti darśayitum| atra hi ñakāramakārasvarūpopādāne.pi vinā pratyāragrahaṇena anyato.pi makārādyantāḍḍapratyayaḥ sidhyatyeva| bahulādhikāravidhānāt| (2)nanv evamapi caturbhir ityevaṃ vaktavyam| yamirñamanteṣv ityatra (3) ñakāreṇāpy asya grahaṇādarśanāt| satyam etad yadi grahaṇamātram abhipretyaitad ucyeta| na cedaṃ grahaṇamātram abhisandhāyoktam| kiṃ tarhi grahaṇaviśeṣam| sautram| na cedaṃ sautraṃ grahaṇam? kiṃ tarhi? āniṭkārikatvam| %\edC, p.30 kecid ityādi| yāny etāny anantaraṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇāny uktāni tāni jhabhañ ityatra yo ñakāras tenaiva bhavantv ityevaṃ vicintya kecid ācāryyā makārasya pratyākhyānaṃ kurvvanti| tatra tu pratyākhyāne pumaḥ khayyaṃpara (8.3.6) ityādiṣu sūtreṣu makārasya sthāne ñakāraḥ karttavya iti teṣām abhiprāyaḥ| tathā ca sati ityādinā makārānubandhapratyākhyāne doṣaṃ darśayati| ṅaño hrasvādaci ṅañuṇ nityam(8.3.32) iti hi pāṭhe jhabhor api pratyāhāre 'ntarbhāvāj jhabhāv apy āgaminau syātām ityetac codyam āpatati| tayoḥ jhabhoḥ padāntayor abhāvān na bhaviṣyata iti parihāro vācyaḥ| tasminn ukte nanu ca labherubjeś ca kvipi vihita āgamināv ubhau sta eva padāntāv iti punaś codyam| tasmiñ jhalāñ jaśonta(8.2.39) iti bakārajakārayoḥ kṛayoḥ kutas tāv iti punaḥ parihāraḥ| nanu cāgaminor jhabhor abhāvād vaiṣamyaṃ syāt| tathā hi ṅaṇanās traya āgaminaḥ| āgamās tu ṅaṇanajhabhāḥ pañca| tataś ca saṃkhyāvaiṣamyān naiṣāṃ yathāsaṃkhyam(1.3.10) iti saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ syād iti punaś codyam| naiṣa doṣaḥ| sūtre yāvanta āgamā āgamino'pi tāvanta eva paṭhyante| tatra lakṣyam anapekṣya ṅakārādīnām eva yathāsaṃkhyam āgamā bhavanti iti sūtrārthe vihita uttarakālaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ kāryyapratipattir bhaviṣyati iti| yeṣāṃ tāvad āgamānām āgamināḥ santi teṣāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhaviṣyanti| jhakārabhakārau tu padāntāv āgaminau na sta iti kṛtvā āgamāv api na bhaviṣyata iti punaḥ parihāro vācyaḥ| evam anekacodyaparihāreṇa āgaminor jhabhor abhāvād hetor āgamābhāvapratipattau sādhyāyāṃ mahāpratipattigauravaṃ bhavet| tasmād ayuktaṃ makārapratyākhyānam iti bhāvaḥ|

samāhāre'pi `dvandvāccudaṣahāntā-t` [[5.4.106]] iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ syāt; samāsāntavidheranityatvānna bhaviṣyati| anityatvaṃ ṣaṣṭhe jñāpayiṣyate| atha <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? `aya-smayādīni cchandasi` [[1.4.20]] iti bhasañjñakatvāt| ādiśabdasya prakāravācitvādaiccha-bdo'yamayasmayādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ| nanu tatra cchandasītyucyate, na cedaṃ chandaḥ, tatkuto bhasañjñā? `chandovat sūtrāṇi bhavanti` ityadoṣaḥ|ihedaṃ sūtramanarthakaṃ vā syādyathākathañcidudāttādivacanavat? sādhvanuśāsanārthavā, vṛddhiśabdasyādaicāñcānena sādhutvamākhyāyata iti? prayoganiyamārthaṃ vā, ādaica para eva vṛddhiśabdaḥ prayoktavya iti? ādeśārthavā, ādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabda ādeśo bhavati te vā tasyeti? āgamāgamisambandhārthaṃ vā, ādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabda āgamo bhavati, te vā tasyeti? viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaprasiddhyarthaṃ vā, ādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabdo viśeṣaṇam, te vā, tasyeti?ekavibhaktikatvaṃ hyatra dṛṣṭam, dṛṣṭaścaikavibhaktikayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, tadyathā nīlamutpalamiti; sañjñāsañjñisambandhārthaṃ vā? dṛśyate hi so'pyekavibhaktikayoḥ, tadyathā `ayaṃ panasaḥ` iti? tatra tāvadādyaḥ pakṣo nopapadyate| sagaṣigatajñānātiśayo hrācāryaḥ parahitapratipannaḥ samāhitacetāḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ kṛtarakṣāsaṃvidhāno maṅgalapūrvakaṃ mahatā prayatnena sūtrāṇi praṇītavān| tatrāśakyamekena varṇanāpyanarthakena bhavituma, kiṃ punariyatā sūtraprabandhena!nāpi śakyaṃ vṛddhiśabdasyādaicāṃ ca iti, <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti dhatvam, <> [[8.4.53]] iti dhakārasya dakāraḥ| ādaico'pyakṣarasamāmnāya upadeśāt| aico'kṣarasamāmnāya upadeśaḥ, nākārasyeti cet? avarṇajāterupadeśāt so'pi prayoganiyamārthametanna bhavatīti pratipādayitumāha- naha ca prayoganiyamā-rthamārabhyata iti| nanu cāyaṃ prayoganiyamārthamevārabhyate `te prāga dhātoḥ` [[1.4.80]] iti? te gatyapasargasañjñakā pratyākhyāyeta, evamapi na doṣaḥ, yataḥ sañjñāniyamo'yaṃ na prayoganiyamaḥ, te prādayo dhātoḥ prāk prayujyamānā eva gatyupasa-rgasañjñakā bhavantīti| athāpi prayoganiyamārthaṃ syāt, evamapi na doṣaḥ, yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu tābhyāmaic` [[7.3.3]] iti ṣaṣṭhīmantareṇāpi darśanāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaprasiddhyarthamapyetann sambhāvyate| tathā hi sambhavavyabhicāre ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati, nīlotpalavat| na cehādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabde tasya vā teṣu sambhavaḥ| nanu ca yathotpalaśabdaḥsarvatrotpalārthe vartamāno nīlaśabdenārthāntarādvayavacchidyata iti vyavacchidyamāno viśeṣyo bhavati, nīlaśabdastu vyavacchindan viśeṣaṇam, tathānayorapabi yo vayavacchedyaḥ sa viśeṣyo bhavati, yastu vyavacchedakaḥ sa viśeṣaṇamiti? naitadasti| ubhayorhi sārthakatve satyetadupapadyate, nīlotpalaśabdavat| na cādaico'rthavantaḥ| bhavatu nāmānayorviśeṣaṇaviśe-ṣyabhāvaḥ, tathāpi naitatsiddhyarthamidaṃ yuktam; niṣprayojanatvāt, tatpunaḥ prakṛtānupayogitvāt| śabdānuśāsane hi śāstre prakṛte yagnāma śabdasaṃskārānupayogivacanaṃ tatsarvamaprayojanam| śabdasaṃskārānupayogitvaṃ tvetatpratipaditena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvenavṛddhiśabdasyādaicāṃ vā svaraviśeṣasya vā rupaviśeṣasya vā saṃskārasyāsiddheḥ| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva eva teṣāṃ saṃskāra iti cet? yadyevam, atyalpamidamucyate<> [[1.1.1]] iti| nīlotpalamityadpi hi vaktavyam, nīlotpalādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaprasiddhaye| na coktam, ato naiṣa saṃskāro'bhimata iti nāsya tādathryaṃ sambhāvyate|nanu tulyavibhaktikānāṃ tadguṇasamādhyāropo'pi dṛṣṭaḥ, tadyathā `siṃho māṇavakaḥ` iti, tasmāt tadarthametadbhaviṣyatīti yatpakṣāntarameke parikalpayāmbabhūvuḥ, tadarthama-pyetanna bhavati, tadguṇasamādhyāropasya sato'pyatra prakṛtānupayogitvenānarthakatvāt| tasmāt pāriśeṣyāt sañjñāsañjñisambandhārthamevaitadityālocyāha-`vṛddhiśabdaḥsañjñātvena` ityādi| bhavatu nāma pariśeṣyāttadartham| etat kuto labhyate? vṛddhi-śabdaḥ sañjñā, ādaicaḥ sañjñinaḥ iti| viparyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati,ādaicaḥ sañjñā, vṛddhiśabdaḥ sañjñī iti? nārhati viparyayo bhavitum| tathā hi, laghvarthatvāt sañjñākaraṇasya, yasminnuccāryamāṇe pradeśeṣu lāghavaṃ bhavati tasya sañjñārthatvena bhāvyam| vṛddhiśabde ca vibhaktike'pyuccāryamāṇe lāghavaṃ bhavati, nādaikṣu; yasmādvṛddhiśabda uccāryamāṇe catastro mātrā bhavanti, ādaikṣu tu pañca| na cādaicāṃ pratyekaṃsañjñābhāvāllāghavaṃ bhavatīti śakyaṃ parikalpayitum, prayojanaviśeṣamantareṇaikasthāne-sañjñāvidhānasya niṣphalatvāt| kiñcāvartibhyaḥ sañjñā bhavanti| vṛddhiśabdaścāvartate, nādaicchabdaḥ tasmānna bhavati viparyayaḥ `vṛddhiśabdaḥ` iti| śabdagrahaṇamarthavyavacche-dārtham| asati hi tasmin śabdādarthāvagaterarthasyaiva sañjñātvaṃ vijñāyeta| yadyapi prāgeva sañjñā vihitā, tathāpi śiṣyapraśiṣyaprabandhādyuparamādvidhīyata itivartamānaprayatven nirdeśaḥ| yatra samudāsya kāryamicchati tatra ubhepadagrahaṇaṃ karoti, yathā `ubheabhyastam` [[6.1.5]] iti, anvarthāṃ vā mahatīṃ sañjñām, `halo'ntarāḥ saṃyogaḥ` [[1.1.7]] iti| tatra hi mahatī sañjñaivamarthā kriyate, samudāyasyaiṣā sañjñāyathā syāditi| etaccottaratra vyaktīkariṣyāmaḥ| iha tu na kiñcittathāvidhaṃ vacanamasti yataḥ samudāyasyai-ṣā sañjñā syāt| tasmādekaikasyaiṣā sañjñeti manasi kṛtvāha `pratyekakam` iti|nanu cehāpi lāghavārthamekākṣarāyāṃ sañjñāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ vṛddhiriti mahatyāḥ sañjñāyāḥkaraṇaṃ samudāyasya sañjñā yathā syādityevamartham? naitadasti| maṅgalārthatvā-dasyāḥ sañjñāyāḥ| ata evāsyāḥ prāguccāraṇam| anyathā sañjñāyāḥ sataḥ kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyamiti, yathā `adeṅguṇaḥ` [[1.1.2]] ityādau pūrvasañjñīnirdiṣṭa-,tathehāpi nirdiśet| ākārasya guṇāntarayuktayoścaicoḥ pratyāhāre'sanniveśānnāmī varṇā iti kasyacinmandadhiyo bhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākaraṇāyāha-`varṇānām` ityādi| pratyāsattestadbhāvitānāmevaiṣāṃ sañjñā syāditi kasyacidviparyayaḥ syāt, atastamapākartumāha-`sāmānyena` iti| vyāptenryāyādityabhiprāyaḥ| sāmānyenetyasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkartumāha- `tadbhāvitanām` ityādi| te tadbhāvitāḥye vṛddhiśabdenotpāditāḥ, tato'nye'tadbhāvitāḥ| āditi taparakaraṇam-<> [[1.1.70]] iti guṇāntarabhinnānāmapi tulyakālānāṃ grahaṇārthaṃ vā syāt, bhinna-kālānāṃ grahaṇanivṛttyarthaṃ vā? tatrpūrvaḥ pakṣastāvannopapadyate; abhedakatvādihodāttādīnāṃ śāstre guṇānāma| kuta etat? `luṅalaṅalṛṅakṣvaḍudāttaḥ` [[6.4.71]] ityudāttagrahaṇāt, anyathā hrudāttaguṇayuktamevāṭamuccārayet| dvitīyo'pi nopapadyate|yadi hrākāraḥ savarṇānāṃ grāhakaḥ syāt, tatastena bhinnakālasyāpyavarṇasya grahaṇe sati tasyāpi sañjñā mā bhūditi bhinnakālānāṃ grahaṇanivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇamupapadyate| nacāsau savarṇānāṃ grāhakaḥ, anaṇtvāt, tasya punarakṣarasamāmnāye'sanniveśāt| tasmādanarthakaṃ taparakaraṇam| tato na kartavyamevetyata āha- `taparakaraṇam` ityādi| ecorarthaḥ prayojanaṃyasy tat tathoktam| nanu ca jātau padārthe plutasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, tatrāpyavarṇajāteḥ samavayāt, tatrāsati taparakaraṇe tasyāpi sañjñā syat, tasmāt tannivṛttaya taparakaraṇaṃ bhavadākārārthamapyupapadyata eva, tatkimucyate `ejartham` iti? evaṃ manyate-jātipakṣasamāśrayaṇe'pi hi dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāddvimātrā evāvarṇavyaktayaḥsamāśritā iti gamyate, itarathā hi lāghavārtham? `ad` ityevābhidadhyāt| na ca hrasvanivṛttyarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇamiti śakyate parikalpayitum, dīrghoccāraṇe'pi hrasva-grahaṇaṃ prāpnotyeva, tatrāpyavarṇajāteḥ sambhavāditi| na cāsandehārtham `āt` ityuktam, varṇāntarāsādhāraṇatvāt, asaṃhitayā vā sandehābhāvāditi| nanu ca <> [[1.1.70]] ityatra taḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhirāśritaḥ, na cātraic taparaḥ, tatkathaṃ taparakaraṇamaijarthaṃ bhavatītyata āha- `tāvapi parastaparaḥ` iti| na kevalaṃ taḥ paro yasmāt sa tapara iti, api tu tādapi yaḥ paraḥ so'pi tapara iti apiśabdena darśayati| etaduktaṃ bhavati, na kevalaṃ bahuvrīhireva tatrāśrīyate, kiṃ tarhi? pañcamītatpuruṣo'pi| yatā caitadubhayamā-śrīyate tathā tatraivopapādayiṣyāmaḥ| iti karaṇo hetau yata evaṃ tādapi parastaparaḥ, tena taparakaraṇamaijarthamityarthaḥ|`khaṭvaiḍakādiṣu` ityādinā tadevaijarthatvaṃ taparakaraṇasya spaṣṭīkaroti|vṛkṣa elakā `vṛkṣailakā`| akriyamāṇe hyatra taparakaraṇe trimātrikasyākāraikārasamudāyasyasthāne vṛddhireci` [[6.1.85]] iti vṛddhirāntaratamyāt trimātrika evaikāraḥ syātyadi tasyāpi vṛddhisañjñā syāt| khaṭvā odanaṃ khaṭvaudanam, khaṭvā elakā khaṭvailakā ityatrāpi pūrvottarasamudāyayoścaturmātrāyoścaturmātrāvakāraikārau syātām,tanmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti trimātracaturmātrāṇāmaicāṃ vṛddhisañjñānivṛttaye taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate| āālāyanaḥ, aitikāyanaḥ` iti| aāletikaśabdābhyāṃ <> [[4.1.99]] , <> [[6.4.148]] iti lopaḥ, `kiti ca` [[7.2.118]] ityādivṛddhiḥ| `aupagavaḥ` iti|upaguśabdāt <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] | `aupamanyavaḥ` iti| upamanyuśabdāta <<anṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.1.104]] ityañ, ubhayatrāpi <> [[6.4.146]] , avādeśaḥ [[6.1.75]] , <> [[7.2.117]] iti vṛddhiḥ| etāni catvāryapi tadbhāvito-dāharaṇāni| nanu ye'tra trayaḥ sañjñinasteṣāmādyaistribhirviṣayo darśitaḥ, kimartha-ścaturthopanyāsaḥ? kecidāhuḥ- vaddhinimittabhedāt, ādyayorudāharaṇayoḥ kittaddhito vṛddhernimattam, tṛtīye'pi ṇit, tacurthe'pi ñit iti| etaccāyuktam| tathā hi <> [[1.1.3]] ityatra`akārṣīt` ityudāhṛtya `ahārṣīn` ityudāhṛtam`, na ca tatra vṛddhinimittabhedo'sti| tathā <> [[1.1.4]] ityatraloluvaḥ ityudāhṛtya `popuvaḥ, marīmṛjaḥ` ityadhikodāharaṇopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ| na ca tatra lopanimittabhedaḥ; pratiṣedhanimittabhedo vā adhikodāharaṇopanyāsasya heturvidyate| prāyeṇā-nyaṣvepi ca sāmānyalakṣaṇeṣu vināpi nimittabhedānādhikodāharaṇopanyāsa upalabhyate| yo'pyāha `opagava ityanenaica aukārasya viṣaye darśite'pi svarabhedādaupamanyava ityetadadhikamudāharaṇamupanyastam` iti, tasyāpi tadayuktam, ata evānantaroktāddhetorveditavyam || yadi nimittabhedaḥ, svarabhedo vā sarvatrādhikodāharaṇopanyāso veditavyaḥ| `śālīyaḥ, mālīyaḥ` iti| atadbhāvitasyodāharaṇe| atra hi vṛddhisañjñāyāṃ vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham` [[1.1.72]] iti vṛddhasañjñāphaṃ chapratyayopanyāsastasyā eva phalabhūtāyā abhivyaktyarthaḥ| vṛddhasañjñāyāṃ hi satyāṃ <> [[4.2.114]] iti jātādāvarthe cho vidhīyate| aikāraukārayostvatadbhāvitayorudāharaṇaṃ nātra darśitam, etadanusarasāra-ṇaiva gamyamānatvāt| ākārasyātadbhāvitasya vṛddhisañjñāyāḥ kārye darśite, tayorapi tadeva kāryamiti tanmukhenaiva gamyata eva| ke punasatyorudāharaṇe? `raimayam, naumayam` iti| ātraikāraukārayorvṛddhisañjñāyāṃ satyāṃ pūrvavadvṛddhasañjñā| tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ rāyo vikāraḥ, nāvo vikāra iti <> [[4.3.144]] iti mayaḍbhavati|`taparakaraṇaṃ tviha sarvārthamiti| sarvasminnarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattathoktam| tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmādviśeṣaṃ darśayati| tatra hraijarthameva, iha tu sarvārtham, akārārthameṅarthamapi| asati hi taparakaraṇaṃ adeṅāmaṇatvāt savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ sati bhinnakālānāmapyeṣā sañjñā syāt| tataśca `taritā` ityatrāntaratmayāddīrghasya dīrgha eva guṇasyāt|nanu ca vṛddhisañjñā guṇasañjñāyā bādhikā bhaviṣyati, tat kuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ? naitadasti| ekasañjñādhikāre hi sañjñayā sañjñāntaraṃ bādhyate, na cātrekasañjñādhi-kāraḥ| syādetat, asatyapyekasañjñādhikāre yathā <> [[4.1.163]] iti gotrasañjñā yuvasañjñayā bādhyate, yathā ca `liṭ ca` [[3.4.115]] , <> [[3.4.116]] iti cārdhadhātukasañjñayā sārvadhātukasaṃjñā bādhyate, tathā guṇasaṃjñā vṛddhisañjñayā bādhiṣyate iti? ayuktametata| yuvasañjñāvidhau tugrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ kriyate| tato yuktaṃ yadyuvasañjñayā gotrasañjñā bādhyata iti| ārdhadhātukasañjñā'pi yat sārvadhātukasañjñā bādhyate tadapi yuktameva, <> [[6.4.86]] ti vacanāt| yadi sārva-dhātukārdhadhātukasañjñayoḥ samāveśaḥ syāt, na bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, tadā <> [[6.4.86]] iti vacanamapārthakaṃ syāt| iha tu na kiñcit tathāvidhaṃ nibandhanamasti, yato vṛddhisañjñayā guṇasañjñā bādhyate| athāpi kathañcidbādhyeta, evamapi trimātrikasyāpi guṇa-sañjñā syādeva| na hi sā tayā śakyā bādhitum, tasya atadviṣayatvāt| trimātrasyāpi guṇasañjñāyāṃ satyāṃ trimātro'pi guṇaḥ prasajyate| ṛkārasya hi kālato yathaikamatriko'kāro'ntaratamo na sambhavati, tathā trimātro'pi, tat kuta etallabhyate? hrasvenaivāsya guṇena bhavitavyam na hi trimātreṇākāreṇeti| kiñca, yadi bhinna-kālānāmapi guṇasañjñā syāt, `khaṭvā indraḥ= khaṭvendraḥ khaṭvā urvī khaṭvorvī` ityatra trimātratvāt pūrvottarasamudāyātmanaḥ sthāninaḥ <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] iti trimātro guṇaḥ syāt| khaṭvā īṣā= khaṭveṣā, khaṭvā uḍhā=khaṭvoḍhā` ityatra caturmā-mātritvāt caturmātraḥ| tasmāt sarvārthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ kartavyam| `taritā` ityādi| `tṛ? taplavanataraṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-969), `ciñ cayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1251), `ṣṭuñ stutau`(dhātupāṭhaḥ-1043), ebhyaḥ `ṇlultṛcau` [[3.1.133]] iti tṛc| <<ārdhadhātukasyeḍ valādeḥ>> [[7.2.35]] itīṭ, <> [[7.3.84]] iti guṇaḥ, su, `ṛduśanas` [[7.1.94]] ityādinā anaṅa, `sarvanāmasthāne ca` [[6.4.8]] iti dīrghaḥ| etāni trīṇi yathākramadeṅāṃ tadbhāvitānāmudāharaṇāni| `paṭhanti, paṭhan` ityakārasyātdbhāvitasyodāharaṇe| atrāntyākārasya guṇasañjñāyāṃ <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvaṃ bhavati| paṭhanniti śatrantametat| ekāsyātadbhāvitasyakāryodāharaṇam- `ahaṃ pace` ityādi| okārasyātadbhāvitas tanna sambhavatīti na pradaśryate|`paribhāṣeyam` iti| nādhikāraḥ, asvaritatvāt| nāpi guṇavṛddhayorvidhāyakaṃ lakṣaṇam, lakṣaṇāntareṇa tayorvidhāsyamānatvāt| `sthāniniyamārthā` iti| sthānini niyamaḥ sthāniniyamaḥ, sthānyantaravyavacchedenaikatra pravartanam, so'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| `aniyamaprasaṅge niyamo vidhīyate` iti| yatra sākṣāt sthānī na nirdiṣṭaḥ <> [[7.3.84]] , <> [[7.2.1]] ityādau, tatrāniyame prasakte niyamameṣāṃ karoti-ika eva nānyasyeti| ataḥ sa evasyā viṣayo veditavyaḥ, na tu yatra sākṣāt sthānī nirdiśyate so'pi, yathā- <> [[6.4.146]] <> [[7.2.116]] ityādiḥ| tatra hraniyamasya prāptireva nāsti| liṅgavatī ceyaṃ paribhāṣā, liṅgaṃ cāsyā guṇavṛddhigrahaṇam, tatropatiṣṭhate| tathā ca dve ṣaṣṭhyau prādurbhavataḥ,-`ikaḥ` ityekā ṣaṣṭhī, <> [[7.3.82]] ityevamādikā dvitīyā|tatra kāmacārādayatheṣṭaṃ sidhyati| tayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ kriyate| `mideḥ` ityatrānta iga na sambhavatīti tsayāṅaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ nopapadyatetasmādatrāṅgenegeva viśiṣyate- mideraṅgasya ya igiti| tena sthānaṣṭhabhāvādalo'ntyasyānupasthāne sati yatra tatra sthasyeko guṇaḥ siddho bhavati| <> [[7.3.84]] ityādau tvaṅgasya igantatvaṃ sambhavati| tena cāṅge viśiṣyamāṇe tadantavidhau satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati| tasmādikai-vāṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, `igantasyāṅgasyeti| evaṃcaya satyasyāḥ sthānaṣaṣṭhītvāt <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityetadupatiṣṭhachate, tenegantasyaivāṅgasya guṇavṛddhī bhavataḥ,netarasya| `svasañjñayā` iti| atra vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ| `ika eva sthāne` iti|yadartheyaṃ paribhāṣā tasya niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati- `akārṣīt` iti| `ḍukṛñ karaṇa` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 1472),luṅa, <> [[3.1.44]] sici vṛddhiḥ [[7.2.1]] <<astisico'pṛkte>> [[7.3.96]] itīṭ| evam `ahārṣīt` iti| atra `hmañ haraṇe` (dhā|899) ityayaṃ viśeṣaḥ| `ika iti kim` ita| ekadeśadvāreṇa samudāyasya paryanuyogo veditavyaḥ| na hi `guṇavṛddhī`ityetāvatā vineggrahaṇenārthaḥ kaścit saṃgṛhrate| `yānam` iti| yāterlyuṭi guṇe vidhīyamāna āntaratamyādakāraḥ syāt| tataśca dvayorakārayoḥ `ato guṇe` (6.1.104pararūpatve kṛte `yanam` ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| `glāyati` iti| `glai mlai harṣakṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-903|904), atra sandhyakṣarasya aikārasya ekāro guṇaḥ syāt| tataścāyādeśe kṛte glayati ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| `umbhitā`iti| `ubha umbha pūraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1319,1320), tṛc, iṭ| atra vyañjanasya kārasyauṣṭhasya okāro guṇaḥ syāt| tataścāvādeśe kṛte `ubhavitā` ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt|atha kathaṃ svasañjñayā śiṣyamāṇāvityeṣa viśeṣo labhyate? na hi sūtresvasañjñāgrahaṇamastītyata āha `punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇam` ityādi| ihapūrvasūtrābhyāṃ guṇavṛddhigrahaṇamanuvartate| katasminnanuvartamāne yat punariha guṇavṛddharigrahaṇaṃ kriyatetasyaitat prayojanam- `yatra svasañjñayā guṇavṛddhī vidhīyete tatrāyaṃ niyamo yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇasāmarthyādanyatarasya guṇavṛddhigrahaṇasya sañjñāpradhānatvaṃ sampādyate| katena svasañjñayā vidhāne niyamo bhavatītyeṣo'-rtho labhyate| anyathā hi yadyevaṃ pūrvo niyamo nātrābhimataḥ syāt, tato niyatasya niya masya prakṛtaguṇavṛddhigrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhatvāt ṅittvavacam` ityādi| yadi ṅiti yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate tallakāre ṅiti syāt, tato liṅa eva ṅittvena cinuyādi-tyādau guṇapratiṣedhasya siddhatvāt <> [[3.4.103]] iti yat tasya yāsuṭo ṅdvicanaṃ tanna kuryāt, prathamasya ` [[2.4.85]] ityādinā tiṣo ḍādeśaḥ, ṭilopaḥ, `ārdhadhātukasya` [[7.2.35]] ityādineṭ| atheṭo vṛddherudāharaṇaṃ kasmānna pradarśitamityāha- `vṛddhiriṭo na sambhavati` iti| aṅgasya vṛddhirñṇidādau pratyaye vidhīyate iṭ cāyamārdhadhukabhavataḥ| na cārdhadhātukasyāṅasañjñāsti ñṇidādau pratyaye| tasmādiṭo vṛddhirna bhavati|antaraṃ chidraṃ vivaraṃ varṇaśūnyaḥ kāla ityarthaḥ| na saṃyogādeḥ>> [[7.2.43]] itīṭ, iha ca `saṃskriyate` iti <<guṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ>> [[7.4.29]] iti guṇaḥ- ityevamādayo'nye'pi bahavo doṣāḥ pratyekaṃ halāṃ sañjñitve bhāṣya udbhāvitāḥ| yadyapi tatraiva te `titaucchatram` iti| `tanoterḍauḥ sanvacca(da|u|1|160) iti ḍau-pratyaye ṭilope dvirvacane ca kṛte rūpam| `saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ`syāt iti| yadya-trākārasyokāreṇa sañjñā syādityabhiprāyaḥ| na ca lope satyukāropadeśasya vaiyathryamāśaṅkanīyam| yatra padasañjñā nāsti titaunītyādau, tatra śrūyamāṇatvāt| `pacati` iti rūpapratyudāharaṇam, `panasam` iti kāryapratyudāharaṇam `skoḥ saṃyogādyoriti lopaḥ `hrasvonapuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti hrasvatvaṃ prasajyeteti bhāvaḥ| nanu cocyate-anayeti karaṇe lyuṭi kṛte, tadantāt `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] ityādinā ṅīpā bhavitavyam, tataśac tadantena bahuvrīhau `mukhanāsikāvacanaḥ` iti nirdeśo nopapadyate? naitadasti; vacanaśabdo'yaṃ <> [[3.3.113]] iti bahulavacanāt karmasādhanaḥ- ucyata itivacano varṇe vartate, na nāsikāyām| ata evāha- `tayā ya uccāryate` iti|` uccāryate` iti karmaṇi lakāraḥ| evaṃ kṛtvā `mukhanāsikāvacanaḥ` iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yaṃ veditavyaḥ, na bahuvrīhiḥ| `anusvāsyaiva` iti| anusvāre hrucyamāne nāsikāyāśca vyāpāro na mukhasya ; tena tasyaiva syāt, na tu syāt ñamaṅaṇanānām ; nāpi `abhra ā~ apaḥ` (ṛ|5|48|1) ityātrārdhacandrākṛtervarṇasya; taduccāraṇe mukhasyāpi vyāpārāt| tataśca <> [[8.4.45]] ityetasmin kārye kartavye'nusvārasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na tu ṅakārādīnāmityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca prāsādavāsinyāyena teṣāmapi bhaviṣyati? yathā`prāsādavāsina ānīyantām` ityukte ye prāsāda eva nivasanti, teṣāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, ye'pi prāsāde bhūmau ca ubhayatra vasanti teṣāmapi| yathā hrabhaya ānīyante, tathehāpi `nāsikāvacanaḥ` ityetāvatyucyamāne nāsikāvacanasyānusvārasya mukhānasikāvacanānāṃca ṅakārādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati,tataścānusvārasya hi syādityayuktamuktam| evaṃ tuvaktavyam- anusvārasyāpi hi syāditi? naitadasti; iha hi trīṇi darśanāni sambhavanti,-` samasta evānunāsiko varṇao nāsikāvacano mukhavacanaśca` ityekaṃ darśanam; `pūrvabhāgastvasya mukhavacanaḥ` iti tṛtīyam| ubhayorapyanantarayordarśanayornāsikāmukhavacanebhāge tathānurāgaṃ karoti yathā'sāvapi nāsikāvacanabhāga iva lakṣyate| tatra yadetadanantaradarśana-dvayam, tasyānyarat pāṇinerabhimatam| na cāsmin prāsādavāsinyāya ekatrāpyavatarati| yadi hi ṅakārādayo nāsikāyo'pi sākalyenoccāryeran, mukhenāpi; tataḥ prāsādavāsinyāyena `nāsikāvacanaḥ` ityetāvatyukte teṣāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| na caivaṃ bhāgasyaiva; teṣāṃ nāsikayā mukhena coccāraṇāt| tadasati mukhagrahaṇe teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt, tadabhāve casañjñā na syāditi yuktamuktam- anusvanārasyaiva hi syāt` iti| `kacaṭatapānāṃ mā bhūt` iti| ete hi kakārādayo mukhenaivoccāryante, na nāsikayā; tataścāsati nāsikā-grahaṇe teṣāmeva syāt| evaṃ ca `śaktaḥ`, `suptam` kṛte, <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralope <> [[8.4.64]] iti yalope ca kṛte `āsyam` iti| etacca mukhāntarvarttināṃ tālvādīnāṃ vācakam| tatra yadi pūrvasyāsyaśabdasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃsyāt, kacaṭatapānāmapi savarṇasañjñā syāt, ṇyadantasyāsyaśabdasya vācye'rtheteṣāṃ tulyatvāt prayatnaviṣayasya| imamataddhitāntasyāsyaśabdasya grahaṇe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā taddhitāntasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti darśayannāha- `āsye bhavamāsyama` iti| kiṃ punastadityāha- `tālvādisthānama` iti| yasmin varṇā niṣpādyante, tat sthānam| āviśabdenanāsikādīnāṃ grahaṇam| nanu ca nāsikā mukhādvahirvṛttirāsyaṃ na bhavati? naitadasti; nahi mukhādbahirvarttinī nāsikeyaṃ vivakṣitā, tasyāṃ varṇānāmaniṣpatteḥ| kā tarhi? antarāsye carma vitatamasti paṇavacarmavat, tatsambaddhā rekhā, yasyāṃ vāyunābhihanyamā-nāyāṃ varṇā niṣpadyante seha nāsikā vivakṣitā| kathaṃ punarvijñāyate taddhitāntasyāsyaśabdasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti? āsyagrahaṇasāthryāt| yadi hrataddhitāntasya grahaṇaṃsyāt, āsyagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| sarveṣāmeva hi tadvācya evārthe prayatnastulyaḥ|nāstyeva hi saḥ, yasya vyavacchedārthamāsyagrahaṇaṃ syāt| nanu ca visarjanīyasya satya-sati vā savarṇatve prayojanamasti, nāpi doṣaḥ|`spṛṣṭatādiḥ` iti| ādiśabdena īṣatspṛ-ṣṭatādīnāṃ
