manyate-dvandvagarbhabahuvrīhāvāśrīyamāṇe tālvādinā sthānena prayatno na viśeṣitaḥ syāt| tataśca kakāraṅakārayormithaḥ savarṇasañjñā na syāt, bāhrasya prayatnasya bhinnatvāt| kakārasya vivṛtakaṇṭhatvādirbāhraḥ prayatnaḥ| ṅakārasya saṃvṛtakaṇṭhatvādiḥ| asatyāṃ ca savarṇasañjñāyāṃ śaṅkitetyatra <> [[8.4.58]] iti ṅakāro na syāt| atha satyapi bāhrasya prayatnasya bheda ābhyantaraḥ spṛṣṭatākhyo'nayostulyaḥ prayatnaḥ, taṃ samāśrityasavarṇasañjñā bhaviṣyati? yadyevam, śakāracakārasayorapi satyapyābhyantarayorvivṛtāspṛṣṭatayoḥ prayatnayorbhede yo'nayorbāhraḥ prayatnastulyo vivṛtkaṇṭhatvādistadāśrayā savarṇasañjñā syāt| tataśca `aruścyotati` iti vakṣya-māṇaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate|tha tripade tu bahuvrīhau tālvādisthānena prayatnoviśiṣyate| tena bāhraṃ prayatnamutsṛjyābhyantara eva spṛṣṭatādirgṛhrate| sa eva hi tālvādāvāsye sambhavati, netaraḥ| ābhyantarasya prayatnasya grahaṇe sati satyapi bāhra-prayatnabhede bhatatyeva kakāra ṅakārayoḥ savarṇasañjñā; ābhyantaraprayatnasya tulyatvāt,tasyaiva ceha grahaṇāt| na ca cakāraśakārayoḥ satyapi bāhrasya prayatnasya tulyatve savarṇasañjñā prasajati; tasyehāgrahaṇāt, yasya ca grahaṇaṃ tasya cāsamānatvāt| tasyāt tripada eva bahuvrīhirāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ; na dvandvagarbha iti| yadi tarhi tripado bahu-vrīhirāśrīyate, bhinnavibhaktikatvādaprādhānyāccāsyaṃ tulyatvenāviśeṣitaṃ bhavati, tataśca bhinnasthānānāmapi savarṇasañjñā prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ| yadādheyaṃ prati yadadhikaraṇamupadīyate, tadādheyatulyayaiva tat tulyamiti vijñāyate| tathā hi- `devadattayajñadattayostulyaṃ kāṃsyapātryāṃ bhojanam` ityukte kāṃsyapātryapi tayostulyetigamyate| yaṃ prati yastulyāsyaprayatnaḥ, sa tameva prati savarṇasañjño bhavatītyeṣo'-rtho yato vacanāllabhyata iha tannāsti| tataśca yo yaṃ prati tulyāsyaprayatnaḥ, sa tato'-nyamapi prati savarṇasañjñaḥ syāditi codyamāśaṅkyāha- `samānajātīyaṃ prati` iti| samānajātīyo yaṃ prati yastulyāsyaprayatnaḥ, taṃ prati sa savarṇasañjño bhavati, na tato'nyam| etacca tulyāsyaprayatnaśabdasya savarṇaśabdasya ca sambandhiśabdatvāllabhyate| sambandhiśabdo hranteraṇāpi śabdāntarasannidhiḥ niyameva sambandhinamupasthāpayati, yathā-`pitari śuśrūṣitavyam` iti| nocyate svasminniti, sambandhāccaitadavagamyate, `yo yasya pitā` iti| tathehāpi| yadyapi yo yasya tulyāsyaprayatnaḥ, sa taṃ prati savarṇasañjño bhavatīti,na cocyate, tathāpi sambandhāt tulyāsyaprayatnaḥ samānajātīyameva prati savarṇasañjño bhavatīti gamyate| atha vā samāno varṇaḥ `savarṇaḥ` ityanvarthasañjñeyam| tenatulyajātīyameva prati savarṇasañjño bhavati| evaṃ hi samāno'sya varṇo bhavati, yadi tameva prati savarṇasañjño bhavati, na vijātīyaṃ prati|`catvāraḥ` ityādi| dvividhāḥ prayatnāḥ, ābhyantarāḥ, bāhrāśca| tatrābhya-ntarāḥ catvāro vṛttarau darśitāḥ| bāhrāstvekādaśaṣa| ke punaste? `vivāraḥ, saṃvāraḥ,āāsaḥ, nādaḥ, ghoṣaḥ, aghoṣaḥ, alpaprāṇaḥ, mahāprāṇaḥ, udāttaḥ, anudāttaḥ, svaritaśca` iti| tatra nābhipradeśāt prayatnaprerito vāyuḥ prāṇo nāma ūdhrvamātrāmannuraḥprabhṛtīnāmanyatamasmin stāne prayatnena vidhāryate, sa vidhāryamāṇaḥ sthānamabhihanti, tataḥ sthānābhighātād dhvanirutpadyate| ākāśe sāvaṇryaśrutiḥ savarṇasyātmalābhaḥ| tatra varṇadhvanāvutpadyamāne yadā sthānamabhihanti, tataḥ sthānābhighātād dhvanirutpadyate| ākāśe sāvaṇryaśrutiḥ savarṇasyātmalābhaḥ| tatra varṇadhvanāvutpadyamāne yadā sthānakaraṇa-prayatnāḥ parasparaṃ ityanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāllabhyate| sa eva hi samaśabdaḥ sarveṣāṃ nāma bhavati yaḥ sarvaśabdaparyāyaḥ, na cānyoḥ prayogayoḥ samaśabdaḥ sarvaparyāyaḥ| tathā hi `samānām` ityatra samaśabdastulyārthe vartate| `same deśe` ityatrāpyaviṣame- nimnonnatādirahite| ata eva cānvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāt saṃjñopasarjanībhūtānāṃ saṃjñā na bhavati| yathā- sarvo nāma kaścit, tasmai sarvāya dehi| atikrāntaḥ ruārvamatisarvaḥ, tasmā atisarvāya dehīti| na hrevaṃprakārāṇi sarveṣāṃ nāmāni; viśiṣṭavsatu viṣayatvāt| `sarvanāmāni` ityatra`pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyām` [[8.4.3]] itiṇatvaṃ tu na bhavati, ata eva nipātanāt|`digupadiṣṭe` iti| diśāmupadiṣṭa ukto digupadiṣṭaḥ| sa punaḥ`diṅanāmānyantarāle` [[2.2.26]] iti yaḥ samāsastasyātra grahaṇam| sa punarlakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā labhyate| pratipadoktasamāsāśrayaṇaṃ tu yā pūrvā dik sottarā'syonmu-gdhasya, `asmai pūrvottarāya dehi` ityatrā mā bhūt| `uttarapūrvasmai` iti|uttarasyāśca pūrvasyāśca diśoryadantarālamiti pūrvoktena sūtreṇa bahuvrīhiḥ, `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ` (jai|pa|vṛ|103) iti pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ, caturthyekavacanam, <> [[7.3.114]] iti yāṭ, `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ|`samāsagrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| yāvatā na bahuvrīhiḥ samāsatvaṃ vyabhicaratyeva, tato'pārthakaṃ viśeṣaṇamityabhiprāyaḥ| `samāsa eva yo bahuvrīhi` iti| yasyātideśena bahuvrīhivadbhāvo na vidhīyate sa veditavyaḥ samāsa eva bahuvrīhiriti| sa punaryaḥ samāsādhikāre vihitaḥ| `bahuvrīhivadbhāvena` iti| yasyātideśikaṃ bahuvrīhitvaṃ sa bahuvrīhivadbhāvenabahuvrīhiḥ| `dakṣiṇadakṣiṇasyai` iti| <> [[8.1.9]] ityato bahuvrīhivaditi vartamāne <<ābādhe ca>> [[8.1.10]] iti dakṣiṇāśabdasya dvirvacanam| bahuvrīhi-vadbhāvācca subluk| ayaṃ bahuvrīhivadbhāvena bahuvrīhiriti vibhāṣā na pravartate| yo'pi <> [[1.1.29]] iti vakṣyamāṇaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ so'pīha na bhavati; tatrāpi samāsādhikārāta| `dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām` iti| atra <> [[1.1.31]] iti nitya eva pratiṣedho bhavati, tena pakṣe suṇna bhavati| yadyevam, `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre` (jai|pa|vṛ103) iti puṃvadbhāvo'tra na syāt; naitadasti; avayavasyādvandvatvāt| nanu vinā'pi bahuvrīhigrahaṇenātra <> [[1.1.31]] iti pratiṣedhena bhāvyameva; tadapārthakaṃ bahuvrīhigrahaṇam, naitadasti; yo hi digdvandvo na bhavati sa tasya viṣayaḥ syāt| digdvandve tvasati bahuvrīhigrahaṇe eṣaiva vibhāṣā syāt| tasmādbahuvrī-higrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam| kasmānna bhavati? `dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām` ityatra pratipadoktasamāsasyeha grahaṇāt| evaṃ tarhruttarārthaṃ bahuvrīhigrahaṇam| <> [[1.1.29]] ityatrāsya prayojanaṃ vakṣyati| vṛttikārasya tveṣo'bhiprāyaḥ- `uttarārthamavaśyakartavyam, taduttarārthaṃ kṛtamihāpi spaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyati` iti|`sarvanāmasaṃjñāyām` ityādi| kathaṃ puretadavagatam- abhyupagatastadantavidhiriti? ata eva pratiṣedhāt, anyathā hi niṣphalaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| tadantavidhyabhyupagame hi `paramasarvasmai uttamasarvasmai` ityatrāpi saṃjñā yathā syāt| `iha ca` ityādi| asya `pratiṣedha ārabhyate` ityanena sambandhaḥ| `tvaṃ pitā'sya, ahaṃ pitā'sya` iti vigṛhra bahuvrīhau kṛte'jñātādyarthavivakṣāyāmasati pratiṣedhe| <> [[5.3.71]] ityatrākac prasajyeta| tataśca `tvakatpita-kaḥ, makatpitṛkaḥ` ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| tasmādakaj mā bhūditi pratiṣeda ārabhyate| tena `prāgivāt kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] iti ka eva bhavati| tatra parataḥ <> [[7.2.98]] iti maparyanta-ryoryuṣmadasmadostvamayoḥ kṛtayoḥ <> [[5.4.153]] iti samāsānte kapi ca `tvatkapitṛkaḥ, matkapitṛkaḥ` iti siddhyati| nanu cānvarthasaṃjñākaraṇādeva saṃjñānirāse kṛte'kaj na bhaviṣyati-na hyatra sarvārthatā sambhavati, viśeṣaviṣayatvāt, naitadasti;samudāyo hi viśeṣe vartate, pūrvapadaṃ tu sarvārthatāyā anapetameva| bhavatvanayoranantarayo-rudāharaṇayoretatsūtraviṣayatā, `priyiāāya` ityādistu napapadyate; na hi priyaviāādayaḥ śabdāḥ sarveṣāṃ nāmāni nāpi tadavayavabhūtānāṃ viāādiśabdānāṃ kiñcit sarvanāmakā-ryamamupapadyate; smaiprabhṛtīnāmaṅgakāryatvāt, viāādiśabdānāṃ cānaṅgatvāt? evaṃ manyate- `tvatkapitṛkaḥ, katkapitṛkaḥ` ityatrākaj mā bhūditi, etadarthaṃ tāvadetadāra-bdhavyam, `priyaviāāya` ityevamādāvapi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti|atha `bahuvrīhau` iti vartamāne kimarthaṃ punarbahuvrīhagrahaṇamityāha- `bahuvrīhau` ityādi| `vastrāntaravasanāntarāḥ` iti| vastramantaraṃ yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhi kṛtvā vastrāntarāśca vasanāntarāśceti dvandvaḥ kṛtaṛ| atra vartamā-natvād dvandvasya <> [[1.1.31]] , <> [[1.1.32]] iti dvandvā-śrito vibhāṣāpratiṣedhaḥ syāt, na nityo bahuvrīhrāśritaḥ| punarbahuvrīhigrahaṇā-ttu bhūtapūrvasyāpi bahuvrīherāśrayamāt tadāśrayo nityaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati| vasanaśabda-ścātra vasatyasminnityadhikaraṇasādhano gṛhe vartate, na vastre; anyathā vastrāntaravasanāntaraśabdayoḥ paryāyatvād dvandvo na syāt, `tulyārthāñca virupāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ` ityekaśeṣavidhānāt|nanu ca <> [[1.1.28]] ityata samāsagrahaṇamanuvartata eva, tat kimarthaṃ punaḥ samāsagrahaṇamityata āha- `samāsa ityanuvartamāne` ityādi| astyeva tṛtīyāsamāso mukhyaḥ, yasmin satyaikapadyamaikasvaryamekavibhkatikatvaṃ ca bhavati| asti ca gauṇaḥ, yasmastādathryādatasminnapi tācchabadyaṃ bhavati| sa punastṛtīyāsamāsārthaṃvākyam| tatrāsati punaḥ samāsagrahaṇe `gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃpratyayaḥ` (vyā|pa|4) iti mukhya eva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| netaratra| tasmāt tatrāpi pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaḥ samāsagrahaṇam| yadi tarhi tṛtīyāsamāsārthe'pi vākye pratiṣedho bhavati,yāvān kaścit tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ, tadarthe vākye sarvatra pratiṣedhaḥ syāt; tataśca `tvayakā kṛtam, mayakā kṛtamityatrākaj na syāt| bhavati hretat <> [[2.1.32]] ityanena yaḥ samāsastadarthaṃ vākyam;tatra kapratyaye kṛte `tvatkena kṛtam, matkena kṛtam` iti rūpaṃ syādityata āha- `pūrvasadṛśa`ityādi| etacca lakṣamapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā labhyate|`tvayakā, mayakā` iti| pūrvavat tvamāvādeśau, subantādakac| kvacit tvakayā, makayā iti pāṭhaḥ sa tvayuktaḥ| prātipadikāt tvakajutpattau tvakayā makayeti bhavati, na cātra prātipadikādakajutpattiriṣyate; api tu subantāt| tathā hrakajvidhau vakṣyati-`prātipidakāt` supaḥ` iti ca dvayamapīhānuvartate| tatrābhidhānato vyavasthā- kvacit prātipadikasya prāk ṭeḥ pratyayo bhavati, kvacit subantasya| `yuṣmakābhiḥ,yuṣmakāsu, asmakāsu, yuvakayoḥ, āvayakayoḥ` ityatra prātipadikasya| tvayakā, mayakā,tvayaki,mayaki` ityatra subantasya` iti|`jasaḥ kāryaṃ prati` ityādi| etacc vyavasthitavibhāṣātvādasyā vibhāṣāyā labhyate| atha vā jasīti kāryāpekṣayā ādhārasaptamīyam, na tu sarvādyapekṣayā parasaptamī; tena jasi yat kāryam= jasādhāraṃ yat kāryaṃ jasaḥ śībhāvaḥ tatra vibhāṣā bhavati, nānyatra| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyata ityata āha-`akaj hi na bhavati` iti hi śabdo hetau|evaṃ vyākhyāyamāne sati `katarakatamakāḥ` ityatrākaj na bhavati; pūrvasūtreṇa saṃjñāpratiṣedhāt anyathā hi yadi jasi parataḥ saṃjñā vikalpyate,tadā pakṣe'kaj bhavedeva| tathā ca tasya tanmadhyapatitvāt tadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt pākṣikaḥ śībhāvaḥ prasajyeta| kapratyaye tu sati tena vyavadhānādevaiṣa doṣo na bhavati|ubhayaśabdasya tayappratyayāntasya` iti| `saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap` [[5.2.42]] ityubhaśabdādvihitasya tayapo yadyapi<> [[5.2.44]] ityayajādeśo vidhīyate, tathāpi sthānivadbhāvāt tadgrahaṇena gṛhrata ityubhayaśabdastayappratyayānto bhavati|`tasya gaṇe pāṭhānnityā sarvanāmasañjñā`iti| na tvanena yogena pareṇāpi pākṣikī| etacca vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāllabhyate| `kākacoryathāyogaṃ vṛttiḥ`iti| tenobhaya- nema-śabdayoḥ sarvāditvānnityamakaco vṛttiḥ, prathamādibhyastu kapratyayasya- ityeṣa yathā-yogārthaḥ||`asaṃjñāyām` iti| saṃjñāyāmasatyām pūrvādayaścet saṃjñārūpā na bhavantī-tyarthaḥ| `svābhidheyāpekṣa` ityādi avadhirmaryādā,tasya niyamo'vaśyambhāvaḥ; avadhibhā-vādabhraṃśaḥ|kiṃviśiṣṭo'vadhiniyamaḥ? svābhidheyāpekṣaḥ hrarthānām- pūrvādiśabdābhidhayānāṃ yat pūrvāditvam, tanniyogataḥ kañcanāvadhimapakṣya sampadyate, na tvavadhinirapekṣam; yathā- pūrvadeśasya yat pūrvatvam,tatparaṃ deśamapekṣya bhavati; parasyāpi yat paratvam, tat pūrvadeśam; tasmāt pūrvādiśabdavācyāpekṣeṇāvaśyaṃ kenacidavadhinā bhāvyam| tatra tasyaivāvadheḥ yaḥ pūrvādiśabdārthāpekṣo'vadhibhāva aikāntikaḥ, sa niyamo vyavasthā, tasyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ pūrvādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ svābhidheya eva vartamānānāmiyaṃ saṃjñā bhavati; na tu vācyāyām| yo hi pūrvādiśabdābhidheyādanyasyārthasyāvadhibhūtasyaniyamaḥ, sa kataṃ pūrvādiśabdavācyo bhaviṣyati!`pūrve,parvāḥ` iti| atra parasamādevāvadheriti gamyate| `pare,parāḥ`iti| pūrva-smādevāvaderiti gamyate| `pravīṇāḥ` iti| kuśalā ityarthaḥ| atra prāvīṇyamātreṇa nimittenāvadhinirapekṣa eva dakṣiṇaśabdo vartata iti vyavasthā na gamyate| `satyāmeva`ityādi| jambūdvīpaṃ vāvadhimapekṣya tatrottaraśabdo vartata iti vidyata eva vyavasthā|`atrāpi nityā sarvanāmasaṃjñā prāptā` iti| gaṇapāṭhāt| evamuttaratrāpi vedatavyam| `na cet` ityādinā jñātidhanākhyāśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| yatra ca śabdāntara-nirapekṣaḥ svaśabdo jñātidhane svarūpeṇācaṣṭe, tatrāsau saṃjñārūpeṇa tayorvartate| `ātmīyā ityarthaḥ` iti| kathaṃ punarayamarthaḥ, yāvatā `sve puttrāḥ` iti jñātyarthogamyate, `sve gāvaḥ` iti dhanārthaḥ? naitadasti; puttragośabdasānnidhyādatadubhayaṃgamyate| svaśabhdenātmīyatvamātraṃ gamyate- `svā jñātayaḥ` iti| prabhūtā svā iticobhayatra śabdāntaramanapekṣya jñātidhane svarūpeṇaiva svaśabdenābhidhīyete| yadyevam, jñātaya ityanuprayogo nopapadyate; paryāyatvāt, yathā- vṛkṣaśabdaprayoge sati taruśabda-śabdasyānuprayogo virudhyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; paryāyaśabdasya hi yatrānekārtho bhavati sandigdhārtho vā, tatra tadarthasyaiva vyaktīkaraṇārthaḥ paryāyāntarasyānuprayogo navirudhyate; yathā- meghādyanekārthavṛttervarāhakaśabdasya prayoge śūkaraśabdasya prayogaḥ| tathā sandigdhārthasya pikaśabdasya prayoge kokilaśabdasya ! svaśabdaścāyamanekārthaḥ, tatrāsatyanuprayoge kiṃviṣayo'yaṃ prayuktaḥ- iti sandeha syāt|`barhiryoge` iti| bahirityanenānāvṛtadeśa ucyate| tena yogo barhiryogaḥ| sa cānāvṛtasya bāhrasya vastuno bhavati| `upasaṃvyāne ca` iti| upasaṃvīyate paridhīyate yattadupasaṃvyānam- <> [[3.3.113]] iti karmaṇai lyuṭ| atha vā, saṃvīyatepidhīyate'neneti saṃvyānam- <> [[3.3.117]] iti lyuṭ| saṃvyānasya samīpamupasaṃkhyānam| abahiryoge sāmarthyāt tadeva veditavyam| `nagarabāhrāḥ` iti| anena bahiryogaṃ darśayati- `paridhānīyamucyate` iti| upasaṃvyānsayedamudāharaṇamupanyastam| vastrāntarāvṛtavastu vastvantareṇāpihitamucyate| aviśeṣābhidhāna'pi yadvastrāntareṇāvṛtam, sāmarthyāt tadevopasaṃvyānamucyate, netarat| `na prāvaraṇīyam` iti| prāvriyate'pidhīyate-neneti prāvaraṇīyam, tannabhidhīyate| tadabhidhāne tasya bahiryogatvātbahiryoga evedamudāharaṇaṃ syādityābhiprāyaḥ|`antare tāpasaḥ prativasati` iti| atra saṃjñāyā abhāvāt saptamyāḥ sminnādeśo na bhavati| nanu ca jasītyanuvarte, tat kasmāt saptamyantaṃ pratyudāhṛtamityata āha-`guṇasūtrasya ca` ityādi| `apurīti vaktavyam` iti| anantaraṃ `gaṇasūtrasya ca`ityabhidhānād gaṇasūtramevaitad vaktavyamiti gamyate| yadyapi gaṇasūtre'ntaraśabda paṭhate,tathāpi `pratipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|29) iti prākārādba-hirvarttinī yā pūstasyā api bahiryogo'stīti tatra vartamānasya ṭābantasyāpyantarāśabdasya sarvanāmasaṃjñā prāpnoti, tenāpurīti vaktavyam| tenāntarāyāmityatra syāṇ na bhavati| `vibhāṣāprakaraṇe` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasyeha pratipādanamarthaḥ|asmin vibhāṣāprakaraṇe tīyapratyayāntasya sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāḥ pratipādanaṃ kartavyami-tyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam <> [[1.1.32]] ityatra `vibhāṣā` iti yoga-vibhāgaḥ kriyate, tatra ca `sarvādīni` `dvandve` iti ca nivṛttam, tena tīyasya vibhāṣā sarvanāmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti| na caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅgaḥ; yogavibhāgadiṣṭasiddheḥnāpi `vibhāṣā dvitīyatṛtīyābhyām` [[7.3.115]] ityasya vaiyathryāpattiḥ; prapañcārtatvāt| tataḥ `jasi` dvitīyo yogaḥ| atra vibhāṣāgrahaṇam, sarvādigrahaṇam, dvandvagrahaṇaṃ cānuvartate|svarādiṣu svastiśabdo'stiśabdaśca paṭhate| tatra svastiśabdasya kimarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ? yāvatāstiśabdapāṭhādeva tadantavidhinā svastiśabdasyāpi bhaviṣyati| `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena ` (vyā|pa|89) iti tadantavidhi pratiṣedhānna sidhyatītyetat tu nāśaṅkanīyam, `avyayam` iti mahatī saṃjñā kriyate, anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyetaliṅgakārakasaṃkyāviśeṣānupādānna vyeti= vividhatvaṃ na gacchatītyavyayam| tasyāścopasarjanapratiṣedhaḥ, tadantavidhiśca prayojanam| tasmādanvarthasaṃjñakaraṇādeva tadantasyāpi bhaviṣyati, svastiśabdo'pi na vyetyeva, satyametatevaṃ tvanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāllabdhastadantavidhirananopada-rśitaḥ| vispaṣṭārthamudāharaṇametat| `tasilādistaddhita edhācparyantaḥ` iti| `pañca-myāstasil` [[5.3.7]] ityata prabhṛti`edhācca` [[5.3.46]] ityetatparyantaḥ|`śastasī`iti| <> [[5.4.42]] <> [[5.4.44]] `kṛtvasuc` iti| `saṃkhyāyaḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc` [[5.4.17]] iti| `dvitricatubhryaḥ suc` [[5.4.18]] | `āsthālau` iti| `iṇa āsiḥ` (da|u|9|81) ityuṇā-disūtreṇa iṇo dhātorāsipratyayaḥ| `ayāḥ` ityudāharaṇam| `pratnapūrvaviomātthāl chandasi` [[5.3.111]] iti| `cvyarthāśca` iti| abhūtatadbhāve `kṛbhyastiyoge sampadya-kartari cviḥ` [[5.4.50]] `vibhāṣā sāti kātrsnye` [[5.4.52]] | `ām` iti| `kime-ttiṅavyayadhādāmvadravyaprakarṣe` [[5.4.11]] | `nipātā vakṣyante` iti| atha kasmāt te svarādiṣu na paṭhante? kaḥ purevaṃ guṇo bhavati? avayayasaṃjñāyāṃ nipātagrahaṇaṃ tathā hi kriyāyoge dṛśyate-`svaḥ paśyanti, svarārohanti` iti| tatra yadi cādayo nipātāḥ paṭhaeran, teṣāṃ sattve'pi vartamānānāmavyayasaṃjñā prasajyeta|`avyayam` ityanvarthasaṃjñeyam` iti darśayitumāha- `sadṛśam` iti| triṣu liṅgeṣu strīpuṃnapuṃsakeṣu sadṛśaṃ tulyam, liṅgaviśeṣāparigrahālliṅgasāmānyopā-dānācca| `sarvāsu ca vibhaktiṣu` iti| vibhaktinimittatvād vibhaktiḥ| vibhajyate vā prātipadikārtha ābhiriti sakārasyaiva tu sthāne syāt|hyatrājantyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? sakāraḥ| tasmānnirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhīyamiti darśayannāha-`acāmityādi| jātau bahuvacam| sūtre'pyaca ityekavacanaṃ jātāveva| yadi tarhi nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhīyam, antyasyāviśeṣitatvādaviśeṣeṇa yataḥ kutaścidantyāt paro mit syāt; na hidvītīyamajgrahaṇamasti, yenāntyo diśeṣyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; samānajātīyasyaiva hi loke nirdhāraṇapratītirbhavati| tathā hi `kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannaśrīratamā` ityukte gaureva pratīyate; nājā, nāpyaāā| tasasmādihāpyacāṃ madhye'ntyādaco'vadherityantyatvena nirdhāryamāṇaḥ samānajātīyo'jeva| (7||72)payāṃsi| pratyayaparatvāpavādārtham- <> [[3.1.78]] ,ruṇaddhi| nanu ca `purastāda-pavādā anantarān vidhīn bādhante nottarān (vyā|pa|9) iti sthāneyogitvasyaivāpavādo yujyate, na tu yathā-bahujakacorantodāttatvam| `bahupaṭavaḥ, uccakaiḥ` ityanayorasati paratve satyaṃ pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ `citaḥ` [[6.1.157]] ityantodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva| `masjeḥ` ityādi| nakārasyopadhāyā `anuṣaṅgaḥ` [[8.3.24]] ityanusvāraḥ| <> [[8.4.58]] ṅakāraḥ| pūrvabhaktaścāyaṃ mid veditavyaḥ; anyathā <> [[3.2.32]] iti lihaḥ khaśi kṛte <> [[6.3.67]] iti mumi kṛte vahaṃlih ityatra <<mo'nusvāraḥ>> [[8.3.23]] iti cāniyamaprasaṅgaḥ? yatra sandehaḥ; yathā-<> [[2.4.52]] iti| atra hi kimasteḥ sthāne? āhosvidanantare? iti sandehaḥ, pūrvatra tūpadhāyā avayavalakṣaṇasya sthānino viśiṣṭāvayavino vyavacchinnatvādavayavaṣṭhaeveyamiti niścitam; tato nātrāsyā vyāpāraḥ| `sthāneyogaiva` iti| sthāna iti nimittasaptamī, yogaḥsambandhaḥ| tenedamuktaṃ bhavati-sthānanimittakasambandhaiveti| etadeva ityarthaḥ| nimittagrahaṇaṃ kurvan sūtre sthāneyogeti nimittasapta-mīyamiti darśayati| yogaḥ punariha sthānyādeśabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| kuta etat? tasyaiva sthāni-hetutvāt| sthānaśabdobhāvasādhanaḥ, sthitiḥ sthānam| tat punastridhā- `apakarṣaḥ,nivṛttiḥ,prasaṅgaśca` iti| gosthāne'āo badhyatāmityapakarṣaḥ sthānaśabdasyāstheyaḥ| `śleṣmaṇaḥ sthāne kaṭukamauṣadham` ityatra nivṛttiḥ| `darbhāṇāṃ sthāne śarairāstakarita-vyam` iti prasaṅgaḥ| tatrādyāvarthāviha na sambhavataḥ; nityatvācchabdārthasambandhasya prathamo na sambhavati; sāmānyenāsterupadeśānna dvitīyaḥ| tasmāt tṛtīya evārtha iti matvāha-`stānaśabdaśca` iti| prasaṅgastvarthakriyānimittabhūtasya kālasyāvasaraḥ| `astesthāne prasaṅge` iti| asteryā kriyā svārthapratipādanalakṣaṇā, tasyā nimittabhūtasya kālasyāvasaraḥ prāpta ityarthaḥ| prasaṅge sambandhasya nimittabhūta ityādinā sūtrārthasyodāharaṇe sambhavaṃ darśayati| `brāuvaḥ` iti copalakṣaṇamātram| asteri-tyāderapi hi ṣaṣṭhī prasaṅga eva sambandhasya nimittabhāva utpannā|ke punarbahavaḥ ṣaṣṭharthāḥ, yataḥ sambandhāntaraviṣayavyavacchedanārthaṃ ṣaṣṭhaā idamucyate? ityāha-`bahavo hi` ityādi| śabde hi samīpānantaravikārāvayavādinimittāḥ sambandhāḥ santi| na tvapatyāpatyavatprabhṛtaya ityato `yāvantaḥ śabde sambhavanti` ityāha| atha sthāneyoga ita kimasamāsaḥ? atha samāsaḥ? yadyasamāsaḥ? tadā yogaśabdasyapuṃlliṅgatvāt strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīśabdena ca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti; yogasyāṣaṣṭhītvāt| ataḥ samāsaḥ kiṃ tatpuruṣaḥ? āhosvid bahuvrīhiḥ? yadi tatpuruṣaḥ? tau ca pūrvoktau doṣau syātām, saptamyā lukaprasaṅgaśca| atha bahuvrīhiḥ? evamapi lukprasaṅgo'trānivārya evetyata āha-`ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā` ityādi| gatārtham|paribhāṣeyamādeśaniyamārthā|`sthāne prāpyamāṇānām` iti| etena nedaṃ vidhāyakaṃ vākyam, kiṃ tarhi? lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāptānāmanantaratamānāmitareṣāṃ ca yo'ntaratamaḥ, sa eva bhavatīti niyamārthamiti darśayati| vidhāyakatve hi `dadhi madhu` itādāvapi prasajyate| kiṃ punaratrāniṣṭam? yāvatāntaratamyād dadhimadhuśabdayostāvevādeśau bhaviṣyataḥ, tayorapyādeśayoranyau dadhimadhuśabdau yāvādeśau syātām, tayorapyanyāvityevamaparisamāptādeśapara-mparāvidhānādanavasthā syāt| tataścārthapratyāyanaṃ prati śabdānāṃ viniyogo na syātnvākhyāyakasya śāstrasya pravṛttyanuparamāt| śāstroparatau hranvākhyātāste prayujyate, nānyathetyaniṣṭam| nanu ca sakṛtpravṛttau lakṣaṇasya caritārtatvāt punaḥ pravṛttirna bhaviṣyati, naitadastica yatra hi prayojanārthā pravṛttistatraitaduktam, iha punarakasmādantaratamo vidhīyata ityanuparataivāsya pravṛttiḥ| niyamākatve'pyasya yadīdaṃ vihitānāṃ niyamaṃ kuryāt ! pararūpatvam, <> [[7.1.14]] iti smaibhāvaḥ| bhyāmi `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghaḥ, tato hrasvasya hrasva ukāro bhavati, dīrghasya dīrghaḥ|`sthāne iti vartamāne` iti| prakṛto hi sthānaśabdaḥ kriyate, sthāne prāpyamāṇānāmantaratama ādeśo bhavati| `sthāne ca bhavati` iti pūrvatra vākye prasaṅgavācī sthāśabdaḥ, uttaratra tālvādisthānavācī| evaṃ vākyabhedena sambandhe sati, pūrvasmin vākye sthānādikṛtānāmāntaryāṇāṃ -parigrahaḥ pratīyate| dvitīye tu teṣāmeva balābalavattvam| `sthāne` iti ca nimittasaptamī| tenedamuktaṃ bhavati- yatrānekamāntaryaṃ tatra sthānena nimittena yo'ntaratamaḥ, sa eva bhavati| vākyabhedasya ca tamabgrahaṇaṃ liṅgam| sādṛśye prakarṣo hi tena pratipādayitumiṣṭaḥ| sa cānekasmin sādṛśye sati sādṛśyāntarāpekṣayā bhavati| ekavākyatāyāṃ ca sthānagrahaṇena sādṛśyāntare niraste kimapekṣayā sādṛśyaprakarṣaḥ syāt ! tasmāt tama-bgrahaṇād vākyabhedo'numīyate, anyathā hi tasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt|`cetā` iti| atrekārasya tālavyatvādekārasya kaṣṭhatālavyatvāt `soṣmaṇaḥ, soṣmāṇa iti ` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau; yasmāt soṣmāṇo dvitīyastasmāt soṣmaṇo hakārasyadvitīyāḥ prasaktā ityarthaḥ| evaṃ `nādavato nādavantaḥ` ityādau vākye hetvarthoyojyaḥ| `śādaya ūṣmāṇaḥ sasthānena dvitīyā hakāreṇa caturthāḥ` iti śikṣā (ā|śi|1|4|dvitīyāḥ` ityanena tu vargadvitīyānāṃ khakārādīnām| `hakāreṇa caturthāḥ` ityanenāpi vargacaturthānāṃ dhakārādīnām| samānaṃ sthānaṃ yasya sa sasthānaḥ| `sasthānena` iti| ittha-mbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā| sasthānena dvitīyā ūṣmatayā lakṣyante| etaduktaṃ bhavati- `yathā sasthāna eveṣāmūṣmā, evamete'pi vargāṇāṃ dvitīyā ūṣmāṇaḥ` iti| atha vā - tulyārthayoga eṣā tṛtīyā, tulyaśabdastvadhyāhāryaḥ, tulyatvamūṣmatayā veditavyam| tatra khakārasya sasthāno hakāraḥ, chakārasya śakāraḥ, ṭhakārasya ṣakāraḥ, thakārasya sakāraḥ| phakārasya sasthāna ūṣmā nāsti| tasmāt tasyāpi viśeṣeṇoṣmatvaṃ lakṣyante, tatsadṛśatvāt| tena yathā hakāra ūṣmā evaṃ te'pītyarthaḥ| `nādavataḥ` ityādi| `vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthāḥ` ityādinā pūrvoktena granthena tṛtīyānāṃ hakārasya nādavattvamuktam| ye soṣmāṇo `nādavantaśca` iti| soṣmatvaṃ hakārasya `śādaya ūṣmāṇaḥ` (ā|śi|1.4.8) ityanenākhyātam,caturthānāṃ tu `hakāreṇa caturthāḥ` (ā|śi| 1.4.1) ityanena nādavattvam, ubhayeṣāṃ vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā ityādinaiva pūrvoktena|atra trayaḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti- `uḥ sthāne'ṇ raparatvaṃ cānenobhayaṃ vidhīyate` ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ| `lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihitasyāṇa uḥ sthāne paścādanena raparatvamātraṃ kriyate` iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ| `uḥ sthāne lakṣaṇāntareṇa vidhīyamāno'ṇa vidhānakāla eva tena lakṣaṇāntareṇa saha saṃhatya raparatvaviśiṣṭo'nena bhāvyate` iti tṛtīyaḥ| tatra [[6.2.49]] iti prakṛtisvare kṛte <> [[6.1.158]] ityanudātto na syāt, <> [[8.4.66]] iti svaritaśca| yadyacaḥ sthāne udāttādayo vidhīyante, tathāpi teṣāmanyo'javakāśa itiṛvarṇasthāne pratipadokto'ṇeva raparaḥ syāt| ye cāpyanya ṛvarṇasthāne pratipadamādeśā ucyante, `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] ityevamādibhirlakṣaṇāntaraisteṣu raparatvaṃ nasyāt; tataśca `kirati` ityādi na sidhyet|atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣa vṛddhisaṃjñakenāntaratamyaviśeṣo nāstīti sarve vṛddhisaṃjñakāḥ paryāyeṇa prasajyeran| tathā ca pakṣe `nāyakaḥ, stāvakaḥ` ityā-dyapyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| ityevamādyayoḥ pakṣayordoṣavattāṃ dṛṣṭvā, tṛtīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha- `uḥ sthāne'ṇ prasajyamāna eva`ityādi| etena lakṣaṇāntareṇa vidhīyamāna-syāṇo vidhānakāla eva tena saha saṃhatya raparatvaviśiṣṭas vidhāviyaṃ paribhāṣā vyāpriyata iti darśayati| etacca sthānadvayagrahaṇasyātrānuvṛtterlabhyante| pūrvakeṇa hi sthānagraha-ṇenehānuvṛttau `uḥ sthāne` ityatadartharūpaṃ labhyate| dvitīyena tu prasajyamānaityetat| tathā hi- sthānagrahaṇaṃ saptamyantaṃ tena nāstyaicorajapekṣaṃ pūrvatvamiti na bhavati sthānivadbhāvaḥ, tadabhāvādaicorāyāvāvapi na prāpnutaḥ; kintvatra `acaḥ` ityetadā-deśaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ ṣaṣṭhantaṃ pratijñātam, na tu pañcamyantam| tadā cācaḥ tadā pañcamya-ntaṃ sampadyate| ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ - iha `tanvanti` ityupratyayasya yaṇādeśakṛta iṭprāpnoti, na hyatrācaḥ pūrvasya vyavasthitasya kiñcitkāryaṃ vidhīyate; yato yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvādiḍāgamo na syāt| tṛtīye tu pakṣe yaṇādeśa eva nimittāt pūrvaḥ| tasya vyavasthitasyeṭi vidhātavye sthānivadbhāvo labhyata iti na bhavati tanvantītyatreṭprasaṅgaḥ; kintvādye pakṣe yo doṣaḥ, sa ihāpi prasajyeta| `vaiyākaraṇaḥ, sauvaām` ityatrāpi yvau nimittāt pūrvau bhavata iti| nanu ca nimittāt pūrvasya kārye vidhātavye sthānivadbhāva ucyate, na ceha nimittāt pūrvayorvyoḥ kiñcit kāryaṃ vidhīyate| na hrāyāvādeśau yvoḥ kāryam, kiṃ tarhi? aicaḥ,naitadasti; aico hi yat kāryaṃ tad yvorapi sambandhi bhavatyeva, tayostadbhaktayostadavayavabhūtatvāt|atrocyate - ādyantayoḥ pakṣayoryo doṣa uktaḥ, sa tāvanna bhavati; yasmād bahiraṅgāvaicau, taddhitaśrayatvādaṅgāśrayatvācca; antaraṅgāvāyāvau, taddhitanirapekṣatvād varṇāśrayatvācca| `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|42) ityasiddhatvādaicorāyāvau nabha bhaviṣyataḥ| itarasminnapi pakṣe yo doṣa uktaḥ, so'pi na bhavatyeva; tatra karmasādhane sarvamiṣṭaṃ na sidhyatīti bhāvasādhanopyāśrīyate| tena tanvantītyatreṭa evāpariniṣpanna-syācaḥ pūrvasya vidhāne kartavye sthānivadbhāvaḥ siddho bhavati| karmasādhane'pyadoṣaḥ; yaṇādeśa evātrācaḥ pūrvaḥ, tasya vidhāne kartavye eva| na hi yaṇādeśāt pūrvasyavyavasthitasya kasyacidiḍ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? yaṇādeśasyaiva| bhāvasādhane tu tasminnadoṣaḥ; yaṇādeśāt pūrvasyāpariniṣpannasyeṭa eva vidhānāt| tasmāt tatrāpi pakṣe bhāvasādhana eva vidhiśabdo'ṅgīkartavyaḥ|`paṭayati` iti| `tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe` iti ṇic, `ṇāviṣṭhavat prātipadikasya`(vā|813)iti ṭilopaḥ| nanu cātra vyavadhānāt pūrvatvaṃ na sambhavati; naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyavahite'pi hi pūrvaśabdo vartate, yathā-`mathurāyāḥ pūrvaṃ pāṭaliputram` iti| nanu ca dvitīyā samarthāṇṇijutpadyate, tatrāntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ jaśtve sati paḍayatīti bhavitavyam| ṭilopasya sthānivadbhāvājjaśtvaṃ na bhavatīti cet, na; jaśtvavidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `tadācaṣṭe` ityatra hi taditi na dvitīyāsamarthāditi, kutastarhi? karmaṇi iti| kuta etat? arthanirdeśa-paratvāt| etaduktaṃ bhavati- karmasaṃjñakāt tadācaṣṭa ityasminnarthe ṇij bhavatīti| tasmādasubandhāṇṇijutpatteḥ padasaṃjñāyā abhāvājjaśtvaṃ na pravartate| `avadhīt` iti| hanterluṅa, `hano kenacidācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratipāditāḥ, kenacittu `tugvirahitasya śuddhasya` ityevam, ubhayaṃ caitat pramāṇam| dvaitatve tatrāṅgena vā cchvau viśeṣyete, chakāravakārābhyāṃ vāṅgamiti| tatrādye nimittābhāvāt tuko nivṛttiḥ; yathā - sthātetyatra ṣatvanivṛttau ṣṭutvasya| atra pakṣe praśna ityetat pratyudāharaṇamajgrahaṇasya| yadyatra sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt, tukaḥ pratyāvṛttirbhavet; niṣṭhāyāmiṭpratiṣedhaḥ| atha punarekāceti tatrānuvartate, tatra niṣṭhāyām `atra bhavitavyamiḍāgamena` iti| seḍgrahaṇamanarthakaṃsyāt; tat kriyate kālāvadhāraṇārtham| iḍāgame kṛte ṇilopo yathā syāt` iti| akṛte tasmaṣṭilope sati kāritamityatra `ekāca upedeśe'nudāttāt` [[7.2.10]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ iṭaḥ prasajyeta| yadi ca rapūrvasmād vidhau kartavye nityaṃ sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt, ṇilopasya āśrīyate, kvacit karmasādhanaḥ| tatra dvirvacanavidhau bhāvasādhanaḥ, tatra hi tadeva vidhātavyam, na hi tasyāvasthitasya kiñcit kāryam| anyatra tu karmasādhanaḥ| tatra hi vyavasthitasya padāntādeḥ tasmādavadheravadhimattantratānirāsārtha eveti-śabdaḥ` iti, atrocyate; yadyavadherevottarasya kāryaṃ yathā syādavadhimato mā bhūdityevama-rthaṃ itikaraṇo'vadheravadhimattantratāmapākartuṃ kriyate, nāvadhimataḥ|yadapyuktam - <> [[6.1.103]] ityatrāpi pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt pūrvaḥ śas na sambhavati` iti, tadapyayuktam;tathā hraśabdādiśabdācca śasi parataḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghatve pūrvatra ca vṛkṣādiśabde śasante vyavasthāpite gacchata ān vṛkṣānupalabhate gacchato vṛkṣānānupalabhata ityatra pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt pūravaṃ śaś sambhavatyeva|atha yatrobhayanirdeśastatra kasya kāryeṇa bhavitavyam? tatra yānavakāśā setarasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati, ataḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati| yathā <<āne muk>> [[7.2.82]] ityatra saptamī niravakāsā <> [[7.2.80]] ityata iti pañcamyāḥpūrvasūtre sāvakāśāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| tathā `īdāsaḥ` [[7.2.83]] iti pañca-myā''na iti pūrvasūtre sāvakāśāyāḥ saptamyāḥ| yatrobhe sāvakāse tatra paratvāt pañcamī saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati| yathā - <<āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ>> [[7.1.52]] iti<<ājjaserasuk>> [[7.1.50]] ityatra pañcamī sāvakāśā| `āmi` iti saptamyuttarārthā| tatrāditi pañcamī āmīti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayati, tena sarvanāmna uttarasyāmaḥ suḍ bhavati| iha tu <> [[6.1.75]] <> [[6.1.76]] iti, yadyapi`cche ca` [[6.1.71]] iti saptamī pūrvasūtre sāvakāśā, tathāpi tasyāḥ svarittvāt pūrvayogādanuvṛttāyā niravakāśatvam| ataḥ sā ca saptamī pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| pañcamī tu paurvaparyaṃ prakalpya sāvakāśā nivartate| tenāyaṃ sūtrārtho bhavati- dīrghāduttaro yacchaḥ, tasmin parataḥ pūrvasya dīrghasyaiva tug bhavatīti| <> [[3.1.67]] ityatra niravakāśāpi saptamī dhātoriti pañcamyāḥ sāvakāśāyā api ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ na prakalpayati; anyathā hi dhātorevādeśā yagādayaḥ syuḥ| tataśca `paraśca` [[3.1.2]] ityasyānuvṛttasya bādhād yagādīnāṃ cānubandhakaraṇasya vayathryaṃ prasajyeta| na hi dhātvādeśatve sati teṣāṃ paratvamupapadyate tu te dhātoḥ pare bhavanti||`śāstre svameva` ityādi| śāstragrahaṇaṃ loke'rthasyaiva grāhratvāt| śabdasyeti <> [[2.3.71]] iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī, śabdaḥ svameva rūpaṃ grāhayati bodhayati, pratyāyayatītyarthaḥ| kaḥ punaḥ śabdasya svarūpasya ca bhedaḥ? yena śabdasyeta vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| paramārthato vastugato nāstyeva bhedaḥ| tathā hi - svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya svabhāvaḥ| taccet tato'rthāntaraṃ syāc śabdasya vaisvabhāvyamevasyāt| asatyapi tu vāstave bhede buddhiviracitaṃ bhedamāśritya ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| buddhirhi svabījaparipākavaśādākāraviśeṣaparigrahavatyupajāyamānā vastuno'satyapi bhede bhedamāpādayati, yathā - rāhoḥ śiraḥ, svasya svabhāva iti| `na bāhro'rthaḥ` iti evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayati|atiprasaktasyāpavādamāha - `aśabdasaṃjñā` ityādi| kimarthaṃ punaridamārabhyataityāha - `śabdena` ityādi| śabdenoccāritenārthaḥ kāryopayogitayā gamyate, na śabda-svarūpam| tathā hi - gaurupalabhyatamityukte'rthamevopalabdhumādriyate, na śabdasvarūpam; vyākaraṇe tu pratyayavidhānādikāryamarthasya na sambhavati; tena saha śabdasya paurvāparyābhāvāt| na cārthād vihitena pratyayena kaścit prakṛtopayogaḥ| tena <> [[4.2.33]] ityukte nāyaṃ saṃpratyayo bhavati| agniśabdasya yo'rthaḥ, sa iha kāryī, tasyedaṃ kāryaṃ vidhīyata iti| tataśca tasyārthasya ye vācakāḥ vidheyamiti| yathā - ākṛtivādināṃgaurduhratāmiti śabdena jātau coditāyāṃ tatra tatkāryāsambhavāt tadādhārāyāṃ vyaktau saṃbhavāt tatsāhacaryācca tasyāmeva vyaktau saṃpratyayo bhavati, na jātau; tathehāpi tanmā bhūt tadvācināṃ saṃpratyaya ityevamarthamidamārabhyate| tadvācināmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī|tadvācino mā vijñāyītyevamarthamidamārabhyata ityarthaḥ|tatra kecidāhuḥ - svarūpasya paryāyāṇāṃ ca kārye prasakte śrūyamāṇasyaivatad yathā syāt, paryāyāṇāṃ bhūditi niyamārthā paribhāṣeyamiti|anye tu - ` liṅgavatī paribhāṣā bhavati` , yathā, <> [[1.1.3]] iti guṇavṛddhī liṅgam| vidhyantaraśeṣabhūtā vā; yathā - `vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam` (kāta|pa|67) iti parasya vidhyantarasya śeṣabhāvamāpadyate| na vāsyā liṅgaṃ vidhyantaraśeṣabhāvo vā vidyata iti saṃjñāsūtramidam` iti pratipannāḥ| yadyapi vṛttau saṃjñāśabdo noccārinaḥ, tathāpi `svameva rūpaṃ śabdasya grāhram` ityevaṃ brāuvatā vṛttikāreṇa saṃjñaivetyākhyātaṃ bhavati| agniśabdādau śabdāntaraiḥ sādhāraṇamapi rūpamasti śabdatvādi, asādhāraṇamapi agniśabdatvādi, tatra sādhāraṇarūpavyudāsenāsādhāraṇasyāgniśabdatvādi-rūpasya parigrahārthaṃ `svam` grahaṇam| taddhi svameva tasya rūm, itarat punaḥ parasyāpi| pratīti pratyanupadeśācchabdasya svarūpamevāsannam, nārthaḥ; viparyayāt, aheyatvā-cca, tannityasambandhitvācca| tathā hranukaraṇaśabdā hrarthaṃ jahati, na tu svarūpam| asādhāraṇañca rūpamrthastu sādhāraṇaḥ; śabdāntarairapi pratyāyamānatvāt|tadevamāsannatvānnityasambadhitvādasādhāraṇatvācca rūpameva śabdasya svam,nārthaḥ| tataśca svagrahaṇādeva rūpaparigrahe siddhe vyākaraṇe rūpavadartho'pyaṅgīkriyata iti jñāpanārthaṃ rūpagrahaṇam| tena - `arthavadgrahaṇena nānarthakasya` (vyā|pa|1) ityetadupapannaṃ bhavati| śabdānuśāsananaprastāvādeva ca śabdasyeti siddhe śabdagrahaṇam - yatra śabdaparo nirdeśastatra svarūpaṃ gṛhrate, nārthaparo nirdeśa iti jñāpanārtham| tena <> [[3.4.40]] ityatra svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| arthaparatvaṃ tu nirdeśasyāvicchinnapāramparyādācāryopadeśādvijñāyate|`āgneyam` iti| agnirdevatā'syetyatrārthe ḍhak|`audaiātkam` iti| ātrāpyudaiātā saṃskṛtamityatrārthe ḍhak| `udaiāto-'nyatarasyām` [[4.2.18]] ityatra <> [[4.2.18]] ityasyānuvatteḥ, `isusu-ktāntātkaḥ` [[7.3.51]] iti ṭhakaḥ kādeśaḥ|`ghagrahaṇeṣu` ityādi| yadi ghuprabhṛtirapi saṃjñāśabda svarūpasya grāhakaḥ syāt <> [[3.3.92]] ityatra yadyapi dhātvadhikārastathāpi ghugrahaṇād ghuśabdāt kipratyayaḥ syāt| upasargagrahaṇaṃ tu prādyupalakṣaṇārtha syāt| yathā - `añ nāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ, nasañcāsthūlāt` [[5.4.118]] <> [[5.4.119]] ityatra| kumārīgha ityatra ca gha iti saṃjñāśabdena svarūpapratyāyane sati <<gharūpakalpacelaḍbruvagotramatahateṣu ṅyo'nekāco hrasvaḥ>> [[6.3.43]] ityādina ghaśabde parato hrasvatvaṃ prasajyeta|nanu ca saṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāt saṃjñāyāḥ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, saṃjñā hi saṃjñinaḥ pratyāyanārthā kriyate; yadi saṃjñāśabdo'pi svarūpaṃ pratyāyayet saṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, naitadasti; saṃjñāvidānasāmarthyāddhi saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayet, paribhāṣāvidhānasāmarthyācca svarūpam| tasmāt pratiṣedhaḥ kartavyaḥ? na kartavyaḥ, jñāpakāt saṃjñāśabdo rūpasya grāhako na bhaviṣyati| yadayaṃ <<ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ>> [[1.1.24]] iti ṣakārāntāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñāṃ vidadhāti,tajjñāpayati- saṃjñāśabdaḥ svarūpasya grāhako na bhavatīti; anyathā hi <<ṣaḍbhyo luk>> [[7.1.22]] ityatra ṣaṭśabdenasvarūpasya pratyāyitatvāt tato'pi lug bhavatīti ṣakārantāyāyaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ ṣaḍiti saṃjñā na kuryāt| ṣaṭśabdo hi ṣakārāntā saṃkhyā, nānyā, satyametat; tathāpi yeṣāṃ jñāpakadvāreṇārthapratipattau pratipattigauravaṃ syāt, tān pratitatparihārāyayāśabda-saṃjñeti pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ| śabdagrahaṇam- vyākaraṇe yā saṃjñā tasyā eva pratiṣedho na laukikyā iti pradarśanārtham| `sittdaviśeṣāṇām` ityādi| yatra viśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇamiṣyate tatra sakāra itsaṃjñakaḥ kartavyaḥ `vṛkṣasya,mṛgasiti| `tato vaktavayaḥ` ityādi| sinnirdeśaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ prathame'dhyāye'nyatra vā paribhāṣeyaṃ kartavyā - sittadviśeṣāṇāmityādi| yasya sakāra itsaṃjñakaḥ, sa tadviśeṣāṇāṃ vṛkṣādiviśeṇāṇāṃ khadirādīnāṃ pratipādaka iti vaktavyam| evaṃ `pitparyāyavacanasya ca sittadviśeṣāṇāmityādigranthopanyāsaḥ||saṃjñāsūtramidam, na paribhāṣā| sāhi niyamārthā bhavati| na cāṇuditāṃ savarṇānā-manyeṣāṃca grahaṇaṃ prāptam, yena savarṇānāmeva grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti niyamaḥ kriyate- `pareṇa ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam` iti| tena ṛkārādayo'pi savarṇānāṃ grāhakāḥ sidhyantītyabhiprāyaḥ| pareṇa ca ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam `a i u ṇ` ityatra pratipāditam| pūrvasūtrāt `svaṃ [[6.4.88]] babhūva, atra sānunāsi-ko'pi syāt| santi hi yaṇaḥ sānunāsikā niranunāsikāśca| mit - `caturanuḍuhorāmudā-ttaḥ`, [[7.1.98]] <> [[7.1.99]] , anaḍvan - atra dīrgho'pi syāt| tat tahrrevaṃ ityaisādeśaḥ; vṛddhireci` [[6.1.85]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `abjāḥ gojāḥ` iti| `janī prādu-rbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1149) apsu jāyate, goṣu jāyata iti - <> [[3.2.67]] |`khaṭvābhiḥ` iti| kataṃ punaretat pratyudāharaṇam, yāvatā <> [[6.1.85]] ityantādivadbhāve bhavitavyamevātraisbhāvena, taparakaraṇasya tu ytaraikādeśo nāsti tadvayavacchedyaṃ bhaviṣyati - `kīlālapābhiḥ, somapābhiḥ` ityādi? naiṣa doṣaḥ; antadivacca` [[6.1.82]] ityatra vakṣyati - `varṇāśrayavidhāvantādivadbhāvo neṣyate`iti| tathā hi - khaṭvābhiritadyatrāntavadbhāvābhāvāt <> [[7.1.9]] na bhavatīti|atha vā - `ataḥ` ityatrākāradvayapraśleṣaḥ kṛtaḥ, śrūyamāṇādato yathā syāt|svarūpavidhiparihārāyārambhaḥ|idamapi saṃjñāsūtram| anādibhūta vastvapekṣya tatpūrvavastuna āditvaṃ na bhavati, antyabhūtaṃ vastvapekṣya tataḥ parasyāntyatvam| na cehādyantayoḥ parasparāpekṣe ādyantatve yujyete| evaṃ hi sati vastvantarasya saṃjñino bhāvādādirantyena sahitaḥ svaryaiva saṃjñā syāt| tataśca <> [[1.1.68]] ityetasyehānuvṛttaye svaritatvāsaṅgo vṛtā syāt| tasmādādyantaśabdābhyāṃ sāmarthyādādyantavyatirekeṇa tanmadhyapāti vastu saṃjñitvenākṣiptamiti matvāha - `tanmadhyapatitānām` iti| jātāvidaṃ bahuvacanam; anyathā hreṅa śabda okārasya saṃjñā na syāt| nanu cādyantaśabdābhyāṃ niyatadeśāvayavāvabhidhīyate, avayavāścāvayavinaḥ samudāya-rūpasya sambandhina iti sambandhiśabdatvādādyantaśabdābhyāṃ tasyaiva saṃjñitvenā-kṣepo yuktaḥ| akata evaṃ vaktavyam - `tanmadhyapatitānāṃ samudāyasya` iti| evaṃ manyate - yadayam <> [[1.1.67]] ityādau varṇānāṃ samudāye parato yakāraṃ yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaṃ karoti, tato gamyate - na varṇasamudāyaḥ saṃjñīti, kiṃ tarhi? pratyekaṃ varṇā eveti; anyathā varṇasamudāye saṃjñini parato varṇamālāṃ yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaṃ kuryāditi| asambhavāt sa na kṛta iti cet, na; varṇamālātmana ādeśasya sambhavāt| tarhi samudāye saṃjñini kāryameva na sambhavatīti cet, yadi ca samudāye parataḥ kāryaṃ na sambhavati varṇā eva pratyekaṃ santu saṃjñinaḥ; tatra kāryaṃ sambhavati, kiṃ samudāyena? `ṭā` ityanena grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi| nanu ca so'pi tāvato'vadheranta eva, na;tāvato'vadheravivakṣitatvāt| ṭakāro hrayam <<ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ>> [[7.1.12]] `dvitīyāṭaustvenaḥ` [[2.4.34]] ityatra tṛtīyaikavacanasya viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, na tu pratyāhārārthaḥ|athādigrahaṇaṃ kimartham? antyena saha samudāya eva saṃjñā mā bhūditi, naitadasti; `āvṛttidharmāṇo hi saṃjñāśabdā bhavanti`| ādireva pradeśavākyeṣvāvartate, nasamudāyaḥ; tasmādantareṇāpyādigrahaṇaṃ sāmarthyādāderevāntyasahitasya saṃjñātvaṃvijñāyate, na samudāyasya| evaṃ tarhi sāmarthyalabdhasyaivārthasya vispaṣṭīkaraṇārthamādi-grahaṇam|atha sahagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tṛtīyayaiva sahārtho gamyate, yathā - `vṛddho yūnā` [[1.2.65]] ityatra? naitadevam; itthambhūtalakṣaṇe'pi tṛtīyā'sti| tasyāṃ ca satyāmādirevāntyenetsaṃjñakenopalakṣitaḥ saṃjñā syāt| tataśca pradeśeṣvaka iti, ika iti, aci iti ca samudāyādvibhaktirna syāt, nirarthakatvenāprātipadiktavāt| `saha` grahaṇāt tu sahabhūtā saṃjñeti samudāyasya saṃjñātvenārthattvāt prātipadikatve sativibhaktirlabhyate|idgrahaṇaṃ tu `aci` ityatrānitsaṃjñakena `caṭatava` ityanena cakāreṇa saṃjñā mā bhūdityevamartham| antyatvaṃ tasya pūrvavat, na samudāyāpekṣayā| evaṃ tarhi <> [[1.3.3]] itītsaṃjñā prāpnoti, tadarthaṃ <> [[1.3.4]] ityatra neti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ|`svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyetyasyāyamapavādaḥ`| idamapi saṃjñāsūtram| na tu paribhāṣā| na hyatra niyamarūpatā paribhāṣādharmo vidyate| `yena` iti karamae tṛtīyā| vidhīyate = apūrva eva kriyate iti vidhiḥ karmasādhanaḥ; upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ` [[3.3.92]] iti kipratyayāntaḥ|tadantasya` iti| so'nto'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ| tadityanena sa eva karaṇabhūtaḥ śabdaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| anataśabdo'yamavayavavācī, avayavaśca samudāyasya bhavati| ataśca tasyaiveyaṃsaṃjñā vijñāyata ityāha - `samudāyasya saṃjñā bhavati` iti|`avaśyalāvyam` iti| `avaśyapāvyam` iti| `lūñ chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1484), `pūñ pavane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1483) vṛddhau kṛtāyām <> [[6.1.79]] ityāvādeśaḥ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt samāsaḥ; `lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtyeḥ` (kāśikā|6.1.149) iti makāralopaḥ|atheha kasmādejantas saṃjñā na sambhavati, <<eco'yavāyāvaḥ>> [[6.1.78]] iti? kiñcasyāt? `cayanaṃ cāyako lavanaṃ lāvakaḥ` ityatrānekāltvādayādayaḥ sarvādeśāḥ syuḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti` (vyā|pa|106) ityeca eva bhaviṣyanti, na sarvasyatadantasya| atha vā - asya yogasyaivaṃ vidho viṣaya eva na bhavati, tato nāyamiha pravartate| tathā hi yeneti karaṇe tṛtīyetyuktam, na cākartṛkaṃ karaṇamastīti kartāpyāśritaḥ| sa punariha sambandhiśabdatvādantaśabdenāvayavavācinā sannidhāpitaḥ samudāyo vijñāpyate| prakṛtatvāt svarūpaṃ ca kartā ca tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ sannihito bhavati| kvacinnirdeśāt - `īdūdeddvicanam` [[1.1.11]] iti, atra dvivacanaṃ kartṛbhūtaṃ nirdiṣṭam| tathā hīdādibhiḥ karaṇaiḥ pragṛhrasaṃjñāṃ vidadhāti| kvacit prakaraṇāt - yathā `erac` [[3.3.56]] iti, atra `dhātoḥ` [[3.1.91]] ityadhikārāddhātuḥ prakaraṇāt kartā sannihitaḥ| sa ikāreṇa karaṇenācaṃ vidadhāti| kvacic sāmarthyāt - yathā <> [[1.2.9]] iti, atra dhātoreva san vidhīyate, nānyasamāditi sāmarthyāddhātuḥ kartā sannihitaḥ; saikā karaṇena sanaḥ kittvaṃ vidadhāti| tadevam, `īdūdeddvivacam` [[1.1.11]] ityādau kartṛkaraṇayorubhayorapi vidyamānatvāt so'sya sūtrasya viṣaya iti tatra tadantavidhirbhavati| <<eco'yavāyāvaḥ>> [[6.1.78]] ityatra tu na kenacit kartā sannihitaḥ prakāreṇa, na cākartṛkaṃ karaṇaṃ sambhavati;tasmāt kartṛkaraṇayorubhayorapyasannihitatvānanāyamasya sūtrasya viṣaya iti na sambhavati tadantavidhiḥ|`vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyāyam - `dvitīyā śrita` 2.1.25) ityādau supā śritādayo viśiṣyante,na śritādibhiḥ sup| viśeṣaṇena catadantavidhiḥ, na viśeṣyeṇa| yasmādayeneti karaṇe tṛtīyā, karaṇaṃ ca paratantraṃ parārthaṃ bhavati, na viśeṣyam, tasmādviśiṣṭaiḥ śritādibhistadantavidhirna bhavati| `naḍādibhyaḥ phak` iti| atrāpi prakṛtena prātipadikena naḍādayo viśiṣyante, na naḍādibhiḥ prātipadikamato'trāpi nāsti tadantavidhiriti|`ugidvarṇagrahaṇavarjam` iti| ugitā varṇena ca prātipadikaṃ viśiṣyate|viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatyeva|`yasmin vidhiḥ` ityādi| tadantavidhau prāpte tadādividhirucyate| yasminni-ti saptamīnirdiṣṭe tadādividhiṃ darśayati| yatrālgrahaṇe saptamīnirdiṣṭe pūrvasya vidhistatra tadādau veditavyaḥ| alādāvityarthaḥ| yadi tarhi tatrāpi tadantividhiḥ syāt, ihaiva syāt - śriyāviti,iha tu na syāt - `śriyaḥ` iti? tadādividhau tu satīhāpi bhavati, svasya ca rūpasyeti śriyāvityatrāpi bhavatyeva|`yasyeti samudāya ucyate` acāṃ madhye yasyādirvṛddhisaṃjñakastasyaiva śabdarūpasya saṃjñā vidhīyate| tacca niyogataḥ samudāyātmakameveti sāmarthyād yasyeti sāmānyapa-denāpi samudāya evābhidhīyate| saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ yasyeti vacanam| acāṃ madhya ityādinā vṛddhisaṃjñinaḥ samudāyādekadeśasya nirdhāraṇaṃ darśayannacāmityasya nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhītvaṃdarśayati| ādiśabdastvihopakrame vartate, upakramamyate ityupakramaḥ, prathamata uccārita ityarthaḥ| acāmiti bahuvacananirdeśād yas bahūnāmacāṃ madhye vṛddhisaṃjñaka ādibhūtaḥ,tasyaiva vṛddhasaṃjñayā bhavitavyam; na tu yasya dvayormadhye iti codyamapākartumāha - `acām` ityādi|yadi tahrracāmiti nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhīyam, evaṃ sati samānajātīyasyaiva nirdhāraṇaṃ bhavatītyacāṃ madhye vṛddhiko'jeva yathā syādityeṣo'rthaḥ syāt| tathā ca satyākāroyasyādistasya saṃjñā na syādāālāyana ityādeḥ, na hrākārasya mukhyamactvamasti;akṣvasanniveśāt| upacaritaṃ tu syāt ; <> [[1.1.69]] ityenenānaco'pi sato'ckāryakaraṇāt| na ca mukye sati gauṇasyāśrayaṇaṃ yuktam, gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃpratyayāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyāptenryāyādākārasyāpi gauṇamactvamāśritya bhaviṣyati,anyathā hraijgrahaṇameva kuryāt, na vṛddhigrahaṇam| `śālīyaḥ, mālīyaḥ, ityādi| atra vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `vṛddhācchaḥ` ś [[4.2.113]] iti ccho bhavati|nanu ca śālāmālāśabdayoḥ kāpaṭuśabdasya ca saṃjñayā na bhavitavyam, na hreṣāṃ vṛddhisaṃjñaka ādiḥ,kiṃ tarhi? hal,naitadevam; vidyamāno'pi hyatra hal nāpekṣyate,ajapekṣasyāditvasyāśrayaṇāt| etadeva hrajgrahaṇasya prayojanam| kataṃ nāma tadapekṣa-yāditvaṃ vijñāyeteti? anyathā tatra kartavyameva syāt| ajgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe satyamartho bhavati| acāṃ madhye yasya yo vṛddhisaṃjñako'jevādibhūta iti| anyebhyo'jbhyo yasya vṛddhisaṃjñakaḥ prāguccāryata iti yāvat| tena śālāśabdāderapi saṃjñā sidhyati|`sābhāsannayanaḥ` iti| atra vṛddhisaṃjñābhāvādaṇeva bhavati, na tu cchaḥ| yadi punarā-digrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tato yasyāpyacāṃ madhye vṛddhisaṃjñakaḥ kaścit sabhāsannayanādesta-syāpyeṣā saṃjñā syāt| atra yadyapi vṛddhiśabdaḥ śrūyate, tathāpi talliṅgakapari-bhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| yasamād yatra niyatasthānike guṇavṛddhī vidhīyate tatra sthāniniyamārthāsā vyāpriyate| etacca prāgevoktam| na ceha guṇavṛddhyorvidhānam, ato nātra vyāpārastasyāḥ| tena yasyāpyaniyatasthāniko vṛddhisaṃjñaka ādibhūtaḥ, tasyāpi saṃjñā siddhā bhavati| `vā nāmadheyasya` ityādi| ye puruṣaivryavahārāya saṃkītryamānāḥ śabdā devadatta ityevamādayaḥ, teṣāmeṣā saṃjñā veditavyā| teṣveva nāmadheyaśabdo rūḍhaḥ,na tu ye jātyādinimittakā gavādiśabdā anādivyavahārāntaḥ pātinasteṣu| nanu cakāśyādipāṭhāt `kāśyādibhyaḥ` [[4.2.115]] ṭhaññiṭhābhyāṃ bhavitavyam, tadayuktaṃ devadattīya iti cchapratyayāntasyodāharaṇam, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yo hi devaidatto devadatta itikriyānimittako devadattaśabdaḥ, tasyaiva tatra pāṭhaḥ,na saṃjñāśabdasya| tena saṃjñābhūtāddevadatta śabdād yadā vṛddhasaṃjñā tadā cho bhavati,anyathā tvaṇ| `gotrāntāt` ityādi| tathā'samastātta kevalādgotrapratyayāntād vṛddhācchapratyayo bhavati tathā samastāda-vṛddhādapi| `ghṛtarauḍhiḥ` iti| `samānādhikaraṇādhikāre śākapārthivādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamuttarapada-lopaśca` (vā|83) iti samāsaḥ| evamuttara rūḍhasyāpatyam, pāṇinasyāpatyam - `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] itīñ| bāhvādiṣu `sambhūyo'mbhasaḥ salopaśca` (ga|sū|66) iti paṭhate|kāśyapaśabdo bidāditvādañantaḥ| `jaihvākātāḥ, hāritakātāḥ` iti| kātyaśabdo gargādiyañantaḥ| jihvācapalaḥ kātyaḥ, jihvākātyaḥ| haritabhakṣaḥ kātyaḥ haritakātyaḥ, tābhyāmautsargika evāṇ, <> [[6.4.148]] ityakārasya lopaḥ; <<āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti>> [[6.4.151]] iti yakārasya||`uttarārtham` iti| uttarasūtre'sya prayojanavattvāt yadyanuvartate,etada-rthamapi kasmānna bhavatītyāha - `iha na sambadhyate` iti| yadīhāpi sambadhyeta tadāyamarthaḥsyāt - `tyadādīni yasyācāmādibhūtāni tadvaddham` iti| tataśca tvatputra ityādāveva syāt, kevālānāṃ ca tyadādīnāṃ na syādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca tvatputromatputra ityādāvupasarjanāni tyadādīni, upasarjanānāṃ ca teṣāṃ tyadāditvaṃnivartitam, tat kuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ? yadi yasyācāmāderityetadiha sambadhyate tadā satyupasarjanatve vacanāt tyadādāveva saṃjñā syāt, na kevalānāmiti manyate; kathaṃpunarihānuvartamānaṃ śakyamasambandhum? svasambnadhānuvṛtteḥ| <> [[1.1.73]] iti tyadādīni ca vṛddhisaṃjñakāni bhavanti| `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham` iti tadvṛddham, <> [[1.1.75]] yasyācāmādigrahaṇamanuvartate| vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam| evaṃ vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam| evaṃ vṛddhiśabdena sambandhamanuvartamānaṃ na śakyate tyadādibhiḥ sambandhum| `tvādāyaniḥ, mādāyaniḥ` iti| `udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt` [[4.1.157]] iti phiñ, <> [[7.2.98]] iti yuṣmadasmadostvāmādeśau| cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena `vā nāmadheyasya` (vā|15) ityādi vaktavyaṃ na bhavati||`prācāṃ deśābhidhāne` iti| prācāṃ sambandhī yo deśastadabhidhāna ityarthaḥ| etena prācāmiti deśaviśeṣaṇaṃ na vikalpārthamiti darśayati| prācāṃ matenetyasyāvivakṣitatvādityākhyātaṃ bhavati| `eṇīpacanīyaḥ` ityādi| eṇīpacana ityādibhyacchaḥ| `āhicchatraḥ` iti, `kānyakubjaḥ` iti ahicchatrakānyakubjaśabdābhyāmaṇeva bhavati| `devadattaḥ` iti| vṛddhā-dhikāre vihito <> [[4.2.117]] iti ṭhaññiṭhau na bhavataḥ, kāśyapādi-pāṭhādapi tau na bhavataḥ; kriyānimittako hi devadattaśabdastatra paṭhate saṃjñāśabdasya cedaṃ pratyudāharaṇam| etacca yadā `vā nāmadheyasya` (vā| 15) iti vṛddhasaṃjñā nāsti;tadā veditavyam| `gaumatāḥ`iti| atra sarvamasti na tu deśābhidhānam| tathā hi gomatī nadī pragdeśe, na deśaḥ| na hi nadī deśagrahaṇena gṛhrate;`nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ` [[2.4.7]] ityatra nadyāḥ pṛthaggrahaṇāt|`eṅ prācāṃ deśe` iti| `udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt` [[4.1.157]] ityevamādiṣu prāgudañcau śrūyete, tayośca vibhāgo na vijñāyate| atastatparijñānāyāha - `prāgudañcau` ityādi| śarāvatī nāma nadī , tasyāḥ pūrveṇa vyavasthito deśaḥ prāgdeśaḥ, uttareṇa udagdeśaḥ| tau śarāvatī vibhajate = vibhāgena vyavasthāpayati tasyāṃ hi maryādāyāṃ satyāṃ tayorvibhāgaḥ parijñāyate| kimarthaṃ vibhajate? `viduṣāṃ śabdasiddhyartham` iti| paṇḍitānāṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ śabdavyutpattyartham| kataṃ vibhajate? `haṃsaḥ kṣīrodakaṃ yathā`| kṣīrodakamiti `jātiraprāṇinām` [[2.4.6]] ityekavadbhāvaḥ| kvacit kṣīrodake iti pāṭhaḥ| saḥ `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati` (vyā|pa|91) iti veditavyaḥ| yathā haṃsaḥ kṣīramudakaṃ ca miśrībhāvamupagataṃ pṛthagasaṅkareṇa vyavasthāpayati, tathā śarāvatī prāgudañcau| yat-tadornityābhisambandāt seti vacanādanuktamapi yetyetallabhyate| yā vibhajate sā no'smān pātu rakṣatu| prasiddhastu pāṭho yatra śloke prāgudīcāviti, tatrā'caḥ `uda īt` [[6.4.139]] iti bhasaṃjñakasyocyamānaḥ kathamīkāraḥ? kathaṃ ca <<ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'dhātoḥ>> [[7.1.70]] iti numa na bhavatīti cintyam| atra varṇayanti - `acpratyanvavapūrvāt sāmalomnaḥ` [[5.4.75]] ityatrājitiyogavibhāgenācpratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ, tenātrāci parato bhasaṃjñāmītvaṃ bhavati| num na bhavati; acā sarvanāmasthānasya vyavahitatvāditi|anaye tu prāgudīcamiti samāhāre kurvanti| teṣāṃ `dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt samāhāre` [[5.4.106]] iti ṭaci samāsānte kṛte pūrvavadīkāro numabhāvaśca bhavati| kvacittu prāgudīceti pāṭaḥ| tatrāvayavadeśāpekṣayā bahutvavivakṣāyāṃ bahuvacanam|prāgdeśānudagdeśāśca vibhajata kimarthamikārastaparaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| śeṣalakṣaṇā vā kāryasambandhavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīyam| kasya kāryasya niṣpattyarthamikārastaparaḥ kriyata iti yāvat| `dīrgho mā bhūta` iti, asati hi taparatve'ṇ gṛhramāṇaḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātītīkāreṇa savarṇānāṃ grahaṇe sati sthānentaratamaparibhāṣayopāsthita, aditetyatra dīrghasthāne dīrgho bhavati, sa mā bhūditi taparatvaṃ kriyate|`ṛte'pabi saḥ` iti| sa ityanena dīrghasya pratyavamarśaḥ| ṛte'pyasmādeva vacanād ghumāsthādisūtreṇa [[6.4.66]] dīrghaḥ siddhaḥ, tasmād vacanasāmarthyāddīrgho na bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇān na gṛhṇāti` (vyā|pa|30) ityato dīrgho na bhaviṣyatīti| eṣa tu parihāro noktaḥ, bhāvyamānenāpyaṇā kvacit savarṇānāṃ grahaṇāt| tathā hi - adasa aupratyaye paratastyadādyatve <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhau kṛtāyām bhavati| <<adaso'serdādu do maḥ>> [[8.2.80]] ityukāro vidhīyamānaḥ savarṇānāṃ grahaṇādaukārasya dīrghasya sthāne dīrgha eva bhavati - amū iti|`anantare pluto mā bhūt` iti| anantarārthe visadṛśārtha ārambhe sati|kuta etat? visadṛśasya ākārasya sthāne kriyamāṇo hrasvo bhavati, na punaḥ plutaḥ| tasmāt plutabādhanārthaṃ taparatvaṃ kartavyam| etadapi nāsti prayojanam| `plutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ` iti| caśabdo hetau| pluto hi dūrāddhūtādiviṣayaviśeṣe [[8.2.84]] ukta eva| tatra yadyanena pluto vidhīyate tadā sarvatra dūrāddhūtādiviṣaye'nyatra cānena bhavitavyam, tataśca dūrāddhūtādiviṣaye'pi tasmin bhavatyuktānuvādadoṣaḥ syāt; tasya kṛtasya karaṇāt| tasmāt pakṣa uktānuvādadoṣo mā bhūditi hrasva eva bhaviṣyati, na plutaḥ iti pratyākhyātaṃ bhāṣye taparatvam|anye tu varṇayanti - `plutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ` ita nānena taparatvaṃ pratyākhyāyate, kiṃ tarhi? tasya prayojanamākhyāyate| dūrāddhūtādiviṣaye pluta iṣṭo'bhipretaḥ, sa na prāpnoti| sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā( 1.1.51) dīrghasyaiva sthāne dīrgha eva vidhīyate| nanu coktaṃ siddha eva dīrgha iti? siddhasya punarvacanaṃ plutasya bādhanārthaṃ syāt| iṣyate ca pluto dūrādadhūtādiviṣaye| tasmāt tasya bādhako dīrgho mā bhūditi taparatvaṃ kartavyam| tena vicāryamāṇānāmityāṣṭamiko bhavatyeva pluta iti|ktvāpratyayasyaupaveśikaṃ kittvamastyeveti tadiṭaḥ ktvāpratyayena grahaṇāt seṭo'pi prāpnotītyataḥ pratiṣedha'yamārabhyate| `ktvāpratyayaḥ seṭ kinna bhavati` iti| atha kiṃ kakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣedhāt kittvanna bhavati? kitkāryasya pratiṣedhādvā? yadi hyatra kakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣedhādakittvaṃ vidhitsitaṃ syāditsaṃjñāprakaraṇe `laśakvaseṭktvātaddhitayoḥ` iti sūtraṃ kuryāt| evaṃ hi dviṣpratiṣedho na kartavyo bhavati| tasmāt kittvapratibaddhaṃ yat kāryaṃ tatpratiṣedhādakittvaṃ seṭaḥ ktvāpratyayasyānena kriyate, na tu kakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣedhāt|atha sānubandhakasya grahaṇaṃ kimartham `na tvā` ityevocyeta,evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati? naitadasti; kakārānuccāraṇe hi kaściddveṣyamapi vijānīyāt| seṭaḥ ktvāpratyayasya kakārānubandha eva nāsti, niranubandhakasyoccāraṇāditi| tadevaṃ mā vijñāyīti sānubandhakasyoccāraṇam|kaḥ punaḥ seṭo niranubandhakatve vidhau niranubandhaka uccāryate? evamapi seṭa eva grahaṇaṃ syāt, pradeśeṣvāvatryate,api tu pratyekaṃ hrasvādiśabdāḥ| tasmāt teṣāṃ dvandvaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśa iti matvāha- `hrasvadīrghaplutaḥ` ityādiḥ| dvandvaikavadbhāvastu `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati` iti vacanāt| nanu ca dvandvaikavadbhāve `sa napuṃsakam` [[2.4.17]] iti nupaṃsakatvena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ puṃlliṅgena nirdeśaḥ, sautratvānnirdeśasya| chandasi <> [[3.1.85]] iti liṅgavyatyaya uktaḥ| `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti` (ma|bhā|1.1.1) ityaviruddhāsyapuṃlliṅgatā| u ū ū3 ityanayā ānupūrvyaiṣāṃ praśleṣa iti darśayati| kutaḥ punareṣa niścayaḥ - eṣaivaiṣāmānupūrvīti? evaṃ manyate - <> [[8.2.93]] ityekamātrikasya heḥ plutavidhānājjñāyate - na mātriko'ntya iti| antyatve hi sati tasya plutasaṃjñā syāt| evañca plutavidhānamanarthaṃ syāt| dvimātriko'pyantyo na bhavati; <> [[8.2.87]] iti dvimātrikasya plutavidhānāt| tasya cāntyatve hi sati yadi plutasaṃjñā syāt, tadā ca plutasya plutavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasamādante ekamātrikadvimātrikau na bhavataḥ| madhye'pyekamātriko na bhavati, <> [[7.3.101]] iti `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] itica dīrghavidhānasāmarthyāt| yadi madhyaekamātrikaḥ syāt tadā tasya dīrghasaṃjñā syāt,dīrghasya dīrghavacanamakiñcitkaraṃ syāt, tasmādādāvekamātrikatve hi sati pāriśeṣyānmadhye dvimātrikaḥ, ante trimātrika iti| `u ū ū3` iti| atrāpyukārādisahacaritāyāmuccāraṇakriyāyamukārādayo vartante| evaṃ kālo'jiti yakārasya lopaḥ| nanu cokāro'yamaṇ gṛhramāṇaḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātītyata ukāreṇa dīrghaplutayogrrahaṇe sati tayorapi hrasvasaṃjñā bhavatītyata āha- `kālagrahaṇam` ityādi| kālagrahaṇe hi yeṣāmetāḥsaṃjñā vidhīyate teṣāṃ yathākramamekamātrikatva dvimātrikatvatrimātrikatvāni viśeṣaṇāni labhyante| tathā hi, kālagrahaṇesati pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptau kriyamāṇāyāṃ trayo bahuvrīhayo bhavanti- uḥ kālo yasy sa ukālaḥ, ūḥ kālo yasya sa ūkālaḥ, ū3#ḥkālo yasya saḥ ū3 kālaḥ| eṣāṃ yathārmamekamātrikadvimātrikatrimātrikā aco'nyapadārthāḥ| yasmānmātrika evācaḥ `u` ityetatsahacāriṇyā uccāramakriyāyāstulyakālaḥ; evaṃ dvimātrika evāca `ū` ityetatsahacāriṇyā uccāraṇakriyāyāstulyakālaḥ; evaṃ trimātrika evāca `ū3` ityetatsahacāriṇyā uccāraṇakriyāyāstulyakālaḥ| evaṃ ca sati mātrāparimāṇasyāco hrasvasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā satyapyukāreṇa dīrghaplutayogrrahaṇe tayorna bhavati, na hi tau mātrā parimāṇau| tena ālūya, pariṇīyetyatra hrasvāśrayastuṅa na bhavati| `pratyakṣya, prarakṣya` iti| `takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-655, 656) `rakṣa pālane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-658) <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāse kṛte `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap` [[7.1.37]] iti lyap| tatra parato dvayorardhamātaryorhaloḥ tataśca <> [[6.1.76]] iti vikalpitastuk prasajyeta| ajgrahaṇe tu sati dīrghasaṃjñā na bhavati,acsamudāyasyājgrahaṇenāgrahaṇāt| nanu ca satyāmapi tasyāṃ samudāyāśrayāyāṃ dīrghasaṃjñāyāyamavayavāśrayā hrasvasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| tadāśrayastuṅanitya eva, naitadasti; paratvāddīrghāśrayastugvikalpaḥ prāpnoti| na caivaṃ vidhaviṣaye punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānamasti; yatra pūrvo vidhiḥ pravartamānaḥ paravidhivijñānaṃ na bādhate tatraitadbhavati - `punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāt siddham` iti, iha tu nityo vidhiḥ paravidhivikalpavijñānaṃ bādhate; nityavikalpayorvirodhāt| tataśca `sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe ityevamādiṣūpatiṣṭhate;tadupasthāne ca ṣaṣṭhīdvayaṃ prādurbhavati; viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacārāt| `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] ityatrācā prātipadikaṃ gṛhramāṇaṃ viśiṣyate - ajantasya prātipadikasyeti, na tu prātipadikenā-jviśiṣyate| yadi hi prātipadikenājviśiṣyeta - prātipadikasya yo'jiti, tadā madhyasthitasyāpyaco hrasvaḥ syāt| `suvāg brāāhṛṇakulam` iti| acā tu prātipadike viśiṣyamāṇe prātipadikasyaivetyeṣā sthānaṣaṣṭhī bhavati, na cāvayavaṣaṣṭhī, tenālo'ntyasyaivāco hrasvo bhavati| <> [[8.2.82]] ityatra gṛhramāṇena ṭiśabdenājviśiṣyate - ṭeryo'jiti| tena ṭermadhyavartino'pyacaḥ pluto bhavati| yadi tvacā ṭirviśiṣyate - ajantasya ṭeriti, tadehaiva syāt - devadattā3 iti; iha tu na syāt - agniciditi| cakāreṇājityanukṛṣyate, tsaya prayojanamihaiva aḥ sthāne'j bhavati `hrasvadīrghaplutaḥ ityevaṃ saṃjñayā vidhīyamāna iti| `dyauḥ, panthāḥ, saḥ` iti| etāni <> [[1.1.3]] ityatra vyutpāditāni| eṣu ca yathāyogaṃ `diva aut` [[7.1.84]] `pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt` [[7.1.85]] <> [[7.2.102]] ityebhiraukārādayaḥ svarūpeṇa vidhīyamānā dīrghādisaṃjñayā na vidhīyanta iti hala eva sthāne te bhavanti, nācaḥ| dyubhyām, dyubhirityatrāpi `diva ut ityukāro hrasvasaṃjñayā na vidhīyata iti hala eva sthāne bhavati, nācaḥ| nanu ca dyaurityādīni trīṇyudāharaṇāni `iko guṇavṛddhi` [[1.1.3]] ityanenaivasaṃjñāvidhānaniyamena siddhāni, tatra hi tasyāpyetāni pratyudāharaṇāni prāgupanyastāni, tasmānnārtha etadarthena saṃjñayā vidhīyamānena niyamena? satyametat; evaṃ manyate - dyubhyām, dyubhirityevamarthaṃ saṃjñāvidhāne niyamaḥ kartavyaḥ; na hrukārasya guṇasaṃjñāsti, nāpi vṛddhisaṃjñā; yataḥ pūrveṇaiva saṃjñāvidhānaniyamenaitadapi siddhyati| tasmādanyārtho'yaṃ saṃjñāvidhānaniyamaḥ kriyamāṇo ye'pi vismaraṇaśīlāḥ pūrvasya niyamasya prayojanaṃ na smaranti tānanugrahītum - dyauḥ, panthā-, sa ityevamartho'pi bhavati||udāttādayo lokavedayoḥ prasiddhāḥ| tat kiṃ saṃjñākaraṇeneti yaścodayet taṃpratyāha - `udāttādiśabdāḥ` ityādi| ādiśabdenānudāttasvaritayoḥ parigrahaḥ|evakāro bhinnakramo varṇadharme ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| lokavedayorudāttādayaḥ śabdā varṇanāṃ yo dharmaḥ = guṇastatraiva prasiddhāḥ, na tu tadvityaci| tasmādiha vyākaraṇa udāttādayo dharmā yasyācastadguṇe'ci saṃjñāpyante = paribhāṣyante; anyathā pradeśeṣūdāttādiśabdaśravaṇādvarṇadharma eva gṛhreta, na tadvānajityabhiprāyaḥ|uccairiti śrutiprakarṣe'sti - śrutiprakarṣavatyuccairbhāṣate uccaḥ paṭhatīti| asti ca pramāṇādhikaraṇavācī uccaiḥ sthito devadatta iti, uccairnāma pramāṇam, tasya tadadhikaraṇaṃ tadihoccaiḥ śabdenocyate| tadiha dvitīyasyoccaiḥ śabdasyārtho gṛhrate, netarasyeti darśayitumāha - `uccaiḥ` iti| uccairbhāṣate ityevamādau tu vākye prayuktasyoccaiḥ śabdasya yo'rthaḥ śrutiprakarṣaḥ sa uccairityatra na gṛhrate| yadi gṛhreta, upāṃśuprayoga udāttādisaṃjñā na syāt; prakarṣābhāvāt, prakarṣasthitatvādudāttādayo na viśiṣyeran| ya eva hi kañcit pratyuccairbhavati, sa eva hi kañcitpratati nīcairbhavati| evañca sarvamudāttaṃ syāt, anudāttatamo'pi ceṣyata ityabhiprāya|`sthānakṛtam` ityādi| ucyatā nāma pramāṇaviśeṣaḥ, tadadhikaraṇabhūtasthānamuccairbhavati| evañca sarvanamudāttaṃ na syāt| anudāttamuccairucyata ityarthaḥ|`bhāgavatsu` iti| bhāgā avayavā yeṣāṃ tāni bhāgavanti| te bhāgāstālvādiṣu sthāneṣvauttarādharyeṇa vyavasthitāḥ| sthānamuccaiḥ śabdenocyate, tat kutaḥ saṃjñina uccaistvaviśeṣaṇam? uccaisthānaniṣpannatvāt| tatra samāne sthāna uccairūdhrvabhāge yoniṣpannaḥ sa udāttasaṃjño bhavati| yadi sthāne ya ūdhrvabhāganiṣpanno'c sa udāttasaṃjño bhavatītyetāvaducyate, evañca sa evānavasthitadoṣaḥ| tathā hi- alpaśarīreṣu ya eva tālvādibhāga uccairbhavati, sa eva mahāśarīreṣu tālvādibhāgāpekṣayā nīcairbhavati| ataḥ `samāna` ityetat sthānaviśeṣaṇamuktam| etacc laghvarthatvāt pratīyate, samānatvamityeṣo'rtha viśeṣaḥ kuto labhyate? avicchinnādupadeśapāramparyāt| tat punaḥ samānatvaṃ vaktrabhinnatvādveditavyam; na tu tālvādisthānasyābhinnatvāt; anyathā tālavyamevāpekṣyodāttaḥ syāt, na tu kaṇṭhādīn| vakturabhedāt taddvāreṇa bhinnānāmapi tālvādīnāṃ samānatve'pi vijñāyamāna eṣa doṣo na bhavati| kiṃlakṣaṇaḥ punarasāvuccabhāganiṣpanno'jityāha - `yasmin` (61|109) itiya okāraḥ, so'pi sthānivadbhāvenānudātto bhavati| `tasyodātte parabhūte` iti| vibhaktyakāre| `ikāro'nudāttaḥ` iti| sarasvatītiśabdasambandhī; `āmantritsaya ca` [[8.1.19]] iti sarasvatīśabdasya nighātavidhānāt| `tasmānna nihanyate` iti| <> [[8.1.18]] ityatrāpādādāviti nighātapratiṣedhāt| `prathamamakṣaram` iti| śakārokāra udāttaḥ, <<āmantritasya ca>> [[8.1.19]] iti ṣāṣṭhikena|`ghṛtaspṛk` iti| <> [[8.2.62]] iti kutvam = śakārasya khakāraḥ, tasya jaśtvam = khakārasya gakāraḥ| `adrdhabhāk` iti| <> [[8.2.30]] iti jakārasya gakāraḥ| ubhayatra <<vā'vasāne>> [[8.4.56]] ita cartvaṃ kakāraḥ| ttarāpṛktasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām <> [[6.1.67]] iti vakāralopo bhavati| pratyudāharaṇeṣu hi tadabhāvānna bhavati|`darviḥ` iti| `dṛ vidāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1493) `vṛ dṛbhyāṃ vin` (da|u|1|23) iti vin| `jāgṛviḥ` iti| `jāgṛ nidrākṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1072), `jṛśṛstṛjāgṛbhyaḥ kvin` (da|u|1|24) iti kvin| `surāḥ` iti| `ṣūñ abhiṣave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1247), surāṃ sunotīti <<anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate>> [[3.3.130]] iti kvip; surāsut, hrasvasya tuk| `tamācaṣṭe` (vā| 201) iti ṇic| `ṇāviṣṭavat kāryaṃ prātipadikasya` (vā|813) iti ṭilopaḥ| surāsavateḥ punaḥ kvip, ṇilopaḥ, prathamaikavacanam, halṅyādinā [[6.1.66]] sulopaḥ; rutvavisarjanīyau| atrāpi ṇilope kṛte'sati pratyayagrahaṇe dhātukārasyāpṛktasaṃjñā syāt| tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ <> [[6.1.68]] iti dhātusakāralopaṛḥ syāt| nanu cāsatyapi pratyayagrahaṇe `pratyāpratyayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|72) iti saṃjñā vijñāsyate, tat kimarthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇam? kriyate vispaṣṭārtham|athaikagrahaṇaṃ kimartham? alsamudāyasya mā bhūditi, naitadasti; algrahaṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, anyathā hralgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt- yadi halsamudāyasyāpi saṃjñā syāt| evaṃ tahrralgrahaṇenātra jātigrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti jñāpanārthamekagrahaṇamam| tena <> [[1.2.10]] ityatra yaduktam - `dambherhalgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvāt siddham` iti tadupapannaṃ bhavati|`tatpuruṣaḥ` iti samāsaviśeṣasyākhyā| sa ca eka evaśabdaḥ| anekasya ca śabdasya bhinnapravṛttinimittakasyaikasminnarthe vṛttiḥ =sāmānādhikāraṇyam| tataśca yatra bāhrena padena tatpurūṣasya sāmānadhikaraṇyam, tatraiveyaṃ saṃjñā syāt - rājapuruṣaḥ śobhana ityādau,asti hyatra tatpuruṣasya kenacit sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti; śobhanaśabdena saha| pācakavṛndāriketyādau tu na syāt, na hyatra tatpuruṣasya kenacit sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti; śabdāntarasya prayogābhāvāditi codyamapākarttumāha- `samānādhikaraṇapadaḥ` iti| samānam = abhinnam, ekamadhikaraṇam = vācyaṃ yeṣāṃ padānāṃ tāni samānādhikaraṇāni padāni, tānyāśrayabhūtāni yasya tatpuruṣasya sa samānādhikaraṇapadastatpuruṣaḥ| etena tatpuruṣārthānāṃ padānāṃ samānādhikaraṇatvādupacāreṇa tatpuruṣo'tra sūtre samānādhikaraṇaśabdenokta iti darśayati| kathaṃ punarbāhranyapadāpekṣayā tatpuruṣasya mukhye sāmānādhikaraṇye sambhavati satyaupacārikasya grahaṇamupapadyate? `karmadhārayaḥ` iti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇāt| iha hi lāghavārthatvāt kasaṃjñākaraṇasya, laghīyasyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ `karmadhārayaḥ` iti mahatīṃ saṃjñāṃ kurvatā - `anyo'pyatra kaścit viparyayaḥ saṃjñāyāmāśritaḥ` ityeṣo'rthaḥ sūcitaḥ| tena `gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasampratyayaḥ` (vyā|pa|4) iti mukhyasya samānādhikaraṇasya grahaṇaṃ na vijñāyate|`samānābhidheyaḥ` iti| tadarthānāṃ padānāṃ samānābhidheyatvāt tatpuruṣo'pyupacāreṇa samānābhidheya ityuktaḥ| `paramarājyam, uttamarājyam` iti| <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| karmadhāraye sati <> [[6.2.130]] ityuttarapadādyudāttamatvaṃ na bhavati| `pācakavṛndārikā` iti| vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ` [[2.1.61]] iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `pācikābhāryaḥ` iti| bahuvrīhirayam| tenātra <> [[6.3.37]] iti pratiṣedho bhavatyeva| `brāāhṛṇarājyam` iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'yam| tenātra samāsāntodāttameva na bhavati, api tūttarapadādyudāttatvam||`samāse` ityadhikaraṇanirdeśo'yam| kaṣṭaśritādayaḥ samāsāḥ na kiñcit prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ śabdarūpamasti| tathā hi - samāse kṛte tata eva samāsād vibhaktirutpadyate, na tu tatra sthācchabdāt| na ca vākyakāle samāsārthāt padād yā prathamotpannā tadāśrayaṃ prathamānirdiṣṭatvaṃ samāsāvayavasya kalpayituṃ yuktam, yataḥ `samāse` ityadhikaraṇanirdeśo'yam| tatra samāse kṛte yasmāt prathamotpadyate, tadeva samāse prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ bhavati; na tu yasmāt vākyakāle vibhaktikāle vibhaktirutpadyate| taddhi vākya eva prathamānirdiṣṭam, na tu samāse; prāgeva samāsāt tasya prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt| tataśca samāse kṛte prathamānirdiṣṭasya saṃjñino'sambhavāt saṃjñā na sambhavītyetaccodyamapākartumāha- `prathamayā vibhaktyā yannirdiśyate` iti| samāsārthaṃ yacchāstraṃ tat samāsaśāstraṃ gṛhrate| tatra prathamānirdiṣṭasyeyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate, na tu kaṣṭaśritādau; samāse prathamānirdiṣṭasyāvidyāmānatvāt vidyate ca samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ saṃjñīti kutaḥ saṃjñāyā aprasiddhiḥ? kathaṃ punaḥ `samāse` ityucyamāne samāsaśāstre yat prathamayā nirdiśyate tasya saṃjñitvaṃ labhyata ityata āha - `samāse` iti| `samāsaśāstraṃ gṛhrate iti| kathaṃ punaḥ `samāse` ityucyamāne samāsaśāstraṃ grahītuṃ śakyam? tādathryāt tatra samāsaśabdasya pravṛtteḥ| bhavati hi tādathryāt tāvacchabdyam , yathā - pradīpārthā mallikā `pradīpaḥ` iti, indrārthā sthūṇā `indraḥ` iti| kaṣṭaśritādiṣūpasarjanasaṃjñayāyāḥ kāryam - `upasarjanaṃ pūrvam` [[2.2.30]] iti pūrvanipātaḥ|tatredaṃ codyate - rājñaḥ kumārīṃ paśya rājakumārīṃ paśyetyatra rājanśabdaḥ `ṣaṣṭhī` [[2.2.8]] iti samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭaḥ; <> [[2.1.24]] iti dvitīyāsamāsaśāstre kumārīśabdaśca| samasāśāstre tatrobhayorapyasyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ pūrvanipātāniyama upasarjanahrasvasvatvañcetyetaddoṣadvayaṃ prāpnotīti| iha ca rājñaḥ kumāryāḥ svaṃ rājakumārīsvamiti dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhantayoḥ samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭatvādubhayorapyupasarjanasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tadeva doṣadvayaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmādusarjanamiti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam - anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeteti| apradhanāmupasarjanam, pradhānamanupasarjamiti| apradhānañca pradhānamapekṣate; sambandhiśabdatvāt| tatra samnabdhādetavagantavyaṃ yat prati yadapradhānaṃ tat pratitadupasarjanamiti| śritādīṃścāpekṣya dvitīyāntamupasarjanaṃ bhavati, na tu dvitīyāntamātram| na ceha śritādayaḥ santi| rājñaḥ kumāryāḥ svaṃ rājakumārīsvamityātrāpyeṣa parīhāraḥ| atrāpi kumārīśabdamapekṣya rājanśabdasyāprādhānyam; na tu rājanśabdamapekṣya kumārīśabdasya| tasmāt rājanśabdasyopasarjanasaṃjñā, na tu kumārīśabdasya| yadi hranvarthasaṃjñeyam, pācakavṛndārikā, puruṣavyāghraḥ, ardhapippalī, pūrvakāyaḥ - ityeteṣu pūrvapadārtha eva pradhānamiti pācikādīnāmiha prādhānyam| ato yadyapyete <> [[2.1.62]] , <> [[2.1.56]] , `ardhaṃ napuṃsakam` [[2.2.2]] , `pūrvāparādharottaramekadeśikanaikādhikaraṇe` [[2.2.1]] ityeteṣu samāsaśāstreṣu prathamānirdiṣṭāḥ, tathāpi teṣāmupasarjanasaṃjñā na prāpnoti; kutaḥ? teṣāṃ prādhānyāt| evaṃ tarhruttarasūtre'nuktasamuccayārthatvāccakārasya bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|anyastvevaṃ manyate - `pācakavṛndāriketyevamādiṣu pūrvokteṣu samāseṣvādyau <> [[2.1.57]] , <> [[2.1.55]] ityetābhyāmeva siddhau; śeṣau tu `ṣaṣṭhī` [[2.2.8]] ityanenaiva| tasmāt <> [[2.1.62]] ityādīnāṃ na tadartha ārambhaḥ; kiṃ tarhi? upasarjana saṃjñārthaḥ; tenāsatyapi pācikādīnāmapradhānatve teṣāmiyaṃ saṃjñā bhaviṣyati` iti, etaccāsamyak, tathā hi - `pūjyamānam`, `sāmānyāprayoge`, `napuṃsakam`, `ekādhikaraṇam` - ityetān viśeṣān vakṣyāmītyetadartha ārambhaḥ syāt| sati caitadartha ārambhe'trāpradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā pradhānasya na syāt||apradhamānirdiṣṭārtho'yamārambhaḥ| vibhaktiśabdaḥ supāṃ vācakaḥ, vibhāgavacano vā| kārakaśaktirvibhāgaḥ - vibhajyate prātipadikārtho'nayeti kṛtvā| `samāse vidhīyamāne` iti| samāsārthavākyakāle| tadā hi tasya samāsasya vidhīyamānatā bhavati| etena samāsagrahaṇamanuvartamānaṃ samāsārthe vākye vartate, na samāsaśāstra iti darśayati| samāsaśāstre hi sarvameva śabdarūpamekavibhaktikameva bhavatītyekavibhaktigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| sarvameva hi prātipadikaṃ paryāyeṇaikayā vibhaktyā prayujyate| tasmādekavibhaktigrahaṇasāmarthyādavadhāraṇamatra vijñāyata ityata āha - `yanniyatavibhaktikam` iti| tadeva spaṣṭīkurvannāha - `dvitīye sambandhiti` ityādi| `pūrvapadenānāvibhaktike'pi` iti| niṣkrāntaśabdaḥ kartṛśaktyupasarjanībhūtaṃ dravyamāha| taccānekasādhanaśaktyupacitamiti kriyāntarasambandhādenekasādhanavibhaktikaṃ bhavati| `uttarapadaṃda tu pañcamyantameva bhavati` iti| niṣakramaṇakriyāpekṣayā''virbhūtāpādānaśaktikatvāt| `niṣkauśāmbiḥ` ityatropasarjanasaṃjñākāryam`gāstriyorupasarjanasya` [[1.2.48]] iti hasvatvam| atha niso'tra kenopasarjanasaṃjñā vidhīyate, yayo'sya pūrvanipātaḥ? pūrvasūtreṇeti cet, naitadasti; tenāpradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñāvidhānāt, nisaścātra prādhānyāt| evaṃ tarhi cakārasyānuktasamuccāyārthatvāt bhaviṣyati| anye tvāhuḥ - mā bhūnnisa upasarjanasaṃjñā, asatyāmapi tasyāṃ pūrvanipāto bhaviṣyati, <> [[1.2.44]] iti vacanāditi, etaccāyuktam; pūrvanipāte hi kartavya ekavibhaktikasyopasarjanasaṃjñā nāstyeva| tatra yadi nisa upasarjanasaṃjñā na syāt, tadodaharaṇe dvayorapyasatyāṃ tasyāṃ paryāyeṇāniyaḥ pūrvanipātaḥ prasajyeta| atha kathamardhapippalyādīnāmūpasarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati? atra ca `vibhāṣā cchandasi` [[1.2.36]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ mamḍūkaplutanyāyenānuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenārdha pippalyā ardhapippalītyādau viṣaye pippalyādīnāmekavibhaktiyuktānāmapyusarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati| yadi hi syāt, tadā hrasvatvaṃ syāt||`abhidheyavacano'yamarthaśabdaḥ` iti| etena prayojanādivacanādvayavacchinatti| arthaśabdo hi prayojanavacano'pyasti, yathā - anenārthanāgataḥ, anena prayojaneneti gamyate| nivṛttivacano'pyassi, yathā - maśakārartho dhūma iti, maśakanivṛttyartha iti gamyate| dhanavacano'pyasti,yathā - arthavān devadatta iti, dhanavāniti gamyate| abhidheyavacano'pyasti, yathā - asya vacanasyāyamartha iti, idamasyābhidheyamiti gamyate| iha tvabhidheyavacanasyaiva grahaṇam| tat punarabhidheyaṃ jātiguṇakriyādravyabhedena caturvidham|ata eva catuṣṭayī śabdānāṃ pravṛttirbhavati| tatra jātiśabdānāṃ jātirabhidheyā - gauriti| yadyarthavataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā vidhīyate tadā'bhāvavacanaśaśaviṣāṇādiśabdānāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā nopapadyate, arthābhāvāt, naitadasti; `arthaśabdo'bhidheyavacanaḥ` (kā|1.2.45) ityuktam, abhāvo'pyabhidheyo bhavatyeva| anyathā hrarthābhāvāditīdaṃ vacanamanuccāraṇīyaṃ syāt, anarthakatvāt, na hranarthakaṃ vacanaṃ prayogarhati| tasmādabāvavacanānāmapi prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavatyeva|`nāntasyādhermā bhūt` iti| nanu cādhāturiti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, tathā hi `vana sambhkatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-463), `dhana dhānye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1104) ityetayoḥ dharātvorete rūpe, naitadasti; avyutpannāvapi vanadhanaśabdau staḥ, tayorevāyaṃ prayogaḥ| atra yadi nāntasyāvadheḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā syāt tadā subutpattiḥ syāt, tataśca padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ nalopaḥ syāt| nanu ca `adhātuḥ` `apratyayaḥ` - naitadasti; anarthakasyāpi dhātorvidyamānatvāt yathā - `iṅa adhyayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1046), `ik smaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1047) iti - etayoradhipūrvayorevārthavattvam, na kevalayoḥ| yastu gaṇapāṭhe'nayorarthanirdeśaḥ, sa samudāyārthamavayave'dhyāropya kṛta iti veditavyam| adhyāropitārthayorapi tayorgaṇapāṭhasāmarthyāddhātusaṃjñā bhavatyeva| evaṃ pratyayo'pyanarthako'pyasti| yathā - <> [[5.4.29]] , yāva eva yāvaka iti| na hyatra pratyayasyānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śakyate'rthavattvaṃ pratyetum| vināpi tena kanpratyayena yāvaśabdādeva tadarthaḥ pratīyayate| tasmādarthavaditi yuktamuktam|`ahan` iti| adāditvācchapo luk, tipo halṅyādinā [[6.1.66]] lopaḥ, aṭ| sa ca hantigrahaṇena gṛhrata iti kṛte'pi tasmin hantirdātureva| atra vinā dhātugrahaṇena prāgeva pratyayotpatteḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā syāt| nalopastu pratyayotpattau padatve satyuttarakālam| atha vā - prātipadikasaṃjñā'pi pratyayotpatteruttarakālameva syāt, tasmāddhātugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| nanu cātra pratyayalakṣaṇena `apratyayaḥ` iti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam,tat kimadhātugrahaṇena? naitadasti; prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ nalopaḥ kāryaḥ, nalope ca `na ṅisambuddhayoḥ` [[8.2.8]] iti pratiṣedho jñāpakaḥ- pratyayalakṣaṇena `apratyayaḥ` iti pratiṣedho na pravartata iti| yadi hrapratyaya iti pratyayalakṣaṇena he rājannityevamādiṣu prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, `na ṅisambuddhayoḥ` [[8.2.8]] iti pratiṣedho anarthakaḥ syāt; prāptyabhāvāt| atha bhid-chid-lūḥ- pūrityevamādīnāṃ kathaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā, yāvatā kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahatīti dhātava evaita iti, atrādhāturiti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; mā bhūdanena, kṛdantatvāduttara sūtreṇa bhaviṣyati| na cottarasyāḥ prāpterayaṃ bādhakaḥ; vākyāntarasthatvāt| `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante nottarān` (vyā|pa|10) iti vā|`kāṇḍe, kuḍae` iti| prathamādvivacanānte ete rūpe| <> [[7.1.19]] iti śībhāvaḥ| atra ca `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya` (bhā|pa|sū|7) iti tadantasya pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, na pratyayamātrasya| nanu ca <> [[1.4.14]] ityatrāntagrahaṇena `anyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti` iti jñāpitatvāt `apratyayaḥ` iti pratyayāntasya pratiṣedho na labhyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; saṃjñāvidhau sa pratiṣedhaḥ, na cāyaṃ saṃjñāvidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? pratiṣedhavidhiḥ| atha kimarthamapratyaya ita pratiṣedha ucyate, yāvatottarasūtre kṛttaddhitagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - `kṛttaddhitāntasyaiva prātipadikasaṃjñā, nānyapratyayāntasya - kāṇḍe,kuḍae ityevamādeḥ`iti? naitadasti, asatyasmin pratiṣedhe'nyatra`saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti` iti kṛttaddhitayoreva prātipadikasaṃjñā syānna tadantasya; tadantasya caiveṣyate - bhicchillūḥpūrityevamādīnāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñārtham| satyapratyaya ityetasmin pratiṣedhe prāpte yathā kṛttaddhitāntasya prātipadikasaṃjñā labhyate tathottarasūtre pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ| nanu ca `kāṇḍe` `kuḍye` - ityetayoḥ pūrvameva prakṛteḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā pravṛttā, vibhaktyā ca sahaikādeśe kṛte'ntādivadbhāvādastyeva prātipadikatvamiti satyapyapratyayagrahaṇe hrasvatvaṃ prāpnotyeva, naitadasti;
