pratijñā, `saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt` - iti hetuḥ| yasmāt saṃjñābhūtānāṃ pañcālādiśabdānāṃ pramāṇatvam, tasmāt tadaśiṣyam| pramāṇatvaṃ punaḥ pratyayalakṣaṇam| sarveṣāmeva śabdānāmevaṃ vidhe svaviṣaye pramāṇatvamasti, ucyate cedam, tatra viśeṣo vijñāyate, sa punarabhidheyagataliṅgasaṃkhyānapekṣayā bhinnaliṅgasaṃkhyānāmapi teṣāṃ svārthe pratyāyakatvam| ata evāha - `saṃjñāśabdā hi nānāliṅgasaṃkhyāḥ` iti| `pramāṇamiti| pramāṇaṃ pratyāyakā vācakā ityarthaḥ| tatraitat syāt - saṃjñāśabdā evāmī pañcālādayo na bhavanti, kiṃ tarhi? yoganimittakā ityata āha - `pañcālā varaṇāḥ` ityādi| yoganimittakāḥ śabdā yogaśabdāḥ| na hi pañcālādayaḥ śabdāḥ kṣatriyādisambandhena janapadādau vartante; kiṃ tarhi? saṃjñā etā janapadādīnām| yadi saṃjñāśabdā ete, tataḥ kimiti? tadaśiṣyamityata āha - `tatra liṅgaṃ vacanañca` ityādi| kuta etat? yat saṃjñāśabdānāṃ liṅgaṃ vacanañca tatsvabhāvasiddhamityata āha - `yathā` ityādi| ekasyāmapi jalakaṇikāyāṃ bahuvacanāntaḥ strīliṅgo'pśabdaḥ prayujyate, ekasyāmapi yoṣiti dāraśabdaḥ puṃlliṅago bahuvacanāntaḥ, gṛhaśabdaścaikasmin veśmani bahuvacanāntaḥ puṃlliṅgaśca, ekasyāmapi vālukāyāṃ bahuvacanāntaḥ sikatāśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ, varṣā ita ekasmin viśiṣṭakāle'pi pravartamānaḥ strīliṅgo bahuvacanāntaśca vartate| tasmāt yathaiveṣāmapprabhṛtiśabdānāṃ svābhāvikaṃ liṅgaṃ vacanañca tathā pañcālādiśabdānāmapīti nārtho yuktavadbhāvacanena| yadyevam, kasmāt pūrvaṃ taduktam? pratiṣedhaviṣayopadarśanārtham| na hranirdiṣṭaviṣayasya pratiṣedhaḥ śakyate karttu jñātuṃ vā||`yogaprakhyānāt` iti|yogo janapadādeḥ kṣatriyādibhiḥ saha sambandhaḥ, tasyāprakhyānādanupalabdherityarthaḥ| ye hi yoganimittikāḥ śabdā yogamabhidhāya tadvati dravye vartante, tebhyo yoga upalabhyate; yathā - daṇḍiśabdādibhyaḥ| na ca pañcālādibhyo daṇḍaādiśapabdavadyoga upalabhyate, tasmānnaite yogaśabdā ityata āha- `na hi` ityādi| prakhyāyate = kathyate, prakāśyate, buddherviṣaya āpadyata iti yāvat| yata evaṃ pañcālā varaṇā iti sambandho na prakhyayate ata eva naitadupalabhāmahe vṛkṣayogānnagare varaṇā iti, kiṃ tarhi? saṃjñā etā anapekṣitapravṛttinimittāḥ| yadi saṃjñāśbadā ete, tataḥ kimityāha - `tasmādatra` ityādi| gatārtham| nanu ca saṃjñā śabdānāmapi vyutpattyartha taddhita utpadyata e, yathā <> [[5.2.133]] hastī, <> [[5.1.3]] kambalyamiti, tatkimucyate - ` tasmādatra <> [[4.2.69]] <> [[4.2.70]] iti taddhito notpadyate` iti? satyam, saṃjñāśabdavyutpattyarthaṃ taddhita utpadyate| sa ca kvotpadyate? yatra śrutikṛto viśeṣo vidyate, na ceha taddhitotpattau lupi satikaścidviśeṣa iti na taddhitotpattiḥ||`yogapramāṇe` iti| yogasya pramāṇaṃ yogapramāṇam, yena yogaḥ pratyāyyate| tat punariha prakṛtatvāt pañcālādiśabdaḥ| sa hi paramatena pañcālādisambandhaṃ svapravṛttinimittamabhidhāyaiva janapadādau vartate, nānabhidhāya| tena yogasya pramāṇaṃ pratyāyako vācaka ityarthaḥ| `tadabhāve'darśanaṃ syāt` iti| yo hi yoganimittakaḥ sa yogābhāve na prayujyate, daṇaḍaādiśabdavadityabhiprāyaḥ| `yogapramāṇe hi` ityādi| hiśabdaṃ hetvarthaṃ prayuñjānaścaśabdo hetvarthavṛttiḥ sūtre upātta iti darśayati| syādetat, bhavatyeva yogābhāve pañcālādiśabdasyādarśanamityata āha - `dṛśyate ca` ityādi| gatārtham|`anyapramāṇatvāt` iti| anyat pramāṇamavagatiheturyasyārthābhidhānalakṣaṇasya tadanyapramāṇam, tasya bhāvo'nyapramāṇatvam| `pradhānaṃ samāse kiñcit padam` iti| yathā rājapuruṣaśabde puruṣa ityetat| `pradhānopasarjane` ityādi| rājapuruṣa ityatra pūrvavadupasarjanam, itarat pradhānam| te ca pradhānārtha saha brāūtaḥ| `prakṛtipratyayau` ityādi| aśakyatvaṃ tvanantaprakāratvāt| tathā hi - citraguriti bahuvrīhau kṛte guṇaguṇibhyāmanyapadārtha ucyate| atra guṇapadaṃ citraśabdo'pradhānam, viśeṣaṇatvāt; guṇipadaṃ gośabdaḥ pradhānam, viśeṣyatvāt| kvacidupasarjanābhyāmanyo'rtho'bhidhīte - plakṣanyagrādhāviti| tathā hi, na kevalaṃ prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brāūtaḥ api tu, kvacit prakṛtyarthamapi, yathā - svārthikeṣu śuklataram, śuklatamamiti| tathā kecidākhyāteṣu svabhāvāt pradhānamāhuḥ prakṛtyartham - `kriyāpradhānamākhyātam` iti|anye tu manyante- ākhyāteṣu pradhānabhūtaḥ pratyayārtha eva śaktirūpeṇocyate, yathā vibhaktibhiḥ kvacit pratyaye; na tu śaktimān padārtho dravyabhāvamāpanna ucyate| ataḥ kriyāntareṇa ca sambandhe śaktyantaramāvirbhavati kartāraṃ paśyeti| evamādyanantaprakāramarthābhidhānaśakyaṃ sarvamupadeṣṭum, tasmāllokata evārthāvagatiḥ| kathaṃ punaretadvijñāyata ityata āha - `yairapi` ityādi| sugamam||bāla-manoramāvibhāṣopayamane 554, 1.2.56 vibhāṣopayamane| `yamo gandhane` itto yama iti, `hanaḥ sic` ityataḥ sijiti, `asaṃyogā`dityataḥ kiditi cānuvartate| tadāha - yamaḥ sickidvā syādvivāhe iti| upayamaśabdo vivāhe vartate iti bhāvaḥ| rāmaḥ sītāmupāyateti| bhāryātvena svīkṛtavānityarthaḥ| sicaḥ kittvapakṣe `anudāttopadeśe`ti makāralope `hrasvādaṅgā`diti sico lopaḥ| udavoḍheti| bhāryātvena svīkṛtavānityarthaḥ| sicaḥ kittvapakṣe `anudāttopadeśe`ti makāralope `hrasvādaṅgā`dita sico lopaḥ| udavoḍheti| bhāryātvena parigrahaḥ - udvāhaḥ| gandhanāṅge upayame tviti| hiṃsāpūrvake vivāhe tvityarthaḥ| rākṣasavivāhe tviti yāvat| `hatvā bhittvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudatīṃ rudato haret| sa rākṣaso vivāhaḥ-` iti smṛteḥ| nityaṃ kittvamiti| `yamo gandhane` iti pūrvasūtreṇe`ti śeṣaḥ| yadi gandhanāṅgake'pyupayamane paratvādiyaṃ vibhāṣā syāttarha eṣā prāptavibhāṣā syāt| tataśca `na veti vibhāṣe`tyatra bhāṣye'prāptavibhāṣāsvasyāḥ parigaṇanaṃ virudhyeta| ataḥ pūrvavipratiṣedha āśrayaṇīya iti bhāvaḥ|bāla-manoramāpradhānapratyayārthavacanamarthasyānyapramāṇatvāt 1279, 1.2.56 atha prasaṅgādanyadapi pūrvācāryaparibhāṣitaṃ nirācaṣṭe - pradhānapratyayārtha| pratyayārtha iti| `prakṛtyarthaṃ prati pratyayārthaḥ pradhānaṃ=viśeṣyam, prakṛtyarthastu tadviśeṣaṇa`mityevaṃ yatpūrvācāryavacanaṃ tadapītyarthaḥ|arthasyānyapramāṇatvādityuktam| kathaṃ punaratrāpyayaṃ heturlabhyata itipraśnāvasara ityāha - `tulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārthaḥ` iti| kathaṃ punastulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārtho bhavati? manyate - tulyamiti pratyākhyānakriyāviśeṣaṇametat| anantaroktena pratyākhyānena tulyametat pratyākhyānam| evañc tulyaṃ bhavati yadi yastasya hetuḥ sa evāsyāpi bhavati| tasmāt tulyagrahaṇasāmarthyāt pūrvako hetutrānuvartate| tena tulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārtho bhavatīti| `ānyāyyādutthānāt` ityādi| utthānaṃ śayanādrātreḥ paścime yāme nyāyyamuktam| saṃveśanam = śayanam tadapi rajanyāḥ prathame yāme nyāyyam| tadevaṃ sakalo divasaḥ; pūrvasyāśca rātreḥ paścimo yāmaḥ, āgaminyāśca prathamo yāma ityeṣo'dyatanaḥ kāla ityuktaṃ bhavati| `aharubhayato'drdharātram` ityādi| kṛtsno divasa ubhayaścādrdharātram| atikrāntāyāśca rātrerāgāminyāśca rātreradyatanaḥ kāla ityapare||`jātirnāmāyameko'rthaḥ ityādinā sūtrārambhasya prayojanamāha| nanu jāteḥ saṃkhyā na vidyate? tasyā dravyadharmatvāt| yadyapi vaiśeṣikasiddhāntaprasiddhā guṇapadārthasaṃgṛhītā yā saṃkhyā sā na vidyate; tathāpi `bhedakā guṇāḥ` ityasmaddarśane` bhedamātrā yā saṃkhyā sā vidyata evetyadoṣaḥ| `jāterākhyā` iti| ākhyānamākhyā = pratyāyanam| `ekasminnarthe` iti| jātyākhyo'rtho `jātyartho bahuvadbhavatīti yāvat` iti| etenaitaddarśayati - na hi jātiviśeṣaṇebhyaḥ sampannādibhyastanna syāt| teṣāmajātiśabdatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punarjātyarthasya bahuvadbhāvo labhyate? anvarthagrahaṇāt| bahuvacanamiha na pāribhāṣikaṃ bahuvacanaṃ gṛhrate, kiṃ tarhi? anvartham| uktiḥ = vacanam| bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ bahuvacam| na caikasminnarthe bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ sambhavati, ataḥ sāmarthyādvityartho gamyate - ekasminnarthe bahuviditi| tadanena prakāreṇa jātyartho bahuvadbhavati| `tena` ityādi| yata e jātyarthasya bahuvadbhāvo vidhīyate, tena jātiviśeṣaṇānāmajātau vartamānānāṃ bahuvacanamupapadyate, jātiśabdavat|`devadattaḥ` iti| devadattaśabdo yadṛcchāśabdaḥ| nānenaikaṃ vastvanekavyaktyanugatamabhidhīyate| anekavyaktyādhārā hi jātiḥ| tato na devadattatvaṃ nāma jātirastīti na bhavatyatra bahuvadbhāvaḥ| nanu cātrāvasthābhedenānekādhāraṃ devadattatvamasti, naitadasti; evaṃ hi jātigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, sarvatra jāteḥ sambhavāt| tasmājjātigrahaṇasāmarthyālloke ye jātiśabdāḥ, pratītāḥ, tadarthā evātra jātiśabdena vivakṣitā iti vijñāyate, na ca devadattaśabdo loke jātiśabdaḥ pratītaḥ|`kāśyapapratikṛtiḥ kāśyapaḥ` iti| kāśyapasyāpatyam `anṛṣyānantarye vidādibhyo'ñ` [[4.1.104]] ityañ - kāśyapa iti| tata ivārthe `eve pratikṛtau` [[5.3.96]] iti kan| `lum manuṣye` [[5.3.98]] iti lap bhavati| `ayaṃ jātiśabdaḥ` iti| `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha` (4.1.63ma|bhā) iti lakṣaṇāt, tasya ca gotrapratyayāntatvāt| na tvayaṃ jātirūpeṇocyate, kiṃ tarhi? pratikṛtiriti| evaṃ tarhi jātipratyāyane hi cikīrṣite bahuvadbhāvena bhavitavyam| na ceha jātipratyāyanaṃ cikīrṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? pratikṛtipratyāyanam|`vrīhiyavau` iti| ekasmiñjātyarthe bahuvadbhāvo'nena vidhīyate| iha tu dvau jātyartho vivakṣitau| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - anyatarasyāmiti vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam| tena saṃkhyāprayoge na bhaviṣyati| atha vā- eko vrīhiḥ sampanna ityatraikaśabdaḥ prayujyamāno jātyarthasyaikatvamudbhāvayati,tacca bahutvena virudhyate| tasmādekatvabahutvayorvirodhādbahuvadbhāvo neha bhaviṣyati||atrāpyarthasya bahutvātideśaḥ| `asmado yo'rthaḥ sa bahuvadbhavati` iti| tena tiṅantasyāpi tatra vartamānasya bahuvacanāntatvaṃ bhavati| `vayaṃ brāūmaḥ` iti| `ekatve dvitve ca` ityādi| yuktaṃ yadekatve bhavati, dvitve tu katham? na hi dvitvamasmadarthasya sambhavati; asmacchabdasyātmaviṣayatvāt, ātmanaścaikatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ātmatvaṃ paratra yadopacaryate `ayaṃ me dvitīya ātmā` iti tadā asmacchabdasya tatrāpi vṛttedvaryarthaviṣayatvaṃ sambhavati| atha vā - tyadādīnāṃ mitho yadyat paraṃ tacchiṣyata ityasmacchabda eva śiṣyamāṇo yuṣmadarthamapyāheti dvayarthatopapadyata iti yujyate dvayarthatā| atha yadyasmacchabdo bahuvacanāntaḥ prayujyate tadaikārthaviṣayo'yam, na dvayarthaviṣaya iti; atha dvyarthaviṣayo'yaṃ naikārthaviṣaya iti kutasyasyaikārthadvayarthaviṣaye vṛttiravasīyate? prakaraṇāt| yathā - ārācchabdasya dūrāntikārthayorvṛttiriti| `aham` iti| <<ṅe prathamayoram>> [[7.1.28]] ityambhāvaḥ, <> [[7.2.94]] ityahāradeśaḥ| `vayam` iti| jasi <> [[7.2.91]] <> [[7.2.93]] ita vayādeśaḥ, <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] `āvām` iti| aupratyaye <> [[7.2.92]] ityāvādeśaḥ| `prathamāyāśca` [[7.2.88]] ityādinātvam| vaktavya iti vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānāṃ tu - anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ yadanuvartatate tasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| `yuṣmadi gurāvekeṣām` iti| etadapi cakārasyānukta samuccayārthatvāt sūtreṇaiva saṃgṛhītam||`cakāro dvayoranukarṣanārthaḥ` iti| nanu ca phalgunyau nakṣatre dve eva, tathā proṣṭhapade api dve; atrānayorditvādvitva eva bahuvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat kiṃ cakāreṇa dvayorityanukarṣaṇārthena? evaṃ tahrretajjñāpayati - nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣa upalakṣaṇārthamiti| tenaitadapi siddhaṃ bhavati - uditāḥ pūrvāḥ phalguṇyaḥ, udite pūrve phalgunyāviti| yadi nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣa upalakṣaṇārthamiti na jñāpyate, tadiha tu na syāt, yato jyotiṣāmāvasthikī nakṣatratā candramasā yoge sati bhavati, nānyadā; anyadā tu jyotiṣṭvameva| na ca nakṣatrābhidhāyinaḥ `uditāḥ pūrvāḥ phalgunyaḥ` ityatra phalgunīśabdasya prayogaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? jyotirmātrābhidhāyina iti| atra jyotiṣṭvameksayāpyastīti tannivṛtyarthaṃ dvayorityanukarṣaṇārthaṃ cakārakaraṇaṃ yuktam| yadi punajryotiṣaupalakṣaṇārthaṃ nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ na syāt, tadā kva syāt? tadehaiva syāt - adya pūrvāḥ phalgunyaḥ, adya pūrve phalgunyāviti| asti hyatra phalgunyornakṣatratā, candramasā yuktatvāt| tathā ha - <> [[4.2.3]] ityaṇ bhavati| śravaṇaṃ tasya na bhavati; <> [[4.2.4]] iti luptatvāt|`phalgunyau māṇavike` iti| phalgunyorjāte iti| `phalgunyāṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau` (vā|451) ityupasaṃkhyānāṭṭapratyayaḥ| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp||`tiṣyapunarvasavo māṇavakāḥ` iti| tiṣyapunarvasuśabdābhyāṃ <> [[4.2.3]] ityaṇ bhavati| tasya <> [[4.2.4]] iti lup| tatastiṣye jāto māṇavakaḥ punarvasvorjātau māṇavakāviti `sandhivelādi` [[4.3.16]] ityādinā'ṇ, tasya `śraviṣṭhāphalgunyanurādhā` [[4.3.34]] ityādinā lup| `paryāyāṇāmapi yathā syāt` iti| nakṣatragrahaṇe satyarthagrahaṇādetadbhavati| śabdagrahaṇe ca <> [[1.1.68]] ityaṣā paribhāṣā bhavatītyuktametat| tadabhāve paryāyāṇāmapi bhavati| `siddhyapunarvasū` iti| siddhyaśabdastiṣyaparyāyaḥ| `yastiṣyastau punarvasū yeṣām` ityavayavena vigrahaṃ darśayati| samudāyastu samāsārtho veditavyaḥ| atha tiṣyapunarvasava iti? bahuvrīhiṇā viparyastamatayaḥ puruṣā evaivamucyante| tataśca nakṣatrasamāsa evāyaṃ na bhavati| tat kimetannivṛttyarthena dvandvagrahaṇenetyevaṃ yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha - `tiṣyādaya eva` ityādi| svadarṇanāparādhādanyathā tiṣyādīn dṛṣṭvā pratipattṛbhista e tiṣyādayo viparyayeṇa dṛśyamānā bahuvrīhiṇaivamucyante, na tu puruṣāḥ| tasmānnakṣatrasamāsa evāyam| `tiṣyapunarvasvidam` iti| kena punaratraikavadbhāvaḥ? `jātiraprāṇinām` [[2.4.6]] iti cet, na; saṃjñāśabadtvāt, devadattādiśabdavat| nāyaṃ jātiśabdaḥ,anekadhārā hi jātirbhavati, na ca tiṣyādistathā| kiñca vakṣyati - `jātipradhānaparatve ca jātidravyāṇāmayamekavadbhāvaḥ, na niyatadravyavivakṣāyām` iti; niyatadravyavivakṣā cātra, tasmānna `jātiraprāṇinām` ityanenaikavadbhāva upapadyate| na cānyadekavadbhāvalakṣaṇamasti| tatra tiṣyapunarvasvornakṣatre dvandvasamāse bahutvādbahuvacanena bhavitavyam| evañca bahuvacanagrahaṇamanarthakamityata āha - `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣā` ityādi| yadayamekavacananivṛttyarthaṃ bahuvacanagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tato'vasīyate - astīyamparibhāṣā `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣaikavadbhavatiṭa (vyā|pa|91) iti| teneha bahuvacanagrahaṇamekavacananivṛttyarthaṃ kṛtimityabhiprāyaḥ|`sarūpāṇām` iti bahuvrīhau kṛte `jyotirjanapada` [[6.3.84]] ityādinā samānasyasabhāvaḥ| rūpaśabdo'tra svabhāve vartate| `sarūpāṇāṃ śabdānām` iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| tena svarūpāṇāṃ madhye samānajātīyo yaḥ sarūpaḥ, sa eka eva śiṣyate, na virūpaḥ| samānajātīyasyaiva hi nirdhāraṇaṃ bhavati, na vijātīyasya| atha vā - samudāyalakṣaṇaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī, sarūpasamudāyāntaḥ pātī ca sarūpa eva bhavati, na virūpaḥ| tena sarūpa eva śiṣyate| `eka vibhaktau` iti| ekaśabdaḥ samānārthaḥ, ekadhanāviti yathā| ekā cāsau vibhaktiśceti `pūrvakālaika` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| ekamekaśeṣa ityatrāpi| atra tvekaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvacanaḥ, śeṣaśabdo'yaṃ nivṛttyā viśiṣṭavasthānamāha, nāvasthānamātram| ata evāha - `ekaḥ śiṣyate, apare nivartante` iti| `vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣau` ityādi| avibhaktikānāmayamekaśeṣaḥ; anaimittakatvādvibhakteḥ| na hrayaṃ parāṃ vibhaktimāśritya vidhīyate| ekavibhaktāvitīhasārūpyopalakṣaṇametat, na nimittanirdeśaḥ| ekasyāṃ vibhaktau parato yāni rūpāṇi dṛṣṭāni, teṣāmanutpannāyāmeva vibhaktau prātipadikānāmekaśeṣo bhavati| tataḥ kṛta ekaśeṣe vibhaktirupapadyate| atha vā - savibhaktikānāmevaikaśeṣaḥ, katham? vibhaktiśabdena hi kārakamabhidhīyate, vibhajyate prātipadikārtho'nayeti kṛtvā| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - ekasmin samāne'bhinne kārake yāni sarūpāṇi teṣāmevaikakārakāṇāmekaśaṣo bhavatīti| yadyevam, `parataḥ` iti vṛttigrantho nopapadyate, kārakaṃ hrarthasamavāyinī śaktiḥ, na ca tayā śabdānāṃ paurvāparyaṃ sambhavati, kathañca vibhaktiśabdena kārake'bhidhīyamāne savibhaktikānāmekaśeṣo labhyate? ucyate; vṛttigranthastāvadupapadyate - paraśabdo hrayamiṣṭavācī, ekavibhaktau parataḥ = ekasyāṃ vibhaktāviṣṭāyāmityarthaḥ| viṣayasaptamī ceyam, sati saptamī vā| ekasmin kārake viṣayabhūta iṣṭe sati saptamī vā| ekasmin kārake viṣayabhūta iṣṭe sati cetyarthaḥ| kiñceṣṭaṃ kārakaṃ bhavati? yadvivakṣitam| ata e vivakṣitatvāt kārakaṃ svanimittāṃ vibhaktikānāmekaśeṣo labhyate|sahabhāvavivakṣāyāñcāyamekaśeṣo bhavati| yadyekena yugapat sarveṣāmartho'bhidhātumiṣyata evaṃ sati bhavati; nānyathā| nanu ca jātiḥ padārthaḥ, jātiścaikaiva; tatraikatvājjāterbahūnāṃ śabdānāṃ prasaṅga eva nāsti,tatkimekaśeṣārambheṇa? iti codyāvasare `dravyaṃ padārthaḥ` ityetaddarśanamāśrityāha - `pratyartham` ityādi| pratyartham = ekaikasminnarthe yasmācchabdānāṃ niveśapravṛttistato'kena śabdenānekārthsayābhidhānam| tatraitaddarśane'keṣāmarthābhidhāne pratyekenaiva kartavye'nekaśabdatvaṃ prasajyata iti yāvantaste'rthāstāvatāṃ śabdānāṃ prayogaḥ prāpnoti, iṣyate caikaśabdatā| tasmādekaśeṣa ārabhyate|`rūpagrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| evaṃ manyate - rūpagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe padadvayasamanugamyo'rtheḥ pratipattavya iti pratipattigauravaṃ bhavati| samānānāmityucyamāne satyekapadasamanuhamyo'rthaḥ pratīyata iti pratipattilāghavaṃ bhavati; tasmāt samānagrahaṇameva kartavyamiti? bhinne'pyarthe yathā syāditi rūpagrahaṇam| yadi rūpagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā viśeṣānabhidhānādyatra sarva samānaṃ śabdo'rthaśca tatraiva syādvṛkṣā ityādau, akṣā ityādau tu na syāt; arthabhedāt| tathā hrakṣaśabda indriyākhye, śakaṭāṅge, bibhītakādāvarthe ca vartateṣa pādaśabdo'pi kārṣāpaṇa - ślokapāda - pāṇipadādāvarthe vartate, māṣaśabdo'pi vrīhrādau| `dvibahvoḥ śeṣe mā bhūt` iti| nanu ca `śeṣa` ityekatvasaṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ dvayorbahūnāñca śeṣo na bhaviṣyati,naitadevam; iha vidhīyamānatvāccheṣa eva pradhānam, na ca pradhāne saṃkhyā vivakṣyate| tathā hi - `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma` [[1.4.49]] itikarmasaṃjñā; īpsitatamasya prādhānyāt| asatyāṃ saṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ dvayorbahūnāñca karmasaṃjñā bhavati| guṇe tu saṃkhyā vivakṣyate, yathā - `ṅayāpprātipadikāt` [[4.1.1]] iti svādayo vidhīyamānatvāt pradhānam; ṅayāpprātipadikamapradhānamiti tatra saṃkhyā vivakṣyate| tenaikaikmādeva svādaya upapadyante| lakṣaṇānurodhādguṇe'pi kvacit saṃkhyā na vivakṣyate, yathā ihaiva - sarūpāṇāmiti| tena dvayorapi sarūpayorekaḥ śiṣyate|`ādeśo mā bhūt` iti| asati śeṣagrahaṇe sarūpāṇāmiti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyaṃ syāt; tataśacādeśaḥ syāt| evañca `aśūpruṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan` (da|u|8|125) iti kvanpratyayānto'āśabdo nitsvarādādyudātta iti dvayoraāśabdayorādyudattayoḥ sthāna ādyudāttadvayavānevādeśaḥ syāt; āntaratamyāt|`payaḥ` ityādi| ekaḥ payaḥ śabdaḥ prathamāntaḥ kartṛpadam, dvitīyo dvitīyāntaḥ karmapadam, tato bhinnavibhaktikatvam;naikavibhaktiparatvamityekaśeṣo na bhavati|` brāāhṛṇābhyām` iti| prathamo brāāhṛṇaśabdastṛtīyāntaḥ,dvitīyastu catuthryantaḥ| tenātrāpi samānavibhaktikatvaṃ nāsti||vṛddhaśabdo'yamasti laukikaḥ, yaścarame vayasi vartate; asti ca śāstrīyaḥ - <> [[1.1.73]] iti; asti ca pūrvācāryasaṃjñā - apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti| tatra yadi laukiko gṛhreta? yuvaśabdasyāpi tatsāhacaryāllaukikasyaiva vayoviśeṣavācino grahaṇaṃ syāt, tataścājaśca varkaraścetyevamādau prasajyeta| vṛddhāvastho hi paśuviśeṣo'ja ityucyate, yuvā tu varkaraḥ| atha śāstrīya upādīyate? aupagavaścaupagaviścetyādāvapi syādityetadālocyāha - `vṛddhaśabdaḥ` ityādi| etena pūrvācāryapraṇītāyāḥ saṃjñāyā vṛddhasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti darśayati| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? upadeśāt| atha vā evaṃ manyate - yuvaśabdo yadyapi loke dvitīye vayasi rūḍhaḥ, tathāpi <> [[4.1.163]] iti paribhāṣābalādapatye yo vartate sa eva gṛhrate| tena tatsāhacaryāt vṛddhaśabdasyāpatyārthavṛttereva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti| gotragrahaṇaṃ tu na kṛtam, vaicitryārtham| `yūnā saha vacane` iti| sahagrahaṇena yūneti sahayoga eṣā tṛtīyeti darśayati| ata e sahayoge tṛtīyāvidhānādavagamyate- sahabhāvavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣo bhavatīti| `samānāyām` ityādinā yatra vṛddhayunimittameva vairūpyaṃ tadva#iṣayaṃ darśayati| ākṛtiḥ= śabdasya pravṛttinimittam, gāgryātvādi, tasyāṃ samānāyām = abhinnāyāṃ yatra vṛddhayuvapratyayādeva kevalaṃ bhidyete, nānyat prakṛtyādikam, tatra vṛddhayuvapratyayanimittameva vairūpyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `gāgryaśca` ityādi| gargavatsaśabdābhyāṃ gargāditvād yañ, gārgyaḥ, vātsyaḥ, tābhyāṃ yūnyapatye <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak| gāgryaśca gāgryāyaṇaśca gārgyau, vātsyaśca vātsyāyanaśca vātsyau| prakaraṇādinātra yuvārtho gamyate| `gargaśca` iti| gargaśabdo'yaṃ mūlaprakṛtatiḥ; na vṛddhe vartate, nāpi yūni| `gāgryavātsyāyanau` iti| atra na kevalaṃ vṛddhayuvapratyayanimittako viśeṣo'sti, api tu prakṛtinimittako'pi| bhāgavittiśabdo gotrāpatye bhagavittaśabdādiñantaḥ| `bhāgavittikaśca` iti| bhāgavittiśabdādyūnyapatye <> [[4.1.147]] ityataḥ `kutsane` ityanuvṛttau <> [[4.1.148]] iti ṭhak||stryarthasya vairūpyakāraṇasyādhikyāt pūrveṇa na sidhyatīti vacanam| `puṃvacca` iti vacanādatadeśo'yam| `strī` iti| strīpratyayagrahaṇaṃ vedaṃ syāt? stryarthavṛttiśabdasya vā grahaṇam? arthagrahaṇaṃ vā? yadi strīpratyayasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tato'nena tasyaiva nivṛttiḥ kriyate - puṃvat strīpratyayo bhavatīti; na tu stryarthasya nivṛttiḥ kriyate; tato gāgryaśca gāgryāyaṇaśceti gargā ityatra `astriyāma` [[2.4.62]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[2.4.64]] iti luṅana syāt; iha tu gargān paśyatīti <> [[6.1.103]] iti natvaṃ na syāt| dvitīye tu pakṣe stryarthavṛtteḥ śabdasyānena puṃvadbhāvaḥ kriyate, na tu strītvasya nivṛttiḥ; tathāpi sa eva doṣaḥ syāt| arthagarhaṇe tu na kaściddoṣa ityataḥ stryarthasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti matvā''ha - `stryarthaḥ puṃvadbhavati` iti| kathaṃ punararthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ labhyate? ucyate; strīpratyayānāṃ tu tasyābhidheyapātantryāt| arthasyāprādhānyamapāratantrayāt| pradhānaguṇana bhavati; aprādhānyāt| apradhānyaṃ tu tasyābhidheyapāratantryāt| arthasyāprādhānyamapāratantryāt| pradhānaguṇasannipāte tu pradhānasya grahaṇaṃ nyāyyamataḥ stryarthaṃ eva gṛhrate| `gārgī, vātsī ca` iti| gāgryavātsyaśabdābhyāṃ `yañaśca` [[4.1.16]] iti ṅīp,pūrvavadakārayakāralopo| `dākṣī` iti| pūrvavanṅīp| `dākṣāyaṇaśca` iti| dākṣerapatyamiti <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak||`strīpuṃsalakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣaḥ` iti| yadyevam, iha na syāt - gauścāyaṃ gauśceyamityetau gāvau tiṣṭhata iti, na hyatra strīpuṃsakṛtaḥ kaścidviśeṣo'sti? mā bhūdanena , `sarūpāṇām` [[1.2.64]] ityādinā bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; yadi hi tena syāt strīśabdasyāpyekaśeṣaḥ prasajyeta| tataśca strīliṅgatāpi syāt liṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvāt| strīliṅgasyaikaśeṣe kṛte puṃsatvaṃ vivakṣitavyamityadoṣaḥ|atha vā, pumāniti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate| tenehāpyasatyapi strīpuṃsakṛte viśeṣe puṃsa evaikaśeṣo bhavati| na caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅago bhavati; yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddheriti| `brāāhṛṇī, kukkuṭī, mayūrī` iti| `jāterastrīvaṣayādayopaghāt` [[4.1.63]] iti ṅīṣ| `kukkuṭamayūryau` iti| atra na kevalaṃ strīpuṃsakṛto viśeṣaḥ,kiṃ tarhi? ākṛtiśrutikṛto'pi| `indrāṇī` iti| `indravaruṇa` [[4.1.49]] ityādinā ṅīṣ, ānugāgamaśca| `prāk ca prācī` iti| prāñcīti prapūrvādañcateḥ `ṛtvik` [[3.2.59]] ityādinā kvin, <> [[8.2.62]] iti kutvam| kvinantāt `dikchabdebhyaḥ` [[5.3.27]] ityādinā'stātipratyayaḥ| tasya <> [[5.3.30]] ) iti luk| `prācī` iti| prākchabdāt <> [[6.3.45]] ityatrāñcateścopasaṃkhyānānṅīp| `prāgityavyayam` iti| <> [[1.1.38]] ityavyayatvam||`anapuṃsakena` iti| `kima` ityādi| nanu ca vinā napuṃsakenāpi sahavacanena sarūpāṇāmityādinaikaśeṣo bhavatyeva; tat ko'tra viśeṣaḥ, yastenaikaśeṣo vidhīyamānaḥ, anenaiva cetyata āha - `ekavacceti na bhavati` iti| yadyanenaikaśeṣaḥ syāt, pakṣa ekavadbhāvaḥ syāt| tena tvekaśeṣe sati na bhavati| athāsyeti kimarthamucyate? yadyasyeti nocyeta, uttaratrāpyekavaccetyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tataścottaratra tu yasyaikaśeṣaḥ kariṣyate, tasyaikavadbhāvaḥ prasajyeta| tasmādasyaiva napuṃsakasyaikavadbhāvo yathā syāt| uttaratra tu yasyaikaśeṣaḥ kariṣyate, tasya mā bhūdityevamarthamasyeti vacanam| asyeti hi vacane sati mā bhūdasya vaiyathryamityuttaratrāpyekavacceti nānuvartate| nanu cāsvaritatvādeva nānuvartaṣyate| evaṃ tarhi tadevāsvaritatvamanena prakāreṇākhyāyate vispaṣṭārtham| ekāro'trānuvartate| tena himañca himānī ca himahimānyau, araṇyañcāraṇyānī cāraṇyāraṇyānyāvityatra na bhavati| indravaruṇādisūtreṇa [[4.1.49]] `himāraṇyayormahatve` (vā| 352) iti vacanāt mahattvamaparo viśeṣaḥ||`pitarau` iti| `ṛto ṅi` [[7.3.110]] iti guṇaḥ| `mātāpitarau` iti| `ānaṅṛto dvandve` [[6.3.24]] ityānaṅa, abhyarhitatvanmātuḥ pūrvanipātaḥ||`sarvagrahaṇaṃ sākalyārtham` iti| vinā tenānapuṃsakenetyasyānuvṛttirāśaṅkyeta, tataśca napuṃsakena saha na syāt| atha vā - tallakṣamaścedeva viśeṣa ityetadihānuvartata ityāśaṅkyeta, tataśca yatra tyadādikṛta eva viśeṣastatraiva syāt - sa ca yaśca yāvityādi, ihi tu na syāt- sa ca devadattaśac tāviti| ataḥ sarvagrahaṇam| `sa ca devadattaśca tau` iti| yadā viśeṣavivakṣā tadaitadudāharaṇam, yadā tu sāmānyavivakṣā , tadā devadatto'pi tacchabdena sambadhyata iti `sarūpāṇām` [[1.2.64]] ityanenanaiva sidhyati| `yadyatparam` iti| gaṇapāṭhāpekṣaṃ paratvaṃ veditavyam||`grāmyāṇām` iti| grāme bhavā grāmyāḥ| `grāmādyakhañau [[4.2.93]] iti yaḥ| nanu ca saṅghasya tarumatvaṃ na sambhavati, nāpi tadvayavacchedyaṃ taruṇatvam| ataḥ `ataruṇeṣu ` ityayuktaṃ viśeṣaṇamityāha- `ataruṇagrahaṇam` ityādi| ucyate cedaṃ viśeṣaṇam, na ca saṅghasya tatsambhavati, tatra sāmarthyādanyeṣāṃ saṅgho vijñāyate| `gāvaḥ imāḥ` iti| imā ityanuprayogaḥ strītvābhivyaktaye| `etau gāvau` iti| kathaṃ punaridaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, yāvatā dvābhyāmapi saṅgho bhavatyeva? naiṣa doṣaḥ, yasmāt mataṃ syāt saṅghagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, vyavacchedyābhāvāt| `anekaśapheṣu` ityādi| anekāni śaphāni khurā yeṣāṃ teṣvayamekaśeṣo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamihānuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenānekaśapheṣveva bhavati,nānyatreti||iti śrobodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃprathamādhyāyasyadvitīyaḥ pādaḥbhūrādiryeṣāṃ te bhūvādayaḥ| bhūvādayo daśagaṇīparipaṭhitā gṛhyante| `bhavati` ityādi| atra dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `dhātoḥ` [[3.1.91]] ityanuvartamāne `vartamāne laṭ` [[3.2.123]] iti laṭpratyayaḥ| `bhū ityevamādayaḥ śabdā dhātusaṃjñakā bhavanti` ityanena gaṇapāṭhenaiveyaṃ dhātusaṃjñā vidhīyata iti darśayati| tena aṇapayati, kaḍḍpayati ityevamādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| yadyavam, yā-vā- diva-ityevamādīnāṃ sarvanāma - vikalpa-svargābhidhāyināṃ dhātusamānaśabdānāmakriyāvacanānāmapi dhātusaṃjñā prāpnotīti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha - `dhātuśabdaḥ` ityādi| laghvarthaṃ hi saṃjñākaraṇamicchantyācāryā ityekākṣarāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ mahatyāḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñāyā yadāśrayaṇaṃ tasyaitatprayojanam - yathāvidhānāṃ te dhātusaṃjñāṃ kṛtavantaḥ, tathāvidhānamevaiṣā saṃjñā yathā syāditi| te ca kriyāvacanānāmeva dhātusaṃjñāṃ vihitavantaḥ| tadihāpi pūrvācāryasaṃjñāśrayaṇāt kriyāvacanānāmeva dhātusaṃjñā vidhīyate| tena yā-vā-diva ityevamādīnāṃ dhātusamānaśabdānāmakriyāvacanānānna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|nanu ca bhūrādiryeṣāmiti bahuvrīhau kṛte, ādiśabde parato yadi saṃhitayā nirdeśaḥ, tadā <> [[6.1.77]] iti yaṇādeśe kṛte `bhvādayaḥ` iti bhavitavyam, athāsaṃhitayā nirdeśastadā bhū ādaya iti, tatkuto'yaṃ vakāro yasmin sati bhūvādaya iti nirdeśo bhavatītyata āha - `bhavādīnām` ityādi| bhūvādīnāṃ saṃjñināṃ nirdeśe'yaṃ vakāro maṅgalārthaḥ prayujyate| maṅgalamarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa maṅgalaśabdo dharmaparyāyaḥ, dharmārtha iti yāvat| yathā vede `triyambakaṃ yajāmahe` ityatra yakārasya dṛṣṭaprayojanaṃ nāstrītyadṛṣṭārtho dharmārtha eva pāṭhastasya, tathehāpi vakāsya| atha vā - apūrvasya vastuno lābho loke maṅgalaṃ sammatam, yathā prātardadhyādīnām; tathehāpi vakārasyāpūrvasyalābho maṅgalaṃ praśastam| praśastārtho maṅgalaśabdaḥ| tathā coktam- `maṅgalādīni maṅgalamadhyāni maṅgalāntāni ca na; citsvarasya hi sarvasya rasyāpavādatvāt pratyayasvareṇahrantodāttatve siddhe citkaraṇasyaitat prayojanam - citsvara eva yathā syāt, yo'nyaḥ svaraḥ prāpnoti sa mā bhūditi| idaṃ tu pratyudāharaṇam - lomānyasya santīti <> [[5.2.100]] ityādinā śaḥ, lomaśaḥ? etadapi nāsti, atrāpi proyajanābhāvādevetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati| idaṃ tarhi pratyudāharam - `karṇalalāṭāt kanalaṅkāre` [[4.3.65]] iti bhāvārthe kan; karṇikā, yadyatretsaṃjñā syāt `kiti ca` [[7.2.118]] ityādivṛddhiḥ stāt, tataśca rūpameva na siddhyeta? yadyevam ivamevopanyasanīyam, netare? evaṃ manyate - etadartham `ataddhite`iti kriyamāṇamihāpi mandadhiyāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ parihartu cūḍālaḥ, lomaśa ityevamarthamapi bhavitumarhatīti||atha kimartham `tasya` ityucyate, yavātetsaṃjñāyāḥ prakṛtatvādyasyetsaṃjñā vihitā sāmarthyāttasyaiva lopo bhaviṣyatīti āha - `tasyagrahaṇam` ityādi| kaḥ punaritsaṃjñako yo'lontyasya nivṛttyarthaṃ tasyagrahaṇaṃ prayojanatītyāha - `ādirñiṭuḍavaḥ` iti| asati tasyagrahaṇe, eṣāmapi ñiprabhṛtīnām <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti vacanādantyasya lopaḥ syāt| tasyagrahaṇena tu prakṛta itsaṃjñake sannidhāpite sarvasya lopo bhavati, nāntyasya; anyathā hi tasyagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| yadi tu `nānarthake'lo'ntyavidhiḥ` (vyā|pa|62) ityeṣā paribhāṣā''śrīyate, tadā tasyagrahaṇamakartuṃ śakyate| tat kriyate vispaṣṭārtham|`saṃkhyāśabdenātra kramo lakṣyate` iti| yatrāneke uddeśino'nudeśinaśca, tatrāniyamena sambandhe prāpte niyamārthaṃmidamārabhyate| yatroddeśino'nudeśino'nekasaṃkhyāḥ; tatrāvaśyaṃ saṃkhyābhedena bhavitavyam| yatra ca saṃkhyābhedaḥ, tatra niyatabhāvī kramaḥ ; saṃkhyābhedavatāṃ yugapaduccārayitumaśakyatvāt| ataḥ sāhacaryāt saṃkhyāśabdena kramo lakṣyate| arthadharmatvaṃ tu śabde samāropya saṃkhyāśabdena kramo lakṣyata ityuktam| yathākramagrahaṇaṃ kathaṃ na kṛtam? vaicitryārtham|`yathāsaṃkhyam` iti| `yathā'sādṛśye` [[2.1.7]] iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| `anudiśyata ityanudeśaḥ` iti| <> [[3.3.19]] iti ghañ| `paścāduccāryate` iti| anuśabdasya paścādarthavṛttitvāddiścoccāraṇakriyatvāt| `samasaṃkhyānam` iti| samasaṃkhyatayā samānatvaṃ darśayati| `{samaṃ paripaṭhitānāmiti mūla (kāśikā) pāṭhaḥ| }samagaṇanaparipaṭhitānāma` iti| tamevārthaṃ śabdāntareṇa vyaktīkaroti| `uddeśināmanudeśināñc` iti| yathākramamityetadapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| uddeśino yadyapi sūtre na śrūyante, tathāpi sambandhitvāt paścādbhāvasyānudeśagrahaṇāllabhyante| `yathākramam` iti| pūrvavadvīpasāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, tṛtīyāntañcaitat; tadayamatrārthaḥ- uddeśināmanudeśināñca yo'yaṃ kramastena krameṇānudeśinaḥ sambadhyanta uddeśibhiḥ saheti| yadyapyuddeśināmiti ṣaṣṭhantaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpyarthādvibhaktervipariṇāmo bhaviṣyatīti tṛtīyāntaṃ sampadyate| `prathamāt prathamaḥ` ityādinā yathākramasambandhaṃ darśayati| ādiśabdastṛtīyāt tṛtīyaḥ, caturthāccaturtha ityādiparigrahāya| taudeya ityādau `so'syābhijanaḥ` [[4.3.90]] ityatrārthe taddhitaḥ|`iha` ityādi| `veśoyaśāaderbhagāt` 94.4.132) iti dve prakṛtī, `yalkhau` iti pratyayāvapi dvāveva; ato yathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| iha kenacinadācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratigrāhitāḥ - `veśo yaśa āderbhagādyal kha ca` ityeko yogaḥ| anye tu dvāvetau yogaviti- `veśoyaśa āderbhagāt` ityeko yogaḥ, `yal kha ca` iti dvitīyaḥ| tatra ya eka evāyaṃ yoga ityevaṃ śiṣyā grāhitāstānpratyayaṃ praśnaḥ| vṛttikāreṇāpi tanmatamevāśritya`svaritena` ityādinā parīhāra uktaḥ| ye tu dvāvetau yogāvityevaṃ grāhitāstān pratyeṣa praśno nāsti; yogavibhāgenaiva yathāsaṃkhyasya syāt, yogavibhāgakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ svaritena liṅgena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ labhyate, yāvatā neha svaritagrahaṇamastītyāha - `svaritenādhikāraḥ` ityādi| <> [[1.3.11]] iti yogaṃ vibhajya `svaritena` ityeko yogaḥ, `adhikāraḥ` iti dvitīyaḥ| tatra prathamo yogaḥ pūrveṇāpi `yathāsaṃkhyam` ityādinā sambadhyate| apiśabdāt pareṇāpi `adhikāraḥ` ityanena| yadi tarhi svaritena liṅgena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati, evaṃ hi sati sandehaḥ syāt| tathā hi - yathāsaṃkhyamiti svaritenādhikāro'pi tatra na jñāyate - kimadhikārārthaḥ svaritānuṣaṅgaḥ? atha vā yathāsaṃkhyārtha iti? sandehamātrametat| sarvanasandeheṣvidamucyate - `bhavati vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattirna hi sandehādalakṣaṇam` (vyā|pa|75) iti||`itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīya` iti| svaritena cihnenādhikārasyopalakṣaṇīyatvāt| yadi pāribhāṣikasyeha svatisya grahaṇaṃ syāt, <> [[8.4.1]] ityatra ṇakāraṇṇākārasyādhikārasyādhikāratā na syāt; paribhāṣikasyājdharmatvāt| ṇakārasyānackatvāditi matvā sarveṣāṃ varṇānāmacāṃ halāñca svaritākhyo yo varṇadharmo guṇasyasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayannāha - `svarito nāma svaradoṣo varṇadharmaḥ` iti| varṇadharmasya tu garhaṇamadhikārāvagamāya| sa iha halyapi svaritāsarañjanādvijñāyate| `adhikāro viniyogaḥ` iti| vyāpārakaraṇam| `adhikṛtatvāduttaratropatiṣṭhate` iti| yathā puruṣo yatrādhikṛto nagarādau tatraivopatiṣṭhate, tathā svaritaguṇayuktaṃ śabdarūpaṃ sūtrakāreṇa niyuktaṃ sūtrakāreṇa tatra tatropatiṣṭhate| `uttaratra` iti vacanamupalakṣaṇārtham| kvacit pūrvatrāpyupatiṣṭhata eva|kva punarasya sadbhāvo bhavati? kva ca vā na bhavati? ityāha - `pratijñāsvaritāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ` iti| pratijñayā svarito yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - yatreva ta ācāryāḥ svaritatvaṃ pratijānate tatraivāsya sadbhāvo bhavati, nānyatreti| tadapi pratijñānaṃ nāniyamena bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? yatrācāryāḥ smaranti tatraiva bhavati| sa cāyaṃ dharmaḥ kalāgadyupama iti veditavyaḥ| kāryārthamupādīyate, kṛtakāryastu nivartate; na tu prayogasamavāyī bhavati| <> [[3.1.1]] ityādinā ye'dhikārāḥ svaritanāvacchidyante teṣāmudāharaṇāni darśayati| atha kimartho'yamadhikāraḥ kriyate? pratiyogaṃ tas grahaṇaṃ mā kārṣīdityevamarthamiti cet, na; yathā devadattāya gaurdīyatāṃ kambalaścetyukte na ca punarucyate devadattāyeti, atha ca prastutatvāddevadattasya kambalaścetyasya sākāṅkṣatvāt tenaiva sambandho bhavati; tathā ca <> [[3.3.17]] `bhāve` [[3.3.18]] ityevamādīnāmapi vākyānāṃ sākāṅkṣatvādghañādīnāñca prastutatvāt taireva sambandho bhaviṣyati, tatkimadhikareṇa? satyametat; yatrānya nirdeśo nāsti tatropatiṣṭhate, yatra tvanyanirdeśastatrāsau prakṛtasya nivartaka eva syāt| tathā hi - gaurdīyatāṃ yajñadattāya kambalo viṣṇumitrāyetyukte'nyanirdeśena prastuto devadatto nivartatte| evañcānyanirdeśenāsya nivartakatve sati `abhividhau bhāva inuṇa` [[3.3.44]] ityasyenuṇo nirdeśena prastutasya ghaño nivartitatvāt `ākrośe'vanyogrrahaḥ` [[3.3.45]] ityatrānantareṇenuṇā sambandhaḥ syāt,na punavryavahitena ghañā,ghañ tviṣyate| nanu ca dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyād ghañevānuvartiṣyate tenaivābhisambandho bhaviṣyati, tathā ca tatra vakṣyati - `dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyāttatra ghañevānuvartate, nānantara inuṇ ` iti naitadasti; yadi dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyādaghaña evānuvṛttiḥ syāt, tadā `ṛdorap` [[3.3.57]] ittatrottareṣvapi yogeṣu ghañevānuvarteta, nāppratyayaḥ| yatpavunarvakṣyati - `dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyāt` iti, tatra dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyaśabdena svaritatvamevoktam| dṛṣṭamanuvṛttau sāmarthyam - adhikṛtasya śabdarūpasya yasmāditi bahuvrīhikṛtvā|tasmāt svaritatvādityayamatrārthaḥ| yadyeṣo'rthaḥ sūtrākārābhimataḥ syāt, svaritatvāditi kasmānnoktamiti cet? na;svacchandato hi vacasāṃ pravṛttiḥ, arthastu parīkṣaṇīya ityacodyatametat| tadevaṃ yato'nyanirdaśaḥ prastutasya nivartako bhavati tasmādadhikāraḥ kartavyaḥ| tasmaśca kriyamāṇe tadavagamopāyadarśanāya `svaritenādhikāraḥ` ityetadipa kartavyaḥ||`tatrāyaṃ niyamaḥ kriyate` iti| vidhīyamānatvāt pradhānasya pratyayasya na tu prakṛteriti vijñāyate| ata evāha - `anudātteto ye dhātavo ṅitaśca tebhyaḥ` iti| yadi punarayaṃ prakṛtiniyamaḥ syāt, tadā kiṃ syāt? anudāttaṅidbhyaḥ pratyayāntaraṃ na syāt| kāmaṃ vacanasāmarthyāt pratyayāntaramapi bhaviṣyatītyeṣa doṣaḥ śakyate parihartum| yastu vacanasāmarthyadvāreṇābhīṣṭe'rthe pratīyamāne pratipattigauravadoṣaḥ syāt, so'parihārya eva| yadi tarhi pratyayaniyamo'yam, tadā prakṛtīnāmaniyatatvāt tābhyaḥ parasmaipadamapi syāt? na bhaviṣyati; `śeṣātkartari parasmaidapadam` [[1.3.78]] iti dvitīyaniyamavidhānāt śeṣādeva parasmaipadam, nānyasmāditi| `āste` ityādi| `āsa upaveśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1021) `vasa ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1023), `ṣūṅa prāṇigarmavimocane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-031) , `śīṅa svapane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1032), adāditvācchapo luk| `śete` iti| <<śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ>> [[7.4.21]] ||bhāva iti dhātvarthaḥ kriyātmaka ucyate, karma tu pāribhāṣikameva| tatredamucyate niyamārthaṃ iti viśeṣaḥ| ayamapi pūrvat pratyayaniyaḥ - bhāvakarmaṇorevātmanepadaṃ bhavati, nārthaniyamaḥ| arthaniyame sati `ko bhavatā dāyodattaḥ`, `ko bhavatā lābho labdhaḥ` iti karmaṇi ghañādirdurlabhaḥ syāt| `supyate` iti| `ñiṣvap śaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1068) vacyādinā [[6.1.15]] samprāsaraṇ| `kriyate` iti| `riṅa śayagliṅakṣu` [[7.4.28]] iti riṅādeśaḥ| `lūyate kedāraḥ svayameva` iti| `karmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ` [[3.1.87]] ityatra vyapadeśātideśaśāsatrātideśapakṣayoḥ karmakartari parasmaipadena paratvādbhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākartumāha - `karmakartari` ityādi| `dvitīyaṃ kartarigrahaṇamupatiṣṭhate` iti| <> [[1.3.14]] ityataḥ| tena karttaiva yaḥ kartā śuddhaḥ kevalaḥ karmavadbhāvarahitaḥ, tatra parasmaipadaṃ bhavati; yatra karmavadbhāvastatrātmanepadaṃ bhavati|kāryātideśapakṣe `kramavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ` [[3.1.87]] ityanenaivātmanapepadaṃ bhavati|`karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī` iti| etena laukikamiha karma kriyātmakaṃ gṛhrate, na pāribhāṣikamiti darśayati| kuta etallabhyate? pratyāsatteḥ| kriyā hi dhātoḥ pratyāsannā, tatra sākṣādvṛtteḥ| sākṣādvṛttistu dhātuvācyatvāt kriyāyāḥ| pāribhāṣike tu sādhanātmake karmaṇi dhātuḥ sākṣānna vartate;tasyādhātuvācyatvāt| tasmāddhātuṃ pratina tasya pratyāsattiriti na gṛhrate, tena sādhanakarmavyatīhāre na bhavatyātmanepadam - devadattasya dhānyaṃ vyatilunantīti| lunātirupasaṃgarhārthe lavane vartate| devadattena yaddhānyaṃ saṅagṛhītaṃ purastāllavanenopasaṃgṛhṇantītyarthaḥ| tataścānyasambandhino dhānayasyānyena saṃgrahaṇādbhavati sādhanakarmavyatīhāraḥ| `anyasambandhinīm` iti| anyasya kartturabhīṣṭayā kriyemāṃ kriyāṃ kariṣyāmīti sehānyasambandhinyabhipretā, anyathā yadyanyena niṣpāditā yā kriyā sehānyasambandhinyabhipretā syāt tadā vyatihāro nopapadyeta, na hranyena niṣpāditāyāḥ punarniṣpādanamupapadyate| `vyatilunate` iti| <<ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ>> [[7.1.5]] ityadādeśaḥ, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ| atha kartṛgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? bhāvakarmanivṛttyarthamiti cet, na; abhīṣṭatvādbhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadam - vyatibhūyate senayā, vyatigamyante grāmāḥ, vyatihanyante dasyava iti| <> [[1.3.13]] ityanenaiva yathā syāt, anena mā bhūdityevamarthamiti cet, na; viśeṣābhāvāt| na hi tenātmanepade satyanena vā kaścidviśeṣo'sti| yadyanena syāt tadā <> [[1.3.15]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tena cātmanepade vidhīyamāne na bhavatyeṣa doṣa iti cet, satyam; eṣo'stu viśeṣaḥ,tathāpi na karttṛgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam; yasmāt `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) ityanantarā yā prāptiḥ sā pratiṣidhyate, na pūrvā| tena bhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadaṃ bhaviṣyati| ata āha - `karttṛgrahaṇamuttarārtham` iti| kaḥ punarasāvuttaro yogo yatrāsya prayojanamityāha - `śeṣāt` ityādi||`vyatigacchanti`iti| <> [[7.3.77]] iti chatvam, `che ca` [[6.1.71]] iti tuk| `vyatisarpanti` iti| `gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-982,983), laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| `vyatihiṃsanti` iti| `tṛhi hisi hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1348,1829)| `vyatighnanti` iti| `hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1012) `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityupadhāpalopaḥ, <> [[7.3.54]] iti kutvam|`pratiṣedhe` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdo'trānekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ pratipādane vartate| tacca pratipādanaṃ prakṛtatvāt pratiṣedhasyeti gamyate| tadayamarthaḥ - pratiṣedhe kartavye hasādīnāmapyātmanepadapratiṣadhasya pratipādanaṃ kartavyamiti| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - neti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena hasādīnāmapi bhaviṣyatīti| tataḥ `gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ` iti dvitīyo yogaḥ, tatra `na` iti vartate|kimarthaṃ punarayam? pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārtham, tena `na` iti yogavibhāgena hasādīnāmeva pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, nānyeṣyamiti|upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam| itaretarānyo'nyaśabdāvupapade yasya sa tathoktaḥ| athopapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, `netaretarānyo'nyābhyām` ityucyatām? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; evaṃ hrucyamāne pañcamīnirdeśāt <> [[1.1.67]] ityuttarasyaiva syāt - itaretarasya vyatilunantīti, iha tu na syāt - vyatilunantītaretarasyeti|`parasparopapadācceti vaktavyam` iti| parasparaśabda upapadaṃ yasya tasmāt pratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam- cakāro'tra kriyate| sa cānuktasamaccayārthaḥ| tena parasparopapadādapi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti|`niviśate` iti| `viśa praveśane` (1424) tudāditvācchaḥ|`nyaviśata` iti| aḍāgamena vyavadhānamityātmanepadena na bhavivyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha - `{yadāgamāstadgrahaṇena` iti - kāśikā|padamañjarī ca| aḍāgamaḥ` ityādi| `madhuni viśanti` iti| atra neḥ parasya viśaterātmanepadaṃ prāpnoti, tatkasmānna bhavatītyāha - `nerupasargasya` ityādi| madhuśabdasya saptameyakavacane <<iko'ci vibhaktau>> [[7.1.73]] iti numi madhunīti rūpaṃ bhavati, tasya cāvayavo niśabdo'narthakaḥ||`parikrīṇīte` iti| <<ī halyaghoḥ>> [[6.4.113]] itīttvam| `paryādaya upasargā gṛhyante` iti| katham? kriya iti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī, na pañcamī - kriyo ye sambandhinaḥ paryādaya iti| arthadvāraśca teṣāṃ sambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| sa copasargaireva paryādibhiḥ sambhavati; nānyairiti sāmarthyādupasargagrahaṇaṃ bhavati| `bahuvi krīṇāti` iti| bahavo vayo yasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| viśabdo'tra pakṣiṇi vartate||`sāhacaryāt` iti| upasargagrahaṇae hetuḥ <> [[1.3.17]] ityatra nerupasargasya grahaṇam| anantarasūtre'pi [[1.3.18]] paryādīnāmupasargāṇāmeva grahaṇam| ataḥ prakaraṇasāhacaryādadviparāśabdāvupasargau gṛhreteta - ityeke|apare tu varṇanti - sāhacarya patryāsattyupalakṣaṇam| yeṣāṃ sāhacaryaṃ teṣāṃ niyogataḥ pratyāsattyā bhavitavyamiti| ataḥ sāhacaryasya pratyāsattyā'vinābhāvitvāt tena pratyāsattirlabhyate| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - pratyāsatterviparāśabdāvupapasargau gṛhrete iti| pratyāsattiśca jayaterviparāśabdābhyāmupasargābhyāmeva, nānupasargābhyām| tathā hi - tābhyāmeva jayatyartho jayatyartho viśiṣyate,netarabhyāmiti||dadāterevāsyaviharaṇe vṛttiḥ sambhavati, nānyeṣāṃ dārūpāṇāṃ dhatūnāmiti| atastatpratiṣedhena tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha - `āṅapūrvāddāñaḥ` iti| `ādatte` iti| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ, `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam|`āsyaviharaṇasamānakriyādapi pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ` ityupasaṃkhyānadhyājenāsyaviharaṇaviṣayaṃ darśayati| katham? viharaṇagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, iha `āṅo do'nāsye` ityetadvaktavyam, tatrāsye dāño vṛttirna sambhavatīti sāmarthyādāsyasamavāyinyāṃ kriyāyāṃ vṛttirvijñāsyate, tatraiva pratiṣedhaḥ,tat kiṃ viharaṇagrahaṇena? nanu ca `āṅo do'nāsye` ityetāvatyucyamāne, svaṃ mukhamādatte devadatta ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ, vā hrāsyaviṣayaiva kriyā tasyāṃ vartamāno dadātirāsyavṛttirbhavati, viharaṇamevāsyaviṣayam, grahaṇaṃ tvāsyaviṣayaṃ grahītṛviṣayañca| tadevaṃ viharaṇamanteraṇāpi siddhe yadviharaṇagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tasyaitat prayojanam - āsyaviharaṇasamānakriyādapi pratiṣedho'yaṃ yathā syādityevamityeke| `itaretarānyo'nyopapadācca` [[1.3.16]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenāsyaviharaṇasānakriyādapi pratiṣedho bhavatītyapare|`svāṅgakarmakācca` iti| vaktavyamiti śeṣaḥ| na cātrādravamūrtimallakṣamaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ svāṅgaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgamiti| tat karma yasya sa svāṅgakarmakaḥ,tasmāt svāṅgakarmāt pratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ| tena parasambandhinā mukhena yadā sakarmako bhavati tadā bhavatyevātmanepadam - `vyādadate pipīlikāḥ pataṅgasya mukham` iti| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - kartarīti vartate, āsyamiti ca sambandhiśabdaḥ, tatraivaṃ vijñāyate - `yasmin kartaryaivātmanepadaṃ bhavati tasya cedāsyam` iti| `āṅa` iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate - āgamayasva tāvanmāṇavakam, ānute śṛgālaḥ, āpṛcchate gurūnityevamarthaḥ| tena `āgameḥ kṣamāyām` (vā|35) iti `āṅi nuprasacchayoḥ` (vā|40) iti ca nopasaṃkhyeyaṃ bhavati||`samā sāhacaryāt` iti| yadyapyanvādirupasargatvaṃ vyabhicarati, samśabdastu na vyabhicarati, atastatsāhacaryādanvādirupasarga eva gṛhrate| `māṇavakamanukrīḍati` iti| māṇavakena saha krauḍatītyarthaḥ| <> [[1.4.85]] `janījṛṣvanasurañjau'mantāśca` (ga|sū|dhātupāṭhaḥ- 817) iti mitsaṃjñāyām `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[6.4.92]] iti hrasvatvam| loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanam, `thāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] <> [[3.4.91]] iti vādeśaḥ| gatestācchīlyaṃ gatitācchīlyam| tācchīlyam = tatsvabhāvatā| `paitṛkamaāā anuharante, mātṛkaṃ gāvo'nuharante` iti| pitṛvanmātṛvadgamanameṣāṃ svabhāva ityarthaḥ| `māturanuharati, pituranuharati` iti| paṭhati| `āgamau guṇavṛddhī ātiṣṭhate` iti| sa tvāgamau guṇavṛddhī ātiṣṭhate| evaṃ hi sa pratijanīta ityarthaḥ||`tiṣṭhantyasminnati stheyaḥ` iti| <> [[3.3.113]] ityadhikaraṇe `aco yat` [[3.1.97]] | gatinivṛttivacana ityāha - `tasya` ityādi| yasya `stheya` ityākhyā, loke tasya pratītiryathā syādityevamarthamākhyāgrahaṇam| tenākhyāgrahaṇena tasya pratītirbhavatīti darśayitumākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| karmatvena prasiddhā tasyāḥ pratipattayarthaṃ kṛtam, sā tu parispandanātmakaiva parispandanātmikaiva ghaṭanabhramaṇādikā, tathā hi - tāṃ kurvāṇaḥ `sakriyaḥ` ityucyate| sthānāsanādikāṃ na kriyeta, tadā yadevārohayateraṇyante karma, sa eva hastī secayateṇryante kartā bhavatīti tadeva karma, sa eva karteti syādevātmanepadam| tasmāṇṇau cedgrahaṇaṃ samānakriyārthaṃ kartavyam|`karteti kimi` iti| kartaryevātmanepadamanena vidhīyate; bhāvakarmaṇoḥ [[1.3.13]] itmanenaiva siddhatvāt| tasmāt sāmarthyalabdhaḥ kartetyabhiprāyaḥ| karttṛgrahaṇaṃ yevāṇyante karma tasminneva ṇyante karttṛtvena vivakṣite satyevātmanepadaṃ bhatavi, nānyathetyevamartha kriyata iti darśayitumāha - `ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, tānārohayati mahāmātraḥ` iti| atra yadevāṇyante hastī karma na tadeva ṇyante karttṛtvena vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? mahāmātraḥ, tenātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| etacca karttṛgrahaṇāllabhyate; tasyānanyārthatvāt| nanu ca yatsagrahaṇamananyakarmārthamityaktam, ihaca karmāntaraṃ hastipakākhyamasta, ato yatsagrahaṇādeva na bhaviṣyati, tat kimetannivṛttyarthena karttṛgrahaṇena? naitadasti;evaṃ sati hi kartṛgrahaṇe'ṇau yatkarma ṇau cet sa kartā tadeva karma kartā bhavatītyasyārthasyaca pratipādanāya kriyamāṇaṃ yatsagrahaṇamarthavadbhavatīti| asati tu karttṛgrahaṇe tanna kartavyameva syāditi kutaḥ samānakarmatā pratīyate|`smarati vanagulmasya` iti| aṇau karmapradarśanārthametat| karmaviṣayeṇa śeṣatvena viṣayiṇā viṣayaṃ darśayitumuktam| nanvatra na karmāsti; tasya śeṣatvena vivakṣitatvāt| tathā hi `śeṣe` [[2.3.50]] ittyanuvartamāne `adhīgartha` [[2.3.52]] ityādinā karmaṇi śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ vihitā| tasmādedaṃ darśayitavyam, - smarati vanagulmamiti| atha vā - yadyapi taccheṣatvena vivakṣitam, tathāpi smaryamāṇatvāt tasya karmatvaṃ vastuto'styeveti| `smarayati` iti| `smṛ ādhyāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-807), vanagulmasya prayojakatve vivakṣite ṇic, ghaṭāditvānmitsaṃjñā, `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[6.4.92]] iti hrasvatvam| `enam` iti| `gatibuddhipratyavasānārtha` [[1.4.52]] ityādinā karmasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām, `dvitīyā ṭaustvenaḥ` [[2.4.34]] ityenādeśaḥ| nanu ca yatsagrahaṇamananyakarmārtham, iha ca karmānataramasti kokilaḥ, tataśca karmāntarasadbhāvādātmanepadaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti kimetannivṛtyarthenānādhyānagrahaṇena? naitadasti; ādhyānāmātraṃ vivakṣityedaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupanyastam| enama iti tu vacanaṃ vanagulmaḥ kartā na kokila ityarthopadarśanaparaṃ veditavyam| evaṃ vanagulmaṃ vanagulmo smarayati| ātmānamātmanā smarayatītyarthaḥ| ṇicyutpanne kokilasya prayojyasya vivakṣitatvānnivṛtte prayojyaprayojakabhāve smarayateṇryantasya prakṛta evārtho bhavati| nanu ca smaraṇaṃ cetanāvatāṃ dharmaḥ, vanagulmaścācetanaḥ, tat kathamasau smaret? naitadasti; acetaneṣvapi cetanāvaddharmopacāraḥ - yathā nadīkūlaṃ pipatiṣatīti| `ruhuḥ kartasthakriyaḥ` iti| tadarthasya nyagbhāvanātmano hastipakeṣu samavetatvāt| `dṛśiśca kartasthabhāvakaḥ` iti| tadarthasya darśanasya karttṛṣu bhṛtyeṣu vyavasthitvāt||`hetubhaye`iti| hetorbhayaṃ hetubhayamiti| <> [[2.1.37]] iti samāsaḥ| bhītirbhayam = trāsaḥ, aniṣṭāpātāśaṅkā| `tataścadbhayaṃ bhavati` iti| yadi tato hetusaṃjñakāt prayojakādbhayaṃ bhavatyevamātmanepadaṃ bhavati, nānyatheti| yadyevam,smayatyartho na viśeṣitaḥ syāt; yasmādbhayaṃ bibheterevārtho na smarateḥ, tataśca rūpeṇa vismāyayatītyavamādāvapyātmanepadaṃ syāt| muṇḍo vismāpayata ityādau na syādityata āha - `bhayagrahaṇam` ityādi| bhayagrahaṇaṃ hi dhātvarthopalakṣaṇārtham| dhātvarthaścet prayojakādbhavatītyayamartho vivakṣitaḥ|tena vismayo'pi yadi tata eva hetorbhavati yadyeṣo'rtho labhyata iti smayatyartho'pi viśeṣita eva| vismayaḥ = āścaryam| `muṇḍaḥ` iti| muṇḍaguṇopetatvānmuṇḍaḥ| `bhīṣayate` iti| `ñibhī bhaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1084),<> [[6.1.51]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ <> [[6.1.56]] iti pakṣa āttvam| <> [[7.3.40]] iti ṣuk| `vismāpayate` iti| `{ṣmiṅa`-dhātupāṭhaḥ} smiṅa īṣaddhasane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-948)| <> [[6.1.57]] ityāttvam;rtihyī` [[7.3.36]] ityādinā puk|`kuñcikayainaṃ bhāyayati` iti| karaṇādatra bhayam, na hetoḥ prayojakāt| tenātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| ṣugapyatra na bhavati, sa hīkārāntasyaiveṣyate, <> [[7.3.40]] ityatra bhī ī - itīkārapraśleṣanirddeśāt| `rūpeṇa vismāyayati` iti| atra karaṇādeva vismayaḥ;na hetoḥ||`viśeṣābhāvāt` iti| kataṃ punarviśeṣabhāvaḥ, yāvatā niranubandhakatvaṃ sānubandhakatvañcānayorviśeṣo'styeva,tataśca `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasyaṭa (vyā|pa|#ā53) ityanayā pirabhāṣāya na līṅo grahaṇena bhavitavyam| tadayuktamuktaṃ viśeṣābhāvāddvayorapi grahaṇamiti? naiṣa doṣa-, utsṛṣṭānubandhako hi līha lyanto bhavati| utsṛṣṭe cānubandhe dvayamevābhedakaṃ bhavati - arthaḥ, śabdāntaratvañca| tatrārthastāvadanayoreka eva, śabdāntaratvamapi nāsti| śabdāntaratvañca prakṛtibedavikaraṇabhedābhyāṃ bhavati| na cānayoṇryantayoḥ prakṛtibhedaḥṣa nāpi vikaraṇabhedo'sti;śabvikaraṇatvāt| yadapi <> [[6.1.51]] ityāttvaṃ tadapyubhayorbhavati| tathā ca vakṣyati - `kimidaṃ līyateriti? līnātilīyatyorāgantukena yakā nidaśaḥ` iti| `nyagbhāvam` iti| abhibhavanamityarthaḥ| `jaṭābhiḥ` iti| hetau tṛtīyā| jaṭā hi pūjādyadhigamahetubhūtāḥ| tathā hi - yasya jaṭāḥ santi loke mahānayaṃ tapasvītayupajātasampratyayaiḥ pūjyate||`mithyopapadāt` iti| upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam, mithyāśabda upapadaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `padaṃ mithyā kārayate` iti| atrātmanepadānābhyāsasya dyotitatvāt <> [[8.1.4]] isi dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| `sāpacāram` iti| sadoṣam| anena mithyāśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| `svarādiduṣṭam` iti| pūrvasyaivārthaṃ vyaktīkaroti| ādiśabdena rūpasya parigrahaḥ| `asakṛt` iti| abhyāsaśabdārthamudāharaṇena darśayati||`katrrabhiprāye` iti| kartāramabhipraitīti <> [[3.2.1]] | yadi sāmānyena yatra kriyāphalaṃ kartāramabhipraiti tatrātmanepadam, tadehāpi syāt - pacanti pācakāḥ, yajanti yājakā iti| tathā hyatra kriyāphalaṃ dakṣiṇā yājakān karttṛnabhipraiti, bhṛtiśca pācakānityata āha - `kriyāyāḥ phalam` ityādi| pradhānabhūtaṃ yatphalaṃ kriyāyāstadiha gṛhrate| na ca dakṣiṇādikaṃ kriyāphalaṃ pradhānabhūtam, tato na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ| kiṃ punastatpradhānabhūtamityata āha- `yadayartham` ityādi| etena yaduddiśyāsau yāgādikriyārabhyate, na tu dakṣiṇādyartham| `yadartham` iti| svargādi, na tu dakṣiṇādi| tathā hi svargādyarthaṃ yāgādikriyārabhyate, na tu dakṣiṇādyartham| `yadartham` iti| kriyāviśeṣaṇametat| yacchabdena kriyāyāḥ pradhānabhūtaṃ phalaṃ nirdiśyate| yadarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya kriyārambhasya phalamātrasya grahamabhipretaṃ syāt, tadā phalagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; vyavacchedyābhāvat| nāstyeva hi sa viṣayo yatra kriyāphalaṃ kartāraṃ nābhipraiti; tataśca katrrabhiprāye kriyāyā ityedaṃ brāuyāt| evamapyukte ṣaṣṭhaā kriyāyāḥ sambandhini katrrabhiprāye pratyāyite sāmarthyāt phamaleva kriya#āyāḥ katrrabhiprāyaṃ gamyate| na hi phalānyat kriyāsambandhi kartāramabhipraiti| tasmāt phalagrahaṇasāmarthyāt pradhānaṃ phalaṃ gṛhrate| atha vā - pradhānatvādeva pradhānaṃ phalaṃ gṛhrate| tathā coktam - pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt siddhamiti| asmin vyākhyāne phalagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham, kartaryātmanepadavidhānāt| pratyāsattaryastasya vācyaḥ kartā yadi tasyaiva tat phalaṃ bhavatīti vijñāyata ityāha - `tacca` ityādi| gatārtham| `svargādi` iti| ādiśabdenaudanādikamapi gṛhrate| `tathāpi` ityādinā dakṣiṇādeḥ phalasyāpradhānyaṃ darśayati| yadarthaṃ sā kriyārabhyate tatpradhānamihopāttaṃ phalam| svargādyarthaṃ ca yāgādikriyā''rabhyate; na dakṣiṇādyartham| ato'prayojakatvāttadapradhām| tena yadyapi tat kartāramabhipraiti tathāpyātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| athābhipragrahaṇaṃ kimartham? viprakṛṣṭe'pi phale yathā syāt dvividhaṃ hi kriyāphalam - āsannam, viprakṛṣṭañca| tatrāsannam - yasya vyāpārānantarameva niṣpattiḥ| viprakṛṣṭantu - uparateṣu vyāpāreṣu yannimittāntaramapekṣya kālaviprakarṣakṛtaṃ saṃskāraparipākāccirādbhavati| tatrādyamāsannatvāt dṛṣṭatvādutpatiṃta pratyavyabhicārācca pradhānamam| itarat punarviprakṛṣṭatvādanumeyatvāt sambhavavyabhicārāccotpatiṃta prati vyabhicāraḥ| yadyapi taduddiśya kriyārambhāt tadapi pradhānam, tathāpyaviprakṛṣṭaphalāpekṣayā tasyāprādhānyamastyeva| tatra yadyabhipragrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā lunīta punīta ityādāveva syāt - yatrāviprakṛṣṭaṃ kriyāphalam| yajate ityādau tu na syāt - yatra viprakṛṣṭaṃ svargādikaṃ kriyāphalam, pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt| abhigrahaṇe tu na doṣaḥ; yasmādabhirābhimukhye vartate, praśabdasattvārambhe| tena prārambhamātrasyābhimukhye phalaniṣpattau buddhāvāśrīyamāṇāyāṃ sarvatra siddhaṃ bhavati| nanu cāsatyabhipragrahaṇe prakṛtīnāṃ yajiprabhṛtīnāmanubandhaviśeṣāsañjanādeva viprakṛṣṭe'pi phale bhaviṣyatica anyathā hi tasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt, na; abhicārādau yatrāviprakṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ dṛṣṭamasti tatra tasya sārthakatvāt| tasmādviprakṛṣṭe'pyapradhāne phale syādityevamarthamipragrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva||`nyāyapavādena` ityādinā yenābhiprāyeṇa dhanakāmo nyāyamapavadate taṃ darśayati||`udyacachati` iti| `cikitsā vaidyaḥ` iti| cikitsāśāstramadhigantumudyamaṃ karotītyarthaḥ||nāsyopasargāḥ prakṛtatvādātmanepadeneti vijñeyam| `tadupapadena dyotite na prāpnoti` iti| uktārthānāmaprayogāt| etenāprāptavibhāṣeyamiti darśayati| nanu casvaṃ yajñaṃ yajate ityatra svaśabdasyopapadatvānnopapadyate? yataḥ `tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham` [[3.1.92]] iti dvitīyadhātvadhikāre yat saptamīnirdiṣṭaṃ tadupapadasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, na ca svaśabda evaṃvidha ityāha - `samīpe śrūyamāṇam` ityādi| etenopoccāritaṃ padamupapadamityanvarthasyopapadasya grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati| etacca pāribhāṣikasyāsambhavāllabhyate| `svaṃ yajñam` ityādinā pañcasūtryāṃ yadādyaṃ sūtraṃ tatrodāharati| `svaṃ putram` ityādinā yaddvitīyaṃ tatra| `evaṃ pañcasūtryāmudāharāryam` iti| anyatrāpīti seṣaḥ| pañcasūtryantargate sūtre yadudāhṛtaṃ tato'nyatrāpyudāhāryamityarthaḥ| svaṃ kaṭaṃ kārayate, kārayati vā| svaṃ vrīhiṃ saṃyacachate, saṃyacchati vā| svaṃ bhāramudyacchate, udyacchati vā| svaṃ vastramāyacchate, āyacchati vā| svaṃ gāṃ jānīte, jānāti veti| etāni `ṇicaśca` [[1.3.74]] ityādiṣu sūtreṣu yathāyogamudāharaṇāni||`pūrveṇa` iti| `anudāttahitaḥ` [[1.3.12]] ityādinā| `sarvatra prāpnoti` iti| aśeṣebhyo'pi| `tadarthamidamucyate` iti| sarvatra parasmaipade prasakte anubandhādinā| `yāti, vāti` ityanubandhaśeṣasyodāharaṇam| `āviśati, praviśati` ityupasargaśeṣasyārthaśeṣasyāpi| evaṃ gandhanādibhyo'nyatra karotītyevamādikamudāharaṇaṃ veditavyam| nanu ca śeṣādityanena pañcamyantena dhātusamānādhikaraṇena dhātureva viśiṣyate, nārthaḥ, tataścāśeṣeṣu gandhanādiṣvartheṣu parasmaipadaṃ prāpnoti, naitadasti; gandhanādayo hi prakṛterevārthāḥ, tatrāsau śeṣagrahaṇānnivartamānastānapi nivartayati| `pacyate, gamyate` iti| nanu ca yadyatra parasmaipadaṃ syāt, tadā <> [[1.3.13]] iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt, anavakāśatvāt, naitadasti; asti hi tasyāvakāśaḥ| kaḥ punarasau? yo na śeṣaḥ - āsyate, śayyate, kriyata iti| anudāttetvaṃ ṅittvañcāśeṣaḥ| `śeṣāt kartari` [[1.3.78]] ityatra karttṛgrahaṇaṃ sāmānyamupāttamiti yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha - `karmakartari` tadādigrahaṇaṃ kimartham? yāvātā vinā'pi tena `yasmāt pratyayavidhiḥ pratyaye'ṅgam` ityetāvatyucyamāne yattadornityābhisambandhādyasmātpratyayo vidhīyate tatpratyaye parato'ṅgasaṃjñā bhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyata ityata āha - `tadādivacanam` ityādi| asati tadādītyetasmin yasmādeva pratyayo vidhīyate tasyaivāṅgatvaṃ syāt, na tu sarvasya sahasyādeḥ, nāpi sanumkasya samudāyasya; tataḥ pratyayasyādivihitatvat| tadādigrahaṇe sati yasmāt pratyayo vidhīyate sa ādiryasya śabdarūpasya tat tadādīti bahuvrīhirāśrito bhavati, tena sarvasya sahasyādeḥ sanumkasya samudāyasyāṅgasaṃjñā siddhyati - iti tadādivacanaṃ syādinumartham| ādigrahaṇena prakṛtipratyayasya madhyavartināṃ pratyayāgamānāṃ grahaṇam; numa āgamopalakṣaṇatvāt| `kariṣyāvaḥ` ityatra yasmāt pratyayo vihitastadādeḥ sahasya pratyayasya samudāyasyāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām <> [[7.3.101]] iti dīrghatvaṃ bhavati; anyathā kva tarhi syāt? `vāvāvaḥ, vāvāmaḥ` ityādau| `aya vaya maya paya taya caya ṇaya gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-474-480), yaṅaluk, abhyāsasya <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] iti dīrghatvam; vasmasoḥ <> [[6.1.66]] iti yalopaḥ - iha vinā vikaraṇena dhātodīrghatvam; vikaraṇasya śapaḥ `adiprabhṛtibhāyaḥ śapaḥ` [[2.4.72]] iti luptatvāt| adāditvam `carkarītañca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1081) ityādiṣu pāṭhāt| `carkarītam` iti yaṅalukaḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| `kuṇḍāni` iti| jasi <> [[7.1.20]] iti śibhāvaḥ| <> [[7.1.72]] iti num| tadāyaṃ num parādiriti pakṣaḥ, tadā `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghatvaṃ vināpi sanumkasyāṅgasaṃjñayā siddham| yadāpi pūrvāntaḥ, tadāpyaṅgakadeśatvāt <> [[6.4.7]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[6.4.8]] iti dīrghatvaṃ siddham| yadā tvabhaktaḥ, tadāṅsyānekadeśatvānna siddhyati| abhaktaścāyaṃ numiti sūtrakārasya pakṣaḥ| tena numarthamapi tadādivacanaṃ kṛtam| `śrayartham, bhvyartham` iti| śriya idaṃ bhruva idamiti - `caturthī tadarthārtha` [[2.1.35]] ityādinā samāsaḥ; astyatra caturthyaikavacanasya vidhiriti| asati hi punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇe śrībhrūśabdayorarthaśabde parato'ṅgasaṃjñā syāt, tataśceyaṅuvaṅau syātām| saptamīnirdiṣṭe tu punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇe śrībhrūśabdayorarthaśabde parato'ṅgasaṃjñā syāt, tataśceyaṅuvaṅau syātāmā| saptamīnirdiṣṭe tu punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇe sati na doṣa iti| tathā hi - tato vihite pratyaye parata ityevaṃ vijñāyate| yaścāto vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa luptaḥ| yadyapi lupte'pi tasmin pratyayalakṣaṇenāṅgasaṃjñā labhyate, kāryaṃ tu na labhyate; <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣamapratiṣedhāt||`sup tiṅiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam` iti| yuktaṃ hi tiṅiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam, anyasya tiṅaśabdasyābhāvāt; kathaṃ subiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam, saptamībahuvacanasya vidyamānatvāt tasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; <> [[8.2.8]] iti pratiṣedhāt| saptamībahuvacanasya supo grahaṇe ṅisambuddhyoḥ padatvābhāvānnalopasya prāptireva nāstīti pratiṣedho'rthakaḥ syāt| `brāāhṛṇāḥ` iti| padatve ca sati <> [[8.2.66]] , <> [[8.3.15]] | `paṭhanti` iti| atra padatve sati `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ` [[8.1.28]] iti nighātaḥ|nanu ca`pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya` (pu pa 24) ityanena <> [[1.1.72]] ityanena vā'ntareṇāpyantagrahaṇaṃ tadantasyaiva saṃjñā bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthamantagrahaṇamityata āha - `padasaṃjñāyām` ityādi| yadīhāntagrahaṇenāpyanyatra saṃjñāvidhau tadantavidhirnāstītyeṣo'rtho na jñāpyate, tadā <> [[1.1.22]] ityatra tarabantasya ghasaṃjñā syāt, na pratyayamātrasya| tasmādatrāsminnarthe'ntagrahaṇena jñāpyate - anyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhiniṣedho yathā syādityevamarthamantagrahaṇam| tena taraptamaporeva ghasaṃjñā bhavati, na tu tadantasya| `gaurībrāāhṛṇitarā` iti|atra gaurīśabdasya tarabante brāāhṛṇitarāśabde parataḥ <<gharūpakalpacelaḍbruvagotramatahateṣu ṅyo'nekāco hrasvaḥ>> [[6.3.43]] ityādinā hrasvo na bhavati; tarabantasyāghasaṃjñakatvāt| pratyayamātrasya ghasaṃjñāyāṃ tatra parato brāāhṛṇīśabdasya hrasvo bhasaṃjñāyāṃ nirastāyāṃ <> [[6.4.148]] ityākāralopo na bhavati| `ṛtviyaḥ` iti| ṛtuḥ prāpto'styeti `ṛtoraṇ` <> [[5.1.106]] ṛtviyaḥ, padatvāt bhatvābhāve tadāśrayaḥ <> [[6.4.146]] na bhavati|atra yadi saptamībahuvacanādārabhya ā kapaḥ pratyayā gṛhreran, tadā `asarvanāmasthāne` iti pratiṣedaṃ na kuryāt; prāptyabhāvāt| kṛtaścāsāvato'vasīyate prathamaikavacanādārabhyā kapaḥ pratyayāḥ svādayo gṛhranta ityata āha - `svādiṣviti suśabdādekavacanādārabhya` iti| `rājatvam, rājatā` iti| <> [[5.1.119]] | `rājataraḥ` iti| <> [[5.3.57]] iti tarap| `rājatamaḥ` iti| `atiśāyane` [[5.3.55]] ityādinā tamap|`rājānau,rājānaḥ` iti| atra padasaṃjñāyā abhāvānnalopo na bhavati| yadyevam, rājatyatrāpi na syāt, pratyayalakṣaṇenāsarvanāmasthāna iti padasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt,naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttijrñāpayati - bhavati sau parataḥ padasaṃjñeti, yadayam `naṅisambuddhayoḥ` [[8.2.8]] iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| atra sambuddhiśabdo'narthakaḥ syāt, padatvābhāvādeva nalopasyāprāpteḥ| atha vā - `asarvanāmasthāne` iti paryudāso'yam, na prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ,tena sarvanāmasthānādanyatra padasaṃjñā vidhīyate; na tu sarvanāmasthānaṃ pratiṣidhyate| tena tatra pūrvasūtreṇa sau pare padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| atha vā- prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi na doṣaḥ, yasmāt `anantarasya vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā`(vyā|pa|12) ityanantarā yā prāptiḥ sā pratiṣidhyate; na vyavahitā| tena <> [[1.4.14]] ityakāralopaḥ||`yaci` iti varṇagrahaṇaṃ saptamīnirdiṣṭam| ataḥ `yasmin vidhistaddāvalgrahaṇe` (vā|14) iti tadādividhinātra bhavitavyamityata āha - `yakārādau` ityādi| gāgrya ityādau bhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralopaḥ|`nabho'ṅiromanuṣāṃ vatyupasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam` iti| bhasaṃjñāyāstvatra padasaṃjñābādhaḥ phalam| `nabha iva` iti tulyārthatopadarśanametat; na tu prathamāsamarthādvatiḥ| sa tu nabhasā tulyaṃ vartata iti `tena tulyam` [[5.1.114]] `āṅgirasvat` iti| pūrveṇa tulyam| `manuṣvata` iti| `janerusiḥ`(da|u|9|37) ityatra bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ `mana jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1176) ityetasmādusipratyayaḥ| <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam| manuṣ iti sthite pūrvavadvatiḥ - manuṣvaditi| yadyatra padasaṃjñā syāt tadā ṣatvasyāsiddhatvādiha rutvaṃ syāt, tataśca manurvadityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya ceha pratipādanam - `siti ca` [[1.4.16]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena nabho'ṅgiromanuṣāṃ vatau bhasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati|`vṛṣaṇvasvaāyoḥ` iti| antarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ bhasaṃjñā vidhīyate,tasyāśca vidhiścakārānuvṛttereva labhyate| vṛṣṇo'āḥ, atra bhatve sati yadyapi ṇatvasyāsiddhatvam, tathāpi nalopaḥ padanibandhano na bhavati, <> [[8.4.37]] iti ṇatvapratiṣedhaśca||`tasau` iti varṇagrahaṇam| na ca varṇamātrānmatvarthīya sambhati, ataḥ sāmarthyāt tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha - `takārāntam` ityādi| `matvarthe pratyaye` iti vyadhikaraṇe pade; ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| matorartho matvartha iti, tatra yo vartate pratyayastasminnityarthaḥ| atha vā- samānādhikaraṇe pade, matuśabdena sāhacaryānmatupsahacaritārtha ucyate - ṇatubartho yasya tasmin, na tu yasminniti matvarthe pratyaya iti| arthagrahaṇaṃ kamatupo'nyatrāpi yathā syāt; itarathā hi matāvityucyamāne matāveva syāt; nānyeṣu| matvarthagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe matupi na syāt; tasyārthaviśeṣaṇatvāt| viśeṣaṇasya ca kāryeṇa sambandhānupapatteḥ| na hi citragurānīyatāmityukte viśeṣaṇabhūtā gāvo'ḍapyānīyante, naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣamapi kvacit kārye viśiṣyate, yathā hi - devadattaśālāyā brāāhṛṇā ānīyantāmityukte devadattaḥ śālāyāṃ viśeṣaṇabhūto yadi brāāhṛṇo bhavati tadā so'pyānīyata eva| `udaiātvāna` iti| bhatvāt padasaṃjñābhāve jaśtvaṃ sidhyati| `jhayaḥ` [[8.2.10]] iti vatvam, `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num, <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ| `payasvī, yaśasvī` iti| <> [[5.2.121]] bhatvādrutvaṃ na bhavati| `indaranpūṣāryamṇāṃ sau` [[6.4.12]] ityanuvartamāne `sau ca` [[6.4.13]] ityanena dīrghaḥ||yadyatra bhasaṃjñā vidhīyeta tadā padasaṃjñā na syāt, atha yadi padasaṃjñā vidhīyeta tadā'tra bhasaṃjñā na syāt, tadā bhapadasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo na syāt; ekasaṃjñādhikārāt| sādhutvavidhāne tveṣa doṣo na bhavati, taddhi keṣāñcidbhasaṃjñā vidhīyate padasaṃjñakānām, keṣāñcidubhayasaṃjñākānām; tasmāt sādhutvameva vidhātuṃ yuktamityata āha - `ayasmayādīni` ityādi| kathaṃ punareṣāṃ sādhutvaṃ vidhīyata ityāha - `bhapadasaṃjñādhikāre` ityādi| dvāram, mukham, upāya tatra bhāṣāgrahaṇamasti, tathāpyayasmayaśabdasyāsmādeva sādhutvavidhānācchandasyapi mayaḍ bhavatīti bhatvādrutvaṃ na bhavati| `saṛkvatā` iti| ṛco'sya santīti matup| padatvāt `coḥ kuḥ` 8.3.30) iti kutvam| bhatvāt <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti jaśtvaṃ na bhavati| `ākṛtigaṇo'yam` iti| ādiśabdasya prakāravācitvāt||`tasyānena bahutvasaṃkhyā vācyatvena vidhīyate` iti| etena vidhyarthatāmasya yogasya darśayati| iha keṣāñcit `svārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyākarmādyātmakaḥ pañcakaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ` iti darsanam| keṣāñcit `svārthadravyaliṅgātmakastrikaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ` iti| tatra svārtho viśeṣaṇam; svarūpajātiguṇadravyāṇi| dravyastu viśeṣyam, tatpunarjātiguṇadravyāṇi| tatra yadā śabdasvarūpeṇa viśiṣṭā jātirabhidhīyate - gauriti, tadā śabdasvarūpaṃ viśeṣaṇatvāt svārtho bhavati; jātistu viśeṣyatvāddravyam| yadā tu jātyā viśiṣṭo guṇo'bhidhīte - paṭasya śuklo guṇa iti, tadā jātirviśeṣaṇatvāt svārtho bhavati; guṇastu viśeṣyatvāddravyam| yadā tu guṇairviśiṣṭaṃ paṭādikaṃ dravyamucyate - śuklaḥ paṭa iti, tadā viśeṣaṇabhūto guṇaḥ svārtho bhavati; viśeṣyabhūtaṃ paṭādikaṃ dravyameva| yadā punadrravyamapi dravyāntarasya viśeṣaṇabhūtaṃ bhavati - yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya, kuntān praveśayetyādau, tadā yaṣṭaādikaṃ dravyaṃ viśeṣaṇabhāvāpannaṃ svārthaḥ; dravyāntaraṃ viśeṣyabhāvāpannaṃ puruṣādikaṃ dravyameva| kvacitsambandho'pi svārtho bhavati - yatra sambandhanimittakaḥ pratyaya utpadyate, yathā - daṇḍī, viṣāṇīti| atra daṇḍapuruṣasambandho viśeṣaṇam, daṇḍīti dravyam| kvacit kra#iyāpi svārtho bhavati, yatra kriyānimittakaḥ pratyayaḥ utpadyate, yathā - pācakaḥ, pāṭhaka iti| kriyākārakasambandho'tra svārtha ityapare| liṅgaṃ strītvādi, saṃkhyaikatvādi, karmādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ kārakaviśeṣāḥ| tatra pūrvoktayordarśanayordvitīyaṃ yaddarśanaṃ tadiha vṛttikāreṇāśritam|dhātostu kriyaiva vācyetyatrācāryāṇāmavivāda eva| tatra prātipadikasya pūrvokte trike'rthe sati dhātośca kriyātmakatve yadīdaṃ sūtraṃ nocyeta, tataḥ `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti` (sī|vṛ|125) iti prātipadikājjasādibahuvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ trika evārthe syāt, na bahutvasaṃkhyāyām| dhātorapi jhiprabhṛti bahuvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ kriyāyāmeva syāt; na tu bahutvasaṃkhyāyām| tasmādanenaiva tasya bahutvasaṃkhyāvācyatvena vidhīyata iti vidhyarthametadbhavati| yathā cānena yogena bahutvasaṃkhyā bahuvacanasya vācyatvena vidhīyate, tathā <> [[2.3.2]] ityevamādibhiryogairdvitīyādīnāṃ karmādi ca| <> [[3.4.69]] ityanenāpi lakārāṇāṃ karmādyeva| tasmādete'pi yogā vidhyarthā eva veditavyāḥ|yeṣāñca pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti matam, teṣāṃ prātipadikasyaiva pañcāpyarthā vācyāḥ| vibhaktayaśca taddayotikā bhavanti| tatra `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti` (sī|vṛ|125) iti vināpi vacanenānena prātipadikādbahuvacanaṃ jasādi bahutve siddhameva| tatra tvaniyamenānyatrāpyekatvādau prāptamanena niyamyata iti niyamārthametadbhavati|kasmāt punarvṛttikāreṇa trikaṃ prātipadikārtha iti darśanamāśritam? yuktatvāt| tathā hi - vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyādau na hi vinā vibhaktibhiḥ saṃkhyākarmādayaścārthāḥ pratīyante| yadyapi payaḥ payo jarayatītyādau vināpi vibhaktyā saṃkhyākarmāderarthasya pratītirbhavatīti, tathāpi payasī payāṃsi payasetyevamādau saṃkhyākarmādipratītyarthaṃ niyogato vibhaktirapekṣyata eva| na hi yathā gargā ityatra bahuvacanena yañpratyayamantareṇāpatyārthaḥ pratīyate, tathā gāgrya ityatra prakṛtirevāpatyārthamabhidhatta iti śakyate vaktuma| api ca - payaḥ payo jarayatītyevamādau vibhaktiviśeṣaotpattisāmarthyādeva saṃkhyākarmādyarthsya pratītirbhavati| tathā hi, yataḥ sa vibhaktiviśeṣa utpannastta evāsāvarthaviśeṣaḥ pratīyate, nānyasmāditi trika eva prātipadikārtho yuktaḥ|yadi tarhi bahutvasaṃkhyā bahuvacanasya vācyatvena vidhīyate tadā sūtre bhāvapratyayena bahutvanirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ, anyathā bahutvasaṃkhyā na pratīyeta? na kartavyaḥ; antareṇāpi bhāvapratyayaṃ bhāvapradhāno nirdeśo bhaviṣyatīti, yathā - paṭasya śukla iti| nanvevamapi bhādasyaikatvādbahuṣviti bahuvacanaṃ nopapadyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmādbahutavasaṃkhyādhārasya dravyasya yo bhedastaṃ bahutve guṇe'dhyāropya bahuṣviti bahuvacanena nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ , saṃkhyāvācyayaṃ bahuśabdo na vaipulyavācīti jñāpanārthaśca| tena vaipulyaṃ bahuvacanasya vācyaṃ na bhavatīti
