hyatra saṃkhye - samudāyasaṃkhyā caikatvam, avayavasaṃkhyā ca phalamūlaśākhādyavayavasamavetā bahutvam| asyāpi prātipadikārthenaikārthasamavāyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'styeva| tathā hi - yeṣvayavaveṣu samaveta| bahutvasaṃkhyā prātipadikārtho'pi samudāyastatraiva samavetaḥ, tataśca tasmādbahuvacanaṃ prāpnotītyata āha - `karmādayaḥ` ityādi| karmādayo hrekavibhaktiśabdavācyatvāt pratyāsannā bahutvasaṃkhyāyāḥ; tataḥ pratyāsattestadīya eva bahutve bahuvacanaṃ bhavati| samudāya eva hi vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyatra dṛśikriyayā vyāptamiṣṭatama iti sa eva karmabhāvamāpadyate, nāvayavāḥ, tatkuto bahuvacanasya prasaṅga? `karmādiṣu` ityādi| karmādayo bahuvacanasya vācyāḥ| tadīyaṃ bahutvaṃ bahuṣveva karmadiṣu sambhavati, ataḥ sāmarthyāt karmādiṣu bahuṣvityeṣo'rthaḥ sampadyate|yadi tarhi vibhaktīnāṃ bahuvacanasya bahutvasaṃkhyā vācyatvena vidhīyate, tadā niḥsaṃkhyebhyo'vyayebhyaḥ svādayo na syuḥ; tataśca padasaṃjñā teṣāṃ na syādityāha - `yatra ca` ityādi| nanu svādividhānasūtre saṃkhyākarmādayaḥ svādīnāmarthāḥ śāstrāntareṇa vihitāḥ, tena sahāsyaikavākyateti vakṣyati| tatkutaḥ svādīnāṃ sāmānyavihitatvam? na hi `bahuṣu bahuvacanama` [[1.4.21]] , <> [[2.3.2]] ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa svaujasādeḥ sūtrasyaikavākyatāyāṃ svādīnāṃ sāmānyavihitatvamupapadyate| evaṃ tarhi jñāpakena avyayebhyaḥ sāmānyena svādyutpattejrñāpi tatvāt sāmānyavihitā ityuktamityadoṣaḥ; kiṃ punastajjñāpakam? <> [[2.4.82]] ityavyayādutpannānāṃ supāṃ lṛgvavacam, na hranutpannānāṃ lugupapadyate||`dvyekayoḥ` iti| ayamapi bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ; anyathā hi bahutvādbahuvacanaṃ syāt| bhāvapradhāne tu nirdeśe,dvitvamekatvañca dvāvetāvarthāviti yuktaṃ dvivacam| `etadapi` ityādinā'syāpi yogasya vidhyarthatāṃ darśayati| `arthābhidhānam` iti| artho vācyo'bhidhīyate yena tadarthābhidhānam||`kāraka iti viśeṣaṇamapādānādisaṃjñāviṣayam` iti| apādānadayaḥ saṃjñā viṣayo yasya tattathoktam| ādiśabdena sampradānādīnāṃ grahaṇam| atha vakṣyamāṇānāṃ dhruvādīnābhiyaṃ saṃjñā kasmānna bhavati? evaṃ manyate - yadīyaṃ saṃjñāśabdā nirdiśyante; ayaṃ tu saptamyā nirdiṣṭaḥ, tasmānneyaṃ dhruvādīnāṃ saṃjñeti| `kārake` iti nirdhāraṇe saptamī, nirdhāraṇaṃ tu bahunāṃ sambhavati, tatkathamekavacanena nirdeśaḥ? sāmānyapekṣayā tvekavacanam| atha vā - `chandovat sūtrāṇi bhavanti` (ma|bhā|1.1.1) tato `vyatayo bahulam` [[3.1.85]] iti bahuvacane prāpta ekavacam kārakeṣu madhye yad dhruvaṃ kārakaṃ tadapādānasaṃjñaṃ bhavati| evamanyatrāpi veditavyamiti|kārakaśabdo'yamastyeva vyutpannaḥ - ṇvulantaḥ kartṛpayryāya iti, asti ca saṃjñāśabdaḥ - avyutpanno payryāya iti| tatreha yadi pūrvoktasya grahaṇaṃ syāta tadāpādānādiṣu kārakaśabdo na vartate, yathā - kartṛśabdaḥ <<ṇvultṛcau>> [[3.1.133]] iti kartari vyutpāditaḥ, tathā kārakaśabdo'pi; kartā ca svatantraḥ, apādānādayaścāsvatantrāḥ, tatkathaṃ teṣu kārakavyapadeśaḥ syāt? asati hi kārakavyapadeśe kārakasaṃśabdeṣu teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt| atha teṣāmapi kathañcit svatantratābhyupeyeta, evañca tatra kartṛsaṃjñā prasajyeta, tataśca grāmādāgacchati, upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadātītyādau grāmādibhyastṛtīyā prasajyeta, itaretarāśrayaścāpi doṣaḥ syāt| tathā hi - kartṛsaṃjñottarakālaṃ kārakaśabdasya vyutpattiḥ, tasyāṃ satyāṃ kārakaśabdopakrameṇa karttṛsaṃjñā syāt bahvevaṃ pratividheyaṃ syāt, pratividhāne ca pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| nimittaparyāyasya tu kārakaśabdasya grahaṇe na doṣaḥ syāt, tataḥ sa eva gṛhrata iti matvāha - `kārakaśabdo'yaṃ nimittaparyāyaḥ` iti| `grāmādāgacchati` iti| grāmasya dhrusyāgamanakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvo'sti| yadīha grāmo'vadhibhāvena nāvatiṣṭhetatata āgamanaṃ na niṣpadyeta,tasmādgrāmaḥ kārakam|`vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patati` iti| vṛkṣaḥ sambandhitvenātra vivakṣitaḥ na tu nimittatvena| apāyasya kārakagrahaṇānnimittatvenāvivakṣitasyāpādānasaṃjñā na bhavati| naitat kārakagrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ yuktam; dhrugrahaṇenaivātrāpādānasaṃjñāyā nivartitatvā#āt, dhruvaṃ hi tadyadavadhibhūtamapāye sādhye| tathā hi vṛttikāro vakṣyati - `apāye sādhye yadavadhibhūtam` (kā|1.4.24) iti| na ceha vṛkṣo'vadhitvena vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? sambandhatvena, naitadasti; vivakṣitāvadhibhāvasyaiva vṛkṣasya sambandhibhāvena vivakṣitvāt| avadhibhūtasya vṛkṣasya sambandhinaḥ parṇa patatītyarthaḥ| na hi sambandhitvena vivakṣā'vadhibhāvavikṣāyā virudhyate| tasmādvivakṣitāvadhibhāvasyaiva vṛkṣsaya sambandhitvamātraṃ vivakṣitam, na tu vidyamānamapyapāyaṃ prati nimittatvamiti kā'trāyuktatā ! `māṇavakasya pitaraṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati`iti| `akathitañca` [[1.4.51]] ityakathitasya karmasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā `kārake ` [[1.4.81]] ityetasminnasati māṇavakasyāpi syāt, katham? akathitaśabdo'yamakīrttita paryāyaḥ| sa ca kasyācidviśeṣasyāprakṛtatvadviśeṣānupādāne sati prayujyamānaḥ sarvatrāviśeṣaeṇākīrttitamātre syāt| tataśca `akathitam` ityucyamāne kārakañcākārakañca sarvamakathitamiti sarvakathitamiti gamyate| yathā pitā'pādānādibhirviśeṣakathābhirna kathitaḥ, tathā māṇavako'pi, atstasyāpi karmasaṃjñā syāt| `kārake` ityasmastu sati praśnakriyānimittasya pitureva bhavati; na tu māṇavakasya| na hrasau praśnakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvena vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? pituḥ sambandhitvena| yadi viśeṣaṇamidaṃ dhruvādīnām; na saṃjñā, tataśca <> [[6.2.148]] ityevamādiṣu pradeśeṣu yatra kārakaśabdaḥ saṃśabdyate tadā tatrāpādānādīnāṃ kārakagrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na syāt| saṃjñāpakṣe tu na doṣaḥ, saṃjñā hrāvartamānā saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyatītyata āha - kārakasaṃśabdaneṣu`ityādi| yatra kārakaśabdasya saṃśabdanaṃ tatrāpyanenaiva viśeṣaṇena vivakṣitārthapratyāyanalakṣaṇo vyavahāro'yaṃ vijñāyate; pradeśāntare'pi kārakaśabdasya nimittaparyāyasyaivopādānāt| tacc nimittamapādānanādyeva, na hi tato'nyatkriyānimittaṃ bhavati| tasmāt kārakagrahamenāpādānādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati|anye tvāhuḥ - sāhacaryāt kārakaviśeṣaṇasahacaritā apādānādayaḥ kārakaśabdenocyanta iti tadgrahaṇenaiva teṣāṃ grahaṇam| kārakagrahamaṃ vā svarayitavyam| tena <> [[1.3.11]] ityeṣa vidhirbhavati| tasmāt kārakagrahaṇenāpādānādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati|apāyaḥ = viśleṣaḥka; vibhāga ityarthaḥ| tasya dviṣṭhatvādyāthā tena vibhāgena yo'paiti so'pāyayuktaḥ, tathā yato'paiti so'pyapāyayuktaḥ; tasmādubhayatra pañcamyā bhavitavyamityata evāha - `dhruvaṃ yadāpāyamuktam` iti| `apāye sādhye` iti| viṣayasaptamīyam| apāyasya sādhyatvena viṣayabhūta ityarthaḥ| yadyapi dhruvaśabdo loka ekarūpatāmācaṣṭe - dhruvamasya śīlam, dhruvamasya rūpamiti; tathāpyayāye sādhye'bhihitayā tayā na kaścidarthaḥ sampadyata iti nātra dhruvatā'pāyaṃ pratyupayujyate? saivopadīyate, sā cāvadhibhāva eva| tasyādapāyasya sannidhau dhruvaśabdaḥ sambandhāt saśleṣalakṣaṇāt pracyavamānasyāvadhibhāvamācaṣṭe, ityata āha - `avadhibhūtam` iti| ata evāpāye sādhye'vadhibhūtaṃ yattadiha dhruvaśabdenocyate| tena dhāvato'āāt patita ityevamādāvapyapādānasaṃjñā aāādeḥ siddhā bhavati| asati hyatrāpi satyapi calatve'āāderapyapāye'vadhibhāvaḥ|atheha kathamapādānasaṃjñā - adharyājjugupsate, adharmādviramati, dharmātpramādyatīti, na hyatrāpāyo'sti? katham? kāryasamprāptipūrvako hrapāyo bhavati, na ceha kāryasamprāptirastīti āha - `jugupsā` ityādi| jugupsādyarthānāṃ dhātūnāṃ prayoge'pādānāsaṃjñāyā upasaṃkhyānam = pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `apādānamiti mahatī saṃjñā kriyate, mahāviṣayeyaṃ saṃjñeti sūcanārtham| evañca mahāviṣayā bhavatīyam - yadi sūtropāttāt saṃjñino'nyo'pyasyā viṣayo bhavati, nānyathā; tena dajugupsādīnāṃ prayoge'satyapāye'pādānasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā - astyevā'trāpāyaḥ, na hi kāryasamprāptipūrvaka evāpāyo bhavatīti, kiṃ tarhi? cittasamprāptipūrvako'pi bhavati| iha tāvadadharmājjugupsate, adharmādviramatīti, ya eva manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī bhavati sa evaṃ paśyati - duḥkha heturayamadharmo nāma, ato nārhatyenaṃ sacetāḥ karttumiti; evaṃ paśyati - `nāsmāddharmāt kiñcidiṣṭaṃ sampadyate, duḥkhameva kevalaṃ tadārambha nimittakaṃ bhavati` sa evaṃ vicārayaṃstaṃ buddhyā prāpnoti, prāpya ca tato nivartate| tathā ca dhruvamapāye'pādānamityevaṃ sa#iddham| `pramādyati` iti| `madī herṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1208), <<śamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani>> [[7.3.74]] iti dīrghaḥ| atheha kathamapādānasaṃjñā - grāmānnāgacchatīti? kathañca na syāt? grāmasyāpāyenāyuktatvāt| yasyāṃ satyāmapāyo bhavati, sā pratiṣiddhyate cāpādanasādhanāgamanakriyā, tadasatyāṃ tasyāṃ kuto'pāyaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ atra hrapādānasaṃjñāyāṃ samupajātāyāṃ paścātpratiṣedhena sambandhaḥ kriyate,anyathā hi pratiṣedhasya viṣayo na darśitaḥ syāt| tathā hrapādānasādhanāgamanakriyā pratiṣeddhumiṣṭā|tatra yadi cādāveva niṣedhaḥ syāt, apāyābhāvāt tadasambaddhasya grāmasyāpādānasaṃjñā siddhā na syāt| tataśca yā pratiṣedhyāpādānasādhanāgamanakriyā pratiṣedhasya viṣayabhūtā; sā na śakyate pradarśakayitum; na cātrāpradarśitakaviṣayeta pratiṣedhaḥ śakyate vaktum| tasmāt pūrvamapādānasaṃjñā bhavati, paścātpratiṣedhena yoga ityeṣa kramaḥ|bhītirbhīḥ; trāṇaṃ trāḥ; sampadāditvāt? kvip| bhīśca trāśca bhītrau| bhītrādarthau yeṣāṃ te bhītrārthāḥ| `bibhetyarthānām` ityādi| bibhetitrāyatiśabdāviha sāhacaryādbibhetitrāyatyarthayorvartete| bibhetirartho yeṣāṃ te bibhetyarthāḥ| trāyatirartho yeṣāṃ te trāyatyarthāḥ| `bibheti` iti| `ñibhī bhaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1084), jauhotyādikaḥ| `udvijate` iti| `ovijī bhayacalanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1460) taudādiko'nudāttet| `trāyate` #iti| `traiṅa pālane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-965) bhauvādikaḥ|`araṇye bibheti` iti| nātrāraṇyādbhayam, kiṃ tarhi? tatrasthebhyaścaurādibhyaḥ| nanu cātrādhikaraṇasaṃjñā paratvāt bādhikā bhaviṣyati|api ca - dhruvamityanuvartate, `dhruvañcāvadhibhūtam` ityuktam| na cāraṇyamavadhibāvena vivakṣitam, tatkimetannivṛttyarthena bhayahetugrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhi pūrvasyāyaṃ prapañcaḥ| na hi kāyasamprāptipūrvaka evāpāyo bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? buddhisamprāptipūrvako'pi| asti ceha buddhikasaṃprāptipūrvako'pyayāyaḥ, tathā hi - caurebhyo bibhetītyatra yastāvat puruṣaḥ prekṣāvān bhavati sa evaṃ paśyati - `yadi māṃ caurāḥ paśyeyudhrruvaṃ me mṛtyuḥ` iti vicārayaṃstān buddhyā prāpnoti, prāpya catato nivartate| tatra dhruvamityādinaiva siddham| tasmāt pūrvasyāyaṃ prapañcaḥ| na ca prapañce gurulāghavaṃ cintyate| evamuttare'pi yogāḥ pūrvasyaiva prapañcā veditavyāḥ; tadudāharaṇānāṃ `adhyayanāt parājayate` ityevamādīnāṃ pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| yathā ca teṣāṃ siddhatvaṃ tathā bhāṣye eva pratipāditam| tasmāt tatrāpi gurulāghavaṃ na cintanīyam||`soḍhuṃ na śakyate` iti| anubhavituṃ na śakyata ityarthaḥ| `adhyayanāt parājayate` ityadhyayanamabhibhavituṃ na śaknoti, na pārayatītyarthaḥ| <> [[1.3.19]] ityātmanepadam| `śatrūn parājayate` iti| abhibhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu ca paratvāt karmasaṃjñayaivātra bādhitatvādapādānasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati, tat kimetannivṛttyarthenāsoḍhagrahaṇena? satyametat; prapañce gurulāghavaṃ na hi cintyate, prapañcaścāyam| asti hyatrādhyayanād buddhisaṃsarga pūrvako'pāyaḥ| tathā hi - yaeva puruṣo'laso bhavati, sa evaṃ manyate - duḥkhāyaivaitadadhyayanamiti, paśyan buddhyā tatprāpnoti, prāpya ca tato nivartate; tasmāt pūrveṇaiva siddham||vāraṇamartho yeṣāṃ te vāraṇārthāḥ| `yavebhyo gā vārayati` iti| `gāḥ` iti gavāmīpsitatamatvena vivakṣitatvātkarmasaṃjñā, gośabdācchasa, <<auto'mśasoḥ>> [[6.1.93]] ityāttvam, rutve kṛte `bhobhagoadhoapūrvasya` [[8.3.17]] iti yatvam, <> [[8.3.22]] iti yalopaḥ| `vārayati` iti| `vṛñ āvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1813), curādiṇic| `nivartayati` iti| `vṛtu vartane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 758), hetumaṇṇic| `yavebhyo gā vārayati kṣetre` iti| atra kṣetrasyānīpsitasya na bhavati saṃjñā; īpsitagrahaṇam| nanu cātra paratvādaradhikaraṇasaṃjñayaiva bādhitatvādapādānasaṃjñāyāḥ, kṣetrasyāpādānasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyatītyato na kartavyamīpsitagrahaṇamiti, etannāśaṅkanīyam; uktottaratvāt||antarddhau iti nimittasaptamīyam| nimittāt karmayoge (vā-138) iti saptamī, yathā - carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hantīti| etadeva jñāpakam - nimittāt karmasaṃyoge'sti saptamīti| asti hyatrādarśanena karmaṇā saṃyogaḥ | yena iti| kartari tṛtīyā| nanu ca <> [[2.3.65]] iti ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyamiti? naitadasti; <> [[2.3.66]] iti niyamāt karmaṇyeva, na kartari| karma tvatrādarśanasyātmā, tasyāntaraṅatvāt sa eva karma vijñāyate| tat kārakam iti| yadyapyatra sūtre tacchabdo nopāttaḥ, tathāpi sa yattadornityābhisambandhāllabhyate| upādhyāyādantardhatte ityatropādhyāyena kartā śiṣya ātmanaḥ karmabhūtasyādarśanamicchati| antarddhinimittam| antardhatte iti dadhāterlaṭ,<> [[1.3.72]] ityātmanepadam, śapaḥ śluḥ, <<ślau>> [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam, <<śnābhyasatyorātaḥ>> [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ, abhyāsasya jaśtvam, <> [[8.2.38]] iti dakārasya dhakāraḥ, parasya dhakārasya <> [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam takāraḥ| nilīyate iti| līṅa śleṣaṇe (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1139) daivādikaḥ| caurānna didṛkṣate iti| atra yaścaurān na didṛśata iti sa tairātmano'darśanamicchati, na tvantarddhinimittam; kintūpaghātanivṛttyartham| vispaṣṭārthañcāntarddhigrahaṇam | paratvāt karmasaṃjñayaiva bādhitatvāccaurāṇāmihāpādānasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati| prapañcārtho'yaṃ yogaḥ, na ca prapañce gurulāghavaṃ cintyata ityuktam| upādhyāyādantardhatte śiṣya iti śiṣyasyāntarddhāturmā bhūt, naitadasti; dhruvamityanuvartate, dhruvañcāvadhibhūtamityuktam; na cāntarddhātāvadhibhūtaḥ| evaṃ tarhyasati yenetyetasmin vacane, satyāmapi dhruvamityasyānuvṛttau sūtrasyāvācakatvaṃ syāt | atastanmābhūditi yenetyuktam ||`niyamapūrvakaṃ vidyāgrahaṇam` iti| vidyāgrahaṇārthaṃ śiṣyapravṛttiḥ = niyamaḥ| sa pūrvo yasya tat tathoktam| <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap| `naṭasya gāthāṃ śṛṇoti` iti| sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| niyamapūrvakamiha vidyāgrahaṇaṃ nāsti||janiśabdo'tra sāhacaryājjanyarthe vartate| ata evāha - `janyarthasya` iti| `janmanaḥ` iti| etena janyarthaṃ darśayati| tathā hi - `janī prādurbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1149) iti paṭhyate| prādurbhāvo janma eva| kaḥ punastasya kartetyata āha - `jāyamānaḥ` iti| <> [[7.3.79]] iti jādeśaḥ| atha prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ kimartham? yāvatā dhruvamityanuvartate, dhruvañcāvadhibhutamityuktam| janikarttṛścāvadhiḥ kāraṇameva bhavati; tatrāntareṇāpi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ prakṛtereva bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; putrāt pramādo jāyata ityādau putrāderapyapādānāsaṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ prakṛtigrahaṇam| dvividhaṃ hi kāraṇam - upādānakāraṇam, sahakārikāraṇañca| tatra yat kāryeṇābhinnadeśaṃ tadupādānakāraṇam, yathā- ghaṭasya mṛtpiṇḍaḥ| sahakārikāraṇaṃ yat kāryeṇa bhinnadeśam, yathā - tasyaiva daṇḍacakrādi| tatrāsati prakṛtigrahaṇe pratyāsatterupādānakāraṇasyaiva syāt, netarasya| prakṛtigrahaṇe tu sati sarvasyaiva kāraṇamātrasya bhavati||`bhavanaṃ bhūḥ`iti| sampadāditvāt kvip| prabhavtayasmīdita prabhava ityapādāne `ṛdorap` [[3.3.57]] ityap| nanu ca `himavato gaṅgā prabhavati` ityetat pūrveṇaiva siddham| tathā hrayamatrārthaḥ - himavato gaṅgā jāyata iti, tatkimarthamidamārabhyata ityāha - `prathamata upalabhyate` iti| eṣa cārtho'nekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ veditavyaḥ| janyarthastvatra na sambhavatyeva, na hi himavān gaṅgāyāḥ kāraṇam, sā hranyebhya eva kāraṇebhya utpannā| himavati tu kevalaṃ prathamata upalabhyata iti||`karmaṇā karaṇabhūtena` iti| nanu ca kathaṃ karma karaṇaṃ bhavati? kriyābhedasambandhāt| tathā hi dadātikriyayā'stumiṣṭatamatvāt tasyāḥ karmatvam, abhiprayāṇakriyāṃ prati tasya sādhakatamatvāt karaṇatvam| `abhipraiti` iti| abhisambadhnātītyarthaḥ| yadi karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa sampradānasaṃjño bhavati, evamajāṃ nayati grāmamityajādibhirnayanakriyākarmabhiḥ sambadhyamānasya grāmasya sampradānasaṃjñā prasajyetetyata āha - `anyarthasaṃjñāvijñānāt` ityādi| sampradānamiti| tena dadāteḥ karmaṇā yamabhipraiti tat sampradānamiti vijñāyate| nanvevamapi rajakasya vastraṃ dadāti, ghnataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dadātītyatatra prāpnoti, naitadasti; dānaṃ hi nāma pūjānugrahakāmyayā svakīyadravyaparityāgaḥ parasvatvāpattiḥ, tacceha nāsti, ato na bhaviṣyati| karmaṇeti kimartham? ` yamabhipraiti sa sampradānam` ityucyamāne yamabhipraiti tasya karmaṇa eva sampradānasaṃjñā syāt| karmasaṃjñāyāstu dadātikarmaṇo'nyatrāvakāśaḥ syāt - odanaṃ pacatīti| `yaṃ sa` grahaṇaṃ kimartham? `karmaṇābhipraiti sampradānam` ityucyamāne ko'bhipraiti tasya sampradānasaṃjñā syāt| tataśca kartuḥ sampradānasaṃjñā syāt, kartṛsaṃjñāyāstu yatra karmasambandho nāsti, so'vakāśaḥ syāt - āste, śete iti| athābhipragrahaṇa kimartham? `karmaṇā yameti sa sampradanām` ityucyamāne kālaviśeṣavivakṣā syāt, vartamāna eva syāt| tataścopādhyāyasya gāmadāt, upādhyāyāyaṃ gāṃ dāstītyatra na syāt, abhigrahaṇe tu sati bhavati| abhirābhimukhye vartate taccāpyatīte'pyasti| praśabda ādikarmaṇi, prārambhe| sa cāsannihitāyāṃ bhāvinyāmapi kriyāyāṃ sambhavatīti sarvatra saṃjñā siddhā bhavati| naitadabhipragrahasya prayojanamupapadyate| yathaiva karmaṇetyatraikatvasaṃkhyāyā vivakṣā na bhavati; yathā ca `yaṃ` `saḥ` ityatra liṅgasaṃkhyorvivakṣā na bhavati tathā kālasyāpi na bhaviṣyati| kiṃ kāraṇam? upalakṣaṇārthatvāt| yathā - `so'rtho yo'narthaṃ bādhate` ityukte yo'pi bādhitavān, yo'pi bādhiṣyate so'pyartha eva| evaṃ tarhi granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ yathā syādityavamarthamabhipragrahaṇam| etena kriyayāpi yamabhipraiti tasyāpi sampradānasaṃjñā siddhā bhavati; anyathā hi yadyapi kriyā prārthanādhyavasānābhyāṃ vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt karma, tathāpi dadātikarmasambandhābhāvānna siddhyet| kathaṃ punaretadavasitam - kriyayā yamabhipraitisa sampradāvamityayamartho'tra pratipādayitumiṣṭatam iti? abhipragrahaṇāt| asti hyatrācāryasya kaścidartho'dhiko'bhimataḥ, yasyāvabhāsanāyādhikaṃ śabdāntaraṃ prayuktamiti gamyate, na tvarthaviśeṣaḥ| na hi tat tasya vācakam| yadyapyavācakaṃ syāt, tathāpi lakṣyadarśanavaśādavicchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśācca viśeṣāvagatirbhaviṣyatītyadveṣyametat| `kriyāgrahaṇamapi kartavyam` iti| kriyayā grahaṇaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam| yena kriyā gṛhrate, tadvayākhyānaṃ kartavyam| kiṃ punastadvyākhyānam? taccāsmābhirabhigrahaṇsaya prayojanaṃ varṇayadbhiḥ kṛtameva| kā punariha kriyā, yayābhipreyamāṇasya sampradānasaṃjñeṣyate? sā vivakṣitā| ata āha - `kriyayāpi yamabhipraiti` ityādi| `nigalhate` iti| `garha galha kutsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-636,637) anudāttet| `yuddhāya sannahyate` iti| `naha bandhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1166) divādau svaritet| sa ceha niścaye vartate, yuddhe niścayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| `patye śete` iti| śīṅatropasarpaṇapūrvake śayana vartate| patimupasṛtya śete ityarthaḥ| `karmaṇaḥ karaṇasaṃjñā` ityādi| etat `paśunā rudraṃ yajate` ityetadviṣayameva veditavyam| yajiḥ svaritet| etacca vyatyayo bahulam 3.1.85 iti subvyatyayena siddhameveti na vaktavyam||`rucinā samānārthā rucyarthāḥ` iti| rucyarthānāmityasmādeva nipātanāta - mayūravyaṃsakāditvānmadhyamapadalopo samāsaḥ| `samānārthāḥ` iti| ekārthā ityarthaḥ| yadyapi `rucirdīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-745) paṭhate, tathāpīhābhilāṣe vartate, anekārthatvāddhātūnām; tatraiva prīyamāṇārthasya sambhavāt| yasya hyabhilāṣaḥ sa prīyamāṇaḥ| yastvabhilaṣati sa prīṇāti| `prīyamāṇaḥ` iti| tṛpyamāṇa ityarthaḥ| `prīñ tarpaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 1474) ityetasmāt karmaṇi vihitasya lasya śānac| `anyakarttṛkaḥ` ityādinā tamabhilāṣaviśeṣaṃ darśayan ruciśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| prīyamāṇāpekṣayā'nyortho veditavyaḥ| prīyamāṇādanyaḥ kartā yasya so'nyakarttukaḥ| `rocate svadate` iti| `ruca dīptau`(dhātupāṭhaḥ-745) `svada āsvādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-18) anudāttettau| `devadattasthasya` ityādinā'nyakarttṛkatāmabhilāṣasya darśayati|`devadattāya rocate modakaḥ pathi` iti| prīyamāṇagrahādihādhikaraṇasya pathaḥ sampradānasaṃjñā na bhavati| atha devadatto modakamabhilaṣatītyatra devadattasya sampradānasaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati? rucyarthābhāvāt `anyakarttṛko hyabhilāṣo ruciḥ, (kā| 1.4.33) ityuktam| na cehānyakarttṛko'bhilāṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? prīyamāṇo devadatto yastatrastho'bhilāṣastatkarttṛkaḥ||`jñīpsyamānaḥ` iti| `māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-811) iti ghaṭādiṣu paṭhate| tasmāt niśāmane jñāne vartamānāt hetumaṇṇic| atha vā `jñapa micca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1624) iti curādau paṭhate| tasmāccurādiṇic, mittvāt hrasvatvam, san, dvirvacanam, `āpjñapyṛdhāmīt` [[7.4.55]] itītvam, `atra lopa'bhyāsasya` [[7.4.58]] ityabhyāsalopaḥ, karmaṇi lakāraḥ, śānac yak, <> [[6.4.48]] | `ślāghate` iti| `ślāghu katthane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-115) anudāttet| `{hnute- kāśikā, `nihnute-padamañjarī|} apahnate` iti| `hnuṅa apanayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1082), ādādikaḥ| `tiṣṭhate` iti| <> [[1.3.23]] iti taṅa| `śapate` iti| `{śapa ākrośe- dhātupāṭhaḥ-} śapa upalambhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1000) ityanenopalasaṃkhyānana taṅa||`uttamarṇaḥ` iti| ṛṇe uttamuttamarṇaḥ| ata eva nipātanāt samāsaḥ, saptamīsamāse ṛṇasya pūrvanipātāt| nanu cottamarṇe ṛṇaśabdena na bhavitavyam| `ṛṇamādhamaṇrye ` [[8.2.60]] ityādhamaṇrye tasya nipātanāt, naitadasti; kālāntare deyaniyamopalakṣaṇārthaṃ hi tatrādhamaṇryagrahaṇam| ata uttamarṇo'pi bhavatyeva| `śataṃ dhārayati` iti| `dhṛṅa avasthāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1412), śataṃ dhriyate svarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhate, svabhāvānna pracyavate| tadanyaḥ prayuṅkta iti <> [[3.1.26]] iti ṇic| `grāme` iti grāmasyādhikaraṇasyānuttamarṇasya na bhavati||`spṛhayati` iti| ato lopasya [[6.4.48]] <> [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadbhāvādguṇo na bhavati| yadā tu puṣpādīnāmīpsitatamatvaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā paratvāt karmasaṃjñaiva bhavati - puṣpāṇi spṛhratīti||krudhadruhāvakarmakau, tatra ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāmayamārambhaḥ ; itarau sakarmakau, tatra dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyām | kathaṃ punareṣāṃ bhinnārthatve sati 'yaṃ prati kopaḥ' iti sāmānyena tadviśeṣaṇamupapadyata ityāha - krodhastāvat ityādi| sugamam | kruddhyati, druhrati iti| krudha kope(dhātupāṭhaḥ-1189), druha jighāṃsāyām (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1197) daivādakau| īrṣyati iti| īrkṣa sūrkṣa īrṣya īrṣyārthāḥ | asūyati iti| asūyaśabdaḥ kaṇḍvādiyagantaḥ| bhāryāmīrṣyati iti | asti bhāryāyāmīrṣyā, na tu tāṃ prati kopaḥ| kevalaṃ parairdṛśyamānāṃ tāṃ na kṣamate| athāsmin dveṣṭītyatra kathaṃ na bhavati sampradānasaṃjñā? dviṣerakrodhādyayarthatvāt| aprītau hyenaṃ smaranti; tathā cācetaneṣvapi prayujyate - auṣadhaṃ dveṣṭīti| nābhinandatīti gamyate ||`rādhyati` iti| `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1262,1263),daivādikaḥ| `daivam` iti śubhāśubhaṃ karma| yasyeti grahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| tathā hi - `yaṃ prati` ityanuvartate, tatra yaṃ vipraśna ityevamabhisambandhe kriyamāṇe yasyetyasyārtho'prayujyamānasyāpi gamyata eva|`pareṇa` ityādi| anyena kenacididaṃ me kriyatāmiti prayukto vyāpāritaḥ san pratijānīte| ataḥ pratijñāturanyena prayuktsayābhyupagamo bhavati| prayokteti vyāpārayitā| sūtre pūrvasyetyarthāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgena nirdeśaḥ|sa tvartho vicāryamāṇaḥ kriyaiva bhavati| yasmāt karteti kriyāyā eva bhavati nānyasyārthasyetyāha - `pūrvasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ` iti| yaścāsau pūrvasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kartā bhavati, sa pratijñātuḥ prayojako bhavatīti hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāmidaṃ vacanam| `devadattāya gāṃ pratiśṛṇoti` iti| atra pūrvasyā yānacakriyāyā devadattaḥ kartā| devadattena hi mahraṃ gāṃ dehīti yācita sa yadā dadāmīti pratijānīte, tadaivaṃ prayujyate - devadattāya gāṃ pratiśṛṇotīti| pūrvasya karteti kim? vinā tena gavāderabhyupayemānasya karmaṇa eva syāt| nanu ca paratvāt karmasaṃjñā tasya bādhikā bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; nāprāpte hi saṃjñāntara idamārabhyata iti| ihāpi ca devadattāya gāmāśṛṇotīti devadattasya hetusaṃjñā prāpnoti| tatra pūrvasya kartetyasminnasati yathā devadattasya hetusaṃjñāṃ bādhate, tadā karmasaṃjñāmapi bādheta| atha vā - `purastādapavādā anantarān vidhīn bādhante nottarān` (vyā|pa|9) iti karmasaṃjñāmeva bādheta| pūrvasya kartetyasmastu sati hetusaṃjñāmeva bādhate, na karmasaṃjñām||`anupratigṛṇaḥ` iti śnāpratyayena nirdeśāt kryādipaṭhitasya `gṛ? śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1498) ityasya, na `gṛ? nigaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1410) ityasya taudādikasya| `hotā prathamaṃ śaṃsati`iti| etena stutikriyāyāḥ pūrvasyā hotā karteti darśayati| protsāhayatītyanenāgṛṇātipratigṛṇātiśabdayorarthamācaṣṭe| kathaṃ punajrñāyate - anupūrvaḥ pratipūrvaśca śaṃsiturgṛṇātiḥ protsāhane vartata ityāha - `anugaraḥ pratigaraḥ` iti| anugīryate = hotā prathamaṃ praśasyate yena śabdena so'yamanugaraḥ| evaṃ pratigīryate yena sa pratigaraḥ| pūrvasay kartetyeva, hotre'nugṛṇātika sadasītyadhikaraṇasya mā bhūt||nanu ca sāmagryadhīnā hi kriyāsiddharekasyāpyabhāvena na bhavati| tat kasyātra prakarṣo yatparigrahāya sādhakatamaśabdasya grahamamita yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `kriyāsiddhau` ityādi| prakṛṣṭam = atyantamupakārakam| atha vā - prakarṣaḥ prakṛṣṭam `nupaṃsake bhāve ktaḥ` [[3.3.114]] | prakṛṣṭena prakarṣeṇopakārakaṃ prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ yat kriyāyasiddhiviṣaye prakarṣeṇopakārakaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tat sādhakatamam| vivakṣitagrahaṇaṃ yadā prakṛṣṭopakārakatvena vivakṣyate, tadā sādhakatamavyavahāro vijñāyate, nānyedita jñāpanārtham| tathāhi - vivakṣāvaśād yadeva kadācit karaṇambhavati - dhanuṣā vidhyatīti, tadeva kadācit svātantryavivakṣāyāṃ karttṛtvamanubhavati - ṭadhanurvidhyatīti| `lunāti` iti| `pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[7.3.80]] |`tamabgrahaṇaṃ kim? gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ` iti| yadi tamabgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato'trādhikaraṇasaṃjñā na syāt| iha hi dvivadha ādhāraḥ- gauṇaḥ,mukhyaśca| tatra mukhyo ya ādheyena vyāpyate, yathā - tileṣu tailamasti;atra tailenādheyenādhārabhūtāstilā vyāptāḥ| avyāpto gauṇo yathā - gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti| atra hi sāmīpyād gaṅgāyāṃ ādhāratvamupacaritam, na mukhyam; vyāptyabhāvāt| tatrāsati tamabgrahaṇe `gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃmpratyayaḥ` (vyā|pa|4) iti mukhyasyaivādhikaraṇasaṃjñā syāt, netarasya; tamabgrahaṇāt tasyāpi bhavati; tathapīha tamabgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam,katham? vināpi tena prakarṣāvagateḥ| yathaiva hranabhirūpāya kanyādānasya pravṛttirnāstītyabhirūpāya kanyā deyetyukte vināpi prakarṣapratyayenābhirūpatamāyeti gamyate; tathehāpi kārakādhikārādasādhake saṃjñāyāḥ pravṛttirnastīti `sādhakaṃ karaṇam` ityukte'ntareṇāpi tamabgrahaṇaṃ sādhakatamamiti gamyate, tatka tamabgrahaṇena? tadetat tamabgrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārthaṃ kṛtam| etadanena jñāpyate - `iha kārakādhikāre itaḥ sūtrādanyatra vinā tamabgrahaṇena prakarṣo nāśrīyate` iti| tena <<ādhāro'dhikaraṇam>> [[1.4.45]] ityanena `gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ` ityādāvamukhyasyāpi gaṅgāderādhārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā siddhā bhavati||`dīvyati` iti| `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghaḥ||parikrītiḥ = parikrayaṇam| `niyatakālam` iti| nātyantikam| `vetanādinā` iti| ādiśabdena bandhakādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `nātyantikaḥ kraya eva` iti niyatakālatvaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| pariśabdo'tra pratyāsatiṃ dyotayati| krayo hi nāmātyantikaḥ| vetanādinā kevalaṃ yattu niyatakālaṃ tadātyantikasya krayasya samīpamiti pariśabdenākhyāyate||`ādhriyante kriyāguṇā asminnityādhāraḥ` iti| `adhyāyanyāyodyāvaṭa [[3.3.122]] ityādinā''dhāraśabdo'dhikaraṇe ghañanto vyatpādita-| kriyāpekṣatvat kārakasyeti kriyāgrahaṇam| yadyādhriyanti kriyā yasmin sa ādhāraḥ iti, evaṃ hi sati kartṛkarmaṇorevādhikaraṇasaṃjñā prasajyeta, tayoreva hi kriyā ādhriyante| tathā hi- kartasthā va #ā kriyā bhavati, karmasthā vā, anavakāśatvāt karttṛkarmaṇoḥ saṃjñā na bhaviṣyatyeṣa doṣa prasaṅag iti, etaccānuttaram; satyapi hranavakāśatve tayoḥ paryāyaḥ syāt| ekadādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavitavyaṃ taṃ darśayati| pratirābhimukhye| `kriyāṃ prati ya ādhāraḥ` iti|| kriyāyā abhimukho ya ādhāra ityarthaḥ| yaśca kriyāṃ dhārayati sa kriyāyā abhimukho bhavati| kriyāyāstu dhāraṇaṃ sākṣāt, vyavadhānena vā; karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyāśrayayordhāraṇāt| atra pūrvasya vyavacchedārthaṃ `karttṛrmaṇoḥ` ityuktam|tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyādhārabhūtayordhāraṇāt kriyāyā abhimukho ya ādhārastasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavatīti| tadevaṃ kriyādhārabhūtakarttṛkarmadhāraṇadvāreṇa kriyāyā abhimukho ya ādhārastasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā; yato'nena vidhīyate tato na bhavati pūrvasya doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| na hi karttṛkarmaṇoranena prakāreṇa kriyāṃ pratyādhāratvam; api tu sākṣādeva kriyādhāraṇāt| nanvevamapi karttṛkarmaṇormukhyaṃ kriyādhāratvam, sākṣādeva kriyādhāraṇāt, karttṛkarmādhārasya tu kaṭādergauṇatvaṃ kriyāśrayabhūtakarttṛkarmadhāraṇadvāreṇa kriyādhāraṇāt| tatra mukhya ādhāre sati gauṇasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā na prāpnotīti sa doṣasatdavastha eva? naitadasti; tamabgrahaṇena jñāpitametat - gauṇasyāpyādhārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavatīti| bhavatu gauṇasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā, mukhyasyāpi karttṛ karmaṇaśca kasmānna bhavatīti cet, na; paratvādanavakāśatvācca karttṛkarmasaṃjñābhyāṃ bādhyamānatvāt| adhikaraṇasaṃjñā hi pūrvo gauṇa ādhāre sāvakāśā, tadviparīte tu karttṛkarmasaṃjñe iti tābhyāṃ bādhyamānā notsahate tayorviṣayamavagāhitum|`kaṭe āste` iti| karttṛsthā kriyā yatra pūrveṇa prakāreṇādhriyate tasyodāharaṇam;; vikledanakriyāyāḥ karmasthatvāt| `sthālyāṃ pacati` iti| karmasthā kriyā yatrādhriyate tasyodāharaṇam; vikledanakriyāyā karmasthatvāt|tatpunaradhikaraṇaṃ triprakāram - aupaśleṣikam,vaiṣayikam, abhivyāpakañca| tatrādye - kaṭe āste,sthālyāṃ pacatīti kaṭāderpayādhārasya hrādheyena sahopaśleṣaḥ saṃyogalakṣaṇo'stītyaupaśleṣikaṃ tadbhavati| vaiṣayikam - gurau vasati, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti| prativasatīti viṣayo hrananyatrabhāvaḥ, yathā - cakṣuṣvaprabhṛtīnāṃ rūpādibhyo'nanyatrabhāvāccakṣurādīnāṃ rūpādayo viṣayā ityucyante, evaṃ śiṣyādīnāṃ gurvādibhyo'nanyatrabhāvādeṣāṃ te viṣayā iti| nanu ca <<ādhāro'dhikaraṇam>> [[1.4.45]] ityuktam, ādhāraśca ko bhavati? ya āśrayaḥ; saṃyogataḥ samavāyo vā bhavati, na ca śiṣyādīnāṃ guruprabhṛtibhiḥ saha saṃyogaḥ samavāyo vā'sti, tadayuktaṃ teṣāmadhikaraṇatvam? naitadasti; yadāyattā hi yasya sthitiḥ sa vināpi saṃyogasamavāyābhyāṃ tasyāśrayo bhavati, yathā - rājāyattasthititvāt puruṣasya rājeti; na ca rājñā saha puruṣasya saṃyogasamavāyau sta-| tathā hi - tadadhīnasthititvāt rājāśrayaḥ puruṣa iti loke vyapadiśyate, tathā śiṣyādīnāṃ gurvādyāyattā sthitiriti yuktastān prati guruprabhṛtīnāmāśrayabhāvaḥ| abhivyāpakaṃ yathā - tileṣu tailam, daghni sarpiriti| tilādikaṃ tailadikamādheyaṃ vyāpyāvatiṣṭhata iti tilādikamabhivyāpakamadhikaraṇam| yadyapyatra tilādīnāṃ tailādibhiḥ saha saṃyogo'sti, tathāpi deśavibhāgābhāvādatra saṃśleṣavyavahāro nāstītyaupaśleṣikāt tatpṛthagevopasthāpyate||`adhyāste` iti| `āsa upaveśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1021) adādiḥ anudāttet||`karttuḥ kriyayā` iti| etena kartturiti nepsitatamāpekṣayā <> [[2.3.67]] ityaneneyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī, api tu kriyāpekṣayā śeṣalakṣaṇaiveti darśayati| nanu ca neha kriyopāttā, tatkathaṃ tadapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī prayujyate? yadyapi nopāttā, tathāpi karttuḥ kriyāpekṣatvāt karttṛśabdo'yaṃ sambandhiśabda iti karttṛsambandhinīṃ kriyāmupasthāpayatītyadoṣaḥ| īpsitaśabdo hrasti rūḍhiśabdaḥ - īpsito'bhipreta iti, asti ca kriyāśabdaḥ-āptamiṣṭa īpsita iti ; tatraha kriyāśabdo gṛhrate, netaraḥ; na hi rūḍhiśabdasya kriyayā karttṛsādhyayā sambandha upapadyate| `īpsita` iti| `āplṛ vyāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1260) san, dvirvacanam, `āpjñapyṛdhāmīt` [[7.4.55]] itīttvam| <<atra lopo'bhyāsasya>> [[7.4.58]] ityabhyāsalopaḥ| īpsa iti sthite, ktapratyaye kṛte, iṭi ca <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralope cepsitaśabdaḥ sampadyate| tenārthadvayamihopāttam - prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthaśca| tatrāptumityanena prakṛtyarthaṃ darśayati,iṣṭatamamityanena pratyayārtham|`karmaṇaḥ` ita| aāsya| atra bandhakriyayā āptamiṣṭatamatvāt karmatvam| sa hi bhakṣaṇakriyayā māṣānāptumicchati| `payasaudanaṃ bhaṅkte` iti| asati hi tamabgrahaṇe payaso'pi syāt| tadapi karttṛrbhujikriyayā vyāptumiṣṭaṃ bhavati| tamabgrahaṇe tu sati na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ; prādhānyādaudanasyaivepsitatamatvāt| prādhānyaṃ tvodanasya saṃskāryatvāt, payasastvaprādhānyaṃ saṃskārakatvāt| `karmetyanuvartamāne` iti| `adhiśīṅasthāsāṃ karma` [[1.4.46]] ityataḥ| `punaḥ`ityādi| pūrva karmagrahaṇamādhāreṇa sambaddham; atastadanuvṛttau tasyānuvṛttiḥ syādata ādhāranivṛttyarthaṃ punaḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| yadi punarādhāro'nuvartate, tataḥ kiṃ syādityatrāha - `ādhārasyaiva hi syāt` iti| `hi` śabdo yasmādarthe| yasmāsyādityāha - `geham` ityādi| ādhārānuvṛttau tu yatra na bhavati taddarśanayitumāha - `odanaṃ pacati` ityādi| ādiśabdenaudanaṃ bhaṅktaṃ ityevamādegrrahaṇam| atha nadī kūlaṃ karṣatītyādau kathaṃ karmasaṃjñā? kathañca na syāt? nadyāderacetanatvāt, acetanānāmīpsāyā asambhavāt, naitadasti; atra nadīti padāntarasambandādīpsāyā abhāvo'cetanasyāpi bhāvaḥ pratīyate| na ca padasaṃskāre padānatarasambandhagamyo'rtha upayujyate, tena kūlaṃ karṣatītyādāvicchāmātramāśritā vyāptiḥ, karma ca saṃskriyate| yadyapi paścānnadyā saha sambandhādacetanatvamicchāyā abhāvaśca pratīyate, tathāpi ca tadbahiraṅgatvādantaraṅgasaṃjñākārya na śaknoti nivartayitum| anenaiva nyāyena yatra vyāptirnāsti,icchāmātraṃ ca kevalam, tatrāpi karmasaṃjñā bhavati, yathā- grāmaṃ ganatumicchāmi na ca me gamanaśaktirastīti| tacca karma trividham - nirvatryam, vikāryam, prāpyañca| tatra nirvarttyaṃ yadasakadevotpādyate, yasya janma kriyate, tannirvarttyam , yathā - kaṭaṃ karoti, kaṭo hrasanneva kriyate| vikāryaṃ yallabdhasattākamavasthāntaramāpādyate kevalaṃ bhasmākhyāmavasthāmāpādyante| prāpyaṃ yatra vyāptivyitarekeṇa kriyākṛtā viśeṣā na vibhāvyante, yathā - ādityaṃ paśyatīti| na hi dṛśikriyayā vyāpyamānasya savituḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣa upalabhyata iti prāpyametat karma||`{mudrita `kāśikāvṛttau` tu `apādānādiviśeṣakathābhiḥ` ityevāsti|}apādānādhibhirviśeṣakathābhiḥ` iti| kārakasāmānyakathāyā vyavacchedārtametat| yadi hi kenāpyakathitasya karmasaṃjñā syāt, tadā māṇavakasya pitaraṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchatītyatrākārakasyāpi māṇavakasya karmasaṃjñā syāt| `parigaṇanam` iti| anayadhātuvyavacchedārthametat| tena `duha prapūharaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1014) ityevamādīnāmeva dhātūnāṃ prayoge'kathitasya karmasaṃjñā vidhīyate, nānyeṣām| `upayujyata ityupayogaḥ` iti| karmasādhano ghañantaḥ|`upayajyate` iti| iṣṭārthasiddhau vyāpāryata ityartha-| `payaḥprabhṛti` iti| prabhṛtiśabdana bhikṣādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `tasya nimittaṃ gavādi` iti| ātrāpyādiśabdena pauravādegrrahaṇam| `tasyoparyujyamānapayaḥ prabhṛtanimittasya` iti| upayujyamānañca tat payaḥ prabhṛti ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaṃ kṛtvanā upayujyamānapayaḥ prabhṛternimittamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `gavādeḥ` iti| ādiśabdena pauravādegrrahaṇam| nanu ca pāṇyādikamapyupayoganimittamiti, tena vinopayogasya payaso'sambhavāt| ādiśabdena kāṃsyapātrādegrrahaṇam| `vihitā hi tatra karaṇādi saṃjñā` iti| ādiśabdenādhikaraṇasaṃjñāyā grahaṇam| `tadartham` iti| karaṇādeḥ karmasaṃjñānivṛttyarthamityarthaḥ| arthaśabdasya nivṛttivacantavāt| `apūrvavidhau` iti| pūrvagrahaṇamatrānyavidherupalakṣaṇārtham| etaduktaṃ bhavati - yasyānyo vidhirnoktasya karmasaṃjñeti| tena yatrāpi vakṣyamāṇe hetukarttṛsaṃjñe iti tatrāpyeṣā saṃjñā nabhavatīti dogdhāpyupayogasya nimittaṃ tasya karmasaṃjñā na bhavati| sūtre'pi `akathitam` iti kathamanivṛttaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ bhūtakālo na vivakṣyate; upalakṣaṇatvāt| tena yo'pi kathayiṣyamāṇo hetukarttṛsaṃjñābhyām, tasyāpi karmasaṃjñā na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| bruviśāsiguṇena` iti| kaḥ punarguṇa ityāha - `sādhanam` iti| sādhanaṃ hi kriyayā upakārakam| yaccopakārakaṃ tadupakāryam pradhānamapekṣya guṇo bhavati| katarat punaḥ sādhanamityāha - `pradhānaṃ karma` iti| kiṃ punastadityāha - `dharmādikam` iti| ādiśabdena pattyādegrrahaṇam| pradhānatvantu dharmādestadarthatvācchiṣyādipravṛtteḥ| `sambadhyate` iti sacata ityasyārthakathanam| tathā hi - `ṣaca samavāye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-997) iti paṭhate, samavāyaśca sambandha eva| sacate = tena guṇena sambandhamupaiti| yacca tena sambandhamuṣaiti tattena sambadhyate| `uktam` iti ācaritamityasya vivaraṇam| sūtrākāreṇetyetadapi `kavinā` ityasya|`gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ` iti| `duha prapūraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1014) ādādikaḥ| <> [[8.2.32]] , <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] , <> [[8.4.53]] iti jaśtvam| nanu cātra vihitā'pādāna saṃjñā, asti hyatrāpāyaḥ - goḥ duheḥ kṣaraṇārthatvāt, kṣarati gauoḥ kṣīram, tadgordogdhā kṣārayati, evañca tat kṣāryamāṇaṃ tato'pakrāmatīti spaṣṭa evāpāyaḥ, tato nedamudāharaṇamupapadyate? naitadevam; satyapi hrapāye nātra goravadhitvaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? kṣīraṃ prati nimittabhāvamātram| yadyevam, goḥ kārakatvaṃ na syāt, yathā - vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatītyatra vṛkṣasya na; kṣaraṇakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvenāvivakṣitatvāt, naitat; avadhitvaṃ hyatra gorna vivakṣitam| kṣaraṇaṃ prati nimittabhāvastu vivakṣita eva| vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatītyatra tu patanaṃ prati vṛkṣasya nimittabhāvamātramapi na vivakṣitam, na kevalamavadhibhāva ityasamānam| `pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate` iti| nanu cātra kathitāpādānādisaṃjñā , asti hrasau| pauravādgāmādatta iti astyevavāpāyaḥ? naitadasti; na hi yācanādevāpāyo bhavati , kiṃ tarhi? avarodhanakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvamātram| asyāñcāvasthāyāṃ vā vivakṣyate; na caitadiha vivakṣitam, hetunā gāmavasthāpayatītyayamatrārtho veditavyaḥ, na tu kvāvasthāpayatītyetadiha cintyata eva| `māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati` iti| `praccha jñīpsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 1413), tudādiḥ, grahijyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.16]] samprasāraṇam| nanu ca kathitātrāpādānasaṃjñā, asti hyatrāpāyaḥ - sahi tasmādupadeśamāditsate, naitadasti; na hi praśnamātreṇāpāyo bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? pṛṣṭaḥ san yadyasāvācaṣṭe tadāpāyena yujyate| satyapyapāye nātra māṇavako'vadhibhāvena vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? praśnakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvamātreṇa|`pauravaṃ gāṃ bhikṣate` iti| `bhikṣa yācñāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-606) anudāttet| ata kimartha yācibhikṣyodrvayorupādānam, yāvatā'nayorarthabhedo nāsti? na ceyaṃ saṃjñā śbadāśrayā, kiṃ tarhi? athaśriyā| tathā hi- yācinā samānārthasyānyasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati - devadattaṃ śataṃ prārthayate, devadattaṃ śataṃ mṛgayata iti| tasmāt satyapi śabdebhede na yuktaṃ tayoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇam| evaṃ tarhi yāciratrānunaye vartate - tana kruddhaṃ yācate, avinītaṃ yācata iti, tadarthaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ syāt|`vṛkṣamavacinoti phalāni` iti| nanu cātra vihitā'pādānasaṃjñā tathā hi - vṛkṣāt phalānyādata ityapāyo'trārthaḥ,naitadasti; na hyatra vṛkṣo'vadhitvana vivakṣitaḥ| kintarhi? phalāvacayanasya hetubhāvamātreṇa| vṛkṣeṇa hetunā phalāvacayanaṃ karotyarthaḥ| tasya vṛkṣasya hetubhāvaḥ kimavadhibhūtasya? adhikaraṇabhūtasya vā? ityevamādikā cintā na kṛtā|evaṃ `māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ brūte, māṇavakaṃ dharmamanuśāsti` iti| `brāūñ vyaktāyāṃ vāci` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1044), `śāsu anuśiṣṭau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1075) adādī| nanu ca kathitātra sampradānasaṃjñā, asti hyatra sampradānatvam, sampradeyena dharmeṇābhipreyamāṇatvāt, naitadasti; dadātikarmaṇābhipreyamāṇasya sampradānasaṃjñā vihitā, na cātra dharmo dadātikarma; brāuviśāsyoradānārthatvāt| athāpi dānārthatā syāt? evamapi māṇavekana nimittena dharmaṃ dadātītyayamarthaḥ syāt| māṇavakasya sampradānatvanāvivakṣitatvāt; dharmadānanimittatvena vivakṣitatvāt|bruviśāsiguṇena ceti cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena nayatiprabhṛtīnāṃ prayoge'pyakathitasya karmasaṃjñeṣyate|tathā coktam - nīvahroharateścaiva gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca|dvikarmakeṣu grahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ|| iti|atrāpi śloke cakāro jayatiprabhṛtīnāṃ prayoge'kathitasya samuccayārthaḥ| kimudāharaṇam? ajāṃ nayati grāmaṃ devadattaḥ| ajāṃ vahati grāmaṃ devadattaḥ| ajāṃ harati grāmaṃ devadattaḥ| śataṃ jayati devadattaṃ yajñadattaḥ| śataṃ gargān daṇḍayatīti| nanu cobhayeṣāmapi `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma` [[1.4.49]] ityanenaiva karmasaṃjñā siddhā| yadi tahrrajādīnāmīpsitatamatvaṃ vivakṣyate, na grāmādīnām, tadā kathaṃ karmasaṃjñā? tathāpi `tathāyuktam` [[1.4.50]] ityanena siddhā| yadā tarhi grāmādīnāmīpsitatvaṃ prakarṣarahitaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā na siddhyati| akarmakāṇāñca dhātūnāṃ kālabhāvādhnagantavyadeśānāṃ karmasaṃjñeṣyate| tathā coktam - kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hrakarmaṇām|daśāścākarmakāṇāñca karmasaṃjñā bhavanti ca||iti vaktavyam (ma|bhā|1|336) iti|tasmāt tadartho'nuktasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ kṛtaḥ kālaḥ - māsamāste māsaṃ svapitīti| bhāvaḥ - godohamāste, godohaṃ kasvapitīti| adhvā gantavyaḥ - krośamāste, krośaṃ svapitīti| adhvā cāsau gantavyaśceti viśeṣamasamāsaḥ| `kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraya` [[2.2.38]] iti viśeṣyasya pūrvanipātaḥ| deśaḥ kurūnāste, kurūn svapitīti| sarvaṃ ete kālādayo'kathitāḥ; pūrvavidheḥ kasyacidpravṛttatvāt||`yāpayati` iti| `artihyī` [[7.3.36]] ityādinā puk|`vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - uttarasūtre [[1.4.53]] anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūto vijñāyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā; tena nīvahrorna bhaviṣyati|`vaheḥ` ityādi| niyacchati = viśiṣṭe viṣaye'vasthāpayatīti niyantā sārathiḥ, avidyamāno niyantā kartā yasya sa tathoktaḥ, tasya| `nīvahyoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ` (vā|62) iti yo'nantaroktaḥ sa vaheraniyantṛkarttṛkasya bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - tasyaivānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣā tvānniyantṛkarttṛkasya vaheḥ karmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti|`ādikhādyoḥ` ityādi| atrāpi vaktavyaśabdasya pūrvavadevārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi pūrvavadeva kartavyam| `bhakṣyati piṇḍī devadattaḥ` iti| curādiṇic| `bhakṣayati` piṇḍīṃ devadattena` iti| hetumaṇṇic| `bhakṣayati balīvarddān śasyam` iti| bhakṣiratra hiṃsārthaḥ| `sarve sacetanā bhāvāḥ` ityasmin darśe hiṃsitaṃ śasyamiti śasyasya bhakṣaṇena devadatto hiṃsito bhavati| yasya hi tacchasyaṃ tasya hiṃsā gamyate|`śabdakarmaṇām` iti| śabdagrahaṇeneha pāribhāṣikaṃ karma gṛhra|te, na tu kriyā| kriyā grahaṇe hi karma grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| kārakādhikārādeva kārakasya kriyāpekṣatvācchabdātmikāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ vartamānā dhātavo grahīṣyanta iti, tat kiṃ karmagrahaṇena? yadi tarhi pāribhāṣikaṃ karma gṛhrate, jalpati devadatto jalpayati devadattam, vilapati devadattaṃ kārṣāpaṇamityatra na prāpnoti, śabdādanyasya pāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo vivakṣitatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; buddhyarthatvāt bhaviṣyati| atra hi jalpatiprabhṛtayastāvacchabdasādhane bodhane vartante| jalpati devadatta iti| vacanena bodhayatītyarthaḥ| evamanyatrāpi| paśyati kārṣāpaṇamityatra dṛśiścakṣuḥ sādhane jñāne vartate| cakṣuṣā jānīta ityarthaḥ| tasmādbuddharthatvāt siddham| `adhyāpayati` iti| `krīṅajīnāṃ ṇau` (6|1||48) ityāttvam| `artihyī` [[7.3.36]] ityādinā puk| kimarthaṃ punaridaṃ sūtram, yāvatā ṇyante dhātau prayojanakavyāpāreṇa preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇākhyena vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt prayojyasya `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma` [[1.4.49]] ityanenaiva karmasaṃjñā siddhā? satyam, niyamārthaṃ vacanam - prayojakavyāpāreṇa vyāpyamānasya yadā karmasaṃjñā tadā gatyarthādīnāmeva,nānyeṣāmiti||gatyarthādayo nivṛttāḥ| tenobhayatra vibhāṣeyam| yadā haratirgatau vartate, abhyavahāre vā, karotiścākarmaṇo bhavati tadā prāpte| yadā tu haratiḥ steyādau vartate, karotiśca sakarmako bhavati tavā'prāpte| `upasaṃkhyānam` iti| pratipādanamityarthaḥ| etacca prakṛtatvāt tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `akathitañca` [[1.4.51]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenābhivādidṛśorapyātmanepade karmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti| `abhivādayate` iti| `ṇitaśca`(1|3|ka74) ityātmanepadam| `darśayate` iti| atrāpi `ṇeraṇau` [[1.3.67]] ityādinā|astyayaṃ svatantaraśabdo bahuvrīhiḥ| svaṃ tantraṃ yasya sa svatantraḥ| asti ca samāsapratirūpako rūḍhiśabdaḥ, pradhānārthavṛttiḥ, yathā - svatantro'yamiha devadatta iti, pradhānabhūta iti gamyate| tatra yadi pūrvo gṛhreta tadā tantuvāyasyaiva syāt; vistṛtā hi tantavastantram, tacca tantuvāyasyaivāsti| devadattaḥ pacatītyādau na syāt| itarasya tu grahaṇe sarvatra bhavati| tasmāt vyāptenryāyāt sa eva gṛhrata iti matvāha - `svatantra iti pradhānabhūtaḥ` iti| yadyevamapradhānamapekṣya pradhānamucyata iti yatrādhikaraṇādīnyaparāṇyapradhānāni kārakāṇi santi, devadattaḥ kāṣṭhairagninodanaṃ sthālyāṃ pacatītyādau tatraiva syāt| yatra tu teṣāmavivakṣā - āste devadattaḥ, śete devadatta ityādau, tatra na syāditi yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha - `aguṇabhūtaḥ` iti| evaṃ manyate - pradhānenāguṇabhāva upalakṣyate| guṇabhāvo yatra nāsti sa karteti| kārakāntarāvivakṣāyāmapyaguṇabhāvo'styeveti sarvatra bhavati| nanu ca sāmagryadhīnā hi kriyāsiddhiḥ, ekasyāpyabhāve na sidhyati, tat kasyātra prādhānyaṃ yatparigrahāya svatantragrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha - `yaḥ kriyāsiddhau` ityādi| yadyapi kriya#āsiddhau sarveṣāṃ vyāpāraḥ, tathāpi svātantryaṃ yasya vivakṣyate sa eva svatantra ityutyate, nānya iti| devadattaḥ pacatītyatra devadattaḥ karttṛsaṃjñakatvāt karttṛpratyayenocyate lakāreṇa||`tasya prayojakastatprayojakaḥ` iti| nanu ca `kartari ca` [[2.2.16]] ityanena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhe nātra bhavitavyamityāha - `nipātanātsamāsaḥ` iti| `prayojakaḥ` iti prerakaḥ = upadeśakaḥ, vyāpāraka ityarthaḥ| na cānyena prayujyamānasya svavyāpāre svātantrayaṃ hīyate; anyathā hrakurvatyapi kārayīti syāt| prayojakatvaṃ dvividham - mukhyam, itaracva| devadattaḥ kaṭaṃ kārayītyatra devadattasya mukhyam| bhikṣā vāsayatītyatra bhikṣāṇāṃ vāsahetutvāt prayojanatvamupacaritam, na mukhyam| na hi bhikṣā yūyaṃ vasathetyevaṃ prayuñjate| iha ca kārakādhikāre tamabgrahaṇavyatirekeṇātiśayo na vivakṣita iti `sādhakatamaṃ karaṇa m` [[1.4.42]] ityatra tamabgrahaṇena jñāpitametat| tena yasyāpi prayojagatvamupacaritam, na mukhyam, tasyāpi hetusaṃjñā bhavatyeva|`saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāraḥ` iti| asati tasminnekasaṃjñādhikārādatra kartṛsaṃjñā na syāt| ataḥ saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāraḥ kriyate| `hetutvāt` ityādinā saṃjñādvayasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| prayojakavyāpāre hi <> [[3.1.26]] iti ṇic vidhīyate| tasya hetutvaṃ prayojakasya hetutve satyupapadyate| hetutvātprayojako ṇico nimittaṃ bhavati| kartṛpratyena na lakāreṇābhidhānaṃ karttṛsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ bhavatīti karttṛtvat karttṛpratyayena lakāreṇocyata iti||ca,vā,ha, aha ityatra nipātasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām <> [[1.1.37]] ityavyayasaṃjñā bhavati| `nipātā ādyudāttā bhavanti` (phi|sū|4|80) ityādyudāttatvañca| atha kimarthaṃ prāggrahaṇam? yāvatā pañcamyuccāraṇasāmarthyādeva prāgityasya dikchabdasyādhyāhāro bhaviṣyati| na ca `parām` ityayamapi dikchabdo'sti| ato nādhyāhāra āśaṅkanīyaḥ| tadadhyāhāre hi <<cādayo'sattve>> [[1.4.57]] ityevamādayo yogā nipātasaṃjñāsambandhābhāvādasambaddhāḥ syuḥ| tasmāt prāgityetadevādhyāhariṣyate| tat kiṃ prāgavacanena? ityāha - `prāgvacanam` ityādi| ekā saṃjñetyanuvartate| nipātasaṃjñā cādiṣu prādiṣu vā kriyāyoge caritārthā| tatrāsati prāgvacane nipātasaṃjñāyā upasargādisaṃjñābhiranavakāśābhirbādhyamānatvāt tābhi) saha tasyāḥ samāveśo na syāt| iṣyate cātra, tadarthaṃ prāgvacanam, tasmin satyevaṃ sambandhaḥ kriyate - rīśvarāta yāvantaḥ prāgvyavasthitāste sarve nipātasaṃjñakā bhavanti, nipātāśca santa upasargādisaṃjñakā iti| tena nimittameva nipātasaṃjñopasargasaṃjñānāṃ bhavati| na ca nimittinā nimittaṃ vyāhanyate, anyathā hi tasya nimitatvameva na syāt| adhyāha#ṛte tu prākśabde rīśvarādye prāgvyavasthitāste sarve nipātasaṃjñakā bhavantītyeṣo'rtho'bhimataḥ syāt, na tu nipātāḥ santa upasargādisaṃjñakā ityeṣo'pyartho labhyate| sūtropātto tu prākśabda eṣo'rtho labhyata eva; anyathā tasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt|atha kimarthaṃ rephādika īāraśabdo gṛhrate - prāgrīśvarāditi, na ca prāgrīśvarādityevocyeta, pratyāsatteranantara eva hīāraśabdo grahīṣyata ityata āha - `rīśvarādvīārātmā bhūta` iti| rephasahita īāro rīśvaraḥ| śākapārthivāditvānmayūravyaṃsakāditvādvā samāsaḥ| rīśvarādityucyamāne vīārānmā bhūt, `adhirīśvare` [[1.4.96]] ityasyaiveāraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| `īāre totunkasunau` [[3.4.13]] ityatra yo vīāraśabdastasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūt| yasya grahaṇe bahūnāṃ saṃjñā bhavatyato vyāptenryāyādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāta| nanu ca vakārastatra nāstyeva, tat kimucyate vīārānmā bhūditi? evaṃ manyate - yadā sūtrāṇi saṃhitayā paṭhante - `śaki ṇamulkamulāvīāretosunkasunau` (3.4.12,13) iti tadā lauśabdasya grahaṇe na prayojakam| yadyapi parasyeāraśabdasya grahaṇe tannibandhanā vyāptirasti, tathāpyanantarasyaiveāraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, na parasya; katham? jñāpakāt; yadayaṃ <> [[1.1.39]] iti kṛto māntasyaijantasyāvyayasaṃjñā śāsti tajjñāpayati - anantarasyeāraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ netarasyeti; anyathā hi ṇamulādīnāṃ nipātatvādevāvyavyasaṃjñā siddheti <> [[1.1.39]] iti vacanamarthakaṃ syāt, naitadasti jñāpakam; yasmāt `īāre tosunkasunau` [[3.4.13]] ityasmāt paro'pi kṛdejanto māntaścāsti| <> [[3.4.14]] `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamula ca` [[3.4.22]] ityevamādiḥ| tatkathaṃ <> [[1.1.39]] ityeta jñāpakaṃ syāt? evaṃ tarhi yadayamavyayībhāvasya <> [[2.4.18]] ityavyayasaṃjñāṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati - anantaro ya īāraśabdastasya grahaṇamiti| anyathā hi <> [[2.4.18]] ityedapārthakaṃ syāt; nipātatvādevāvyayībhāvasyāvyayasaṃjñāyāḥ siddhatvāt|asyāpi jñāpakatāmapākarttumahā - `samāseṣvavyayībhāvaḥ` iti| sarveṣāṃ samāsānāṃ nipātatvādavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ <> [[2.4.18]] ityetadvacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ syāt - samāseṣu tatpuruṣādiṣu madhye'vyayībhāva evāvyayasaṃjño bhavati, nānya iti| evaṃ tarhi laukikanyāyādanantarasyaiveāraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| loke hi `odakāntaṃ priyaṃ prothamanuvrajet` iti ya evānantara udakāntastameva gatvā tata eva bāndhavā nivartante, na vyavahitāt| tasmādihāpyanenaiva nyāyenānantarādevaāraśabdānnipātasaṃjñā nivartiṣyata ityata āha - `laukikaṃ cātivartatate` iti| laukikamapi nyāyaṃ loko'tikramya vartate, yasmāt dvitīyamapyadakāntaṃ snehāt kathāprasaṅgadvā gatvā nivartante bāndhavāḥ| tadevaṃ rephādhika īāraśabda uccāryate| tena vīārānmā bhūditi sthitametat||`asattve` iti| paryudāso'yaṃ vā syāt, prasajyapratiṣedho vā? tatra yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt, tadā sattvādanyatra vartamānāścādayo nipātasaṃjñakā bhavantīteyaṣaḥ sūtrārthaḥ syāt| tataśca paśuśabdasya cādiparipaṭhitasya jātivyavacchinne dravye vartamānasya nipātasaṃjñā syāt| yo hi jātiviśiṣṭe dravye vartate, sa jātidravyasamudāyātmakamarthamāha| yaścaivaṃvidho'rthaḥ sa dravyāt kevalādanyo bhavati| nipātasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ paśuriti savibhaktikasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt| prasajyapratiṣedhe tveṣa doṣo na bhavati| tatra hi yatra dravyagandho'pyasti tatra sarvatra pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam| asti ceha dravyagandhaḥ| paśutvajātyāśritasya dravyasyāpi paśuśabdenābhidhānāt| tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedha evāyaṃ yukta ityālocyāha - `prasajyapratiṣedho'yam` iti| kva tarhi vartamānaḥ paśuśabdo'sattvavacano bhavati? yatra vṛttau nipātasaṃjñāṃ labhate dṛśyarthe - yathā, lodhaṃ nayanti paśu manyamānā iti| atra dṛśyarthena paśuśabdena mananaṃ viviṣyate| darśanametanmananam, samyagjñānamityarthaḥ| sattvaśabdo'yamiha sattāyāṃ vartata iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha - `sattvamiti ca dravyamucyate` iti| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe| dravyameva na sattetyarthaḥ| yadi hyatra sattavaśabdena sattocyate, pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt? na hi cādiṣu madhye śabdaḥ sattāvācī kaścidasti| tasmādadravyamevocyate| idaṃ tarhi sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyo yo'rthastaddravyamiti| tathā coktam - vastūpalakṣamaṃ yatra sarvanāma prayujyate|dravyamityacyate so'rtho bhedyatvena vivakṣitaḥ|| iti|bhedyatvena viśeṣyatvenetyarthaḥ| ata evāvasīdati yatra guṇo viśeṣaṇabhāveneti satttvaṃ taddravyamucyate|`caṇ` iti paṭhate| tasya ṇakāro viśeṣārthaḥ `nipātairyadyadihantakuvinnekacceṇkaccidyatrayuktam` [[8.1.30]] iti, sa tu cecchabdasyārthe vartate|yatra` iti paṭhate| tasya <> [[1.1.38]] ityavyayasaṃjñā siddhaiva| `nipātairyadyadihantaḥ` [[8.1.30]] iti viśeṣaṇārtha nipāta saṃbodhyate| asati nipātatve `traiṅa pālane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-965) yaṃ trāyata iti yatra ityasya <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] iti kapratyayasya grahaṇaṃ syāt| `nañ` iti paṭhate; naño ñakāraḥ `nalopoḥ nañaḥ` [[6.3.72]] iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| `nalopo nañ` ityucyamāne pāmanaputra ityatrāpi syāt, yadi tatra <> [[6.3.1]] ityuttarapadagrahaṇa pūrpapadaṃ naśabdena viśeṣyate - nāntasya pūrvapadasyeti| atha tu pūrvapadena viśeṣyate - (see in other tekṣṭ)page no|206)uttarasaṃjñīttarasūtre kṛtā saṃjñopasargasaṃjñā| tasyā viśeṣaṇaṃ vyavacchedaḥ prādibhyo'nyasmādvayāvartanamuttarasaṃjñā mā bhūt` iti| ekayoge hi sati yathā prādīnāmupasargasaṃjñā bhavati tathā cādīnāmapi syāt| ataḥ prādīnāmevopasargasaṃjñā yathā syāccādīnāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ kriyate| `parāḥ senāḥ` iti| senāyāḥ dravyatvāt tatra vartamānasya parāśabdasyeha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| parā utkṛṣṭāḥ paradeśasthitā vā| yatra tvekavacanaṃ paṭhate - parā seneti, tatra rūpodāharaṇaṃ veditavyam| dvivacanabahuvacanayostu nipātatvādavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ vibhakterluksyāt||`praṇayati` iti| praśabdasyopasargatvāt <<upasargādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya>> [[8.4.14]] iti ṇatvam| `pranāyako deśaḥ` iti| atranayanakriyayā praśabdasya yogo nāstītyupasargasaṃjñā na bhavati| nanu cātrāpi gamikriyayā yogo'styeveti syādeva tasyopasargasaṃjñā, netadasti; kriyāyogagrahaṇaṃ hrevamanarthakaṃ syāt| katham? prādīnāṃ kriyāyogāvyabhicārāt; tasmāt kriyāyogagrahaṇasāmarthyādyaṃ prati kriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatuyapasargasaṃjñakā bhavanti, nānyaṃ prati| na ceha nayanakriyayā yuktaḥ praśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? gamikriyayeti nayatiṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñako na bhavati|`marucchabdasyopasaṃkhyānam` iti| tatvavidhāviti| śeṣaḥ; anyathā hi `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80) `upasargāścābhivarjam` (phi|sū|4|81) ityādyudāttatvamapi syāt| antodāttaśceṣyate marucchabdaḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ; marucchabdasyopasargasaṃjñāyāḥ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `upasargāḥ` iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate| atra ca `prādayaḥ` iti nābhisambadhyate| tena marucchabdasya tatvavidhāvupasargasaṃjñā bhavatīti| ata eva yogavibhāgāt śracchabdasyāṅavidhāvantaḥ śabdasyāṅgividhiṇatveṣūpasargasaṃjñā bhavatīti veditavyam| yogavibhāgasyedaṃ liṅgam <> [[5.2.101]] , <<tiro'ntarddhau>> [[1.4.71]] iti ca nirdeśaḥ| tataḥ `kriyāyoge` iti dvitīyo yogaḥ| atra ca `prādayaḥ` iti sambadhyate| kimarthamidam? pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvājñāpanārtham, tena nātiprasaṅagaḥ| prādīnāmakriyāyoga upasargasaṃjñā mā bhūdityevamarthañca| `maruttaḥ` iti| <> [[7.4.47]] iti ktapratyaye kṛte dvitakāranirdeśāddavāteḥ sarvādeśaḥ| nanu casatyāmupasargasaṃjñayāṃ karucchabdasyānajantatvāt tatvena na bhavitavyamityata āha - `saṃjñāvidhāna sāmarthyāt` ityādi| yathā hrupasaraja ityatra ḍitkaraṇasāmarthyādabhasyāpi ṭilopo bhavati, tathehāpyanajantādapi tatvaṃ bhaviṣyati; anyathā hīdaṃ vacanamapārthakaṃ syāt| marucchabdasyopasargasaṃjñāyā anyakāryābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ|`śracchabdasyopasaṃkhyānam` iti| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya sa evārthaḥ| pratipādanamapi tadeva| nanu ca bhidādipāṭhādeva hi śraddheti siddham;tatkathaṃ tatsiddhaye śracchabdasyopasargasaṃjñā kriyate? evaṃ manyate- anārṣastatra pāṭha iti||bāla-manoramāprādayaḥ 23, 1.4.59 prādayaḥ| asattva ityanuvartate, nipātā iti ca| tadāha - adravyeti| tatheti| nipātasaṃjñakā ityarthaḥ|bāla-manoramāupasargāḥ kriyāyoge 24, 1.4.59`prakṛtya` iti| gatisaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap` [[7.1.37]] iti lyap| `prakṛtam` iti| `kte ca` [[6.2.45]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[6.2.49]] iti prakṛtisvareṇādyadāttaḥ praśabdaḥ| `yatprakaroti` iti| praśabdādanantarasya `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ` [[8.1.28]] iti nighāte prāpte `nipātairyadyadi` [[8.1.30]] ityādinā pratiṣedhe tipaḥ pittvādanuvadāttatvam| `satiśiṣṭasvarasya balīyastvamanyatra vikaraṇasvarebhyaḥ` (vā; 9;6.1.164) iti vikaraṇasvarasya pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati| karotereva tu bhavati - `dhātoḥ` [[6.1.156]] iti| śeṣamanudāttaṃ bhavati| praśabdasya `upasargāścābhivarjam` (phi|sū|4|81) ityādyudāttatve prāpte <> [[8.1.70]] iti nighāte'nuvartamāne <> [[8.1.71]] iti karotiśabde tiṅanta udāttavati parato'nudāttatvaṃ bhavati| tatra hi `pūjanāt pūjitamanudāttaṃ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ` [[8.1.67]] ityato'nudāttamiti vartate| etacca prayojanatrayamuttaratra gatisaṃjñāyā veditavyam|atha kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na gatigrahaṇaṃ pūrvayogaga eva kriyate? ityata āha- `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ` iti| `uttaratra ` ityādinā yogavibhāgasyottarārthatāṃ darśayati| yadyuttaratrāpyupasargasaṃjñā syāt, tadā kiṃ syādityata āha - `ūrīsyādityatra ` ityādi|`cakāraḥ saṃjñāsamāveśārthaḥ` iti| asati cakāra ekasaṃjñādhikārādekatra saṃjñādvayasya vidhānāt paryāyaḥ syāt, na samāveśaḥ| `praṇītam` ityādinā saṃjñāsamāveśasya phalaṃ darśayati| `gatiranantara iti svaraḥ` iti| udāharaṇadvaye'pi `upasargāditi ṇatvaṣatve bhavataḥ` iti| `praṇītam` iti| <<upasargādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya>> [[8.4.14]] iti ṇatvam| `abhiṣiktam` iti| `upasargātsunoti` [[8.3.65]] ityādinā ṣatvam|`kārikā` ityādi| dhātvarthanirdeśa etadupasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam| yo'nyaḥ kartari kārikāśabdo ṇvulantaḥ, tasya kārikāṃ kṛtvetyevaṃ bhavati| `upākhyāna` śabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - uttarasūtre cakārsayānuktasamuccayārthatvāt kārikāśabdasya gatisaṃjñā bhavatīti|`punaścanasau` ityādi| punaścanaḥ śabdau chandasi viṣaye gatisaṃjñakau ca bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tūttarasūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatāmāśritya
