bhavati| yadyevam, gativyavadhāne'pi prākprayogo na prāpnoti - samāharatītyādau naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hi tulyajātīyako vyavadhāyako bhavati| gatyupasargajāterāśrayaṇānnāsti vyavadhānam| `ā mandraiḥ` ityādi| atrāṅo mandrairityādibhiḥ padaivryadhāne'pi yāterdhātoḥ prākprayogaḥ| `āyāhi` iti| etenāṅo yāhītyanena sambandhaṃ darśayati||`karmapravacīyāḥ` iti vakṣyamāṇānāṃ saṃjñināṃ bahutvādbahuvacanena nirdeśaḥ| mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇasyaitatprayojanamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta - karma proktavantaḥ karmapravacīyā iti| bhūte <> [[3.3.113]] iti kartaryanīyar| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ| ke ca karma proktavantaḥ? ye samprati kriyāṃ na tvāhuḥ| tadevamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇadvāreṇa ye kriyāṃ dyotitavantaḥ, na tu proktavantaḥ? yeta samprati kriyāṃ na tvāhuḥ| tadevamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇadvāreṇa ye kriyāṃ dyotitavantaḥ, na tu samprati dyotayanti, te karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā bhavantītyuktaṃ bhavati| yadi sampratati na kriyāṃ dyotayanti, kintarhi? sambandhaviśeṣam| yathā śākalyasya saṃhitāmanuprāvarṣakhadityatra hi niśamanakriyayā saṃhitāpravarṣaṇayoryaḥ sambandha upajanito hetuhetumadbhāvalakṣaṇaḥ, tamanuśabdo dyotayati| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām <> [[2.3.8]] iti dvitīyā bhavati||`lakṣaṇāśabdo'tra cihne vartate` iti matvā kaściccodayati - `kimartham` ityādi| itarastu <> [[1.4.90]] ityādau sūtre| tatra cihne jñāpake vartamānasya lakṣaṇaśabdasya grahaṇam, iha tu kārake hetau, atastena na sidhyatītyenābhiprāyeṇa taṃ pratyāha - `hetvarthantu vacanam` ityādi| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe - hetvamarthameveti| hetuśabdo'tar kārakahetuvacanaḥ, na jñāpakahetuvacanaḥ; anyathā hraparihāra evāyaṃ syāt| heturartho yasya tattathoktam| hetau vartamānasyānoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthamidaṃ vacanamityarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ punahatau vartamānasya tasyeyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyata ityāha - `hetau tṛtīyāyām` ityādi| saṃhitā hi varṣaṇasya hetuḥ, anuhuddyajñaḥ sekasya, tathā hi - saṃhitāmanuniśamya śrutvā prāvarṣat| avuḍudyajñañcānuniśamyāsiñcat| tatra yadi hetāvanoreṣā saṃjñā nocyeta śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu raprāvarraṣadityādau `hetau` [[2.3.23]] iti tṛtīyā syāt| tasmāttāṃ bādhitvā dvitīyaiva yathā syādityevamartha hetāviyaṃ saṃjñā'norvidhīyate||`nadīmanvavasitā` iti| sahārtho'tra tṛtīyārthaḥ| <<sahayukte'pradhāne>> [[2.3.19]] iti sahārthayoge tṛtīyāvidhānāt| `anvavasitā` iti| `ṣiñ bandhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1477) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ rūpam||`anuśākaṭāyanaṃ vaiyākaraṇāḥ` iti| śākaṭāyanamapekṣyānye vaiyākaraṇā hīnā iti| apekṣayātra janito yaḥ sambandhastena vyatiricyate śākaṭāyana iti| tataḥ ṣaṣṭhaāṃ prāptāyāṃ tadapavādena dvitīyā vidhīyate| ekayaiva vibhaktyobhayastho'pi sambandho dyotita iti| tena sambandhyantaravācino vaiyākaraṇaśabdādaparaḥ sambandhivibhaktirna bhavati||adhikadhyārūḍhamucyate| na cānadhikena vinādhikaṃ sambhavati| tenādhike sambandhe'dhyārūḍhakriyājanite saṃjñeyaṃ vijñāyate| cakāraddhīne ca| `upakhāryāṃ droṇaḥ` iti| khāryā droṇo'dhika ityarthaḥ| `yasmādadhikam` [[2.3.9]] ityādinā saptamī| tayaiva sambandhasyābhihitatvāt droṇaśabdāt <> [[2.3.8]] iti dvitīyā na bhavati||`prakṛtena sambandhinā` iti| varṣādinā| `kasyacit` iti| trigartādeḥ| `apa trigartebhyaḥ` iti| `pañcamyapāṅaparibhiḥ` [[2.3.10]] iti pañcamī| `pari pari trigartebhyaḥ` iti| <> [[8.1.5]] iti dvirvacanam|`odanaṃ pariṣiñciti` iti| sarvataḥ siñcatītyarthaḥ| <<śe mucādīnām>> [[7.1.59]] iti num| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyā abhāvādupasargasaṃjñaiva bhavati| tena `upasargātsunoti` [[8.3.65]] ityādinā ṣatvaṃ bhavati||yatrāṅo maryādāyāmabhividhau ca kāryamicchati tatrobhayorapi grahaṇaṃ karoti, yathā - <<āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ>> [[2.1.13]] ityādi| iha tu maryādāgrahameva kṛtam, nābhividhigrahaṇam, ato'bhividhāvanayā saṃjñayā na bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `vacanagrahaṇāt` ityādi| vacanagrahaṇe hi sati bahuvrīhirlabhyate| `maryādā` ityetadvacanaṃ yatra sūtre tanmaryādāvacanam| tatrāyamartho bhavati - yatra maryādāgrahaṇamasta sūtre, tatra ya āṅa sa karmapravacanīyasaṃjño bhavati| tatpunaḥ sūtram - <<āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ>> [[2.1.13]] ityetat - tatra cāṅa maryādābhividhyorvartamāna upātta ityubhayatrāpi bhavati|kaḥ punarvarjanasya maryādāśca viśeṣaḥ, yena pūrvasūtre varjanamabhidhāyeha maryādāgrahaṇaṃ karoti? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ - varjane hi tatparityāgenānyatra sāmānyena varṣaṇādinā sambandho gamyate, yathā - ā trigartebhyo vṛṣṭo deva iti, atra hi yasyāṃ diśi vyavasthito vaktedaṃ vākyaṃ prayuṅkte tasyāṃ diśi yo deśo yastathānyāsu dikṣu tatra sarvatraiva trigartān? varjayitvā vṛṣṭa iti gamyate| maryādāyāṃ tvidaṃ vākyaṃ prayuṅakte - ā pāṭaliputrādvṛṣṭo deva iti, tatsambandhinyāmeva diśi yo vyavasthito deśastasya deśasya varṣaṇena sambandharaḥ pratīyata ityeṣa viśeṣaḥ|`īṣadarthe kriyāyoge mā bhūt` iti| īṣadartha ākaḍāra iti| kriyāyoge samāharatīti| pūrvatra saṃjñāyā abhāvātpañcamī na bhavati| itaratra <> [[8.1.70]] iti nighāto bhavati| yastu vākyasmaraṇayorākāro vartate, tasyāṅittvādiha ṅakāroccāraṇādeva saṃjñāyā aprasaktiḥ||lakṣaṇaṃ jñāpako hetuścihnamihābhipretam| lakṣyate cihnyate yena tallakṣaṇam| kañcitprakāramāpannamitthambhūtam, tasyākhyānamitthambhūtākhyānam| `bhī prāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1844) ātmanepadī| tasmāt `ā dhṛṣādvā` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1805 taḥ paścāt) iti vibhāṣitaṇico yadā curādiṇij nāsti, tadā ktāntasya bhūta iti rūpaṃ bhavati| svīkriyamāṇoṃ'śo bhāgaḥ| yastvasvīkriyamāṇe'śe bhāgaśabdaḥ prayujyate - priyaṅgorbhāgo nagarasya bhāga iti, sa svīkriyamāṇāṃśasādṛśyāt| padārthān vyāptumicchā vīpsā| ete ca lakṣaṇādayaḥ pratyādīnāṃ na dyotyāḥ| kiṃ tarhi? viṣayabhūtāḥ, ata evāha - `viṣayabhūtāyam` iti| etacca `abhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti` (vyā|pa|73) iti liṅgavipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇādibhiḥ sambadhyate| etacca `abhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti` (vyā|pa|73) iti liṅgavipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇādibhiḥ sambadhyate| yadi lakṣamādayaḥ pratyādīnāṃ na dyotyāḥ, tarhi kiṃ te dyotayanti? sambandhaviśeṣam| `vṛkṣaṃ prati vidyotate vidyut` iti| atra vṛkṣo lakṣaṇam, vidyotamānā vidyullakṣyā; sā hi vṛkṣaṃ prāpya vidyotata iti tayoḥ prāptikriyājanito'tra lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ pratiśabdena dyotyate| `sādhurdevadatto mātaraṃ prati` iti| pratinā devadattasya mātṛviṣayā sādhubhāvāpattirākhyāyate| atrāpi mātaraṃ prāpya sādhubhāvāpattiriti prāptikriyājanita eva mātuḥ sādhubhāvāpatteśca viṣayaviṣayibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ pratinā''khyāyate| `yadatra māmityādi| yo bhāgo māmabhibhajate sa dīyatāmityarthaḥ| atrāpi vibhajanakriyājanitaḥ svīkārakriyājanito vā svasvāmibhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ| `mām` iti| asmacchabdasya <> [[7.2.97]] iti mādeśaḥ| `dvitīyāyāñca` [[7.2.87]] ittyāttvam| `vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati siñcati` iti| atra vīpsā dvirvacanenaiva dyotyate| pratiśabdasya tu sekakriyājanito vṛkṣāyāṃ yaḥ sambandhaḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sa eva dyotyaḥ| vṛkṣādinimittaṃ sādhanam, sekaḥ sādhyaḥ| dvitīyā ceha sakarmakatvāt siceḥ sekena vyāptumiṣṭatamānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ karmatve sati <> [[2.3.2]] ityanenaiva siddhā| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayopasarjanasaṃjñayā nivarttitattvāt `upasargāt sunoti` [[8.3.65]] ityādinā dhatvaṃ na bhavati| `pariṣiñcati` iti| sarvataḥ siñcatītyarthaḥ| athetyādi codyam| varjanetyādi parīhāraḥ| apaśabdasāhacaryādityatatrraivopapattiḥ| tatra hi karmapravacanīyādhikārādvarjanārthasyāpaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ varjana eva| tasya <> [[1.4.88]] iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā| tasmāttena sāhacaryādvarjanārthasya parogrrahaṇam| atastenāpi yoge varjana eva viṣaya iyaṃ pañcamī vidhīyate, na lakṣaṇādiṣu||`yadatra māmābhiṣyāt` iti| <<śnasorallopaḥ>> [[6.4.111]] ityakāralopaḥ| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyā abhāvadupasargatvamastyeva| tena `upasargaprādubhryāmastiryacparaḥ` [[8.3.87]] iti ṣatvam| `mām` iti| yadyapyastirakarmakastathāpyakarmakā api dhātavaḥ sopasargāḥ sakarmakā bhavantīti karmaṇi dvitīyā [[2.3.2]] nanu cābhiśabdo bhāgasambandhasya dyotaka iti tenāsteḥ sambandho nāsti; tatkathaṃ sakarmakatā? naitadasti; asti sambandhadvāreṇa hrabhiśabdo bhāgasambandhaṃ dyotayati, anyathā hi yadi tasyāstinā yogo na syāt tadopasargasaṃjñāpi na syāt| tataścopasargasaṃjñānibandhanamabhiṣyāditi ṣatvamapi na syāt||`abhimanyurarjunataḥ prati` iti| arjano mukhyaḥ| tatsadṛśo'bhimanyuḥ| so'rjumanukarotītyatrānukaraṇakriyājanitaḥ sambandhaviśeṣo'nukāryānukaraṇabhāvaḥ pratinā dyotyate| `pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt` [[2.3.11]] iti pañcamī| <> [[5.4.44]] | `māṣānasmai tilebhyaḥ` iti| tilānāṃ pūrvadattānāṃ māṇāṇāṃ pratidānamiha niryātanam| tilān gṛhītvā māṣān dadātītyarthaḥ| dānagrahaṇakriyājanito'tra sambandha uttamarṇādhamarṇabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ||bāla-manoramāpratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ 591, 1.4.92 pratiḥ pratinidhi| sadṛśaḥ pratinidhiḥ, dattasya pratiniryātanaṃ pratidānam| uktasaṃjña iti| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaka ityarthaḥ| bāla-manoramāpratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ 592, 1.4.92 pratinidhi| atreti sūtroktaviṣaye ityarthaḥ| sūtre yasmāditi ṣaṣṭharthe pañcamī, asmādeva nirdeśāt| `kṛṣṇasya pratinidhiḥ` iti tu `jñāpakasiddhaṃ na sarvatre`ti samādheyam| tathāca yatsambandhinī pratinidhipratidāne, tasmāt karmapravacanīyayuktātpañcamityarthaḥ phalati| pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇātpratīti| yuddhādau pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇanirūpitasādṛśyavānityarthaḥ| pañcamyarthaḥ sādṛśyam| pratistu taddyotakaḥ| tilebhya iti| ṛṇatvena gṛhītān tilān svarūpeṇa mūlyādyātmanā vā pratyarpayatītyarthaḥ| karmaṇi pañcamī|`anarthāntaravācinau` iti| #etenānarthāntaravācitvādanarthakādavityuktam, na tvarthābhāvāditi darśayati| yadi hravidyamānārthatvādanarthakau syātām, nirarthakamidaṃ sūtraṃ syāt| tathā hi - karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā gatyupasargasaṃjñābādhanārthā'nena vidhīyate| na cānarthakayoradhiparyorgatyupasargasaṃjñāprāptirasti| yaṃ prati kriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñā vidhānāt| anarthakayośca kriyāyogāsambhavāt| `kuto'dhyāgasacchati` ityādi| kuta ityāpādāne pañcamī| karmapravacīyeti [[2.3.8]] dvitīyā na bhavati; `upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī`(cāṃ|pa|69) iti vacanāt| sūtrārambhasya tu prayojanamākhyātameva| kuta iti, kiṃśabdāt <> [[5.3.7]] iti tasil, <> [[7.2.104]] iti kubhāvaḥ| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayā gatyupasargasaṃjñorvādhitatvāt <> [[8.1.70]] iti nighāto na bhavati| nanu cāgacchatītyukta āgamanaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ pratīyate, adhyāgacchati, paryāgacchatīti - adhipariyoge tvāgamanasyoparibhāvaḥ sarvatobhāvaścāvagamyata ityaparo viśeṣaḥ, tatkathamanarthāntaravācitvamanayoḥ? naitadasti; yadā tayorapyarthayoḥ prakaraṇādeḥ kutaścidavagatayoradhiparī prayujyete tadā tayoranarthāntaravācitvaṃ veditavyam| kathaṃ punaravagatārthayoḥ? naitadasti; yadā tayorapyarthayoḥ prayogaḥ, `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ` (vyā|pa|60) iti vacanāt? satyam, avagatārthasyāpi prayogo dṛśyate, yathā - `brāāhṛṇau dvau` iti| lokasya prayoge gurulāghavaṃ pratyanādarāt||`susiktaṃ bhavatā` iti| bhavacchabdāt kartari tṛtīyā| dvitīyā tu pūrvavadeva na bhavati| `dhātvarthaḥ stūyate` iti| śobhanodbhāvanaṃ stutiḥ, saiva tasya pujā| `upasargāśrayaṃ ṣatvaṃ na bhavati` iti| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayopasargasaṃjñāyā bādhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `suṣiktaṃ kiṃ tavātra` iti| kṣepo'yam,na pūjā||`atistutameva bhavatā` iti| niṣpanne'pi phale stutiḥ pravṛtterthaḥ| `śobhanaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ` iti| pūjāmāviṣkaroti||`padārthe` iti| anyasya padasyārtho lakṣyate| na svārthaḥ, nāpi svasambandhinaḥ; padasyārthaḥ padārthaḥ| svapadārthagrahaṇaṃ, svasambandhipadārthagrahaṇaṃ vā padārthagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| apiśabdasya hi yo'rthaḥ yaścāpiśabdasambandhinaḥ syādityādeḥ padasya , sa padārtha eveti kiṃ padārthagrahaṇena? tasmāt padārthagrahaṇasāmarthyādviśiṣṭapadasyārtho vijñāyata ityāha - `padāntarasya` ityādi| `sarpiṣo'pi syāt` iti| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayopasargasaṃjñāyā nivartitatvāt `upasargaprādubhryāmastiryacparaḥ` (8|3|ka87) iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati| atha sarpiḥśabdāddvitīyā kathaṃ na bhavati? apiśabdena tasya yogāsambhavāt| sarpiṣo hi yā mātrā sā'piśabdena yuktā, na sarpiḥ| mātrāśabdāt tarhi kasmānna bhavati? tasya prayogābhāvāt| yadā tu prayujyate, tadā karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaiva nāsti; aprayujyamānasya padāntarasyārthe tadvidhānāt| `adhikārthavacanena` iti| adhikartho mūlakasaharuāsekādiḥ, tasya vacanena sekādāvarthe kriyāyāṃ yacchakterapratighātasyāviṣkaraṇam = prakāśanaṃ tatsambhāvanam| `api siñcenmūlakasaharuām| api stuyādrājānam` iti| tasya seke stutau ca sāmarthyaṃ na vihanyata ityarthaḥ| `sambhāvane'lamiti cet siddhāpyoge` [[3.3.154]] iti liṅa| `kāmacārābhyanujñānam` iti| kamacāraḥ = icchayā pravṛttiḥ, tasyābhāyanujñānaṃ kāmacārābhyanujñānam| `api siñca, api stuhi` iti| siñca vā stuhi vā yatheṣṭamabhyanujñāto'sītyarthaḥ| `dhigjālmaṃ devadattam` iti|ubhayasarvatasoḥ kāryā dhiguparyādiṣu triṣu|dvitīyāmreḍitānteṣu tato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate||(vā|118) ityupasaṃkhyānāddvitīyā| `api siñcetpalāṇḍum` iti| <> [[3.3.169]] iti liṅa| palāṇḍumiti karmaṇi dvitīyā [[2.3.2]] | `api siñca, api stuhi ` iti| ekasmin kartari stutisekakriyayoścanīyamānatā| atra samuccayaḥ| siñca ca stuhi ceti prasiddhasamuccayārthasya caśabdasya prayogeṇa tameva samuccayamudāharaṇe vyaktīkaroti||`tadayaṃ svasvāmisambandhe` iti| parilapālanādikriyājanito'tra sambandhaḥ| `tatra` ityādi| sarvatra hi sambandhe kiñcidanūdyate, kiñcidākhyāyate| yatprasiddhaṃ tadanūdyate, yadaprasiddhaṃ tadākhyāyate = vidhīyate; jñāpyate; yathā - yaḥ kuṇḍalī sa devadatta iti| kuṇḍalitvānuvādena devadattanuvādena devadattatvaṃ vidhīyate| yacca vidhīyate tatpradhānam, itaradapradhānaṃ viśeṣamam| tatra yadā svamaprasiddhatvādvidhīyate tadā svāmī pradhānatvādvayatirekamāpadyata iti tata iva karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyuktatvādvyatirekanibandhanavibhakto ṣaṣṭhaāṃ prāptāyāṃ tadapavādaḥ `yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceāravacanaṃ tatra saptamī` [[2.3.9]] iti saptamī bhavati| tayaiva sambandhasya dyotitatvāt svāt prathamaiva bhavati, na saptamī| yadā tu svāmyaprasiddhatvāt vidhīyate, tadā viparyayo veditavyaḥ||adhirīśvara iti vartate| tena prāpte vibhāṣeyam| adhipūrvaḥ karotirviniyoge vartate| viniyuktasyaivaāryaṃ sampadyate| `yadatra māmadhikariṣyati` iti| māmiti karmaṇi dvitīyā| adhikariṣyatīti; atra `nipātairyadyadi` [[8.1.30]] ityādinā nighāte pratiṣiddhe'sya prakṛtisvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati||la iti prathamā vā syāt? ṣaṣṭhī vā? tatra yadi prathamā syāllakārasyaiva parasmaipadasaṃjñā syāt, na tadādeśānāṃ tibādīnām| kāmam, teṣamamapi sthānivadbhāvena syāt| <> [[1.4.100]] ityatra tu `laḥ` ityanena taṅānayoḥ sambandho nopapadyeta, na hi taṅānau lau bhavataḥ| atra taṅānabhāvo lakāra eva taṅānāvityevamabhihitaḥ| sāhacaryādvā lādeśau taṅānāvava `la` ityuktāviti vyākhyeyam| tathā ca vyākhyānadvāreṇeṣṭārthapratipttau sādhyāyāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe tveṣa doṣo nāsti, atastamāśrityāha - `laḥ` iti ṣaṣṭhī` ityādi| nanvayamapi pakṣo doṣavāneva, lādeśasya hi parasmaipadasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā tiṅāṃ na syāt, teṣāṃ paratvāt <> [[1.4.101]] ityādinā prathamapuruṣādisaṃjñayā bhavitavyam| parasmaipadasaṃjñāyāstu śatṛkvasvoścāvakāsaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayaṃ `sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu` (7.2.1|) ityāha tajjñāpayati - bhavati ca tiṅāṃ parasmepadasaṃjñeti| sa hi parasmaipade pare sici vidhīyate, na hi sijviṣaye śatṛkvasū sambhavataḥ| `tiptasjhi` ityādi rūpodāharaṇamātram||`katīha nighnānāḥ` iti| nipūrvoddhanteḥ <> [[3.2.129]] iti cānaśpratyayaḥ| `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityādinopadhālopaḥ| `hohanterñṇinneṣu` [[7.3.54]] iti kutvam| yadyanādeśo'pi cānaśātmanapadasaṃjñakaḥ syāt parasmaipadino hantarna syāt||tiṅa iti prathamābahuvacanam| tiṅaḥ saṃjñinaḥ kiṃbhutāḥ? trīṇi trīṇityevambhūtā ityarthaḥ| vacanāpekṣayā napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ| vīpsāyāñcaitaddvirjanam| yadi tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi vacanāni prathamamadhyamottamapuruṣasaṃjñakāni bhavanti, evaṃ sati ṣaṭtrikāḥ saṃjñinaḥ saṃjñāstitra iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti; vaiṣamyāt| tatra yadyekasyānekasaṃjñāvidhānavaiyathryādekā saṃjñā bhavet, na tvekaikasya tiruāḥ, tathāpi saivaikaikā bhavantītyavyavasthā vā syāt; naiṣa doṣaḥ;iha hi parasmaipadagrahaṇamātmanepadagarhaṇañcānuvartate| tadanuvṛttau ca dvau rāśī bhavataḥ- navānāṃ tiṅāṃ parasmaipadasaṃjñakānāmeko rāśiḥ, tathā nāvānāmātmanepadasaṃjñakānāṃ dvitīyaḥ| tatra prathame rāśau ye trayastrikāḥ, ye ca dvitīye rāśau trayastrikāstairidaṃ sūtraṃ pratyekamabhisambadhyate - parasmaipadeṣu tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi pthamamadhyamottamāḥ, tathātmanepadeṣu tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi prathamamadhyamottamā iti| evaṃ hi sati na bhavati saṃkhyātānudeśābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| tamevārthaṃ darśayitumāha - `tiṅo'ṣṭādaśa pratyayāḥ` iti| `nava` ityādinā rāśidvayaṃ darśayati| `tatra` ityādinā prathame rāśau ye trayastrikāstairasya sūtrasya sambandha#ṃ karoti| `ātmanepadeṣu` ityādināpi dvitīye rāśau ye trayastrikāstaiśca||`tāni` iti bahuvacanaṃ saṃjñāsamāveśārtham; anyathā hrekasaṃjñādhikāre sati vacanparāmāṇyāt puruṣavacanasaṃjñāḥ paryāyeṇa pravarteran| evañca tatra <<āḍuttamasya picca>> [[3.4.92]] ityādinā vidhīyamānamāḍādikāryaṃ pākṣikaṃ syāt| asmastu sati bhavati saṃjñāsamāveśaḥ| tacchabdena hi trīṇi trīṇi labdhapuruṣasaṃjñakāni tānyekavacanādisaṃjñakāni bhavantīti pratyavamṛśyante, tena yāni labdhaprathamapuruṣādisaṃjñakāni tānyevaikavacanādisaṃjñakāni bhavanti| nanu ca trikāṇāṃ prathamādisaṃjñaikaikasya caikavacanādisaṃjñā, tatra viṣayabedādekasaṃjñādhikāre'pi virodho nāstyeveti; naiṣa doṣaḥ; tadasti puruṣādisaṃjñāpi hi pratyekameva, na hi samudāyo nāmānyastrikebhyo'sti; tasmāt tibādayastrakā eva saṃjñinaḥ| trigrahaṇantu maryādārtham| tratvasaṃkhyāparicchinnāstiṅaḥ pratyekaṃ puruṣasaṃjñāḥ pratipādyante| tasmāt prathamādisaṃjñānāmekavacanādisaṃjñānāñcaikaviṣayataiveti saṃjñāsamāveśārthaṃ tānītyuktam||suviti pratyāhāragrahaṇam| prathamaikavacanāt suśabdādārabhya saptamībahucanasya supaḥ pakāreṇa| atha kapaḥ pakāreṇāyaṃ pratyāhāra kasmānna vijñāyate? saptamībahuvacanasya pakārasya vaiyathryaprasaṅgāt| sa hranudāttārthaḥ syāt? pratyāhārārtho vā? tatrānudāttārtho na bhavati; anudāttasya supatvādeva siddhatvāt| tatra yadi pratyāhārārtho'pi na syāt tadāsyāpārthakatvameva syāt| tasmāt tenaivāyaṃ pratyāhāro vijñāyate, na tu kapaḥ pakāreṇa; svaravidhau tasya caritārthatvāt||cakāraḥ puruṣādisaṃjñāsamāveśārthaḥ| vinā tenaikasaṃjñādhikāre vacanaprāmāṇyāt paryāyaḥ syāt| tiṅo vibhaktatve prayojanam `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ` (ra1.3.4) itītsaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ| supastvecca, anyacca tyadādyatvādi||niyatārthametaditi darśayitumāha - `lasyetyadhikṛtya` ityādi| etacca niyamārthatve kāraṇam| satyārambho niyamārtho bhavati, nāsiddhe| sa punarayaṃ niyama upapadārthaniyamo vā syāt - tiṅo yuṣmadyupapade madhyama eva? puruṣaniyamo vā syāt - yuṣmadyevopapade madhyam iti vā? tatra yadi prathamo niyama āśrīyate, tvayā kurvatā tvayā kurvāṇeneti yuṣmadyupade lasya śatṛśānajādeśau na bhavataḥ| tasmāt tadarthaṃ yatnāntaramāstheyam| itaratra tu na kiñcidyatnasādhyam, ato dvitīyapakṣamāśrityāha - `teṣāmayam` ityādi| vyavahite ca, avyavahite ceti| nanu ca parasparaṃ sannikṛṣṭaṃ yatpadaṃ tadupapadamucyate - upoccāritaṃ padamiti kṛtvā;yacca vyavahitaṃ tadavyavahitāpekṣayā viprakṛṣṭam, ato vyavahitena bhavitavyam, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmāt sannikṛṣṭaṃ viprakṛṣṭamityavyavasthitametadubhayagrahaṇam; sāpekṣatvāt parāparavat| tatra yadyavyavahitamapekṣya vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ bhavati, tathāpyanyadviprakṛṣṭataramapekṣya sannikṛṣṭaṃ bhavatītītaratra vyavahitenāpi bhavitavyam| yadyevam, upapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham? pūrvabhūte'pi yathā syādityevamartha kṛtam| anyathā `yuṣmadi` ityetāvatyucyamāne<> [[1.1.66]] iti parabhūta eva yuṣmadi pūrvasya madhyamaḥ syāt, na tu pūrvabhūte parasya| upapadagrahaṇādatrāpi bhavati| pūrveṇa pareṇāpi prayujyamānamupapadaṃ bhavatyeva|`samānādhikaraṇe` ityanena samānābhidheya iti vyācakṣāṇo'yamadhikaraṇaśabdo'bhidheyavacanaḥ sūtra upātta iti darśayati| tatpunarabhidheyaṃ yatra lakāra utpadyate kartari karmaṇi vā kārake pratyāsattestadeva vijñāyate ityāha - `tulyakārake` ityādi| tulyaṃ kārakaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| tulyaśabdena samānaśabdasyārtho darśitaḥ| `prayujyamāne'prayujyamāne'pi` iti| anena sthāninyapītyasyārthamācaṣṭe| sthānaśabdaḥ prasaṅgavācī - sthānamasyāstīti sthānī| kasya ca sthānam? tasyaiva sthānamasti yasyārtho gamyate, śabdo na prayujyate| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - aprayujyamāne'pi yuṣmadi, apiśabdāt prayujyamāne'pi| samānādhikaraṇagrahaṇaṃ kim? `tvayā pacyate` ityatra mā bhūt, bhinnaṃ hradhikaraṇam| tathā hi - `tvayā` ityetat karttṛvāci; kartari tṛtīyāvidhānāt| `pacyate` iti karmavāci; karmaṇi lakāravidhānāt||`prahāse gamyamāne` iti| yatra bhūtārthābhāvādvañcanaiva kevalaṃ tatra vakturabhiprayāviṣkaraṇena prahāso gamyate| `manyopapade` iti|manyatirupapadamupoccāritaṃ padaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| madhyamasya dhātorvidhānāt dhāturanyapādratho vijñāyata ityāha - `dhātoḥṭa iti| `sa caikavat` iti| yatra dvau mantārau bahavo vā tatrāyamekavadbhāvo vidhīyate| anyatra tu manturekatvādevaikavacanaṃ siddham| `madhyamottamayoḥ` iti| yathākramaṃ yuṣmadasmadorupapadayoḥ samānādhikaraṇayoraprayujyamānayorapyarthasya vidyamānatvāt| yathā pratyudāharaṇe pūrvakamupapadagrahaṇaṃ yuṣmacchabdenābhisambaddhamihānuvarteteti tanmanyatinā'śakyamabhisambandhṛmiti punarupapadagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| manyateriti śyanā nirdeśaḥ, ityasya tānādikasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdatyevamarthaḥ| tenenaha na bhavati - ehi manuṣe rathena yāsyāmi na hi yāsyasi yātastena te piteti| evaṃ hi manoterbhavati||yadā yuṣdasmadī dve apyete upapade staḥ, tadā kathaṃ bhavitavyam? yadi karttṛśaktī ādhārapratiniyate apekṣyete, tadā''khyātamapi pṛthageva prayujyate - pacasi pacāmi ceti| athāvirodhācchaktidvaye'pi lakāra utpadyate, tadā vipratiṣedhāduttama eva bhavati - tvañcāhañca pacāva iti| yadyapi `tyadādīnāṃ yadyatparaṃ tacchiṣyate` bhavati| āvāṃ pacāva ityatra hrasmacchabdasya yuṣmadartho'pi vācyaḥ, anyathā hi dvivacanaṃ na syāt| na hrasmacchabdasyaiva dvitvamupapadyate||`paraśabdo'tiśaye vartate` iti| yathā paraṃ duḥkhamiti| etana paraśabdola digādiṣvapyartheṣu vartate, tathāpīhātiśaye vartamānasya tasya grahaṇamita darśayati| sannikarṣaḥ = pratyāsattiḥ, saṃśleṣaśca| tatreha pratyāsattirgṛhrata iti darśayannāha - `sannikarṣaḥ pratyāsattiḥ` iti| saṃśleṣastu na gṛhrate, tasya varṇeṣvasambhavāt| saṃśleṣo hrekakālānāṃ bhavati, na ca varṇāmāmekakālatāpattiḥ; krameṇoccāritvāduccaritapradhvaṃsitatvāt| saṃśleṣo hrekakālānāṃ bhavati, na ca varṇānāmekakālatāpattiḥ; krameṇoccāritvāduccaritapradhvaṃsatatvāt| satyāmapi caikakālatāyāṃ na sambhavatyeva varṇānāṃ saśleṣaḥ| tathā hi - saṃśleṣaḥ saṃyogato vā syāt, samavāyato vā; tatra pūrvako dravyasyaiva syāt, na tu śabdasya - nirguṇā guṇā iti kṛtvā| itaro'pi naiva śabdasya sambhavati, na hi varṇo varṇe samavaiti; śabdasyākāśasamavāyitvāt| na ca saṃyogasamavāyayoratiśayaḥ sambhavati; sarvatraikarupakatvāt| tathā ca `paraḥ` iti viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate| pratyāsattistvapekṣākṛtabhedāt prakarṣāprakarṣābhyāṃ prayujyamānāparagrahaṇena viśiṣyata iti yuktaṃ tasya viśeṣaṇatvam| kaḥ punarasau paraḥ sannikṛṣṭān varṇānuccārayati vaktari pūrvasya varṇasya ye niṣpādakāstālvādayasteṣāṃ vyāpāroparatau varṇāntarasya ca ye niṣpādakāstālvādayasteṣāṃ vyāpāropadeśanamadrdhamātrākālamāhuḥ| sa varṇānāṃ vyavadhānaḥ = vyavadhāyako yasmin so'drdhamātrākālavyavadhānaḥ sannikarṣaḥ| yadi varṇānāmadrdhamātrākālavyavadhānaḥ sannikarṣaḥ,kathaṃ tarhi dadhyatretyādau vayavadhāyakakālo nopalakṣyate,varṇāḥ saṃśliṣṭā evopalabhyante? naitat; kimarthaṃ punaretadārabhyate, yāvatā parameva sannikarṣaṃ saṃhiteti vadantyācāryāḥ, tathā hi saṃhitāmadhīṣvetyukte paraṃ sannikarṣamevādhīte śiṣyaḥ? naitadevam; padasya padāntareṇa yadānantaryaṃ sā saṃhiteti loke'bhidhīyate| tathā ca vaktāro vadanti - saṃhitāmadhīte na padāni, padānyadhīte na saṃhitāmiti| tathā caikapade hi saṃhitākāryaṃ na syāt, <> [[6.1.77]] iti - kumāryau, kurmārya iti| sati hrasmin varṇānāṃ sannikarṣaviśeṣasyānena saṃhitāsaṃjñā vidhīyata ita sarvatraiva bhavati|||`viratirvirāmaḥ` iti| bhāve ghañ| virāmo vaṇoccāraṇābhāvo'vasānasaṃjño bhavati| `viramyate'neneti virāmaḥ` iti virāmaśabdasya dvitīyamarthaṃ darśayati| <> [[3.3.113]] iti bahulavacanādasaṃjñāyāmapi `halaśca` [[3.3.121]] iti ghañ| atra pakṣe yenāntyena varṇena viramyate so'vasānasaṃjño bhavati| tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe'bhāve paurvāparyābhāvāt `kharavasānayoḥ` [[8.3.15]] ityatrāvasānāpekṣayā viṣayasaptamīyaṃ vijñāyate; na parasamaptamī| kharapekṣayā tu saptamīyam|anye tu - yadyabhāve paurvāparyaṃ na sambhavatītyavasanāpekṣayā `kharavasānayoḥ` [[8.3.15]] iti parasaptamī nopapadyate, tadā <> [[6.1.77]] ityādāvapi parasaptamī nopapadyate| katham? varṇānāṃ kramabhāvitvāt, uccaritapradhvaṃsitatvācca| yadegasti tadāñ nāsti, yadā tvajasti tadeg nāsti| athātra buddhiprakalpitaṃ paurvāparyamāśritya parasaptamīṣyate, tadā `kharavasānayoḥ` [[8.3.15]] ityatrāpitathaivaiṣṭavyeti manyamānā avasānāpekṣayāpi parasaptamīmicchanti|apare tu - antyasya tu varṇasyāvasānasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `kharavasānayoḥ` [[8.3.15]] iti ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate| atrāvasānāpakṣayā sthānaṣaṣṭhī| rephasyāvasānasya visarjanīya iti kharapekṣayā tavānantaryalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhīti vadanti| tanmate sthānaṣaṣṭhaāṃ hi `ro ri` [[8.3.14]] ityato rephasyānuvṛttasya yat sthānitvaṃ tadavirudhyate tadevamekāpi vibhaktiryathāyogaṃ vibhajyate| nanu cābhāvapakṣe'pi pūrvasminnapi bhāge'nuccāramamasti, tatrāpi visarjanīyaḥ prāpnoti - ratha iti, asti hyatrāpi rephāt prāguccāraṇam? naiṣa doṣaḥ tatra hi prakṛtaṃ padagrahaṇaṃ repheṇa viśiṣyate - rephāntasya padasyeti| na ca pūrveṇa repheṇa padaṃ bhavati| nanvevapyarthasyaiṣā saṃjñā syāditi `kharavasanāyoḥ` [[8.3.15]] ityatra <> [[1.1.66]] iti paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| śabde hi saptamīnirdiṣṭe satīyamupatiṣṭhate, nārthe| tadanupasthāne ca pareṇa repheṇa rephāntasya ratha ityetasya padasya pūrvo yo rephastasya vyavahitasyāpi visarjanīyaḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; jñāpakānna bhaviṣyati, yadayaṃ <> [[1.1.51]] iti vyavahitasya rephasya visarjanīyamakṛtvā nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati- vyavahitasya rephasya visarjanīyo na bhavatīti| `nanvatra loke prasiddherevāyantye varṇe'vasānaśabdasya sampratyayo bhaviṣyati| prasiddho hi loke - antye varṇe'vasyateḥ prayogaḥ| tathā hi kenāvasyatītyukte vaktāro vadanti - ikāreṇokāreṇa veti| ikārādivarṇenāvasānaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| tataḥ pradeśa evāvasānagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti nārthaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñipraṇanena, naitadasti; apūrvo hi syatiḥ parisamāptāvapi vartate - avasito vāda iti, avagame'pi vartate - avasito'rtha iti, parābhave'pi vartate - dvayorvivāde'vasito davadatta iti| tatra yadīyaṃ nārabhyate, tadāvasānagraṇe sandehaḥ syāt - kimabhidhānāvasānaśabdasya grahaṇamiti? <<virāmo'vasānam>> [[1.4.110]] iti tu hrantagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam - kharantyayoriti? etadapi nāsti; evaṃ hi sandehaḥ syāt - kimantyasya varṇasya? uta padasya? āhosvadvākyasyeti? tatrāntyasya viśeṣaṇārthaṃ varṇagrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt| tasmāt saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhaḥ kartavyaḥ|`vṛkṣaḥ, plakṣaḥ` iti| `kharavasanāyorvisarjanīyaḥ` [[8.3.15]] | `dadhiṃ madhu~` iti| <<aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ>> [[8.4.57]] iti| atra hi <<vā'vasāne>> [[8.4.56]] ityato'vasānagrahaṇamanuvartate||iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃprathamādhyāyasyacaturthaḥ pādaḥ samāptaścāyaṃ prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||`paribhāṣeyam` iti| parito vyāpṛtā bhāṣā = paribhāṣā| tathā coktam - `paribhāṣā punarekasthā sarva śāstramabhijvalayati, yathā - vaśmapradīpaḥ`| kutaḥ punaretadvijñāyate - paribhāṣeyam, nādhikāra iti? padavidhigraṇālliṅgāt| uttaratra hi sarvaḥ parāṅgavadbhāvādiranukarasyamānaḥ padavidhireva| tatra yadyamadhikāraḥ syāt, padavidhigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; vayāvatryābhāvāt| paribhāṣāyāṃ tvasyām, paribhāṣā hrekadeśasyāpi sarvatra śāstre vyāpriyata ityasati padavidhigrahaṇe varṇavidhāyavapyupatiṣṭheta| tato varṇavidhinirāsārtha kriyamāṇaṃ padavidhigrahaṇamarthavadbhavati| tasmāt padividhagrahaṇālliṅgāt paribhāṣeyaṃ nādhikāra ityavasīyate| yadyavam, <> [[8.3.44]] , <> [[8.1.24]] ityevamādiṣu yogeṣu sāmarthyagrahaṇaṃ yuktagrahaṇañca kimarthaṃ kriyate, yāvatā `padasya` iti tatrānuvartate, tatra padavidhitvādevāsāmarthye na bhaviṣyati? satyametat; yadarthaṃ tu kriyate tat tatraiva pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ|vidhiśabdo'yamastyeva bhāvasādhanaḥ - vidhānaṃ vidhiriti| asti ca karmasādhanaḥ - vidhīyata iti vidhiḥ| tatra bhāvasādhane vidhiśabda āśrīyamāṇe padānāmapariniṣpannānāṃ pariniṣpādanaṃ padavidhiriti padeṣu karmaṇi kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī; teṣāṃ vidhinā sambandhāt| karmasādhane tu pariniṣpannānāṃ vyavasthitānāmeva padānāṃ yatsamāsādi kāryaṃ vidhīyate sa padividhiḥ| tatra padeṣu ca śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati; vidhīyamānasya kāryasya padasambandhitvenopādānāt| tatra yadīha bhāvasādhano vidhiśabda āśrīyeta tadā vibhaktividhānameva saṅgṛhītaṃ syāt,samāsa - parāṅgavadbhāva - taddhitavṛttyādikaṃ na saṅgṛhretaca na hi tatra padānāmasatāṃ vidhānam; kiṃ tarhi? vyavasthitānāmeva padānāṃ samāsādi kāryaṃ vidhīyate| itaratra tu vidhiśabda āśrīyamāṇe te'pi saṅgṛhītā bhavantīti manyamānaḥ karmasādhanaṃ vidhiśabdamāśrityāha - `vidhīyata iti vidhiḥ` iti| nanu cātrāpi pakṣe vibhaktividhānaṃ na saṅgṛhreta, na hi <> [[2.3.2]] ityevamādiśāstreṇa vyavasthitānāṃ padānāṃ kiñcit kāryaṃ vidhīyate, api tu padānyeva vidhīyante? yadi na saṅgṛhītaṃ syānna nāma| na ca tadasaṅgrahe kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata ityuttaratra pratipādayiṣya#āmaḥ| `samāsādiḥ` iti| ādiśabdena taddhitavṛtyādīnāṃ grahaṇam|`samarthaḥ śaktaḥ` iti| svakāryanirvartanakṣama ityarthaḥ| sa hi loke samartha ityucyate| svārthapratipādanameva śabdānāṃ svakāryam| ye ceha laukikā vaidikāśca śabdā adhikṛtāste sarve eva svakāryapratipādanaṃ prati samarthāḥ| tasmāt `samarthaḥ` ita viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādviśeṣaḥ kaścidāśrīyate| sa ca viśeṣaḥ - vṛttyarthaṃ yadvākyamupādīyate, pratyāsattestadarthapratipādane yā śaktatā tallakṣamo vijñāyata ityāha - `vigrahavākyarthābhidhāne` ityādi| viśeṣeṇa gṛhrate vijñāyate'neneti vigrahaḥ, vigrahaśca tadvākyam| atha vā - viśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ vigrahaḥ, vigrahārthaṃ yadvākyaṃ tadvigrahavākyam| śākapārthivāditvānmadhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ| vigrahavākyasyārtho vigrahavākyārthaḥ, tadabhidhāne tatpratyāyane yaḥ śaktaḥ sa samartho veditavyaḥ, yathā - rājapuruṣa ityayaṃ samasāḥ, etadarthaṃ yadvākyaṃ rājñaḥ puruṣa iti tasya yo'rthastadabhidhāne rājapuruṣa ityayaṃ śabdaṃ śaktaḥ; tato'pi tadarthasya pratīteḥ| sa punararthaḥ - saṃsargaḥ, bhedaśca;bhedasaṃsargau vā|tatra svaviśeṣasya svāmiviśesya svāmiviśeṣeṇa yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa `saṃsargaḥ` ākhyāyate| svāntarasya svāmyantarebhyaḥ, svāmyatarasya svātantarebhyaśca vyāvṛttiḥ `bhedaḥ` ākhyāyate|tatra saṃsargavādino mate saṃsarga eva śabdārthaḥ, vyāvṛttistvarthasaṃgṛhītā| na hravyāvarttyasaṃgṛhītā| na hravyāvarttyamānayoḥ svasvāminoḥ sambandhyantarebhyaḥ saṃsarga upapadyate| bhedavādinastu vyāvṛttirava śabdārthaḥ, saṃsargo'rthasaṅgṛhītaḥ; na hi vyāvarttyamānasya sambandhyantareṇāsambaddhasya svāmyāderavasthānamasti| ubhayavādinastu ubhaya eva śabdārthaḥ| yadi vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne yaḥ śaktaḥ sa samartho vijñāyeta, evaṃ sati samāsataddhitaviṣayameva sāmarthyāmiti parāṅgavadbhāvavibhaktividhānayoriyaṃ paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭheta; na hi tatra vigrahavākyārthābhidhānamasti? yadi nopatiṣṭheta, na nāma; na ca tadanupasthāne kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyeta| tathā hi - parāṅgavadbhāve tāvannimittagrahaṇaṃ deśayiṣyati bhāṣyakāraḥ| tatra ca nimittasya nimittinā sāmarthyamastyeva - madrāṇāṃ rājan, paraśunā vṛścanniti| vibhaktividhāne'pi yāstāvat kārakavibhaktayastā yeṣveva kārakeṣu karmādiṣu vidhīyante teṣāṃ kriyayā sambandho'styeva| upapadavibhaktiṣvapi <<sahayukte'pradhāne>> [[2.3.19]] ityevamādiṣu yuktagrahaṇādīni santi, tatrāpi sāmarthyamastyeva| tatraivaṃ sambandhe sati vibhaktaya iṣyante, na tu va#igrahavākyārthābhidhānalakṣaṇasāmarthye| evaṃ tāvanmukhyārthavṛttiḥ samarthaśabdo darśitaḥ|idānīmupacaritavṛtiṃta darśayitumāha - `atha vā` ityādi| samarthāni padānyāśrayo yasya sa samarthapadāśrāyaḥ; tadbhāvaḥ samarthapadāśrayatvam| tato hetoḥ samāsādiḥ samartha ucyate| āśrayasya samarthatvādupacāreṇāśrito'pi tatheti vyapadiśyate; kāraṇadharmasya kārya upacārāt, yathā - naḍvalodakaṃ pādarogaḥ| `samarthānām` ityanena vākye vyapadeśalakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyamāha| tathā hi `rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ` ityatra vākye rājā puruṣamapekṣate - mamāyamiti, puruṣo'pi rājānamapekṣate - ahamasyeti| `saṃsṛṣṭārthānām` ityanena samāse padānāmekārthībhāvanalakṣamaṃ sāmarthyaṃ darśayati| ekārthībhāvaśca pṛthagavasthitānāṃ bhinnārthānāṃ padānāṃ samāse sādhāraṇārthatā nāmāvasthāviśeṣaḥ| vākye hi sādhāraṇārthatā nāsti; bhinnārthatvāt| ata eva tatra bhedanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhyupajāyate - rājñaḥ puruṣa iti| vṛttau tūbhayapadavyavacchinārthābhidhānat sādhāraṇārthatā bhavati| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati - samāse hi viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyamanupraviśatyekārthī bhavati viśeṣyeṇa saraha, vākye hi viśeṣamaṃ viśeṣyāt pṛthagavatiṣṭhata iti| yasminnasati, vākye rājño gauścāāśca puruṣaśceti bhedanibandhanasamuccayapratipādanāya caśapabda prayujyate| samāse tu yasmin sati sa nivartate rājño gavāāpuruṣā ityayamekārthībhāvo veditavyaḥ| `paśya devadatta kaṣṭam, śrito viṣṇumitro gurukulam` iti| atra kaṣṭaśabdasya paśyetyanena sambandhaḥ; na tu śritaśabdana; tena sāmarthyābhāvātsamāso na bhavati| nanu ca śritādīnāṃ śrutatvāttaireva dvitīyāṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ - śritādīnāṃ sambandhinī yā dvitīyeti śakyate vyapadeṣṭam | asati tu tasmin, dvitīyāmātraṃ śritādibhiḥ samasyata iti vijñāyate| evaṃ sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ syādeva - mahat kaṣṭaṃ śrita iti, bhavati hyatra śritādinimittā dvitīyā| tasmāt samarthagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `kiṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi saṅkulayā, khaṇḍo devadatta upalena` iti| atropalena tṛtīyāntena kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanam| atastatkṛtatvamastīti prāpnoti samāsaḥ; samarthagrahamānna bhavati| samarthagrahaṇe tu satyayamartho bhavati - yasyaiva tṛtīyāntasya samāsastenaiva yadi kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanamiti| na ceha tatkṛtaṃ khaṇḍanamato na bhavati samāsaḥ| evamanyatrāpyasāmarthyādasamāso veditavyaḥ|`parasyāṅgavat` iti| atrāṅgavaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| parsayāṅgavat paraikadeśavadbhavati| tadgrahaṇena gṛhrata ityarthaḥ| evaṃ tādātmyātideśo'yaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `tādātmyātideśo'yam` iti| tādātmyam = tatsabhāvatvam| `subantam` ityādinā tameva tādātmyātideśaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| `subantamāmantritamanupraviśati` iti| tatrāntarbhavatītyarthaḥ| `kuṇḍenāṭan` iti| atra kuṇḍaśabdokāra āmantritasvaraḥ| evamanyatrāpi sasupkasyāmantritasya svaro veditavyaḥ|`pīḍae pīḍamāna` iti| he pīḍamāna tvadīyayā pīḍayā'haṃ pīḍae, bādhye'hamityarthaḥ| `pīḍa avagāhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1544), curādiṇic, ubhayatra karmaṇyātmanepadam, ekatrottamapuruṣaikavacanamiṭ, anyatra śānac, sārvadhātuke yak, ṇilopaḥ, <> [[6.1.186]] itīṭo'nudāttatvam, yakaḥ pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam, yakaḥ pratyayasarveṇādyudāttatvam, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ` (ra8.2.5) ityekāra udāttaḥ| pīḍamānetyasya tu `pīḍa` ityasyāt padāduttarasya <<āmantritasya ca>> [[8.1.19]] iti nighātaḥ| `gehe gārgyaḥ` iti| gehaśabda uñchādipāṭhādantodāttaḥ, saptamyekādeśaḥ pūrvavadudāttaḥ, gāgrya iti ñtsareṇādyudāttaḥ| pṛthaksvara evātra bhavati| `devadatta kuṇḍenāṭan` iti| yadi paragrahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadā devadattaśabdaṃ pūrvamapyāmantritaṃ prati subantasyānupraveśaḥ syāt, tataśca devadattaśabdāt padātparasyāṭannityetasya <<āmantritasya ca>> [[8.1.19]] iti nighātaḥ syāt| nanu ca paragrahaṇe kriyamāṇe kuṇḍaśabdasya parāṅgavadbhāve satyādyudāttatve ṣāṣṭhike kṛte devadattaśabdāt padātparasyāṭannityetasya nighātena bhavitavyameva? naitadasti; apādādau hi sa nighātaḥ, pādāditvañceha vivakṣitam; tatra ca devadattetyāmantritasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| evaṃ kuṇeḍanāṭannityapi| āmantritanighāto'tra na bhavati; pādāditvāt| `yathā mṛtpiṇḍībhūtaḥ svaraṃ labheta` iti| kathaṃ nāma subantasamudāyo mṛtpiṇḍa ivaikībhūta ekarūpatāmivāpannaḥ svaraṃ labhetatetyavamarthamaṅgagrahaṇam| kimarthaṃ punarekībhūtasya svaraprāptaye yatnaḥ kriyata ityata āha - `ubhayoḥ` ityādi| yadyaṅgagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tataśca kāryātideśa- śāstarātideśa-vyapadeśātideśānāmanyatamaḥ syāt| tathā ca sati yathā parasya kāryamādyudāttatvamāmantritavyadeśa ādyudāttaśāstraṃ ca; tathā subantasya pūrvasyāpi syāditi,tataścobhayorapyādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| aṅgagrahaṇe tu sati tādātmyātideśo'yaṃ bhavati| tena mṛtpiṇḍībhūtaḥ subantasamudāya āmantritādyudāttarūpaṃ svaraṃ labhata iti na bhavatyubhayorādyudāttatvaprasaṅgaḥ| `svāśrayamapi kāryaṃ yathā syāt` (iti)| `āma kuṇḍenāṭan` ityatra aṭannityetasya padātparasya `āmantritasya` (8||19) iti nighāte prāpte `na luṭ` [[8.1.29]] ityato netyanuvartamāne `āma ekāntaratāyā abhāvāt| parameva hi syāt subantamasata#ivatkaraṇe, na ca tathābhūtenaikāntaratā yuktā| vatkaraṇe tu sati, bhavati kadācit svāśrayamapyanaṅgatvamityupapadyata ekāntaratā, tena nighātapratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati| tatrāyaṃ svaravibhāgaḥ - āmityasya nipātasvareṇādyudāttatvam| kuṇḍaśabdasyāpi parāṅgavadbhāve satyāmantritasvareṇādyudāttatvam| tathā nighātapratiṣedhe satyaṭannityetasyāpi ṣāṣṭhikenādyudāttena bhavitavyam| `kūpe siñcan` iti| atra parāṅgavadbhāvo nāstīti padāditvaṃ sakārasya bhavati| tena <> [[8.3.111]] iti ṣatvapratiṣedhaḥ syāt| `carma naman` iti| atrāpi parāṅgavadbhāvābhāvāt samānapadasthau nimittanimittinau na bhavata iti samānapadāśrayaṃ ṇatvaṃ na bhavati|`subantasya parāṅgavadbhāve samānādhikaraṇasya` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ samānādhikaraṇasya na prāpnoti, yata idamupasaṃkhyānaṃ kriyata ityāha - `anantaratvāt` iti| <> [[1.1.66]] ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāt vyavahite na prāpnotittayupasaṃkhyāyate| `tīkṣṇayā sūcyā sīvyan` ityatra sīvyannityetasmin paratastīkṣṇayetyasya vyavahitasyāpi parāṅgavādādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `uccairadhīyāna` iti| uccaiḥ śabdasya parāṅgavadbhāvābhāvādāmantritanibandhanamādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati| tasminnasati tatrāntodāttatvameva bhavati; svarādiṣvanantodāttasya pāṭhāt| tathā hi tatraiva sannatara - uccais- nīcairityevamādīni pṛthakparyantānyupadiśya `ete sannataraprabhṛtayo'ntodāttāḥ paṭhante` [[1.1.36]] ityuktam| adhīyānetyasya yadā pādāditvaṃ vivakṣyatetadā''dyudāttatvam, anyatra <<āmantritasya ca>> [[8.1.19]] iti nighātaḥ||`yathāvṛddham` iti| atra samāsasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām <> [[1.2.46]] ityevamādi kāryaṃ bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ prāgvacanam? yāvatā pañcamīnirdeṃśādeva prāgityasyādhyāhāro bhaviṣyati; na ca parāgityayamapi dikchabdo'sti, atastasyāpyadhyāhāraḥ syādityaśaṅkanīyam, tadadhyāhāre kaḍārasaṃśabdanāt pare ye'nukraṃsyante teṣāṃ samāsasaṃjñā syāt; tathā ca kaḍārasaṃśabdanādanantarameva samāsādhikāraṃ kuryāt, iha tu kṛtaḥ, tasmādiha karaṇasāmarthyāt samāsādhikārasya prāgityasyādhyāhāro bhaviṣyati, tato nārthaḥ prāgvacanenetyāha - ` prāgvacanam` ityādi| uttaratrāvyayībhāvādisaṃjñābhiḥ saha samāsasaṃjñāyāḥ samāveśo yathā syādityevamartha prāgvacamanam| asati tu tasmin, tābhiranavakāśābhiriyaṃ saṃjñāla bādhyeta| asyāstu samāsasaṃjñāyāḥ <> [[2.1.4]] ityatra saheti yogavibhāgena yaḥ samāsaḥ krite so'vakāśaḥ syāt - anuprāvarṣat, anuvyacaladiti, tiṅantenātra samāsaḥ; asatyapi sāvakāśatva ekasaṃjñādhikāre vacanapramāṇyāt paryāyeṇa vṛttiḥ syāt, na tu samāveśaḥ| sākṣāt sūtreṇopātte tu prāgvacane sati bhavati samāveśaḥ, katham? evaṃ hi sambandhaḥ kriyate - kaḍārāt prāgyāvanto vyavasthitaḥ sarve te samāsasaṃjñakā bhavanti, samāsasaṃjñakāḥ santo'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñāṃ labhanta ita| tena nimittameva samāsasaṃjñā'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñānām| naca nimittinā nimittaṃ vihanyate; anyathā tasya nimittatvameva na syāditi yuktaḥ sūtropāttena prāgvacanena samāveśaḥ| adhyāhmate tu tasmin `kaḍārasaṃśabdanātprāgyāvanto vyavasthitāḥ sarve te samāsasaṃjñakā bhavanti` ityeṣo'rtho labhyate, na tu `samāsasaṃjñakāḥ santo'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñakāḥ` ityeṣo'pi| sākṣāt sūtropātte tu tasminneṣo'pi labhyate; anyathā tasya sūtre sākṣādupādānamanarthakaṃ syāt||`yathāvṛddham` ityatrāvyayībhāvatve sati <> [[2.4.18]] iti napuṃsakatve <<nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ>> [[2.4.83]] ityeṣa vidhirbhavati| `anvarthasaṃjñā ceyam` iti| anavyayamavyayaṃ bhavatītyavyayībhāvaḥ| `pūrvapadārthaprādhānyam` ityādinā anvarthasaṃjñāyāḥ phalamāha| prāyeṇa hravyayībhāve pūrvapadamavyayam, parapadamanyavyayam; samudāyo nāvyayam| sa yadi pūrvapadavaśena tasya pūrvapadasya yo dharmo'vyayatvaṃ tatpratipadyate tato|ñanavyayasvabhāvaḥ sannavyayasvabhāvo bhavati| evañca pūrvapadavaśena taddharmaṃ pratipadyate yadi pūrvapadaṃ pradhānaṃ bhavati, nānyathā| pradhānavaśena hi vastunaḥ svadharmaparityāgena dharmāntarāpattiryuktā| tadevamanvarthasaṃjñeyaṃ bhavantī pūrvapadārthaprādhānyamavyayībhāvasya darśayati| tena yadā pūrvapadārthasya prādhānyaṃ bhavati tadāvyayībhāvo bhavati, nānyathetyuktaṃ bhavati||`ye ya vṛddhāḥ` ityanena `yathāvṛddham` ityatra yathāśabdo vīpsāyāṃ vartata ityācaṣṭe| `yathā devadattastathā yajñadattaḥ` iti| devadattasadṛśo yajñadatta ityarthaḥ| nanu ca yathāśabdo'yamupamānaṃ `yajñadatta` ityupameyamapekṣate| tatra `sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavati` ityasāmarthyādeva samāso na bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthamasādṛśya iti pratiṣedhena? naitadasti; na hyatra yathāśabda upamānam, kiṃ tarhi? `yathā devadattaḥ` ityeṣa samudāyaḥ| tasmāt tasyaivopameyāpekṣayā'sāmarthyam, na tu yathāśabdasya||`iyattāparicchedaḥ`iti| iyato bhāva iyattā = parimāṇam, tasyāḥ paricchedo niścayaḥ| `yāvanti pātrāṇi` ityādinā tameveyattāparicchedaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| `nāvadhārayāmi` ityādinā iyattāparicchedābhāvaṃ darśayati||`vṛkṣaṃ prati` ityatra lakṣaṇe pratiśabdo vartate, na mātrārthe| nanu paraṃ subgrahaṇaṃ kamarthaṃm? yāvatā `subāmantrite` [[2.1.2]] ityataḥ subgrahaṇamatuvartiṣyata ityata āha - `subgrahaṇam` ityādi| subgrahaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ hravyayena sambaddham; atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmādavyayanivṛttyarthamidamanyata subgrahaṇaṃ kriyate||`kitavyavahāre` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ kitavavyavahāra iṣyamāṇe'pi tatra labhyate? svabhāvata eva; samāsasya tatra vṛtteḥ|na hrarthā atidiśyante, laukikatvāt teṣām| `tasya` ityādi| tasya pātayitustasya ca vipāta ityanena sambandhaḥ| vipātaḥ = parājayaḥ| `etasya` iti| akṣādereva pratyavamarśaḥ| abhedavivakṣāyāmekavacanam| etasyānayathā pāta ityanena sambandhaḥ| `anyathā` iti| jaye ya uktaḥ pātaprakārastadapekṣayā'nyathātvaṃ vivakṣitam| `pañcasu tvekarūpāsu jaya eva bhavati` iti| pañcaparīti samaso na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| jaye hi yadakṣādīnāṃ vṛttaṃ tadapekṣayānyapātatve sati samāsena bhavitavyam| na ca pañcasvekarūpāsvanyathātvaṃ sambhavati| ata eva jayastadā bhavati yadā pañcāpyekarūpā bhavanti - uttānā avāñco vā| etena prakāreṇa `pareṇa catuṣpari` ityatropapattirdarśitā| `pareṇa` iti| atiśayenetyarthaḥ|`akṣādayastṛtīyāntāḥ` ityādi| anyathā vṛttāvayaṃ samāsa iṣyate| tatra cākṣādināmanyathāvṛttau karttṛtvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ vā bhavati, atastṛtīyayā bhavitavyamiti tadantā eva samasyante| `pūrvoktasya` iti| akṣāderityarthaḥ| kuta etat? akṣādayastṛtīyāntā iti pūrvamakṣāderevoktatvāt| abhedavivakṣāyāmekavacanam| ṣaṣṭhī ceyaṃ śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ vṛttaśabdāpekṣayā sambandhalakṣaṇā, vṛttaśabdastvadhyāhartavyaḥ| `yathā na tat` iti| akṣādeḥ pūrvoktasya yathā vṛttamabhūt pūrvaṃ jaye tathā vṛttaṃ yadi samprati na bhavatyevaṃ samāso bhavati , nānyathā| pūrvavṛttasyānyathātvadyotane pariṇeti kim?? subantamātreṇa saha samāso mā bhūt| kitavavyavahāra iti kim? akṣābhyāmakṣairvā na tathā vṛttaṃ yatā pūrvaṃ jaye||atha maryādābhividhigrahaṇaṃ kimartham? yāvatā pañcamītyanuvartate, āṅā ca karmapravacanīyenaiva yoge pañcamī vidhīyate - etayorevārthayoḥ <<āṅ maryādāvacane>> [[1.4.89]] ityāṅaḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā4, nānyatra; tatrāntareṇāpi maryādāvidhigrahaṇaṃ tayorevārthayo samāso
