kriyate, na ca guṇavacanaśabdaḥ| guṇamuktavān = guṇavacanaḥ| <> [[3.3.113]] iti kartari lyuṭ| atha vā - karaṇe, guṇa ukto'neneti guṇavacanaḥ| yaśca pūrva guṇe vartitvā paścāt tadvati dravye vartate sa guṇavacanaḥ| guṇenetyucyamāne ghṛtena pāṭavamityādau prasaṅgaḥ, atastannivṛttyarthaṃ vacanagrahaṇam| tasmaśca sati guṇe vartitvā tadvati dravye yo vartate tenaiva samāso bhavati, na tu guṇa eva yo vartate tena saha| na ca pāṭavādayaḥ śabdāḥ pūrvaṃ guṇe vartitvā paścāt tadvati dravye vartante, api tu guṇa eva| vacanagrahaṇāt taiḥ saha samāso na bhavati| `śaṅkulākhaṇḍaḥ, girikāṇaḥ` iti| khaṇḍakāṇaśabdāvatra khaṇḍanena nimīlane ca kriyārūpāpanne guṇe vartitvā paścānmatublopādabhedopacārādvā tadvati dravye vartate iti guṇavacanau bhavataḥ| `dhānyārthaḥ` iti| bhavutyayamarthaśabdastatkṛtaḥ, tathā hi sa gobhirvapāvān kṛtaḥ| na tu vapāvānityayaṃ śabdo guṇamuktavāmiti na guṇavacanaḥ, tatastena saha samāso na bhavati||yuktaḥ samasadṛśaśabdābhyāṃ samāsaḥ, yāvātā tābhyāṃ yoge `tulyārtheratulopamābhyām` [[2.3.72]] iti tṛtīyāvidhānam, itaraistu pūrvādibhiḥ kathaṃ tṛtīyāsamāsa upapadyate? na hi tadyoge kenacittṛtīyā vihitā ityāha `asmādeva` ityādi| subodham|`pūrvādiṣvavarasyopasaṃkhyānam` iti| pūrvādiṣu samāsakāraṇatvenopātteṣu satsvavaraśabdasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| avaraśabdenāpi tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ pratipadyata ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - uttarasūtre bahulagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tenāvaraśabdenāpi samāso bhavati||`bhikṣābhiruṣitaḥṭa iti| hetau [[2.3.23]] tṛtīyā vihitā| vaservacyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.15]] samprasāraṇam, `śāsivasighasīnāñca` [[8.3.60]] iti ṣatvam, `vasatikṣudhoḥ` (7|2|ka52) itīṭ| `dātreṇa dhānyaṃ lūnavān` iti| `lvādibhyaśca` [[8.2.44]] iti niṣṭhānatavam| `pādahārakaḥ` iti| pādābhyāṃ hyiyata iti pādāhārakaḥ| pādābhyāmiti pañcamī caturthī vā| hāraka iti <> [[3.3.113]] iti karmaṇi ṇvul| `galecopakaḥ` iti| gale cupyata iti| `cupa mandāyāṃ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 403) ityasmāt pūrvavadeva ṇvul| <> [[6.3.14]] ityulak||`stutinindāprayuktam` iti| stutyā nindayā vā yat prayuktaṃ pravarttitaṃ tat stutinindāprayuktam| tadarthamuccāritamityarthaḥ| `adhyāropitārthavacanam` iti| adhyāropito'rtho'sanneva buddhyā samāropitastasya vacanamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `kṛrttṛkaraṇayoḥṭa iti| arthe kāryāsambhavāt tadabhidhāyini subante kāryaṃ vijñāyate| `kākapeyā` iti| `pā pāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-925) iti `aco yat` [[3.1.97]] `īdyati` [[6.4.65]] īttvam| atra sampūrṇatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nadyāḥ stutiḥ, adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ kākapeyatvam - evaṃ nāma sampūrṇatoyā nadī yattaṭasthairapi kākaiḥ śakyā pātum| `ālehraḥ kūpaḥ` iti| `ṛhaloṇryat` [[3.1.124]] atrāpyāsannodakatvodbhāvanaṃ kūpasya stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ ālehratvam - evaṃ nāmāsannodakaḥ kūpo yataḥ śnabhirapi lihrate| `bāṣpacchedyāni tṛṇāni` iti| atra māradvātiśayodbhāvanaṃ tṛṇānāṃ stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārtho bāṣpacchedyatā - evaṃ nāma mṛdūni tṛṇāni yadbāṣpeṇāpi śakyāni chettum| `kaṇṭakasañceya odanaḥ` iti| atrāpi vaiṣadyātiśayodbhāvanaṃ viklinnatodbhāvanañcaudanasya stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ kaṇṭakasañceyatvam - evaṃ nāmaudanasya viśadatātiśayo vikledaśca yatkaṇṭakenāpi śakyaḥ sañcetum| evaṃ tāvat stutiprayukte'dhikāryavacana udāharaṇāni|nindāprayukte'dhikārthavacana etāvantyeva draṣṭavyāni| tathā hi - kākeyā nadītyatrālpatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nadyā nindā| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthastadeva pūrvoktaṃ kākapeyatvam, evaṃ ālehrādāvapi pūrvokta evādhyāropito'rtho draṣṭavyaḥ - evaṃ nāmālpatoyā nadī yatkākairapi śakyaṃ pātumiti| ālehraḥ kūpa ityatrāpyaśuddhatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nindā- evaṃ nāmālpa odano yatkaṇṭakairapi cīyata iti| nanu ca bahulavacanādadhikārtho'pi pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ samāsaḥ, tatkimarthamidamityāha - `pūrvasya` ityādi| te vai vidhayaḥ susaṃgṛhītā yeṣāṃ prapañcaśceti| susaṃgṛhītaṃ yathā syāditi pūrvasyāyaṃ prapañca kriyate||`dadhyodanaḥ` iti| nanu ca kriyākṛtaḥ kārakāṇāṃ sambandha-, na tu svataḥ| na ca vṛttāviha kācana kriyā śrūyata iti sāmarthyābhāvaḥ| asati ca sāmarthye samāsābhāvaḥ| athāsatyapi sāmarthye vacanasāmarthyāt samāso bhavatīti cedāsyatāṃ dadhnā, odano bhujyatāṃ devadattenetyatrāpi syādityata āha - `vṛttau` ityādi| na hrasatyāmupasecanakriyāyāṃ saṃskāryaṃ saṃskārakaṃ sambhavati| asti ceha tadubhayamityatastadbhāvādeva samāsāntarbhūtā kriyā gamyate| taddvārakaścānnavyañjanayoḥ sambandha iti vidyata eva sāmarthyam||`tadarthena` ityādi| yadi tādathryamātre samāsaḥ syāt, balirakṣitagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tathā hi - kuberabaliḥ,gorakṣitamityatrāpi tādathryaṃ gamyatata eva| tasamādbalirakṣitagrahaṇālliṅgāt `tādarthye prakṛtivikārabhāve samāso bhavati` iti vijñāyate| nanu ca sampradāne catuthryarthaṃ balirakṣitagrahaṇaṃ syāt, naitadasti; dadātikarmaṇā hi abhipreyamāṇasya kriyayā vā sampradānasaṃjñeṣyate, na ceha dadātikarmaṇā kriyayā vā'bhipreyamāṇatā'sti, tatkutaḥ sampradāne caturthī? kena punastādarthye caturthī bhavatītyāha - `asmādeva` ityādi| yadi tādarthye caturthī na syāt, tadā tadarthagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādyadetat, tadarthena catuthryantasya samāsavidhānaṃ tadeva jñāpakam - tādarthye caturthī bhavatīti|`arthena` ityādi| kartavyamiti śeṣaḥ| nityasamāsa ucyate = kathyate, yena tannityasamāsavacanaṃ vyākhyātavyam| etaduktaṃ bhavati - yenārthaśabdena nityasamāsaḥ pratyāyyate tadvayākhyānaṃ kartavyamiti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenārthaśabdena nityasamāso bhaviṣyati, sarvaliṅgatā ceti| `paravallaliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ` [[2.4.26]] iti paravalliṅgatāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ sarvaliṅgatā vidhīyate| eṣā tu lokāśrayatvālliṅgasyeti siddhā| atha vā - bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ sarvametat siddham| gohitam, gosukhamiti `caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣya` [[2.3.73]] ityādinā caturthī| hitayoge tvanāśiṣyapi caturthī bhavati| tathā hi vakṣyati - `hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā` (vā| 123) iti|`bhayabhītabhītibhībhiriti vaktavyam` iti| evaṃ hi tribhirapi bhītādibhiḥ samāso bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| svayameva vyākhyātumāha - `pūrvasya` ityādi| yathaiva hi <> [[2.1.32]] iti tṛtīyāntasya samāso vidhīyamāno bahulagrahaṇasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārthatvādanyavibhaktyantasyāpi samāso bhavati - pādahārakaḥ, galecopaka iti, tathā vṛkabhīta ityādāvapi samāso bhaviṣyati| tasmāt pūrvakasya bahulagrahaṇassayaivodāharaṇapradarśanārtho'yaṃ yogaḥ prapañcārtho veditavyaḥ| `tathā ca` ityādi| yasmāt pūrvakeṇaiva bahulagrahaṇena siddhaṃ tasyaivāyamprapañcaḥ; tasmāttata eva bahulagrahaṇāt `grāmanirgataḥ` ityādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdena vṛkabhītādegrrahaṇam||`alpaśaḥ` iti| <> [[5.4.42]] iti śas| `alpā pañcamī samasyate` iti|| alpebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ utpannā yā pañcamī sā samasyate, na tu sarvebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ ityarthaḥ||`stokānmuktaḥ; kṛcchrānmuktaḥ` iti| `karaṇe stokālpakṛcchra` [[2.3.33]] ityādinā pañcamī| `antikādāgataḥ, dūrādāgataḥ` iti| dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca` [[2.3.35]] ityanena||śauṇḍairiti bahuvacananirdeśādādyartho gamyata ityāha - `śauṇḍādibhiḥ` ita| kena punarvihitāyāṃ saptamyāṃ tadantasya śauṇḍādibhiḥ samāso vidhīyate? <> [[2.3.36]] ityaneneti cet, vārtametat| tathā hradhikaraṇaṃ kārakam, tacca kriyāpekṣam| na cākṣaśauṇḍa ityādau vṛttau kācana kriyā śrūyate| tatkuto'dhikaraṇasyeha sambhavaḥ? na ca śakyate vaktum - asmādeva vacanācchauṇḍādibhiryoge saptamī bhaviṣyatīti, devadattaḥ śauṇḍa ityatrāpi prasaṅghaḥ syādityata āha - `vṛttau` ityādi| astyevātra prasaktikriyā| sā tu samāsārtha evāntarbhūtetigamyamānatvāddvṛtau kriyāpadaṃ na prayujyate| tasyā yatsādhanamadhikaraṇaṃ tatra saptamītyadoṣaḥ| antaḥ śabdastvatrādhikaraṇapradhāna eva paṭhate| tasya prayoge tatsāmānādhikaraṇyameva saptamyāḥ kāraṇam| vane'ntarvanāntarvasatīti pūrvapadārthapradhānye tu `vibhaktyarthe yadavyayam` [[2.1.6]] ityavyayībhāva eva bhavatiḥ- antarvaṇamiti| adhiśabdo'tra paṭhate - tasyādhikaraṇaprādhānye satyavyayībhāvaḥ- adhistri| ādheyaprādhānye tu tatpuruṣaḥ - brāāhṛṇeṣvapi brāāhṛṇādhīna iti| brāāhṛṇādhiśabdaḥ kevalo na prayujyate| `aṣaḍakṣāśita` [[5.4.7]] ityādinā'dhyuttarapadāt svārthikasya nityasya khasya vidhānāt||`dhvāṅakṣeṇetyarthagrahaṇam` iti| arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| yatra hi śabdapradhāno nirdeśastatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavati, anyatra tvarthagrahaṇameveti pratipāditametat prāk| arthapradhānatvantu nirdeśasyāvicchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśādvijñāyate| bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterarthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā| api ca `kṣepe` ityucyate, kṣepaścārthakārita evetyarthagrahaṇameva yuktam| arthagrahaṇe ca sati dhvāṅakṣaparyāyairapi samāso bhavati, ata āha - `dhvāṅakṣavācinā` ityādi| `tīrthe dhvāṅakṣa iva` iti| upamānabhāve sati dhvāṅakṣasya kṣepo gamyate,nānyatheti darśayitumivaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| samāse tu samāsa evopamānārthasyāntarbhūtatvādivaśabdo gatārtho na prayujyate| yathaiva hi tīrtha dhvāṅakṣaściraṃ sthātāro na bhavanti, tadvadanyo'pi yaḥ kāryaṃ pratyanavasthitaḥ sa `tīrthadhvāṅakṣaḥ` ityucyate, yadāha - `anavasthita ityarthaḥ` iti| kāryaṃ pratyanavasthitatvameva kṣepaḥ||`yapratyayāntenaiva samāsa iṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punaryatpratyayenaiva labhyate? alpaśa ityanuvṛtteḥ, `māsadeyam` iti| pūrvavadyat, īttvañca| saptamī hyatraupaśleṣike'dhikaraṇe veditavyā| māse hratīte yo'ntaro divasaḥ sa māsaṃ pratyupaśliṣṭo bhavati, `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣamam` [[2.3.37]] ityanena vā| māsātikramaṇabhāvena hi ṛṇadānabhāvo lakṣyate| atha ṛṇa ityucyate, tatredaṃ na sidhyati - pūrvohṇegeyaṃ sāma, prātaradhyeyo'nuvākaḥ, ityata āha - `ṛṇam` ityādi| ṛṇaṃ hi niyogato niryātayitavyamiti niyogasahacaritam| ataḥ sāhacaryāt tena niyogo'vaśyambhāva upalakṣyate| etacca `kṛtyaiḥ` iti bahuvacananrideśālliṅgādgamyate| katham? `kṛtyaiḥ` iti bahuvacanamatra vivakṣitam, tacca ṛṇagrahaṇasya niyogopalakṣaṇārthatve prakṛtibhedena| bhidyamāne kṛtye sati prasajyate, na tvanyathā| yatpratyayasyaikatvāt tenaiva samāsasyeṣṭatvāt||`samudāyopādhiḥ` iti| `saṃjñāyām` iti nedaṃ pūrvapadasyottarapadasya vā viśeṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? samudāyasya - samudāyena cetsaṃjñā gamyata iti| kimevaṃ sati sidhyatītyata āha - `tena` ityādi| atraivopapattimāha - `na hi` ityādi||`etattu te divāvṛttaṃ rātrau vṛttañca drakṣyasi` ityādi| nātrāharavayavāḥ rātryavayavāśca santi, kiṃ tarhi? kṛtsnamevāhaḥ, kṛtsnā ca rātririti, teneha samāso na bhavati||`tatretyetat saptamyantam` iti| saptamīsādhamryāt| tralpratyaya evātra saptamīśabdenoktaḥ| bhavati hi tāddhamryāt tācchabdyam| yathā - gaurvāhīka iti| saptamīsādhamryaṃ punastralo'dhikaraṇārthatvāt| yathaiva hradhikaraṇapratyāyanāya saptamī prayujyate,tathā tralapi| atha mukhyaiva saptamīvibhaktiḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? tasyāstatraśabde'sambhavāt| asambhavastu tralaiva tadarthasya dyotittavāt| anyastvāha - yadā vibhaktyādaśāstralādayastadā sthānivadbhāvenaivaitat saptamyantaṃ bhavati| ādeśapakṣasatu tatra vṛttikṛtā nāśrita ityasamyagetat| antaśabdaścātrāvayavavacanaḥ| saptamītralpratyayo'nto'vayavo yasya tattathoktam||`avataptenakulasthitam` iti| <> [[6.3.14]] iti saptamyā aluk| kaḥ punaratra kṣepaḥ? kāryeṣvanavasthitatā| yadāha - `etaccāpalam` ityādi| yathā avatapte deśe nakulā na ciraṃ sthātāro bhavanti, tadvadanyo'pi yo'rthānārabhya na ciraṃ teṣvavatiṣṭhate taṃ pratīdamucyate - avataptenakulasthitamiti| `udakaṃ viśīrṇam` ityādāvapyārambhasya niṣphalatā kṣepaḥ| ata evāha - `niṣphalaṃ yatkriyate tadevamucyate` iti| `pravāhe mūtritam` iti| `mūtra praruāvaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1909) curādiḥ||`yuktārohrāviparigrahārthaḥ` iti| yuktārohrādiṣu yuktārohrādibhirvā parigarho'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya pāṭhasya sa tathokkataḥ| kimarthaṃ punaryuktārohrādiṣu parigrahasteṣāmiṣyata ityāha - `pūrvapadādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt` iti yuktārohrādīnāṃ hi `yuktārohrādayaśca` [[6.2.81]] ityanena pūravapadādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| tatra yadi ye ktāntāste na paṭhaeran, tadā teṣāmādyudāttatvaṃ na syāt| kathaṃ punaḥ pātresamitādayo yuktārohrādigrahaṇena gṛhyante; yatasteṣāṃ vidhīyamānamādyudāttatvaṃ pātresamitādīnamapi bhavatītyāha - `yuktārohrādiṣu hi` ityādi| `udumbaramaśakādiṣūpamayā kṣepaḥ` iti| yastatraivāvaruddho na kvacidgacchati tamava viśiṣṭacaṃ manyate - nāsmātparamastīti, so'dṛṣṭavistāra ucyata udumbaramaśaka iti| evamanyatrāpyapamānāt kṣepaḥ| `pratiṣiddhasevanena` iti| yaḥ kaścit pratiṣiddhamācarati sa `mātaripuruṣaḥ` ityucyate| `nirīhatayā` iti| yo na kiñcit kartuṃ samarthaḥ sa `piṇḍīśūraḥ` ityevamādibhiḥ padairabhidhīyate| `cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ` iti| pātresamitādaya eva yatā syuḥ, yadanyat samāsāntaraṃ teṣāṃ prāpnoti tanmā bhūditi| tena paramapātresamitā ita#i `sanmahat` [[2.1.60]] ityādinā samāsāntaraṃ na bhavati||`bhinnapravṛttinimittaprayuktasya` ityādi| bhinnapravṛttinimittagrahaṇaṃ paryāyanivṛttyartham| ekagrahaṇaṃ gauraā ityādinivṛttyartham| `pūrvakāla ityarthanirdeśaḥ` iti| arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| tena svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `pariśiṣṭānāṃ svarūpagrahaṇam` iti| śabdapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| `pūrvakālo'parakālena` iti| kutaḥ punaranukto'pyeṣo'rthaviśeṣo labhyate; sambandhiśabdatvāt pūrvakālasya? na hranapekṣyāparakālaṃ pūrvakālaṃ sambhavati; ataḥ pūrvakālaparigrahe kṛte satyaparakālasyāpi parigrahaḥ kṛta eva| `snānānuliptaḥ` iti| pūrvaṃ snātaḥ paścādanulipta ityatra snātaśabdaḥ snānena nimittena prayuktaḥ, anuliptaśabdo'nulepanena; tayoścaikatrārthe vṛttirityasti sāmānādhikaraṇyam| `ekaśāṭī` iti| ekā cāsau śāṭī ceti <> [[6.3.42]] ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ||`pūrveṣukāmaśamītyādiḥ` grāmāṇāṃ saṃjñā| pūrvā cāsāviṣukāmaśamī ceti pūrveṣukāmaśamī| mandaśriyāṃ pūrvottarapadavibhāgamātrapradarśanārthaṃ vākyaṃ kṛtam| na hyatra vākyena bhavitavyam| na hi vākyena saṃjñā gamyate||ekasyā api saptamyā viṣayabhedena bhedaṃ darśayitumāha - `taddhitārthe viṣaye` ityādi| yadi taddhitārthe'bhidheya ityevaṃ vijñāyeta, tadā pāñcanāpitirityādau taddhito durlabhaḥ syāt| tadarthasya samāsenaivoktatvādityetanmanasi kṛtvā taddhitārthāpekṣayā viṣayasaptamīyamiti darśayituṃ `taddhitārthe viṣaye` ityuktam| taddhitāḥ = aṇādayaḥ, teṣāmartho'patyādiḥ, tasmin viṣaye| ananyatrabhāvo viṣayaśabdasyārthaḥ, yathā - matsyānāṃ jalaṃ viṣaḥ iti| `paurvaśālaḥ` iti| pūrvasyāṃ śalāyāṃ bhava iti taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte?prāk samāsaḥ| tataḥ subluk| tatastaddhitaḥ| `pūrvaśālāpriyaḥ` iti| pūrvā śālā priyā'syeti pūrvaṃ padānāṃ trayāṇāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| paścāt priyaśabde uttarapade parataḥ parvayoḥ padayostatpuruṣaḥ| tasmin sati samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati śāletyatra| `samāhāre {dikśabdaḥ iti mūlapāṭhaḥ, padamañjarī ca| } diṅa na sambhavati` iti| samāhāro hi samūhaḥ| sa ca bhinnārthānāmevaikakālānāṃ bhavati| buddhyā yugapadārthānāṃ parigrahādekakālatvam, na tvabhinnavastunaḥ| saṃkhāyaiva ca bhedamācaṣṭe; tasyā bhinnārthābhidhāyitvāt, na tu dikśabdaḥ; tasya pratiniyataviṣayatvāt| tasmāt samāhāre da#ikśabdona sambhavatīti sa na tatra samasyate| `pañcānāpitiḥ` iti| pañcānāṃ nāpitānāmapatyamiti taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte prāk samāsaḥ| paścāt `ata iñ` (4|1| 95)| `pañcakapālaḥ` iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛta iti taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte pūrvaṃ samāsaḥ; paścādaṇ| tasya <> [[4.1.88]] iti luk| `{pañcagavadhanam iti mudrita pāṭhaḥ}pañcagavadhanaḥ` iti| pañca gāvo dhanamasyeti prāk trayāṇāṃ padānāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| uttarakālaṃ dhanaśabda uttarapade parataḥ pūrvayoḥ padayostatpuruṣaḥ| tasmin sati <> [[5.4.92]] iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ| tatra hi `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ` [[5.4.86]] ityatastatpuruṣagrahaṇamanuvartate| `pañcapūlī`iti| pañcānāṃ pūlānāṃ samahāra iti vigrahaḥ| `dvigurekavacanam` (2.4.1|) ityekavadbhāvaḥ| `akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate` (vā|156) iti strīliṅgatā; <> [[4.1.21]] iti ṅīp| nanu samāhāraḥ = samūhaḥ, samūhaśca taddhitakārtho bhavatītyapārthakaṃ samāhāragrahaṇam; taddhitārtha ityeva siddhatvāt? naitadasti; pañcakumārītyatra hi samūhapratyayasya <> [[4.1.88]] iti luki kṛte <> [[1.2.49]] iti strīpratyayasyāpi luk syāt| samāhāre tu pṛthaggṛhīte taddhitānutpattirevātra viṣaye samākhyāyate| tato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| pañcānāṃ kumārīṇāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcamakumāri| `ekavibhakticāpūrvanipāte` [[1.2.44]] ityupasarjanasaṃjñāyām <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvatvam| kathaṃ punaratraikavibhaktatvam? ṣaṣṭhaaivaikayā yogāt| tathā hi samāhāraḥ samūhaḥ, tena ca tatsambandhe ṣaṣṭhaaiva bhavitavyam| ataḥ samāhāraḥ kumā4rīṇām, samāhāraṃ kumārīṇāṃ paśya, samāhāreṇa kumārīṇāmityevamādibhiranekābhirvibhaktibhiryujyamāne'pi samāhāraśabde kumārīśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhaaivaikayā yujyata ityekavibhaktikatvam||va`samāsānto bhavati` iti| ṭac| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac` [[5.4.91]] ityuvṛtteḥ||kutsitaśabdo'yamiha rūḍhimācaṣṭe| tathā ca niṣṭhā bhūtakālaṃ nopādatte| kutsanaśabdena ca kutsāhaturdharmo gṛhrate - kutsyate gahrrate'neneti kṛtvā| bahuvacananirdeśastu svarūpavidhernirāsārthaḥ| tena kutsitavādinā kutsanavacanaiḥ saha samāso vijñāyate, na tu kutsitaśabdasya kutsanaśabdena| ata āha - `kutsitavācīni` ityādi| śabdapravṛttinimittakutsāyāmayaṃ samāso veditavyaḥ| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate? pratyāsatteḥ| śabdasya hi pravṛttinimittaṃ pratyāsannam, atastat kutsāyāmeva samāsena bhavituṃ yuktam| `vaiyākaraṇakhasūciḥ` iti| vaiyākaraṇaścāsau khasūciśceti vigrahaḥ| yaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ san vyākaraṇe khamākāśaṃ sūcayatīti nirīkṣate niṣpratibho bhavati sa evamucyate| atra hi vaiyākaraṇatvaṃ vaiyākaraṇaśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ tat kutsyate; tatpunaḥ vyākaraṇādhyetṛsambandhaḥ, vyākaraṇaveditṛsambandho vā|tena hi nimittena vaiyākaraṇaśabdo puruṣe vartate| evamanyatrāpi śabdapravṛttinimittakutsāyāṃ samāso veditavyaḥ| `yājñikakitavaḥ` iti| kitava iva kitavaḥ| yathā hi kitavaḥ kiṃ tavāstīti dhanavattāmātramapekṣamāṇo dyūte pravartate, na tu tasya jātyādikamapekṣate; tathā yājñiko'pi yājane pravartamāno yastṛṣṇayā'yājyasya dhanavatāmātramapekṣate, na tu tasya yāgārhatāṃ sa yājñikakitava ityucyate| ata āha- `ayājyayājanatṛṣṇāpara ucyate` iti| `mīmāṃsakadurdurūḍhaḥ` iti| mīmāṃsako mīmāṃsādhyayanaphalamanavāpya nāstiko jāta iti pratīyate|`vaiyākaraṇaścauraḥ` iti| nanu cauratvena gahrramāṇo vaiyākaraṇaḥ kutsito bhavatyeva| tadabhiṣāyī ca vaiyākaraṇaśabdaḥ| tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupapadyata ityāha - `na hyatra ` ityādi| pratyāsatterhi śabdapravṛttinimittasya kutsāyāṃ sasāsena bhavitavyam| na ceha vaiyākaraṇaśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ kutsyate; yasmāccauro'pi samyak vyākaraṇaṃ vettyadhīte vā| tasmānnātra śabdapravṛttinimittaṃ kutsyate, kiṃ tarhi? yatra tadvaiyākaraṇatvaṃ vartate sa kutsyate, vaiyākaraṇatvantu tasyopalakṣaṇameva kevalam, yo'sau vaiyākaraṇaḥ sa cauraḥ, yathā - yaḥ kampate so'āttha iti| atra kampanamaātthasyopalakṣaṇam| `kutsito bāhṛṇaḥ` iti| bhavatyatra kutsitaśabdaḥ kutsitābhidhāyī| na tu brāāhṛṇaśabdaḥ kutsanavacanaḥ||`pāpāṇakaśabdau kutsanābhidhāyinau` ityuktam| yadyevamatra pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ samāsaḥ, kimarthamidanucyata ityāśaṅkyāha - `tayoḥ` ityādi| yadi pūrveṇa syāt samāsaḥ, tataḥ kutsitaśabdasya prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt pūrvenipātaḥ syāt, pāpāpaṇakaśabdayostu paranipātaḥ| tasmāt pūrvanipātārthamidamārabhyate| kutsitagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| anyathā pūrvayogādeva kutsita ityanuvartiṣyata iti tanna kartavyameva syāt||`upamīyate'nenetyupamānam` iti| sādṛśyena yena paricchidyate tadupamānamityarthaḥ| yathā gauriva gavaya ityatra gaurupamānam,tena hi sādṛśyena gavayaḥ paricchidyate| `yādṛśo gaustādṛśo gavayaḥ` ityarthaḥ pratīyate| sāmānyamanekasādhāraṇaṃ bhavati; iha copamānasya śrutatvāt tasya copameyāpekṣatvādupamānopameyoreva sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ sāmānyaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `upamānopameyayoḥ` ityādi| `tadviśiṣṭopameyavacanairayaṃ samāsaḥ` iti| tena sāmānyena dharmeṇa viśaṣṭaṃ yadupameyaṃ tadvacanairayaṃ samāso bhavati| kṛtaḥ punaḥ sāmānyavacanairityukte satyeṣa viśeṣo labhyate? nyāyāt| tathā hi - sāmānyamuktavantaḥ sāmānyavacanāḥ, yathā- guṇamuktavanto guṇavacanā iti| kadā ca te sāmānyavacanā bhavanti? yadā sāmānyamabhidhāya sāmānyaviśiṣṭe tadvati dravye vartante| tacca sāmānyavadupamānasya sambandhiśabdatvādupameyameva vijñāyata iti nyāyaprāpta evārtho vṛttikṛtā darśitaḥ| `śastrīśyāmā devadattā` iti| atropamānaṃ śastrī, upameyā devadattā| prasiddhaṃ hrupamānaṃ bhavati, nāprasiddham| śastryeva śyāmaguṇatvena prasiddhā, na devadattā| tayoḥ sāmānyaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ śyāmatvam| tat śyāmatvamuktvā śyāmaśabdo da#evadattayāmabhedopacārānmatublodvā vartata iti sāmānyavacano bhavati| nanu ca samānādhikaraṇenetyanuvartate, iha ca śastrīśabdasya śastryāṃ vṛttiḥ, śyāmāśabdasya devadattāyām, ato vaiyadhikaraṇyāt samāsena na bhavitavyam? naitadasti; sarvatra hrupamānopameyayorbhedāt tadvācinorvaiyadhikaraṇyameva, ucyate cedaṃ vacam, ato vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi vacanasāmarthyāt samāso bhaviṣyati|atha vā - śastrīśabdo'pyatra devadattāyāṃ vartate| tena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ evāyaṃ samāsaḥ - śastrau cāsau śyāmā ceti śastrīśyāmā| nanu ca śastrīśabdo'yaṃ jātivacanaḥ śastrītvaṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāya tadvati vartate, na ca tat śastrītvaṃ devadattāyāmasti, tat kathaṃ tatra vartate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `sarva evāmī śabdā guṇamupādāya tadvati dravye vartante` ityapi darśanamasti| tatra śyāmatvaṃ guṇamupādāya śastrīśabdo devadattāyāṃ vartiṣyate| tāddhamryādvā devadattā śastrīśabdenābhidhāsyate| bhavati hi tāddhamryāt tācchabdyamityuktaṃ prāk| tāddhamryaṃ punaḥ śyāmaguṇatvam| `phālā iva taṇḍulāḥ` iti| bhavanti hi phālā upamānam| tathāhi tairdīrghatvādinā sādṛśyena taṇḍulā upamīyante| taṇḍulaśabdastu sāmānyavacano na bhavati| nanu ca taṇḍulaśabdo'pi taṇḍulatvaṃ sāmānyamupādāya tadvati dravye vartata iti bhavatyeva sāmānyavacanaḥ, tadayuktamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam? naitadasti; tathā hrupamānopameyayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ sāmānyamityuktam| na ca taṇḍulatvaṃ phālānāmasti, kiṃ tarhi? taṇḍulānāmeva||`sāmarthyādupamānavacanaiḥ` iti| yadyapi `upamānavacanaiḥ` iti sūtre nopāttaṃ, tathāpyupameyamānāpekṣamityupamitaśabdaḥ sambandhiśabdatvādupamānatvaṃ vyāghradīnāṃ gamayati| tena viśeṣānabhidhāne'pi sāmarthyādupamānavacanaistaiḥ samāso vijñāyate| `na cetsāmānyavācī śabdaḥ prayujyate` iti| upamānopameyayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ, śauryādi, sāmānyamṣa yadi tadvācī śabdo na prayujyate, evaṃ sati samāso bhavati; nānyathā| nanu ca sāmānyasya samāse'ntarbhūttavāt tdavācināṃ śabdānāṃ prayogo nāsti, tatka pratiṣedhena? naitadasti; sādhāraṇadharmaḥ sāmānyaṃ hi samāse'ntarbhūtam, na tu tadviśeṣaḥ| tatrāsati pratiṣedhe viśiṣṭasādhāraṇadharmavācinaḥ prayogaḥ syādeveti kartavyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ? na kartavyaḥ,katham? sāmānyaśabdaprayoge hi sati tadapekṣatvena sāpekṣamasamartha bhavatītyasāmarthyādeva samāso na bhaviṣyati| eṃ tahrretajjñāpayati - `bhavati hi pradhānasya sāpekṣyasyāpi samāsaḥ` iti| puruṣāścātropameyatvāt pradhānaḥ, upamānantu vyāghrādi tadarthatvādapradhānam| kimetena jñāpakena prayojanam? `rājapuruṣaḥ śobhanaḥ` ityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati| `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti prāpte` iti| nanu ca viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyeṇa samānādhikaraṇena samāsaṃ vakṣyati, upamānopameyayośca bhedādvaiyadhikaraṇyam, tatkuto viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti prāptiḥ? evaṃ manyate - puruṣādāvupameye vatrmānaivryāghrādibhirupamānaśabdairayaṃ samāso bhavati| yathā copamānaśabdānāmupameyavṛttitve sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tathā pūrvasūtra eva vyākhyātam||`bhedakaṃ viśeṣaṇam` iti| `{śiṣlṛ viśaraṇe iti mudrita); śiṣlṛ śeṣaṇe, vipūrvaḥ - padamaṃjarī} śiṣlṛ viśeṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1451) ityasmāddhātorvipūrvāt karaṇe lyuṭ| viśiṣyate'neneti viśeṣaṇam| tasyedaṃ lakṣaṇam - bhademiti| yat sāmānyākāreṇa pravṛttamanekaprakāravadvastu prakārāntarebhyo vyavacchidyaikatra prakāre vyavasthāpayati, tad bhedakaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti| `bhedyaṃ viśeṣaṇam` iti| viśeṣaṇīyaṃ viśeṣyam| vipūrvāt tasmāddhātoḥ `ṛhaloṇryat` [[3.1.124]] iti karmaṇi ṇyat| tasyedaṃ lakṣaṇam, bhedyamiti| yadanekaprakāravadvastu prakārāntarebhyo vyavacchidyaikatra prakāre vyavasthāpyate tadbhedyaṃ viśeṣyamiti| atha kimarthaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorubhayorupādānaṃ kriyate? na; anyatarasyaiva kriyeta, sambandhiśabdatvāddhi tayoranyataropādānenaivetarasyāpyavagatirbhavatyeva? satyametat; yatra pūrvottarapade pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhūte bhavatastraiva samāso bhavatīti jñāpānārthamubhayorupādānam, yathā - nīlotpalamiti| atra nīlārtho bhramarādibhyo vyāvatryotpalārthenotpale vyavasthāpyate| utpalārtho'pi raktotpalādibhyo vyāvatrya nīlārthena nīle vyavasthāpyata ityasti pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ| sa yatra nāsati tatra tu na samāsaḥ yathā - vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti| vṛkṣo hi śiṃśapātvaṃ vyabhicarati, śiṃśapā tu na vṛkṣatvam| atastatprakārāntarebhyaḥ palāśādibhyastaṃ vyavacchinattīti śiṃśapā tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, na tu viśeṣyam| vṛkṣastu viśeṣyaḥ śiṃśapārthastu vṛkṣatvaṃ na vyabhicaratīti na tasyāsau viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| atha kiṃ na bhavitavyameva śiṃśapāvṛkṣaḥ, āmravṛkṣa iti? viśeṣaṇasamāsena bhavitavyam, yadā śiṃśapādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣe vṛttirnāvadhāryate| tathā hi - śiṃśapādiśabdāḥ phalasya vṛkṣasya mūlasya ca vācakāḥ sāmānyaśabda iti tadarthānāṃ vṛkṣatvavyabhicārādadviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, vṛkṣaśca viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| yadā tu kutaścit prakaraṇādarthādvā vṛkṣādyarthā evāvasitavṛttayo bhavanti tadā na bhavitavyam| nanu ca vṛkṣārthāvasitavṛttitvādvṛkṣaśabdasya tadā prayoga eva nopapadyate, uktārthatvāt, `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ` (vyā|pa|60) iti vacanāt| tataśca samāsasyāprasaṅga eva| tatka tannivṛttyarthenobhayagrahaṇena? naitadevam; kvaciduktārthānāmapi loke prayogo dṛśyate, yathā - apūpau dvāvānayeti|yadi tarhi yatrobhayoḥ pratyekaṃ viśeṣamaviśeṣyabhāvastatra samāsena bhavitavyam, evaṃ sati pratyekamupasarjanatvaṃ syāt, ubhayorapi viśeṣaṇatvāt, viśeṣaṇasyeha sūtre prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt, tataścotpalanīlaramityapi syāt, nīlotpalamiti tu sarvadaiveṣyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmādekataraṃ pradhānam, itaradapradhānam| dvayoḥ prādhānye parasparānupakāritvādasambandhayorekatra prayogo na syāt| aprādhānye'pi dvayoḥ pradhānāpekṣāvatornāsti parasparopakāritvamiti na syādevaikatra prayogaḥ| tasmādekatra pradhānam, aparaṃ tvapradhānam| yaccāpradhānaṃ tedavopasarjanasaṃjñāṃ bhavati, netarat; anvarthatvādupasarjanasaṃjñāyāḥ - upa = samīpe viśeṣye svārtha sṛjati = kṣipatīti| nīlaśabdaścāpradhānam, tadarthasya guṇasyāprādhānyāt; utpalaśabdastu pradhānam, tadarthasya dravyasya prādhānyāt| tasmānnīlaśabda evopasarjanam, notpalaśabda iti na bhavati pūrvoktadoṣāvasaraprasaṅgaḥ| yatrobhāvapi tatra paryāyeṇopasarjanabhāvaḥ, yathā - kubjakhañja, khañjakubja iti|atha kuto'tra dravyasya prādhānyamavasitam? ucyate;yathā - otaṃ chāgamālabhetetyasyāṃ deśanāyāṃ deśanāyāṃ otaguṇasyābhāve'nyavarṇasyāpi cchāgasyālambhanācchāgābāve otaguṇasyānyadravyasyānālambhanācca| na hi cchāgābhāve piṣṭakapiṇḍīlamālabhya yājñikaḥ kṛtī bhavati| yadi ca pradhānaṃ guṇaḥ syāttadā yathā chāgābhāve piṣṭakapiṇḍī nālabhyate, tathā otaguṇābhāve'nyaguṇo'pi cchāgo nālabhyate| na ca sa nālabhyate, tasmāt dravyameva pradhānam, na guṇa iti| nanu cotpalaśabdo'pi naiva dravyaśabdo'yamiti vyavasthāpyate| evaṃ nīlaśabde'pyatiprasaṅgaḥ, prabhṛtyā vināśāt svādhāraṃ dravyaṃ naiva jahāti| ato dravyātmabhūtatvājjātestannimittakaḥ śabdo dravyasyotpatte| guṇāḥ punarapāyino'napāyino vā satyetasmin dravye vartante nivartante ca| tasmānnaite dravyātmabhūtā iti na tannimittaśabdo dravyaśabdo vyavasthāpyata ityalamatiprasaṅgena|`takṣakaḥ sarpaḥ` iti| nanu ca takṣakaḥ sarpasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva, tathā hi - sarpa tyukte sarpasāmānyaṃ pratīyate, na sarpaviśeṣaḥ| takṣaka- sarpa ityukte sarpaviśeṣo'takṣakādvyāvṛtto'vasīyate, tadayuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇametat; naitadasti;uktaṃ hretat- yatraikaisyobhayatra bhāvastatra samāsa iti| na tu kadācit sarpārthasya takṣako viśeṣyo bhavati| kathaṃ na bhavati? takṣakasya sarpatvāvyabhicārāt| nanu ca takṣakaśabdasyānekaprakāratvena prakārāntaranivṛttaye yujyata eva sarpasya takṣako'pi viśeṣyaḥ? naitadasti; na nāmadheyasya kriyāśabdena tulyamarthābhidhānasāmarthyam| avayavārthānusāreṇa hi kriyāśabdo'rthaṃ bodhayati, samudāyarūpeṇa tu nāmadheyam| `avayavaprasiddheḥ samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī` (vyā|pa|108) iti tasyāṃ satyāṃ kriyāśabdārthaviṣayāpekṣā nopajāyata eva| `lohitastakṣakaḥ` iti| bhavati lohito viśeṣaṇam, na tu takṣako viśeṣyam| tasya lohitatvāvyabhicārāt| yadi tarhi takṣako na viśeṣyaḥ, lohito'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ na syāt; viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyāpekṣatvāt| na ca śakyaṃ takṣakādyarthāntaraṃ paṭādikaṃ viśeṣyaṃ tadapekṣayā lohitasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ parikalpayitum| evaṃ hi lohitādyadarthāntaraṃ ta#īvraviṣādikaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ tadapekṣaṃ takṣakasyāpi viśeṣyatvaṃ prasajyeta| tasmādvispaṣṭārthamubhayogrrahaṇamityapare||`pūrvasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ` iti| tenaiva siddhatvāt| asti hyatrāpi pratyekaṃ pūrvottarapadayarviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyabhāvaḥ||`śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavacanam` iti| abhūtatadbhāve vartamānānāṃ samāso yathā syāt| yadā hi śreṇyādiśabdānāmarthā apariniṣpannā eva niṣpādyante tadā samāsa iṣṭe| yadā tu niṣpannā eva te rūpāntareṇa kriyate tadā śreṇayaḥ kṛtā daṇḍitāḥ satkṛtā vetyevamādyarthavivakṣāyāṃ neṣyate| kṛtaśabdasya daṇḍitādiśabdānāmartheṣu vṛttirna sambhavatītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam| karoteḥ kriyāsāmānyavācitvāt| anekārthatvādvā dhātūnām| śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavacanamityasyāyamarthaḥ - cvyartha ucyate = pratyāyyate yena taccvyarthavacanam| `kartavyam` iti| yena śreṇyādiṣu samāsakarāṇatvenopātteṣu cvyarthatā pratipadyate tadvayākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - bahulagrahaṇamihānuvartate, tena cvyarthānāmeva samāso bhavatīti nācvyarthānām| `cvyantānām` ityādi| cvervikalpena vidhānāddvividhāścvyarthāḥ - cvyantāḥ, acvyantāśca| tatra ye śreṇyādayo'cvyantāsteṣāmanena samāsaḥ| cvyantānāntu <<ūryādicviḍācaśca>> [[1.4.61]] iti gatisaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ paratvāt <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāso bhaviṣyatīti||ayaṃ viśiṣṭaśabdo'styeva sāvadhāraṇa ādhikye vartamānaḥ| yathā - devadattayajñadattāvāḍhaāvabhirūpau prekṣāvantau| devadattastu yajñadattāt svādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ; svādhyāyenaivādhika iti gamyate| anye tu guṇāḥ samānā eva bhavanti| asti ca niravadhāraṇa ādhikye vartamānaḥ, yathā - devadattayajñadattāvāḍhaāvibhirūpau prekṣāvantau| devadattastu yajñadattāt svādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ, svādhyāyenādhika iti gamyate| anye tu guṇāḥ samānā bhūyāṃso vā, te na vivakṣitā bhavanti| yadyapi cābhinnarūpameva vākyadvayametat, tathāpi prakaraṇādeḥ kutaścidarthabhedo gamyate, yathā - ārācchabde dūrāntikārthabhedaḥ| tatra yadi niravadhāraṇa ādhikye vartamāno viśiṣṭaśabdo gṛhreta, tadā siddhaṃ ca tadabhuktañcetyatrāpi syāt, astyatra nañādhikaṃ ktāntam| tasmāt sāvadhāraṇa ādhikye vartamānaṃ viśiṣṭaśabdaṃ parigṛhrāha - `nañaiva viśeṣo yasya` ityādi| `prakṛtyādikam` iti| ādiśabdena pratyayopasargayoḥ parigrahaḥ| `anañ` iti| avidyāmāno nañ yasmin ktānte tadanañ| `kṛtañca tadakṛtañca` iti| kathaṃ punarekameva vastu kṛtaṃ syādakṛtañca? avayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya tathā vyapadeśādadoṣaḥ| kṛtabhāgasambandhāt kṛtam, akṛtabhāgasambandhāt tadevākṛtamityucyate| atha vā- yadarthaṃ kṛtaṃ tatrāsāmarthyādakṛtam, yathā - putrakāryāsāmarthyāt putro'pyaputra iti| yadi nañeva viśeṣo yasya sarvamanyat prakṛtyādikaṃ tulyaṃ tena samāsaḥ, evaṃ sati yasya nuḍapyadhika iḍāgamo vā, tena saha samāso na bhavatītyāha - `nuḍiṭau` ityādi| yattu nañviśiṣṭaṃ ktāntaṃ tadbhaktau nuḍiṭau, atastadgrahaṇena gṛhrete, ato nāsya bhedakau tau| abhedakāvityarthaḥ| tena tadadhikamapi nañviśiṣṭameva bhavatīti tena samāso bhavatyeva| `aśitānaśitena` iti| <> [[6.3.74]] iti nuṭ| `kliṣṭākliśitena` ti| <> [[7.2.50]] iti pakṣe iṭ| anañici śakyamakartum| yadi sa nañ samasyeta tadā nañviśiṣṭatā nopapadyate; dvoyarapi nañsambandhāt| tasmānnañviśiṣṭagrahaṇādevānañ samasyata ityeṣo'rtho labhyata ityanañgrahamamanarthakam| tat kriyate vispaṣṭārtham|`kṛtāpakṛtādīnām` ityādi| kṛtāpakṛtaprabhṛtīnāmupasaṃkhyānam = pratipādanaṃ kartavyam| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - bahulagrahaṇamihānuvartate, tena kṛtāpakṛtādīnāmapi samāsī bhavatīti| `kṛtāpakṛtam` iti| tadekadeśasyeṣṭasya karaṇāt kṛtam| apakṛtañca tadekadaśasyānabhimatasya karaṇāt| `bhuktavibhuktam` iti| bhuktaṃ tvabhyavahmatatvāt, vibhuktañcāśobhanatvāt| viśabdo'trāśobhavatvaṃ pratipādayati virūpavat| atha vā- bhuktañca tatpratyāgatañceti `gatapratyāgatam`| yātañca tatpūrvamanuyātañca paścāt `yātānuyātam`| `krayākrayikā` #iti| mahān krayaḥ krayaśabdonocyate, alpastu krayikāśabdena| krayāvayavasambandhāt krayaḥ, krayikāvayavasambandhāt krayitā, krayaścāsau krayikā ceti krayākrayikā| <> [[6.3.137]] iti dīrghaḥ| evaṃ puṭaścāsau puṭikā ceti `puṭāpuṭikā`| phalañca tat phalikā ceti `phalaphalikā`| mānañca tadunmānikā ceti `mānonmānikā`| `samānādhikaraṇādhikāre` ityādi| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanantu pūrvavadeva||`pūjyacamānavacanairiti vacanāt` ityādi| pūjyamanatvaṃ hravamuttarapadasya bhavati yadi pūjāvacanā bhavanti, nānyathā; tasmāt pūjyamānagrahaṇāt sadādayaḥ pūjāvacanā vijñāyante| ata eva sacchabdena śatṛśānacogrrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, na hi tau pūjāmāhatuḥ| `utkṛṣṭā gauḥ kadrdamāt` iti| uddhṛtetyarthaḥ| atha kathaṃ mahādrumaḥ, mahodadhiriti samāsaḥ, na hyatra pūjā gamyate, kiṃ tarhi? pramāṇātireka uttarapadārthasya? yadyapyevam, tathāpi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterbhaviṣyati||vandārakādayo jātiśabdāḥ| te copamānatve sati pūjāvacanā bhavanti| tatra vyāghrāderākṛtigaṇatvāt <> [[2.1.56]] ityevaṃ siddhe samānyaprayogage'pi yathā syādityevamartho'yamārambhaḥ| ``pūjyamānam` iti vacanādvṛndārakādayaḥ pūjāvacananā gṛhyante` iti| na hranyathā pūjyamānatvamupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ|`suṣīmo nāgaḥ` iti| nanu ca viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti vartate| na ca nāgādanyaḥ suṣīmo'sti, saṃjñā hreṣā nāgasyaiva? evaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ vṛttikṛtā darśitā|idantvatra pratyudāharaṇam - devadatto nāgo yasmānmūrkha iti||`jātiparipraśna eva vyutpādyete`iti| `kiṃyattadaurnirdhāraṇe` [[5.3.92]] ityanuvartamāne `vā bahūnām` [[5.3.93]] ityādinā| syādetat - kataraśabdaviśeṣaṇārtha jātiparipraśnagrahaṇamityāha - `kataraśabdo'pi` ityādi| `tadeva jñāpayati` iti| yadi tarhi katamaśabdo jātiparipraśna eva vartamāno gṛhrate, jātiparipraśnagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāta, vinā'pi tena yathoktayā nītyā kataratamaśabdau jātiparipraśna eva vartamāno grahīṣyete| `tathā ca` ityādi| yata eva takamaśabdasya jātiparipraśnādanyatrāpi vṛttiḥ, evañca kṛtvā bhavatāṃ devadattaḥ katama iti pratyudāharaṇamupapadyate| anyathā tannopapadyet; tasya jātiparipraśnādanyatrāpravṛtteḥ||`kiṃsakhā` iti| `anaṅa sau` [[7.1.93]] ityanaṅādeśaḥ| atha kiṃrājetyādau `rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac` [[5.4.91]] <> [[5.4.92]] iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ kasmānna bhavatītyāha - `kimaḥ kṣepe` ityādi| atra `na pūjanāt` [[5.4.69]] ityataḥ `na` ityanuvartate||viśeṣaṇamityādinā samāse prāpte vacanamidaṃ paranipātārtham| guṇaśabdā hrete| tatra yadi tena samāsaḥ syāta tadaiṣāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ prasajyeta| atha dhūrtagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā kutsanaśabdo'yam, <> [[2.1.53]] ityevaṃ samāsaḥ siddha? ityāha - `dhūrtagrahaṇamakutsārtham` iti| śabdapravṛttinimittakutsāyāṃ samāso vijñāyate, na kutsāyām||`rūḍhiśabdāḥ praśaṃsāvacanā gṛhyante` iti| triprakārā hi praśaṃsāśabdāḥ- ke#ijjātiśabdāḥ parārthe prayujyamānāḥ praśaṃsāmācakṣate yathā - siṃho devadatta iti| kecidguṇaśabdā guṇaguṇisambandhena praśaṃsāvacanā bhavanti, yathā - ramaṇīyo grāmaḥ, śobhanaḥ pācaka iti| kecidrūḍhiśabdā matallikādayaḥ; teṣāṃ praśaṃsaiva śabdārthaḥ| tadiha vacanagrahaṇāt praśaṃsāyāmeva ye vartante te gṛhyante rūḍhiśabdāḥ| `goprakāṇḍam` iti| śobhanaḥ praśasto gaurityarthaḥ| yogavibhāgo'sandehārthaḥ| yadi pūrvayoga eva praśaṃsāvacanā gṛhreran, tadā sandehaḥ syāt - kiṃ poṭādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ vacanamabhisambadhyate? atha praśaṃsayeti? poṭādibhiḥ sambandhe tatparyāyairapi samāsaḥ syāt||`khalatyādibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇaiḥ` ityādi| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ jaratībhiriti strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ, jaradbhirityevaṃ nāma nirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt, na hi jaratīśabdena strīliṅgena yuvaśabdasya puṃliṅgasya sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyata ityāha - `jaratībhiriti strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ` ityādi| kathaṃ punaranena nirdeśenaiṣā paribhāṣā śakyate jñāpayitum? yadyeṣā na syāt tadā jaratībhirityevaṃ nirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt| tathā ca samānādhikaraṇādhikārāt samānādhikaraṇena jaratīśabdenāyaṃ samāso vijñāyate| na ca tena strīliṅgena puṃsi vartamānasya yuvaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati, tadeṣa nirdeśaḥ kathamarthavān bhavati? yadyeṣā paribhāṣā'vatiṣṭhate ! tasyāṃ hi satyāṃ yuvaśabdasya grahaṇe yuvatiśabdasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyupapadyate| yuvatijaratīśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tasmaśca sati tayoḥ samāsaḥ| tedavaṃ jaratībhiriti nirdeśo jñāpayati - eṣā paribhāṣā'stīti| nanvevamapi jaratyā samāsa ucyamāne jaratā na prāpnoti - yuvajaranniti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vṛttyantare hi jaradbhiriti paṭhate| ubhayathā'pyācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratipāditā ityubhayaṃ sidhyati||`tulyaparyāyāśca` iti| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? evaṃ manyate - kṛtya ityarthagrahaṇam| atastatsāhacaryāt tulya ityarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, tatrārthe kāryāsambhavāt tadvācināṃ samāso vijñāyata ityākhyāgrahaṇaṃ tulyanāmadheyaparigrahārtham| anyathā gaurvāhīka ityatrāpi syāt ; gośabdasyeha sādṛśyārthatvāt| sarva eva hi śabdāḥ parapadārthe prayujyamānāḥ sādṛśyaṃ gamayanti| ākhyāgrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe gośabdo'tra tulyanāmadheyaṃ na bhavatīti samāsābhāvaḥ| bhojyoṣṇamityādāvuṣṇādayaḥ śabdā guṇavacanāḥ| tatrāsatyasmin yoge viśeṣaṇasamāse sati teṣāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| ataḥ paranipātārtha ārambhaḥ| `tulyamahān` iti| yadyapyatra `sanmahat` ityādinā samāsaḥ prāpnoti, tathāpi paratvādanenaiva bhavati| tulyākhyāyāmasyāvakāśaḥ - tulyaota iti| tasya cātulyākhyāyāmavakāśaḥ - mahāpuruṣa iti| `bhojya odanaḥ` iti| odana śabdo'tra jātivacanaḥ||<> [[2.1.57]] iti vartate| tatra yadi dvayorapi varṇaśabdayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇamiha syāt, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo nopapadyeta; abhinnārthatvāt| na hi tadeva devadattasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ copapadyate| athāpyekasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, aparasyārthagrahaṇam? evapyekaḥ sāmānyavācī syādvarṇaśabdaḥ, dvitīyastu viśeṣavācī kṛṣṇādiśabdaḥ| tataśca pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ ca na syāt| yatra ca tadubhayamasti tatra samāsa iti prāgubhayagrahaṇasya prayojanamuktam| tasmādubhayatrāpyarthagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `varṇaviśeṣavāci` ityādi| `kṛṣṇasāraṅgaḥ, lohitasāraṅgaḥ` iti| nanu ca kṛṣṇaśabdo lohitaśabdaścāvayave vartate sāraṅgaśabdastu samudāye; yathā - śabalaśabdaḥ, tatkathamavayavavṛtteḥ kṛṣṇādiśabdasya samudāyavṛttinā sāraṅgādiśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyamityāha - `avayavadvāreṇa` ityādi| kṛṣṇa ityucyate, lohitāvayavasambandhāllohita iti| ata eva gauṇatvādatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasya <> [[2.1.57]] ityādinā samāso na prāpnotītīdamārabhyate mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeteti| tenāpradhānamupasarjanamiti| na cātra samudāyo'pradhānam, kiṃ tarhi? pradhānameva| avayavānāntu tadarthatvādaprādhānyam| ato'vayavavacanasyaiva kṛṣṇaśabdāderupasarjanatvam| na samudāyavacanasya sāraṅgādiśabdasya||`taiḥ saha strīliṅga eva kumārīśabdaḥ samasyate` iti| na tu puṃlliṅga ityavadhāraṇena darśayati| na hi puṃlliṅgasya strīliṅgena sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| `tairupabhayathā` iti| strīliṅgaḥ, puṃlliṅaśca| kathaṃ punaḥ puṃlliṅgaiḥ samāsa ucyamānaḥ strīliṅgaiḥ syādityata āha - `prātipadikagrahaṇe` iti| gatārtham||`catuṣpādaḥ` iti| catvāraḥ pādā yāsāṃ tāścatuṣpādaḥ| <<pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ>> [[5.4.138]] ityantasya lopaḥ| `catuṣpājjātiriti vaktavyam` iti| catuṣpādo jātivacanā eva garbhiṇyā samasyanta ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - poṭādi [[2.1.64]] sūtrādiha jātigrahaṇamanurtate| tena catuṣpajjātivācyeva garbhiṇyā samasyate, nānyaditi||`mayūravyaṃsakaḥ` iti| mayūraścāsau vyaṃsakaśceti mayūravyaṃsakaḥ| vyaṃsakaśabdasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipātārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| evaṃ cātra mayūravyaṃsakādīnāṃ yavanamuṇḍaparyantānām| `chandasi hstegṛhra` ityādi| samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap` [[7.1.37]] | bhāṣāyāntu - hastegṛhītvā, punardattvetyevaṃ bhavati| `ehīḍādayo'nyapadārthe` iti| ehi īḍa yatra karmaṇi vartate taducyate - `ehīḍam` iti| evam - `ehiyavam` iti| ehivāṇijeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā `ehivāṇijā`| evam - `apehivāṇijā, prehivāṇijā`| ehi savāgatamiti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā `ehisvāgatā`| evam - `apehisvāgatā`| prauha kaṭamiti yasyāṃ sā `prohakaṭā`| eṃ prohakardamādaya āharavasanāntāḥ| kṛndhi vicakṣaṇeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā `kṛndhivicakṣaṇā`| `uddharotsṛja` iti| tiṅantayoḥ samāsaḥ| `ākhyātamākhyātena kriyāsātye` (ga|sū|20) ityevaṃ siddhe'sātatyārthaṃ vacanam| uddharotsṛjati yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā uddharotsṛjā| kriyāpradhānaścāyaṃ samāsaḥ| `utpatanipatā`| `uttamavidhamā`| evamuddharotsṛjetyādikamasātatyaviṣayameva| `uccāvacanam` iti nipātyate| udak cāvāk citi vigṛhra| uccaiśca nīcaiśceti vigṛhroccanīcamiti nipātyate| ācitañcopacitañceti vigṛhra `ācopacam`| ācitañca parācitañceti `ācaparācam`| niścitañca pracitañceti `niścapracam`| na kiñcana `akiñcanam`| `snatvākālakaḥ`| `pītvāsthirakaḥ`| `bhuktvāsuhitaḥ` ityeṣāmantodāttārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| lyabbhāvaśca nipātyate| `proṣyapāpīyān` iti| aikapadyamaikasvaryañca samāsādbhavati| evam - utpatyapākalādīnām| `nityarohiṇī| niṣaṇṇaśyāmā| apehiprasavā| ihapañcamī| ihadvitīyā` iti| aikapadyamaikasvaryañca samāse bhavati|`jahi karmaṇā bahulamābhīkṣṇye kartārañcādhidadhāti` iti| jahīti loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanam| tadantaṃ karmaṇā ca bahulaṃ samasyata ābhīkṣṇye gamyamāne samāsena cetkartā cābhidhīyate| jahijoḍamityābhīkṣṇyaṃ ya āha sa ucyate `jahijoḍaḥ` iti| jahistamba iti, loṭ; sip, <> [[6.4.36]] iti jādeśaḥ| joḍāderatra karmabhāvaḥ| `ākhyātam` ityādi| tiṅantaṃ tiṅantena saha samasyate kriyāsātatye gamyamāne| aśnīta pibatetyasakṛdyatrocyate tatra `aśnītapibata` iti prayujyate| kriyāpradhānaścāyaṃ samāsaḥ| evaṃ pacatabhṛjjatetyevamādayo veditavyāḥ| bhindhi lavaṇamiti yatrībhidhīyate sā `bhindhilakṣaṇā`| evaṃ `pacalavaṇā` iti|| iti śrībodhasattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃdvitīyādhyāyasyaprathamaḥ pādaḥ`sāmarthyādekadeśavacanāḥ` iti| yadi hi pūrvādayaḥ śabdā ekadeśavacanā na syusatadottarapadasyaikadeśitvaṃ na gamyeta;ekadeśina ekadeśāpekṣatvāt| tasmāt sāmānyoktā api pūrvādayaḥ śabdā sāmarthyādekadeśavacanāḥ samasyanta iti vijñāyate| ekādhikaraṇagrahaṇamekadeśino viśeṣaṇamityasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkartumāha - `ekaṃ ca` ityādi| ekamityekasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamityarthaḥ| `ekadravyam` ityanenādhikaramaśabdo'tra dravye vartamāna upātta ti darśayati| nanu `ekadeśinā` iti tṛtīyāntametat, `ekādhikaraṇe ityetat saptamyantam, tat kathaṃ tayorbhinnavibhaktikayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva upapadyate, kathañca na syāt; bhinnārthatvāt? naitadasti; `chandovat sūtrāṇi bhavanti` (ma|bhā|1.1.1) ityato <> [[3.1.85]] iti bahulavacanāt| `ekādhikaraṇe` ityatra tṛtīyārtha evaiṣā saptamī| na <> [[2.3.36]] ityanena| ato nāsti bhinnārthatvamityadoṣaḥ| `ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ` iti| `ekadeśinā` iti vacanāt pūrvādayaḥ śabdā ekadeśavacanā āśrīyante| sambandhiśabdā hi niyatameva pratiyoginamupasthāpayanti| tatrāvayavāvayavisambandhe steyakadeśinaḥ ṣaṣṭhaāmupajanitāyāṃ `ṣaṣṭhī` [[2.2.8]] iti samāsaḥ prāpnoti, atastadapavādo'yaṃ yoga iti| `pūrvakāyaḥ` ityatra kāya ekadeśī, ekadravyañca; ekasaṃkhyāyuktatvāt|`pūrvaṃ nābheḥ kāyasya` iti| nābheriti digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī| nābherupariṣṭāt yat pūrvaṃ tat kāyasyetyeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ| tenātra nābhirekadeśinī na bhavati| kiṃ tarhi? avadhibhūtā, tadvācī nābhiśabdaḥ pañcamyanto na samasyante| yastvekadeśī kāyastadvācinaḥ kāyaśabdasya bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| satyapi pūrvaśabdasya sāpekṣatve kāyasya prādhānyāt pradhānasyaca sāpekṣasyāpi samāso bhavatīti jñāpitametat <> [[2.1.56]] ityatra| `pūrvaṃ {chātrāṇāmāmantraya ita mūlapāṭhaḥ, padamañjarīsammataśca|} chātrāṇāmāmantrayasva`iti| atra bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaikadeśinaśchātrā iti na bhavati samāsaḥ| nanu cātra paratvāt `na nirdhāraṇe` [[2.2.10]] iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedho bhaviṣyati| tat {kimevādhikaraṇe- iti mudrita pāṭhaḥ|} kimekādhikaraṇagrahaṇena? naitadasti; yadi tahrrāmantrayasvetyetannāpekṣyate tadā pūrvaṃ chātrāṇāmityetāvadvākyaṃ parisamāpyate,tadā nirdhāraṇābhāvānnāyaṃ tasya pratiṣedhasya viṣaya ityasatyekādhikaraṇe'nekasaṃkhyenāpyekadeśinā samāsaḥ syāt| atha sarvaṃ hi vākyaṃ kriyayā parisamāpyata iti pūrvaṃ chātrāṇāmityatra yāṃ kāñcit kriyāmadhyāhmatya nirdhāraṇaṃ parikalpyeta, evaṃ `pūrvaṃ kāyasya` ityatrāpi nirdhāraṇaṃ syāt| asti hyatrāpyakarṣaṇakriyā nirdhāraṇahetuḥ| tathā ca tasyaiva yogasya viṣaye kilārabhyamāṇo'yaṃ yogastadapavādaḥ syāt| na cotsargāpavādayorvipratiṣedha upapadyate, tatkathaṃ paratvāt `na nirdhāraṇe` [[2.2.10]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ pravartate - saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyetyādi? yadayaṃ <> [[6.3.110]] ityāha, tato jñāpakādavasīyate - sarveṇaikadeśinā'hnaḥ samāso bhavatīti| anyathā hi sāyapūrvatvamahnaśabdasya nopapadyata ityayuktametadvacanaṃ syāt||`samapravibhāge tvadrdhaśabdo napuṃsakamāviṣṭaliṅgastasyedaṃ grahaṇam` iti| yadyevam, samagrahaṇameva kartavyam? naivaṃ śakyam, anekārthatvāt samaśabdasya| tathā hi - sa nimnonnatādirahite'pi deśe vartate - yathā - same yajeteti, nimnonnatādirahite deśe yajetetyarthaḥ| athāpi samapravibhāga icyucyate, evamapi gurutvaṃ syāt, tasmānnapuṃsakagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam; adrdhamiti napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśādeva hi napuṃsakasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; asati hi napuṃsakagrahaṇaṃ śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakanirdeśa iti vijñāyeta, yathā - <> [[1.1.35]] , `banthuni bahuvrīhau` [[6.1.14]] iti ca; tataścādrdhaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvatā'nāśritā syāt| evamanupaṃsakaliṅgo'pi samasyeta| tasmādadrdhaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvamāśrayituṃ napuṃsakamiti vaktavyam| `adrdhapiptalī` iti| `paravaliṅgam` [[2.4.26]] iti strīliṅgatā| athātra <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? anupasarjanatvāt| upasarjanatvaṃ tu `ekavibhakti ca` [[1.2.44]] iti| atra <> [[7.4.44]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā pratipāditā| `grāmārddhaḥ` iti| grāmasyaikadeśa ityarthaḥ|`adrdha paśordaivadattasya` iti| devadattaśabdena saha samāso na bhavati| anekadeśitvāddevadattasya| na hrasāvekadeśaḥ, kintarhi? svāmī| yastvekadeśī paśuśabdaḥ, tena saha bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| satyapi paśuśabdasya sāpekṣatve paśoḥ prādhānyāt samāso bhavatyeva - adrdhapaśurdevadattasyeti||`anyatarasyāṃ grahaṇāt so'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhavati` iti| nanu ca pūraṇapratyayāntā ete dvitīyādayaḥ śabdāḥ| tatra pūraṇetyādinā samāsaniṣedhena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ so'pi bhavatītyāha - `pūraṇa` ityādi| yadyatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt tadā'nyatarasyāṃ grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| vākyasya tu mahāvibhāṣayaiva siddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyāḥ` iti| bhikṣāyā dvitīyo bhāga ityarthaḥ| `dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyā bhikṣakasya` iti| bhikṣukeṇa sahātra samāso na bhavati| na hrasāvekadeśī, kiṃ tarhi? svāmī| turyaśabdaḥ `caturaśchayatāvādyakṣaralopaśca` (vā|571) iti yatpratyayāntaḥ pūraṇārthasya pratipādakaḥ||`dvitiyāsamāse prāpte` iti| `dvitīyā śrita` [[2.1.23]] ityādinā| `samāsavidhānātso'pi bhavati` iti| apiśabdādayamapi bhavati| `prāptajīvikaḥ`iti| `ekavibhakti ca` [[1.2.44]] ityādinopasarjanatvam| hrasvatvaṃ tu <> [[1.2.48]] iti| atra ca `paravalliṅgam` [[2.4.26]] ityādinā jīvikāyā yalliṅagaṃ tat samudāyasya kasmānna bhavati? `dviguprāptāpannalaṃpūravagatisamāseṣu pratiṣedo vaktavyaḥ`(vā|163) iti vacanāt| tena prāptāpanyoryalliṅgaṃ tat samudāyasya bhavati| atha yadā prāptājīvikāmiti vigṛhra samāsaḥ kriyate tadā kimudāharaṇam? prāptajīvika iti| ṭāpaḥ śravaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? `striyāḥ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] iti yogavibhāgāt puṃvadbhāvena ṭāpo nivartitatvāt||`sāmarthyāt parimāṇavacanāḥ` ita| evaṃ hruttarapadasya parimaṇivācitvaṃ gamyate yadi kālaśabdāḥ parimāṇavacanā bhavanti, nānyathā| tasmāt kālā ityeviśeṣābhidhāne'pi sāmarthyāt `parimāṇavacanaḥ kālaśabdāḥ samasyante` iti vijñāyate| nanu cakālaḥ parimāṇeva bhavati; anavadhitvāt, tat kathaṃ tadabhidhāyinaḥ śabdāḥ parimāṇavacanā bhavanti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi mukhyasya parimāṇasya vācakā na bhavanti, gauṇasya tu bhavatyeva| iha hi mukhyaṃ parimāṇatvaṃ kālasya māsaderna bhavatīti sāmarthyāt paricchedahetumātraparimāṇasādhamryamupādāyopacāreṇa kālāḥ parimāṇtavenābhimatāḥ| māsādayo'pi hi jātādeḥ sambandhinīrādityagatīrgamayanti, ato bhavanti paricchedahetavaḥ| `ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaviṣaye yogārambhaḥ` iti| parimāṇaparimāṇisambandhe hi parimāṇavācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhaā bhavitavyam| yatra ca ṣaṣṭhī bhavati sa ṣaṣṭīsamāsasya viṣayaḥ,tenāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya viṣayo yoga ārabhyate| `māsajātaḥ` ityatra jātaḥ parimāṇī| tasya parimā~ māsaḥ| `dvayahajātaḥ` iti| dvayorahnoḥ samāhāra iti dvyahaḥ| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac` [[5.4.91]] | <> [[6.4.145]] iti ṭilopaḥ| <> [[5.4.89]] ityahnādeśapratiṣedhaḥ| dvyaho jātasya dvyahajātaḥ| atha `kālāḥ` iti bahuvacananirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ? svarūpavidhinirāsārtha iti cet; naitadasti; na hi svarūpagrahaṇe satyuttarapadasya parimāṇivācitvaṃ gamyate, kālaśabdasyāparimāṇavācitvāt| tasmāt parimāṇigrahaṇādeva kālaviśeṣavācināṃ māsādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tarhi bahuvacananirdeśo'yaṃ mātrādhikyena sūtraprabandhasyārthādhikyasūcanārthaḥ| tathā coktam - `iṅgitenonmiṣitena mahatā sūtraprabandhenācāryāṇāmabiprāyā lakṣyante` iti| tena saṃkhyāpūrvapadastripado'pyayaṃ parimāṇinā tatpuruṣasamāso bhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyate| tena dvyahnajāta ityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati| dve ahanī jātamasyeti vigṛhra tripade tatpuruṣe kṛte jātaśabda uttarapade pūrvayoḥ padayoḥ <> [[2.1.51]] iti dvyavayavastatpuruṣo bhavati, pūrvaṣaṭṭac, `ahnohna etebhyaḥ` [[5.4.88]] ityahnādeśaḥ||naño ñakāraḥ <> [[6.3.73]] iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, pāmanaputrādiṣu mā bhūt| <> [[5.2.100]] | athābrāāhṛṇa iti kiṃpradhāno'yaṃ samāsaḥ? uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ, yathā - rājapuruṣa iti| pūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāvaḥ, yathā - amakṣikamiti| anyapadārthapradhāno bahuvrīhiḥ, yathā - abrāāhṛṇako deśa iti| yadyevam, abrāāhṛṇamānayetyukte brāāhṛṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti? atha nivṛttipadārthako'yaṃ brāāhṛṇaśabdaḥ, sā ca nivṛttiḥ svābhāvikī nañā dyotyata iti matam, evaṃ ca satyabhāva evāsyārtha ityabrāāhṛṇamānayetyukte na kasyacidānayanaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;sarvaṃ hi padaṃ svārthe prayujyamānaṃ prayogapratijñānamapekṣate| tathā coktam - `ātmā buddhyā sametyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā` iti|tacca dvividhaṃ jñānam - samyak, mithyā ceti| ubhayamapyetat brāāhṛṇaśabdaḥ pravartayati| yatra samyagjñānapūrvake brāāhṛṇaśabdaprayoge nāsti naño vyāpāraḥ, na hi tatra nañā kiñcita kriyate| mikhyājñānapūrvake tu vidyata eva tasya vyāpāraḥ| tatra hi tena mithyājñānaprabhāvatā parasyākhyāyate| mithyājñānaṃ ca duṣṭendriyahetukam| taccasādṛśyādṛte na sambhavatīti pratiṣedhe satyattarapadārthasadṛśaḥ samāsārtho jāyate| tathā coktam - `nañiva yuktamanyasadṛśādhikaraṇe tathā hrarthagatiḥ` (vyā|pa|65) iti| tasmādabrāāhṛṇamānayetyukte brāāhṛṇasadṛśe kṣatriyādau pratītirbhavatīti na bhavati pūrvokatdoṣāvasaraprasaṅgaḥ||`īṣadguṇavacanenati vaktavyam` iti| īṣadityetadavyayaṃ samasyate, na sarveṇākṛdanetanetyetadrūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| ttaredaṃ vyākhyānam - vibhāṣetyanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena guṇavacanenaiva samāso bhaviṣyati, nānyena| `īṣadgārgyaḥ` iti| gāgryaśabda'yaṃ jātivacanaḥ, na guṇavacanaḥ| nanvakṛtetyucyate, ttara īṣatpītaḥ, īṣadunna ta ityādi na sidhyati; pītādiśabdasya kṛdantatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avyutpannā hrete pītādiśabdā veditavyāḥ; na tu kṛdantāḥ||`kṛdyogā ca` ityādi| `kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī samasyate` iti vyākhyeyam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - yadayaṃ `ktena ca pūjāyām` [[2.2.12]] <> [[2.2.13]] <> [[2.2.14]] `tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari ca {ca nāsati sūtre}` iti niṣedhamārabhate, tajjñāpayati - `kṛdyogā yā ṣaṣṭhī sā samasyate` iti ; anyathā pratiṣedhārambho'narthakaḥ syāt; prāptyabhāvāt| `idhmapravraścaḥ` iti| karaṇa lyuṭ| `kṛtyulyuṭo bahulam` [[3.3.113]] iti kartari vāta| `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| palāśaśātanaḥ` iti| śadeṇryantasya <<śaderagatau taḥ>> [[7.3.42]] iti dakārasya takāraḥ| pūrvavallyuṭ, ṣaṣṭhī ca| kimarthamityucyate, yāvatā ṣaṣṭhītyanenaiva kṛdyogalakṣaṇāyā api ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ siddhaḥ evetyata āha- `pratipadavidhānā ca` ityādi| subodham|cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena `tatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭī samasyata iti vaktavyam` (iti) iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati;anenaiva siddhatvāt| tasmin sthitāḥ = tatsthāḥ| prakṛtasyānyasyābhāvāt tadityanena guṇā eva pratyavamṛśyante| tena guṇātmanyeva ye guṇā vartante , na kadāciddravyātmani, taiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate| yadyapi nāstyeva hi sa guṇo yo dravye na vartate, sarvanasya guṇasya dravyāśritatvāt; tathāpi guṇaśapabdāstu kecit matublopādabedopacārādvā tadvati dravye vartamānā guṇamādhārānugataṃ gamayanti, yathā - śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, lohitaḥ kambala iti| apare tvāśrayādvibhaktaṃ dravyaṃ pratyanupasarjanībhūtaṃ guṇamāhuḥ, yathā - candranasya gandhaḥ, kapisthasya rasa iti| tasmādabhidhānaśaktavyāpārāpekṣayā tatsthairiti viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - ye guṇāḥ svaśabdaidrravyaṃ pratyanupasarjanabhāvāpannā eva pratyāyyante, taiḥ saha ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti candanasya gandhaśabdanagandhaḥ, kapitthasya rasaḥ kapittharasaḥ| gandhādayo hi svaśabdairādhāravibhaktā eva pratyāyyante, na tu kadācidāśrayānugatā dravyaṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtāḥ||`manuṣyāṇāṃ kṣatriyaḥ śūratamaḥ` iti| `yataśca nidrdharāṇam` [[2.3.41]] iti ṣaṣṭhī| `pratipadavidhānā ca` ityādi| <<ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe>> [[2.3.50]] iti sāmānyalakṣaṇavihitāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ tyaktvā yā'nyā viśeṣalakṣaṇāvihitā ṣaṣṭhī sā pratipadavidhānā,ka sā ca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyata ityetadrūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - neti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena pratipadavidānā ṣaṣṭhī na samasyata iti|yadyevam, kathaṃ gṛhasvāmī, vidyādāyādaḥ, pṛthvīāra iti, pratipadavidhānā hreṣā ṣaṣṭhī bādhiṣyata iti cakāreṇa punaḥ ṣaṣṭhīpratiprasavaḥ kriyate| na hrevaṃvidā ṣaṣṭhī pratipadavidhānā bhavati| ata va `na nirdhāraṇe` iti niṣedho vidhīyate| `yataśca nirdhāraṇam` [[2.3.41]] ityatrāpi cakāreṇa saiva śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī pratiprasūyate, anyathā hīyamapi pratipadavidhānaiva ṣaṣṭhīti samāso na syāt| tataśca `na nirdhāraṇe`iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt|`sarpiṣo jñānam` iti| `jño'vidarthasya` [[2.3.51]] iti karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī||`chātrāṇāṃ pañcamaḥ` iti| <> [[5.2.48]] <> [[5.2.49]] samudāyasamudāyisambandhe śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| evaṃ `valākāyāḥ śauklyam`, `kākasya kāṣṇryam` ityatra guṇaguṇisambandhe śeṣalakṣaṇaiva ṣaṣṭhī veditavyā| brāāhṛṇasya kartavyamityatra <> [[2.3.71]] iti ṣaṣṭhī| atha kathaṃ gorviśatiriti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, yāvatā saṃkhyāyā guṇatvāt pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayaṃ <<śatasahasrāntācca niṣkāt>> [[5.2.119]] ityāha, tajjñāpayati - saṃkhyāyāḥ samāso bhavatīti| na hi tenā vinā śatasaharuāāntatā niṣkasya prātipadikasya sambhavati| `tavyatā sānubandhakena samāso bhavatyeva` iti| niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā tasyāgrahaṇāt| `brāāhṛṇakartavyam` iti| <> [[6.2.139]] iti prakṛtisvareṇāntasvaritamuttarapadaṃ bhavati| yadi tarhi niranubandhakenāpi samāsaḥ syāt prakṛtisvare kṛte pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ syāt, sa cāniṣṭaḥ; ato niranubandhakena samāsaḥ pratiṣidhyate, na tu sānubandhakena| kiñca syāditi? evaṃ manyate - kriyamāṇe'pyetasmin pratiṣedhe viśeṣaṇasamāsenātra bhavitavyameva| tadavasyambhāvini samāse yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāt tadā ko doṣaḥ syāt, yatparihmataye'yaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti? - `{pūrvanipātasyāniyamaḥ - kāśikā}pūrvanipātāniyaḥ` ityādinā doṣamāha| yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāt tadā dvayorapi padayoḥ `tirviśaterḍiti` [[6.4.142]] iti ṭilopaḥ| `āsannadaśāḥ` iti| daśānāmāsannā āsannadaśāḥ| te ca pūrvavannavaikādaśa vā| `adūradaśāḥ` iti| daśānāmadūrā ye, te punaḥ pūrvoktā eva| `adhikadaśāḥ` iti| daśānāmadhikāḥ , te punarekādaśādayaḥ| `dvitrāḥ` iti| dvau vā trayo vati vigrahaḥ| vārthecāyaṃ samāsaḥ| vārthaścāyaṃ saṃśayaḥ, na vikalpaḥ| yadi vārtha iha vikalpa āśrīyate tato yadā dvau bhavataḥ, tadā bahuvacanaṃ na syāt| tasmāt saṃśayo'tra vārthaḥ| saṃśayite cārthe bahuvacanaṃ bhavati, yathā - kita bhavataḥ putrāḥ| uktañca bhāṣye - `avijñāte'rthe bahuvacanaṃ prayoktavyam` iti| tatkatham? saṃśayajña#ānasyobhayapakṣarāmarśitvena bahvarthaviṣayatvāt| ubhayapakṣāparāmarśitve saṃśaya eva na syāt| atha vā - pañcaivātra sadā bhavanti, na kadāciddvau trayo veti| tathā ca `dvitrā` ityukte pañcaiveti gamyate| saiṣā pañcādhiṣṭhānāvāgiti tato yuktaṃ bahuvacanam| yadi tarhi vārthe'yaṃ samāsaḥ, tasyārthasyānyapadārthatvāt pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ samāsaḥ? na siddhyati, matvarthe hi pūrvayogaḥ; amatvartho'yaṃ yogaḥ| atha vā - prathamārthe varjayitvā'nyatra vibhaktyarthe pūrveṇa samāsaḥ| prathamārthamidaṃ vacanam| `tricaturāḥ` iti| `caturo'cprakaraṇe caturastryupābhyāmupasaṃkhyānam` (vā|639) ityac samāsāntaḥ| `dvidaśāḥ` iti| dvirdaśeti vigrahaḥ| sujarthe'yaṃ samāsaḥ| daśasambandhinī yā''vṛttirdaśaśabdena lakṣyamāṇā sā dviśabdenākhyāyate| sujarthaśca pratyayārtho nānyapadārtha iti pūrveṇa na siddhyati| atha vā - prathamārthe'picāyam, amatvarthe'pi; ataḥ pūrveṇa na sidhyati| samāsa eva sujarthaṃ gamayituṃ samartha iti vṛttau suj na prayujyate|`adhikā viṃśatirgavām` iti| viṃśatiśabdo'tra [[1.1.28]] ityatra diśāṃ yaḥ samāsaḥ pratipadavihitastasya grahaṇamiṣyate| pratipadavihitaśca samāso diśāmeva bhavati yadyayaṃ yoga ārabhyate, nānyathā| `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ` iti| sa
