rūḍhiśabdau, kiṃ tarhi? yogikau - indrasyeyamaindrī, kuberasyeyaṃ kauberī| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ||`itikaraṇaḥ` ityādi| samāsādabhimate'rthe itikaraṇo yamarthaṃ pratipādayati taṃ darśayitumāha - `laukikamarthamanusārayati` iti| anugamayati prabodhayatīti yāvat| sa punarlaukiko'rtho grahaṇādiriti darśayannāha `tataḥ` ityādi| yasmāditikaraṇo laukikamarthamanusārayati tato hetorgarhaṇādiriti sarvaṃ labhyate| `yattatretyādinā` karmavyatīhāra iti parasparagrahaṇam, parasparagrahaṇañcetikaraṇādeva labhyata iti veditavyam| svarūpavidhiratretikaraṇādeva na bhavatīti veditavyam| daṇḍaiśceti karaṇe tṛtīyā| `sa cāvyayam` iti| tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhādavyayībhāvaḥ; <> [[2.4.18]] ityavyayasaṃjñāvidhānāt| `sarūpam` iti| samānasya `jyotiravacanasya` [[6.3.84]] ityādinā sabhāvaḥ||`tulyayoge vartamānam` ityādi| tulyogaḥ = samānasambandhaḥ| taṃ yadā sahaśabdodyotayati tadāsau tatra vartate| `saputraḥ` iti| saha putreṇeti vigrahaḥ kartavyaḥ| <<sahayukte'pradhāne>> [[2.3.19]] iti tṛtīyā| <> [[6.3.82]] iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| atra saputra āgato devadatta iti devadattasya putrasya cāgamanena tulyasambandhaḥ sahaśabdena dyotyate| atha kathaṃ punaḥ sakarmaka ityādau syāt? kathañca na syādityāha - `na hyatra` ityādi| `prāyikam` iti|asarvaviṣayamityarthaḥ| kutaḥ punaḥ prayikatvamasya labhyate? itikaraṇāt| nanu cānyaditikaraṇasya prayojanamasti, kiṃ tat? sahaśabdaḥ svarūpapadārthako yathā gamyeta; anyathā hrarthanirdeśo'yaṃ vijñāyeta| tataśca sākaṃ sādrdhamityādayo'pi samasyeran? naivaṃ brāūmaḥ; - iha sūtre ya itikaraṇastato labhyata iti, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvasūtrādyo'nuvartate tata iti||kaḥ punarayaṃ cārtho nāmetyāha - `samuccayā'nvācaya` ityādi| samuccitiḥ = samuccayaḥ| sādhanamekaṃ kriyāṃ vā prati kriyāsādhanānāmātmarūpabhedanena cīyamānatā'nekatvamiti yāvat| sa punastulyabalānāmaniyatakramayogapadyānāmeva bhavati, yathā - gāmaāṃ puruṣaṃ paśuñcāharaharnayamāno vaivasvatastṛpta nopayātīti| anvācayo'pi yatraikasya prādhānyam, itaradapradhānam, tadanurodhenānvācīyamānatā, yathā - bho vaṭo bhikṣāmaṭa gāñcānayeti| itaretarayogaḥ samāhāraśca samuccayasyaiva prabhedaḥ| sa eva hi parasparāpekṣāṇāmavayavabhedānugata itaretarayogaḥ, yathā - devadattayajñadattābhyāmidaṃ kāryaṃ kartavyam| ubhāvapi tatkāryaṃ prati parasparāpekṣau| tathā hi tadekasyāpyabhāve na kriyate| avayavapradhānaścāyamiti dvitvāddvicavacanaṃ bhavati| parasparāpekṣāṇāmeva tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ saṃhatipradhānaḥ samāhāraḥ; yathā - chatropānahamatiti| atrāpi kasyāñcit kriyāyāṃ chattrādeḥ parasparāpekṣatvam| saṃhatipradhānatvāccaikavacanam| yadi tarhi samuccayānvācayāvapi cārthau tadā tayorapi samāsaḥ prāpnotīttayata āha - `tatra` ityādi| samuccaye tāvat parasparānabhisambandhā eva gavādayo nayanādibhiḥ sambadhyamānāḥ samucīyanta ityāsāmarthyāt satyapi cārthe tasmin na bhavati samāsaḥ| anvācaye'pyekaṃ sāpekṣaṃ netarat, yathā - pūrvokta udāharaṇe| ttara hi gavānayanaṃ bhikṣāṭanamapekṣate, na tu bhikṣāṭanaṃ gavānayanam,; vināpi tena tadanuṣṭhānāt| sa yadi gāṃ paśyati tadā tāmapyānayati, na cet bhikṣāmevāṭatītyanyatarāpekṣārahite cārthe na bhavati samāsaḥ| `itaretarayoge samāhāre ca vidhīyate` iti| tatra sarveṣāṃ sāmarthyasya vidyāmānatvāt| `vāktvacam, vāgdṛṣadam` iti| `dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt samāhāre` [[5.4.106]] iti ṭac| samāsāntaḥ| `jātiraprāṇinām` [[2.4.6]] ityekavadbhāvaḥ||`pūrvavacanaṃ paraprayoganivṛttyartham` iti| nanu ca paraprayogaviparyayo loke na dṛṣṭa eva; tatkathaṃ paraprayoganivṛttyarthena pūrvagrahaṇenetyata āha - `aniyamo hi syāt` iti| sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅa| evaṃ manyate - yadyapi paraprayogaviparyayo na dṛṣṭaḥ, tathāpyasati niyāmake vākye puruṣāparādhādviparītaprayogo'pi sambhāvyeta| yeṣāñca vākyameva samāsībhavatīti darśanam, teṣāṃ vākyasyānitayatakramatvāt tadvikāro'pi samāso'niyatakramaḥ sāditi sūtrārambhaḥ||`pūrvasya paranipāta` iti| liptavāsitādyuptagāḍhaparyanteṣu| udūkhalamasalādayo ye dvandvāḥ, tatra kvacidalpāctaratvāt pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti, kvacid dhyantatvāt pūrvanipātaḥ, kvacidajādyantatvāt; kvacitulyādaniyamaḥ| `dṛṣdupalam` iti pramādāccāyaṃ pāṭho lakṣyate| alpāctaratvādaddṛṣacchabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ| `akṣibhruvam, dāragavam` iti| acaturādisūtreṇāc [[5.4.79]] samāsāntaḥ| `sthūlapūlāsam` iti| pramadapāṭho'yaṃ lakṣyate;pūrvoktādeva kāraṇāt||`upasarjanam` ityanvarthasaṃjñāvidhānādapradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñā vihitā| dvandve ca sarveṣāṃ padānāṃ prādhānyam| na kasyacidaprādhānyamityupasarjanasaṃjñāyā abhāvādaniyame prāpte vacanamidam| atra yatra bahūnāṃ pūrvanipātaprasaṅgastatra kimekasyāniyamo bhaviṣyati, uta sarveṣāmityāha - `anekaprāptāvekasya` ityādi| eva cārtho jātipadārthasyāśrayaṇāllabhyate vyaktau tu padārthe prativyakti śāstrapravṛtyā bhavitavyam, tataḥ sarveṣāṃ niyamaḥ syāt| ākṛtau tu padārthe lakṣya ekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sakṛdeva pravartate| tena caikasya pūrvanipāte jātiḥ kṛtārtheti śeṣāṇāmaniyamo bhavati| evamuttaratrāpyekasya niyamaḥ, śeṣāṇāntvaniyama iti veditavyam| `vispaṣṭapaṭuḥ` iti| vispaṣṭaḥ paṭuḥ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ||`dvandve ghyantādajādyadantaṃ vipratiṣedhena` iti| <> [[2.2.32]] iti tasmādajādyadantamityetatadbhavati vipratiṣedhena| `dvandve ghi`ityasyāvakāśaḥ - paṭuśuklau,paṭuguptau| `ajādyadantam` ityasyāvakāśaḥ - uṣṭraśaśau, uṣṭrakharau| indrāgnī ityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, ajādyadantaṃ bhavati vipratiṣedhena||`ṛtunakṣatrāṇām` ityādi| ṛtūnāmānupūrvya prādurbhāvakṛtam, nakṣatrāṇāmudayakṛtam| ṛtunakṣatrāṇāmityatraiva varṇagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kṛtamiti paryanuyogadoṣamāśaṅkyāha - `samānākṣarāṇām` ityādi| asamānākṣarāṇāmapi varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa pūrvanipāta iṣyata iti pṛthagvacanam| ānupūrvyañca varṇānāṃ janmakṛtamiti lokavyavahāre prasiddham| prasiddhiśca śrutikṛtā| śrutau hi paṭhate `mukhate brāāhṛṇamasṛjat, bāhubhyāṃ rājanayam, ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyam, padbhyāṃ śūdram` iti| `saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ` iti dvandve ceti vaktavyam| `dvitrāḥ,tricaturāḥ` iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `navatiśatam` iti dvandvaḥ||`sarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ` iti| yatra guṇavacanena saha samāsaḥ so'sya viṣayaḥ| yatra tu dravyavācinā tatra sarvanāmaṃkhyayorviśeṣaṇatvādeva pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ|`saptamyāḥ pūrvanipāte` ityādi| saptamyantasya pūrvanipāte prāpte gaḍvādibhyaḥ paravacanaṃ kartavyamiti| saptamynataṃ paramucyate = kathyate yena vyākhyānena tat paravacanam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - āhitāderākṛtigaṇatvād gaḍukakaṇṭhaprabhṛtayastatraiva draṣṭavyāḥ,tena gaḍvādibhyaḥ paraṃ saptamyantaṃ bhaviṣyati| `kathaṃ vahegaḍuḥ` iti| yadi gaḍvādibhyaḥ saptamyāḥ paravacanamiti bhāvaḥ| `prāptasya ca bādhā vyākhyeyā` iti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[2.2.37]] ityato vāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena prāptasya paranipātasya bādhanaṃ bhaviṣyati||`nanu viśeṣaṇamevātra niṣṭhā` iti| kṛtaśabdaḥ kriyāśabdaḥ| kaṭaśabdo dravyavacanaḥ| tatra yathā guṇo dravyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ tathā kriyā'pi| tathā sati niṣṭhāntasya viśeṣaṇatvāt pūrveṇaiva pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ| kaṭekṛtamanenetyādinā vigrahabhedena niṣṭhāyā viśeṣaṇatvābhāvaṃ darśayati| atra vigrahe saptamyantameva viśeṣaṇam, niṣṭhāntaṃ viśeṣyam, sāmānādhikaraṇye hi kriyāguṇau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvau niyamenānubhavataḥ, na hi vaiyadhikaraṇye| tathā hi - paṭasya śuklaḥ, kākasya gatirityatra guṇāderviśiṣyetvam, vyavacchedyatvāt; dravyasya tu viśeṣaṇatvam, vyavacchedakatvāt| `niṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipāte` ityādi| jātyādibhyo niṣṭhāntaṃ paramucyate, tena tadvyākhyānaṃ kartavyam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - sāraṅgajagdhī-māsajātā-sukhajātādayaḥ śabdāḥ āhitāderākṛtigaṇatvāt tadantaḥpātinaḥ, tena jātikālasukhādibhyo niṣṭhāntaṃ paraṃ bhavatīti| `sāraṅgajagdhī` iti| sāraṅgaśabdo jātivacanaḥ| tataḥ <> [[4.1.51]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[4.1.53]] iti ṅīṣ| `kathaṃ kṛtakaṭaḥ` iti| kaṭaśabdasya jātivācitvāditi praśnaḥ| `prāptasya cābādhā vyākhyeyā` iti| tena kṛtakaṭa ityatra#āpi bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ| sā punaraprāptasya cābādhā pūrvavadeva vyākhyeyā| evamuttaratrāpi vyākhyeyā| `praharaṇārthebhyaḥ` ityādi| praharaṇamartho yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| tebhya pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - asyudyataḥ, daṇḍapāṇirityevamādināṃ śabdānāmāhitāgnyādiṣu pāṭhāt pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau bhavata iti||kaḍārādayo ye guṇaśabdāsteṣāṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ bhavatītyāha - `guṇaśabdānām` ityādi| gatārtham||iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃdvitīyādhyāyasyadvitīyaḥ pādaḥdadhāterhinotervā'nabhihita ityasya rūpam; samānatvāt, anekārthatvācca dhātūnām| na jñāyate kimarthasyānabhihitaśabdasya grahaṇamiti sandehaḥ syāt, atastaṃ nirākarttumāha - `anabhihite'nukte` ityādi| yadyanabhihite karmādau dvitīyādayo vibhaktayo bhavantīti sāmānyenocyeta; tato yathā `kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ` ityatra ktapratyayena karmaṇo'bhihitatvāt kaṭaśabdāddvitīyā na bhavati, tathā `kaṭaṃ karoti`, `bhīṣmamūdāraṃ śobhanaṃ darśanīyam` ityatra kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānayā dvitīyayā bhīṣmādigatasya karmaṇo'bhihitatvādbhīṣmādibhyo dvitīyā na prāpnoti| tasmāt kaścidviśeṣo'trābhimata iti matvā taṃ viśeṣaṃ pṛcchati - `kenānabhihitate`? iti| itaro viditābhiprāya āha - `tiṅakṛttaddhitasamāsaiḥ` ityādi| kriyata iti karmaṇi lakāraḥ| <> [[3.1.67]] | `riṅa śayagliṅaśu` [[7.4.28]] iti riṅādeśaḥ| `śatyaḥ, śatikaḥ` iti| <<śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate>> [[5.1.21]] iti ṭhanyatau bhavataḥ|`bahuṣu bahuvacanam` ityevamādi| tatredamuktam- karmādayo'vyapare vibhaktīnāṃ vācyāḥ, ata stadīye bahutve bahuvacanaṃ bhavatīti| evañca brāuvatā vṛttikṛtā karmādyāśritāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ dvitīyādayo vibhaktayo bhavantītyetaduktaṃ bhavati| na ca tatra kaścidviśeṣa upāttaḥ| santi ca karmādayo'bhihitāḥ, anabhihitāśca| tatra viśeṣānupādānta, yathā anabhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣvekatvādiṣu dvitīyādayo vibhaktayo bhavanti, tathā'bhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣvapi syuḥ| ato'nabhihitā ye karmādayastadāśrayeṣvekatvādiṣu yathā vibhaktayaḥ syuranyatra mā bhūvannityanabhihita ityetadviśeṣaṇamārabhyate| `anabhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣu` iti| anabhihitāḥ karmādaya āśrayā yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| etena <> [[1.4.21]] ityādeḥ śāstrasya, anabhihita ityetasya ca <> [[2.3.2]] ityevanamādibhiḥ sahaikavākyatāṃ darśayati - anabhihite karmaṇi dvitīyā bahuṣu bahuvacanamiti| evamanyatrāpyekavākyatā veditavyā| ekavākyatā ca guṇapradhānabhāvamantareṇa na sambhavatītyekasya guṇabhāvena bhavitavyam, aparasya pradhānabhāvena| tatra viśeṣaṇatvādanabhihita ityasya karmādyepekṣayā guṇabāvaḥ, karmādīnāṃ tu viśeṣyatvāt prādhānyam, ekatvādyapekṣayā karmādīnāntu viśeṣaṇatvādaprādhānyam| ekatvādīnāṃ viśeṣyatvāt pradhānabhāvaḥ| atha kathaṃ kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyā mīṣmādipadānugataṃ karmābhidadhāti, yathā - niṣṭheti cet? syādadat - `yathā kaṭaḥ kṛto bhīṣma udāraḥ śobhano darśanīya ityatra karoteḥ karmaṇyutpadyamānā niṣṭhā sarva bhīṣmādikamapi karmābhidadhāti,tathā kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyā` iti, vārtametat; kṛta iti kriyākārakasambandhanimittakabhidhānam| kriyā cotpadyamānā sāmarthyāt sarvāṇi kārakadravyāṇyākṣipati| tataḥ kṛña utpadyamānaḥ ktaḥ sādhāraṇatayā yāvat karoteruyāti karmatāṃ tāvat sarvamevābhidadhātīti yuktam| bhīṣmādigatāyā api karmatāyāḥ ktapratyayenābhidhānam| kaṭastu viśiṣṭadravyavacanaḥ, tata utpadyamānā dvitīyā tadgatameva karma śaknotyabhidhātum, nānyagataṃ kiñcit, tatkathaṃ tayā bhīṣmādigatamapi karmābhidhīyate? tathā ca nirarthakaṃ parigaṇanam| tasmāt tiṅakṛttaddhitasamāsairevābhidhānaṃ sambhavatīti sambhavadudāharaṇapradarśanamaparametat parisaṃkhyānaṃ veditavyam, na parigaṇanam||dvitīyā tiṅavibhaktirapyastīti tasyā apyatra grahaṇamiti kasyacidāṅkā syāt, atastannirākartumāha - `dvitīyādayaḥ śabdāḥ` ityādi| karmaśabdeneha sādhanaṃ karma gṛhrate, na tu kriyākarma| tathā hi - ye vibhaktyarthā ekatvādayasteṣāṃ viśeṣaṇatvenaiva karmādayo'nukraṃsyante| na ca kriyākarmaṇi dvitvabahutve staḥ; sādhanakarmaṇi tu vidyete, tasmāt tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, netarasya|`ubhasarvatasoḥ`ityādi| ubhasarvaśabdayostasipratyayāntayoḥ prayoge dvitīyāvibhaktiḥ kāryāḥ| śeṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaāṃ prāptāyāmayamārambhaḥ| ubhasarvatasorityatra yadyupyabhaśabdaḥ paṭhitastathāpi sāmarthyādubhayaśabdo gṛhrate; sādhamryāt| na hrubhaśabdastasipratyayānto'sti; tasya nitydavivacanaṭābviṣayatvāt| tathā coktam - `anyabhāvo ni#etyadvivucanaṭābviṣayatvādubhayo'nyatra` (1.1.28-vā|8,9) iti| `ubhayataḥ, sarvataḥ` iti| <> [[5.3.7]] | dhikśabdayoge'pi dvitīyā kāryā| tathoparyādiṣu triṣu yoge dvitīyā kāryā| `āmreḍitānteṣu`iti| kṛtadvirvacaneṣvityarthaḥ| `uparyuyari grāmam` ityādau <> [[8.1.7]] iti dvirvacanam| `tato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate` iti| yathoktādanyatrāpi dṛśyate dvitīyeti sambandhaḥ| kva cānyatra dṛśyata ityata āha - `abhitaḥ` ityādi| `prayabhibhyāñca` [[5.3.9]] iti tasiḥ| apiśabdo vikalpārthaḥ| api dṛśyate'pi na dṛśyateca| tena hā tāta hā mātarityādi sidhyati||`yavāgvā'gnahotraṃ juhoti` iti| yadyapyatra `supāṃ supo bhavanti` (vā|818) iti dvitīyāsthāne tṛtīyādeśavidhāne'pyetat sidhyati; tathāpi payasā juhoti, ājyena juhotītyevamādi na sidhyati| tathā hi - sthānivadbhāvāt `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] ityekasya luk prāpnoti| aparasya `ato'm` [[7.1.24]] ityambhāvaḥ||`antarāntareṇaśabdau nipātau sāhacaryādgṛhrete` iti| ayamantarāśabdo yadyapi strīpratyayānto'sti, tathā'strīpratyayānto'pi;antareṇaśabdastvastrīpratyayānto gṛhrate| yaścāstrīpratyayānto'ntarāśabdaḥ sa nipāta evetyantarāśabdasya tāvannipātasya grahaṇam| atastena nipātena sāhacaryādantareṇaśabdasyāpi tasyaiva grahaṇam| tenānipāto yastṛtīyānto'ntareṇaśabdaḥ, yaśca ṭābanto'ntarāśabdastābhyāṃ yoge dvitīyā na bhavati| kiṃ te bābhrāvāṇāṃ śālaṅkāyamānāñcāntareṇa gatena? grāmayorantarāyāṃ puri vasatītyantaraśabdo'tra viśeṣavacanaḥ| gamirapi jñānavacanaḥ| kiṃ te viśeṣaṇa jñānenetyarthaḥ| `ṣaṣṭhapavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ` iti|ra śeṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ ṣaṣaṭhaāṃ prāptāyāmasyārambhāt| ṣaṣṭhaāpavādatvamasya yogasyāntarāntareṇaśabdārthapradarśanadvāreṇa vispaṣṭīkarttumāha - `tatra` ityādi| madhyaṃ hi sambandhiśabdatvādamadhyabhūtaṃ dvitīyaṃ sambandhinamapekṣya bhavati| tatra yadapekṣaṃ madhyatvaṃ tato madhyena vyatireke samupajanite ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti| vinārtho'pi śeṣa eva| atrāpi ṣaṣṭhaeva prāpnoti| `antarā tvāñca māñca kamaṇḍaluḥ` iti| tava mama madhye kamaṇḍalurityarthaḥ| atha kamaṇḍaluśabdāddvitītā kasmānna bhavati? satyapyantarāntareṇayoge tasya prādhānyāt| tathā hi - kamaṇḍaloḥ svārthā pravṛttiḥ , yuṣmadasmadostu parārthā; kamaṇḍaluviśeṣaṇatvena tayoḥ pravṛttatvāt| tatra kamaṇḍaloḥ svārthe vartamānāt prādhānyenāvasthitvāt prātipadikārthādapracyutatvāt paratvāt prathamaiva bhavati| dvitīyāyāstvapradhāne yuṣmadasmacchabde'vakāśa iti tābhyāṃ teneva prathamāntena kamaṇḍalunopajanite vyatireke ṣaṣṭhaāṃ prāptāyāṃ dvitīyā vidhīyate| `antareṇa puruṣakāram` iti| vinā puruṣakāreṇetyarthaḥ| `antarā takṣaśilāṃ pāṭaliputrañca ruāughnasya prākāraḥ` iti| atra ruāughnaḥ prākāraviśeṣaṇatvenopakṣīṇasāmarthya iti na bhavati tsayāntarāśabdena yogaḥ||kālādhvanorityarthagrahaṇam| ata āha - `kālaśabdebhyo'dhvaśabdebhyaśca` ityādi| `māsasya dviradhīte| krośasyaikadeśe parvataḥ| yojanasyaikadeśe parvataḥ` iti| nātra `kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge` iti dvitīyā bhavati||`apavargaḥ`iti| atyantasaṃyogasya phalarūpametadviśeṣaṇamupāttam| tacca kriyātyantasaṃyogasyaiva sambhavati, nānyasyati sāmarthyādatra kriyātyantasaṃyoga eva gṛhrate| sarvasyāśca kriyāyāḥ parisamāptirasti; tasmādviśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt phalaprāptau satyāṃ kriyāyāḥ parisamāptirihāpavargo vijñāyata ityata āha - `phalaprāptau` ityādi| `karttṛvyāvṛtau` iti| na hi māsamadhīto'nuvāko na cānena gṛhīta ityukte'pavargo gamyate, kiṃ tarhi? kartturaśaktimātram| na ca tatrāpavargavyapadeśaḥ||`adya bhuktvā devadatto dvyahe bhoktā, dvyahādbhoktā` iti| nanu cātra eka eva kartā, kārakabhede sati tannibandhano madhyavyayapadeśo bhavati, tat kathamasati kārakabhede kārakayormadhye kālo bhavatītyata āha - `karttṛśaktyoḥ`ityādi| na hi dravyaṃ kārakam, kiṃ tarhi? śaktiḥ, sā ceha bhidyate| tathā hi - devadatte dve śaktī vyavasthite; ekādya bhujeḥ sādhanam, aparā dvyahe'tītīti karttṛśaktibhede sati yukto madhyavyapadeśaḥ| `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ` ityādi| iṣvāsaḥ kartā, lakṣyaṃ karma| `karmāpādānayoḥ` iti| karma tadeva| apādānaṃ yataḥ paro niryāti| `karmādhikaraṇayorvā` iti| ihetyanena yannirdiśyatetadadhikaram| karma ca tadeva| `tayormadhye krośaḥ` iti| krośasyehāpādānādhikaramatvābhāvāt saptamīpañcamyau na bhavatiḥ| na hi krośāccharo'paiti, kiṃ tarhi? tadekadeśāt| nāpi krośe vyavasthitaṃ lakṣyam, kiṃ tarhi? tadekadeśa eva| tasmāt krośasya śeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhaāṃ prāptāyāṃ saptamīpañcamyau vidhīyete| athātra saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati? yāvatā kālādhvanau hi dvau, saptamīpañcamyāvapi dva, ata eva sāmāt saṃkhyātanudeśena bhavitavyam- kālāt saptamī, adhvanaḥ pañcamītyata āha - `saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ` ityādi| <> [[1.3.11]] ityatra svariteneti yogavibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ, tata pūrveṇāpi sambadhyate| yatra svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate tatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yathā syāt| iha tu svaritatvaṃ nāsti, ato na bhavati saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ||`śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣat` iti| <> [[1.4.84]] iti karmapravacanayīsaṃjñā|`upakhāryāṃ droṇaḥ` iti| khāryā adhiko droṇa ityarthaḥ| <<upo'dhike ca>> [[1.4.87]] ityupaśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā| `yasya ceāravacanam` iti| yasya ceāravyapadeśa ityarthaḥ| īāravyadeśastu svāmina eva sambhavati| tatraiva saptamyā bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrānti syāt, atastānnirākarttumāha - `yasya ceāravacanam` ityādi| yasya ceāravacanamityanena dvayorapi = svasvāminoḥ paryāyeṇa saptamī bhavatīti| katham, yāvatā `adhirīśvare` [[1.4.96]] ityanenādhikaśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā, īārastu svamī, sa ca svamapekṣya bhavati? svasvāmisambandhe'dhiśabdaḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjño bhavati| tatra kadācit svāmī karmapravacanīyavibhaktayā yujyate, kadācit svamityetat pratipāditaṃ prāgeva| kathaṃ punaryasya ceāravacanamityucyamāne svamapi karmapravacanīyavibhaktyā yujyate, na hi tasyeāravyapadeśo'sti? evaṃ tarhi anuktasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ kriyate, tena yasyeāravyapadeśo nāsti tatrāpi saptamī vijñāyata ityadoṣaḥ||apapariśabdayoḥ <> [[1.4.88]] ityanena karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā, āṅaśca <<āṅ maryādāvacane>> [[1.4.89]] ityanena| `vṛkṣaṃ pari vidyotate` iti| pariḥ <> [[1.4.90]] ityādinā||`mukhyasadṛśaḥ pratinidhiḥ` iti| mukhyo yaḥ kaścit kārye rūḍhaḥ = samarthaḥ, prasiddhaḥ = pradhānabhūtastena sadṛśo yastadabhāve tasya kāryasya siddhyarthamupādīyate sa pratinidhiḥ| `abhimanyurarjunataḥ prati` iti| mukhyādarjunādabhimanyuḥ pratinidhistataḥ pañcamīvibhaktirbhavati| pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ| `māṣānasmai tilebhyaḥ pratiyacchati` iti| ye tilāḥ pūrvaṃ dattāstebhyo māṣāṇāṃ pratidānam| tilebhya iti pañcamī bhavati| tilān gṛhītvā māṣān dadātītyarthaḥ|nanu ca <> [[1.4.92]] iti prateḥ pratinidhipratidānarorevārthayoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tayoreva pratinā yoga upapadyate, na tu yataste tasyeti manyamāna āha - `nanu ca` ityādi| `sambandhasambandhāt` iti| sambadhyata iti sambandhaḥ=pratinidhiḥ, pratidānañca, tadubhayamayi karmapravacanīyena pratinā yujyate| tena sambandhena yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa sambandhasambandhaḥ| kasyapunastena sambandhaḥ? yataḥ pratinidhiḥ pratipādanañca tasya| sambandhiśabdau hi pratinidhipratidānaśabdau| tau ca nāsati pūrvavijñāte mukhye pūrvadatte ca bhavatīti pratinidhipratidānābhyāṃ yasya sambandhastasya tābhyāṃ sambandho'stīti te api karmapravacanīyairyukte bhavata iti| kvacit `sambandhisambandhāt` iti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāpi pratinidhiḥ hūtidānañca sambandhiśabdenocyate; tadubhayasyāpi karmapravacanīyena sambandhāt| tena sambandhinā yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa sambandhisambandha iti sa evārthaḥ||yadi kriyāmātramiha ceṣṭāśabdenocyate tadā ceṣṭāgrahaṇamapārthakam| sarvo hi dhātuḥ kriyāvacanaḥ| tasmādviśeṣaṇaṃ pādānasāmarthyāt parispandavacano'yaṃ ceṣṭāśabdo vijñāyate, ityāha - `parispandakriyāṇām` iti| parispandaḥ = śarīravyāpāraḥ, sā kriyā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| `adhvanītyarthagrahaṇam` iti| arthapradhānatvannirdeśasya, saptamīnirdeśācca| yadīha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt `anadhvanaḥ` iti kuryāt| `āsthitapratiṣedhaścāyaṃ {vijñeyaḥ- kāśikā|} vijñāyate iti| yena deśaviśeṣeṇa prāpyaṃ grāmādikaṃ prāpyate sa deśaviśeṣo loke'dhveti rūḍhaḥ| kena ca prāpyaṃ prāpyate? yaḥ panthā ākrāntastena| tasmāt tasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| yadā tu sa evotpathena prāpyate tadā tasya patho'dhvavyapadeśo na bhavatīti bhavatyeva tatra caturthī| `dvitīyāgrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| karmaṇi kārake caturthyāṃ vikalpitāyāṃ pakṣe nyāyaprāptaiva dvitīyeti bhāvaḥ| tat kriyate bādhakabādhanārtham| `apavādaviṣaye'pi yathā syāt` iti| athārthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na gatikarmaṇītyevocyeta, yāvatā gatirartha eva? naitadasti; yā gatirgaminaiva śabdāntarasannidhānādyanapekṣatayocyate tatra yathā syāt| pādaviharaṇātmikā ca yā gatiḥ pradhānabhūtā tasyā evagrahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| teneha na bhavati - striyaṃ gacchati, ajāṃ grāmaṃ nayati| atra hi gamema~thunamathaḥ strīśabdasannidhānādgamyate, na tu gameḥ kevalāt| nayateśca prāpaṇamevārthaḥ pradānabhūtaḥ, tadviśeṣaṇantu prādavihaṇamapradhānam| yadyevam,grāmaṃ gamayati grāmāya gamayatīti ṇante guṇabhūtatvādgamarna sidhyati, gameratra preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādiko hrarthaḥ prādhānyamanugacchati, naiṣa doṣaḥ ; na hyatra grāmo ṇyantasya karma, kiṃ tarhi? gamereva||`devadattāya rocate` iti| <> [[1.4.33]] iti saṃpradānasaṃjñā| `puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhrati` iti| atra <> [[1.4.36]] ityanena|`tādarthye upasaṃkhyānam` iti| tacchabdena catuthryantasyārtho nirdiśyate| tasmā idaṃ tadartham, tasya bhāvastādathryam| tatra catuthryā upasaṃkhyānam = pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `caturthī` iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena tādarthye caturthī bhavatīti| athavā <> [[2.1.36]] iti tādarthye caturthyāḥ samāsavacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhavati - tādarthye'pi caturthīti|`kḷpi sampadyamāne` ityādi| kḷptyarthānāṃ dhānūnāṃ prayoge sampadyamāne kartari saṃpādanakriyāviśiṣṭe caturthī vaktavyā, vyākhyeyetyarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tameva yogavibhāgamāśritya| tathā `utpātena jñāpyamāne` ityādāvapi| `mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūḥ` iti| yavāgūrmūtravikārarūpeṇa bhavatītyarthaḥ| vikārarūpāpattau caturtī vijñeyā| teneha na bhavati - devadattasya śālayaḥ saṃpadyanta iti| yadā cābhedavivakṣā tadā paratvāt prathamaiva bhavati, na caturthī - mūtramidaṃ saṃpadyate yavāgūriti, uccāro'yaṃ sampadyate yavaudana iti| yadā tu `janikarttṛḥ prakṛtiḥ` [[1.4.30]] iti prakṛterapādānātvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā yavāgvā iti pañcamyeva syāt - mūtraṃ sampadyate yavāgvā iti| `vātāya kapilā vidyut` iti| atra kapilāvidyudutpāto vātasya lakṣaṇam| tena jñāpyamāne vāte caturthī bhavati| `arocakine` iti| <> [[5.2.115]] itīniḥ||`kriyārthā kriyopapadaṃ yasya` ityādi| kathaṃ punarayamartho labhyate, yāvatā neha sūtre dvitīyaṃ kriyāgrahaṇamupāttamastītyāha - `tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām` [[3.3.10]] ityasmin viṣaye kriyārthopapadaṃ sambhavatīti yadatra kriyārthopapadaṃ tat kriyaiveti gamyate| `sthāninaḥ`iti| śabdāstiṣṭhantyasminniti sthānam| tadasyāstīti sthāni| etaduktaṃ bhavati - yasyārthaḥ pratīyate, na tu prayogo'sti, sa sthānītyucyata iti|`edhebhyo vrajati`iti| āṅapūrvo haratiratra sthānī, tatkarma tvedhāḥ| edhānāharttu vrajatītyarthaḥ| nanu cātra tādathryamasti, atastādathryaṃ ityevaṃ siddhā caturthī, tatkimarthaṃmidaṃ vananam? niyamārtham- sthānino'prayujyamānasyaiva karmaṇi yathā syāt, prayujyamānas mā bhūt| `bhakṣiratra sthānī` iti| praviśa gṛhaṃ piṇḍīṃ bhakṣayeti gamyamānatvāt| praviśa tarpaṇamityatrāpi pibatiḥ sthānī| `na tu kriyārthopapadaḥ` iti| tumunnādiviśiṣṭapratyayānto hi kriyārthopapado bhavati| ayantu loḍantaḥ| na ca loṭ kriyārthopapade vidhīyata iti na bhavati bhakṣiratra kriyārthopapadaḥ||`tumunā samānārthaḥ` iti| vṛttau gamyamānatvāt samānaśabdo na prayuktaḥ| `tumarthabhāvavacanapratyayāntāt` iti| tumartho bhāvavacanapratyayo'nto yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `bhāvavacanāśceti vakṣyati, tasyedaṃ grahaṇam` iti| sa eva hi tumartho bhāvavacanaḥ sambhavati, nānyaḥ| `pākāya vrajati` iti| yadyapyatra tādathryaṃ gamyate tathāpi caturthī na bhavati; tasminneva tādathryaṃ vihitena bhāvapratyayena tasyoktatvāt,yathā - pācako vrajatītyatra na bhavati| tena caturthīvidhānārthamidamārabdham| atha vā - bhāvavacanādeva yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt - pācako vrajatīti niyamārthaṃmetat| `pākaḥ, tyāgaḥ, rāgaḥ` iti bhāve ghañ| nanu ca kriyārthopapadagrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate, tadarthādvibhaktervipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvaivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate - kriyārthopapadādbhāvavacanāditi| yastu kriyārthopapado bhāvavacanaḥ sa tumartha eveti kiṃ tumarthagrahaṇena? naitadasti; na hi kriyārthopapadagrahaṇaṃ bhāvavacanasya viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati| kiṃ tarhi? dhātoreva| tasmāt tumarthagrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva| `kārako vrajati`iti - `tumunṇvulau` [[3.3.10]] iti ṇvul| bhavatyayaṃ tumartho na tu bhāvavacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? karttṛvacanaḥ, tena tadantānna bhavati||`alamiti paryāptyarthasya grahaṇam` iti| <> [[5.1.101]] ityalaṃśabdasamānārthena prabhavatiśabdena yoge caturthīnirdeśālliṅgāt| nanu cāsmālliṅgādarthasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na tu śabdasyetyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate; na tu paryāptyarthasyetyeṣo'rthaḥ| tathā ca bhūṣaṇapratiṣedayorapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| evañca kanyāmalaṃkurute, alaṃ bāle rodanenetyādāvapi caturthī syāt; naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, katham? kanyāmalaṅakurute ityatra `upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī` (cāṃ|pa|69) iti <> [[2.3.2]] iti dvitīyayaiva bhavitavyam| `alaṃ bāle rodanena` ityatrāpyata eva hetoḥ karaṇe tṛtīyayaiva| atra hi rodanaṃ karaṇabhāvamāpannameva pratiṣedhena sambadhyata iti sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasya grahaṇaṃ sampadyate| `cakāraḥ punarasyaiva samuccayārthaḥ` iti| yadetannamaḥprabhṛtiyoge caturthīvidhānaṃ tatsamuccayārthaścakāraḥ| tena punarvidhnāt `caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣya` [[2.3.73]] ityādināśīrvivakṣāyāṃ pakṣe yā ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate tāmapi bādhitvā caturthyeva bhavati| yadyavam, kārakavibhaktimapi bādhitvā `kanyāmalaṅkurute` ityādau caturthyeva syāt, tataśca yaduktam- sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti, tannopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; kārakavibhakterbalīyastvāt, punarvidhānasya cānyatra caritārthatvāt| atha vā - vakṣyamāṇā vibhāṣā siṃhāvalokitanyāyenehāpyupatiṣṭhate| tena `kanyāmalaṅkurute ityādau caturtī na bhavati||`anādarastiraskāraḥ` iti| atraivānādaraśabdasya rūḍhatvāt| tiraskāraḥ = paribhavaḥ, avajñānamityarthaḥ| ` na tvā tṛṇāya manye` iti| tṛṇādapi nikṛṣṭataraṃ tvāmahaṃ ityarthaḥ| ` vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ` iti| `manikarmaṇi` iti kasmānnoktam? eva hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavatīti? `mana jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1176) ityasya daivādikasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, `manu bodhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1471) ityasya tānādikasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartho vikaraṇanirdeśa iti darśayitumāha- `na tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manve` iti|`aśmānaṃ dṛṣadaṃ manye` ityādau yathāvyavasthitasya vastunaḥ svarūpamāviṣkriyata ityatrānādaro na gamyate| `yedatadaprāṇiṣviti tadanāvādiṣviti vaktavyam` iti| aprāṇigrahaṇapanīyanāvādigrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| yathānyāse hi na tvā nāvaṃ manya ityatra caturthī syāt| na tvā śune manya ityatra caturthī na syādityabhiprāyaḥ||`tṛtīyāvidhāne {prakṛtayādīnāmitivṛttau pāṭhaḥ} prakṛtyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam` iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam? na siddhyati, karttṛkaraṇayorabhāvāt| tayostvabhāvaḥ prakṛtyā'bhirūpa ityādau kriyāyā avidyamānatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| prātipadikenātra sambandamātraṃ pratīyate, na tu kācana kriyā| na ca tayā vinā karttṛkaraṇe sambhavataḥ; tayoḥ kriyāpekṣatvāt| tataśca sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt - prakṛterabhirūpaḥ, prāyasya yājñikaḥ, gotrasya gāgrya iti| `samena dhāvati, viṣameṇa dhāvati` iti| yadyapyatra kriyā'pyasti, tathā'pi nātra samaviṣamaśabdau karaṇatvena vivakṣitau, kiṃ tarhi? karmatvena, tataśca dvitīyā syāt| `dvidroṇena dhānyaṃ krīṇāti` ityādāvapi dvidroṇātyeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ| `pañcakena paśūn krīṇāti` iti| pañca parimāṇamasya paśusaṃghasya pañcakaḥ saṅghaḥ| pañcakaṃ saṅghaṃ kṛtvā paśūn krīṇātītyarthaḥ| evaṃ `sāharuoṇāāān krīṇāti`iti sāharuāṃ saṅghaṃ kṛtvā| saharuāṃ saharuāṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanārthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - pratīyamānā'pi kriyā kārakāṇāṃ nimittaṃ bhavatyeva| iha ca prakṛtyā'bhirūpa ityatrāpi karotyartho bhavatyartho vā gamyate| gāgryo'smi gotreṇetyatrāpi jñāne bhavane vā gamyamāne gotrasya karaṇatvaṃ pratīyate| samena dhāvatītyadau samena viṣameṇa vā pathā karaṇeneti gamyate| dvidroṇenetyatrāpi tṛtīyā na karmatvaṃ bodhayati| kiṃ tarhi? karaṇatvam| atra hi dvidroṇādyarthaṃ hiraṇyādikaṃ mūlyabhūtaṃ tādathryāddvidroṇādiśabdenoktam| tasyāpi karaṇatvamastyeveti karaṇa ityevaṃ sarvatra tṛtīyā siddhyati||kriyāguṇadravyasambandhe hi sati sahayogo bhavati| ataḥ `putreṇa sahāgataḥ` ityādīni kriyādisambandhe yathākramudāharaṇāni vṛttikṛtopanyastāni| sarvatra ca putrasyātrāpradhānyamiti tatastṛtīyā bhavati| nanu cobhayorapi pitāputrayoḥ kriyādisambandhaḥ pratīyate, tatkutaḥ putrasyāprādhānyamitarasya pradhānabhāva ityāha - `pituratra` ityādi| `yadypyubhayagataḥ kriyādisambandhaḥ pratīyate, tathā'pyupāttaśabdavyāpārāpakṣayā pradhānāpradhānavyavasthāḥ - śabdena yasya kriyādisambandhaḥ pratyāyyate tat pradhānamitaradapradhānamiti| iha tu piturava kriyādisaṃbandhaḥ pratyāyyate śabdena, na tu putrasya| kuta etat? śabdaśaktasvābhāvyāt| tathāvidhā hi śabdaśaktiryataḥ piturevātra kriyādisambandhaṃ śnoti pratipādayitum, na putrasyeti; evañcāgata ityādavekavacanamupapadyate; anyathā hi dvitvāddvivacanaṃ syāt, yathā - pitatāputrāvāgatāviti| `putrasya tu pratīyamānatvādaprādhānyam` iti| arthātsa punararthaḥ sahārthayogaḥ| sa ca bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt putrasya kriyādisambandhamantareṇa na sambhavatīti sambandhasya nāntarīyakatvāt putrasyāpi kriyādisambandhaṃ pratyāyayati| `sahārthena yoge tṛtīyāvidhānāt` iti| kutaḥ punaretadavagataṃ sahārthena yoge tṛtīyāvidhānamiti? yuktagrahaṇāt| tasya caitadeva prayojanam - sahārthena yoge tṛtīyā yathā syāt, nānyat| `śiṣyeṇa sahopādhyāyasya gauḥ` iti| atra dravyasambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhaaivopādhyāyasyocyata ityasya prādhānyāt| tatrāsatyapradhānagrahaṇe pradhāne'pyupādhyāye syāt| nanu ca paratvāt ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati? na bhaviṣyati; aśeṣatvāt| sati tvapradhānagrahaṇe śeṣo'yaṃ sampadyata iti ṣaṣṭhī||ayamaṅgaśabdo'vayave prasiddhaḥ| sa yadi tatraiva vartamāna iha gṛhrate tadā'traiva syāt - akṣi kāṇamasyeti; atra hrakṣṇaḥ śarīrāvayavasya vikāraḥ kāṇena guṇena dyotyata iti| iha tu na syāt - akṣṇā kāṇa iti| na hyatrāvayavasyākṣṇo vikāro lakṣyate, kiṃ tarhi? aṅganaḥ samudāyasyetyata āha - `aṅgaśabdo'tra`ityādi| aṅgamasyāstītyaṅgaḥ, arśa āditvādacpratyayānto'ṅgaśabda upātta iti darśayati; aṅgino'ṅgāpekṣatvāt| yadapekṣayā'ṅgino'ṅgitvaṃ tadeva yenetyanena nirdiśyata iti darśayitumāha - `yena` ityādi| vikṛteneti sāmarthyāllabdhamarthaṃ darśayati| na hravikṛtenāṅganino'ṅgena vikāro lakṣyate| `lakṣyate` iti| dyotyata ityarthaḥ| `akṣṇā kāṇaḥ` iti| atrākṣṇā'vayavena vikṛtenāṅgino devadattasya vikāro lakṣyata iti tatsatṛtīyā| vibhaktirbhavati| kathaṃ punaravayavena vikṛtena samudāyastathā vyapadiśyata ityāha - `avayavadharmeṇa` ityādi| yāthā'ḍhamidaṃ nagaramityavayavadharmeṇāḍhatvenātra samudāyo vyapadiśyate, tathehāpyavayavena vikṛtana samudāyo vyapadiśyata iti| kathaṃ punaratrākṣiśabdasya prayogaḥ kriyate, yāvatā vinā'pi tena kāṇatvaṃ guṇaḥ samudāyasya prata#īyata eva? satyametat; laukike śabdaprayoge gurulāghanaṃ pratyanādarāt| yastu tadādriyate so'kṣiśabdaṃ na prayuṅkta eva|`akṣi kāṇamasya` iti| atrāsatyaṅgagrahaṇe kāṇaśabdāt tṛtīyā syāt| lakṣyate hi kāṇatvena guṇenākṣṇo vikāraḥ samudāyasyāvayavasya||kañcit prakāramityanena ityamityasyārthamācaṣṭe| tathā hi prakāravacane <> [[5.3.24]] iti thamupratyaye vihite itthamityedrūpaṃ bhavati| sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāra ucyate| āpanna ityanena bhūtaśabdsayārthamācaṣṭe| tathā hi - `bhū prāptāvātmanepadī` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1844) ityasya caurādikasya `ā dhṛṣādvā` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-805) ityasyānantaram) iti yadā ṇij nāsti tadā ktapratyaye `bhūta` iti rūpaṃ bhavati| tasyetītvambhūtasya| `lakṣaṇam` iti| lakṣyate cihnyate'neneti lakṣaṇam = cihnam| `api bhavān kamaṇḍalunā chātramādrākṣīt` iti| atra manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, tasya cchātratvaṃ prakāraḥca; taṃ prāptasya cchātrasya kamaṇḍalurlakṣaṇam| `chātreṇopādhyāyam` iti| manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, tasyopādhyāyatvaṃ prakāraḥ; taṃ prāptasyopādhyāyasya lakṣaṇaṃ chātraḥ| `śikhayā parivrājakam` iti| manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, parivrājakatvaṃ prakāraḥ| taṃ prāptasya parivrājakasya lakṣaṇaṃ śikhā|`lakṣaṇasya samāse'ntarbhūtatvāt` iti| ekārthībhāvad bahuvrīhrarthena lakṣaṇārthasyāpṛthagbhāvādityarthaḥ| bahuvrīhāveva vācyatvenāntarbhāvo lakṣaṇasyeti gatārthatvāt tṛtīyā na bhavati| itthambhūtalakṣaṇa iti kim? vṛkṣaṃ pari vidyotate vidyut| nātra vidyotanatvaprāptasya kasyacidvṛkṣeṇa lakṣaṇam| kiṃ tarhi? vidyotanasyaiva||`mātrā sañjānīte` iti| `jñānanorjā` [[7.3.79]] iti jādeśaḥka, <<ī halyaghoḥ>> [[6.4.113]] itītvam, `saṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne` [[1.3.46]] ityātmanepadam| ādhyāne tu <> [[2.3.52]] iti paratvāt ṣaṣṭhī bhavati - mātuḥ sañjānātīti| kṛtprayoge cānādhyāne'pi `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti paratvāt ṣaṣṭhaeva bhavati - saṃjñāteti||heturdvividhaḥ - śāstrīyaḥ,laukikaśca| tatra śāstrīyaḥ <> [[1.4.55]] | laukikaḥ phalasādhanayogyaḥ padārthaḥ| tatra śāstrīye hetau `karttṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā` [[2.3.18]] ityevaṃ siddhā tṛtīyā| tasmāllaukikasya hetoridaṃ grahaṇamityata āha - `phalasādhanayogyaḥ` ityādi| aniṣpādayannapi phalaṃ tāsāśanayogyaḥ padārtho loke heturityucyata iti yogyagrahaṇam| `dhanena kulam` ityādau kulādīnyakurvantyapi dhanādīni tatkaraṇayogyatayā loke hetuvaypabadeśamāsādayantīti tebhyastṛtīyā| iha yūpāya dārviti sadapi dāruṇo hetutvaṃ na vivakṣitam| kiṃ tarhi? kāraṇasyānyathātvam| tena tādarthye caturthī bhavati||`śatena bandhitaḥ`iti| bandheṇryantasya niṣṭhāyāmetadrūpam| `śatamṛṇañca bhavati`iti| uttamarṇāya deyatvāt| prayojakatvāt karttṛsaṃjñeti, <> [[1.4.55]] iti cakārāt karttṛsaṃjñāvidhānāt| nanu laukiko hetuḥ pūrvasūtre gṛhītaḥ, sa cehānuvartata iti tata eva pañcamī vidhīyate, na cātra laukiko hetuḥ, kiṃ tarhi? pāribhāṣika iti prāptyabhāvādakartarīti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ? naitadasti;tatra hi śāstrīye hetau tṛtīyā siddheveti laukikasya hetaugrrahaṇam, iha tu pañcamī vidhīyate| na cātarāsau śāstrīye hetau kenacit sidhyati| dvāvapīha hetū gṛhrete| atha vā śāstrīyasyāpi hetorlaukikaṃ hetutvamaviruddhameva| yo hi bandhane prayuṅkte sa tatsādhanayogyo bhavatyeva||`dhanena kulam` iti| dhanaṃ dravyam, na guṇaḥ| dravyāśrito hi guṇo bhavati, na dravyameva ! guṇaśabdena cātra sambandhimātraṃ parārtharūpāpannamucyate, tenāgniratra dhūmādityādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati| nanu cāstriyāmityucyate, tena nāstīha ghaṭo'nupalabdherityādi na sidhyati? naitadasti;`vibhāṣā guṇe` iti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ|tena yatreṣyate tatraya yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddhiriti striyāmapi bhavatyeva||prayogasya śabdadharmatvāt heturityanena hetuśabda eva vijñāyata ityata āha - `{hetuśabdasya prayoge - kāśikā} hetuśabdaprayoge` iti| evañca hetuśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇe sati tatparyāṇāṃ nimittakāraṇādīnāṃ prayoge ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatīti kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā śeṣavivakṣayaivātrādhyayanādibhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati, tatsamānādhikaraṇyācca hetuśabdādapi? evaṃ tarhi saiva śeṣavivakṣā'smin viṣaye vacanenākhyāyate mandadhiyāmanugrahāya||`nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ vibhaktīnāṃ prāyadarśanam` iti| etaccakārasyānukkatasamuccayārthatvallabhyata iti veditavyam|yadarthagrahaṇametata kasmāt paryāyopādānaṃ kṛtamitmāha - `paryāyopādānam` ityādi| asati paryāyagrahaṇa etat svarūpagrahaṇamiti kasyacidbhrānti syāt| atastannirākarttu paryāyagrahaṇam||`vṛkebhyo bibheti` iti| <> [[1.4.25]] ityapādānatvam| adhyayanāt parājayata ityatra <> [[1.4.26]] ityapādānatvam| `viparābhyāñjeḥ` [[1.3.19]] ityātmanepadam|`pañcamīvidhāne ityādi| yadetat pañcamīvidhānamatra lyablope pañcamo syādityupasaṃkhyānam = vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - iha pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvartate| sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena lyablope karmaṇi pañcamī bhaviṣyati|`adhikaraṇe copasaṃkhyānam` ityādi| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu pūrvavaccakārānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya kartavyam|`praśnākhyānayośca` ityādi| vaktavyeti vyākhyātavyetyarthaḥ| vyākhyānantu tāmeva cakārānuvṛttimāśritya kartavyam| atha vā - atrāpādāna ityevaṃ siddhā pañcamī| tathā hi kuto bhavānitytarāgacchatīti pratīyate, pāṭaliputrādityatrāpyagacchāmīti; ataḥ sphuṭamevāpādānatvam|`yataścāṣvakāla` ityādi| yataḥ prabhṛtyadhvanaḥ kālasay nirmāṇamiyattāparicchedastatra pañcamī vaktavyā| etaduktaṃ bhavati - adhvani kāle ca nirmīyamāṇe yadavaśribhūtatvena vivakṣyate tatra pañcamī vaktavyā = vyākhyeyā| vyākhyānantu pūrvavaccākārānuvṛttimāśritya kartavyam| atha vā- adhvani nirmīyamāṇe apādāna ityevaṃ siddhā pañcamī| tathā hi - gavīdhumataḥ sāṅkāśyaṃ catvāri yojanānītyatra niḥsṛtyeti kriyā gamyate| ato yuktamevāpādānatvam| kārttikyā āgrahāyaṇī māsa ityatrāpi pareṇeti śabdo gamyate| tatrottarasūtreṇa digyolakṣaṇā pañcamī bhaviṣyati|`tadyuktātkāle` ityādau tadityanena pañcamī sambadhyate| pañcamīyuktāt paro yaḥ kālastatra saptamī vaktavyā = vyākhyeyā| vyākhyānaṃ tu kārttikyā āgrahāyaṇī māsa ityatra `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam` [[2.3.37]] ityanena saptamī siddhā| kārttikyāḥ paro yo māsastatsattayā''grahāyaṇyā bhāvo lakṣyate|`adhvanaḥ prathamā` ityādi| tadyuktāditi vartate| tatra yadā sāṅkāśyasya yojanādabhedo vivakṣyate tadā prathamā| `gavīṣumataḥ sāṅkāśyaṃ catvāri yojanāni` iti| bhedavivakṣāyāntu `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam` [[2.3.37]] iti saptamī| tathā hi gavīdhumataḥ sāṃkāśyaṃ caturṣu yojaneṣu gateṣu satsu bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate| tatra yojanasya sambandhi sambandhi gamanaṃ sāṅkāśyabhāvasya lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati||`anya ityarthagrahaṇam` iti| arthadvāraka eva hi śabdasya śabdāntaraṇe yogo bhavati| tasmādarthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tenetyādinā'rthagrahaṇasya phalaṃ darśayati| athānyo devadattādyajñadatta iti yajñadattaśabdādapi pañcamī kasmānna bhavati? devadattādutpannayā pañcamyobhayagatasyāpyanyatvasya pratipāditvāt tadviśiṣṭamanyatvamekata evotpādyamānayā pañcamyā śakyaṃ pratipādayitumiti dvitīyasambandhinaḥ pañcamī na bhavati|`itara iti nirdiśyamānasya pratiyogī padārtha ucyate` iti|yathā kvacitprakaraṇe dvau prakṛtau - devadattaḥ, anyaśca kaścit| tatraikastāvannirdiśyate - devadattaḥ śūra iti| tasya nirdiśyamānasya yo'sau dvitīyaḥ sambandhī pratiyogī sa itaraśabdenocyate, yathā - itaraḥ kātara iti| `śabdagrahaṇamityādi| śabdagrahaṇe sati diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda iteṣo'rtho labhyate| tena yo'pi samprati dikśabdo deśe kāle ca vartate, so'pi diśi duṣṭa iti tadyoge pañcamī bhavati| tatra deśavṛttinā pañcamī - pūrvo grāmāt parvata iti| kālavṛttinā'pi - pūrvo grīṣmādvasanta iti| `itarathā hi digvṛttinaiva yoge syāt` iti| tatraiva dikśabdasya mukhyatvāt|`prāggrāmāt` iti| prapūrvādañcaterṛtvigādisūtreṇa [[3.2.59]] kvinpratyayaḥ| tadantādyadādiśabdebhyaḥ `saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo digdeśakāla` [[5.3.27]] ityādinā vihitasya stāteḥ <> [[5.3.30]] iti luk; luki kṛte tadedamudāharaṇam| `dakṣiṇā grāmāduttarā grāmāt| `dakṣiṇāhi grāmāduttarāhi grāmāt` iti| `dakṣiṇādāca` <<āhi ca dūre>> [[5.3.37]] <> [[5.3.38]] ityājāhī pratyayau||vikalpena pañcamyāṃ vihitāyāṃ pakṣe śeṣatvādeva yadyapi sidhyati, tathā'pi tadiha ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat `caturthī cāśiṣya` [[2.3.73]] ityādinā''śiṣi yā caturthī vidhīyate tāmapi bādhitvā ṣaṣṭhaeva yathā syādityevamartham - dūraṃ hitaṃ grāmasya, antikaṃ hitaṃ grāmasyeti| nanu cānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ prakṛte punaranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamityāha - `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam` ityādi| yadīhānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā pakṣe tṛtīyā syāt; tasyā evānantarasūtre śrutatvāt| punaranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ pañcamīvidhānārthaṃ vijñāyate; prayojanāntarābhāvāt| tathā hi - tṛtīyāvikalpārthaṃ tāvadetanna bhavati| tṛtīyāvikalpo hi pūrvakeṇānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sidhyati| na cānyā kācidvabhaktiḥ prakṛtā, kiṃ tarhi? pañcamī| tasmāt pañcamīvikalpārthametadvijñāyate||`{evamprakārakaṃ vākyaṃ vṛttau nāsti}pañcamī ca` iti| tadanuvṛttisāmarthyāt| `tṛtīyā'pi samuccīyate` iti| cakāreṇa| `yathāyatham` iti| yathāsvaṃ yo yasyātmīyo viṣayastatrāsau bhavati, na vibhaktyantaramityarthaḥ||`dūrāntikārthebhyaścataruāo vibhaktayo bhavanti` iti| pūrvasūtreṇa dvitīyādayastiruāḥ, anena saptamī|`saptamīvidhāne ktasyenviṣayasya` ityādi| inviṣayo yaḥ ktastadīye karmaṇi saptamī| vidheyā| kaścenviṣaḥ ktaḥ? yastadantastenaiva saha prayujyata ityarthaḥ| ananyatrabhāvārthatvādatra viṣayaśabdasya| `adhītī vyākaraṇe` iti| adhītaṃ vyākaraṇamaneneti| <<śrāddhamanena bhuktaminiṭhanau>> [[5.2.85]] ityato'nenetyanuvartamāne <> [[5.2.86]] ityata inirityanuvartamāne ca <> [[5.2.88]] itīnipratyayaḥ| atra yadyapi karmaṇyeva kto vihitastathāpi taddhita utpanne'dhītavyākaraṇorabhisambandho nivartate| asti ca dhātvarthasya vyākaraṇena sambandha iti karmaiva vyākaraṇaṃ bhavatītyato dvitīyā syāt, yathā - kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti| tasmāt saptamyā upasaṃkhyānam = pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - yo'sāvadhītī kartā tasya vyākaraṇaṃ viṣamatvena vivakṣyate| tasmādadhikaraṇa ityevaṃ siddhā saptamī||`sādhvasādhuprayoge` ityādi| anarcārthamiha sādhuśabdasya grahaṇam| arcāyāṃ hi `sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyām` [[2.3.43]] ityanenaiva siddhā saptamī| `sādhurdevadatto mātari` ityādi| atrāpyadhikaraṇa eva saptamī| tathā hyatra mātṛsthāsu kriyāsu mātṛśabdo vartate, pitṛsthāsu kriyāsu pitṛśabdaḥ; tāsāñca kriyāṇāṃ sādhvasādhutāṃ prati viṣayabhāvo'stīti vaiṣayikādhikaraṇa eva saptamī| vaktavyaśabdastu vyākhyeya ityarthe vartate| evamuttaratrāpi| `kārakārhāṇāñca` ityādi| bhāvapradhāno'tra kārakaśabdaḥ| kriyāṃ prati yeṣāṃ kārakatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ nyāyyaṃ te kārakārhāḥ, teṣāṃ kārakārhatve saptamī vaktavyā| `ṛddheṣu` ityādi| ṛddhā hi bhujikriyāṃ prati sādhanabhāvamarhinti| teṣāmeva ceha kārakatvaṃ vivakṣitam| etadanusāreṇa kārakārhāṇāñcākārakatva ityevamāderartho veditavyaḥ| atrāpi sarvatra `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam` [[2.3.37]] ityenaiva siddhā saptamī| tathā hi - ṛddhādisambandhinā bhujikriyādilakṣaṇenātra bhāvena daridrādisambandhyāsanādibhāvo lakṣyate|`carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti` ityatra dvīpinanasya nimittaṃ carma, tasya dvīpinā karmaṇā saha saṃyogaḥ| atrāpi cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt siddhā saptamī| nanu ca dūrāntikārthānukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥca nārthastadanukarṣaṇārthena cakāreṇa, saptamīti yogavibhagādeva dūrāntikārthebhyaḥ saptamamī bhaviṣyati| atha vā - uttarasūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt saptamī veditavyā||kīdṛśī punaḥ kriyā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣayatītya ta āha - `prasiddhā ca` ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ, prasiddhaivetyarthaḥ| na hi svayamaprasiddhaṃ parasya lakṣaṇamupapadyate| atha kathaṃ phalāyāmāneṣvāmreṣu gataḥ, paktevaṣvāgata ityatra saptamī, na hīha bhāvaḥ śrūyate? yadyapi na śrūyate? tathā'pi gamyate| phalāyamāneṣu jāteṣvityarthaḥ||anādaraḥ tiraskāraḥ, paribhava ityarthaḥ| `rudataḥ` iti| `rudir aśruvimocane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1067) śatṛpratyayaḥ||svāmīārādhipatīnāmekārthatve'pi bhedenopādānaṃ paryāyāntaranivṛtyartham| iha mā bhūt - grāmasya rājeti| `ṣaṣṭhaāmeva prāptāyām` iti| śeṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaāṃ prāptāyām||āyuktatā nipuṇatā ca kaṭādikaraṇaviṣayaiveti saptamyāmeva prāptāyāṃ pakṣe ṣaṣṭhīvidhānārthaṃ vacanam| `āsevāyāmiti kim? āyukto gauḥ śakaṭe` (iti)| īṣadyukta ityarthaḥ||kimarthaṃ punaridam? yāvatā nirdhāryamāṇo'vayavaḥ samudāyāntarbhūtaḥ; tatra yadā samudāyāsyādhikaraṇatvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā saptamī siddhaiveti, yathā - vṛkṣe śākheti; yadā tvavayavāvayavisambandhastadā ṣaṣṭhī, yathā - vṛkṣasya śākheti? satyametat; prapañcārtha vacanam||`vibhāgo vibhaktam` iti| <> [[3.3.114]] | ` yasminnirdhāraṇāśraye` iti| yato nirdhārayate sa iha nirdhāraṇāśraya iti sarvasminneva nirdhāraṇāśraye vibhāgostīti viśeṣaṇopādānasāthryādvibhāga eva yatra sa nirdhāraṇāśrayo vijñāyate; tena kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannakṣīratametyatra na bhavati| tathā hi - goṣu nirdhāryamāṇa ekadeśo yasmāt gotvenāntarbhūtaḥ pratīyate tasmānnāsti vibhāga iti| yadā tu kṛṣṇena guṇena pathagbhūtaḥ pratīyate tadāsti vibhāga iti| nātra nirdhāraṇāśrayo vibhāga eva| iha punarmāthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhatarā iti māthuratvena nāpyāḍhataratvena māthurāṇāmantarbhāvaḥ| tas #ādatra vibhāga evetyayamasya yogasya viṣayaḥ|anye tvāhuḥ - yatra rāśīkṛtya pṛthakkaraṇaṃ sa pūrvasya yogasya viṣayaḥ; yatra tu pṛthagbhūtasyaiva guṇāntarāviṣkaraṇaṃ so'sya; tatra dvayorapyavasthayorvibhāga eveti kṛtvā ayamapi yogaḥ prapañcārtha eva| vibhāgo hi samnabdhātpracyutiḥ| pāṭaliputrakāśca sambandhāt pracyavamānānāṃ māthurāṇāṃ sambandhe pracyuteravadhibhāvamupavāntītyapādāna ityevaṃ pañcamī siddhā||`{apratyādibhirahita vaktavyam` iti vṛttau pāṭhaḥ|} apratyāderiti vaktavyam` iti| ke punaḥ pratyādayaḥ? yeṣāṃ <> [[1.4.90]] ityādinā karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā te pratiparyanavaḥ ityādayaḥ||prasitaśabdo'yaṃ guṇavacano'pyasti - prakṛṣṭaḥ sitaḥ prasitaḥ, kriyāśabdo'pyasti - `ṣiñ bandhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1477) ityasya prapūrvasay niṣṭhāyāṃ vyutpādyate, tatrehotsukaśabdena kriyāśabdena sāhacaryāt kriyāśabdo vijñāyata ityata āha - `prasitaḥ prasaktaḥ` iti| `yastatra nityamevābaddhaḥ sa prasitaśabdenocyate` iti| ābaddha ivābaddhaḥ, yo hi yatra prasaktaḥ sa tatrābaddha iva bhavati| `keśaiḥ prasitaḥ, keśeṣu prasitaḥ` ityādi| prasitatvamutsukatvañca keśaviṣayamiti `saptamyadhikaraṇe` [[2.3.36]] ityeva siddhā saptamī pakṣe tṛtīyāvidhānārtha vacanam||nakṣatre ca lupīti subvyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamīvidhānam| ata evāha - `labantānnakṣatraśabdāt` ityādi| `puṣyeṇa` ityādi| <> [[4.2.3]] iti vihitasyāṇaḥ <> [[4.2.4]] iti lup| pañcāleṣu vasatītyatrāpi <> [[4.2.69]] iti vihitasyāṇaḥ <> [[4.2.81]] iti lup|`maghāsu grahaḥ` iti| sāmīpye'dhikaraṇa eva saptamī| atra <> [[4.2.3]] ityasyārthasyāvivakṣitatvādaṇ na bhavati| `adya puṣyaḥ` iti| pūrvavadaṇ, lup| `adhikaraṇe` [[2.3.36]] ityanuvartate| na cehādhikaraṇatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ||`prātipadikārthaḥ sattā`iti| yadi jātistadā devadattādau na syāt| atha sato bhāvaḥ sattā, tadākāśakusumādau na syādityāha - prādipadikārthaḥ satteti| yatrārthāntaranirapekṣā śabdasya pravṛttiḥ sa sarvaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ| sattāgrahaṇantūpalakṣaṇārtham| uccairnīcaiḥ` iti| atroccaiḥ śabdasya svārthe jātyādyarthāntanirapekṣaḥ vṛttiḥ| atra ca prathamāyāḥ prayojanam - <> [[8.1.26]] iti vikalpena temayādividhiryathā syāt - grāma uccaiste svam, grāma uccaistava svamiti| padasaṃjñā tu ṣaṣṭhaā'pi syādeva| `kumārī, vṛkṣaḥ, kuṇḍam` iti| nanu cātrāpi prātipadikārtha ityevaṃsiddhā prathamā; liṅgamapi prātipadikārtha eva bhavati| tathā ca vakṣyata <> [[4.1.3]] ityatra `siddhāstu striyāḥ prātipadikaviśeṣaṇatvāt svārthe ṭābādayaḥ` (vā|4|13) iti? naitadasti; idamapi hi tatra vakṣyati - `atha vā punaridamastu| striyāmabhidheyāyām` (ma|bhā|4.1.3) iti| kiñca - strītavaṃ pratyeṣā gatiḥ syāt, puṃnapuṃsake tu niyogato vibhaktivācye eva| tathā hi - vinā vibhaktyā taṭaśabdāḥ pratyujyamānaḥ kiṃ puṃstvamācaṣṭe? uta napuṃsakatvam? iti sandehaḥ syāt| tatra yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ityatra prātipadikārthenānupātte svasvāmikasambandhe tasya cābhidhāne vibhaktyapakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, tathā puṃnapuṃsakayorapi ṣaṣṭhī syāt| tasmālliṅgagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam|`droṇaḥ, khārī, āḍhakam` iti| nanu cātrāpi prātipadikārthatvādeva sidhyati prathamā, tathā hi - droṇādayaḥ śabdāḥ parimāṇe lauhe dārumaye vā arthāntaranipekṣā eva vartante? satyam; sidhyati tadā yadā parimāṇa eva vartante, yadā tu punaḥ parimeye vartante tadā na sidhyati| tathā hi - droṇādayaḥ śabdā droṇādikaṃ parimāṇamarthāntaraṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāya vrīhrādau parimeyaṃ vartante| kathaṃ punaste tatra vartante? so'yamityabedasambandhāt- droṇaparimito vrīhidrroṇa iti| yadyevam, nimittarūpeṇa nimittano'bhidhānādavyatirikta eva prātipadikārtha iti prātipadikārtha ityeva siddhā prathamā? na sidhyati, na hi mukhye sati gauṇasyāśrayaṇaṃ yuktam| nanvevamapi liṅgagrahaṇādevātra prathamā bhaviṣyati, tatka parimāṇagrahaṇena? naitadasti; tasya hi yatra parimāṇaṃ nāsti so'vakāśa iti| atra parimāṇādhikye ṣaṣṭhaeva syāt| tasmāt parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam|parimāṇagrahaṇañca yatra nimittādarthāntare so'yamityabhedasambandhācchabdaḥ pravartate, tadupalakṣaṇārtha veditavyam| tena parimāṇavadarthāntarabhūteṣvapyunmānādiṣu prathamā bhavati| ghṛtam, palam, dīrgha kāṣṭham, śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, hasto muṣṭirvitastirityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati| kuta etat? mātraśabdāt| sa hyatra vyāptivacano gṛhrate, yathā - kanyāmātraṃ varayati, brāāhṛṇamātraṃ bhojayatīti| tena parimāṇagrahaṇasyaivopalakṣaṇārthatā vijñāyate yadi tu yathā `payomātraṃ bhuṅkte` ityatra mātraśabdo niyamārthaḥ, tathehāpi niyamārtha eva syāt; tataśconmānādiṣu prathamā na syāt; tasya parimāṇādanyatvāt - ukteṣvapyekatvādiṣu prathamā yathā syāditi|vacanagrahaṇe tvasatyukteṣvekatvādiṣu prathamā na syāt| <> [[2.3.1]] ityadhikārāt| nanu ca parigaṇanaṃ tatra kṛtam, tat kuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ? naitadasti; pratyākhyātaṃ hi tatra parigaṇanam| tathā hi - rūḍhaḥ karma, bhīṣmādayo'pi karmaṇi, tatra karmāṇi, tatra karmaṇītyeva dvitīyā siddhā| kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyayā sāmānyakarmoktam, na viśeṣakarma| tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣo vaktavya iti bhīṣmādibhyo'pi viśeṣābhidhānārtha dvitīyā bhaviṣyati| atha vā - kaṭa eva karma, tatsāmānādhakaraṇyāt bhīṣmādibhyo'pi dvitīyā bhaviṣyati; nārthaḥ parigaṇanena| yatpunaridaṃ `tiṅakṛttaddhitasamāsaiḥ parisaṃkhyānam` [[2.3.1]] iti vṛttāvupanyasatm, tadebhirevābhidhānaṃ sambhavatīti sambhavapradarśanārthaparaṃ veditavyam| yadyapyekādibhirapi saṃkhyāśabdairektavādīnāmabhidhānaṃ sambhavati, tathā'pyabhihite'pi tairetkatvādāvarthe vacanagrahaṇāt yatnāt vibhaktyeti| tairapyabhidhānasya sambhavapradarśanārtha yatnaḥ kṛtaḥ|`nipātarasyānarthakasya` ityādi| athārthaviśeṣaṇārtha prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? asati hi tasmin na jñāyate - kasyārtha iti, tathā cārthamātre prathamā syāt? naitadasti;prātipadikāddhi prathamā vidhīyate| tatrāsati prātipadikagrahaṇe prātipadikārtha eva bhavatīti vijñāyate| tasyādvṛttikāroktameva prātipadikagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ nyāyyam||sambodhanam = abhimukhīkaraṇam, `tadadhike prātipadikrathā` iti| abhimukhīkaraṇasya kriyāparatvāt prātipadikārthe tasyāntarbhāvo nāsti, tsayātadātmakatvāt, tasmāta tenādhikaḥ prātipadikārtho bhavati| atha kathamiha prathamā-he-pacanam, he pacamāneti? kathañca na syāt? śatṛśānajbhyāmuktatvāt sambodhanasya| etāvapi `sambodhane ca` iti sambodhana eva vakṣyate| mā bhūdanena, pūrvasūtreṇa bhaviṣyati? sambodhanārthasyeha <> [[1.2.46]] ityanena prātipadikārthatvāt| yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ||`tadantaṃ śabdarūpam` iti| nanu ca `saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti` (pu|pa|vṛ|81) iti jñāpitametat <> [[1.4.14]] ityatrāntagrahaṇena| iha ca saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇam, tat kathaṃ tadantasya saṃjñā vidhīyate? naitadasti; yadyapi saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇamiha, tathā'pi tadantasyaiveyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate| yadīha pratyayamātrasya saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ syāt tadā pradeśeṣu tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, tathā ca saṃjñākaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| pradeśeṣu sambodhana ityevaṃ brāūyāt| evamapi pratyayamātrasya grahaṇaṃ labhyata eva| tasyaiva sambodhane vihitatvāt| tasmāt saṃjñākaraṇādeva tadantasya saṃjñā labhyate| seti vacanaṃ pūrvasūtreṇāpi sambodhane yā vihitā tasyā apīyaṃ saṃjñā yathā syāt - he pacan, he pacamānetyatra| asati tvasmin `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) iti pūrvasūtreṇaiva yā vihitā tasyā eva syāt; setyetaducyamānaṃ sarvanāmapadaṃ sāmānyena pravartata iti kṛtvā| ataḥ sambodhanamātre yā prathamā tāṃ pratipādayati, tena sarvatra saṃjñā siddhā bhavati| āmantritasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ he devadatta ityādau <<āmantritasya ca>> [[6.1.198]] ityādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `āmantritam` iti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham||`he paṭo, he devadatta` iti| atra sambuddhisaṃjñāyāṃ satyām, <> [[7.3.106]] ityadhikṛtya `hrasvasya guṇaḥ` [[7.3.108]] iti guṇe <> [[6.1.69]] iti sorlopo yathāyogaṃ bhavati| atha sugrahaṇameva kasmānna kṛtam, na ca saptamībahuvacanasya prasaṅgaḥ, sambodhanaprathamādhikārāt? satyam; kintu naitadasti; pratyayamātrasya saṃjñāvidhānārthamekavacanagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam - he pacanam, hepacamāneti; anyathā hi pūrveṇa yathā tadantasya saṃjñā vihitā tathehāpi syāt| na cehāsaṃjñinaḥ kaścidviśeṣo'ṅgīkriyata iti suśabdena tadantameva lakṣyate, tataśca tadantakasyaiva saṃjñā syāt| tathā <> [[6.1.69]] iti sorlopo vidhīyamānaḥ <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityādereva syāt; pratyayamātrasya na syāt| tasmāt pratyayamātrasya saṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthamekavacanagrahaṇam||karmādīnāṃ prakṛtatvāt tadapekṣayā śeṣatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `karmādibhyo yo'nyaḥ` iti| karmādayaḥ kārakaviśeṣāstasya sambandhasya hetubhūtāḥ, sa tu phalabhūtaḥ| hetuphalayośca prasiddhamanyatvamiti tebhyo'nyo bhavati| prātipadikārtha{vyatiriktaḥ-kāśikā|padamañjarī ca} vyatirekaḥ| vyatirekaḥ = ādhikyam| atha vā - yena prātipadikārtho vyatiricyate = vyatirekīkriyate sa vyatirekaḥ| prātipadikārthasya vyatirekaḥ = prātipadikārthavyatirekaḥ| sa śeṣaḥ| kaḥ punarasavityāha - `svasvāmikasambandhādiḥ` iti| ādiśabdenovayavāvayaviprabhṛteḥ sambandhasya grahaṇam| sambandhaśca yadyapi dviṣṭhastathāpi tasyaikatvādekata eva sambandhina utpadyamānayā ṣaṣṭhaā vibhaktyā'bhihitatvāt dvitīyāsambandhinaḥṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| ekasmādutpadyamānā'pi ṣaṣṭhī viśeṣaṇādeva bhavati ; na viśeṣyāt| viśeṣyāttu prathamaiva bhavati; yasmāccheṣaśabdo'yaṃyathā prakṛtādanyaviśeṣaṇamācaṣṭe tathā parārthamapi| evaṃ hrabhiyuktāḥ puruṣā upadiśanti - śeṣaḥ parārtha iti| rājñā puruṣa iti svasvāmikasambandasyodāharaṇam| atra puruṣasya prādānyam, viśeṣyatvāt| rājño'prādhānyam, viśeṣaṇatvāt| viśeṣaṇasya parārthatvāt śeṣabhāva iti tataḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| yadā tu dvāvapi viśeṣaṇabhūtau tṛtīye sambandhinyapekṣitau bhavataḥ, tadā dvābhyāmapi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati `rājñaḥ puruṣasya gṛham` iti|`paśoḥ pādaḥ` iti| atrāvayavāvayisambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| `pituḥ putraḥ` ityatra janyajanakasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| atha śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <> [[2.3.2]] ityevamādau pratyaniyamo'rthaniyamaśceti dvāvapi pakṣau| tatra pratyayaniyamapakṣe yadi śeṣagrahamaṃ na kriyeta tadā karmaṇyeva dvitīyeti karmāniyatam, dvitīyā tu niyatā; atastatrāpi ṣaṣṭhī syāditi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| śeṣa eva yathā syādanyatra mābhūditi arthaniyamapakṣe tu śeṣagrahamaṃ śakyamakarttum| yāvatā karmaṇi dvitīyaivaiti karma niyatam, dvitīyā tvaniyatā; tasyāmanyatrāpi prāptāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhītyucyamānaṃ sūtramidaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - yatra ṣaṣṭhī cānyā ca prāpnoti tatra ṣaṣṭhaeva bhavati| evamanyatrāpi veditavyam||yadyapi bahavo vidayaḥ santi, tathāpi yasyārthe jānātarvṛttiḥ sambhavati tasyaiva videḥ pratiṣedhakaraṇaṃ yuktam, `vida jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1064) ityasyaivārthe jānātervṛttiḥ sambhavati, tasmādavidarthasyetyanena jñānārthasyaiva pratiṣedho vijñāyata ityāha - `ajñānārthasya` ityādi| `sarpiṣo jānīte, madhuno jānīte` iti| <> [[1.3.44]] ityanuvartamāne, <> [[1.3.45]] ityātmanepadam| dhuna iti - ` iko'ci vibhaktau` (ra7.1.73) iti num| sarpiṣā karaṇabhūte pravartata ityarthaḥ| yasya priyatamaṃ sarpistasya pravṛtiṃ prati sarpiṣaḥ karaṇabhūtatvāt| dhātūnāmanekārthatvājjānātiriha pravṛttyarthaḥ| `sarpiṣiraktaḥ pratihato vā` iti| sarpiṣi raktatvaṃ pratihatatvaṃ ca cittabhrānteḥ kāraṇamāha| yadi sarvameva grāhraṃ tadātmanā sarpiḥsvabhāvatayā pratipadyate| evaṃ satyavidarthatā nopapadyate, jñānārthatvādityata āha - `mithyājñānamajñānameva` iti| jñānakāryākaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ| aviparītaviṣayaparicchedo hi jñānakāryam, katacca mithyājñānena na kriyata iti mithyājñānamajñānamucyate, yathā - putrakāryākaraṇāt putro'putra iti||`adhīka` iti| `ik smaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1047) ityasyādhipūrvasya grahaṇam| adhīgityanena samānārthā adhīgarthāḥ| kakārānubandhakaraṇamasya dhātoratraiva sūtre viśeṣaṇārtham| adhyayanārthānāmityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt - ko'yaṃ dhāturiti| adhipūrvasyoccāraṇenādhipūrvasyaivāsya brāāhṛṇeṣu prāptiḥ, na karmaṇyodane| na hi prādurbhāvasyodanaḥ karma; bhavaterakarmakatvāt| pākasyaiva tvodanaḥ karmatvena vivakṣitaḥ|`akākārayoḥ`ityādi| niyamasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| akākārayoḥ prayoge niyamo na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - `catuthryarthe bahulaṃ chandasi` [[2.3.62]] ityato bahulagrahaṇamanuvartate, tenākākārayoḥ prayoge niyamo na bhaviṣyatīti|`śeṣe vibhāṣā` iti| asyāpyartho bahulagrahaṇasamāśrayaṇena vyākhyātavyaḥ| `bhedikā` iti| pūrvavadbhāve ṇvuc| `cikīrṣā` iti| `a pratyayāt` [[3.3.102]] ityakārapratyayaḥ||`rājñāṃ mataḥ` iti| `matibuddhi` [[3.2.188]] ityādinā ktaḥ| rājñāmiti kartari ṣaṣṭhī| karma tu niṣṭhayābhihitam| atheha kasmānna bhavati - śīlito devadattena, rakṣito devadattenetyādi, śīlitādiṣvapi <> [[3.2.188]] iti cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvanādvartamāna eva kto vidhīyate? yadyapyevam, tathāpi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtteriha na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atha vā - prakaraṇādevātra vartamānakālatā gamyate| padārthastu bhūtatvameva pratipādayati, na vartamānatām| yasya tu padārtho vartamānastatprayoge bhavatyeva ṣaṣṭhī, yathā - `kānto hariścandra iva prajānām` iti|`śeṣavijñānāt siddham` iti| upasaṃkhyānaṃ ptyācaṣṭe - `tathā ca` ityādinā| yastūpasaṃkhyānamārabhate, tasya karttṛtvāvivakṣāyāmapi ṣaṣṭhaeva bhavati, na tṛtīyeti darśayati||`tasya prayoge ṣaṣṭhī vibhaktirbhavati` iti| yathāsambhavaṃ yatra karttaiva saṃbhavati tatra kartari bhavati; yathā - idameṣāmāsitamiti| atrāserakarmakatvāt kartaiva sambhavati, na karma| yatra tu karma kartāpi sambhavati tatrobhayatrāpi, yathā - idameṣāṃ bhuktamodanasyeti| bhujeḥ sakarmakatvāt karmāpyastyevaudanaḥ| <> [[2.3.66]] iti niyamaḥ kasmānna bhavati? `karttṛkarmaṇo kṛtiḥ` [[2.3.65]] ityasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prāptereva niyamo vijñāyate| `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pūrakaḥ` iti| `pūrī āpyāyane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1151) caurādikaḥ| tasmāt `ṇvultṛcajau` [[3.1.133]] iti bhaviṣyatkāle ṇvul| sa hi triṣu kāleṣu bhavati| `bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasyedaṃ grahaṇam` iti| iha
