<<ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ>> [[7.1.5]] ityadādeśaḥ, pūrvavadupadhālopaḥ, <> [[8.4.40]] itiścutvam| kvacit `ajñan` iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra jhiḥ, tataḥ parasmaipadaṃ vadheyam| `brāāhṛṇe prayogo'yam` iti| yo'yamanantaraṃ mantre janeruktaḥ sa brāāhṛṇo mantravyākhyānagranthaḥ| mantre janerluk ca dṛśyata iti tadviṣayamudāharaṇaṃ nopanyastam| yadi tahrramantre lugbhavati mantragrahaṇaṃ kimarthamityāha - `mantragrahaṇam` ityādi||`īhāñcakre` iti| `īha ceṣṭāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-632), liṭ, `ijādeśca` [[3.1.36]] ityādinā''m| tasya kṛtve makārāntasya kṛdantatvāt prātipadikasaṃjñā, suḥ, āmaḥ svarādipāṭhādavyayatvam, <> [[2.4.82]] iti sulopaḥ, `kṛñca` [[3.1.40]] ityādinā liṭparasya kṛño'nuprayogaḥ, `āmpratyayavat` [[1.3.63]] ityādinā''tmanepadam, tata eśādeśaḥ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam| āmo makārasyānusvāraḥ, <> [[8.4.58]] | atheha kasmānna bhavati - jagāma, śaśāmeti? arthavadāmo grahaṇāt, asya cānarthakatvāt| pratyayastu `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti` (pu|pa|pā|90) ityarthavān| iha tarhi kasmānna bhavatyam roga iti - āmeti? `lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|3), asya tu lākṣaṇikatvāt||`tatra śālāyām` iti| tacchabdāt saptamyāstral| tasya `prāgdiśo vibhakti` [[5.3.1]] iti| vibhaktisaṃjñā, tyadādyatvam,ṭāp, <> [[6.3.35]] iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| <> [[1.1.38]] iti tralo'vyayatvam, tatautpannasya ṭāpo luk| kena punaravyayāṭṭābutpadyate? `ajādyataṣṭāp` [[4.1.4]] iti cet, naca striyāṃ ṭāpo vidhānāt, avyayasya cāliṅgatvāt| tasmādavyayāṭṭāpaḥ sambhava eva nāstītyavyayādapārthakaṃ ṭāpo lugvacanam? nāpārthakam; <> [[4.1.3]] guṇipradhānanirdeśaḥ - strītvavati padārthe ṭābādaya iti| strītvavati ca tasyāṃ śālāyamityetasmin padārthe tatretyetadavyayaṃ vartate| yadyapi vākyārtho'tra strītvam; tathāpi vākyārthatayaiva tasay strīpratyayo dyotyate, sati ca strīpratyaye padārtha eva strītvaṃ bhavati, tataṣṭāpo lugvaktavyaḥ| `kṛtvā, hmatvā` iti| <> [[1.1.40]] iti ktvāpratyayasyāvyayatvam, tata utpannasya supo luk| kena puravyayāt subutpattiḥ? svādi [[4.1.2]] sūtreṇeti cet, na; tatra <> [[1.4.21]] itayādinā śāstrāntareṇaikavākyatāyāṃ svādīnāṃ niyatvāt, avyayānāñcāsaṃkhyatvāt| syādetat - yatra saṃkhyāsti tatra `bahuṣu vahuvacanam` [[1.4.21]] ityevamādinā svādiniyaḥ kṛtaḥ, avyayebhyastu niḥsaṃkhyebhyaḥ samānyavihitāḥ svādayo vidyanta eveti?vārtametat; svādisūtreṇa [[4.1.2]] hi <> [[1.4.21]] ityādinā śāstrāntareṇaikavākyatāyāṃ svādīnāṃ vidhānāt| tathā hi - tatrokkataṃ saṃkhyākarmādayaśca svādīnāmarthāḥ śāstrāntareṇa vihitāḥ, tena sahāsyaikavākyateti| ekavākyatāyāñca kutaḥ svādīnāṃ sāmānyena vidhānām| na hraparaṃ lakṣaṇamasti yena svādayaḥ sāmānyena vihitāḥ| evaṃ tahrretadevāvyayādutpannasya supo lugvacanaṃ jñāpakam - bhavantyavayayāt svādaya iti| na hranutpannasya lugupapadyate| etadeva jñāpakaṃ hmadi kṛtvoktam - `avyayebhyastu niḥsaṃkhyebhyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ svādayo vidyanta eva` iti||`etasmin pratiṣiddhe pañcamyāḥ śravaṇameva bhavati` iti| katham? iha dvoyararthayorvidhānāt, vidhāyake ca vākye dve eva| tatra `nāvyayībāvādataḥ` ityetat pratiṣedhasya vidhāyakamekaṃ vākyam| `am tvapañcamyāḥ` ityetadamo vidhāyakaṃ dvitīyaṃ vākyam, tatra cāta ityetadapekṣate| ata eva vṛttau vākyadvayamupanyastam - `adantādavayayībhāvaduttarasya supo na lugbhavati` ityekaṃ vākyam, `amādeśastu tasya bhavatyapañcamyāḥ` iti dvitīyam| tatrāpañcamyā ityanena `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) iti pañcamyā amādeśa eva pratiṣidhyate, na tvaluk pūrvavākyena vihitaḥ| ata evāluki sati pañcamyāḥ śravaṇameva bavati| ekavākyatāyāṃ hi satyāṃ kāryadvayasyaikayā pāṭhapravṛtyā vidhīyamānatvāt kāryadvayasyāpañcamyā iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| pañcamīṃ varjayitvaitat kāryadvayaṃ veditavyam| vākyabhede tvapañcamamyā ityetat pratyāsannamamādeśamapekṣate, na tu vākyāntaravihitamalukam| tenāpañcamyā ityanena sambadhyamānaḥ sāmānyena vidhīyamānaḥ sannaluk pañcamīmapyavagāhate; tasmāt pañcamyāḥ śravaṇameva yuktam| tuśabdenāpyayamartho labhyate|nanu ca kriyāyāḥ kārakāṇi bhavanti, pūrvapadārthapradhānaścāvyayībhāva uktaḥ,pūrvapadārthasya cāsattvabhūtatvāt kriyāmantareṇa sambandhābhāvādapādānādibhāvo nāsti, tat kuto'vyayībhāvāt pañcamyādayo vibhaktayo bhaveyuḥ?naitadasti; pūrvapadārthaprādhānye'pi guṇabhūtottarapadārthapekṣaḥ kriyāyoga upapadyate, yathā - pañcapūlīmānayeti| tatra bhāvaprādhānye'pi guṇabhūta dravyāpekṣaḥ kriyāsambandhaḥ||`sumadram` iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādinā samṛddhāvavyayībhāvaḥ| ` unmattagaṅgam` iti| <> [[2.1.21]] ityanena| `ekaviṃśatibhāradvājam` iti| <> [[2.1.19]] iti||parasmaipadasyātmanepadasya ca yathākramaṃ ḍārauras - ityeta ādeśā bhavanti` iti| yadeyavam, parasmaipadeṣu tip tas jhītyetat pratyekaṃ prathamapuruṣasaṃjñā, ātmanepadeṣvapi ta ātāṃ jha iti; tatra sthāninaḥ ṣaṭ, traya ādeśā iti vaiṣamyāt saṃkhyāyānudeśābhāvādekaikasya paryāyeṇa sarva ādeśāḥ syuḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ānantaryato hi vyayasthā bhaviṣyati| taccārthakṛtamānantaryam - ` ekārthasyaikārthaḥ, dvayarthasya dvyarthaḥ, bahvarthasya bahvartha iti| `kartā` iti| <> [[3.3.15]] , tip, tasyānekāltvāt ḍā ityayaṃ sarvādeśaḥ| nanu ca nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam (vyā|pa|14), ḍakāraścānubandhaḥ,tat kuto'nekāltvaṃ yataḥ sarvādeśaḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hrakṛte sarvādeśe `cuṭū` [[1.3.7]] itītsaṃjñā bhavati| itsaṃjñāyā abhāve cānubandho na bhavatītyanekāltvāt sarvādeśo bhavati| ḍityabhasyāpi `ṭeḥ` [[6.4.143]] iti ṭilopaḥ| `kartārau, kārtāraḥ` iti| `rica` [[7.4.51]] iti sakāralopaḥ| evamadhyetetyevamādīni rūpāṇi `iṅa adhyayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1046) ityetasya| atra paramapi ṭeretvaṃ bādhitvā'ntaraṅgatvāt ḍādaya ādeśā bhavanti| antaraṅgatvaṃ punasteṣāṃ sthānimātrāpekṣatvāt| ṭeretvantu bahiraṅgam; taddhi dhātumapyapekṣate, na kevalaṃ sthāninam; ā tṛtīyādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ `dhātoḥ` [[3.1.7]] ityasyādhikṛtatvāt| `thāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] iti jñāpakam - tiṅādeśasya ṭeretvaṃ na bhavatīti| tena kṛteṣvapi ḍāraurassvettvaṃ na bhavati| `kartāsi` iti| <> [[7.4.50]] iti sakāralopaḥ||iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃdvitīyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥsamāptaścāyaṃ dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||`pratyayaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvenādhikriyate` iti| śāstrasya lāghavārtham| yadi sanpratyayaḥ, kyacpratyayaḥ, kyaṅapratyayaḥ ityevamekaikaṃ saṃjñinamupādāyānakeṣāṃ bhinnavākyaiḥ pratyayasaṃjñā vidhīyet tadā śāstrasay gauravaṃ syāt; saṃjñināṃ bahutvāt| na hi teṣāṃ tathāvidhaṃ sāyānyamabhinnamasti yadupādāyaikena vākyenānekeṣāṃ saṃjñā kavidhīyet yathā - <> [[1.1.73]] iti| nanu cedamasti samānyaṃ saviti, evañca sūtraṃ kariṣyate - `sappratyayaḥ` iti, saviti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ ca sanaḥ sakārādārabhya kapaḥ pakāreṇa? naitadasti; anye'pi bahavaḥ pakārāḥ santi - <> [[3.1.34]] , <> [[3.1.106]] ityevamādayaḥ tatra yadi pratyāsattimāśrityānantaraḥ pakāraḥ pratyāhārārtha gṛhrate,tadā sipaḥ pakāremaiva pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ vijñāyeta| atha vyāptirgṛhrate? tadā `taptanaptanāthanāśca` [[7.1.45]] iti tanapaḥ pakāreṇaiva syāt| syādetat - vyāptereva nyāya āśrayitavyaḥ| na ca tanapaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāragarhaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, api tu kapa eva, <<ica ekāco'mpratyayavacca>> [[6.3.68]] iti vacanājjñāpakāt; anyathā ṣaṣṭhe'pi pratyayasaṃjñāvyāpārādapārthakamidaṃ syāt? naitadasti; asati hi prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati, asti hrasya prayojanam, kiṃ tat? ampratyayapratibaddhaṃ viśiṣṭameva yathā syāt| pratyayamātrapratibaddhaṃ mā bhūditi niyamārthametat syāt, tatkuto vaiyarthyam| athāpi kathañcit kapaḥ pakāreṇaiva pratyāhāro labhyeta, evamapi pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| ato lāghavārthamadhikāreṇaiveyaṃ saṃjñā vidhātuṃ yukteti matvā''ha - `pratyayaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvenādhikriyate` iti| yadyevam, pratiyogaṃ tenopasthātavyam, tatrāsāvupasthitaḥ sannādibhireva sambadhyate, na prakṛtyādibhiriti niyamaheturnāsti| ataḥ prakṛtyupapadopādhivikārāgamānāmapyeṣā saṃjñā syāt| tatra prakṛtiḥ - <> [[3.1.5]] , upapadam - `stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ` [[3.2.13]] , upādhiḥ - `haraterdatināthayoḥ paśau` [[3.2.25]] | yadyapi paārthasya saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanaṃ nāsti, tathāpi tadvācino'stīti tasya syādeva| vikāraḥ - <> [[3.1.108]] , āgamaḥ - <> [[4.3.138]] | pratyayasaṃjñāyāñcaiṣāṃ paratvamādyudāttatvañca syāt| yadyapi yugapadagupādīnāṃ parasparāpekṣayā sanādīnāñca paratvaṃ na sambhavati, tathāpi paryāyeṇa syāt - kadācit gupādayaḥ pare syuḥ, kadācit sannādayaḥ, anyato vā kutaścidgupādayaḥ pare bhaveyurityata āha - `prakṛtyupapada` ityādi| etacca nyāyaprāptamevoktam| katham? prakṛtyupapadopādhayastāvat parakāryasiddhaye bhūtavibhaktyā pañcamyādikayā nirdiśyanta iti teṣāṃ pañcamyādivibhaktyantaṃ śabdarūpaṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhaṃ pratipattumayogyam| tathā hi - prathamāntasay vā sāmānādhikaraṇyena saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandho bhavati yatra buddhyāhitasaṃjñārūpaḥ so'yamityabhedasambandhamupagataḥ saṃjñī saṃjñayā saha nirdiśyate, yathā - <> [[1.1.1]] iti; ṣaṣṭhantasya vā yatra saṃjñāsaṃjñinorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ saṃjñāśabdena svarūpapadātmakenopādīyamānenopajanitavyatirekaḥ ṣaṣṭhaā saṃjñī nirdiśyate, yathā - <> [[1.1.68]] iti| prakṛtyādayastu paropakārayogyaṃ vibhaktiviśeṣamupādāya vartanta ityaśakya eṣāṃ saṃjñāsambandhaḥ karttum| na ca saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhayogyavibhaktyadhyāhāre satyeṣāṃ saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti yuktaṃ parikalpiyitum| asati hi vacanasyāvakāśe'dhyāhāro yuktaḥ, na tu sati| asti cāvakāśaḥ sannādiḥ| aprādhānyācca prakṛtyādīnāmayuktā saṃjñā| pradhāne ha#i kāryasampratyayo loke dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā - bahuṣu gacchatsu kaścit pṛcchati ko'yaṃ yāti? sa āha - rājeti| tatra yaḥ pṛcchati, yaścācaṣṭe - tayorubhayorapi pradhāne rājani sampratyayayo bhavati| tasmādihāpi pradhāne sannādau kāryasampratyayāt tasyaiva saṃjñā bhaviṣyati| prādhānyaṃ punastasyāpūrvasya vidhānāt| prakṛtyādīnāṃ dhātvadipāṭhe nijrñātasvarūpāṇāṃ sannādyarthopādānādaprādhānyam, tat kutasteṣāṃ saṃjñā? āgamavikārayoryadyapi saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhayogyatayā prathamayā nirdeśaḥ, vidheyatvācca prādhānyam, tathāpi na bhavati saṃjñā;yasmātpratyaya iti mahatī saṃjñā kriyate| tasyā etatprayojanamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā syāt - pratiyanatyanenārthāniti pratyayaḥ| na ca vikārāgamābhyāṃ kañcanārthaṃ pratiyanti| yadi tahrranvarthasaṃjñeyam, <> [[5.4.28]] <> [[5.4.29]] ityevamādīnāṃ pratyayasaṃjñā na prāpnoti; arthābhāvāt| dvivadho hrarthaḥ - laukikaḥ, śāstrīyaśca; tatra pūrvaḥ padenaiva pratīyate, dvitīyastvanvayavyatirekābhyām; sa ca teṣāṃ nāsti, vinā pratyayaiḥ prakṛtereva tadarthasya pratīteḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi teṣāmanvayavyatirekābhyāmartho na samadhigamyate, tathāpi `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti` (pu|pa|90) ityasmādevāptavacanāt samadhigamyate| tasmāt tairapi svārthaṃ pratiyantīti te'pi pratyayā itlamatiprasaṅgeneti sthitametat - prakṛtyādīnāṃ pratyayasaṃjñā na bhavatīti| `kartavyam, karaṇīyam` iti| tavyadādeḥ pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ `yasmātpratyayavidhiḥ` [[1.4.13]] iti tasmin parato'ṅgasaṃjñā bhavati| atha kathaṃ tadanantaraṃ sannādimatikramya vyavahita eva tavyadādirudāhṛtaḥ? tatrādyudāttāderapi pratyayasaṃjñākāryasya sambhavāt| sannādau tu tanna sambhavati; dhātusvareṇaiva bādhitatvāt||`ayamapyadhikāraḥ` iti| na kevalaṃ pratyaya ityapiśabdārthaḥ| `yoge yoge upatiṣṭhate` iti| paribhāṣāyā adhikārasya bhedaṃ darśayati| paribhāṣā hrekadeśasthaiva sarvatra śāstre vyāpriyate, na tu pratiyogamupatiṣṭhate| `paribhāṣā vā` iti| pakṣāntaraṃ darśayati| ekadeśasyaiva sarvatra śāstre vyāpriyata ityeṣa paribhāṣādharmo vṛttau na darśitaḥ; adhikāradharmapradarśanadvāreṇāvagamyamānatvāt| yadi hi prayogamupatiṣṭhamānā paribhāṣā kāryasiddhau vyāpriyeta tadā'dhikāraparibhāṣayorbhedo na syāt, tathā ca tayoriha bhedenopanyaso niṣphalaḥ syāt| liṅgavatī ceyaṃ paribhāṣā, liṅgañcāsyāḥ pratyayasaṃjñaiva| dhātorveti kriyāvācinyā prakṛteridamupalakṣaṇam, tena tiṅantamapi gṛhrate| tadapi kriyāpradhānatvāt kriyāvācīti śakyate vyapadeṣṭum| pradhānena hi vyapadeśā bhavanti, yathā - rājadhānīti| `prātipadikādvā` iti| akriyābhidhāyinyāḥ prakṛteridamupakṣaṇam, tena ṅyāpāvapi gṛhrete| `taittirīyam` iti| proktārthe `tittiravaratantukhaṇḍikokhācchaṇ` [[4.3.102]] iti chaṇ| tadantāt <> [[4.2.59]] ityaṇ| tasya <> [[4.2.64]] iti luk| atha cakāraḥ kimarthaḥ; yāvatā nātra kiñcit prakṛtamasti yaccakāreṇa samuccīyate? ityāha - `cakāraḥ punaḥ` ityādi| anyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvādasyaiva samuccayārthaścakāro vijñāyate, tena bahulādhikāre'pi ye pratyayā vidhīyante teṣvapyṛṇādiṣu paratvaṃ na vikalpyate|kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate? paro yathā syāt, pūrvo mā bhūditi| naitadasti prayojanam, tathā hi - yamicchati pūrvaṃ tamāha - `avyayasarvanāmnāmakac prākṭeḥ` [[5.3.71]] iti| ya idānīmato'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ so'ntareṇāpi vacanaṃ para eva bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; yeṣāmeva hi pratyayānāṃ deśo niyamyate ta eva niyatadeśāḥ syuḥ| ya idānīmato'nyo'niyatadeśaḥ sa kadācit pare, kadācit pūrve, kadācinmadhye syāt, tasmāt paraśceti vaktavyam? na vaktavyam; yasmāt dhātoḥ pratipadikāditi ca digyogalakṣameyaṃ pañcamī; anyasyāpādānādeḥ pañcamīnimittasyābhāvāt| tasmādeṣaiva paradikśabdādhyāhāraṃ kariṣyati? naitadasti; pūrvadikśabdādhyāhāraḥ syāt, tathā ca pūrve'pi kadācit sannādayaḥ syuḥ| <> [[1.1.67]] ityanayā paribhāṣayā tarhi vyavasthā bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; yatra pañcamīnirdiṣṭāt parasya ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasya kāryaṃ vidhīyate so'sya viṣayaḥ, na ca sannādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhaā nirdiśyante, tanāpi teṣāṃ sambandhikāryaṃ vidhīyate, teṣāmeva bhāvyamānatvāt| nanu ca pratyayasaṃjñākāryaṃ vidhīyate? naivam, kathaṃ punarasatāṃ teṣāṃ śakyaṃ saṃjñākāryaṃ vidhātum? kiñca yeṣāṃ pratyayasaṃjñaiva na vidhīyate - `kaṇeṣṭhaḥ` (da|u| 5|6) `śamerḍhaḥ` (5|11), ityevamādīnām, tatra kā gatiḥ syāt? na hreṣāṃ pratyayasaṃjñeṣyate, tathā hi - kaṇṭhaḥ, śaṇḍha ityatra pratyayasyocyamānamikādeśādikāryaṃ na bhavati| yadyevam, pratyayasyocyamānaṃ paratvamapi na syāt? paraścetyadhikārasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati| asati hretasmin vacane satyapi tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasthāne bahulādhikāre vidhīyamānatvāduṇādiṣu paratvaṃ vikalpyeta| tasmāt kartavyametat||`aniyatasvarapratyayaprasaṅge` ityādinā sūtrārambhasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| aniyato'vyavasthitaḥ svaro yasya sa tathā, sa cāsau pratyayaśceti karmadhārayaḥ, tasya prasaṅgaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| aniyatasvaro yaḥ pratyayastasya prasaṅge sati vacanamidamāderudāttārtham| `aniyatasvaraprasaṅge` iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ| tatrāniyataśabdasya svaraśabdena viśeṣamasamāsaṃ kṛtvā prasaṅgaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| aniyatānāmudāttādīnāṃ svarāṇāṃ prasaṅge satyāderudāttārtha vacanam| `anekākṣu ca` ityādi| aneke'co yeṣāṃ te'nekācaḥ| teṣvanekākṣu pratyayeṣu deśasyāniyame sati vacanamāderudāttārtham - āderevodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt, madhye'nte ca mā bhūditi| ye hrekācaḥ pratyayāstatra deśasyābhāvādasatyapyādigrahaṇe deśyāniyamo na sambhavati, ato'nekākṣu cetyuktam|anekācāṃ hrasatyādigraha ādimadhyāntānāmaniyamena svaraḥ prasajyetanekācaḥ pratyayāderyadyādyudāttārthavacanaṃ nārthaṃ etena; yasmādāderanudāttādīnāṃ madhyāntayoścodāttasya prasaṅga eva nāsti| tathā hi - yamanudāttamicchati, karoti tatra pakāramanubandham, āha ca - <> [[3.1.4]] iti; svaritamapi yamicchati, karoti tatra takāramanubandham, āha ca - <> [[6.1.185]] iti; ekaśrutiṃ yamicchati tatraikaśrutigrahaṇaṃ karoti, āha ca - `ekaśruti dūrātsambuddhau` [[1.2.33]] iti; antodāttamapi yamicchati karoti tatra cakāramanubandham, āha ca - `citonta udātto rita` (kā|6.1.169) iti; madhyodāttamapi yamicchati, karoti tatra rephamanubandham, āha - <> [[6.1.217]] iti; ya idānīmato'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ so'ntareṇāpi vacanamādyudātta eva bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; yeṣāmeva hi svaro niyamyate ta eva niyatasvarāḥ syuḥ, yastvaniyatasvaraḥ pratyayastasyāniyamenaiva svaraḥ prasajyeta - kadācidudāttaḥ kadācit svarāntaram| udātto'pi bhavan kadācidādau, kadācinmadhye, kadācidante syāt| tasmāt kartavyametat||`pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ` iti| nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt| subiti pratyāhārasya grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya; tasya pittvādevānudāttasya siddhatvāt| ata eva vṛttau `supaḥ` iti bahuvacanena nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| pratyāhāragrahaṇañcedaṃ supa eva pakāreṇa nānyena; tasyānanyārthatvāt| `pacati, paṭhati` iti| śabatrodāharaṇam, na tipa; tasya `tāsyanudātta` [[6.1.180]] ityādinaiva siddhatvāt||`pratyayasaṃjñā cādhikṛtaiva` iti| vispaṣṭārthametat| pratyayaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvenādhikriyate; `ā pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ` (kā|3.1.1) ityato vacanādeva pratipādyasyāvagatatvāt| nanu ca satyapi pratyayasaṃjñāyā ihopasthāne naiva tayā sano bhavitavyam; yataḥ pratyaya ityanvarthasaṃjñeyam - pratiyantyanenārthāniti pratyayaḥ, na ca sanā kañcanārthaṃ pratiyanti; tasyānarthakatvāt, na hīha sanaḥ kaścanārtho nirdiśyate| na ca `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhaviṣyati` (pu|pa|pā|90) itisvārtha eva san bhaviṣyatīti yuktaṃ parikalpayitum; gopanādeḥ svārthasya sannantādapratīteḥ|athānarthakasyāpi pratyayādhikāre vidhānasāmarthyāt saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti cet? na; evañca <> [[3.1.108]] <> [[4.3.138]] iti vikārāgamayorapi syāt| naiṣa doṣaḥ; astyeva sano'rthaḥ, kaḥ punaraso? nindādiḥ| yadāha - `nindākṣamāvyādhipratīkāreṣu saniṣyate` (vā| 178) iti| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam - sano'rthā nindādaya iti? anvayavyatirekābhyām| sati hi sani jugupsata ityādau te'rthāḥ pratīyante, asati tu sani satsvapi gupādiṣu gopayatītyādau te na pratīyante| tasmādarthavāneva sanniti bhavatyeva pratyayasaṃjñā| `jugupsate` ityārdhadhātukatvābhāvādiṇ na bhavati| ārdhadhātukatvābhāvastu sano dhātorityavidhānāt| `kuhoścu` [[7.4.62]] iti cutvam - jakāraḥ| `titikṣate` iti| jakārasya <> [[8.2.30]] kutvam - gakāraḥ| tasya `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - kakāraḥ|`nindākṣamā` ityādi| kathaṃ punarnindādiṣviṣyamāṇo labhyate? vakṣyamāṇaṃ vāgrahaṇaṃ sarvasya śeṣo vijñāyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena nindādiṣu nityaṃ san bhavati, anyatra na bhavati| prāyikañcaitat vyādhipratīkārasyārthamanyathā vyākhyāsyati| atha vā - kṣetriyāṇi ca tṛṇāni śasyārthe kṣetre jātāni cikitsyāni vināśayitavyāni| atha vā - kṣetriyaḥ pāradārikaḥ| paradārāḥ parakṣetram,tatra cikitsyo nigrahītavya ityarthaḥ| saṃśaye'pi dṛśyate - `vicikitsati me manaḥ` iti| yadyapyatropasargasambandhāt saṃśayaḥ pratīyate, tathāpi dhātoreva vācya iṣyate, upasargasya tu dyotyaḥ| tasmāt prāyikaṃ vyādhipratīkāragrahaṇam| prāyeṇa hi loke vyādhipratīkāre cikitsatīti prayujyate| `anyatra` iti| gopanādau| `gopayati` iti| hetumaṇṇic| tejayati, `saṅketayati`iti| hetumaṇṇic, curādiṇjvāḥ; bhvādau curādau cānayoḥ pāṭhāt|atha jugupsata ityādau kathamātmanepadaṃ sannantādvidhīyate, na ca gupādibhya prāk sana ātmanepadaṃ paśyāmaḥ? ityāha - `gupādiṣvanubandhakaraṇam` ityādi| ātmanepadaṃ yathā syāditi| gupādiṣvanubandho'nudāttārthaḥ kṛtaḥ tasmāt `anudāttaṅitaḥ` [[1.3.12]] ityātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca kṛte'pyanubandhe na bhavitavyameva tebhya ātmanepadena; sanā vyavahitatvāt? naitadasti; anubandhakaraṇasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati| atha vā - `avayave kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati` (hai|ga|pa|107) iti jugupsādaya eva samudāyā anudāttetaḥ, tenāvayavadhānenaiva tebhya ātmanepadaṃ bhaviṣyati| evaṃ sthite yadatra dveṣyamāpadyate tat `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityatropanyastamapāstañca| atha kimarthaṃ sano'kāra upadiśyate, yāvatā tasyārdhadhātuke <> [[6.4.48]] iti lopena bhavitavyam, sārvadhātuke'pi śapā sahaikādeśena, tatra satyasati vā'kāropadeśe nāsti kaścidviśeṣaḥ? naitadasti; iha pratīṣiṣatīti prapūrvādiṇaḥ sani vihite yadyakāropadeśo na syāt <> [[6.1.2]] iti dvitīyasyaikāco dvarvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ sa ityasya na syāt, anackatvāt sanaḥ| akāropadeśe sati sa ityasya dvitīyasyaikāco bhavati| tadartho'pakāropadeśaḥ||mānbandhī anudāttetau, śeṣau svaritetau| iha dīrghagrahamāt `acaśca` ( [[1.2.28]] iti paribhāṣopasthānādacā'bhyāso viśiṣyata ityajantasyābhyāsasya dīrgho vidhīyamāno niyataṃ halādiśeṣamapekṣate; vinā tenājantatvābhāvāt| tasmastu sati na kiñcit pratīkṣaṇīyamiti tatsamanantarameva dīrgheṇa bhavitavyam, tataścābhyāsasyāvarṇasya sthāne bhavan bdherittvasya bādhakaḥ syāt, śeṣāṇāntu hrasvasya, tataścāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāditi yo manyeta taṃ pratyāha - `abhyāsasya cekārasya dīrgho bhavati` iti|kathaṃ punarikārasya dīrgho labhyate, yāvatā viśeṣavidhiḥ sāmānyavidherbādhako bhavati, viśeṣavihitaśca dīrghaḥ, tato'yaṃ sāmānyavihitamittvaṃ bādhitvā'kārasyaiva prāpnoti? ata evaṃ manyate - `dīrgho'kitaḥ [[7.4.83]] ityatra jñāpitametat syāt - `abhyāsavikāreṣvapavādānotsargān vidhīnbādhante` (vyā|pa|23) iti| akidgrahaṇasyaitat prayojanam, iha mā bhūt - yaṃyamyate, raṃramyate iti| yadi cābhyāsavikāreṣvapavādairutsargā bādhyerannevaṃ satyapavādatvānnuki kṛte'najantatvādeva dīrgho na bhaviṣyati, kimakita ityanena| kṛtañca; atastato jñāpayati - nābhyāsavikāreṣu bādhyabādhakabhāva iti| `bībhatsate` iti| `ekāco baśo bhaṣ` [[8.2.37]] iti bakārasya bhakāraḥ, dhakārasya `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti takāraḥ|`uttarasūtre` ityādi| atra hi sano vidhimātramapekṣyate vāvacanena, na tvanantara eva vidhiḥ| tena trayāṇāmapi yogānāṃ śeṣo vijñāyate| sarvagrahaṇaṃ gupādisūtrasyāpi [[3.1.5]] śeṣo vijñāyata iti jñāpanārtham, anyathā hranantarasyaiva sūtrasya śeṣo vijñāyeta| `mānayati` iti| hetumaṇṇic, curādiṇijvā, curādāvapyasya pāṭhāt| `{niśānayati - kāśikā} niśānam` iti| pacādyac||karttṛḥ kriyayā vyāptumiṣṭatamasya karmabhāva upapadyate| nānyathetyavaśyaṃ yā kācit kriyā'pekṣitavyeti| iha cānyā na śrūyate, pratyayārthatvena cecchā sannidhāpitā, ataḥ saivāpekṣituṃ yuktā; pratyāsattenryāyāt,tasmāt, tayaiva vyāpyamānasya karmabhāvo vijñāyata ityāha - `iṣikarma` ityādi| iṣeḥ karmeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| pratiyogyapekṣatvāt samānatvasya niyogataḥ pratiyogyapekṣitavyaḥ, na ca sūtre pratiyogī śrūyate, tatra pūrvoktanyāyeneṣereva pratiyogitvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `iṣiṇaiva` ityādi| samāna ekaḥ kartāsyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, ekakarttṛka ityarthaḥ| nanu caṭa dhātoḥ karmatvaṃ nopapadyate, tasyārthadharmatvāt, dhātośca śabdātmakatvāt| atha karoti dhātumicchatītyādau prayoge dhātorapi karmatā dṛṣṭeti cet? na brāūmaḥ - sarvathā dhātoḥ karmatvaṃ na bhavatīti, kiṃ tarhi? ya iha sannutpattinimittabhāvanopāttaḥ samānakarttṛkaḥ, tasya na sambhavatīti brāūmaḥ; yasmāt samānakarttṛkatvaṃ sādhyamānasyārthasya bhavati, karmatvaṃ tu siddhasvabhāvasya| aṅgīkṛtya ca samānakarttṛkatvaṃ dhātoḥ karmatve doṣa uktaḥ idānīṃ tadapi na sambhavatyeva| tathā hi - dhātuḥ śabdaḥ kriya#āyāśca kartā bhavati, na śabdasyetat āha - `karmatvam` ityādi| `arthadvārakam` iti| artho dvāramupāyo yasya tadarthadvārakamiti| arthasya karmatvāt samānakarttṛkatvācca tadvacano'pi dhāturarthadharmeṇopacārāt karmasamānakarttṛkaścocyate, yathā - `dvandvaśca prāṇitūrya` [[2.4.2]] ityatrārthasya prāṇyaṅgatvāt tadvacano'pi prāmāyaṅgamityucyata iti bhāvaḥ| `cikīrṣati` ityatra karoterartha icchayā vyāpyamānatvāt samānatvāt karmasamānakarttṛkaśceṣiṇā; yasmāt ya eveṣeḥ kartā sa eva tasyāpi| atastaddvāreṇa karotirapi karmasamānakarttṛkaśceti bhāvaḥ| tataḥ san, <> [[1.2.9]] iti sanaḥ kittvāt guṇabhāvaḥ, `ajjhanagamāṃ sani` ( [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghaḥ, `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttvam, raparatvam, `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghaḥ, `iṇkoḥ` [[8.3.57]] ityanuvartamāne <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam|dhātugrahaṇaṃ kimiti| dhātugrahaṇaṃ hrevamarthaṃ kriyate - gamanamicchatīti subanthānmā bhūditi| nanu cāsatyapi dhātugrahaṇe tataḥ san bhavituṃ notsahate; <> [[3.1.8]] itpapavādena bādhitatvāt, tasmāt pāriśeṣyādvināpi dhātugrahaṇena dhātoreva bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha - `sopasargādutpattirmā bhūt` iti| yadopasargaviśiṣṭo dhātvartha iṣiṇā vyāpyate tadāsāvupasargaviśiṣṭa eva karmatvamanubhavatīti tadadvāreṇāsau sopasarga eva dhātuḥ| karmeti sopasargādutpattiḥ syāt,tataśca prācikīrṣadityatra dvirvacanaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ sannantasyaikācaḥ prathamasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti <> [[6.1.9]] iti samudāyādeḥ praśabdasya syāt| laṅi ca sopasargasyāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ tataḥ prāgaḍāgamaḥ syāt| yadi tarhi sopasargaḥ, karmadhātorutpattirna syāt, tasyākarmakatvāt? naitadasti, samudāyasya hi karmatve'vayavā apikmatvamanubhavanti;avayavātmakatvāt samudāyasya| abhyupāya eva hravayavakarmatā samudāyakarmatāyāḥ; anyathā yadi samudāye karmaṇyavayavāḥ karmabhāvāpannā na bhaveyuḥ, tadā mahāntaṃ putramicchatītyatra karmalakṣaṇāvayavā dvitīyā na syāt| ` gamenenecchati` iti| karaṇatvapradarśanārthaṃ lyuhantopanyāsaḥ| dhātoreva hi sano'nutpattiḥ pratyudāharaṇam| astyatra samānakarttṛkatvam| tathā hi - ya eveṣeḥ kartā sa eva gamanasya, sa hrātmīyena gamanena karaṇabhāvamāpannena kimapi vastvicchati| kmatvaṃ tu gamerarthadvārakaṃ nāstīti na bhavatyataḥ san| `devadattasya bhojanamicchati` iti| devadattasyeti `kartakarmaṇoḥ kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī| atra hi bhojanasya devadattaḥ kartā, iṣestu yajñadatta iti samānakarttṛkatvaṃ nāsti| `kartuṃ jānāti` iti| icchāgrahaṇādiha jñāne'rthe sanna bhavati| nanu ceṣikarmā yo dhātu riṣiṇaiva samānakarttṛkastata icchāyā vā san bhavatītyuktam| iha ca yathecchā pratyayārtho nāsti tathā dhātoriṣikarmatvamapi, iṣiṇā samānakarttṛkatvañca, tadayuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, aṅgatrayavaikalyāt? naitadasti, sati hīcchāgrahaṇe tadviśeṣaṇadvayaṃ pratyāsatterlabhyate| asati tu tasmin yāṃ kāñcit kriyāṃ prati dhātoḥ karmatvaṃ vijñāyate, pratiyogimātrāpekṣayā ca samānakarttṛkatvamiti kā'trāyuktatā !`vāvacanādvākyamapi bhavati` iti| uttarasūtra iti śeṣaḥ| iha tu `samānakarttṛkeṣu tumun` [[3.3.158]] ityata eva vidhānāt karttṛmicchatīti vākyaṃ bhaviṣyati| nityatvehi sanastasya vacanasyānarthakyaṃ syāt| anyadapi vāvacanaprayojanamuktameva, tasyai samuccayārtho'piśabdaḥ| `dhātoriti vidhānāt` ityādi| `ārdhadhātuke śeṣaḥ` [[3.4.114]] ityanena dhātorityevaṃ dhātuśabdamuccārya vihitasya pratyayasyārdhadhātukasaṃjñāvidhānāt| iha dhātorityeva sano vidhānamityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā na bhavati, na hi tasya tathā vidhānamasti|`āśaṅkāyāmupasaṃkhyānam` iti| āśaṅkā = sambhāvanā, sā ca prayoktṛdharmaḥ| `nadīkūlaṃ pipatiṣati` ityacetanatvāt kūlasyecchā na sambhavatīti na prāpnoti| `āśaṅke kūlaṃ patiṣyati` ityasmin viṣaya evaṃ prayogaḥ| `āā mumūrṣati` iti| pūrvavat kittvadīrghatve| `udoṣṭhapūrvasya` [[7.1.102]] ittyuktam; raparatvañca| atra satyapi cetanatve jīnasya priyatvācchuno martumicchā na sambhavatīti na prāpnoti| eṣa ca prayogaḥ `ahamāśaṅkemariṣyati āā` ityatrārthe veditavyaḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| kartavya ityavyāhāryam| pratipādanaṃ tu - dhātoriti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ, tenāśaṅkāyāmapi san bhaviṣyati|`icchāsanantāt` ityādi| icchāyāmarthe yo vihitaḥ san tadantāt sanaḥ pratiṣedho vyākhyeyaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tūttaratra kariṣyāmaḥ| svārthe yaḥ san tadantāt saniṣyata evetīcchāviśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtam| `jugupsiṣate` iti| <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ| `śaiṣikāt` ityādi| aāptayādibhyo'rthebhyo'dūrabhava ityetatparyantebhyo'nyo yo'rthaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tatra bhavaḥ śaiṣikaḥ, `adhyātmādibhyaṣṭhañ` (vā|456)| tasmācchaiṣikaḥ sarūpaḥ pratyayo naṣṭaḥ| śālāyāmbhava iti <> [[4.2.114]] śālīyaḥ, śālīye bhava iti punaścho na bhavati| virūpastu bhavatyeva - ahicchatre bhava āhicchatraḥ, <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] āhicchatre bhava āhicchatrīyaḥ - aṇantādvṛddhāccho [[4.2.113]] bhavati| matubarthe bhavaḥ pratyayo matubarthīyaḥ, <> [[4.2.138]] iti cchaḥ, matubartho'syāstīti matubarthikaḥ pratyayaḥ, <> [[5.2.115]] iti ṭhan| matubartho'syāstītimatubarthīyāt pratyayānmatubarthikaḥ sarūpaḥ pratyayo neṣṭaḥ| daṇḍo'syāstīti daṇḍikaḥ, pūrvavaṭṭhan, daṇḍiko'syāstīti matubarthīyāt punaṣṭhan na bhavati| virūpastu bhavatyeva - daṇḍo'syāstīti daṇḍī, daṇḍino'syāṃ śālāyāṃ santīti daṇḍamatī śālā, innantānmatup bhavati| `sannatānna saniṣyate` iti| `sarūpaḥ` iti sambadhyate| tatra yadyapi sano rūpasārūpyavyabhicāro nāsti, tathāpi viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādarthasārūpyamāśrīyate| tenecchāsanantāditi gamyate, pūrvam `icchāsanantātpratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ` (vā|181) ityabhidhānācca| yastu nindādiṣu gupādibhyaḥ san tat icchāsan bhavatyeva| tathā caivaṃ vṛttādudāhṛtam|etatsarvaṃ nyāyaprāptamevodāhṛtam| katham? niṣpannā hi prakṛtiḥ pratyayavidhernimittaṃ bhavati| na ca sarūpaśaiṣikapratyayavidhānakāle tathāvidhapratyayānatā niṣpannā prakṛtirasti, nāpi sarūpamatubarthikapratyayavidhānakāle tathāvidhapratyayāntā niṣpannā prakṛtiḥ, nāpīcchāsani vidhīyamāna icchāsanantāt prakṛtirlabdhasattākāsti; idānīmeva hi <> [[4.3.53]] ityādibhirlakṣaṇaiḥ sarūpāṇāṃ śaiṣikādīnāṃ bhāvyamānatvāt| tasmādavidyamānaprakṛtikatvāt te yathoktaprakārāyāḥ prakṛterna sambhavantīti||ātmaśabdaḥ parasya vyāvṛtiṃta kurvāṇo yastatpratiyoginamarthamācaṣṭe sa iha parigṛhrate, na tu yo'ntavryāpāravati puruṣe bhoktari vartate; sa iha gṛhramāṇo'kiñcitkaraḥ syāt| tenecchā viśiṣyeta, subantaṃ vā; tatrecchā tāvadātmanaḥ, anyasya na sambhavtayeveti tadviśeṣaṇatā tasyāyuktā| subanthamapyeṣitrānyena vā sambadhyamānamātmasambaddhameva bhavati; ubhayorapi tayorātmasambandhitvāt| tasmāt subantaviśeṣaṇatvamapi tasyāyuktamiti parapratiyogivacana eva gṛhrate| evaṃ hi kaparanivṛttiḥ śakyate karttum, nānyathā| atrāpīcchāyāḥ sannidhānāt tayaiva vyāpyamānasya karmatvaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha - `iṣikarmaṇaḥ` iti| ātmagrahaṇena yadīcchā viśiṣyeta tadehāpi syāt - rājñaḥ putramicchatīti| rājño'pi putra iṣyamāṇe satyātmana evaiṣituricchā bhavati| tasmāsubantamevātmagarhaṇena viśeṣayituṃ yuktamiti matvā''ha - `eṣiturātmasambandhinaḥ` iti| ātmasambandhitvaṃ tu subantasyārthadvārakaṃ veditavyam| athaiṣiturevaitat kuto labhyate? icchayā sannidhīyamānayehaiṣituḥ sannidhāpitatvāt| etadapi kutaḥ? tena vinā tadabhāvāt| `putrīyati` iti| <> [[7.4.33]] itīttvam|sabgrahaṇamiha prātipadikanivṛttyarthaṃ vā syāt? dhātunivṛttyarthaṃ vā? tatra prātipadikanivṛttyarthaṃ tāvannopapadyate, na hi subantāt pratyayotpattau prātipadikādvā kaścidviśeṣo'sti| dhātunivṛttyarthamapi na yujyate, tato vihitasya sano bādhakatvādityabhiprāyeṇāha - `subgrahaṇaṃ kim` iti, `vākyānmā bhut` iti| subgrahaṇaprayojanamāha - asati subrāgrahaṇe vākyādapi syāt, atastannivṛttyarthaṃ kṛtaṃ subgrahaṇam| atha kimidānīṃ na bhavitavyameva mahāputrīyatīti? bhavitavyaṃ yadā samāse kṛta etadvākyaṃ bhavati - mahāputramicchatīti, yadātvetadvākyaṃ bhavati - mahāntaṃ putramicchatīti, tadā na bhavitavyam| padasamudāyopalakṣaṇañca vākyagrahaṇaṃ veditavyam| tasmānmahāntaṃ putramityataḥ samudāyāt prāptirāśaṅkyate, na caitadvākyam; aparisamāptyarthatvāt| kiñca syāt yadyataḥ syāt? pratyayārthe guṇībhūtayormahatputraśabdayorasatyekārthībhāvalakṣaṇe'sāmārthye samāso na syāt| tataścottarapade vidhīyamānaṃ <<ānmahataḥ samānādhikaraṇajātīyayoḥ>> [[6.3.46]] ityāttvaṃ na syāt| atha vā - pratyayārthe guṇībhūtasya putraśabdasya pūjyamānatāviśeṣaṇaṃ na syāditi <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā samāso na syāt, tadabhāvādāttvamapi na syāt| atha kriyamāṇe subgrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati, subantaṃ hretat? naitat; pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā yataḥ subūtpannaḥ subgrahaṇe sati tadādereva grahaṇaṃ bhavati| na ceha vākyāt subutpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? avayavāt| tena vākyādutpattirna bhavati| avayavāt tarhi putraśabdāt kasmānna bhavati? agamakatvāt| vṛttisamānārthena hi vākyena pratyayāntena bhavitavyam| yaśceha mahāntaṃ putramicchatīti vākyanārthaḥ pratīyate nāsau pratyayāntena| {tathā hi mahāntaṃ putramicchatīti vākyenārthaḥ kañcit - vārāṇasīmudraṇam} tathā hi mahāntaṃ putrīyatītyukte mahāntaṃ kañcit putramivācaratītyeṣo'rtho vākyārthadbhinnajātīya e gamyate| `rājñaḥ putra micchati` iti| nanu ca sāpekṣatvādasāmarthye sati na bhaviṣyati, kimātmagrahaṇena,kathamasāmarthyam? sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavati` (cāṃ|pa|27) iti vacanāt? naitat| yadā tahrrarthāt prakaraṇādvā'napekṣaṃ nijrñātaṃ bhavati tadā prāpnoti| iha ca prāpnoti - pāpamicchati, aghamicchatīti| atra hi tṛtīyasya parapadasya prayogamantareṇāpi parasyeti gamyate, na hi kaścidātmanaḥ pāpamicchati| `kakāra#ḥ` ityādi| asati kakāre'sya grahaṇaṃ na syāt; <> [[1.4.15]] ityatra kakārānubandhavato grahaṇāt| cakārastadavighātārthaḥ| asati cakāre tu sati kyackyaṅakyaṣo dvanubandhakā bhavantīti sāmānyagrahaṇasya vighāto na bhavati| antodāttārthastu cakāro na bhavati; `ghātoḥ` [[6.1.156]] iti tasya siddhatvāt| `vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānantu - vetyanuvartamānasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| tena māntāvyayebhyaeḥ kyajna bhavati|`chandasi` ityādi| chandasi parecchāyāmapi kyajbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ punaryadyaṃ kyaci kṛte `aāādyasyāt` [[7.4.37]] itīttvabādhanārthamaghaśabdasyettvaṃ śāsti tajjñāpayati - chandasi parecchāyāmapi kyajbhavati| na hi kaścidātmano'ghamicchati| `aghāyavaḥ` iti| jñāpakasutreṇāttvam, <> [[3.2.170]] ityupratyayaḥ, `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] iti guṇaḥ, avādeśaḥ||nanu ca dvāvapyetau kyackāmyacau subantāt karmaṇa ātmecchāyāṃ vidhīyete, tadekayoga eva kathaṃ na kṛta ityāha - `yogavibhāgaḥ` ityādi| `supa ātmanaḥ kyackāmyacau` (ityeka yoge satyuttaratra dvayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| nanu ca yogavibhāge'pyānantaryāt kāmyaca evānuvattiḥ syāt, na kyacaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakāro'tra kriyate kyaco'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ; kyaco'nukarṣaṇasyaitatprayojanam - uttarasūtre'nuvṛttiryathā syāt iha yojanābhāvāt| kāmyajapi kasmānnānuvartatata iti cet, na; yogavibhāgasāmarthyāt| atha <> [[1.3.8]] iti kakārasyetsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavatītyāha - `kakārasyetsaṃjñā` ityādi| nanu ca lopa eva kāryam? na kāryam; lopa iha hi varṇasya kāryārtho bhavtayupadeśaḥ, śravaṇārtho vā| kāryaṃ tāvadiha nāsti| tatri yadi śravaṇārtho na syādupadeśo'narthakaḥ syāt| idaṃ tarhi kāryam - agnikāmyatīti guṇapratiṣedho yathā syāt? naitat prayojanam, sārvadhātukārdhadhātuyoraṅgasya guṇa ucyate| dhātorvihitaśca pratyayaḥ śeṣa ārdhadhātukasaṃjño bhavati; na cāyaṃ dhātorvidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? subantāt| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam - upayaṭkāmyatīti, vaccādinā [[6.1.15]] saṃprasāraṇaṃ yathā syāt? naitadapi; yasmāt tatra yajādibhiḥ kidviśiṣyate - yajādīnāṃ yaḥ kiditi| kaśca yajādīnāṃ kit? yo yajādibhyo vihitaḥ, na cāyaṃ tathā vihitaḥ| abhyupagamyāpi prayojanaṃ parīhārāntaramāha - `cakārāditvāt` iti| evaṃ manyate - kriyate vinyāsa evam, dvicakāro nirdeśaḥ, supa ātmanaḥ kyacca kāmyacceti; sa itsaṃjñakaścakāraḥ kakārasyatsaṃjñāparitrāṇārtho bhaviṣyatīti| atha dvitīyaścakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvatā `dhātoḥ` [[6.1.162]] ityevamantodāttatvaṃ siddham? iha putrakāmyiṣyītati satiśiṣṭasvaramapi bādhitvā citkaraṇasāmarthyāt kāmyaca eva svaro yathā syāt| `upayaṭkāmyati` iti| <> [[3.2.73]] iti vic, upayajamicchatīti kāmyac, vraścādinā [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, tasya jaśtvaṃ ḍakāraḥ, tasyāpi `vāvasāne` [[8.4.55]] iti cartvaṃ ṭakāraḥ||`kyajanuvartate na kāmyac` iti| atra ca kāraṇaṃ pūrvamuktam| ācārakriyāyāḥ pratyayārthatvāt tadapekṣayavopamānasya karmatā; pūrvavat pratyāsatteḥ|`adhikaraṇācca` ityādi| adhikaraṇādācāre kyajbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| vyākhyānantu pūrvavaccakārakaraṇamanuvarttya tasyānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya kartavyam||salopasanniyogena cāyaṃ kyaṅa vidhīyate| tena yatraiva salopastatraiva syāt - payāyata ityādau, iha tu na syāt - kākaḥ śyenāyata ityādau| ekaṃ hīdaṃ vākyam,cakāraśca samuccaye, tenaitaduktaṃ bhavati - kyaṅasalopau bhavata iti| tathā ca yugapadanayorvidhānāt salopābhāve kyaṅā na bhavitavyam| yugapadanayorvidhāne hi nānyatarābhāve kāryamupayujyate, yathā - `sthādhvoricca` [[1.2.17]] , ityata āha - `anvācaśiṣṭaḥ` ityādi| etadanena hi| nāyaṃ samuccaye cakāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi? anvācaye| tatra dve vākye bhavataḥ - karttuḥ bhavati sarvatra, yatra tvasti sakārastatra tasyāpi lopaḥ| tatrādyena vākyena salopamanapekṣya prādhānyena vidhīyamānaḥ kyaṅa salopavidhāvapi pravartate| `śyenāyate` iti| `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ|`salopavidhāvapi vāgrahaṇaṃ sambadhyate` iti| anyathā payasyata iti na sidhyet| `sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā` iti| anyathaujaso'psarasorapi vibhāṣā salopaḥ syāt| `ojasopsarasornityaṃ payasastu vibhāṣayā` (vā|185 - (jai|sū|2.1.92) iti yaduktam, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā bhavatīti, tadanena vispaṣṭīkaroti| atha haṃsāyate sārasāyata ityatra salopaḥ kasmānna bhavatītyāha - `salopavidhau ca` ityādi| yadi salopavidhāvapi kartturityeṣā pañcamī syāta tadā hi <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityasyānupasthānāt yatratatrasthas salopo bhavannihāpi syāt| na ca salopavidhau kartturityeṣā pañcamī, kiṃ tarhi? ṣaṣṭhī| yasmādarthādvibhaktipariṇāmo bhavatīti sthānaṣaṣṭhī sampadyate| sthānaṣaṣṭhaāṃ ca <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityupasthāne'ntyasyaiva lopena bhavitavyam| tena haṃsāyata ityādau na bhavati lopaḥ|`ācāre` ityādi| kyaṅaviṣayopalakṣaṇārtham; tena kyaṅapavādaḥ kvibdidhīyate| atra cāvagalbhādīnāmanudāttamakāramanubandhamāsajya nirdeśādavagalbhata ityātmanepadaṃ bhavati, punaravalbhādibhyo vikalpena kvib vidhīyate, yāvatā `{galbha dhārṣṭae - dhātupāṭhaḥ-} avagalbha ā dhṛṣṭe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-392), `klībṛ {adhārṣṭae - dhātupāṭhaḥ-) made` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-381), `huḍṛ hoḍṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-352, 354) ityātmanepadinaḥ, tatraitebhyo yadā lakārastadāvagalbhata ityādi bhaviṣyati, yadā tu kṛtamutpādyācaṃ prātipadikāni kṛtvā kyaṅutpādyate tadāvagalbhāyata iti bhaviṣyati? idaṃ prayojanaṃ vikalpena kvibvidhānasya - avagalbhāñcakra iti `kāspratyayādāmamantre` [[3.1.35]] ityāṃ yathā syāt| anyathā hrapratyayāntāt pratyayāntāddhātorāmucyamāno na syāt| `sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ` iti| tarapyavagalbhādyanukarṣaṇaṃ kartavyam - anubandhāsañjanārtham| iha cācāre kvib vetyapekṣate| tena sarvaprātipadikebhya ācāra eva kvib bhavatīti vākyaṃ niṣpadyate| atha kimarthaṃ kakārapakārau kvipo'nubandhāvāsajyete, yāvatākakārasya guṇapratiṣedhaḥ prayojanam, na ceha guṇaprāptirasti? kvipo dhātorityavidhānāt sārvadhātukatvābhāvāt| sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayorhi guṇa ucyate| pakārasya cānudāttatvaṃ prayojanaṃ, tacca kvipo na sambhavati; anackatvāt, sarvalopitvācca <> [[6.1.67]] iti| tarhi dvāvetau sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthau, na; anyatareṇaiva sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātasya siddhatvāta| anyathā vijviṭorapi tadartho'nubandhaḥ kartavyaḥ syāditi cintyametat||`bhuvi` iti| bhavanaṃ bhūḥ, sampadāditvādbhāve kvip| iha halgrahaṇena yathāsambhavaṃ bhṛśādayo viśiṣyante, viśeṣeṇena na tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha - `halantānāñca` ityādi| ihāpi pūrvavadanvācayaśiṣṭo halo lopaḥ, tena tadabhāve'pi kyaṅa bhavatyeva| halo lopavidhau bhṛśādibhya iti sthānaṣaṣṭhī sampadyate, arthādvibhaktivipariṇāmāt| tatra <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti niyame sati bhṛśāyata ityādāvahalantyasya halo lopo na bhavati| nanu ca bhṛśādīnāṃ bahutvāt tatsambnadhenācvibhya iti bahuvacanena bhavitavyam, tatkathamacverityekavacanena nirdeśa ityāha - `acveḥ` ityādi| bhṛśādacveḥ, śīghrādacveriti pratyekamabhisambadhyate| tasmādekavacanaṃ nyāyyam|`kimarthaṃ punaḥ ` ityādi| acverityadhikṛtya praśnaḥ| kasmānna kartavyamityāha - `yāvatā` ityādi| `abhūtatadbhāva` ityādinā bhavatiprayoge cvirvidhīyate| tatra tenaivoktārthatvāccvyantebhyaḥ kyaṅa na bhaviṣyati, `uktārthānāmaprayoge` (vyā|pa|60) iti kṛtvā| nanu cānuprayogaṃ bādhitvā kyaṅeva syāt? naitadasti; anavakāśā hi vidhayo bādhakā bhavanti, sāvakāśaśca kyaṅa| kva? accvyantā ye bhuśādayastatra; acvyantāt cvervikalpena vidhānāt| tatrācverityanuvartamāne jvyanteṣūbhayaprasaṅge paratvādanuprayogeṇaiva bhavitavyam, ata evāha - `tatsadṛśa` ityādi| `nañivayuktamanayasadṛśādhikaraṇe tathā hrarthagatiḥ` (vyā|pa|65) iti cvyantasadṛśābhṛśādayaḥ kathaṃ nāma pratīyerannityevartho'cveriti pratiṣedhaḥ| tatsāṃdṛśyaṃ cvyantasyābhūtatadbhāvaviṣayatvāt arthakṛtamevāśrīyate, na śabdādikṛtamityāha - `abhūtatadbhāvaviṣayebhyaḥ` ityādi| iha bhṛśādiṣu kaiścinmanasprabhṛtayaḥ sopasargāḥ paṭhante, tebhyaḥ sopasargebhya eva pratyayaḥ syāt| tataśacodamanāyateti sopasargasyāṅgasaṃjñātvādupasargāt prāgaḍāgamaḥ syāt| sumanāyya gata ityatra sopasargasya kvānte'nupraveśāt tadvyatirikta upasargo nāstīti samāso na syāt, tataśca labna syāt? naitadasti; yathaiva hi prakṛrttumaicchaditi sopasargasyāpi karmatve dhātugrahaṇenopasargānniṣkṛṣya dhātumātrāt pratyayo bhavati, tathehāpi bhaviṣyati| nanu tatra dhātugrahaṇamastīti cet? ihāpi subgrahaṇamanuvartata iti hetuḥ| sumanas ityādīni subantasamudāyāni| tena subantasamudāyāt kyaṅa| laṅa kasmānna bhavati? ucyate - laṅavidhāvapi dhātugrahaṇamanuvartate| atha `lopaḥ` [[3.1.11]] ityanuvartamāne punarlopagrahaṇaṃ kimartham? sakāranivṛttyartham| pūrvakaṃ hi lopagrahaṇaṃ sakāreṇa sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt, tataśca tasyānantasyāpi lopaḥ prasajyeta; itarathā hi tadanuvṛttirapārthikā syāt||`lohitayāte` iti| <> [[1.3.90]] ityātmanepadam| `paṭapaṭāyate` iti| paṭacchabdāt `avyaktānukaraṇāt` [[5.4.57]] iti ḍāc| `ḍāci bahulaṃ dve` (vā|888) iti dvirvacanaṃ ḍācaḥ prāgeva bhavati; ḍācītyasya hi viṣayasaptamītvāt| ḍāci kṛte ṭilopaḥ| dvirvacane yo'cchabdastadavayavasya takārasya <> [[6.1.100]] iti pararūpam - pakāraḥ| `lohitaḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣvacanam` ityādi| lohitādisūtreṇa yadetat kyaṣo vidhānaṃ tallohitāt, ḍājantebhyaścetyarthaḥ| nanu cānyānyapi nīlādiśabdarūpāṇi lohitādiṣu paṭhante, atastebhyo'pi kyaṣā bhavitavyamityāha - `bhṛṣādiṣu` ityādi| lohitaśabdāditarāṇi yāni tāni bhṛśādiṣu draṣṭavyāni| yastviha teṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ, sa pramādataḥ| arvākkālabhāvitvādanārṣa ityabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tarhi bhṛśādiṣvitarāṇi paṭhante, evamādiśabdasyānarthakyam, na hi kiñcidasti yat tenopādīyeta? ata āha - `yāni` ityādi| yāni prāmādāllohitādiṣu paṭhante teṣāṃ bhṛśādiṣu pāṭho veditavyaḥ| na tvaparipaṭhitānāṃ varmādīnām| atasteṣāmādigrahaṇena grahaṇe sati kyaṣeva bhavati| `varmāyate` iti| <> [[8.2.7]] iti nalopaḥ, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ| nidrādayo'tra śabdāḥ paṭhante, te yadyapi dharamamātravacanāstathāpi kyaṣvṛttiviṣaye tadvapi dravye vartante; śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt| `nidrāyate` iti| anidrāvān nidrāvān bhavatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaraparipaṭhitānāṃ lohitāditvaṃ bhavatītyāha - `ākṛtigaṇaścāyam` iti| kathametajjñāyata ityāha - `tathā ca` ityādi| keyati sāmānyagrahaṇārthamityāha - `naḥ kye` iti| tatraitat syāt| paripaṭhitānāṃ madhye yo nakārāntastasya padasaṃjñārthaḥ kakāro'nubadhyata ityāha - `na hi` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ kyaṣā yoge ḍājbhavati, yāvatā `kṛbhvastiyoge` ityanuvṛtteḥ karotyādiyoge ḍāj vidhīyate, na kyaṣā? ityāha - `{kṛbhvastibhireva` iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ}kṛbhvastibhiriva` ityādi| yadetat ḍājantebhyaḥ kyaṣo vidhānametadeva jñāpayati - yathā kṛbhvastibhiryoge ḍājbhavati tathā kyaṣāpīti| anyathā ḍajgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ yadi kyaṣā yoge ḍāj na syāt| nanu ca yadā bhavatiyoge ḍājbhavati tadā tadantāt kyaṣ bhaviṣyati, ttakuta ānarthakyam? naitat; na hīdānāṃ kyaṣ bhavitumarhati, bhuvo bhavatinaivoktārthatvāt| `acverityanuvṛtterabhūtatadbhāve kyaṣvijñāyate` iti| mañivayuktanyāyeneti bhāvaḥ| yathaiva hi pūrvasūtre'cveriti pratiṣedhādamunā nyāyenābhūtatadbhāvaviṣaye kyaṅa vidhīyate, tathehāpi kyaṣiti||`kyaṅanuvartate, na kyaṣ` iti| kyaṅa eva svaritatvāt| `caturthī samarthāt` iti kaṣṭāyeti nirdeśādeva caturthī samarthavibhaktirlabhyate, atastatsamathryāt pratyayo vijñāyate| kramaṇaśabdo'yamasti pādaviharaṇe, asati cānārjave; tatra kramaṇa ityaviśeṣābhidhāne pādaviharaṇe pratyayo mā vijñāyīti viśeṣaṇamupāttam| jihṛm, pāpam, anārjavamityanarthāntaram| tato'nārjava ityanena krameṇa viśeṣite satyānārjavalakṣaṇaṃ yatkramaṇaṃ tatraiva pratyayo vijñāyate, na kramaṇamātre| etacca `dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ` [[3.1.7]] ityādeḥ sūtrādvāgrahaṇasyānuvartamānasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāllabhyate| `kaṣṭāya kramaṇe` iti tādarthye caturthī| `kaṣṭāyate` iti| kaṣṭāya kramaṇamanārjavaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| `atyalpamidamucyate` iti| sarvalakṣyāsaṃgrahāt| kathaṃ tarhi vaktavyamityāha- `{sattrakakṣa` iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} satrakaṣṭa` ityādi| asmin nyasāntare yadyapi samarthavibhaktinirdaśo nāsti, tathāpi subadhikārāt tatsamarthayogyā vibhaktiradhyāhartavyā| satraṃ cikīrṣatīti sattrāyate, pāpaṃ karttumicchītyarthaḥ|`ajaḥ kaṣṭaṃ krāmati` iti| kramiratra pādaviharaṇe| kaṣṭamiti karmapadametat| kaṣṭaṃ deśaṃ gahanaṃ krāmatītyarthaḥ| atha vā - kaṣṭamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇametat| ajaḥ kaṣṭaṃ yathā bhavati tathā sañcaratītyarthaḥ| kriyāviśeṣamapakṣe'pi kaṣṭamiti dvitīyāntametat| prasipāditaṃ hi `karaṇe ca stokālpa` [[2.3.33]] ityādau sūtre - kriyā viśeṣāṇānāṃ karmateti| tenātra sūtre pratyudāharaṇe dvitīyāntasya kaṣṭaśabdasya nirdeśaḥ| mūlodāharaṇeṣvapi dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiradhyāhartavyeti vijñāyate||karmaṇa iti pañcamī; romanthatapobhyāṃ pañcamyantābhyāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| satyapi tābhyāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇye dvivacanaṃ na bhavati, pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāpteḥ| ` vartticaroḥ` iti| vartanaṃ varttiḥ, ṇyantāt striyāṃ ktin| nanu ca ktinā na bhavitavyam, <<ṇyāsaśrantho yuc>> [[3.3.107]] iti yucā bādhitatvāt| asmādeva nipātanāt ktin bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| caraṇaṃ cariti sampadāditvāt kvip|`hanucalane` ityādi| abhyavahmatasya yat punarudgīrya carvaṇaṃ hanucalanam| atrārthe romanthaśabdāt kyaṅa bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| vyākhyānaṃ tu vāgrahaṇamanuvarttya tadvyavasthitarakavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| vāgrahaṇaṃ tvavaśyamanuvartayitavyam, romanthaṃ vartayatīti vākyaṃ yathā syāt| `kīṭo romanthaṃ vartayati` iti| udgīrṇaṃ vahirnirastamavagīrṇaṃ vā pṛṣṭhāntena nirgataṃ romanthākhyaṃ dravyaṃ vartayati, guṭikāṃ karotītyarthaḥ| tenātra hanucalanaṃ na vidyate| mūlodāharaṇe tu vidyata eva, tathā hi romanthāyata iti| abhyavahmataṃ punarākṛṣya carvayītyarthaḥ| taccarvaṇaṃ hanucalanātmakameva|anye tu hanucalane pratyayamanyathā pratipādayanti| asti cāyaṃ romanthaśabdaḥ kriyāpadārthako yo romanthaśabdāt prātipadikāddhātvartha ityādinā ṇicamutpādya ghañanto vyutpādyate, sa hrabhyavahmatasya dravyasya punarākṛṣya yaccarvaṇaṃ tatra vartate| asti ca dravyavacano'yaṃ ya udgīrṇamavagīrṇaṃ vā romanthakriyāviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamāha| tatra yaḥ kriyāvacanastasyedaṃ grahaṇam, yato dravye'pyayaṃ vartamānaḥ kriyādvāreṇaiva vartate| ato dravye gauṇaḥ, kriyāyāṃ mukhyaḥ; gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasampratyayaḥ (vyā|pa|4)| tena kriyāvacanādeva bhavati, na dravyavacanāditi|`tapasaḥ parasmaipadaṃ ca` iti| vaktavyamityapekṣate| ṅittvādātmanepade prāpte parasmaipadaṃ vaktavyam = vyākhyeyam| vyākhyānaṃ tu `anudāttaṅitaḥ` [[1.3.12]] iti sūtre `napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena` [[1.2.69]] ityādeḥ sūtrānmaṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvartamānasyānthatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| tena tapasaḥ kyaṅantādātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| tadabhāvāt <<śeṣāt kartari parasmaipadam>> [[1.3.78]] iti parasmaipadameva bhavati|`phenācceti vaktavyam` iti| phenaśabdādvamane'rthe vartamānāt kyaṅa bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| vyākhyānaṃ tu - `bhṛśādibhyaḥ` [[3.1.12]] ityataḥ sūtrāccakāramanuktasamuccayārthamanuvarttya kartavyam||karaṇaśabdenātra kriyocyate, na sādhakatamam| yasmāt `karmaṇaḥ` [[3.1.15]] ityadhikārācchabdādibhyaḥ karmabhya eva pratyayena bhavitavyam| tatra yadi sādhakatame pratyayaḥ syāt prakṛtipratyayāvasambaddhau syātām, kriyāpekṣatvācca karmatvasya kriyāyā abhāve karmatvaṃ na syāt| tasmāt kriyāvacana eva karaṇaśabdaṃ niścityāha - `karaṇe karotyarthe`iti|`sudina` ityādi| sudinādibhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ karamae karotyarthe kyaṅapratyayo bhavati#ītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| vyākhyānaṃ tu - ihāpi tamevānuktasamuccayārtha cakāramanuvarttya kartavyam| ata evānuktasamuccayārthāccākārādaṭādīnāmapi grahaṇam| tenaṭāyata ityādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati|`aṭāṭṭa` ityādi| aṭādīnāṃ grahaṇamupādānamityarthaḥ| ayañca `tatkaroti` (vā|200) iti ṇici prāpta ārambhaḥ; so'pīṣyate - śabdayati, vairayatīti| tasmādetadarthāpi cakārānuvṛttirveditavyā||`vedanāyāmarthe'nubhave` iti| pratyakṣeṇa vastuna upalabdhiḥ = anubhavaḥ| nanu ca vedanāśabda upalabdhimātarvacano loke dṛṣṭaḥ, tatkathameṣa viśeṣo labhyate? yathā labhyate tathottarasūtre pratipadāyiṣyāmaḥ| kartā kārakam, kārakañca kriyāpekṣaṃ kriyāyā eva bhavati| vedanā ceha kriyā śrūyate, nānyā| tasmāt tasyā eva kartā vijñāyate| tasyāśca so vedayitā sa eva vijñāyate| tasmādaviśeṣābhidhāne'pi vedayitari kartari vartamānaḥ karttṛśabdaḥ gṛhrata iti - `vedayituścet karttuḥ` ityādi| etena karttṛgrahaṇena sukhādayo viśiṣyante, na tu vedaneti darśayati| yadi karttṛgrahaṇena vedanā viśiṣyeta - karttuḥ sambandhinī cedvedanā bhavatīti, tadehāpi syāt - devadattasya sukhaṃ vedayati prasādhaka iti| prasādhakasyāpi sambandhinī vedanā bhavatyeva, tathā hi so'pi tasyāḥ kartā| yathaiva hi prasādhyaḥ sukhaṃ vedayate tathā prasādhako'pi| etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ - ekaḥ pratyakṣeṇa vedayate, aparaścānumānena; sarvathā hi tadakarttṛkatve vedayata ityetanna syāta, na hrakartā vedayata ityucyate| tasmāt sukhādīnāmeva karttṛgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktimiti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca sukhādiviśeṣaṇatve'pi sa eva doṣaḥ, yasmāt prasādhakasyāpi janyajanakabhāvalakṣaṇena sambandhena sukhādayaḥ sambandhino bhavanti? naitat; sarvatraiva hi karttṛsambandhinaḥ sukhādayaḥ, kriyate cedaṃ karttṛgrahaṇam| ataḥ karttṛgrahaṇasāmarthyādviśiṣṭo yaḥ kartā sukhādīnāmāśrayaḥ samavāyikāraṇaṃ sa eva gṛhrate| tenāśrayāśrayibhāvena sambandhena karttṛsambandhibhyaḥ sukhādibhyaḥ pratyayo vijñāyate| na ca prasādhakaḥ sukhādīnāṃ samavāyikāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi? nimittakāraṇam| sukhādisamavāyikāraṇasya kartturye sukhādaya āśrayāśrayibhāvena sambandhinaste pratyakṣeṇopalabhyante| tena tadupalabdhiranubhavasvabhāvā bhavatīti yuktamuktam - vedanāyāmarthe'nubhava iti| yadi tarhi karttṛgrahaṇena sukhādayo viśiṣyante, na vedanā, tataśca karttṛvedanāyāmiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na prāpnoti, asāmarthyāt? sautratvānnirdeśasya satyapyasāmarthye samāso bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atha vā - asamāsa eva, ṣaṣṭhaāstvaśravaṇam; `supāṃ suluk` [[7.1.39]] iti luptatvāt||`karaṇaviśeṣe pūjādvau` iti| ādiśabdena paricaryāścaryayogrrahaṇam| `namasaḥ` ityādinā'nantarasyoktārthasya viṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati| eṣa cārtho yadyapi karaṇa iti karaṇasāmānyamanuvartate, tathāpyabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyallabhyate vināpi vacanena, yathā - pacādīnāṃ vikledādiṣu vṛttiḥ, bahuvrīheśca matvarthe| `namasyati devān` iti| nanu ca namasyatiśabde namaḥśabdo'sti, atastadyoge `namaḥ svasti` [[2.3.16]] ityādinā catuthryā bhavitavyam? naitadasti; `arthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya` (vyā|pa|1) ityarthavato namaḥśabdasya karttumaśakyatvāt| atha vā - `upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī` (cāṃ|pa|69) iti dvitīyaiva bhavati| upapadasambandhanirapekṣatvāt kārakavibhakterbalīyastvam| upapadavibhaktestu padāntarasāpekṣatvāddurbalatvam| `namasyati` iti| namaskāraṃ karotītyarthaḥ| `varivasyati`| paricarītyarthaḥ| `citrīyate` iti| vismāpayata ityarthaḥ||`pucchāt` ityādi| udasanam = ūdhrvakṣepaṇam, paryasanam = paritaḥ kṣepaṇam| yadodasane pratyayastadā tasya dyotanārtha ucchabdaḥ prayujyate - `utpucchayate` iti| yadā paryasane pratyayastadā pariśabdaḥ - `paripucchayate` iti| `ṇāviṣṭhavat kāryam prātipadikasya` (vā|813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvavāṭṭilopaḥ| samācayanam - rāśīkaraṇam| arjanam = alabdhasya lābhaḥ| paridhānam = ācchādanam||`prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-ga|sū|186) ityanena muṇḍādibhyaḥ siddho ṇic| ayañca tasyaiva prapañcaḥ| yadyapi tasya tatkarotītyādiḥ prapañca uktaḥ, tathāpīha mandabuddhīnāmanugrahāya punarucyate| `tannivṛttau vā` iti| bhojananivṛttau| `payo vratayati` ita| payo bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ| `vṛṣalānnaṃ vratayati` iti vṛvalānnaṃ na bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ| `haliṃ gṛhṇāti halayati, kaliṃ gṛhṇāti kalayati` iti| nanu ceha halakalaśabdayoḥ etenaitaddarśayati - sūtre'pi halikalyoreva grahaṇam, tayostvattvanipātanaṃ kṛtam, `sanvallaghuni` [[7.4.93]] ityādinā sanvadbhāvo mā bhūditi| ato yuktaṃ halikalyogrrahaṇam| tathā hi - nātra ṇij durlabhaḥ, gaṇasutreṇaiva siddhatvāt| kevalaṃ prapañcārthamidamucyate| sa ca prapañco halikalyorapi grahaṇa upapadyata eva| ayantu viśeṣaḥ - akārāntayogrrahaṇe satīkārāntābhyāmapi gaṇasūtreṇaiva ṇic prāpnoti, tatra kṛte satīṣṭhavadbhāvena ṭilopaḥ prāpnoti, <> [[7.2.115]] iti vṛddhiśca,ubhayorapi tayoranityatvam| tathā hi, ṭilopasya satyapi kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitve śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityatvam| tathā hi, kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhāvaikārasya prāpnoti, akṛtāya#āntvikārasya; vṛddhestu ṭilope satyaprāptyā'nityam| aprāptistvanajantatvāt| ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvādvṛddhiḥ, tasyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ ṭilopaḥ, tatrāpyaglopyaṅgaṃ na bhavati| tathā ca sati `sanvallaghuni` [[7.4.93]] iti sanvadbhāve'bhyāsasyetve <> [[7.4.94]] iti dīrghatve ca acīkalat, ajīhalādityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prasajyeta| halikaliśabdayostu kṛtāttvayogrrahaṇe sati yadyapi paratvādvṛddhirbhavati, tathāpi satyāmapi tasyāmageva lupyata ityaglopyaṅgaṃ bhavati| tataśca sanvadbhāvāt acakalat, ajahalāditīṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sidhyati| tatra yayogrrahaṇe satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati tayoreva grahaṇam, na tu yayogrrahaṇe'niṣṭaṃ prāpnoti| nahraniṣṭārthā śāstre prakḷptiryuktā||`ekāc` iti| bahuvrīhirayaṃ na tatpuruṣaḥ; `halādeḥ` iti viśeṣaṇāt| `kriyāsamabhihāre vartate` iti| etena kriyāsamabhihārasya prakṛtiviśeṣaṇatvaṃ darśayati| `tasmādyaṅapratyayo bhavati` iti| kva? `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti`(pu|pa|pā|90) iti tatraiva kriyāsamabhihāre| viprakīrṇānāmaketra rāśīkaraṇaṃ samudāyabhāvāpattirmukhyaḥ samabhihāraḥ| sa ca kriyāgāmutpannāpavargiṇīnāṃ sahānavasthānādekena ca dhātunā'nakasyāḥ kriyāyā yugapadanabhidhānānna sambhavatīti gauṇaṃ samabhihāraṃ darśayatumāha - `paunaḥ punyam` ityādi| ubhayamapi hretat samabhihārasādṛśyādupacāreṇa samabhihāre vyapadeśamāsādayati| yathā dravyāṇāṃ samāhmatānāṃ dravyāntarairavyapetānāṃ samāhāro bhavati, tathā kriyāṇāmapi kriyāntarairavyapetānāmetadubhayaṃ bhavatīti sādṛśyam| kriyā ca dviprakārā - pradhānā,apradhānā ca| tatra pradhānakriyā vikledanādiḥ, guṇakriyā cādhiśrayaṇādiḥ| tatra yaḥ phalāntaṃ pākamavasāyya kriyāntaramanārabhya punaḥ pākamevārabhate sa pradhānakriyāṃ samabhiharati, tāsāṃ paunaḥpunyaṃ samabhihāraḥ| yastvadhiśrayaṇādīreva kriyāḥ kriyāntarairavyapetāḥ sākalyena karoti sa guṇakriyāḥ samabhiharati, tāsāṃ bhṛśārthatā samabhihāraḥ| phalātireko vā bhṛśārthatā| tathā hi - yo jvalanaphalamavāpya jvalati, dīpyate vā, sa jājvalyate dedīpyate iti cocyate| `pāpacyate` iti| <> [[6.1.9]] iti dvirvacanam, `dīgho'kitaḥ` [[7.4.83]] iti dīrghaḥ| atra `kriyāsamabhihāre dve bhavataḥ` (vā|886) iti dvitvaṃ na bhavati; kriyāsamabhihāre vidhīyamānasya yaṅaḥ svayameva tadabhivyaktau sāmarthyāt| yastu `kriyāsamabhihāre loḍ loṭo hisvau vā ca tadhvamoḥ` [[3.4.2]] iti loḍ vakṣyate sa kriyāsamabhihāravyaktau svayamaśakta ityapekṣate dvirvacanam| na hrasau kriyāsamabhihāre vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? karmādiṣu; <> [[3.4.69]] iti vacanāt| tena tasya prayoge dvirvacanaṃ bhavatyeva - `lunīhi lunīhītyevāyaṃ lunāti| `dedīpyate` iti| `guṇo yaṅa lukoḥ` [[7.4.82]] iti guṇaḥ|`bhṛśaṃ prāṭati` iti| asati dhātugrahaṇe, ekāj yaḥ śabdo halādiḥ kriyāsamabhihāre vartate tasmādyaṅa pratyayo bhavatītye| sūtrārthaḥ syāt| tataśca prapūrvādaṭateryaṅa prasajyeta; prapūrvasyāṭateryaḥ samudāyastasya yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvāt| dhātugrahaṇe satyeṣa prasaṅgo na bhavati| na hrayaṃ dhātuḥ, kiṃ tarhi? dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ| `jāgarti` iti| ādāditvācchapo luk| atha kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na samabhihāra ityevocyeta? naivam| sādhanasamabhihāre'pi syāt| naitadasti, prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ hretat| na ca prakṛteḥ sādhanasamabhihāre vṛttiḥ sambhavati| api ca `karaṇe` [[3.1.17]] iti vartate, tena samabhihāro viśeṣayiṣyate - karaṇasambandhī cet samabhihāraḥ, tat kutaḥ sādhanasamabhihāre prasaṅgaḥ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam - kriyāmātrasamabhihāre yathā syāt; anyathā pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt pradhānakriyāsamabhihāra eva syāt, na guṇakriyāsamabhihāre| `sūci` ityādi| `sūca paiśūnye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1873), `sūtra {veṣṭane` dhātupāṭhaḥ-} avamocane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1908), `mūtra praruāvaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1909) `aṭa gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-295), `ṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1098), `aśa bhojane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1523) `ūrṇūñ ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1039), - āsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ yaṅavidhau grahaṇaṃ kartavyam, tacca pūrvasyaiva cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāllabhyate, kimarthaṃ punarāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ grahaṇamityāha - `anekājahalādyartham` iti| anekāj ahalādirarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattathoktam| sūcyadīnāṃ tisṛṇāṃ curādiṇijantānāmanekārthaṃ grahaṇam, ūrṇotestvanekājarthamahalādyarthañca, śeṣāṇāṃ tu ahalādyarthameva| `sosūyate` iti| <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti ṇilopaḥ, pūrvavadabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| `aṭāṭayate` iti| <> [[6.1.2]] iti ṭakārasya dvirvacanam, halādiḥ śeṣaḥ, dīrghaśca| `arāryate` iti| `yaṅi ca` [[7.4.30]] iti guṇaḥ| dvitīyasyaikāco ryaśabdasya dvarvacanam| <> [[6.1.3]] iti tu nāsti, `yakāraparasya rephasya pratiṣedhaḥ` (vā| 651) iti vacanāt| `aśāśyate` iti| dvitīyasyaikācaḥ `śya` ityasya dvirvacanam| `prorṇunūyate` iti| atrāpi nuśabdasya dvirvacanam| rephastu na dvirucyate, tathaiva pratiṣedhāt| `bhṛśaṃ rocate, bhṛśaṃ śobhata ityatra neṣyate` iti| tadarthaṃ vetyanuvṛttasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ vyākhyeyam||dhātorityeva| `gatau` iti| prakṛtiviśeṣaṇametat| gatau vartamānāddhātorityarthaḥ| amumevārthaṃ paryāyāntareṇācaṣṭe - `gativacanāddhātoḥ` iti| `caṃkrakamyate, daṃdramyate` iti| `kramu pādavikṣepe` (dhā|pa|473), drama hamma mīmṛ gatau (dhātupāṭhaḥ-466, 467, 468) <<nugato'nunāsikāntasya>> [[7.4.85]] iti numāgamaḥ| yo'lpīyasyadhvani gatāgatāni karoti sa kuṭilāṃ gatiṃ sampādayan caṃkrabhyate dedramyata iti cocyate| atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'nabhidānādevātra vākyaṃ na bhaviṣyati? na hi caṅakramyata iti vṛtterarthaṃ kuṭilaṃ krāmatīti vākyaṃ śaknoti gamayitum| tathā hi kuṭilaṃ krāmatīti vākyāt saṃśayo bhavati - kiṃ gatikauṭilyam? uta manaḥ - kauṭilyamiti? caṃkramyata iti vṛttau tvasaṃśayaṃ gatikauṭilyameva gamyate, ityāha - `nityagrahaṇam` ityādi| gatikauṭilyaṃ viṣayaḥ| tatra yaṅo niyamo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| `gativacanāt` ityādinā niyamasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `na tu` ityādinā tadvyavacchedyam| nityam = sarvakālaṃ gativacanāt kauṭilya eva bhavati, na tu kadācit kriyāsamabhihāre| tena `bhṛśaṃ krāmati` iti kriyāsamabhihāre pūrveṇa prāpto yaṅ na bhavati|`luplṛ chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1431), `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1427), `abhra vabhra cara gatyarthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-556, 557, 559), `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-397, 398), `{jabhī dhātupāṭhaḥ-}jabha {jṛbhi-dhā|pāka} gātravināme` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-388,389), `daha bhasmīkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-991), `danśa daṃśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-989), `gṛ? nigaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1410)| `dhātvarthagarhāyām` ityanena bhāvagarhāyāmityasyārthamāha| `garhitaṃ lumpati` iti| garhitamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇametat| tena bhāvagarhātra gamyate| garhitatvaṃ chedanasay nirarthakatvāt, doṣaduṣṭatvācca| evamuttaratrāpi garhitatvaṃ veditavyam| `cañcūryate` iti| <> [[7.4.87]] iti nuk| `utparasyātaḥ` [[7.4.88]] ityuttvam, `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghaḥ| `jañjapyate` iti| `japajabha` [[7.4.86]] ityādinā nuk| `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttvam, raparatvam, dvirvacanam| giryāśabdasya rephayakārayostu halādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ, purvavadguṇaḥ, <> [[8.2.20]] iti latvam|`sādhu japati` iti| nātra dhātvarthasya garhā, kiṃ tarhi? praśaṃsā| `mantraṃ japati vṛṣalaḥ` iti| atra sādhanasya vṛṣalasya garhā gamyate; vṛṣalasya = śūdrasya vaidikamantrajāpyaṃ pratyanadhikārāt||curādibhyo'nyeṃṣāmiha grahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham| `prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca` (vā|813) iti siddhatvāt|`arthaveda` ityādi| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu - prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiti kāryāntaravidhānārthādbahulaṇādeṣāṃ ṇicsanniyogenāpugbhavatīti| satyaśabdasya tu `satyāpa` ityata eva nipātanādāpugbhavatīti veditavyam| `vipāśayati` iti| pāśaṃ vimocayatītyarthaḥ| `nirūpayati` iti| rūpaṃ paśyatītyarthaḥ| `abhiṣeṇayati` iti| `upasargāt` [[8.3.65]] ityādinā ṣatvam| `tvacayati` iti| nanu ca tvacśabdo halantaḥ, tasmāt ṇici `ṇāviṣṭhavat` (vā|813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvāṭṭilope prāpte tatra <> [[6.4.163]] iti prakṛtivadbhāve kṛte <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, tat kathaṃ tvacayatīti hi bhavitavyamityāha - `akārānto'yaṃ tvacaśabdaḥ` iti| śabdāntaramevedamakārāntaṃ tvacśabdasamānārtham| ata eva tvaca ityakārāntasya sūtre nirdeśaḥ, tasyakārasya lope kṛte sthānivadbhāvādvṛddhirna bhavati| `curādibhya svārtha` iti| steyādau| nanu ca neha sūtra ākhyānādayo'rthā upāttāḥ, tatkathaṃ te labhyante? alabdhāśca kathaṃ nirdiśyante? ityāha - `svābhāvikatvāt` ityādi| śabdānāmarthābhidhānaṃ svābhāvikam,na tu vācanikam; tasyāśakyatva#āditi prāgevoktam| tasmāt svabhāvata eva yo yasyārthasyābhidhāyakaḥ sa sūtrānupātto'rtho yukta eva nirdeṣṭum| `yathāyatham` iti| yo yasyātmīya ityarthaḥ||kiṃ punarime kaṇḍvādayo dhātavaḥ? uta prātipadikāni? tatra yadi dhātavaḥ, yaki kṛte kaṇḍūriti na sidhyati| kaṇḍūyeti prāpnoti| nanu ca vetyanuvartiṣyate, tataryadā yaṅa nāsti tadā kaṇḍūriti bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; na hi dhātoḥ subvibhaktirutpattumutsahate; tasyāḥ prātipadikādvidhānāt| syādetat - yagantāt `anyabhyo'pi` [[3.2.178]] iti kvipi kṛte ato lope [[6.4.48]] vali yakāralope [[6.1.66]] ca kaṇḍūriti bhaviṣyati? asadetat; kartari kvib vidhīyate, kaṇḍūriti ca vedanāmātramucyate, na kartā; tathāpi sampadāderākṛtigaṇatvāt bhāve kvipaṃ vidhāya kaṇḍūriti vyutpādyate| evamapi mantuḥ, valguriti na sidhyet| yadi tāvadvetyanuvṛttyā manuvalguśabdābhyāṃ pakṣe yagna bhavati tadā vibhaktistābhyāṃ nopapadyeta, tathā ca mantu, valgu ityavibhaktikaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| athāpi tābhyāṃ yakaṃ vidhāya kvip kriyate? evamapi mantūrvalgurityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| avaśyaṃ yaki kṛte `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghatvena bhavitavyam| atha prātipadikāni kaṇḍavādayastadā yakaḥ karāro'narthakaḥ syāt, sa hi <> [[7.3.84]] iti prāptasya guṇasya <> [[1.1.5]] iti pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate| prātipadikatve teṣāmetatprayojanaṃ nopapadyate, na hi prātipadikādvihitaḥ pratyaya ardhadhātukasaṃjñāṃ labhata iti yo deśayet, taṃ pratyāha - `dvividhāḥ` ityādi| tatreti nirdhāraṇe saptamī| teṣu dhātuprātipadikeṣu madhye ye dhātavaḥ kaṇḍvādayastebhyo yak| `dhātvadhikārāt` ityatravopapattiḥ| evamevārthaṃ draḍhayitumāha - `tathā ca` ityādi| yata evaṃ dhātubhyaḥ pratyayo vidhīyate; dhātvadhikārāt , prātipadikebhyaḥ| evañca kṛtvā yakaḥ kakāro'nubadhyate guṇapratiṣedhāt| yadi tu pratipadikebhyo yak syāt tasyānārdhadhātukatvādguṇasya prāptireva nāsti, tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ kakārānubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|`dhātuprakaraṇāddhātuḥ` iti| pratyayamutpādayatīti śeṣaḥ| `dhātorekācaḥ` [[3.1.22]] ityota dhātugrahaṇamanuvartate| tena dhātureva kaṇḍvādiśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, na prātipadikam| `kasya` ityādi| yaccedaṃ kakārānubandhāsañjanamato'pi hetoreva dhātuḥ pratyayamutpādayati| anyathā kakārānubandhakaraṇaṃ pūrvoktayā rītyā nirarthakameva syāt| ataeva dhātubhūtebhyaḥ kaṇḍavādibhyo yagvidhānāt kakārānubandhāsañjanācca teṣāṃ dhātutvaṃ vijñāyate| na hradhātubhūtebhyo yagvidhānamupapadyate, nāpi kakārānubandhakaraṇam; prayojanābhāvāt| atha prātipadikatvaṃ kaṇḍvādīnāṃ kathamavasīyate? ityāha - `āha cāyam` ityādi| cakāro hetau| yadyete dhātava eva syustato yaki kṛte `akṛta` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghatvasya siddhatvāt kaṇḍūñ, hmaṇīṅ, mahīṅiti dīrghaṃ noccārayet, uccārayati ca dīrgham, ato'vasīyate - `dhāturvibhāṣitaḥ` iti| dhātutvameṣāṃ vikalpitamityarthaḥ| nanu ca pakṣe yatra yaṅa nāsti tatrāyagantebhyaḥ kvibādau pratyaya utpanne kaṇḍūḥ, kaṇḍūtiḥ, kaṇḍūtavāniti dīrghasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇaṃ syāt| tat kutastasyānarthakyam! kathaṃ punarayagantebhyaḥ kvibādayo bhavanti, yakaḥ pākṣikatvāt, tadapi kutaḥ? vetyanuvṛtteḥ, naitat; nityatvādasya vidheḥ| nityatvantu vāgrahaṇasya nivartitatvāt| kutaḥ punastannivṛttiravīsayate? `āyādayaḥ` [[3.1.31]] ityādeḥ sūtrārambhāt| yadyatra vetyanuvṛttistadottaratrāpyanuvartanādāyādayo vā bhaviṣyantītyetannārabheta| na ca tadanārambhe sārvadhātuke'pyāyādayo vikalpena prāpnuvanti; vāgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt| tasmādāyādaya ityāderārambhādvāgrahaṇanivṛttiravasīyata iti nityaṃ yakā bhavitavyam| tataśca yadyeṣāṃ pakṣe prātipadikatvaṃ na syāddīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāddīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāt prātipadikatvameṣāmastītyekānta eṣa pakṣaḥ| tatra dhātupakṣe kaṇḍūyata ityādayaḥ sidhyanti, prātipadikapakṣe tvasati yaki kaṇḍūrmanturvalgurityādayaḥ| magadha ityādayo ye'kārāntāḥ kaṇḍvādiṣu paṭhante teṣāṃ <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ - magadhyati, sukhyati, duḥkhyati| leṭloṭau śabdau paṭhaete, tayoḥ lvarūpeṇaiva grahaṇam, na tu pratyayatvena, kaṇḍvādibhiḥ svarūpaśabdaiḥ sāhacaryāt||`stutyarthena` ityādi| `paṇa vyavahāre stutau ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 439) `pana ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-440) ityanayā'nupūrvyā gaṇe pāṭhaḥ| tatra `pana ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-440) ityatra stutāvityanuvartate, na vyavahārārthaḥ tena paṇivryavahārārthaḥ, stutyarthaśca,paniḥ stutyartha eva| tadiha stutyarthena paṇinā sāhacaryāt panerapi stutyartha eva gṛhrate| tenāsau stutāveva vartamānaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, na tu vyavahāre| `śatasya` iti| `vyavahmapaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ` [[2.3.57]] iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| atra paṇāyatītyatrātmanepadaṃ kasmānna bhavati, yāvatā paṇirayamanudāttet paṭhate? tatra `anudāttaṅitaḥ` [[1.3.12]] iti yathā kevalādātmanepadaṃ bhavati tathāyapatpratyayāntādapi tena bhavitavyamityata āha - `anubandhaḥ` ityādi| yo hi tasyānubandhaḥ sa āyapratyayarahite paṇatau caritārthaḥ = kṛtātmanepadakāryaḥ, tenāyapratyayāntādātmanepadaṃ na bhavati; tasya dhātvantaratvāt||`sautraḥ` iti| sūtre paripaṭhitatvāt| sūtre bhavaḥ sautraḥ| `ghṛṇāyāṃ vartate` iti| ghṛṇā = jugupsā| tasyāmayaṃ svabhāvata eva vartate| atha kasmādīyaṅucyate, na cchaṅityevocyeta, tasyeyādeśe ṛtīyata iti sidhyati? na sidhyati; paratvādiḍāgame kṛte satyapratyayāditvādīyādeśo na syāt| nanu cāntaraṅgatvādīyādeśa eva bhaviṣyati, antaraṅgatvantu tasyāyannādiṣu `upadeśivadvacanamiṣṭasvarasiddhyartham` (7.1.2|vā|1) iti vacanāt; evaṃ tahrretajjñāpayati - `dhātupratyayānāmāyannādayo na bhavanti` iti| tena śamerḍhapratyaye kṛte śaṇḍhaḥ ityevamādayaḥ siddhā bhavanti| atha vā - svaravidhāvupadeśivadbhāvaḥ svarasidhyarthamiti vacanāt| tena nāstyantaraṅgateti paratvādiḍāgamaḥ syāt, tasmādīyaṅ vidhīyate||`ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ` iti `aca upadhāyāḥ` [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiryathā syāt| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ `na kampamicamām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-817) iti kamermitsaṃjñā pratiṣidhyate `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[6.4.92]] iti hrasvo mā bhūditi? naitadasti; ṇitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva tanna bhaviṣyati; anyathā ṇitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| nānarthakam? <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti sāmānyagrahaṇārthatvāt| yadā ca `āyādaya ārdhadhātuke vā` [[3.1.31]] iti ṇiṅ nāsti, tadā hetumaṇṇici hrasvatvaṃ mā bhūditi mitsaṃjñā pratiṣidhyate||`ārdhadhātukaviṣaye` ityetenārdhadhātuka ityasya viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| ārdhadhātukaviṣayatvaṃ tu tadvivakṣāyāṃ satyāṃ buddhisthe tasmin sambhavati,nānyathetyāha - `ārdhadhātukavivakṣāyām` iti| kena punarabhisandhinā viṣayasaptamītvamāśrīyata iti? evaṃ manyate - parasaptamyāmutpattirvā vikalpyate? nivṛttirvā? yadyutpattistadā gupeḥ striyāṃ ktini vihite tatra yadāyapratyayo notpadyate tadā kāmaṃ guptaritīṣṭaṃ sidhyati| yadā tūtpadyate, tadāto lope [[6.4.48]] vali lope [[6.1.64]] ityakāre kṛte tatra parato yadā nivṛttirna bhavati tadā kāmaṃ gopāyetīṣṭaṃ sidhyati| yadā tu bhavati tadā gopetyaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti| guptiriti satyāmasatyāṃ vā nivṛttāviṣṭaṃ na sidhyati; viṣayasaptamyāṃ tūtpatau vikalpitāyāmutpatsyate| ardhadhātukamiti ārdhadhātukavivakṣāyāmādāveva vikalpaḥ| tatrānutpattipakṣe striyāṃ ktini vihite guptiriti sidhyati, utpattipakṣe gopāyeti| na ca gopātirityaniṣṭamapi; āyapratyayāntāt ktino'bhāvāt| nāpi gopetyaniṣṭamāpadyate, āyapratyayasyānutpatteḥ| `nityapratyayaprasaṅge` iti| pūrvakaistribhiḥ sūtrernityamāyādiṣu prāpteṣvityarthaḥ| `tadutapttau` ityādi| teṣāmāyādīnāmārdhadhātukaviṣaya utpattirvikalpyate, na tūtpannānāṃ nivṛttiḥ| yadi hi nivṛttirvikalpyeta tadārdhadhātuke viṣayabhūte satyāyapratyaye nivṛtte pratyayalakṣaṇena `a pratyayāt` [[3.3.102]] ityakārapratyaye vihite viṣayasaptamyāmapi gopetyaniṣṭaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `yathāyatham` iti| yo yataḥ prāpnoti sa paścādutpattivikalpāduttarakālaṃ tato bhavatītyarthaḥ||`sanādayo'nte yeṣām` iti vākyaviśeṣeṇa bahuvrīhi darśayati| gamakatvana hi vyadhikaraṇānāmapi bahuvrīhirbhavatyeva, yathā - kaṇṭhekālaḥ, urasilometi| ādiśabdena kyajādīnāṃ ṇiṅaparyantānāṃ grahaṇam| `samudāyāḥ` iti| prakṛtipratyayasamudāyāḥ| etena tadguṇasaṃvijñānabahuvrīhi darśayati; anyathā sanādyupalakṣitānāṃ prakṛtīnāmeva dhātusaṃjñā vidhīyeta| `{dhātusaṃjñāḥ - kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|}dhātusaṃjñakāḥ` iti| dhātuḥ saṃjñā yeṣāṃ te dhātusaṃjñakāḥ| dhātuśabdaścātra svarūpapadārthakaḥ, na bhūvādipadārthakaḥ, anyathā bhūvādayaḥ sanādyantānāṃ saṃjñāḥ syuḥ, taccāyuktam, na hi tāvatīnāṃ saṃjñānāṃ karaṇe kiñcit prayojanamasti| āvartinyaśca saṃjñā bhavanti| na hi bhūvādīnāmeva sarveṣāmāvṛttiḥ kvacicchāstre'stīti na tatpadārthako dhātuśabdaḥ| iha hi saṃjñāvidhau sanādīnāṃ pratyayanāṃ grahaṇam| <> [[1.4.14]] ityatra cāntagrahaṇena jñāpitametata - `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya` (pi|pa|vṛ|44) iti| eṣā paribhāṣā saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe pratiṣiddhā| tatrāsatyantagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna syāt, iṣyate ca, atastadarthamantagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam, tatrānenāntagrahaṇa#enāpūrva eva tadantavidhiḥ kriyata iti manyamāno yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha - yadi tarhi sanādyantānāmiyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate tadā devadattaḥ prācikīrṣadityatra devadattasya sopasargasya ca saṃjñā prasajyeteti| ata āha - `pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva` ityādi| na hranenāntagrahaṇenāpūrva eva tadantavidhiḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? padasaṃjñāvidhādantagrahaṇena pratiṣiddhā satī pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva punariha pratiprasūyate| kṛtapravṛttividhātā satī punaḥ pravartata ityarthaḥ| tataśca yataḥ sanādayo vihitāstadādereva samudayasya saṃjñā bhavati, na śabdāntarāderiti śāstrātideśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? kāryātideśaḥ| kāryātideśasūtrameva svatantraṃ yagādeḥ kāryasya vidhāyakam, tacca param; ato vipratiṣedhādyaka eva balīyastvam||` pakāraḥ svarārthaḥ` iti| <> [[3.1.4]] ityanudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| `śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ` iti| `tiṅaśitsārvadhātukam` [[3.4.113]] iti sārvadhātukatvaṃ yathā syāt| śyanprabhṛtīnāmapi śakārasyaitat prayojanaṃ dīrghaḥ||`sanoti, kṣaṇoti` iti| `ṣaṇu dāne (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1464), kṣaṇu hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1465)| `niyamārtham` iti|etadeva tanādikāryaṃ yathā syādityeṣa niyamo yathā syāt| anyat tanādikāryaṃ sarvamiṣṭaṃ sidhyayatyevetyata āha - ` bahulagrahaṇam` ityādi| sarvasya prakṛtasyāprakṛtasya vidhevryabhicāro vyatyayalakṣaṇo yathā syādityevamartha bahulam, itarathā hrasati bahulagrahaṇe vyatyayaḥ - dhuri dakṣiṇāyāmiti prāpte saptamyā viṣaye ṣaṣṭhī| tiṅām - ye yūpāya takṣati| takṣantīti prāpte| lādeśavyaṅgyakriyāviśeṣo mukhya upagrahaḥ| iha tu tadvyaktinimittatvāt parasmaipadātmanedayorupagrahaśabdo vartate| etaduktaṃ bhavati - ātmanepadaparasamaipadayovryatyaya iti| sa brāhṛcāriṇamicchate, pratītamanyadagna yudhyati| icchati, badhyata iti prāpte| liṅgasya - madhostṛptā ivāsata iti| madhuna iti prāpte| narasya = prathamapuruṣādeḥ - atopacārairdaśabhirviyūyāya iti| viyūyāditi prathamapuruṣaviṣaye madhyamapuruṣaḥ, `yu miśraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 1033), patnayo garbhiṇayaḥ| patnyo garbhiṇya iti prāpte| īkārasya ikāraḥ| svarāṇām - <<anto'vatyāḥ>> [[6.1.220]] ityantodāttatvaṃ yatheha bhavati - aāvatīṃ somavatīṃ prajāvatīṃ sūryavatīṃ dṛṣadamita,
