[[5.1.115]] iti; na tu <> [[5.1.116]] iti; tulyakriya iti prathamānirdeśāt| anyathā tulyakriye, tulyakriyasyati saptamyā ṣaṣṭhaā vā nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| tulyākriyā'syeti tulyakriyaḥ| kena tulyakriyaḥ? karmaṇā| sāpekṣatve'pi gamakatvāt samāsaḥ| tulyaśabdo'yaṃ sadṛśavacanaḥ| na ca sādhanasya karmaṇaḥ kriyayā sādṛśyamupapadyate; atyantabhedāt| tathā hi - karma dravyaṃ pariniṣpannam| tdaviparītasvabhāvā kriyā| tasmāt karmaṇeti karmaśabdo'yaṃ gauṇastātsthyādupacāreṇa karmasthāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ vartate, yathā - mañcāḥ krośantīti, atra mañcaśabdaḥ puruṣeṣu| upacārastu karmasthabāvakānāṃ karmasthakriyāñca karmavadbhāvo yathā syāt, kartṛsthabhāvakānāṃ kartṛsthakriyāṇāṃ ca mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| etatsarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvāha - `karmaṇi kriyā karma` iti| etena karmaśabdo'yaṃ karsthakriyāvācītyācaṣṭe| karmasthakriyāvācini ca karmaśabde yaḥ sūtrārthaḥ sampadyate taṃ darśayitumāha - `karmasthayā` ityādi| evaṃ sthite sūtrārthe tulyaśabdo'yaṃ sādhāraṇavacana iti manyamāno yo deśayet - `yadi karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakra#iyaḥ sādhāraṇakriyaḥ kartā karmavadbhavati tadā pacatyodanaṃ devadatta ityatrāpi syāt; yasmādihāpi yāsau pradhānakriyā tāmuddiśya sarvāṇi kārakadravyāṇi pravartante, tayākarmasthayā pravartante, tayākarmasthayā sādhāraṇakriyaḥ kartā bhavati, yathaiva hrasāvanyeṣāṃ kārakāṇāṃ sambandhinī tathā kartturapi` iti, taṃ pratyāha - `yasmin karmaṇi` ityādi| tadvadyathāśabdau sādṛśyārthau prayuñjānaḥ `sadṛśavacano'yaṃ tulyaśabda-,na sādhāraṇavacanaḥ` ityācaṣṭe| yasmin karmaṇi karttṛbhūte'pi katrravasthāṃ pratapanne'pi tādṛśī kriyā lakṣyate yādṛśī karmāvasthāyāṃ sa kartā karmavadbhavati| sādṛśyañca kañcidbhedādhiṣṭānamityasādhāraṇa evādhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇaḥ karttṛvyāpāro gṛhrate, na tu sādhāraṇo vikledādilakṣaṇaḥ| sa cāsādhāraṇaḥ pacacyodanaṃ devadatta ityatra kārakāntaravyāpāravisadṛśo devadattasya karttuvryāpāra iti na bhavati karmavadbhāvaḥ| atha vā - karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmavadbhavatītyukte sadṛśavacanastulyaśabda iti manyamāno yo deśayet - `yadyevam, bhidyamānaḥ kusūlaḥ pātrāṇi bhinattītyatrāpi prāpnoti, tathā hi yādṛśī pātreṣvavayavavibhāgātmikā kriyā tādṛśyeva kusūle kartari lakṣyate` ityasmin pūrvapakṣa idamāha - `yasmin karmaṇi` ityādi| sa ityanena yasminnityanena yo'rtho nirdiṣṭaḥ sa eva pratyavamṛśyate| etenaikadravyādhārayaiva karmasthayākriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmavadbhavatīti darśayan pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati| evacca pratyāsattenryāyāllabhyate| ekadravyasamavāyino hi kriyā pratyāsannā, dravyāntarasamavetā tu viprakṛṣṭā|nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakamiti darśanam, na ca karmaśaktiḥ kadāpi karttṛbhāvamāpadyate, tadayuktamuktam - yasmin karmaṇi karttṛbhūte'pīti? śaktiśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣāyāṃ śaktyādhāraṃ dravyamevaitaduktamityadoṣaḥ| idaṃ tahrrayuktamuktam - `tadvat kriyā lakṣyate yathā karmaṇi` iti| yasmādya eva karmāvasthāyāṃ vyāpāraḥ sa eva katrravasthāyāmapīti sādṛśyaṃ nopapadyate, tasya bhedādhiṣṭhāne sati sattvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avasthābhedena kriyābedādyadyapyavasthāvaddravyamabhinnam, tathāpyavasthābhedo'sti - anyaiva hi katrravasthā,anyā ca karmāvasthā| avasthābhedena kriyābheda iti tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ sādṛśyaṃ bhavati|ihātideśo nimitta - vyapadeśa - śāstra - kāryabhedādanekavidhaḥ| tatreha nimittātideśo na bhavati, na hi karmaṇo yannimittaṃ kartturopsitatamatvaṃ tat kartaryatideṣṭuṃ śakyate; vastvantaradharmāṇāṃ vastvantareṇa viruddhadharmiṇā sambandhābhāvāt| vyapadeśātideśastu saṃjñāpakṣānna bhidyate| saṃjñāpakṣe tu vakṣyamāṇo doṣaḥ, vatigrahaṇañcānarthakaṃ syāt| śāstrātideśapakṣe tu śāstramatidiśyate, tasminnatidiṣṭe taireva śāstrairyagādayaḥ prāpyante; tataśca yadyayaṃ śāstrātideśaḥ syāt karmakartari paratvācchabādayo bādhakāḥ syuḥ, tatra pratividheyaṃ syāt| kāryātideśe tvanenaiva yagādayo vidhīyante| tena yena katrrāśrayāḥ karmakartari śabādayaḥ prāpnuvanti te paratvādyagādibhirbādhyanta iti na kiñcitpratividhātavyam| pradhānaṃ tu kāryātideśaḥ; tadarthatvanādatideśaśāstrāṇām| ataḥ kāryātideśatāmasya darśayannāha - `karmāśrayāṇi` ityādi| nanu ca `tulyakriyaḥ` iti prathamānirdeśāt tadantasya karturatideśo vijñāyate, na ca sūtre karttṛgrahaṇamasti| yadyapi ca prakṛtaṃ tadapi saptamyantam, prathamānirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ tatkathaṃ prathamāntakarttṛgrahaṇamantareṇa śakyate'tideśaḥ karttumityāha - `kartari` ityādi|kiṃ punarasyātideśasya prayojanamityāha - `yagātmanepada` ityādi| `bhidyate` iti yaka udāharaṇam| `abheri` iti ciṇaḥ| `kāriṣyate` iti ciṣvadbhāvasya| karmaṇi hi `syasicsīyuṭ` [[6.4.62]] ityādinā ciṇvadbhāvo vihitaḥ| ātmanepadasya tu sarvāṇyevaitānyadāharaṇāni|`svāśrayamapi` ityādi| yadvināpyatideśo na bhavati tat svāśrayam, tadyathā syādityevamarthaṃ vatkaraṇam| asati hi tasmin saṃjñāsūtramidaṃ syāt, tataśca karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmasaṃjñakaḥ syāt| evañca sati sakarmakatvāt <> [[3.4.69]] iti bhāve lakāro na syāt| vatkaraṇe tu satyatideśo bhavati| tena cāprāptameva karttuḥ karma kāryaṃ bhavati, na svāśrayaṃ karttṛtvam| akarmakasvabhāvatvamapanīyate, tatra tasyā vyāpārāt| etenākarmakāṇāṃ bhāve laḥ siddho bhavati - bhidyate kusūneti| atha bhidyate kusūlaḥ svayamevetyatra kusūlaśabdāddvitīyā kasmānna bhavati, etadapi karma kāryaṃ bhavatyata āha - `liṅyāśiṣyaṅiti` ityādi| dvau lakārau yasmin sa dvilakāro nirdeśaḥ| yadi dvilakārako nirdeśastadā kimityāha - `tatra` ityādi| kāryaṃ pratītyadhyāhāryam| dvilakāranirdeśe sati `liṅyāśiṣyaṅa` [[3.1.86]] ityato lānuvṛttelantisyaiva kāryaṃ prati kartā karmavadbhavati, na tu prātipadikasya| itikaraṇo hetau| yata evaṃ tasmāt kusūlāddvitīyā na bhavati|`karaṇādhikaraṇābhyām` iti| karmaṇetyasatyasmin karaṇādhikaraṇasthayāpi kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmavat syāt, asmastu sati na bhavati| `sādhvasiśchinatti` iti| kaṇasya karttṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ karaṇasthayāpi kriyayā chedyadravyāntaḥpraveśalakṣaṇayā tulyakriyo'trāsiḥ kartā| `sādhu sthālī pacati` iti| atrādhikaraṇasya karttṛtvavivakṣāyāmadhikaraṇasthayā kriyayā sambhavati dhāraṇātmikayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā| atheha kasmānna bhavati - pacatyodanaṃ devadattaḥ, rādhyatyodanaḥ svayameveti; bhavati hyatrāpi karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā, tathā hi yādṛśyodene karmabhūte kriyā vikledanalakṣaṇā lakṣyate tādṛśyeva karttṛbhūte'pi, pacatirādhyatyorekārthatvādityāha - `dhātvadhikārāt` ityādi| samānaśabdo'yamekaparyāyaḥ, yathā - devadattayajñadattayoḥ samānā māteti| ekā māteti gamyate| `dhātorekācaḥ` [[3.1.22]] ityato dhātugrahaṇamanuvartate| karmādiśabdāśca sambandhiśabdāḥ,ye ca sambandhiśabdāste prakṛtyaiva niyatarūpaṃ sambandhinamupasthāpayanti| tathā hi - mātari bhaktyā pravartitavyāmityukte'ntareṇāpi svasyāmiti vacanaṃ svasyāṃ mātarīti gamyate| tena yaṃ dhātumapekṣya tasya karmaṇaḥ karttṛtvaṃ tameva dhātuṃ sannidhāpayati, nānyam| tataśca dhātugrahaṇe'nuvartamāne satyayamartho labhyate| yasmin dhātau karmaṇopasthāpite yat karama tasminneva dhātau sa yadi kartā bhavatyevaṃ satyayamatideśaḥ, nānyathā| tena pacatyodanaṃ devadattaḥ,rādhyatyodanaḥ svayamevetyatra na bhavati, bhinnayordhātvorodanasya karmakarttṛtvāsambhavāt| atha vā - dhātoriti yeyamekā saṃkhyā sā vivakṣitā, tenaikasminneva dhātau karmavadbhāvo bhavati|`karmasthabhāvakānām` ityādinā nyāyaprāptamevārthaṃ darśayati|tathā hi - karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyasya karttuḥ karmavadbhāvo bhavati| na ca karttṛsthabhāvakānāṃ karttṛsthakriyāṇāṃ kartā tathāvidho'sti| yadyapi kriyāpyupādīyate, <> [[3.2.126]] ityatra ca bhāvo'pi parigṛhrate; tathāpīha dvayorupādānasāmarthyādarthabhedo draṣṭavyaḥ|sā parispandanasādhanasādhyā kriyā kriyāśabdenocyate, aparispandanasādhyā tu bhāvaśabdena| yeṣāṃ karmasthobhāvaḥ karmasthā ca kriyā; yeṣāṃ karttṛstho bhāvaḥ kartasthā ca kriyā, teṣāmudāharaṇaṃ darśayitumāha - `karmasthaḥ pacaterbhāvaḥ` iti| pacyate ghaṭaḥ svayamevetyatra yadā taddeśasthaghaṭakarmakapāko niṣpadyate tadā'parispandanasādhanasādhyasvabhāvaḥ pākaḥ kartastho bhavati, yadā tu deśāntaraṃ gacchataḥ pākadravyasya pākābhinirvṛttirbhavati tadā karmasthaiva paceḥ kriyā, yathā - pacyata odana ityatrodāharaṇe| `karmasthā ṭaca bhideḥ kriyā` iti| bhidyate kusūlaḥ - svayameveti| avayavavibhāgalakṣaṇā hi bhideḥ kriyā,sā ca daśāntaraprāptau satyāṃ bhavatīti bhidyate parispandaḥ,tena karmasthā kriyā bhavati| `māsāsibhāvaḥ kartasthaḥ` iti| āserdhātorbhāva asibhāvaḥ| āsanaṃ hi bhāvaḥ; tasyāḥ parispandanasādhanasādhyatvāt| tathā hi - vyāpāroparatāvāsta iti prayujyate| māsasahacarita āsibhāvaḥ| śākapārthivāditvāt samāsaḥ - māsāsibhāvaḥ| kadā sa māsasahacarita āsibhāvo bhavati? yadā māsamāsta iti prayujyate| māsamiti karmaṇi dvitīyā| karmasaṃjñā tu `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ kramasaṃjñā hrakarmaṇām` (vā|1.4.51) iti vacanāt| māsāsibhāvaḥ kartastho bhavati, āsitari samavāyāt| tenāsyate māsaḥ svayameveti na bhavati| `karttṛsthā ca gameḥ kriyā` #iti| gamanaṃ pāda viharaṇātmakam| tacca parispandanasā nasādhyatvācca kriyā, sā ca gantari devadattādau samavetā, na karmaṇi grāmādau| tena karmasthakriyābhāvādgamyate grāmaḥ svayameveti na bhavati||`tapaḥ karmakasyaiva` iti| evakāro vispaṣṭārthaḥ; vyavacchedaphalatvāt, sarvavākyānāmityevaṃ tadarthasya labdhatvāt| yadi hratapaḥkarmakasyāpi syāt, tapaḥkarmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `nānyakarmakasya` ityavadhāraṇena yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayati| `kriyābhedāt` iti| kriyāvisadṛśatvādityarthaḥ| pūrvaṃ hi kriyāsādṛśye karmavadbhāvo vihita iti vaisadṛśyena prāpnoti, ato vidhyarthametat| ata eva karmasthayā kriyayā tulyatvaṃ na sambhavatīti `karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ` [[3.1.87]] ityetannānuvartate| `upavāsādīni` ityādinā tameva kriyābhedaṃ darśayati| upavāsādiśabdena tapaḥ śabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| `duḥkhayantītyarthaḥ` ityanena tāpasasya karmāvasthāyāṃ taperduḥkhanamartha iti darśayati| `svargāya tapastapyate` iti| tapaḥśabdo'tra jñānaviṣeya svargādyavāptihetau vartate| `arjayītyarthaḥ`ityanena tāpasasya katrravasthāyāṃ tapirarjane vartata iti darśayati| nivartayatītyartha iti, na duḥkhayatīti; tapaso'cetanatvādduḥkhāsambhavāt||`uttapati suvarṇam` ityādau suvarṇakarmakatvāt tapeḥ karmavadbhāvo na bhavati||`karmakartari yakciṇānupadiṣṭau na bhavataḥ` iti| karmakartarīti viśeṣaṇam| `karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ` [[3.1.87]] iti prāptayoryakciṇorayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, na tu ciṇvadbhāvakarmaṇoḥ| <> [[3.1.67]] iti ca| śuddhe karmaṇi yau prāptau tayorapīti darśanārtham| etacca `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) iti paribhāṣayā labhyate| `dugdhe` iti| yaki pratiṣiddhe śap, tasyādāditvālluk| pūrvavad ghatvaghatvajaśtvāni| `adugdha` iti| luṅa| ciṇi pratiṣiddhe ksaḥ, tasya `lugvā` [[7.3.73]] ityādinā luk| `prasnute` iti| `{ṣṇu praruāvaṇe` dhātupāṭhaḥ-} snu praruāvaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1038), pūrvavacchapo luk| `prāsnoṣṭa` iti| luṅa| `namate` iti| `ṇama prahvatve śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-981)| antarbhāvitaṇyartho'tra namiḥ karmaṇi vartata iti veditavyam| evaṃ hi karmasthakriyo bhavati; anyathā karttṛsthakriyatvāt prāptirnāstyeveti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| antarbhāvitavyarthastu karmasthakriyo bhavati - namati daṇḍaṃ devadattaḥ| `namate daṇḍaḥ svayameva` iti| yathā ṇyantāvasthāyām| `yakciṇoḥ pratiṣedhe` ityādi| yakciṇoḥ pratiṣedhe kartavye śranthyādīnāmapi tasya pratiṣedhasyopasaṃkhyānam = pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu neti yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddhyarthāt kartavyam| ṇīti hetumaṇṇica itarasya ca ṇegrrahaṇam| hetumaṇṇic| `kārayati` kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ| kārayate kaṭaḥ syavameva` iti| yaki pratiṣiddhe śap| `acīkarata kaṭaḥ svayamevaṭa iti| ciṇi pratiṣiddhe `ṇiśri` [[3.1.48]] ityādinā caṅa,ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ` [[7.4.1]] iti hrasvaḥ| `caṅi` [[6.1.11]] iti dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam| itaro ṇiḥ - `pucchabhāṇḍa cīvarāṇṇiṅa` [[3.1.20]] | `utpucchayate gāṃ gopaḥ| utpucchayate gauḥ svayameva` (iti)| yaki pratiṣiddhe śap| evamuttaratrāpi veditavyam| `udapupucchata gauḥ svayameva` iti| ciṇi pratiṣiddhe pūrvavaccaṅa| evamuttaratrāpi veditavyam| `śrantha grantha sandarbhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1512,1513)| curādau granthiśranthī paṭhaete (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1837,1838)| `ā dhṛṣādvā` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1805 anantaram) iti vibhāṣāṇicau| tayoryadā ṇij nāsti tadodāharaṇe; anyathā ṇītyevaṃ siddhiḥ| granthi granthaṃ devadattaḥ| granthate granthaḥ svayameva| agranthiṣṭa granthaḥ svayameva| śranthati mekhalāṃ devadattaḥ| śranthate mekhalā svayameva| `śrantha grantha sandarbhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1512,1513) itikryādāvapi paṭhaete, tayorapyayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ - śrathnīte mekhalāṃ devadattaḥ, śranthīte mekhalā svayameva| <<ī halyaghoḥ>> [[6.4.113]] itīttvam| aśranthiṣṭa mekhalā svayameva| grathnīte granthaṃ devadattaḥ| granthīte granthaḥ svayameva| agranthiṣṭa granthaḥ svayameva| brūte kathāṃ devadattaḥ| brūte kathā svayameva| pūrvavacchapo luk| avocata kathāṃ devadattaḥ| avocata kathā svayameva| `brāuvo vaciḥ` [[2.4.53]] iti vacirādeśaḥ, `asyativaktikhyātibhyoṣa'ṅa` [[3.1.52]] ityaṅādeśaḥ; `vaca um` [[7.4.20]] | antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt karmasthakriyātvaṃ veditavyam| `ātmanepadākarmakāṇām` iti| ātmanepadavidhāvakarmakā ye dhātavo gṛhyante ta ātmanepadākarmakāḥ| `vikurvate saindhavāḥ svayameva` iti| <<ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ>> [[7.1.5]] ityadādeśaḥ| `vyakṛṣata saindhavāḥ svayameva` ityatrāpi kṛño vipūrvāt <> [[1.3.45]] ityātmanepadavidhānādātmanepadākarmakatvam| atrāpi valgane vartamānaḥ karotirantarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ karmasthakiyo bhavati||rañjeḥ kṛtānunāsikalopanirdeśo lāghavārthaḥ| `yagātmanepadayorapavādau` iti| śyan yako'pavādaḥ; parasmaipadaṃ tvātmanepadasya| `rajyati` iti| `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `prācāṃ grahaṇaṃ vikalpārtham` iti| etena pūjārthatāmapanayati| pūjārthe tasmin vikalpo na labhyeta| `kuṣyate` ityādinā vikalpārthe prāggrahaṇe yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| `syādiviṣaye ca` ityādi| ādiśabdena tāsiprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| `cukuṣe, rarañje` iti| liṭ, ātmanepadam, tapratyayaḥ, tasyaiśādeśaḥ| `koṣiṣīṣṭa` iti| āśiṣi liṅa, sīyuṭ, <> [[3.4.107]] iti suṭ, laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, ṣatvam, ṣṭutvañca| `raṅakṣīṣṭa` iti| `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam - gakāraḥ| `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - kakāraḥ| `akoṣi, arañji` iti| luṅa,ciṇ||`yaṅavidhau dhātorityadhikārāt` iti| `dhātorekācaḥ` [[3.1.22]] iti yaṅavidhau yat dhātugrahaṇaṃ tasyehādhikārādityarthaḥ| iyañca dhātugrahaṇasyānarthakatve yuktiḥ| `kṛdupapadasaṃjñārthaṃ tu` iti| ānarthakyamapākaroti| nanu ca pūrveṇāpi dhātugrahaṇena kṛdupapadasaṃjñe sidhyata syātām, iha kariṣyatīti syapratyayasya `kṛdatiṅa` [[3.1.93]] iti kṛtsaṃjñā syāt| tataśca <> [[1.2.46]] iti prātipadikasaṃjñā prasajyeta, tasyāñca satyāṃ subutpattiḥ| <> [[3.1.43]] ityatra ca `tatropapadam` [[3.1.92]] iti luṅo'pyapapadasaṃjñā syāt, tataśca luṅyupapade clirityayamarthaśca sambhāvyeta| tasamādiha dhātvadhikāre kṛdupapadasaṃjñe yathā syātāṃ pūrvatra mā bhūtāmiti pūnardhātugrahaṇam| athādhikāreṇaite saṃjñe vidhāsyete pratyayasaṃjñāvat, tena pūrvatra na bhaviṣyatīti cet? na hi; siṃhāvalokitanyāyopyasti| adhikāreṇa vidhāne pūrvatrāpi sambhāvyeyātām| tatra vyākhyānaṃ kartavyaṃ bhavet| vyākhyānācca laghu dhātugrahaṇaṃ bhavati| avaśyañcānyārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, tadanyārtha kriyamāṇaṃ kṛdupapadasaṃjñāvidhāvapi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyati| tāmeva cānyārthatāṃ darśayitumāha - `ārdhadhātukasaṃjñārtham` ityādi| caśabdādvā'sarūpavidhānārthañcetyayamatrārtho veditavyaḥ| <> [[3.1.94]] ityasmin dhātvadhikāre'sarūpo'pavādo bādhako yathā syāt, pūrvatra mā bhūt| tena ksādibhiḥ sicaḥ samāveśo na bhavati| nanu ca pūrveṇāpi dhātugrahaṇenārdhadhātukasaṃjñā setsyati, kiṃ dvitīyadhātugrahaṇena? ityata āha - `dhātorityevam` ityādi| dhātorityevaṃ dhātuśabdamuccārya vihitasyārdhadhātukasaṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punardhātukṛgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ punardhātorityevaṃ vihitasyārdhadhātukasaṃjñocyate? ityāha - `iha mā bhūt` itati|asati dvitīye dhātugrahaṇe lūbhyām, lūbhirityatrārdhadhātukasaṃjñā syāt| bhavati hyatra dhātoḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ - `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati` (vyā|pa|132) iti kṛtvā| ārdhadhātukatve satyārdhadhātukalakṣaṇa iṭ prasajyeta| dvitīyaṃ tu dhātugrahaṇaṃ kriyamāmaṃ sāmarthyādchabandapadātmakaṃ bhavati| tenāyamartho labhyate - dhātorityevaṃ dhātusaṃśabdanena yo vihitaḥ sa ardhadhātukasaṃjño bhavatīti| tena lūbhyāmityādāvārdhadhātukatvaṃ na bhavati| na hīha dhātorityevaṃ pratyayo vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? prātipadikādityevam||`saptamyā nirdiṣṭam` ityanena saptamīsthamityasyārthamācaṣṭe| śabdasya hīyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate, sa ca kaḥ saptamīstho bhavati? yasyāḥ saptamyā nirdeśaḥ| `kumbhakāraḥ` iti| upapadasaṃjñāyāṃ `upapadamatiṅa` [[2.2.19]] iti samāsaḥ, <> [[6.2.139]] ityattarapadasya prakṛtisvaratvaṃ bhavati|`sthagrahaṇam` ityādi| nirdiśyate'neneti nirdeśaḥ| saptamī nirdeśo yasya sa saptamīnirdeśaḥ| tatpratipattyarthaṃ sthagrahaṇam| etaduktaṃ bhavati - sūtre yat saptamyā nirdiṣṭaṃ tasya saṃjñitvena pratipattiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ sthagrahaṇam| yadi punaḥ sthagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tataḥ kiṃ syādityata āha - `itarathā hi` ityādi| itarathā hrakriyamāṇe sthagrahaṇe `saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti` (pu|pa|vṛ|81) itisaiva saptamyupapadasaṃjñāṃ pratipadyeta| na cāsataḥ saṃjñinaḥ saṃjñā yukteti yatra śrūyate saptamī - stamberama ityādau tatraiva syāt| syādetat - naitat pratyayagrahaṇam,kiṃ tarhi? saptamīśabdasya svarūpasya grahaṇamityāha - `yatra` ityādi| gatārtham| `sthagrahaṇāttu` ityādi| sthagrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe granthādhikyāt sūtre yasya saptamyā nirdeśastat saṃjñitvena nirdiśyate, tenu sarvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati; yeṣāmiyaṃ saṃjñeṣyate teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva sūtre saptamīnirdeśāt| tathā hi - `stambakarṇayoḥ` [[3.2.13]] ityatra stambakarṇaśabdau sūtre saptamyā nirdiṣṭau| <> [[3.2.97]] ityatrāpyupasarādayaḥ| <> [[3.2.1]] ityatrāpi karmābhidhāyinaḥ kumbhaprabhṛtayaḥ|nanu ca lāghavārthaṃ saṃjñākaraṇam, tatkimarthaṃ gurvī saṃjñā kriyate? ityāha - `gurusaṃjñākaraṇam` ityādi| upaśabdaḥ sāmīpye| upoccāritaṃ padamupapadamityanyarthasaṃjñāvijñāne sati samarthaparibhāṣāvyāpāro yathā syādityevamarthaṃ gurusaṃjñākaraṇam| samarthaparibhāṣopasthāne sati yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate taddarśayitumāha - `paśya kumbham` ityādi| anvarthasaṃjñāyāṃ hi satyāmupapadāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ padavidhirbhavati| yatra ca padagandho'pyasti tatra samarthaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate| tena paśya kumbhaṃ karoti kaṭamityatra <> [[3.2.1]] na bhavati| na hīha kumbhasya karotinā sāmarthyam, kiṃ tarhi? paśyetyanena| padaśabdo'pyatrānvartha eva, na pāribhāṣikaḥ| tathā hi subantasya padasaṃjñā ṭacopapadasaṃjñāvidhanakāle subantatayāsti; iti| āpṛcchyapratiṣīvyaśabdayoḥ siddhya āpracchiptiṣivaśabdābhyāṃ dvau kyapau bhavataḥ||`pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī` iti| <> [[3.1.85]] ityanena| kasyāḥ punaḥ pañcamyā arthe ṣaṣṭhī? digyogalakṣaṇāyāḥ| pratyayavidhau hi `paraśca` [[3.1.2]] iti sambandhāt pañcamyā bhāvyam||`avaśyambhāva āvaśyakam` iti| manojñāditvādvuñ| etadeva jñāpakam - avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopo bhavatīti| atra dvayaṃ sambhāvyate - upapadatvam, āvaśyaka upapada iti; upādhikatvañca, āvaśyake dyotya iti| tatra yadyevaṃ jñāpyate - āvaśyakaupapada iti, tadopapadarahitādāvaśyake dyotye na syāt| `lāvyaṃ pāvyam` iti|āvaśyake dyotya ityevaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `āvaśyake dyotye` iti| etacca pratyāsatyā labhyate| upādhirhi pratyayāntadyotyatvādantaraṅgaḥ, upapadena ca sambandho bahiraṅgaḥ, tadarthasya padāntaravācyatvāt| `svarasamāsānupapattiḥ` iti| upapade hrāvaśyake vijñāyamāne `upapadamatiṅa` [[2.2.19]] iti samāso bhavati| tasmaśca sati <> [[6.2.139]] ityupapadāśraya uttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam, na titsvaro bhavati| dyotyapakṣe tu samāso na syāt; lakṣaṇābhāvāt| athāpi kathañcidupapadasamāsādanyaḥ samāsaḥ syāt? evamapyupapadasamāsāśrayaḥ svaro na syāt; tataśca titsvaro na labhyet, samāsāntodāttatvaṃ hi syāt| `avaśyalāvyam` iti| `lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye` iti malopaḥ| `mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt` ityādi| mayūravyaṃsakāderākṛtigaṇatvādavaśyalāvyaprabhṛtalāvyaprabhṛtayastatra draṣṭavyā iti darśayati| svaraḥ kathamityāha - `uttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve ca` ityādi| tatrāyaṃ yatnaḥ - <> [[6.2.139]] ityatra <<ṣaṭ ca kāṇḍādīni>> [[6.2.135]] ityataścakāro'nuvarttiṣyate, sa cānṛktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenāvaśyalāvyamityādāvapi prakṛtisvaro bhavatīti||`yato'pavādaḥ` iti| `ṣṛñ abhiṣave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1247), `yu miśraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1033) anayo rajantvāt| `ḍuvapa bījatantusantāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1003), `rapa lapa vyaktāyāṃ vāci` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-401,402), `trapūṣ lajjāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-374), `camu adane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-469) - eṣāmadupadhatvanāt pavargāntatvāt| `dābhyam` iti| dabhirdhātuṣvapaṭhita eva prakṛtyantaramasti culumpavat||`ṇyannipātyate` iti| yati prāpte| yadyanitye nipātyate ghaṭādiṣvapyatiprasaṅgaḥ, teṣāmanityatvādityāha - `rūḍhaḥ` ityādi| satyapi pravṛttinimittatve rūḍhaā niyataviṣayatvācśabdā viśiṣṭa evārthe vartante, nāviśiṣṭe, mayūrādiśabdavat| na hi mahrāṃ rautīti sarvo mayūra ityucyate, nāpi gacchatīti sarvo gaurityucyate, kiṃ tarhi? viśiṣṭa eva prāṇī| tasmādrūḍhiśabdāddakṣiṇāgnāveva vartate, na ghaṭādiṣu| `nityamajāgaraṇāt` iti| satatamajvalanādityarthaḥ| jvalanameva hi tas jāgaraṇam| dakṣiṇāgnāvapi viśiṣṭa evāvatiṣṭhate na sarvatreti darśayitumāha - `yaśca` ityādi| kiṃ punastasya yonivakalpo'sti, yenaivaṃ viśiṣyate? ityāha - `tasya hi` ityādi| yoniḥ = kāraṇamityarthaḥ| `vaiākṛlāt` ityādinā yonivikalpaṃ darśayati|`ānāyyo'nitya iti cet` iti| ghaṭādiṣvapi prāpnotīti śeṣaḥ| `dakṣiṇāgnau kṛtaṃ bhavet` iti| `ānāyyaḥ` ityetasminnipātanaṃ dakṣiṇāgnāveva viśiṣṭe kṛtaṃ bhavet, nānyatra| liṅa sambhāvanāyām| etat sambhāvyate, nānyathetyarthaḥ| `ekayonau ca taṃ vidyāt` iti| tamānāyyaśabdamāhavanīyena ya ekayonirdakṣiṇāgnistatra vidyājānīyādityarthaḥ| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe - ekayonāveva| `āneyo hranyathā bhavet` iti| ghaṭādāvanitye dakṣiṇāgnau cāhavanīyena bhinnayonau `aco yat` [[3.1.97]] iti yati kṛta āneya ityevaṃ bhavati|||avidyamānā sammatirityanena vākyaviśeṣeṇa bahuvrīhiṃ darśayaṃstatpuruṣāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti - `sammatiḥ sammatatā` iti| sammata iti pūjita ityucyate| sammatasya bhāvaḥ sammatatā| etena sammatiśabdeneha pūjitābhidheyateti darśayati|`yadyevam` ityādi| avidyamānapūje caurādau praṇāyyaśabdasyāntevāsini prayogo nopapadyate| na hi pūjā'ntevāsini na vidyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `brāhṛ prabrāūyāt` iti brāhamaśabdenātra veda ucyate| `sammatirabhiloṣo'pyucyate` iti| na kevalaṃ pūjetyapiśabdena darśayati| `tadabhāvena` iti| abhilāṣābhāvena| `niṣkāmatayā` iti| bhāvabhogābhilāṣarahitatayetyarthaḥ||`pāyya` iti|` āto yuk` [[7.3.33]] `havirviśeṣeṣvatiṣṭhate` iti| yatraivāyaṃ rūḍhastatraivāvatiṣṭhate| na havirmātre| `dhāyyā` iti| pūrvavat yuk| `ṛgviśeṣasya vācakaḥ` iti| sarvā ṛco na sāmidhenīśabdenocyate, kiṃ tarhi? samidādhānamantraḥ| tathā hi samidādhānamantre sāmidhenīśabdo vyutpādyate| sāmidhenyapi na sarvā ṛgabhidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? kācideveti darśayannāha - `tatra` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyena nipātanāṃ kriyamāṇaṃ viśeṣaviṣayaṃ labhata ityāha - `rūḍhiśabdo hramam ` iti|dhāyyāśabdo rūḍhiśabda ṛgviśeṣasya vācakaḥ| saivānenocyate, nānyā| kathaṃ punajrñāyate rūḍhiśabdo'yamityata āha - `tathā ca` ityādi| yadi rūḍhiśabdo'yaṃ na syāt sāmidhenyāṃ nipātitatvād dhāyyāḥ śaṃsadityatra ṛgviśeṣe na dṛśyeta, dṛśyate cāsau| tasamādrūḍhiśabdo'yamityavasīyate| yadi tahrrasāmidhenyāmapi dṛśyate, sāmidhenīgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? nānarthakam; rūḍhiviśeṣopalakṣaṇārthatvāt|||`pibateḥ` iti| `pā pāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-925)| `adhikarame yatpratyayaḥ` iti| lyuṭi prāpte| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ ṇyataṃ tyaktvā yatpratyayāntaḥ kuṇḍapāyyaśabdo nipātyate? ata āha - `yato'nāva iti svaraḥ` iti| yatpratyayāntatve hruttarapadādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| ṇyatpratyayāntatve'ntasvaritatvaṃ syāt| `kuṇḍapānam` iti| kratoranyatra lyuḍeva bhavati||`saṃpūrvādvaheḥ` ityādi| halantatvāṇṇyat siddha eva; tasmastu sati samprasāraṇaṃ na prāpnoti; akittvāt| ṇyataḥ kṛte'pi samprasāraṇe `halaḥ` [[6.4.2]] iti dīrghatvaṃ na prāpnoti; yasamādaṅgāvayavāddhala uttaraṃ yat samprasāraṇaṃ tadantasyāṅgasya dīrgatvaṃ vidhīyate; na cāyamevamprakāro'sti,ata ubhayaṃ nipātyate| na sampūrvādūheḥ sāmānyavihitena ṇyataiva sidhyati| agnāveva vaheḥ sampūrvāṇṇyadyathā syāt, iha mā bhūt - saṃvoḍhavyo brāāhṛṇa iti||`tenāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati` iti| yatpratyayāntanipātane hi pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ padasya bhavati| ṇyati tu sati titsvaritatvaṃ bhavati| tasmāt prakṛtaṃ tyaktvā yapratyayo nipātyata iti bhāvaḥ||`cakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ` ityādi| tṛjtṛnoḥ sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ yathā syāditi| asati tu tasmin `niranubandhakaraṇe na sānubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|53) iti tṛno grahaṇaṃ na syāt| athāntodāttārthaḥ kasmānna bhavati? tasya pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhatvāt||`pratyāsattyā pacinaivādiśabdasya sambandho mā vijñāyītyata āha - `pratyekam` ityādi|`nandivāśi` ityādi| `ṭunadi samamṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-67), `vāśṛ śabde` dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-745) - ebhyo dhātubhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ lyurbhavati| nandayatīti| nandanamityevamādyudāharaṇam| `dūṣaṇam` iti| <> [[6.4.90]] ityūttvam| aṇyantānāṃ tveṣāmasaṃjñāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ syāt| atha dvayanubandhakasya jahāterna syāt| kakāre tu sati dvayorapi sānubandhakatvāt sāmānyena grahaṇamupapadyate| `vrīhau kāle ca kartari` iti| etena vrīhikālayoḥ pratyārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ darśayati| darśayati| `jihīte bhāvān` iti| `jihīte bhāvān` iti| etenāpi saṃvatsare||`prasṛlvaḥ` iti samabhihāraṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaḥ| numāgamastu satyapi napuṃsakatve na kṛtaḥ, anityatvādāgamaśāsanasya| samabhihāre vun iti| anyatra samabhihāraśabdasya paunaḥpunyādikamartha iti, ihāpi sa evārtha iti kasyacit bhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha - samabhihāragrahaṇena ityādi| lakṣyate pradarśyate ityarthaḥ| etaccānekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ labhyate | śilpinītyanuvṛtterityapare | śilpī = sādhukārī | `sādhukāriṇi vunvidhānam` sādhukāritvopalakṣaṇasya phalaṃ darśayati| `sakṛdapi` ityādi| anantarasyaiva ceha dhātuviśeṣasyānāśrayaṇāt| dhātumātrāśrayo bhavati, na tu kutaścideva viśeṣāt| `jīvatāt, nandatāt` iti| āśiṣi loṭprayogeṇa jīvakanandayostatsamānārthatāṃ darśayati| kā punariyamāśīrnāmetyāha - `āśīḥ prārthanāviśeṣaḥ` iti| aprāptasyābhīṣṭasya vastunaḥ prārthanā = āśīḥ| `sā ceha kriyāviṣayā`iti| kriyā viṣayo'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| eṣa cārtho dhātugrahaṇāt, dhātośca kriyāvācitvādvijñāyate| `amuṣyāḥ kriyāyāḥ` iti| jīvanakriyāyā nandanakriyāyāśca kartā bhavedityevamāśāsyate - jīvanaṃ nandanañca te bhūyāditi||iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃtṛtīyasyādhyāyasyaprathamaḥ pādaḥ`karmaṇi` iti nedaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam; `aśabdasaṃjñā` [[1.1.67]] iti pratiṣedhāt| yadi ca karmapradeśeṣu svarūpameva gṛhrate,tadā saṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt; nāpi kriyāgrahaṇam, tasya hi grahaṇe `kartrabhiprāye` [[1.3.72]] iti nirdeśo nopapadyate, kriyākarmaṇo hi grahaṇe kriyāvācyupapade pratyayena bhavitavyam, na ceha kriyāvācyupapadamasti tasmāt `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma` [[1.4.49]] iti karma gṛhrate| tasya prabhedaṃ darśayitumāha - `trividham` ityādi| tatra nirvarttyaṃ yadasadevotpadyate, tathā - kumbhaṃ karoti,nagaraṃ karotīti| kumbhādikaṃ hravidyamānamevotpadyata iti nirvarttyaṃ karma| vikāryam - yasya sata eva kaścidadvikāro vidhīyate, tadyathā - kāṇḍaṃ lunāti, nagaraṃ lunātīti| sata eva kāṇḍāderlavanena vikāro vidhīyata iti vikāryaṃ karma| prāpyam - nāsata evotpādanaṃ kriyate, nāpi sata eva vikārādhānam, kevalaṃ kriyāsambandhamātraṃ pratīyate, tadyathā - vedamadhīte, carccāṃ parayatīti| atrahravyayanādinā vedādeḥ sambandhamātraṃ pratīyate, na tvasata evotpādanam| nāpi sata evānyathālakṣaṇo vikāra iti prāpyametat karma| `sarvatra` ityādi| traprakāre viśeṣānupādānāt| `karmaṇyupapade` iti nābhidāne kuto mā bhūt? `kartari kṛt` [[3.4.67]] ityasya bādhā iti| `śīlikāmi` ityādi| `{śīla upadhāraṇe iti dhātupāṭhaḥ- curādau paṭhate; etayostu striyāṃ viśeṣaḥ - aṇi hi ṅib bhavati, ṇe tu ṭāp| ṇakāraḥ <> [[7.2.115]] vṛddhyarthaḥ| `pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvañca` iti|`gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛt` [[6.2.139]] ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve māṃsaśīlādibhyaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvañca bhaviṣyatīti| māṃsaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ - `vṛtṛvadihanikami{kaṣiyumucibhyaḥ da|u|} kaṣibhyaḥ saḥ` (da|u|9|21) ityanuvartamāne `manerdīrghaśca` (da|u|9|23) iti yo guruḥ sa udātto bhavati| `bahvaṣ` iti bahvajityarthaḥ| nanu ca śīlyādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ghañaṃ kṛtvā tadantena bahuvrīhau kṛte sidhyatveva māṃsaśīlādi, tatka ṇavidhānena? naitadasti; bahuvrīhau sati ciṇkṛtoḥ>> [[7.3.33]] iti yuk||`anupasarge` iti| vyatyayena pañcamīprasaṅge'pi saptamī| dhātuviśeṣaṇañcaitat| ata evāha - `ākārāntebhyo'nupasargebhyaḥ`iti ca| `godaḥ` iti| pūrvavaladākāralopaḥ| `pāṣṇam` iti| `traiṅa pālane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-965)||supīti grahaṇāt karmaṇīti na sambadhyate, tiṣṭhaterakarmakatvācca| `samasthaḥ` ityādau saptamyanta upapade `atra` ityādi| supītyeko yogaḥ, tatra cāta ityanuvartate| `supītyādinā` asya yogasyārthamācaṣṭe| `tataḥ stha ita` iti| dvitīyo yoga iti| `sthaśca supi` iti vivaraṇam|`kimityādi| pūrveṇa siddhamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `bhāve'pi yathā syāt` iti| ārambhasāmarthyāt kartari tāvanna bhaviṣyati| na cārthāntaraṃ nirddiśyate, tatra `anirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti` (pu|pa|pā|90) iti bhāva eva syāt| sa eva hi dhātūnāṃ svārthaḥ| `{ākhūtthaḥ-kāśikā} ākhūttham` iti| <> [[8.4.61]] iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ||`parimṛjāpanudoḥ` iti| subvyatyena pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī| `mṛjū śuddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1066) pūripūrvaḥ| `nuda preraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1426) apapūrvaḥ| `ālasya` ityādi| pratyayārthopādhirayam| alasa evālasyam| cāturvaṇryāditvāt svārthe ṣyañ| āharatītyāharaṇaḥ| <> [[3.3.113]] iti kartari lyuṭ| sukhasyāharaṇaḥ sukhāharaṇaḥ| ālasyakartari sukhasyāharaṇe'nena ko bhavati, nānyatretyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - atrāpi pūrvavadvavibhāṣāgarhaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenālasyasukhāharaṇayoreva karttoḥ ko bhavati, nānyatreti| `tundaparimārja evānyaḥ` iti| anālasye tvaṇ bhavati| <> [[7.2.114]] | `śokāpanodaḥ` iti| yaḥ pratipakṣopadeśena śokaṃ kevalamapanudati, na tu sukhamutpādayati| atrāṇeva tu bhavati|`kaprakaraṇe` ityādi| mūlavibhujādibyastadarthe caturthī| ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ| mūlavibhujādyartha mūlavibhujādayaḥ sādhavo yathā syurityevamartha kapratyayasyopādānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - <> [[3.2.2]] ityataḥ <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] ityatra cakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena mūlavibhujādibhyaḥ kapratyayo bhaviṣyatīti| mūlaṃ vibhujati| `{bhujo-dhātupāṭhaḥ-} bhuja kauṭilye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1417)| nakhāni muñcantīti nakhamucāni| `muclṛ mokṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1430)| ` kākagṛhāstilāḥ` iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-896)| kākebhyo gūhitavyāḥ|tavyadādyapavādaḥ| karmaṇi kaḥ| `kau modate kumudam` iti| tṛjādyapavādaḥ||`sopasargārthaṃ ārambhaḥ` iti| anupasargāt <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] ityevaṃ siddhatvāt| `dadāteḥ` iti| dārūpāṇāṃ dhātūnāmupalakṣaṇametat| anyeṣāmapi dārūpāṇāṃ grahaṇamiṣyame; `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ` (vyā|pa|124) iti vacanāt| `preṇopasṛṣṭāt` iti| preṇopasargeṇa sambaddhādityarthaḥ| sūtre `pre` iti subvyatyayena tṛtīyārthe saptamī veditavyā| `pathiprajñaḥ` iti| panthānaṃ prajānātītyarthaḥ||`gāṃ sañcaṣṭe` iti| vākyaviśeṣeṇa `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ` [[2.4.54]] iti khyāñādeśasya grahaṇam, na `khyā prakathane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1060) ityetasyeti darśayati| etacca saṃpūrvasya khyāteḥ prayogāsambhavāllabhyate||`lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayorlukvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|50) iti `pā` iti pānārthasya grahaṇamam, rakṣaṇārthasya na| yadyapi `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ` (vyā|pa|124) ucyate, tathāpi pibatinā sāhacaryāt `gā` ityasyālugvikaraṇasya grahaṇam, na gatyarthasyetyāha - `gāyateḥ, pibateśca` iti| ṭakaḥ kitkaraṇamāto lopārtham| ṭitkaraṇaṃ ṅībartham; na tu <<ādyantau ṭakitau>> [[1.1.46]] ityevamartham| kuta etat? ādyantayoravayavatvāt| na ca pratyayo'vayavo yujyate, `paraśca` [[3.1.2]] iti vacanāt| nanu ca gāporiti ṣaṣṭhī ṭako'vayavatvañca bodhayiṣyate? naitadasti; pañcamyarthe tveṣā ṣaṣṭhī, karttṛviśeṣaṇārthā vā - gāpoḥ kartarīti| yuktañcaitat, evaṃ hi pratyayaparatvaṃ bādhitaṃ na bhavati| kiñcāditve hi ṭakaḥ kitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|pibaterūpapadāntasya nivṛttyarthamāha - `surāśīdhvoḥ` ityādi| tatra pibateriha grahaṇam, na pāterityetat prāgeva vyavasthāpitam| iha `vibhāṣā` [[3.1.143]] ityanuvartate, sā tu vyavasthitavibhāṣā; tena surāśīdhvorupapadayorbhaviṣyati, nānyatra| `kṣīrapā` iti| strīliṅgodāharaṇaṃ striyāṃ viśeṣa iti pradarśanārtham|`bahulam` ityādi| pibateśchandasi bahulaṃ ṭagbhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu - tasyaiva vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| tasya tu phalaṃ surāpeti pakṣe kapratyayo bhavati||`udyamanamutkṣepaṇam` iti| adhaḥ sthitasya vsatuna ūdhrvaṃ nayanamityarthaḥ| `aṃśaharaḥ` iti| aṃśaṃ svīkarotītyarthaḥ, na tūtkṣepayati|`acprakaraṇe` ityādi| `prātipadikagrahaṇe {liṅgiviśiṣṭasya` iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|} liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|29) iti ghaṭagrahaṇenaiva ghaṭīgrahaṇe siddhe ghaṭīgrahaṇamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham| tasya tu prayojanam - `dityadityādityapattyuttarapadāṇṇyaḥ` [[4.1.85]] ityatra vakṣyate| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena śaktyādiṣūpapadeṣu graherajbhaviṣyati|`sūtre ca` ityādi| dhārerartho dhāyryarthaḥ| tatra vartamānādgraheḥ sūtre copapade'ca upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyam| pratipādanaṃ tāvattadeva| `sūtragrāha evānyaḥ` iti| yaḥ sūtraṃ kevalamupādatte na dhārayati, tatrāṇeva bhavati||`udyamanārtho'yamārambhaḥ` iti| anudyamane pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| `asthiharaḥ`iti| asthyutkṣepaṇasamarthe vayasi vartata ityarthaḥ||anudyamanamiti nivṛttam| tenāviśeṣāllabhyate - udyamane cāyaṃ vidhiriti| nanu cānudyamane pūrveṇaiva siddham, paratvāddhi tṛn prāpnoti, vāsarūpavidhānādajapi bhavati? naitadasti; vakṣyati hretat - tācchīlikeṣu vāsarūpeṇa tṛjādayo na bhavantīti| `tācchīlyaṃ tatsvabhāvatā` iti| tat punarmānaso dharmaḥ| phalanirapekṣayā pravṛttiranumīyate| `puṣpāharaḥ`ityādinā tācchīlyamudāharati||`{strīliṅge iti mūlapāṭhaḥ} striyāṃ viśeṣaḥ` iti| aṇi hi sati ṅībbhavati, aci tu sati ṭāp||`japeḥ śabdakarmakatvāt` iti gāyatrīṃ japati;anuvākaṃ japatītyatra śabdakarmakasyaiva prayogadarśanāt| `karmaṃ na sambhavati` iti| karṇasyāśabdātmakatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|itikaraṇo hetau| yata eva karṇaśabdaḥ karma na sambhavati tena supītyetadiha sambadhyate,na karmaṇīti|`hastisūcakayoḥ` ityādi| hastisūcakagrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasyaiva kartturviśeṣaṇam| `stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ` iti yo'yamajvidhiḥ sa hastisūcakayoḥ katrrorbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu - tasyaiva vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| `stamberamaḥ karṇejapaḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.14]] iti saptamyā aluk| `sūcakaḥ`iti| piśunaka ityarthaḥ||`dhātumātrāt` iti| dhātumātragrahaṇenāpavādaviṣaye'pi vidhānaṃ darśayati| evaṃ hi dhātumātrādbhavati, yadyapyapavādaṃ bādhitvā tadviṣaye'pi bhavati| eṣa cārtho dhātugrahaṇāllabhyate| `śami saṃjñāyām` ityādinā dhātugrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayanam, dhātupratipāditamarthaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti - `śami saṃjñāyām` iti| sūtropalakṣaṇametat| `śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām` ityasmin sūtra ityarthaḥ| `hetvādiṣu` iti| ādiśabdena tācchīlyānulomyayogrrahamam| śamyupapade karoteḥ saṃjñāyāṃ hetvādiṣu vivakṣiteṣu <> [[3.2.20]] iti ṭaḥ prāpnoti, atastadvādhanārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇam| śami dhātoritysayāvakāśaḥ karoteranyo dhātuḥ śamyupapadaḥ sambhavati - śaṃvada iti, `kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomye` [[3.2.20]] ityasyāvakāśaḥ karotiḥ śabdāntaropapadaḥ - śrāddhaṃ karotīti śrāddhakara iti; karoteḥ śamyupapade saṃjñāyāyamubhayameva prāpnoti - śaṅkarā nāma śakuniketi| sā hi tacchīlā, tatsaṃjñā ca, tatra paratvāṭṭaḥ prāpnoti, punardhātugrahaṇāddhātu mātrādvidhīyamānaṃ ṭaṃ bādhitvā'jeva bhavati||`supīti sambadhyate` iti|śeterakarmakatvāt| adhikaraṇasya cākarmakatve sambhavati supītīha sambadhyate, na karmaṇīti|`pār(āādiṣūpasaṃkhyānam` iti| ārambho'yamanadhikaraṇārthaḥ| pār(āābhyāmiti tṛtīyāntamupapadaṃ darśayati| uraḥśaḥ, pṛṣṭhaśaya ityatrāpi tṛtīyāntamevopapadaṃ veditavyam|`digdhasahaśayaḥ` iti| digdhena saha śeta iti `tṛtīyā` [[2.1.29]] iti yogavibhāgena samāsaḥ| digdhasya sahena prāk pratyayotpatteḥ paścādupapadasamāsaḥ|`girau` ityādi| girāvupapade śeteśchandasi viṣaye ḍo bhavati| `giriśaḥ`iti| ḍittvāṭṭilopaḥ| etat sarvaṃ <> [[3.1.85]] iti bahulavacanāt siddham||bāla-manoramāadhikaraṇe śeteḥ 744, 3.2.15 adhikaraṇe| subante'dhikaraṇavācinyupapade śīṅdhātorac syādityarthaḥ| pār(āādiṣviti| atrā'dhikaraṇavācaninīti na saṃbadhyate| taddhvanayannudāharati - pār(āābhyāmiti| uttānādiṣu kartṛṣviti| vārtikamidam| uttānādiśabdeṣu kartṛvāciṣūpapadeṣu śīṅo'jityarthaḥ| girāviti| vārtikamidam| girāvupapade śīṅo dabhasyāpi ṭerlopaḥ| yadyapi vaidikaprakriyāyāmevedaṃ vyākhyeyam, tathāpi loke ḍapratyayasya na pravṛttiḥ ki tvajeveti pradarśanārthamiha tadvyākhyānamityabhipretya loke acpratyayamudāharati - giriśaya iti| kathamiti| loke ḍapratyayā'saṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ| samādhatte - girirasyāstītyādi| bāla-manoramāharaterdṛtināthayoḥ paśau 752, 3.2.15 haraterdṛtināthayoḥ| dṛtiḥ carmabhastrikā| dṛtihariḥ āā iti vṛttiḥ| `nātha` śabdasya vivaraṇam - nāsārajjumiti| nāsikāprotarajjumityarthaḥ| nāthahaririti| nāsikāprotarajjuke paśuviśeṣe rūḍho'yam|`pratyayāntarakaraṇaṃ ṅībartham` iti| ṭittvānṅībbhavati||`anadhikaraṇārtha ārambhaḥ` iti| adhikaraṇe pūrveṇaiva siddham| bhikṣāñcaratīti `bhikṣācaraḥ` senāñcaratīti `senācaraḥ`| `ādāya` iti lyabantametat| ādāya caratīti `ādāyacaraḥ` atrādātavyakarmaṇo'vivakṣitattvāt pūrvākālamātre vivakṣite pratyayaḥ| ādānaṃ kṛtvā caratīti yāvat| tena sāpekṣatvādasāmarthye sati pratyayo na sidhyatītyetadacodyam| athāpi karmāpekṣate? evamapi na doṣaḥ; vacanasāmarthyādasāmarthye'pi pratyayo bhavati||puraḥśabdaḥ `pūrvādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣām` [[5.3.39]] ityasipratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ| agrataḥśabdo'pi `tasiprakaraṇa ādyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam` (vā|634) iti tasipratyayāntaḥ| `agre` iti| agraśabdasyaikārāntatvaṃ nipātyate - agresara ityetadrūpaṃ yathā syāt| nanu ca saptamyā alukāpyetat sidhyati? satyam; yadā sidhyati tadā saptamyanta upapade pratyayaḥ| yadāgraḥ saratīti, agreṇa vā saratītyasaptamyantastadā na sidhyati; tadarthamekārāntatvaṃ nipātyate||`pūrvaśabde karttṛvācinyupapade pratyayaḥ` iti| etena kartarītyanenopapadaṃ viśiṣyate, na kartā| pratyayārtho nirdiśyata iti darśayati; tasya `kartari kṛt` [[3.4.67]] ityanenaiva nirdeśāt| ayuktatvādiha nirdeśasyetyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca pūrvaḥ saratītyatrāsāmarthyamasti, tathā hi - pūrvaśabdo'yaṃ vyavasthāvacanaḥ, avayavavācī vā| tatra pūrvasmin kalpe'vadhirapekṣaṇīya - asmādayaṃ pūrva iti| itarasmastvavayavī padārthaḥ, yathā - pūrva kāyasyeti, ubhayorapi sāpekṣitatvāt, asāmarthye sati pratyayānutpattiḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvaśabdaḥ sambandhiśabdaḥ| sāpekṣe'pi vṛttirnanu bhavatyeva, yathā - devadattasya gurukulamiti||hetvādaya ete, nopapadāni| yadi hrupapadāni syuḥ, <<śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām>> [[3.2.14]] ityatra dhātugrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| taddhi kṛño hetvādiṣu ṭapratiṣedhārthaṃ kṛtam| yadyeṣāmupapadatvaṃ syāṭṭapratyayasya prāptireva nāstīti dhātugrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|ato naivāmupapadatvam, nāpi pratyayārthatvam; `kartari kṛt` [[3.4.67]] iti karttuḥ pratyayārthatvāt| na ca tairbādhā yuktā, virodhābhāvāt| tasmāt pratyayārthaviśeṣamatvameṣāṃ yuktam| tatra kartari pratyayo bhavati yasminnabhidhīyamāne tadviśeṣo hetvādayo gamyante| ata evāha - `hetau tācchīlye ānulomye ca gamyamāne` iti| `heturaikāntikaṃ kāraṇam` iti| etena laukikahetogrrahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati| pāribhāṣiko hetuḥ svatantrasya karttuḥ prayojakaḥ, yadi tasyeha grahaṇaṃ syāta kṛña iti nopapadyate; na hraṇyantāt prayojakakartari prayojaka itpadyate, api tu ṇyantādantarbhāvitaṇyarthāt pratyaya utpadyata iti cet? naitadasti; ṭapratyayāntaṇṇyarthasyāpratīteḥ| nanu ca laukikasya hetogrrahaṇe sati nimittatayā kartā viśiṣyate, taccāyuktam; na hi kartturanimitvamasti yadviśeṣaṇena vyāvarttyeta? naiṣa doṣaḥ siddhe kartturhi nimittatve punarhetuśabda upādīyamāna aikāntikatvaṃ bodhayatīti - yaḥ kartā yasyāḥ aikāntiko heturiti| ata evoktam - `heturaikāntikaṃ kāraṇam` iti| ānulomyam = anukūlayāmītyārādhyacittānupravartanam| `yaśaskarī`iti| `ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa` [[8.3.46]] ityādinā visarjanīyasya satvam||bāla-manoramākṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu 748, 3.2.20 kṛño hetu| hetuḥ - kāraṇam| ānulomyam - ārādhyacittānuvartanam| dyotyeṣviti| kartureva pratyayavācyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| hetvādiṣūpapadeṣviti tu nārthaḥ, vyākhyānāt| karmaṇyupapade ityapi draṣṭavyam| `kupvo`riti jihvāmūlīyamāśaṅkyāha - ata- kṛkamīti| hetāvudāharati - yaśaskarī vidyeti| vidyā yaśohetuḥ| śrāddhakara iti| śrāddhakriyāśīla ityarthaḥ| vanakara iti| gurvādivacanānuvartītyarthaḥ| bāla-manoramānāḍīmuṣṭa�ośca 758, 3.2.20 nāḍīmuṣṭaośca| yathāsaṅkhyaṃ neṣyate iti| idaṃ tu bhāṣye spaṣṭam| ghaṭīkhārītyādi spaṣṭam|`yathāyogam` iti| divāśabdasya supīti sambandhaḥ, tasyādhikaraṇasya pradhānatvāt karmatvānupapatteḥ| śeṣāṇāṃ tu sattvapradhānatvāt karotisambandhe karma copapadyata iti karmaṇītyanena sambandhaḥ| `ahetvādyartha ārambhaḥ` iti| hetvādiṣu pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| `bhāskaraḥ` iti| kathaṃ punaratra sakāraḥ, yāvatā sakārasya rutvavisarjanīyayoḥ `kupvo ka pau ca` [[8.3.37]] iti visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyayoranyatareṇa bhavitavyamityāha - `sakārasya nipātanāt` ityādi| bhāskarānteti yatsakārasyoccāraṇaṃ tadeva nipātanam| `bahukaraḥ` iti| bahuśabdo vaipulyavācī| `ahaskaraḥ` iti| ahannityasya <<ro'supi>> [[8.2.69]] iti nakārasya rephaḥ, tasya visarjanīyaḥ| tasya `ataḥ kṛkami` [[8.3.46]] ityādinā satvam| `dhanuṣkaraḥ, aruṣkaraḥ` iti| <> [[8.3.44]] , <<nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya>> [[8.3.45]] iti ṣatvam| athānantagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, antagrahaṇādevānantaśabde'pi tadantavidhinā bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; sarvasminnupapadavidhau na hi tadantavidhiriṣyate| tathā hi `{ vārtikakāraḥ} padakāraḥ paṭhati - `upapadavidhau bhayāḍhaādigrahaṇaṃ tadantavidhiṃ prayojayati` (1.1.73 vā|9) iti| evaṃ tarhi nānatakaro'nantakara ityantaśabdenāpi nañsamāso bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śaṅkyam;svare doṣaḥ syāt| sati śiṣṭe hi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā prakṛtisvare hi nañsvaraḥ prasajyeta| tathā cānantakaraśabda ādyudāttaḥ, `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80) iti naña udāttatvātiṣyate ca `{ gatikārakakopapadāt kṛt iti sūtram} gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛt` [[6.2.138]] ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttatvam| tasmādanantagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam|`kiṃyattadbahuṣvajvidhānam` ityādi| kimityādiṣūpapadeṣvajvidhānaṃ kartavyam, tatkathamiha ṭo'pyanuvartate? māṇḍūkalputinyāyenājapi, vibhāṣāgrahaṇamapi| tadvayavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt kiṃyattadbahuṣu kṛño'jeva bhavati, śeṣeṣu divādiṣu ṭa eva| ahetvādyarthatvāccārambhasya yadā hetvādayo viśeṣā na vivakṣyantetadā kiṃyattadbahuṣu kṛño'jvidhānam, teṣu vivakṣiteṣu pūrvasūtreṇa ṭa eva bhavati| tathāyaṃ prayoga upapanno bhavati - jātiriyaṃ kiṃkarīti| kiṃkaraṇaśīlā kiṃkarī, na kiñcidapi karoti| niṣprayojananeti yāvat||`karmaṇīti svarūpagrahaṇam` iti| kuta etat? karmagrahaṇasamāthryāt| yadi pāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo grahaṇamiha syāt karmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; karmādhikārāt| karoteśca sakarmaṃkatvāt tenaiva sambaddho bhaviṣyati| tathā ca prāguktam - karmaṇi supīti dvayamapyanuvartate, tatra sakarmakeṣu karmaṇītyetadupatiṣṭhate, anyatra supīti| tasmāt svarūpagrahaṇamevaitat| `karmanirdeśaḥ`iti| karma vyāpāraḥ, tasya nirdeśaḥ = mūlyam||`hetvādiṣu ṭaḥ prāptaḥ` iti| `kṛño hetu` [[3.2.20]] ityādinā||`vrīhivatsayoriti vaktavyam` iti| karttṛviśeṣamaṃ vrīhivatsagrahaṇam| anena sūtreṇa ya in vidhīyate sa vrīhivatsayoḥ katrrorbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - ihāpi vibhāṣetyanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena vrīhivatsayoḥ katrroreva bhaviṣyati, nānyatra| nityatvāduttarapadādādyudāttatvam||`paśau kartari` iti| etena paśugrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasya kartturviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| pratyayārthatvaṃ tu `kartari kṛt` [[3.4.67]] iti vacanāt| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam - pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇameveti, na punarbādhakameveti? taducyate - dhātoḥ pratyayasya vidhānāt tadarthasya yena sambandhastatra vācye pratyayena bhavitavyam| dhātvarthaḥ = kriyā tasyāśca sādhanena sambandhaḥ, na vastusvarūpeṇa| sādhanañca śaktiḥ, na vastusvarūpam| paśuśabdena vastusvarūpeṇa svārthamācaṣṭe| na śaktisvarūpeṇeti| tenāśaktisvarūpe pratyāyyamānaḥ paśurnārhati pratyayārtho bhavitum| so'pratyayārthaḥ sannaśaktitvāt kathamimaṃ pratyayārtha bādheta| tasmāt pratyayārthaḥ, tena kartari viśiṣyata iti yuktamuktam - paśau kartarīti| eṣa nyāyo'nyatrāpi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe draṣṭavyaḥ||`brāhṛvaniṃ tvā kṣatravanimiti| brāhṛ vanati, kṣatraṃ vanatītyarthavivakṣāyāminpratyayaḥ| tadantāddvitīyā, tasyāḥ `supāṃ suluk` [[7.1.39]] iti luk| yuṣmacchabdāddvitīyādibhakteḥ <> [[8.1.23]] iti tvādeśaḥ| `gosanim` iti| gāṃ sanatītyartha inpratyayaḥ| tadantādami pare pūrvarūpatvam| panthānaṃ rakṣata iti `pathirakṣī`| dvivacanametat| pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam| `havirmathīnām` iti| havirmathantīti vigṛhra pratyayaḥ| tadantāt ṣaṣṭhaā bahuvacanam||ṇyantāt` iti| etena prakṛtyantarasyāyamejerikā nirdeśa ityāśaṅkāṃ nirasyati| kutaḥ punaṇryantamavasitam? khaśaḥ śitkaraṇāt| prakṛtyantarasya grahaṇe śitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| taddhi sārvadhātuke sati tadāśrayasya śapo vidhiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate| na caijeḥ prakṛtyantarasya satyasati vā śapi kaścidviśeṣo'sti, ṇyagrahaṇe tu sati śitkaraṇamarthavadbhavati| asati tasmin ṇilopaḥ syāt, tasmastu sati sārvadhātunibandhane śapi ṇilopo na bhavati| ārdhadhātukatvaṃ ṇilopa ityeke, etaccāyuktam; uttarārthaṃ hi śitkaraṇaṃ syāt| asati hi tasminnuttarasūtre dheṭa āttvaṃ syāt, dhmaśca dhamādeśo na syāt| tathā ca stanandhayaḥ, nāsikandhama iti na sidhyet| tasmādvyākhyānādeva ṇyantatvamavaseyam| `khakāro'yaṃ mumarthaḥ`iti| <> [[6.3.66]] ityadhikṛtya <> [[6.3.67]] iti mumāgamo yathā syāt| `śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ` iti| `tiṅaśit sārvadhātukam` [[3.4.113]] iti sārvadhātukasaṃjñā yathā syāt| `aṅgamejayaḥ` iti| śap, guṇāyādeśau|`khaśprakaraṇe` ityādi| vātādiṣūpapadeṣu `aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-230), `dheṭ pāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-902), `tuda vyathane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1281),`ohāk tyāge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1090) - ityebhyo dhātubhyaḥ khaśprakaraṇa upasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - <> [[3.2.30]] ityatra cakāraḥ, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena vātādiṣūpapadeṣvajādibhyo dhātubhyaḥ khaś bhaviṣyati| `śunindhayaḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.66]] iti hrasvatvam| `śadrdhañjahāḥ` iti| juhotyādibhyaḥ śapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam, `śnābyasatyorātaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ||`stane dheṭaḥ` ityādinā yathāyogamupapadasambandhaṃ darśayannudāharaṇāni darśayati| `nāsikandhamaḥ` iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa [[7.3.78]] dhamādeśaḥ| `taccaitat` ityādi| yathāsaṃkhyābhāve hetumāha| stanaśabdo hi nāsikāpekṣayalpāctaraḥ, tasya pūrvanipāte kartavye yo'yamapūrvanipātaḥ kṛtaḥ salakṣamavyabhicāraṃ sūcayati| yatheha pūrvanipātaśāstraṃ vyabhicarati, svaviṣaye na pravartate, tathā yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīti| ato'smāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnādyathāsaṃkhyābhāvo labhyate||`udi` iti| saptamīyam- udi sati| tatrotkūlaśabdayorviṣayavyavasthā draṣṭavyā| <> [[1.4.80]] iti vacanāddhātoranantaramutśabdaḥ, tasmāt pūrvaḥ kūlaśabda iti| atha vā - `{ uditi - mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} udīti parasaptamī - udi parataḥ kūlaśabdasyopapadatva iti| athocchabdasyāpyupapadasaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati, pratyekaṃ saptamyuccāraṇāt? eṣā hrācāryasya śailī yatra pratyekamupapadatvamasti tatra samudāyāt saptamīmuccārayati, yathā - `nāḍīmuṣṭyoḥ [[3.2.30]] iti| iha tu viparyayaḥ kṛta iti na bhavatyupapadatvam| api ca rujivahoḥ sakarmakatvāt karmaṇītīhopatiṣṭhate| na cocchabdasay karmatvaṃ sambhavati asattvavācitvāt| kutastasyopapadatvam| `kūlamudrujaḥ` iti| tudāditvācchaḥ` `kūlamudvahaḥ` iti| śap||`vahaṃlihaḥ` iti| `liha āsvādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1016) adāditvācchapo luk, <> [[1.2.4]] iti ṅitvādguṇābhāvaḥ||`prasthampacā,droṇampacā` iti| prasthadroṇaparimite vrīhrādau prasthadroṇaśabdāvupacāreṇa vartete; na prasthādāveva parimāṇaviśeṣe kāṣṭhādimaye| kledavācī hyatra paciḥ| na ca mukhyasya prasthādervikledaḥ sambhavati, ato na tasya sambandha upapadyate| svarūpagrahaṇamapyata eva na bhavati; na hi svarūpapradhānena parimāṇena vikledavacanasya paceḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati| yadyapi hi prasthādiśabdaḥ parimeye vartate, tathāpi parimāṇavyapadeśo na tasya virudhyate, prathamaṃ parimāṇavṛttitvāt||`aparimāṇārtha ārambhaḥ` iti| parimāṇe pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| mitanakhaśabdayoraparimāṇavacanatvāt| sarvadaiva hi mitaśabdaḥ parimeyadravyavacanaḥ , nakhaśabdo hi prāṇyaṅgavacanaḥ||`aruntudaḥ` iti| aruśśabdasya <> [[6.3.67]] ityukārāt paro mumāgamaḥ, saṃyogāntalopaḥ [[8.2.23]] , <<mo'nusvāraḥ>> [[8.3.23]] , <> [[8.4.58]] itiparasavarṇaḥ||`asūryampaśyāḥ` iti| prāghrādisūtreṇa [[7.3.78]] paśyādeśaḥ| `dṛśinā nañaḥ sambandhāt` iti| asāmarthya hetuḥ| atra hi darśanaṃ pratiṣidhyate,na tu sūrya eva| tasmāddṛśinaiva nañaḥ sambandhaḥ, na sūryeṇetyasāmarthyam| `sūryaṃ na paśyanti` iti dṛśinā nañaḥ sambandhaṃ darśayati| yadā sūryaḥ pratiṣadhyate tadā na bhavitavyameva pratyayena, anabhidhānāt| samāsaścāyamasāmarthye'pi bhavati, gamakatvāt| asmādeva vacanādvā| nanu ca yathā rājadārāḥ sūryaṃ na paśyantīti tathānyadapi parapuruṣādikam, tatrāyuktaṃ sūryeṇaikena viśeṣaṇenetyata āha - `guptiparañcaitat` iti| yatetadasūryampaśyā rājadārā iti vacanametadguptipradhānam; guptipratipādanāya prayuktatvāt| `evaṃ nāma` ityādinā guptiparatvamasya darśayati||`ugrampaśya` iti| <> [[3.2.1]] iti prāpte dṛśeḥ khaś nipātyate| pūrvavat paśyādeśaḥ| `irammadaḥ`iti| `irayā mādyati`iti| `madī harṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1208)| tṛjādiṣu prāpteṣu khaś nipātyate| tatra divāditvācchyani prāpte tadabhāvo nipātyate| `pāṇindhamāḥ` iti| adhikaraṇe lyuṭi prāpte khaś nipātyate| pūrvavaddhamādeśaḥ|`cakāraḥ `khacihrasvaḥ` iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ`iti| `khe hrasvaḥ` ityucyamāne khaśyapi syāt| nanu caikānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasyeti (vyā|pa|52) na bhaviṣyati? evaṃ tarhi paribhāṣāśrayaṇāccakārakaraṇameva laghviti ca manyate| nanu ca priyaṃvado vaśaṃvada iti khaśyapi siddhyati, kimarthaṃ pratyayāntarakaraṇamityāha - `pratyayāntarakaraṇamuttarārthamiti| <> [[3.2.39]] ityatra khaci hrasvastāperyathā syāt| ṇilopaścetyādyarthaṃ pratyayāntaraṃ kriyate| athottaratraiva khac kasmānna kriyate? atrāpi khajbhavatīti vijñānārtham| tena gamerapi supyupapade khac siddho bhavati|yadi `khacprakaraṇe gameḥ supyapasaṃkhyānam` (vā|247), tatropasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanārthaṃ pratyayāntaraṃ kriyate| pratipādanantvidameva veditavyam|`vihāyaso viha ca` iti| gamervihāyaḥśabda upapade khacpratyayaḥ, tatsanniyogena vihāyaḥśabdasya vihādeśaḥ| `khacca ḍidvā vaktavyaḥ` iti| ḍittvāṭṭilopaḥ syāt, `vihāyaso viha ca` (vā|248) ityato'sya bhedena pāṭhāt| ḍittvasyānityatvajñāpānārtham; anyathā vihaṅgama iti na sidhyet|`ḍe ca` ityādi| ḍapratyaye ca gamervihāyaso vihādeśaḥ| `vihagaḥ` iti| na punaratra ḍapratyayaḥ? asmādeva vacanādbhavati| atha vā vakṣyatyuttarataḥ `ḍaprakaraṇe'nyeṣvapi dṛśyate` (vā|256) iti||`dvayorapi grahaṇam` iti| ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ viśeṣābhāvāt| `dvitakārako nirdeśaḥ`iti| `dviṣatparayoḥ`iti nirdeśe dvau takārau,tatraiko dviṣacchabdasyāvayavaḥ, tena dviṣacchabdo viśiṣyate - dviṣacchabda upapade takārānta iti| `tena striyāṃ na bhavati` iti| strīpratyayāntastakārānto na bhavati| asati tu dvitīye takāre `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati` (vyā|pa|29) iti strayiyāmapi syāt| `{dviṣatīkāśikā} dviṣatī` iti| <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp| ugittvantu dviṣacchabdasya <<dviṣo'mitre>> [[3.2.131]] iti śatrantatvāt||`śāstritaḥ` iti| śāstre kṛta iti vigṛhra śāstraśabdāt pratipadikāddhātvarthe ṇic, tadantāt kte vihate śāstrita iti| śāstravihita ityarthaḥ| atha vā śāstriṇa itaḥ śāstritaḥ, śāstravida itaḥ = jātaḥ, pravṛttaḥ| atha vā - śāstraśabdastārakādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ| śāstramasya sañjātamiti śāstritaḥ| `vācaṃyamaḥ` iti| vācaṃ yacchatīti vigṛhra khaci <> [[6.3.69]] iti pūrvapadasya mumabhāvo nipātyate| nanu ca pratyayo'pi tenaiva nipātanena bhaviṣyati, tatkimanena? naitadasti; yacchatīti pacādyaci vihite tataśca `vāco yamaḥ` iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāse kṛte vācaṃyama iti sidhyati| sampadyata eva, tatra tu nipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt| evañca sati nityamupapadasamāso na syāt| ataḥ khacpratyayo vidheyaḥ, nipātanamapi kartavyam||`dāri` iti| `dṛ? vidāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1493) ityasya ṇicā nirdeśaḥ| `purandaraḥ` iti| pūrvapade mumbhāvo nipātyate|`bhage ca dāreriti vaktavyam` iti| bhage copapade dāreḥ khajbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[3.2.37]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate, na cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena bhage copapade dāreḥ khajbhavatīti||`sarvaṅkaṣaḥ` iti| `kaṣa khaṣa śiṣa jaṣa jaṣa {śaka iti mu|pāṭhaḥ} śaṣa vaṣa maṣa ruṣa riṣa hiṃsārthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-685-694)||`upapadavidhau` ityādi| nanu cābhayaśabdo nañsamāse sidhyatyeva? naivaṃ śakyam, satiśiṣṭatvāddhi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarādyudāttatvaṃ syāt, `{gatikārakopapadāt kṛt` iti sūtram} gatikārakopapadānām` [[6.2.138]] ityādināntodāttatvaṃ ceṣyate| tasmāt kartavyam| apavādatvāt khajayamaṇaṃ bādhate, hetvādivivakṣāyāñca paratvāṭṭapratyayamapi||atha `kṣemapriyamadre vā` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam? kimaṇgrahaṇena? khaci vikalpyate, <> [[3.2.1]] ityanenaivāṇ bhaviṣyītyata āha - `veti vaktavye` ityādi| `kṣemapriyamadre vā` ityucyamāne pakṣe vāgrahaṇādyathāprāptamapīṣyate| tato hetvādiṣu vivakṣiteṣu `kṛño hetutācchīlya` [[3.2.20]] ityādinā ṭaḥ syāt; atastadvādhanārtham| tena hetvādivivakṣāyāṃ ṭapratyayaṃ bādhitvā'ṇ bhavati||atra supītyupatiṣṭhate, na karmaṇīti; bhavaterakarmakatvāt| `āśitaśabde subante` ityādi| atha viparyayaḥ kasmānna vati, karaṇabhāvayorupapadayorāśite pratyayārtha iti? asambhavāt| āśita ityaśnāteḥ kartocyate, tasya bhavatinā sambandho nopapadyate| na hi yo'śnāteḥ kartā sa bhavateḥ pratyayārtho bhavatumutsahate| tasmādāśitaśabdasyopapadatvam, itarayostu pratyayārthatvam| evañca ghañlyuṭorapavādo bhavati| vā'sarūpavidhinā lyuḍapi bhavatyeva - āśitabhavana odana iti| ghañastu svarūpatvādbādhakha eva|||`saṃjñāvaśāt` iti| saṃjñāśabdā hi dvividhā bhavanti - kecidavayavārthānugatāḥ,yathā - saptavarṇa iti; kecittu viparītāḥ, yathā tailapāyiketi| tadiha yatrāvayavārthānugamo'sti viāmbharaḥ, śatruntapa ityādiṣu , tatra karmaṇīti sambadhyate - viāṃ bibhartīti viāmbharaḥ| yatra tvavayavārthānugamo nāsti, yathā - rathantaraṃ sāmeti, tatra vyatpattyarthaṃ supīti sambadhyate - rathena taratīti, rathe taratīti vā| `patiṃvarā` iti| `vṛñ varaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1254), `vṛṅa sambhaktrau`(dhātupāṭhaḥ-1509)| patiṃ vṛṇīte, patiṃ vṛṇuta iti vigrahaḥ| śatruṃ jayatīti `śatruñjayaḥ`| `dhāri` iti| dhṛño ṇyantasya grahaṇam| yugaṃ dhārayatīti `yugandharaḥ`| pūrvapadadhrasvatvam| śatruṃ sahata iti `śatruṃsahaḥ`| śatruṃ tapatīti `śatruṃtapaḥ`| ariṃ dāmyatīti `arindamaḥ`| yadyapi damirakarmakaḥ, tathāpyantarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt sakarmako bhaviṣyati| ariṃ damayatītyarthaḥ||`yasya sautaṅgamiḥ putraḥ` iti| putrasya sautaṅgamitvavyapadeśena pituḥ sutaṅgamasaṃjñānumīyata iti darśayati| satyāṃ hi pituḥ sutaṅgamasaṃjñāyāṃ tatputrasya sautaṅgamiśabdenābhidhānaṃ bhavati, nāsatyām| atha yogavibhāgaḥ kimarthaḥ, pūrvasūtra eva gamegrrahaṇaṃ kriyātamityāha - `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ` iti| gamerevottaratrānuvṛttiryathā syāt, bhṛñādīnāṃ mā bhūt| ekayoge hi te'pyanuvarteran||`ḍakāraṣṭilopārthaḥ`iti| ḍiti `ṭeḥ` [[6.4.155]] iti ṭilopo yathā syāt| kathaṃ punaḥ satyapi ḍakāre ṭilopo labhyate, yāvatā bhasaṃjñakasya hi ṭilopa ucyate, na ceha bhasaṃjñā'stītyāha - `ḍityabhasyāpi` ityādi| yadi satyapi ḍiti ṭilopo mā bhūt, tadā tasya vaiyathryaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu caśravaṇārtha bhaviṣyati, tatkuto vaiyathryaṃ syāt? evaṃ manyate - <> [[6.3.15]] iti kṛtaṭilopasya janerḍapratyayāntasyāyaṃ nirdeśaṃ karoti, tato'vasīyate ḍakārasyāśravaṇārthateti| `sarvatra` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `gamaśca` [[3.2.47]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate| tasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt sarvatretyādānupapade ḍo bhaviṣyatīti| sarvatraśabdaścātra supītyanena sambadhyate, na tu karmaṇītyanena; tasyādhikaraṇaśaktipradhānatvāt karmatvānupapatteḥ| pannaśabdaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt karmaṇītyanena sambadhyate| pratipāditaṃ hi `karaṇe ca stokālpa` [[2.3.33]] ityādisūtre kriyāviśeṣaṇasya karmatvam|`uraso lopaśca` iti| <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti sakārasya|`sudūroradhikaraṇa` iti| lyuḍapavādo ḍo vidhīyate| vā'sarūpavidhinā so'pi bhavati - sugamanam, durgamanamiti| adhikaraṇa iti kim? karmaṇi mā bhūt| `īṣadduḥsuṣu` [[3.3.126]] ityādinā khaleva bhavati - sugamaḥ, durgama iti|`niro deśe` iti| nirśabda upapade gamerḍo bhavati deśe'dhikaraṇe| nirgamyate'smin deśe nirgo deśaḥ| deśādanyatra lyuḍeva - nirgamanamiti||`āśiṣi` iti| pratyayārthametat| tasmin kartari pratyayo bhavati yasmin vidhīyamāna āśīrgamyate| `timiṃ vadhyāt` iti| āśīrliṅa| prayogavato vākyasyopanyāsastu samānārthatvāt timihaśabdasya prakhyānārthaḥ|`dārāvāhana` ityādi| ṭakārādeśa evopasaṃkhyāyate| aṇpratyayastu <> [[3.2.1]] ityanenaiva siddhaḥ| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityantasya bhaviṣyatīti? naca ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyālontyaviṣayo bhavanti| na ceha hanteḥ ṣaṣṭhaā nirdeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? pañcamyā| nanvarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati - hana ityasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī sampadyate? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthamantagrahaṇam| `dārvāhanti` iti|dāruśabdo'tra dvitīyāntaḥ| `svamornpuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] iti luptatvānna dvitīyā śrūyate|`cārau vā` iti|atrā'pyādeśo vikalpena vidhīyate| aṇ tu <> [[3.2.1]] iti nityameva siddhaḥ| `cārvāghāṭaḥ`iti| `ho hanterñṇinneṣu` iti kutvam| <<hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ>> [[7.3.32]] iti tatvam| `karmaṇi sami ci` ityetadvākyaṃ karmaṇyupapada ityasyaiva viśeṣaṇam||<> [[3.2.31]] ityatrocchabdasyopapadatve yo nyāya uktaḥ sa ihāpyapaśabdasya veditavyaḥ| `anīśīrartha ārambhaḥ`iti| āśiṣi pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt||`kumāraghātī` iti| pūrvavat tatvakutve| `nipātanācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ` iti| kumāraśīrṣayorityata eva nipātanācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvo bhavati, na punaḥ <<śīrṣaṃśchandasi>> [[6.1.60]] ityanena| tatra hi śīrṣanniti śiraḥśabdasamānārthaṃ śabdāntaraṃ nipātyate,anyathā śīrṣaghātīti cchandasyeva syāt,na bhāṣāyām| `kumāraśīrṣayoḥ` iti ca nirdeśo nopapadyate, sa hi nakārāntaḥ; akārāntena cāyaṃ nirdeśo bhavati, na nakārānteneti| ṇinerdvitīya ikāro nakārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārthaḥ, ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ||lakṣyate cihnyate'neneti lakṣaṇam| tadasyāstīti tasmin lakṣaṇavati| etena matvarthīyākārapratyayānto lakṣaṇaśabdaḥ sūtra upātta iti darśayati, sa ca karttuḥ pratyayasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayannāha - `lakṣamavati kartari` iti| atha lakṣaṇaśabdasyopapadatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? kecidāhuḥ- `hanteḥ sakarmakatvāt karmaṇītīhopatiṣṭhate;tatra yadīha lakṣaṇasyopapadatvaṃ syāt, tat karmaṇā viśiṣyeta| na ca lakṣaṇaṃ hanteḥ karmopapadyate, sa hi hiṃsāyāṃ vartate, hiṃsā ca prāṇiviṣayā| jāyāpatyoḥ prāṇidharmatvāt karmatvamupapadyate`iti, etaccānupapannam ; matvarthīyākārapratyayāntasya lakṣaṇaśabdasya prāṇinyapi vṛtteḥ| vyākhyānādeva lakṣaṇasyānupapadatvaṃ vijñāyate| anabhidhānādvā| jāyāpatyoḥ katrrorabhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam| `jāyāghnaḥ`iti| kittvāt `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityādinopadhālopaḥ, pūrvavat kutvam| `patighnī`iti| ṭittvānṅīp||`amanuṣyakarttṛke` iti| amanuṣyaḥ kartā yasya sa tathoktaḥ etacca dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇam, dhātvartho hanterityata āha - `{ evaṃprakārā paṃktirmūlapāṭhe nāsti} amanuṣyakarttṛke dhātvarthe` ityādi| athāmanuṣyakarttṛkagrahaṇamupapadaviśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? karmaṇītyanuvartate, karmaṇaścāmanuṣyakatrrā saha sambandhānupapatteḥ| sādhanasya hi kriyāyāḥ sambandhaḥ, na kārakāntareṇa| pratyayārthasya karttṛridaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? tasyāmanuṣyakarttṛkatvābhāvāt| na hi karttuḥ kartā sambhavati, api tu kriyāyāḥ| nanu ca karttṛgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, vināpi hi tenāmanuṣyakartari pratyayo labhyata eva? naivaṃ śakyam; karttṛgrahaṇamantareṇāmanuṣyagrahaṇaṃ kevalamupādīyamānamupapadaviśeṣaṇamapi vijñāyate| tasmāt karttṛgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| tasmin satyamanuṣyakarttṛgrahaṇaṃ tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ na sambhavatītyato dhātvartha eva tena viśeṣayituṃ yuktaḥ| `iha kasmānna bhavati` iti| hastikarttṛkatvādamanuṣyakarttṛko dhātvarthaḥ| etasmādbhavativyameva ṭakpratyayeneti manyate||`śaktau gamyamānāyām` iti| anenopapadatvaṃ śakternirākaroti| `hastikapāṭayoḥ karmaṇīrupapadayoḥ`ityanenāpi hastikapāṭayoḥ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate - śaktāvupapade hastikapāṭayoḥ katrroriti? ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi vijñāyamāne hastikapāṭayormanuṣyakarttṛke dhātvarthe hantirvartate| tathā ca pūrveṇaiva siddhe'syārambhavaiyathryaṃ syāt| upapadatve tu tayoḥ śaktau gamyamānāyāṃ manuṣye kartari vijñāyata iti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ|`viśeṣa hastinaṃ hanti`iti| viṣeṇetyaśaktikatvaṃ darśayati| yo hi svayaṃ hantuṃ na samarthaḥ sa viṣādinopāyāntareṇa hanti||`pāṇighatāḍaghau` iti| ṭapratyayo ghatvaṃ ṭilopaśca nipātyate||`accau`iti| bahuvrīhiḥ - na vidyate cviryasmistatrāccau| tatpuruṣo vā - cveranyo'cviḥ| acvyanta ityarthaḥ| acvādityāḍhaādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam| ekavacanaṃ tu pratyekaṃ tairabhisambadhyate| `āḍhaādiṣu` ityādinā karttṛviṣaṣaṇatvamāḍhaādīnapākaroti| `karaṇe kārake`ityanenāpi karaṇasyopapadatvaṃ nirasyati| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate - karaṇa upapade āḍhaādiṣu karttṛṣviti? tatra kecidāhuḥ - āḍhaādayo'tra śabdapradhānāḥ, na ca tathābhūtānāṃ karttṛtvamupapadyate| śabdapradhānatvaṃ punasteṣāṃ cvyanteṣvacvāviti pratiṣedhādvijñāyate| śabda eva hi cvyanto bhavati, nārthaḥ| cvyantatā śabdasyaiva vidyate, nārthasya| tatra yadyete'rthapradhānāḥ syuḥ; cvyartheṣviti viśeṣaṇamanupapannaṃ syāt, acvāviti ca pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| paryudāso'pyanarthakaḥ syāt ; na; tsayāpyāḍha ityevaṃśabdaḥ sukhati, subhagaśabdaḥ sukhayītyādiprayogeṣu kartatvadarśanāt| vyākhyānādevārthaniścayo'dveṣyaḥ| karaṇasya pratyayārthatvena nirdeśāt `kartari kṛt` [[3.4.67]] iti na vyāpriyate| nanu ca neme cvyarthāḥ, te niyogata eva cvyantāḥ, iha tvacvyantā āḍhaādayo na sambhavantyeva, tatka paryudasyanta ityāha - `cvervikalpena vidhānāt` ityādi| vikalpena vidhānaṃ tu <> [[4.1.82]] ityato vāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ|`āḍhaṃ tailena kurvanti` ityādi| na hrasau prāganāḍhastailenāḍhyaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? āḍhastailenābhyajyate| anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ karotiratrābhyañjane vartate| tenābhūtaprādurbhāve nāstīti bhavati pratyudāharaṇam| atha vā - bhavatu nāmābhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ, tathāpi yuktamevedaṃ pratyudāharaṇamiti darśayitumāha - `prakṛteravivakṣāyām` ityādi| na hrabhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ ityevaṃ sarvo'bhūtaprādurbhāvaścvyartho bhavati, kintu viśiṣṭa eva; yasmāt tatra prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ darśayiṣyate| prakṛtiḥ kāryasya pūrvāvasthā| tena yatrāśritaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvārambhaśca kāryasy bhāvyamānatayā vivakṣyate tatra sa abhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ, sa eva cvyarthaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati - yadā kāryasya pūrvāvasthā vivakṣyate tadā cvyartho bhavati, nābhūtaprādurbhāvavivakṣāyāmiti| iha tu pūrvāvasthāmaparāmṛśyānāśritapūrvārambhe kārye'bhūtatadbhāvamātraṃ vivakṣitam| tena satyapyabhūtatadbhāve cvyartho na bhavati| ato bhavatyetat pratyudāharaṇam - `āḍhyīkurvanti` iti| `abhūtatadbhāve kṛbhvasthiyoge` [[5.4.50]] ityādinā cviḥ, <> [[7.4.32]] itīttvam| `lyuṭā bhavitavyam` iti| <> [[3.3.117]] ityanena lyuḍvidhānāt| yadi lyuṭā bhavitavyaṃ tataḥ kimityāha - `na ca` ityādi| ubhayatrāpi tadeva rūpam, sa eva svaraḥ| rūpaṃ tāvadabhinnam, ubhayatrāpi samāsasya nityārthatvāt; tathā hi khyunyupapadasamāsena bhavitavyam, lyuṭapi gatisamāsena? <> [[6.3.66]] iti ca pratiṣedhānmumā ni bhavitavyamiti rūpabhedo nāsti| svaro'pi na bhavati bhedakaḥ; khyuni sati yatraiva nitsvaro bhaviṣyati, lyuṭapi litsvarastatraiva| `pratiṣedhasāmarthyāt` iti| āḍhyīkaraṇamityasya rūpasya nirāsāya `acvau` [[3.2.56]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| evaṃ tasya nirāsaḥ kṛto bhavati yadi khyunā mukte lyuḍapi bhavati, anyathā hi syādeva| tadeva rūpamiti pratiṣedhaḥ syāditi vaiyathryamiti bhāvaḥ| `arthataḥ` iti| na śabdataḥ| arthastu pratiṣedhasāmarthyameva| `uttarārthaśca` iti| uttarasūtrasyopayogaṃ darśayati| tatra khiṣṇuckhukañbhyāṃ mukte tṛjādibhirbhavitavyamityasti viśeṣaḥ|khyunaḥ khakāro mumarthaḥ, nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ||`kartari kārake` iti| karttṛgrahaṇaṃ karaṇanivṛttyartham| nanu cāsvasitatvādevānuvṛttirna syāt? satyametat; dveṣyamapi kaścidavijānīyāt - yathaivāḍhaādayo'nuvartante tathā tatsambandhakaraṇamapīti| uttarārthañca karttṛgrahaṇam|`udāttatvāt` ityādi| udāttāditaro'nudāttaḥ, tena bhavatervihitasyārdhadhātukasya `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt` [[7.2.10]] itīṭpratiṣedho na bhavati| balādilakṣaṇeṭā [[7.2.35]] bhavitavyam, tataśca tenaivekārāditvaṃ siddham,tato na kartavyaṃ khiṣṇuca ikārāditvamiti bhāvaḥ| ikārāditvakaraṇasya prayojanamāha - `nañastu` ityādi| yadi| khiṣṇu ca ikārāditvaṃ na kriyate tato yadyapīṭi kṛte satīkāraditvaṃ tasya bhavati, tathāpi tasya lākṣaṇikatvāt <> [[6.2.160]] ityatreṣṇujgrahaṇena na grahaṇaṃ syāt| tataścānāḍhambhaviṣṇuriti naña uttarasyottarapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ na syātiṣyate ca| ato naña uttarasyottarapadāntodāttatvaṃm, tenekārāditvamiṣṇucaḥ kriyate| nanu ca satyapīkārāditve alaṃkṛñādisūtre [[3.2.136]] vihitasyaiveṣṇuco grahaṇena bhavitavyam, netarasya , tasyaikānubandhakatvāt, asya dvayanubandhakatvāt? ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyādasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| khakāro mumarthaḥ; cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, ñakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ||<> [[3.2.4]] ityatroktam - `karmaṇi` `supi`iti dvayamanuvartate, tatra sakarmakeṣu karmaṇītyupatiṣṭhate, anyatra supīti| spṛśirayaṃ sakarmakaḥ, ataḥ spṛśerdhātoranudake subanta upapada ityukte pūrvāparavyāhati manyamāna āha - `nanu ca` ityādi|`naiṣaḥ` ityādinā parihāraḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ karttṛgrahaṇe karttuśca pracayārthe vijñāyamāne subanta upapade pratyayo labhyata ityāha - `subantamātre` ityādi| subantamātra upapade satyekaḥ pracayārthaḥ kartā karmaṇyupapade sati bhavati, aparaḥ karaṇādāvupapade; tatra bhede sati tatsambandhabhedena bhidyamānasya karttuḥ pracayo labhyate| `ghṛtaspṛk` iti| `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ` ityādi| `kvipratyayasya kuḥ` ityucyamāne kvipo'pi grahaṇaṃ syātto nakāro'nubadhyate| prakṛterādyudāttārtho nakāro na bhavita; spṛśerekāctvāt,tatsvareṇaiva siddhatvāt| kakāro guṇapratiṣedhārthaḥ, vakāraḥ <> [[6.1.67]] iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ||`ṛtau yajati` iti| vasantādika ṛtau yajati, yasmin ṛturdevatā sa yāga ṛtustaṃ yajatīti| `ṛtuprayukto vā yajati` iti| yasmin yāga ṛtuḥ prayojakastamṛtuprayukto yajatīti| asmin pakṣe prayuktamātrasya lopo nipātyate| `ṛtvikiti| yajāditvāt [[6.1.15]] samprasāraṇam| `yathākathañcidanugantavyā` iti| yena kenacit prakāreṇa vyutpādayitavyam, na tvavayavārthastantramiti darśayati| `antodāttatvaṃ nipātyate` iti| niyatasvarabādhanārtham| `dadhṛk` iti| abhyāsasya `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattvam, halādiḥśeṣaḥ, [[7.4.60]] jaśtvam| `ṣatvañca nipātyate` iti| <> [[8.3.111]] iti pratiṣedhānna prāpnotīti kṛtvā| `ṣṇiha prītau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1200), utsnihratītyuṣṇik| `nipātanaiḥ` saha nirdeśāt` ityādinā nipātanaiḥ sahaiṣāṃ yo nirdeśaḥ sa eṣāmapi kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| tenaiṣu kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati| idaṃ tvalākṣaṇikam - yaḥ sakarmakasyāpi subantamātra upapade bhavati| `prāṅa` iti| <<ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'dhātoḥ>> [[7.1.70]] iti num, halṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogādi [[8.2.23]] lopau,nakārasya pūrvavat kutvam| `kevalāt` iti| satyapi karmaṇi supītyadhikāre nirupapadādeva bhavati; nipātanaiḥ saheti nirdeśāt| kvinvidhānasāmarthyādvā| upapade hi sadādisūtreṇa [[3.2.61]] kvipā bhavitavyam| `sopapadāt` ityādi| na ca sopapadādyujeḥ kvipi kvinā vā viśeṣo'sti; <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvasya siddhatvāt| anupapadatve <> [[7.1.71]] iti numi kṛte nakārasya kutvārthaṃ kvino vidhānaṃ sārthakaṃ bhavati||anālocanamiha cakṣujrñānamātramabhipretam| yadi tatra dṛśirna vartata evaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyathā| `tyādṛk, tyādṛśaḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.89]] ityanuvartamāne <<ā sarvanāmnaḥ>> [[6.3.91]] ityātvam| `kaño ñakāraḥ `ṭiḍḍhāmaña` iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ iti| yadi kaño ñakāro na kartavyasatdodāttārtho nakāraḥ kartavyaḥ| evañca kañkannityevaṃ [[4.1.15]] kartavyam| tataścaivamucyamāne <> [[5.4.29]] yādiketyatrāpi ṅīp prasajyate, atastadviśeṣaṇārtho ñakāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti| nanu ca dṛśerdarśanakriyatvāt tādṛk tādṛśa ityādiṣu darśanakriyā'styeva, tathā hreṣāṃ vyutpattau taṃ paśyatyevaṃprakāraṃ vākyamupadiśyācāryāḥ pratyayaṃ kurvanti| vākyasamānārthā vṛttirbhavati, sā ca darśanakriyā jñānārthikā| tatkathamatra dṛśiranālocane vartata ityāha - tādṛgādayo hi rūḍhiśabdaprakārāḥ`ityādi| rūḍhiśabdeṣu nāvayavārthena bhavitavyam,kiṃ tarhi? samudāyārthena| ata evātrāvayavārtho nopadīyate| vyutpattyarthastu vidyamāno'pyavayavārtha nopādatte, yathā - vyājighratīti vyāghra ityādau| tasmādiha yadyapi vyutpattyarthaṃ vākyasya darśanakriyopādīyate, tathāpyasau vṛttau nāstyeva| tathā hi - tādṛk tādṛśa ityādibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ sadṛśavastuviṣaye pratyaya upajāyate, na tu darśanakriyāviṣaya iti yuktaiva dṛśeranālocane vṛttiḥ|`samānānyayośceti vaktavyam` iti| samānānyayośca śabdayorupapadayordṛśeḥ kvinkañau pratyayau bhavava ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - pūravasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuvatasamuccayārthaḥ| tena samānānyayorupapadayordṛśeḥ pratyayau bhaviṣyataḥ| `sadṛśaḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.84]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[6.3.89]] iti sabhāvaḥ||`karmagrahaṇaṃ tu `spṛśo'nudake kvin` ityataḥ prabhṛti na vyāpratīyate` iti| nanu sakarmakā api dhātavaḥ santi, tatkathaṃ na vyāpriyata iti? evaṃ manyate - spṛśo'nudake kvin` [[3.2.58]] ityādiṣu yat `kartari` [[3.2.57]] ityanuvartate tat karttṛpracayārthaṃ vijñāyate, tena supīti vyāpriyate, na karmaṇīti| evaṃ hi karttṛpracayo labhyate, nānyathā| atha upasargagrahaṇaṃ kimarthama? yāvatopasargāḥ subantā eva, tatra subgrahaṇenaivopasargagrahaṇaṃ siddhamityāha - `upasargagrahamaṃ jñāpanārthamiti| `anyatra subgrahaṇa upasargagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati` iti| kvānyatra subrāgrahaṇa
