samasyate`(vā| 83) iti samāsaḥ| atha kartari ṣaṣṭhī kasmānna bhavati? ātmagrahaṇasāmarthyāt| na hrātmano'nyasya padārthasya matiḥ sambhavati, tasyā ātmaguṇatvāt| athātmaśabdo'yaṃ na sukhādiguṇamācaṣṭe, ki tarhi? parābhāvam| paro yo na bhavati sa ātmeti, tathāpyātmagrahaṇamanarthakam| evaṃ hi manturyā matiryā matisttatra vartamānādityeṣo'rthaḥ syāt, sa cāyuktaḥ,ka sarvā hi matiḥ paramapi manyamānasya mantureva bhavati, tasmāt karmaṇyeva ṣaṣṭhī| `yadā pratyayārthaḥ kartā` ityādi| kathaṃ punareṣa evārthaḥ, karma kartā ca yujyate? śaktibhedāt, yathā - pīyamānaṃ madhu madayatīti| khaśaḥ khakāraḥ <> [[6.3.67]] iti mumarthaḥ| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ||bhūtaśabdo'yamatikrāntavacanaḥ, asti ca svarūpavacanaḥ, tatra na jñāyate - kasmin bhūte pratyaya iti? atastatpajñānāyāha - `dhātvadhikārācca`ityādi| caśabdo hetau| yasmād dhātoriti vartate tasmāddhātvarthabhūta iti vijñāyate| nanu ca dhātvadhikārāddhātoreva bhūta ityetadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam? na; asambhavāt| dhātohrrasminnabhidheye guṇībhūtasya bhūta ityetadviśeṣaṇamanupapannam| atastatrāsambhavāt tadarthasyaiva tadviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate||`ṇiniranuvartate, na khaśiti| ṇinereva svaritatvāt| kva punaryāgaḥ karaṇamityāha - `agniṣṭomaḥ phalabhāvanāyām` ityādi| phalaṃ svargaḥ, tasya yā bhāvanotpādanā = yajamānasambandhī vyāpāraḥ, tatrāgniṣṭomayāgaḥ karaṇaṃ bhavati| nanu cāgniṣṭomavyatirekeṇa yajamānasay vyāpāro bhāvanākhyo nāstyeva, yatra yāgaḥ karaṇamiṣyate, tathāhragniṣṭomākhyenaiva hrasau yāgena svargākhyaṃ phalamutpādayati? naitadevam; viśeṣavyāpāre hi sāmānyavyāpāro'sti, vikṣeṣasya sāmānyavyabhicārāt| sāmānyavyāpāra eva hrādau phalārthino buddhau sanniviśate| tathā hi - pratipattā phaḻaṃ samīhamānaḥ svayameva phalakāmaḥ san `svargo manasi kartavyaḥ`iti sāmānyavyāpāraṃ buddhāvāropayati, tataḥ ` agniṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta`iti śāstrasyāgniṣṭomena karaṇena svarga bhāvayeditīmamartha pratipādya, svargabhāvanāṃ prati karaṇatvenāgniṣṭomamāśrayati| tasmāt sāmānyavyāpāre svargasyotpādo viśeṣavyāpāro'gniṣṭomākhyo yāgaḥ svargābhāvanāyāṃ karaṇaṃ bhavati| nanu cānuṣṭhīyamānaḥ karmatvamanubhavati, tathāpi tasya śaktibhedāt karaṇatvaṃ na virudhyate, yathā - `nipīyamānena madhunā mattaḥ` ityatra karmabhāvamanubhavato'pi madhunaḥ karaṇabhāvo bhavati| tadevamagniṣṭomayājītyasyāyamarthaḥ - agniṣṭomena karaṇena svarga bhāvitavāniti| svargaśabdastu vṛttādantarhitatvānna prayujyate||`pitṛvyaghātī` iti| <<hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ>> [[7.3.32]] iti tatvam| <> [[7.3.54]] iti ghatvam, `sau ca` [[6.4.13]] iti dīrghatvam| `kutsitagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti pratyayarthasya viśeṣaṇam| gṛhrate'neneti grahaṇam| tat punavryākhyānam| etaduktaṃ bhavati - yena kutsitaḥ kartā pratyayārtho gṛhrate tadvyākhyānaṃ kartavyamiti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - vakṣyamāṇabahulagrahaṇamapakṛṣyeha sambandhaḥ kriyate, tena pitṛvyavadhādikāṃ pratiṣiddhāṃ kriyāṃ kurvāṇo yaḥ kartā kutsyate, tatrava, nānyatra||`brāhṛhaḥ`iti| pūrvavaddīrghatvam|`sarvadhātubhyaḥ kvibvihita eva` iti| <> [[3.2.76]] ityanena| `caturvidhaścātra niyamaḥ` iti| dhātuniyaḥ, upapadaniyamaḥ, pratyayaniyamaḥ, kālaniyamaḥ| cakāro'vadhāraṇe - caturvidha eva| `brāhṛādiṣveva hanternānyasminnupapade`iti dhātuniyamaṃ darśayati| ata eva yataevakārakaraṇaṃ tato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti| upapadebhyaḥ para evakāraḥ prayujyamāno hanta niyamayati| prāyikaścāyaṃ niyamaḥ, kvacidanyasminnupapade dṛśyate - madhuhetu| prāyikatvañca tasya vakṣyamāṇabahulagrahaṇasya purastādapakarṣāllabhyate| `brāhṛādiṣu hantereva nānyasmāt` iti upapadaniyamaḥ| atra hi hanteḥ ekāraḥ śrūyamāṇa upapadaṃ niyamayati - brāhṛādiṣu hanterbhūte kvibeva| `nānyaḥ pratyayaḥ` iti kālaniyamaḥ| brāhṛādyupapade hanteḥ kvipi vihite bhūtakālasya niyamitatvāt| yadi brāhṛādiṣu kvibeva nānyaḥ pratyayaḥ iti, tadā niṣṭhāpi na prāpnoti - brāhṛāṇaṃ hatavāniti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante, nottarān`(vyā|pa|10) ityaṇādaya eva bādhyante, na niṣṭhā| evamapīha vṛtrasyāhanturiti tṛj na prāpnoti? prāyikatvānniyamasya na doṣaḥ| `tathā bhūtakāla eva nānyasmin` iti pratyayaniyamaḥ, bhūtakāle pratyayo niyamyata iti kṛtvā| kathaṃ punarekadā catvāro niyamā labhyanta ityāha - `tadetatityādi| <> [[7.4.78]] iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ bahulagrahaṇaṃ purastādapakṛvyānena yogena sambadhyate - brāhṛbhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvibbahulamiti, tenāyaṃ caturvidho niyamo labhyate||`suśabdaṃ varjayitvā`iti| tasyāsattvavacanāt karmatvānupapatteḥ| `svādiṣu karmasu` iti| bāhulyamāśrityoktam, yathā - `brāāhṛṇagrāmaḥ, bhaṭṭagrāmaḥ` iti| kuta etat? suśabdaṃ varjayitvetyanantarāṇāmevābhidhānāt| `trividhaścātra niyamaḥ` iti| etadapi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhyate| `kālopapadapratyaya{niyamaḥ-kāśikā}viṣayaḥ` iti| kālopapadapratyayā viṣayā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa punaḥ kālaniyamaḥ, upapadaniyamaḥ, pratyayaniyamaśceti| tatra kālaniyamaḥ - svādiṣu kṛño bhūta eva kvibeva bavati, nānyaḥ pratyaya iti; na bhavati - karma kṛtavān karmakāra iti| upapadaniyamaḥ - svādiṣu kṛña eva, nānyasmāddhātoriti; na hi bhavati kvip - mantramadhītavāniti, aṇeva bhavati mantrādhyāya iti| pratyayaniyamaḥ - svādiṣu kṛño bhūta eva kvip, na vartamāne, bhaviṣyat ivā, tena mantraṃ karoti, mantraṃ kariṣyatīti vetyarthavivakṣāyāṃ mantrakṛditi na bhavati| `śāstrakṛt` iti| <> [[3.2.76]] iti kvip||`dhātukālopapadapratyaya viṣayaḥ`iti| pūrvavadbahuvrīhiḥ| kālādiniyamo'nyapadārthaḥ| tatra kālaniyamaḥ - some sunoteḥ kvibeva bhūte, nānyaḥ pratyayaḥ; na hi - somaṃ sutavān somasāva iti| dhātuniyamaḥ - soma eva sunoteḥ kvip, nānyasminnupapada iti;iha na bhavati - surāṃ sutavān surāsuditi| upapaniyamaḥ - some sunotereva, nānyasmāddhātoritita;iha na bhavati kvip - somaṃ krītavāniti , somakrāya ityaṇeva tu bhavati| pratyayaniyamaḥ - some sunoterbhūta eva kvip, nānyatreti;tena somaṃ sunoti, soṣyati vetyarthavivakṣāyāṃ somasuditi na bhavati||`atrāpi pūrvavatityādi| tatra kālaniyamaḥ - agnau cinoterbhūte kvibava, nānya iti; tenāgna citavānityarthavivakṣāyāmagnicāya iti na bhavati| dhātuniyamaḥ - agnāveva cinoternānyasminnupapada iti; teneṣṭakāciditati na bhavati| upapadaniyamaḥ - agnau cinotereva nānyasmāddhātoriti; tenāgnikṛditi na bhavati| pratyayaniyamaḥ - agnau cinoterbhūta eva kvip, nānyasmin kāle; tena vartamānabhaviṣyatoragniciditi na bhavati||<> [[3.2.86]] ityata upapadaviśeṣame karmagrahaṇe'nuvartamāne yat punariha karmagrahaṇaṃ tasya pratyayārthatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `karmaṇyeva kārake` iti| `dhātūpapada` ityādinā samudāyopādhitkmetadagnyākhyāgrahaṇasya darśayati|`ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ rūḍhisampratyayārtham` ityādi| agniśabdo'yamagnisāmānyavācī, atrāsatyākhyāgrahaṇe viśeṣo na vijñāyate - kasyeha grahaṇamiti, rūḍhisampratyayārthamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tadarthamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kriyata ityāha - `agnyartho hi` ityādi| agnyartho ya iṣṭakānāṃ racanāviśeṣaḥ sa śyenacidityucyate, tatraivāyaṃ pratyaya iṣyate| sa kathaṃ tatraiva labhyate? yasya grahaṇaṃ kriyate, tasmaśca sati prasiddho gṛhramāṇo'gnyartho ya iṣṭakānāṃ racanāviśeṣaḥ sa eva pratyayārtho vācyatayā vijñāyate, nānyaḥ||`karmaṇīti vartamāne` ityādi| `karmaṇihanaḥ` [[3.2.86]] ityataḥ| `punaḥ karmagrahaṇam` ityādi| yat karma kriyāsambandhamanubhavat karttuḥ kutsāmāvahati,tat kutsānimittaṃ karma yathā syādityevamartham| karmagrahaṇe'nuvartamāne punaḥ karmagrahaṇamanantarasūtre yat karmapratyayārthatve'niṣṭaṃ karmagrahaṇaṃ tannivṛttyartham| karmagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? tasya svaritatvādevānuvṛtteḥ| `somavikrayī` iti| somavikrayaṇaṃ śāstre pratiṣidhyata iti somākhyaṃ karma vikrayaṇakriyayā sambadhyamānaṃ vikretuḥ kutsāmāvahati| `dhānyavikrāyaḥ` iti| <> [[3.2.1]] ||`pratyayāntaranivṛtyartham` iti| pratyayāntaramaṇādi, tasya nivṛttyartham| nivṛtte satyapi pratyayaḥ pratyayāntaratve bhavatyeva - paralokaṃ dṛṣṭavāniti| atra ca kāraṇaṃ `brāhṛbhrūṇa` [[3.2.87]] sūtra eva uktam||saptamīti pratyayagrahaṇam | tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha - `saptamyanta upapade` iti | svarūpagrahaṇamata eva na bhavati| `upasarajaḥ` iti | ḍitkaraṇasāmarthyādabhasaṃjñakasyāpi ṭilopaḥ| `mandurajaḥ` iti| <<ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam>> [[6.3.63]] iti hrasvaḥ||`buddhijaḥ` iti| `janikṛrttuḥ prakṛtiḥ` [[1.4.30]] iti buddherapādānatvādapādāne pañcamī|, tadasyopapadatvam| buddhyādiśabdā jātiśabdā na bhavanti; buddhyādīnāmātmaguṇatvāt||`samudāyopādhiḥ`iti| dhātūpasargapratyayasamudāyena yadi saṃjñā gamyata ievaṃ pratyayārtho bhavati, nānyatheti darśayati - `{prajāḥ- kāśikā} prajāḥ` iti| prāṇisamudāyasyaiṣā saṃjñeti| yadyasya sūtrasya prajetyetadevodāharaṇam, tadā `pre janaḥ saṃjñāyāmiti vaktavye prajeti sidhyatyeva, kimupasargagrahaṇena? upasargagrahaṇamuttarārtham; <> [[3.2.100]] ityupasarge yathā syāt, karmapravacīye mā bhūt| athānantyasya prayogaviṣayasyānyasminnupapade kadācit pratyayo dṛśyate yadi, tadaitadarthamapi||`anupūrvājjaneḥ` ityādi| athānuśabdasyopapadatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? yato na bhavati sa hetuḥ `udi kūlerujivahoḥ` [[3.2.31]] ityatra vyākhyāta iti punarnākhyāyate| `pumamujaḥ` iti| lupte'pi supi pratyayalakṣaṇena padatvam, tena saṃyogāntalopo [[8.2.23]] bhavati||`apiśabdaḥ` ityādi| sarva upādhaya upapadādayaḥ, teṣāṃ vyabhicāro yathā syādityevamartho'piśabdaḥ| `dhātvantarādapi`iti| `khanu avadāraṇe`(dhātupāṭhaḥ-878) ityetasmāt| `kārakāntare'pi` iti| kartturanyasmin kārake karmaṇi||`kṛtam` iti| atra kittvād guṇābhāvaḥ| `kṛtavān` iti| `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num| <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogāntalopau [[8.2.23]] |`niṣṭhāyām` ityādi| niṣṭhāsaṃjñake pratyaye vidhātavye'prasiddhaniṣpattikasya niṣṭhāsaṃjñakasya pratyayasya niṣṭheti cāsyāḥ saṃjñāyā aprasiddhiḥ, kutaḥ? itaretarāśrayatvāt| kathamitaretarāśrayatvamityāha - `saṃjñāyām` ityādi| niṣṭhetyevaṃ saṃjñāmuccārya ktaktavatvoriha bhūte vidhānam, vidyamānayośca tayoḥ saṃjñayā bhavitavyamitītaretarāśrayatvam, `itaretarāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi śāstre na prakalpyante`(vyā|pa|28)| yadito ktaktavatū svarūpeṇa vijñātau bhavata evañca <> [[1.1.26]] ityanyasya saṃjñā vidhātuṃ śakyate,nānyathā| ataḥ saṃjñāyā aprasiddhiḥ, tasyāścāprasiddhau tayoraprasiddhiḥ| `bhāvinī` iti| bhaviṣyantītyarthaḥ| yathā - asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayeti| bhāvinīśabdo'yam `gameriniḥ`(da|u|6|57) `āṅi ṇit` (da|u|6|58) `bhuvaśca` (da|u|6|59) itīnipratyayānto vyatpāditaḥ| sa ca <> [[3.3.3]] iti bhaviṣyatkāle vihitaḥ| tena bhāvinītyasya bhaviṣyantītyevārtho labhyate| `sāmarthyāt` ityādi| sa bhūte bhavati yasyotpannasya niṣṭhetyeṣā saṃjñā bhavati| na cānyasyotpannasya niṣṭhetyeṣā saṃjñā bhavati| api tu ktaktavatvoreveti sāmarthyam| `ādikarmaṇi` ityādi| karmaśabdo'tra kriyāvācī| ādibhūte kriyārambhādibhūte prathame kriyālakṣaṇa ityarthaḥ| yāvatkriyālakṣaṇaiḥ sakalaḥ kaṭaḥ parisamāptimupaiti kriyālakṣaṇānāṃ tāvatāmapavarge bhūtakālo bhavati| ādye kriyālakṣaṇe samudāyasyāpariniṣpannatvāt vartamānakāla eveti| tatra vartamāne niṣṭhā na prāpnoti, ato vaktavyo vyākhyeyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - yadayaṃ <> [[1.2.21]] ityādikarmaṇi karmaṇi niṣṭhā vikalpayati| yadvā - <<ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca>> [[3.4.71]] ityādi, tajjñāpayati - ādikarmaṇi niṣṭhā bhavatīti| `prakṛtaḥ kaṭam` iti| praśabdo'trādikarma dyotayati| ya evārthaḥ prakaroti kaṭaṃ devadatta iti, sa evārthaḥ prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadatta iti||`sutvā` iti| <> [[6.1.71]] iti tuk, `sarvanāmasthāne ca` [[6.4.8]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ, <> [[8.2.7]] iti nakāralopaḥ||`jaran` iti| atṛno nittvādādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num||`dadarśa` iti| darśarliṭa, ṇal, dvirvacanam, `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattm, raparatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ [[7.4.60]] , laghūpadhaguṇaḥ [[7.3.86]] | `ātatāna` iti| `tanu vistāre` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1463) āṅapūrvaḥ, <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `dhātusambandhe sa vidhiḥ` iti| <> [[3.4.1]] ityato dhātusambandhagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `ayaṃ tvaviśeṣaṇeṇa` iti| bhūtamātre| liṭa ikāraṭakārāvuttarasūtre viśeṣaṇārthau| `laḥ kānajvā` ityucyamāne lakārāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt| ṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ||kānacaścikaraṇamantodāttārtham| kitkaraṇaṃ kitkāryārtham| tatpunaḥ `bandha bandhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1508) ityevamādayaḥ saṃyogāntāḥ prayojanti,nānye| asaṃyāgāntebhyaḥ <> [[1.2.5]] iti siddhaḥ, saṃyogāntā api kittvaṃ bhāṣāyāṃ prayojayanti, na chandasi| tatrāha - <> [[6.4.86]] iti liṭaḥ sārvadhātukatvāt <> [[1.2.4]] iti ṅittvamastyeva| na kittve ṅittve vā cchandasi kaścidviśeṣo'sti| bhāṣāyāṃ tu yadyasaṃyogāntebhyaḥ kittvaṃ na syādyo'yaṃ `ṛcchatyṛtām` [[7.4.11]] iti guṇaḥ pratiṣedhaviṣaya ārabhyate sa yatheha na bhavati - nipaparatuḥ, nipaparuriti;tathehāpi syāt - nipapurāṇa iti; kittve ca sati na bhavati| bhāṣāyāṃ tu kittvamarthavadbhavati| `pṛ pālana pūraṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1086), nipūrvāt kānac| dvirvacanāt paratvāt `udoṣṭhapūrvasya` [[7.1.102]] ityuttvam, raparatvañceti| <<dvirvacane'ci>> [[1.1.59]] iti sthānivadbhāvāt pṛśabdo dvirucyate| urattvaraparatvahalādiśeṣāḥ, aṭkupvādinā [[8.4.2]] ṇatvam| bhāṣāyāṃ kānajbhavītyasmādeva jñāpakādavasīyate| `cikyānaḥṭa iti| abhyāsāduttarasya cinoteścakārasya <> [[7.3.58]] iti kutvam, `eranekācaḥ` [[6.4.82]] ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| `suṣuvāṇaḥ` iti| `{sunoteriti-iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|} sunoteriti; `aci śnudhātu` [[6.4.77]] ityādinovaṅādeśaḥ, <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam| `vibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati` iti| yadyapi liḍiti prathamāntaṃ prakṛtaṃ tathāpyarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati| ādeśambandhāduttarasya liṭaḥ ṣaṣṭhantatā bhaviṣyati|tasmādantareṇāpi liḍgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtvālliṭa eva kānajādeśo bhaviṣyatīti liḍgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `yo'pi` ityādi| yo'pi <> [[3.2.115]] ityanenaliḍvihitastasyāpi liḍgrahaṇe sati kānajādeśo bhavati| asati tu tasmin `anantarasya vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) ityasyaiva syāt, na parokṣe liṭaḥ| athāsati liḍgrahaṇe pratyayāntaraṃ kānac kasmānna vijñāyate? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum, pratyayāntare hi `na sadviṣayatvāt| yaccendriyāṇāmaviṣayaḥ tat parokṣamiti sa eva hi dhātvarthaḥ parokṣaḥ, tataḥ parokṣagrahaṇamanarthakam, vyavacchedyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ|`satyametat` iti| yadanantaramuktam| yadi satyametat tadā kasya vyavacchedārthaṃ parokṣagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityāha - `asti tu` ityādi| yatra sādhyāni pratyakṣāṇi tatrāniṣpanne kriyātmani dhātvarthe pratyakṣābhimāno lokasya bhavati| nanu ca sāvadhānānyapi naiva pratyakṣāṇi;śaktisvabhāvatvāt, śakteśca kāryānumeyatvāt, na hraśaktau kāryaṃ karotīti kāryakaraṇe śaktiranumīyate; tat kimucyate sādhanāni pratyakṣāṇi? naiṣa doṣaḥ;`dravyāśritā hi śaktayaḥ`iti dravyasya pratyakṣṭavādāśrayadhamamāśriteṣu śaktyātmakeṣūpacāryāṇyetānyapi pratyakṣāṇītyucyante| atha vā - tadapi sādhanāśrayaṃ dravyaśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt sādhanaśabdenocyate; tadanena parokṣagrahaṇena pratyakṣābhimāno'sti, sa eva parokṣa icyucyate - tadāha - `sa yatra nāsta` iti| ātmaviṣaya uttamasya ca dhātvarthasya parokṣatvaṃ nopapadyate; tatsādhanānāṃ pratyakṣatvāt| tatra lokasya pratyakṣatvāt, tataścottamena sidhyatīti codyamāśaṅkyāha - `uttamaviṣaye` ityādi| ātmasādhyā hi kriyā, yatra cittavikṣepānnopapadyate, tadāsau parokṣā bhavati, tenottamaviṣaye'pi parokṣabhāvaḥ| tadbhavatyeva| `vilalāpa` iti| lapervipūrvasyottame ṇali rūpam|`atyantāpahnave` iti| pratyakṣametat| apahnavaḥ = apalāpaḥ| sa kcidatyanto bhavati yaḥ sarvāpahnavaḥ, kvacidanatyanto ya ekadeśāpahnavaḥ| tatra yo'tyantaḥ sa sarvāpahnavaḥ, tatra liḍvaktavya, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi bahulagrahaṇamāśrit kartavyam| kaścit kenacit pṛṣṭaḥ - `kaliṅgeṣu prasthito'si`ityādi| sa evamāha - `nāhaṃ kaliṅgān jagām` iti| atra kevalaṃ na kaliṅgaviṣayasyāpahnavo'pi tu gamanasyāpīti vidyate'tyantāpahnavaḥ| yastu sthānamātrasyāpahnavo na gamanasyāpi , tadānatyantāpahnave laṅeva bhavati - na hi kaliṅgeṣu pratyatiṣṭha iti| tathā kaścit kenacit pṛṣṭaḥ dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviśya tvayedaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtamiti| sa evamāha - `nāhaṃ dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviveśa` iti| atrāpi vidyate'tyantāpahnavaḥ| tathā hi - na kevalaṃ dakṣiṇāpathapiṣayaṃ kāryaṃ pratiṣidhyate, api tu praveśamapi||`praṣṭavyaḥ praśnaḥ` ityanena praśnaśabdaṃ karmasādhanaṃ darśayati| karaṇasādhane hi pṛcchyate'neneti śabdaḥ praśnaśabdenocyate| tathā ca sati tasyoccaryamāṇatvādātmalābhasya sarvadaivāsannakāla ityāsannakālagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| bhāvasādhane'pyarthāntaravācibhyo dhātubhyo na syāt| `agacchatiti| `gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-982, 983), `iṣugamiyāṃ chaḥ` [[7.3.77]] iti chatvam| `iyāja` iti| `liṭabhyāsasyobhayeṣām` [[6.1.17]] iti samprasāraṇam| `jaghāna` iti| kaṃsavadho'tra pṛcchamānaḥ| sa cedānīntanaprayokturapekṣayā viprakṛṣṭakālaḥ| pañcavarṣābhyantaramāsannakāla iti naiyāyikā varṇayanti| pañcavarṣātītastu viprakṛṣṭa iti bhavati| kaṃsavadho'tra viprakṛṣṭakālaḥ||`naḍena sma purādhīyate` iti| iṅo'dhipūrvāllaṭ, <> [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam, ṭeretvam, <> [[3.1.67]] , `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ| upasargeṇa sahākaḥ savarṇe [[6.1.97]] dīrghatvam| atha vā - kartaryātmanepadam, adāditvācchabdo luk, <<ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ>> [[7.1.5]] ityadādeśaḥ, dhātoriyaṅa yathāyogaṃ pūrvavat||`brāvīti` iti| `brāuva īṭ` [[7.3.93]] | `kathayati` iti| `katha vākyaprabandhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1851), curādāvadantaḥ, tasmāṇṇic, <> [[6.4.48]] , <> [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadbhāvāt <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhirna bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ punaridamārabdham? pūrveṇa parokṣe vidhānādaparokṣe na prāpnoti, atastatrāpi yathā syādityevamartham| nanu ca pūrvayoge parokṣagrahaṇaṃ nivartiṣyate, tasmin nivṛtte pūrveṇaiva parokṣe cāparokṣe ca bhaviṣyati? satyametat; codyamapi kaścidvijānīyādyadi parokṣagrahaṇaṃ nivṛttaṃ tatsambaddhamanadyatanagrahaṇamapi nivṛttamiti, tadanyathā mā vijñāyīti pūrvasūtre parokṣagrahaṇamanuvartate, tasmaścānuvartamāne kartavyametat, anyathā hraparokṣe na syāt||`pṛṣṭaprativacane` iti| praśnaḥ = pṛṣṭam, bhāve niṣṭhā| pṛṣṭapūrvakaprativacanaṃ pṛṣṭaprativacanam, śākapārthivāditvanmadhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ| `anadyatane parokṣa iti nivṛttam` iti| asvaritatvāt| `akārṣīḥ kaṭaṃ devadatta` ityeṣa praśnaḥ| `nanu karomi bhoḥ`ityetat praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanam| `avocastatra kiñciddevadatta`ityeṣa praśnaḥ| `nanu karomi bhoḥ`ityetat praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanam|`nanvakārṣīt` iti| praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanaṃ na bhavatīti luṅeva bhavati| nanu ca prativacanaṃ sarvaṃ praśnapūrvakamevu, tadanarthakaṃ pṛṣṭagrahaṇam, vyavacchedyābhāvāt? naitadiṣṭam ;prativacanaśabdo'yamastyeva pṛṣṭānvākhyāne - yaḥ praśnamantareṇa na bhavati; astyavyayībhāve - vacanaṃ vacanaṃ prativacanam, yathārthe `avyayam` [[2.1.6]] iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ;asti samādhivacanaḥ - pratipūrvasya vaceḥ samādhāviti darśanāt, tathā hi vaktāro vadanti - yadananābhihitaṃ tanmayā prayuktamiti, pariṣkṛtamityarthaḥ; tadevamanekārthe prativacanaśabda-, yadi pṛṣṭagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate sarveṣvartheṣu syāt| asmastu kriyamāṇe praśnapūrvo yaḥ prativacanaśabdaḥ, sa eva gṛhrate, nānya iti na bhavtayānarthakyam||`nākarṣamiti| pūrvavadambhāvaḥ||`purāśabde` iti| etena purāśabda ihopapadatvenopātto na puriti darśayati| yadyetadeva, asyākārāntatvāt purīti saptamyanto nirdeśo nopapadyate? <<āto dhātoḥ>> [[6.4.140]] iti yogavibhāgādākāralopādadoṣaḥ| atha `pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ`(dhātupāṭhaḥ-1086) ityetasmādbhrājādisūtreṇa [[3.2.177]] kvipi vihitaḥ `udoṣṭhapūrvasya` [[7.1.102]] ityuttve raparatve ca kṛte yaḥ pūḥśabda sampadyate tasyehāpyupapadatvenopādānamiti kasmānna vijñāyate? tasyānadyatanavṛttyasambhavāt| purāśabdastu tatraiva vartata iti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| `luṅa ca` iti cakāreṇa laḍanukṛṣyata iti darśayati| `yathāviṣayam` iti| `yathā'sādṛśye` [[2.1.7]] iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| `anye'pi`iti| laṅādayaḥ| `vasanti` iti| laṭ| `avātsuḥ` iti| luṅa, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] iti jherjusādeśaḥ, `vadavraja` [[7.2.3]] ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavat sakārasya tatvam| `avasan` iti| laṅa| `ūṣuḥ` iti| liṭ, `parasmaipadānām` [[3.4.82]] ityādinā jherjus, dvirvacanam, vacyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.15]] samprasāraṇam, `liṭabhyāsasyobhayeṣām` [[6.1.17]] ityabhyāsasya ca; `śāsivasighasīnāñca` [[8.3.60]] iti ṣatvam||`prārabdho'parisamāptaśca` iti| prārabdho yaḥ sādhayituṃ prastutaḥ, na ca samāptimupagataḥ sa vartamāna ityucyate| vartamānagrahaṇaṃ dhātvadhikārāt tadarthasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `vartamāne` ityādi| na hradhātvarthe dhātorvṛttiḥ sambhavati| laṭaṣṭakāraḥ <<ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere>> [[3.4.79]] iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| akāraḥ <> [[3.4.83]] iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ; ikāre hraccārite liḍādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt||śatṛśānacoḥ śakārau sārvadhātukārthau| ṛkāra ugitkāryārthaḥ| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇa iti paryudāso'yam| prathamāśabdo'yaṃ vibhaktiviśeṣe soraujasparynate śāstre rūḍhaḥ| prathamāyā anyā dvitīyādikā vibhaktiḥ = aprathamā| samānaśabdo'yaṃ sādhāraṇavacanaḥ, yathā - devadattayajñadattau samānadhanāvita| adhikaraṇaśabdo'yamabhidheyavacanaḥ samānañca tadadhikaraṇañceti karmadhārayaḥ| aprathamayā samānādhikaraṇam = aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇam| `tṛtīyā` [[2.1.29]] itiyogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ| tataḥ `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam` [[2.3.37]] iti saptamī| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇabhāvena śatṛśānacorbhāvo lakṣyate| aprathameti paryudāsavṛttyā dvitīyādervibhaktegrrahaṇam, tena pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhirbhaviṣyatītyāha - `aprathamāntena cet` ityādi| `tasya` iti| laṭaḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyam` iti| samānābhidheyamiti| yadi dvitīyāntena śabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam = samānābhidheyatvaṃ sambhavatyevaṃ śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ, nānyatheti vākyārthaḥ| evaṃ vivṛmvatā'prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe'tra paryudāsa āśritaḥ, na prasajyapratiṣedha iti daśryate, anyathā hi yadi prasajyapratiṣedha āśritaḥ syāt prathamāntena ceta sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na bhavatītyevaṃ brāūyāt| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi prasajyapratiṣedha āśritaḥ? aprathāsamānādhikaraṇa uttarapade śatṛśānacau na syātām - bhajyata iti bhaktiḥ, kurvan bhaktirasya kurvadbhaktiḥ, kurvāṇo bhaktirasya kurvāṇabhaktiḥ| ye ca prathamāsamānādhikaraṇavṛttayastaddhitāsteṣu na syātām - `praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap` [[5.3.66]] kurvadrūpam, kurvāṇarūpamiti; `īṣadasamāptau kalpaśabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ` [[5.3.67]] kurvatkalpaḥ| nanu paryudāse'pi bhavatyeva doṣaḥ, na hyatrāprathamāntena kvacit prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe'pi bhavata iti| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu pratiṣedhaṃ vidhāya pratiṣiddhasya ca purvidhānamayuktam| `pacantaṃ devadattaṃ paśya` iti| dvitīyāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ darśayati| `pacatā` iti| tṛtīyāntena| vibhaktervipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā devadatteneti sambandhāt| nanu ca laḍādeśasyātrāprathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, na laṭaḥ; tasya prayogābhāvāt| ādeśadharmasya sthāninyupacārāt laṭo'pyupacāritaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ|atha laḍgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'nantarasūtrāllaḍityanuvartata eva? syādetat; prathamāntañcaitat| ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśena cehārthaḥ, tasmāt ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśārtha punarlaḍgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti, etaccāyuktam,prathamāntasyāpi laḍgrahamasyārthadvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyatīti ṣaṣṭhantaṃ vijñāsyata ityata āha - `laḍiti vartamāne` ityādi| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe punarlaḍgrahaṇam| tena kvacit prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe bhavataḥ - kurvan brāāhṛṇaḥ| `san brāāhṛṇaḥ` iti| `asa bhuvi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1065), adāditvācchapo luk| `śnasoralopaḥ` [[6.4.111]] , ityakāralopaḥ| `vidyamānaḥ` ityādau sarvatra brāāhṛṇa ityapekṣate| `vida sattāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1171), divādirātmanepadī, śyan| `juhvat` [[7.1.78]] iti| `hu {dānādanayoḥ (ādāne ityeke prīṇane'pi iti bhāṣyam) -dhātupāṭhaḥ-} dāne`(dhātupāṭhaḥ-1083), <> [[6.4.87]] iti yaṇādeśaḥ, `nābhyastācchatuḥ [[7.1.78]] iti numāgamābhāvaḥ| `adhīyānaḥ`iti| `iṅa adhyayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-11046), adhipūrvaḥ| pūrvavat `aciśnu` [[6.4.77]] ityādinā iyaṅa|`māṅyākrośe` iti| māṅyupapada ākrośe gamyamāne laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ| `mā pacan, mā pacamānaḥ` iti| nanu cātraiva māṅi luṅā bhavitavyam, etasmādevādhikavidhānāt? punarlaḍgrahaṇādākrośe na bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `māṅi luṅa` [[3.3.175]] ityasya yatrākrośe nāsti so'vakāśaḥ|`kecidvibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartayanti` iti| san brāāhṛṇo'sti brāāhṛṇa ityādau vikalpena śatṛśānacau yathā syātāmityevamartham| keciditi vacanāt kecinnānuvartayantītyuktaṃ bhavati| teṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥ - yadi prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe nityaṃ tau bhavatastadā'prathamāsamānādhikaṇagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, `śatṛśānacau`ityevaṃ brāūyāt| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ - sāmānyena prathamāsānādhikaraṇe'nyatra śatṛśānacorvidhānāt punagrrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati| tasmādaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇagrahaṇasāmarthyādaprathamāsamānadhikaraṇa eva nityau tau bhavataḥ, prathamāsamānādikaraṇeṣvanyatheti| yadi tarhi vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartayanti, yathā san brāāhṛṇaḥ, asti brāāhṛṇaḥ, vidyamāno brāāhṛṇaḥ,vidyate brāāhṛṇa ityādau vikalpena bhavataḥ; tathā kurvadbhaktiḥ kurvāṇabhaktirityevamādāvapi syātāmityata āha - `sā ca` ityādi| `tatra` iti| vyavasthitavibhāṣayāṃ satyām| `yathādarśanam` iti| yathā lakṣyasya darśanaṃ tadanurūpāḥ prayogā unneyāḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati - lakṣyadarśanavat syāt| kvacinnityaṃ tau śatṛśānacau veditavyau, kvacit pākṣikau,kvacidavidyamānāviti| tatra kurvadbhaktiḥ, kurvāṇabhaktiḥ, kurvattaraḥ, kurvattama ityādau nityam ; san brāāhṛṇaḥ , asti brāāhṛṇa ityādau pākṣikau; taraptamavādipratyaye pare tāvavidyamānāveva| `pacatitarāma` iti| pacatiśabdāt `tiṅaśca` [[5.3.56]] iti tarap, `kimet` [[5.4.11]] ityādināmi kṛte na bhavataḥ||`prathamāsamānādhikaraṇārtha ārambhaḥ` iti| avadhāraṇamiha draṣṭavyam| pūrvayogo hraprathamāsamānādhikaraṇārthaḥ, kvacit prathamāsamānādhikaraṇārthaśca; ayaṃ tu prathamāsamānādhikaraṇārthaṃ eva| yadi tarhi pūrvasūtraṃ prathamāsamānādhikaraṇārthamapi, tahrreṣaṃsati tau yathā anyatra prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe'pi bhavatastathā sambodhane'pi bhaviṣyata ityapārthakam? nāpārthakam; tasyaiva prapañcārthatvāt| `he pacan` iti| <> [[8.2.8]] iti nalopapratiṣedhānnalopābhāvaḥ| `he pacamāna` iti| <> [[6.1.69]] iti sulopaḥ||`dhātvartha viśeṣaṇañcaitat` iti| dhātvadhikārāt| athopapade kasmānna bhavataḥ? kriyāyā iti vacanāt| yadyupapade syātāṃ tadā kriyāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| upapadaṃ hi dhātorbhavati, sa ca kriyāvacana ityentareṇāpi kriyāgrahaṇaṃ lakṣamahetū kriyāviṣayau vijñāsyete| tat kriyāgrahaṇena dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatve hi tayoḥ kvaciddhātvartho dravyasya heturbhavati, lakṣaṇaṃ vā ; kvacidguṇasya , kvacitkriyāyāḥ| ato dravyādinivṛttyarthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ yuktam; ataḥ `kriyāyāḥ` iti vacanam| `kriyāviṣayau` iti| kriyāyā ityetadvivaraṇam| kriyā viṣayo yathostau tathoktau| etena `kriyāyāḥ` iti yeyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī sā subvyatyayena saptamyāḥ sthāne vihiteti sūcayati| `śayānā bhuñjate` iti| śīṅo'pavāditvācchapo luk, `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke` [[7.4.21]] iti guṇaḥ| atra śayanaṃ lakṣaṇam, bhujikriyā viṣayaḥ|tena hi bhujikriyā lakṣyate tatra śīṅa vartate| `tiṣṭhanto'nuśāsati` iti| tiṣṭhateḥ pāghrādisūtreṇa [[7.3.78]] tiṣṭhādeśaḥ| atrāvasthānaṃ lakṣaṇam, tenānuśāsanakriyā lakṣyate| `arjayan vasati` atrādhyayanam|`pacati, paṭhati` iti| nātra kriyāyā lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvo vivakṣitaḥ| `yaḥ kampateso'ātthaḥ`iti| atra hi kampanaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti tenāāttho lakṣyate, na tu kriyāviṣayam, kiṃ tarhi? dravyaviṣayam; aātthasya dravyaviṣayatvāt| `yadutplavate tallaghu` iti| atrotplavanenalaghusaṃjñako guṇo lakṣyata iti gu viṣayaṃ tat, na tu kriyāviṣayam| varṣatīti dhāvati, hantīti palāyata ityatra yadyapi varṣaṇahananābhyāṃ dhāvanapalāyanakriye lakṣyete, tathāpi śatṛśānacau na bhavataḥ; <> [[3.2.121]] ityato vyavasthitavibhāṣetyanuvartate; itikaraṇena hetubhāvasya dyotitatvāt| pūrvanipātalakṣamavyabhicāraliṅgam` iti| <> [[2.2.32]] ityanena dhyantasya yaḥ pūrvanipātaḥ kriyate tasya vyabhicāraḥ| svaviṣaye satyapi tasya kvacidabhāvaḥ| tasya vyabhicārasya liṅgamayaṃ nirdeśaḥ|yadi hrabhicārī dhyantasya nipātaḥ syāt, `hetulakṣaṇayoḥ`iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| vyabhicāre tu sati dhūmāgnī ityevamādaya upapannā bhavanti||nanu ca prakṛtatvādeva śatṛśānacoriyaṃ saṃjñā syāt, tatka taugrahaṇamityāha - `taugrahaṇam` ityādi| upādhinā viśeṣamenāsaṃsargārthaṃ taugrahaṇamityarthaḥ| upādhistu vartamānakālaḥ, tatra śatṛśānacorvihitvāt| upādhyasaṃgarhārthe taugrahaṇe sati kiṃ bhavatītyāha - `śatṛśānajmātrasya` ityādi| mātragrahaṇamupādhisaṃgrahavyavacchedārtham| asati hi taugrahaṇe yādṛśau prakṛtau tādṛśayorava saṃjñā syāt| kīdṛśau ca tau? vartamānakalāvihitau| tataśca lṛḍādeśayorbhaviṣyatkālavihitayoḥ saditi saṃjñā na syāt| nanu ca `luṭaḥ sadvā` [[3.3.14]] iti sacchabdena tau vidhīyete, tato vacanasāmarthyāt tu bhaviṣyataḥ? na brāūmaḥ - vidhānaṃ tayorna sidhyatīti, kiṃ tarhi? vihitayoruttarakālasaṃjñā na sidhyati| tataśca brāāhṛṇasya kariṣyan, brāāhṛṇasya kariṣyamāṇa ityatra `pūraṇaguṇa` [[2.2.11]] ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedho na syāt| sadgrahaṇaṃ tu sacchabdenaiva vartamānaśatṛśānajante ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhārthaṃ syāt| taugrahaṇe śatṛśānacorviśeṣaṇamanapekṣya rūpamātre saṃjñā''khyāyata iti vartamānakāle vidhānāsaṃsaktayorapi saṃjñā sidhyatīti||vartamānavihitāḥ śatṛśānacprabhṛtayaḥ| ete lādeśā vā syuḥ? pratyayā vā? tatra yadi iha laṭa ityanuvartate tadā lādeśāḥ, atha nānuvartate tataḥ pratyayāḥ| tasyādeśāḥ kriyeraṃstadā <> [[3.2.121]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartayitavyaṃ jāyeta; anyathā pavate devadattaḥ, yajate devadatta iti tiṅaśravaṇaṃ kuryāt| pratyayalakṣaṇe tu vāsarūpavidhinā yadā laḍ bhavati tadā pratyayaśravaṇaṃ tiṅaśravaṇamupapadyate| kiñca, ādeśapakṣe <> [[3.4.69]] iti bhāvakarmaṇorapi śānannādayaḥ syuḥ, kartaryeva ceṣyante| pratyayapakṣe tu `kartari kṛt` [[3.4.67]] iti kartaryeva bhavanti, na bhāvakarmaṇoḥ, iha katīha maṇḍayamāna ittyuttarasūtre tṛnniti pratyayagrahaṇaṃ syāt tadā śānanprabhṛtīnāṃ pratyayārthe sati `somaṃ pavamānaḥ` ityādau ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho na syāt| na ca tṛnniti pratyayasya grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? pratyāhārasya| tatra pratipatteḥ, tasmāt saṃyogagrahaṇamiti na kartavyametat? kriyate pradhānakarttṛpratipattyartham| yāgasya ye kartāro bhūtvā phalaṃ prāpnuvantaḥ sunvantaste pradhānakartāraḥ, te punaryajamānāḥ,na viśeṣavihitatvācca| `kādīn` iti| bādhata iti sambandhaḥ| ādiśabdena ṭagādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `tenāpavādaviṣaye'pi bhavati` iti| apavādāḥ sāmānyavihitasyāṇaḥ kādayaḥ, tadviṣaye'pi bhavati| <> [[3.3.12]] ityasyā'nākārāntakriyopapado'vakāśa - kāṇṭalāvo vrajatīti, <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] ityasyākārāntaḥ kriyopapado'vakāśaḥ - goda iti; iha hrubhayaṃ prāpnoti - godāyo vrajatīti, paratvādaṇ bhavati| tathā `gapoṣṭak` [[3.2.8]] ityasyāvakāśaḥ - surāpaḥ,śīdhupaḥ,aṇaḥ sa eva;ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti - surāpāyo vrajati, śīdhupāyo vrajatīti||`cakārāt` ityādi| etena kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmityasyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāra iti darśayati| `kariṣyāmi` iti| <<ṛddhanoḥ sye>> [[7.2.70]] itīṭ||`satsaṃjñau` iti| `tau sat` [[3.2.127]] itisaṃjñāvihitatvācchatṛśānacau satsaṃjñakau| kathaṃ punarlṛṭaḥ śatṛśānacau bhavata ityāha - `aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe` ityādi| prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe vikalpena yathā laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau,tathā lṛṭo'pi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā satsaṃjñakau bhavataḥ| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇādiṣu nityaṃ bhavataḥ - kariṣyantaṃ paśya, kariṣyamāṇaṃ paśya, he kariṣyan, he kariṣyamāṇa, arjayiṣyan vasati, kariṣyadbhaktiḥ, kariṣyamāṇabhaktiḥ, kariṣyadrūpaḥ,kariṣyamāṇarūpa ityaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe|prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe tu vikalpaḥ - kariṣyati devadattaḥ kariṣyan devadattaḥ; kariṣyate devadattaḥ, kariṣyamāṇo devadatta iti| lṛḍiti vartamāne punarlṛḍgrahaṇaṃ sthāninirdeśārtham; itarathā hi pratyayāntaratvaṃ satsaṃjñakayorvijñāyeta| lṛṇmātrasya yathā syādityevamarthaṃ vā| tena yo'nadyatane lṛṭ tasyāpi bhavataḥ - āo'gnīnādhāsyamāneneti| <> [[3.2.112]] ityasya na bhavataḥ; bhaviṣyatītyadhikārāt, asya ca bhaviṣyatkālavihitatvāt| anadyatane punarlṛḍuttarasūtre'nadyatana itiyogavibhāgādbhavatīti veditavyam| lṛṭaṣṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ, ṛkāraḥ <> [[3.1.33]] ityatra viśeṣārthaḥ||`anadyatana iti bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ` iti| adya bhāvo nāsyāsminnityanadyatanaḥ| `tena` ityādinā bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayaṇasya phalaṃ darśayati| etacca <> [[3.2.111]] ityatra vyākhyātaprāyamiti tata evādavagantavyam| `adya āo vā gamiṣyati` iti| adya āśca gamiṣyatītyarthaḥ|`paridevane` ityādi| bhaviṣyadanadyatane luḍukto bhaviṣyatsāmānye na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca, etadarthamidamucyate| paridevanam = anuśocanam| `āstanī` iti| luṭa iyamanyācāryasaṃjñā| `vaktavyā` iti| vyākhyeyā| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[3.3.13]] ityataścakāro'nuvanartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tataḥ paridevane āstanī bhaviṣyatyarthe bhaviṣyatīti| anyastvayaṃ nu kadā gantetyādāvanadyatana eva kāle luḍiti darśayannāha - padamanvākhyāne vyākaraṇe ca, tacca padaṃ gantetyādikamanadyatana eva vartate| tasya yadā'nadyatane bhaviṣyatsāmānye vā vṛttiḥ sārthāt prakaraṇādvā bhavatīti vākyārmatho'vatiṣṭhate| na ca vākyārthaḥ padasaṃskārasya nimittam, kiṃ tarhi? padārthaḥ| tasmādanadyatane luḍityeṣa siddhamiti| anena tu nyāyena paridevane āstanītyādi samyagetat| luṭo'pi ṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ; ukāraḥ <> [[2.4.85]] iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ||paderṇvṛltṛcorapavādo ghañ vidhīyate, rujiviśibhyāmigupadhalakṣaṇasya kasya, spṛśeśca pacādyacaḥ| `pādaḥ` iti| <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiḥ| yadyevam, padamiti na siddhyati? na tu khalu na siddhyati, `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam [[6.1.152]] iti nipātanāt|`spṛśa upatāpe iti vaktavyamiti| upatāpaḥ = rogaḥ, tatra spṛśerghañbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - `lṛṭaḥ sadvā` [[3.3.14]] ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena spṛśerupāta eva kartari bhavati, nānyatreti| `svare viśeṣaḥ` iti| aci hi satyantodāttatvaṃ bhavati, ghañi tu padasyādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| ghaño ñakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ, ādyudāttārthaśca| ghakāraḥ `cajoḥ kughiṇṇyatoḥ` [[7.3.52]] iti kutvārthaḥ||`sarterdhātoḥ` iti| `sṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-935) ityasmāddhātoḥ| `sthire kartari` iti| etena sthiragrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasya kartturviśeṣaṇaṃ na tūpapadamiti darśayati|`ghañpratyayo bhavati` iti| tṛjādyapavādaḥ| kaḥ punarayaṃ sthiro nāmetyāha - `sthira iti kālāntarasthāyī` ityādi| tatraivopapattimāha - `sa ciram` ityādi| sarterdhātorgatirarthaḥ| sa ca kālāntarasthāyina eva karttuḥ sambhavati, nātmalābhasamanantaranāśinaḥ| tasmāt kālāntarasthāyyeva gaterdhātvarthasya kartā yujyata ityeveha sthiraśabdenocyate| yadi kālāntarasthāyina eva gatiḥ sambhavati sthiragrahaṇamanarthakam, na hrasthiraḥ sarttyarthas kartopapadyate? nānarthakam; prakarṣeṇa yaḥ sarati tatra kartari pratyayo yathā syādityevamarthatvāt| ata eva sa ciraṃ tiṣṭhan kālāntaraṃ saratīti vṛttau ciragrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| `candasāraḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|`vyādhimatsyabaleṣviti vaktavyam` iti| asthirārtho'yamārambhaḥ| eṣu vyādhyādiṣu triṣvipi ghañ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi cakārānuvṛttimāśritya kartavyam| `atīsāraḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.122]] iti dīrghatvam||`rāgaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.26]] <> [[6.4.27]] ityanunāsikalopaḥ| nanu ca `bhāve` iti bhavatināyaṃ ghañantena nirdeśaḥ kriyata iti bhavativiṣaya eva pratyayārthanirddeśaḥ kṛto bhavati, tataśca bhavateryo bhāvastasminneva vācye pratyayaḥ syāt, sa ca bhavaterevotpadyamānena pratyayena śakyo'bhidhātum, atastata eva pratyayena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ pākastyāgo rāga iti pacyādibhyo bhavati? ata āha - `kriyāsāmānyavācī` ityādi| kriyāsāmānyaṃ hi sarva dhātvarthānugataṃ bhavaterarthaḥ| tena kriyāsāmānyavācinā'rthanirdeśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ sarvadhātuviṣayaḥ kṛto bhavati, ataḥ pacyādibhyo'pi pratyayo bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu dhātvarthaḥ pūrvāparībhūto'pariniṣpannaḥ, tato yadi tatra vācye pratyayo bhavati tasyāsattvabhūtatvālliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ pratyayārthasya sambandho na siddhyati, tata āha - `dhātvarthaśca` ityādi| evakāraḥ pratyayavyavacchedārthaḥ| dhātunaivocyate dhātvarthaḥ, na tu pratyayena| kathaṃ tarhi ghañādayo vidhīyanta ityata āha - `yastasya` ityādi| tasya dhātvarthasya siddhatā niṣpanntā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādayaḥ pratyayā vidhīyante, tato yuktaḥ pratyayārthasya liṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ| tasya yo dharmastasya sattvabhūtatvādityarthaḥ| bhāva iti - ihi puṃlliṅgenāyaṃ nirddeśa ekavacanenana ca| tena puṃlliṅga eva bāve ekavacana eva pratyayāḥ syuḥ| na liṅgāntarayukte nāpi vacanāntare| evañca sati <> [[3.3.94]] ityatra `bhāve` `striyāmiti caitayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate, vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ hi syāt| tataḥ striyāṃ bhāve ktinpratyayo na syāt, arthāntara eva karmādau syāt| bhāve ca puṃlliṅge pākau pākā ityatraikavacanaṃ syāt|yathājātīyakaṃ hrarthamupādātuṃ samartho bhāvaśabdastathājātīyake'rthe pratyayena yuktaṃ bhavituṃ nānyatretyata āha - `puṃlliṅgamekavacanaṃ cātra na tantram` iti| sarvaliṅgasaṃkhyāsambandhayogyaṃ pratātipadikārthasāmānyanimittaṃ pratyayanimittatvenopādīyate, tadeva pradhānam, na liṅgaṃ nāpi vacanam| tatra prātipadikārthasāmānyaṃ vinā liṅgavacanābhyāṃ na śakyaṃ nirddeṣṭumiti nāntarīyakatvāt tayorupādānam| pratīte tu tasmin prātipadikārthasāmānyacaritārthatvālliṅgavacane liṅgāntare ca pratyayā bhavantyeva| `paktiḥ` iti| bhāve <> [[3.3.94]] | `pakvam` iti| `nupaṃsake bhāve ktaḥ` [[3.3.114]] | `pacanam` iti| <> [[3.3.115]] iti lyuṭ| atrāpi yadi bhāve pulliṅgastantraṃ syāt, tato bhāvanapuṃsakaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattervaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ syāt, tataśca bhāve napuṃsake lyuṇna syāt, arthāntara eva tu syāt| bhāve ca puṃlliṅge pacanamityasya tulyatvāccodyaparihārasyopanyāsaḥ, anyathā hranyadeva bhāvagrahaṇamadhikṛtya lyuṭo vidhānādadamihānupanyasanīyameva syāt| `pākau` ityādikaṃ vacanāntare bhāvapratyayasyodāharaṇam||`prāsaḥ`iti| `asu kṣepaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1209), `prasevaḥ` iti| `ṣivṛ tantusantāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1108), ubhayatrāpyatra karmaṇi ghañ| `āhāraḥ` iti| `hmañ haraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-899)| `madhurāhāraḥ` iti| karmadhārayaḥ, ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo vā|`meṣaḥ` iti| `miṣa spadrdhāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1352), pacādyac| `kartavyaḥ` iti| karmaṇi tavyaḥ|`cakāraḥ saṃjñāvyabhicārārthaḥ` iti| cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakramaḥ saṃjñāyāmityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, tadanena cārtha dyotyate| `saṃjñāyāñca`iti cārthaṃ dyotayannasau saṃjñāvyabhicārāya bhavati, tenāsaṃjñāyāmapi ca bhavati yadyevam, saṃjñāgrahaṇamakṛtvā sāmānyenaiva pratyayo vidheyaḥ; tatrāpyayamarthaḥ - saṃjñāvyabhicārārthaścakāro na kartavyo bhavati? satyametat ; tathāpi bāhulyena saṃjñāyāṃ bhavati; asaṃjñāyāṃ tu kvacidevetyamumarthaṃ sūcayituṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| dīyata iti `dāyaḥ` karmaṇi ghañ, pūrvavad yuk| `lābhaḥ` iti karmaṇyeva ghañ| `kārakagrahaṇam` ityādi| paryudāse hi `akartari` ityukte kārakagrahaṇamanteraṇāpi nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā|pa|65) kartturanyatra tādṛśe kāraka eva karmādau pratītirbhavati, yathā - abrāāhṛṇa iti brāāhṛṇasadṛśe kṣatriyādau| tasmāt paryudāse vināpi kārakagrahaṇena kārakaeva pratyayo labhyataita kārakagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu kartavyam, tatra hi kriyāpratiṣedhamātraṃ pratīyate, na sadṛśaṃ vastvantaram| tatra yadi `akartari saṃjñāyām` ityetāvaducyeta, kartari na bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyeta| evañca vidhāyakasya vākyāntarasyābha#āvāt karmādiṣu pratyayo na syāt| kva tarhi syāt? `anirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti (puṃ|pa|90) iti svārthe| nanu ca vihitaḥ svārthe pūrveṇeva? naitadasti;`dhātvarthasya hi siddhatā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādayo vidhīyante` ityuktam| tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedhe kārakagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha - paryudāse kārakagrahaṇamantareṇāpi sidhyati, sa evāśrayiṣyate, tatkimarthamaṃ kārakagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha - `tatkriyate` ityādi| yadi tarhi paryudāsa evaiṣa nañsamāsaḥ syāt, kārakagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, vināpi hi tena kāraka eva pratyayo labhyate; prasajyapratiṣedhe tu sati kārakagrahaṇamarthavadbhavati, na hi tatra vināpi tena kārake pratyayo labhyate| ivañcānantarameva pratipādanam| tasmāt kārakagrahaṇena prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi samāso'stīti jñāpyate| tena <<ādeca upadeśe'śiti>> [[6.1.45]] ityatra prasajyapratiṣedhe samāso labhyate, tataśca yaduktam - `anaimittikamāttvaṃ śiti pratiṣedhaḥ` iti, tadupapannaṃ bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra prasajyapratiṣedha āśrīyate? prāgeva pratyayotpatteranimittaka āttve kṛte suglaḥ sumla iti <<ātaścopasarge>> [[3.3.106]] iti ko yathā syāt| paryudāse tu tatrāśrīyamāṇe śito'nyatra tṛjādau pratyaye parabhūta āttvena bhavitavyam, tataśca glāyatiprabhṛtibhya ākārāntalakṣamaḥ pratyayo na syāt| nanu cācāryapravṛttijrñāpayati - bhavantyejantebhya ākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyaya iti, yadayaṃ kabādhanārthaṃ <> [[3.2.2]] ityaṇaṃ śāsti, tasmādaśitīti paryudāse'pyāśrīyamāṇe jñāpakādejantasyākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyayaḥ sidhyatyeva? naitadasti; karmopapadaviṣayamevaitajjñāpakaṃ vijñāyate| tasmādaśitītyatra prasajyapratiṣedha evāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ| tasya cāstitvamiha kārakagrahaṇena jñāpyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ prasajyapratiṣedho na sidhyati, yatastadastitvajñāpanaṃ pratipannaṃ kriyate? asāmarthyaṃ kāraṇam; sāmarthye hi sati samāsena bhavitavyam,na ca tat prasajyapratiṣedhe| tathā hi tatarnañ kriyayā sambaddhaḥ, nottarapadena||`ekastaṇḍulaniścāyaḥ`iti| <> [[3.3.58]] ityapi prāpte dhañ| `dvau śūrpaniṣpāvau` iti| atrāpi `ṛdorap` [[3.3.57]] ityapi prāpte| <> [[8.3.41]] iti visarjanīyas ṣatvam| `dvau kārau`iti| `kṛ vikṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1409)| nanu ca dvau śūrpaniṣpāvāvityatra <> [[3.3.28]] ityanena ghañ siddhaḥ, tatkimarthamidamihoktam? evaṃ manyate - anyārte sarvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe parimāṇākhyāyāṃ vā'nyatraiva siddham, niṣpūrvādapi hrappratyayo yuktaḥ, <> [[3.3.28]] ityasya tu yatra parimāṇākhyā na gamyate so'vakāśa iti| kaḥ punastena vānena vā ghañi sati viśeṣaḥ? ko nyāyo vākhyayate? na kaścit| nanu ca dhātoriti sāmānyamadhikṛtam, na dhātuviśeṣa iti| antareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇaṃ dhātumātrāddhañ bhaviṣyati tatkimarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇamityāha - `sarvagrahaṇam` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati sarvagrahaṇe'po bādhā na sidhyatītyāha - `purastāt` ityādi| `purastādapavādā anantarān vidhīn bādhante nottarān` (vyā|pa|9) iti| sati sarvagrahaṇe ghañamanantaramacameva bādheta, nāpam| sarvagrahaṇe tu satyapamapi bādhate| tasmādapo'pi bādhā yathā syāditi sarvagrahaṇam|na ca parimāṇaśabdo'yaṃ prasthādiṣu rūḍho na saṃkhyāyām, tatkathaṃ parimāṇākhyāyaṃ pratyayo vidhāyamāna ekastaṇḍulaniścāya ityādau gamyamānāyāṃ bhavatītyata āha - `ākhyāgrahaṇam` ityādi| ākhyāgrahaṇamiha rūḍhernirāsastyāgo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kṛtam| tena rūḍhau tyaktāyāṃ saṃkhyāpi gṛhrate| ākhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyāddhi parimāṇam, ato yuktaṃ tasyāpi grahaṇam| yadi sarvagrahaṇāt paramapyayaṃ ghañ bādhate, sthīpratyayānapi bādhetetyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| ata evāha -`strīpratyayāstu na bādhyante` iti| kṛtaḥ punarayamartho labhyate? `sarvebhyaḥ`iti pañcamyantena nidrdaśāt| pañcamyantanirddeśe hi sarvaśabdo dhātusamānādhikaraṇo vijñāyate| tena prakṛtyāśrayasyāpavādasya sarvagrahaṇādbādhā bhavati, nārthāśrayasya| yadi tvarthāśrayo'pyapavādo bādhitumiṣṭaḥ syāt, tadā sarvasminniti sarvaśabdaṃ saptamyantamuccārayet| `ekā tilocchritiḥ`iti| śriña utpūrvāt <> [[3.3.94]] , <> [[8.4.40]] iti cutvam, <<śaścho'ṭi>> [[8.4.63]] iti cchatvam| `dārajārau` ityādi| dārajāraśabdau nipātyete| kimatra nipātyate? `dṛ vidāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1493) `jṛṣ vayohānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1130) ābhyāṃ hetumaṇṇyantābhyāṃ kartari tṛjādiṣu ghañi ṇiluk| nanu ca <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti ṇilope hi sati `janījṛṣknasurañjo'mantāśca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-817) iti mitsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṇilope kṛte'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena jīryatermitāṃ hrasvatvaṃ prasajyate| astu tarhi mitāṃ hrasvatvam, punarghañāśrayā vṛddhirbhaviṣyatīti cet? ayuktametat; na hi ghañāśrayā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, <> [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadbhāve sati ṇicā vyavahitatvāt| luki tu sati tasyāparanimittatvādasati sthānivadbhāve ghañamāśritya vṛddhirbhavati| na ca pratyayalakṣaṇena hrasvatvaṃ prasajyate; `na lumatāṅgasya [[1.1.62]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt| tasmāllugvaktavyaḥ||`aco'pavādaḥ` iti| `erac` [[3.3.56]] iti prāptosyottarasyāpīvarṇāntādghañ vidhīyamāno'ca evāpavādo veditavyaḥ| `adhyāyaḥ` iti| karmaṇi ghañ| `tadantācca vā ṅīṣ` iti| yo'yamapādāne ghañ tadantānṅīṣ pratipādyaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `voto guṇavacanāt` [[4.1.44]] ityatra veti yogavibhāghaḥ kartavyaḥ, tenāpādāne striyāmiṅo yo ghañ vihitastadantānṅīṣ bhaviṣyatīti| yadā ca puṃyogo na vivakṣyate tadā ṅīṣ pratipādyaḥ| yadā tūpādhyāyasya strīti puṃyogo vivakṣyate tadā <> [[4.1.48]] ityeva ṅīṣ siddhaḥ| upetyādhīyate'syā upādhyāyī|`śṛ vāyuvarṇanivṛteṣu` iti| `śṛ hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1488) - asmādvāyvādiṣu vācyeṣu ghañ pratipādyaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu tameva cakāramanuktasamuccayārtham, <> [[3.3.113]] iti bahulagrahaṇaṃ vā''śritya kartavyam| nivṛttam = nivāraṇam| śītādiduḥkhopaśamaheturnivāraṇamucyate|`akṛtanīśāraḥ` iti| akṛtaśītanivāraṇa ityarthaḥ| pūrvavadupasargasya dīrghatvam||`apo'pavādaḥ` iti| `ṛdorap` [[3.3.57]] iti prāptasya| uttarasūtreṇāpyuvarṇāntāddhañ vidhīyamāno'pa evāpavādo veditavyaḥ||`anupasargebhyaḥ`iti| avidyamāna upasarga eṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ `anupasargebhyaḥ` iti pañcamyantena vivaraṇaṃ kurvan sūtre'nupasarga iti subvyatyayena eṣā saptamīti darśayati|`kathaṃ prabhāvo rājñaḥ` iti| anupasargavacanādiha praśabda upasarga upapade na bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `{kathaṃ ca - kāśikā} kathaṃ nayo rājñaḥ` iti| anupasargādghañātra bhavitavyamiti manyate||`vikṣāvaḥ`iti| `ṭukṣu śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1036)||`unnāyaḥ` iti| <> [[8.4.45]] iti vā'nunāsikaḥ| `kathamunnayaḥ padārthānām` iti| ucchabdopapadatvāddhañātra bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ||`sāmānyena grahaṇam` iti| viśeṣānupādānāt| `yathāsaṃkhyamupasargasambandhaḥ` iti| nisopasargeṇa puvaḥ sambandhaḥ, abhinā lūñaḥ| nanu ca pūñpūṅlūñastrayo dhātavaḥ, upasargau dvau, ato vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyena na bhavitavyam? pūrūpamutsṛṣṭānubandhasāmānyamekameva, tato nāsti vaiṣamyamityadoṣaḥ||`ṝdorap` [[3.3.57]] itiprāptasyāyamapavādaḥ| uttaratrāpi ṝkārāntāddhañ vidhīyamāno'pa evāpavādo veditavyaḥ| `dvayorapi grahaṇam` iti| viśeṣānupādānāt||dhānyamiha prakṛtyartho vā syāt? pratyayārtho vā syāt? prakṛtyarthastāvannopapadyate;dhānyasya dravyatvāt dhātośca kriyāvācitvāt| pratyayārthastūpapadyate dhānyam;kintu pratyayenābihitatvādutkāro dhānyasyeti dhānyaśabdasya prayogo na prāpnoti| athāpi prayogaḥ syāt? evamapi pratyayarthe'ntarbhūtatvāt ṣaṣṭhī nopapadyate - utkāro dhānyasyeti| sāmānādhikaraṇyameva pratyayāntena syāt, evaṃ hi pratyayartho bhavati yadi pratyayāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati, yathā - dṛtihariḥ paśuriti| tasmānnedaṃ pratyayārthaḥ,nāpi prakṛtyarthaḥ, api tu prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti hiṃsārthasya` iti| `kṛ hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1496) ityasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha - `anabhidhānāt` iti| śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādutkāraśabdābhyāṃ dhānyaviṣayo vikṣepa evābhidhīyate, na hiṃsā| yasya cārthaḥ pratyayāntenābhidhīyate tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, netarasya| `utkāro dhānyasya` iti| vikṣepo dānyasyetyarthaḥ||`sametya stuvanti yasmin deśe` ityādinā saṃstāvaśabdasyādhikaraṇasādhanatvaṃ darśayati||`barhiṣprastaraḥ`iti| `idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya` (8.3.41 ) visarjanīyasya ṣatvam||`tṛṇavistaraḥ` iti| tṛṇācchādanamityarthaḥ||chandaḥśabdo'yamastyeva mantrabrāāhṛṇe, astyanyadakṣarāṇāmittāviśiṣṭavṛtte yasya gāyatryādayo viśeṣāḥ| tadiha katarastadartho gṛhrate? ityāha - `vṛttam` ityādi| atraivopapattimāha - `nāmagrahaṇāt` iti| yadyatra mantrabrāāhṛṇamiṣṭaṃ syānnāmagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, chandasītyeva brāūyāt| evamapi hrucyamāne mantrabrāāhṛṇagrahaṇaṃ labhyata eva, yathā - <> [[7.4.78]] ityādau vākye| tasmannāmagrahaṇāvvṛttamiha cchando gṛhrate| `viṣṭārapaṅktiḥ` iti| <> [[8.3.94]] iti ṣatvam| viṣṭāraśabda evātra ghañantaśchandonāmeti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, tannirākaraṇāyāha - `viṣṭārapaṅktiśabdo'tra` ityādi| tatra = viṣṭārapaṅktiśabde| `avayavatvena vartate`iti| ghañantaṃ śabdarūpamiti sambandhanīyama| yadi ghañantaṃ śabdarūpaṃ na cchandonāma, kintu viṣṭārapaṅktiśabdaḥ, tatra ghañantarūpamavayatvena vartate, evaṃ tarhi `chandotatkathamunnīyate? asya hi chandonāmni gamyamāna ityeṣo'rthaḥ,pratyayāntaṃ chandonāma bhavatīti yāvat| evañcārtha evaṃ sati nopapadyata ityāha - `chandonāmnītyadhikaṇasaptamyeṣā`iti| etena cchandonāmni pratyayāntasyādhikaraṇabhūte pratyayayo bhavatītyayamatrārtho veditavyaḥ,na cchandonāmni gamyamāna ityeṣa iti darśayati||`apo'pavādaḥ` iti| <> [[3.3.58]] iti prāptasya|`{chandasi vipūrvādapīṣyateruāugudyamananipātanayoḥ`ityeva vārttikapāṭho mudrito dṛśyate|} chandasi tu`ityādi| yajñapātraviśeṣo yenāhutirdīyate tatruāugucyate, tasyodyamanam = ūdhrvalanayanam, nipātanam = dhastānnayanametayorarthayogrraheśchandasi viṣaye ghañiṣyate| sa ca <> [[3.3.113]] iti labhyata iti veditavyam| `nigrābham` iti| hmagrahorbhaśchandasyupasaṃkhyānāddhakārasya bhakāraḥ||graheḥ kriyāvācitvāt muṣṭeścākriyātmakatvāt tatra graherna sambhavati, tasmānmuṣṭigrahe yo'rthastasya viṣayo vijñāyata ityāha - muṣṭiviṣayaścedvātvartho bhavati` iti| astyevāyaṃ muṣṭiśabdaḥ parimāṇe - śākasya muṣṭiriti, astyaṅgulīnāṃ racanāviśeṣe, yathā - hanti muṣṭineti,tataryadīha parimāṇavṛttegrrahaṇaṃ syādasya sūtrasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt, <> [[3.3.20]] ityeva siddhatvāt| tasmādaṅgulīnāṃ racanāviśeṣavṛttegrrahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `muṣṭiraṅgulisanniveśaḥ` iti|sanniveśaḥ = racanāviśeṣaḥ| `aho mallasya saṃgrahaḥ`iti| muṣṭerdāḍharmityarthaḥ| ata evāha - `dṛḍhamuṣṭitā''khyāyate` iti|`padārthānām` ityādi| padārśabdo vastuvācī| kutsitaścāraḥ = apacāraḥ|yatāprāptasyākaraṇamityarthaḥ| yathāprāptasyākaraṇamasādhvetaditiloke kutsyate, tasmādanyaḥ śāntaścāro'napacāraḥ| etamevārthaṃ paryāyāntareṇa vyaktīkarttumāha - `yathāprāptasya karaṇam` iti| yadyat prāptimiti `yathā'sādṛśye` [[2.1.7]] itivīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| karaṇam = sampādanam| etuduktaṃ bhavati - yukterāgamāllokaprasiddhervā yaḥ padārthānāṃ prāpnoti tasya sampādanamabhreṣa iti|`{ bhreṣṛ gatau-dhātupāṭhaḥ-} bhreṣa calane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-884) bhreṣaṇam = bhreṣaḥ, svarūpāt taccalanam| abhreṣo bhreṣasvarūpādacalanam| evaṃ hi padārthāḥ svarūpādacalitā bhavanti yadi prāptaṃ nātivartante| `parimāyena` iti| <<upasargādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya>> [[8.4.14]] iti ṇatvam| `hanti` iti bādhate| `samantānnayanena` iti| pariṇāyenetyasyedamarthakathanam||`anatipātaḥ` iti| anitakrama ityarthaḥ| `atipāta ityarthaḥ` iti| atikrama ityarthaḥ||paryāyo'nupātyaya eva,tatrānupātyayagrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhe paryāyagrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārtham| abhividhivivakṣāyāṃ parimāṇamapi bādhitvā ghañeva yathā syāt| evañcārthe śabdādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti labhyate, na tu paryāyaśabdo'syārthasya vācakaḥ||`hastādānagrahaṇena` ityādi| hastenopāyāntaranirapekṣeṇopādānam = pratyāsattiḥ, tataeva vastuno bhavati, tasmāddhastādānagrahaṇena grāhrasya vastunaḥ pratyāsannatopalakṣyate; hastādānaśabdābhidheyasyārthasya pratyāsatteḥ sāhacaryāt|`vṛkṣaśikhare` ityādi| vṛkṣaśikharagrahaṇenādeyasyāpratyāsannatvaṃ sūcayati||`rāśīkaraṇam` iti| prakīrṇasyaikatrakaraṇamityarthaḥ| `cikhallinikāyaḥ` iti| cikhallirjanapadaḥ, tasya nikāyaḥ = nivāsaḥ| athādigrahaṇaṃ kim? arthasya mā bhūt| yadyevam, `caḥ kaḥ` iti vaktavyam? evaṃ tarhi yadā yaṅlugantādutpadyate tadā `{antyābhāve antyasadeśasya` śāka|pa|}antyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya` (śāka|pa|56) iti dvitīyasya cakārasya mā bhūdityavamarthamādigrahaṇam||`ekadharmaniveśena` iti| ekadharmānugamanenetyarthaḥ||`dātoḥ` [[3.1.91]] ityadhikārāddhātuvācyaṃ yatkarma tadava gṛhrate,na sādhanakarma| na hi dhātostatra vṛttirastīti matvā''ha - karmaṃ kriyā`iti| `cakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ` iti| antodattārthaścakāraḥ kasmānna bhavati? nārhatyantodāttārtho bhavitum; ṇajantādaño vidhānāt| satiśiṣṭasvareṇādyudāttena bhavitavyam,tatra kuto'ntodāttasya sambhavaḥ| tasmādviśeṣaṇārtha eva cakāraḥ| `striyām` ityucyamāne <> [[5.2.101]] iti prājñetyatrāpi syāt| `vyāvakrośī` ityādi| `kruśa { āhvāne rodane ca - dha|pā|}, `likha akṣaravinyāse` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1365),`hase hasane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-721) - ebhyo ṇac, `ṇacaḥ striyām` [[5.4.14]] iti svārte'ñ, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp, <> [[7.3.6]] ityaijāgamapratiṣedhaḥ| ādivṛddhireva bhavati|`vyatipākaḥ` iti| tatra puṃlliṅgatvādbhāvasya ghañ bhavati| atha <> [[3.3.94]] ityasminneva prakaraṇe ṇac kasmānnoktaḥ, kaḥ punarevaṃ sati guṇo bhavati, dviḥ striyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavita? asti guṇaḥ,vāsarūpavidhistu na syāt ; astriyāmiti pratiṣedhāt| tataśca ktino ṇacāsamāveśābhāvādvyāvakruṣṭiriti na sidhyet| iha tu kriyamāṇe ṇac sidhyati; yasmāt <> [[3.1.94]] ityatra strīgrahaṇasya ca svaritatvāt stryadhikarāravihitapratyayaviṣaya eva `astriyāma` [[3.1.94]] iti pratiṣedho vijñāyate,na strīpratyayamātraviṣaye| tasmādyathānyasameva nyāyyam|`vyāvacorī, vyāvacarcī` iti| `cura steye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1534), `carca adhyayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1712) - ābhyāṃ curādiṇijantābhyām <<ṇyāsaśrantho yuc>> [[3.3.107]] iti yuc prāpnoti, sa ca viśeṣavihitatvāt paravācca bādhakaḥ, tathāpi tadviṣaye tu ṇajeveṣyate| `vyatīkṣā,vyatīhā` iti| `īkṣa darśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-610), `īha ceṣṭāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-632) - ābhyāṃ <> [[3.3.103]] ityakāraeva pratyayo bhavati| na ṇac śakyaḥ karttum;yasmāt kvacidbādhakaviṣaye sa iṣyate, na sarvatra| bādhakatvaṃ tvakārapratyayasya pūravavadveditavyam| `vyātyukṣī`iti| `ukṣa secane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-657)| atra bādhakasyāpyakārasya viṣaye ṇajeva bhavati| `tadetadvaicitryaṃ kathaṃ labhyate` iti| na kathañcit| tallābhahetorabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| <> [[3.3.113]] ityanena| ato hetorvecitryametallabhyata iti darśayati||`sāṃkūṭinam` iti| `kūṭa {paritāpe (paridāhe ityanye)-dhātupāṭhaḥ-} (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1890), <> [[5.4.15]] itīnumantāt svārthiko'ṇ| <> [[6.4.164]] iti prakṛtibhāvāt <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopo na bhavati|`saṃrāvaḥ` iti| `upasarge ruvaḥ [[3.3.22]] iti ghañ| `saṃdrāvaḥ` iti| atrāpi <> [[3.3.23]] iti| nanu ca bhāva iti vartata eva, tatkimarthaṃ punastadgrahamityāha - `bhāve` iti| `vartamāne` ityādi| bhāvagrahaṇamihātiricyate, taditaricyamānaṃ vāsarūpanirāsārthaṃ vijñāyate| tena ktena sahenuṇaḥ samāveśo na bhavati| nanu ca kāraka ityapi vartate, tatastannivṛttyarthaṃ bhāvagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? evaṃ manyate - bhāve kāraka iti dvaye prakṛte'pi prayogadarśanavaśādvayavasthā bhavati, yathā ṇacaḥ| sa hi dvathe'pi prakṛte lakṣyadarśanānurodhāt punagrrahamantareṇāpi yathā bhāva eva vijñāyate, na karāke, tathātrenuṇapi bhāva eva vijñāsyate| tasmādvāsarūpavidhinirāsārthameva punarbhāvagrahaṇaṃ yuktamiti| yadyevam, tarhi, yathā ghañenuṇaḥ samāveśo na bhavati tathā lyuṭāpi na syādityata āha - `lyuṭā tu` ityādi| gatārtham| inuṇo ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ| ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ||` grahavṛdṛ` [[3.3.58]] ityādinā prāpte vacanam| `dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmthryāt` iti| prayogopasthānena ghaño'nuvṛttisāmarthya dṛṣṭam, inuṇastu kalpayitavyam| dṛṣṭasāmarthyayośca sannidhau dṛṣṭasāmarthyadagrahaṇaṃ nyāyyam| ato ghañevānuvartata ityeke| evaṃ tu `grahavṛdṛ` [[3.3.58]] ityādāvapi sūtre ghañevānuvartate, nāp| tasmādanyathā vyākhyāyate - dṛṣṭamanuvṛttisāmarthyamadhikṛtasya yatra taddṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyam, tatra punaḥ svaritatvam| tato hi śāstre'dhikṛtasya śabdasyānuvṛttau sāmarthye dṛśyate| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - ghaña eva svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, nenuṇaḥ| tasmāt svaritatvādghañevānuvartate, nenuṇiti||`apo'pavādaḥ`iti| `grahavṛdṛ` [[3.3.58]] ityādinā prāptasya| `nīvārā nāma vrīhayo bhavanti` iti| etena yadyapi dhānyaśabdena sāmānyavācināyaṃ vyutpādyate, tathāpi pratyayāntaṃ śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāddhānyaviśeṣa e vartata iti darśayati| `upasargasyaghañi` [[6.3.121]] iti dīrghatvam|`nivarā` iti| nivriyata iti nivarā| svabhāvenābantamapi striyāṃ vartate| evañca yad ghañabanto ghājantaśceti liṅgādhikāre'bantasya puṃlliṅgatāpratipādanaṃ tat prāyikaṃ veditavyam||`ajaporapavādaḥ` iti| śrayaterivarṇāntatvādaco'pavādaḥ, yautiprabhṛtīnāṃ tūvarṇāntatvādapaḥ| `kathaṃ patanāntāḥ samucchrayā iti` iti| ucchabdopapadatvāddhañātra bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `vakṣyamāṇam` ityādi parihāraḥ| yadi tarhi vibhāṣāgrahaṇamiha sambadhyate, yautiprabhṛtīnāmapi vikalpena pratyayaḥ prasajyate? vyavasthitavibhāṣayā na prasajyata ityadoṣaḥ||rauteḥ <> [[3.3.22]] iti nityaṃ ghañi prāpte plavaterapyuvarṇāntatvādapi sūtrārambhaḥ||`grahavṛdṛ` [[3.3.58]] ityādināpi prāpte tadapavādaḥ, pakṣe ghañabhidhīyate| `kutaścinnimittāt` iti| sattvakarmāparādhādhikārāt||`vaṇiksambandhana ca` ityādi| tulāsūtraṃ hi prāyeṇa vaṇijāsambaddham = sahacaram, tataḥ sāhacaryādvaṇiksambandhena tadupalakṣyate| nātra vaṇijāṃ prādhānyām| tasmāt tadeva tulādisūtraṃ tadanyaśabdasyābhidheyam||`rathādiyuktānām` ityādi| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate,yāvatā raśmiśabdaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ, yathaivāsāvaāādisaṃyamanārthāyāṃ rajjvāṃ vartate tathā candrārkādisambandhiṣvapi raśmiṣu? evaṃ manyate- yathā <> [[3.3.48]] iti dhānyaśabdasyāpi dhānyaviśeṣa eva gṛhrate, pratyayāntena śabdaśaktisvabhāvyāddhānyaviśeṣasya vābhidhānāt; tathā yadyapi raśmiśabdaḥ sāmānyavācī, tathāpi pratyayāntaḥ svabhāvādrajjuviśeṣa eva vartate| tasmāt yuktaṃ grahaṇamiti||`vṛṇoteḥ`iti| śnuvikaraṇena nirdeśo vṛṅo nivṛttyarthaḥ| atrāpi sāmānyavācitve prāgvadācchādanaśabdādanyatra| pakṣe `grahavṛdṛ` [[3.3.58]] ityādinābbhavati||`cakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ` iti| vināpi tena thāthādisūtre [[6.2.143]] apratyayādityapratyayasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt| `ajvidhau` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu <> [[3.3.113]] ityetadāśritya kartavyam| anyastu <> [[2.1.37]] `varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyāntarasyām` [[3.4.32]] iti nipātanādbhayādīnāṃ siddhimicchati, na cāsau yuktā; kimidaṃ bhayavarṣaśabdayornapuṃsakaliṅgayoruccāraṇam? it puṃlliṅgayoḥ? iti sandehāt| `vaktayau`iti| vyākhyeyāvityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tadeva bahulagrahaṇamāśritya kartavyam| `javaḥ, savaḥ` iti| `ju` kimucyate viśeṣābhāvādityata āha - `ghañyapi` ityādi| `thāthādisvareṇa<> [[6.2.144]] ityetadvihitena||`ḍo vaktavyaḥ`ityādi| sarvatra vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityeṣo'rthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam- pratyayo vidhīyate, yāvatā kutvārthaṃ tasya vidhānam, na ca khaneḥ kaścidavayavaḥ kutvabhāgasti? evaṃ tahrretajjñāpayati - anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatīti| tena khalaḥ,bhagam, padamityevamādayaḥ siddhā ityarthaḥ| `īṣatkāryaḥ`iti| `ṛhaloṇryat` [[3.1.124]] iti ṇyat| īṣacchabdo'tra manāgityasyārthe vartateta|`lakāraḥ svarārthaḥ` iti| liti pratyayāt pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| nanu ca hrasvādikaṃ khitkāryaṃ <> [[6.3.66]] ityevamādiśāstreṇānavyayasya vidhīyate; īṣadādayaścāvyayasaṃsajñāḥ; tatkimarthaṃ khalaḥ, khitkaraṇamityāha - `khitkaraṇamuttaratra mumartham` iti|uttaratrānavyaye'pyupapade khal vidhāsyate, tatra <> [[6.3.67]] iti mum yathā syādityevamarthaṃ khitkaraṇam||karttṛkarmaṇorupapadatvaṃ bhavati, na tu pratyayārtham| yadi ca tayoḥ pratyayārthatvaṃ syādīṣadādiṣvevopapadeṣu pratyayaḥ syāt, tataśca khitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; anavyayasya khitkāryavidhānāt| īṣādādīnāñcāvyayatvāt; tasmādato'pi khitkaraṇam| upapade karttṛkarmaṇī, na tu pratyayārthāvetāvityavasīyate| atra ca karttṛkarmaṇī īṣadādayaśca na pratyekaṃ pratyayasya nimittam, kiṃ tarhi? tatsamudāyaḥ| cakāreṇa hratar sanniyogaḥ kriyate, tena karttṛkarmaṇorīṣadādīnāñca yugapadupapadatvaṃ bhavati; nānyathā| yadyevam, kathaṃ dvayorupapadayoryugapat samāsaḥ? kaḥ punarāha - yugapat samāsa iti? pūrvaṃ hi parasyopapadasya samāsaṃ kṛtvā paścāt pūrvasya samāso bhavati| kiṃ punaratra paramupapadam? karttṛkarmaṇī| kuta etat? khitkaraṇasāmarthyāt| khitkaraṇaṃ hi mumartham, mumāgamaścānavyayasya vidhīyate| tatreṣadādīnāṃ dhātoścānantarye khitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `īṣadāḍhambhavaṃ bhavatā` iti| akṛcchramāḍhaena bhayate bhavatetyarthaḥ| `īṣadāḍhaṅkaro devadatto bhavatā` iti| akṛcchramāḍhyaḥ kriyate devadatto bhavatetyarthaḥ|`karttṛkarmaṇoḥ`ityādi| cvyartho'bhūtatadbhāvaḥ| tadarthayoḥ karttṛkarmaṇorupapadayoḥ khala bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - prāyagrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvartate, tena yadā karttṛkarmaṇī cvyarthe bhavatastadaiva pratyayo bhavati, nānyadeti| `svāḍhaena bhūyate` iti| atra cvyarthasyāvivakṣitatvāt pratyayo na bhavati||`sūpasadanam` iti| `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-854), upapūrvaḥ||`sudohanam` iti| `duha samprahāre` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1173), `dṛśirprekṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-988), `ñidhṛṣā prāgalbhye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1269), `mṛṣa titikṣāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1164) - ityetebhyo'pi bhāṣāyāṃ yujbhavatīti| kathaṃ punaretadavasitam - `sarvavyabhicārārtho'piśabda iti? sūtrārambhāt| yadi hi gatyarthavyabhicāra evātrābhisaṃhitaḥ syāt, sūtramidaṃ nārabheta| pūrvasūtra eva ca gatyarthagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt||yadi samīpasya bhāvo'bhidhīyeta taddhi syāt, evaṃ sati vartamānasya sāmīpyena ca samāso na syāt; sambandhābhāvāt| na hi sāmīpyasya vartamānena sambandhaḥ, api tu tatsamīpena; tasya tadguṇatvāt| tasmāt svārtha evāyamiha bhaviṣyatīti matvāha''ha - samīpameva sāmīpyam` iti| kimarthaṃ punaḥ svārthikaṃ ṣyañaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate, na vartamānasamīpa evocyeta yato lāghavaṃ bhavati? ityata āha - `vartamānasāmīpye vartamāne` ityucyamāne vartamānakālavihitāḥ pratyayā vartamānasāmīpye bhavantītyeṣo'rtho labhyata evatyata āha - `vatkaraṇam` ityādi| asati vatkaraṇe vartamānakālena rūpamātrameṣāṃ viparyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `viśeṣaṇamityādi| viśeṣaṇaṃ hi parārthatvādguṇo'pradhānamityarthaḥ| tena ca pradhānakālasya viśeṣyasyopakāraḥ kartavyaḥ| na ca tat pradhānamaparityajya svakālaṃ pradhānakālamapratipadyamānaṃ pradhānopakārakriyāṃ karttuṃ samartha bhavatīti pradhānasya yaḥ kālastamurudhyate| viśeṣyaṃ tūpakāryatvātpradhānam|na ca pradhānasya guṇakālāpattiryuktā, anyathā yadiguṇakālaṃ pradhānakālaḥ pratipadyeta tadā tasya pradhānatvaṃ hīyeta| tena na bhavati viparyayaḥ|atha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pratyaya ityanuvartata ityata āha - `pratyayādhikāre`ityādi| hi yadi pūrvakaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tadā `bhuṅkṣva bhuṅkṣvetyevāhaṃ bhuñjai`iti <<āḍuttamasya picca>> [[3.4.92]] iti, pittvānṅittvaṃ nāsti, tataśca `śnaṣorallopaḥ` [[6.4.111]] ityākāralopo na syāt| tadhvamāvevasthāninau kasmānna vijñāyete? aśakyaṃ hi tau sthānitvena vijñātum| tayorapi sthānitve'loḍādeśayorapi hisvau syātām| atha tadhvamau viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ - loṭo yau tadhvamāviti, tato'yamadoṣa iti loṭaḥ sthāne bhavataḥ| tena parasmaipadatvanamātmanepadatvañca bhedena viṣayavibhāgena vyavatiṣṭhate| tatra hiśabde parasmaipadatvaṃ vyatiṣṭhate; loṭsambandhino heḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñakatvāt| svaśabde ca` [[6.3.63]] iti dīrghatvaṃ syādeva| ṇamuli sati sarvavidhayapavādastu vijñāyeta, tena dīrghatvamapi na bhavati| avaśyañcottarārthaṃ ṇamul vidheyaḥ, na ca tasminnuttaratra vidhīyamāne lāghavaṃ `bhujipratyayena` ityādi| yadyapi ṇamulā'nabhihitaḥ kartā, tathāpi bhujipratyayena laṭābhihita iti na bhavitavyaṃ tṛtīyayā| nanu ca śaktilakṣaṇaḥ kartā, anyā ca svādukaraṇaviṣayā śaktiḥ, anyā ca bhujikriyāviṣayā, tatra laṭābhihitāyāmapi bhujikriyāviṣāyāyāṃ śaktāvitarasyāḥ śakteḥ karttṛsaṃjñāyā anabhidhānāt {prāpnotītyeva-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} prāpnotyeva tṛtīyetyāha - `na cāsmin` ityādi| atra hi karotiḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ prayujyamāna evānarthako bhavati? anyathādayaete prakāravacanāḥ, te yadānuprayogadhātorarthas prakāramācakṣate tadā kṛñapi tairviśeṣyamāṇastadīyaprakāramācaṣṭe, gacānyata ityubhayamapyetacchabdarūpapadārthakasyānukaraṇam| yadi ca śabdapadārthakasya yadanukaraṇaṃ tasyāpi prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt, tadā tyadādyatvādike prakṛtikārye kṛte - etasya, amuṣyeti rūpaṃ syāt| [[5.3.42]] | `dvaidhaṃ kṛtvā` iti| `dvitryosca dhamuñ` [[5.3.45]] iti dhamuñ| `dvedhākṛtya` iti| `edhācca` [[5.3.46]] ityedhāc|`hiruk kṛtvā, pṛthak kṛtvā` iti| asati pratyayagrahaṇe pratyayagrahaṇaṃ samāsaikadeśatvādyatnānuvṛttaṃ syāt| `nānā kṛtvā kāṣṭhāni gataḥ` iti| cvyartho'tra nāsti; prakṛtyanyāvasthāyā avivakṣitatvāt| `dhārthamarthagrahaṇam` iti| dhāpratyayo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathoktaḥ| dhārthā hi pratyayā bahavaḥ,tatrasatyarthagrahaṇe dhāpratyayasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, nānyeṣāṃ tadarthānām| athagrahaṇe tu sati teṣāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| atha nārthamapyarthagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `nā punareka eva` iti| arthagrahaṇaṃ hi tatra kriyate yatra bahavo grāhrāḥ sambhavanti, nāpratyayastveka eva,tasya cārthagrahaṇamantareṇa sidhyatīti na tadarthamarthagrahaṇam| nanu ca ghamuñādīnāmapi sthānivadbhāvādeva dhāgrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, atodhārthamapyarthagrahaṇamayuktam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; aghādeśo'pi dhārthapratyayo'sti, `ghamuñantāt sānubandhakaḥ| tatrāsatyarthagrahaṇe `niranubandhagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|53) iti nāpratyayasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na sānubandhakasya nāñaḥ| arthagrahaṇe tu sati tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati||nanu ca <> [[3.4.61]] ityato bhūgrahaṇamanuvartata eva, tat kimarthaṃ bhuva itīhocyate? ityāha - `bhūgrahaṇam` ityādi| pūrva hi bhūgrahaṇaṃ kṛñā sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ tumun yathā syādityevamartho'yamārambhaḥ| na hi śaknoti bhoktumityādau kriyārthopapadaṃ gamyate| kiṃ tarhi? arthāntaram, anyadeva| iha tāvat - `śaknoti bhoktum, utsahate bhoktum, jānāti bhoktum` iti prāvīṇyaṃ gamyate| `glāyati bhoktum` iti tadaśaktatā gamyate, `ghaṭayati bhoktum, arhati bhoktum` iti tadyogyatāmātram| `ārabhate bhoktum, prakramate bhoktum` iti bhujerevādyāvasthānakriyāntaram| `labhate bhoktum` iti pratyākhyānam| `asti bhoktum` ityādau sambhavamātram||`paryāptiranyūnatā` iti| paripūrṇatetyarthaḥ| `alamarthaviśiṣṭeṣu` iti| yadyapi bhūṣaṇādayo'lamarthāḥ, tathāpi paryāptivacane sāmarthyemeva sambhavatīti tadeva gṛhrate| prayogadarśanārthabodhena vyākhyānato vā| tenālamarthaviśiṣṭeṣvityayamartho bhavati| yadyevam, sāmarthyeṣvityevaṃ kasmānnaktam? naivaṃ śakyam ; evaṃ hrucyamāne sāmarthyena bhuṅkte, balena bhuṅkta ityādāvapi syāt| yathānyāse tu na doṣaḥ; na hyatra paryāptirdṛśyate| kiṃ tarhi? saukaryam| sukarametadityarthaḥ| yathāvidhyasya sambhavamātraṃ vivakṣitam, sambhavatyevaṃvidhasya karaṇamityarthaḥ||kimarthamidam? kartari tṛjādayo yathā syuḥ| kva tarhi syuḥ? anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe (pu|pa|pā|90)| nanu ca svārthe yatra pratyayamicchati tatra bhāvagrahaṇaṃ karoti, yathā - ghañādividhau bhāva iti, na caite ghañādayaḥ svārthe bhavanti, kiṃ tarhi? tasya dharme siddhatākhye; tathā lakārādividhau <> [[3.4.69]] ityatra sūtre lakārā api naiva svārthe vidhīyante, kiṃ tarhi? tasya dharme sādhyatākhye? yadyapi ghañādīnāṃ lakārāṇāñca bhāve vidhānam, tathāpi śabdaśaktistvābhāvyādeṣa viṣayavibhāgo labhyate| ghañādīnāṃ hi dhātvarthasya siddhatāmevābhidhātuṃ sāmarthyam, lakārāṇāṃ sādhyatāmeva| tadevaṃ yadanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti, tasmāt tṛjādayo'pi tatraiva bhaveyuḥ, ataḥ kartaryeva te yathā syurityevamarthamidamārabhyate|atra ca dvedham - kṛdutpattivākyānāmayaṃ śeṣo vā syāt - ṇvultṛcau kartari, nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ kartarīti? arthādeśo vā? nirapekṣaiḥ svaiḥ svairvidhāyakaivarvākyairvihitānāṃ kṛtāṃ paścādanenārtha ādiśyeta - ye na lakṣaṇāntaraiḥ kṛto vihitāste kartari vācye bhavantīti| tatra yadi dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta tato yathā tṛjādīnāmanenartha ākhyāyate, tathā khyunnādīnāmapi; viśeṣānupādānāt, tataste'pi kartari syuḥ| sveṣu vidhivākyeṣu karaṇādīnāmupādānāt kaṇādiṣvapi| yadyapyekasya pratyayasya kartari karaṇe ca yagupadvṛttirna sambhavati, tathāpi vacanasāmarthyāt paryāyeṇa kartari karaṇe ca syuriti| tasmādduṣṭo'yaṃ pakṣa iti prathamaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha - `kṛdutpattivākyānām` ityādi| anena teṣāmasya caikavākyatāmāha| yadyevam, khyunnādivākyeṣvapyanenopasthātavyam - teṣāmapyayaṃ śeṣa iti kṛtvā, tataścāsminnapi pakṣe dvitīye pakṣe bhāvī doṣaḥ syāt? ityata āha - `tatra yeṣu` ityādi| tatraiva he#utamāha - `arthākāṅkṣatvāt` iti| śeṣo hi teṣāṃ bhavati yānyaparisamāptatvādarthamākāṅkṣanti, nānyeṣām| ato yeṣu vākyeṣvartho na#ādiśyate teṣāmeva sākāṅkṣatvāt śeṣo'yaṃ yuktaḥ| tṛjādīnāmeva vidhāyakāni vākyānyarthānādaśādarthākāṅkṣāṇi| tathā hi - `ṇvultṛcau bhavataḥ` ityukte'rthaviśeṣākāṅkṣā bhavati - kvemau bhavata iti| tasmāt teṣāmevāyaṃ śeṣa iti teṣvevopatiṣṭhate| `na khyunnādivākyeṣu` iti| `upatiṣṭhate` iti| prakṛtenaiva sambandhaḥ| `sākṣāt` ityādi| anupasthāne kāraṇam| khyunnādivākyānyarthākāṅkṣāṇi na bhavanti, teṣu karaṇādīnāmarthānāṃ sākṣānnirdeśāt| tasyānna teṣāmayaṃ śeṣa iti na tataśca kartaryeva lakāraḥ syāt, ṣaṣṭhaāmevāsyāmanantaryalakṣaṇā vijñāyeta| tathā ca lakārasya yo'nantarastasyaivārthanirdeśaḥ syāt, tataśca sa eva doṣo yaḥ pañcamyām| atrāpyādeśāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate?evamapi lakārādeśānāmanenāmartho nirdiśyata ityayameva viṣayārtho na nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt| nanu ca lakārasya prayoga eva nāsti, tatkathaṃ tasyaiva karmādayo'rthāḥ? sāmarthyāt tadādeśānāmete'rthā vijñāsyanta ityadoṣaḥ| `sakarmakebhyo bhāve na bhavanti` iti| akarmakebhya iti vacanāt; anyathā hi tadanarthakaṃ syāt||`tayoreva bhāvakarmaṇoḥ` iti| etena `tayoḥ` ityanena `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ` ityasya pratyavamarśa iti darśayati| nanu cānantarasūtre dve vākye - `laḥ karmaṇi bhavanti kartari ca` ityekaṃ vākyam, `bhāve cākarmakebhyo'pi bhavanti kartari ca` iti dvitīyam, tatrānantaravākyaśrutayoḥ karttṛbhāvayoreva tayorityanena pratyavamarśo yuktaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ| yadayamuttarasūtre `kartari ca` [[3.4.71]] iti karoti,tato'vasīyate - bhāvakarmaṇoreva pratyavamarśa iti yadi bhāvakatrroreva pratyavamarśaḥ syāt, karttṛgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; kartaryanenaiva siddhatvāt| evaṃ hi tatra vaktuṃ yuktaṃ syāt - karmaṇi ceti, karmaṇi kenacidaprāptaḥ syāt| yadā punariha bhāvakarmaṇoḥ pratyavamarśastadā yuktaṃ kartarigrahaṇam, kartaryaprāpte yathā syāt| yathāprāptaṃ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ| tasmādbhāvakarmaṇoreva pratyavamarśo yuktaḥ| `evakāraḥ` ityādinā evakārasya vyavacchedyaṃ apakarṣaṇārthaḥ = nivṛttyarthaḥ|`śayitam` iti| `niṣṭhā śīṅa` [[1.2.19]] ityādinā kittvapraratiṣedhādguṇaḥ|`īṣatkaraḥ,sukaraḥ` iti| `īṣaduḥsuṣu` [[3.3.126]] ityādinā khal| `īṣadāḍhaṃbhavam` iti| atrāpi `karttṛkarmaṇośca bhūkṛñoḥ [[3.3.127]] ||`ādikarmaṇi` iti| ādiścāsau karma ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `kriyākṣaṇaḥ` iti| etena karmaśabdokriyāṃ karmācaṣṭe, na sādhanaṃ karmeti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam - `kriyāṃ karmācaṣṭa iti? ādiśabdena viśeṣaṇāt| bahunāṃ kriyākṣaṇanāmādimadhyāntabhāve satyanādibhūtakriyākṣamavyavacchedādādibhūto yaḥ kriyākṣaṇastadādikarmeti yuktaṃ pratipādayitum| ādigrahaṇena sādhanaṃ karma tvekamevetyādiśabdena viśeṣayituṃ na śakyate; āderanādibhūtatvāpekṣatvādādiśabdasya tatrāpravṛttiḥ, vyavacchedyābhāvāt| ādikarmaṇi ca `bhūte` [[3.2.84]] ityanuvartamāne `niṣṭhā` [[3.2.102]] ityanenaiva vihita iti darśayatinnāha - `tasmin` ityādi| ādyo yaḥ kriyākṣaṇaḥ sa pariniṣpannatvādbhūto bhavatīti yuktā tasya bhūtatvena vivakṣitatā| `prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ` iti| kartari ktaḥ| tenaiva kartā'bhihita iti devadattaśabdāt tṛtīyā na bhavati| karmaṇastvanabhihitatvāt kaṭaśabdāddvitīyā bhavatyeva| `prakṛtaḥ kaṭo devadattena` iti| atra karmaṇi ktaḥ| tenaiva karṇaṇo'bhihitatvāddvitīyā na bhavati| kartaranabhihitatvāddevadattaśabdāt tṛtīyā bhavatyeva| `prakṛtaṃ devadattena` iti| bhāve ktapratyayaḥ| sarvatra praśabda ādikarma dyotayati| nanu cādibhūtakriyākṣamakāle kaṭo'nabhinirvṛtta eva bhavati, kaṭakāraṇabhūtā eva pīraṇādayastadānīṃ santi, na ca tadavasthaḥ kaṭaḥ tadavasthaḥ kaṭaḥ, tatkathaṃ prakṛtaḥ kaṭa iti bhūtakālena prakṛtaśabdena kaṭasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam? ādyena kriyākṣaṇena yo vīraṇādīnāṃ viśeṣa āhitastatra tādathryāt kaṭaśabdo vartate, sa ca bhūta evetyadoṣaḥ||`upasthitaḥ` iti| `dyatisyatimāsthāmiti kiti` [[7.4.40]] ittītvam| `anūṣitaḥ` iti| vacyādinā (6.1.15 samprasāraṇam, `vasatikṣughoḥ` [[7.2.52]] itīṭ, `śāsivasighasīnāñca` iti ṣatvam| `anujātaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.42]] ityāttvam| `ārūḍhaḥ` iti| `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] , `jhaṣastathorddho'dhaḥ` [[8.2.40]] iti dhatvam, <<ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ>> [[8.4.41]] , <<ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ>> [[8.3.13]] , <<ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ>> [[6.3.111]] iti dīrghaḥ| `anujīrṇaḥ` iti| `jṛ vayohānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1494), `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttvam, `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghatvam, `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] ityādinā natvañca|nanu ca śliṣādīnāmakarmakatvādeva sidhyatīti tatkimarthameṣāṃ grahaṇamityāha - `śliṣādayaḥ` ityādi| `tadartham` iti| sakarmakārthamityarthaḥ||`goghnaḥ` iti| sa eva hanteḥ pacādyac| sampradāne'c nipātyate, upadhālopaśca| atha vā - ṭakpratyayo nipātyate, upadhālopaśca `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityādinaiva siddhaḥ, `ho hanteḥ` [[7.3.54]] ityādinā kutvam| yadi sampradāne `goghnaḥ` iti nipātyate, tataścāṇḍālāderapi tenābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti; yasmāt tasmai api ye hrāgatāya dātuṃ ghnanti te'pi sukṛta ityata āha - `nipātanasāmarthyāt` ityādi| yathaiva hyatra nipātanasāmarthyāt kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ labhyate tathā'rthaviśeṣo'pi| tasmādyadyapi `goghnaḥ` ityaviśeṣeṇa nipātyate, tathāpi viśiṣṭasyaiva| tena ṛtvigāderabhidhānam, nānyasya cāṇḍālādeḥ| yadā tarhi dātuṃ hanyate tadā tasya goghna ityabhidhāṃ na prāpnotītyata āha - `asatyapi` ityādi| yathā hrapacannapi yogyatayā pācaka ityucyate, tathā'satyapi gohanane goghna iti||`{uṇādipratyayāntā ete - kāśikā`} ūṇādipratyayā ete`| iti| uṇādayaḥ pratyayā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| ke punasta uṇādayaḥ pratyayāḥ? ityata āha - `śyādhūsūbhyo mak` ityādi| ādiśabdena maṅkvannādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yadi tarhruṇādipratyayā ete, evaṃ satyuṇādipratyayānāṃ rūḍhiśabdāt kriyākārakasambandhābhāvādapādāne vṛttirna sambhavatyeva? naiṣa doṣaḥ; rūḍhiśabdeṣvapi keṣāñcit kriyākārakasambandho'styeva, yathā - tailapāyikādiṣu| ato'deśyametat| `tābhyām` ityādi| nanu cāsatyasmin sūtre tābhyāmityeṣa nirdeśo nopapadyate; apādānasyāprakṛtatvāt, tatkutaḥ paryudāsasya prasaṅgaḥ? naiṣa doṣa-; arthakatvametat| asmin hrasati tatraivaṃ sūtraṃ kartavyam - tato'pādānāccānyatroṇādaya iti| tathā ca yadīdaṃ nocyeta,tadā syādeva paryudāsaḥ||atha kimarthaṃ tābhyāmityanena sampradānāpādānapratyavamarśaḥ kriyate, etāvadeva vaktavyam - avyatroṇādaya iti, prakṛtatvādeva hi tayostābhyāmanyatroṇādayo vijñāsyante? ata āha - `sampradānapratyavamarśārtham` ityādi| `anyathā hi` ityādi| yadi `tābhyām` ityanena tayoḥ pratyavamarśo na kriyate ityarthaḥ| `anantaratvāt` ityādi| `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) iti nyāyādapādānasyaiva paryudāsaḥ syāt, yadi tābhyāmiti nirdeśo na kriyeta| `kṛṣiḥ` iti| `ik kṛṣyādibhyaḥ` (vā|324) itīk| `tantuḥ` iti| `sitanigamimasisacyāvidhāñkruśibhyastun` (da|u|1|122) iti tun| `carma` iti| manin||nanu ca neyaṃ loke prasiddhiḥ - dhrauvyārthā akarmakāḥ, pratyavasānārthā abyavahārthā iti, tatkathamayamartho labhyate? ityata āha - `svanikāyaprasiddhiḥ` iti| svanikāyaḥ = vaiyākaraṇasaṅghaḥ, tatreyaṃ prasiddhiḥ| `karttṛbhāvādhikaraṇeṣu` iti| bhāvakarmaṇoḥ `tayoreva` [[3.4.70]] ityādinā| `idameṣām` iti| `adhikaraṇavācinām` [[2.3.68]] iti ṣaṣṭhī|`katham` ityādi| `bhuktā brāāhṛṇāḥ, pītā gāvaḥ` iti| kartari niṣṭhā, anyathā'nabhihitatvāt karttubrrāāhṛṇaśabdādgośabdacca kartari tṛtīyā syāt| na pratyavasānārthebhyaḥ kenacit kartari kto vihitaḥ, tatkathametau sūtrādanantaramidaṃ kasmānna paṭhate, ekaḥ evaṃ sati guṇo bhavati, dviḥ ktagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati| tadevaṃ vaktavyam - ādirmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca, tataḥ śliṣaśīṅasthāsavajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca, tato'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhya iti, evañca dviḥ ktagrahaṇaṃ gatyarthākarmakagrahaṇañca na kartavyaṃ bhavati? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; evaṃ hrucyamāne yathā dhrauvyārthebhyaḥ kartari kto bhavati, tathā pratyavasānārthebhyo'pi syāt, sa ca neṣyate| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu||`akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ` iti| etenānubandhaśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| anubandhe hrasminnakārānubandhaviśiṣṭayoreva laṅalaṭogrrahaṇaṃ syāt, nānyeṣāṃ liḍādīnām| `arthaviśeṣe`iti| karttṛkarmādau`| `kālaviśeṣe` iti| vartamānādau| `akṣarasamāmnāyavat` iti| yathā'kṣarasamāmnāye pratyāhāre'kārādayo varṇā ānupūrvyā kathyante, tadvadityarthaḥ|`atha lakāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati` iti| viśeṣānupādānāmiti bhāvaḥ| `cūḍālaḥ` iti| <> [[5.2.96]] iti lac| `dhātvadhikāraḥ` iti| `dhātoḥ` [[3.1.91]] iti pañcamyantamanuvartate, tena ca lakāro viśiṣyate - dhātorvihitas lasyeti| <> [[3.4.69]] ityādau prakāraṇe ye'rthāḥ karttṛkarmabhāvā nirdiṣṭāsta ihānuvartante, taiśca lakāro viśiṣyate - katrrādiṣu vihitasya lasyeti| tena visiṣṭasyaiva lakārasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati, na sarvasyeti bhāvaḥ||`pakāraḥ svarārthaḥ` iti| `anudāttau suptitau` [[3.1.4]] ityanudātto yathā syāt| `iṭaṣṭakāraḥ` ityādi| nanu cāsatyapyetasmin viśeṣaṇārthe naivaṃ kiñcidaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti, `iṭo't` [[3.4.106]] ityatra sūtre liṅādeśasyeṭo'dvidhānāt, tato'nyasya liṅgādeśasyekārasyāsambhavāt| tivādyavayavo'stīti cet? na; tasyālādeśatvāt| tibādayo hi samudāyā lādeśāḥ, na ca tadavayavā ikārādayaḥ| arthavadgrahaṇe (vyā|pa|1) paribhāṣayārthavadikārasya grahaṇe sati kṛtastabādyavayavasya prasaṅgaḥ ! na hi te'rthavantaḥ; tibādīnāmeva samudāyānāmarthavatvāt| tasmānna kartavya eva ṭakāraḥ? satyaṃ na kartavyaṃ, ya evaṃ pratipattuṃ samarthastaṃ prati; yastvasamarthastaṃ prati kartavya eva| atha <<ādyantau ṭakitau>> [[1.1.46]] iti viśiṣṭadeśa āgamabhūtasyāsya vidhānaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṣṭakāraḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? ityāha - `tibādibhiḥ` ityādi| tulyatvam = sadṛśatvam, tatupanarekayoganirdiṣṭatvena| tasmin sati lasya [[3.4.77]] ityanayā ṣaṣṭhaā sarveṣaṃ tibādīnāṃ sambandho bhavati| dvitīye tviṭa eva| tatra yasminpakṣa āśrīyamāṇe sarveṣāmanugraho bhavati sa evāśrayituṃ yukta iti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyamaṅgīkartavyā| iṭo'pyādeśatvaṃ tena bhavatīti na bhavati deśavanidhyarthaṣṭakāraḥ| atha vā - tibādibhirekayoganirdiṣṭatvena yat tibādibhistulyatvaṃ tat sāhacaryopalakṣamam| tibādibhistulyatvāt tatsāhacaryādityarthaḥ| sāhacaryeṇa sandigdhārthaniścayo bhavati, yathā - savatsā dhenuriti| tathehāpi sandeho jāyate - kimayamādeśaḥ? utāgamaḥ? iti, tathāpi tibādibhirasandigdhādeśabhāvaiḥ sāhacaryādādeśo'yamiti niścīyate| tena deśavidhyarthatā ṭakārasya na bhavati| yadyevam, `phalipāṭinamimanijanāṃ guk paṭinākidhataśca` (da|u|1|103) ityatrāpi paṭaādibhirādeśaistulyatvādgugāgamo'pyādeśaḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; <> [[8.2.11]] iti tatrānuvartate,na cādeśena saṃjñā gamyate, kintvāgamena| tasmādguka āgamatvaṃ veditavyam| tatraikāpi ṣaṣṭhī yadā'deśana sambadhyate tadā sthānaṣaṣṭhī bhavati, yadā tvāgamena tadāvayavaṣaṣṭhī| `mahiṅo ṅakāraḥ` ityādi| atha ṅitvārtho ṅakāraḥ kasmānna bhavati? tasya <> [[1.2.4]] ityanenaiva siddhatvāt||7ra9| ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere| [[3.4.79]] `iha kasmānna bhavati` ityādi| śānajapi ṭito lakārasya sambandhyātmanepadasaṃjñakaśca, tasmāt tasyāpi ṭeretvena bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| `prakṛtaiḥ` ityādi| prakṛtānāṃ tibādīnāṃ madhye `yānyātmanepadāni` - ityevamihātmanepadāni viśiṣyante, tena na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| na hi śānac tibādiṣu sanniviṣṭaḥ| lāghavārthaṃ `ṭitastaṅām` iti vācye `ātmanepadānām` iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham| nanu ca `taṅām` ityucyamāne tasastakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt? arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|1) na bhaviṣyati| yastarhi thasya sthāna ādiśyate tena syāt? na; tibādiṣu sanniviṣṭā ye teṣāṃ tiṅāṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāsyate| pratyāsattervā ātmapadīyena taśabdena pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ vijñāsyate| vyāptestvanāśrayaḥ; lakṣyasthityanurodhāt||`peciṣe` iti|liṭ, `ata ekahalmadhve'nādeśāderliṭi` [[6.4.120]] ityetvābhyāsapopau| `paktāse` iti| luṭ, tāsiḥ, <> [[7.4.50]] iti sakāralopaḥ| `pakṣyase` iti| lṛṭ, <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam - kakāraḥ| atha thakāramātrasyaiva sakārādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati - thaḥ sa iti, thakārasya sakāre kṛte parasya bhāgasya ṭeretve satyabhīṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva? naitacchakyamca evaṃ hrārthāśabdasya yasthakārastasyāpi syāt| dhātvadhikārāddhātoryo vihita iti viśeṣaṇānna bhavatīti cet? na; asambhavāt| na hi tathāvidhastakāro dhātorvihitaḥ sambhavati| atha dhātoranantarasyaiti viśiṣyeta? evamapyanāditva eva parasya syāt, netarebhyo vikaraṇebhyaḥ; vyavadhānāditi yathānyāsamevāstu| ṭerettvenaiva siddha ekārāntatve yadekārāntatvāmādeśasya kriyate, tat `tiṅāmādeśānāṃ ṭeretvaṃ na bhavati` iti jñāpanārtham| tena ḍāraurasprabhṛtiṣu ṭeretvaṃ na bhavatīti - paktā, paktārau, paktāra iti||`śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ` iti| asati tasmin dhātvadhikārāt <> [[1.1.67]] ityādeḥ parasya takārasya prasajyeta| śakāre tu sati <> [[1.1.55]] iti vacanāt sarvasya bhavati| atha `śe` iti kasmānnoktam? naivaṃ śakyam; `śe` iti hi pragṛhrasaṃjñā syāt| iha ca vyatipapa iti pibādeśaḥ syāt| eśi tu sati na bhavati, vakṣyati hretat - `varṇe yat syāt tacca vidyāt tadādau` iti||`papaktha` iti| <<upadeśe'tvataḥ>> [[7.2.62]] itīḍabhāvaḥ| `pecitha` iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, tatra hi <<ṛto bhāradvājasya>> [[7.2.63]] iti niyamādiṭ| <> [[6.4.121]] ityevatvābhyāsalopau| `peca` iti| `dhātoḥ` [[3.1.91]] ityadhikārāt <> [[1.1.67]] , <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti thakārasyākārādeśaḥ| dvayorākārayoḥ <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam| atha vā - āntaratamyādbahvarthasyākārasya bahvartha eva sthānī yukta iti samudāyasyaiva bhavati| `peciva, pecima` iti| krādiniyamādiṭ||`vida jñāne` iti| etena jñānārthasya videgrrahaṇam, nānyeṣāmiti| evaṃ manyate - vida iti pañcamī, tena <> [[1.1.67]] ityanantarāṇāṃ tibādīnāmādeśena bhavitavyam| na cānyasmādvideḥ parasmaipadānyanantarāṇi sambhavati; vikaraṇaivryavadhānāt| vicārasattārthayoścātmanepaditvāt parasmaipadānupapattiḥ| tasmāt jñānārthasyaiva grahaṇamiti||`pañcaiva` ityādi| nanu ca neha dvitīyaṃ pañcagrahaṇaṃ, nāpyadigrahaṇamādeśaviśeṣamam, tatra pañcānāmādyānāṃ sthāne sarvaireva ṇalādibhiḥ paryāyeṇa bhavitavyam, tat kathaṃ pañcaiva ṇalādaya ādeśā bhavantītyeṣo'rtho labhyate? ityata āha - `sthānisambandhāt ` ityādi| iha hi sthāninaḥ pañcaivā'dyā nirdiṣṭāḥ, teṣāñca <<sthāne'ntaratamaḥ>> [[1.1.50]] iti paribhāṣayā pañcirevādyaiḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati, netaraiśca| tathā hi - pañcānāmevādyānāmāntaratamyamasti, tulyārthatvāt| nānyeṣām, viparyayāt| tasmāt sthānisambandhādādeśeṣvapi pañcatvamāditvañca vijñāyata iti yuktam - pañcaiva ṇalādaya ādeśā bhavantīti| `āttha` iti| `āhasthaḥ` [[8.2.35]] iti hakārasya thakāraḥ, tasya
