darśayati| `bhuvo vug luṅaliṭoḥ` [[6.4.88]] iti vuk| nanu ca naiveha pūrvasūtreṇa prāpnoti, na hīha sijapekṣayānantaryaṃ jhervidyate, tat kiṃ pratiṣidhyata ityāha - `pratyayalakṣaṇena` ityādi| lupte hi pratyayalakṣaṇenānantaryamasti, ataḥ pūrveṇa prāpnoti| jus niyamena pratiṣidhyate| yadi tarhi niyamārthamidam, `akārṣuḥ` ityatrāpi na syāt, na hyatrātaḥ sijlugantātparo jhirbhavatīti? ityata āha - `tulyajātīya` ityādi| ātaḥ sijlugantānniyamārthamayaṃ jus vidhīyate| sa ca niyamastulyajātīyāpekṣaḥ, tena samānajātīyameva vyavacchinatti| kaśca samānajātīyaḥ? anyaḥ {sijalugantaḥ iti mu|pāṭhaḥ|} sijlugantaḥ| na cākārṣurityatra jheḥ pūrvaḥ sijlugantaḥ iti nāyaṃ niyamasya viṣayaḥ, tena bhavatyeva jus||`ayuḥ, avuḥ` iti| pūrvavacchapo luk, pūrvavacca pararūpatvam|`laṅeva` ityādi| yatsambandhino jherjusbhāvo vidheyaḥ| tiṅatvamadhikṛtyemuktam| kutaḥ etat? laṅaliṅorapyākārāntādanantarayoḥ sambhavāt| tatsambandhinostu <> [[3.4.108]] ityevamādinaiva śāstreṇa jusbhāvo vihita iti na tāvadadhikṛtyedamucyate| evakārastu lṛṅavyavacchedārthaḥ, syapratyayena jhevryavadhānāt| sa cātideśadvāreṇa yasya laṅavadbhāvo na bhavati sa veditavyaḥ| yasya hratideśadvāreṇa laṅavadbhāvo vihitaḥ sa upacāreṇa laṅityucyate| paramārthatastu loḍevāsau, na laṅeva| `laṅavadbhāvena yaḥ` iti| laṅiti sambadhyate|laṅā tulyaṃ mā bhūditi mukhyasyaiva laṅo grahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ laṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| kena punarlaṅavadbhāvo bhavatītyāha - `loṭo laṅvat` iti| anena hi sūtreṇa [[3.4.85]] loṭo laṅvat kāryaṣvatidiṣṭeṣu laṅkāryayogāt tasya laṅvadbhāvo bhavati| tena laṅasadṛśabhūta upacāreṇa laṅiti vyapadiśyate| atrāyamarthaḥ - yadi mukhyasya laṅaḥ parigrahārthaṃ laṅgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tataḥ `loṭo laṅvat` [[3.4.85]] ityatideśādyathā tāmādikāryaṃ loṭo bhavati, tathedamapi syāt| ato'sya doṣasya nivṛtyarthaṃ laṅagrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti mā bhūnnāmāyaṃ jus; loṭo laṅagrahaṇādyatnāt|| yastu `sijabhyastavida#ibhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] ityanena vidhīyate sa vibhyatu, jāgratu, vidantvityādau kasmānna bhavati, na hi kiñcit tatra yatnāntaramasti? ityāha - `sijabhyasta` ityādi| kathaṃ punarvinā yatnena pūrvako jus loṭo na bhavatītyāha - `jusbhāvamātraṃ hi` ityādi| na hrayameva jus mukhyena laṅā viśiṣyate,kiṃ tarhi? jusbhāvamātram| yo'smin prakaraṇe jus vihitaḥ sa mukhyasyaiva laṅo bhavati, netarasyeti| tena pūrvako'pi jus na bhavati| `ekakāra uttarārthaḥ` iti| atha tadarthaṃ evakāraḥ kasmān bhavati? vidhyarthatvāt tasya| na hi vidhyarthavākya evakārasyārthavatvamupapadyate| sa hi niyamārtheṣūpayujyate, na hi vidhyartheṣu| na cedaṃ niyamārtham; siddhe hi vidhirārabhyamāṇo niyamārtho bhavati (kā|du|pa|59), na ca siddhe'yamārabhyate| tasmāduttarārthaṃ evakāraḥ| nanu śākaṭāyanasyaiva matena yathā syādanyeṣāṃ mate mā bhūdityevamarthamihaivakāraḥ syāt? na; tena vinā'pyasya niyamasya siddhatvāt| yadyanyeṣāṃ mate na syāt, śākaṭāyanagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt||`adviṣu` iti| adāditvācchapo luk||`bhavati, nayati` iti| tiṅaḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyāṃ tannibandhanaḥ kartari śap, tasyāpi śitaḥ sārvadhātukatvāt `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ` 7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ| `roditi` iti| pūrvavacchapo lopaḥ, <> [[7.2.76]] itīṭ| `pavamānaḥ, yajamānaḥ` iti| <> [[3.2.128]] ,tasya sārvadhātukatvāt śap, tasyāpi sārvadhātukatvāddhātorguṇaḥ||`lavitā` iti| tṛc, `ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ` [[7.2.35]] itīṭ| `vṛkṣatvam` iti| <> [[5.1.119]] | `lūbhyām` iti| lunāteḥ kvibantādbhyām| `jugupsate` iti| gupādisūtreṇa [[3.1.5]] san| tvalādīnāmārdhadhātukatvābhāvādiḍabhāvaḥ| yaktaṃ `vṛkṣatvam` pratyudāharaṇam, tvapratyayasya dhātoravidhānāt, `lūbhyām` ityādyayuktam, `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati` (vyā|pa|132) iti nyāyāt, myāmpratyayo dhātoreva vihitaḥ, sanpratyayo'pi dhātoḥ, gupāderdhātutvāt? naitadasti;asyaiva hi doṣasya parīhārāya dhātuśabdena yo vihita ityuktam| tasya cāyamarthaḥ - dhātorityevaṃ yo vihitaḥ,dhātuśabdamuccārya yo vihita iti yāvat| yasya vidhāyakalakṣaṇe dhātugrahaṇamasti,na caivaṃ bhmāṃsanau vihitau; tdavidhau dhātvadhikārasya dhātugrahaṇasya cāsambhavāt| kathaṃ punardhātusaṃśabdanena yo vihita ityeṣo'rtho labhyate, yāvatā dhātorityekameva dhātugrahaṇamanuvartate, taccādhātupratyayanivṛttau caritārthatvānnāparaṃ kiñcidviśiṣṭamabhidhātumutsahate? evaṃ manyate - yaṅavidhānasūtrāt [[3.1.22]] `śamidhāto saṃjñāyām` [[3.2.14]] ityato vā dvitīyadātugrahaṇamanuvartate, tatraikena dhātunā adhātupratyayo nivartatate, apareṇa dhātupratyayo viśiṣyate - dhātorityevaṃ yo vihita iti| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kim? tiṅaśitormā bhūt, anyathā hrekasaṃjñādhikārābhāvāt pratyayādisaṃjñānāmiva samāveśaḥ syāt||`śekitha` iti| ārdhadhātukatvālliṭaḥ <<ṛto bhāradvājasya>> [[7.2.63]] itīṭ| tatra ṛta eva bhāradvājasya nānyeṣāṃ dhātūnāmityeṣo'rtho'bhimataḥ| <> [[6.4.121]] ityetvābhyāsalopau| `jagle, mamle` iti| ārdhadhātukatvāt <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ|`nanu ca ` ityādinā yaduktaṃ `sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyā apavādaḥ` (kā|3.4.115) iti tadvighaṭayati| ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra samāveśo bhavati, yathā - tyayādisaṃjñānām| na cātraikasaṃjñādhikāro'sti,tadayuktamasyāḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyā apavādatvamityabhiprāyaḥ|`satyametatityādinā apavādatvameva samarthayate||`{laviṣīṣṭhā` iti mu|pāṭhaḥ} laviṣīṣṭa` iti| thās , <> [[3.4.107]] iti suṭ, ṣaṣvam, ṣṭatvañca||`{astaye iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} svastaye` iti| `asa bhuvi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1065), striyāṃ ktin| sārvadhātukatvādasterbhūbhāvo na bhavati|`viśṛṇvire` iti| atra liṭaḥ sārvadhātukatvāt <<śruvaḥ śṛ ca>> [[3.1.74]] iti śnupratyayaḥ, śṛbhāvaśca| `sunvire` iti| <> [[3.1.73]] | `upastheyāma`iti| tiṣṭhaterliṅa,yāsuṭ,mas, <> [[7.4.24]] ityetvam|nanu <> [[3.1.85]] ityanenaiva siddhaṃ sarvamevedam, kimartho'yamārambha ityāha - `vyatyayo bahulamityasyaiva` iti| gatārtham||iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃtṛtīyasyādhyāyasyacaturthaḥ pādaḥ|samāptaśca tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ||`adhikāro'yam` iti| svaritenāsañjitatvāt| `ā pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ` iti| anenādhikārasyāvadhiṃ darśayati| tataḥ paraṃ nāyamanuvartate; asvaritatvāt| `svādiṣu kapparyanteṣu` iti| adhikārasya viṣamācaṣṭe| `ṅī iti ṅīpṅīṣṅīnāṃ sāmānyena grahaṇam` ityādi| `ṅī` iti viśeṣakarānanubandhānutsṛjya yat sāmānyaṃ ṅīmātraṃ tadiha gṛhrate| `ṭābḍāpcāpāmāp` iti| sāmānyena grahaṇamiti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| nanu ca ṅyādīnāṃ bahutvādbahuvacanena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ `ṅyāpprātipadikāt` [[4.1.1]] ityekavacanena nirdeśa ityāha -`teṣām` ityādi| samāhāradvandeneha ṅyādīnāmayaṃ nirdeśaḥ kṛta ityarthaḥ| itaretarayoge hi dvandve syādbahuvacanam| na cāyamitaretarayoge dvandvaḥ,kiṃ tarhi? samāhāre| tasya caikārthatvādekavacanameva yuktam| `samāhāranirdeśaḥ` iti vacanamitaretarayoganivṛttyartham,sāmāsantaranivṛttyarthañca, anyathā hi ṅyāpoḥ prāptipadikaṃ ṅyāpprātipadikamityapi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa āśaṅkyeta| tato ṅyantamābantañca samāsaprātipadikaṃ yat tataḥ syād rājakumāryādibhyaḥ na tu kevalebhyaḥ kumāryādibhyaḥ| ṅyāpostu vidhānenaiva prātipadikaṃ prakṛtiḥ syāt| tasmāt samāhāra dvandvenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ| tatra tu trayaṃ prakṛtitvenādhikriyate, tena sarvato bhavati|atha kathaṃ punaratra vigrahaḥ? kecidāhuḥ - `ṅīśca āpca prātipadikañceti| nanu ca `apratyayaḥ` [[1.2.45]] iti prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedhād ṅīśceti vibhaktyutpattirna syāt? ucyate; nāyaṃ pratyayaḥ, api tu pratyayānukaraṇamidam| evamapi `prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati` (vyā|pa|113) iti syādeva pratiṣedhaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥca anukaraṇaṃ dvaidham - arthasya, śabdamātrasya ceti| jñāpitamācāryeṇaitad dvedhā nirdeśāt - <> [[1.3.18]] , <> [[1.3.19]] itīyaṅādeśasya karaṇākaraṇābhyām| ato'tra śabdamātramanukṛtam, na tvarthasahitam| tenātra `apratyayaḥ` [[1.2.45]] iti nāstyeva pratiṣedhaḥ| prakṛtivadatideśastvarthavatyanukaraṇe| nanu cevamapi halṅyādilopena [[6.1.68]] bhāvyam? ucyate; ṅyantāt sulopaḥ, na ṅīmātrāt| vyapadeśivadbhāvāt syāditi cet? na; `vyapadeśavadbhāvo'prātipadikena` (śāka|pa|65) ityucyate, prātipadikañcadam| tasmāt `ṅīśca` iti| atha pratyayavidhiviṣayaiṣā paribhāṣā pūrvādiniḥ` [[5.2.85]] <> [[5.2.87]] ityatra jñāpitatvāt? na cāyaṃ pratyayavidhiḥ, kastarhi? lopavidhiriti, ataḥ paribhāṣā na pravartata ityastyeva vyapada#eśivadbhāva iti tataḥ pravartate lopaśāstram| ataḥ sulopena bhavitavyam - ṅī ceti| sāmānyena paribhāṣāpravṛttimāśritya ṅīśceti vigrahaḥ|anyastvāha - `prayogasya eva kumārī, gaurītyādiṣu ya īkāraḥ so'trānukṛta eva luptavibhaktikaḥ,tena ṅī ityeva bhavati| yadyevam, kuto ṅakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārtha āsajyate? nanu cānukriyamāṇenārthenārthavattvāt punarapi vibhaktyutpattiḥ prāpnoti, tataśca ṅīśceti bhavitavyam? naitadasti; prākkālabhāvinī yā vibhaktistāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇenāśrityāpratyaya [[1.2.45]] iti pratiṣedhāt| athāpi syāt - <> [[8.2.8]] iti jñāpakāt pratyayalakṣaṇenāpratyaya [[1.2.45]] iti prātipadikasaṃjñā na pratiṣidhyate` iti| asadetat; nalopavidhiviṣayamevaitajjñāpakam| ato'tra nāstyeva pratyayalakṣaṇena prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedha iti sthitametat|nanu ca pratyayatve sati `paraśca` [[3.1.2]] iti vacanāt pare bhavantaḥ svādayaḥ pūrvāṃ prakṛtimākṣipya bhavanti, na hranyathā paratvamupapadyate, tasya paratvasya pūrvāpekṣatvāt, na ca ṅyādibhyo'nyā prakṛtirupapadyate| tatra ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇamantareṇāpi pāriśeṣyādiyameva prakṛtirlabhyate tathā hi, prakṛtyantaraṃ dhāturiti - tiṅantañca, vākyañca| pratyayā api svādayaḥ, ṭābādayaḥ aṇādayaśca| tatra dhātostāvat svādibhirna bhavitavyam, te hrekatvādiṣvartheṣu vidhīyamānāstadvantaṃ śabdamākṣipanti| na ca dhāturekatvādimān| athāpyaviśeṣaṇotpadyante, utpannānāṃ tu niyamaḥ kriyate? tathāpi na #aiva teṣāṃ dhātorutpattiryuktā; sāmānyavihitānāṃ svādīnāṃ viśeṣavihitaistavyadādibhirbādhitatvāt| ṭābādayastarhi dhātorbhaveyuriti cet? syādetat| asati ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇe'kārāntebhyo dhātubhyo jugupsādibhyaḥ `ataḥ` [[4.1.4]] iti ṭāp syāt, apidbhyo vañcuprabhṛtibhyaḥ <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp syāt, nakārāntebhyo manprabhṛtibhyaḥ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīppratyayaḥ iti? etacca nāsti ; yataḥ striyāṃ ṭābādayo vidhīyante, kriyāvacanaśca dhātu#ḥ| kriyāyāścāsattvabhūtatvālliṅgena yogo nāsti; tasya dravyadharmatvāt| etena tiṅantādvākyācca ṭābādīnāmutpattiḥ pratikṣiptā; tayorapi kriyāpradhānatvāt| aṇādīnāmapi naiva dhātorutpattirupapadyate| te hrapatyādinārthena sambandhe sati vidhīyante| dhātuvācyasyārthasyāsattvabhūtatvādyathā strītvena yogo na sambhavati, tathāpyapatyādinā hrarthena| etena tiṅantādvākyāccāṇādīnāmutpattirnirastā; tadarthasyāpi kriyāpradhānasyāpatyādinā sambandhābhāvāt| devadattasya pacati yastasyāpattyamiti satyapi sambandhe `tiṅaśca` [[5.3.56]] iti jñāpakānna bhavati| ye'patyādinārthena sambandhe taddhitā vidhīyante te'nantaroktayā nītyā mā bhūn, ye tu svārthe vidhīyante tairyuktameva bhavitumiti cet? vārtametat; yathaiva hi svādīnāṃ sāmānyavihitānāṃ viśeṣavihitaistavyadādibhirbādhitatvāt tadutpattirnopapadyate tathā svārthikānāmapi sāmānyavihitānāṃ svārthikaistumunnādibhirviśeṣavihitairbādhitatvānnopapadyata eva| tiṅantāt tarhi ke syuriti cet? jñāpakānna bhaviṣyanti| yadayaṃ kvacit taddhitavidhau tiṅgarhaṇaṃ karoti - <> [[5.3.55]] `tiṅaśca` [[5.3.56]] iti, kvacit taddhitavidhau tiṅgrahaṇaṃ karoti - <> [[5.3.55]] `tiṅaśca` [[5.3.56]] iti, tajjñāpayati - tiṅantāt taddhitā na bhavantīti| vākyāt tarhi bhaveyariti cet? anabhidhānānna bhaviṣyanti| na hi `devadattasyāākaḥ` ityukte vākyārthagatā ajñātādayo'rthāḥ kapratyayena dyotyante, kiṃ tarhi? aāśabdagatā eva|svādibhirapi naiva tiṅantādbhavitavyam, teṣāṃ hrekatvādayo'rthāḥ,te ca tiṅabhirevoktāḥ| na coktarthānāṃ prayoge yuktaḥ; `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ` (vyā|pa|60) iti vacanā| nanu coktārthānāmapi prayogo dṛśyate, yathā - eko dvau bahava iti cet? yukto'tra prayogaḥ vacanagrahaṇāt| `prātipadika` ityādau hi sūtre vacanagrahaṇasyaitat teṣāṃ bhavati; tatrāsyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasthānāt| tena liṅgaviśiṣṭānāmapi sarvādīnāṃ sarvanāmakāryamupapadyate| yadyevam, imameva nyāyamāśritya śakyaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇamakarttum? naitadasti; na hi prātipadikasaṃjñā liṅgaviśiṣṭasyārthavataḥ śabdarūpasya bhavitumarhati; `aprtayaya` [[1.2.45]] iti pratiṣedhāt| na ca prātipadikasaṃjñāvidhau sarve'rthavantaḥ saṃjñinaḥ svarūpeṇa śakyā darśayitum; teṣāmānantyāt| yadyevam, `ṇāviṣṭhavat prātipadikasya` (vā|813) ityatrāpi tarhīyaṃ paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate; svarūpāgrahaṇāt, tataśca liṅgavśīṣṭeṣvaṣṭhavadbhāvo na syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ? kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārīyatītyatra ṭilopo na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bahulamiṣṭhavadbhāva iṣyate, tathā ca curādau paṭhate `prātipadikād dhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca` (curā|ga|sū|186) iti| tasmādbahulavacanālliṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpīṣṭhavadbhāvo bhaviṣyati|`kiñca` ityādanā prayojanāntaraṃ samuccinoti| taditi ṅyāpoḥ pratyavarśaḥ| ṅyantādābantācca taddhitavidhānaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ca ṅyābgrahaṇam| `kālitarā` iti| kālaśabdājjanapadādisūtreṇa [[4.1.42]] ṅīp, tadantāt `dvivacanavibhajyopapade` [[5.3.57]] ityādinā tarap, <<gharūpakalpacelaḍbruvagotramatahateṣu ṅyo'nekāco hrasvaḥ>> [[6.3.43]] ityādinā hrasvaḥ| `hariṇitarā` iti| haritaśabdāt `varṇādanudāttāt topadhāto naḥ` [[4.1.39]] iti ṅīp, takārasya nakāraḥ, `aṭkupvāṅ` [[8.4.2]] ityasati ṅyābgrahaṇe paratvādātiśayikaḥ syāt| asmastu sati ṅyāpostaddhitavidhāne prakṛtitvenāśrayaṇāt pūrvaṃ ṅyābbhyāṃ bhavitavyamiti tadantāt taddhitavidhiḥ sidhyati| nanu cāntaraṅgaḥ strīpratyayaḥ, bahiraṅgāstaditāḥ, tathā hi - <> [[4.1.82]] ityadhikārādvibhaktyantāte utpadyante, vibhaktayaśca karmādyapekṣāḥ, karmādayaśca bāhrakriyānimittatvādbahiraṅgāḥ tataśca nimittasya bahiraṅgatvāt taddhitā api bahiraṅgāśrayā eva bhavanti; liṅgasya tu sambandhyantarānapekṣatvādantaraṅgatvañca, atastannimittā api ṭābādayo'ntaraṅgā bhavanti, tataścāntaraṅgatvādeva ṭābādibhistāvadbhavitavyam, paścāt tadantāt taddhitairityapārthakaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇam? naitadasti; tadantāt taddhitavimadhānārthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇamityatra hi vākye taddhitagrahaṇena svārthikā ye taddhitāsta eva vivakṣitāḥ| imamevārthaṃ sūcayituṃ kālitarā, hariṇitareti strīpratyayāntāt svārthika eva tarappratyaya udāhṛtaḥ|svārthikeṣu ca `samarthānām` [[4.1.82]] ityetannānuvartate| tathā hi kṣyati brāāhṛṇatvādīnāmabhivyaktirbhavati| yathā ca teṣāṃ tathā ca kvacit strītvādīnām| kiṃ punaridaṃ strītvam? pratyayārthaḥ? uta prātipadikaviśeṣaṇam? ityāha - `strītvañca` ityādi| yadā strīśabdo vinā'pi bhāvapratyayena strītve vartate tadā striyāmabhidheyāyāṃ ṭābādayo bhavantīti strītvaṃ pratyayārtho bhavati| yathaiva hi gośabdo jātipadārthapakṣe bhāvapratyayarahito'pi gotve vartate tathā strīśabdo'pi strītve| yadā tu strītvaṃ viśeṣaṇamupādāya tadvati dravye strīśabdo'pi vartate tadāyaṃ pakṣo'pi bhavati - striyāṃ yat prātipadikaṃ vartate tasmāṭṭābādaya iti strītvaṃ prakṛterviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| `ubhayathā'pi yujyate` iti| kathaṃ punarubhayathā yujyate, yāvatā strītvasya pratyayārthatve strītvaṃ pradhānamāpadyata iti tatra vyatirekalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti, yathā -strītvaṃ devadattāyā iti, tataśca kumārī devadatteti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt? dvivacane bahuvacane ca kumāryau kumārya iti na syātām, ekatvāt strītvasya? anekaśca pratyayo nopapadyate gārgāyaṇī, iti| dadāteḥ pibateśca <<āto maninkvanibvanipaśca>> [[3.2.74]] iti manin, pūrvavat <> [[6.4.7]] dīrghaḥ| atha samīmā, sīmānau, sīmānaḥ; atimahimā, atimahimānau, atimahimāna ityatra kataṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, yāvatā mana ityarthavato mana etadgrahaṇam| na ca yathā dāmā pāmetyatarmanaḥ pratyayārthenārthavatvaṃ tathā sīmetyevamāda na kenacidarthenārthavattvam, tathā hi sīmāśabdastāvadavyutpannaṃ prātipadikam, tasyaiva cārthavattvam, na tadavayavabhūtasya manaḥ; atimahimetyatrāpi naiva mano'rthavattvam, tathā hi - `mahato bhāvaḥ` ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ <> [[5.1.122]] iti mahchabdādimanijvihitaḥ, tatra cemanica evārthavattvam, na tadekadeśasya mana ityata āha - `aninasmangrahaṇāni` ityādi| etadvākyaṃ paṭhatā vākyakāreṇa an, ins, man - ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇe'rthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣā (vyā|pa|1) na vyāpriyate| tenaiṣāmanarthakānāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, ebhiścānarthakaiḥ sārthakaiśca tadantavidirbhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati, tataśca sīmā'timahimetyādāvapi pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati||`anupadhālopo hranupadhālopino vā bahuvrīheḥ pakṣe ṅībvidhīyate? upadhālopino vā? tatra prathamastāvat pakṣo nopapadyate, yadi hyatrānupadhālopinaḥpakṣe ṅībvidhīyeta pratiṣedhavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; dvitīyo'pi nopapadyate, `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām` [[4.1.28]] iti pratipadaṃ vikalpena ṅīpo vidhāsyamānatvāt| na ca tadanyatarasyāṃgrahamaṃ na kariṣyāma itīhānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ karttuṃ yuktam; taddhyavaśyameva kartavyam, upadhālopino hi ṅīpā mukte ḍāppratiṣedhau yathā syātām - bahurājñyau, bahurājānau, bahurāje iti| itarathā hi ḍāppratiṣedhau suparvādiṣvanupadhālopiṣu sāvakāśau paratvānṅīpā bādhyeyātām| tasmādvakṣyamāṇamapyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kartavyameveti tatsarvaṃ manasi kṛtvā''ha - `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimartham` iti| nirarthakamiti bhāvaḥ| `bahuvrīhau`ityādi| <> [[4.1.7]] ityanena yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate tasyāpi bahuvrīhau vikalpo yathā syādityevamanarthakamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam| yadyatprāptaṃ tattadvikalpena pratyupasthāpayitavyam| ṅībrophāvaprāptau, <> [[4.1.12]] iti pratiṣedhāt| tasmāt tadvidhānārthamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| kathamanyatarasyāmiti? yogavibhāgo'tra kriyate, tatra bahuvrīhigrahaṇamanuvartate, <> [[4.1.7]] ityetacca maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena| tena vannantādbahuvrīheranyatarasyāṃ ṅībrophaścāntādeśo labhyata iti bahupīvā, bahudhīvā, bahupīvarī, bahudhīvarītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati| anye tvāhuḥ - ubhābhyāṃgrahamasahitādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇādvannantādbahuvrīherṅībrophau labhyete| `ubhābhyām` [[4.1.13]] itineyaṃ pañcamī, kaṃ tarhi? tṛtīyā, vannante bahuvrīhau strītvamubhābhyāṃ ṅībrophābhyāṃ karaṇābhyāṃ prayoktrā pratyāyayitavyamiti| nanu ca mannantāt prātipadikādannantācca bahuvrīherḍābubhābhyāmityadubhābhyāṃgrahaṇasya prayojanam? evaṃ manyate - svaritatvādeva `ubhābhyāma` [[4.1.13]] iti vacanamantareṇāpyubhābhyāmeva pratyayo labhyata eveti||`sarvatra` iti| strīprakaraṇe| nanu ca <> [[4.1.33]] <> [[4.1.65]] ityādau nānuvartate, tasyāta ityasyāsambhavādviśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyata ityāha - atastadantebhyo ṅībna syāt, tataścaka karaṇī, sāmagītyādi na sidhyet| `ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāt` iti| yadi teṣāmapi ṭidgrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na syāṭṭitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; prayojanāntarāsambhavāt| tasmāt satyapi dvyanubandhakatve ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāllyuḍādayo gṛhranta ityadoṣaḥ| laṭo'pi tarhi ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva grahaṇena bhavitavyamityata āha -`itaratra` iti| laṭi hi ṭitkaramasya <<ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere>> [[3.4.79]] iti ṭeretvaṃ phalam| ato yadyapi grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi naiva ṭitkaraṇasya vaiyathryaṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāllyuḍādayo gṛhranta ityadoṣaḥ| laṭo'pi tarhi ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva grahaṇena bhavitavyamityata āha -`itaratra` iti| laṭi hi ṭitkaraṇasya <<ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere>> [[3.4.79]] iti ṭeretvaṃ phalam| ato yadyapi tasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi naiva ṭitkaraṇasya vaiyathryaṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt ṭitkaraṇasya caritārthatvādayuktaṃ tasyedaṃ grahaṇam|`paṭhitā vidyā` iti| atrāpi kathamiti sambadhyate| iḍāgamasya hi pratyayabhaktatvāt pratyayasya ṭittvamasti, tatasca ṅīpā bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ paṭhitetyetadrūpaṃ bhavatīti?`āgamaṭittvamanimittam` iti| prakṛtatvāt ṅīpa iti vijñāyate| kathaṃ jñāyate'yamanimittamityāha -`ṭauṭaulau` grahaṇena na bhavitavyamityata āha - `niranubandhako ḍhaśabdaḥ` ityādi| nanu cāyaṃ niranubandhako'sti `śilāyāḥ ḍhaḥ` [[5.3.102]] iti? naitadasti; svabhāvata eva hrayaṃ napusaṃke vartate| ayaṃ tahrrasti svābhāvyāt - `{sabhāyā ḍhaśchandasi iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} sabhāyā yaḥ` [[4.4.104]] <<ḍhaśchandasi>> [[4.4.106]] iti? ayamapi naiva striyāṃ vartate, chandasi sabheyīśabdasya prayogādarśanāt| tasmānnaranubandhako ḍhaśabda striyāṃ nāstīti neha niranubandhakaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate; anyathā hi ḍhagrahamamanarthakaṃ syāt|`ṇe'pi` iti| aṇi yat kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ taṇṇe'pi kvaciditi kvacinna bhavatītyuktaṃ ṇe'pyaṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ na syāt nipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt| karmaśabdāt karma śīlamasyeti `chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ` [[4.4.62]] iti ṇe kṛte <> [[6.4.144]] ityevaṃ ṭilopasya siddhatvāt| `an` [[6.4.167]] iti prakṛtibhāvānna sidhyatīti cet? naitadasti; aṇi hi prakṛtibhāva ucyate, tatra <> [[6.4.164]] ityato'ṇītyanuvartate| tadevaṃ `tācchīlike ṇe'pyaṇi kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati` ityasyārthasya jñāpitatvāt tatraivāṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati, nānyatra| ` caurī, tāpasī` iti| curā śīlamasyāstapaḥ śīlamasyā iti `chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ` [[4.4.62]] ṇe'pyaṇkṛtaṃ bhavatīti ṅīp| `dāṇḍā mauṣṭā` iti| daṇḍaḥ praharaṇasyām, grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, aṇantādeva siddhatvāt|`autsī, audapānī` iti| utsasyodapānasyeyamiti <<utsādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.1.86]] ityañ| atha `śāṅrgaravādyaño ṅīn` [[4.1.73]] ityatra punarañgrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ kriyate,|yāvatānenaiva siddham, tadeva hi rūpaṃ sa eva hi svaraḥ, tathā hi - ṅīni sati <<ñnityādirnityam>> [[6.1.197]] ityādyudāttaṃ bhavati,autsītyatrāpyutsaśabdādañantānñitsvareṇādyudāttānṅīpi kṛte jātigrahaṇamanuvartanīyam| tasmaścānuvartamāna autsītyatrotsasyeyamityarthavivakṣāyāmañi kṛte'jātitvādīkārastatra na prāpnoti,tasmādihāpyañgrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva|dvayasajādīnāmanubandhoccāraṇaṃ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-474,485,479,480) iti tayo dhātorajantaṃ prātipadikaṃ sambhavati, atastannivṛttyrathaṃ pakāroccāraṇam|`ūrudvayasī` ityādi| ūrupramāṇamasyāḥ, jānupramāṇasyā iti <> [[5.2.37]] iti ṭhak, ṭhasyekādeśaḥ|`lāvaṇikī` iti| lavaṇaṃ paṇyamasyā iti <> [[4.4.52]] | atha kimarthaṃ ṭhakṭhañaurbhedenopādānām? na viśeṣakarānubandhānutsṛjya `ṭha`iti sāmānyenaiva grahaṇaṃ kriyetetyata āha - `āḍhasubhaga` [[3.2.56]] ityādinā khyun, <> [[6.3.67]] |nañsnañīkak` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamucyārthaḥ, tena nañādibhyo'pi bhaviṣyatīti| `straiṇī,pausnī` iti| striyā iyam, puṃsa iyamiti `strīpuṃsābhyāṃ naṅasnañau bhavanāt` [[4.1.87]] iti nañsañau| `śāktīkī, yāṣṭīkī` iti| śaktiḥ praharaṇamasyākṣitam| taruṇī surā,talunī sureti - atra surādau viṣaye taruṇatalunaśabdābhyāṃ ṅībveditavyaḥ, na hi surādīnāṃ vayo'sti,tasya prāṇidharmatvāt| abhinatvamātraṃ surādīnāṃ taruṇatalunaśabdābhyāṃ gamyate| yadā tu vayo vivakṣyate tadā gaurādipāṭhānṅīṣā bhavitavyam| tatra svare viśeṣaḥ - taruṇatalunaśabdau hi `{kṛvṛdāribhya unan` (da|u|5|52) `tro raśca lo vā` (da|u|5|56) ityunanapratyayāntau vyutpāditau,ato nitsvareṇādyudāttau| [[6.4.150]] iti yakārasya ca|`apatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam` iti| apatyaṃ gṛhrate yena tadapatyagrahamam| vyākhyānametaduktaṃ bhavati - tathā vyākhyānaṃ kartavyaṃ yathā yaño viśeṣaṇamapatyaṃ gṛhret| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - uttarasūtre vikalpārthaṃ prācāmiti vacanamanenāpi yogena sambadhyate,vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca sā vijñāyate, tenāpatye'rthe yo yañ vihitastadantānnityaṃ bhavati, yastu dvīpaśabdājjātādāvarthe vihitadantānna bhavatīti| atha yogavibhāgaḥ kimarthaḥ? na pūrvasūtra eva añgrahaṇaṃ kriyetetyata āha - `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ` iti| uttarasūtre yañantādeva ṣpho yathā syāt, ṭidādibhyo mābhūditi||`ṣakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ` iti| <<ṣidgaurādibhyaśca>> [[4.1.41]] iti ṅīpyathā syāt| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi ṣakāre naiva ṅīṣā bhavitavyam, ṣphapratyayenaiva strītvasyābhivyaktatvādityata` āha - `pratyayadvayena` ityādi| na hi kevalaḥ ṣphaḥ strītvamabhivyaṅktuṃ samartha iti ṅīṣamapekṣate| tena sahitābhyāmeva tābhyāṃ strītvaṃ vyajyata iti ṅīṣā bhavitavyam| `taddhitagrahaṇam` ityādi| `kṛttaddhitasamāsaśca` [[1.2.46]] iti prātipadikasaṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam| prātipadikasaṃjñā tu ṅīṣ yathā syādityevamartham| nanu ca vināpi tayā ṣitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva ṅīṣ bhaviṣyati, anyathā hi ṣitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syat, prayojanantarābhāvāt; na ca `trapūṣ lajjāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-374) ityato'pi dhātoḥ syādityatiprasaṅga āśaṅkanīyaḥ, dhātoḥ ṣitkaraṇasya `ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅa` [[3.3.104]] ityaṅavidhau caritārthatvāt, ata iti cādhikārāt? satyametat, pratipattigauravaṃ tu syāt| tasmāt sukhapratipattaye taddhitagrahamam|`sarvatragrahaṇam` ityādi| uttarasūtre sarvatragrahaṇamanarthakam| taddhi sarveṣāmacāryāṇāṃ matena yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate, etaccāprayojanam, asvaritatvadeva hi prāggrahaṇasya sarveṣāṃ matena bhavitavyam| tasmāduttarasūtre sarvatragrahaṇamanarthakam, atastadihāpakṛṣyate| kimarthamityāha - `bādhakabādhanārtham` iti| `āvaṭaāccāpaṃ vakṣyati` ityādanā bādhakabādhanārthamityasyaivārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti|avaṭaāccāpo'vakāśaḥ - udīcāṃ matena āvaṭaeti, ghavaṭaśabdād gargādiñantāccāp, <> [[4.1.17]] ityasyāvakāśaḥ - gāgryāyaṇīti; āvaṭaāt prācānubhayaprasaṅge paratvāccāp syāt| kurukataśabdasyāvayavaḥ kataśabdastasya svāntantryaṃ nāsti; samudāyapratibaddhatvāt| kaḥ punarasau kataśabdaḥ svatantraṃ prātipadikamityata āha - `kapiśabdāt` ityādi| `lauhityāyanī`| śāṃsityāyanī` iti| lohitaśaṃsitaśabdābhyāṃ gargāditvādyañ| `vābhravyāyaṇī` iti| atrāpi babhruśabdāt `madhubabhruvobrrāāhṛṇakauśikayoḥ` [[4.1.106]] iti yañ <> [[6.4.146]] , <> [[6.1.79]] iti vāntādeśaḥ, yañantebhyaḥ ṣphaḥ| `kaṇvāttu`ityādi| kaṇvaśabdāt pūrvaḥ śakalaśabda iṣyate, kataśabdāttūttaraḥ| kimevaṃ sati bhavatītyāha - `pūrvottaro`ityādi| evaṃ sati pūrvottaro gaṇau tadantādī bhavataḥ| tacchabdena śakalaśabdaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| śakalaśabdo'nta ādiśca yathākramaṃ yayoḥ pūrvottarayorgaṇayostau tadantādī pūrvottaragaṇau| lohitādiḥ śakalaśabdānto bhavati pūrvo yathaḥ| uttara gaṇaḥ kaṇvādiḥ śakalaśabdādirbhavati| kiṃ punaḥ pūrvottarayorgaṇayostadantāditve prayojanamityāha -`ṣphāṇau tatra prayojanam` iti| pūrvasya gaṇasyaśakalāntatve ṣphaḥ prayojanam| uttarasya śakalāditve'ṇ prayojanam|`prātipadikeṣvanyathā pāṭhaḥ`iti| kapikata, kurukata, anaḍuh, kaṇva, śakala - ityanayā'nupūrvyā prātipadikeṣu pāṭhaḥ| `sa evaṃ vyavasthāpayitavyaḥ` iti| kaṇvāttu śakalaḥ pūrvaḥ`ityādinā yā''nuparvī darśitā tayā vyavasthāpayitavyaḥ| ata etaduktaṃ bhavati - kurukata, anaḍuh - ityetāvanyasmin sthāne paṭhitavyau, śakalaśabdastu katakaṇvaśabdayormadhye paṭhitavyaḥ| `manyate` iti ślovārttikāraḥ| kathaṃ punarevaṃ pāṭhe sati śakalaśabdāt ṣphāṇau sidhyata āha - `katantebhyaḥ` ityādi| katasyāntaḥ katanta iti tatpuruṣaḥ `katantebhyaḥ`iti nipātanātpararūpatvam| kataśabdo'nte yeṣāṃ lohitādīnāṃ te katantā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| katantaśca śakalaśabdaḥ, katantāśca lohitādaya iti katantaśca katantāśceti sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ| `tathā` ityādinā yathā katantebhya ityatra bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorekaśeṣaḥ, tathā kaṇvādibhya ityatrāpīti darśayati| kaṇvasyādiḥ kaṇvādiḥ śakalaśabdaḥ kaṇvaśabdaḥ ādiryeṣāṃ gokakṣādīnāṃ te kaṇvādayaḥ, kaṇvādiśca kaṇvādayaśca kaṇvādayaḥ, pūrvavadekaśeṣaḥ| `tatpuruṣavṛttyāsaṃgṛhītaḥ`iti| `katantebhyaḥ` ityatra <> [[4.2.111]] ityatra tatpuruṣavṛttyā tatpuruṣasamāsena| `madhyāpīta` iti| katakaṇvaśabdayorgaṇayorvā| `pratyayadvayam` iti| ṣphapratyayam, aṇpratyayañca| `pratipadyate` iti| prāpnoti| tatpuruṣavṛttyāhi tasya saṃgrahe satyasya sūtrasyāyamartho jāyate - katantācchakalaśabdāt tathā yañantāt katantebhyaśca lohitādibhyo yañantebhyaḥ striyāṃ ṣphapratyayo bhavatīti| tena ṣphapratyayaṃ pratipadyate śakalaśabdaḥ| `śākalyāyanī` iti| <> [[4.2.111]] ityatrāpi tatpuruṣavṛttyā śakalaśabdasya saṃgrahe satyayamartho bhavati| kaṇvādeḥ śakalaśabdāntādgotrapratyayāntāt kaṇvādibhyo gokakṣāntebhyo gotrapratyayāntebhyaḥ śaiṣikeṣvartheṣvaṇpratyayo bhavatīti| tenāṇpratyayamapi śakalaśabdaḥ pratipadyate - śākalyasyeme chātrāḥ śākalā iti||`kathaṃ kauravī`iti| kauravyaśabdādevātra hībvihita iti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| kuruśabdādevātrāṇantānṅībvihita iti darśayannāha -`tasyedam` ityādi|`kauravyamāṇḍūkayoḥ` ityādi| kauravyamāṇḍūkayoranena sūtreṇa yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate tasyāsurerapyupasaṃkhyānam = pratipādanaṃ kartavyam| āsurerapi ṣphaḥ pratipādayitavya iti yāvat| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - cakāro'tra kriyate,sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ tenāsuriśabdādapi ṣpho bhaviṣyatīti| `āsurāyaṇī`iti| asurasyāpatyamiti `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] , tadantāt ṣphaḥ| `iñaścetyaṇi prāpte` iti| tatra <> [[4.2.110]] neti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ, tenāsuriśabdādapi pratiṣiddhe <> [[4.2.114]] iti cha eva bhaviṣyati - āsuriṇā prokta āsurīyaḥ kalpa iti||`yauvanādiḥ` iti| ādiśabdo vṛddhatvādyupasaṃgrahārthaṃ iti| `śrutyā vartate` iti| yat prātipadikaṃ śravaṇamātreṇaiva prakaraṇādyanapekṣaṃ prathamaṃ vayaḥ pratyāyayati tadatra śrutyā vartate| `kumārī` iti| nanu ca nāyaṃ kumārīśabdaḥ prathame vayasi vartate, kva tarhi? puṃyogābhāve, tathā hi vṛddhāyāmapi hi prayujyate - vṛddhā kumārīti? naitadasti;kumārīśabdo hi prathama eva vayasi rūḍhaḥ| yastu vṛddhāyāmapi tasya prayogastatra kumārīsādhamryāt, na tu puṃyogābhāvāt| bhavati hi tāddhamryāt tācchabdyam, yathā -#ṛ- gaurvāhīka iti|`vayasyacarame` iti| acarame = anantye ṅībbhavatītyetadartharūpamasya sūtrasya vyākhyānamityarthaḥ| tetredaṃ vyākhyānam - prathamavayograhaṇamihācaramasya vayasa upalakṣaṇam, tenānyatrāpyacarame vayasi ṅībbhavatīti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ prathama eva vayasi gṛhramāṇe na sidhyati, yenaivaṃ sūtrārtho vyākhyeyaḥ? ityāha - `dvitīyavayovacanāvetau` ityādi| iha keciccatvāri vayāṃsīcchanti -kaumāra yauvana madhyatva vṛddhatvāni| tathā cāhuḥ - `prathame vayasi nādhītaṃ dvitīye nārjitaṃ dhanam|tṛtīye na tapastaptaṃ caturthaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati|| iti|anye trīṇīcchanti -kaumārayauvanasthāvirāṇi| tathā cāhuḥ -pitā rakṣatikaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane, putrastu sthāvire bhāve na strī svātantryamarhati||iti| kecidbālyamadhyatvavṛddhatvānīti trīṇīcchanti|tathā cāhuḥ -āṣoḍaśādbhavedbālo yāvat kṣīrānnavartakaḥ|madhyamaḥ saptatiryāvat parato vṛddha ucyate|| iti|eteṣu sarveṣu yauvanaṃ dvitīyaṃ vayo bhavati| nanu prathamavayovacanau tu vadhūṭīciraṇṭīśabdāvityato na prāpnoti, tasmādacaramasya vayasa ihopalakṣaṇaṃ prathamaṃ vaya iti vyākhyeyamiti kecit|yastu manyate `kecittu dve eva vayasī icchantīti, yāvatyo buddhimatyo'vasthāstāḥ sarvā rāśīkṛtya prathamaṃ vayo vyavasthāpyate, yāstvapacayavatyo'vasthāstāḥ sarvā rāśīkṛtya dvitīyaṃ vayaḥ| tathā coktam - `vadrdhate yāvadannena tāvadvardhitavyaṃ paścadapāyena yokṣyate`iti,etadeva darśanamāśrityaitat sūtraṃ praṇītam| iti| tena vadhūṭī, ciraṇṭītyatrāpi ṅībbhavatīti tena dvitīyavayovacanāvetau| prāptayauvanā stryabhidhīyata ityasya granthasyāvirodhāya yatitavyam| na hrasmindarśane yauvanaṃ dvitīye vayasyantarbhavati;yauvanāvasthā vṛddhimatītvāt|atha kathamuttānaśayālohitapādiketi, yāvatā bālyamatra gamyate, bālaiva hruttānaśayā lohitapādikā bhavati, tasmādbhavitavyameva ṅīpetyata āha - `naitā vayaḥ śrutayaḥ` iti| naite vayovacanāḥ śabdā ityarthaḥ| iha tāvaduttānaśayeti prātipadikaśravaṇamātreṇa kriyākārakasambandhamātraṃ pratīyate - uttānā śeta ityuttānaśayā| <<harateranudyamane'c>> [[3.2.9]] ityato'jgrahaṇe'nuvartamāne <> [[3.2.15]] ityatrottānādiṣu karttuṣvityupasaṃkhyānādac,`striyāḥ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| sarvaivottānā śete, ucyate cedamuttānaśayeti;tatra niyamo gamyate| anyathā śāyitumasāmarthyāduttānaiva yā sete sottānaśayeti gamyeti| avagate'pyasminniyame sandeha eva - kimasau bālā? vṛddhā vā? iti| vṛddhā'pi hi kadācidanyathā śayitumaśaktā syāt, uttānaiva ca śete| tasmādyadottānaiva śeta iti niyamapratītirbhavati, vṛddhatvābhāvaśca kutaścitaprakaraṇāderavasito bhavati, tadā bālyaṃ gamyate| `lohitapādikā`iti| atrāpi lohitau pādāvasyā ityanyapadārthamātraṃ tāvat tacchabdāt pratīyate| yadā tu prakaraṇādinā svabhāvata evāsyā raktau pādau nālaktakarasādineti pratītirbhavati tadā bāleti gamyate| itiśabdaḥ prakārārthaḥ| evamprakārā naitā vayaḥ śrutaya ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ bālā, vatseti? ajāditvāṭṭābbhaviṣyati| nanu vacanasāmarthyādanena ṅībapi prāpnoti? naitadasti;tasyānyatra kumārī, kiśorītyādau caritārthatvāt||`pañcapūlī` iti| pañcānāṃ pūlānāṃ samāhāra iti| <> [[2.1.51]] iti samāhāradviguḥ| `akārāntodattarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate` (vā| 156) iti strīliṅgatā|`triphalā` iti| trayāṇāṃ phalānāṃ samāhāra iti| pūrvavad dviguḥ||`taddhitaluki sati`iti| etena `taddhitaluki` ityeṣā viṣayasaptamīti darśayati| parasaptamītyeṣānopapadyate;luko'bhāvarūpatvāt, abhāve ca paurvāparyābhāvāt| `sarvato mānaṃ parimāṇam` iti| pariśabdaḥ sarvato bhāve| sarvata ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca mīyate = paricchadyate yena tatparimāṇam- prasthādiḥ|`pañcāāā` iti| taddhitārthe dviguḥ, <> [[5.1.37]] ityārhīyaṣṭhak, `adhyarthapūrvāddvigorluk` [[5.1.28]] | `kālaḥ saṃkhyā ca na parimāṇam` iti| na hi tābhyāmārohataḥ na parimāṇaṃ bhavatīti| vistādi ca parimāṇaviśeṣa eva grahītavyaḥ| ato vṛttigranthaḥ - parimāṇārthaṃ grahaṇamiti| kāṇḍasya vā parimāṇatve tūttarasūtreṇa niyamārthatā na virudhyate| yadyevaṃ <> [[2.2.5]] ityatra sāmarthyāt parimāṇavacanāḥ kālaśabdāḥ samasyanta iti yaduktaṃ tadvirudhyate? nāsti virodhaḥ; upacāreṇa tathānyatra parimāṇivācinā subantenābhidhānāt| iha hi mukhyaṃ kālasya parimāṇatve niṣidhyate| tatra hraupacārikaṃ kālasya parimāṇatvamāśritya parimāṇavacanāḥ kālaśabdā ityuktam - kālāḥ parimāṇaneti brāuvatā| parimāṇavacanatvaṃ kālaśabdānāmupayuktaṃ bhavati,na hi tena vinā parimāṇāpekṣayottarapadasya parimāṇivyapadeśa upapadyate| na ca kālasya mukhyaṃ parimāṇatvamasti| ataḥ sāmarthyādaupacārikaṃ parimāṇatvamāśritamiti gamyate| upacārasya hetuḥ paricchedasya hetutvamātram, parimāṇasya sādhamryam| kālo hi māsādirjātādisamabandhinīmādityagatiṃ gamayatīti bhavati paricchedasya hetuḥ| ataḥ parimāṇasādhamryādupapadyate, tatra ca parimāṇopacāraḥ| `dvivarṣā, trivirṣā` iti| dve varṣe bhūteti <> [[5.1.80]] ityanena vihitasya ṭhakaḥ <> [[5.1.88]] iti luk pākṣikaḥ| cittavattve tu pratyayārthasya vivakṣite <> [[5.1.89]] iti nityameva luk| dve varṣe pramāṇamasyā iti `pramāṇe lo dvigornityam` (vā|558,559) iti nityameva luk| `dviśatā, triśatā` iti| dvābhyāṃ śatābhyāṃ krīteti `paṇapādamāṣasaśatādyat` 5.1.34) iti yati prāpte <<śāṇādvā>> [[5.1.35]] ityatropasaṃkhyānam - `śatācceti vaktavyam`(vā| 510) iti| tena śatasaśabdāt pakṣe <> [[5.1.22]] iti kan,tasya pūrvavalluk|`dvivistā`iti| dvau bistau pacati| <> [[5.1.52]] ityanenārhīyaṣṭhak, tasya pūrvavalluk| dvāvācitau pacati `dvyācitā`| <<āḍhakācitapātrāt kho'nyatarasyām>> [[5.1.53]] iti vartamāne <> [[5.1.54]] iti ṣṭhan, tasya pūrvalluk| dvābhyāṃ kambalyābhyāṃ krītā `dvikambalyā`| <> [[5.1.37]] iti ṭhak,tadvadeva| luk|`dvyāḍhakī` iti| dvāvāḍhakau pacati| <<āḍhakācitapātrāt kho'nyatarasyām>> [[5.1.53]] iti vartamāne <> [[5.1.54]] itipakṣe ṣṭhan, tasyā luk| `pañcāāī` iti| pūrvavat samāhāre dviguḥ|ihemau dvaupratiṣedhāvucyete, tatraikaḥ śakyamakarttum| katham? evaṃ sūtranyāsaḥ kariṣyate - parimāṇāntātaddhitalukīti| pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthametat - parimāṇāntādeva taddhitaluki ṅībbhavati, nānyasmāt| tena dvyāḍhakītyādāveva bhavati, na pañcāotyādau;tato vistācitakambalyebhyo na taddhitalukītyanuvartate,bistādibhyaḥ parimāṇebhyo'pi taddhitaluki ṅībna bhavatīti? naivaṃ śakyam; viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyeta -parimāṇāntāt taddhitalukyevana bhavati, nānyatreti| tataśca dvayoḥ kuḍavayoḥ samāhāro dvikuḍavīttra na syāt| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu||`niyamārtham` iti| kṣetra eva yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā sāmarthyādeva tadantavidhirlabhyata eva, yathā - pūrvasmin sūtre, na hi kevalasya kāṇḍaśabdasya kenaciddvigusaṃjñā vihitā? satyametat, kintvasatyagrahaṇe kāṇaḍameva kṣetreṇa viśiṣyeta - kāṇḍaśabda eva kevalo yaḥ kṣetre vartate iti, tataśceha pratiṣedhaḥ syāt - dvābhyāṃ kāṇḍasaṃjñakābhyāṃ kṣetrābhyāṃ krītā dvikāṇḍī vaḍaveti| iha tu na syāt - dve kāṇḍe pramāṇamasyāḥ kṣetrabhakteḥ dvikāṇḍā kṣetra bhaktiriti| antasūtre tu sati kāṇḍaśabdasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kṣetraṃ na bhavati; tasya dvigo guṇabhūtatvāt|`pramaṇe yaḥ puruṣaśabdo vartate`iti| jātivacano'pi puruṣaśabdaḥ, yadā pramāṇaśabdenābhisambadhyate tadā puruṣagate pramāṇe vartate| bhavati padāntarasambandhena śabdasyārthāntare vṛttiḥ, yathā - siṃho māṇavaka iti| siṃhaśabdo jātivacano'pi māṇavakasānnidhyācchauryalakṣaṇaṃ guṇamācaṣṭe| `dvipuruṣī` iti| `pramāṇe dvayasac` [[5.2.37]] iti vihitasya dvayasacaḥ `pramāṇe lo dvigornityam`(vā| 558,559) iti luk|`aparimāṇāntatvāt pratiṣedha prāpte`iti| `aparimāṇavista` [[4.1.22]] ityādinā| `dvābhyāṃ puruṣābhyāṃ krītā dvipuruṣā` iti| pūrvavadārhīyasya ṭhako luk|`taddhitaluki` ityeva| `pañcapuruṣī` iti| pramāṇārthavṛttānāmeva samāhārānnāsti dvyaṅgavikalatā||`ūdhaso'naṅiti samāsānte kṛte` iti| akṛta eva samāse bahuvrīhrarthaṃ uttarapade pūrvaṃ samāsāntena bhavitavyamiti prāk tataḥ samāsānta eva bhavati, tato bahuvrīhiḥ tataḥ strīpratyayaḥ - ityevaivānupūrvī|`ano bahuvrīheḥ` ityādi| itiśabda ādyarthe| <> [[4.1.12]] ityādinā śāstrāntareṇetyarthaḥ| tatra `ano bahuvrīheḥ` ityanena sūtreṇa pratiṣedhe prāpte `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām` [[4.1.13]] ityanena ḍāp| `kuṇḍoghnī` iti| kuṇḍamivodho'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ,<<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] ityakāralopaḥ|`prāptodhāḥ` iti| <> [[2.2.4]] iti tatpuruṣaḥ, <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ|`ana upadhālopinaḥ`ityādi| `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām` [[4.1.28]] ityetenāpi vidhīyamānasya ṅīpo'yaṃ ṅībbādhaka iṣyate| kathaṃ punarihocyamānastasya bādhako bhavati? uttarasūtrānuvṛtteḥ| asatyānuttaratrānuvṛttau `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante` (vyā|pa|10) ityevamayaṃ ṅībḍāppratiṣedhāveva bādhate, nopadhālopino ṅīṣam| tataśacopadhālopinaḥ paratvāt sa eva pakṣe bhavet| tasmāt `ana upadhālopinaḥ` [[4.1.28]] ityatrāsyānuvṛttiḥ kartavyāḥ| tenopadhālopino'pyūdhasantānṅīṣeva bhavati| `samāsāntaśca striyāmeva` iti| samāsāntavidheranityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu punarūdhaḥśabdena sakārāntenāsamāsāntena viśeṣaṇādvijñāyate| yadi hi nityaḥ syāt `bahuvrīherūghnaḥ` iti nirdeśaḥ syāt||`dvyūghnī`ityādi| dve ūdhasī asyāḥ| trīṇyūdhāṃsyasyāḥ|abigatamūdho'syāḥ|nirgatamūdho'syā iti vigrahaḥ|`ādigrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| evaṃ manyate - saṃkhyāvyayābhyāmityeva vaktavyam, `bahuvrīherūdhasaḥ` [[4.1.25]] iti hi vartate,, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate - saṃkhyāvyayābhyāmuttaro ya ūdhaḥśabdastadantābahuvrīherṅībbhavatīti, tathā ca niṣpalamādigrahaṇam, vināpi tena siddhatvāditi| `dvividhoghnī` ityādi| yadyādigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā `saṃkhyāvyayābhyām` iti pañcamīnirdeśāt saṃkhyāyā anantaro ya ūdhaḥśabdastadantādeva syāt| yatra tu vyavadhānaṃ tatra tu na syāt, ādigrahaṇāttu tatrāpi bhavati| dvividhamūdho yasyā iti vigrahaḥ| atrādigrahaṇe sati vidhaśabdena vyavadhāne'pi bhavati||`ūdhasaḥ` iti nivṛttam,prakṛtyantaropādānāt| `saṃkhyāgrahaṇanuvartate, nāvyayagrahaṇam` iti| saṃkhyāgrahaṇasyaiva svaritatvāt| `ḍāppratiṣedhavikalpeṣu prāpteṣu` iti| `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām` [[4.1.13]] ityādinā ḍāpi prāpte <> [[4.1.12]] iti pratiṣedha `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyāmṭa [[4.1.28]] iti vikalpe ca| dve dāmanī asyā iti `dvidāmnī`| `dvau hāyanāvasyā iti `dvihāyanī`| `hāyano vayasi smṛtaḥ` iti| prakṛtiriti śeṣaḥ| kasya prakṛtiḥ? ṅīpaḥ prakṛtatvāt tasyaiva| bahuvrīhradhikārādatra hāyamānto bahuvrīhiriti gamyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati - hāyamānto bahuvrīhirvayasi gamyamāne ṅīpaḥ prakṛtirācāryaiḥ smṛta iti| tena yadi vayo gamyate tato ṅībbhavati, nānyathā| etaccottarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasyobhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūtatvādvyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| atha tricatubhryāṃ hāyanasyāpyupasaṃkhyānādyathā hi trihāyanī caturhāyaṇītyatra ṇatvaṃ bhavati; tathā trihāyanā śālā, caturhāyanā śāletyatrāpi kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `ṇatvamapi` ityādi| tadapi hi ṇatvamaupasaṃkhyānikamācāryairvayasyeva smaryate| na ca śālāyā vayaḥ sambhavati, tasya prāṇidharmatvāditi neha ṇatvaṃ pravartate|antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| bahuvrīhradhikārādeva hi sāmarthyāt tadantavidhirlabhyate; na hi kevalayordāmahāyanaśabdayorbahuvrīhisaṃjñā kenacidvihitā||`upadhālopī`iti| upadhālopo yasya ṅīpi parataḥ sambhavati sa upadhālopī|`nanu` ityādi| <> [[4.1.12]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, `ḍābubhābhyāmamanyatarasyām` [[4.1.13]] iti ḍāp, anayatarasyāṃgrahaṇācca pakṣe ṅīp| yadi tarhi `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām` ityanena ṅībapi vidhīyate, tadā dāmā pāmetyatrāpi syāt? anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvānna bhaviṣyati| `anupadhālopinaḥ` ityādi| yadīdaṃ nocyeta, anupadhālopino'pi ṅīp syāt| tasmādupadhālopina eva ṅībyathā syāt, anupadhalopino mā bhūdityevamarthamidamucyate| `bahurājā` iti| ṅīppratiṣedhaḥ| `sarvanāmasthāne ca` [[6.4.8]] iti nopadhāyā dīrghaḥ| `bahurājñī` iti| ṅīp, <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] | `bahurāje` iti| ḍāp, `auṅa āpaḥ` [[7.1.18]] iti śībhāvaḥ, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | dvivacananirdeśo ḍāpo'bhivyaktaye| ekavacane hi ḍāppratiṣedhayorna kaścidviśeṣaḥ; ubhayatrāpi tulyarūpatvāt| kvacit `bahurājāḥ` iti bahuvacanena nirdeśaḥ, tasyāpi tedava prayojanam|`bahumatsyā` iti| `sūryātiṣyāgastyamastyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ` [[6.4.149]] iti lopavidhānādupadhālopītyeṣa bahuvrīhiḥ| `suparvā` iti| ayamupadhālopī na bhavati| `na saṃyogādvamantāt` [[6.4.137]] ityupadhālopapratiṣedhāt||nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| pūrvaṇaiva hi vikalpena ṅīp siddhaḥ, tadārambhasāmarthyādeva ṅībnityaṃ bhaviṣyati, anyathā hīdaṃ vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt||atha māmakagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'smadaḥ <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇi kṛte <> [[4.3.3]] itimamakādeśena māmaka iti bhavati, tataśca `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] ityeva ṅīpsiddheḥ? satyametat; niyamārthaṃ tu māmakaśabdasya grahaṇam; saṃjñācchandasoryathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi||`ajasau` iti| viṣayasaptamīyam, na parasaptamī, kutaḥ? strīpratyayasyāntaraṅgatvājjasaḥ paratvāvirodhādviṣayasaptamītve na doṣa ityāha - `jasviṣayatvāt` ityādi|`ajasādiṣviti vaktavyamiti|jāsādiviṣayādanyatra rātriśabdānṅībbhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - iha lāghavārthaṃ `ajasi` iti vaktavye'jasāvityuktam, mātrādhikyādarthādhikyasūcanārtham, tenājasādiṣu ṅībbhavatīti| ādiśabdenāmādīnāṃ grahaṇam|`katham` ityādi| `rātryaḥ` iti| rātriśabdasya jasantasya prayogaḥ| evaṃ hi <> [[6.1.105]] iti savarṇadīrghatve pratiṣiddhe yaṇādeśa upapadyate, nānyathā| yadi tu rātriśabdasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ syāt, tataḥ `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] iti guṇe kṛte'yādeśe ca rātraya iti rūpaṃ syāt| īkārāntaśca rātriśabdo na sambhavati;ajasāviti ṅīppratiṣedhāt| tataśca rātrya iti prayogo nopapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `ṅīṣayamityādi| nanuca rātriśabdo bahvādiṣu paṭhate, tatkathaṃ bahvādilakṣaṇastato ṅīṣbhaviṣyati? ityata āha -`tatra hi` ityādi| `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ`iti| kṛta ikāraḥ kṛdikāraḥ,tadantānṅīṣ bhavati|`vṛdṛbhyāṃ vin` (da|u| 1|23) varvī, darvī| yastu ktinsambandhī tadantānna bhavati - <> [[3.3.94]] kṛtiḥ, hmatiḥ| `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke` iti| eka ācāryā sarvato'ktinnarthāt kṛdikārādakṛdikārācca ṅīṣ bhavatītyāhuḥ, rājiḥ rājī| rājiśabdo'vyayutpattipakṣe kṛtikārānto na bhavati| aktinnarthāditi, na vidyate ktinnartho yasya so'ktinnarthaḥ, tasmāt sarvato ṅīṣ bhavati| yastu ktinnarthastadantānna bhavati - kṛtiḥ hmatiḥ| <<ākrośe nañyaniḥ>> [[3.3.112]] - akaraṇiḥ, aharaṇiḥ| rātriśabdaścāyaṃ vyutpattipakṣe kṛdikārānto bhavati, `rā ādāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1057), `rāśadibhyāṃ trip` (da|u|1|36) rātriḥ, tasmāt pakṣe ṅīṣ rātrī| avyutpattapakṣe tu kṛdikārānto na bhavati, tataḥ `sarvato'ktinnarthāt` (ga|sū|51) iti ṅīṣ||`sa tu nakārāntatvādeva siddhaḥ` iti| `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` 4.1.5) ityanena| `nipātanasāmarthyāt` ityādi| yathaiva hi nipātanasāmarthyādanyat kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati, tathārthaviśeṣe'pi vṛttiḥ| kasminpunararthaviśeṣe vṛttirbhavati? ityata āha - `antarvatpativat` ityādi| yathākramamantarvadityasya garbhasaṃyoge vṛttiḥ, patipadityasya bhartṛsaṃyoge| garbheṇa saṃyogo garbhasaṃyogaḥ, sa kasyā bhavati? yasyāḥ kukṣau garbho vyajyate| bhatrrā saṃyogo bhartusaṃyogaḥ, sa ca kasyā bhavati? yasyāḥ patirjīvati| bhartā ceha yo'gnisākṣipūrvakeṇa pāṇigrahaṇanena sambandhī sa evābhimataḥ, natu yaḥ pṛthivīsvāmī| `{rāśatibhyāṃ da|u|} iha tu na bhavatīti - antarasyāṃ śālāyāṃ vidyate` (iti) śālāyāṃ kukṣigatena garbheṇa sambandhābhāvāt| `patimatī` iti| parirasyā astīti matup, <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp| atra patiśabda īāre svamini vartate| tena saṃyoge ca na pativaditi nipātyate| yena tu saṃyogo nipātyate sa cākhyāta eva|`matubnipātyate` iti| antaḥśabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvāt prathamāsamarthatā nāsti| prathamāsamarthāccāstisamānādhikaraṇena matubvidhīyate, na cāstināntaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tasmānmatubna prāpnotīti nipātyate| `vatvaṃ na siddham` iti| `mādupadhāyāśca` [[8.2.9]] ityādinaivākāropadhatvāt| `nipātyate` iti| kenacidaprāptatvāt| ` matupsiddhaḥ`iti| patirasyāstīti prathamāsamarthasya patiśabdasyāstinā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| `garbhiṇī` ityanena garbhasaṃyogaṃ darśayati| `jīvapatiḥ`ityanenāpi bhartṛsaṃyogam|`antarvatpativatoḥ`ityādi| antarvatpativadityetayoḥ śabdayornipātanānmatubavatve bhavataḥ, yathākramaṃ garbhiṇyāṃ jīvapatyāṃ ca striyāmabhidheyāyām| garbho'syā astīti garbhiṇī| jīvatīti jīvaḥ, pacādyac; jīvaḥ gatiryasyāḥ sā jīvapatiḥ|nanu ca <> [[1.4.8]] iti ghisaṃjñoya'yaṃ patiśabdaḥ,tatra <> [[7.3.119]] ityātvautvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ jīvapatāviti bhavitavyam, tadayukto jīvapatyāmiti nirdeśaḥ? naitadasti; <<śeṣo ghyasakhi>> [[1.4.7]] iti, siddhāyāmeva ghisaṃjñāyāṃ <> [[1.4.8]] ityanena śeṣasyaiva patiśabdasya ghisaṃjñā niyamārthaṃ vidhīyate, na cāyaṃ śeṣaḥ; `ṅiti hrasvaśca` [[1.4.6]] iti nadīsaṃjñāsambhavāt| nadīsaṃjñāyāṃ ca satyāṃ <> [[7.3.117]] iti `ṅerām nadyāmnībhyaḥ` [[7.3.116]] ityām, yaṇādeśe jīvapatyāmiti bhavati| `vā cchandasi nugvidhiḥ`| chandasi vikalpe tu nugvidhirbhavati| sa ca vakṣyamāṇasya vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya siṃhāvalokitanyāyenānuvṛttevryavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| nukpakṣe `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp| `antarvatnī` iti| anukpakṣe <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp -antarvatīti bhavati||`yajñasaṃyoge` iti| yajñasambandhe| kasya punaryajñena saṃyogaḥ? patiśabdavācyārthasya| atha patiśabdasyaiva kasmānna bhavati? asambhavāt| tayorhi vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ syāt, na kevalaḥ patiśabdo yajñasya vācakaḥ| kathaṃ punaryajñena saṃyoga ityāha - `tatsādhanatvāt` iti| tasya yajñasya sādhanaṃ tatsādhanam, tadbhāvo yajñasādhanatvam| tasmādyajñena saṃyogo bhavati| yajamānasya yā bhāryā tasyā yāgaṃ prati sādhanabhāvo'stīti; vinā tayā tadaniṣpatteḥ| na hi bhāryāvirahitastrairṇikaḥ kevalo yajñe'dhikriyate| tasmāt sa tayā karaṇabhūtayā yajñaṃ niṣpādayatītyasti tasyā yajñena saha kriyākārakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ| `tatphalagrahītṛtvādvā` iti| yajñasaṃyoge dvitīyo hetuḥ| anena tu svasvāmibhāvalakṣamaḥ sambandhaḥ pratipādyate| yajñasya yatpradhānaṃ phalaṃ svargākhyaṃ tadyajamānasya patnī parigṛhṇāti| ato yadyapi yajñaṃ prati tasyāḥ sādhanatvaṃ na vivakṣyate, tathāpi tatphalasya grahaṇāt, yathā yajamānasya yajñena hasa svasvāmibhāvasambandhaḥ, tathā tatpatnyā api| atha phalagrahītṛtvāditi kathamatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ? kathañca na syāt? `kartari ca` [[2.2.16]] iti tṛcā saha ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhāt? naivāyaṃ tṛjantena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? dvitīyeti yogavibhāgāt tṛnnantena dvitīyāsamāsaḥ| atha vā - yājakādiṣu grahītṛśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhaviṣyati| athāpi tatra na paṭhate? evamapi <> [[2.2.9]] iti cakārasyānuktasamucayārthatvādbhaviṣyati| `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti grahītṛśabdādiha ṅīp na bhavati, strītvasyāvivakṣitatvāt| kvacit `phalagṛhṇītatvāt` iti pāṭhaḥ|tatra phalagṛhītaśabdayorbahuvrīhiḥ| phalaśabdasya jātivācitvānniṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam` (vā|116) iti gṛhītaśabdasya paranipātaḥ|`katham` ityādi| eṃ manyate - `śūdrasyaiva tāvadyajñe'nadhikṛtvādyajñena saṃyogo nāsti, kiṃ punastadbhāryāyāḥ? ataḥ `vṛṣalasya patnī` ityeṣa prayogo nopapadyate` iti| `upamānādbhaviṣyati` iti| patnīvaddhi patnī| yathaiva hi yajamānasya patnyagnisākṣipūrvakeṇa tatpatyuḥ sambandhinī tatkāryeṣu cādhikṛtā tathā vṛṣalasya bhāryā'pi| tasmāt patnīsamādhamryāt sā'pi patnītyucyate||`patiśabdāntasya`ityādi| etena patiśabdasya grahaṇam, sapūrvagrahaṇam, anupasarjanagrahaṇañca - trayamapyetat prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| sahaśabdo'yamastyeva tulyayoge - saśiṣyo gururāgata iti, guroḥ śiṣyasya cāgamanena tulyayogaḥ pratīyate; asti ca sattāvacanaḥ, yathā - sahaiva daśabhiḥ putrairbhāraṃ vahati gardabhī` iti, vidyamanairevetyarthaḥ| tadiha sattāvacano gṛhrate, sapūrvasya vidyamānapūrvasyetvarthaḥ| yadi hi tulyayoge vartamāno gṛhrate, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt - sahapūrveṇa patiśabdāntasya nakāro bhavatīti| tataśca patiśabdāt pūrvasyāpi vṛddhādiśabdasya nakāraḥ syāt| evaṃ hi tulyayogo bhavati yadi nakāra ubhayorapi bhavati| pūrvaśabdo'yamastyeva vyavasthāśabdaḥ, yathā -pūrvaṃ mathurāyāḥ pāṭaliputramiti; astyavayavavacanaḥ, yathā - pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti| tadihāvayavavacano gṛhrate| saha vidyamānaḥ pūrvo'vayavo yasya tat sapūrvamityucyate| yadi vyavasthāśabdo gṛhreta, tatrāyamarthaḥ syāt - vidyamānaḥ pūrvo yasmāt tasya patiśabdāntasya nakāro bhavatīti| tatasca dṛḍhapatnītyatra na syāt, na hi patiśabdāntādihakaścit pūrvo'stīti| atha patiśabdasyaiva sapūrvatvamanupasarjanatvañca viśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? aśakyatvāt| sa hravayavavacanaṃ vā pūrvaśabdaṃ gṛhītvā viśiṣyeta, vyavasthāśabdaṃ vā| tatra pūrvastāvadayuktaḥ kalpaḥ avyabhicārāt, asambhavācca| katham? yadi pakāraṃ pūrvamabhipretya vidyamānaḥ pūrvo'vayavo yasyeti viśiṣyeta, tato'vyabhicārādayuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam| na hi pakāreṇa yasya pūrvatvaṃ tatpatiśabdo vyabhicarati| atha śabdāntaram? tadasambhavādayuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam| na hi śabdāntaraṃ patiśabdasyāvayava upapadyate| vyavasthāśabdapakṣe tu vidyamānaḥ pūrvo yasmāt taditi viśiṣyate| yujyate ca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ| kintu vākye'pi nakāraḥ prāpnoti - grāmasya patiriyaṃ brāāhṛṇīti; asti hyatra patiśabdāt pūrvo grāmaśabda-| anupasarjanagrahaṇenāpi patiśabde viśiṣyamāne bahuvrīhau vikalpo na prāpnoti - dṛḍhaḥ patirasyā dṛḍhapatiḥ, dṛḍhapatnīti| na hyatrānupasarjanaṃ patiśabdaḥ, sarvopasarjanatvādbahuvrīheriti bahuvrīhravayavānāmapyupasarjanatvāt| tasmāt prātipadikasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam|`patiriyaṃ brāāhṛṇī grāmasya` iti| nanu ca vyapadeśivadbhāvādidamapi sapūrvamiti śakyate vyapadeṣṭum| na ca `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pratipadikena` (śāk|pa|65) iti vyapadeśivadbhāvābhāvaḥ; prātipadikatvāt| yadyevam, patiśabdāntatāpi nāstīti, ato dvyaṅgavikalatā? naitadasti; sapūrvagrahaṇe hi kriyamāṇe patiśabdāntasyetyeṣo'rtho labhyate| akriyamāṇe tu tasmin śabdasyaiva śuddhasya nakāro vijñāyate||`sapatnyādiṣu` iti| ke punaḥ saptnatyādayaḥ? ye paṭhante| teṣu prātipadikeṣu yeṣāṃ samānādīni pūrvapadāni te sapatnyādayaḥ| kuta etat? samānādīnāṃ gaṇe pāṭhāt, sapatnyādīnāṃ cāpāṭhāt| lāghavārthaṃ samānārthaṃ samānādiṣviti pravaktavye kṛte nakāradeśasya sapratyayasya ca sapatnyādiṣviti samudāyasyoccāraṇam - niyogata eva samudāya īkāranta eva yathā syādityevamartham| tena sapatnī bhāryā yasya sa sapatnībhārya iti `striyāṃ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] iti puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati| `sapatnyādiṣu nityam` ityādi| samānādiṣu pūrveṣvayavayaveṣu satsu nityaṃ patiśabdasya nakārādeśo bhayatītyarthaḥ| yadi pūrveṇa vikalpe prāpta idaṃ vacanam, evaṃ hi nityagrāhaṇayanarthakam, ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi nityaṃ vidhirbhaviṣyatītyata āha - `nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham` iti|`dāsācchandasi` iti| dāsaśabdāt paro yaḥ patiśabdastadantasya prātipadikasya cachandasi viṣaye nityaṃ nakārādeśo bhavati| dāsaḥ patiryasyāḥ sā dāsapatnī| bhāṣāyāṃ tu pūrveṇa vikalpaḥ - dāsapatiḥ, dāsapatnīti||`aikāraścāntādeśo bhavati` iti| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam - ādejño'yamiti, na punaḥ pratyayaḥ? uttarasūtre'pyādeśatvāt| uttarasūtre hrayamevaikāro'nuvartate, tatra cāsyādeśatvam| ata ihāpyādeśatvamavasīyate| uttarasūtre kuto'syādeśatvaṃ niścitamiti cet? udāttavacanāt| yadi hi pratyayaḥ, tasyādyudāttatvādudāttavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; pratyayasvareṇaivodāttatvasya siddhatvāt|`traya ete yogāḥ` iti| ayaṃ caikaḥ, vakṣyamāṇau cānantarau - dvau - ete trayo yogāḥ puṃyogaprakaṇe <> [[4.1.48]] ityevamādau draṣṭavyāḥ; tasminneṣāṃ svaritatvenānuvṛtteḥ| pūtaḥ kraturyena pukaṣeṇa sa pūtakratuḥ, tasya strī pūtakratāyī||`vṛṣākapiśabdo madhyodāttaḥ` iti| `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ` (phiṭ|2|42) iti vacanāt| asyāyamarthaḥ - laghāvante parato dvayośca laghvoḥ parato bahvacśabdasya yo guruḥ sa udātto śeṣamanudāttam| tatra yadyudāttagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetānudāttasya sthāne ya ādeśaḥ sthānivadbhāvena so'nudātta eva syāt| tasmādvṛṣākapi śabda udāttatvaṃ prayojayati| `agnyādiṣu punarantodātteṣu` iti| `phiṣaḥ` (phi|sū|1|1) ityādināgnyādīnāmantodāttatvam| ādiśabdena kusitakusīdayogrrahaṇam| `phiṣ` iti prātipadikasyaiva punaranyācāryākṛtā saṃjñā||`vāgrahaṇena dvāvapi vikalpyete` iti| pratyekaṃ vāgrahaṇenābhisambandhāt| yadā caikāraukārau na bhavatastadā ṅībapi na bhavati ; tasya sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt| `manuśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| etenodāttagrahaṇamanuvartayitavyam; anyathā śeṣasyānudāttatve sthānivadbhāvenādeśasyāpyanudāttatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| `mana jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1176) `{bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanimamasjbhya uḥ - da|u|}bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanidhanimimasjbhya uḥ` (da|u|1|92) ityanuvartāne `kapilā` iti| `kamu kāntau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-443) `salikalyanimahibhaḍibhaṇḍiśaṇḍipiṇḍituṇḍikukibhūbhya ilac` (paṃ|u|155), `kameḥ paśca` (paṃ|u|1|56) iti makārasya pakāraḥ, citsvareṇāṇāntodāttaḥ kapilāśabdaḥ||`ṣidbhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ` iti| ṣakāra idyeṣāṃ tāni| kathaṃ punaḥ prātipadikāni ṣinti bhavanti, yāvatā dhvunādeḥ pratyayasya ṣakāra itsaṃjñakaḥ,na tu teṣām? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avayavagataṃ hi ṣittvaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, yathā - akṣigataṃ kāṇatvaṃ puruṣasya -kāṇaḥ puruṣa iti| yadyevam, dhātugatamapi ṣittvaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ prāpnoti, `trapūṣ lajjāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-347), vartata iti guṇavacanaḥ, na tūkārāntaḥ| `ākhuḥ` iti| jātivacano'yam, na gaṇavacanaḥ|`guṇavacanānṅībādyudāttārtham` iti| guṇavacanānṅībvidheyaḥ, na ṅīṣ| svare viśeṣaḥ| kimartham? ādyudāttārtham| antodātteṣu <> [[6.1.174]] ityudāttatvamīkārasya vidhīyata iti nāsti viśeṣo ṅībṅīṣoḥ| ādyudātteṣu tu ṅībanudātta evāvatiṣṭhate, tasmāt tadarthaṃ ṅībvidheyaḥ| nanu ca ṅīṣ prakṛtaḥ, tat kathaṃ ṅīp śakyate vidhātum? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṅībeva hyatra maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvartate, na ṅīṣ; asvaritatvāt| `vasvī` iti| `vasa nivāse` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1942) `bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritani{dhani-nāsti-da|u|} dhanimimasjibhya uḥ` (da|u|1|92) iti vartamāne `dhānye nit` (da|u|1|94) iti ca śṛsvṛsnihitrapyasivasihaniklidivandhimanibhyaśca` (da|u|1|95) ityupratyayaḥ, nicca, nittvādādyadāttatvaṃ bhavati| guṇavacanaścāyaṃ vasuśabdaḥ, vasutve guṇe varttitvā tadvati dravye vartata iti kṛtvā| paṭuśabdo'pyādyudāttatvānṅīpaṃ projayati| `aṭa paṭa gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-296,297), hetumaṇṇic, `phalipāṭinamimanijanāṃ guk paṭinākidhataśca` (da|u|1|103) ityupratyayaḥ, pāṭeśca paṭirādeśaḥ, `dhānye nit` (da|u|1|94) ityanuvṛtternatvādādyudāttatvam| mṛduśabdaśca pratyayasvareṇāntodātta iti, tatra ṅīpo ṅīṣo vā viśeṣo nāsti| `mrada mardane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-767), `kubhrraśca` (da|u|1|107) ityataḥ kurityanuvartamāne `prathimradibhrasjāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ ca` (da|u|1|113) iti kupratyayaḥ, samprasāraṇaṃ ca bhavati|`kharusaṃyogopadhapratiṣedhaḥ` iti| kharuśabdāt saṃyogopadhāśca pratiṣedhaḥ| sa tu vetyasya vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādeva labhyata iti vaktavyamiti| `utaḥ` iti taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyartham, tena paṭurityatra na bhavati| paṭumicchatīti `supaḥ ātmanaḥ kyac` [[3.1.8]] , `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ| paṭū ya iti sthite kvip, <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ, <> [[6.1.66]] iti yakārasya lopaḥ| iha `utaḥ` iti viśeṣaṇopādanādeva śāstrīyaguṇasyāparigrahaḥ siddhaḥ ma hredeṅgāṃ madhye kaścidukārānto'sti| loke tu kvacidupasarjanaṃ guṇa ityabhidhīyate, yathā - guṇabhūtā vayamiti, apradhānabhūtā iti gamyate| yasya guṇasya hi bhāvāt tadvati dravyaśabde niveśastadabhidhāne tvatalāvityatra viśeṣaṇamātraṃ guṇaśabdenocyate, tathā hi, jātāvapi bhāvapratyayo bhavati - iha tu yādṛśo guṇa iṣyate tādṛśaṃ paribhāṣitumāha - `sattve nivaśate'paiti` ityādi| vyavacchedaphalakatvāt sarvavākyānāṃ sattava evetyavadhāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| sattvam = dravyam, tatraiva niviśate, tadevāśrayatītyarthaḥ| apaiti = tataḥ sattvādapagacchathi, yathā - āmraphale śyāmatā pūrvamupaiti, raktatāyāmupajātāyāṃ tato'paiti| `pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate` (iti)| pṛthak = nānā jātayo yeṣāṃ te pṛthagjātayaḥ, atasteṣu pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate| na hi gotvamaāādiṣu vyaktiṣu dṛśyate| govyate| govyaktau dṛṣṭaḥ śaṅkhādāvapi śuklādirguṇau dṛśyate| etena sarveṇa jātirguṇo na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| na hi jātidrravyamevāśrayati| yathā hi sattā dravyaguṇakarmasu triṣvapi vartate, dravyatvaṃ dravya eva, karmatvaṃ karmaṇyeva, guṇatvaṃ guṇa eva, nāpi dravyavartinī jātiḥ sattvādapaiti; janmanaḥ prabhṛtyā vināśāttasyādhāradravyāparityāgāt na jātiḥ pathagjātiṣu dṛśyate| na hi gotvamaāādivyaktiṣu dṛśyate, nāpyaātvaṃ gavādiṣviti nāsti jāterguṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ| karmaṇastu syāt; tadapi hi sattva eva nivaśite yadā sakriyaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati, apaiti ca tato yadā tu niṣkriyaṃ bhavati| `pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate` iti| ghaṭapaṭādiṣu dṛśyate| ataḥ raktatā guṇaḥ, sa hragnisanniyogena niṣpādyate| `akriyājaśca` iti| kriyā = vyāpāraḥ, tato jātaḥ kriyājaḥ, na kriyājo'kriyājaḥ = nityaḥ, yathā - ākāśādiṣu mahattvādirguṇaḥ| tadevaṃ guṇasyotpādyatvānutpādyatvaprakāradvayadarśanena karmaṇo guṇatvanivṛttiḥ kṛtā bhavati| taddhyutpādyameva, nānutpādyam| evamapi dravyasya guṇatvaṃ prāpnoti,tasyāpi hrete dharmā vidyante|tathā hi - tadapi yadi dravya evārambhake'vayavabhūte niviśate, apaiti ca tataḥ, yathā - śarīramavayavīti| taddhi hastapādādiṣvavayaveṣu samavaiti; tadvināśe ca vināśāt tato'paiti| pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate, hastyādiṣu dṛśyate| dravyasyāpi pūrvoktaṃ prakāradvayamastyeva| avayavidravyasyotpādyatvādākāśādestadvadanutpādyatvāt? ityata āha - `so'sattvaprakṛtirguṇaḥ`iti| prakṛtiḥ = svabhāvaḥ| sattvaṃ dravyaṃ prakṛtiryasya sa sattvaprakṛtiḥ, na sattvaprakṛtirasattvaprakṛtiḥ| yathoktairdharmairyukto yo dravyasvabhāvo na bhavati sa guṇaḥ| dravyam = dravyasvabhāvam, ato guṇo na bhavati||bahvādiṣu `śaktiḥ śastre` iti paṭhate, tasyāyamarthaḥ - śastre'bhidheye śaktiśabdādvā ṅīṣ bhavati - śaktiḥ, śaktī| śastra iti kim? śaktiḥ,sāmarthyam| anye tu śaktiśastrī iti śabdadvayaṃ paṭhanti - śaktiḥ,śaktī, śastriḥ, śastrī| `itaḥ prāṇyaṅgāt` iti| ikārāntāt prāṇyaṅgavācino vā ṅīṣ bhavati - dhamaniḥ, dhamanī| ita iti kim? samarthā grīvā| prāṇyahgāditi kim? śreṇiḥ| `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ` (iti)| `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke` (iti)| asyārthaḥ <> [[4.1.31]] ityatraiva vyākhyātaḥ| yadi sarvato'ktinnarthāt ṅīṣ bhavati, śakaṭaādīnāṃ gaṇekimarthaṃ ikārāntānāṃ pāṭhaḥ? tasyaiva prapañcārthaḥ| paddhatiśbadsayāktinnarthāditi pratiṣedhe prāpte pāṭhaḥ| pādasya hatiḥ paddhatiḥ, <> [[6.3.54]] iti padbhāvaḥ| `candrabhāgānnadyām` iti| candrabhāgaśabdānnadyāmabhidheyāyāṃ vā ṅīṣ bhavati - candrabhāgī nadī| nadyāmiti kim? candrabhāgā nāma devatā| `ahan` iti| ayaṃ śabdaḥ kevalaḥ striyāṃ na vartate| tasmāt samāse tadanta udāhāryaḥ| dīrghāṇyahāni yasyāṃ śaradi sā dīrghāhno| ṅīppratiṣedhāvapyasmādbhavataḥ| `anoḥ bahuvrīha#e#ḥ` [[4.1.12]] `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām` [[4.1.13]] ityapi ḍābbhavati; `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām` [[4.1.28]] iti vā ṅīp ca| tena dhāturūpyaṃ bhavati| yadi bahuśabdo guṇavacanaḥ,tatkimarthamasyeha grahaṇam,yāvatā purveṇaiva siddho ṅīṣ? ityata āha - `tasya` ityādi||atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pūrveṇaiva siddhe vikalpe satyārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha - `nityagrahaṇamuttarārtham` iti||`prabhvī` ityādi| `bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ` [[3.2.179]] ityataḥ `bhuvaḥ` ityanuvartamāne `vipraṃśabhyo ḍvasaṃjñāyām` [[3.2.180]] itipratyayaḥ, tadantānṅīṣ| `svayambhūḥ` iti| bhavateḥ kvibantasya rūpam| nanu ca `bhuvaḥ` iti bhūśabdāddīrghādiyaṃ pañcamī, , tataśca dīrghādeva pratyayena bhavitavyam, na hrasvādityata āha - `hrasvādeveyaṃ pañcamī ` iti| tarhi `bhuvaḥ`iti nirdeśo nopapadyate, <> [[7.3.111]] iti guṇe kṛte `bhoḥ` iti nirdeśena bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `sautro nirdeśaḥ`iti| chandasi varṇavyatyaya uktaḥ| tena tasya guṇe'kṛta uvaṅādeśaḥ kṛta iti darśayati||`puṃyogāt` iti| `vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām` [[2.3.25]] iti hetau pañcamī| yogaḥ = sambandhaḥ| `ākhyāyām` iti| pañcamyartha eṣā <> [[3.1.85]] iti saptamī| ākhyāyate'nayā prātipadikakārtha iti śrutyā''khyā| `puṃsa ākhyāyām` iti| puṃso vācakabhūtamityarthaḥ| taddhi puṃyogāddhetoḥ samprati striyāṃ vartate; na puṃsi| atīta e kāle puṃso vācakamāsīt, ato bhūtagrahaṇam| etaduktaṃ bhavati - yat prātipadikaṃ prāk puṃso vācakamabhūt, paścāttu paṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ vartate tasmān ṅīṣbhavatīti| kathaṃ punaryoge guṇabhāvamāpannasya puṃsa ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yujyate, striyāmityanuvṛtteḥ striyā eva? naitadasti; yo hi puṃyogāt striyāṃ vartate so'vaśyaṃ striyamacaṣṭa iti viśeṣaṇamidamadanarthamakameva syāt| puṃyogasya tarhīdaṃ viśeṣaṇam? na; asambhavāt| na sambhavatyeva hi tat prātipadikaṃ yat puṃyogāddhetoḥ pūrvaṃ striyāṃ vartate, puṃyogasya cākhyābhūtaṃ bhavati| gaṇakādayo hi ye śabdāḥ puṃyogāt striyāṃ vartante te sarve eva vācakāḥ prāgabhūvan, na puṃyogasya| ye tu puṃyogādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃyogasya vācakāḥ, te puṃyogāt striyāṃ na vartanta eva| na ceha kaścit tathāvidho'nya prakṛtaḥ, nāpi śrūyate, yasyākhyāgrahaṇena sambandhaḥ syāt| tasmādguṇabhūtasyāpi puṃsa evānena sambandho vijñāyate| `gaṇakī` ityādi| gaṇayatīti gaṇaka,ṇvul| pratiṣṭhita iti praṣṭhaḥ, <<ātaścopasarge>> [[3.1.136]] iti kaḥ| <<praṣṭho'gragāmini>> [[8.3.92]] iti nipātanānmūrdhanyaḥ| sarva ete puṃso vācakāḥ| puṃyogāttu yadottarakālaṃ striyāṃ vartante tadaitebhyo ṅīṣ| `puṃsi śabdapravṛttinimitasya sambhavāt` iti| gaṇanādikriyāsvabhāvaṃ yadgaṇakādiśabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ tasya puṃsi sambhavaḥ, na striyām, nāpi napaṃsake| tasmāt puṃsi śabde ete| puṃso vācakā ete śabdā ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi striyāṃ vartante? ityāha - `tadyogāt` ityādi| tadyogaḥ = tasyāyamiti sambandhaḥ, svasvāmibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| tasmādete puṃśabdā api svabhāvataḥ striyāṃ vartante| yathaiva tadyogāt striyāṃ snānodvartanapariṣekādīn labhate tathā tācchabdyamapi|`devadattā` iti| atra devadattaśabdasaṃjñakena puruṣeṇa yogāddevadattaśabdaḥ striyāṃ na vartate| kiṃ tarhi? svata eva, tasyā hīyaṃ saṃjñā kṛtā| `parisṛṣṭā, prajātā` iti| prasūtetyarthaḥ| nirluṭhitagarbheti yāvat| parisṛṣṭaprajātaśabdau striyāṃ vartamāno prasavanimittamupādāya pravartete| parisargaḥ, prajanaḥ, prasava ityekārthā ete śabdāḥ| tasya ca prasavasya puṃyogo nimittam, tena vinā tadabhāvāt| tasmāt puṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ vartata iti| vartata iti| na tu puṃśabdākhya iti īkāro na bhavatīti| `ete śabdāḥ` iti| bahuvacanaṃ ye'nye'pyevaṃjātīyāḥ śabdāstānapekṣya veditavyam; anyathā hi parisṛṣṭaprajātaśabdayordvitvadetau śabdāviti vaktavyaṃ syāt|`gopālikādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ` iti| siddhye iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| gopālikādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ siddhaye ṅībpratiṣedhaḥ| sa tu `voto guṇavacanāta` [[4.1.44]] ityato vetyanuvṛttestasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya pratipādyaḥ|`sūryāddevatāyāṃ cāvvaktavyaḥ`iti| nanu ca ṅīṣa eva pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, ṅīṣi pratiṣiddhe ṭābbhaviṣyati, ṭāpi ca sūryeti sidhyatyeva? naitadevam; yadyapi hi rūpaṃ siddhyati, svaratu na sidhyati, yasmāt sūryaśabdo'yamādyudāttaḥ| tathā hi `rājasūyasūryaḥ` [[3.1.114]] ityatra kyabanto nipātitaḥ, tataḥ kyapaḥ pittvādanudāttatvam| dhātostu suvateḥ sartervā dhātusvareṇāntodāttatvam| tatra ṭāpi satyanudāttatvaṃ syāt, tu satyantodāttatā bhavati| pitkaraṇaṃ tu `ṅyāpprātipadikāt` [[4.1.1]] ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārtham| `sūrī`iti| sūryasya strī mānuṣī sūrī, ṅīṣeva bhavati, `sūryatiṣyāgastyamastyānām` [[6.4.149]] iti yalopaḥ||`yeṣām` iti| indrāṇīnām| `anyeṣāṃ tu` iti| himādīnām| atha kimarthamānuk kriyate, anugeva nocyeta, tena savarṇadīrghatvena sidhyati? na sidhyati; <> [[6.1.97]] iti pararūpatvaṃ hi prāpnoti| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, pararūpe hi nugeva vaktavyaḥ syāt| evaṃ tahrrakāroccāraṇasamathryādbhaviṣyati| lvarasandhireva na bhavatītyevamapi vijñāyate| tasmānmaivaṃ vijñāyītyānugeva vaktavyaḥ| atha vā - indramācaṣṭa iti `tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe` (vā|200,201) iti ṇici `ṇāviṣṭavat prātipadikasya` (vā|813) iti ṭilopaḥ, indrayateḥ kvip, ṇilopaḥ, indraḥ strīndrāṇītyatra dīrghaghasyākārasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthamānuko vidhānam| ānuki hi sati dīrgho na śrūyeta| nanu ca naivātra ṅīṣā bhavitavyam, ata ityadhikārāt? dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati|`himāraṇyayormahattve` iti| mahattvena yuktā himādayaḥ strīliṅgenābhisambadhynate yadā, tadā strītvavivakṣāyāmanayoḥ pratyayāgamayorvidhānamityetadanenākhyāyate, na tu strīpratyayasyāyamapavāda ucyate| strītva eva hi pratyayo bhavati|`yathāddoṣe`iti| yavāddoṣe gamyamāne striyāṃ ṅīṣ bhavati - duṣṭo yavo yavānī|`yavanāllipyām` iti| `yavanānāṃ lipiḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] ityapprasaṅge ṅīṣ vidhīyate, sa tu tadarthasya ṅīṣaiva dyotitatvānna bhavati| `ācāryadaṇatvañca` iti| nedamapūrvaṃ vaktavyam, kṣubhnādiṣvasya pāṭhāt|`svārtha evāyaṃ vidhiḥ` iti| evakāreṇa puṃyogo vyavacchidyate| yadi hi puṃyoge vidhirayaṃ syāt śūdrā'pi kṣatriyasya bhāryā kṣatriyāṇīti syāt| tasmāt svārthe evāyaṃ vidhiḥ - kṣatriyaiva kṣatriyāṇīti| `puṃyoge tu ṅīṣaiva bhavitavyam` iti| pūrvasūtreṇa|`licca`iti| kasya tallitvam? ānukaḥ| tathā hi - mudgalānīśabdas dvitīya udātta āmyāye paṭhate| ṅīṣastu litve tṛtīya udāttaḥ syāt||karaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ yasminnityādinā karaṇapūrvagrahaṇaṃ krītagrahaṇañca ubhayamapyetatprātipadikasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| pūrvaśabdo'yamavayavavacanaḥ| karaṇamavayavo yasminnityarthaḥ| atha krītaśabdasyaiva karaṇapūrvagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? aśakyatvāt| krītaśabdo hravayavavācinaṃ vā pūrvaśabdaṃ gṛhītvā viśeṣyeta - karaṇaṃ pūrvasminniti? vyavasthāśabdaṃ vā - karaṇaṃ pūrvamasmāditi? tatra prathamaḥ pakṣo na sambhavati; na hyatra krītaśabdasya karaṇavāciśabdāntaramavayava upapadyate, dvitīyastu sambhavati, kintu vākye'pi syāt - aona krīteti, asti hyatra krītaśabdāt karaṇaṃ pūrvam| prātipadike tu viśeṣyamāṇe na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| na hraona krītetyetat karaṇāvayavaṃ krītaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikam| kiṃ tarhi? vākyam| tasmāt prakṛtaṃ prātipadikaṃ sāmānyamevāvayavavācinā pūrvaśabdena viśeṣyate| krītaśabdenāpi tadeva karaṇapūrvaṃ prātipadikam| tena tasmin viśeṣyamāṇe sāmarthyāt tadantavidhiḥ prasajyetetyāha - `krītaśabdāt prātipadikāt` iti| `vastrakrītī, vasanakrītī` iti| atra `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāksubutpatteḥ` (vyā|pa|vṛ|138) iti vastravasanayoḥ karaṇayoḥ krītaśabdena <> [[2.1.32]] iti prāgeva subutpatteḥ samāsaḥ|`sukrītā, duṣkrītā` iti| gatyupapadatvāt prāgeva subutpatteḥ `kugatiprādayaḥra` [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| duṣkrītetyatra `idudupadhasya cāpratyaya` [[8.3.41]] iti ṣatvam|`ṭābantena samāsaḥ` iti| subantayoreveti veditavyam| ṭāpi vihite kṛdantatāyā vihitatvāt| atra kiṃ ṭāp kriyatām? uta vibhaktiriti? antaraṅgatvāṭṭāp| paścādbahiraṅgā vibhaktiriti vibhaktyantayoḥ samāsaḥ| antaraṅgatvaṃ bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu ṭābvibhaktyoḥ `ṅyāpprātipadikāt` [[4.1.1]] ityatra pratipāditam| kṛte tarhi ṭāpi ṅīṣ kasmānna bhavatītyāha - `ata iti ca` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ ṭābantena samāsaḥ sidhyati, yāvatā `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ` (vyā|pa|vṛ|138) iti prāgeva kṛdantatāyāṃ samāsena bhavitavyamityata āha - `gatikārakopapadānām` ityādi| kathaṃ punarbahulaṃ taducyate? ityāha - `karttṛkaraṇe` ityādi| <> [[2.1.32]] ityanena hi gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ samāso vidhīyate| sa ca bahulagrahaṇāt kvacit kṛdantāvasthāyāṃ prāgeva subutpatteḥ, kvacidanyathā| tena `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ (vyā|pa|vṛ|138) iti bahulaṃ tadācāryairucyate| tataśca ṭābantenāpi kvacitsamāso labhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ||`abhraviliptī` iti| `lipa upadehe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1433), asmāt ktaḥ| alpairabhrairviliptetyasyāmarthavivakṣāyāṃ pūrvavatprāksubutpatteḥ samāsaḥ| alpaśabdastu gatārthatvānna prayujyate| `candanānuliptā` iti| bahucandanānuliptetyarthaḥ||`śaṅkhabhinnī` iti| `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] iti natvam| niṣṭhāntasya `niṣṭhā` [[2.2.36]] iti pūrvanipāte prāpte `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam` (vā|116) iti sa na bhavati| śaṅkhādiśabdā hi jātivacanāḥ| ata eva hi <> [[6.2.170]] ityantodāttatvaṃ bhavati| `galakotkṛtī` iti| `kṛtī chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1435) ityasmāt ktaḥ| `keśalūnī` iti| keśān lunātīti| <> [[8.2.44]] iti natvaṃ codayati|`pādapatitā` iti| <> [[2.1.32]] iti tatpuruṣasamāse'ntodāttatvam|`antodāttājjātapratiṣedhaḥ` iti| antodāttādbahuvrīherṅīṣo vidhāne jātaśabdāntāt pratiṣedhaḥ, sa cāntagrahaṇādeva labhyata iti na vaktavyam| ihāntagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyameva, vinā'pi tena yathā `varṇāadanudāttāt` [[4.1.39]] ityatrānudāttāntāditi vijñāyate, tathehāpyantodāttantāditi vijñāsyate? tadevamarthaṃ kriyate - antodātta eva yo nityaṃ bahuvrīhistato yathā syāt, vikalpena yo'ntodāttastato mā bhūditi| iha ca dantājātā, stanajātetyatra <> [[6.2.171]] iti vikalpenāntottatvam, ato'yaṃ vidhirna bhaviṣyati| atha vā - uttarasūtre vāgrahaṇamubhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣaḥ, vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca, tena jātaśabdāntānna bhaviṣyati| asmastu vyākhyāne'ntagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthameveti veditavyam|`pāṇigṛhītyādīnāmarthaviśeṣe`iti| `siddhaye` iti śeṣaḥ| pāṇigṛhītītyādīnāṃ siddhyarthaṃ viśeṣa eva ṅībbhavati, na sarvatra| etadapi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā labhyate| viśeṣastu pāṇigrahaṇasya veditavyaḥ| āgnisākṣipūrvakaṃ bhāryārthaṃ yasyā pāṇigrahaṇaṃ kriyate sā pāṇigṛhītīti bhavati| `yathākathañcit` iti| yathoktāt prakārādanyena kenāpi prakāreṇetyarthaḥ|`abahunañ` ityādi| bahvādipūrvānṅīṣ na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tasyaiva vāgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| `jātikālasukhādi` ityādi| `bahukṛte` ityatra <> [[6.2.175]] ityantodāttatvam| `akṛtā, sakṛtā` ityatra `nañsubhyām` iti| `māsajātaḥ` ityādiṣu <> [[6.2.170]] iti||`asvāṅgapūrvapadāt` iti| na svāṅgam = asvāṅgam, tat pūrvapadaṃ yasya bahuvrīheḥ sa tathokta-| `sāraṅgajagdhī` iti| `ada bhakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1011), `ado jagdhiḥ` [[2.4.36]] ityādinā jagdhyādeśaḥ, <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti takārasya ghatvam, <> [[8.4.65]] iti ghalopaḥ| `palāṇḍabhakṣitī` iti| `bhakṣa adane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1557), curādiṇic| `surāpīti` iti| ghumāsthādi [[6.4.66]] sūtreṇetvam| sarvatra `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ` [[6.2.169]] ityādinottarapadāntodāttatvam|`vastracchannā, vasanacchannā` iti| `chada apavāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1833) ityasya curādiṇyantasya ktapratyaye `vā vāntaśāntapūrṇa` [[7.2.27]] ityādinā cchannaśabdo nipātitaḥ| `anācchādanāt` [[6.2.169]] ityuttarapadāntodāttatvapratiṣedhe <> [[6.2.1]] iti prakṛtisvare kṛte <> [[6.1.158]] iti śeṣasyānudāttatvādihāntodāttatvaṃ nāsti| pūrvapade evātrādyudātte -ekaṃ nitsvareṇa, aparaṃ litsvareṇa| `thasa ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1023), ṣṭranpratyayaḥ -vastram| dhātorvasanam -lyuṭ| `bahulam` ityādinā saṃjñāyāṃ chandasi bahulaṃ ṅīṣbhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatra vāgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvādeva bahulaṃ saṃjñācchandasorbhaviṣyati| nanva sūtreṇaivānenāvasya bahuvrīhitvādbhaviṣyati ṅīṣ, kimarthaṃ tarhīdam? ityāha - `pravṛddhā ca`ityādi| vigrahaviśeṣeṇa tatpuruṣaṃ darśayati|`candramukhī` iti| candra iva mukhamasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| atra ca `prathamānirdiṣṭam` [[1.2.43]] ityādinā mukhaśabdasyopasarjanasaṃjñā| `atikeśī` iti| <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| `eka vibhakti ca` [[1.2.44]] iti keśabdasyopasarjanatvam|`aṅga` iti| aṅgādibhya upasarjanebhyo ṅīṣ bhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimartham? saṃyogopadhatvānṅīṣ na prāpnoti, tadarthametadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| tadidaṃ vyākhyānam - uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāṅgādibhyaḥ saṃyogopadhebhyo ṅībbhavatīti| `adravam` iti| mukhanāsikābhyāṃ yo'bhiniṣkrāmati vāyuḥ sa prāṇaḥ, prāṇo'syāstīti, prāṇī, tatra yattiṣṭhati tatprāṇistham; mukhādi svāṅgamucyate| yadyevam, kapho'pi svāṅgaṃ syāt, tataśca bahukaphetyatra ṅīṣ prasajyeta? ityata āha - `adravam` iti| viśeṣaṇopādānānna bhavatyayaṃ prasaṅgaḥ, kaphasya dravātmakatvāt| evamapi jñānaṃ svāṅgaṃ bhavet, prāṇisthatvādadravatvācca, tataśca bahujñānetyatrāpi ṅīṣ syāt? ityata āha - `mūrtimat` iti| asarvagatāni yāni dravyāṇi teṣāṃ parimāṇaṃ hrasvādimadyat tanmūrttiḥ, sā yasyāsti tanmūrtimat| na ca tadjñāne'stīti;nirguṇatvāt| guṇānāṃ ca jñānasyātmaguṇatvānnāsya svāṅgatvaprasaṅgaḥ| yeṣāmapi kāṭhinyādisparśaviśeṣo mūrttiḥ, tanmatenāpi naiva jñāṃ mūrtimadbhavati, na hi jñānasya sparśo'sti| evamapi śophasya āyathusaṃjñakasya svāṅgatvaṃ prāpnotyeva; yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvāt| tataśca bahuśophetyatra ṅīṣ prasajyetetyata āha - `avikārajam` iti| vikāraḥ = dhātuvaiṣamyam, bhūtaprakṣoma ityarthaḥ, tato jātaṃ vikārajam| na vikārajam = avikārajam| tadevaṃ viśeṣamopādānasāmarthyāt| śophasyāpi svāṅgatvaṃ na prāpnoti| yadi prāṇisthaṃ svāṅgaṃ bhavati, evaṃ tarhi rathyādipatitānāṃ keśānāṃ svāṅgatvaṃ na syāt, tataśca dīrghakeśī rathyeti na sidhyatītyata āha - `atatstham` ityādi| tasmin prāṇini tiṣṭhatīti tatstham, na tatsthamatatstham = aṇistham| evamapi keśādi svāṅgaṃ bhavati yadi tatprāṇini pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati| pratimāvayavānāṃ tarhi mukhādīnāṃ svāṅgatā na syāt, aprāṇisthatvāt, tataśca dīrghamukhī pratimeti ṅīṣ na syāt? ityata āha - `tasya cettatathā` iti| tasya prāṇinastat svāṅgaṃ yathā yutaṃ yena prakāreṇa saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa sambaddhaṃ tathā tena prakāreṇāprāṇino'pi yadi sambaddhaṃ bhavatyevamapi tasya svāṅgatvaṃ bhavati| atha vā - tasya cedaṃ prāṇinastat svāṅgaṃ tathā yadi yutaṃ sambhavati yathā prāṇinaḥ, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavati|anyeṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ- `tena cetattathā yutam` iti| tena prāṇinā yena prakāreṇa saṃsthānaviśeṣādinā sambaddhaṃ tathā yadyaprāṇināpi sambaddhaṃ bhavati, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavati| atha vā -tenāprāṇinā tanmukhādi yadi tathā yutam = sambaddhaṃ bhavati yathā prāṇinā, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavati| atha vā tena cenmuravādīnāṃ svāṅgena tadaprāṇisthaṃ dravyaṃ tathā yadi yutaṃ bhavati yathā prāṇidravyam, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavatīti| sarvathāyayamarthaḥ - yādṛśaṃ prāṇino mukhādi svāṅgaṃ tādṛśameva yadyaprāṇino'pi bhavati svāṅgamevameva bhavatīti||`bahvajlakṣaṇe` ityādi| nāsikodarayoḥ| <> [[4.1.56]] iti bahvajlakṣaṇe pratiṣedhe prāpte vacanam| śeṣāṇām `asaṃyogopadhāt` [[4.1.54]] iti saṃyogopalakṣaṇe| `sahanañvidyamānapūrvalakṣaṇanastu pratiṣedho bhavatyeva` iti| nāsikodarayostāvadayaṃ yogaḥ `purastādapavādā anantarān vidhīn bādhante, nottarān` (vyā|pa|9) ityanantarameva bahvajlakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, na sahādilakṣaṇam| oṣṭhādiṣvapi `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante` (vyā|pa|10) iti pūrvameva saṃyogopadhalakṣaṇam, tenāsau bhavatyevama - sahanāsikā, anāsikā, vidyamānanāsiketi| `bimboṣṭhī` iti| bimbamivoṣṭhau yasyāḥ sā bimboṣṭhī - `otvaṣṭhayoḥ samāse vā pararūpaṃ vaktavyam` (vā|687) ityaupasaṃkhyānikaṃ pararūpatvam| ye tu bimbauṣṭītyaukāraṃ paṭhanti te <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛdiṃdha kurvanti|`pucchācceti vaktavyam` iti| pucchāntācca prātipadikānṅīṣ bhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| kimartham? saṃyogopadhādapi pucchāntādyathā syāt| vyākhyānaṃ tu cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya kartavyam| `kalyāṇapucchī` iti| kalyāṇaṃ pucchamasyāḥ|`kabara` ityādi| kabarādibhyo yaḥ pucchaśabdastadantānṅīṣ bhavatīti| eṣo'pi tata eva cakārādvāgrahaṇasya vā vyavasthitavibhāṣātvallabhyate| kabaraṃ pucche yasyāḥ sā kabarapucchī| evaṃ `maṇipucchī, viṣapucchī, śarapucchī` iti| <> [[2.2.35]] iti pucchasya pūrvanipāto na bhavati; `saptamyāḥ pūrvanipāte gaḍvādibhyaḥ paravacanam` (vā| 115) iti vacanāt| `upamānāt pakṣāt pucchācca` iti| nityamiti sambadhyate| etadapi pūrvoktāt kāraṇadvayāllabhyate| `pucchācceti vaktavyam` (vā|364) ityanenaiva siddhe punariha pucchagrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham,nityārthaṃ vā| ulūkasyeva pucchaṃ yasyāḥ sā puṃvadbhāvaḥ| uttarapadasya `gostriyoḥ` [[1.2.48]] ityādinā hrasvaḥ| tataḥ `svāṅgāccopasarjanāt` [[4.1.54]] ityādinā prāptasya ṅīpo'nena pratiṣedhaḥ tataṣṭāp| `mahālalāṭā`iti| `āmanmahat` (6|346) ityādinātvam||`sakeśā` iti| saha keśairvartata iti| `tena saheti tulyoge` [[2.2.28]] iti samāsaḥ| <> [[6.3.82]] iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| `akeśā`iti| avidyamānāḥ keśā asyeti, `naño'styarthānāṃ bahuvrīhiruttarapadalopaśca` (vā|102) iti vidyamānaśabdalopaḥ| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kim, sahanañvidyamānādityevocyeta, etayā hi pañcamyā svāṅge viśeṣyamāṇe sahādipūrvatā labhyata eva? naitadevam; pañcamī hi paratvena svāṅgaṃ viśeṣayet - sahādibhyaḥ paraṃ yat svāṅgamiti| tataśca sahādibhyaḥ pareṇa svāṅgenānyasyāpi kalyāṇaṃ vidyamānamukhamasyā iti vigrahaḥ| atha vā - vidyamānaṃ mukhaṃ yasya sa vidyamānamukhaḥ, kalyāṇo vidyamānamukho yasyā iti vigrahaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇe sati pūrvaśabdasyāvayavavācitvāt sahādipūrvatvena prātipadikaṃ viśeṣyata iti sahādyavayavaṃ yat svāṅgāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ tasmāditi vijñāyamāne nātra pratiṣedho bhavati, na hretat sahādyavayavameva| kiṃ tarhi? kalyāṇaśabdāvayavamiti na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ||`sūrpaṇakhā` iti| `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ` [[8.4.3]] iti ṇatvam| atha kathaṃ śūrpanakhī rākṣasīti? asaṃjñātvāt| saṃjñāyāmityucyate, na ceyaṃ saṃjñā| tathā hi - `pūrvapadāt` [[8.4.3]] ityādinā ṇatvaṃ na bhavati| yaugikastveṣa tasyā vyapadeśaḥ; śūrpākāranakhayogāt - śūrpamiva nakho yasyāḥ śūrpanakhīti||atha kimarthamīkārāntanipātanaṃ kriyate, na `dīrghajihvā cchandasi` ityevocyeta, evamucyamāne pratiṣedha prakaraṇāt pratiṣedho vijñāyeteti cet? na; saṃyogopadhatvena prāptyabhāvāt, prāptipūrvakatvācca pratiṣedhānām| tasmāt sāmarthyādvidhireva vijñāsyata ityāha - `nipātanaṃ nityārtham` iti| kalpitatvāt prakṛtasya ṅīṣa ihāpi vikalpita [[4.1.56]] <> [[4.1.57]] iti| etenaitat sūcayati - `svāṅgāccopasrjanāsaṃyogopadhāt` [[4.1.54]] ityādi vidhiśāstramihānuvartate, <> [[4.1.56]] ityādi pratiṣedhaśāstram, tena yatra viṣaye ṅīṣ strīpratyayasyāpi luk, <> [[1.1.38]] ityavyayatvam, <> [[2.4.82]] iti supo luk - prāg mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā prāṅamukhī, <> [[8.4.45]] iti ṅakāraḥ| `prāṅmukhā` iti| ṭāp| nanu ca ṅīpā mukte vāgrahaṇaṃ karoti| yadyatrāṇā vikalpitena mukte <> [[4.1.120]] (iti) ḍhakāreṇa bhavitavyaṃ kiṃ vāgrahaṇena? tasmādasmādvāgrahaṇādidaṃ jñāpyate - yatrotsargo'pi vibhāṣā tatrāpavādena mukta utsargo na <> [[6.4.131]] ityataḥ samprasāraṇānuvṛtteḥ| ṭhakāraḥ <> [[6.1.89]] iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| <> [[6.1.108]] iti pararūpatvam, <> [[6.1.89]] iti pūrvapadākāreṇa saihakādeśo vṛddhiḥ||`sakhī` iti| vṛttāvāha - `jātivāci yat prātipadikam` iti| `astrīviṣayāt` iti| ananyatrābhāve'pi viṣayaśabdo vartate, ata eva vṛttāvāha - `na cet striyāmeva niyatam` iti| na striyāmeva yasya bhāvaḥ, kintu striyāṃ cānyatra ca tadastrīviṣayam|jātirityucyate, keyaṃ jātirnāmeti praśnasyottaramāha -`ākṛtigrahaṇā` ityādi| ākriyate vyajyate'nayetyākṛtiḥ = saṃsthānamucyate| tathā hi - durākṛtiḥ duḥsaṃsthānamucyate, svākṛtiśca susaṃsthānam| gṛhrate'nenetita grahaṇam, karaṇe lyuṭ| ākṛtigrrahaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā''kṛtikagrahaṇā, saṃsthānavyaṅgyeti yāvat| nanu cākṛtiśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyādgrahaṇaśabdasya striyāṃ vṛttiriti `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīpā bhavitavyam, tadantena samāse kṛte <> [[5.4.153]] iti kap, tataścākṛtigrahaṇīketi prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; grahaṇaśabdo hi pūrva karaṇasāmānye vyutpāditaḥ, paścādviśeṣeṇābhisambadhyate| tatra padāntarasannidhāne yastasya liṅgaviśeṣasambandhaḥ, sa ca bahiraṅga iti sāmānyaliṅgenaivāntaraṅgeṇa vākyaṃ kṛtvā samāsaḥ kriyate, yathā - <<mukhanāsikāvacano'nunāsikaḥ>> [[1.1.8]] ityatra| tadanena lakṣaṇena sāmānyarūpā gotvādilakṣaṇā jātirityuktaṃ bhavati| gotvādayo hi viṣāṇādimatsaṃsthānavyaṅgyatvādākṛtigrahaṇāḥ| etena lakṣaṇena brāāhṇatvādayo jātiviśeṣā na saṃgṛhītāḥ| na hi te saṃsthānavyaṅgyāḥ; tadāśrayasya saṃsthānasyābhinnatvāt| yādṛśaṃ hi saṃsthānaṃ brāāhmaṇasya kṣatriyādeḥ saṃsthānamapi tādṛśamevetyato dvitīyaṃ lakṣaṇamāha - `liṅgānāñca` ityādi| yāpi sarvāṇi liṅgāni na bhajati sāpyasaṃsthānavyaṅgyāpi jātiḥ, yathā - brāāhṛṇatvādiḥ| sā hi strīliṅgaṃ puṃliṅgaṃ ca bhajati - brāāhṛṇaeḥ, brāāhṛṇīti, na tu napuṃsakaliṅgamityasarvaliṅgabhāgbhavati| brāāhṛṇatvādiṣvapyudeśābhivyaṅgyatā'śrayaṇīyā, anyathā devadattaḥ, devadatteti liṅgadvayaṃ bhajati, atrāpi jātitvaṃ syāt| na cāyaṃ jātiśabda iṣyate, kiṃ tarhi? saṃjñāśabdaḥ| vidhyarthañcedam| ataḥ sarvaliṅgabhājo'pi pūrveṇa lakṣaṇena jātitvamasti, yathā -taṭaḥ,taṭī, taṭamiti| sarvaliṅgaṃ bhajata iti sarvaliṅgabhāk, karmaṇyupapade <> [[3.2.62]] iti ṇviḥ| nanu ca liṅgāpekṣayā sarvaśabda upapade bhajo ṇvipratyayo na prāpnoti, upapadāśrayatvā, upapadasamāsaśca asamarthatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva hi devadattasya gurukulamityatrāsāmarthye'pi samāso bhavati, gamakatvāt; tathaivamubhayamapi bhaviṣyatīti|sā ca jātiḥ - `sakṛdākhyātanigrrāhrā` iti| sakṛt = ekavāram, ākhyātā = upadiṣṭā, nigrrāhrā = niścayena grāhrā| etena jātidharmānekatvanityatvapratyekaparisamāptitvalakṣaṇān darśayati| sakṛdevāraṃ yasmāt kṛṣṇe dhavale vā gopiṇḍa ākhyātā tadvilakṣaṇe'pi gopiṇḍe nigrrāhrā, tasmādeva nityā pratyekaṃ parisamāptā ca| yadi hrekā na syāt, sakṛdākhyātā gauriti piṇḍāntare na gṛhreta| yadi ca nityā na bhavet, piṇḍavināśe tasyā api vināśāt piṇḍāntareṇa na gṛhreta| yadi ca pratyekaṃ sarvātmanā parisamāptā na syāt, tasminnapi tāvat piṇḍe sarvātmanā na gṛhreta yatrākhyātā, kiṃ punaḥ piṇḍāntare ! aṃśena hi parisamāptau satyāmaṃśa eva parigṛhrate, na jātiḥ| najātyaṃśo jātirbhavati, anekatvaprasaṅgāt|tṛtīyaṃ jātilakṣamamāha - `gotrañca` ityādi| `apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram` [[4.1.162]] iti gotraṃ pāribhāṣikam| iha tu laukikamapi gotramapatyamātraṃ gṛhrate| caraṇamadhyayanabhedenānekadhā| gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha jātirbhavati| gotraṃ nāḍāyanādi| yadyapi nāḍāyanatādi sāmānyaṃ gotravadeva kalpyate, tathāpi tat saṃsthānavyaṅgyaṃ na bhavati| sarvaliṅgabhāvaktvācca - nāḍāyanaḥ pumān, nāḍāyanī strī, nāḍāyanaṃ napuṃsakamiti| ato gotrasya jātitvapratipādanasiddhaye gotrañcetyuktam| caraṇaśabdastvadhyayanakriyāsambandhena pravṛttatvāt| kriyāśabda eva jātiśabda ityatastadarthasya jātitvaptipādanāya caraṇaiḥ tvanantarāpatye tadā'prāpta eva pakṣe vidhīyate||`svārthikapratyayavadhiścāyamadhikāraḥ`iti| svārthe prakṛtyarthe bhavāḥ svārthikāḥ , adhyātmāditvāṭ(vā|456) ṭhañ| svārthikāḥ pratyayā avadhirmaryādā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `prāgdiśo vibhaktiriti yāvat` iti| anena yataḥ pareṇa svārthikāḥ pratyayā avadhibhūtāḥ pravartante tatsūtraṃ darśayan <> [[5.3.1]] ityetatsūtrāt prāgayamadhikāra icyācaṣṭe| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ svārthikeṣvayamapyadhikāro na pravartate? ityāha - `svārthikeṣu` ityādi| `samarthānām` iti| sambaddhārthānamāmityeṣo'rthaḥ| sambaddhārthatā ca dviṣṭhatvāt pratiyogini sati bhavati, svārthikānāñca prakṛtyarthādarthāntaraṃ na sambhavati yatpratyayāyanāya śabdāntaraṃ prayujyeta,yadapekṣayā ca samarthatā syāt| tasmāt samarthatāvā abhāvāt svārthikeṣu samarthānāmityetat tāvannopayujyate| ata eva pratiyogino'bhāvāt prathamādityetadapi nopayujyata eva| yadi hi pratiyogiśabdāntaraṃ syāt, tata āśaṅkā syāt - kiṃ prathamāt pratyayaḥ? uta dvitīyāditi? tataśca tannivṛttaye prathamāditi vacanamanuvartamānamarthavat syāt| asati tu dvi#ītīye pratiyogini tadanuvṛttirnopayujyate| `vikalpo'pi tatrānavasthitaḥ`iti| aniyata ityarthaḥ| yataḥ kecit svārthikā nityameva bhavanti|
