tathā ca `aṣaḍakṣāśitaṅgvalaṃkarmālam` [[5.4.7]] ityādau sūtre bhāṣyakāraḥ parigaṇanaṃ kariṣyati - `ke punarnityāḥ pratyayāḥ? tamabādayaḥ prāk kāt, ñyādayaḥ prāgvunaḥ, āmādayaḥ prāṅamayaṭaḥ, bṛhatyā jātyantāt samāsāntāśca` iti| tatra <> [[5.3.55]] iti tamapprabhṛtayo ye pratyayāḥ `prāgivāt kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] ityetasmāt prāk te nityāḥ| tathā <<pūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt>> [[5.3.112]] ityato ñyapratyayāt prabhṛti `pādaśatasya saṃkhyādervīpsāyāṃ vunma lopaśca` [[5.4.1]] ityato vunaḥ prāgye te nityāḥ| tathā <> [[5.4.11]] ityata āmprabhṛti prāk tatprakṛtavacane mayaṭo ye pratyayāste nityāḥ| tathā <> [[5.4.6]] iti yo vihitaḥ kapratyayaḥ`jātyantācchobandhuni` [[5.4.9]] iti ca yaścapratyayo ye samāsāntā ḍajādayaste sarve nityāḥ| tasmādvikalpaḥ svārthikeṣvanavasthitaḥ| tataśca vāgrahaṇamapi tatrānavasthitameva kvacidanuvartate, kvacinnetyuktaṃ bhavati|iha prathamāditi viśeṣaṇaṃ prayogavākyasya? lakṣamavākyasya vā? yadi prathamaḥ ,tato laukike vākye padānāṃ prayoge niyamo nāstīti; pātramāhara, āhara pātramiti prayogāt| tataśca yadāpatyamupagoriti prayujyate tadāpatyaśabdāt prathamāsāmarthyāt pratyayaḥ syāt| nanu ca tasyetanena sūtropāttenānukaraṇapadena ṣaṣṭhantena prathamenālaukikavākyasamavāyi paścānnirdiṣṭamapi padamanukṛtam, tat prathamatvāt prathamavyapadeśamāsādayati| tena yadāpyapatyamupagoriti laukikaṃ vākyaṃ prayujyate, tadopaguśabdādeva yathoktenaiva prakāreṇa labdhaprathamavyapadeśāt pratyayo bhaviṣyati; nāpatyaśabdāt| tadādye'pi pakṣe samāśrīyamāṇe na doṣa iti cet? vārtametat; na hi mukhye prathame sambhavapisati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam| ataḥ satyapyupaguśabdasya gauṇena prathamatve mukhyāt prathamādapatyaśabdādeva pratyayaḥ syāt, nopaguśabdāt| pratipattigauravañca| dvitīye tu pakṣa eva doṣo nāvatarati; lakṣamavākyeṣu padānāṃ prayogasya niyatvāt| atastamāśrityāha - `lakṣaṇavākyāni` ityādi| samarthānāṃ madhye prathamaḥ pratyayaprakṛtitvena nirdhārita iti, yathā - kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannakṣīratameti, gavāṃ madhye kṛṣṇā gauḥ sampannakṣīratamātvena| yadi tarhi samarthānāṃ prathamāt pratyayo bhavati, evaṃ sati <> [[4.1.92]] ityatra tasyetyetatsarvanāma| sāmānyavāci prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭamiti sāmānyavācina eva pratyayaḥ syāt, na viśeṣavācinaḥ; prātipadikādupagvityādeḥ, na hi tallakṣamavākye prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭam? ityata āha -`tasya` ityādi| `viśeṣalakṣaṇārtham` iti| viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthamityarthaḥ| yadi hi tasyetyedviśeṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ na syāt tadā samarthatā tasya na syāt| na hi tasyetyetat prakaraṇādyanapekṣaṃ viśeṣeṣvatiṣṭhachate| na ca viśeṣeṣvanavasthitenānenāpatyasya kaścidupakāraḥ kṛto bhavati; sambandhisāmānyasya sambandhiśabdatvāt, apatyaśabdenaiva gamitatvāt| tataścopākārabhāvāt samarthatā na syāt| ucyatecedam - tasyeti| tasmāt sāmarthyādviśeṣopalakṣaṇārthatvaṃ tasyetyasya| tena ye viśeṣā upalakṣitāḥ = pratipaditānte sambandhyantaravyavacchedena viśiṣṭaṃ sambandhinaṃ pratipādayanta upakāriṇo bhavantītyupapadyate taiḥ saha sāmarthyam| tasmāt tasyetat sāmānyaṃ viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ draṣṭavyam| tena tasya yat prāthamyaṃ tadviśeṣāṇāmupaguśabdādīnāṃ vijñāyate| tataśca tata eva pratyayo bhavati, na ca sāmānyavācinaḥ|`kambala upagorapatyaṃ devadattasya` iti| atropaguśabdaḥ kambalena saha sambaddhaḥ, nāpatyena| apatyaśabdasyāpi devadattaśabdena, nopaguśabdena| tasmādapatyaśabdena, sahopaguśabdasya sambandho nāstīti na tataḥ pratyayo bhavati|`vākyamapi hi yathā syāt` iti| asati hi vāgrahaṇe vākyenāpatyasyābhidhāne prāptetasminnarthe vidhīyamānaḥ pratyayastannivartayet| nanu ca samāne'rthe śāstrānvito'śāstrānvitasya nivartako bhavati, yathā - `gamerḍoḥ` (da|u|2|11) ityanena śāstrānvito gośabdo'śāstrānvitasya gāvīśabdas samānārthasyaiva, na tu bhinnārthasya ḍitthādeḥ| na ca vṛttivākyayoḥ samāno'rthaḥ, vṛttau hrekārthībhāvaḥ sāmarthyam, vākye tu vyapekṣā? naitadevam; satyapi hretasminnarthabhede pradhānārtho na bhidyate, tathā hi - upagorapatyamānayetyukte ya evārtho'patyātyavatsambandhaviśiṣṭaḥ sa ānīyate| aupagavamānayetyukte sa eva| pradhānāpekṣayaiva ca samānārthaḥ śāstranvito'śāstrānvitaṃ nivartayati, anyathā hi gośabdo'pi gāvīśabdaṃ na nivartayet| asti hi tayorapyarthabhedaḥ, tathā hi - gośabdo gotvamācaṣṭe, gāvīśabdastu tathā, aśāstriyatvañca| tasmādasati vāgrahaṇe yathā gośabdaḥ satyapyapradhānārthabhede pradhānārthasya samānarthādgāvīśabdaṃ nivartayati, tathā taddhito'pi śāstrānvito'śāstranvitaṃ vākyaṃ nivartayet| tasmādvākyamapi yathā syāditi vāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| `yadyevam` ityādi| yadi vāgrahaṇena taddhitasya bhāvābhāvau kurvatā vākyasya bhāvaḥ kriyate, evaṃ sati yadā vākyaṃ nāsti tadā taddhitenaiva bhavitavyam| samāsavṛttirupagvapatyamityeṣaḥ taddhitavṛttyā bādhyeta| `naiṣa doṣaḥ` ityādi| gatārtham||`prāgdīvyat` ityayukto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ , yāvatā `dīvyati` [[4.4.2]] iti vakṣyati, na tu dīvyaditi, tatra dīvyatīśabdasyāvadhitvenopādāne dīvyateriti nirdeśena bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `tadekadeśaḥ`ityādi| samastasya dīvyatiśabdasyāvadhitvenopādānā#e sati na yujyetāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ, na tu samastasyopādānam, api tu tadekadeśasya dīpavyacchabdasyetyadoṣaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ dīvyadgrahaṇaṃ prāggrahaṇañcata, naṇityevādhikāraḥ kriyatām? naivaṃ śakyamevaṃ hi kriyamāṇe <> [[4.1.120]] ityevamādinā'dhikārāntareṇa vicchinanasyāṇaḥ `tena raktaṃ rāgāt` [[4.2.1]] ityevamādiṣu punagrrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ jāyeta| avadhinādhikāraparimāṇa ākhyāte tadavadhikeṣvartheṣu sarveṣvayamabhyanujñāyata itipunaraṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ na bhavati| tasmādadhikāraparimāṇajñāpanārthaṃ dīvyadgrahaṇaṃ tāvatkartavyam| prāggrahaṇamapi kartavyameva tasyaivāvadhitvadyotanārtham| asati hi tasmin `dīvyato'ṇ` ityucyamāne prakṛtiraṇo dīvyacchabdo vijñāyeta| `triṣvapi darśaneṣu` ityādi| kathaṃ punariyamapavādaviṣayaparihāreṇāṇaḥ pravṛttirlabhyate, yāvatādhikāre tasmin sati pratiyogamupasthānādapavādaviṣaye'pyaṇ prāpnoti - `ata iñ aṇ ca` iti, anyathā hi tasya tatropādānamanarthakaṃ syāt? paribhāṣāpakṣe'pi prāgdīvyato'rtheṣvaṇityaviśeṣeṇa paribhāṣite sāmānyena paribhāṣā pravartamānā kenāpavādaviṣayaṃ pariharet? vidhāvapi prāgdīvyato yāḥ prakṛtayastāḥ sarvā ihaikadhyamupanīyāṇ vidhīyamānaḥ sarvataḥ pravarteta, anyathā sarvato vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt? evaṃ manyate - jñāpakādapavādaviṣaye na bhaviṣyatīti, yadayaṃ kvacidvāgrahaṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇañca karoti - <> [[4.1.118]] , `udaiāto'nyatarasyām [[4.2.18]] iti,tajjñāpayati - nāpavādaviṣaye'ṇ bhavatīti| vidhau tu bhūyān parīhāraḥ| na hi prāgdīvyato yāḥ prakṛtayastābhyo'ṇ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? prāgdīvyato ye'rthāsteṣu| tatra samānārthe prakṛtiviśeṣādutpādyamāna iñaṇaṃ bādhiṣyata iti| atha kimarthamiyānavadhirupādīyate, na prāk ṭhaka ityevocyeta, <> [[4.4.1]] ityetasmāṭṭhakaḥ prāgityarthaḥ? naivaṃ śakyam; <> [[4.2.18]] ityevamādirapi ṭhagavadhitvena vijñāyate| `prāk kaṃsīyāt` ityevaṃ tarhi vaktavyam - `kaṃsīyaparaśabdayoryañañau luk ca` [[4.3.168]] iti,tatra yaḥ kaṃsīyaśabdastataḥ prāgityarthaḥ? evamapyaśakyaṃ vaktum; <> [[4.1.88]] ityetayāpi kaṃsīyādutpadyeta, tataśca dvayoḥ kaṃsīyayorvikāro dvikaṃsa ityatra luṅna syāt| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu||`pattyuttarapadācca` iti| etenottarapadaśabdaḥ patiśabdenaiva sambadhyate, nānyairdityādibhiriti darśayati| etacca pratyāsattevryākhyānādvā labhyate|`yamācceti vaktavyam` ita| yamaśabdācca ṇyapratyayo bhavītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| tatreyaṃ vyākhyā - iha lāghavārthaṃ patyantāditi vaktavye patyuttarapadādita vacanamadhikavidhānārtham | granthādhikyādarthāviṣayaṃ bhavatīti| tena yamaśabdādapi ṇyo bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā - pūrvasatrāccakāro'nuvartate,tasmādanuktasamuccatayārthatvādbhaviṣyatīti| `vāṅamatipitṛmatām` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu tadeva granthādhikyādarthādhikyamāśritya cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthasyānuvṛttervā kartavyam| yāmyamityādiṣu yathāyogaṃ prāgdīvyatīyepatyādāvarthe ṇyapratyayaḥ|`pṛthivyā ñāñau` iti| ete ñādayaḥ - <> [[4.1.76]] iti bahuvacanenānuktataddhitaparigrahārthena siddhyantīti na vaktavyāḥ| tatra pṛthivīśabdādyadā ñastadā ṭāp - pārthivā, yadā tvañ tadā `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp -pārthivī| `bahiṣaṣṭilopaśca` ityādi| nanu ca `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ sāyaṃprātikādyarthaḥ` (vā|802) ityenaiva ṭilopasiddhiḥ, tatkimarthaṃ punarucyate? ityata āha - `ṭilopapavacanam` ityādi| `ārātīyaḥ` iti| anityatvājñāpanasya prayojanam| ārādbhavatīti <> [[4.2.114]] |`sthāmno'kāraḥ`(iti)| sthāmanśabdasya kevalasyāpatyārthe prayogo nāstīti tadantasyākārapratyayo vijñeyaḥ| aāsyeva sthāmāsyetyaātvāmā, pṛṣodāditvāt sakārasya takāraḥ| aātthāmno'patyamaātthāmaḥ, <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopaḥ|`lomno'patye` iti| lomaśabdo bāhvādiṣu paṭhate, tasya kevalasyāpatyena sambandho nāstīti tadantavidirvijñāyate| atrāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ bahuṣviñi prāpte tadapavāda evākāro vidhīyete| uḍulomno'patyāni bahūnyuḍulomāḥ|`sarvatra` iti| apatye ca anyatra ca|atha vā - prāgdīvyatīye cānyatra cārthe'jādipratyayaprasaṅgaṃ iti| ajādeḥ pratyayasya prasaṅgaḥ = prāptiḥ| tatra gośabdāt sarvatra yad bhavati| yadyevam, <> [[5.1.2]] ityatra gograhaṇaṃ kimartham? asyaiva prapañcārtham| `gavyam` iti| gorapatyam, gavā caratīti vā| aṇaṣṭhako vā'jāderyatrārthe prasaṅgastatra yadbhavati, nānyatra| `gorūpyam, gomayam` iti| `hetumanu,yebhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ` [[4.3.81]] , `mayaṭ ca` [[4.3.82]] |`ṇyādayaḥ` ityādi| lakṣamaśabdo nimittavacanaḥ,cihnavacano vā| arthaviśeṣo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya so'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇo'ṇapavādaḥ| tasmāt pūrvavipratiṣedhena ṇyādayo bhavanti| na cedaṃ vaktavyam; paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvāt tenaiva siddhatvāt| ādiśabdena <<utsādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.1.86]] ityevamādayaḥ pratyayā gṛhyante| tatra ṇyasyāvakāśaḥ bhavati - daityaḥ, vānaspatyamiti| ṇyaścāyaṃ sarveṣvapatyādiṣvartheṣu vidhīyata iti sāmānyapratyayo bhavatīti, ato nārthaviśeṣalakṣaṇaḥ| arthaviśeṣalakṣamasyāṇapavādasyāvakāśaḥ - dulerapatyamiti `itaścāniñaḥṭa [[4.1.122]] iti ḍhak - dauleyaḥ, ḍhagayamapatya evārthaveśeṣe vidhīyata ityarthaviśeṣalakṣaṇo bhavati| ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti - diterapatyaṃ daityaḥ, vanaspatīnāṃ samūho vānaspatyamiti vā, ṇyapratyayo bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena| arthaviśeṣalakṣaṇāditi kim? yo'ṇapavādo'rthasāmānyenārthaviśeṣe vihitaḥ sa paratvāṇṇyādīn bādhitvā bhavatyeva| uṣṭrapatirnāma pattram| tasyoṣṭrapateridamiti tasyedaṃ vivakṣāyām <> [[4.3.123]] ityañ - auṣṭrapatyam, tasyedaṃlakṣaṇo hrayamañaṇo'pavādaḥ, na yo'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇastasya| arthaviśeṣā hrapatyādayo'rthāḥ| tasyedamarthastu sāmānyam, nārthaviśeṣaḥ|`kathaṃ vaiteyaḥ`iti| yadi ṇyādayo'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇādaṇapavādāt pūrvavipratiṣedhana bhavanti, daiteya iti na sidhyati| atrāpi hi ṇyapratyayenaiva bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `ditiśabdāt` ityādi| ditiśabdo'yaṃ `do avakhaṇḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1148) ityasmāt `kticktau` [[3.3.174]] iti ktic, `dyatisyati` [[7.4.40]] ityādinettvamityevaṃ yadā vyutpādyate tadā `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ` (ga|sū|50) iti ṅīṣ| athāvyutpannaṃ prātipadikaṃ tadā `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke` (ga|sū|51) iti| nanu `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati` (vyā|pa|29) iti ditiśabdo gṛhramāṇo ditīśabdamapi grāhayati, tataśca yathā ditiśabdāṇṇyapratyayaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena bhavati, tathā ditīśabdādapi tena bhavitavyamityata āha -`liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā'nityā` iti| anityatvaṃ punarasyāḥ `acprakaraṇe śaktilāṅgalāṃkuśayaṣṭitomaraghaṭaghaṭīdhanuḥṣu graherupapasaṃkhyānam` (vā|235) iti ghaṭaśabdoccoraṇādveditavyam||`tadapavādānāñca` iti| iñādīnām| `vaṣkayā'se` iti gaṇe paṭhate| tasyāyamarthaḥ- vaṣkayaśabdādañ bhavati, ase asamāse ityarthaḥ| pūrvācāryaiḥ samāsasya `sa` ityeṣā saṃjñā kṛtā| vaṣkayasyāpatyaṃ vāṣkayaḥ| asa iti kim? `gauvaṣkayiḥ`| `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] itīñeva bhavati| `udasthānāddeśe` iti| udasthānaśabdāddeśe vācye'ñ bhavati| udasthāne bhavo deśa audasthānaḥ| deśa iti kim? udasthāno nāma kaścitpuruṣaḥ, tasyāpatyamaudasthāniḥ| `pṛṣadaṃśe` iti| pṛṣacchabdādaṃśe'bhidheya'ñ bhavati| pṛṣadoṃ'śaḥ pārṣadaḥ| aṃśa iti kim? pārṣado'nyaḥ| aṇeva bhavati| kuruśabdo'tra paṭhate, tasyāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ kaurava iti na sidhyati,yasmāt <> [[4.1.151]] <> [[4.1.172]] itica ṇyapratyayaḥ prāpnoti| añpratyayo hi sāmānyavihitaḥ, ṇyapratyayastu viśeṣavihitaḥ| sāmānyavihitaśca viśeṣavihitena bādhyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ayaṃ yogastayoryogayoranuvartiṣyate; tatrāpyapatye'rthe kuruśabdo'navakāśa ityañapi tato bhaviṣyati| apatyārthasya <> [[4.3.120]] ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ vā kaurava iti bhaviṣyati|`grīṣmādacchandasīti vaktavyam` (iti)| grīṣmaśabdādacchandasyabhideye'ñ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamityāha - `iha mā bhūt` ityādi| chandasi triṣṭuvādau vācye sandhivelādisūtreṇa [[4.3.16]] ṛtvaṇeva yathā syāt, añmā bhūdityevamartham| tena graiṣmī triṣṭuvityañ na bhavati| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - veti vartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena grīṣmaśabdācchandasi vācye'ñ na bhavatīti| `vṛttaṃ gṛhrate` iti| yasya triṣṭujjagatītyādayo viśeṣāstadiha vṛttam; ataśchando gṛhrate, na vedaḥ||`atra tāvat strīśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇam, na ṭābādistrīpratyayantasya śabdasya| tato hi <> [[4.1.120]] iti ḍhakaṃ vakṣati, tatsāhacaryāt puṃśabdo'pi taddharmaiva vijñāyate| tasyāpi svarūpagrahaṇeva| `pausnam` iti| `saṃyogānatasya lopaḥ` [[8.2.23]] iti lopaḥ|yadi prāgbhavanasaṃśabdanāt strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsanañau bhavataḥ, vatyarthe'pi tau syātām, tataśca strīvat, puṃvaditi na sidhyedityāha- `striyāḥ puṃvat` ityādi| yadayam `striyāṃ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] iti nirdeśaṃ karoti tato jñāyate - vatyarthe nañsnañau na bhavataḥ| nanu caitasmānnirdeśāt snañpratyayo vatyarthe na bhavatīti śakyaṃ vijñātum, na tu nañpratyayo na bhavatīti, tataśca strīvaditi na sidhyati? ityata āha - `yogāpekṣañca` ityādi| `puṃvat` iti nirdeśādayaṃ yogo vatyarthe na pravartate - ityavamarthamidaṃ yogāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam, na tu snañpratyayāpekṣam| tena strīvadityetadapi sidhyati||`prāgdīvyataḥ` iti| tasya svaritatvāt| `na bhavanātiti| viparyayāt| dvigoriti pañcamī ceyaṃ syāt? ṣaṣṭhī vā? tatra yadi pañcamī, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt - dvigoḥ parasyānapratyapratyayasya prāgdīyavyatīyasya lugbhavatīti| tataśca yathā dvigusaṃjñānimittasya lugbhavati - pañcakapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ puroḍāśaḥ pañcakapāla iti, tathā yo dviragornimittaṃ na bhavati tasyāpi syāt - pañcakapālasya puroḍāśasyedaṃ khaṇḍam| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ - pāñcakapālamiti| tamimaṃ pañcamīpakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā, ṣaṣṭīpakṣamāśrityāha - dvigoriti ṣaṣṭhī` iti| `dvigoryaḥ sambandhī` iti| yasya taddhitasyārthe <> [[2.1.51]] iti samāhāradvigurvidhīyate sa dvigoḥ sambandhīti; arthadvāreṇa tadarthasya dvigusambandhitvāt| so'pi taddvāreṇa dvigusambandhī| `nimittatvena`iti| anena nimittanaimittikabhāvena yaḥ sambandho tasya lugbhavati, na tu paurvāparyabhāvena yastasyeti darśayati| etacca nimittanaimittikabhāvasyāntaraṅgatvāllabhyate| sa hi dvigorādyastaddhitena sambandhaḥ; tasmāt sa gṛhrate| paurvāparyabhāvastūttarakālamapi bhavatīti bahiraṅgo bhavati, ato na tasya grahaṇam| `pañcakapālaḥ` iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛta iti `taddhitārtha` [[2.1.50]] iti samāsaḥ, <> [[2.1.52]] iti dvigusaṃjñā, <> [[4.4.3]] ityaṇ, tasya luk| `dvivedaḥ`iti| dvau vedāvadhīta iti pūrvavatsamāsaḥ, <> [[4.2.59]] ityaṇ|`dvaidevavattiḥ` iti| dvayordevadattayorapatyamiti `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] | `pañcakapālasyedamiti pāñcakapālam` iti| atra saṃskṛtārthe yaḥ prathamaḥ pratyaya utpannaḥ sa eva dvigornimittam, na tu ya uttarakālaṃ tasyedamityarthavivakṣāyām| na hi tasyārthe viṣayabhūte dvigurvihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? saṃskṛtārthe yo vihitastasya| tenādvigunimittatvāt `tasyedam` iti yo vihitastasyeha lugna bhavati| `atha vā` ityādi| pūrvaṃ hi dvigoryastaddhito nimittaṃ tasya lugvihitaḥ, idānīṃ dvigoreva vidhīyata ityasti viśeṣaḥ| kathaṃ punardvigoreva lugbhavati? ityata āha - `dvigoriti sthānaṣaṣṭhī` iti|`nanu ca` ityādinānantarokaktavyākhyānaṃ vighaṭayati| <> [[1.1.61]] itilugādikāḥ pratyayādarśanasyaitāḥ saṃjñā vihitāḥ, tato lugucyamāno'nena na śakto dvigoreva lukaṃ vidhātumityābhiprāyaḥ| `satyametat` iti| yadanantaramuktam| yadyevam, kathaṃ luksaṃjñāyā dvigorluglabhyate? ityata āha - `upācāreṇa tu` ityādi| atathābhūte vastuni yo'dhyāropitatathābhāvo jñānaviśeṣaḥ sa upacāraḥ| lakṣyate'nayeti lakṣaṇā, sāpunarihopacāra eva `etena hṛdvigurūpastaddhito dvigurūpatayā lakṣyate| yathā mañcāḥ krośantītyatrāmañcarūpā api puruṣā mañcarūpatayā lakṣyante, tathehāpyadvigurūpastaddhito dvigurūpatayā| upacārasya tu nibandhanaṃ dvigunimittabhūtatvam, yadāha - ` dvigunimittabhūtaḥ pratyaya eva dviguḥ` iti| bhavati hi kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ, yathā - āyurghṛtamiti| `dvigunimittako'pi tarhi` ityādi| dvigurnimittaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| yo dharma upacārasya nibandhanaṃ sa iha guṇaśabdena vivakṣitaḥ| guṇanimittā kalpanā = guṇanimittakalpanā, sā punarupacārātmikaiva veditavyā| yadyupacāreṇa dvigornimittaṃ pratyayo'pi dvigurucyate, dviguryasya nimittaṃ so'pa#i gauṇyā kalpanayā kasmāddviguriti nocyate? kārye'pi hi kāraṇaśabda upacārāt prayujyamāno vidyata eva, yathā - purātanaṃ sarvamidaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karma bhujyata iti| `pāñcakapālam` iti| pañcakapālasya puroḍāśasyedaṃ khaṇḍamityaṇ, sa ca dvigorutpannatvāddvigunimittaka ityabhiprāyaḥ| na tasya dvigutvaṃ nimittamiti niṣpannatvāddvagostaddhitasyotpadyamānasya na dvigutvaṃ nimittaṃ, kiṃ tarhi? prātipadikam| tathā hi - nāsau dvigurityevaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? prātipadikādityevam| tasmāt sannihitā'pi dvigutā na pratyayasya nimittamiti, na ca pratyayo dvigurityupacāreṇa vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyata iti| `itarastu` iti| taddhitapratyayaḥ, yas mūlodāharaṇe lugdarśitaḥ| `dvigutvasyaiva nimittam` iti| evakāreṇa prātipadikasya vyavacchedaḥ kriyate - dvigutvasyaiva nimittam, na tu prātipadikatvasya; yatastadarthe dvigusamāso vidhīyate,na tu prātipadikatvamityasti viśeṣaḥ| tataśca dvigoryo nimittaṃ tatraiva dvigutvavyapadeśa upācārādbhavati| na tu niṣpannāddvigorya utpadyate tatrāpi|`yadyevamityādi| yadi dvigoryo nimittaṃ taddhitaḥ so'tra nimittatvādupācāreṇa dvigurucyate tasya lopo bhathavi| evaṃ satīha kathaṃ lopaḥ - pañcakapālyāṃ saṃskṛtaḥ pañcakapāla iti? atra hi pañcānāṃ kapālānāṃ samāhāra iti samāhāre dvigau niṣpanne tatastūttarakālaṃ taddhito vidhīyamāno na dvigornimittaṃ bhavati| `naivātra` ityādi parihāraḥ| kasmānnotpadyata ityāha - `traiśabdyaṃ hi` ityādi| traya eva śabdāḥ = traiśabdyam| cāturvaṇryāditvāt svārthe ṣyañ| ihāsmābhistraiśabdyaṃ sādhyam| pañcakapālīśabdastaddhitotpattimantareṇāpi siddhatīti na tasmāt taddhita utpadyate| `pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ` ityādinā traiśabdyaṃ darśayati| `dvayoḥ śabdayoḥ` ityādi| yaśca samāhāre pañcakapālīśabdaḥ, yaśca taddhitārthaviṣaye samāse pañcakapālaśabdastau dvāvapi samānārthau,tayorekena pūrveṇa vigraha eveti tasmānna taddhitotpattirvijñeyā| `aparasmādutpattiḥ` iti| pañcakapālaśabdāt| avyavikanyāyena| yathā'vermāṃsamāvikamityaviśabdena vigrahaḥ,aviśabdastu pratyayamutpādayati tadvadihāpi|`atheha kasmānna bhavati` ityādi| rūpyamayaṭāvapi hi dvigornimittabhūtau, atastayorapi lukā bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `vetyanuvartate` iti <> [[4.1.82]] ityataḥ| nanvevamapi sarvatra vikalpena luk prāpnotītyata āha - `sā ca` ityādi| ca śabdo hetau| yasmāt sā vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate, tena pañcakapāla ityādau nityaṃ lugbhavati| pañcagargarūpyamityādau na bhavatyeva||`aci` iti| yadyeṣā parasaptamī syācchavidhāvitaretarāśrayatā prasajyeta| katham? gargasyāpatyāni bahuni <> [[4.1.105]] , tasya yadi luk syāccho na syāt| lupte'pi tasmin <> [[1.1.62]] iti cet? <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalopapratiṣedhādvṛddhyabhāvena vṛddhasaṃjñā na syāt, tataśca vṛddhalakṣaṇaccho na syāt| tasmādvṛddhatvaṃ prātipadikasya vāñchato'luk pūrva syāt| sa cāluka che parato yadi bhavati tataścālugvinimittaśchaḥ, tannimittaścālugitivyaktamitaretarāśrayatvam| tadimaṃ parasaptamyāṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣayasaptamīyamiti darśayannāha -`ajādau prāgdīvyatīye viṣayabhūte` iti| viṣayabhūte = anutpanna eva buddhistha ityarthaḥ| `gārgīyāḥ` iti| gargasyāpatyāni bahūni| gargāditvādyañ [[4.1.105]] | tasya gargāṇāñchātrā ityarthavivakṣāyāmajādāvanutpanne buddhyabhimukhīkṛte viṣayabhūte <> [[4.1.101]] itiyo luk prāpnoti tasyānena pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, tataścādivṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ tannibandhanāyāṃ ca vṛddhasaṃjñāyām <> [[4.2.114]] iti cchaḥ, īyādeśaḥ, <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralopaḥ, <<āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti>> [[6.4.151]] ita yakārasya| `vāstīyāḥ` iti| pūrveṇa tulyam| `ātreyīyāḥ` iti| attrerapatyāni bahūni| <> [[4.1.122]] iti ḍhak, tasya `attribhṛgukutsa` [[2.4.65]] ityādinā luki prāpte'trīṇāṃ chātrā iti cche viṣayabhūte tasya pratiṣedhaḥ| `khārapāyaṇīyāḥ` iti| kharapasyāpatyāni bahūni| <> [[4.1.99]] , <> [[2.4.63]] iti tasya prāptasya lukaḥ kharapāṇāṃ chātrā iti cche viṣayabhūte pratiṣedhaḥ|`kaubalam, vādaram` iti| kubalīvadarīśabdau gaurādiṅīṣantau pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau, tayoḥ śeṣamanudāttam| tena kubalyā vikāraḥ phalam, vadaryā vikāraḥ phalamityarthavivakṣāyām| <> [[4.2.44]] tasya <> [[4.3.163]] iti tayorlug yaḥ prāpnoti tasya kubalasyedaṃ vadarasyedamityarthavivakṣāyāmajādau che viṣayabhūte pratiṣedho na bhavati; gotragrahaṇāt| gotre yaḥ pratyayo vācakatvena vartate tasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam| na cāyamañ gotre vācakatvena vartate, api tu vikāre, tena tasya lugbhavatyeva| tasmin sati `luktaddhitaluki` [[1.2.49]] iti strīpratyayasyāpi luk| añi lupte vṛddhyabhāvādvṛddhatvaṃ nāstītyaṇeva bhavati, na tu cchaḥ| `gargarūpyam, gargamayam` iti| pūrvavadrūpamayaṭau| yadyatrāluk syādgāgryarūpyaṃ gāgryamayamiti syāt| `gārgīyam` iti| <> [[5.1.5]] iti `prākkrītācchaḥ` [[5.1.1]] iti cchaḥ, sa ca prāgdīvyatīyo na bhavati; dīvyataḥ pareṇa vidhānāt| `gotrasya` iti| gotrapratyayasya| `bahuṣu lopinaḥ` iti| bahuṣvartheṣūtpannasya yasya lopo vidhīyate sa bahuṣu lopī| `bahuvacanāntasya pravṛttau` iti| pravṛttiḥ = arthāntarasaṃkrāntiḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati - bahuvacanāntasyārthāntarasaṃkrāntāviti| sā cārthāntarasaṃkrāntāviti| sā cārthāntarasaṃkrāntistadantādyadā yūni pratyaya utpadyate tadā bhavatīti veditavyam; tadā gotrāntasya yūni pravṛtteḥ| `dvayekayoḥ` iti| yadā gotrapratyayāntādekasminnarthe yūni dvayorvā yūnoḥ utpadyate tadā'rthāntarasaṃkrāntau satyāmalugbhavati| bidasyāpatyānibahuni| `anuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ña` [[4.1.104]] ityañ, sa ca <> [[2.4.64]] iti bahuṣu lugvidhānādbahuṣu lopī bhavati, tadantādyuvavivakṣāyāmekasmin yūni dvayorvā `ata iñ` (4|195), tasya ṇyakṣattriyādisūtreṇa (2|458) luki kṛte gotrapratyayāntasya tasyārthāntarasaṃkrāntau satyāṃ gotrapratyayasyāña ihāpi bahuṣūtpannasya lagna bhavati| kathaṃ punarna bhavati, yāvatā'luko viṣayābhāvāt prāgdīvyatīyo'jātiriñ pratyaya upanītaḥ? pratyayalakṣaṇam` (vyā|pa|96) iti ca paribhāṣā| yathā gave hitaṃ gohitamiti caturthīsamāse subluki kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena caturthīvibhaktimāśritya gośabdasya `eco'yavāyāvaḥ` ityavādeśo na bhavati; varṇāśrayatvāt| varṇāśrayatvaṃ tu tasyāci vidhānāt| yathā ca `varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇamṭa (vyā|pa|96) iti paribhāṣā, tathā baidaḥ, baidau - ityatrāpyalukā varṇāśrayatayā na bhavitavyam? naitadasti, na hralugatra varṇāśrayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? taddhitāśrayaḥ| acītyetat tviha sūtre viśeṣaṇatvenoktam| ata eva vṛttāvuktam - ajādau prāgdīvyatīye pratyaya iti| tasmāt tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā ihovasthāne'sati `gotre'lugaci` iti bhavatīti, anenaivātrāluk siddhaḥ| sa ca bahuṣu yuvasu mā bhūditi dvayekayorevetyupasaṃkhyānam| tatra bidā ityeva bhavati|`ekavacanadvivacanāntasya` ityādi| ekavacanāntatasya gotrapratyayasya dvivacanāntasya ca bahuṣvartheṣu yuvasaṃjñakeṣu pravṛttau saṃkrāntau satyāṃ lugvaktavyaḥ| tatra baidasyetyekavacanāntaṃ gotram, baidayoriti dvivacanāntam| atra ca pūrvavadañ, tayoryuvāpatyabahutvavivakṣāyām `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] | tasya ṇyakṣattriyādisūtreṇa [[2.4.58]] luki kṛte'ño'pi gotrapratyayasya lugiṣyate| sa ca na prāpnoti, tasmādupasaṃkhyāyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na prāpnoti? ityāha - `na hyatra` ityādi| <> [[2.4.64]] iti anena hi bahuṣūtpannorlugvidhīyate, na cāñ huhaṣūtpanna,kiṃ tarhi? ekasmin dvayośca, tasmānna prāpnotīti| tadevaṃ sarvathā bahuṣu bidā ityevaṃ bhavitavyamiti sthitam||`yūni` iti| <> [[3.1.85]] iti ṣaṣṭharthe saptamī| ata eva vṛttāvāha -`yuvapratyayasya` iti| ajādau pratyaye vivakṣite buddhisya ityādinā'cīti viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| yadyeṣāṃ parasaptamī syāt, yatrāpi cchapratyayo neṣyate tatrāpi syāt| yuvapratyayāntasya buddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|`phāṇṭāhmatarūpyam, phāṇṭāhmatamayam` iti| yadyatra luk syāt, phāṇṭāhmatarūpyaṃ phāṇṭāhmatamayamiti na syāt| `bhāgavittikīyam` iti| prākkrītīyacchaḥ [[5.1.1]] pūvavat||`gārgīyāḥ, vātsīyāḥ` iti| pūrvapadakārayakāralopaḥ| `vā` [[4.1.82]] iti vartamāne'nyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ `pūrvasūtre nityo vidhiḥ` iti jñāpanārtham||`pūrvairuttaraiśca pratyayairabhisaṃbadhyate` iti| tatra pūrvaistāvadaṇādibhiḥ sambadhyate; asaṃyuktavidhānāt| asya yadi pūrvairabhisambandho na bhavet `tasyāpatyamata iñ` ityekayogameva kuryāt| yatastu `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] ityanena <> [[4.1.92]] ityetadasaṃyuktaṃ karoti, tato'saṃyuktavidhānātpūrvārthametadvijñāyata ityevaṃ tāvatpūrvairabhisambadhyate| uttarairapyabhisambadhyate; teṣvasya svaritatvāt| `tasya` iti| puṃlliṅgena nirdeśaḥ kriyate, ekavacanena ca| tena puṃlliṅgādevotpattiḥ syāt, ekavacanāntācca| strīliṅgānnapuṃsakācca na syāt - devadattāyā apatyam, kulasyāpatyamevamādau na syāt| dvivacanabahuvacanāntācca - dvayormātrorapatyam, tisṛṇāṃ mātṛṇāmapatyevamādau na syāt| atha napuṃsakaliṅgenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ? strīliṅgāt puṃlliṅgācca na syāt| apatyamityekavacane'tra nirdeśaḥ kriyate, tenaikasminnevāpatye syāt, na dvayornāpi bahuṣu - upagorapatye aupagavau; upagorapatyānyaupagavā iti| etasmin pūrvapakṣa idamāha - `prakṛtyartaviśiṣṭaḥ` ityādi| `gṛhrate` iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| prakṛtyartha upagavādiśabdānāmarthaḥ,tena viśiṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭhartho'patyāpatyavatsambandhaḥ| nanu ca tasyātra tacchabdasya sāmānyavācino grahaṇam, tasya kṛta upagavādirarthaviśeṣaḥ, yena ṣaṣṭhartho viśiṣyate? tasyetyasya viśeṣopalakṣaṇatvādadoṣāḥ| viśeṣopalakṣaṇatvaṃ cāsya prāgeva pratipāditam| tasmādviśeṣa evopagvādiḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ| `apatyamātrañca` iti| mātraśabdo'dhikasya liṅgādevryavacchedāya|`liṅgavacanādikam` iti| ādiśabdena kālasya grahaṇam| vartamānena hi kālenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate| yathoktam - `yatrāpi sākṣādanyakriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāpyastirbhavantīparaḥ prathamapuruṣo'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyate` iti| tatra vartamānakālavivakṣāyāṃ kālāntare na syāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ liṅgavacanādi na vivakṣyate? tasyāpradhānyāt| avaśyaṃ hi yena kenacilliṅgādinā nirdeśaḥ kartavya iti, nāntarīyakatvāt| tasyehopādānam, yathā - dhānyārthinaḥ palālāderapradhānasyāpi|`tasyedam` ityādi| <> [[4.3.120]] ityetatsūtramapatyārthe'pi vartate| yo hrupagorapatyamupagorasāvayamiti śakyate vyapadeṣṭum| tasyedamityasya viśeṣā hrete - apatyam, samūhaḥ, nivāsaḥ, vikāra iti| tataśca <> [[4.3.120]] ityanenaivāpatyārthe'pyaṇ siddhaḥ, tat kimarthaṃ tasyāpatyamityetat sūtraṃ kṛtam? `bādhanārtham kṛtaṃ bhavet` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] ityanena vidhīyamānasyāṇo yo bādhakaḥ <> [[4.2.114]] iti cchaḥ prāpnoti, tadbādhanārthamidaṃ kṛtam| etatsūtravihitenāṇā chapratyayasya bādhanaṃ yathā syāt| kathaṃ punaraśaiṣikaḥ śaiṣikaṃ bādhate? apatyādibhyaścaturarthīparyantebhyo'nyoṣaḍarthaḥ śaiṣikāṇāṃ viṣayaḥ| ayaṃ cāpatyācchaviṣaye nāstyeva| tadasannayaṃ kathaṃ chapratyayaṃ bādhiṣyata ityata āha - `utsargaḥ śeṣa evāsau` iti| asatyasmin yoga ityabhiprāyaḥ| asāvityanena prakṛtatvāt tasyāpatyamityeṣo'rthaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| utsarga utpannenāpyaṇā sa evārtha utsargasāhacaryāducyate| utsargasāhacaryantu tasya tatrotsargasyāṇādervidhānāt| ihāpi kriyamāṇe <> [[4.1.92]] ityetasmin yoge <> [[4.3.120]] ityetasminnanupraveśādyathānyastadviśeṣaḥ śeṣo bhavati tathā'patyārtho'pi| asti tasyāpyupayuktāpekṣamanyatvam, `caturarthīparyanteṣvanantarbhāvāt| tataśca śeṣatvādapatyārthe cchapratyayaḥ prāpnoti| asmastu yoge <> [[4.3.120]] ityatra śeṣe nānupraviśati; upayuktatvāt| tataścāśeṣatvādapatye chapratyayasya chapratyayasya prāptirnāstyeva| saivāprāptirbādhanaśabdenoktā| atha bādhanārthasyāsya kiṃ prayojanamityāha - `vṛddhānyasya prayojanam` iti| vṛddhāni prātipadikānyasya yogasya prayojanam| bhānorapatyaṃ bhānavaḥ, śyāmagorapatyaṃ śyāmagava ityatrāṇ siddho bhavati| asati tvasmin yoke'patyārthaḥ pūrvoktarītyā śeṣaḥ syāt| tataśca tatra vṛddhebhyacaḥ <> [[4.2.114]] prasajyeta||`kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasaṃpratyayaḥ`(vyā|pa|6) iti paribhāṣikasyaiva gotrasya grahaṇam| apatyādhikāre gotragrahaṇācca| apatyamātraṃ hi laukikaṃ gotram, tasya yadīha grahaṇamabhimataṃ syādeka ityevaṃ brāūyāt, laukikasya gotrāpatyādhikārādeva labdhatvāt| tasmādgotragrahaṇācca pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇamatyāha -`apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram` iti| `bhedena` ityādi| bhedena = vibhāgena, apatyamapatyaṃ prati = pratyayatyam| yāvantyapatyāni sambhavanti tebhyo'pi sarvebhyaḥ pratyayānāmutpatteḥ prasaṅge prāptau satyāmityarthaḥ| sarveṣāmapatyena yogena gargagārgigāgryagāgryāyaṇānāmanyatamasya yadapatyaṃ tatsarveṣāmapatyaṃ bhavatīti paramaprakṛteranantaragotramuvalakṣaṇāḥ pratyayāḥ prāpnuvanti| gargasya yadapatyaṃ tatsarveṣāṃ gārgigāgryagāgryāyaṇānāmapi sambandhi bhavati| tathā hyatra yadyapi gargasyāpatyamiti gargaśabdena vigrahaḥ kriyate, tathāpi nāyaṃniyamo labhyate - gargaśabdādevotpattiriti, api tu kāmacāraḥ| tataśca yadā gargaśabdādutpattirbhavati tadā gargāditvādyañ [[4.1.105]] , yadā gārgiśabdāt tadā <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak, yadāpi gāgryaśabdāt tadāpi sa eva phak, yadā gāgryāyamaśabdāt tadā `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] | evaṃ pratyapatyaṃ vibhāgena pratyayānāmutpattau prasaktāyāmanena niyamaḥ kriyate - `eka eva pratyayo bhavati` iti| etena pratyayaniyama iti darśayati| pratyayaniyamastvekastvekaśabdasya pratyayaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāllabhyate| ekaśabdaścāsminniyame saṃkhyāvacano veditavyaḥ yathā -ekaḥ,dvau, bahava iti| evakāreṇa dvayādivyavacchedaḥ kriyate - eka eva pratyayo bhavati,na dvau, nāpi bahava iti| sa caikaḥ pratyayo bhavannekagrahaṇāt paramaprakṛtereva bhavatīti sāmarthyāduktaṃ bhavatīti| yadi hi gārgiśabdādutpadyet, dvau syātām - iñphakau, naikaḥ? atha gāgryaśabdādevamapi dvāveva - yañphakau? atha gāgryāyaṇaśabdāt, trayaḥ syuḥ - yañphagiñaḥ| tasmānmūlaprakṛterevotpattāvekaḥ pratyayaḥ sidhyatītyekagrahaṇaṃ kurvatā sāmarthyānmūlaprakṛtereva gotrapratyayasyotpattiruktā bhavati| nanu cotpādayitaivāpatyena sambadhyate, evaṃ hi loke dṛśyate - pitāmahasyotsaṅge dārakamāsīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaścit pṛcchati - kasyāyamiti? sa āha - devadattasyeti, tenotpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati, nātmānam? tataḥ sarveṣāmapatyena yogābhāvāt pratyapatyaṃ bhedena pratyayotpattiprasaṅgo nāstyeveti nivarttyābhāvādidaṃ niyamārthaṃ nārabdhamityata āha - `sarve'patyena yujyante` iti|atraivopapattimāha - `apatanādapatyam` iti| yannimittaṃ hi yasy pāpeṣvapatanaṃ tadapatanāt tasyāpatyaṃ bhavati| tasmādyo vyavahitena janitaḥ so'pi paramaprakṛtivācyasyārthasyāpatyaṃ bhavati,tasyāpi yenāpatanāt| paramaprakṛtigrahaṇañcopalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam| itaraprakṛtivācyasyāpi hrarthasyāvyavahitajanito'patyaṃ bhavatyeva| yatpunaruktam - kasyāyamityukte utpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati, nātmānamiti, na tenotpādayiturevāpatyena yogaḥ, śakyate pratipādayitum| yasmānna tatra yasya tenāpatanaṃ sa jijñāsitaḥ syāt, kiṃ tarhi? ya utpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati nātmānam| yadi yasya tu tenāpatanaṃ sa jijñāsitaḥ syāt, tadā''tmānamapi vyapadiśedeva| yadi ca sarve'patyena na yujyeran, `apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram` [[4.1.162]] iti yo'yamapatyapautraprabhṛtiśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeśaḥ, sa nopapadyate; yadapekṣayā pautrādivyapadeśamāsādayanti pumāṃsastaṃ prati teṣāmanapatyatvāt| tasmādato'pi nirdeśāt - sarve'patyena yujyanta iti vijñāyate| `tatputtro'pi gārgyaḥ` iti| apiśabdāt tatpautrādirapi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatputtro'pi gāgrya ityāha - `sarvasmin` ityādi| yadapi gārgyāyaṇa ityatraikena vyavahitena janitaṃ gotrāpatyaṃ yasmāt tatrāpi gargaśabdādyañeva bhavati, tasmāt tatputtro'pi gāgryo bhavati| gargaśabdādityanena paramaprakṛterbhavatīti darśayati| etaccaikagrahaṇāllabhyata ityuktam|`atha vā` ityādinā prakṛtiniyamaṃ darśayati prakṛtiniyamastvekaśabdasya prakṛtisāmānādhikaraṇyāllabhyate| ekaśabdo'tra prāthamyaniyame vartata iti veditavyam, yathā - vargāṇāṃ prathamadvitīyāḥ saṃvṛtakaṇṭhāḥ āāsānupradānā aghoṣā eke'lpaprāṇā itare sarve mahāprāṇā iti| atra hi prathame'lpaprāṇā iti gamyate| ekaśabdasyedaṃ vivaraṇam - `prathamā prakṛtiḥ` iti| kā ca prathamā? yā paramaprakṛtirapratyayāntā `garga naḍa` ityevamādikā| `prakṛtirniyamyate` iti| prathamaiva prakṛtiḥ pratyayamutpādayati, nāprathamā - gārgigāgryagāgryāyaṇaprabhṛtiśabdāḥ pratyayāntāḥ| gargasyāpatyaṃ gārgyaḥ, tatputtro'pi gārgyaḥ| naḍasyāpatyaṃ nāḍāyanaḥ, tatputtro'pi nāḍāyanaḥ| sarvatra vyavahitajanite'pi gotrāpatye prathamā prakṛtiḥ pratyayamutpādayati||`ayamapi niyamaḥ` iti| na kevalaṃ pūrvaḥ - ityapiśabdena darśayati| sarveṣāṃ hrapatyena yoge paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhyo'pi yuvāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, atastannivṛttyarthaṃ niyamaḥ kriyate| `gotrādeva`iti| gotrapatyayāntādevetyarthaḥ| anena niyamasvarūpaṃ darśayati| `na parama` ityādinā niyamasya vyavacchedyam| `gāgryāyaṇaḥ, dākṣāyaṇaḥ` iti| gotre yau yañiñau vihitau tadantāt <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak| `aupagaviḥ` nāḍāyaniḥ` iti| gotre yāvaṇphakau vihitau tadantāt `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] |`dākṣī` iti| vakṣasyāpatyaṃ caturtha strī| `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] , <> [[4.1.65]] iti ṅīṣ|`kiṃ punaratra pratiṣidhyate` iti| sarvasmin pratiṣidhyamāne doṣaṃ manyate| tameva doṣamāviṣkartumāha - `yadi` ityādi| `striyāmaniyamaḥ prāpnoti` iti| paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhyo'pi striyāṃ yuvapratyayaḥ prāpnotītyarthaḥ| `gotrasaṃjñāyā yuvasaṃjñayā bādhitatvāt` iti| `jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā` ityatra tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ kṛtaḥ| tena abhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti| `tasmāt` ityādi| yata eva ca niyamayuvapratyayayorubhayorapi pratiṣedhe doṣaḥ, tasmāt tannirāsāya yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ| tatra ` gotrādyūni` ityeko yogaḥ, anena ca niyamaḥ kriyate, yadāha - `gotrād yūni pratyayo bhavati` iti| tataḥ `astri yām` iti dvitīyo yogaḥ| tena ca yūnītyatra yaduktaṃ kāryaṃ tasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, yadāha - `yūni yaduktaṃ striyāṃ tanna bhavati` iti| `yuvasaṃjñaiva pratiṣidhyate` iti| katham? `astriyām` ityatra hi yoge yūnītyetadanuvartate, tenaivaṃ vijñāyate - yūni yaduktaṃ kāryaṃ striyāṃ tanna bhavatīti| yuvasaṃjñā ca yūnyeva kāryayuktetyataḥ saiva pratiṣidhyate| `yuvasaṃjñaiva` iti| evakāreṇa niyamayuvapratyayovryavacchedaḥ kriyate| `tena strī gotrapatyayenābhidhāsyate` iti| tasyāṃ yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ gotrasaṃjñāyā avicalatvāt||`ataḥ`ityanena prakṛtaṃ prātipadikaṃ viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyata āha - `akārāntāt prātipadikāt` iti| athāta iti `ata sātatyagamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-34) ityasya kvibantasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? <<śivādibhyo'ṇ>> [[4.1.112]] iti vacanāt| taddhīño bādhanārthaṃ kriyate| yadi ceha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, śivādibhyaḥ prasaṅga eva nāstīti tebhyastadbādhanārthamaṇvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, krauḍaādīnāñceñantānāṃ pāṭhāt| tasmādakārāntasyaivedaṃ grahaṇam| yadyevam, asyāpatyamirityatra na prāpnoti, anakārāntatvāt? etadapi vyapadeśivadbhāvenākārāntaṃ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `śubhaṃyāḥ, kīlālapāḥ` iti| yāteḥ, pibateśca <<āto maninkvanibvanipaśca>> [[3.2.74]] ityatra hi `vijupeśchandasi` [[3.2.73]] ityataścakāreṇa vijapyanukṛṣyate|`katham` ityādi| daśarathaśabdādapyakārāntadiñā bhavitavyam| tataḥ `dāśarathāya` ityaṇantasya prayogo nopapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| `śeṣavivakṣāyām` ityādi| etena daśarathasyāyamityarthavivakṣāyāmatrāṇa vihitaḥ, na tu <> [[4.1.92]] ityarthavivakṣāyāmiti darśayati| yadā tu daśarathasyāpatyamiti vivakṣyate, tadeñbhavatyeva - dāśarathiriti||`bāhaviḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.146]] | `kvacit` iti| ajīgartāviṣkārānteṣu| bāhuprabhṛtīnāṃ vaṭākuparyantānāmanakārāntatvāt prāptyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| cūḍāśabdasya ca `dvaya caḥ` [[4.1.121]] iti ḍhaki prāpte| vṛkalādīnāṃ prāk puṣkarasacchabdāt `avṛddhābhyo nadīmānuṣībhyaḥ` [[4.1.113]] ityaṇi prāpte| puṣkarasadityevamādīnāṃ lomaśabdaparyantānāṃ prāptyarthaḥ, anakārāntatvāt|`amitaujasaḥ salopaśca` iti| amitaujasśabdādiñ bhavati, salopaśca| āmitaujiḥ| udañcviti paṭhate, tatrāñcaterdhātoścakāro veditavyaḥ| nāyaṃ punarakārāntaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? kvinnantaḥ, pratyayavelāyāṃ nipātanādanunāsakilopo na bhavati| udīco'patyamaudañciḥ| śiraḥ śabdastadantavidhiṃ prayojayati, kevalasya napuṃsakasyāpatyena sambandhābhāvāt| hastiśiraso'patyaṃ hāstiśīrṣiḥ, <> [[6.1.61]] ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccalomno'patyam - audhrvalomiḥ| ajīgartādīnāṃ prāgudaṅkaśabdāt `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇi` [[4.1.114]] ityādināṇibādhake prāpte| `udaṅkaḥ saṃjñāyām` iti| udaṅko nāma kaścit, tasyāpatyamaudaṅkiḥ| `sambhūyo'mbhasoḥ salopaśca` (iti)| sambhūyas, ambhasityetayoriñ bhavati, sakāralopaśca - sāmbhūyiḥ,āmbhiḥ| `bāhvādiprabhṛtiṣu` iti| prabhṛtiśabdeneta ūdhrvaṃ ye vakṣyante te parigṛhyante| `yeṣāṃ darśanaṃ gotrabhāve laukike` iti| darśanaṃ = prasiddhiḥ| laukike gotre bhāvaḥ = saṃjñākāritvam| yeṣāṃ laukikagotrabhāve prasiddhisteṣāṃ bāhvādiṣu parigraho draṣṭavyaḥ| `tato'nyatra teṣāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ` iti| yeṣāṃ laukike gotrabhāve na darśanamapi tu tato'nyatra darśanam, teṣāṃ pratiṣedho veditavyaḥ| tena bāhurnāma kaścidādipuruṣo yaḥ saṃjñākāritvena prasiddho yadapatyasantānāntaḥ pātinaḥ pumāṃso bāhuvyapadeśamāsādayanti, tata eveñ bhavati| yastvidālīntano bāhurnāma kaścit tato'ṇeva bhavati - bāhava iti| etacca vetyanuvṛttevryavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāccalabhyate| sambandhiśabdānāñca āśurādīnāñca yatkāryamucyate tasya tatsādṛśyāt pratiṣedho bhavati| atrāpi pūrvokta eva heturveditavyaḥ| rājaāśurādyat` [[4.1.137]] iti āśuraśabdādyatpratyayaḥ sambandhiśabdādeva bhavati, na saṃjñāśabdāt| tena āśuro nāma kaścit, tasyāpatyaṃ āāśuritīñeva bhavati| `saṃjñāāśurasya` iti| saṃjñayā yaḥ āśuraḥ, na sambandhena sa saṃjñāāśuraḥ||`vyāsavaruḍa` ityādi| vyāsādīnāmiñ, tatsanniyogena cākaṅādeśo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - pūrvasūtrāmiha cakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ,tena vyāsādīnāmapi bhaviṣyati| `vaiyāsakiḥ` iti| `na yvābhyām` [[7.3.3]] ityādinaijvṛddhipratiṣedhau| atha bāhvādiṣveva sudhātṛśabdamadhītya tatra cākaṅādeśaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, yathā - amitaujasaḥ salopaśceti gaṇe paṭhate? sūtre vā, na tatra kaścillāghavābhāvādviśeṣo labhyata iti yatkiñcidetat||`iño'pavādaḥ` iti| akārāntatvāt kuñjādīnām| `cakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ`iti| yadyatra cakāro na kriyeta tataḥ <> [[5.3.113]] ityatrāpi naiva kriyate, cphañpratyayasyābhāvāt| tataśca `vātaphañorastriyām` ityucyamāne `aāādibhyaḥ phañ` [[4.1.110]] ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt| `kauñjāyanyaḥ, kauñjāyanyau` iti| `pūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt` [[5.3.112]] ityataḥ `ñyaḥ` ityanuvartamāne <> [[5.3.113]] iti svārtha ñyaḥ| `kauñjāyanāḥ` iti| `ñyādayastadrājā-` [[5.3.119]] iti tadrājasaṃjñakatvāt `tadrājasya bahuṣu` [[2.4.62]] ityādinā luk| kiṃ punaratra ñitvasvareṇa bhavitavyam? uta citsvareṇa? ityata āha - `ekavacanadvivacanayoḥ` ityādi| ekavacanadvivacanayostāvat sati tasmin citsvare paścād ñye vihite samupajāyamāno ñitsvaraḥ satiśiṣṭo bhavatīti tenaiva bhavitavyam| bahuvacane tu ñye nivṛtte prāpte taṃ tyaktvā citsvara eveṣyate| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi sa labhyate, citkaraṇasāmarthyāditi cet na; ñitkaraṇasāmarthyād ñitsvaro'pi labhyate| evaṃ tarhi svaravidhau yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate,idamasti - `citaḥṭa [[6.1.157]] iti; tataḥ `taddha#itasya` [[6.1.158]] iti, tatra `citaḥ` ityevānuvartate| kimarthamidam? paratvāt <<ñnityādirnityam>> [[6.1.197]] ityādyudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti, tadbādhanārtham| tataḥ `kitaḥ` [[6.1.159]] iti, kitaśca taddhitasyānta udātto bhavati||naḍādiṣu `śalaṅku śalaṅkañca` iti paṭhate| tasyāyamarthaḥ- śalaṅkuśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati śalaṅkabhāvaṃ cāpadyate, tena śālaṅkāyana iti bhavati| `pailādiṣu `iti| pailādiṣu śālaṅkiśabda iñantaḥ paṭhate, tata utpannasya yuvapratyayasya lugyathā syāt - `śālaṅki pitā, śālaṅkiḥ putraḥ` iti| tatra hi `ṇyakṣattriyārṣañitaḥ` [[2.4.58]] ityādeḥ sūtrāt `yūni luk` iti cānuvartate, tasya śālaṅgiśabdasya tatra pāṭho na yujyate - naḍādiṣu pāṭhāt phakā bhavitavyamiti kṛtvā, tat kathamiñantastatra paṭhata iti codyam| tasya parihāramāha - `gotraviśeṣe` ityādi| kauśikaṃ yadgotraṃ tatraiva śalaṅkuśabdādācāryaḥ phakaṃ smaranti, tato'nyatra tviñeva bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| sa tviñ bāhvāderākṛtigaṇatvāllabhyate| abhyupetyāpi gotramātre phako vidhānam| parihārāntaramāha - `atha vā` ityādi| iño bhāva upalakṣaṇam| śalaṅkabhāvasyāpi hi pailādipāṭha eva jñāpakam| pūrvatrāpi parihāre tasya eva jñāpakaṃ veditavyam| `agniśarman vṛṣagaṇe` iti| agniśarmañśabdādvṛṣagaṇe gotre phagbhavati - āgniśarmāyaṇaḥ| anyatrāṇeva - āgniśarmaḥ| `amuṣya` iti paṭhate| tatarnipātanādvibhakteraluk - āmuṣyāyaṇa iti| `kṛṣṇaraṇau brāāhṛṇavāśiṣṭhayoḥ` iti| kṛṣṇaraṇaśabdau yathākramaṃ brāāhṛṇe vāśiṣṭhe cābhidheye phakamutpādayataḥ| kāṣrṇāyano brāāhṛṇaḥ| rāṇāyaṇo vaśiṣṭhaḥ| vaśiṣṭhagotra ityarthaḥ| anyatreñeva bhavati - kāṣṇaḥ, rāṇiriti| `kroṣṭu kroṣṭañca` iti paṭhate| kroṣṭuśabdaḥ phakamutpādayati, kroṣṭañcāpadyate - krauṣṭāyanaḥ||`na ca` ityādi codyam| `satyametat` ityādi parihāra ucyate| gotre yo'ñ vihitastadantebhyo haritādibhyaḥ phak| na ca gotrapratyayādaparo gotrapratyayayaḥ sambhavati| tatra sāmarthyādagotrādhikāre'pi yūni pratyayo vijñāyate| yadyevam, gotrādhikāraḥ kimarthaḥ? ityāha - `gotrādhikāra uttarārthaḥ` iti||atha <> [[4.3.10]] iti yo yañ vihitaḥ, yaśca `vṛñchaṇ` [[4.2.79]] ityādinā sūtreṇa sutaṅgamādibhya iñiti tadantāt kasmānna bhavati, na hyatra kaścidviśeṣa upāttaḥ?ityata āhaḥ - `dvīpādanusamudraṃ yañ` ityādi| gotragrahaṇena hyatra yañiñau viśeṣyete - gotre yau yañiñāviti| na ca `dvīpāt` [[4.3.10]] ityādinā gotre yañ vihitaḥ,kiṃ tarhi? jātādāvarthaviśeṣe| nāpi sutaṅgamādibhyo gotre iñ vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tadasminnastīti deśe` (4.2.68,70) ityevamādiṣu catuṣrvartheṣu, tena tadantānna bhavati| yadi tarhi gotragrahaṇeneha yañiñau viśeṣyete, na pratyayārthaḥ, evaṃ sati kvāyaṃ pratyayo bhavatīti na vijñāyata ityata āha -`tadantāt` ityādi| kasmāt tadityāha - `gotrādyūnīti vacanāt` iti||`gotra ityetat` iti| yadi tarhi gotra iti vartate, bhuguvatsābhyāṃ mūlaprakṛtibhyāṃ pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate, gotrapratyayābhyāmeva hi tābhyāṃ gotrāpatyaṃ pratyayārthaḥ śakyo viśeṣayitumta eva yuktaṃ syādvaktum - bhārgavavātsyāyanāgrāyaṇeṣviti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;gotrādhikārasāmarthyāddhi gotrāpatya eva vartamānāviha gṛhrete, kārye kāraṇopacāraṃ kṛtvā| tāmeva gotrāpatye tayorvṛtiṃta darśayituṃ vṛttāvityuktam - `śāradvatāyano bhavati bhārgavaścet, śaunakāyano bhavati vātsyaścet` iti||`katham` ityādi| yadi gotrāpatye droṇādibhyaḥ phagbhavati, tatkathaṃ drauṇāyanaḥ, droṇataḥ pratītyevamādiṣu prayogeṣvanantaro'ātthāmā ityucyate? `naivātra` iti| nātredānīntano droṇastadanantarāpatye phakā droṇāyana iti, kiṃ tarhi? `anādiḥ`iti| śrutisambhavadarśanārthamidamuktam| yena hetunāātthāmā drauṇāyana ityucyate tamidānīntanetyādinā darśayati| `idānīntanāttu`ityādi| anādidroṇavyavacchedaparametadveditavyam| na hi tāvadbhāratadroṇa idānīntano bhavati; cirātītatvāt| cirātīto'pyartho buddhau paribhāvyamāno vartamānatāṃ pratipadyate, yathā - adya kaṃso hanyatām| idānīntanād droṇādapyaātthāmni droṇāyana ityevaṃ gotrapratyayena yadabhidhānaṃ tadadhyāropeṇa bhavati| avidyamānasyaiva tatrāsañjanamadhyāropaḥ| kasyādhyāropaḥ? gotrasya| `śrutisāmānyāt` iti| adhyārope hetuḥ| anādedrroṇasyāātthānamnaḥ pituśca droṇa iti samānā śrutiḥ| ataḥ śrutisāmānyādanādidroṇāpatyasya yo dharmo gotratvaṃ tadbhāvaṃ bhāratadroṇāpatye'ātthāmnyapi śrutisāmanyāccalitabuddhayaḥ pratipattāra adhyāropayanti| tenādhyāropeṇa droṇāyana iti tatrābhidhāṃ pravartata#e||`ye punaratrānṛṣiśabdāḥ` ityādi| nanu ca sūtre ānantaryaśabdo bhāvapratyayānta upāttaḥ,tatraivaṃ vivaritavyam - ye punaratrānṛṣiśabdāḥ puttrādayastebhyo'patyānantarya eva bhavati? naitadasti; na hrayaṃ bhāve ṣyañ vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? svārtha eva, cāturvaṇryavat; anyathāpatyasya dharma ānantarye pratyayaḥ dharma ānantarye pratyayaḥ syāt, nāpatye, tatreṣyate ca| kathaṃ punargotrādhikāre satyanuṣibhyo'nantarāpatya eva pratyayo labhyate? atra gotragrahaṇaṃ nivartate| ṛṣiśabdebhyo'nantarāpatya eva svadityata āha - `anṛṣyānantarya ityasyāyam` ityādi| `yadyayamarthaḥ` ityādi| asmin hrarthe satyanṛṣyānantarya ityetadviṣyartha bhavati; anṛṣeranantarāpatye pratyayavidhānāt| tataśca ṛṣyapatya ānantaryepratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syādityāha - `ṛṣiśabdo'traṛṣijātāvṛṣitve vartate| `apatyeṣu nairantaryam` iti| `saptamī` [[2.1.39]] iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| paścādṛṣerapatyanairantaryamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tadāyamartho bhavati - ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryaviṣaye'ñaḥ pratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syāt| atha vā - ṛṣayaśca te'patyāni ca ṛṣyapatyāni, teṣāṃ nairantaryaṃ tadviṣaye pratiṣedho'ñaḥ pratyayasya na kṛtaṛ syādityarthaḥ| tatar ko doṣaḥ? ityāha - `tatredam` ityādi| sapta kāśyapā ṛṣayo'patyāpatyavatsambandhena parasapraṃ sambaddhāḥ, yeṣāṃ mittrahūrnāma kāśyapaḥ saptamaḥ, teṣāmuṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryam| tatra ṛṣyapatyānāṃ vā nairantarye viṣaye'ñaḥ pratiṣedha iṣyate,kāśyapānāmityetadrūpaṃ yathā syāt| añi sati tasya bahuṣu lopābhāvāt kāśyapānāmiti prāpnoti| sa ca pratiṣaedho'sminnarthe sati na prāpnoti, tataśca kāśyapānāmiti na sidhyati| tasmāt `anṛṣyānantarye` ityasya ṛṣyapatyanairantaryeṇa na bhavatītyeṣo'rtho vijñāyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `anantarāpatyarūpeṇaiva` iti| na cātra gotrāpatyaṃ vivakṣitam| kiṃ tarhi? kiṃ tarhi? anantarāpatyam| ato'nantarāpatyarūpeṇaiva ṛṣyaṇā ṛṣyandhakādiṣu [[4.1.114]] vihitena kāśyapānāmityabhidhānaṃ bhaviṣyati| etadeva draḍhayitumāha - `avaśyañca` ityādi| ṛṣyapatyaṃ nairantaryaṃ viṣayo yasya pratiṣedhasya sa tathoktaḥ| ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu ṛṣyapatyānāṃ vā yannairarantarya tadviṣaye pratiṣedhe vijñāyamāna ityarthaḥ| `kauśiko viāāmitra iti duṣyati` iti| kiṃ kāraṇam? viāāmitrastapastepe - nānṛṣiḥ syāmiti, tatrabhavānṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ,sa punastapakṣepe -nānṛṣeḥ puttraḥ syāmiti, tatrabhavān gādhirapi ṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ; sa punastapastepe - nānṛṣeḥ pautraḥ syāmiti; tatrabhavān kuśiko'pi ṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ| tadetadbhavati - ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryamṛṣyapatyānāṃ vānantaryam| tataśca ṛṣyapatyanairantarye na bhavatītyevaṃ vijñāyamāne kauśiko viāāmitra iti na sidhyati|`parastrī paraśuñca` iti|parastrīśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati pareśubhāvañcāpadyate| parastriyā apatyaṃ pāraśavaḥ||`kathaṃ mānavī prajā`iti| gargādiṣu pāṭhādyañā bhavitavyam, tataśca mānavīti na sidhyatīti| lohitādilakṣaṇe hi yañantāttu ṣphe vihite mānavyāyanīti bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| gotramityucyate, gotre hi yañ pratyaya ucyate, nāpatyasāmānye| tena tatrautsargiko'ṇ mānavīti bhaviṣyati| `katham` ityādi| yadi gotramityucyate, tato yathā gargaśabdādanantarāpatye yañ na bhavati, tathā ca jamadagniparāśaraśabdābhyāmapi na bhavitavyam, tatkathamanantaro rāmo jāmadagnyaḥ, vyāsaḥ pārāśarya ityatra yañ bhavati? `gotrarūpādhyāropeṇa bhaviṣyati` iti| yadānantarāpatyayorapi gotrarūpayo rāmavyāsayorvivakṣitatvādgotrarūpādhyāropaḥ kriyate, tadā yañ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| asato na yuktā vivakṣetyetacca na sambhāvanīyam; dṛśyate hrasato'pi vivakṣā, yathā - vindhyo varddhitakaḥ, samudraḥ kuṇḍiketi| yadā tahrranantarāpatyavivakṣā bhavati, tadā kena bhavitavyamityāha - `antarāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ tu` ityādi| `vājā'se`iti| vājaśabdo yañamutpādayati| ase, asamāsa ityarthaḥ| vājyaḥ asamāsa iti kim? sauvājiḥ||yadi tarhi babhruśabdasya gargādipāṭhādeva siddhe kauśike niyamārthamiha grahaṇam, evaṃ sati nārtho gargādiṣu pāṭhena, kauśike vidhyarthameva grahaṇamastu, nāsya? ityata āha - `gargādiṣu pāṭho'pi` ityādi| gargādiṣu pāṭho'pi kartavyaḥ| `sarvatra lohitara` [[4.1.18]] ityādināntargaṇakārya ṣpho yathā syāt| atha gaṇa e kauśikagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kṛtam, kaḥ punarevaṃ sati guṇo bhavati, sutre punarbabhrugrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati? satyametat; `apāṇinīyatvāt` gaṇasya| naivaṃ cākaraṇe pāṇinirupālambhamarhati| gaṇakāreṇāpi hi kiṃ na kṛtam? vaicitryārtham| vicitrā hi gaṇasya kṛtirgaṇakāreṇa||`kāpeyaḥ`iti| `itaścāmiñaḥ` [[4.1.122]] iti ḍhañak| yadi kapiśabdo gargādiṣu paṭhate, niyamārthaṃ tviha tasya grahaṇam, evaṃ satyāṅgirase vidhyarthamevāsya grahaṇamevāstu,nārtho gargādiṣu pāṭhena? ityata āha - `lohitādikāryārthaśca` ityādi||kimarthamidam? anarthakamidamityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha - `yāvatā` ityādi| `śivādiṣvapi` ityādinā prayojanaṃ darśayati| yadīdaṃ nocyeta, tato gargādipāṭhādāṅgirase yathā yañ bhavati, tathā śivādiṣu pāṭhādaṇapi syāt| tasmādāṅgirase yañā śivādyaṇo bādhanaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punarvacanam| atha gargādipāṭhādeva siddhe, āṅgirase niyamārthametaditi kasmānnoktam? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; prayojanābhāve hi niyamārthaṃ bhavati| iha cāsti prayojanam, tacca darśitameva||`vātaṇḍaāyanī` iti| lohitādilakṣaṇaḥ ṣphaḥ||`ye tvatra` ityādi| <> [[4.1.93]] iti vacanādgotrapratyayāntādaparo gotrapratyayo nopapadyate| tatra sāmarthyādagotrādhikāre'pi ye gotrapratyayāntāḥ paṭhante tebhyaḥ <> [[4.1.94]] iti yūni pratyayo vijñāyate| `śapa ātreye` iti| śapaśabdāt phañāttreyaścedbhavati śāpāyana āttreyaḥ, anyatra śāpiḥ| vailyaśabdo gotrapratyayāntaḥ, tasmādyūni bhavati| vilirnāma rājarṣiḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ gotram, <> [[4.1.171]] , vailyaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ vailyāyano yuvā| ānaḍuhraśabdo'pi gotrapratyayānto gargādiṣu, yañantatvāt; tasmādapi yūnyeva phañ - ānaḍuhrāyano yuvā| striyāṃ ḍhageva bhavati - jātāyā apatyaṃ jāteyaḥ| `āttreya bhāradvāje`iti| āttreyaśabdāt phañ bhāradvājaścedapatyārtho bhavati - āttreyāyaṇo bhāradvājaḥ, anyatra āttreyiḥ| `bhāradvāja āttreye` iti| bhāradvājaśabdāt phañ āttreye'patyaviśeṣe - bhāradvājāyana āttreyaḥ, anyatra - ṛṣyaṇ||`yathāyatham` iti| yathāsvam| yasya ya iñādirātmīyapratyayastadapadādo'ṇ vidhīyate| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `śivādibhyaḥ` ityevocyeta? `śivādibhyaḥ` etāvatyucyamāne yathāvihitamiñādireva pratyayo mā bhūt, aṇeva yathā syādityevamarthamiti cet; naitadasti; yathāvihitamiñādīn pratyayān pratyetadvacanamanarthakam; vināpyanena tatsiddheḥ| tasmādantareṇāpyaṇgrahaṇamaṇeva bhaviṣyati| nanu cāsatyaṇgrahaṇe phañaḥ prakṛtatvāt tasyaiva vidhirvijñāyate? naitadasti; yadi hi śivādibhyaḥ phañ vidhātumiṣṭaḥ syāt, tato'āādiṣveva teṣāṃ pāṭhaṃ kuryāt| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam - ayamuṣṭiṣeṇaśabdaḥ śivādiṣu paṭhate, tasya <> [[4.1.152]] iti ṇyapratyayaḥ prāpnoti| tatrāsatyaṇgrahaṇe punarvidhānamidaṃ tadbādhane kṛtārthamiti tato yathāvihitamiñeva syāt, nāṇ; tato'ṇeva yathā syādityaṇgrahaṇam|`udīcāmiñaṃ bādhitum` iti| `udīcām` [[4.1.153]] ityaneneñ prāpnoti, tatastaṃ bādhituṃ takṣanśabdo'tarpaṭhate| tathā tarhi takṣanśabdasyātra pāṭhādudīcāmiñ bādhyate, tathā <> [[4.1.152]] iti yo ṇyastasyāpi bādhā prāpnoti| tataśca `tākṣaṇyaḥ` iti na sidhyati? ityāha - `ṇyapratyayasya tu bādho neṣyate` (iti)| kathamaniṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? supiṣṭaśabdādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt| iha yastakṣañśabdaḥ supiṣṭamayūrakharadūratakṣannityevaṃ supiṣṭādibhiḥ saha paṭhate, yathā teṣāñceñapavādārtho'tra pāṭhaḥ, taiḥ sāhacaryādasyāpīñapavādārtha eva pāṭho vijñāsyate| tatra śivādīnāṃ prāg bhūriśabdādiñapavādārthaṃ vacanam| bhūri, sandhi, muni - ityeteṣāṃ <> [[4.1.122]] iti ḍhaki prāpte| kuṭhāra, anabhimlāna - ityetayoḥ kakutstha - ityemādīnāṃ prāg jaratkāruśabdādiño bādhanārtham| jaratkāruprabhṛtīnāṃ prāk supiṣṭaśabdāt <> [[4.1.120]] iti ḍhaki prāpte| supiṣṭādīnāṃ prāk takṣañśabdādiñaḥ| takṣannityasya kārilakṣaṇodīcāmiñaḥ| ṛṣṭiṣeṇasya senāntalakṣamasya ṇyasya ca bādhanārtham| gaṅgādipāṭśabdayoryasminnaprāpta iha pāṭhaḥ sa vṛttikāreṇaiva vyākhyātaḥ| yaskādibhyaḥ prāg bhūmiśabdādiñi prāpte| bhūmiśabdasya <> [[4.1.122]] iti ḍhaki| ilāśabdasyāpi `{dvyacaḥ iti sūtram} dvyacaśca` [[4.1.121]] iti ḍhaki| emeva sapatnīśabdasyāpi <> [[4.1.120]] iti ḍhakyeva| `dvyaco nadyāḥ` iti| nadīvācakā ye dvyacastebhyo'ṇ bhavati, sandhyā - sāndhyam, kulyā - kaulyam| nanu cātra tannāmiko'ṇastyeva? satyamasti; sa tu <> [[4.1.121]] iti ḍhakā bādhyate| tasmāt tadbādhanārthaṃ vacanam| `triveṇī trivaṇañca` iti| triveṇīśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, trivaṇañcāpadyate| triveṇyā apatyaṃ traivaṇaḥ||śāstrāntare paribhāṣitamapi vṛddhamasti - apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti; iha śāstre'pi paribhāṣitaṃ vṛddhamasti <> [[1.1.73]] iti, ato vṛddhapratiṣedhe kasyacit sandehaḥ syāt - kasya vṛddhasyāyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃsvit yadiha paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ? uta yacchāstrāntareṇa paribhāṣitaṃ tasyeti? atastannirāsāya `vṛddhiryasya` 91.1.74) ityādineha śāstre yat paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam - iha vṛddhaṃ yat paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam - iha vṛddhaṃ yat paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti? nadīmānuṣīnāmadheyasya gotrapratyayāntasyāsambhavāt| nadīgrahaṇe tviha laukikyeva nadī gṛhrate, na tu pāribhāṣikī| kuta etat? laukikārthavṛttinā mānuṣīśabdena sāhacaryāt| atha svarūpagrahaṇameva nadīmānuṣīśabdayoḥ kasmānna bhavati? vṛddhapratiṣedhāt| svarūpagrahaṇe hi vṛddhapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt; prasaṅgābhāvāt| bahuvacananirdeśācca na svarūpagrahaṇam| svarūpagrahaṇe hī nadīmānuṣīśabdayordvitvāddvicanenaiva nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| `avṛddhābhyiti śabdadharmaḥ syāt| yadi tarhrarthadharmo'yam, kathaṃ nadīmānuṣībhya ityanena prakṛtayo nirdiśyante, arthadharma eva hrevaṃ nirdiṣṭo bhavati, na prakṛtayaḥ? ityata āha - `tena` ityādi| tenārthabhedopacārāt| nadīmānuṣyabhidhāyinyaḥ prakṛtayo nirdiśyante| `pratyayaprakṛtiḥ` iti| pratyayasya prakṛtiriti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `ḍhako'pavādaḥ` iti| avṛddhādīnāṃ nadīnāṃ manuṣīṇāṃ nāmadheyānāṃ strīpratyayāntatvāt| `vaitastaḥ, nārmadaḥ` iti| vitastānarmadāśabdābhyāmaṇ| `śaikṣitaḥ` iti| śikṣitāśabdāt|`sauparṇeyaḥ, vainateyaḥ` iti| suparṇāvinatāśabdau pakṣiṇīnāmadheye, na nadīmānuṣyau| `śaubhaneya-` iti| śobhanāśabdo vartate nadīmānuṣyarthaḥ, na tu saṃjñātvena, kiṃ tarhi? viśeṣaṇatvena||`iño'pavādaḥ` iti| nanu cānakārāntebhyo'tstryādibhyo ye ḍhagādayaḥ prāpnuvanti tadapavāda eva yukta ityata āha - `attryādibhyastu` ityādi| ekenādiśabdena ṛṣayo jātasenādayo'ndhakādiṣu ca vartamānā ugrasenādayaḥ, parigṛhyante, dvitīyena ṇyādayaḥ pratyayāḥ| tatra ṛṣyaṇo'vakāśaḥ - vāsiṣṭhaḥ, <> [[4.1.122]] iti ḍhako'vakāśaḥ -dauleyaḥ;attriśabdādubhayaprāptau paratvād ḍhagbhavati - āttreyaḥ| ṛṣyaṇo'vakāśaḥ sa eva, senāntalakṣamasya ṇyasyāvakāśaḥ - kāriṣeṇyaḥ, hāriṣeṇyaḥ;jātaseno nāma ṛṣiḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati - jātasenyaḥ| andhakāṇo'vakāśaḥ -vāsudevaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; śūraseno viṣvakseno nāma vṛṣṇiḥ, tasmādubhyaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati - śaurasenyaḥ , vaiṣvaksenyaḥ| kurvaṇo'vakāśaḥ -nākulaḥ,ṇyasya sa eva; ugraseno nāmāndhakaḥ,tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati - augrasenyaḥ| vṛṣṇyaṇo'vakāśaḥ - vāsudevaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; śūraseno viṣvakseno nāma vṛṣṇiḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati - śaurasenyaḥ, vaiṣvaksenyaḥ| kurvaṇo'vakāśaḥ -nākulaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; bhīmaseno nāma kuruḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati - bhaimasenyaḥ|`kathaṃ punaḥ` ityādi codyam| `kecidāhuḥ` ityādi codyaparihāraḥ| `kākatālīyam` iti| abuddhipūrvakamityarthaḥ| `saṅkalitāḥ` iti| samuccitāḥ| `nityā eva` iti| andhakādīnāṃ vaṃśānāmanāditvāt||`dvaimāturaḥ`iti| prāk taddhitārthe viṣaye dvikuḥ, paścāt taddhitaḥ| `sāmmāturaḥ` iti| pūrvaṃ prādisamāsaḥ, paścāt taddhitaḥ|`bhādramāturaḥ` iti| pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ; tatastaddhitaḥ|atha pratyayārtha vacanaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `pratyayaḥ punaḥ` ityādi| utsargalakṣaṇenaiva <> [[4.1.92]] ityanena| nanu ca saṃkhyādipūrvatvaṃ mātṛśabdasya viśeṣaṇam, tatra mātṛśabdāpekṣayā nirdeśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ puṃlliṅga eva dṛśyate, tatkathaṃ `saṃkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ` iti strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ? ityata āha - `strīliṅganirdeśo'rthāpekṣaḥ` iti| mātuḥ śabdasya yo'rthastadapekṣo'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, sa cārthaḥ strīliṅgaḥ| tena strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| `tena` ityādinārthāpekṣasya phalaṃ darśayati| arthāpekṣe hi strīliṅganirdeśe strīliṅgo yasyārtho mātṛśabdasya , tasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam, tena dhānayamātugrrahaṇaṃ na bhavati| na hi tasya strīliṅgo'rthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? puṃlliṅgaḥ| dhānyaṃ mimīte yo bhṛtakaḥ sa dhānyamātetyucyate|`saumātraḥ` iti| prāk prādisamāsaḥ| tata autsargiko'ṇ||atra vatsabharadvājāstriśabdā vātsyabhāradvājāttreyeṣu gotraviśeṣeṣu labdhavṛttaya upāttā iti| ata evāha - `vaikarṇo bhavati vātsyaśceta, śauṅgo bhavati bāradvājaścet, cāgalo bhavatyāttreyaścet` iti| sā punasteṣāṃ gotrāpatye vṛttiḥ kārye kāraṇīpacārādveditavyā|`dvayamapi caitat pramāṇam` iti| kathaṃ punaḥ parasparaviruddhamapi pramāṇaṃ bhavati? ityāśaṅkyāha - `ubhayathā hretat sūtramācāryeṇa praṇītam, tasmāt ko virodhaḥ||`iha strīgrahaṇena ṭābādistrīpratyayāntāḥ śabdāḥ gṛhyante` iti| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? bahuvacananirdeśāt| svarūpagrahaṇe hi tasyaikatvādekavacanenaiva nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| stryarthamātrasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? vimātṛśabdasya stryarthasya śubhrādiṣu pāṭhāt| yadyatra stryarthamātrasya strīśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tasya śubhrādiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt, anenaiva ḍhakaḥ siddhatvāt| `aiḍaviḍaḥ dāradaḥ` iti| iḍaviḍo'patyaṃ varado'patyamityaṇeva bhavati| ḍhagiti vartamāne ḍhakaḥ punagrrahaṇaṃ nityārtham| `vaḍavāyā vṛṣa vācye` iti| yastasyā garbhe bījaṃ prakṣipati sa vṛṣo vāḍaveya ityucyate|`aṇkruñcākokilāt smṛtaḥ` iti| vṛṣa iti nāpekṣyate| apatye vidhirevāyam| ḍhako'pavādaḥ||`tannāmikāṇo'pavādaḥ`iti| ye dvyacaḥ strīpratyayāntā nadīmānuṣīnāmadheyabhūtāstebhyo viśeṣavihitatvāt tannāmikāṇ bhavati| tatastadbādhanārthaṃ ḍhagvidhīyate||`yathāyogam` ityādi| ye tāvadakārāntāstebhya iño'pavādaḥ| śalākā, kurekā,ambikā, aśokā, khaṭvā, piṅgalā, khaṇḍonmattā - ityetempastannāmikāṇaḥ| vidhavāśabdāt kṣudrālakṣaṇasya ḍhrakaḥ| kiṃkasā, rohiṇī, ajavasti, śakandhi, kṛkalāsa, sudatta, paridhi - etebhyaścatuṣpāllakṣaṇasya ḍhañaḥ| godhāśabdād godhāyā ḍhrakaḥ, vacanasāmarthyāt so'pi bhavatyeva| śeṣebhya autsargiko'ṇa ityeṣa yathāyogārthaḥ| `lakṣaṇaśyāmayorvāsiṣṭhe` iti| lakṣaṇa, śyāma - ityetayorvāsiṣṭhe'patyaviśeṣe ḍhagbhavati| lākṣaṇeyo vāsiṣṭhaḥ, lākṣaṇiranyaḥ| śyāmeyo vāsiṣṭhaḥ, śyāmāyano'nyaḥ| aāāditvāt phañ||kulanyaṭatīti kulaṭā| nanvakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatve kṛte kulāṭeti bhavitavyamityata āha - `pararūpam` ityādi| `pūrveṇaiva` iti|<> [[4.1.120]] ityananaiva| vyavahite'pi pūrvavyapadeśaḥ pravartate, yathā - mathurāyāḥ pāṭaliputraṃ pūrvamiti|`kaulaṭeraḥ` iti| eyādeśe kṛte vali yalopaḥ||`caṭakāyā apatyaṃ strī caṭakā` iti| <> [[1.2.49]] iti luki kṛte punaṣṭāp kartavyaḥ| puṃlliṅgādapi striyāmiṣyata eva luk| evam `caṭakādairak` ityetat sūtramāsīt, idānīṃ pramādācca `caṭakāyāḥ` iti pāṭhaḥ||`godheraḥ` iti| pūrvavadyalopaḥ||`ācāryagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham` iti| nanu cāsatyācāryagrahaṇe nitya evāyaṃ vidhiḥ syāt, tathā cārakaḥ pūrveṇa ḍhrakā samāveśo na syāt| tadvikalpārthamevācāryagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha - `vacanasāmarthyāt` iti| ḍhragapi hrucyate, āragapi, tatra vacanasāmarthyāt samāveśo bhaviṣyati| tasmāt pūjārthamevācāryagrahaṇam| `jñāpakaṃ tu` ityādi| rakā siddhe yadāragvacanaṃ sañjñāpanārtham| tenaivaṃ jñāyate - anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavati;anyathā hrāragvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt raki siddheḥ| tena jaḍasyāpatyaṃ jāḍāraḥ, pāṇḍāra iti siddhaṃ bhavati, na hretadrakā sidhyati||`arthadharmeṇa` iti| arthasya kṣudratvāttadabhidhāyinyo'pi prakṛtaya upacāreṇa kṣudrā iti nirdiśyante||`kathaṃ punaḥ` ityādi| ḍhagvidhau ṭābādistrīpratyayāntagrahaṇāt pitṛṣvasṛśabdasya cāstrīpratyayāntatvāt| tato ḍhako bhāvamasambhāvayataḥ praśnaḥ| `etadeva` ityādi| yadetat pitṛṣvasṛśabdaṃ prati ḍhako nimittatvenāśrayaṇam, etadeva pitṛṣvasṛśabdat tasya bhāvaṃ jñapāyati| na hrasato nimittabhāva upapadyate||`pitṛṣvasurityetadapekṣate`iti| ihāpi `anantarasya pitṛṣvasurvidhirvā bhavatipratiṣedho vā` iti lopa evānantaraḥ prāpnoti, na chaṇ; vyavahitatvāt| ubhayamapi caitadiṣyate, tatra yato hetoretaddvayamapi labhyate tamanena darśayati - `pitṛṣvasuḥ` iti| etadihāpekṣyamāṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhantaṃ jñāyate yathā lopavidhau `pitṛṣvasuḥ` [[4.1.132]] iti ca ṣaṣṭhī, tenāyamarthaḥ sampadyate - pitṛṣvasuryaduktaṃ tanmātṛṣvasurapi tena chaṇ ḍhaki lopaśca labhyate| ubhayamapi hretat pitṛṣvasuruktam||`catuṣpādbhyaḥ` iti| catvāraḥ pāda āsāmiti tāstathoktāḥ| `pādasya lopa'hastyādibhyaḥ` [[5.4.138]] iti lopaḥ| ihāpyarthadharmeṇa tadabhidhāyinyaḥ prakṛtayo nirdiśyante| ata evāha - `catuṣpādabhidhāyinībhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ` iti| bahuvacananirdeśaḥ svarūpavidhinirāsāya| `aṇādīnām` iti| ādiśabdena ḍhagādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `kāmaṇḍaleyaḥ` ityādi| kamaṇḍalūśuntibāhujambuśabdāścatuṣpājjātivācinaḥ,teṣāṃ `ḍhe lopo'kadravāḥ` [[6.4.147]] ityuvarṇalopaḥ||aṇādīnāmapavādaḥ| ādiśabdena ḍhakaḥ| bahuvacananirdeśastu prakṛtibhedena tayorbhedasya vivakṣitatvāt| tatrājavastimitrayuśabdayoraṇo'pavādaḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ <> [[4.1.122]] iti ḍhakaḥ||`kṣatriyajātiścet` iti| pratyayāntena yadi kṣatriyajātirgamyate evaṃ yad bhavati| yo hrapatyameva rājño na kṣattriyajātistatrāṇevautsargiko bhavati| etacca `vā [[4.1.131]] ityasyehānuvṛttasya vyavasthivibhāṣātvavijñānāllabhyate| `rājanyaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.168]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `rājanaḥ` iti| atrāpi `an` [[6.4.167]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ||`ghapratyayo bhavati` iti| ghaśabda eva, na tu taraptamapāviti veditavyam| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate,yāvatā `ghaḥ` iti taraptamaporiyaṃ saṃjñā, coccaritā saṃjñinaṃ sampratyayāyatīti tayoreva grahaṇaṃ yuktam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pratyayavidhau yatra `ghaḥ` iti śrūyate,tatra svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati; jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ pratyayāderghakārasyeyādeśaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati - yatra pratyayavidhau ghaḥ śrūyate svarūpameva gṛhrata iti| na hi saṃjñinogrrahaṇena pratyayāderghaḥ sambhavati||`uttarasūtre` ityādi| uttarasūtre hi pūrvapadapratiṣedhādyasyāṃ paribhāṣāyāṃ prātipadikaśrutirasti, sā'tra nopatiṣṭhata ityeṣo'rtho jñāyate| yadi hrupatiṣṭheta, tadā grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādeva (vyā|pa|89) sa pūrvapadānna bhaviṣyatītyapūrvapadāditi pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| sāmānyāpekṣañca jñāpakam; tena `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena` (śāka|pa|65), `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirneṣyate` (vyā|pa|89) ityetayorapīha paribhāṣayorupasthānaṃ na bhavati| tataśca kulaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ kulaśabdo gṛhrate||nanu pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ; na ca kulaśabdasya padāntaramavayava upapadyate; pṛthagbhūttavāt, anārambhakatvācca, tato vyapacchedyābhāvādapūrvapadādityuktametatkulaśabdasya viśeṣaṇam? ityāha - `samāsasambandhi` ityādi| samāse satyetadbhavati - pūrvapadam, uttarapadamiti| tasmāt samāsasambandhinaḥ pūrvapadsayābhāvena kulaśabdo viśeṣyate - avidyamānaṃ samāsasambandhi pūrvapadaṃ yasyeti| kasya cāvidyamānam? yaḥ samāsasyāntabhūto na bhavati kevalaḥ kulaśabdaḥ,tena kevalāt kulaśabdādayaṃ vidhirityuktaṃ bhavati| atha vyavasthāvācyeva pūrvaśabdaḥ kasmānnāśrīyate? aśakyatvāt| tatra hrāśrīyamāṇe'vidyamānaṃ pūrvapadaṃ yasmāt kulaśabdāt so'pūrvapadaśabdenocyate| tataśca devadattaḥ kulyo devadattaḥ kauleyaka iti vākye yaḍḍhakañau na syātām; devadattasyeha pūrvapadasya vidyamānatvāt| `padagrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| apūrvādityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, evamapi hīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, laghu ca sūtraṃ bhavatīti manyate| `bahucpūrvapadādapi yathā syāt` iti| `apūrvāt` ityucyamāne bahuc pūrvaṃ yatpratātipadikaṃ bahujasya pūrvaṃ iti tataḥ pratyayo na syāt| padagrahaṇe tu sati tato'pi bhavati; tasyāpūrvapadatvāt| `bahukulyaḥ` iti| īṣadasamāptaṃ kulamiti <> [[5.3.68]] iti bahuc| bahukulasyāpatyaṃ bahukulyaḥ||`takāraḥ svarārthaḥ` iti| <> [[6.1.185]] iti svaritatvaṃ yathā syāt|nanu <> [[4.1.35]] iti sapatnīśabda eva strīliṅgo vyutpāditaḥ, tatkathaṃ sapatna iti prayogaḥ puṃliṅgasya yujyata ityāha - `sapatnaśabdaḥ śattruparyāyaḥ` ityādi| `ivārthe` iti| ivārthaḥ = sādṛśyam| yathaiva hi sapatnī duḥkhahetuḥ, tathā śattrurapīti| yaḥ sapatnīva sapatnaḥ sa ucyate||`yathāyogam` ityādi| tatrādyānāṃ caturṇāṃ strīpratyayāntatvād ḍhako'pavādaḥ; vṛkañcin - ityasyāṇaḥ, śeṣāṇāmakarāntatvādiñaḥ||`apatyaṃ prautraprabhṛti gotraṃ gṛhrate` iti| na laukikamapatyamātram, tadgrahaṇe hi gotragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| apatyādhikārādeva tadgrahaṇasya labdhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `piturasaṃvijñāne` iti| aprasiddhau| tasya piturasaṃvijñānapradarśanārthaṃ mātrā yo vyapadeśo'sti tena kutsā syāt| `gārgo jālmo gārgikaḥ` iti| gargaśabdādgotre gargādiyañantāt `yañaśca` [[4.1.16]] iti ṅīpi <> [[6.4.150]] itilope sati yakārasya gārgī iti sthite ṇaṭhakau| `glaucukāyanaḥ` ityādi| glucakasyāpatyaṃ gotraṃ strī `prācāmavṛddhāt` phin bahulam` [[4.1.160]] iti phin,tataḥ <> [[4.1.65]] iti ṅīṣ,tato ṇaṭhakau|`kārikeyaḥ`iti| kārakaśabdāṇṇvulantāṭṭāp|kārikāśabdo'yaṃ gotre na vartate,tato ḍhageva bhavati| `aupagaviḥ`iti| upagorapatyaṃ gotraṃ pumānṇ, tadantādiñeva bhavati| atra kenacit pratiṣiddhācaraṇādinā kutsā veditavyā|`gārgeyo māṇavakaḥ` iti| atra pitari vijñāte mātuḥ parijñānārthaṃ tanmatrā vyapadeśaḥ kriyata iti nāsti kutsā, tena ḍhagena bhavati||`sauvīreṣviti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam` iti| sauvīreṣu yadvṛddhaṃ sauvīragotrābhidhāyi yadvṛddhamityarthaḥ| `bhāgavitteḥṭa ityādi| bhagavittasyāpatyaṃ gotram| `ata iña` [[4.1.95]] , tadantāt ṭhak - `bhāgavittikaḥ`| `bhāgavittāyanaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak| tṛṇādibindorapatyamautsargiko'ṇ tārṇabindavaḥ, tataṣṭhak - `tārṇabindavikaḥ`| pūrvasūtre ṭhak cānukṛṣṭa itīha nānuvartata iti punaṣṭhaggrahaṇaṃ ṇsaya nivṛttyartham| vāpūrvakaṃ hi ṭhaggrahaṇaṃ ṇapratyayena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt|`bhāgapūrvapado vṛttiḥ` ityādi| yebhyo'nena sūtreṇa ṭhagiṣyate, ta etena ślokena parigaṇyante| `bhāga` ityetat pūrvapadaṃ yasya vṛttiśabdasya sa tathoktaḥ| ayaṃ tāvadeko bhāgavittiḥ, dvitīyastārṇabindavaḥ, tṛtīyastvākaśāpeyaḥ - ya ete trayaḥ śabdāḥ ,gotre ṭhagbahulaṃ tata iti| sauvīragotravacanāntāt prātipadikādbahulaṃ yaṣṭhagucyate sa tatastebhya eva bhāgavittiprabhṛtibhyastribhyo bhavati, nānyebhya ityarthaḥ|atha vṛddhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pūrvasūtrādgotragrahaṇamanuvartate, sauvīragrahaṇenaiva viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ; yaccasauvīragotre vartate prātipadikaṃ bhāgavittyādikaṃ tadvṛddhameva, tato nivṛttyabhāvādapārthakaṃ vṛddhagrahaṇam? ityāha - `vṛddhagrahaṇam` ityādi| taddhi gotragrahaṇaṃ striyā viśeṣaṇam, atastasminnanuvartamāne viśeṣyāyāḥ striyā anuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmāt tannidṛttyarthaṃ vṛddhagrahaṇam| gotragrahaṇamevānuvartiṣyate; tasyaiva svaritatvāt, na strīti - etadvyākhyeyaṃ bhavati| vyākhyānācca laghu vṛddhagrahaṇameva|`aupagaviḥ` iti| aṇantādiñ| nanu ca parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam,tatkathamaupagavaśabdāt ṭhakprasaṅgaḥ? sauvīragrahaṇe sati tatparigaṇanam| tathā hi - bhāgavittiprabhṛtayaḥ sauvīragotrābhidhāyina eva parigaṇitāḥ| tatrāsati sauvīragrahaṇe aupagavaśabdādapi prasajyate - `bhāgavittāyanaḥ` iti| pūrvavat phak|atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham,na, vāgrahaṇameva kriyeta,tenāpi hi bhāgavittiko bhāghavittikāyana ityādi sidhyatyeva? ityata āha - `bahulagrahaṇam` ityādi| vāgrahaṇādvikalpamātraṃ labhyate, na tūpādhivaicitryam| bahulagrahaṇe tu tadapi| tasmādupādhīnāṃ viśeṣamānāṃ vaicitryam = nānāprakāratā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ bahulagrahaṇam| tadevopādhivaicitryaṃ darśayitumāha - `gotrastriyā ityārabhya` ityādi| sukhāvabodham||`yamundaśca`ityādi| yebhyo'nena sūtreṇa chaṭhakāviṣyete, teṣāmanena ślokena parigaṇanaṃ kriyate, tattu bahulagrahaṇānuvṛttereva labhyata ityevaṃ tadveditavyam| yamundamuddiśya vṛttikāreṇaivodāharaṇaṃ darśitam| itarayostu darśayāmaḥ - suyāmno'patyaṃ, phiñ - sauyāmāyaniḥ,tasyāpatyaṃ sauyāmāyanikaḥ| vṛṣasyāpatyaṃ,phiñ, tasya vādhryāyaṇiḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ vāṣryāyaṇīyaḥ,vāṣryāyaṇikaḥ| ete yamundādayaḥ śabdāḥ phiñaḥ smṛtāḥ = phiñantā vijñātāḥ| <> [[4.1.147]] ityādayaścatvāro yogāḥ| tatrādyaḥ kutsana eva, antyaḥ sauvīreṣveva| madhyamau tu dvau sauvīreṣu kutsāyāñca śabdavitsmaret jānīyāt||`ālpāctarasya` ityādi| mimataśabdo'yamalpāctaraḥ, tasya `alpāctaram` [[2.2.34]] iti pūrvanipāte prāpte yaḥ paranipātaḥ sa lakṣamavyabhicāracihnaṃ sūcayati| yathedaṃ pūrvanipātalakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicarati = svaviṣaye na pravartate, tathā yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| ata evaikaikasmāt pratyayadvayaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati||`kauravyaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.146]] , <> [[6.1.79]] ityavādaśaḥ| `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ` ityādi| kimarthaṃ punaḥ kuruśabdādaparo'pi ṇyapratyayo bhaviṣyati, yāvatānenaiva siddham, tadeva hi rūpam, sa evaca svaraḥ? ityata āha - `sa tu kṣattriyāt` iti| anenārthabhedaṃ darśayati| sa hi <> [[4.1.168]] ityadhikārāt kṣattriyādbhavati, ayaṃ tu tato'nyataḥ| tataścaikaḥ kṣattriyāpatyo bhavati, aparastvakṣattriyāpatya iti spaṣṭa evārthabhedaḥ| rūpaviśeṣo'pi bahuṣu vidyata iti darśayannāha - `tadrājasaṃjñakaḥ` ityādi| tasya hi tadrājasaṃjñakatvāt `tadrājasya bahuṣu` [[2.4.62]] ityādinā bahuṣu lukā bhavitavyam - kurava iti| ayaṃ tu śrūyata eva kauravyā iti|rathakāraśabdo'tarpaṭhate, tatra rathakāraśabdaścāstyeva jātivacanaḥ, asti ca kārivacanaḥ, tadiha tayoḥ kataraḥ paṭhate? ityāha - `rathakāraśabdo'tra paṭhate` ityādi| atha kārivacano'pi kasmānna paṭhate? ityāha - `kāriṇastu` ityādi| yo hi vacano rathakāraśabdaḥ, tata uttarasūtreṇaiva ṇyaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkitra tasya pāṭhena !`puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati` iti| `bhasyā'ḍha taddhite` (vā|731) iti yaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, sa keśinī śabdasya na bhavati| yadi syāt, <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilope kṛte `kaiśyaḥ` ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `strīpratyayasya nirdeśasāmarthyāt` iti|yadi hi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt, strīpratyayenāsya nirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt, puṃlliṅgamevainaṃ paṭhet| puṃlliṅgasyāpi pāṭhe liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā keśinīśabdādapi pratyayaḥ sidhyati| nanu ca puṃlliṅganivṛttyarthaḥ strīpratyayāntasya pāṭhaḥ syāt? naitadasti; abhidhānādeva hi puṃlliṅgānna bhaviṣyati|`tasya kaṇvādivatiti| apatyādhikāre'yamatideśo bhavan kaṇvādibhirapatyapratyayāntairvijñāyate| kaṇvādayaśca gargādyantaḥ pātinaḥ, tena yañantānāṃ kaṇvādīnāṃ yatkāryaṃ tadvāmarathyasya svaravarjaṃ bhavatītyayaṃ bhavati| `lugādikam` iti| ādiśabdena ṅībādikaṃ gṛhrate| kaṇvādīnamapatyapratyayasya <> [[2.4.64]] iti bahuṣu lugbhavati| striyāṃ `yañaśca` [[4.1.16]] iti ṅīp| `prācāṃ ṣpha taddhite` [[4.1.17]] itiṣpha pratyayaḥstriyāmeva| <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak| śaiṣikeṣvartheṣu <> [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ <> [[4.3.120]] ityarthavivakṣāyām| `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñām` [[4.3.127]] ityaṇ| etāni kāryāṇi yathā kaṇvādīnāṃ bhavanti tatā vāmarathyasyāpi| eṣāṃ `vāmarathā` ityādīni yathākramamudāharaṇāni| `nātideśikamādyudāttattvam` iti| yathā kaṇvādīnāṃ yañantānāṃ ñitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ, na tathā vāmarathyasya, kiṃ tarhi? pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `samrājaḥ kṣattriye` iti| samrājaḥ kṣattriye ṇyo bhavati, samrājo'patyaṃ sāmrājyaḥ| anyatrāṇeva - sāmrājaḥ||atra grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhi (vyā|pa|89) pratiṣedhāllakṣaṇaśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇam| ata evāha - `lakṣaṇaśabdāt` iti| kārītyarthagrahaṇam| tatrārthe kāryasyābhāvāt tadvācinaḥ pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha - `kārivacanebhyaśca` iti|yathā lakṣaṇaśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tathā kāriśabdasya kasmānna bhavati? śivādiṣu takṣanniti pāṭhāt| asya hi kārilakṣaṇamiñaṃ bādhituṃ tatra pāṭhaḥ| yadi ca kāriśabdasyeha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, takṣanśabdādibhyaḥ prāpterasambhavādutsargeṇaivāṇā bhavitavyamiti tasya śivādiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| arthagrahaṇe tvanena prāptasyeño bādhanārthastatra pāṭho yujyate||`vacanasāmarthyāt` ityādi| ṇyo'pyucyate, iñapi, vacanasāmarthyādevāntareṇācāryagrahaṇaṃ tayoḥ samāveśe siddhe tadācāryagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tadvaicitryārtham| ācāryagrahaṇasyātiricyamānatvādayamartho labhyate, granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti kṛtvā| nanu ca pūjārthamācāryagrahaṇaṃ syāt? naitadasti; evaṃ hi prācāmapi grahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt| te'pi hi senāntalakṣaṇakāribhya iñaṃ smaranti| `takṣanśabdaḥ` ityādinā vaicitryaṃ darśayati| `tākṣṇaḥ` iti| śivādyaṇi kṛte <<ṣapūrvahandhṛtarājñāmaṇi>> [[6.4.135]] ityallopaḥ| `tākṣaṇyaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.168]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ||`kauravyaśabdaḥ paṭhate` ityādi| kauravyaśabdo'yamastyeva kṣattriyagotravacano yaḥ <> [[4.1.172]] iti ṇyapratyayāntaḥ; tayoriha pūrvo gṛhrate| kuta etat? aurasaśabdena sāhacaryāt| aurasaśabdo'yaṃ <> [[4.1.168]] ityañpratyayāntaḥ, tenāsau kṣattriyavacanaḥ, tatsāhacaryāccakauravyaśabdo yaḥ kṣattriyapratyayāntatvāt kṣattriyavacanaḥ sa eva gṛhrate|`yastu` ityādi| yastu <> [[4.1.151]] | iti ṇyapratyayānto brāāhṛṇādigotravacanaḥ, tasmāt `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] idīñaiva bhavitavyam, tatraitat syāt? svamanīṣikeyaṃ bhavata ityāha - `tathā ca` ityādi| yata evaṃ brāāhṛṇādigotravacanādiñaiva bhavitavyam| tathā hi ṇyakṣattriyādi [[2.4.58]] sūtre pūrverapi vṛttikāraiḥ - kauravyaḥ pitā, kauravyaḥ putra ityudāhṛtam| yadi cātaḥ phiñ syāt tadudāharaṇaṃ na yujyeta|na hi ṇyapratyayāntādvihitasya phiño yūni lugucyate, api tvaṇiñoḥ||`paramaprakṛterevāyaṃ pratyaya iṣyate` iti| kośalaśabdāt, karmāraśabdācca| evakāḥ <> [[4.1.171]] iti ñyaṅanto yaḥ kauśalyaśabdaḥ, yaśca <> [[4.1.152]] iti kārilakṣaṇaṇyapratyayāntaḥ karmāryaśabdaḥ tayovryavacchedāya|yadi mūlaprakṛtereveṣyate, kathamidaṃ vikṛtaṃ prakṛtirūpaṃ śrayūte? ityāha - `pratyayasanniyogena` ityādi| na ceyaṃ svamanīṣikā, api tvācāryaṇāmeva bhāṣyakāraprabhṛti#īnāmidaṃ matamiti darśayannāha - `tathā ca` ityādi| kaḥ punaḥ paramaprakṛteḥ pratyayāntādvatpattau viśeṣaḥ? paramaprakṛterutpattāvapatyamātre pratyayo labhyate, pratyayāntāt tūtpattau `gotrādyūni` [[4.1.94]] iti vacanāt `yūnyapatye` ityeva viśeṣaḥ| `yuḍ vādiṣṭasya` iti| ādiṣṭagrahaṇamāyannādeśae kṛte yathā syādityevamartham; anyathā hranāditvādāyannādeśo na syāt| `dāgavyāvaniḥ` iti| `orguṇeḥ` [[6.4.146]] kṛte <> [[6.1.79]] ityavādeśaḥ||`kātrrāyaṇiḥ` iti| kartturapatyamityaṇ - kārtraḥ, tataḥ phiñ| ` dākṣāyaṇaḥ` iti| dākṣiśabdādiñantādyūni pañiñośca` [[4.1.101]] iti phak| pratipādanādi sugamam||`vṛddhāt` iti| ihaiva yatpāribhāṣikaṃ vṛddhaṃ tadgṛhrate, na śāstrāntaraprasiddham, agotrāditi pratiṣedhāt| `kāriśabdāt` ityādi| kārilakṣaṇasyeño'vakāśaḥ - tāntuvāyiriti, phiño'vakāśaḥ -āmraguptāyaniriti; ihobhaṃ prāpnoti - nāpitāyaniriti, paratvāt phiñeva bhavati||`yadiha vṛddhamagotram` iti| vākinaśabdādikākaparyantam| `iñādyapavādo yogaḥ` iti| ādiśabdenāṇo grahaṇam| tatra carmivarmaśabdayoraṇo'pavādaḥ śeṣāṇāmiñaḥ|`camivarmiṇornalopaśca` iti| carmin, varmin - ityetayoḥ kukphiñau bhavataḥ, nalopaśceti| kuki kṛte prātipadikasyānakārāntatvānnalopo'tra na prāpnotīti vidhīyate - cārmikāyaṇiḥ,vārmikāyaṇiḥ||`tena` ityādi| vacanāt pūrvasūtreṇaivodīcāṃ matena yaḥ pakṣe phiñ vihitastasminnanenānyatarasyāṃ kugāgamo'pi vidhīyate|tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti||`vikalpārthaḥ` iti| vikalpaprayojanāya| `ekenaiva sidhyati` iti| vikalpārthatvāditi|prakṛtatvādvikalpa iti gamyate| atra ca kimarthaṃ sarveṣāṃ grahaṇamityadhyāhāryam| tatretyādyuttaram| yaccodīcāṃgrahaṇaṃ yacca prācāṃgrahaṇam, tadubhayaṃ pūjārtham| `bahulagrahaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham` (iti)| pāriśeṣyādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthamityuktaṃ bhavati| `kvacit` ityādinā bahulagrahaṇasya vaicitryārthatāṃ darśayati||`tathā ca` ityādi| yasmādapatyārtho'tra nāsti, evañca kṛtvā mānuṣā iti bahuṣu lugna bhavati| apatyārthe tu sati <> [[2.4.64]] iti bahuṣu luk prasajyeta|`apatye kutsite` ityādi| mūrdhanyopasaṃkhyānaparo'yaṃ ślokaḥ| aṇpratyayo'patyavivakṣāyām <> [[4.1.92]] ityenaiva sidhyati| nanu ca mūrdhanyo'pi ca bahulagrahaṇānuvṛttyā sidhyatyeva? evaṃ tarhi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhya evārthaḥ ślokena kathyate| sa cāpi mūrdhanyo viśiṣṭa eva viṣaye mūḍhādāvapatye bhavati, na sarvatra| anadhītavedatvadajño mūḍhaḥ| mūḍhatvādeva pratiṣiddhācaraṇādvā kutsito yaḥ sa brāāhṛṇajātīyo māṇava ucyate||prabhṛtiśabda ādiśabdasyārthe| pautraḥ prabhṛtiryasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| yadi pautraprabhṛti yadapatyaṃ tadgotrasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, gargasyāpi gotrasaṃjñā prāpnoti, so'pi kañcit prati pautro bhavatyeva| satyāñca gotrasaṃjñāyāṃ gotraśabdādanantarāpatye pratyayo na prāpnotīti codyamāśaṅkyāha - `sambandhiśabdatvāt` ityādi| gotrasaṃjñā hrapatyas potraprabhṛtervidhīyate| te ca yascāpatyamiti sambandhiśabdo'sau niyogato'patyavantamapekṣata| tena tasya yadapatyaṃ tadapekṣayā gotrasaṃjñā vidhīyate| na ca yasya gargaḥ potrastasyāsau gargo'ptayamiti śakyate vyapadeṣṭum ; apatyatvasya tatrāpratibhāsanāt| apratibhāsanaṃ pustastasya dvato'vivakṣitatvāt| yadapi hi tatrāpatyatvaṃ tadapyavivakṣitasvarūpeṇa nākhyātam, tato'patyasya potraprabhṛtervidhīyate| ataḥ svarūpeṇa pratibhāsamāno na bhavati gargasya gotrasaṃjñāyāḥ prasaṅgaḥ|`gargasya pautraprabhṛti` iti| gargasambandhi pautrādyapatyaṃ gāgrya iti gotrasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ <> [[4.1.98]] ityato gotra ityanuvartamāne <> [[4.1.105]] itigotre'patye yañ bhavati| `apatyamiti vyapadeśo'yam` iti| saṃjñina iti śeṣaḥ| taccottarasūtra ityabhiprāyaḥ| iha tu pautrasyāpatyatvāvyabhicārāt tadapatyameva pratyayāntaiḥ vijñāyata iti nārthaḥ saṃjñivyapedaśārthenāpatyagrahaṇena| uttarasūtre tu pautraprabhṛtyetat ṣaṣṭhantaṃ vipariṇamya pautraprabhṛteḥ sambandhino'patyasya yuvasaṃjñeṣyate, sā cāpatyagrahaṇamantareṇa na labhyate| anyadapi hrapatyāt pautraprabhṛteḥ sambandhyasti, tatra na jñāyate - kasyeyaṃ saṃjñeti? atastatra saṃjñino vyapadeśāya yuktamapatyagrahaṇamityeke|iha tu saṃjñivyapedaśārthaṃ yuktamapatyagrahaṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ| asati hrapatyagrahaṇe sambnadhiśabdatvādapatyaśabdasyetyādi yaduktaṃ codyanirāsāya tadaghaṭamānaṃ syāt| tataśca gargasyāpi gotrasaṃjñā syādeva| tasmādihāpi saṃjñivyapeśāyāpatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva, apatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya saṃjñā yathā syāt|`anyasya mā bhūt` iti| nanu ca tasmādeva tatprakṛtamapatyagrahaṇaṃ tadeva saṃjñivyadeśāya bhaviṣyati, tat kimapareṇāpatyagrahaṇena? naitadasti; taddhi pratyayārthatayā pkṛtaṃ kathaṃ saṃjñino vyapadeśāya syāt; syādetat yadyapi tatpratyayārthe kṛtaṃ tathāpi tasyehānuvṛttas tatprayojanaṃ nāstītyataḥ saṃjñivyapadeśāya vijñāsyata iti?etacca nāsti; uttarārthaṃ hradhikārāṇāmanuvṛttirdṛśyate,vyākhyānañcaivaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt, vyākhyānācca vacanameva laghutaramityapatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `kauñji-, gārgiḥra` iti| anantarasya gotrasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt <> [[4.1.98]] , <> [[4.1.105]] iti yaśca gotre vidhīyamāno na sa bhavati||`abhijanaprabandhaḥ` iti| abhajanāḥ = pitāmahādayaḥ, prabandhaḥ = santānaḥ, tatra bhavo vaṃśya iti digāditvādyat| `pautraprabhṛtyapatyam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `pautraprabhṛtīti ca` ityādi| yadi pautraprabhṛtītyetat sāmānādhikaraṇyenāpatyaṃ viśeṣayet pautraprabhṛti yadapatyamiti tadārabhya yuvasaṃjñā syāt, taccāniṣṭam| tasmānnaitat sāmānādhikaraṇyenāpatyasya viśeṣaṇam kiṃ tarhi? arthādvibhavanaktavipariṇāme kṛte ṣaṣṭhantatāmāpannaṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyena pautraprabhṛryadapatyamiti, tathā sati yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate taddarśayitumāha - `tena` ityādi| yata evaṃ vibhaktivipariṇāme kṛte pautraprabhṛtītyanena ṣaṣṭhantenāpatyaṃ viśeṣyate tena caturthādārabhya yuvasaṃjñā vidhīyate, tasya ca vibhaktapariṇāmasyāpatyaṃ hetuḥ| apatyaśabdo hi sambandhiśabdatvanāddhetvādyapekṣate,tatra ṣaṣṭhaā heturbhavati| sannihitatvācca| pautraprabhṛti tasyetyetadevāpekṣate, tatastatraiva ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati|yadi tahrrapatyagrahamasāmarthyāt pautraprabhṛteḥ ṣaṣṭhīvipariṇāmo bhavati, pūrvasūtre'pi kasmānna bhavati? tatra prathamāyā anavakāśatvāt| pūrvasūtre hrakṛtārthā prathamā, tato na śakyate tasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ vipariṇamayitum| iha tu kṛtārthā śakyate ṣaṣṭhībhāvena vipariṇamayitum| `gāgryāyaṇaḥ` iti| iha yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ <> [[4.1.94]] iti gotrapratyayāntādyūni pratyayo bhavati| `tu śabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ` iti| kaḥ punaḥ saṃjñāsamāveśe doṣaḥ kathyate? śālaṅkerapatyaṃ yuvā <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak, pailasyāpatyaṃ yuvā <> [[4.1.156]] ita phiñ,tayoḥ <> [[2.4.59]] iti lugucyate - śālaṅkiryuvā, pailo yuveti| yadi ca gotrayuvasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśaḥ syāt tadā śālaṅkeryūnaśchātrā ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ prāgdīvyatīye'jādau pratyaye viṣayabhūte gotrādayaḥ <<gotre'lugaci>> [[4.1.89]] ityaluk syāt| tatastasmādyūno gotrasaṃjñā mā bhūdityavadhāraṇārthastuśabdaḥ kriyate||bhrātṛśabdas sambandhiśabdatvādyadapekṣaṃ bhrātṛtvaṃ meva bhrātaraṃ saṃjñitvenopakṣipati| jyāyāniti praśasyatarovṛddhataraścābhidhīyate| tasya ca jyāyastvaṃ guṇairvayasā vā| yuvānaṃ pratiyoginamapekṣya bhavatīti sa eva jyāyasītyanena pratiyogī pratyupasthāpyate| tena bhrātureva kanīyasaḥ saṃjñā vijñāsyata iti matvāha - `kanīyān bhrātaḥ yavasaṃjño bhavati` iti| `pūrvajāḥ` ityādinā avaṃśyārthatāmārambhasya samarthayate| `akāraṇatvāt` ityanenāpi bhrāturavaṃśyatvam| yo hi sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa vā kāraṇaṃ sa vaṃśyaḥ, na ca bhrātā kāraṇam, tasmādasau vaṃśyo na bhavatīti|| gārgye jīvati bhrātari jīvatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ vātsye jīvati vātsyāyano'sya kanīyān bhrātā, dākṣau jīvati dākṣāyaṇo'sya kanīyān bhrātā veditavyaḥ||janapadavṛttiśabdaḥ pañcālādirjanapada ityuktaḥ,kṣatriyavṛttiḥ kṣatriya ityabhidhāne'bhidheyopacārāt, sāhacaryādvā| nanu pañcālādayaḥ śabdāḥ, te <> [[4.2.69]] iti taddhite kṛte tasya <> [[4.2.81]] iti lupi ca janapade vartante, tat kathamavarakālayā janapadaśabdatayā nityāḥ kṣatriyaśabdā viśeṣyante? kathaṃ punaḥ kṣattriyasambandhādete janapade vartanta ityetadabhidhātumarhati vidvān| sūtrakāreṇa hi `tadaśi,yaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvālluvyogāprakhyānāt` (1.2.53,54) itiyuktavadbhāvaṃ lupañca pratyādiśatā janapade kṣattriyeṣviva svata eva pañcālādiśabdasya vṛttiruktā| yathā śabdā nityāstathā pañcālādirapi janapada iti kuto janapadavacanānatāyā avarakālatā !`pāñcālaḥ` ityādi| pañcālādayaḥ śabdā deśe santaḥ kṣattriyavācino'pi bhavanti svabhāvata eva, tebhyo'patyārthe'ñ| `aikṣvākaḥ` iti| ikṣvākuśabdasya `dāṇḍināyanahastināyana` [[6.4.174]] ityādau sūtre ukāralopo nipātitaḥ|`drauhravaḥ` iti| drahruśabdaḥ kṣattriyavacana eva, na janapadaśabdaḥ, tenāṇeva bhavati| `pāñcālirvaidehiḥ` iti| iha pañcālavidehaśabdau bhavato janapadaśabdau, na tu kṣattriyavacanau| api tu brāāhṛṇavacano, teneñeva bhavati| `kṣattriyasamānaśabdāt` ityādi|
