kaumāra ityetannipātyate, apūrvavacane| kiṃ punariha nipātyata ityāha - `kumāryā aṇvidhīyate` iti| kumārīśabdādaṇ nipātyata ityarthaḥ| kadetyāha - `apūrvatvaṃ yadā tasyāḥ` iti| iha hi nipātanena pumānabhidhīyate, strī vā,tatra dvayorapi pakṣayorapūrvatvam| yadā tasyāḥ striyā viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, na puṃsaḥ, tadetannipātanam, nānyathetyarthaḥ| `kumāryā bhavatīti vā` iti| anena yogaḥ pratyākhyāyate| yo hi kumārīṃ prāptavānasau tatra bhavati| tatasca <> [[4.3.53]] iti śaiṣike bhavārthe'ṇantaṃ kaumāraśabdaṃ vyutpadyeta,tataḥ puṃyagolakṣaṇe ṅīṣi sati hi kumārītyetat siddham| svarakṛto viśeṣo nāstyeva| tathā hi aṇantānṅīṣyapi kṛte <> [[6.4.148]] iti lope ca <> [[6.1.161]] ityudāttena ṅīpā bhavitavyam| ṅīṣ pratyayasvareṇādyudātta eva| nanu caivaṃ sati kaumārasya yā'nyāpi strīkaumāravyapadeśasya kāraṇaṃ sāpi kaumārīti prasajyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pratyāsatterhi yā tas pratyāsannā saiva tasya kaumārīti bhaviṣyati| kā punastasya pratyāsannā? yā kaumāre vyapadeśasya hetuḥ| yasyāmasau bhavan kaumāra ityucyate saiva, nānyā| yadyapi vyāsādayo'pi kumāryā bhavanti tathāpi teṣvaṇ, na bhaviṣyati; anabhidhānāt| etaccāvaśyamanabhidhānamāśrayaṇīyamiti; itarathā hi kriyamāṇe'pi nipātane <> [[4.3.53]] ityanenāṇ syādeva||`samudāyena ca` ityādinā prakṛtipratyayopādhitvaṃ vratasya darśayati| `śāstritaḥ` śabdaḥ <> [[3.2.40]] ityatra vyutpāditaḥ||`{odasvityam iti mu|pāṭhaḥ} audaiātkam` iti| `isusuktāntāt kaḥ` [[7.3.51]] ||`kṣaireyī` iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp||`tataścedvivakṣā bhavati` iti| tata iti pratyayānto nirdiśyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati - yadi pratyayāntālloke'sya vivakṣā bhavatyevaṃ pratyayo bhavati; nānyathetyarthaḥ| `pratyayāntena ca` ityādinā saṃjñāyāḥ samudāyopādhitvaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| `eṣā saṃjñā` iti| yā pratyayāntena gamyate| `pauṣī` iti| <> [[4.2.3]] ityaṇ, tadantānṅīp|`iha na bhavati` iti| saṃjñāyā anavagamyamānatvāt| na hi daśarātrasya pratyayāntāḥ saṃjñā, nāpi bhṛtakamāsasya| kiṃ tat tulyaṃ phalamityāha - `prayogānusaraṇam` iti| prayogānusaraṇaṃ prayogopalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| saṃjñāgrahaṇe hretat kriyate - prayogamupalakṣya yatra prayogo dṛśyate māsārdhamāsasaṃvatsareṣu tatra pratyaya utpādayituvyaḥ, na tu bhṛtakamāsādau| iti karaṇenāpyetadeva kriyate| tathā hi - pratyayāntādyadi lokasyārthavivakṣā bhavati, evaṃ hi pratyaya utpādayitavyaḥ, nānyatheti| evamarthamitikaraṇa upādīyate, tataśca lokavivakṣā māsārdhamāsasaṃvatsaraviṣayā bhavati, evaṃ hi na bhṛtakamāsādiviṣayā| tasmāt proyagānusaraṇam, ubhayorapi phalaṃ tulyameva| `saṃjñā` ityādi| nanu ca yathā saṃjñāśabdaḥ prayogānusaraṇaphalatayā loke prasiddhaḥ, tathetikaraṇo'pi, tatkimarthamiha tasya tena tulyatvameva jñāyate? ityāha - `na hrayam` ityādi| tathā hi - loke'yaṃ saṃjñāśabdaḥ prayogānusaraṇaphalatvena yathā prasiddhaḥ, na tathetikaraṇaḥ| tasmādasya tena tulyatā jñāpiteti bhāvaḥ| `saṃjñārthatveṭa ityādinā jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| saṃjñayā tulyo'rtho yasya sa saṃjñārthaḥ| samāsena gamyamānatvāt tulyaśabdo na prayujyate, yathā `rucyarthānām` [[1.4.33]] ityatra rucinā samānaśabda iti bhāvaḥ| saṃjñārthasya bhāvaḥ = saṃjñārthatvam| arthaśabdaścāyaṃ prayojanavacanaḥ| `tadupapannaṃ bhavati` iti| yata eva saṃjñāśabdenetikaraṇasya tulyārthatā jñāpitā tena yatra yatra prayogānusāraṇārthaṃ itikaraṇaḥ, tatastataśca vivakṣā bhavatītyucyate - tadupapannaṃ bhavatīti; itakaraṇasya saṃjñāprayojanatvāt|`pūrṇamāsādaṇ` iti| pūrṇo māso yasyaṃ tithāviti tatrārthe bahuvrīhiḥ| asmādeva nipatānādaṇ| pūrṇamāsasyeyaṃ `paurṇamāsī`| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| tithiviśeṣasyeyaṃ saṃjñā| vyatpattistu yathākathañcit kartavyāḥ||bāla-manoramākṣīrāḍḍhañ 1203, 4.2.21 |bāla-manoramāsāsminpaurṇamāsīti 1204, itiśabdāditi| etacca bhāṣye sthitam| pauṣīti| puṣyeṇa yuktā pauṣī paurṇamāsī, sā yasminmāse sa pauṣo māsaḥ| pauṣīśabdādaṇi `yasyeti ce`ti īkāralopaḥ| evaṃ maghābhiryuktā paurṇamāsī māghī, sā yasminsa māgho māsaḥ| tathā phālguna ityādi| saṃjñāyāṃ kim?| pauṣī paurṇamāsī asminpañcadaśarātre|`tasminnabhidheye` iti| yāgasampradānabhūtadevatāsvāminīke puroḍāśādau| eṣa cābhidheyaviśeṣaḥ| sāmānyoktāvapītītyasyehānuvṛtterlabhyate| `ādiyatyam, bārhaspatyam` iti| `dityadityādityapatyuttarapadāt` [[4.1.85]] ityādinā ṇyaḥ| yāgasya devatehābhipretā|aindro mantra iti ca prayoge kasyacit puroḍāśādikasya deyasyābhāvādindrasya sampradānatvaṃ nāsti| ato nāsau devadeti pratyayenātra na bhavitavyamiti manyate| `maṃntrastutyam` iti| yathā devatā pūjārhā tathā mantrastutyamapi vastu, tato devatāsādhamryāt tadi devatetyupacaranti vidvāṃsaḥ| indraśca mantrastutyo bhavati, tasmādasampradānabhūtamapi taṃ devatetyucaparanti| daivatopacāraṃ tatra kurvantītyarthaḥ| nanvemapi naivātra pratyayena bhavitavyam; mukhye sati gauṇasyāśrayaṇasyāyuktatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ;yathaiva hi kaścidenakenaiva yatnena oto dhāvatīti tantreṇa vākyadvayamuccārayati, tathehāpyācāryeṇa dve vākye tantreṇoccārite| tatraikaṃ mukhyārtham; aparaṃ gauṇārthaṃ bhaviṣyati|`katham` ityādi| agnerhi na mukhyaṃ devatātvam, nāpi gauṇam| tatra mukhyaṃ tāvannāsti;deyābhāvenāsampradānabhūtatvāt| gauṇamapi nāsti; mantraśabdābhāvena mantrastulyatathānupāttatvāt| tasmādatra pratyayena na bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `upamānādbhaviṣyati` iti| devatāsvāminīka evātra pratyaya upapadyate| yastvarthāntare pratyayāntaprayogaḥ sa āgneya ivāgneya ityupamānādbhaviṣyati, yathā - kāṣāyau gargabhasya karṇāviti| nanu ca sāsmin paurṇamāsīti seti prakṛtameva| tatkimarthaṃ punariha samarthavibhaktirnirdeśyata ityata āhu - `seti prakṛte` ityādi| yadidaṃ seti prakṛtaṃ tatsaṃjñāsambaddhamiti, tadanuvṛttau saṃjñāgrahaṇasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmāt tannivṛttyarthaṃ punariha samarthavibhaktinirdiśyata iti||bāla-manoramāarddeḥ saṃnivibhyaḥ 871, 4.2.24 arddeḥ saṃnivibhyaḥ| samarṇa iti| samard ta iti sthite `radābhyā`miti niṣṭhātasya pūrvadakārasya ca natvaṃ| ṇatvam| bāla-manoramāsā'sya devatā 1207, 4.2.24 sā'sya devatā| asminnarthe prathamāntādaṇādayaḥ syurityarthaḥ| aindraṃ haviriti| indrātmakadevatāsambandhītyarthaḥ| pāśupatamiti| paśupatirdevatā asyeti vigrahaḥ| nanu devatāśabdasya lokaprasiddhajātiviśeṣavācakatve pitaro devatā asya pittrayamityādyanupapannamityata āha -tyajyamānadravye iti| `haviśśeṣamṛtvigbhyo dadāti`, viprāya gāṃ dadātī`tyādau ṛtvigviprāderdevatātvavyāvṛttaye viśeṣagrahaṇam| tyajyamānahavissādhyo'smadādyapratyakṣaḥ yastṛptyādyupakārastadāśrayo devateti yāvat| mantrastutyā ceti| `agnimīḍe purohita`mityādimantreṣu yajñapurohitatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭatvena yā pratipādyate sāpi devatetyarthaḥ| aindro mantra iti| indrastutyako mantra ityarthaḥ| nanu `āgneyo vai brāāhṛṇo devatayā` ityatra kathaṃ devatātaddhitaḥ| atra agnerhaviruddeśyatvasya mantrastutyatvasya cā'bhāvādityata āha -āgneyo vai iti| śaiṣike'rthe iti| `śeṣe` iti sūtralabdhe vidhānasāmarthyāt| `kāyam` iti| vṛddhyāyādeśau||aponapāt, apānnapāditi yadyete devatānāmadheyetat kathametadvilakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtirūpaṃ sūtre śrūyate? ityāha -`tayostu pratyayasanniyogena` ityādi||atha kimarthaṃ yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, na `aponaptṛ - apānnaptṛbhyāṃ ghacchau` ityekayoga eva kriyate? ityāha - `yogavibhāgaḥ` ityādi| ekayoge hi dve prakṛtī, pratyayāvapi dvāveva, samasaṃkhyatvāt `{śṛsvṛsnihitrapyasi - da|u|} śṛsvasnihitapyasivasihaniklidibandhimanibhyaśca` (da|u|1|95) ityanena vyutpādita upratyayāntaḥ| ādyudāttatvādaṇi prāpte| sahāyaśabdo'pi `laghāvante bahvaṣo guruḥ` (phi|sū|2|42) iti madhyodāttaḥ| tatra anudāttāderañi prāpte talo vidhānam|`gajācceti vaktavyam` iti| gajaśabdāt tal bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ ceha cakārasyānuvṛttimāśritya kartavyam||`kāpotam, māyūram` iti| kapotamayūraśabdau `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ` (phi|sū|2|42) iti madhyodāttau`| `taittaram` iti| tittiriśabdaḥ kit` (da|u|1|48) iti kitpratyayāntaḥ| tarateḥ {sanvalluk iti| prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ} sanvattuk cābhyāsasyeti pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| nanu ca sanvadbhāvādādyudāttaḥ prāpnoti? <> [[3.3.1]] iti bahulavacanāt svare sanvadbhāvo na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ||`ādyudāttārthamacittārthañca vacanam` iti| asatyetasminnādyudāttebhyo'ṇ syāt, acitebyo'cittalakṣaṇaṣṭhak prasajyeta| `kṣudrakāścamālavāśceti kṣattariyadvandvaḥ` iti|kṣudrakasyāpatyāni bahūni <> [[4.1.168]] , mālavasyāpatyāni bahūni| <> [[4.1.171]] | tayoḥ `tadrājasya` [[2.4.62]] iti bahuṣu luk, paścāddvandvaḥ| `tataḥ pūrveṇāñi siddhe` iti| samāsāntodāttatve kṛte dvandvasamāsasyānudāttāditvāt| vacanaṃ gotravuño bādhanārtham| <> [[4.2.39]] ityādinā gotralakṣaṇo vuñprāpnoti, tadbādhanārthaṃ kṣudrakalṛmālavakasyeha gaṇe pāṭhaḥ|`nanu ca` ityādi| paratvādevāñ vuñaṃ bādhiṣyata ityato nārtho vuño bādhanārthenānena vacaneneti bhāvaḥ| etacca gotratvamabhyupetyoktam| idānīṃ gotratvameva na bhavatīti darśayitumāha - `na ca` ityādi| gotrasamuccayo'yam| na ca gotrasamudāyo gotragrahaṇena gṛhrate, yathā janapadasamudāyo na janapadagrahaṇena| tathā ca kāśayaśca kośalāśca kāśikośalāḥ, teṣu bhavāḥ kāśikośalīyāḥ| janapadatvābhāvāt `{janapadavadhyośca -mu|pāṭhaḥ} janapadatadavadhyośca` [[4.2.123]] iti vuñ na bhavati, `vṛddhāśchaḥ` [[4.2.113]] eva tu bhavati| syādetat - yadyapi gotrasamudāyo gotraṃ na bhavati, tadavayustu bhavati, kṣudrakamālavakaśabdo'vayavo gotram, atastadantavidhinā tadantādgotrasamudaḥyādapi vuñ prāpnoti? ata āha - `na ca` ityādi| na hi sarvastadantavidhirbhavatīti| tathā hi - <> [[1.1.72]] ityatroktam -`samāsapratyayavidhau pratiṣedhaḥ`, `ugidvarṇagrahaṇavarjam` (vā|12,13) iti| pratyayavidhiścāyam| yeṣu tatra ca tadantavidhiriṣyate te tatraiva `bhayādyādigrahaṇam` (vā|303) ityādinā parigaṇitāḥ, na cāsya tatra parigaṇanam| tato nāsti tadantavidhiḥ| `evaṃ tarhi` ityādi| yadayaṃ kṣudramālavakagrahaṇaṃ karoti vuñbādhanarthām, tajjñāpayati - vuñi pūrvavipratiṣedho bhavati, na paravipratiṣedhaḥ| `sāmūhikeṣu ca tadantavidhirasti` iti| kimetasya jñāpane prayojanamityāha - `aupagavakam, kāpaṭavakam` iti| etad vuñpūrvavipratiṣedhajñāpanasya projanam| asati hretasmiñjñāpane parivipratiṣedhena <> [[4.2.44]] ityañ syāt| vuñastu yatrādyudāttatvaṃ so'vakāśaḥ - glaucukāyanakamiti| glucukāyanaśabdo hi `prācāmavṛddhāt phin bahulam` [[4.1.160]] iti phinpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ|| `vānahastikam,gothenukam` iti| tadantavidhijñāpanasya prayojanam| asatyetasmiñjñāpane <> [[4.2.47]] iti dhenuhastiśabdābhyāṃ vidhīyamānaṣṭhak na tadantāt syāt|`{kṣudrakamālavāt - kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|} kṣudrakamālavakāt` iti| gaṇe `kṣudrakamālavāt senāsaṃjñāyām` (ga|sū|82) iti paṭhate, tatra yadyayameko yogaḥ syāt, ekena yatnena ca jñāpanaṃ niyamaśca na labhyate| tasmādatra yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ| tatra kṣudrakamālavādityeko yogaḥ, senāsaṃjñāyāmiti dvitīyaḥ| tatra pūrvo yogo jñāpanārthaḥ, uttaro niyamārthaḥ| `punarasyaiva` iti| kṣudrakamālavādityasyaiva yogasya| `kṣaudrakamālavī` iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| `kṣaudrakamālavakamanyat` iti| tadantavidhinātra vuñ bhavati|`añsiddheḥ` ityādi| kṣudrakamālaśabdāt <> [[4.2.44]] ityañ siddhaḥ| tatko'rthaḥ kiṃ prayojanaṃ tasya gaṇapāṭhena?na kiñcidityarthaḥ| syādetat -yo gotralakṣaṇo vuñ syādetastadbādhanārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ? ityāha - `gotrādvuñ vidhīyate` (iti)| na ca kṣudrakamālavaśabdo gotram, tatkutastato vuñprāptiḥ? `tadantāt` ityādi| yadyapi kṣudrakamālavaśabdo gotrasamudāyo gotraṃ na bhavati, tadavayavastu bhavati, tena tadantavidhinā prāpnotyeva| `na ca sarvataḥ` iti| na ca tadantavidhiḥ sarvatraiva bhavati| parigaṇiteṣveva kāryeṣu tadantavidhiriṣyate, na cedaṃ tatra parigaṇyate, tatkutastadantavidhinā vuñprāptiḥ| `jñāpakaṃ syāt` ityādi| idaṃ hi kṣudrakamālavagrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārthaṃ bhavet| etajjñāpayati - sāmūhikeṣu tadantavidhirastīti| evaṃ kṛtvā'ṣaḍapiśalervidhirupapanno bhavati| vidhīyate'neneti vidhiḥ, sa punaḥ `dhenoranañaḥ` (vā|423) iti, etaddhi tatsūtram| asyāyamarthaḥ - dhenuśabdaḥ samūhe'rthe ṭhakamutpādayati, na ceddhenuśabdo naña uttaro bhavatīti| nañpūrvapado na bhavatīti yāvat| yadi tatra sāmūhikeṣu tadantavidhirna syāt `anañaḥ` iti vacanaṃ nopapapadyate| asati tadantavidhau dhenuśabdāducyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ, kaḥ prasaṅgo yadadhenuśabdāt syāt ! tadetadanañiti vacanaṃ paramarthavadbhavati yadi sāmūhikeṣu tadantavidhirbhavati, nānyathā| prayojanāntaramāha -`senāyām` ityādi| senāsaṃjñāyāmeva kṣudrakamālaśabdādañ bhavatītyeṣa niyamo yatā syādityevamarthastasya gaṇe pāṭha ityarthaḥ| `yathā` ityādi| ceti samuccaye| pūrvavipratiṣedhena vuñā'ño bādhanaṃ yathā syādityevamartho gaṇe pāṭhaḥ|`{khaṇḍikā -kāśikā} khaṇḍika` iti| khaṇḍikaśabdo matvarthīyaṭhanpratyayānto nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `vala { saṃvaraṇe sañcalane ca` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-} saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-491) ityasmāt <> [[3.3.1]] ityavanpratyaye ḍalayorekatvasmaraṇāllakārasya ḍakārādeśe ṭāpi vaḍaveti bhavati| bhikṣukaśabdo'pi kutsārthavivakṣāyāṃ kannantatvāt pūrvapadādyudāttaḥ| śukolūkayorapi `prāṇinā kupūrvāṇām` (phi|sū|1|30) iti kupūrvādirudātta eva| āñśabdaḥ `kanin yuvṛṣi` (da|u|6|51) ityataḥ kaningrahaṇe'nuvartamāne `ānnukṣanpūṣanplīhankledantasnehanmūrdhanmajjannaryamanviāpsanparijmanmātariānmaghavan` (da|u|6|55) iti kaninpratyayānto nipātitaḥ,tenasāvapi pūrvavadādyudāttaḥ| yugavaratrāśabdayoracitārthaḥ| saṃhatavigṛhītārthaṃ yugavaratrāgrahaṇaṃ varṇayanta - yaugam, vāratram, yogavaratramiti||`gotarcaraṇādvuñityārabhya` iti| nanu ca tatra dharmagrahamaṃ nāsti, tatkathaṃ dharmavadityatideśaḥ prayujyate? ityāha - `tatredam` ityādi| idameva dharmavaditi vacanaṃ liṅgabhūtaṃ gamayati - `caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoḥ` (vā|476) ityetadvacanaṃ śeṣabhūtamiti| na hi tena vinā'deśa upapadyate| `vatiḥ sādṛśyārthaḥ` iti| asati hi vatau yadi caraṇagrahaṇaṃ dharmapratyayairabhisambadhyate - caraṇebhyo dharme'bhyo ye pratyayā abhidhāsyante te bhavanti <> [[4.2.37]] ityetasminnartha iti, samūhaprakṛtirna viśeṣitā syāt| evañceha prakṛtimātrāddharmapratyayāḥ prasajyeran| atha prakṛtiḥ sambadhyate - dharme ye vidhāsyante pratyayāste bhavanti| `caraṇebhyaḥ samūhaḥ` ityetasminnarthe, evamapi dharmapratyayāna viśeṣitāḥ syuḥ| tataścācaraṇebhyo'pi ye dharme vidhāsyante pratyayāste'pīha caraṇebhya āpadyeran| athāpyubhayasannidhānādubhayaṃ viśeṣyate, tena vākyabhedaṃ kṛtvā pratyayaiḥ prakṛtibhiḥ sambadhyate - caraṇebhyo dharme'tha ye pratyayā vidhāsyante te samūhe bhavanti caraṇebhya iti? evamapi kaścit caraṇaprakṛtikaḥ pratyayo yataḥ kutaściccaraṇāt samūhe syāt| <> [[4.3.132]] chandoga#ādibhyo'pi syāt| vatau tu tasya sādṛśye vidhānāt sarvasādṛśyaparigraho bhavati| tena yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaścaraṇaviśeṣaṇena ye pratyayāḥ vihitāḥ , ihāpi tābhyaḥ prakṛtistenaiva viśeṣaṇena ta eva pratyayā bhavantīti na kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| tasmāt sarvasādṛśyaparigrahārthaṃ vatkaraṇaṃ kartavyam| ` kāṭhakam, kālāpakam` iti| <> [[4.3.126]] | `chāndogyam, aukthikyam` iti| `chandogokthikayājñikabahvṛcanaṭāññyaḥ` [[4.3.129]] iti ñyaḥ| `ātharvaṇam` iti| <> [[4.3.132]] ,<<ātharvaṇikasyekalopaśca>> [[4.3.133]] ityaṇ, ikalopaśca| ete pratyayā yathā caraṇebhyo dharme bhavanti, tathā samūhe'pi||`acita` iti| arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasyārthasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na svarūpasya, tenācittavācibhyaṣṭhagvijñāyata ityāha - `acittavācibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ` iti| hastidhenuśabdayośca śabdapradhānatvānnirdeśasya svarūpagrahaṇam| ata eva `hastidhenuśabdābhyām` iti|`{dhenoranaña iti vaktavyam - iti vārtikapāṭhaḥ|} adhenoriti vaktavyam` iti| dhenuśabdādanañpūrvāṭṭhag bhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - vakṣyamāṇamihānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣo vijñāyate, vyavasthivibhāṣā ca|tena dhenuśabdādanañpūrvādeva bhavatīti, na nañpūrvāditi| `ādhenavam` iti| <<utsādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.1.86]] | nanu ca dhenuśabdastatra paṭhate, tatkathamadhenuśabdādbhavatīti?tatrāpi tadantavidheḥ sambhavāt| tat kathaṃ vijñāyate? vaṣkayāsa iti vaṣkayaśabdasya samāse pratiṣedhāt| vaṣkayaśabdāddhi pratyayavidhānam, govaṣkayaśabdānna prāpnoti,kiṃ samāsapratiṣedhena? itaḥ pratiṣedhādvijñāyate - asti tatra tadantavidhiriti||keśaśabdādacittalakṣame ṭhaki prāpte vacanamidam| aāśabdādapyaṇi sūtramidamārabhyate| anyatarasyāṃgrahamāṭṭhagaṇāvapi bhavataḥ||acittalakṣaṇake kaṭhi prāpte vacanamidam||gośabdādaṇi prāpte, khalarathābyāmacittalakṣaṇe ṭhakīdaṃ vacanam| atra pāśādiṣveva khalādīnāṃ pāṭhaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ? ityāha - `pāśādiṣvapāṭha uttarārthaḥ` iti| uttarasūtra initrakaṭacaḥ khalādibhya eva yathā syuḥ, pāśādibhyo mā bhūditi||`khalādibhya inirvaktavyaḥ` iti| vaktavyo vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena khalādibhya inipratyayo bhaviṣyati| ādiśabdaścāyaṃ prakāre, khalaprakāra ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaste khalaprakārāḥ? yebya inirdṛśyate| yadi tarhi khalādibhya inirbhavati, vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti? vākyabhedādadoḥ| ekaṃ vākyaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati, iha dve vākye iti| initrakaṭacaḥ khalagorathebhyo bhavantītyekaṃ vākyam; cakāraścānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, taḥ khalādibhya inirbhavatīti dvitīyam| dvitīye tu vākye khalaśabdasya tatra prakāropalakṣaṇatvaṃ veditavyam, na tu prakṛtitvam||`yo'sau viṣayo deśaścet sa bhavati` iti| nanu ca yo viṣayaḥ sa deśa eva bhavati, kiṃ tadviśeṣaṇena deśe grahaṇena? ityāha - `viṣayaśabdo'yam` ityādi| `atyantaśīlite` iti| atyantābhyasta ityarthaḥ|`ākṛtigaṇaścāyam` iti| aparisamāptatāṃ rājanyāderdarśayati|ādiśabdaścāyaṃ prakārārthaḥ||`chandasaḥ` iti| na svarūpagrahaṇam, nāpi mantrabrāāhṛṇayoḥ| kasya tarhi? akṣarāṇāmiyattāvacanaśchandaśabdo'sti, yasya jagatyādayo viśeṣāḥ, tasyedaṃ grahaṇam| tasyaiva hi pragātha ityādau sambandhaḥ, netarasya| tena paṅktyādibhyaḥ pratyayo bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati|`{pragathanena -kāśikā} pragranthena` iti| uccāraṇaviśeṣaṇena pragranthāt prakarṣādgāyanarthādveti| etena yannimittakaḥ pragāthaśabdastāṃ kriyāṃ darśayati| pragāthaśabdo'yaṃ yadā <> [[3.3.19]] iti karmaṇi ghañanto vyutpādyate - pragravayate'sau pragātha iti, pṛṣodarādipāṭhādgranthe rephānunāsikayorlopaśca , tadā pragranthanakriyānimittako bhavati| yadā tu `kai gai śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-916,917) ityasmāt <> [[3.3.1]] iti pragāthasthanpratyayānto vyutpādyate, tadā gāyanakriyānimitto bhavati|`nupaṃsake` ityādi| napuṃsakaliṅge svārtha eva cchandasaḥ pratyayasyopasaṃkhyānam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - iti karaṇo vivakṣārthaḥ| tena yatra pratyayāntācchiṣṭānāṃ vivakṣā bhavati tatra pratyayena bhavitavyam| napuṃsakaliṅge svārthe'pi ca sā bhavati, atastatrāpi pratyayo bhavati| avaśyaṃ caitadeva vijñeyam| yo hi manyate - `sarvātiprasaṅganivṛttiritikaraṇena kriyate` iti, tasyāsāvanarthaka eva syāt; sarvātiprasaṅgānānupādhibhirnirastatvāt||atra `saṃgrāme` iti pratyayārtha iti, saptamyantatvāt| `prayojanayoddhṛbhyaḥ` iti pañcamyantatvāt prakṛtinirdeśaḥ, tataśca <> [[4.1.82]] ityetadvirudhyate; prathamasya pratyayārthatvena dvitīyasya prakṛtitvenopādīyamānatvādityasya codyasya nirāsāyāha - `so'syeti samarthavibhaktiḥ pratyayārthaścānuvartate` iti| etenaitaddarśayati - `prayojanayoddhṛbhyaḥ` ityetadevamarthaṃ yasmāt pūrvasūtrādeva sa iti prathamaṃ tadihānuvartate, tadvaśeṣaṇaṃ tu prayojanayoddhṛbhya iti| pratyayātho'pyasyeti pūrvasūtrādanuvartate, tadviśeṣaṇaṃ saṃgrāmaḥ, tatro nāsti virodhaḥ; pūrvasūtre yat prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ tata eva pratyayavidhānāditi||`kriyeti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam` iti| yatra tadghañantaṃ kriyāvāci cedbhavatīti| tena bhāve yo ghañ tadantāt pratyayo bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| nanu ca bhāve yo ghañ tenaiva tadantaṃ kriyāvāci? yasmāddhātvarthasya siddhatā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādibhirbhavitavyamityuktaṃ prāk, dharmadharmiṇorbhedasyāvivitatvāt kriyādharmo'pi kriyāśabdanokta ityadoṣaḥ| `itikaraṇo vivakṣārthaḥ`iti| nanu ca parvasūtrādevetikaraṇo'nuvaritiṣyate,tatka punariha tasyopādānam? itikaraṇasyeha prakaraṇe'nadhikāratāṃ darśayituṃ punarupādānam| tena <> [[4.2.59]] ityatrāsyetikaraṇasyānanuvṛttau vivakṣāniyamābhāvādadhyetṛveditṛmātre pratyayaḥ siddho bhavatītyeke| vaicitryārthamitikaraṇopādānamityapare| `śyainampātā` iti| `śala hula patlṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-843, 844,845) bhāve ghañ, śyenasya pāta iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ñe vihite <<śyenatilasya pāte ñe>> [[6.3.71]] ita mum| `prākāraḥ` iti| karoteḥ prapūrvāt <> [[3.3.19]] iti karmaṇi ghañ| <> [[6.3.122]] iti praśabdasya dīrghaḥ| bhavatīdaṃ ghañantam; na tu kriyāvāci; prākāras dravyatvāt|`atha`ityādi codyam| `krīḍāyāmityanena tatsambaddham` ityādi parihāraḥ| syādetatnuvartatāṃ krīḍā, tasyāñcedaṃ pratyavidhānamiṣyata ityata āha - `sāmānyena ca` ityādi||`vaiyākaraṇaḥ` iti| `nana yvābhyām` [[7.3.3]] ityādinā vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ,aijāgamaśca| `dvistaddagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadi `tadadhīte veda` ityevocyeta pratyayārthadvasya dvitīyāsamarthe samuccayo vijñāyate, tataśca yastvadhīte vetti ca tatraiva syāt; yastvadhīte kevalaṃ na vetti, vetti vā kevalaṃ nādhīte tatra na syāt| dvistadgrahaṇe tu vākyabhedādadhīyāne viduṣi ca pratyekaṃ pratyayaḥ sidhyati| tadarthaṃ dvistadgrahaṇam| naitaddvistadgrahaṇasya prayojanam, yathaiva hi `te na dīvyati khanati jayati jitam` [[4.4.2]] ityatra sakṛt samarthavibhaktyupādāne'pi pratyayārthacatuṣṭayena tṛtīyāsamarthena samuccayo na vijñāyate,tathehāpi na vijñāsyate| tena yathā dīvyatiprabhṛtiṣu pratyayo bhavati, tathehāpi pratyekamadhīyāne viduṣi ca bhaviṣyatīti? na brāūmaḥ - ihaiva dvistadgrahaṇamadhīyānaviduṣoḥ pṛthagvidhānārthamiti| `kutastarhi? <> [[4.2.60]] , <> [[4.2.63]] ityatra ca| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra na syāt? kratuśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyaḥ,vasantādayo'pyṛtuvacanāḥ, teṣāmadhyayanaṃ nopapadyate| tatsahacarite granthe syāt, sa ca tatra goṇa iti na gṛhrate| mukhya evārthe vedane sambhavatīti tebhyo viduṣyeṇa pratyayaḥ syāt, nādhyetari| punardvistadgrahaṇādgauṇasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti pratyekamadhyetṛviduṣoratra ṭhakpratyayo bhavati||kratuśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyaḥ, tasyādhyanavedane dve na sambhavata iti sāhacaryāt tadartho grantho gṛhrate, na tu kratunāmā kraturastīti tadviśeṣā ropadha iti sthite guṇe kṛte vibhaktau ca ropadhayoriti nirdeśaḥ syāt| tatraiva sandehaḥ syāt -kiṃ ropadhasyedaṃ grahaṇam? uta ropadhasyekārāntasyeti? taparakaraṇe tu sati sandeho na bhavati| īropadhāditi noktam, vaicitryārtham||`tadavadherapi` ityādi| `janapadatadavadhyośca` ityatra tacchabdena sannihitatvājjanapada evaparāmṛśyate| na cāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṣaṣṭīsamāse hrajanapado'pi yo'vadhistato'pi vuñ prasajyeta| cha eva tasyeṣyate - mauñjī nāma vāhīkānāmavadhigrrāmaḥ, tatra bhavo mauñjīya iti| tasmāt samānādhikaraṇa evāyaṃ samāsaḥ - saeva janapado'vadhirmaryādā tadavadhiriti| tena janapadāvadhireva eva gṛhyante, na grāmaḥ|`kimarthaṃ tarhi tadavadhigrahaṇam` iti| yadi tadavadhirapi janapada eva gṛhrate,nirarthakaṃ tarhi tasya grahaṇam, `janapadācca` ityetāvadeva vaktavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| `bādhakabādhanārtham` iti| gartottarapadādvakṣyamāṇaścha eva paratvādviśeṣavihitatvācca bādhakaḥ, tasya bādhanārthaṃ tadavadhigrahaṇam|tenahi trigarteṣu bhavastraigartaka ityatrottarasūtreṇa gartattottarapadācchaṃ bādhitvā vuñeva bhavati||`aṇchayorapavādaḥ` iti| avṛddhādaṇo'pavādaḥ, vṛddhācchasya| atha viṣayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, vināpi tena viśeṣo labhyata eva| katham? iha janapadatadavadhiśabdābhyāṃ samānādhikaraṇatvādvahuvacanaśabdo na pāribhāṣiko vijñāyate,kiṃ tarhi? anvarthaḥ - bahūnāmarthānāṃ vacano yo janapadastadavadhiśceti| yaśca bahūnāmarthānāṃ vacanaḥ so'rthān bahūn brāūvan sāmarthyādeva bahuvacanaviṣayo bhavati? ityāha - `viṣayagrahaṇam` ityādi| ananyatrabhāvaḥ kathaṃ nāma labhyata ityevamarthaṃ viṣayagrahaṇam| ananyatrabhāvaḥ kimarthamiṣyata ityāha - janapadaikadeśaḥ kriyate| vartanī ca vartanī ca vartanī ca vartanyaḥ,tadbahūnāṃ vācako bhavati| tataśca yadi viṣayaghaṇaṃ na kriyate tato vartanīṣu bhava iti vuñ syāt| viṣayagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati, ananyatrabhāvo viṣayaḥ| tenaivaṃ vijñāyate - bahuvacanaṃ na yo vyabhacarati| yaścaikaśeṣaḥ sa bahūvacanaṃ vyabhicarati, tasyahi vivakṣābhāve bahutvāt| dvayorapi ca kadācidvṛtteḥ|`apigrahaṇam` iti| apigrahaṇaṃ hi vṛddhādapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate| vṛddhātpūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ, tat kimapigrahaṇena? `takrakauṇḍinyāyena` iti| yathā `brāāhṛṇebhyo dadhi dīyatā takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya` iti sāmānyena vṛttasya dadhidānasya viśeṣe vartamānena takradānena bādhā kriyate, tathehāpi bahuvacanaviṣaye ca sāmānyena pravṛttasya pūrvayogasya bahuvacanaviṣaye vartamānenānena yogena bādhā vijñāyate| tasmādvṛddhādapi yathā syādityapi śabdena samuccīyate||`aṇāderapavādaḥ`iti| ādiśabdena kacchādīnāṃ grahaṇam| tatra deśavacanā avṛddhā yedhūmādayastebhyo'ṇo'pavādaḥ| ye tu vṛddhāstebhyaśchas| ya udīcyagrāmāstebhyo'ṇaḥ| ye bāhīkagrāmāstebhyaṣṭhaññiṭhayoḥ| `tasya yopadhatvādeva vuñi siddhe` iti| <> [[4.2.121]] ityanena| `janapadalakṣaṇe vuñi siddhe` iti| <> [[4.2.125]] ityādinā| `kūlāt sauvīreṣu` iti| kulaśabdādvṛñ bhavati sauvīreṣu| kaulako bhavati sauvīraśceta, kaulo'nyat||`nāgarā brāāhṛṇāḥ` iti| aṇ| nanu ca `nagara,māhiṣmatī` [[4.2.94]] iti nagaraśabdaḥ kattryādiṣu paṭhate, tato ḍhakañā bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ nāgarā iti pratyudāhyiyata ityāha - `kattryādiṣu` iti| dvividho nagaraśabdaḥ - jātivacanaḥ, saṃjñāvacanaśca| tayoḥ kattryādiṣu māhiṣmatīśabdena sāhacaryāt saṃjñāśabdaḥ paṭhate| tatra jātiśabdānnāgarā iti pratyudāhṛtam| saṃjñāśabde tu nāgareyaka iti pratyudāhartavyam||`aupasaṃkhyānikasya ṇasyāpavādaḥ` iti| `araṇyāṇyaḥ` (vā|437) ityupasaṃkhyānātprāptasya| `pathyadhyāyanyāya` ityādi| eṣu pathyādiṣu vuñbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[4.2.127]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ,tena pathyādiṣu vuñbhavati|`vāgomayeṣu` iti| gomayeṣu vācyeṣu vā vuñbhavatīti| sa tu tasyaiva cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthasyānuvṛttervakṣyamāṇasya vibhāṣāgrahaṇasyobhayoḥ śeṣabhūtatvāllabhyate| yadi tarhi vakṣyamāṇaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūtaṃ pathyādiṣvapi vikalpena vidhiḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyavasthitavibhāṣā hi sā, tena gomayādvikalpena vidhirbhavati, pathyādiṣu nityamiti||`saiṣā yugantharārthā vibhāṣā` iti|na kuruśabdārthā| tatra kacchādipāṭhādvināpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇenāṇā bhavitavyam| nanu yugandharaśabdādapyaṇi <> [[4.2.125]] iti nityaeva vuñi prāpte vacananityārthaṃ bhaviṣyati, nitye hi vuñi punarārambho'narthaka- syāt, tasmādyugandharārthā'pi vibhāṣā na prasajyeta? naitat punarārambho viparyayeṇāpi śakyate samarthayitum| janapadalakṣaṇo [[4.2.123]] yo vuñ sa vibhāṣā,ayaṃ tu nitya iti|asmāttu yugandharārthaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| manuṣyatatsthayostu kuruśabdānnitya eva vuḍhbhavati, kacchādiṣu pāṭhasāmarthyāt| anyathānayaiva vibhāṣayā vuñaṇoḥ siddhatvāt kaccādipāṭho'rthakaḥ syāt; anavakāśatvāt||`janapadavuño'pavādaḥ`iti| <> [[4.2.125]] ityādiprāptasya| madravṛjyoḥ kanniti ñyantasya paranipātaḥ <> [[2.2.32]] ityasya vidheranityatvajñāpanārtham| tena dhūmāgnī ityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati||`janapadavuño'pavādaḥ` iti| pūrvatpraptasya| kiṃ punardeśādanyatra vartamāno neṣyate, yo deśe vartate? ityāha - `anyatretyādi pūrveṇa` iti|`prasthottarapadāt` [[4.2.109]] iti sūtreṇa|athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na kopadhādyathāvihitamevocyeta, yathāvihitamucyamāne'ṇapavādo vuñ syāditi cet? na; vuñvidhāne hi vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt,tena vinā vuñaḥ siddhatvāt| tasmādvacanasāmarthyādvihito'ṇeva prāpnoti| anyena bādhitvā ata evāṇ ataevāṇ bhaviṣyatīti| sa hi <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] iti vihito bādhitaśca vuñaivetyata āha - `aṇgrahaṇam` ityādi| `ikṣvākuṣu jātaḥ`iti| ikṣvākuśabdādordeśe ṭhañ [[4.2.118]] prāptaḥ, tasmin janapadavuñā bādhite yadīhājgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadā punarvacanādvuñeva bhavati, aṇgrahaṇādaṇeva bhavati| `aikṣvākaḥ` iti| `dāṇḍināyanahāstināyana` [[6.4.174]] ityādāvikṣvākuśabdasyokārasya lopo nipātitaḥ||`vuñāderapavādaḥ` iti| ādiśabdena ṭhañaḥ| tatra ye janapadabahuvacanaviṣayāstebhyo vuñaḥ prāptasyāpavādaḥ| sindhuvarṇuśabdābhyāmordeśe ṭhañaḥ [[4.2.118]] | `kacchaśabdo na bahuvacanaviṣayaḥ` iti| tena <> [[4.2.125]] ityādinā bādhakasya vuño'prāptāveva sāmānyenāṇsiddha eveti darśayati| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ tasya pāṭhaḥ? ityāha - `tasya` ityādi| uttarasūtreṇa vuñ manuṣyatastthayoryathā syādityavamarthaḥ kacchasyeha pāṭhaḥ, na tvanarthakaḥ| `kopadhādevāṇ siddhaḥ`iti| pūrvasūtreṇeti| `ihagrahaṇamuttarārtham` iti| uttarasūtra vuñ yathā syāt||`sālvaḥ` iti| kacchādipāṭhādaṇ||avṛddhārtha vacanam| vṛddhāttu `vṛddhācchaḥ` (4.2.113) ityanenaiva siddhamiti| sati tu vṛddhāvapi paratvādanenaiva bhavitavyam| `ano'pavādaḥ` iti| nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt| `vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇañca` ityādi| yad gartottarapadaṃ vāhīkavāci tato vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇau ṭhaññiṭhau bādhittavāt paratvāccha eva bhavati, tasya gartottarapadamavakāśa iti| athottarapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na gartāntādityevocyeta? ityāha - `uttarapadagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadi gartāntādityucyeta tadā bahugarta ityetasmādapi bahucpūrvāt syāt, bhavati hretadgartāntam| uttarapadagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati, na hretadgartottarapadam| samāse hi satyetadbhavati - pūrvapadamuttarapadamiti||`kopadhalakṣaṇasya ca` ityādi| akekāntāt `kopadhādaṇ` (4.2.131) ityaṇi prāpte'ṇo'pavādaḥ| kopadhādapi vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇasya ṭha()ño ñiṭhasya ca| `ropadhetoḥ prācām` iti| `akekāntagrahaṇe kopadhagrahaṇam` iti| iha sūtre'kekāntagrahaṇamapanīya kopadhagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| kopadhādityevaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ||`vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇasya` iti| ṭhaññiṭhayośca| antagrahaṇenaiva siddha sattyuttarapadagrahaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham||`pārvatīyāni phalāni` iti| nanu cāmanuṣyaśabdo rakṣaḥpiśācādiṣveva rūḍhaḥ tathā hi `sabhā, rājā'manuṣyapūrvā` (2.4.23) ityatra `iha kasmān bhavati -kāṣṭhasabheti, tatredamuktam -`amanuṣyaśabdo rūḍhirūpeṇa rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣveva vartate` iti, tatkathaṃ `amanuṣye` ityucyamāne phalādiṣvabhidheyeṣu bhavati?naiṣa dvoṣaḥ;dvau hramanuṣyaśabdau - rūḍhaḥ, vyutpannaśca| tatra `sabhā rājā'manuṣyapūrvā` (2.4.23) ityatra rūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇam, iha tvitarasya manuṣyādanya vartamānasya||`bhāradvājaśabdo'pi deśavacana eva,na gotraśabdaḥ`iti| deśa eva bhāradvāje kṛkaṇaparṇaśabdavṛtteḥ sambhavāt||`tatra vaṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati` iti| dve hi prakṛtī, pratyayāśca traya iti vaiṣamyam| nanu ca?ñchāvevānena vidhīyete, aṇpratyayastvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena yathāprāptasyābhyanujñāne kṛte śāstrādeva bhavati, tatkṛto vaiṣamyam? cho'pi tarhi tenaivānena vidhīyate, tasyāpi hi cakāro'bhyanujñāpaka eva| so'pi svaśāstrādeva `vṛddhācchaḥṭa [[4.2.114]] ityetasmādbhavatīti? evamapi vaiṣamyam| sarvathā nāsti yathāsaṃkhyaprasaṅga||`tasminniti sākṣadvihitaḥ khañ nirdiśyate` iti| tasminnityukte prāgeva tatraiva pratītyutpatteḥ| tatra punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sākṣādvihitvamānantaryācca khañaḥ, tasyaiva yuktaḥ| nanu ca pūrvasūtre?ñceti cakāreṇa ccho'nukṛṣyate,vācakadeśaśca vācya iti khañaścha evānantaro bhavati| syādanantaro yadi cakārastasya vācakaḥ syāt, na cāsau tasya vācakaḥ| sa hi samīpavartinaḥ padārthāntarasya sahāyatāmātramācaṣṭe| khañaḥ sahāyatāmākhyāya nivṛtte cakāre sā sahāyatā prakaraṇācchenaiva vijñāyate| tasmāccakāraśchasya vācako na bhavatīti nāsau tādṛśaḥ|tatkṛtayostasyānantarya `nimittayoḥ` ityādi| dve hi nimitte - khañaṇau, nimittanāvapi dvāvevādeśau, tataḥ samānatvadyathāsaṃkhyenātra bhavitavyamiti manyamānas praśnaḥ| `yogavibhāgaḥ ityādi` parihāraḥ|`yuṣmadīyaḥ, asmadīyaḥ` iti| yadi `tasminnaṇi ca` iti nocyeta to yathā pūrvasūtravihitayoḥ khañaṇorimāvādeśau bhavatastathā cche'pi syātām| tasmastu sati na bhavataḥ||pūrveṇa yuṣmākāsmākayoḥ prāptayoḥ <> [[7.2.98]] iti tvamayorekavacanetavakamamakāvādeśau vidhīyete| `ekavacanaparayoḥ` iti| ekavacanaṃ paraṃ yābhyāṃ te tathokte| `nimittayostu` ityādi| yathā pūrva eva sūtre yogavibhāgānnimittayorādeśau prati yathāsaṃkhyatvaṃ na bhavati, tathehāpi na bhaviṣyati| tasya ca yathāsaṃkhyābhāvasya pūrvasūtra eva yogavibhāgo hetuḥ| tena hi pūrvatra nimitte nivṛtte yathāsaṃkhye kṛte tasmādihāpyanuvartate| te nivṛtte yathāsaṃkhye evānuvartete; ajahaddharmatvādadhikārāṇām| tasmādihāpi pūrvakayogavibhāgādyavāsaṃkhyabhāvaḥ| iha sarvavidhibhyo lugvidhirvalavānityekavacanasya luki kṛte yuṣmadasmadorekavacanaparatā na sambhavatīti pratyayalopalakṣaṇena samarthayitavyā| tadapi pratyayalopalakṣamaṃ pratiṣedhalakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣedhayitumāha - `nanu ca` ityādi| `vacanāt` ityādi parihāraḥ| yadi hi pratyayalopalakṣaṇaṃ na syādidaṃ vacanamapārthakaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca yasyaivaka vacanaparatā sambhavati tasya viśeṣaṇārthamekavacanaṃ syāt, kasyaikavacanaparatā sambhavati? nimittasya khañādeḥ| nimitte tvekavacanaparatvena viśeṣyamāṇe satīhaiva syātām - yauṣmākaḥ putraḥ, āsmākaḥ putraḥ; atra hrekavacanaparatvam, taddhi tasyopapadyate; iha ca na syātām - tāvakāḥ putrāḥ, māmakāḥ putrā iti| na hyatra nimittasyaikavacanaparatā sambhavatīti? naitadasti; yuṣmadasmadī pūrvasūtre viśeṣe abhūtām| tathā hi - khañyaṇi ca parato yuṣmadasmadoriti khañaṇparatā tayoḥ, ata eva yuṣmadasmadī viśeṣyete| tadihāpi tathābhūte evānuvartete; ajahaddharmatvādadhikārāṇāmiti tayorevaikavacanaparatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| atha vā tavakamamakayorvidheyatvena prādhānyāt tayorevaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| tayoreva tadviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavat sthānidvārakameva bhavati| yadi sthāninorekavacanaparatā, evamādeśau sthānivattvādekavacanaparau bhavataḥ| tadanenāpi prakāreṇa yuṣmadasmadorekavacanaviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| na tu kathañcinnimittasya khañādeḥ|`atha vā` ityādi| purvaṃ pāribhāṣikamekavacanamāśritya vyākhyātam, idānīṃ tvartamāśritya vyācaṣṭe - eko'rtha ucyate yena tadekavacanam| atra tu vyākhyāne `ekavacane` iti nedaṃ saptamyekavacanam| kiṃ tarhi? prathamādvivacanāntam||`grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti` (vyā|pa|89) ititadantavidhipratiṣedhāt pūrveṇāprāptāvayamārambhaḥ| tatrādhamottamaśabdau nindāpraśaṃsāvacanau, tatpūrvādaṇi prāpte satyamārambhaḥ| parāvaraśabdau yāvadikchabdau tatpūrvādapyaṇyeva| yau tu dikchabdau tatpūrvāduttarasūtreṇa ṭhañi yati ca| kathaṃ punaḥ `parāvarādhamottamebhyaḥ` ityucyamāne parāvarādipūrvatā śakyā vijñātum? ityāha - `ardhāditi vartate` ityādi| iha hi pūrvasūtrādardhādityanuvartate| tatra parāvarādhamottamebhyaḥ paro yo'rdhaśabdaḥ - ityevaṃ viśeṣamāṇe'drdhaśabdasāmarthyādeva tasya parāvarādipūrvatā vijñāsyate, tatka pūrvagrahaṇena? `tatra` iti| parāvarayoradikśabdayoḥ| `pareṇa` iti| uttarasūtreṇa ṭhañyatau syātāmiti| yadi pūrvagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetetyabhiprāyaḥ| `asmāt` ityādi| parāvarādipūrvādeva yathā syādityetadeva hi pūrvagrahaṇasya prayojanam| tena hi pūrvaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati, na paramityeṣo'rthaḥ sūcyate| tasmāt dikśabdapakṣe'pi parāvarapūrvādyadeva bhavati||`paurvārddhikam` iti| pūrvasminnarthe jātaḥ| ` taddhitārtha` [[2.1.50]] ityādinā samāsaḥ,tatastaddhitaḥ| atha padagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, dikpūrvādityevocyeta? ityāha - `padagrahaṇam` ityādi| asati hi padagrahaṇe svarūpavidhiḥ syāt, tataśca digarddhe jāta ityatraiva syāt| padagrahaṇe tu sati yannāma kiñciddiksambandhiḥ pūrvapadaṃ tasya grahaṇamupapannaṃ bhavati||`yato'pavādau` iti| pūrveṇa prāptasya| `paurvārdhāḥ` iti|pūrvavatsamāsaḥ| nanvatra pūrvasminnarddhe grāmasyeti grāmamapekṣamāṇasyārdhaśabdasyāsāmarthyāt samāso nopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pradhānamātrārddhaṃ bhavati| pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ - ityetat <> [[2.1.56]] ityatra jñāpitam||madhyaśabdo yo gahādiṣu pṛthivīmadhyavacanaḥ `madhyamadhyamañcāṇ caraṇe` (ga|sū,|99) iti paṭhate, tatastu tata eva vidhirbhavati| yastvanyastasyeha grahaṇaṃ veditavyam||nyāyyaṃ yuktamityādibhiḥ paryāyaiḥ sāmpratikaśabdārthamācaṣṭe -`{sāmpratikam -nyāyyam, yuktam, ucitam, samamucyate -kāśikā,padamañjarī ca} sāmpratikaṃ nyāyyamucyate` (iti)| tathā hi prayogo dṛśyate na bāhraṃ prāptamityevaṃ varttitavyamasāmpratamiti| atra nyāyyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ pratīyate| sāmpratameva sāmpratikam| vinayāderākṛtigaṇatvāt `vinayādibhyaśca` [[5.4.34]] iti ṭhak||`anusamudram` iti| samudraṃ samayā'nusamudram| <> [[2.1.15]] ityavyayībhāvaḥ| `aṇo manuṣyavuñaścāpavādaḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.133]] iti prāptasyāṇaḥ| <> [[4.2.134]] iti prāptasya vuñaḥ||`kālaviśeṣavācinaḥ` iti| anena kālādityarthagrahaṇam, na svarūpasyeti| yadi hi svarūpagarhaṇaṃ syāt, sandhivelādi [[4.3.16]] sūtreṇāṇo vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt; <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| iha tvarthagrahaṇe ṭhañbādhanārthatvāt tasyānarthakyaṃ bhavati| tasmādarthagrahaṇametat|iha kecicchabdā mukhyayā vṛttyā kāle vartante - māso'rdhamāsa iti,kecidgauṇyā vṛttyā - kadambapuṣpasāhacaryāt kālaḥ kadambapuṣpaḥ,vrīhipalālena sāhacaryāt kālo vrīhipalāla iti; teṣāmihobhayeṣāmapi grahaṇam| ata evāha - `yathā kathañcit` iti| yena kenacitprakāreṇetyarthaḥ| `guṇavṛttyā'pi` iti| anena yathākathañcidityasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| aupacārikī, vṛttiḥ, apradhānabhūtā vṛttirityarthaḥ| apiśabdānmukhyāyapi vṛttyā| nanu ca mukhye sati gauṇasya grahaṇamayuktam, gauṇamukhyayormukhye, kāryasampratyayāt (vyā|pa|4)? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttijrñāpayati - gauṇasyāpi kālasya grahaṇamiti, yadayaṃ sandhivelādisūtre [[4.3.16]] prakṛtena kālagrahaṇena nakṣatrāṇi viśinaṣṭi| na hi mukhyārthaḥ kālo nakṣatrāṇāṃ viśeṣaṇamupapadyate| teṣu mukhyasya kālatvasyāsambhavāt||`ṛtvaṇo'pavādaḥ`iti| sandhivelādisūtreṇa [[4.3.16]] prāptasya| `{śrāddha iti na karma gṛhrate` ityeva mūlapāṭho dṛśyate|`śrāddha iti karma gṛhrate - padamañjarī|} śrāddhaṃ iti na karma gṛhrate` iti| kriyāviśeṣaḥ kaścit śāstroktena vidhinā sādhyaḥ śrāddhagrahaṇena gṛhrate, na tu śraddhāvān puruṣaḥ| kuta etat? tasya pratyayenānābhidhānāt| śāradikaśabdena hrabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyāt karmaṇa evābhidhānam, na puruṣasya||tasya {tasya cetīti mūlapāṭhaḥ;padamañjarīśca|} veti| ṭhañaḥ| kuta etat? tasya vidhīyamānatayā prādhānyāt, pradhāne ca kāryasampratyayāt| sa ca tuḍāgama ikādeśe kṛte bhavatīti veditavyam| nanu sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt tuṭastenaiva tāvadbhavitavyam, paścādaṅgasaṃjñāyāmabhinirvṛttāyāmikādeśena? naitadasti; upedaśāvasthāyāmeva hīkādeśe kṛte na bhavitavyam, jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ <> [[4.2.80]] iti pratyayasvarārthamanubandhaṃ cakāraṃ karoti| pratyayasaṃjñāyāḥ sanniyogāddhi pratyayasvare kṛte paścādikādeśa iti siddhamantodāttatvam, kiñcitkaraṇena? tasmāccitkaraṇādvijñāyate - sanniyogaśiṣṭebhyo'pi pūrvamikādeśo bhavati| tena ṭhaggrahaṇānyaṅgasaṃjñābhūtānīkameva bodhayantīti tuḍapi tasyaiva bhaviṣyatīti vijñāyate| `etābhyām` ityādi| āḥśabdo'yamavyayaṃ kālavācī| tena yadā ṭhañtyapau na bhavataḥ,tadā `sāyañciram` [[4.3.23]] ityādinā ṭauṭaulau api bhavataḥ||`ṭhaño'pavāda-ṭa iti| <> [[4.3.11]] iti prāptasya| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yathāvihitamevocyeta,tenaivamucyamāne na prāpnotītyāśaṅkanīyam, yadi ṭhañ syāt punarvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt, tasmādvacanaprāmāṇyādyo vihito na sa prāpnoti, ṭhañpratyayena bādhitatvāt sa eva bhaviṣyati, sa vācya? ityata āha - `aṇgrahaṇam` ityādi| sandhivelādiṣu paurṇamāsīśabdo vṛddhaḥ paṭhate| svātiriti nakṣatraśabdo vṛddho'sti| tatra yadyaṇgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tābhyāṃ paratvāṭṭhañā che bādhite punarvacanāccha eva syāt| tasmāt tanapi bādhitvā vṛddhādaṇeva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaraṇgrahaṇam| `taiṣam, pauṣam` iti| tiṣyapuṣpaśabdābhyāṃ <> [[4.2.3]] ityaṇ, tasyāṇo <> [[4.2.4]] iti lup, tato'nenāṇ, tiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi` (vā|808) iti yalopaḥ|`saṃvatsarātphalaparvaṇoḥ`iti| saṃvatsaraśabdādaṇbhavati phale parvaṇi cābhidheye| sāṃvatsaraṃ phalam, sāvaṃtsaraṃ parva vā| sāṃvatsarikamanyat||atha kimarthaṃ pratyaye mūrdhanyaḥ paṭhate, na `raṣābhyām` [[8.4.1]] ityenaiva ṇatvaṃ bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam, iha hi na syāt - prāvṛṣeṇiti padāntatvāt||atha kimarthaṃ ṭhagvidhānam,kālāṭ [[4.3.11]] ṭhañaiva siddhatvātubhayatrāpi tadeva rūpamiti? naivam; ṭhaki sati pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ syāt, ṭhañi tu sati <<ñnityādirnityam>> [[6.1.197]] ityādyudāttatvam||`yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ` iti| `sarvatrāṇ ca tarlopaśca` [[4.3.22]] iti vakṣyati, sa hemantaśabdasyaiva yathā syāt, vasantasya mā bhūt| yadi `hemantavasanatābhyām` ityekayogaḥ kriyeta, tato vasantasyāpi syāt; tasya hruttaratrānuvṛtteḥ||chandasi pūrveṇa ṭhañi prāpte bhāṣāyāmapi ṛtvaṇi caitaducyate| `sarvatragrahaṇam` ityādini sarvatragrahaṇasya prayojanamācaṣṭe| `chandasi bhāṣāyāñca` ityādinā chando'dhikāranivṛtteḥ phalaṃ darśayati| `nanu ca` ityādi| asvaritvādeva cchandasīti nānuvartiṣyate, tato nārthaśchanado'dhikāranivṛttyarthena sarvatragrahaṇenetyabhiprāyaḥ| `saiva` ityādinā yāsāvasvaritatvādananuvṛttiḥ saiva sarvatretyanena śabdenākhyāyate| kimarthamityāha - `prayatnādikyena` ityādi| pratyatnādhikyametadeva śabdenākhyātam| tena hetunā pūrvasūtre'pi sarvatraśabdasya sambandho yathā syādityevamarthaḥ śabdenākhyāyate| kasmāt punaḥ pūrvasūtre'pi sarvatragrahaṇasya sambandha iṣyate? ityāha - `haimantikamiti hi` ityādi| hiśabdo hetau| ācāryā hi haimantikamiti bhāṣāyāṃ ṭhañaṃ smasanti| sa caivaṃ bhāṣāyāmapi siddhyati, yadi pūrvasūtre'pi sarvatra grahaṇasya sambandho bhavati| tatra hi sati pūrvasūtrasyāyamartho bhavati - hemantācca sarvatra cchandasi bhāṣāyāmapi ṭhañ bhavatīti| `kaḥ punaranayoraṇo viśeṣaḥ`iti| na kaściditi bhāvaḥ| `ṛtvaṇi hi` ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati| `haimantī` iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| `tadevam` ityādi| yata eva pūrvasūtreṇa ṭhañ bhavatyanenāṇ talopasahitaḥ,tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti||<> [[4.3.11]] iti ṭhañi prāpte sāyamādibhyaḥ ṭauṭaulau vidhīyete, tayośca tuḍāgamaḥ| ṭhañapavādatvācc ṭauṭauloḥ| ṭhañaiva cchasya bādhitvādetābhyāṃ punaśchasya sampradhāraṇaiva nāsti| tena vṛddhādapi ṭauṭaulāveva bhavataḥ - prāktanamiti| `tayośca` ityādi| yadyanādiṣṭayostuṭ syāt tadā yurūpau pratyayau na bhavata ityanādeśo na syāt| tasmādādiṣṭayostayoḥ kṛtādeśayostuḍāgamaḥ| etacca <> [[6.3.17]] iti nirdeśāllabhyate| na hranādiṣṭayostuḍvidhānena tanaśabda upapadyate| atha pratyayoṣṭitkaraṇaṃ kimartham, na tuṭa eva ṭittvena pratyayorapi ṭittvaṃ vijñāsyata iti, yatastadgrahaṇena grahaṇādāgamānām? naitadasti; yuktaṃ yat pratyayadharmā āgame bhavanti tasya pratyayabhaktatvāt, natvāgayadharmā pratyaye| tasmāṭṭitkāryārthaṃ pratyayorapi ṭittvamāsajyate| `syaterantakarmaṇaḥ` iti| `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1147) ityasya| `prāhṇe prage ityekārāntam` iti| nipātyata iti sambandhaḥ| nanu ca <> [[6.3.17]] iti saptamyā alukaiva siddham, tadapārthakaṃ nipātanam? yatra tarhi saptamyartho nāsti tadarthaṃ nipānam - grāhṇaḥ sa#oḍho'sya prāhṇetanaḥ, pragaḥ soḍho'sya pragetana iti| atra hi <> [[4.3.52]] iti prathamāsamarthātpratyayavidhānātsaptamyartho nāsti| tadabhāvatsaptamyapi nāstyeva|`ciraparutparāribhyastno vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu <> [[4.1.76]] ityatraiva kṛtam| evamuttaratrāpi veditavyam| ciraśabdasya sūtre copādānāṭṭaulāvapi bhavataḥ| `pragasya cchandasi galopaśca` iti|vaktavya iti sambandhaḥ| vaktavyaśabdasya sa evārthaḥ| vyākhyānāt tvihāpi `pratnapūrvaviomāt thāl cchandasi` [[5.3.111]] itinipātanamāśritya kartavyam|`antācceti vaktavyam` (iti)| antaśabdāḍḍimajbhavatītyetadartarūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu kṛtameva| ḍimaco ḍitkaraṇaṃ paścādityasya ṭilopārtham| nanu ca `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopo vaktavyaḥ` (vā|842) ityanenaiva siddham? na sidhyati; anityatvāt tasya| yathā ārātīya ityatra na bhavati, tathehāpi na bhavatīti kasyacidbhrānati syāt, atastannirāsārthaṃ ḍitkaraṇam||`{pūrvāhṇetanam -kāśikā} pūrvāhṇetanaḥ` iti| ahnaḥ pūrvo bhāga iti pūrvādisūtreṇai [[2.2.1]] kadeśisamāsaḥ| `rājahaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac` [[5.4.91]] iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ, <<ahno'hna etebhyaḥ>> [[5.4.88]] ityahnādeśaḥ,`ahno'dantāt` [[8.4.7]] iti ṇatvam| yadā'patyamyantāt pratyayastadā pūrvāhṇatana iti bhavitavyamiti; saptamyabhāvāt| saptamyabhāvastu prathamāsamarthāt taddhitotpatteḥ||`aṇādayo ghādayaśca` iti| ekenādiśabdenāṇādīnāmihotsargāṇāṃ grahaṇam, dvitīyena ghādīnāṃ śeṣādhikāravihitānām| ruāaughnaḥ,māthuraḥ` iti| `prāgdīdīvyato'ṇ` [[4.1.83]] | `autsaḥ, audapānaḥ` iti| <<utsādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.1.86]] | `rāṣṭriyaḥ,avārapārīṇaḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.93]] | `śākalikaḥ, mālavikaḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.117]] iti ṭhaññiṭhau| `kāttreyakaḥ, aumbheyakaḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.95]] ||`eṇyasyāpavādaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.17]] iti prāptasya||`samudāyena cetsaṃjñā gamyate` iti| anena samudāyopādhitvaṃ saṃjñāyā darśayati|prakṛtipratyayasamudāyena cetsaṃjñā gamyate ityarthaḥ| yadyevam, śāradakā darbhā itidarbhaśabdasya prayogo na prāpnoti, pratyayāntenābhihitatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva hi śāradakaśabdo darbhaviśeṣasya nāmadheyaṃ tathā mudgaviśeṣasyāpi| tatrāsati darbhaśabdaprayoge'nekārthasādhāraṇatvāt kasya nāmadheyamiti sandehaḥ syāt - ko'rthaḥ śāradakaśabde vivakṣita iti| tasmādasandehārtho darbhaśabdo upādīyate| `saṃjñādhikāram` ityādi| `kecit` iti vacanāt kecinnānṛvartayantītyuktaṃ bhavati||`pūrvāhṇakaḥ,aparāhṇakaḥ` iti| pūrvavadekadeśisamāsādikaṃ kāryaṃ vidheyam - <> [[4.3.24]] iti, tatra ṭauṭaulvidhiśca| `ādrrakaḥ, mūlakaḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.3]] ityāgatasyārthaḥ <> [[4.2.4]] iti lup tato vun| `niśāpradoṣābhyāmiti| ṭhañvidheḥ| `ṭhañādaya eva ` ādiśabdena ṭauṭaulādayo gṛhyante||`ekadeśāvikṛtasya` ityādi| <> [[3.1.122]] ityatra ṇyatyavṛddhireva nipātyate| avṛddhistu vṛddherekādeśabhūtatayā vikāro bhavatītyekadeśavivṛtamamāvasyāśabdasyopapadyate| ye tu sandhivelādiṣu hrasvopadhamadhīyate, teṣāṃ vṛddhyupadhasya grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti, na hi vikṛtiḥ prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇāti| tasmāddīrgha eva pāṭho yuktaḥ|||atha yoga vibhāgaḥ kimarthaḥ,na `amāvāsyā a ca vā` ityevocyeta, cakāro vuno'nukarṣārtho bhaviṣyati, vāvacanañcobhayorvikalpārtham, tena tābhyāṃ mukkate'ṇapi bhaviṣyati? astyetat; kintvekayoge sati <> [[4.3.32]] iti kanneva vikalpena kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt; atastannivṛttyarthaṃ yogavibhāge hi sati vyavadhānatayā vikalpasya kan nityo vijñāyate||nakṣatrāṇaḥ śravaṇe prāpte lugucyate| nanu ca <> [[4.3.37]] ityanenaiva lugbhaviṣyati? satyametat; tasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ| uttarāvapi yogau prapañcau tasyaiva veditavyau|śraviṣṭhādayaścaite <> [[4.2.3]] ityanenānagatasyāṇaḥ <> [[4.2.4]] iti kṛte lubantā veditavyāḥ|` strīpratyayasyāpi` <> [[1.2.49]] iti lugbhavati` iti| ye strīpratyayāntāsteṣāmupasaṃkhyānamiti pratipādanamityrathaḥ| taccopariṣṭāt kariṣyate| citrāyāṣṭāpo luki kṛte punaṣṭāp kriyate|`gaurāditvānṅīṣ` iti| revatīrohiṇītyatra|`phalgunyaṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau vaktavyau` iti| striyāmityapekṣyate| tayostu vidhānasāmarthyānna lugbhavatiṣa| ṭasya ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ, ano nakāra ādyudāttārthaḥ| vaktavyaśabdo vyākhyeye vartate| vyākhyānaṃ tu kṛtameva ca|`śraviṣṭhāṣāḍhābhyāṃ chaṇapi vaktavyaḥ` iti| atra striyāmiti nopapadyate| ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ| vaktavyaśabdasya sa evārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi kariṣyate ca| kṛtameva||gośālakharaśālayohryasvāntayoḥ pāṭhānnapuṃsakayogrrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| napuṃsakaliṅgatā tu `vibhāṣā senāsurā` [[2.4.25]] ityādinā| yadyapi napuṃsakayogrrahaṇam, tathāpi pratipadikagragaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti strīliṅgābhyāmapi lugbhavatyeva| udāharaṇe'pyautsargisyāṇau luk||vatsaśālaśabdo napuṃsakaliṅgo gṛhrate| kuta etasvyaptevryāyāta;napuṃsakaliṅgasya hi grahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā strīliṅgādapi lugna sidhyati; na tu strīliṅgasya grahaṇe napuṃsakāt| `bahulagrahaṇasyāyaṃ prapañcaḥ` iti| vatsaśālaśabdo yadyapi nakṣatravacano na bhavati, tathāpi bahulavacanāt tato'pi lugbhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ||`rohiṇaḥ`ityādau nakṣatrāṇaḥ pakṣe luk| `mṛgaśirāḥ`iti| <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ|`mārgaśīrṣaḥ`iti| <> [[6.1.61]] ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ| atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham? napūrvasūtrādeva vāgrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate? idaṃ prayojanam - na kvacidanyadeva yathā syāt, tena phalgunyaṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau siddhau bhavataḥ| śraviṣṭhāṣāḍhābhyāñchaṇapīti||`nanu ca` ityādi| janmavadvastu jātaśabdasyārthaḥ, kṛtasyāpi janmāstyeva, tasmādyadyatra kṛtaṃ jātamapi tattatra bhavati| `yacca krītam` ityādi| prāptaṃ labdhamucyate| krītaṃ prāptamapapi tadbhavatyeva, tasmāt krītaṃ labdhamapi bhavati| `śabdasyārthasyābhinnatvāt` iti|svajanmanyanubhūtakarttṛbhāvo jātaśabdasyārthaḥ| jātaśabdasyaiva viśeṣopalakṣitaparavyāpāro svajanmaniṣpattau kṛtaśabdasyārthaḥ| prāptisāmānyaṃ labdhaśabdasyārthaḥ| prāptiviśeṣo yasya mūlahetukā prāptiḥ| sa krītaśabdasyārthaḥ| na ca sāmānyaviśeṣayorekārthatā yuktā| mā bhūtparyāyaprasaṅga iti bhidyate śabdārthaḥ| `vastumātreṇa` iti| krītalabdhayoryadādhārabhūtaṃ vsatumātraṃ tasyābhinnarūpatvātkrītaṃ labdhaṃ bhavati| mātragrahaṇaṃ śabdārthavyavacchedārtham| ata evāha - `śabdārthastu bhidyata eva` (iti)| na hi yena rūpeṇa krītaśabdena tatpratyāyyate tenaiva labdhaśabdena| evaṃ jātakṛtaśabdayorvastutvenābhinnatvam| śabdārthadvāreṇa tu bhinnārthatvameva| anyenaiva hi rūpeṇa jātaśabdena tadvastu pratyāyyate, anyena kṛtaśabdena||`prāyabhavagrahaṇamanarthakam` iti| vaicitryādanyasyārthasyābhāvādanarthamityucyate| vaicitryeṇa tu sārthakameva| kasmāt punararthakamiti? `tatra bhavena kṛtārthatvāt` iti| yat `prāyabhavaḥ`ityasya sādhyam, tasya <> [[4.3.53]] ityanenaiva sādhitatvāditibhāvaḥ| yo hi rājye prāyeṇa bhavati tatrāsau bhavatyeva| tataśca tatra bhave tasyāntarbhāvāt <> [[4.3.53]] ityanenaiva kṛtaṃ sampādanamriti kiṃ prāyabhavagrahaṇena? `anityabhavaḥ` ityādinā parasyottaramāśaṅkate|syādetat - anityabhavaḥ prāyabhavo nityabhavastatra bhava iti, tasmāt tatra bhavena prāyabhavsayāsaṃgrahānna sidhyati? ityāśaṅkyāha - `muktasaṃśayena tulyam` iti| muktastyaktaḥ saṃśayo yena tat muktasaṃśayam|nyāyyastatra bhavo'yamiti yo niścitastena tulyaṃ bhavati| tathā hi - ruāghne bhavo devadattaḥ ruāaughna ityucyate, na cāsau ruāughne sadā bhavati, avaśyaṃ hi kadācidudagdesādīnapakrāmati, atha ca tatrabhavapratyayo bhavati| yadi ca nityabhavastatra bhavaḥ? jihvāmūle bhavo varṇaḥ jihvāmūlīya ityatra `tatra bhavaḥra` [[4.3.53]] ityadhikāre jihvāmūlāṅguleśchaḥ` (4|3|ka62) iti ccho na syāt, na hi varṇo nityaṃ jihvāmūle bhavati| tasmāt prāyabhava kakakakakakakakakasya tatrabhavāntarbhavāt tato na ṇyatiricyata itnarthakaṃ prayabhavagrahaṇam||`avakḷptiḥ`ityādi| avakḷpti = sambhāvanā| pramāṇānatirekaḥ = ādhārapramāṇādādheyapramāṇasyānatiriktatā, yasyāṃ satyāṃ ruāvamādheyamādhāramanupraviśati| `ruāudhne sambhavati` (iti)| yastu ruāudhne sambhāvyate, ruāughnapramāṇānnātiricyate, tadanupravaśāt sa senādiko'rtha evamucyate||`kauśeyaṃ vastram` iti| nanu ca varuāṃ kauśeyaṃ na sambhavati, kintu kṛmiḥ, tataśca kṛmāveva syāt, na vastre; api ca viśeṣānabhidhānāt khaḍgasambandhino'pi kośāt pratyayaḥ prasajyetetyāha - `rūḍhireṣā` ityādi| rūḍhiśabdo hi yathākathañcidutpādyate, na tatrāvaśyamavayavārtho'pekṣyaḥ, kvacidavayavārthāsambhavāt| tathā hi tailaṃ pibatītyevaṃ tailapāyikāśabdo vyutpādyate, na tatrāvaśyamavayavārtho'pekṣyaḥ, kvacivayavārthāsambhavāt| tathā hi tailaṃ pibatītyevaṃ tailapāyikāśabdo vyutpādyate, sa ca tailapānakriyārahita eva kvacit prāṇiviśeṣe vartate| sasmādyadyapi na kṛmau| atha khaṅgakośādutpattau ko doṣaḥ, yena tataḥ pratyayo neṣyate? khaṅgasyābidhānaṃ prāpnoti| sa hi tatra sambhavatīti cet? itarasmādapi tarhi kośāt pratyayotpattau ca kṛmerabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, sa hi tatra sambhavati| atha tatrāpi rūḍhivaśādvastrasyābhidhānam, na kṛmeḥ| itarasmādapi tarhi kośādutpattau varuāsyābhidhānaṃ na khaṅgasya? evaṃ manayate - yadyapi sambhūtādhikāre kośāḍḍhañ vidhīyate, tathāpi kauśeyaśabdānna sambhavo'rtha pratīyate, api tu vikāro'rthaḥ; rūḍhivaśāt| kauśeyaṃ varuāmitikośavikāro varuāmityarthaḥ| tathā ca vārttikakāreṇoktam - `vikāre kośāḍḍhañ, `{sambhūtārthānupapattiḥ -vā|pāṭhaḥ`} sambhūtārthānupapatteḥ` (vā| 1,2 [[4.3.42]] iti| vikārasca kauśeyaśabdāt kṛmikośasya pratīyate, na khaṅgakośasya ; rūḍhivaśāt| tasmādyasya vikāraḥ pratīyate tadabhidhāyina eva kośaśabdādyukkataḥ pratyayaḥ netarasmāt||kālāditi svaryate, prakṛtīruttarā viśeṣayitum| na ca svarūpagrahaṇe satyuttarāḥ prakṛtayaḥ śakyā viśeṣayitum; svarūpasyādhāraṇatvāt| tasmādarthagrahaṇamevaitat| tenakālaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha - `kālaviśeṣavācibyaḥ` ityādi| `haimanaḥ`
