vyākhyāyate'neneti vyākhyānam, karaṇe lyuṭ| cakārāt `tatra bhave ca` iti| nanu ca vyākhyānaṃ pratyayārthaḥ, tasya samīpe cakāraḥ śrūyata iti pratyayārthamātrasyaiva samānajātīyasya tenānukarṣaṇaṃ nyāyyam, na tu samarthavibhakterapi; samānajātīyasya tu cakāraḥ samuccayaṃ karoti, yathā - <> [[4.2.40]] iti; pratyayasamīpavarttinā cakāreṇa pratyaya eva samuccīyate, yathā - <<ṭhañ kavacinaśca>> [[4.2.41]] pādānāt pūrvasyāḥ samarthavibhakternivṛttau satyāṃ bhavārthe'pi ṣaṣṭīsāmarthyādeva pratyayo yuktaḥ - tadayuktamuktam; tatra bhave ceti, tasya bhave ceti vaktuṃ yuktam? ityata āṅa - `vākyārthasamīpe` ityādi| ihetirakaraṇena tasya vyākhyāna ityeṣo'rthaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| na tu vyākhyānapratyayārthaḥ| tasmāditikaraṇāntataramuccāritaścakārastatpratyayavamṛṣṭasya vākyārthasyaiva samīpe śrūyamāṇastulyajātayīmeva vākyārthaṃ samuccinoti| tena bhavārthe saptamīsāmarthyādeva eva kṛtaḥ; anyathā hi `tasya vyākhyāne ca` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| kaḥ punarasau vākyārtha ityāha - `tatra bhave` iti| `na tu pāṭalīputraśabdo vyākhyātavyanāma` iti| nanu ca pāṭaliputraḥ kośalayā vyākhyāyate, niyataṃ tena vyākhyātavyena bhavitavyam, anyathā tasya vyākhyānī sukośalā na syāt| tasya vyākhyānasya pāṭaliputraśabdo vyākhyātavyanāma bhavatīti bhāvaḥ? naitadasti; yadīha vyākhyātavyamabhipretam, na tasyaitannāma bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kiñceha vyākhyātavyamabhipretam? yadvyākhyātavyatayā loke prasiddhataram| kuta etat? vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇāt| iha hi vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyātavyārthaṃ tu na kartavyameva;vināpi hi tena vyākhyāvyanāmna eva pratyayasiddheḥ| tathā hi `tasya ` iti tasya pratiyogivyākhyānamupāttam| tacca vyākhyātavyasyaiva sambhavati, nānyasya| tasmādyadyattasay vyākhyātavyaṃ sāmarthyāttadeva tasyetyanena ṣaṣṭhantenopādīyata iti vijñāyate| tataścāntareṇāpi vyākhyāvyanāmagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyātavyanāmābhidhāyina eva pratyayo bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇena? tat kriyate vyākhyatavyatayā loke yaḥ prasiddhastadabhidhāyina eva pratyayo yathā syādityevamartham| vyākaraṇādayo granthaviśeṣā loke prasiddhāḥ, na te pāṭaliputrādayaḥ| evamapi nāmagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, vyākhyatavyagrahaṇasāmarthyādeva hi vyākhyātavyatayā prasiddhatarebhyaḥ pratyayo labhyata eva? naitadasti;vyākhyāne hi pratyayārthe vyākhyānādeva vyākhyātavyavācinaḥ pratyaye siddhe punavryākhyātavyagrahaṇasāmarthyāda vyākhyātavyatayā ye prasiddhāstebyaḥ pratyayo labhyate, na tu tatra bhave; tatra sāmarthyābhāvāt| bhave'pi cārthe tatra vyākhyātayā prasiddhatarāḥ, tadabhidhāyibhya eva pratyaya iṣyata iti; na tu yataḥ kutaścit| tasmādbhavādhikāre rūḍhaupasaṃgrahārthaṃ nāmagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam|atha kimarthaṃ bhavavyākhyānayoryugapadadhikāraḥ kriyate? ityāha - `bhavavyākhyānayoḥ` ityādi| ṭhañādīnapavādānatrābhidhāsyāmītyevamartho yugapadanayoradhikāraḥ| nanu kimucyate - apavādavidhānārthaṃ iti; prakṛtānāmaṇādīnāṃ pratyayānāmarthanirdeśo yathā syāt? ityata āha - `kṛtanirdaśau hi tau` iti| kṛtanirdeśau hi tāvarthau| ekaḥ `tatra bhavaḥ` iti, aparaḥ `tasyedam` iti| tasyedaṃviśeṣatvādvyākhyānasya||`anantodāttārtha ārambhaḥ` iti| yadyevam, rājasūyikam, vājapeyikamityetadevopadāharaṇadvayaṃ yuktam| rājasūyavājapeyaśabdayoḥ kṛdantottarapadayoḥ prakṛtisvareṇa madhyodāttatvāduttarapadaṃ cādyudāttamatra| ekaṃ vyābantatvāt kṛtsvareṇa, aparaṃ `yato'nācaḥ` [[6.1.207]] iti| samāse ca kṛte <> [[6.2.139]] iti prakṛtibhāvenādyudāttamevanāvatiṣṭhate; `{āgniṣṭomikaḥ, nāvayajñikaḥ -kāśikā} āgniṣṭomikaṃ nāvayajñikam` iti| etadudādaharaṇadvayamayuktam, agniṣṭomanavayajñaśabdābhyāṃ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttābhyāmanenāprāpteḥ? na hi pūrveṇānena vā ṭhañi viśeṣaḥ| kratusāhacaryādatrodāhṛtam| śabdaḥ sāhacaryādvartata iti vijñāyate||puroḍāśasyedamityantodāttaḥ| tasmādbahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañi [[4.3.67]] prāpte| puroḍāśastu `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ` (phi|sū|2|42) iti madhyādāttaḥ| asmādaṇi prāpte ṣṭhan vidhīyate| vakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ, nakāra ādyudāttārthaḥ| teṣāṃ saṃskāro mantraḥ pauroḍāśa iti| `puroḍāśasahacaritaḥra` iti| sāmarthyāt sāhacaryādvā puroḍāśā yena mantraṇa saṃskriyante puroḍāśaśabdo vartate, na puroḍāśeṣu| kṛta etat? vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| na hi puroḍāśā vyākhyātavyatayā prasiddhatarāḥ||`aṇorapavādaḥ` iti| ādiśabdena ṭhañaḥ| tatra ya ṛkārāntā udgātṛprabhṛtayo bahvaco'ntodāttastebhyaṣṭhaño'pavādaḥ| brāāhṛṇaprathamādhvarebhyo'pi ṭhaña eva| te'pi barvacaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttāḥ| nāmākhyātaśabdādapi samastāt tasyaiva| so'pi bahvac, samāsasvareṇāntodāttaśca| pariśiṣṭebhyo'ṇaḥ| `pāṃśukam, pāñcahotṛkam` iti| `isusuktāntāt kaḥ` [[7.3.51]] | pañcahotṛcaturhotṛśabdāvigante `dvigau` [[6.2.29]] itipūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttau| pūrvapadaṃ hi `nraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ` (phi|sū|2|28) ityudāttam| puraścaraṇaśabdolyuḍantaḥ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa [[6.2.138]] madhyodāttaḥ| ākhyātaśabdaḥ <> [[6.2.49]] ityādyudāttaḥ|`saṅgātaviguhītārtham` iti| taccaikaśeṣasamāsāśrayaṇāllabhyata iti veditavyam||`ṭhañorapavādaḥra` iti| ādiśabdena ṭhakaśchasya ca| tatra ye bahvaco'ntodāttastebhyaṣṭhañaḥ| vidyānyāyaśikṣāśabdebhyo dvyajlakṣamasya ṭhakaḥ| vyākaraṇaśabdādvṛddhācchasya| aṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? na ṛyayanādibhyo tā vihitamevocyeta, na caivaṃ satyapavādāḥ ṣṭhanādayaḥ syuriti sambhāvyate; apavādavidhānasya hi vaiyathryaṃ syāt| tasmādvacanaprāmāṇyadyo vihito na ca prāpnotyanyena bādhitatvāt sa eva bhaviṣyati, sa cāṇeva? ityata āha - `aṇgrahaṇam` ityādi| tatra yadyaṇgrahaṇaṃ na kriyet, tadā yadatra vṛddhamantodāttaṃ ṭhañā bādhite purvacanāccha eva bhaviṣyati| tasmācchasya bādhakasay bādhanārthamaṇgrahaṇam| tena vāstuvidya iti siddhaṃ bhavati| vāstuvidyāśabdo vṛddhaḥ,samāsasveramāantodāttaśca|`ṛgayana` ityādi| ṛgayanamiti| ṛgayanaśabdo bhāvasādhana ṛcāmayanam,yadyapi bhāve lyuṭ, tathāpyabhadopacārāt tadvati granthe vyākhyātavye vartate, sa ca <> [[6.2.150]] ityantodāttaḥ| yaistu karaṇe lyuṭaṃ kṛtvāṛgayanaśabdo vyutpādyate, teṣāṃ sa kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa madhyodātto na gaṇe pāṭhaṃ prayojayati tataḥ <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] ityeva siddhaḥ| padavyākhyānaśabdaḥ <> [[6.2.151]] ityantodāttaḥ| `{nāsti - kāśikāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ ca|} māna` iti| manordhātoryadā ghañ tadā <> [[6.2.144]] ityantodāttaḥ| atha mināterlyuṭ,tadā <> [[6.2.150]] ityantodāttaḥ| `chandobhāvaḥ` iti| `gatikārakopapadāt` kṛt` [[6.2.138]] iti kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| bhāṣāśabda <> [[3.3.103]] ityakārapratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ| `chandoviciti` iti| <> [[6.2.151]] ityādināntodāttaḥ| punaruktaśabdaḥ <> [[6.2.144]] ityantodāttaḥ| `{ nāsti -kāśikāyām` } niruktaḥ` <> [[6.2.146]] ityantodāttaḥ, vyākaraṇaśabdo lyuḍanto madhyodāttaḥ| nigamaśabdaḥ `gocarasañcara` [[3.3.119]] ityādisūtre ghapratyayānto nipātitaḥ pratyasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| vāstuvidyāśabdo'ṅgavidyā {kṣattravidyā -kāśikā padamañjarī ca|} kṣattriyavidyetyete ca samāsasvareṇāntodāttāḥ| utpāt, `{utpāda -kāśikā` } udapāda -ityetau thāthādi [[6.2.143]] sūtreṇāntodāttau| saṃvatsara iti| `aśeḥ sara` (da|u|8|50) ityanuvṛttau `vaseḥ saṃpūrvāccit` (da|u|8|51,52) ityevaṃ vyutpādatitvāt saṃvatsaraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| mṛhraterdhātoḥ ktaḥ, kte ūrāgamaḥ, tena `muhūrta` ityantodāttaḥ| `nimitta` śabdo'pi prātipadikasvareṇa| `upaniṣat` iti| upanipūrvāt sadeḥ kvip| kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ||atha `ruāughnādagacchan vṛkṣamūlādāgataḥ` iti| atra vṛkṣamūlaśabdāt pratyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `mukhyam` ityādi| mukhyaṃ pradhānaṃ vivakṣitam, tadiha parigṛhrate; na tu nāntarīyakapradhānam, na hi mukhye satītarasyāpradhānasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam; mukye kāryasampratyayāt||`āyasthānaṭhako'pavādaḥ` iti| bāhulyādevamuktam; yasmāt kṛkaṇaśabdo'tra paṭhate| tatra hi <> [[4.2.145]] iti prāptasya cchasyāpavādaḥ| tīrthaśabdaśceha dhūmādiṣu paṭhate, tataḥ <> [[4.2.127]] iti prāptasya vuño'pavādaḥ| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na śuṇḍikādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta, na caivaṃ paṭhamāne'pavāda eva syādityāśaṅkanīyam; apavādavidhāne hi vacanavaiyathryaṃ syāt, tasmādantareṇāpyaṇgrahaṇamaṇeva bhaviṣyati? ityata āha - `aṇgrahaṇam` ityādi| `udapāna` śabdo'tra paṭhata āyasthānavacanam, utsādiṣvasau paṭhate; tatrāsatyagrahaṇa āyasthānaṭhakaṃ bādhitvā <<utsādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.1.86]] ityañeva syāt| tasmāt tasya bādhakasya bādhanārthamaṇgrahaṇam| tenodapāna ityatrāṇsiddho bhavati||'taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham' iti| atha dīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? asambhavāt| na hi vidyāyonisambandhiṣu kiñcidṛkārāntaṃ prātipadikamasti yannivṛttyarthastakāraḥ syāt||`pitryam` iti| `rīṅa ṛtaḥ` [[7.4.27]] ita rīṅa, yasyati [[6.4.148]] lopaḥ||yadi gotrādaṅkavatpratyayavidhirbhavatītyucyate'ṇa evātideśaḥ prāpnoti, na vuñaḥ| yasmādaṇvidhāvevāṅgagrahaṇamasti| `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇa` [[4.3.127]] ityādau sūtreṇa vuñvidhau <> [[4.3.126]] ityatra? ityāha - `aṅkagrahaṇen` ityādi| yathā kākebhyo dadhi rakṣyatāmityatra kākagrahaṇamupadhātasāmānyasyopalakṣaṇam, evamihāpyaṅkagrahaṇaṃ <> [[4.3.120]] ityasya| tenāyaṃ sūtrārtho bhavati - yathā <> [[4.3.120]] ityatra pratyayo bhavati, tathā <> [[4.3.74]] ityatrāpi| tena vuño'pyatideśa upapadyate| nanvevamapyaṇo'tideśo na prāpnoti, na hi tadvidhau gotragrahaṇamasti? pūrvasūtrādgotragrahaṇamanuvartata ityadoṣaḥ| `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇa` [[4.3.127]] #eityādinā yena sūtreṇāṇ vihitastaddarśayati||`samādagatam` iti| samāddhetorāgatamasyārthaḥ| kena punariha pañcamī? asamādeva jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ pañcamyantāt pratyayamāha tato jñāyate - hetau pañcamī bhavati||`yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyānirāsārthaḥ` iti| nanu cānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇenautsargike'bhyanujñāyamāne vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyasya prāptereva nāsti? satyametat; yastu rūpyamayaṭorapūrvatvādvidhīyamānapekṣayā yathāsaṃkhyatvaṃ manyeta,taṃ prati yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate||`{prathamataḥ -kāśikā`} prathama upalabhyata ityarthaḥ` iti| prathama ityanena praśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| `upalabhyate` ityanenāpi bhavateḥ| anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ bhavatirihopalabdhau bhavatirihopalabdhau vartate| `himavataḥ prabhavati` iti| <> [[1.4.31]] iti himavato'pādānasaṃjñā||bāla-manoramāhetumanuṣyebhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ 1440, 4.3.85 hetumanuṣyebhyaḥ| `tata āgata` ityeva| hetubhya udāharati -samādāgatamityādi| manuṣyavācina udāharati -devadattarūpyamiti| bāla-manoramāprabhavati 1442, 4.3.85 prabhavati| tata ityeveti| `āgata` iti tu nivṛttam| prabhavatītyarthe pañcamyantādyathāvihitaṃ pratyayāḥ syurityarthaḥ| prabhavaḥ-prathamaprakāśaḥ| himavataḥ prabhavatīti| himavati prathamaṃ prakāśata ityarthaḥ| `bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ` ityāpādānatvam| bāla-manoramāabhiniṣkrāmati dvāram 1445, 4.3.85 abhiniṣkrāmati dvāram| kānyeti| kānyakubjākhyajanapadasya dvāramityarthaḥ|`tatra tu saṃskriyate` iti| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| saṃskriyate eva ca tatra vidūre nagare, na tataḥ prabhavati|`vālavāyo vidūrañca` iti| vālavāyaśabda eva pratyayamutpādayati, na vidūraśabdaḥ| prabhavatiśabdasya prathamata upalabhyata ityarthaḥ| prabhavati ca vālavāye parvate| tasmādyataḥ prabhavati tadvācī vālavāyaśabdaḥ prakṛtitvenākṣipyate| yathā viśravaṇaravaṇā ityādeśāveva śivādiṣu paṭhaete| apatyādhikārāttu yena tayorapatyāpatyavatsasambandhaḥ sa eva prakṛtitvenākṣipyate viśravasśabdaḥ| viśravaso'patyaṃ vaiśravaṇaḥ, rāvaṇaḥ|atha vā prakṛtyantarameva vidūraśabdo vālavāye vartate| vidūrāt bhavati vālavāyāt parvatāt prabhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ sthite yo brāūyāt - naiva tatra vālavāye prasiddho vidūraśabda iti,taṃ pratyāha - `jitvarīvadūpācaret` iti| yathā vaṇija eva vāsāṇasī nagarīṃ `jitvarī` ityuccārayanti maṅgalārtham, na lokāḥ, evaṃ vaiyākaraṇā eva vālavāyaṃ vidūramityuccārayanti| niyatadeśapuruṣaviṣayā api rūḍhayo bhavantītyetajjitvarīvadityanena kathayati||patho niṣkriyatvādgameḥ kartatvaṃ nopapadyata ityāha - `tatstheṣu` ityādi| puruṣavṛttirgamanaṃ pathyupacaryata iti darśayati| `atha vā` ityādi| prāptāvatra gamirvartate| asti ca pratyakṣagamyaiva ruāughnādīnāṃ patho'syaivānantaryalakṣaṇā prāptiḥ||kathaṃ punaḥ karaṇatvena prasiddhaṃ dvāraṃ svātantreṇaiva vivakṣyate?ityāha - `yathā` ityādi| yathā cchedanakriyāyāmasiḥ karaṇatvena prasiddhau'pi svātantryeṇa vivakṣyate|nanu cetanāvato'bhiniṣkramaṇaṃ bhavati, cetanāvatā prayuktasya vā - devadatto'bhiniṣkrāmatīti, na ca dvāraṃ cetanāvatā prayuktam, tasmānnopapadyate tasyābhiniṣkramaṇam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; acetaneṣvapyabhiniṣkrāmatīti vyavahāro dṛśyate, tadyathā anena guhāmukhena vāyurabhiniṣkrāmatīti| niṣkrīyatvāt tarhi nopapadyate? tatstheṣu niṣkrāmatsu dvāramabhiniṣkramatītyupacaryata ityadoṣaḥ||nanu `kṛte` iti karmaṇi niṣṭhā, tataśca tayā'bhihitatvāt karmaṇo dvitīyā na prāpnoti? ityāha - `adhikṛtyetyetapekṣayā dvitīyā` iti| lyabantena yā kriyā'bhidhīyate tadapekṣayā dvitīyā, na ca tasyā yatkarma tatkenacidabhihitam| niṣṭhayā hi granthātmakameva karmābhihitam, na tu lyabantakriyāyā yatkarma subhadrādikaṃ tadapi| girimittramadhikṛtya kṛto `gairimittraḥ`| yayātimadhikṛtya `yāyātaḥ`|`lup` ityādi| ākhyāyikāyai iti tādarthye caturthī| ākhyāyikārthamākhyāyikāmabhidhātuṃ pratyayasya lugbhavatītyarthaḥ||`yamasabham` iti| `sabhārājā` [[2.4.23]] ityādinā nupaṃsakaliṅgatā| yadīndrajananādāveva śiśukrandādayo draṣṭavyāḥ,tatkimarthaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam? ityata āha - `prapañcārtham` ityādi| `evañca sati` ityādi| caśabdo hetau| yasmādindrajananāderākṛtigaṇasya tadantarbhūtānāmeva śiśukrandādīnāṃ prapañcārthaṃ grahaṇam; tasmādevamartha'smin sthite devāsurādīnāṃ pratiṣedho na vaktavyaḥ, prāptyabhāvāt| yebhya eva cchapratyayo'yaṃ dṛśyate, ta evendrajananādayaḥ, na ca devāsurādibhyo dṛśyate||`tatsambandhāddeśo'pyabhijana ucyate` iti| yathā yaṣṭīḥ pravedaśayeti yaṣṭisambandhādyaṣṭiśabdaḥ puruṣe vartate, tathā'bhijanaśabdo deśe vartate| kaḥ punarasau yo'bhijanasambandhādabhijana ucyate? ityata āha - `yasmin` ityādi| `iha deśavācinaḥ` ityādi| kathaṃ punarmukhye'bhijane gauṇāt pratyayo bhavati? ityāha - `nivāsapratyāsatteḥ` iti| nivāso [[4.3.89]] 'nukṛṣyate tenābhijano viśeṣyate nivāso yo'bhijana iti| tasmāddeśavācina eva pratyayo bhavati, na bandhubhyaḥ ; teṣāmanivasatvāt|nivāsābhijanayoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ? nāstyeva kaścidviśeṣaḥ, abhijanasya nivāsabhūtatvāditi manyate| `yatra` ityādi| viśeṣaṃ darśayati|`yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ` iti| uttareṣu yogeṣvabhijanapratyayā yathā syuḥ, nivāse mā bhūvanniti||`āyudhajīvibhyaḥ` iti| tādabhya caturthīti pañcamīṃ nirākaroti| yadi hreṣāṃ pañcamī syāt, āyudhajīvibhya eva parvate'bhidheye cho bhavatītyeṣa sūtrārthaḥ syāt, na ceṣyate; tasmāt evaiṣā caturthī, na pañcamīti| `sāṅkāśyakāḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.121]] ||`aṇāderapavādaḥ` iti| ādiśabdena chādeḥ| atra ye śaṇḍikādīn parvātanācakṣate teṣāṃ matena pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasya chasyāpavādaḥ| ye tu janapadaśabdāḥ, teṣāṃ <> [[4.2.125]] iti prāptasya vuñaḥ| śaṇḍikaśabdāt <> [[4.2.132]] iti prāptasyāṇaḥ||`prabhṛtayaḥ` iti| prabhṛtiśabdena madhu, vasanta, kamboja, sālva,kaśmīra - ityete gṛhyante| {gandhāra iti mu|pāṭhaḥ gandhāri iti prācīnamudrita pāṭhaḥ|}kiṣkindhā, `{nāsti gaṇa pāṭhe}sāradi, `{urasa kāśikā}uras, darat - ityeteṣām <> [[4.2.125]] ityādinā vuñi prāpte vacanam| takṣaśilādiṣvapi kaumedura, kāṇḍavāraṇa, grāmaṇī - ityeteṣāṃ <> [[4.2.114]] iti che prāpte| śeṣāṇāṃ <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] ityaṇi||`bhajyate sevyata iti bhaktiḥ` iti| `bhaja sevāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-998) ityetasmāt karmasādhanaḥ ktin||nanu ca deśakālayoracittayoḥ pratiṣedhānnañivayuktanyāyena (vyā|pa|65) prakṛticetanaiva vijñāsyate, tatkimacittagrahaṇena? naitadasti; vinā hi tenādeśakālāditi na jñāyate - kimayaṃ prakṛtinirdeśaḥ, uta deśakālayoḥ pratiṣedha iti? tatrāniṣṭamapi vijñāyate - adeśaśabdāt , kālaśabdācceti| acittagrahaṇe tu sati tenātiprasaṅge satyadeśakālāditi pratiṣedho vijñāyate| asmādeva ca pratiṣedhādacittāditi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati| svarūpagrahaṇe hi deśakālābhyāṃ prasaṅgo pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt||nanu ca pūrvasūtrādeva ṭhaganuvartiṣyate, tenāpi hi mahāṃrājika iti sidhyatyeva, tatkathaṃ ṭhañ pratyayāntaraṃ kriyate? ityāha - `pratyayayāntarakaraṇam` ityādi| ñitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi pratyayāntarakaraṇam| ṭhaki hi sati taddhitasya `kitaḥ` [[6.1.159]] ityantodāttatvaṃ syāt||bāla-manoramāsudhāturakaṅ ca 1081, 4.3.99 sudhāturakaṅ ca| cādiñiti| sudhātṛśabdātṣaṣṭhantādapatye'rthe iñpratyayaḥ, prakṛterakaṅādeśaścetyarthaḥ| akaṅo ṅakāra it, akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `ṅicce`tyantādeśaḥ| tadāha -saudhātakiriti|vyāseti| vyāsa, varuḍa, niṣāda, caṇḍāla, bimba-ebhyaśca iñi prakṛterakaṅādeśa ityarthaḥ| bāla-manoramāmahārājāṭṭhañ 1456, 4.3.99 mahārājāṭṭhañ| `so'sya bhaktirityarthe` iti śeṣaḥ| māhārājika iti| mahārājo bhaktirasyeti vigrahaḥ|vāsudevaśabdādvṛddhācchasyāpavādaḥ| arjunaśabdādautsargikasyāṇaḥ| nanu cārjunaśabda kṣattriyākhyaḥ,tasmāduttarasūtreṇa prāptasya vuño'pavādo yuktaḥ? evaṃ manyate - bahulagrahaṇaṃ tatra kriyate, tenārjunaśabdādnuñpratyayasya prāptireva nāsti, tasmādasmādaṇeva syāt, atastadapavādo nyāyyaḥ|`nanu ca` ityādi codyam| syādetat - vuñvunorviśeṣo'sti, ato vāsudevaśabdādvun vidhīyate? ityāha - `na cātra` ityādi| vāsudevaśabdasya ca vuñi vuni vā sati nāsti kaścidviśeṣa iti| tathā hrubhayatra tadevarūpam, sa eva svaraḥ| yo'pi vuñi sati puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ <> [[6.3.39]] iti,sa vunyapi labhyata eva <> [[6.3.37]] iti| `saṃjñeṣaḥ` ityādinā, yaduktam - `nanu ca vāsudevaśabdādgotrakṣatriyākhyebhyaḥ` [[4.3.99]] iti vuñastyeva` iti, tannirākaroti| gotrakṣattriyākhyebhyo vuñ vidhīyate| na ca vāsudevaśabdo gotrākhyaṃ prātipadikam, nāpi kṣattriyākhyam, tatkuto ityanena `alpāctaram` [[2.2.34]] ityanena vārjuśabdasya pūrvanipātamakurvataitadvijñāpitam -abhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ nipatati| tena mātāpitarau, śraddhamedhe, dīkṣātapasī - ityatra śāstrādevābhyārhitasya pūrvanipātaḥ siddho bhavati| abhyarhitatvaṃ tu vāsudevaśabdasya devatāviśeṣatvāt||`glaucukāyanakaḥ| mlaucukāyanakaḥ` iti| glucukamlucukaśabdābhyāṃ `prācāvṛddhāt phin` [[4.1.160]] tadantādvuñ| ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? na gotrakṣattriyebhya ityevocyeta? ityata āha - `ākhyāgrahaṇam` ityādi| yadyākhyāgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato ye'pi yathākathañcit kṣattriye vartante tebhyo'pi syāt, neṣyate; tasmāt prasiddhakṣattriyapiragrahārthamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tenaha na bhavati - vidvān kṣattriyo bhaktirasyeti| na vidvacchabdaḥ kṣattriyaśabda iti prasiddhaḥ| kṣattriyaśabdasya tu sāmānādhikaraṇyāt kṣattriye vṛttirgamyate| `pāṇinīyaḥ` iti| pāṇino'patyamityaṇ; `gāthividatha` [[6.4.165]] ityādinā prakṛtibhāvaḥ, pāṇino bhaktirasyeti <> [[4.2.114]] `pāṇinīyaḥ`| pauravo bhaktirasyeti `pauravīyaḥ`||`{nāsti -kāśikā}ekaśabdāḥ` iti| etena samānaśabdo'yamekavācīti darśayati| `pratyayaḥ prakṛtiśca` iti| sarvaśabdena yo'rtha upāttastamācaṣṭe| `tadvat aṅgā kṣattriyā bhaktirasya` iti| aṅgādibhyaḥ kṣattriyebhyo bahuṣvapatyeṣu <> [[4.1.170]] ityādinā vihitasyāṇaḥ `tadrājasya` [[2.4.62]] ityādinā luk kriyate| bahuvacane'ṅgadayo janapadino janapadena samānaśabdā bhavanti| atra janapadavṛttibhyo'ṅgādibhyo yathā `so'sya bhaktiḥ` [[4.3.95]] ityetasmin viṣaye <> [[4.2.124]] iti vuñ bhavati, tathā janapadavṛttibhyo'pi -`pañcālā brāāhṛṇāḥ`iti| yadā pañcālanivāsiṣu sāhacaryāt pañcālādiśabdo vartate, tadā bhavanti brāāhṛṇā janapadena bahuvacane samānaśabdāḥ, na tu te janapadinaḥ| tenātideśābhāvādaṇeva bhavati - `pāñcālaḥ`|`sarvagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadi sarvagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā pratyayasya vidhīyamānatayā prādhānyāt pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt tasyaivātideśaḥ syāt, na prakṛteḥ| tasmādyathā prakṛterapyatideśo bhavati tadarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| `sa ca` ityādi| sa ca prakṛtyatideśaḥ sarvagarhaṇaṃ dvyekayoreva prayojayati, na bahuṣu| janapadaśabdo nātra vṛddhaḥ, tasmādavṛddho janapadaśabdo dṛśyate| bahuvacane tu `tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām` [[2.4.62]] iti luki kṛte vināpyatideśenāvṛddhaḥ, ata eva bhavatīti tatra prakṛtyatideśo'narthakaḥ| tato netadarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `vṛddhinimitteṣu` ityādi| vṛddhinimitteṣu vuñādiṣvādiṣṭāyāmavṛddhāyāṃ prakṛtau punarvṛddhibhāvāt| `prakṛtinihryāsekṛte` iti sarvagrahaṇātprakṛtyadeśena nirhāsaḥ| nihryāso'lpatayā'pakṣaya ityarthaḥ| `mādraḥ` iti| etāñca prakṛtimapekṣya madra ityeṣā prakṛtiralpā bhavati| `vārjyaḥra` ityetāñca vṛjiriti| nanu vateḥ sarvasādṛśasyārthatvanādvatinirdeśenaiva prakṛteratideśo bhaviṣyatīti, tatka sarvagrahaṇena? naitadasti; yataiva tatra sarvasādṛśyārthe vatau na pratyārtho devatārthe'tidiśyate, tathehāpi janapadarūpaṃ janapadini nātidiśyate| kasmāt punastatra pratyayārtho nātidiśyate? vatinā tayorbhedasya pratipāditatvāt| vatirhi sādṛśye ridhīyate, sādṛsyaṃ ca bhedāśrayam; yadi bhavārthasyāpi devatārthatayā vipariṇāmaḥ syāt, tadā vatireva na syāt| tasmādanyasya kāryasya sādṛsyaṃ vatirācaṣṭe, pratyayārthayostu bhedam, ihāpi ca janapadajanapadinorbhedamācaṣṭa iti| asati sarvagrahaṇe janapadarūpaṃ janapadarūpaṃ janapadini na labhyate| tasmāt sarvagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|`bahulagrahaṇam` ityādi| samānaśabdatāyā viṣayapradarśanaṃ lakṣaṇam| tadarthaṃ bahuvacanagrahaṇam| `anyathā hi` ityādi| bahuvacanagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetetyarthaḥ| `tatraiva` iti| bahuvacane| bahuvacana eva tadrājapratyayasya luki kṛte samānaśabdatā bhavati, yataśca tatraivātideśaḥ syāt| `ekavacanadvivacanayorna syāt` iti| tatra samānaśabdatayā abhāvāt| `bahuvacane tu` itādi| bahuvacanagrahaṇe tu sati bahuvacane ye janapadena samānaśabdāsteṣāṃ yatra vā tatra vātideśe vijñāyamāne dvyekayorapyasau siddho bhavati||`prakarṣeṇoktam` iti| prakarṣaḥ = atiśayaḥ,tena vyākhyātaṃ tadadhyāpitaṃ vā `proktam` ityucyate| `na tu kṛtam` iti| na tu kṛtamutpāditaṃ proṣatamityucyate| kasmādityāha - <> [[4.3.116]] iti gatārthatvāt| kathaṃ māthurītyaṇ, yāvatā vṛdhācchenaiva bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; <<kalāpino'ṇ>> [[4.3.108]] ityatrāṇgrahaṇasyānyebhyo bhavatītyetat prayojanaṃ vakṣyati, tena māthuraśabdādapyaṇbhavati| `pāṇinīyam` iti| pāṇiśabdāt <> [[4.2.114]] iti cchaḥ| `āpiśalam,kālakṛtsnam` iti| āpiśalikāśakṛtsniśabdābhyāṃ `iñaśca` [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ||`taittirīyāḥ` iti| chaṇpratyayaḥ, tebhyaḥ `tadadhīte` [[4.2.58]] ityaṇ, tasya <> [[4.2.64]] iti luk| `chandobrāāhṛṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi` (4.2.67 iti tadviṣayatā|`chandasi` ityādi| kathaṃ punaścachandasi labhyate? na hi cchandograhaṇamastītyāha - `śaunakādibhyaḥ` ityādi||`ṇakāra uttaratra vṛddhyarthaḥ` iti| uttareṣu yogeṣu vṛddhiryathā syāt| iha hi ṇakārasya prayojanaṃ nāsti, tasya hi vṛddhireva prayojanam| kāśyapakauśikaśabdau vṛddhimantau| `tasyāpi ca` ityādi| nanu ca cchandobrāāhṛṇādīnāṃ tadviṣayatā yuktā, tatkathaṃ kalpasyāpi sā bhavati? ityāha - `śaunakādibhyaḥ` ityādi| syādetat - yadyapīdaṃ na siddhyatyeva| na hi śaunakādibhyaśchandasi` [[4.3.106]] ityatrānuvartate, tathāpi chandobrāāhṛṇādīnāṃ tadviṣayatocyamānā kalpasya na sidhyatyeva| nahi śaunakādisūtrā [[4.3.106]] nuvṛttau satyāmasya yogasay kalpaśchandobhāvaṃ brāāhṛṇabhāvamāpadyata ityāha - `chando'dhikāravihitānañca` ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇā'pi chando'dhikāravihitānāṃ svaryate| tena <<śaunakādibhyaśchandasi>> [[4.3.106]] itīdamprakṛtayo vihitāḥ proktapratyayāḥ, teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva kalpādāvapi tadviṣayatā bhavati| atha guṇakalpanayā kalpādīnāmapi chandastvaṃ vivakṣyate| nanuca <> [[4.2.66]] ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt tenaiva prāgeva kalpādestadviṣayatā pratipāditā, tatkimarthaṃ punaranena prakāreṇa pratipādyate| tatra vā kalpādestadviṣayatāpratipādanārthaścakāraḥ kartavyaḥ, ayaṃ vā prakāra āśrayitavya iti vikalpapradarśanārtham|`idānīntanena` ityādi| idānīntano yaḥ kāśyapaḥ sa kāśyapagotraprabhavatvāt kāśyapa ityucyate, tathedānīntano yaḥ kauśikaḥ sa kauśikagotraprabhavatvāt kauśika ityucyate; tatra yadi ṛṣigrahaṇaṃ ṛṣiśabdādeva, tathā hi pravarādhyāye ye paṭhante ta ṛṣaya iti, imāvapi tatra paṭhaete eva? naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādayamṛṣiśabdaḥ kriyāśabdo vijñāyate - ṛṣirdarśanāditi| tena yāvananyapuruṣasādhāraṇenaupadeśikena darśanena tadvnatau kāśyapakauśikaśabdau tata idaṃ pratyayavidhānam; na cedānīntanau kāśyapakauśikaśabdāvevaṃvidhau, tābhyāṃ cha eva bhavati||abhidhāne'bhiyopacārāt kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsyabhidhāyinaḥ śabdā iha kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsiśabdena nirdiṣṭāḥ| ata evāha - `kalāpyantevāsinām` iti|nanu ca ye vyavahitāḥ śiṣyaśiṣyāḥ, te kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsina eva bhavanti, tadayuktamuktam - kalāpyantevāsinaścatvāraḥ,vaiśampāyanāntevāsino nava? ityāha - `pratyakṣakāriṇaḥra` ityādi| karotiratrādhyayane vartate| yaiḥ sākṣādadhītaṃ te pratyakṣakāriṇaḥ| ihāntevāsino gṛhyante caitāvanta eveti| kimatrāyuktam? kuta iha sākṣātkāriṇo gṛhyante, na hi vyavahitā ityatra hetuṃ pṛcchati| `kalāpikhāṇḍāyanagrahaṇāt` iti| hetunirdeśaḥ| `{tathā hi -kāśikā}tathā ca` ityādi| asyaiva vivaraṇam| vaiśampāyanasay kalāpyantevāsī, tasya ye'ntevāsinaste vaiśampāyanāntevāsino bhavantyeva| yadi tatra ye vyavahitāste'pyantevāsino gṛhreran kalāpigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, `vaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaḥ` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| tathā vaiśampāyanāntevāsī khāṇḍāyanaḥ;tatra yadi vyavahitā apigṛhreran, tato vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvādanenaiva sūtreṇa siddhe śaunakādiṣu khāṇḍāyanaśabdasya pāṭho niṣphala eva syāt| tasmādihāpi kalāpigrahaṇaṃ śaunakādiṣu khāṇḍāyanaśabdasya pāṭha etadubhayamapi sākṣātkārigrahaṇasya liṅgaṃ jñāpakam| `hāridraviṇaḥ` ityādi| haridruprabhṛtibhyaḥ proktārthe ṇiniḥ,tadantāt <> [[4.2.59]] ityaṇ, tasya `proktālluk` `ulapena caturthena` iti| sahārthe tṛtīyā| `kālāpakam` iti| kalāpina idaṃ kālāpakam, `gotracaraṇād vuñ` [[4.3.126]] | nanu ca `dharmāmnāyayorvuñ` (vā|476), na ceme śivyā dharmāmnāyāḥ,tatkathaṃ vuñ? evaṃ tarhrupamānādbhaviṣyatīti| kālāpakamiva dharmavacchiṣyā ucyante| yathā dharmaḥ kalāpisambandhī, tathā śiṣyā ityucyata upamānārthaḥ| `ālambirnāma prācāṃ deśaḥ, tatrotpannaḥ `carakaḥ`| evaṃ `palaṅgakamalāvubhau`| prācāmevatrayaḥ| ete prācyāḥ vaiśampāyanaśiṣyāḥ `ṛcābhāruṇitāṇḍaāśca madhyamīyāstrayo'pera` carakāḥ| madhyadeśe bhavā madhyamīyāḥ| gahādiṣu `madhyamadhyamañcāṇ caraṇe` (ga|sū|99) iti paṭhate| tasyāyamarthaḥ - madhyaśabdo madhyamabhāvamāpadyate, chapratyayaśca tato bhavati, caraṇe tu pratyayārthe'ṇ ca bhavatīti| tatra yadā ṛcābhādīnāṃ caraṇatvaṃ na vivakṣyate,tadā che kṛte madhyamīyā iti bhavati| caraṇavivakṣāyāṃ tvaṇi kṛte mādhyamā iti bhavati| udakṣu bhavā udīcyāḥ, <> [[4.2.101]] ityādinā yat| udīcyeṣu madhye śyāmāyaniścarakaḥ|kaṭhakalāpināvapyudīcyeṣu carakau, aparasyāpyuktam - <<kalāpino'ṇ>> [[4.3.108]] iti| nanu ca vaiśampāyanāntevāsināṃ kaṭhenaiva caraka ityeṣākhyā, tatkathaṃ caraka ityucyata? ityāha - `caraka iti vaiśampāyanasya` ityādi| yadyapi teṣāṃ caraka ityākhyānaṃ na bhavati, tadgurostu vaiśampāyanasya bhavati, tatsambandhena tacchiṣyā api tathocyante||`bhāllavinaḥ`iti| bhāllavaḥ, śāṭaāyanaḥ,aitareya - ityetebhyaḥ proktārthe ṇiniḥ| tadantāt `tadadhīte` [[4.2.58]] ityutpannasya <> [[4.2.64]] <> [[4.2.66]] ityādinā tadviṣayatā| `paiṅgī` iti| `āruṇaparājī` iti| piṅgāruṇaparājaśabdābhyāṃ ṇiniḥ| `yājñavalkāni` iti| `āśmarathaḥ` iti| yājñavalkyaāravyaśabdābhyāṃ gargādiyañantābhyāṃ <> [[4.2.111]] ityutpannasya, `āpatyasya` [[6.4.151]] ityādinā yalopaḥ| nanu yājñavalkādīnyapi purāṇaproktānyeva brāāhṛṇāni, brāāhṛṇāntaraiḥ purāṇaproktestulyatvāt? ityāha - `yājñavalkya` ityādi| ākhyāneṣu hreṣā vārtā - yājñavalkyādayo'parakālāḥ pravaktāro'nyebhyaḥ pravaktṛbhyaḥ| tathā ca vastutvamanapekṣya vyavaharati sūtrakāra ityadoṣaḥ| `tadviṣayatā kasmānna bhavati` (iti)| <> [[4.2.66]] ityādineti bhāvaḥ| `pratipadam` ityādi| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) hi pratipadaṃ viśeṣaṇam| brāāhṛṇamuccārya brāāhṛṇeṣu yaḥ pratyayo vihitastasya tadviṣayatā vidhīyate| tasmāt tadviṣayatāsya na bhavati| kalpeṣu tarhi kasmānna bhavati; yathā - kāśyapena proktaṃ kalpamadhīyate kāśyapina ityatra? `na cāyam` ityādi| chando'dhikāre ye yogastadvihitasya pratyayasya tadviṣayatā bhavati, na cāyaṃ yogaśchando'dhikāramanuvartate;tenaitadvihitasya pratyayasyādhyetṛveditṛviṣayatā kalpeṣu na bhavati - paiṅgī kalpaḥ, āruṇaparājī kalda iti|purāṇa iti ko'yaṃ śabdaḥ, yāvatā `sāṃyaciram` [[4.3.23]] ityādinā ṭauṭauloḥ sanniyogena tuṭi kṛte purātanamiti bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `purāṇa iti nipātanāt tuḍabhāvaḥ (iti)| yadyevam, na bhavati purātanam? ityāha - `{na vā kāśikā}na ca` ityādi| nanu `bādhakānyapi nipātanāni` (vī|pa|vṛ|109) ityato bhavitavyameva vācakeneti? avācakānyapi (nī|pa|vṛ|110)| abādhakānyapi bhavanti, etacca <<śaderagatau taḥ>> [[7.3.42]] ityatra pratipāditam||`chāṇorapavādaḥ` iti| ye vṛddhāstebhyaśchasyāpavādaḥ, śeṣebhyastvaṇaḥ| `śaunakinaḥ| vājasaneyinaḥ` iti| śaunakena proktaṃ vājasaneyena proktamiti ṇiniḥ| tadantāt [[4.2.58]] ityaṇ, tasya <> [[4.2.64]] , pūrvavat tadviṣayatā|`kevalāddhi` ityādi| tat saṃhatārthamityatrāyaṃ hetuḥ| yasmāt kevalāt kaṭhāllakaṃ vakṣyati, tasmāt kaṭhaśāṭha iti yadatra paṭhate tatsaṃhatārtham||`kaṭhāḥ, carakāḥ` iti| proktapratyayasya luki kṛte yo hradhyetaryaṇ bhavati tasyāpi proktālluk [[4.2.63]] | pūrvavat tadviṣayatā||`kālāpāḥ`iti| pūrvavat proktapratyayāntādadhyetaryutpannasyāṇo luk, tadviṣayatā ca| `atha` ityādi| nanu cāsatyaṇgrahaṇe yathā prāpte vidhīyamāne ṇinerevāpavādaḥ syāt? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādyo vihito na ca prāpnotyanena kabādhitatvāt sa eva bhaviṣyati, sa cāṇeva| `evamādi` iti| ādiśabdena maudāḥ,paippalādāḥ, śākalāḥ, jājalāḥ - ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇam| asata, tvacgrahaṇe sarvameva na sidhyet; <> [[4.2.114]] iti chenāṇa autsargikasya bādhitatvāt||`chāgaleyinaḥ` iti| ihāpi pūrvavadevādhyetaryutpannasyāṇo luk ca tadviṣayatā| evamuttarayoryogayorveditavyaḥ||`yathāsaṃkhyam` ityādi| pārāśaryādbhikṣusūtre pratyayaḥ śilālino naṭasūtre| `tadviṣayatā cātreṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇāpi sā labhyate? ityāha - `tadartham` #ityādi| nanu cānuvartamānacchandohaṇenaiva tadviṣayatā prāpnoti? na; bhikṣuvanaṭasūtirayoracchandasatvādityāha - `guṇakalpanayā ca` ityādi| chandasastūpacāranimittaṃ yo dharmaḥ sa iha guṇo'bhipretaḥ, taddhetukā kalpanā| yathā chando yadarthamadhīyate tathā sūtramapi taddhetuṃ sampādayati| bhikṣunaṭayorityevamādikayā guṇakalpanayā bhikṣunaṭasūtrayośchandastvamaupacārikam| `pārāśariṇaḥ` iti| pārāśaryaśabido gargādiṣu vañantaḥ, <<āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti>> [[6.4.151]] iti yalopaḥ| `śailālinaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopaḥ|`pārāśaram` iti| <> [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ| `śailālam` iti| autsargiko'ṇ, `nāntasya ṭilope sabahyahṛcāripīṭha` (vā|798) ityādinā ṭilopaḥ||`tena`iti| `tulyārthairatulopamābhyām` [[2.3.72]] iti tṛtīyā| `saudāmanī` iti| `an` [[6.4.167]] iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopādyabhāvaḥ|nanu ca teneti prakṛtameva,tatkimarthaṃ punariha tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktirupādīyate? ityāha - `teneti prakṛte` ityādi| pūrvatra hi teneti chando'dhikārasambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmācchando'dhikāranivṛttayepunariha tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktirupādīyate| kimarthaḥ punaśchando'dhikāraḥ pūrvatra kriyate? ityāha - `pūrvatra` ityādi| pūrveṣu yogeṣu cchando'dhikārāt tadviṣayatā sādhyate| tasmāt tatra cchando'dhikāraḥ kartavyaḥ| tasmastu kriyamāṇe tannivṛttyarthaṃ iha ca yatna āstheyaḥ chandasyeva pratyayaḥ syāt||`akālakam` iti| kālaparibhāṣārahitamityarthaḥ||kaḥ punaḥ kṛtopajñayorviśeṣaḥ, yenopajñāyata iti prakṛte sati kṛtagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāh - `utpāditam` ityādi||bāla-manoramāsaṃjñāyām 1476, 4.3.119 saṃjñāyāṃ| tenetyeveti| tena kṛtamityarthe saṃjñāyāṃ tṛtīyāntādyathāvihitaṃ pratyayāḥ syurityarthaḥ| `granthe` iti nānuvartate| tadāha -agranthārthamiti| bāla-manoramāsaṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñāmaṇ 1486, 4.3.119 saṅghāṅka| yañantāt, añantāt, iñantācca saṅge aṅke lakṣaṇe ca idantvena vivakṣite'ṇityarthaḥ| chasyāpavādaḥ| ghoṣeti| `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇaghoṣeṣu` iti sūtraṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tathāca tiruāḥ prakṛtayaḥ, pratyayārthāścatvāra iti na yathāsaṅkhyam| gārga iti| saṅgho'ṅko ghoṣo ve`ti śeṣaḥ| gārgamiti| `lakṣaṇa`miti śeṣaḥ| evaṃ dākṣa dākṣamityatrāpi nanvaṅkalakṣaṇaśabdayoḥ paryāyatvāt pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityarta āha -parampareti| yathā gavādiniṣṭhastaptamudrāviśeṣo'ṅkaḥ| tasya hi godvārā svāmisambandhaḥ| sākṣāditi| vidyāviśeṣastu devadatte sākṣādvidyamānatvāttasya lakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| vaidī vidyā| `ghoṣa ābhīrapallī syā`dityamaraḥ|`svare viśeṣaḥ` iti| aṇi hi pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ syāt| añi tu sati ñitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati||`tasya` iti| puṃlliṅgenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ, puṃsyeva syāt, na dvivacanabahuvacanāntāt; pratyakṣavācinaśca syāt; nāpi viśeṣavācinaḥ; tacchabdasya parokṣavastumātravācitvāt| pratyayārtho'pīdamityekavacanena napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdiṣṭa ityekasminnarthe syāt - napuṃsaka eva,nānyatra; parokṣe na syāt; idamaḥ pratyakṣavācitvāt? ityetat? sarvamāśaṅkyāha -`prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ` ityādi| prakṛtau ṣaṣṭharthamātraṃ vivakṣitam| pratyayārthe'pi ṣaṣṭharthasambandhimātram, yena vinā ṣaṣṭhartho na sampadyate| `yadaparam` ityādinā mātraśabdena yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayati| ādiśabdena sāmānyabhidhāyitvaṃ gṛhrate| asya tu sarvatra vivakṣākāraṇam <> [[4.1.92]] ityatraivaktam| atheha kasmānna bhavati - devadattasyānantaram, devadattasya samīpatyādi? `anantarādiṣu` ityādi| `anabhidhānāt` iti| pratyayāntenānantarādīnāmapratyāyanamityarthaḥ|`saṃvahestuḥ`iti| vahestrantādityarthaḥ| `sāṃvāhitram` iti| sampūrvādvahesturiṭ ca, yaṇādeśaḥ| `siddha evātrāṇ` iti| <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] ityanena| yadyevaṃ kimarthamupasaṃkhyānam? ityāha - `iḍartham` ityādi| upasaṃkhyāne hrasatīḍāgamo na syāt, `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt` [[7.2.10]] itīṭpratiṣedhāt|`agnīghaḥ` ityādi| agnīgha ityetasmāccharaṇe gṛhe vācye raṇ vaktavyaḥ, bhasaṃjñā ca vaktavyā, bhasaṃjñāyāñca satyāṃ padasaṃjñābhāvājjaśatvaṃ na bhavati|`samidhām` ityādi| ādhīyante yena mantraviśeṣeṇa samidhastasmin sanidhāmādhānaviśeṣe samicchabdāt vaṇyaṇ pratyayo vaktavyaḥ = vyākhyeyaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu -`havirnivāsasāmidhenīṣu` [[3.1.129]] ityetannirdeśamāśritya vaktavyam| `sāmidhenī` iti| <<ṣidgaurādibhyaśca>> [[4.1.41]] iti ṅīṣ, <> [[6.4.150]] iti yalopaḥ||`nānyatra` iti| sannāhādau||`patrādvāhre` (vā|474) ityavadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyam - pattrādvāhra eveti| anyatra kasmānna bhavata? anabhidhānāt| atha kimarthaṃ na pūrveṇa sahaikayoga eva kriyate - `pattrapūrvapatrādhvaryupariṣado'ñ` iti? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi pūrvapattrapūrvāt prātipadikādanyato'pi prasajyeta| yogavibhāge pūrvasmin yoge rathādityanuvṛtte ratha eva pattrapūrvagrahaṇena viśeṣyata iti na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ| ekayoge tu rathādyanuvṛttau satyāṃ yathā pattrapūrvatayā ratho viśeṣyate, tathā pattrādibhirapi ratha eva niśeṣyate ityaniṣṭaṃ syāt| tasmādyogavibhāga eva nyāyyaḥ||`bābhraṇyaśālaṅkāyanikā` iti| vunnantaḥ svabhāvādeva striyāṃ vartata iti ṭāp , `pratyayasthāt` [[7.3.44]] ityādinettvam||vuni prakṛte vuñvidhānaṃ vṛddhyartham| taccāvṛddhā eva gotracaraṇaśabdāḥ prayojayanti, na vṛddhāḥ| teṣu hi vuñi vuni vā sati na kaścidviśeṣaḥ| `glaucukāyanakaḥ` iti| `prācāmavṛddhāt phin bahulam` [[4.1.160]] iti phin, tadantādvuñ|`caraṇāt` ityādi| caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoreveṣyate, nānyatra; anabhidhānāditi||tena vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| asati tu ghoṣagrahaṇe, añādayastrayaḥ saṅghādayo'pi tatra iti samānādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ syāt? ghoṣe ca pratyayo na syāt| `baidaḥ` iti| `anṛṣa` [[4.1.104]] ityādināñ; tadantādaṇ| aṅkalakṣamayoḥ ko viśeṣa iti? nāstyeva kaścidviśeṣaḥ| paryāyatvādaṅkalakṣamayoriti manyate| `lakṣaṇam` ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati| lakṣaṇaṃ cihnaṃ lakṣyasyaiva svam, nānyasya; yathā vidyā bidānām| bidānāmeva hi lakṣaṇānāṃ sambandhinām nānyasya kasyacit| aṅkastu gavādistho na gavādīnāṃ sambhavati| kiṃ tarhi? tato'nyeṣām, gavādisvāminām| atha kimarthaṃ gitkaraṇaṃ pratyayasya, yāvatāñantādyañantāḥ prakṛtayo vṛddhā eva? ata āha - `ṇitkaraṇam` ityādi| baidī vidyetyatra ṅīb yathā syāt| iha ca baidīvidya ityatra <> [[6.3.39]] iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho yathā syāt| evamarthaṃ ṇitkaraṇam,na vṛddhyartham||`vuño'pavādaḥ` iti| caraṇalakṣamasya śākalaśabdasya caraṇalakṣaṇatvāt| `śākalāḥ` iti| śākalyaśabdādgargādiyañantāt <> [[4.2.111]] iti proktārthe' ṇ| `āpatyasya ca taddhitenāti` [[6.4.151]] iti yalopaḥ| śākala iti sthite <> [[4.2.59]] ityaṇ, tasya proktālluk [[4.2.63]] -śākalāḥ, teṣāṃ saṅghaḥ śākalaḥ, śākalaka iti vā||`vuñaṇorapavādaḥ` iti| chandogādibhyaścaraṇalaṇasya vuño'pavādaḥ| naṭādautsargikasyāṇaḥ||`daṇḍapradhānā māṇavā daṇḍamāṇavāḥ` iti| madyamapadalopisamāsaṃ darśayati| sa punarmayūkhyaṃsakāditvādvetivyaḥ| mayūravyaṃsakāderākṛtigaṇatvāt| `vuñpratyayo na bhavati` iti| etena vuño'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| kathaṃ punajrñāyate vuño'yaṃ pratiṣedha? ityāha - `gotragrahaṇam` ityādi| iha hi gotragrahaṇamanuvartate <> [[4.3.126]] ityataḥ, tenāyamartho bhavati - <> [[4.3.120]] ityetasminnarthe yaḥ pratyayo gotrāt prāpnoti sa daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu na bhavatīti, gotre vuñeva prāpnotīti, atastasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedho vidhīyate| gaukakṣyaśabdādgargādiyañantāt <> [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ, pūrvavadyalopaḥ| `dākṣāḥ` iti| dākṣiplākṣimāhakibyaḥ `iñaśca` [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ||`prakṛteravasthāntaram` iti| prakṛteḥ kāraṇasyāvasthāntaram = anayathātvam| `aprāṇī` iti| prāṇinaḥ <<prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.3.154]] añaṃ vakṣyati| `ādyudāttam` iti| <> [[4.3.140]] ityañaṃ vakṣyati| `avṛddham` iti| vṛddhānmayaṭaṃ vakṣyati -<> [[4.3.144]] iti, yasya ca nānyat pratipadaṃ vidhānamiti - gopayasoryat` [[4.3.158]] ityevamādi| nanu ca `an` [[6.4.167]] iti prakṛtibhāvena bhavitavyam, tatkathamāśma iti bhavati? ityāha - `aśmano vikāra iti ṭilopaḥ` iti| ṭilopārthamaāmano vikāra ityetadupasaṃkhyānaṃ kṛtam| `nitsarevādyudāttā ete` iti| aśmādayaḥ śabdāḥ| tatrāśmabhasmaśabdau maninpratyayāntatvānnatsvareṇādyudāttau| mṛttikāśabdo'pi tikanpratyayāntatvāt - <> [[5.4.39]] iti| atha tasyeti vacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tasyagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtameva? ityāha - `{tasyaprakaraṇam - prācīna mudrita vā} tasya prakaraṇam` ityādi| taddhi prakṛtaṃ tasyeti vacanaṃ śaiṣikairghādibhiḥ {sambaddha -mu|pāṭhaḥ} sambaddham| atastadanuvṛttau te'pyanuvarteran| asmastu tasyagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe pūrvakaṃ tasyeti vacanaṃ nivartate| tasmāt prakṛte'pi tasyeti vacane śaiṣika nivṛttyarthaṃ punastasyetyucyata iti| nanu ca pradhānaṃ ghādayaḥ, vidhīyamānatvāt; tasyeti tu vacanapradhānam, tadarthatvāt; tatrāyuktā guṇe nivartamāne pradhānasya nivṛttiḥ prasajyeta, yathaiva hi prakṛtaṃ tasyeti vacanaṃ ghādibhiḥ sambaddhaṃ tathā aṇādibhirapi? naiṣa doṣaḥ, ubhayeṣāṃ hi nivṛttī niṣpalaḥ sūtrasyārambhaḥ syāt| vidheyasya kasyacidabhāvāt, tasmānna bhavatyubhayeṣāṃ nivṛttiḥ| nanu cārambhasāmarthyādubhayeṣāmanyatameṣāṃ nivṛttirityetāvadvijñāyate| tatka ghādayo nivartante? utāṇādayaḥ? sandeha eva| sandehamātrametat, sarvasandeheṣvidamupatiṣṭhate - `vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattirna hi sandehādalakṣaṇam` (vyā|pa|75) iti| ghādayo nivartanta ityevaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ, svaritatvādaṇādīnāmanuvṛttirbhaviṣyati| nanu cāsvaritvāddhādīnāmanuvṛttiḥ, saiva tu tasyeti vacanenākhyāyate śaiṣikanivṛttyartham| `vikārāvayavayoḥ` ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati| kena punavikārāvayavayorghādayaḥ prāpnuvanti? <> [[4.3.120]] ityanenaca tasyedaṃviśeṣatvāt tayoḥ| `hālaḥ,sairaḥ` iti| yadi śaiṣikā anuvarteraṃstato halasīraśabdābhyāṃ <> [[4.4.81]] iti ṭhak syāt| tannivṛttau tvaṇeva bhavati||`maurvaṃ kāṇḍam` iti| mūrvāśabdādavayave pratyayaḥ| `maurva bhasma` iti| vikāre|`ita uttaram` ityādinā vakṣyamāṇānāṃ pratyayānāṃ viṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati| `katham` iti| kena prakāreṇāyaṃ vibhāgo labhyate| pratyakṣamarthaṃ pṛcchati - `dvayamapi`ityādi| yato hetoreṣa viṣayavibhāgo labhyate taddarśayati| tatar phalapākāntā oṣadhaḥ,puṣpavantaḥ phalavantaśca vṛkṣāḥ, tadviśeṣā vanaspatayaḥ phalavanta eva| tatra vanaspatigrahaṇena vṛkṣaviśeṣāstato'nyena gṛhyante| vṛkṣagrahaṇe tu vanaspaterapi grahaṇaṃ vijñeyam| `vikārāvayavayoḥ` ityādi| yugapadadhikāre hraṇādīn vakṣyāmītyevamartho yugapadadhikāraḥ| aṇādīnāmarthanirdeśārtho'pi kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `kṛtanirdeśo hi tau` iti| kṛtanirdeśo hi tāvarthau <> [[4.3.120]] ityanenaiva;tasyedaṃ viśeṣatvāt tayoḥ||`añmayaṭorapavādaḥ` iti| yadatrānudāttādi tasmāt <> [[4.3.140]] iti prāptasyāño'pavādaḥ| yadvṛddhaṃ tataḥ <> [[4.3.144]] iti mayaṭaḥ| tatra bilvaśabdasya prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatve prāpte `bilvatiṣyayorvāntasvaritatvam` (phi|sū|1|23) iti svaritatvaṃ bhavati, udātto vā| `vrīhimudga` śabdau ghṛtāditvādantodāttau| `masūragodhūma` śabdau `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ` (phi|sū|2|42) iti madhyodāttau| evaṃ `gavedhukā` śabdo'pi| iṣeḥ ksuḥ, `ikṣuḥ`| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `veṇuḥ` śabdo'pi <> [[6.1.215]] itipakṣe'ntodātta eva| `karpāsīpāṭalī` śabdau `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt` iti ṅīṣantau| ṅīṣpratyayāntatvānṅīṣptyayasvareṇāntodāttau| `karkandhū` śabdaḥ `andūdṛgbhūjambūkaphelūkarkandhūdidhiṣūḥ` (da|u|1|176) iti nipātanānmadhyodāttaḥ| `kuṭīra` śabdaḥ `laghāvante` (phi|sū|2|42) ityādinā madhyodāttaḥ| sarva ete <> [[6.1.158]] ityanudāttādayaḥ| tenāñbādhanārthaṃ grahaṇamiti| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na bilvādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta? naivaṃ śakyam; pāṭalīśabdo hyatra vṛddhaḥ paṭhate, tasmādaño bādhake mayaṭi prāpte punarvacanādañeva syāt| aṇgrahaṇāt tvaṇeva bhavati| tasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ kriyate||`yathāyogam` iti| prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyo vikārāvayavayoḥ, anyebhyastu vikāramātra ityeṣo yatāyogārthaḥ| `año'pavādaḥ` iti| `orañ` [[4.3.137]] , `anudāttādeḥ` [[4.3.138]] ityetābhyāṃ prāptasya| `tittiḍīkamāṇḍūka dardurūkamadhūka`śabdāḥ `laghāvante` (phi|sū|2|42) ityādinā madhyodāttāḥ,tenānudāttādayo bhavanti||`oraño'pavādaḥ` iti| anudāttatvāt| `aprāṇyādi` iti| ādiśabdenauṣadhitvamavṛkṣatvaṃ ca gṛhrate||`anudāttāderanyadihodāharaṇam` iti| anudāttāderuttarasūtreṇaiva siddhatvāt| `daivadāravam, bhādradāravam` iti| devadārubhadradāruśabdau `pītadravarthānām` (phi|sū|2|37) ityādyudāttau| tasyāyamarthaḥ -pītadruḥ artho yeṣāṃ te pītadravarthāḥ, teṣāṃ pītadravarthavacanānāmādirudāyo bhavati||`dādhittham` ityādi| dadhni tiṣṭhatīti, kapau tiṣṭhatīti -supi sthaḥ` [[3.2.4]] iti kaḥ,<> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvāt sakārasya takāraḥ,upapadasamāsaḥ, samāsasvareṇāntodāttau| tena dadhitthakapitthaśabdāvanudāttādī bhavataḥ||`ubhayatravibhāṣeyam` iti| prāpte cāprāpte ca| tāmevobhayatravibhāṣāṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha - `palāśakhadira` ityādi| palāśaśabdo dhṛtāditvādantodāttaḥ,khadiraśabdo'pi titsvareṇa| `iṣimadimudikhidicchidibhidimandicanditisimihimuhimucirucirudhibandhiśuṣibhyaḥ kirac` (da|u|8|26) ityanuvartamāne `ajiraśiśiraśithilasthirasphirasthavirakhadirāḥra` (da|u|8|27) iti kiracpratyayānto nipātitaḥ| śiṃśapāśabdaḥ `pāntānāṃ gurvādīnām` (phiṭ|3|55) iti madhyodāttaḥ| tasyāyamarthaḥ - pāśabdāntānāṃ gurvādīnāṃ dvitīyamudāttaṃ bhavatīti| athakha `dvitīyaṃ prāgīṣāt` (phi|sū|3|50) ityatrānuvartate, `spadi kiñciccalane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-14) asmāt `anudāttādeśca halādeḥ` [[3.2.149]] iti yuc - spandanaḥ, citsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `kṛśṛgṛṭipaṭi{śauṭibhyaḥ -da|u|}śaṭibhya īran` (da|u|8|72) karīra śabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `kṛśṛgṛkaṭipaṭi{śauṭibhyaḥ da|u|}śaṭibhya īran` (da|u|8|72) karīra śabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `kṛhmabhyāmīṣan` (da|u|9|9), `śṛpṛbhyāṃ {kit -da|u|}kicca` (da|u|9|10) iti śirīṣaśabdo'pi nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| vikaṅgatapūlāsayavāsāśca `grāmādīnāṃ ca` (phi|sū| 2|38) ityādyudāttāḥ||`año'pavādaḥ` iti| śamīśabdasay gaurāditvānṅīṣantasya pratyayasvareṇāntodāttasyānudāttāditvāt| ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ||`etayoḥ` iti| `kimanena`ityādi codyam| `ye viśeṣapratyayāḥ` ityādi parihāraḥ| ādiśabdena <> [[4.3.157]] ityevamādayo gṛhyante| yadi hretayoriti nocyeta, tato ya iti uttare viśeṣāḥ pratyayāḥ añādayaḥ taiḥ saha samprasāraṇāyāṃ paratvāt ta eva syuḥ| `etayoḥ` ityucyamāne tu viśeṣapratyayeṣvapi pakṣe bhavanti, tena kapotamayamityādi siddhaṃ bhavati| atha kriyamāṇe `etayoḥ`ityetasmin, kathamavādaviṣaye mayaḍ? bhavati? etayorityasya dvitīyavidhānārthatvānmayaṭpratyayo vikārāvayavayorbhavati| ekam - vidhānametayoriti, mayaḍbhavatīti `tarati` [[4.4.5]] ityetasminnarthe punarupasthānaṃ yathā syāditi|`ṭhakprakaraṇe` ityādi| taditi karmābhidhāyibhya āhetyetasminnarthe māśabdādibhyaṣṭhaka upasaṃkhyānan| `vākyādetat pratyayavidhānam` iti| sa eva hi vākyārtha iti nāvamṛṣṭaḥ karmabāvamupagataḥ| tadāheti nirdiśyate -tadabhidāyina eva vākyāt pratyaya iti| padasamudāyo hi vākyamiti| `mā` ityetasya ca `śabda` ityetasya ca padasya yaḥ padasya yaḥ samudāyastadvākyam| evamanyatrāpi veditavyam|kathaṃ punaḥ prātipadikādhikāre vākyātpratyayavidhiḥ? ityata āha - `prabhūtādibhyaḥ` iti| punarvacanāt| yadi hranenāpi prātipadikādeva pratyayavidhiḥ syādevaṃ sati `{āheti prabhūtādibhyaḥ - prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ} āhau prabhūtādibhyaḥ` (vā|483) iti punarupasaṃkhyānamanarthakaṃ syāt; anenaiva siddhatvāt| prabhūtādayo'pi hi māśabdādayo bhaviṣyanti, te ca karmābhidhāyina eva pratyayamutpādayanti; kriyāviśeṣaṇābhidhāyitvāt| kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ hi karmatvaṃ `tatpratyanupūrvamīpalomakūlam` [[4.4.28]] ityatra pratipādayiṣyate - pratyayārtho'pyaheti| sa eva tasmādāheti prabhūtādibhya itipunarvacanādvākyādeva pratyavidhānaṃ vijñāyate| `kriyāviśeṣaṇāt` iti| prabhūtādiśabdaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇābhidhāyitvādabhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ kṛtvā kriyāviśeṣamaśabdenoktaḥ||`tena` iti pratyekamabhisambadhyate| `sarvatra karaṇe tṛtīyā` iti| dīvyatītyādau kartari lakāra iti tenaiva kartturabhihitatvāt kartari tṛtīyā nopapadyate| tasmāt karaṇa eva tṛtīyā| atha hetau tṛtīyā kasmānna bhavati? anabhidhānāt| jitamityatra karmaṇi niṣṭhāvidhānādyadyapi kartaryapi tṛtīyā sambhavati, tathāpi dīvyatītyādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt karaṇa eva tṛtīyā vijñāyate| devadattena jitamityatra kartari tṛtīyā; tena vākyameva bhavati; na pratyayaḥ|iha sūtre dīvyatītyādinaikavacanāntenaikasaṃkhyasya pratyayārthasya vartamānena ca kālena nirdeśaḥ| tataścaikasminneva pratyayārthe pratyaya syāt, na dvibahvoḥ| tathā vartamāna eva kāle, na bhūtabhaviṣyatoriti yaścodayet, taṃ ityāha - `pratyayārthe saṃkhyākālayoravivakṣā` iti| avivakṣātu tayornāntarīyakatvāt| avaśyaṃ hi yayā kayācit saṃkhyayā yena kenacit kālena nirdeśaḥ kartavya iti| na tau pradhānam, na ca tayorvivakṣeti| yadi tarhi saṃkhyākālayoravivakṣeti sādhanasyāpyavivakṣā prāpnoti, ekaprakaraṇatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasya hi vivakṣāmantarema dvitīyasya padasyoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ bhavati tanniyogato vivakṣitavyam| dīvyatītyādiṣvanvarthamātre vivakṣyamāṇe dvitīyasya padasyoccāraṇamanarthakamāpadyeteti na yuktā sādhanasyāpyavivakṣā|iha dīvyatītyevamādau `kriyāpradhānamākhyātam` iti kriyaiva padena prādhānyenākhyāyate, kartā tu guṇībhūtaḥ, taddhitastu -ākṣika iti prādhānyena kartāramevātra vakti, kriyā tu guṇabhāvena, etaccāyuktam; ākhyāteṣūtpannaiḥ pratyayairyathā'sau tiṅantenābhidhīyate, tathaiva pratyayāntenāpi yukto'bhidhātumiti yaścodayet, ityāha - `kriyāpradhānatve'pi ca` ityādi| abhidhānasvabhāvaścāyam, yena kriyāprādhānyasyāpyanuvidhīyamānastaddhitaḥ karttupradhāno bhavati| tasmāt karttṛtvabhāvo'trāpekṣitavyaḥ| na hi svabhāvo'pi na hi svābhāvo'pi paryanuyogamarhati||yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ - <> [[4.4.4]] ityayamapavādaḥ saṃskṛta eva yathā syāt, `dīvyati` ityādau mā bhūdityevamartho yogavibhāgaḥ||`svare viśeṣaḥ`iti| ṭhaki hi sati taddhitasya `kitaḥra` [[6.1.159]] ityantodāttatvaṃ syāt| ṭhañi sati ñitsareṇādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati||iha prakaraṇe keṣucit saṃhitikaḥ ṣakāro dṛṣṭaḥ, keṣucitpratyayasyaivānubandhaḥ;tadiha ṭhagadhikāre na jñāyate - kaḥ sāṃhitikaḥ? kaḥ pratyayānubandhaḥ? iti| ato'sandehārthaṃ parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam| tacca `ākarṣātparpādibhyaḥ` ityādinā ślokena karoti| <<ākarṣāt ṣṭhal>> [[4.4.9]] , `pargādibhyaṣṭhan` [[4.4.10]] , `bhastrādibhyaṣṭhan` [[4.4.16]] , `kasusīdadaśaikadaśāt ṣṭhanṣṭhacau` [[4.4.31]] , <<āvasathāt ṣṭhal>> [[4.4.74]] , <> [[4.4.53]] iti vitaḥ ṣaḍete| nanu ca <> [[4.1.40]] ityādayo'nyebhyo'pi vitaḥ santyeva| tatkimucyate ṣaḍete? ityata āha - `ṭhagadhikāre` ityādi| ṭhakaḥ prakṛtatvāt tadadhikāre ye ṣitaḥ ta eva parigṛhranta iti darśayati|nanvevamapi sati sapta bhavanti, kusādādi [[4.4.31]] sūtre ṣitpratyayadvayavidhānāt? ityatrāha - `vidhivākyāpekṣaṃ tu ṣaṭtvam` iti| ṣitaḥ pratyayānāṃ saptatvāt| etenaiva yogāḥ ṣitaḥ prayuktāḥ| ṣitpratyayārthāḥ ṣaḍete yogā ityarthaḥ||`lakāraḥ svarārthaḥ` iti| liti pratyayāt pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| `ṣakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ` iti| <<ṣidgaurādibhyaśca>> [[4.1.41]] iti ṅīṣ yathā syāt| `ākarṣikī` iti| `svarṇaparīkṣārtho nikaṣopala ucyate` iti| ākṛṣyate svarṇamiti kṛtvā|parpādiṣu `pādaḥ pacca` iti paṭhate, tasyāyayamarthaḥ - pādaśabdāt ṣṭhan pratyayo bhavati tatsannayogena capadityayamādeśaḥ padikaḥ, padikī| yadyevaṃ <> [[6.3.53]] iti `padbhāva ike caratāvupasaṃkhyānam` (vā|740) itikasmādupasaṃkhyāyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; <> [[6.4.130]] ityasyāpaurāṇikatvāt||`ṣvāgaṇikaḥ`iti| śunāṃ gaṇaḥ āgaṇaḥ| nanu ca āñśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭhata iti `dvārādīnāñca` [[7.3.4]] iti vṛddhipratiṣedhenaivāgamena bhavitavyam, tatra tadādividheriṣṭatvāt, tatkathaṃ āāgaṇika iti bhavati? ityāha - `āāderiñiṭa ityādi| dvārādikārye ca pratiṣiddhe satyādivṛddhireva bhavati||`krayavikrayagrahaṇaṃ saṅghātavigṛhītārtham` iti| iha tantreṇa krayavikrayaśabdāvuccāritau;tatraikasya saṅghātārthaṃ grahaṇam, aparasya tu vigṛhītārthaṃ veditavyam||bhastrādiṣu `śīrṣebhāra` iti paṭhate| tatrāsmādeva nipātanācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ, `saptamī` [[2.1.39]] iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ, <> [[6.3.14]] iti pakṣe saptamyā aluk||`paryāhāre` iti| paritaḥ sa hyiyata iti paryāhāraḥ, maṇḍalādikamucyate||`ḍivataḥ ktrirityayaṃ triśabdo gṛhrate` iti| saṃkhyāśabdaḥ kasmānna gṛhrate??nabhidhānāt| na hi trirityucyate vivakṣitārthasya pratītirbhavati| `uptrimam` iti| <> [[6.1.15]] iti samprasāraṇam|`nityagrahaṇaṃ svātantryanivṛttyartham` iti| kevalasya tripratyayāntasya mappratyayarahitasya prayogaḥ svātantryam, tannivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇam| svātantranivṛttyarthe nityagrahaṇe sati yo'rthaḥ sampadyate taṃ `{tryantaḥ - mu|pāṭhaḥ} tryantam` ityādinā darśayati| `viṣayāntare` ityādinā yadevakārasya vyavacchedyaṃ tadācaṣṭe| mappratyayaviṣayārthādanyaviṣaye yatra pratyayo na bhavati tadvi yāntaram| nityagrahaṇaṃ tannivṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ veditavyam||`apamitya` iti| <> [[3.4.19]] iti ktvā, tasya lyabādeśe kṛte,apamityeti bhavati| tasya ca <> [[1.1.40]] ityavyayasaṃjñā| tena tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktyādhikāre'pyavibhaktikādevāsmāt pratyayavidhiḥ||nanu ca <> [[4.4.3]] ityeva saṃsṛṣṭe pratyayayo bhaviṣyati, yat punaryena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tattena saṃskṛtaṃ bhavati? naitat; sato hrutkarṣādhānaṃ saṃskāraḥ,ekabhāvaḥ saṃsargaḥ| na ca tatrotkarṣeṇa bhavitavyam, svaśucidravyasaṃsarge svaprakarṣa eva bhavati, notkarṣaḥ| saṃsargamātre pratyaya iṣyate; tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭa iti vaktavyameva; etadeva kriyatām; kiṃ <> [[4.4.3]] ityanena? asatyapi saṃsarge yatra saṃskṛtamasti tatrāpi pratyaya iṣyate - vaidyikaḥ, na vidyayā saṃsarga upapadyate; saṃsargo dravyayoreva bhavati, yathā -daṇḍapuruṣayoḥ| mūrtimatastaddharmatvāt, rana tu vidyā mūrttimatī| kulatthakoladhādaṇo [[4.4.4]] vidhānārthaṃ saṃskṛtagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| na hi saṃsṛṣṭamātre pratyaya iṣyate; kintu tatkṛtaguṇādhāne||nanu ca cūrṇena ye saṃsṛṣṭāsteṣāṃ cūrṇamasti, tatra matvarthīyenaiveninā siddhamiti tadapārthakamidam? naitat ; astivivakṣāyāṃ matvarthīyena siddhaṃ syāt, saṃsṛṣṭavivakṣāyāṃ punarna sidhyati, ta hi ṭhak syāt| ṭhako bādhanārthatve kuto'syānarthakyam||`dravyavācī` ityādi| lavaṇaśabdo'yamastyeva guṇavacano yo rasaviśeṣe vartate, rasasya guṇatvāt| asti dravyavacanaḥ, yathā -pañca lavaṇānīti| tatra yo guṇavacanaḥ sa lukaṃ na prayojanayati| guṇairhi yadyapi dravyaṃ na saṃsṛjyate, tathāpi guṇaśabdāḥ `so'yam` ityabhedena sambandhāddravye vartante, yathā - śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, {kṣāram - mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} kṣauram, amlaṃ dadhīti; tathā lavaṇaśabdo'pi vartiṣyate, tataḥ kiṃ lukā? avaśyaṃ tadevaṃ vijñāyam, anyathā hi madhurādibhyo'pi lugvaktavyaḥ syāt| dravyaśabdāstvanyatra so'yamityabhedasamarthanānna vartante| tasmāddravyavācī lavaṇaśabdo lukaṃ prayojayati||`vyañjanaiḥra` iti| bahuvacananirdeśaḥ svarūpavidhinirāsārthaḥ| tenetyadhikārādeva tṛtīyāyāṃ samarthavibhaktau vartamānāyāṃ tṛtīyānuvādaḥ sukhapratipattaye| <> [[4.4.22]] iti vartamāna upasiktasyaitat prayojanam - odanādau yathā syāt| iha mā bhūt - sūpena saṃsṛṣṭā sthālīti| udakenodasikta odana iti| udakaṃ vyañjanaṃ na bhavati; vyañjanaśabdasya sūpādāveva rūḍhatvāt| nanu yadvyañjanairupasiktaṃ tattaiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ bhavati; tatra saṃskṛtameva siddham? na sidhyati; sato hrutkarṣāvānaṃ saṃskāraḥ, na cāsau sarvatropasiktaḥ sambhavati| tathā hi - vyapagate svādurasai pratibhāvāpannairupasikteṣvodanādiṣvapakarṣa eva bhavati, notkarṣaḥ| upasiktamātre'pi ceṣyate| tasmāt prāk tasya pṛthagārambhaḥ||`vartate` iti| ceṣṭata ityarthaḥ| `tatprakriyāviśeṣaṇam` ityādi| anena hi vṛttyarthasya kartavyatāmācaṣṭa| vartata iti vartamānaṃ karotyarthaḥ| sa hi vṛttyarthaḥ kartavyatayā sambadhyamānaḥ karma sampadyate| tatsāmānādikaraṇyācca tadviśeṣaṇamapi kartavyatayā yujyate| tadapi karma ca prasaktam| kriyāviśeṣaṇasyaivākarmake'pi dhātau karmatvamākhyātam| tadityanena dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāmapi dvitīyāntā iha prakṛtayo nirdiṣṭā vispaṣṭārtham; anyathā pratyayavidhau pañcamī nyāyyeti tadantā eva nirdiśyeran||`prātīpikaḥ` iti| pratigatā āpo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe` [[5.4.74]] ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| evañca <<dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt>> [[6.3.97]] itīttvam| aparatra tu <<ūdanordeśe>> [[6.3.98]] iti deśādanyatrottvameva, tataṣṭhak| `{prātilomikaḥ, ānalomikaḥ -kāśikā,padamañjarī ca|} prātilomikam, ānulomikam` iti| pratigatāni lomānyasya , anugatāni lomānyasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ac pratyanu` [[5.4.75]] ityādinā'c samāsāntaḥ||`pañcamyayāṅparibhiḥ` [[2.3.10]] iti pañcamī| <> [[2.1.12]] ityavyayībhāvasamāsaḥ, tataṣṭhak| svābhimukhaṃ varjayitvā yaḥ sevako vartate sa pārimukhikaḥ| sarvatobhāve vā pariḥ, tasya <> [[2.2.18]] iti prādisamāsaḥ| yato yataḥ svāmino mukhaṃ vartate tatastato yaḥ sevako vartate sa pārimukhikaḥ||`dviguṇam` iti| tādathryāt tācchabdyaṃ darśayati| ādviguṇārthe vastuni dviguṇaśabdaṃ vartayitvā tatra pratyayaṃ kurvataḥ ko'bhiprāyaḥ? evaṃ manyate - dvaiguṇika iti uttamarṇa ucyate, na cāsau dviguṇaṃ prayacchati, kiṃ tarhi? skandayitvā dviguṇaṃ gṛhṇāti; anyathā hi viparyaye sati prasasyameva syāt, na tu gahrram| yadaikasminnarthe tādathryāddviguṇaśabdo vartate tadaikameva dviguṇārthaṃ prayacchato dviguṇameva bhavatīti gahrramiti| garhā punariha pratiṣiddhasya śāstreṇa dīyamānasya pratyavāyahetutvādvetitavyā| `prakṛtyantaram` ityāpinopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe`| tatrāpi tādathryādvṛddhyarthaṃ yaddīyate tadvṛdhudhiśabdenocyate| nanu ca tatpratyākhyāne vṛddhiśabdāt pratyaye sati vārdhika ityapi syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avyavikanyāyena hi vṛddhiśabdena vākyameva bhavati| vṛdhuṣiśabdena vākyaṃ vṛttiśca||tatrāpi kusīdārthe vastuni daśaikādaśārtheṣu ca daśasu daśaikādaśaśabdaṃ vartayitvā tataḥ pratyayaḥ| sarvataḥ pūrvavadabhiprāyo veditavyaḥ| daśa caikādaśa ceti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ| nanu ca bhinnaviṣayayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate? daśaikādaśaśabhdo'pyekādaśārtheṣu daśasvevopacarādvartata ityadoṣaḥ| yo daśa prayacchatyekādaśa eva syuriti sa daśaikādaśa ityucyate| daśaikādaśāditi nirdeśādakārāntatvaṃ nipātyate; kimartham? vākye'pyakārāntatvaśravaṇārtha daśaikādaśān prayacchatīti||`uñchati` iti| uddhunotītyarthaḥ||tadityanenaiva dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ śabdadarduramiti dvitīyānirdeśo laukikavākyapradarśanārthaḥ| śabdadarduraṃ karotītyedvyāvahārikaṃ vākyam| asya pratigraho yatra loke vyavahārastatra pratyayo bhavati nānyatretyartha sūcayate, tena śabdaṃ karoti ravara ityatra na bhavati| loke sa śābdika ityucyate yaḥ śabdaṃ vetti; vaiyākaraṇa eva śabdaṃ vetti, tena tatraiva pratyayo bhavati, na khare| ca asau vaiyākaraṇaḥ pratyayaprakṛtyādinā sarvaṃ śabdaṃ jānāti||`svarūpasya paryāyāṇāñca tadviśeṣaṇānāñca grahamiṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi paryāyādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ labhyate? arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati, nārthapradhāna iti pratipāditametat prāk| yadi tarhi paryāyāṇāmapi grahaṇam, ajihṛān hantyanimiṣān hantītyatrāpi prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ iha dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ punarditīyāsamarthavibhaktinirdeśo laukikavākyapradarśanārthaḥ| asay parigrahaḥ - yatra laukikavākyavyavahārastatra pratyayo bhavati nānyatretyasyārthasya sūcanārtham, tenājihṛān hantītyādau pratyayo na bhavati| ajihṛān hantyanimiṣān hantītyasyārthasya vivakṣāyāmājihiṛkaḥ, ānimiṣika iti loke na vyavahāro'sti| tatra pakṣiṣu `pākṣikaḥra` itaci svarūpasyodāharaṇam| `śākunikaḥ` iti paryāyasya| `māyūrikaḥ, taittirikaḥ` iti| viśeṣasya| matsyeṣu `mātsyikaḥra` iti svarūpasya| `mainikaḥra` iti paryāyasya| `śāpharikaḥra, śākulikaḥ`iti viśeṣasya| mṛgeṣu `mārgikaḥ` iti svarūpasya| `hāriṇikaḥra` iti paryāyasya| `saukarikaḥ, sāraṅgikaḥ` iti viśeṣasya||yathā parimukhañceti parimukhaśabdasyāvyayībhāvatvaṃ tatpuruṣatvañca, tathehāpi paripanthaśabdasya taddvayaṃ veditavyam| `taditi dvitīyāsamarthāt` iti| nanu ca tiṣṭhatirayamakarmakaḥ tatkathaṃ dvitīyayā saha sambandhaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; akarmaṇāmapi hi {kālabhāvādhvanāṃ mudritapāṭhaḥ} kālabhāvādhnaḥ karmasaṃjñāṃ pratipadyante| tathā coktam - `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hrakarmaṇām` (vā|1.3.51) iti| `pāripanthikaścauraḥ` ityavyayībhāvaḥ| cauro yaḥ panthānaṃ varṇayitvā tiṣṭhati sa pāripanthikaśabdenocyate| tatpuruṣapakṣe tu yaścauraḥ patho vyāpya tiṣṭhati sa paripanthika ucyate|`cakāraḥ` ityādi| tiṣṭhati cetyatra pratyayārthasamanantarameva cakāro draṣṭavyaḥ, tena samānajātīyasyaiva pratyayārthasya samuccayaṃ karoti| atha prakṛtereva samuccayaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? karmatvānupapatteḥ| tatra hi dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiranuvartate, tiṣṭhateścākarmakatvāt prakṛtāyā matsyādeḥ pkṛteḥ karmabhāvo nopapadyate| kālabhāvādhvanāmeva hrakarmakāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñeṣyate, na matsyādīnām|laukikavākyapradarśanārthaṃ tadetaddvitīyoccāraṇaṃ karotītyāha - `{paripathaśabdaparyāyaḥ - kāśikā}paripathaparyāyaḥ` iti| kimetasya jñāpane prayojanamityāha - `sa viṣayāntare` ityādi| asati hrasmin jñāpane ṭhakpratyayasanniyogena prakṛtirnirdiśyamānā pratyayābhāvena prasajyate| jñāpane tu sati yatrāpi pratyayo na bhavati tatrāpi prayoga upapadyate||daṇḍabhāvo mātho daṇḍamāthaḥ = ṛjuḥ panthā ucyate, taṃ dhāvati `dāṇḍamāthikaḥ`| śulkasya māthaḥ śulkamāthaḥ, `śaulkamathikaḥ`| padasya paścādanupadam, paścādarthe'vyībhāvaḥ, anupadaṃ dhāvati - `ānupadikaḥ`| pratyāsatyā dhāvatītyarthaḥ| dvitīyāyāṃ samarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ punardvitīyānirdeśaḥ `iṣṭāddvitīyāntādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt` ityevamartham| tena yaḥ <> [[2.1.15]] <> [[2.1.16]] `kugatipradāyaḥ` [[2.2.18]] ityādibhiryogairanuśabdasya samāsaḥ, tato na bhavati||`ārtāyanam` iti| paritrāṇārthamīyate gamyata ityayanam, ārtānāmayanamārtāyanam| śaraṇamityarthaḥ||padagrahaṇena svarūpameva gṛhrate, na suptiṅantaṃ padam| ata evāha - `padaśabda uttarapadaṃ yasya` iti| etacca dvitīyāyāṃ laukikaravākyapradarśanārthatvāddvitīyānirdeśāllabhyate| padottarapadaṃ gṛhṇātītyetallaukikaṃ vākyam| asya pradarśanenaitat sūcitam - laukikasya hi padasya grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti|atha padāntādityeva kasmānnoktam? ityāha - `padāntāditi noktam` ityādi| gatārtham| padamevottarapadaṃ yasya tasmādyathā syāt| iha tu ślokapādapadaṃ gṛhṇātīti bhavatīti kecit||kaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ prati pratikaṇṭham, yathārthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, ābhimukhye vā <> [[2.1.14]] iti| kaṇṭhasyābhimukhya iti| kaṇṭhasyābhimukhyaṃ pratikaṇṭham, prātikaṇṭhikaḥ sa ucyate sarva kaṇṭhaṃ yo gṛhṇāti, yo vā kaṇṭhamābhimukhyena gṛhṇāti| dvitīyāsamarthaprakaraṇe punardvitīyānta prakṛtinirdeśa iṣṭādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| tena pratigataḥ kaṇṭhamiti <> [[2.2.18]] iti tatpuruṣo yaḥ pratikaṇṭhaśabdastato na bhavati||`caratirāsevāyām` iti| āsevā = paunaḥpunyam|`adharmācca vaktavyam` iti| adharmaśabdāccaratītyetasminnarthe ṭhagbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - pūrvasūtrādiha cakāra'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārtho veditavyaḥ, tenādharmādapi bhaviṣyati||`pratipadhikam` iti| pūrvavadvīpsāyām, ābhimukhye vā'vyayībhāvaḥ| panthānaṃ panthānaṃ prati pratipatham| ābhimukhye - patha ābhimukhyaṃ pratipatham| yaḥ sarvān patha eti, ābhimukhyena vā panthānameti sa prātipadika iti cābhidhīyate||`samavāyaḥ samūha ucyate, na samprasāraṇā` iti| kuta etat? tatra samavaitītyasya pratyayārthasyāyogāt| āgatya tadekadeśībhavatīti samavaitiśabdasyārthaḥ| sampradhāraṇā cāmūrtiḥ, caitasiko dharmaḥ, na ca tadekadeśībhavituṃ śakyate| tasmāt samūha eva samavāyaśabdasyārthaḥ, naitītyasyārthaḥ| etīti vartamāne samavaitīti vacanamarthaviśeṣapratipattyartham| etīti prāptimātraṃ kurvannucyate| samavaitītyāgatya tadekadeśībhavatīti||`abhidheyaniyamārthaḥ` iti| abhidheye sevakaviśeṣe ca pratyayāntasya niyamaḥ| tatraiva vṛttiryathā syādityevamartham| `na tu rūḍhartham` iti| lālāṭikakaukkuṭikaśabdayo rūḍhaāmekatvāt|`tadanena` ityādi| yata eva sarvāvayavebyo lalāṭaṃ dūre dṛśyate, tasmādanena lalāṭadarśanena sevakasya svāminaṃ pratyanupaśleṣo labhyate| na tvatra lalāṭārtho darśanaṃ cāsti| yādṛśaścānupaśleṣo vivakṣitaḥ, taṃ `kāryeṣvanupasthāyitvam` ityanena darśayati|`kukkuṭīśabdenāpi` ityādi| kakkuṭaā hralpadeśaviṣayaḥ pāto bhavati| tadanena kukkuṭīpātadeśasyālpatā lakṣyate| na tvatra kukkuṭartho deśaśca vidyate||apūpāḥ paṇyamasyetyāpūpikaḥ|atha yathā vākye paṇyaśabdo yujyate tathā vṛttāvapi kasmānna yujyate? ityāha - `paṇyam` iti| `viśeṣaṇam` ityādi| atha ya evamavekṣyamāṇaḥ paṇyārthaṃ vṛttāvantarbhāvayati tena gatārthatvāt paṇyaśabdo na prayujyate||`śalālukaḥ`iti| `isusuktāntāt kaḥ` [[7.3.51]] ||`śilpaṃ kauśalam` iti| kriyābhyāsapūrvako jñānaviśeṣaḥ| `mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpamasya` iti| mṛdaṅgo vādyate yena śilpena tanmṛdaṅgavādanam| nanu ca mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpaṃ yasyeti vigṛhra pratyaya utpadyamāno mṛdaṅgavādanaśabdādeva prāpnoti, na tu mṛdaṅgaśabdāt, tato mārdaṅgavādanika iti bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ mārdaṅgika iti bhavati? ityāha - `mṛdaṅgavādanam` ityādi| mṛdaṅgaśabda eva pratyayamutpadayati, sa tu mṛdaṅgavādane vartamānaḥ, na mṛdaṅge| atraśabdaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ| na cāyaṃ niyamaḥ - yena vigrahaḥ kriyate, tata eva pratyayena bhavitavyamiti| yathā hraveridaṃ māṃsamāvikam, māṃsamityaviśabdena vigrahaḥ kriyate'vikaśabdādeva pratyayo bhavati, tathehāpi mṛdaṅgavādanaśabdena vigrahaḥ kriyate, pratyayastu mṛdaṅśabdādbhavati| tena tatra gatārthatvācchilpaśabdo na prayujyata ityabhiprāyaḥ||`dhānuṣkaḥ` iti| kādeśaḥ `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ` [[8.3.39]] iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam||atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, ikageva nocyeta, ikakyapi savarṇadīrghatve kṛte śāktīko yāṣṭīka iti sidhyatyeva? na sidhyati; ikārasya <> [[6.4.148]] iti lopena bhavitavyam| tatkutaḥ savarṇadīrghatvam? ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyādeva lopo na bhaviṣyati| nanu cāvagrahanivṛttirikārasya prayojanaṃ syāt? naitat; yadi hretat prayojanaṃ syāt sūtrārambho'narthakhaḥ syāt; ṭhakāpyanavagrahasya siddhatvāt? nānarthakaḥ ; vākyanivṛttyarthatvāt| evamapi pratyayagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, ṭhakpratyayo hi prakṛtaḥ , tatraitāvadena vaktavyam - śakkatiyaṣṭaoriti| evaṃ punarvidhānāṃ vākyanivṛttyarthaṃ bhaviṣyati, kimīkagvidhānena? tasmādikaggrahaṇasāmarthyāllopo na bhaviṣyati| evamapi ṭhakaiva <> [[6.4.148]] iti lopābhāvenānavagrahe siddhe hīkaggrahaṇamadhikavidhānārthaṃ pratīyate| tena <> [[6.4.148]] iti lopo na bhavati| yathā tasmādakaḥ savarṇe [[6.1.97]] dīrgho'pi na syāditi vigṛhītameva śrūyeta| tasmādīkagvaktavyaḥ||`kiṃ tarhi paraloko'stīti {yasya matiḥ - kāśikā} matiryasya` iti| kathaṃ punarasati viśeṣopādāna etallabhyate? ityāha - `tadetat` ityādi| abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyāllabhyate| nanu cāstīti tiṅantam, nāstīti vākyam| ata etābhyāṃ na prāpnoti pratyayaḥ, prātipadikādhikārāt (4.1.1|)? ityata āha - `astināstiśabdau` ityādi| abhyupagamyāpi tiṅantatvaṃ vākyatvañca parihārāntaramāha - `vacanādākhyātādvākyācca pratyayaḥ` iti||`apūpabhakṣaṇaṃ śīlamasya` iti| śīlaviṣayatvādupācārāt tathā vyapadeśaḥ| bhakṣaṇakriyā tadviṣayañca śīlaṃ taddhitavṛttāvantarbhavati| tena tatra pratīyamānatvādbhakṣaṇaśīlaśabdau na prayujyete iti bhāvaḥ||chattraśīlatvaṃ śiṣyasya pratipādayitumāha - `chādanādapavāraṇācchattram` ityādi| apavāriṇādityanena cchādanādityasyārthaṃ vyaktīkaroti| ācchādayati hi yat tacchatramityucyate , tena śiṣyo'pi gurukāryatatparo gururyāni cchidrāṇi gopayati teṣāmāvaraṇāya pravṛttastatra yuktaḥ sacchatrasahacaritāṃ kriyāmācara~śchattraśīlo bhavati|`sthāśabdo'tra paṭhate, sa copasargapūrvo gṛhrate` iti| tataśca tasya <<ātaścopasarge>> [[3.3.106]] ityaṅpratyayamutpādyāpyutpāditatvāt| kevalasya tu pāṭhaḥ sarvopasargasaṃgrahārthaḥ|`curā` iti, paṭhate, tatra nipātanādakārapratyayo guṇābhāvaśca||kriyayā yadvyāpyamānamīpsitatamamanīpsitatamaṃ vā tat karma| iha tvanīpsitatamaṃ gamyate| ata evāha - `yasyādhyayanaprayuktasya` ityādi| na hi kasyacidadhyayane yuktasya parīkṣākāle paṭhataḥ skhalitapāṭharūpamīpsitaṃ bhavati| adhyayanaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ, karmasādhano vā| adhītam, adhīyate, vā'dhyayanam| vṛttaṃ = bhūtamutpannamityarthaḥ|`ekamanyatityādi| samyak pāṭhāpekṣayānyo'rtho veditavyaḥ| `dvaiyanyikaḥ; traiyanyikaḥ` iti| `na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyām` [[7.3.3]] ityaijāgamaḥ| `adhyayane karma vṛttamityetat sarvaṃ taddhitavṛttāvantarbhavati` iti| tena tatrādhyayanavṛttaśabdo'vagatārthatvānna prayujyata iti bhāvaḥ||`dvādaśānyikaḥ` iti| dvādaśaśabdo bahvacpūrvapadam| dvau ca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ| <> [[6.3.47]] ityāttvam, tato dvādaśānyānīti vigṛhra `taddhitārthe` 92.1.52) iti samāsaḥ| nanu caikādeśe kṛte pūrvottarapadābhāvāt bahvacpūrvapadaṃ na bhavati, na cāntādivadbhāvo'sti - `ubhayata āśraye nāntādivat` (vyā|pa|51) naiṣa doṣaḥ; <> [[7.3.22]] iti jñāpakādeśādeśāt pūrvaṃ pratyayaḥ| `tatrodaśānyikaḥ` iti| trayaśca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ, <> [[7.1.53]] iti traya ādeśaḥ| anyaśabdo'tra samyak pāṭhāpekṣayāpapāṭhe vartata ityata āha - `caturdaśāpapāṭhāḥra` ityādi| kathaṃ punajrñāyate'pāṭhe'nyaśabdo vartate? ityāha - `udātte` ityādi| udātte kartavye'nudāttakaraṇamapapāṭhaḥ| tatra ya udātte kartavye'nudāttaṃ karoti sa yasmādanyaṃ karoṣītyucyate tato jñāyate'nyaśabdo'papāṭhe vartata iti||nanu hitaśabdayoge catuthryā bhavitavyam, `hitayoge caturthī bhavati` (vā| 123) ityupasaṃkhyānāt, `tasmaihitam` [[5.1.5]] iti nirdeśāt? `sāmarthyādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati` iti| sāmarthya punastadevopasaṃkhyānam| liṅgañca - hitārthā kriyā taddhitavṛttāntarbhavati, tena na prayujyata iti||nanu ca `tadasay paṇyam` [[4.4.51]] ityatastaditi prathamā samarthavibhaktiranuvartiṣyate, tadapārthakaṃ punaḥ prathamāsamarthavibhaktyupādānām; `asmai` iti pratyayārthopyapārthaka eva| tathā hi `asya` [[4.4.51]] ityanuvartate, tatra `dīyatau` iti ityabhisambandhātttu samparadānatvena bhavitavyam| tataśca śeṣasambandhe nivṛtte catuthryamatra vipariṇamyate, tasmāt `dīyate niyuktam` ityetāvadeva vaktavyam? atrocyate - samarthavibhaktyupādānaṃ tāvat pūrvasūtre samarthavibhaktiviśeṣaḥ pratyayanutpādayatītyasy sūcanārtham| teneha na bhavati - duḥkhamasyādhyane vṛttam, ajayo'syādhyayane vṛtta iti| apapāṭha eva hi vṛtte pratyaya iṣyate| dīyamāne na sarvasmāt caturthī - areḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dadātīti| sa ca ṣaṣṭhaā eva viṣayo'rthaḥ| ṣaṣṭharthaṃ eva pratyayo vijñāyate, catuthryantādyathā syāt| evaṃ `asmai` iti pratyayārtho nirdiśyate||`atha ṭhañeva kasmānnoktaḥ` iti| eva hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| syādetat - ṭhañṭiṭhanorviśeṣo'sti, ataṣṭinnukto na ṭhañ? ityata āha - `na hyatra` ityādi| dvyorapyanayorvṛddhatvānnāsti viśeṣaḥ| yo'pi `vṛddhinimittasya` [[6.3.38]] ityādinā ṭhañi puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, tasay <> [[6.3.37]] iti ṭiṭhnnapyabhāvānnātra ṭhañṭiṭhanoḥ kaścidviśeṣo'sti| `māṃsaudana` ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati|`kecit` iti vacanādvigṛhītagrahaṇaṃ kecinnecchanatītyetaduktaṃ bhavati| tanmate ṭhañeva vaktavyaḥ| ṭiṭhatvacanaṃ vaicitryārtha veditavyam||atha <> [[4.4.69]] iti vartamāne punarniyuktagrahaṇaṃ kasmāt kriyate? arthabhedāt| na tasya hrakavyabhicāralakṣaṇo nityabhāvo'rthaḥ| asya tu tato'nya evārtho yadāha - `niyuto'dhikṛtaḥ` ityādi||adhyetuṃ śīlamasyetyadhyāyī, tācchīliko ṇiniḥ| `adhyayanasya yau deśakālau śāstreṇa pratiṣiddhau tāvadeśakālaśabdenocyete` iti| apratiṣiddhābhyāṃ deśakālaśabdābhyāmanyatvāt paryudāsavṛttyā'bhakṣyāsparśanīyavadadhyayanasyeti| ata āha - tasyādhyāyinā pratyayārthena sannidhāpitatvāt| na hi vinādhyayanenādhyāyyupapadyate||alpāctarasya prastāraśabdasya ca pūrvanipātamakurvannetat sūcayati - anyadapi kāryaṃ lakṣaṇaprāptaṃ na bhavati| tena kaṭhināntaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti kaṭhinaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhrate| `{haratirayam - prāṃu| pāṭhaḥ} vyavaharatirayamasti paṇinā samānārthaḥ - yasya `vyavahmapaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ` [[2.3.57]] ityatra grahaṇam, asti vivāde - vyavahāre parihmatamiti, asti ca vikṣepe śalākāṃ vyavaharatīti, asti ca laukike kriyātatve - laukiko vyavahāra iti| iha tu kriyātattve vartamānasya grahaṇamityetaddarśayitumāha -`vyavahāraḥ kriyātattvam` iti| kriyāyā aviparītasvabhāvatvādi kriyātattvam| `yathā` ityādi| laukiko vyavahāra ityatra yathā vyavahāraḥ kriyātattve vartate, tathehāpi darśayati| kriyātattve vartamānasya grahaṇam| `tatra` [[4.4.69]] itisaptamyadhikāre saptamīnirdeśāt prasiddhyupasaṃgrahaṇaṃ labhyate| `vāṃśakaṭhinikaśchakracaraḥra` iti| yaścakracaraḥ sannanuṣṭheyāṃ kriyāṃ śāstroktamavigītā vaṃśakaṭhine'nutiṣṭhati sa evamucyate||nikaṭe samīpa ityarthaḥ| yatra śāstrato nikaṭavāsastatrāyāyaṃ vidhiḥ| etacca saptamyāṃ samarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ punaḥ saptamīnirdeśāt prasiddhyupasaṃgrahaṇena labhyate| sa hrevamarthaḥ kṛtaḥ - iṣṭe saptamyante yathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| sa punaḥ śāstrato nikaṭavāsa āraṇyakasya bhikṣoriti darśayati - `āraṇyakena bhikṣuṇā` ityādi||taditi dvitīyāmarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ rathādīnāṃ dvitīyānirdeśa iṣṭādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| tenehava bhavati - gauryugya iti; iha na bhavati - yugaṃ vahati rājā kaliṃ dvāparaṃ veti| tathā prāsajyata iti prāsaṅgaḥ, yat kāṣṭhaṃ vahanakāle vatsānāṃ kaṇṭhāasajyate tatprāsaṅgaḥ, taṃ vahati prāsaṅgyaḥ| iha na bhavati - prasaṅgādāgataṃ prāsaṅgam| `yugyañca pattre` [[3.1.121]] iti nipātanādyugyaśabde siddhe yugagrahaṇaṃ svarārtham| na yugyamayugyamityatra naño guṇapratiṣedhe <> [[6.2.155]] ityato naña ityanuvartamāne <> [[6.2.156]] iti naña uttarasyāntodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| tena na hrekasvaro labhyate| tasya kyabantatvāt||atha `dhuro ṭhak ca` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, cakāraḥ samuccayārthaḥ, yathābhihite pratyaye vijñāyamāne yadeva bhaviṣyati? naitadevam; yo hi dhuraṃ vahati dhuso'sau voḍhā bhavati|tasya yathāvihite pratyaye vijñāyamāne <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇapi syāt| yadgarhaṇāt tasyedaṃvivakṣāyāmapi yadeva bhavati||`sarvadhuram` iti| sarvā cāsau dhūśceti `pūrvakālaika` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ` [[5.4.74]] ityādinā samāsāntaḥ|`strīliṅge nyāyye` iti| tatpuruṣasyottarapadārthapradhānatvāt `paravalihghaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ` [[2.4.26]] iti dhūḥśabdasya yalliṅgaṃ tadeva nyāyyamiti| tatra `sarvadhurāyāḥ` iti sūtre kartavye yataḥ sarvadhurāditi napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ sa śabdarūpāpekṣaḥ, arthāpekṣe hi nirdeśe paravalliṅgatā bhavati| ayantu śabdarūpāpekṣaḥ,śabdarūpañca napuṃsakamiti napuṃsakenaiva nirdeśo yuktaḥ| arthavivakṣāyāṃ tu strīliṅgameva bhavati - sarvadhurāṃ vahatīti||`ekadhurāt` ityayamapi śabdarūpāpekṣayā nirdeśaḥ| arthāpekṣayā hi paravalliṅgatā bhavati| atrāpi pūrvavat samāsasamāsāntau veditavyau| vacanasāmarthyātpakṣe lugvidhīyate| yadi hi nityo luk syāt, khasya vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, yata eva hi lukaṃ vidadhyāt|nanu caikadhuraśabdāt kenacidvihito na syāt, tasya kathaṃ luk śakyate vijñātum? lugvacanādeva yato'pi vidhiranugamyata ityadoṣaḥ||rathaśakaṭahalasīrebhyaḥ pratyayavidhānamanarthakam, <> [[4.3.120]] ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| śabdabhedādvidhānamiti cedanyo hi śabdo rathaṃ vahatīti, anyo hi rathasya voḍheti| tadā'rthāśrayatvāt pratyayavidhānasyārthasāmānyāt siddham| na hi kaścidravyamityukte rathasyāyamityevāvaiti, vahatyarthaḥ pratīyate| tasmāt syādeva rathādyat||bāla-manoramāśakaṭādaṇa 1612, 4.4.80 śakaṭādaṇ| dvitīyāntācchakaṭaśabdādvahatītyarthe aṇ syādityarthaḥ| yato'pavādaḥ| bāla-manoramāagārāntāṭṭhan 1601, 4.4.80 agārāntāṭṭhan| tatra niyukta ityeva| nittvānnādivṛddhiḥ| tadāha -devagārika iti|śakaṭādaṇevotsargaḥ kartavyaḥ| evañca vākyaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ; yatā - rathasya voñā rathya iti| na tat vidhīyate; tatra pratyayavidhāne <> [[4.1.88]] ityanena luk prāpnoti| anena punarna prāpnoti, kasmāt? `prāgādīvyato'ṇ` [[4.1.83]] #ityadhikārāt| nanu ca kriyāmāṇe'pīha dvigoraṇ pratyayo na prāpnoti, `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti` (vyā|pa|89) iti? na; etadeva hi <<śakaṭādaṇ>> [[4.4.80]] ityavamādikaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhavati tadantavidheriti| tena dvaihalikaḥ, dvaiśakaṭaḥ , dvaisīrika ityevamādikaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati||astyatra yarbha iti `{in ityeva sūtram - da|u|} in sarvadhātubhyaḥ` (da|u|1|46) janayatīti vā| `atra kṛdikārādaktinaḥ` (ga|sū|50) `sarvato'ktinnarthāt` (ga|sū|51) iti ṅīp - janī, tāṃ vahanti janyāḥ = jāmāturvayasyāḥ| vivāhamānitābhidhīyate| kecittu kartari jāyate'syāṃ garbha iti <> [[3.3.113]] iti lyuṭi jananaśabdācca ṅīpi nakārākārayorlopena sādhayanti| nanu ca janīśabdādeva yadvidheyaḥ? sarvakālārthaṃ nipātanamityeke||`padyāḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.53]] itipādaśabdasya padbhāvaḥ| `ūravyāḥ` iti| <> [[6.1.79]] ityavādeśaḥ|`nanu ca` ityādi| dhanuratra prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthena vāhraṃ karaṇamapekṣyate, tena sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavatītyasāmarthyam? nanu caṭa vyadhanamevātra sāpekṣam, kriyayā karaṇaṃ sambadhyata iti kṛtvā, tacca vyadhanaṃ kriyāpradhānatvādākhyātasya pradhānaṃ bavati, pradhānas sāpekṣasya bhavatyeva vṛttiḥ, yathā - rājupuraṣo'yamabhirūpa iti? naitadasti; yadyapi kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, tathāpīha pratyayārthaṃ eva pradhānam| pratyayārthasya sādhanaṃ vyaddhā| tathā ca prāguktam - `kriyāpradhānatve'pi cākhyātasya taddhiteḥ svabhāvāt sādhanapradhānaḥ` iti| atha kriyādvāreṇa vyaddhurapi karaṇaṃ pratyapekṣā bhavatīti kalpyate, tathā ca sati prakṛtyarthasyāpi kriyādvāreṇaiva karaṇaṃ pratyapekṣā bhavatīti kena vāryate ! na hi pādau vidhyati dhanuṣeti karaṇavivakṣāyāṃ vyadhanamātrasya pādau karma dhanuṣkaraṇaviśiṣṭasya| tasmādvyadhanasyāpi kriyākaraṇe pratyapekṣetyasāmrathyātpratyayo na bhaviṣyati| `anabhidhānācca` iti| atraivocapapattyanataram| kathaṃ punarupapattyantaramityāha - `na hi` ityādi| dhanuṣā padya ityukte dhanuṣa padyaṃ pratyupalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambhāvyate, yathā -śikhayā parivrājakamadrākṣīdittra śikhayā parivrājakaṃ prati| dhanuṣā saha dṛṣṭaḥ padya ityeṣo'pyarthaścāśaṅkyate| na tu pādau vidhyati dhanuṣetyayamartho vivakṣitaḥ pratīyate| `evaṃ tarhi ` ityādinā kriyāviśeṣaṇaparo dhanuṣeti nirdeśaḥ; na dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ| pratiṣedhe pradhānamiti darśayati -`tena` ityādinā| kriyata eva dhanuṣaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, tena kriyā viśeṣyate| tena cauraṃ vidhyatītyādau na bhaviṣyati| sambhāvyate hi caurādivyadhanakriyayā dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvam||kathaṃ punaratra dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiḥ, yāvatā `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti ṣaṣṭhaā bhavitavyam? ityāha - `labdheti tṛnnantam` ityādi| tṛnnantasya hi prayoge `na lokāvyayaniṣṣākhalarthatṛnām` [[2.3.69]] iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhena dvitīyā bhavati||vaśaḥ = kāmaḥ, icchā| vaserdhātorata eva nipātanādapratyayaḥ| dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau prakṛtāyāṃ vaśamiti dvitīyānirdeśa iṣṭe viṣaye dvitīyāntādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| tenehaiva bhavati - vaśaṃ gataḥ, icchāprāptaḥ, vidheya ityatraiva bhavati||karmaṇaḥ kṛtaivābhihitatvāddvitīyā na sambhavati| na ca dvitīyāprathamābhyāmanyatra vibhaktau padamiti rūpamupapadyate| tasmāt prathamāntamevaitaditi niścityāha - `nirdeśādeva` ityādi||āvarhaṇamāvarhaḥ, utpādanamityarthaḥ| vṛherāṅapūrvādbhāve ghañ, āvarho'syāstītyāvarhīti| dvitīyāvibhaktiriha nāsti| na ca prathamādvitīyābhyāmanyasyāṃ vibhaktau mūlamityetadrūpamupapadyate| tasmāt prathamāntamevaitat| nirdeśādeva prathamā samarthavibhaktirupapadyate iti matvāha - `mūlaśabdāt prathamāsamarthāt` iti||`yaśca pratyayaḥ` iti| kimarthaṃ punaryapratyayo nipātyate? ityāha - `antodātto hrayamapīṣyate` iti| yati sati titsvareṇāntasvaritatvāt| antodāttaśceṣyate| tasmādyapratyaya eva nyāyyaḥ| na kevalaṃ saṃjñāviṣaya eveṣyate; api tvantodātto'pītyeṣo'piśabdasyārthaḥ||`saṃyukte` iti| sambaddha ityarthaḥ|`anyasyāpi` ityādi| yathaiva hi gṛhapatiryajanamāno gārhapatye kāryaṃ karoti, tathā dakṣiṇāgnāvāhavanīye ca| tasmādanyasyāpi dakṣiṇādergṛhapatinā saṃyogo'sti| yadyevam, atiprasaṅgo'nyatra prāpnoti? ityāha - `tatr saṃjñādhikārāt` ityādi| abhidheyaniyamārthaṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇamanuvartate, teneha na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ||pratyayārthasāmarthyalabhyā` iti| `nirmite` iti pratyayārthaḥ| tatra cchandasaḥ karaṇatvamiti sāmarthyāt tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| chandaḥśabdo'yaṃ vede triṣṭuvādau, icchāyāśca vartate; iha tvicchāyāṃ vartamāno gṛhrate, ata evāha - `icchāyā kṛtaḥ` iti| icchāvṛttistu saṃjñāgrahaṇasyābhidheyaniyamārthasyānuvṛtterlabhyate||`saṃjñādhikārādabhidheyaniyamaḥ` iti| tenorasā nirmitaṃ sukhamityādau na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||`hmadyaḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.50]] ityādinā hmadbhāvaḥ||ṛṣiśabdo'yamastyeva guṇavati puruṣaviśeṣe, asti ca vede;iha saṃjñādhikārādeva na manuṣyagrahaṇamiti darśayati - `ṛṣirvedo gṛhrate (iti)||`{pratyayārthasāmarthyāllabdhā -mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|} pratyayārthasāmarthyālabhyā` iti| karaṇādayaḥ pratyayārthāḥ| tatra karaṇādayaḥ śabdā bhāve karaṇe ca vyutpādyanta iti sāmarthyādevopalabhyamānā ṣaṣṭhīvibhaktirvijñāyate| yadyapi karṣaśabdaḥ parimāṇavacano'pyasti, tathāpi karaṇādīnāṃ sāhacaryāt kriyāśabda eva gṛhrate| karaṇaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ| yadā tu karaṇasādhanaḥ, tadā kriyate'neneti karaṇam, `rathasītāhalebhyo yadvidhau` (vā|473) iti tadantavidhiratreṣyate| tasyodāharaṇam - `dvihalyaḥ` iti darśayati| `bhāvasādhanañca` iti| atrāpi pūrvavadvibhāgo veditavyaḥ||`sāmanyaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.168]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| sādhuriha nipuṇaḥ, yogya iti bhāvaḥ||janaṃ janaṃ prati pratijanam, `yathārthe'vyayam` [[2.1.6]] ityavyayībhāvaḥ| `parasyakulam, amuṣyakulam` iti| nipātanādaluk| <<ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe>> [[6.3.21]] iti vā yadā parakulatvenākruśyate|`yatra` ityādi| `pratijana` , `sarvajana` ityevamādiṣu keṣuciddhitārtha eva pratīyate, na tu pravīṇo yogyaśabdasyārthaḥ| tena tatra vacanasāmarthyāt pare'pi prākkrītīyāḥ pratyayā bādhyante| anyathā hi vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt||`svare viśeṣaḥ` iti| yati sati <<yato'nāvaḥ>> [[6.1.213]] ityādyudāttaṃ syāt, ye tu sati pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaṃ syāt||vasatīti vāsī| nipātanādeva ṇiniḥ, grahādilakṣaṇo vā| atha vā - vasanaṃ vāsaḥ, so'syāstīti vāsī, matvarthīya iti| atha `tatra` [[4.4.98]] iti vartamāne punaḥ `samānatīrtheṭa iti saptamyupādānaṃ kimartham? prakṛtitveneṣṭhāt saptamyantādyathā syāt; aniṣṭānmā bhūt| etena guruvacano yastīrthaśabdastadantāt saptamīsamarthāt pratyayo bhavati, na tu yaḥ prayogādivacanastadantāt| amumevārthaṃ cetasi kṛtvā''ha - `tīrthaśabdena gururucyate` iti||`okāraścodāttaḥ` iti| yataḥ svare prāpta okārasyodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| `śayitaḥ sthita ityarthaḥ`(iti)| anekārthatvāt tasya sthitāvapi vṛtteḥ; tathā hi - jalāśaya iti| samānodaryaḥ` iti| samānañca tadudarañceti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ pratyayaḥ||ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt sodarśaśabdādapi pūrveṇa yatyeva prāpte yo vidhīyate| <> [[6.3.88]] iti viṣayasaptamīti matvā''ha - `yakārādau pratyaye` ityādi| `o codātta iti nānuvartate` iti| pratyaya vidhānasāmarthyādya udāttaḥ||`aṇādīnāṃ ghādīnāñcāpavādaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.53]] iti prāptānām| yadyevam, yatā bādhitatvācchandasi teṣāmabhāvaḥ syāt, tataśca muñjāvatyaṃ mauñjāvataṃ vetyevamādi na sidhyati? ityāha - `sati darśane` ityādi| kathaṃ punarevaṃ labhyate? ityāha - `sarvavidhīnām` ityādi| sarvavidhivyabhicārastu <> [[7.4.78]] iti bahulagrahaṇāllabhyate| muñjāvān nāma parvataḥ, tatra bhavo'sau mauñjāvataḥ||ḍaḍaḍayoḥ svare viśeṣaḥ| ḍati hi sati <> [[6.1.185]] ityantasvaritaḥ syāt, ḍae tu pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati||samāno garbhaḥ, samāno yūtha iti karmadhārayaḥ| `ṇu stutau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1035) , bhāvektaḥ, samānaṃ nutamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| samānañca tannutañceti karmadhārayo vā| `svare viśeṣaḥ` iti| yati sati <> [[6.1.185]] ityantasvaritatvaṃ syāt, yanisati nitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| `sarvatra samānasya cchandasi` iti| <> [[6.3.84]] ityasyopalakṣaṇapara ekadeśa upāttaḥ||`sāmānyena yadvihitaḥ` iti| `bhave cchandasi` [[4.4.109]] ityanena| atha yadgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na yathāvihitamevocyeta? naivaṃ śakyam; `agraścāḍḍimac` (vā| 448) ityevāmagraśabdāḍḍimajapyuktaḥ, tatra yathā vihite pratyaya ucyamāne ḍimacapi syāt| tasmādyadgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||`svare viśeṣaḥ` iti| ghe vihite'ntodāttatvaṃ syāt, ghani tu satyādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati||nanu ca `ajādyantam` [[2.2.33]] `alpāctaram` [[2.2.34]] ityabhraśabdasya pūrvanipātena bhavitavyam, tatkathamapūrvanipātaḥ? ityāha - `amraśabdasya` ityādi||bhāve <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇi prāpte <> [[5.1.124]] iti ṣyañi yato vidhām| yeṣāṃ <> [[5.1.126]] ityatra `dūtavaṇigbhyāñca` (vā|540) ityupasaṃkhyāyate, teṣāṃ karmaṇi ye prāpte||`nirdeśādeva samarthavibhaktiḥ` (iti)| sā punaḥ ṣaṣṭhī `karttukarmaṇoḥ kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti karmaṇi draṣṭavyā| yogyatāmātre vivakṣite hanyate'nayeti hananī, karaṇe lyuṭ, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| nanu ca rakṣīyātuśabdayordvitvāddvivacanena bhavitavyam, tatkathamidamuktam? vacanasāmarthyāt sambhāvanameva stutiriti darśayitumāha - `bahuvacanam` ityādi| yogaścāyaṃ <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇi prāpte veditavyaḥ||`ṣaṣṭhīsamamarthebhyaḥ` iti| sāmarthyāddhi ṣaṣṭhayeva samarthavibhaktirvijñāyate| yathā hi - `{śaṃsa - prāṃu|pāṭha}śaṃsu stutau` (dhā|yā|728) ityato'smādeva nipātanādbhāve kyappratyayaḥ; <> [[3.3.113]] iti bahulavacanāt| tatrāvaśyaṃ kṛdyogalakṣaṇayā ṣaṣṭhaā bhavitavyam| ayamapi yogaḥ pūrvavadaṇi prāpte veditavyaḥ||`ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāt` iti| `asurasya` iti nirdeśādeva ṣaṣṭhī samarthavibhaktarlabhyate| `svam` iti| ātmīyamityarthaḥ| `aṇo'pavādaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] iti prāptasya||māyāyāṃ neti vaktavye'ṇgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham||sa vivakṣito'vayavo'sminniti tadvān| kaḥ punarasau? samudāyaḥ| ata evāha - `tadvānityavayavena samudāyo nirdiśyate` iti| etenaikadeśādidaṃ pratyayavidhānamityuktaṃ bhavati| ` varcaḥśabdo'smin mantre'sti` ityādinā tatsamudāyaṃ pradarśayati| `cayanavacanaḥ` iti| cinotereva karaṇe lup| `tejasyā`iti| tejaḥśabdo'sya mantsyāstīti tejasvānupadhānamantraḥ| śeṣaṃ vigrahavākyādi pūrvavat| mantrādeva, samudāyānmā bhat| yadyapi samudāyaḥ prātipadikamaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi vacanasāmarthyāpi syāt| kiṃ tarhi vacanānna labhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ|`itikaraṇo niyamārthaḥ` iti| asatīhetikaraṇe mantre bahūnāṃ sambhave sarveṇa padena tadvān mantro gṛhrate| asmastu sati tena niyamārthena yenaiva padena tadvatā mantreṇeṣṭakopalakṣyate,tenaiva sarvo mantro gṛhrata ityetadupapannaṃ bhavati|atha matubgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā matubantādayaṃ vidhīyate, tatra pratyayasya lug vijñāyamāno vidhānasāmarthyācca matupa eva bhaviṣyatītyapārthakaṃ matubgrahaṇaṃ? naivam;
