uttaratra `aiāmānaṇ` [[4.4.125]] ityatarhrupavānamātrāvayave dvau matvarthīyau - inimatupau, tatrāsati matubgrahaṇe luk syāt; asmin sati matupa eva bhavati||`āiānīḥ` iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp||`mūrdhanvatīḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp| vayasyāstā mūrdhanvatyaśceti vayasvāmanupadhāno mantraḥ, tāsāmiti vayasyāḥ| mūrdhanvānupadhāno mantraḥ, tāsāmiti mūrdhandatyaḥ|`yatri` ityādi| na hrevaṃvidho yāsāmupadhāno mantrastato vayasyātviti vacanāt| atra mūrdhaśabda evāsti, na vayaḥ śabdaḥ, tato na bhavati -mūrdhanvatya iti|`vaktavye` iti| tadvānityadhikārānmatubantānmardhaśabdātpratyayena bhavitavyam| ataḥ `mūrdhanvataḥra` iti yuktaṃ vaktum, tanmatupo bhāvinaṃ lukaṃ cetasi kṛtvā| evaṃlaghu sūtraṃ bhavati||matvarthe māsatanvoriti pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam| matvarthagrahaṇādeva prathamā samarthavibhaktirastyupādhikā labhyate? ityāha - `prathamasamarthādastyupādhikāt` iti|`{anantarārtheva vā - kāśikā} anantarārthe ca` iti| na kevalaṃ matvartha eva tyayo vaktavyaḥ|`nanu ca tapa) prabhṛtīnāṃ pratyayārthamāsādivacanānāmabhidheyaliṅgavacanāni bhavantīti puṃlliṅgatā prāpvoti, tasyāñca satyāṃ <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrgheṇa bhavitavyam; tatkathaṃ tapaśca sahaśca nabhaśceti prayogaḥ? ityata āha -`napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ chāndasatvāt` iti| ayaṃ hi cchāndasaḥ prayogaḥ| tatreti puṃlliṅge'bhidheye napuṃsakaliṅgamupapadyate| <> [[3.1.85]] iti liṅgavyatyayasya cchandasi vidhānāt| iḍasminmāse'stīti `iṣaḥ`| ūrghasmin māse'stīti `ūrjaḥra`| śugasmin māse'stīti `śūciḥ` śug vāsmin māse'stīti `śukraḥ`| <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam| arthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `matau chaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ` (52|59) ityatra yathā `matau` ityucyamāno matvarthe pratyaya ucyate, tathehāpi labhyate, tasmāt `matau` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam? satyametat; vispaṣṭārthamarthagrahaṇam||asantatvāt <> [[5.2.121]] iti vinipratyaye prāpte matupo'pavādaiḥ saha samāveśāt matupi yatkhau vidhīyete| atha yadgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, nanu `ojaso'hani kha ca` ityevocyeta, cakāreṇa yathāvihite pratyaye vijñāyamāne yaditi ca bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam; cakāreṇa hi sandehaḥ syāt - kimanenānantarasūtravihito ño'nukṛṣyate? atha prakṛto yaditi? tasmādasandehārthaṃ yadgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||litkaraṇaṃ svarārtham||`yogavibhāgaḥ` ityādi| yadi pūrvasūtra eva khagrahaṇaṃ kriyate; dve prakṛtī pratyayāvapi dvāveveti sāmarthyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt tannirāsārtho yogavibhāgaḥ|nanu <> [[1.3.10]] ityatra iha kasmānna bhavati - `veśoyaśañāderbhagādyal kha ca` iti darśayitavā svaritena liṅgena yathāsaṃkhyamityuktam? tadekayogatāmabhyupetya| bhavatu nāmaikayogaḥ, tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavatīti darśanārtham, tata kuto yathāsaṃkhya nirāsārtho yogavibhāga? ata āha - `uttarārthaśca` iti||`pūrvaḥ kṛta minayau ca` iti| kha eva yathā syāt, yanmā bhūt| `pūrvairiti bahuvacanāntena ` ityādi| `pathibhiḥ pūrvaiḥra` ityevamādibhirvedavākyaiḥ pūrvapuruṣakṛtatvenayadā praśaṃsāṃ pratipādayituṃ niṣṭhā sādhveva śakyate vijñātum, tadā pūrvapuruṣābhidhāyinaḥ pūrvaśabdāt pratyaya upapadyate| tasmāt pūrvairiti bahuvacanāntena pūrvapuruṣā abhidhīyante| chandasāmarthaparatvādbahuvacanasya|tena pūrvapuruṣāṇāṃ panthā āsthitaḥ sampadyata iti darśayitumāhaśabde kāryāsambhavāt matupśabdena matvartho lakṣyata ityāha - `matvarthe` ityādi| matvarthe ca pra prathamāsamarthādastyupādhikāt pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha - `saharuāmasya vidyate` iti||`tadarhati` [[5.1.62]] ityarhārthe ṭhaki prāpte yo vidhīyate| `svare viśeṣaḥ` iti| yatyādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| yapratyaye tu satyantodāttatvaṃ bhavati||`{nāstīyaṃ paṃktiḥ - kāśikā, padamañjarī ca}rūpyamayaṭo'pavādo yogaḥ` iti| `maya iti mayaḍartho lakṣyate` iti| śabde kāryāsambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| `tatra yathāyogaṃ samarthavibhaktiḥra` iti| tatrāgatārtha pañcamī, vikārāvayavayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī| prakṛtavacane prathameti yathāyogārthaḥ||mayaḍartha āgate prakṛtavacane yathāyogaṃ rūpyamayaṭoḥ prāptayoryadvidhīyate| tatra mayaṭo hi <> [[4.3.150]] iti prāptasya <> [[4.3.151]] iti pratiṣedha ucyate||vidhiḥ, adhikāraḥ, paribhāṣā veti trayamatra sambhāvyate| yathā caitat? tritayamapi nirdoṣam, tathā <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] ityatra darśatam| yadyevam, kāśikākāreṇa kasmānna sūcitam? ekadeśānusmaraṇena sarvasya sūcitatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| atha prāgiti ko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, yāvatā prapūrvasyāñcateḥ kvini nalopādike vihite `ugidacām? [[7.1.70]] ti numi, saṃyogāntalope ca, <> [[8.2.62]] iti nakārasya ṅakāre prāṅiti bhavitavyam? athedṛśī vyutpattirāśrīyeta, yāvatā `añcateścopasaṃkhyānam? (vā|336) iti kṛte ṅīpi prācyāṃ diśi vasatīti `dikśabdebhyaḥ saptamī` [[5.3.27]] ityādinā astātiḥ, tasya <> [[5.3.30]] iti luk, `luktaddhitaluki` [[1.2.49]] iti ṅīpo'pi `tasilādistaddhita edhācparyantaḥ` ityavyayatve `avyayāt` [[2.4.82]] iti sorluki <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt? sarvanāmasthānābhāve numo'pyabhāvaḥ, tataḥ kutve sati prāgiti sampadyate? yastu manyate - `ādye'pi pakṣe kriyāviśeṣaṇatvānnapuṃsakatvam, kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ yathā napuṃsakatvam, karmabhāvaśca; tathā `karaṇe ca stokālpakṛtchra` [[2.3.33]] ityatra pratipāditam, tatra karmaṇi dvitīyāyāḥ `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] iti luki kṛte pūrvavannumabhāvaḥ` iti, tanmate dvitīyaikavacanāntaṃ padaṃ sañjāyate| tadevamitarasmin? pakṣe `ṣaṣṭhatasarthapratyayena` [[2.3.30]] iti ṣaṣṭhaā bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ `krātāt` iti pañcamīnirdeśaḥ? nai tadasti; yāvatā `anyārāditarartedikśabdaḥ` [[2.3.29]] ityatredamuktamdikśabdatvādeva siddhe'ñcūttarapadagrahaṇaṃ `ṣaṣṭhatasartha` ityanena prāptāṃ ṣaṣṭhīmapi bādhitvā pañcamyeva yathā syāditi kutaḥ ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgaḥ| ato vyavasthitamidam - prak? krītāditi|atha prāgvacanaṃ kim, na `krītācchaḥ` ityevocyeta? naitadasti; evaṃ hru cyamāne krītaśabda eva prakṛtitvena jñāyeta, tataśca krītaśabdādeva pratyayaḥ syāt| tasmāt krītādityavadhidyotanārthaṃ prāgiti vaktavyam| tahrrayamarthaḥ `prāgghitāt` [[4.4.75]] ityataḥ prakṛtena prāggrahaṇena hi sambadhyate| evaṃ tatraitat? syāt - taddhi `bhave cchandasi` [[4.4.109]] iti, tena cchando'dhikārasaya nivṛtteḥ| tarhi hi `prāgdīvyataḥ` [[4.1.83]] ityataḥ prakṛtatvāt? tenāpi ca vahaterityevamādikaṃ sambadhyeta, yathā - `strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt` [[4.1.87]] iti? naitadasti; evaṃ hi <> [[4.2.30]] ityādau yatra pañcamī śrūyate tatra sarvatra prāgvacanena sambandhe na jñāyate - ko vidhiḥ, kā ca prakṛtiriti syāt| yeṣāmavadhitvamiṣyate, teṣāmeva prākśabdamadhītavāniti| iha tu prakṛtena prāgvacanena sambadhyate| tananu ca viparyayaḥ kasamānna bhavati - bhavanāditi prakṛtiḥ strīpuṃsābhyāmityavadhinirdeśa iti? naitadasti; avaderakatvādekavacanena nirdeso nyāyyaḥ prakṛtinirdeśe tu dve eva prakṛtī parasparāpekṣe iti dvivacanamupapadyate| nanu ca viśadamidamuditamapyarthajñānam| svarita liṅgādadhikārāṇāmāsaṅga ityetadbhavatā vismṛtam, tadevam? `somāṭṭaṇ` [[4.2.30]] ityādau kaḥ prāgvacanasambandhaprasaṅga iti nārthaḥ prāggrahaṇena? satyametat; kintu svaritatvāsvaritatvakhyāpanaparamparayā mandadhiyo mohamāsādayantīti tatpratipattyarthaṃ prāggrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `avatsīyaḥ` iti| vikalpanāt? trayamatra sambhavati - anutpanne pratyaye nañāsya sambandha iti, utpanne vā saṃsargaḥ, utpattikāla eveti| tatrādye pakṣe vatsadanyasmai hitamitauṣṭābhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti| na cāpi caturthī; hitārthasya pratiṣidhyamānatvat| tṛtīye tu pakṣe yatā doṣo na bhavati tathā pratividhīyate| tatra vatsahitaśabdayoḥ padāntaranirapekṣayoḥ kriyāpadena bhavatinānugammānatvāt, na ca brāāhṛsambandho'ntaraṅgasambandhaṃ nivartayituṃ śaknoti| ata eva na devadattāya gāṃ dadātīti sampradāne caturthī bhavati; karmaṇābhiprāpterantaraṅgatvāditi| tathānena ca krameṇa yatrāpi prāptirna vidyate, kevalaṃ tvicchāmātrameva, atrāpi karmasaṃjñā pravartate, tadyathā-grāmaṃ gantumicchāmi na kaścit? sahāyo'stīti| yadapyucyate-asāmarthyāttaddhitena na bhavitavyamiti, tadetadapyasāram; yadayam, <> [[6.2.155]] iti tadantānyuttarapadāni naño guṇapratiṣedhe vartamānāni parāṇyantodāttāni bhavantīti taddhitagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| atha kimarthamiyānavadhirupādīyate, na hi tatra tāvadasya vyāpāro'sti; pratyayāntarairbādhitatvāt| laghutvāt? `prākṭhañaśchaḥ` iti vaktavyam? ityata āha-`artho'vadhitvena` ityādi| kaḥ punararthamavadhitvenāṅgīkurvato guṇa iti cet? ayamabhiprāyaḥ-`prākṭhañaśchaḥ` ityucyamāne prāk? ṭhaño yāḥ prakṛtayastābhyaścho bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt| tataścādhikārasya pratiyogopasthānādapavādaviṣaye chapratyayaḥ prasajyeta| arthe tvavadhitvenopādīyamāne prāk? krītādye'rthāsteṣu ccho bhavatītyayamarthaḥ sampadyate, tato'tiprasaṅgo na bhavati| tena samāne'rthe prakṛtiviśeṣādutpadyamāno'pavādaśchaṃ bādhate| nanu ca `prāk? ṭhañaḥ` ityucyamāne'pavādaviṣaye'pi ccho na bhaviṣyatyeva; jñāpakāt, yadayaṃ <> [[5.1.4]] iti vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ śāsti; itarathā hradhikārāccho'pi labhdha eveti vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? satyametat; kintu jñāpakadvāreṇārthapratipattau satyāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| tasmāt? sukhapratipattyarthamartho'vadhitvenoktaḥ| anye punarāhuḥ - gṛhīta iti `āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacya` [[3.3.132]] ityanena bhaviṣyati niṣṭhāpratyaya iti| tenāyamarthaḥ sampadyate-vatsīyādirūpasiddhyarthamarthamavadhiṃ grahīṣyāmīti| ataḥ śālāturīyeṇa `prāk? ṭhañaśchaḥ` iti noktam; anyathā hi pratyayāvadhitve pratipadoktā antaraṅgā ityupāttābhyaḥ prakṛtibhya eva pratyayaḥ syādityāśaṃkyeta| anye punaranyathā varṇayanti-`parikhayā ḍhañ` [[5.1.17]] ityatra `chayatoḥ pūrṇo'vadhiḥ` ityabhidhāsyati; tataśca tena krītamiti vakṣyatītyucyate, tataścedaṃ viruddhamityāha-`artho'vadhitvena` ityādi| gatārtham| naiyāyika ityāha-`kvacidatho'vadhitvena gṛhrate, yatā-`ārhāt` [[5.1.19]] `bhavanāt` [[4.1.87]] | iti, kvacit? pratyayaḥ prāgvahateḥ - <<ā ca tvāt>> [[5.1.120]] iti, kvacit? prakṛtiḥ - `ākaḍārāt` [[1.4.1]] `prākkaḍārāt` [[2.1.3]] iti, kvacidekadeśaḥ - <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] iti, kvacinniravadhiḥ pratyayaḥ - `ṅyāpprātipadikāt` [[4.1.1]] iti; tenāyamātmano vaicitryamācāryo darśayatītyavasīyate` iti| atha krītaśabdādeva pūrveṇa cchapratyayo bhavatītyevaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate, yathā-`vibhāṣā supo bahuc? purastāttu` [[5.3.68]] iti? anabhidhānāt| na hi krītaśabdāt? purastādutpadyamānena pratyayena kasyacidarthasyābhidhānamasti| na cāpi <> [[5.1.37]] iti nirdeśa upapadyate| tatraivamapi prāk? krītaśabdādeva pratyayo bhavatītyeva kasmānna vikalpyate? anabhidhānādeva| na hi tata utpannena pratyayena vivakṣito'rtho'vagamyate| arthāntaraṃ bhavādikam, tatra ca vṛddhalakṣaṇaścha eva siddha ityanarthakamidaṃ syāt| tasmāt? prāguditameva prayojanaṃ nyāyyam||ugiti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ vā syāt? uvarṇagrahaṇaṃ vā? tatrādye pakṣe'yaṃ vākyārtho jāyate-ugantebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyo'vādibhyo'vakārādibhyo'vasuprabhṛtibhya iti| vakārādīn? varjayitvetyarthaḥ| nanu caivaṃ sati pañcamyā nirdeśaḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `supāṃ suluk` [[7.1.39]] iti lukā nirdaṣṭatvāt| evaṃ tarhi prātipadikeṣu gavādipāṭhasāmarthyāt? pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; anyathā hi gavādīnāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| etat? sarvaṃ manasi kṛtvā''ha-`uvarṇāntāt` iti| sarvatragrahaṇe tadantavidherabhyupagamādityabhiprāyaḥ| `śaṅkavyam` iti| <> [[6.4.146]] <> [[6.1.79]] ityavādeśaḥ| `sanaṅaguḥ` ityādi| carmavikāralakṣaṇasyāño'va kāśāḥ - vādhrram, vāratram, uvarṇāntalakṣaṇasya yato'vakāśaḥ - śaṅkavyam? picavyamiti; sanaṅagurnāma carmavikāraḥ, tatrobhayaprāptau paratvāt? <<carmaṇo'ñ>> [[5.1.15]] ityañ? prāpnoti `tathā` ityādi| `annavikārebhyaśca` iti| apūpādilakṣaṇāsya pkṣīkasya yato'vakāśaḥ - apūpyāstaṇḍulāḥ, apūpīyā iti, uvarṇāntalakṣaṇasya sa eva; carurnāma havirviśeṣaḥ; saktuścānnavikāraḥ, tata ubhayaprasaṅge paratvāt? <> [[5.1.4]] iti havirlakṣaṇo'nnavikāralakṣaṇaśca vidhiḥ prāpnoti| tadevaṃ sanaṅguśabdādañ? prāptaḥ, carusaktuśabdābhyāṃ vikalpena yat, nityaśceṣyate, tadarthaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedho bhāṣitavya iti| <> [[6.4.146]] , <> [[6.1.79]] ityavādeśaḥ| `sanaṅgavyam` ityādi| etacceṣṭavācitvāt? paraśabdasya labhyata ityavagantavyam| `gavādiṣu nābi nabhañceti paṭhate` iti| atra kasyacidiyamāśaṅkā syāt - bhasaṃjñāpratiṣedo vidhiyata ti, tataśca yasyeti lopena bhavitavyamityata āha - `nābhiśabdo yatpratyayam` iti| śarīrāvayavo yo nābhiśabdastatra kathaṃ bhavitavyamityāha - `yastu` ityādi| tataḥ śarīrāvayavādyati kṛte paratvāt? `nābhyaṃ tailam` iti| nanu ca śarīrāvayavalakṣaṇe yati sati nabhabhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavatītiyāha-`gavādiṣu yatā` ityādi| sa hi gavādiyatā saha vihitaḥ| tena `sanniyogaśiṣṭānāmanyatarābāva ubhayorapyabhāvaḥ` (vya|pa|48) iti nabhabhāvo na bhavati| `śunaḥ` ityādi| ānnityetasya samprasāraṇe kṛte'nnantatā'stīti <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopena bhāvyameveti| evaṃ tarhi samprasāraṇasāmarthyānna bhavati? naitadasti; `yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, yastu vidernimittameva nāsau bādhyate` (vyā|pā|56) iti tadavastho doṣaḥ| dīrghavidhānasāmarthyāditi cet? evamapi pakṣe syāt| evaṃ tahrranyathā vyākhyāyate| iha cakāradvayaṃ paṭhate - samprasāraṇañja, vā dīrghatvañceti| dvitīyaścakārī bhinnakramaḥ samprasāraṇasamīpe draṣṭavyaḥ| sa ca samucyārtho'nyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvāt? tadeva samuccinoti| tatra samprasāraṇamekena kriyate dvitīyena tadrūpasyaivāvasthitiriti| `tatsanniyogena` ityādi| tadityanena dīrghatvaṃ pratyavamṛśyate| tena dīrghatvena yata evāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati; anyathā <<yato'nāvaḥ>> [[6.1.213]] ityādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| `ūdhaso'naṅ? ca` iti| ūdhaḥśabdasyānaṅādeśo bhavati, cakārādyacya| `ūdhanyaḥ`| pūrvavat? prakṛtibhāvaḥ||nanu `aparimāṇavistācitakambalyebhyaḥ` [[4.1.22]] iti nipātanādeva kambalya iti sidhyati kambalyaṃ hi pariṃmāṇaviśeṣaḥ, itarathā hi kambalyaśabdasya tatra grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, parimāṇaviśeṣasya kambalyaśabdo nāmadeyam; ayamapi pratyayaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ vidhīyamānastatraiva bhavati, nānyatra; nahyatra kambalyaśabdaḥ saṃjñā, tasmānnārtho'nena? naitadasti; nipātanena hi kambalyaśabdaḥ parimāṇe sādhurityetāvat? pratīyate, na tu yadanto'yamiti| tataścāntasvaritatvaṃ na syāt| tasmāt? svaritatvaparijñānārthamidaṃ kartavyam| anantaraśrutasya yato'nukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ| nanu svaritatvādeva yadbhaviṣyati? cho'pi tarhi syāt| nanu ca cchasya sannidhāne prakṛtimātrāccha ukta iti niyamārthamidaṃ syāt, taccāniṣṭam, yat? punarniyataviṣaya iti tatsambandhe vidhyarthatā, vidhiniyamayośca vidhereva jyāyān? naitadasti; chasyāpi sambandhe vidhyarthatā sambhavati| kathaṃ saṃjñāyāmityucyate, saṃjñā cānupāttāvayavārthāpi bhati, tatrānavayavārthānāmaprākkrītīyatvāddhitādyarthābhāve chapratyayārthametat? syāt, tasmāccakaro yatpratyayānukarṣaṇārthaḥ kartavyaḥ? na kartavyaḥ; iṣṭato'pyadhikārāṇāṃ pravṛttinivṛttī bhavata iti yata evānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati, na tu cchasya| evaṃ tarhi cakāra ugavādibhya ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| kimarthamidam? sanaṅgvādibhyaḥ paratvādañādayaḥ prāpnuvanti tadbādhanārthamiti| atha gavādiṣveva `kambalācca saṃjñāyām` iti kasmānna paṭhati? tatra pāṭhe na kaścidgurulāghavakṛto viśeṣa iti yatkiñcidetaditi||haviḥśabdo gavādiṣu paṭhate, tena tasmānnityaṃ yatā bhavitavyam| atra haviṃrviśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇam, nasvarūpasyeti; ugavādisūtre svarūpaparibhāṣāyā upasthānāt| na hi tatra sopatiṣṭhamānā kenaciniṃnavāryate, tena svarūpasyaiva grahaṇam| tatra svarūpagrahaṇe satīha svarūpaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate; anyathā hi yadyatrāpi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, tataḥ svatantra ekasmāt? śabdāt? nityaśca yato vidhiḥ syādanityaścetyubhayamekatra nopapadyata iti na bhavati viparyayaḥ| atha vā-haviḥśabdasyehi pṛthagupādānādarthapradhānatvamavasīyate, anyathā hrapūpādiṣveva paṭhediti| `annavikārebhyaśca` iti| annavikāraḥ=annaprakārāḥ, te ca pratyayamutpādayanti vibhāṣā-udanyāḥ, udanīyā iti| yadyevam, apūpādīnāṃ kiṇvaparyantānāmatra vikāratvādeva siddhatvāt? pāṭho'narthako jāyate? yadā tarhi kenacidākārasādṛśyenāpūpādayo'rthāntare upacaryante, tadarthameṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ| kiṃñcānnavikāragrahaṇenāpūpādiṣu pratyamicchata ihāpi syāt - yavāpūpāḥ, vrīhitaṇḍulā iti| pratipadapāṭhe tu grahaṇavattvāt? tadandavidhiḥ paryudasto bhavati| nanu ca <> [[5.1.20]] ityasamāsagrahaṇādbhavitavyamevātra tadantavidhinā, etenāsamāsagrahaṇena pūrvatra tadantavidhirastītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratipādyate? satyametat; apūpādiṣu pratipadapāṭhasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati||etadeva jñāpakam-hitayoge catuthryastīti| tena yaduktam-`hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā` (vā| 123) ityetadupapananaṃ bhavati||śīryata iti śarīram, tena ghaṭāderapi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyata āha - `śarīraṃ prāṇikāyaḥ` iti| etena rūḍhiriyamiti darśayati| gavādāveti śarīrāvayavavācinaḥ| tatra tu yāḥ prakṛtayastābhyo'nenāpi pūrveṇāpi vā yati viśe ṣo nāstyeva| yatra viśeṣaḥ - `nābhi nabhañca` (ga|sū|106) iti, sa viśeṣastatraiva veditavya eva||khalādīnāṃ vṛṣaparyantānāṃ `yasyeti` [[6.4.148]] lopaḥ| `brāhṛṇyam` iti| `na saṃyogādvamantāt` [[6.4.137]] iti pratiṣedhāt? <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] ityakāralopo na bhavati| <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopo'pi na bhavita; <> [[6.4.168]] iti prakṛtibhāvāt| vṛṣaśabdo'yamatrākārānto gṛhrate, na tu brāāhṛṇaśabdo'kārānta iti| nanu cāśaṅkā vṛṣaśabde yuktā-nalope sati kimayamakārāntaḥ? āhosvinnakārāntaḥ? iti, brāhṛnśabdācca yato nivṛttiprasaṅgād? brāhṛñśabdādapi yacaca pratyayo nivartata iti bhāvaḥ| ata evāha - `chapratyayo'pi` ityādi| yatpratyayāpekṣayāpirayam - na kevalaṃ yatpratyayo na bhavati, api tu cchapratyayo'pīti| brāāhṛṇaśabdācchapratyayābhāvo yojyaḥ| nanu cābhyāmihānupādanād? yatpratyayo na bhavati, <> [[5.1.5]] iti cchapratyayastu kasmānna bhavati? ityāha-`anabhidhānāt` iti| na hīha vṛṣīyam, brāāhṛṇīyamityukte vivakṣito'rthaḥ pratīyate; yato'rthapratipādanaṃ prati niyatā eva śabdaśaktayo bhavantīti kvacit? pratyayāntenārthasyābhidhānamṣa kvacidvākyeneti| ato vākyamevāvatiṣṭhate-`vṛṣṇe hitam, brāāhṛṇebhyo hitam` iti| vākyasamadhigamyasyārthasya taddhitenānabhidhānāditadi yāvat||ajaśabdo'yamiha puṃlliṅga upāttaḥ; aviśabdasya dhyantaśabdasyāpūrvanipātāt| ābantasya grahaṇe hṛdiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| adantasya grahaṇe `dvandve dhi` [[2.2.32]] ityetasya bādhitatvāt? `ajādyadantam` [[2.2.33]] ityajabdasya pūrvanipāto yujyate| tasmāt? puṃlliṅgasya grahaṇam| tathā va `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati` (vyā|pa|29) iti strīliṅgādapi pratyayo bhavatyeva-ajābhyo hitamajathyam| <> [[6.3.35]] iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| parisaṃkhyāyante hi tatra tasilādayaḥ, teṣāñca madhye parisaṃkhyātauayātmannityatra nalopaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, yāvatā dvandvenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate, tatra <> [[8.2.7]] iti nalopaḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha-`ātman` ityādi| ātmannityeva bhavatyeṣā prākṛtiriti jñāpanārthaṃ nalopo na kṛtaḥ| kaḥ punarevaṃ sati viśeṣaḥ? ityāha-`tena` ityādi| gatārtham| yadyevam, viājanaśabdena hruttarapadasya sambandhaḥ prāpnoti? evaṃ manyate-ātmanniti nalopābāvena pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptevryabhicārasya darśitatvāt? tataḥ pratyāsaterbhogaśabdenaiva sambadhyate, na tu viājanaśabdeneti nāsati doṣaḥ| `karmadhārayādeveṣyate` iti| vāryapāramparyopadeśāt| vibhāvāgrahaṇānuvṛttevryavasthitavibāṣāvijñānādvedaṃ veditavyam| viāsya jano viājanaḥ, viāo jano'syeti viājana iti samāsena bhavitavyam| yathā kho na bhavati tathā ccho'pi na bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha-`bahuvrīhistu` ityādi|`upasaṃkhyānam` iti| pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-iha hi bhogasamāsāditi vāktavye uttarapadagrahaṇamadhikavidhānārtham| na caivaṃ sati bahupūrvādīṣadasamāptau bhogo bahubhoga ityasmāt? khaḥ syādityāśaṅkanīyam; bahucpracpratyayasya samāsābāvāt| tato'tri chenaiva bhavitavyam - bahubhogīya iti| tena pañcajanādapi bhaviṣyati| saṃjñāśabdaścāyam; <> [[2.1.50]] iti samāsaḥ| tathā sarvajanādapi veditavyaḥ| `tatpuruṣādeva` iti| viśeṣānabhidhāne'pi mahājanāditi nirdeśādeva samānādhikaraṇādeva bhogaśabdo'yaṃ bhāvasādhanaḥ - bhuktirbhoga iti, karmasādhano vā - bhujyata iti bhoga iti| ayamavyutpannaḥ śarīravācīsa, tasyeha grahaṇamityāha - `bhogaśabdaḥ` ityādi| bhogaśabdaḥ śarīrameva pratipādayatītyarthaḥ| yatra vartamāno'yaṃ sākṣāt? sambandhamāha, tatraiva khapratyayamāsādayati| vartate ca kriyāyāṃ dravye ca| tathā hi - yadyapi bhujikriyayā dravyeṇa ca sambandho'sti, tathāpi śarīreṇa mukhyaḥ sambandha iti tato bhavati pratyayaḥ| yathā rājācāryābhyāṃ vākyameva bhavati, tathehāpi bhavitavryāmiti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `ācāryādaṇatvam` iti| kṣubhnādipāṭhāt| `kevalābhyāṃ vākyameva bhavata#i` iti| chapratyayo na bhavati, anarbhidhānādeva||`sarvāṇṇasya vāvacanam` iti| abhidhāne'bhidheyopacārādveti vikalpmāha| ihāpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttereva veditavyam| na ca sarvapuruṣābhyāṃ vikalpa āśaṅkā; vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt| `puruṣādvadha` iti| tatra vadhe - <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇo'pavādaḥ, vikāre - <<prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.3.154]] ityañaḥ, samūhe'pi - <> [[4.2.37]] ityaṇaḥ| `tena kṛte granthe` [`kṛte granthe` ityeva pāṇinīyaṃ sūtram] [[4.3.116]] ityaṇa eva||ubhayasmin? ñitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham| carake vṛddhyarthaṃ ca| māṇave tu <> [[6.3.39]] iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārtham| māṇavīnā bāryāṃ yasya sa māṇavīnābhārya iti||tasmai idaṃ tadartham, `caturthī tadartha` [[2.1.35]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| etadeva vacanaṃ jñāpakam - arthottarapade samāse samudāyārthasya liṅgaṃ bhavati, na ca paravalliṅgatetiṃ| etena yaduktaṃ - `arthena nityasamāsaḥ sarvaliṅgatā ca vaktavyā` (vā|78) iti sā siddhā bhavati| `prakṛtirupādānakāraṇam` iti| samānajātīyamabhinnasantānavṛtti kāraṇamupādanakāraṇamityucyate| upādīyata ityupādānam, bahulavacanāt? karmaṇi lyuṭ, tasya kāraṇamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `tasyaiva va` ityādi| tasyaivopādānakāraṇasyottarabhāvyasthāviśeṣo vikṛtiḥ| `vikṛtivācinaḥ` ityādi| nanu ca <> [[4.1.82]] iti vacanāttadarthamiti prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭatvāt? prakṛteśca tadarthatvāt? tadvācina eva pratyayaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; prathamasya cāprathamasya ca kāryaprāptau prathamādeva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ prathamagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ kṛtam| iha tu prathamāt? prāptireva nāsti| `prakṛtau` iti| saptamyā prakṛteḥ pratyayārthatvena sampāditatvāt| `vikṛteḥ` iti| pañcamyā vikṛteḥ prakṛtitvena tasmānnāyamasya viṣaya iti vikṛtivācina eva pratyayo bhavati| `vikṛtyarthāyām` iti| anena tadarthamityatra subvyatyayena saptamyāḥ sthāne prathamā, liṅgavyatyayena ca strīliṅgasya sthāne napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ kṛtamiti darśayati| nanu ca chandasi vyatyaya uktaḥ, nedaṃ chandaḥ, tatkuto vyatyayaḥ? `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti` (ma|bhā|1.1.1) ityadoṣaḥ| `tadarthagrahaṇena` ityādi| iha prakṛtyantaranivṛttiḥ - yavānāṃ dhānāḥ, dhānānāṃ saktava iti| kvacidvikārasya prakṛtisambandhaḥ - dhānānāṃ yavāḥ, saktūnāṃ dhānā iti| kvacit? prakṛterananyārthatā, yathā - kāṣṭhānāmaṅgārāḥ| prakṛterananyārthatākhyānārthena yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate, taddarśayati - `pratyayārthasya ca` ityādi| iha vikṛtyarthāyāṃ prakṛtau pratyaya ucyate| tasya tasmāt? tādarthye caturthyeva śakyate pratibodhayitum| ataḥ pratyayārthasya tadarthatvena sāmarthyāccaturthī samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| `kecittu` ityādi| teṣāṃ vacanalabhyaivu caturthī samarthavibhaktiḥ|`tadartham` iti| kimiti ṣaṣṭhī pratyudāhyiyate? ṣaṣṭhati tādathryaṃ brūte, yathā - guroridaṃ gurvarthamiti| tathā sati ṣaṣṭhapi samarthavibhaktirbhavati| aṅgārāṇāṃ kāṣṭhānīti pratyudāharaṇaṃ tu prakṛtyantaranivṛttyā, tayā yavādeḥ samarthyete| aṅgārebhyaḥ kāṣṭhāni, prākārebhya iṣṭakā iti| idamasati tadarthagrahaṇe na jñāyate kimarthaṃ vivakṣitamiti| tasmādananyārthatā prakṛtervivakṣiteti| etat? prayojanaṃ pratipādayituṃ tadarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca prakṛtyantaranivṛtyā prakṛtireva sambadhyamānā vyatiricyata iti yavādereva vyatirekavibhaktirbhavati| ye tu caturthīṃmanuvartayanti, teṣāṃ tadarathagrahaṇaṃ catarthīviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate - tādarthye caturthīti| tatra mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūriti pratyudāharaṇam| teṣāṃ catuthryanuvṛttirapārthikā; tadarthagrahaṇenaiva gatārthatvāt| tathā ca yā tādathryasamānārthā ṣaṣṭhī sā cāsatyāṃ viśeṣyate| `yā kācit` itaci| na tūpādānakāraṇabhūtāpītyarthaḥ| syādetat - kūpaḥ prakṛtirudakasya na bhavatyeva; tatastannivṛttyarthaṃ vikṛtigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamityata āha - `bhavati ca` ityādi| caśabdovadhāraṇe| nanu cānyebhya eva svakāraṇebhya udakamutpādyate, tatkathaṃ kūpastasya prakṛtiḥ? ityāha - `tatrotpādanāt` iti| yathaiva hi prayājādīnāṃ dharmāṇāmutpattyādhārabhūtau darśapaurṇamāsau prakṛtau bhavataḥ, evamudakasyotpattyādhārabhūtatvāt? kūpaḥ prakṛtirbhavati| yadyevam, udakamapi tasya vikṛtiḥ? ityāha - `nanu` ityādi| atraivopapattimāha - `atyantabhedāt` iti| vikāro hi prakṛteruttaramavasthāntaramiti tato nātyantabhinno bhavati, yathā - kāṣṭhānāmaṅgārāḥ| te hi pārthivenābhinnasantānavarttitvena kāṣṭhebhyo nātyantaṃ bhidyante| udakaṃ tu bhinnasvabhāvatvādbhinnasantānavarttitvācca kūpādatyantaṃ bhinnam| ato na tasyottaramavastāntaramiti na bhavati vikṛtiḥ| `na tu kośī tasya prakṛtiḥ` iti| atatkāraṇatvāt, anutpattyādhārabhūtatvācca| nanu ca prakṛtirvikṛtiriti sambandhiśabdāvetau| sambandhiśabdaśca niyata eva pratiyogini pratītimupajanayati, yathā hi - `mātarivarttitavyam` ityukte na cocyate `svasyāṃ mātari` iti, yā yasyā mātā tasyāmiti pratīyate| evaṃ sati kūpalakṣaṇāyāṃ prakṛtau vikṛtyarthāyāṃ pratyayārthatvena vivakṣitāyāmasatyapi vikṛtagrahaṇe tasyaiva kūpasya yā yā vikṛtistata eva pratyayo vijñāyate| tathā ca vikāravācino'siśabdāt? pratyaye vidhitsite yasyāsau prakṛtistasyāmeva tadarthāyāṃ prakṛtāvasatyapi prakṛtigrahaṇe pratyayo vijñāyate| tasmādanyataropādāne'pi sarvamiṣṭaṃ sampadyate| na kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata ityāha - `tadarthaṃ dvayorapi` ityādi| anenaivaṃ manyate - syādetadeva yadāsau prakṛtivikṛtiśabdau niyogataḥ sambandhiśabdau, na cemau niyogataḥ sambandhiśabdau| tathā hiṃ, vipūrvastāvadayaṃ karotiṃrastyevāpakāre - devadatto'sthityai vikarotīti; asti ceṣṭānānātve - vikurvate cchātrā iti; astyanaucitye - vikṛtireṣā strīṇāṃ yat? svātantryamiti| asti kārye - tantunāṃ paṭo vikāra iti| tatā prapūrvo'pyayamasti kāraṇe - tantavaḥ prakṛtiḥ paṭasyeti; asta caudāsīnye - sattvānāṃ prakṛtiriti| tānyucyante yānyanārambhakāṇi; asti doṣāpagame - prakṛtisto'yamiti| asti svabhve-prakṛtyā'bhirūpa iti; asti dharmāṇāmutpattyādhāre, yathā-darśapaurṇamāsau dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtistho'yamiti| asati svabhāve-prakṛtyā'bhirūpa iti; asti dharmāṇāmutpattyādhāre, yathā-darśapaurṇamāsau dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtiriti| tadevamarthabahutvādanayoḥ sarmbāndhatvamanaikāntikamiti, ato'nyataragrahaṇe na sidhyati| na cānyatareṇa śakyate vaktuṃ vivakṣitaḥ prakṛtivikārabhāvaḥ| ayamupādānakāraṇasya taduttarāvasthābhūtasya ca yo vikāraḥ sa iha veditavyaḥ| yadi tu vipūrvaḥ karotiranekārthaḥ, <> [[4.3.134]] ityatrāpi sandehāpagamāya tarhi prayatitavyam? satyametat; śailīyamācāryasya yasya kvacidabhidhānamāśrayati, kvacannyāyam, kvacidvacanamiti tat? sarvamucyate| tena sarvaṃ pratyāyyate||yadā chadiścarmavikāro vivakṣyate tadāpi ḍhañeveṣyate - chādiṣeyaṃ carmeti| nanu ca paratvāt? <<carmaṇo'ñ>> [[5.1.15]] ityañ? prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `carmaṇo'ñ` ityatra chadiṣo ḍhañanuvarttiṣyate| yathā chadiḥśabdādvaliśabdāccaturthīsamarthāt? prakṛtivikārabhāve pratyaya upajāyate, tathopadhiṃśabdādapi bhavativyamityāśaṅkyāha - `upadhiśabdāt` ityādi| atra yuktimāha - `upadhīyate` ityādi| tena `karmaṇyupasarge ghoḥ kiḥ` iti darśayati| tena ca dravyasyānāsāditottarāvasthasyābhidhānam| yadyupadhiṃśabdādvikṛtivācinaḥ syāt, evamarthāntare syāt| na cāsau prakṛtiviśeṣe bhavati| na tūpadhiśabdādvācyasya pratyāntarasya prakṛtivikārabhāvo'sti, abedāt| tathā hi - yadeva rathāṅgamupadhiśabdenocyate tadevānāsāditottarāvasthamaupadheyaśabdenāpi| syādetat - yadā bhāvasādhana upadhiṃśabda upadhānamupadhiriti tadā nāsti bhedaḥ, kriyābhidhānāt; yadāpyupadhiśabdena kriyādravyasya vikāra ucyate tadaupadheyaśabdena ca tatprakṛti dravyam, ataḥ prakṛtiviśeṣe parapratyayau bhaviṣyatīti? etaccāyuktam; na hi kriyādravyasya vikāro yujyate; atyantabhedāt| tasmāt? sthārthaṃ evopadhiṃśabdāt? pratyayo vijñāyate||`carmaṇyapi` ityādi| ñyasyāvakagāśaḥ - aupānahro muñjaḥ, año'vakāśaḥ - vādhrram, vāratram; carmaṇi prakṛtitvena vivakṣite satyubhayaprāptau pūrvavipratiṣedhena ñya eva bhavati - aupānahraṃ carmeti||`carmaṇaḥ` iti pañcamī vā syāt? ṣaṣṭhī vā? yadi pañcamī, carmaṇa eva pratyayo bhavet, na carmavikāravācibhyaḥ| etacca kuto labhyate? anabhidhānāt| tathā hi prakṛtiviśeṣa eva pratyaya iṣyate| na ca carmaśabdādutpanne pratyaye vivakṣitārthasyābhidhānamasti| tasmānneyaṃ pañcamī, api tu ṣaṣṭhī||dvitīyāśaṅkāmapaninīṣurāha - `tat` ityādi| asterakarmakatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| avayavārthapūrvatvādavayavyarthasyetyāha - `asya` ityādi| karotīti karaṇaḥ| kartari bahulavacanāllayuṭ| itiścāsau karaṇaśceti karmadhārayaḥ| `sambhāvane'lamiti cetsiddhāprayoge` [[3.3.154]] | nanu ca prākārīyā iṣṭakāḥ, prāsādīyaṃ dārviti ca pūrveṇaiva siddham, tathā hi - yāsāmiṣṭakānāṃ yasya ca dāruṇo bahutvena prākāraḥ prāsādaśca sambhāvyate, tāsāmiṣṭakānāṃ tasya ca dāruṇo yathāsaṃkhyena prākāraprāsādau vikārau bhavataḥ, tādathryācceṣṭakānāṃ dārūṇāñcāstīvetyata āha - `prakṛtivikāra` ityādi| gatārtham| `dvistadgrahaṇam` ityādi| ityeṣa nyāyo'nena pradaśryate| <> [[5.2.94]] ityādau naikaḥ pratyayārthaḥ| tatra tatsamudāyena samarthavibhakteḥ sambandho vijñāyate| tataśca yatra dvābhyāṃ pratyayārthābhyāṃ samarthavibhakteḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati - śākhāvān? vṛkṣa ityādau, tatraiva tat? syāt| yatra tvanyatareṇaiva sambandhaḥ - gomān devadattaḥ, vṛkṣavān? parvata ityādau, tatra na syāt| asmastu nyāye pradarśiśate sarvatra bhavati||parikhāśabdena cātra kheyamucyate||prāgvacanaṃ <<śīrṣacchedādyacca>> [[5.1.65]] , <> [[5.1.66]] ityevamādinādhikāravatā ṭhañi viccinne <> [[5.1.72]] ityevamādāvarthanirdeśe ṭhañeva yathā syādityevamartham||`tadarhati` [[5.1.62]] ityeko vidhiḥ, <> [[5.1.117]] iti dvitīyaḥ, tat? kasyehāvadhitvenopādānam? ityāha - `tadarhati` ityādi| itarasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? evaṃ manyate yadi tasya grahaṇabhipretaṃ syāt? `prāgvateḥ` [[5.1.18]] ityanenaiva sambandhaṃ kuryāt, na `ārhāt` ityanena| nanu ca vatyarthe'pi naitadasti; yadyapi vatyarthe'pi ṭhagadhikriyate, tathāpi tatra tena na bhavitavyam; pratipadavihitena vatinā bādhitatvāt, anabhidhānādvā| tasmādarhatiśabdaikadeśasyaivārhaśabdasyāvadhitvaṃ nyāyyam| `gopucchādīn? varjayitvā` iti| kathaṃ punaretajjñāyate - agopucchāditi pratiṣedho'yamiti? anyasyārthasyehāsambhavāt| nanu cāyamarthaḥ syāt - agopucchaśabdāt? saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇācceti? aśakyo'yamarthaṃ iha sambhāvayitum| yadi hrayamarthaḥ syāt, niṣkādibhyaḥ parimāṇādeva siddhatvāt? punarvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| nanu ca niyamārthaṃ punarvacanaṃ syāt - asamāsa eva yathā syāditi? naitadasti; na hi vidhau sati niyamārthatā yuktā| niyame hi satyavaktavyasya tyāgācchabdabādhanam| kiñca, siddhañca punarvacanamupādīyata iti, uktānuvāde doṣaśca| vidhau tu na śabdabādhanam, nānuvāda#oṣa itadi| vidhiniyamasambhavavicāre vidhinaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum| tasmādanyasyehārthasyāsambhavāt? `agopucchāt` iti pratiṣado'yamiti vijñāyate| jñāpakātprakṛtaratara na vivakṣyate, yadayam? <> [[5.1.44]] iti ṭhako nivṛttyarthaṃ ṭhañaṃ karoti| `abhividhāvayamākāraḥ` iti| maryādāyāṃ hi vartamānasyākārasyātra grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, prāggrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhatvāt| abhividhivṛtterākārasya grahaṇe sata yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate, taddarśayitumāha - `arhatyarthe'pi ṭhagbhavati` iti| `bhedagaṇanaṃ saṃkhyā` ti| bhidyanta iti bhedāḥ, bhinnāḥ padārthāḥ, te gaṇyante saṃkhyāyante paricchidyante yena tadbhedagaṇanam, ekatvādi| saṃkhyābhede hi sati padārthanusaṅkalpanamekatvādibhiḥ kriyate| ekatvasaṃkhyā'pi bahuṣu sanniveśiteṣu bhedamekamasahāyamāha| `gurutvamānamunmānam` iti| suvarṇādervastuno gurutvamutkṣipyate, yena tadunmānaṃ tulādi| `āyāmamānaṃ pramāṇam` iti| tiryagabhimukhasya vastuno yenāyāmaparicchedaḥ kriyate tat? pramāṇam, vitastyādi| `ārohaparaṇāhamānaṃ parimāṇam` iti| ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca mīyate vrīhrādyartho yena tatparimāṇam| ārohaḥ ucchrāyaḥ, pariṇāhaḥ vistāraḥ| saṃkhyāparimāṇayorbhede pṛṣṭe yadunmānādīnāṃ viśeṣapradarśanaṃ tatprasaṅgena tadviṣayasyājñānasyāpanayanārtham| saṃgraheṇa kilaśabda evamādimatamācāryāṇāmityarthaṃ sūcayati| `sarvataḥ` iti| ārohataḥ pariṇāhataścetyarthaḥ| `saṃkhyā bāhrā tu sarvataḥ` iti| unmānāt? parimāṇāt? pramāṇācca saṃkhyā bāhrā; tatrānantarbhāvāt||`ṭhaño'pavādaḥ` iti| yena nāprāptityāyena (vyā|pa|49)| niṣkādibhyo droṇaparyantebhyaḥ parimāṇaśabdatvāt? ṣaṣṭhiśabdasya saṃkhyāśabdatvāṭṭhaki paryudaste ṭhañeva prāpnoti, atastasyaivāyamapavādaḥ| `tedantāpratiṣedhasya` iti tadantavidherapratiṣedhasyetyarthaḥ| yadi tarhi tadantāt? pratyayo vijñāyate, evaṃ tarhi `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena` (śā|pa|65) iti kevalebhya- pratyayo nopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; asamāsagarahaṇena hi grahaṇavatparibhāṣāyā (vyā|pa|89) nivṛttirākhyātā, nivṛttāyāñca <> [[1.1.72]] iti tadantādbhavati| tatra ca `svasya ca rūpasya` (kāśikā|1.1.73) iti prakṛtatvāt? kevalādapi bhavati| yattu manyate-`apūrvopādānasāmarthyāt? kevalāditi lāghavārthaṃ kevalānāṃ pāṭhaḥ syāt` iti, yatkiñcadetat| `ita uttarañca` ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi tadantavidhirlabhyate, yāvatā `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirna` (vyā|pa|89) iti pratiṣidhyate? asyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu tasyā gargādiṣu `vājāse` iti samāse pratyayapratiṣedhādgamyate| nityatve hi vājaśabdādutpadyamānasya pratyayasya samāse prāptireva nāstīti pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt| `dviśūrpam` iti| dvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītamiti taddhitārthe dviguṃ kṛtvā| na tāvadeṣā lugantā prakṛtiriti saṃkhyāpūrvapadādapi <<śūrpādañanyatarasyām>> [[5.1.26]] ityañeva kriyate, tasya `avyadrdhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñāyām` [[5.1.28]] iti luk| `dviśaurpikam` iti| <> [[7.3.17]] ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| yaduktam - `saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidhiritīṣyate` iti, yaccoktam - `lugantāyāstu prakṛterneṣyate` iti, tadubhayamāptāgamena sthirīkarttumāha - `tathā coktam` ityādi||`kano'pavādaḥ` iti| uttarasūtreṇa prāptasya| `śatikam` iti| <> [[5.1.57]] iti vartamāne <> [[5.1.58]] iti saṅghe pratyayārthe vivikṣita uttarasūtreṇa kanneva bhavati| `pratyayārtho'tra saṅghaḥ` iti| śatamadhyāyānāṃ parimāṇaṃ yasya nidānakhyagranthasya, sa ceha pratyayārthaḥ| sa ca śatasaṃkhyāvyavacchinnāvyāyasamudāyātmaka iti saṅgha eva paratyayārto bhavati| `śatameva vastutaḥ` iti| avyāyaśatasyānanyārthatvāt tatasca prakṛtyarthāt? na bhidyate| tadeva hradhyāyānāṃ śataṃ prakṛtyābhidhīyate, pratyayāntenāpi tadeveti neha prakṛtyarthāt? pratyayārthabhedaḥ| tadetena yatra cāvyatiriktaḥ prakṛtyārthāt? pratyayārthastatra pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| na ca vyatirikta ityetadākhyātam| nanu ca `saṅghe cānauttarādharye` [[3.3.42]] , <> [[5.1.58]] ityatra ca prāṇisamūhe saṅghaśabdo gṛhrate, tatara kathaṃ granthaviṣayo gṛhrate/ upacāreṇetyadoṣaḥ| yadi vā saṃkhyāsūtre saṃjñāśabdasāhacaryādviśiṣṭaḥ saṅgho gṛhrate| `saṅghe cānauttarādharye` ityatrāpi <> [[8.3.94]] ityato nāmagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ prāṇisaṅgho gṛhrate| iha tu yatvābhāvād? ganthasyāpi grahaṇamityaviśeṣaḥ| `iha tu` ityādi| nanu ca śate'bhidheye pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam, iha ca śatadyaṃ śāṭakaśatam, śatikaṃ śāṭakaśatamityukte śataṃ pratīyata eva, tatkimiti pratiṣedho na bhavati? ityāha - `vākyena` ityādi| śatyaśatikaśabdau hi sāyānyaśabdau, sāmānyaśabdāśca na prakaraṇādikamantareṇa viśeṣe vartante| tena yāvacchāṭakaśatimityetatpadāntaraṃ na prayujyate, tāvat? pratyayārthasya śatatvaṃ nāvasīyate| tasmāt? padāntarasannidhau gamyamānatvāt? padāntarārtho bhavati, na pratyāyārthaḥ| `na śrutyā` iti| gamyata iti sambandhaḥ| yatra pratyayāntena padāntaranirapekṣeṇa pratyayārthasya śatatā''khyāyate, tatra śrutyā pratyayāntaśravaṇamātreṇaiva gamyate, yathā - pratyudāharaṇe śataṃ parimāṇamasya śatakamityukte gamyata evaitat - pratyayārtho'pi śatameveti| iha tu vākyācchatatvaṃ pratīyate| na ca padasaṃskārakāle vākyārthastayāṅgabhāvo'sti| tadā tasyopasarjanatvāt? prakṛtyarthādatirikte pratyayārthe pratiṣedho bhavati, na tu vyatiriktavākyagamya iti| tadāptavacanena draḍhayitumāha - `tathā coktam` ityādi| śatapratiṣedhe kartavye prakṛtyarthādanyasya pratyayārthasya śatatve'pratiṣedha ityetaduktaṃ bhavati| tatrānyat? prakṛtyarthaḥ śatam, anyat? pratyayārthaḥ śatam| tatra vidhireva bhavati; na pratiṣedha iti| kena panaḥ samāse prāpnoti, yatastatpratiṣedārtho'samāsānukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ kriyate? ityāha - `prāgvateḥ` ityādi||`pañcakaḥ paṭaḥ` iti| laukikyāḥ saṃkhyāyā udāharaṇam| `bahukaḥ` ityādi| paribhāṣitāyāḥ| `catvāriṃśatkaḥ` iti| `isusuktāntāt? kaḥ` [[7.3.51]] | `arthavartāstaśabdasya grahaṇāt` iti| arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|1|)| `ḍateḥ paryudāso na bhavati` iti| śabdāpekṣayā'vayavaṣaṣṭhīti| pratyayasya ya ekadeśastiśabdastasya paryudāso na bhavati, na hrayamarthavān| `katikaḥ` iti| kiṃ parimāṇameṣāmiti <> [[5.2.41]] iti ḍatiḥ, `ṭeḥ` [[6.4.143]] iti ṭilopaḥ| katibhiḥ krītamiti vigṛhra kan| yadyarthavatastiśabdasya grahaṇam, navateryastiśabdastasyāpi paryudāso na prāpnoti; navatiśabda eva hi samudāyaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣeṇārthavān, na tadekadeśastiśabdaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; navatiśabde yo navaśabdaḥ so'nekārthaḥ| tathā ca saṃkhyāviśeṣāvagatamato navaśabdāt? paro yastiśabdastata eta vijñāyate; tadbhāve bhāvāt| aśītiśabdasya tarhi tiśabdasya paryudāso na prāpnoti, nāsāvarthavān? nāpi tataḥ pūrvo yo'śīśabdastasya kaścidartho'sti, samudāya eva tu saṃkyāviśeṣeṇārthavān? naitadasti; yadyapyaśī-itiśabdasya na kaścanārthaḥ prakāśate, tathāpi pratijñāyate| aśītiśabdo hrevaṃ vyutpādyate - aṣṭānāṃ daśānāmaśībhāvaḥ, tiśabdaśca pratyayaḥ| ya evāṣṭānāṃ daśānāmārthaḥ so'śīśabdasya, yastu saṃkhaghyāviśeṣaḥ so'yaṃ tiśabdasyaiveti, tatastasya nānarthakyam| evamapi viśateḥ pratiṣedho na sidhyati? sa hrevaṃ vyutpādyate - dvayordaśatorvinbhāvaḥ, śatiṃśca pratyaḥ| tatra śatipratyayāt? pūrvasya bhāgasya dvayordaśatoryo'rthaḥ sa eva pratijñāyate śatipratyayasya, saṃkhāyaviśeṣaḥ, tiśabdasya na kaścit| iṣṭameva tat| saṃgrāhitaḥ kan? viṃśateḥ - `tadiṃvaśatikam` iti| atha `atiśadantāyāḥ` ityatrāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, atiśacchabdasya na prāgvatīyatvāt? pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva (pu|pa|la|vṛ|44) tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati/ evadeva tarhi prayojanam - anayacā paribhāṣayā tadantavidhirmā bhūditi| kiñca syāt? ihaikasaptatyā krīta iti pratiṣedho na syāt; ekasaptadaśatastipratyayasyāvidhānāt| antagrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe sati samudāyasyānte tiśabdaḥ śruyata ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati||`vatvantasya saṃkhyātvāt` iti| bahugaṇasūtreṇa [[1.1.22]] saṃkhyāsaṃjñāviṃdhānat| `tasya` ityādi| kathaṃ punastasyānenāgamaḥ śakyo vijñātum, yāvatā neha kangrahaṇam? yadapi prakṛtaṃ tadapi prathamānirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, `vatoḥ` iti pañcamī `kan` iti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati <> [[1.1.67]] iti| `tāvatkaḥ` iti| tatparimāṇamasyeti `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup` [[5.2.39]] , <<ā sarvanāmnaḥ>> [[6.3.91]] ityātvam||`viṃśakaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.142]] iti tiśabdasya lopaḥ, ato guṇe [[6.1.94]] pararūpatvam| yasyeti [[6.4.148]] lopo na bhavati; `asidhdavadatrā bhāt` [[6.4.22]] iti lopasyāsiddhtvāt| nanvihāntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā, tatkathaṃ pararūpatvam? evaṃ tahrrasiddhatvasyānityatvād? yasyeti lopo bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `kathaṃ punaratra kan` iti| tiṃraśatka ityadhikṛtya praśnaḥ viṃśatika ityatrārthavatastiśabdasya grahaṇāt? paryudāso na pravartata iti tamadhikṛtyāsya praśnasyopanyāso nopapadyate| `yogavabhāgaḥ kariṣyate`iti| tiṃraśadarthamityabhiprāyaḥ||`ṭhaño'pavādaḥ` iti| na ṭhakaḥ, kaṃsaśabdasya parimāṇavācitvāt||`ṭhaño'pavādaḥ` iti| na ṭhakaḥ, śūrpaśabdasya parimāṇavācitvāt||`ṭhakṭhañorapavādaḥ` [`ṭhaño'pavādaḥ` iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| śatamānaṃ parimāṇam, saharuāṃ saṃkhyā, tenaitābhāṃ ṭhagna prāpnotīti ṭhaño'pavādaḥ| viṃsatyā krītaṃ `viṃśātikam` iti| tacca paramāṇamapi sambhavati| tatra parimāṇāṭṭhaño'pavādaḥ, aparimāṇaṭṭhakaḥ, vasanaśabdāṭṭhagapavādaḥ||`adhyaradhakasam` iti| adhyardhena kaṃsena krītamiti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| `prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvadapānāṃ tadantavidhiraluki` (ma|bhā| 2|346) iti `kaṃsāṭṭiṭhan? [[5.1.25]] iti ṭiṭhan, tasya luk| `dvikaṃsam` iti| `adhyardhaśūrpam` iti| śūrpādañanyatarasyām` [[5.1.26]] ityañ; ṭhañanyatarasyām, tasya luk| yadyatira dvigoḥ parasyārhīyasya lugvidhīyate, viśeṣānupādanāt? taddhitalugantādapi dvigoḥ parasya prāpnoti - dvābyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītaḥ paṭo dviśūrpaḥ paṭaḥ, dviśūrpeṇa paṭena krītamiti dviśaurpikamiti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyamāṇaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ pūrveṇāpi sambadhyate| vyavasthitavibhāṣā sā| tena taddhitalugantāddvigoḥ parasya na bhaviṣyati - dviśaurpikamiti| prāgvatīye ṭhañi kṛte <> [[7.3.17]] ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `pāñcalohitikam, pāñcakalāpikam` iti| kasyācit? parimāṇaviśeṣasya nāmadheye ete| pañca lohinyaḥ parimāṇamasyeti, pañca kapālāḥ parimāṇamasyeti vigṛhra taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, <> [[5.1.57]] iti ṭhañ, `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite` (vā|731) iti puṃvadbāvāllohinīśabdasyekāranakāranivṛttiḥ| `adhyardhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyaiva` iti| abhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ kṛtvā, `adhyardhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyaiva` ityuktam| yathaiva hrekādikā laukikasaṃkhyā, evamadhyardhaṃśabdo'pi| `sa kimarthaṃ bhedanopādīyate` [`saḥ` nāsti - kāsikā] iti| saṃkhyāyā iti śeṣaḥ| iha hi dvagoradhyardhapūrvasya bhedenopādanādadhyardhapūrvasya bhedena saṃkhyāyā upādānaṃ bhavatīti| atastasyādhyardhaśabdasya bhedenopādānasya prayojanaṃ darśayituṃ pṛcchati| `jñāpakārtham` ityādinā prayojanamācaṣṭe| kiṃ punarasya saṃkhyākāryaṃ na bhavatītyāha - `saṃkhyāyāḥ` ityādi||`adhyardhasaharuām` iti| `śatamānaviṃśatika` [[5.1.27]] ityādinā vihitasyāṇo luk| `adhyardhasāharuām` iti| <> [[7.3.15]] ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `suvarṇaśatmānayorupasaṃkhyānam` iti| upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `vistācca` [[5.1.31]] ityataḥ siṃhāvalokitanyāyena cakāro'tropatiṣṭhate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena suvarṇaśatamānayorapi viṣyati| `adhyardhasuvarṇam` iti| ṭhaño luk, `adyardhaśatamānam` iti| `śatamāna` [[5.1.27]] ityādi-vihitasyāṇaḥ| `adhyardhaśatamānam` iti| `parimāṇāntasya` [[7.3.17]] ityādinottarapadavṛddhiḥ| nanu ca suvarṇamunmānam, na parimāṇam, tatkutastasya buddhiḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; uttarapadavṛddhau hayunmānamapi parimāṇamiti gṛhrate| kaguto jñāyate? `asaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ` [[7.3.17]] iti śāṇaśabdasya pratiṣedhāt| yadi tarhi tatronmānaṃ na gṛhreta, tadā śāṇasyonmānārthasya prāptireva nāstīti pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt| adhyardhapūrvadvigubhyāṃ kārṣāpaṇasaharuāyoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ kasmān bhavati? lakṣaṇavyabhicāreṇa tadabhāvasya sūcitatvāt| iha tāvat? `adhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ` [[5.1.28]] iti nirdeśe'lpāctaratvād? dhyantatvācca dviguśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti, `kārṣāpaṇasaharuāābhyām` ityatrālpāctaratvāt? saharuāśabdasya? tāvetau nirdeśau lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ bodhayantau yatāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣāyā apyabhāvaṃ bodhayata iti na bhavati yathāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣā||adhyardhapūrvagrahaṇamasvaritatvānnopatiṣṭhate| `dviniṣkam` iti| dvābhyāṃ niṣkābhyāṃ krītamiti asamāne ṭhako vidhānādatra ṭhañ, tasya luk| `dvinaiṣkikam` iti| `parimāṇāntasya` [[7.3.17]] ityādinottarapadavṛddhiḥ| `bahupūrvācca` iti| bahupūrvaddvigorniṣkaśabdāntādārhīyasya pratyayasya vibhāṣā lugbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - `dvitribhyāṃ niṣkāt` ityeva siddhe pūrvagrahaṇamadhikaṃ kurvatai tat? sūcitam - `anyadapyadhikaṃ kiñcidasti` iti| tena bahupūrvādapi bhavati||`dvitripūrvāditi cakāreṇānukṛṣyate` iti| nanu ca svaritatvādeva dvitrigrahaṇamanuvarttiṣyate, svaritatve satyadhikāraparimāṇaṃ na jñāyata iti cet? vārtametat| vyākhyānato'dikāraparamāṇaṃ vijñāsyate? evaṃ tarhi svaritatvādeva dvitripūrvagrahaṇasyānuvṛttau siddhāyāṃ yattadanukarṣaṇārthaṃ cakaramadhikaṃ karoti, tenaitat? sūcayati - anyadapyatra kiñcidadhikaṃ bhavatīti| tena bahupūrvādapi vibhāṣā luk? siddho bhavati| `bahibistam` iti| `dvibistam` iti dvau visto parimāṇamasyeti ṭhañ, tasya luk| `dvibaistikam` iti| uttarapadavṛddhiḥ||`dvitripūrvagrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam; pūrvatra cānukṛṣṭatvāt, asvaritatvādvā| śatamānādisūtreṇa [[5.1.27]] aṇi prāpte tasya luki kho vidhīyate| `vidhānasāmarthyādasya lugna bhavati` iti| yadi luk? syāt, khavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| na hraṇaḥ khasya ca luki sati kaścidviseṣo'sti||paṇapādamāṣebhyaḥ <> [[5.1.20]] iti asamāse ṭhako vidhānāṭṭhañi prāpte tasya luki śataśabdādapyasamāse <<śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate>> [[5.1.21]] iti ṭhanyatorvidhānāt? samāse saṃkhyālakṣaṇe kani yad? vidhīyate| `dvipādyam` ityādi| nanu padbhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati `padyatyatadarthe` [[6.3.53]] iti? satyam; <> [[6.3.52]] ityatra prāṇyaṅgasyaiva padbhāvavidhānāt| kṛta etat? `ājyāti` ityādinā gativacanena sambandhastasyaivopapadyate; na parimāṇaśabdasya| sa eva prāṇyaṅgavācyuttarasūtre'pyanuvartiṣyata iti tasyaiva padbhāva iṣyate| syādetat - ayamapīha pādaśabdaḥ prāṇyaṅgavācī, ato bhavitavyameveha padbhāvena? ityata āha - `padbhāvo na bhavati` iti| <> [[6.3.53]] iti padbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, sa na bhavati| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha - `prāṇyaṅgasya` ityādi| <> [[6.3.52]] ityatra prāṇyaṅgasya pādasya grahaṇam| `idaṃ tu parimāṇagrahaṇam` [`parimāṇam-kāśikā] iti| paṇādibhiḥ parimāṇaiḥ sāhacaryāt? parimāṇaṃ pādo gṛhrate, na prāṇyaṅgamiti padbhāvasyāprasaṅgaḥ||`sāptatikam, āśītikam` iti| <> [[5.1.18]] `naiṣkikam`; pāṇikam` iti| <> [[5.1.20]] iti ṭhak| `śatyam, śatikam` ita| <> [[5.1.20]] iti ṭhak| `śatyam, śatikam` iti| <<śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate>> [[5.1.21]] iti| `dvikam, trikam` iti| <> [[5.1.22]] | sāmānyārthābhidhāne teneti tṛtīyopādanādiha kasmānna bhavati - devadattena krītam, pāṇinā kritam? ityata āha - `tena` ityādi| karaṇe tṛtīyā| parimūlyāt? tataḥ pratyayena bhavitavyam| `anyatra` iti| anyatara mūlyāt? karaṇe tṛtīyā bhavati| `anabhidhānāt` iti| na hi yā kartari tṛtīyā yāpyamūlyāt? karaṇe tṛtīyotpadyate, tadantādutpannaḥ pratyāyo vivakṣitaṃ vastu pratipādayitumalaṃ sambhavati| tathā ha - daivadattikaṃ pāṇikamiti cokte, devadattena katrrā krītam? pāṇinā karaṇena krītamityeṣo'rtho nāvasīyate| devadatteneti kartari tṛtīyā, pāṇineti karaṇe| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - pragatyāsannavinimayadravyasambandhānabhidhānāditi| `anabhidhānādeva` iti| na hi prāsthikamityukte, prasthābhyāṃ krītaṃ praśthairvā krītamityeṣo'vagamyate| tatra punarabhidhāne ko hetuḥ? śabdaśaktirīdṛśī, kimatrānyena hetunā! api ca prasthādayaḥ śabdā arthatastu parimāṇānāmarthānāṃ vācakā iti teṣāmabhidheyasya pracaye pravṛttisambhave ko hetuḥ? nanvevaṃ vākye'pi pracayo nopapadyeta? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vākye hi pracayasya vācikā vibhaktirastīti pracayābhidhānaṃ na virudhyate| vṛttau tu na kaścit? pracayamācaṣṭa iti nāsau vṛttiviṣaye yujyate| yadi tarhi dvivacanabahuvacanāntāt? pratyayena na bhavitavyam, evaṃ sati dvābhyāṃ krītaṃ dvikam, tribhiḥ krītaṃ trikamityevamādi na sidhyatītyata āha - `yatra tu` ityādi| anabhidhānaṃ dvivacanāntāt? pratyayānutpatterhetuḥ| taccābhidhānaṃ kva na bhavati? yatra prakṛtyarthasya saṃkhyābhedāvagamo nāstīti; pramāṇābhāvāt| iha tu pramāṇamastyeva kiñcit| dvyādaya eva śabdāḥ prakṛtitvenopāttāḥ| te hi svapravṛttinimittabhūtayaiva saṃkhyayā'vacchinnaṃ vastu pratipādayanti| ataḥ svārthasya saṃkhyāviseṣāvagame pramāṇam| tenātrānabhidhānādityeṣa hetunastiti bhavati pratyayaḥ| `tathā` ityādi| yathā trikamityādau prakṛtyarthasaṃkhyānabhāvopagame pramāṇasambhavādbahuvacanāntādapi pratyayo bhavati, tathā maudgikamityādāvapi mudgādiśabdaprakṛtiratra svārthasya saṃkhyāvagame pramāṇamityetaddarśayitumāha - `na hrekena` ityādi| mudgādinaikaya vyaktyā krayo na bhavatīti vināpi vibhaktyā mudgādiśabdānuvṛttau bahutvaṃ gamyate| tatra pramāṇaṃ bhavati| ekagrahaṇa trayānupayoginodrvayorapyupalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam||`mahābhūtānām` [mahābhūtapariṇāmaḥ=utpāttaḥ - kāśikā] iti| pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānām| `sāharuām` iti| śatamānādisūtreṇa [[5.1.27]] aṇ||`ṭhañādīnāmapavādaḥ` iti| adiśabdena ṭhagādīnāṃ grahaṇ| nanu ca saṃkhyāparimāṇayoḥ paryudāsāt? kanaṣṭhako'pavāda iti vaktuṃ śakyate, tatkasmāṭṭhañādīnāmityucyate? ṭhañādīnāmityayamatadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhidrraṣṭavyaḥ| anayaivāpekṣayoktam - aāsya nimittamāiākamiti| ṭhak, pratyudāhṛtaḥ| sarvapratyayasambhavaḥ, tadbādhanārthamidamuktam| `pañcakam, aṣṭakam` iti| saṃkhyālakṣaṇaḥ kan? [[5.1.22]] | `prāsthikaḥ` iti| prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ, [[5.1.18]] ||<> [[5.1.38]] ityatastasyagrahaṇamanuvartate, tatkimarthaṃ punastasyanirdeśaḥ? ityāha - ṣaṣṭhīprakaraṇe punaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamarthavibhaktinirdeśaḥ` ityādi| `pratyayārthasya` iti| nimittasya| `anyathā` iti| yadi ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ pratyayārthai nivṛttyartho na kriyate, tato yathā saṃyoga utpātaśca pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam, tatheāro'pi tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta| tathā ceāraviśiṣṭe nimitta eva pratyayaḥ syāt||īārānukarvaṇārthaścakāraḥ| itikaraṇo vivakṣārthaḥ||sarvatra ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ ṭhako nivṛttyartham, anyathā hi prakṛtimātranirdeśe kriyamāṇe `ārhāt` [[5.1.19]] iti ṭhakprasajyeta||`apyate'smin? vāpaḥ` iti| adhikaraṇasādhanaḥ `halaśca` [[3.3.121]] iti ghañ||`pātraśabdaḥ parimāṇavācī` iti| `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ` iti| atreyaṃ yuktiḥ - yadi hraparimāṇavācī syāt? tadārhīyasya ṭhako'pavādaḥ, na ṭhañaḥ| `pātrikī` iti| <<ṣidgaurādibhyaśca>> [[4.1.41]] iti ṅīṣ||nanu ca vṛddhyādīnāṃ bahutvākhyānenaiva bahuvacanaṃ tena bhavitavyamitita kathaṃ dīyata ityekavacanāntena tasya nirdeśaḥ? ityāha - `dīyata ityekavacanam` ityādi| yadi samuditairvṛddhyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ kriyate tarhi syādbahuvacanam| na ca taiḥ samuditaiḥsa kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? pratyekam, ata ekavacanameva| vṛddhiśabda iha laukiko dhanaviśeṣavācī gṛhrate, na ca saṃjñāpadam, āyādibhirdhanaviśeṣavācibhiḥ saha nirdeśāt| ata evāha - `tatra` ityādi| uttamarṇasya yaddhanaṃ tasmādatiriktamadhikaṃ dhanamadhamarṇena yaddātavyaṃ tadvṛddhiḥ| `grāmādiṣu` iti| ādiśabdena kṣetrādi| `paṭādīnām` ityādi| paṭādīnāṃ vyavahyiyamāṇānāmupādānaṃ sūtrādi| tasya yanmūlyaṃ tasmādatiriktaṃ dravyaṃ paṭādivikrayeṇa yallabhyate sa lābha-| `rakṣānirveśaḥ` iti| vaṇijāṃ rakṣākārī rājño bhāgo rakṣānirveśa ityucyate| nanu cāsāvapayāyaḥ, tadapārthakaṃ śulkasya pṛthagupādānam? naitadasti; pañcāsmin? grāma āya ityāyaṃ prati grāmasyādhikaraṇabhāvaḥ; utpadyamānasyāyasyādheyabāvāt| śulke tu na sambhavati| pañcāsmin? śate śulkā iti śataṃ na śulkasyādhikaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi? iyatāparicchedaḥ śatena śulkasya kriyate| tasmādasya bhinnatvāt? śulkaḥ pṛthaguktaḥ| `siddhaṃ tu` ityādi| vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi bhavantīti sampradānākhye cādhikaraṇatvena vivakṣetyāha - `samam` ityādi| gatārtham||`ṭhaño'pavādaḥ` iti| na ṭhakaḥ; bhāgaśabdasya parimāṇatvāt| nanu cāṅgamātravacano'pi bhāgaśabdo'sti? satyamasti; na tu tasyeha grahaṇam| tasya hi grahaṇe vṛddhyādibhiḥ sambando nopapadyate| parimāṇavacanastu prasiddho rūpakāṃśe vartata iti vṛddhyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ upapadyate||`prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam` ityādi| prakṛteḥ prātipadikasya| `bhārādvaṃśādibhya ityarthaḥ` iti| atrārthe vaṃśādaya eva śuddhāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti| nanu ca vaṃśādayaḥ śabdāḥ, bhāra ityapi śabda eva; na ca śabda śabdāntarasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇamupapadyate, tatkathaṃ bhārabhūtebhyo vaṃśādibhya ityeṣo'rtho bhavati? ityāha - `bhāraśabdo'rthadvāreṇa` ityādi| vaṃśādīnāṃmarthasya bhāraśabdasyārtho mukhyaṃ viśeṣaṇam, arthadvāreṇa tu vaṃśādīnāṃ bhāraśapabdasya copacaritam| arthadharmeṇa śabdo'pi tathā vyapadiśyata ityarthaḥ||pūrveṇa ṭhaki prāpte tadapavādau ṭhankanau vidhīyate||`pramāṇānatirekaḥ` iti| pramāṇādanādhikyamityarthaḥ| `nanu ca` ityādi| tathā hi - sakthālīprasthaṃ pacati; tatrāvaśyaṃ prasthasya sambhavena bhavitavyam; na hranyathā śakyate paktumityabhiprāyaḥ| `nāstyatra niyogaḥ` iti| vyabhicāramāha - `prasthaṃ pacati brāāhṛṇī` iti| atra hi pāka eva gamyate, na sambhavaḥ|| `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ` iti| āñakādīnāṃ parimāṇakatvāt? pūrvema prāptasya||pūrveṇa ṭhankhayoḥ prāptayostataśca lukīdamucyate| `vidhānasāmarthyādanayorlugna bhavati` iti| yadi hyatrāpi luk? syāt, vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| `ṭhañastu pakṣe'nujñātasya` iti| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena| `dvyāḍhakī` iti| ṭhaño lukpakṣe <> [[4.1.21]] iti ṅīp| `dvyācitā` iti| `aparimāṇa` [[4.1.22]] ityādinā ṅīppratiṣedhe ṭāp||`cātūrūpyam` iti| ekaṃ khe rūpam, ṣṭhani dvitoyam, luko'pi vikalpitatvāṭṭhaño'luki tṛtīyam, luki caturtham| nanu ca kulijaśabdasaya parimāṇavācitvāt? `parimāṇāntasya` [[7.3.17]] ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āāha - `parimāṇāntasya` iti| `parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇakulijāt` ityevaitat? sūtraṃ pratyetavyamiti darśayati||<> [[5.1.51]] ityatrāpi vasnaśabdena mūlyamucyate||`prāsthiko rāśiḥ` ityādau sarvatra ṭhañ| `dviṣāṣṭikaḥ` ityādi| `saṃkhyāyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca` [[7.3.15]] ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `punarvidhānasāmarthyāt` ityādinā punarvidhānaphalaṃ darśayati| `dviṣāṣṭikaḥ` ityādau dviḥ pratyavidhānam, tatra pūrvasūtrāt? samarthavibhakteḥ pratyāyārthasayānuvṛtteḥ prathamaṃ pratyayo vidhīyate, tasya `adhyardhapūrva` [[5.1.28]] sūtreṇa lugbhavati| nanviha ca yaḥ sūtre samarthavibhakteḥ pratyayārthasya copādanāt? punarvidhīyate tasyāpi punarvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt||`parimāṇopādhikāt` iti| parimāṇamupādhirviśeṣaṇaṃ na sambhavati, na hi śabdaḥ parimāṇaṃ śabdasya sambhavatīti? tadarthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyata ityadoṣaḥ| nanu cārthasyāpi na sambhavati, saṃkhyā hi naiva parimāṇam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nātra rūḍhaḥ parimāṇaśabdo gṛhrate, kiṃ tarhi? kriyāśabdaḥ - parimāyate yena tat? parimāṇamiti| saṃkhyāyāpi ca parimīyata iti sāpi parimāṇam| nanvevamapi viśeṣaṇamanarthakam; na hraparicchedikā saṃkhyāsti, sañcakṣāṇā hi saṃkhyocyate? satadyam; paricchedikaiva saṃkhyā, sā tu svasyābhideyaṃ paricchinattīti ṣaṣṭharthamavaśyaṃ na paricchinatti| pañcāsya saṅghasya putrā iti nātra sahghasyeyattā pratīyate| iha tu pañcasaṃkhyā parimāṇamasya saṅghasyeti bhavatīyattāpratītiḥ saṅghasya| tasmādupapannaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam| `tatra` ityādi| pañcaśabdo'yaṃ saṃkhyeya eva vartate, na kadācidapi saṃkhyānamātre| tataśca ya eva saṃkhyeyāḥ pañcatvasaṃkhyayāvacchinnāḥ pañcaśabdenocyante, pratyayāntenāpi ta eva na hi teṣāṃ bhinnānāmatra saṃkhyeyāntaraṃ parimāṇaṃ pratyayavākyaṃ sambhavapati| tasmāt? saṃjñāyāṃ svārthaṃ eva pratyayo vācyaḥ| tathā cāha vārttikakāraḥ - `saṃjñāyāṃ svārthe utpadyate` iti| `pañcako'dhītaḥ` iti pāṭhāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgaḥ| `adhītiradhyayanam` iti| anena bhāvasādhanamadhyayanaśabdaṃ darśayati| yadyadhīyata ityadhyayanaṃ karmasādhano'dyayanaśabdaḥ syāt, sūtragrahaṇaṃ pṛthagvaktavyaṃ na syāt; adhyayanagrahaṇenaiva siddhatvāt, sūtramapyadhīyata eva| `pañcāvṛttyaḥ` iti pāṭhe punaḥ kriyātmikāḥ pañca vārā ityādinā paryāyāntareṇa pañcāvṛttya ityasyaivārthaṃ vyaktīkaroti| `stome ḍavidhiḥ` iti| atrāpi cchandasīti sambadhyate| mantrasamudāyaḥ stomaḥ| `ekaviṃśaḥ` iti| <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvaṃ ca, `ti viṃśaterḍiti [[6.4.142]] iti tiśabdalopaḥ|`śanśatoḥ` ityādi| śannityevamantācchandasi ḍinirvaktavyaḥ||`apadatvaṃ ca` iti| padanibandhanasya jaśatvādeḥ kāryasya pratiṣedhārthamihaite viṃśatyādayaḥ parimāṇe nipātyante| <> [[5.1.57]] ityadhikāre nipātanāt| evañca gavāṃ viṃśatiriti ṣaṣṭhī vyatirekanibandhanā na prāpnoti|viṃśatiśabdena hi tānyeva godravyāṇi gṛhyante, na tadadhikaṃ kiñcidarthāntaram| bahuvacanaṃ prasajati teṣāṃ bahutvāditi yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `viṃśatyādayaḥ` ityādi| yathākathañcitprakāreṇa| vināpyavayavārtheneti yāvat| rūpamātraṃ pradhānam, nāvayavārthaḥ| yastveṣāmarthaḥ sa lokata eva vyavatiṣṭhata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `nātrābhiniveṣṭavyam` iti| saṃkhyāparimāṇopādhikaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ| `parimāṇamātraṃ pratyayāḥ` iti nāyamatrābhiniveśaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ| anabhiniveśasya kāraṇamāha - `tathā hi` ityādi| syādetat - `atrāpyavayavārtho'sti` ityata āha - `na ca` ityādi| brāāhṛāṇānāṃ paṃktirityukte saṃkhyāparimāṇopādhikaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ, parimāṇo vā kaśṭacit; pratyayārtho hi na gamyate, kiṃ tarhi? sanniveśaviśeṣaḥ saṃsthānātmako guṇa eva pratīyate| tathā hi - tasya sanniveśaviśeṣasyānavagame tāvatsyeva brāāhṛṇeṣu paṃktiriti na prayujyate| tadevaṃ guṇaśabdatvādiṃvaśatyādīnāṃ gavāṃ viṃśatiriti sidhyati ṣaṣṭhī; viṃśatiśabdasya saṃkhyānavṛttitvāt| yadi tarhi guṇaśabdā ete, viṃśatigavi iti dravyaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti? guṇinyatra vṛttiḥ, guṇamātre na tato'yamadoṣa iti| vaktavyaḥ sa hetuḥ yata eteṣā kvacidguṇamātre vṛttirbhavati, kvacidguṇini| bahuvacanaprasaṅgācca guṇini vṛttirityetadeva duḥstham; bahutvādguṇinām| iha ca viṃśatiḥ kuṇḍānīti napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ prāpnoti, viṃśatibrrāāhṛṇā iti puṃlliṅgam, guṇavacanānāṃ hi śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti, yathā - śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklaṃ vastram, śuklā śāṭīti| yadāsau dravyamāśritya bhavati guṇaḥ, tasya liṅgavacanaṃ yat? tadguṇavacanasyāpi bhavati, yathā - guṇaśabdatve'pyeṣāmāśrīyamāṇe na bhavatyeva doṣaprasaṅgānmuktiḥ? ityata āha - `yā caiṣām` ittayādi| na kevalamarthābhidānaṃ svābhāvikam, kintvetadapītyapiśabdena darśayati| yatra dravyeṇa guṇinaiṣāmabhidheyo guṇo viśeṣyate, tatra svabhāvādeva guṇamātre vṛttiḥ| yatra tveta upasarjanībhūtasvārthāstena svārthena dravyaṃ viśeṣayanti tatraiṣāṃ svabhāvata eva guṇini vṛttiḥ| `svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānaṃ ca` iti| guṇinyaṇi vartamānānāṃ yayorliṅgasaṃkhyayoryadanuvidhānamanuvartamānametadapi sarvaṃ svābhāvikam| anyeṣāmapi, guṇaśabdānāmapi kvacit? svabhāvata eva guṇini vṛttirbhavati, tadyathā-śuklaḥ paṭa ityatra śuklaśabdasya| kvacidguṇamātre, yathā - asyaiva śuklo guṇaḥ paṭasyetyatra| anyeṣāmapi keṣāñcit? śabdānāṃ svābhāvikaṃ svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānaṃ dṛśyata eva, tadyathā - vedāḥ pramāṇam, śrutayaḥ pramāṇamiti| tasmāt? svābhāvikatvādguṇamātre guṇini ca vṛtteḥ svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānasya ca na bhavati yathaktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ| yadā hi svabhāvata iti saṃkhyānamātre guṇe guṇamātre vṛttiḥ tadā vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| yadā tu guṇini, tadā tayorapi ca dravyaśabdatvākat? sāmānādhikaraṇyamapi bhavati| dravye'pi vartamānānāṃ svābhāvikaṃ svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānam| atha saharuāādayo'pi kasmānna vyutpādyante? ityāha - `saharuāādayo'pi` ityādi| evañjātīyakā evamprakārā viṃśatyādibhiḥ sadṛśā ityarthaḥ| teṣāmapi guṇavattvāt? tadvadeva viṃśātyādivadeva draṣṭavyāḥ| viṃśātyādaya iva te'pi prakṛtyādivibhāgena vyutpādyanta ityarthaḥ| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ viṃśatyādaya eva sūtre upāttāḥ? ityāhma#ṛ`udāharaṇamātram` ityādi| udāharaṇamātraṃ viṃśatyādigrahaṇam, anye'pyevañjātīyāḥ saharuāādayastathaiva vyutpādyāḥ||nanu ca `saṅgha` ityanuvarttiṣyate, kiṃ vargagrahaṇena? naitadasti; saṅghaśabdo hi prāṇisamudāye rūḍhaḥ| vargaśabdastu samūhamātre iti vargagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||saṃkhyālakṣaṇe kani prāpte saptañśabdācchandasyañvidhānam||tiṃraśacchabdāt? `viṃśatitiṃraśadbhyām` [[5.1.24]] iti yogavibāgena kani prāpte catvāriṃśacchabdādapi <> [[5.1.18]] iti ṭhañi prāpte'yamārabhyate| `abhidheye saptamyeṣā` ityādi| viṣayasaptamyāmasyāṃ brāāhṛṇaviṣayaścet? prayogo bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ syāt, tathā cānyatra pratyayāntasya prayogo na syāt, tasmānna viṣayasaptamyeṣā| etacca saṃjñāgrahaṇādeva vijñāyate| na hi brāāhṛṇagrahaṇāt? tiṃraśaccatvāriṃśatau ḍaṇṇantau kasyacit? padārthasya saṃjñinau staḥ, brāāhṛṇānāṃ tu vidyate||`autacchatrikaḥ, vāstrayugmikaḥ` ityādiṣu ṭhak| `ārhāt? [[5.1.19]] ityabhividhau cāyamākāra iti||`nityagrahaṇam` iti| atha vibhāṣāyā nivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇena kasmānna vijñayate? aśakyaṃ tannivṛttyarthaṃ vijñātum| vināpi nityagrahaṇena mahāvibhāṣānivṛttiḥ śakyate vijñātum| tathā hi - chedādibhyaḥ pūrveṇaiva ṭhaki siddhe punarvacanādeva nityavidhirbhaviṣyati, kiṃ nityagrahaṇena? tato nityagrahaṇamahanyahanyarhatvāt? `tadarhati` [[5.1.62]] ityasyārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tathā ca jātamārambhasya prayojanamiti vākyaṃ na nivartate| `virāgo viraṅgañca` iti| virāgaśabdaṣṭhakamutpādayati viraṅgādeśaṃ cāpadyate| nityaṃ virāgamarhati vairaṅgikaḥ| pratyayasanniyogena cāyasādeśa iti pratyayābhāvādvākye na bhavati||pratyayasanniyogena śīrṣabhāvaḥ, tena vākye pratyayābhāvānna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||daṇḍaśabdo'yamasti kriyāvacanaḥ - dḍanaṃ daṇḍa iti, asti dravyavacanaḥ; viśeṣābhāvāddvayorapi grahaṇam||yadanuvartate, nānantaro yaḥ; yata eva svaritatvāt||`ṭhakṭhañorapavādaḥ` iti| nanu ca pātraṃ bhājanam, na parimāṇam, atastadvācinaṣṭhak? prāpnoti, tasyaivāpavādo yuktaḥ, tatkimucyate ṭhakṭhañorapavādaḥ? ityāha - `pātraṃ parimāṇamapyasti` iti| na kevalaṃ bhājanamityapiśabdena darśayati| tatra yadā parimāṇe pātraśabdo vartate, tadā ṭhaño'pavādaḥ; yadā bhājane, tadā ṭhakaḥ| pātraṃ sthālyādi| ko'rthaḥ? caṇḍālādirbāhraśca pātraṃ parimāṇamarhati| yena bhukte punarna saṃskāreṇa bhājanaṃ śudhyati sa pātriyaḥ, pātrya iti cocyate||`cakārādyacca` iti| athānantarasya yataḥ samuccayaḥ kasmānna bhavati? evaṃ manyate - svaratatvaṃ pratijñātamiti| anantarācca svarita āsannataraḥ| sa ca pratiyogamupatiṣṭhamāno vākyaśeṣa eva bhavati| tasmādyata eva samuccayo yukta iti| yo gaurnirguṇatvāt? khalakaṇādyanarhaḥ sa kaḍaṅgaryaḥ kaḍaṅgarīya iti cocyate| māṣādīnāṃ khaleṣvavaskaraṇālakāṣṭhamatidurjaraṃ busādyapi kaḍaṅgaramucyate| athātra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kasmānna bhavati, asti hi tasya prāptiḥ, prakṛtipratyayānāṃ sāmyāta; tathā hi - dve prakṛtau, dvau pratyayau? ityata āha - `alpāctarasya` ityādi| dakṣiṇaśabdasyālpāctarasya pūrvanipāte prāpte yo'yamiha paranipātaḥ sa lakṣaṇānapekṣatāṃ nirdeśasya darśayan? lakṣaṇavyabhicārasyacihnaṃ bhavati| atastena cihnena yathā-saṃkhyābhāvaṃ sūcayati sūtrakāraḥ| tena na bhavati yathāsaṃkhyam||`chayatāvanuvartete` iti| nanu cānukṛṣṭamuttaratra nānuvartata iti cānukṛṣṭasya yataḥ punariha cakāreṇānu-vṛttirnopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; anityā hreṣā paribhāṣā| kathaṃ jñāyate? <> [[8.4.12]] ityatra ṇe prakṛte punarṇagrahaṇāt| taddhi <> [[8.4.10]] ityanuvartamānasya vikalpasya nivṛttyarthaṃ kriyate| yadi ceyaṃ nityā syātad, pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvādeva hi tasyānuvṛttirna bhavati| atha vā - cakāropyatrānu-vartate yato'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tena pūrvatra cānukṛṣṭasyāpi tasya punariha cakāreṇānukṛṣyamāṇasyānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati| `sthālībilakaḍaṅgaradakṣiṇāccha ca` ityekayoge kartavye yadidaṃ yogavibhāgakaraṇaṃ tatsthālībilādviśeṣe vartamānāt? pratyayo yathā syādityevamartham| tena sthālomukha eva vartamānaḥ sthālīvilaśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati| na tu sthālīsambandhini cchidramātre vartamānaḥ||dvitīyāprakaraṇe punardvitoyoccāraṇamiṣṭaviṣaye dvitīyāntādyathā syādityevamartham| tena yadyapi pārāyaṇaṃ guruṇā śiṣyeṇa ca gamyate tathāpi śiṣya eva pratyayo bhavati, na gurau| tathā turāyaṇo yāgo yadyapi yajamānena yājakaiśca varttyate tathāpi yajamāna eva pratyayo bhavati, na yājake||atrāpi dvitīyāprakaraṇe punardvitīyoccāraṇamiṣṭaviṣaye dvitīyāntādyathā syādityevamartham| tena yadyapi dve api kartṛkarmaṇī saṃśayamāpanne, tathāpi yadviṣayaḥ saṃśaya utpadyate tatraiva karmaṇi sthāṇvādau pratyayo bhavati, na tu saṃśayasya kartari puruṣe; anabhidhānāt||`krośaśatayojanaśatayorupasaṃkhyānam` iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tathā tato'bhigamana-marhatīti cetyādāvapi vākye| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - iha dvitīyādhikāre punaradvitīyoccāraṇamadhikaṃ tu kurvataitat? sūcitam - anyadapyatra kiñcidadhikaṃ bhavati| tena sarvametadgaditaṃ kāryamupapannaṃ bhavati||`nityagrahaṇam` ityādi| atha vākyanivṛttyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? panthaśabdasya vākyāsamavāyitvāt| sa hi pratyayasanniyogena vidhīyate, na vākyena samavaiti| nanu ca pathinśabdena vākyaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ syāt? naitadasti; yadi tadevamarthaṃ syāt? pūrvasūtra eva kṛtaṃ syāt - yatra pathinśabdaḥ śruyate| iha tu karaṇe pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate||`cakāraḥ pratyayārtha` iti| pratyayārthasamīpe śrūyamāṇatvāt| gacchatītyatra pūrvaṃ dvitīyāntāt? pratyaya utpannaḥ| tadihāpi tata eva pratyayena bhavitavyamiti bhrāntiḥ syāt| atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `atrāpi` ityādi| cakāro hrarthāt? paraḥ śrūyamāṇo'trārthamātrasyaiva gacchatotyasyānukarṣakaḥ pratīyate, na tu vibhakterapi; sambandhābhāvāt| tasmāt? sa ihānuvṛttaḥ sannihitayā samarthavibhaktyā sambadhyamānastṛtīyāsamarthādeva pratyayamutpādayatīti bhāvaḥ| `vārijaṅgala` ityādi| vāryādayaḥ pūrvapadaṃ yasya tat? tathoktam| etayorevārthayorupasaṃkyānam| `madhukamaricayoḥ` ityādi| madhukamaricayorabhidheyayoḥ sthalāt? paro yaḥ pathinśabdaḥ, tadantādāhṛte vaktavyaḥ||kālāditi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ? pṛthagasya yogasyārambhāt| kālaśabdasyāpi yadi svarūpagrahaṇama bhīṣṭaṃ syādimaṃ pṛthagyogamakṛtvottarasūtre kālaśabdādeva tṛtīyāmuccārayet - kālena nirvṛttamiti| evaṃ hi nirdeśādeva tṛtīyāsamarthāt? pratyayo vijñāyate| uttarasūtre ca kālaśabdaḥ svaritatvādanuvarttiṣyata iti siddhamiṣṭam| ato na kartavya evāyaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ| sa eva kriyate'rthagrahaṇaṃ taditi darśayitum||`āhnikaḥ` [āhnikam-kāśikā] iti| <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] ityakāralopaḥ| ṭilopastu <> [[6.4.145]] iti niyamādiha na bhavati||<> [[2.3.5]] iti dvitīyā| `tamadhīṣṭaḥ` ityādau karmaṇi dvitīyā nopapadyate; adhyeṣyamāṇādi hi puruṣādikarmānayāniṣṭayābhihitam, na cānyā kriyā'sti yasyāṃ māsādi karma syāt|`nanu ca` ityādinā, yaduktam - <> [[2.3.5]] dvitīyeti tadvighaṭayati| tena kathaṃ māso vyāpyata iti? na kathañcit| vighaṭata ityarthaḥ| yaddhi muhūrttaṃ kriyate, tena muhūrtena māsaikadeśo vyāpyate, na tu sakalo māsaḥ| `kriyārthe` iti| adhyayanādikriyārthe| tadarthaṃ hi te kriyete| `phalabhūtayā kriyayā` iti| adhyayanādikayā| `tābyāmeva vyāpta ityucyate` iti| tadanyavyāpārasya tatropacārāt| yathā `caureṇa grāmo dagdhaḥ` ityukte na caureṇa grāmo dahrate, api tu tadāhṛtenāgninā| upacāreṇa tu tathā vyapadeśaḥ||`sāmarthyādbhūt? evātrābhisambadhyate` iti| vayasi bhūtārthasyaiva sambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| bhāvyartho'pi tatra sambhavatīti cintyametat| atha tu neṣyate, punarabhidhānaṃ śaraṇamāśrayitavyam| khaño ñitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham, vṛddhyarthañca| nanu ca vṛddha eva māsaśabdaḥ? satyaṃ vṛddho'yam, tathāpi vṛddhasyāpi vṛddhireṣitavyā| māsīnābhārya iti <> [[6.3.39]] iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedo yathā syāt||`prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantagrahaṇamaluki` iti (kāśikā| 5.1.20) tadantaviderabhyanujñānāddvigorapi - | yayaḥ pitkaraṇananudāttārtham| anyathā māsaśabdāntāt? pratyaye vihite siti śiṣṭatvāt? `igantakāla` [[6.2.29]] iti dvigāveveti svarabādhanāt? pratyayasvaraḥ syāt, - syāt| pratyaye'nudāttārthe piti `iganta` [[6.2.29]] iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ siddho bhavati||ṣaṇmāsaśabdo dviguḥ| tasmāt? pūrveṇa yapi prāpte vacanam| `sa cakāreṇa samuccetavyaḥ` iti| yadyevam, kathamanantaro yabbhavati? ityāha - `svaritatvāccānuvarttiṣyate` iti| tenānuvṛttisāmarthyādanantaro yabbhavatīti manyate||`pūrveṇa` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ samāśabdādvidhīyamānaḥ pratyayastadantāddvigoḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha - `prāgvateḥ` ityādi| gatārtham||`dvyahīnaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.145]] iti ṭilopaḥ| vibhāṣānuvartate, tena vyavasthitavibhāṣātvānna ṭajbhaviṣyati| `dvaiyahnikaḥ, traiyahnikaḥ` iti| `na yvābhyām` [[7.3.3]] ityādinaijāgamaḥ, vṛddhipratiṣedhaśca||`bhāvini tu traivarṣikaḥ` iti| tatra hi `abhaviṣyati` [[7.3.16]] iti vacanāt| ihādivṛddhireva bhavati||yadi cittavati pratyayārthe nityaṃ lugbhavati, <> [[7.3.16]] ityatra yadvakṣyati - `dve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma kariṣyatoti dvivārṣiko manuṣyaḥ` ita, tadvirudhyate; na hi nitye lukyadhīṣṭabhṛtayorutpannasya pratyayasya cittavatyabhidheya evaṃ rūpamupapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhūta evāsyotpannasya pratyayasya cittavati nityaṃ lugiṣyate, na sarvatra| kuta etat? nityagrahaṇāt| iha nityagrahaṇamanarthakameva| ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityo lugbhaviṣyatīti kiṃ niyamagrahaṇena? tat? kriyate viśiṣṭe'rthe nityo lugyathā syādityevamartham| sa punarviśiṣṭo bhūta eva||`bahuvacavāntasya nirdeśādbahuvacana eva ṣaṣṭikaśabdasya sādhutvam, nānyatra` iti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `bahuvacanamatantram` iti| apradhānamityacarthaḥ| apradhānatvaṃ tu tasya nāntarīyakatvāt| avaśyaṃ hi yena kenacidvacanena nirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ| yadyevam, ekavacanena nirdeśaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, evaṃ hi laghurbhavati? satyam; vaicitryārthaṃ bahuvacanena kṛtaḥ| yadi `ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante` ityasminnayaṃ etannipātanaṃ, mudgādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ, te'pi hi ṣaṣṭirātreṇapacyante? ityata āha - `saṃjñaiṣā` ityātadi| dhānyaviśeṣa eva hiṃ ṣaṣṭikaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena rūḍhaḥ| tenābhidhānāmmudgādiṣvatiprasaṅgo na bhavati||`parijayyaḥ` iti| pariḥ sarvatobhāve| śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ| sarvataḥ śakyo jetuṃ `parijayyaḥ` `labhyaḥ` iti, `kāryyaḥ` iti| atrāpi śakyārtha eva kṛtyau| māsena śakyo labyo māsikaḥ paṭaḥ| māsena śakyaṃ kartu sukaraṃ vā māsikaṃ cāndrāyaṇam| <> [[5.1.79]] <> [[5.1.80]] iti vibhaktitadvaye prakṛte punasteneti tṛtīyopādanāṃ dvitīyānivṛttyartham||`dvābhyāmapi sambadhyate` iti| samarthavibhaktyā, pratyayārthena ca| kathaṃ sambadhyate? ityāha - `kālasya` ityādi| iha hi dvitīyā'tyantasaṃyoge|sā hiyaḥ kālasya vyāpakastamapekṣate, nāntarayakatvāt| na hi tena vinā'tyantasaṃyoga upapadyate| brāhṛcaryaṃ ca `kālasya vyāpakam` iti| `vyāpakam` iti| vyāpakamapekṣamāṇāyāṃ vibhaktau brāhṛcaryasambandho bhavati| kathaṃ pratyayārthena sambadhyate? ityata āha - `pratyayārthasya ca svam` iti| pratyayārthaḥ pratiyogi vasaktu svamapekṣate|prakṛtatvācca brāhṛcaryasyaiva pratiyogitvaṃ vijñāyate, taddhi tasya svaṃ bhavati| ataḥ pratiyogyapekṣāyāṃ pratyayārthasyāpi brāhṛcaryeṇa sambandho bhavati| `pūrvatra` ityādinā pūrvottarayorvṛttyorviśeṣaṃ darśayati| kiṃ punaratra pramāṇamityāha - `dvayamapi` ityādi| kathaṃ punadrdhayamapi pramāṇamityāha - `ubhayathā` ityādi| ubhayasminnapi hyatrārthe sūtrametadācāryeṇa praṇītam| dvayamapi pramāṇam| `mahānāmnyādibhya` iti| brāhṛcaryaṃ evārtha idamupasaṃkhyānām| `taccarati` ityādi| taditi dvitīyāsamarthebhyo mahānāmnyādibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ `carati` ityetasminnarthe idaṃ ṭhaña upasaṃkhyānam| `tatsahacaritaṃ vrataṃ tacchabdenocyate` iti| bhavati hi sāhacaryāt? tācchabdyam, yathā - yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti| atha ṛca evocyanta ityevaṃ kasmānna vijñāyete? caraṇārthasyāyogāt| brāhṛcarya hi caryate| `caturmāsāṇṇyo yajñe` ityādi| catumasiśabdāt? tatreti saptamīsamarthādbhava ityetasminnarthe yajñe viṣaye ṇyo vaktavyaḥ| `saṃjñāyāmaṇvaktavyaḥ` iti| caturmāsādbhava ityetadapekṣate| idañca yajñādanyatropasaṃkhyānam| nanu ca `tatra bhavaḥ [[4.3.53]] ityanenāṇābhavatyeva, kimarthamupasaṃkhyāyate? satyamasti; tasya tu dvigorluganapatye` [[4.1.88]] iti lukprapnoti| ato lugbādhanārthaṃ tasyopasaṃkhyānam||athākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? na yajñebya ityucyeta? ityata āha - `ākhyāgrahaṇam` ityādi| yajñānamadheyamātrādakālavācino'pi pratyayo yathā syādityevamarthamākyāgrahaṇamiti| `itarathā hi` ityādi| yadyākhyāgrahaṇaṃ na kriyotetyarthaḥ| nanu caikāhadvādaśāhādayo naiva kālaśabdāḥ, tatkutasteṣāmevātragrahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ? athākālavācināmapyeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ sambhavati? evaṃ satyagniṣṭomādīnāmapi bhaviṣyatītyapārthakamākhyāgrahaṇam? ityata āha - `prāgvateḥ` ityādi| yadyapyete kālaśabdā na bhavanti, tathāpi prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidhirabhyanujñātaḥ| tena satyapi kālādhikāre'pyasti teṣu grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| tathā ca tatra vacanasya caritārthatvādagniṣṭomādibhyo na syāt, tebhyo'pi yathā syādityākhyāgrahaṇam| nanu caivamapi sūtramanarthakam, yā hragniṣṭomasya dakṣiṇā sāpyagniṣṭome bhavati| tatra <<bahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ>> [[4.3.67]] <> [[4.3.68]] ityeva ṭhañ? siddhaḥ| idamapi sūtraṃ ṭhañarthamevārabhyate? satyametat, kintu bhāvarthe <> [[4.3.120]] iti vivakṣite tadā paratvādaṇādayaḥ syuriti yuktaṃ vidhānam| api ca yajñākhyebhyastena ṭhañiṣyate| grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhyabhāvāt? saṃkhyāpūrvapadebhyaṣṭhañ? na labhyeta - dvayorvājapeyayorbhavā dakṣiṇā dvaivājapeyikīti| anena ca vidhānena `prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantagrahaṇamaluki` (kāśikā| 5.1.20) iti ṭhañ? siddho bhavati| athāpi kathañcit? tadantavidhirbhavārthe labhyate, tathāpi <> [[4.1.88]] iti lukprasajyeta| tasmādyuktaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ|`yathā māse bhavaṃ māsikam` ityādi| <> [[4.3.11]] iti| `prāvṛṣeṇyam` iti| <> [[4.3.17]] | `vāsantaṃ śāradam` iti| sandhivelādisūtre [[4.3.16]] ṇāṇ| `haimanam` iti| <> [[4.3.21]] iti, `sarvatrāṇca talopaśca` [[4.3.22]] iti| vatiḥ sādṛśyārthaḥ| <> [[4.2.34]] ityatraitadvyākhyātam| tata evānugantavyam| cakāraḥ kālādityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ, tena cānukṛṣṭatvāduttaratra nānuvartate, ata āha - `kālādhikārasya pūrṇo'vadhiḥ` ityādi| nanu ca yanmāse dīyate kāryaṃ ca tanmāse bhavati; māsādhāratvāt? tatsattāyāḥ| ataḥ <> [[4.3.53]] ityanenāṇaiva siddhamiti kimatideśena? evaṃ tena satyapi bhavatyarthe kāryadīyamānayoḥ kāryatāṃ dīyamānatāñca kālāntāt? taiḥ pratyayairapi khyāyayitumatideśaḥ| kiñcānena ca tatra bhavānāmapi na| tena sati tasmin? tadantavidheriṣṭatvāddvayormāsayordīyate kāryaṃ vā - dvaimāsikamiti| athāpi kathañcidbhavārthe'pi tadantavidhirgṛhrate, evamapi <> [[4.1.21]] iti luk? syāt| nanu cātrāpi vidhāne satyatideśādeva luk? prāpnoti? vacanasāmarthyān? pratyayamātrasyātideśo vijñāsyate, na sarvakāryāṇāmityadoṣaḥ||vyuṣṭaśabdo'yaṃ kālaśabdaḥ| tatsāhacaryānnityaśabdo'pi kālaśabda eva gṛhrate| nākāśādivacanaḥ| tena tatra saptamyapavādaḥ `kāladhvanoratyantasaṃyoge` [[2.3.5]] iti dvitīyā bhavati| tena saptamyadhikāre'pi nityaśabdāddvitīyāsamarthādeva pratyayaḥ| nityaṃ dīyate `naityam`| sarvakāle dīyate ityarthaḥ| `aṇprakaraṇe` ityādi| padetat? kātyāyanenoktam? `aṇprakaraṇe agnipadādibhya upasaṃkhyānam` (vā|532) ityetanna vaktavyam| kathaṃ tahrraṇ? syāt? vyuṣṭādiṣvevāgnipadādayaḥ paṭhitavyā| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā bhavavat` [[5.1.95]] ityetadihānuvartate, tenaivātrāṇapi bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi sati vyuṣṭanityaśabdābhyāṃ <> [[4.3.11]] iti ṭhañ? syāt; naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatra punarārambhasāmarthyādyaṣṭhañā bādhitaḥ sa eva bhaviṣyati| kaḥ punarasau? aṇeva| evamapi tīrthaśabdāt? dvyajṛdbrāāhṛṇādi [[4.3.72]] sūtreṇa ṭhagvihita iti tataṣṭhageva syāt| ye cātra praveśanādayo'ntodāttāḥ; tebhyaṣṭhañ? syāt? `brāhvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ [[4.3.97]] iti; tebhyo bhavārthe ṭhaño vihitatvāt| tasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||`yathāsaṃkhyaṃ neṣyate` iti| alpāctarasya hastaśabdasya paranipāto lakṣaṇavyabhicārasya vacanahetuḥ| `tṛtīyārthamātrañcātra sambhavati` iti| tṛtīyārthasya gamyamānatvāt| tathā hi - yathākathāca dattamityukte, anādareṇa dattamiti gamyate| `na tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktiḥ` iti| yathākathācaśabdasaya vākyatvāt| pratyastu vacanasāmarthyādvākyādapi bhavatyeva||`guṇotkarṣaḥ sampattiḥ` iti| sampādinītyatra prakṛtibhāgasyārthamācaṣṭe| pūrvāvasthāyā guṇātireko guṇotkarṣaḥ| `āvaśyake ṇiniḥ` iti| avaśyaṃ sampadyata iti `āvaśyakādhamarṇayorṇiniḥ` [[3.3.170]] | `viśeṣataśobhate` iti| śobhanākhyasya guṇasya pūrvāvasthāyā utkarṣādatiricyamānatvāt||`kaṇryam` iti| <> [[6.4.168]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ||`saktumāṃsaudanādvigṛhītādapi` iti| apiśabdāt, saṅghātādapi| sāktumāṃsaudanikaḥ| sāktukaḥ| māṃsikaḥ| audanikaḥ||atha kimarthaṃ taditi samarthavibhaktirnirdiśyate; yāvatā samaya iti nirdeśādeva sā dṛśyate? ityatrāha - `samarthavibhaktinirdeśa uttarārthaḥ` iti| `ṛtoraṇ` [[5.1.104]] inyevamādau prathamāsamarthādyathā syāditi uttarārthañca kriyamāṇo'trāpi vispaṣṭārtho bhaviṣyatītyatraiva kṛtaḥ; nottaratra||vasanto'sya puṣpaderṛtuḥ prāptaḥ, sa tasya janakatvāt? prayojako bhavatīti <> [[5.1.109]] iti ṭhañi prāpte satyayamārabhyate||ghasaḥ sakāraḥ `siti ca` [[1.4.16]] iti padasaṃjñārthaḥ| tena padatvena bhatve niraste `ṛtviya` iti| atra <> [[6.4.146]] iti guṇo na bhavati||`prakṛṣṭam` iti| <> [[3.3.114]] | kālasya dīrghatvamiha prakṛṣṭaśabdenocyate| atha ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā prakṛta eva ṭhañ, tatra prakṛṣṭamityetāvadeva vaktavyam? ityāha - `ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham` iti| asati hi ṭhañgrahaṇe yato'nantaratvāt? sa eva vidhīyata iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt| tasmānmandabuddhi pravaktāraṃ prati vispaṣṭārthaṃ grahaṇam||prayojayatīti prayojanam| <> [[3.3.113]] iti kartari lyuṭ||ṭhañapavādo yogaḥ| mantho'vakṣāro viloḍanadaṇḍo vā||`viśipūrī` ityādi| `viśa praveśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1824), `pūrī āpyāyane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1803), `patlṛ gatau` (dā|pā| 845) `ruha bījajanmani` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 859) - etāḥ prakṛtayo yasyānasya <> [[7.1.1]] iti yusthāne vihitasyānaḥ, tasmādvidyamānapūrvapadāccha upasaṃkhyeyaḥ| kevalasyānasya sapūrvapadatvaṃ na sambhavatīti tasya śabdasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate| gṛhapraveśanaṃ prayojanaṃ yasya tatra gṛhapraveśanaśabdo viśiprakṛtyanantaḥ, gṛhaśabdena ca sapūrvapadaḥ| yadi tarhi viśyādiprakṛtyanantācchaśabdāccha upasaṃkhyāyate, anupravacanādiṣu saṃveśanārohaṇādīnāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ; tasyaiva prapañcārthatvāt||atha padagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, sapūrvādityevocyeta? ityata āha - `padagrahaṇam` ityādi| asati hi padagrahaṇe, īṣadasamāptaṃ samāpanaṃ bahusamāpanaṃ tat? prayojanamasyeti tatrāpi prāpnoti; bhavati hrayaṃ samāpanaśabdaḥ sapūrvaḥ| padagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati; bahucapratyayasyāpadatvāt||`caure niyamārtham` iti| prakṛtatvācca ṭhaña eva| evaṃ brāuvatā ṭhañāntametannipātyata ityuktaṃ bhavati| nanu ca ṭakārānubandha evamarthamāsaṅgyate, ṅīvyatā syāditi, sa cātra ṭhañantatvādeva siddhaḥ, tat? kimarthaṃ ṭakāraḥ? ityata āha - `ṭakāraḥ` ityādi| asati hiṭakāre, yathā ṅībbhavati tathā ñitsvaro'pi - ādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| `kāryāvadhāraṇārthaṣṭakāraḥ` kriyate, tena ṅībeva bhavati, na ñitsvaraḥ| `apara ikaṭpratyayaṃ vṛdiṃdha ca nipātayanti` iti| teṣāṃ ṅībartha eva ṭakāraḥ| ekaśbado'sahāyarthaḥ, sa cāsahāyavācī draṣṭavyaḥ| asahayagrahaṇaṃ caurasya svārthe, na tūpalakṣaṇaṃ prayojanam||ādiḥ=janma, antaḥ=vināśaḥ, tayorvacanamādyantavacanam| tasmin? satyetannipātanam| `samānakālāvādyantāvasya` iti| nanu cotpadanavināśayorayaugapadyāt? samanakālatvaṃ na sambhavati, na hranena janmanāśayorekakālatā pratipadyate, kiṃ tarhi? vidyudāderanavasthāyitvapradarśanaparatvādasyetyata āha - `utpādānantaraṃ vināśinītyarthaḥ` iti| `ākālāṭṭhaṃśca` iti| yadā ṭhan? tadā - ākālikā| yadā ṭhañ? tadā - ākālikī| ākālaśabdaścāyaṃ <<āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ>> [[2.1.13]] ityavyayībhāvaḥ| ā kālādākālam - <> [[2.2.18]] iti, tatpuruṣo vā - āvṛttaḥ kāla ākāla iti||`tulyam` iti| karmapadametat, kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt| pratipāditaṃ hi prāk? kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ karmatvam? <> [[2.1.39]] iti sūtre| `brāāhṛṇena tulyaṃ vartate brāāhṛṇavat` iti| kā punaratra kriyā? brāāhṛṇena tulyaṃ vartate kṣatriyādigatā adhyayanādikā| nanu ca tasyā brāāhṛṇaniṣṭhayā'dhyayanādikriyayaiva tulyatā| na ca tāṃ brāāhṛṇaśabda āha| kiṃ tarhi? jātiṃ dravyaṃ vā| na ca tābhyāṃ kriyayā tulyatvam; svabhāvabhedāt| yatra hi kiñcit sāmānyam, kaścidviśeṣaḥ, sa viṣayastulyatāyāḥ iha tvatyantabheda eva? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi brāāhṛṇādiśabdaiḥ kriyā nocyate, tathāpyabhidheyasambandhena pratīyate, yathā - `guḍaḥ` ityukte guḍenānabhidhīyamānā api mādhuryādayaḥ| tatra brāāhṛṇādiśabdena yo'rtha ucyate tena tulyatvaṃ kriyāyā na sambhavati| ucyate cedaṃ vacanasāmarthyāt| yāsāvabhidheyana brāāhṛṇena kriyā gamyate tayā tulapyātā vijñāsyate| nanu ca tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktivācyayā kriyayaiva pratyayārthakriyāyāstulyatā, tasyāśca ghañanto'vakāśaḥ - tailapākena tulyo ghṛtapāka ityādi? naiṣo'styavakāśaḥ; ghātvartho hi kriyā, sā ca pūrvāparībhūtā| atha vā - asattvabhūtā| na ca tasyāṃ ghañādayo bhavanti, kva tarhi? tasyaiva dhātvarthasya dharme siddhatāyāmeva| ghātvarthasyāpi ghañādisthāyā bhidyate| tatkathaṃ ghañādīnāmarthaḥ kriyeti śakyate vaktum? na ca tayā ghañādivācyasiddhatayā dravyagatāyāstulyatā| na hi dravyabhūtenāsattvabhūtasya vastutulyatopapadyata ityato nāsti vacanasyāvakāśaḥ| yadi tarhi kriyā ghañādibhirnābhidhīyate - kartuṃ gamanam, bhoktuṃ pākaḥ, karakasya vrajatīti `tumuṇṇavulau kriyāyaṃ kriyārthāyām` [[3.3.10]] iti tumuṇṇvulau na prāpnutaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadatra prakṛtirūpaṃ tasya kriyaivārtha iti tadāśrayau tumuṇṇvulau bhaviṣyata ityalamatiprasaṅgena||atha kiyarthamivetyucyate, na vatyarthe sādṛśye bhaviṣyati? bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; na hi tulyagrahaṇaṃ śakyamihānuvartayitum| taddhi kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt? karma, tatra yadīha tasyānuvṛttiḥ syāt? tathābhūtasyaiva syāt| tataśca karmaṇyeva tulye pratyayaḥ syāt, tathā ca - mathurāyāmiva mathurāvat? sludhne prāsāda ityādi na sidhyet| tasmādiveti vaktavyam| akriyārthaścāyamārambhaḥ||arahatītyarthaḥ| kriyāgrahaṇamihānuvartate, tato'syāmevarhaṇakriyāyāṃ kartṛbhūtāyāṃ pratyayo vidhīyata iti| yatrāsau pratyayārthatvena vivakṣyate, tatra vākyameva bhavati - brāāhṛṇamarhatīti||upasargāḥ prādayaḥ, te caivamātmakāḥ| yatra kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prayujyate, tatra kriyāyā viśeṣakā bhavanti - āgacchati, pragacchatīti| yatra na prayujyate, tatra samādhanakriyāvācakāḥ - saṅkaṭaḥ, utkaṭa iti| kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prādīnāṃ vatyantānāṃ prayoge na prayujyate| tena sādhano dhātvartheḥ svārthaḥ| tena sādhane dhātvarthe vartamānādupasargāt? pratyayo vijñāyati ityāha - `samādhane dhātvarthe` iti| yadi hrevamātmakā upasargāḥ, dhātvarthagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam? satyametat; tat? kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| `udvataḥ, nivataḥ` iti| ucchabdāt? niśbadāt samādhane dhātvarthe vatiḥ| nanu ca vateravyayasaṃjñakatvādvibhakterluk? prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati? avyayasaṃjñāyā anityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu tasyāḥ `satyametat; tat? kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| `udvataḥ, nivataḥ` iti| ucchabdāt? niśabdāt? samādhane dhātvarthe vatiḥ| nanu ca vateravayayasaṃjñakatavādvibhakterluk? prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati? avyayasaṃjñāyā anityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu tasyāḥ `sarvamidaṃ kāṇḍaṃ svarādāvapiṃ paṭhate` ityādinā'vyayasaṃjñāprakaraṇa eva pratipāditam||bhavateranekārthatvādbhavāśabdo'yamabhiprāyādiṣvanekeṣu vartate| tatra na jñāyate-ko'trārto bhāvaśabdena vivakṣitaḥ? ityatastatparijñānārthamāha - `bhavato'smāt` iti| yasmādgotrāderviśeṣaṇatvādviśeṣye gavādau gaurityevamādikaḥ śabdo bhavati, gotvākāravatī ca buddhistena yo'rtho gavādeḥ śabdasya pravṛttanimittaṃ sa bhāvaśabdenocyate| tathā coktam - `yasya gaṇasya bhāvāddravye śabdaniveśastadabhidhāne tvatalau` iti| guṇa iti viśeṣaṇamihocyate, dravyaṃ viśeṣyam| yasya viśeṣaṇasya bhāvādvidyamānatvādviśeṣye śabdasya niveśaḥ pravṛttirbhavati, tadabhidhāne tvatalādayaḥ pratyāyaḥ bhavanti| tat? panaḥ śabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittamanekaprakāram; jātiśabdānāṃ jātiḥ - aātvamiti, guṇaśabdānāṃ guṇaḥ - śuklatvamiti, kriyāśabdānāṃ kriyā-pācakatvamiti| kecittu kriyākārakasambandhaṃ kriyāśabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittamicchanti| yadṛcchāśabdānāṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhitvamiti saṃkṣepeṇaitaduktam| vistareṇa tu bhāṣyādāvuktamiti tata evānugantavyam| atha nānātvamityādau kathaṃ pratyayo bhavati? kathaṅkāraṃ na bhavitavyam? ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāt pratyayavidhānāt, nānetyevamādīnāñcāvyayānāṃ ṣaṣṭharthenāyogāt, ayogāstu teṣāmasattvavācitvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sasattvabhūto'pyarthaḥ śabdāntareṇa pratyavamṛṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭharethena prayujyate - nānetyasya bhāva iti| tañca pratyavamṛṣṭārthaṃ vṛttireva gamayatīti nānupapannā ṣaṣṭīsamarthatā||`prathimā` iti| `turiṣṭemeyassu` [[6.4.154]] iti, `ṭeḥ` [[6.4.155]] iti ṭilopaḥ| `ra ṛtohalāderlaghoḥ` [[6.4.161]] iti ṛkārasya rephaḥ, <> [[6.4.8]] iti dīrghaḥ| `pārthavam` iti| <> [[5.1.131]] ityaṇ| `apavādaiḥ` ityādi| imanicprabhṛtīnapavādastvitalorvakṣyati, taiḥ saha tayoḥ samāveśaḥ| ekaviṣayatā yathā syādityevamarthamidam| nanu ca svaritatvādanuvartamānāvanuvṛttisāmarthyādevāpavādaviṣaye'pi bhaviṣyataḥ? naitadasti; asti hranuvṛtteḥ prayojanam, kiṃm? <> [[5.1.124]] iti karmaṇyapi yathā syātām; itarathā hi bhāve vidhīyamānau karmaṇi na syātām| `karmaṇi ca` ityādi| nanu cānuvṛttisāmarthyādeva karmaṇyapi bhaviṣyataḥ?
