naitadasti; asti hranyadanuvṛtteḥ prayojanam, kim? apavādaviṣaye'pi yathā syātām| tasmasatvasati na syātām, asmastu satyetadubhayamapi labhyate| `cakāraḥ` ityādi| yadi cakāro na kriyeta tato'traiva prakaraṇe ye'pavādāstaireva samāveśaḥ syāt, na nañsnañbhyām; tayoranyatara vihitatvāt| cakāre tvapavādasamuccayārthe sati sarvāpavādaviṣaye tvatalau labhyete| tena strīpuṃsābhyāmapi siddhau bhavataḥ| yadyevam, anyeṣvartheṣu sāvakāśau nañsnañau bhāve na sidhyataḥ, tvallabhyāṃ bādhyamānatvāt? naiṣaḥ doṣaḥ; `bhavanāt` ityavadhyupādānasāmarthyādbhāve'pi bhaviṣyataḥ; itarathā hi bhāvameva vidhitvenopādadīta||adhikāro'yam| tenottareṣāṃ bhāvapratyayānāṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate; na tvataloriti matvā''-`ita uttare ye bhāvapratyayāḥ` ityādi| na tu <> [[5.1.122]] ityevamādiṃbhiryogaiḥ parigaṇitābhya eva prakṛtibhyaḥ pratyayo vidhīyate| na ca tatra kācit? prakṛtirnañpūrvā gṛhrate, na ca tadantavidhirasti; grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt| tasmāt tatra nañpūrvāt? prāptirnāstīti nāstyasyopayogaḥ? satyam; yatra tvantagrahaṇ - <> [[5.1.128]] ityevamādiṣu yogeṣvasti, yatra ca svarūpagrahaṇaṃ nāsti <> [[5.1.132]] ityevamādiṣu, tatra nañpūrvādapi prāptirastīti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| `apatitvam` iti| nañsamāse kṛta uttarakālaṃ patyantādabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ <> [[5.1.128]] ityādinā yagna bhavati| `apaṭutvam` iti| `iganta` [[5.1.131]] ityaṇ? na bhavati| `aramaṇīyatvam` iti| `yopadāt` [[5.1.132]] ityādinā vuñ? na bhavati| nāsya paṭavaḥ santītyapaṭuriti bahuvrīhirayam, tenāsmādigantalakṣaṇo'ṇ? bhavati - `āpaṭavam` iti| `ācaturyam` iti| brāāhṛṇāditvāt? ṣyañ| nanu ca nañsamāsā brāāhṛṇādiṣu na ṣaṭhante, tatkutastena ṣyañ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ākṛtigaṇo hi brāāhṛṇādiriṣyate| acaturādipratiṣedha evākṛtigrahaṇasya jñāpakam||pṛthvādiṣu ya igantā laghupūrvāḥ pṛthumṛduprabhṛtayaḥ, teṣāmaṇi prāpte; ye guṇaśabdāḥ khaṇḍa caṇḍa - ityevamādayaḥ, teṣāṃ ṣyañi; ye vayovacanāḥ - bāla vatsa - ityevamādayaḥ, teṣāṃ <<prāṇabhṛjjātivayovacanodgātrādibhyo'ñ>> [[5.1.129]] ityādināñi sarveṣāmapavāda imanijvidhīyate| `vāvacanam` ityādi| ādiśabdenaṣyañādīnāmupasaṃgrahaḥ| vākyārthaṃ tu vāvacanaṃ na bhavati; mahāvibhāṣayaiva vākyasya siddhatvāt||bahuvacanaṃ prateyakamabhisambadhyate - varṇebhyo dṛḍhādibhyaśceti; tena bahuvacananirdeśādvarṇaśabdena varṇavācināṃ grahaṇamiti vijñāyate, na svarūpagrahaṇe tu varṇaśabdamapi dṛḍhādiṣu evādhīyīta| varṇaśabdaśca guṇaviśeṣasya vācakaḥ; na brāāhṛṇādīnām| kutaḥ? dṛḍhādibhirguṇavacanaiḥ sāhacaryāt| ata evāha-dṛḍhādibhiḥ sāhacaryādrūpaviśeṣā eva śuklādayaḥ pratyayamutpādayanti, na tu svarūpaśabdāḥ, nāpi tatparyāyāḥ| katham? dṛḍhādayo hi guṇā upasarjanaṃ dravye vartante| tatsāhacaryādvarṇaśabdā api tatsadṛsā eva gṛhyante| na varṇaśbadasya tatparyāyāṇāṃ vā tādṛśī vṛttirasti; guṇamātravacanatvāt| varṇadṛḍhādīnāṃ guṇavacanatvādeva siddhe punarvacanamimanijartham| yadyevam, ṣyañgrahaṇanarthakam, imanijeva vidheyaḥ, sa ca vibhāṣayaiva prakṛtaḥ? taducyate; avasyaṃ ṣyañgrahaṇamuttarārtha kartavyam| tatra vā kriyata iha veti nāsti viśeṣaḥ| `śuklimā` iti| pūrvavaṭṭilopaḥ| `draḍhimā` iti| pūrvadṛkārasya rabhāvaḥ| `aucito, yathākāmī` iti| <<ṣidgaurādibhyaśca>> [[4.1.41]] iti ṅīṣ| <> [[6.4.150]] iti yalopaḥ| `veyatilābhamatimanaḥśāradānām` iti paṭhate| tasyāyamarthaḥ - viśabdāduttareṣāṃ yātādīnāṃ pratyayābhavantīti| viyātatvam, viyātatā, viyātimā, vaiyātyam| vilābhatā, vilābhatvam, vailābhyam, vilābhimā| vimatitvam, vimatitā, vaimatyam, vimatimā, `igantāt` [[5.1.130]] ityaṇ, vaimatam| vimanasatvam, vimanastā, vimanimā, vaimanasyām| viśāradatvam, viśāradatā, vaiśāradyam, viśāradimā| `samo matimanasoḥ` iti| sama uttarayormatimanasoḥ pratyayo bhavati| saṃmatitā, saṃmatitvam, saṃmatimā, sāṃmatyam| saṃmanastvam| saṃmanastā, saṃmanimā, sāṃmanasyam||<> [[4.3.120]] iti śaiṣikeṣu prāpteṣu karmaṇi ṣyañvidhānam, cakāradbhāve ca| `karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ` ita| sādhanakarmavacanaśaṅkāmapākaroti| ye hi jaḍādiśabdāḥ guṇaśabdāḥ, gumavacanāḥ, brāāhṛṇādayaśca teṣāṃ sādhanakarmaṇā sambando na sambhavati; kriyāvācakatvābhāvāt| tasmāt? kriyāśabda eva karmaśabdaḥ| `brāāhṛṇādirākṛtigaṇaḥ` iti| avṛtkṛtatvāt| `ādiśabdaḥ prakāre` [`prakāravacanaḥ` - kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| evaṃ prakārebhyaḥ ṣyañ? bhavatītyevamarthamādiśabdaḥ prakaravacanatvaṃ bodhayati| yadyevam, guṇavacanagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikeṣu ca brāāhṛṇādīnāmanukramaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? nānarthakam; prapañcārtha hi tat? svārthe vidhānārthañca| tatra brāāhṛṇaśabdāt? <<prāṇabhṛjjātivayovacanodgātrādibhyo'ñ>> [[5.1.129]] iti jātivacanatvādañi prāpte tadbādhanārthaṃ ṣyañvidhīyate| māṇavavāḍavābhyāṃ gotralakṣaṇe vuñi| `arhato num? ca` iti| asya numarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ - arhantyam| coradhūrtābhyāṃ manojñāditvādvuñi prāpte| ārādhaya, virādhaya, aparādhaya - ityetebhyo'patyavivakṣāyāṃ <> [[4.1.168]] , tasya <> [[4.1.175]] iti luk| tato gotravuñi prāpte pāṭhaḥ| ekabhavādīnāmanyabhāvaparyantānāṃ svārthe vidhānārtham| akṣetrajñaśabdasya ` nañpūrvāt` [[5.1.120]] iti pratiṣedhe prāpte| prāgbāliśaśabdāt? kuśalādīnāṃ yudāditvādaṇi prāpte| bāliśaśabdo vayovacanaḥ, tasmādvayolakṣaṇe'ñi prāpte| anīāraśabdasya `na nañpūrvāt` [[5.1.120]] iti pratiṣedhe prāpte| `alasa` iti bahuvrīhiḥ ṣyañamutpādayati, tatpuruṣāttu, `na nañpūrvāt` [[5.1.120]] iti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam; tasya prapañcārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| rājanśabdasya purohitaditvādyaki prāpte| `saṃvādin` `saṃveśin`, `bahubhāṣin, `śīrṣadhātin`, `sayastha`, `paramastha`, `duṣpuruṣa` - ityevamādīnāṃ nañpūrvārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| `gaṇapati`, `adhipati` - ityetayoḥ patyantalakṣaṇe yaki prāpte| `gaḍula`, `dāyāda`, `viśasti` - ityeteṣāṃ tvatalornivṛttyarthaḥ| śeṣāṇāṃ prapañcārthaḥ| guṇavacanā eke rāśiḥ, brāāhṛṇādayo dvitīyaḥ, tābhyāṃ bhāve karmaṇi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti, tat? kasmānna bhavati? brāhṛṇādiśabdasyālpāctarasya paranipātāt| sa hi lakṣaṇe nirapekṣatāṃ nirdeśasya jñāpayan? yathāsaṃkyalakṣaṇānapekṣatāmapi bodhayati, tena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati||`dūtavaṇigbhyāñca` ityādi| dūtavaṇigbhyāṃ yo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ - `dūtavaṇigbhyāñca` ityādi| dūtavaṇigbhyāmapi bhavati||kapiśabdāt? <> [[5.1.131]] ityaṇi prāpta idaṃ vidhīyate| `yathāsaṃkhyam` ityādi| tatra <> [[5.1.124]] ityatra yatāsaṃkhyābhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ| ihāpi pratipādyate| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - atra cakāro'nuvartate, sa caikasyāḥ prakṛterbhāve karmaṇi ca ḍhagviṃdhiṃ samuccinoti| tena yathāṃsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati; anyathā hi samucyayo nopapadyate| asvaritatvādvā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhaviṣyati, pratipāditaṃ hi pūrvam - `svaritatvena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati` iti| na ceha yathāsaṃkhyārthaṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate||patyantāt? pūrvavadaṇi prāpte, purohitādiṣu rājaśabdarādbrāāhṛṇādipāṭhāt? ṣyañi, śeṣebyastvataloryagvidhīyate| `rājāse` iti| rājaśabdādase=asamāse yagbhavati - rājyamiti| samāse tu brāāhṛṇāditvāt? ṣyañeva bhavati - ādhirājyamiti| nanu ca kevalo rājaśabdo brāāhṛṇādiṣu paṭhate, tetkathamadhirājaśabdāt? tadantavidhinā; etadeva jñāpakamasa iti vacane - astauhi prakaraṇe rājaśabdena tadantavidhiriti| iha patyantapurohitādī iti dvau rāśī, arthāvapi bhāvakarmaṇī dvāveveti sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti; tadasvaritatvāt? pūrvavanna bhavati||prāṇabṛtaḥ prāṇina ucyante, teṣāṃ jātiḥ prāṇabhṛjjātirityarthaḥ| tadvācino yatāsambhavaṃ tvatalādiṣvañvidhīyate| prāṇabhṛdgrahaṇāt? tṛṇādiśabdebhyo na bhavati-tṛṇatvam, tuṇateti| jātigrahaṇāddevadattādiśabdebhyo na bhavati - devadattatvam, devadattatā| yadigantaṃ laghupūrvaṃ ca tasmāt? paratvādaṇbhavati| `taittiram` iti| vayovacanādapi yathāyogaṃ tvatalādiṣveva prāpteṣvañvidhānam| vacanagrahaṇaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārtham; anyathā vayaḥśabdādeva syāt| tatrodgātrādiṣu `udgāt, unnatṛ, adhvayuityeteṣāmṛtvigvacanāt? <> [[5.1.135]] iti cche prāpte satyañarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| suṣṭhu, duṣṭhu, vadhū - ityeteṣāṃ laghupūrvalakṣaṇe'pi prāpte| `subhagamantre` iti| subhagaśabdo mantraviṣaye'ñamutpādayati - mahate saubhāgāya| `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante` (pu|pa|vṛ| 56) iti| `hmadbhagasindhvanta` [[7.3.19]] ityuttarapadavṛddhirna bhavati| mantra iti kim? saubhāgyam, brāāhṛṇāditvāt| śeṣaṇāmiha pāṭhastvataloḥ prāptayoḥ||hāyanāntāt? tvataloḥ prāptayoraṇvidhānam| nanu ca <> [[4.3.120]] ityanena hāyanāntādaṇa siddhaḥ? na sidhyati; paratvāt? tvatalbhyāṃ bādhyate - āṣāḍhahāyaṇasya bhāvaḥ karma vā āṣāḍhahāyaṇa iti <> [[4.2.114]] prasajyeta| tasmādyuktaṃ hāyanāntādaṇvidhānam| `yauvanam` iti| `an` [[6.4.167]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| yuvādiṣu yuvaśabdasya vayolakṣaṇaṃ badhitvā manojñāditvādvuñi prāpte pāṭhaḥ| sthaviraśabdasya vayolakṣaṇe'ñi hotṛśabdasyāpyudgātrāditvādañeva| `puruṣāse` iti| puruṣaśabdādasamāse'ṇ| bhavati - pauruṣam| asa iti kim? rājapuruṣatvam| asya <<prāṇabhṛjjātivayovacanodgātrādibhyo'ñ>> [[5.1.129]] ityaprāpte pāṭhaḥ| kamaṇāḍaluśabdasyegantatvādevāṇi siddhe tvatalorbādhanārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| `hmadayāse` iti| hmadayaśabdādasamāse'ṇ? bhavati| hādrdam, <> [[6.3.50]] iti hmadbhāvaḥ| asa iti kim? hmadayaśabdādasamāse'ṇ? bhavati| hādrdam,<> [[6.3.50]] iti hmadbhāvaḥ| asa iti kim? paramahmadayatvam| kuśalādīnāṃ kṣetrajñaparyantānāṃ brāāhṛṇāditvāt? ṣyañi prāpte pāṭhaḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ tu tvataloḥ| nanu ca grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidherabhāvāt? samāsādaṇprāptireva nāsti, tadaparthakaḥ `puruṣāse`, `hmadayāse` iti ca pratiṣedhaḥ? nāpārthakaḥ, eṣā hi viṣayasaptamī - samāse cikīrṣite viṣayabhūta eva puruṣaśabdahmadayaśabdāviti| yadi pratiṣedho nocyeta, tato nañsamāsasya bhāvapratyayasya cāṇo yugapatprasaṅge paratvādaṇeva syāt| pratiṣedhāttu samāsa eva tāvadbhavati| tato yasya bhāvapratyayasya nimittamasti sa utpadyate| kaścāsau? tvatalau - apuruṣatvam, apuruṣatā; ahmadayatvam, ahmadayatā| iha hāyanānta ekaraśiḥ, yuvādidrva#itīyaḥ; arthāvapi dvāveva - bhāvakarmaṇī, tena sāmarthyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti; tadalpāctarasya yuvādiśabdasya paranipātalakṣavyabhicāracihnānna bhavati| asvaritatvādvā||`igantāt` iti| ik? anto yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| prātipadikamanyapadārthaḥ| `laghupūrvagrahaṇe` ityādi| athegeva kasmānna viśeṣyate? tasya bahuvrīhrarthe guṇabhūtatvādviśeṣaṇena sambandhasya karttumaśakyatvāt| pūrvaśabdo'yaṃ vyavasthāśabdatvādaparamapekṣate| iha cāparasyānirdiṣṭatvānna jñāyate - kuto laghuḥ pūrvaḥ? tatparijñānāya pṛcchati - `kutaḥ punarasau laghuḥ pūrvaḥ` iti| pratyāsattinyāyamāśrityāha - `sannidhānāt` ityādi| sannidhānaṃ tviha sūtre ikaḥ; śrutatvāt| `tena` iti| antabhūtena laghupūrveṇekāntagrahaṇamitiricyata iti; niṣphalatvāt| yato hi `laghupūrvāt` ityukte ca prātipadikasya tadantavidho sati sāmarthyādeva tasyāntatvaṃ labhyata ityapārthakamantagrahaṇamasmin? vyākhyāne| pūrvake tu vidhāne, antagrahaṇe'sati `laghupūrvegvataḥ` ityeva vidhinirdeśo vijñāyate, tataścānantasyāpīko vidhitvaṃ syāt| tadā laśunalakuṭaprabhṛtibhyo'pi pratyayaprasaṅga ityevamarthamantagrahaṇam| `kathaṃ kāvyam` iti| anyathā bhavitavyam; kaviśabdasya laghupūrvogantatvādityabhiprāyaḥ||tvatalādiṣu prāpteṣu vuñvidhīyate| uttamaśabdo'yamihāvyutpannaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhrate; tatsvabhāvāt? triprabhṛtīnāmantyamāheti matvā''ha - `triprabhṛtīnāmantyam` ityādi| tamapratyayāntasya tu grahaṇe sati `aṇioranārṣayoḥ` [[4.1.78]] ityādau sutāre yo doṣa uktaḥ, sa ihāpi tadanusāreṇa veditavyaḥ| uttamasya samīpamupottamam, `avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpa` [[2.1.6]] ityavyayībhāvaḥ||dvandvāt? tvatalādiṣu prāpteṣu vuñvidhīyate| manojñādiṣu yo guṇavacanastasmāt? ṣyañi, cauradhūrtaśabdābhyāmapi brāāhṛṇāditvāt? ṣyañyeva; yuvaśabdādyavāditvādaṇi, śeṣebhyastvataloḥ| `amuṣyaputraḥ` iti| nipātanādvibhakteraluk| iha dvandvamanojñādī dvau rāśī, pratyayārthāvapi bhāvakarmaṇī dvāveva - iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prpnoti, tatpūrvavadasvaritatvānna bhavati| atha vā - cakāro'tra samuccayārthaḥ kriyate| tasya cānyatsamuccetavyaṃ nāstīti vuñvidhimeva pratyekaṃ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ samuccinoti| tenaikasmādrāśerbhāve karmaṇi ca vuñ? bhavati, na tu yathāsaṃkhyam; anyathā hi samuccayo nopapadyate||apatyanimittā samākhyā gotrakhyā, sā ca pravarādhyāye paṭhate| yā ca vedādhyayanaprayuktān? puruṣānācaṣṭe sā caraṇaśabdasyākhyā| `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha` (ma|bhā|, 2|225) iti pāribhāṣikaṃ gotracaraṇayorjātitvamiti <<prāṇabhṛjjātivayovacanodgātrādibhyo'ñ>> [[5.1.129]] ityādinā'ñi prāpte vuño vidhānam| iha gotracaraṇavācinī dve prātipadike, arthāvapi dvāveva - tatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti, tat? pūrvapadasvaritatvānna bhavati| ata evāha - `pratyekaṃ bhāvakarmaṇorarthayoḥ` iti| `ślāghādiṣu viṣayabhūteṣu` iti| tathā hi na bhāvaḥ ślāghādīnāmanyatamo'pi bhavitumarhati| śabdapravṛttinimittaṃ bhāvaḥ| na ca gotracaraṇaśabdānāṃ ślāghādayaḥ pravṛttinimittaṃ bhavati| karmāpi naiva ślāghādisvabhāvaṃ bhavati| na hi gotracaraṇānāṃ ślāghādayaḥ karmatayā rūḍhāḥ, yathā - agnestāpādayaḥ; kriyārūpatvātteṣām| sādhyatayā bhāvakarmaṇoḥ pratyayārthatayā viṣayabhūteṣu vuñ? bhavati| `tadavetastatprāptaḥ` iti| iṇo'tra gatyarthatvāt| `tajjñāto vā` iti| avapūrvasyeṇo jñāne'pi vṛttisambhavāt| tacchabdena ceha gotracaraṇayoḥ sambandhinī bhāvakarmaṇaii pratinirdiśyete| `gārgikayā` iti| <<āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti>> [[6.4.151]] iti yalopaḥ||tvataloḥ prāptayoścho vidhīyate||`neti vaktaye` iti| chapratyaye'pyapavāde pratiṣiddhe tvapratyayaḥ| `tasya bhāvastvatarlau [[5.1.118]] ityeva sidhyati| tasmānnetyeva vaktavye yadetadvacanaṃ tattvena talo bādhanaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| yadi netyucyate; tadā cche pratiṣiddhe yathā tvo bhavati tathā talapi syāt| tvavacane tu talo bādhā siddhā bhavati|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ pañcamādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ|| - - - atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥdvitīyaḥ pādaḥ`bhavanti jāyante'sminniti bhavanam` iti| adhikaraṇe lyuṭ| jāyanta utpadyanta ityarthaḥ| etenotpattivacano bhavatiratra gṛhrate, na sattāvacanaḥ tasya hi grahaṇe satyanyatra cotpannānāṃ yatra sthāpanaṃ paścādyatra sthāpyante tatrāpi prasajyeta| yadi taddhyutpattivacano bhavatirgṛhrate, kṣetragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tatra mudgānāṃ bhavanaṃ kusūla ityatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate| na cotpattivacanasya bhavategrrahaṇe sati kusūle prasaṅgaḥ, na hrasau mudgādīnāmutpatteradhikaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi? sattāyāḥ; naitadasti; sati hi kṣetragrahaṇe bhavatiratrotpattivacano bhavati| katham? kṣetraśabdo hrayaṃdhānyānāmutpattyādhāramācaṣṭe| tena tasya grahame sati sattāṃ prati na bhūmiḥ kṣetravyapadeśamāsādayatīti yuktaṃ tadutpattau bhavatirvartata iti| kṣetragrahaṇe tvasati, bhavatiḥ sattāvacano'pi gṛhrate| tathā kusūle'pi prasajyeta| api ca - bhavanaśabdo rūḍhaā gṛhavacano'payasti, so'pi kṣetraśabdena nivatryata iti| atha kathaṃ ṣaṣaṭhī samarthavibhaktirupādīyate, yāvatā <> [[5.1.119]] ityataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamarthavibhaktiranuvartata iti tataiva siddham| evaṃ tahrretajjñāpayati - pūrve pratyaya#ā nāvaśyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādbhavantīti| tena <> [[5.1.135]] iti| hotrāyāḥ prathamāsamarthayāḥ svārthe cchaḥ siddho bhavati - hotraiva hotrīyamiti| evañca caturvarṇādibhyaḥ prathamāsamarthebhyaḥ svārtheṣyañ? siddho bhavati||`khañi prāpte vacanam, pakṣe so'pi bhavati` iti| yuktaṃ yat? pakṣe tilamāṣāṇubhyaḥ khañ? bhavatīti; teṣāṃ dhānyatvāt| umābhaṅgayostvadhānyatvāt? khañ? pākṣiko na yuktaḥ| yadeva hi `tilāśca me yavāśca me` ityādiṣu vedavākyeṣu paṭhate tadeva dhānyam| yāvādaya evu mantre paṭhante, nomābhaṅge| yadi tayorapi dhānyatvaṃ syāt? te api paṭhayātām, tato'vagamyate na tayordānyatvām, evañca na khañastābhyāṃ prāptirasti, yataḥ so'pi pakṣe syādityevāha - `umābhaṅgayoḥ` ityādi| śaṇasaptadaśamudgāni dhānyānīti smṛtiḥ| tatra śaṇādiṣu madhya umābhaṅge api dhānyatvena saṃkhyāyete iti tayordhānyatvamāśritameva| yastu punarvede tayorapāṭhaḥ; sa vaidikakarmaṇyanupayogāt| ato na tatrāpāṭhādadhānyatvamityabhiprāyaḥ||iha kṛtaḥ pratyayārthaḥ| tatra carmaṇaḥ karaṇatvaṃ syāt, kartṛtvaṃ vā| tatra yadi karaṇatvaṃ tadā niyataṃ karaṇalakṣaṇayā tṛtīyayā bhavitavyam| atha karttṛtvameva `na loka` [[2.3.69]] ityādinā ṣaṣṭhaāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ karttṛlakṣaṇā tṛtīyaiva| tasmāt? pratyayārthasāmarthyālabhyā tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktiriti matvā''ha - `tṛtīyāsamarthāt` iti| sa ca sarvacarmaṇa iti nirdeśaḥ sarvaśabdasya carmaśabdena samāsaṃ kṛtvā kṛtaḥ| tataḥ `carmaṇaivāsya sambandho na hayanyatā samāsa upapadyate` iti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha - `sarvaśabdaścātra` ityādi| yadyevam, asāmarthyāt? samāso na prāpnoti? ityata āha - `tatrāyam` ityādi| asmādeva nipātanādityabhiprāyaḥ| atha carmaṇaivabhisambandhaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? ityāha - `sarvaścarmaṇā kṛtaḥ` iti| atra hi vākyārthe taddhitavṛttiriṣyati| tathā hrayameva vākyārthastaddhitānugataḥ pratīyate| asmaścārthe vākyārtha evaṃ taddhitavṛttirlabhyate, yadi sarvaśabdaḥ kṛtena sambadhyate na carmaṇā| yadi sarvaśabdaścarmaṇā sambadhyate, sarvacarmaṇā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā syāt, karmadhārayo vā; tatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāse taddhitāntāt? sarvasambandhinā carmaṇā kṛta ityeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate| karmadhāraye tu sarvacarmaṇā kṛta ityeṣo'rthaḥ| na cāyaṃ dviṣprakāro yastaddhitāntādavasīyate, api tu sarvacarmaṇā kṛta ityayameva| tasmādaśakyaḥ sarvaśabdasya carmaṇā sambandho vijñātumiti kṛtenaiva sambandho yuktaḥ||`dṛśyate'sminniti darśanaḥ` iti| adhikaraṇe lyuṭ| `yathāmukham` iti| `yathā'sādṛśye` [[2.1.7]] ityavyayībhāvaḥ| mukhasya sadṛśaṃ yathāmukham| kiṃ punastat? ādarśāśrayaṃ pratibimbam| nanu ca `asādṛśye` iti pratiṣedhānnātra samāsena bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `nipātanāt` ityādi| samāsaścāyaṃ pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ| pūrvapadaṃ cāsattvavacanamiti prathamāsamarthādeva pratyaya upapadyate| atha vā - <<nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ>> [[2.4.83]] iti jñāpakādavyayībhāvāddvitīyādayo bhavantītyato dvitīyāsāmarthyāt? pratya upapadyate| `yathāmukhaṃ yatāmukhīnaḥ` iti| mukhasadṛsya darśanaḥ` iti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| yatrā''darśādau sarva mukhaṃ dṛśyate sa evamucyate||atha sūtra dvitīyāntaprakṛtyuccāraṇaṃ kimartham? taditi dvitīyāsāmarthyāt? pratyayo yathā syāt| atha vā - pathyaṅgakarmapattrapātramiti naiveyaṃ dvitīyā, na hi vyāpnotikriyayā pathyādayaḥ sambadhyante, kiṃ tarhi? sarvādi| tasmāt? tasyaiva karmatvam, na pathyādīnāṃ tadavayavānām| tat? kutaḥ? na sā dvitīyā, subvyatyayena pañcamyāḥ sthāne prathamā tveṣā| tasmāt? samāhāradvandvasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvāt? `ato'm` [[2.4.83]] ityabhbhāvaḥ kṛtaḥ| `pariśiṣṭam` iti| `sarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapattrapātram` ityetacca| sarvādeḥ prātipadikasya pathyādayaścādau na bhavanti| tataḥ sāmarthyāt? tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha - `pathyaṅgakarmapattrapātrāntāt` iti| `sarvapathīnaḥ` iti| sarvaścāsau panthāśceti `pūrvakāla` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā samāsaḥ, `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe` [[5.4.74]] ityakāraḥ samāsāntastadataḥ| nanu ca samāsānte kṛte pathyantameva na bhavati? yadatra pathyantaṃ tadāśrayo vidharirbhavatītyadoṣaḥ| nanu ca vyavadhānānna prāpnoti? antagrahaṇāt? samāsāntāḥ samāsagrahaṇena gṛhranta iti nāsti vyavadhānam||`tayoravyayībhāvaḥ` iti| <<āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ>> [[2.1.13]] ityanana| `śarīreṇāsambaddhasyāpi paṭasya pramāṇamākhyātam` iti| prāptiyogyatāmupādāya hi yogyo'sāvāprapadāccharīraṃ prāptum| atha vyāptiprāptyoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ, yena vyāpnotīti kṛte prāpnotītyuktam? sambandhamātraṃ prāptiḥ, sambandha eva sākalyena vyāptirityeva viśeṣaḥ||`anurāyāme` ittayādi| yadāyāme tadā <> [[2.1.16]] iti samāsa-| yadā sādṛśye tadā `yatārte yadavyayam` tena `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādinā| yatā padamāyataṃ tathā ca `baddhopānadanupadīnā`| sādṛśye yathānupadaṃ tatā baddhā'nupadīnā| `padapramāṇetyarthaḥ` iti| yadāpyanu sādṛśye, tadāpyayamartha veditavyaḥ, tulyapramāṇatayaiva sādṛśyam| `ayaḥ pradakṣiṇam` iti| ayanamayaḥ, gamanamityarthaḥ| pradakṣiṇaṃ gamanamaya ityucyeta| `anayaḥ prasavyam` iti| ayaviparītaṃ prasavyamanaya ityucyate| evamavayavārthaṃ darśayitvā samudāyārthaṃ darśayitumāha - `pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāminām` ityādi| bahuvacanamayānayanimittapradarśanārtham| yadi śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ prasavyaṃ ca gacchantyevamayānayau bhaktaḥ, nānyathā| tatrātmoyāḥ śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ gacchanti, parakīyāḥ prasavyam| teṣāmevaṅgāmināṃ yānisthānāni teṣāṃ yasmin? pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanātmake gativiśeṣe sati parairvipakṣabhūtaiḥ śārairasamāveśaḥ=anadhyāsanamanākramaṇaṃ so'yānaya ityucyate; na tu pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanamātre sa evāyam| evaṃrūpo'yānayo yadā samahāyaiḥ śārauḥ padānyadhiṣṭhīyante tadā veditavyaḥ| sasahāyānāmeva hi śārāṇāṃ padāni parairna śakyanta#e'dhyāsitum| asahāyānāṃ tu śakyata eva| `phalakaśirasi sthitaḥ` iti| yatra phalake'ṅka'kṣairdīvyanti tasya śirobhūtaṃ yatra sthānaṃ kiṃtavānāṃ prasiddhaṃ tatra sthitaḥ śāraḥ `ayānayīnaḥ` ityucyate; tatraivāyānayīnaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt| apare tu, neyo netavyaḥ, na notastataḥ| tatra `śirasi sthitaḥ` ityarthānupapatteḥ `phalakaśirasi sthāpyate` ityartha iti granthena bhavitavyamityāhuḥ| nīto vā neyaḥ; tadupalakṣaṇatvāt| bhāvinyāvasthayoktaḥ| ayānayasambandhitve'pi sarveṣāṃ viśeṣyādeva pratyayotpattiruktaiva| satyapi dvitīyādhikāre punardvitīyoccāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭādddhitīyāntādyathā syādityevamartham| tena viśiṣṭārthaneyavacanādayānayaśabdādddhitīyāntātad? pratyayo bhavati, na neyavacanamātrāt| sa eva viśiṣṭo yo nayaḥ pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmītyādinā granthena darśitaḥ| athāyānya iti ko'yaṃ śabdaḥ, yadi hrayaṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ, tasya napuṃsakatvādayānayamiti bhavitavyam? athetaretarayoge, dvyarthatvādayānayāviti bhavitavyam? nāyaṃ dvandvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt? tatpuruṣaḥ - ayasahito'nayo'yānaya iti| atha baddhābhakṣayatineyeṣviti kathaṃ tiṅantasya dvandvaḥ? kaḥ punarāhāyaṃ dvandva iti? yadi na dvandvaḥ, kathaṃ neyeṣviti bahuvacanam? sautratvānnirdeśasya| subvyatyayena vā cchandasyekavacanasya sthāne bahuvacanamupapannam| nanu cchandasi subvyatyaya uktaḥ, nedaṃ chandaḥ? `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti` (ma|bhā| 1-1-1) ityadoṣaḥ| atha vā; dvandva evāyam, na tu tiṅantasya| na hi bhakṣayatiśabdo'yaṃ tiṅantaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? tiṅantapratirūpako nipātastiṅantena samānārthaḥ, yathā - astikṣīrā brāāhṛṇītyatrāstiśabdaḥ||kathaṃ punarapratyayasanniyogena nipātanasya vinā pratyayena darśanamupapadyate? ityāha - `tacchabdāntarameva draṣṭavyam` iti||`gāmī` iti| `āvaśyakādhamaṇryayorṇiniḥ` [[3.3.170]] ityāvaśyakārthe ṇiniḥ| bhaviṣyati cāyaṃ kāle gāmiśabdo vartate, yadāha - `gamiṣyatīti gāmī`| sā ca bhaviṣyati vṛttiḥ <> [[3.3.3]] iti vacanāllabhyate; ityāha - `bhaviṣyati` ityādi| `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamaṇryayoriti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ` iti| tena dvitīyāsamarthatopapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| kṛdyogā hi ṣaṣṭhī dvitīyāyā apavādaḥ, tena ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhe hi sati dvitīyayaiva bhavitavyam| `avārapāram` iti| avārasya pāramiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam| vā ca ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pūrvanipāto vaktavyaḥ| tena pakṣe pārāvāramityapi bhavati| `vigṛhītādapi` iti| [`bhavati`-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] `viparītācca` iti| kathaṃ punaradhikārādeva dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāmihādhikaṃ dvitīyopādānaṃ kṛtam? etena tadadhikasya vidhirbhavatīti sūcitam| tena vigṛhītādviparītācca pratyaya upapadyate| `atyantam` iti| antasyābhāvo'tyayo veti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādinā'vyayībhāvaḥ| atha vā - antamatikrāntamiti `kugati` [[2.2.18]] ityādinā tatparuṣaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇañcaitat| `bhṛśaṃ gantetyarthaḥ` iti| bhṛśārthatvena loke'tyantaśabdasya prasiddhatvāt| `anukāmam` iti| kāmasadṛśamanukāmam| kāmanurūpamityarthaḥ| yathārthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| idamapi kriyāviśeṣaṇameva||`samāṃ samāsa` iti| <> [[8.1.4]] iti vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam| ata āha - `samāṃsamāmiti vīpsā` iti| `subantasamudāyaḥ prakṛtiḥ` iti| prātipadikādhikāre vacanasāmarthyāt| `garbhaṃ dhārayatītyarthaḥ` iti| anekārthatvāddhātūnām| `pūrvapade supo'lugvaktavyaḥ` iti| taddhita utpanne <> [[1.2.46]] iti prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ <> [[2.4.71]] iti subluk? prāpnoti, tasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| `garbhavimocane'pi vijanirvartata ityāhuḥ` iti| tadevaṃ manyate - yadā garbhadhāraṇe vartate tadatyantasaṃyoge dvikatīyaivātra, na saptamī| garbhavimocane vijanāvupapadyate saptamī| `yalopamātram` iti| na hi garbhavimocanena sakalā samā vyāpyata iti mātraśabdena sarvasyā vibhakterlopo na bhavatīti darśayati| `pariśiṣṭasya` iti| āmśabdasya|`anutpattau` iti| taddhitasya| `uttarapadasya ca` iti| cakārāt? pūrvapadasya lopo vaktavya iti yakārasya pratyayasanniyogena vidhīyamāno lopastadabhāve na prāpnotīti pakṣa upasaṃkhyāyate||`avaṣṭabdhe vijana āsanne prasave` iti| atra pūrvayoḥ padayoruttarābhyāṃ yathākramamarthākhyānam||`abhyamitrāt` iti| amitrasyābhimukhamabhyamitram| <> [[2.1.14]] ityavyayībhāvaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇañcaitat| tena dvitīyaiva samarthavibhaktarbhavati||`bhūtapūrvaṃ caraṭ` [[5.3.53]] iti prāpte khañ? vidhīyate| `gāvastiṣṭhantyasminniti goṣṭham` iti| `supisthaḥ` [[3.2.4]] iti kaḥ, `ambāmbagobhūmi` [[8.3.97]] ityādinā mūrdhanyaḥ| `bhūtapūrve` iti| pūrvaṃ bhūta iti bhūtapūrvaḥ| `supsupā` [[2.1.4]] iti samāsaḥ| `bhūtapūrvagrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva viśeṣaṇam` iti| arthadvārakaṃ veditavyam, yathā - `dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samāna` [[3.1.7]] ityādisūtre karmatvam, samānakarttṛkatvañca||`ekāhena gamyata iti ekāhagamaḥ` iti| `akartari ca` [[3.3.19]] ityādinā ghañ, nipātanānna vṛddhiḥ| <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsaḥ| `āāīnāni śataṃ patitvā` iti| ekāhena yāni gamyante yojanāni teṣāṃ śataṃ gatvetyarthaḥ| śataṃ saṃkhyeye vartamānaṃ svasaṃkhyopādāna eva svabhāvādvartate| tenāāīnāni śatamityāāīnaśabdena bahvarthapravṛttisāmānādikaraṇye'pye'pyekavacanāntameva prayujyate||`yathākathañcit` iti| yena kenacit? prakāreṇa| nāvayavārthe pratyabhiniveśaḥ kartavya iti darśayati - `uttarapadalośca` iti| uttarapadaṃ praveśanaśabdo'vataraṇaśabdaśca, tasya lopaḥ| `śālīno jaḍaḥ` iti| sa hi jāḍaāt? prativacanamapi dātuṃ śakto'pyāryairādriyamāṇo na śaknoti tatra sthātum - janatā paśyatīti, ataḥ śālāpraveśanamarhati| śālāśabdo'yamihi kuṭīravacanaḥ| `kaupīnaṃ pāpam` iti| taddhi loke nindyatvādakāyryatvāccākāyryam, talloke kūpe'vataraṇaṃ praveśanamarhatītyucyate| tatsāmarthyāccharīrāvayavaḥ kaścitkaupīnaśabdenocyate| yadapi tasya śarīrāvayavasyācchādanārthaṃ vāsaḥ, tadapi tatsambandhāt? pravrajitādīnāṃ kaupīnamityucyate||`nānājātīyāḥ` iti| anekajātīyāḥ| `aniyatavṛttayaḥ` iti| aniyatakriyāḥ| `teṣāṃ karma vrātam` iti| vrātasāhacaryāt? tadapi vrātamityucyate| atha vā - vrātānāmidamityarthavivakṣāyāṃ che prāpte, asmādeva nipātanādaṇ? bhavati| tatpunaḥ karma bhāravahanādi| `tatra neṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi na bhavati prakṛtāyāṃ mahāvibhāṣāyāṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt||`sāptapadīnamiti nipātyate` iti| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate? pratyayaḥ pratyayārthaśca prakṛtaḥ| khañpratyayārthaścāvāptiḥ| saptabhiḥ padairavāpyata iti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| tataḥ saptapadaśabdātkhañ|`katham` ityādi| sakhyubhaviḥ karma vā sakhyām| tatra yadi sāptapadīnamiti nipatyate, sakhiśabdena sāmānādikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti, na hi sakhyameva sakhā bhavatīti praṣṭurabhiprāyaḥ| `guṇapradhānaḥ` ityādi| guṇo bhāvaḥ karma vā pradhānaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa yadā ca guṇamātre mukhyayā vṛttyā vartate tadā guṇapradhāno veditavyaḥ| `tadā sakhyaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati` iti| dvayorapyekārthavṛttitvāt| `yadā tu` ityādi| lakṣaṇā upacāraḥ| dharmadharmiṇorabhenopacāreṇa gauṇyā vṛttyā taddhiti saṃkhyāvati puruṣe vartate tadānenaiva samānādhikaraṇo bhavati| yathā yadā śuklaśabdo guṇamātre vartate tadā dravyaśabdena samānādhikaraṇo na bhavati - paṭasya śukla iti, yadā tvasau tvamityabhisambandhāt? paṭe vartate tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati - śuklaḥ pada iti; tathehāpi veditavyam||`hrogodohasya hiyaṅgvādeśaḥ` iti| hrogodohasya hiyaṅgaśabda ādeśa ityarthaḥ| hrau godohanaṃ hrogodohaḥ, `supsupā` [[2.1.4]] iti samāsaḥ| `vikāre khañpratyayaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.134]] iti prāptasayāṇo'pavāda iti||aṇo'pavādau| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇi prāpte kuṇabadayo vidhīyante| jakārasya prayojanābhāvāt? `dhuṭū` [[1.3.7]] itītsaṃjñā na bhavati||`ekayoganirdiṣṭānām` iti| svaritatvenādiśabdānāmanuvṛttirbhavati| svaritatvapratijñāpratibaddhatvāt| ekayoganirdiṣṭānāmapi yatra pratijñāyate svaritatvaṃ tatraiva bhavati, nānyatra| tenaikayoganirdiṣṭanāmapyekadeśasyānuvṛttirupapadyate||`vidyācuñcuḥ, vidyācaṇaḥ` iti| atha `cuṭū` [[1.3.7]] iti cakārasyetsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati? ukto'sya hetustatraiva - pṛthagyogakaraṇamasya vidheranityatvajñāpanārthamiti||`svārthe nānāñau pratyayau bhavataḥ` iti| `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti` (sī|pa| 125) iti kṛtvā| ñakārastvādyudāttārthaḥ|| bāla-manoramāvinañbhyāṃ nānāñau nasaha 1805, 5.2.27 vinañbhyāṃ| `nasahe`ti saṅghātaḥ pṛthaktve vartate| prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamidam| tadāha - asahārthe iti| tasya vivaraṇaṃ - pṛthagbhāve iti| vartamānābhyāmityanantaraṃ `vinañbhyā`miti śeṣaḥ| svārtha iti| pratyayārthasya anirdeśāditi bhāvaḥ| pratyayāviti| `yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nānāñā`viti śeṣaḥ| vineti| vernāpratyaye rūpam| pṛthagityarthaḥ| nāneti| naño nāñi ādivṛddhau rūpam| pṛthagityarthaḥ| `nasahe`tyasya pratyayārthatve tu netyanena na saheti gamyeta| evaṃ sati nānā na na saha, kiṃtu sahaivetyarthaḥ syāt, `dvau nañau` prakṛtamarthaṃ gamayataḥ` iti nyāyāditi bhāṣye spaṣṭam|bāla-manoramāveḥ vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau nasaha 1806, 5.2.27 vaiḥ śālacchaṅkaṭacau| kriyāviśiṣṭeti| kriyāviśiṣṭakārakavācakātsvārthe śālacśaṅkaṭacpratyayo sta iti yāvat| idaṃ ca bhāṣye spaṣyaṭam|`sasādhanakriyāvacanāt` ityādi| uktametat - upasargā hrevamātmakā bhavanti yatra kaścit? kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prayujyate tatra kriyāviśeṣaṇamāhuḥ| yatra na prayujyate tatra sasādhanakriyāmiti| iha na kaścit? kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prayujyate, tasmāt sasādhanakriyāvācina upasargāt? pratyayo bhavati| sa ca bhavan? `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti` (sī|pa| 125) ityanirdiṣṭārthatvāt? svārthe bhavati| `vigate śṛṅge` iti| etena vigamanakriyāyāṃ śṛṅgasādhanāyāṃ viśabdo vartata iti darśayati| yadi sasādhanāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ pratyayaḥ, viśālo gaurviśaṅkaṭo gauriti na sidhyati, na hi gauriha vigamanasya sādhanam, kiṃ tarhi? śṛṅge? ityata āha - `tadyogāt` ityādi| yathā sāsnādyavayavayogādavayavadharmeṇa gauḥ sāsnetyucyate, tathā viśālaviśaṅkaṭaśṛṅgayogādgaustathetyucyate| `paramārthatastu` ityādi| samudāyo vyutpatyarthaḥ| ato'tra na kevalaṃ sasādhanakriyā nāsti, api ca sādhanamipi nāsti| tasmādguṇaśapabdā viśālādayaḥ paramārthato loke prasiddhāḥ yathā - śuklādayaḥ śabdāḥ| tena nātra viśālīdiṣu prakṛtipratyayārthayorabhiniveśaḥ kartavyaḥ| tadevaṃ paramārthato'narthakāḥ| veḥ śālacchaṅkaṭacāvapyanarthakāveva vidhīyate ityuktaṃ bhavati| `ete` iti| vyutpādayiṣyamāṇān? saṅkaṭādīn? buddhau kṛtvā bahuvacanaṃ kṛtam, te'pi hi guṇaśabdā eva||sasādhanakriyāvacanādupasargāt svārthe pratyaya iti sarvaṃ pūrvavadeva veditavyam| `alābūtilomā` ityādi| alābūprabhṛtibhyo rajasyabhidheye kaṭacpratyayasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam| vikārapratyayānāmapavādaḥ; alābūprabhṛtīnāṃ yadrajastasya tadvikāratvāt| `goṣṭhādayaḥ` ityādi| ādiśabdaḥ prakāre| paśunāmāni gośabdādīni, tebhyaḥ sthānādiṣvabhidheyeṣu goṣṭhajādayaḥ pratyayā vaktavyāḥ| <> [[4.3.120]] ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ sthānādiṣu goṣṭhajādayo vidhīyante| nanu <> [[4.1.76]] iti bahuvacanenaiva saṃgṛhītaṃ saṅghāte kaṭajityādi sarvam? satyam; anantaroktasyaiva vākyasya prapañco'yam| `avikaṭam` iti| atra <> [[4.2.37]] iti sāmūhike pratyayo kaṭaṭ| `avipaṭam` iti| prakīrṇānāmavīnāṃ vistāra ucyate| dvāvuṣṭau `uṣṭragoyugam`| ṣaṅ hastino `hastiṣaṅgavam`iṅgudasya sneha `iṅgudatailam`| tilasya `rasāstilatailam`| `bhavane kṣetre` ityādi| ikṣūṇāṃ bhavanaṃ kṣetra `mikṣuśākaṭam`| `ikṣuśākinam`| mūlasya bhavanaṃ kṣetraṃ `mūlaśākaṭam`| mūlaśākinam||`namanaṃ natam` iti| bhāve niṣṭhāṃ darśayati| `nāsikāyāḥ sambandhinī` iti| anenāpi nāsikāyā ityapi sambandhalakṣamā ṣaṣṭī| yadi nāsikāyāḥ sambandhini nate vācya ete pratyayāḥ, kathaṃ tadetena nāsikā puruṣaścābhidhīyate? ityāha - `tadyogāt` iti||`kathaṃ nibiḍāḥ` iti| tadyogo'tra nāsti| atastadyogābhāvāt? tathābhidhānaṃ nopapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `upamānādbhaviṣyati` iti| niviḍatayā nāsikayā tulyāḥ keśā vastrāṇi ca nibiḍatayā| tenopamānāt? tadubhayaṃ nibiḍaśabdavācyaṃ bhaviṣyati||`saṃjñādhikārācca` iti| `nate nāsikāyāḥ` [[5.2.31]] ityādisūtrāt? saṃjñādhikārānuvṛtteḥ| `niyataviṣayam` iti| parvataviṣayamevāsannārūḍhaṃ gṛhrate| tena vṛkṣasyāsannam, plakṣasyārūḍhamityatara na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| athopatyakā, adhityaketyatra `pratyayasthāt? kāt? pūrvasya` [[7.3.44]] ityanenettvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha - `pratyayasthāt? kāt` iti| yadyatrettvaṃ syāt? saṃjñārūpaṃ na sidhyet; nopatyikādhityiketyevaṃrūpā saṃjñā| tasmāt? saṃjñādhikārādittvaṃ na bhavati||`karmaṇi` ityanena karmaṇīti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ darśayiti| atha pāribāṣikasya karmaṇo grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? asambhavāt| asambhavastu ghaṭaterakarmakatvāt| `aṭhacpratyaye'kāroccāraṇaṃ ṭhasyekādeśanivṛttyartham||tārakādiṣu `bubhukṣāpipāsā` śabdau paṭhaete, tayoḥ kimarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ, yāvatā sannantābhyāṃ niṣṭhāyāmiṭi ca kṛte bubhukṣitaḥ, pipāsito devadatta iti bhavati? satyam; bhūte vidhānādvartamāne na sidhyati| anena tu vartamāne'pi sidhyati| tasmādyuktastayoḥ pāṭhaḥ| `garbhādaprāṇini` iti| garbhaśabdādaprāṇinyabhidheya itacpratyayo bhavati| garbhitāḥ śālayaḥ| aprāṇinīti kim? garbhaḥ sañjāto'syā garbhiṇī gauḥ||pramāṇaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvātpratyayārtho vijñāyate| `prathamaśca dvitīyaśca` ityādi| dvayasajdadhnacau ūdhrvamāna iṣyete| upari nikṣipya yatra mīyate, na tiyryak? samantato vā, tadūdhrvamānam| `aviśeṣeṇa` iti| pramāṇe parimāṇa unmāne vā'viśeṣeṇa sarvatra mātrajbhavatīti| `prasthamātramityapi bhavati` iti| apiśabdādvitastimātramityapi bhavatīti|`pramāṇe loḥ` iti| lukaścāyaṃ pūrvācāryavihitā saṃjñā| ayaṃ mātraca utpannasya lugucyate; na dvayasajdadhnayoḥ| tayorūdhrvamāne vidhānāt| asminnartha utpattirapi nāsti| `dvigornityam` iti| dvigorapramāṇatvāt| satyapi ca pramāṇāntatve tadantaviderabhāvāt| pūrveṇa prāpta eva lugucyate| `nityagrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| na hi vikalpaḥ prakṛto yannivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| na ca pūrvasya vidhervikalpena pravṛtiṃta jñāpayitumiha nityagrahaṇaṃ kartuṃ yuktam| na hrasau vibāṣayeṣyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `saṃśaye`, ityādinā nityagrahaṇasya prayojanamāha| śravaṇaṃ prādaḥ, `kṛtvalyuṭo bahulam` [[3.3.113]] iti bhāve ghañ` śrāvo'syāstīti śrāvī, sa punarvakṣyamāṇo mātracpratyayaḥ pramāṇasambandhenocyate| `stome ḍaṭ` ityādi| pañcadaśāhāni parimāṇamasya yajñasya `pañcadaśaḥ`| `pañcadaśī` iti| ṭittvānṅīp| `śanśatorḍiniḥ` iti| stome cānyatrāviśeṣeṇāyaṃ vidhiḥ| `viṃ śinaḥ` iti| ḍiniḥ, <> [[6.4.142]] iti tilopaḥ, yasyeti lopaśca| `śamamātraṃ diṣṭimātramiti| pramāṇasyodāharaṇadvayam| `prasthāmātram, kuḍavamātramiti` parimāṇasya| pañcamātram, daśamātramiti saṃkhyāyāḥ| yatraitanna nirṇīyate śamaṃ syādvā na veti tatra śamamātramiti prayucyate| evamanyatrāpi yathāyogaṃ veditavyam||`hāstinam` iti| `hanaṇyanapatye` [[6.4.164]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `dvipuruṣī iti| `puruṣāt? pramāṇe'nyatarasayām` [[4.1.24]] iti ṅīp| `dvihastino iti| atra ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp||`yāvān` iti| <<ā sarvanāmnaḥ>> [[6.3.91]] ityakāraḥ| ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num, <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| pramāṇaparimāṇaśabdau paryāyāviti matyamāno paścodayet - atra kasmāt? parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, yāvatā pramāṇagrahaṇamanuvartata eveti? taṃ pratyāha - `pramāṇe iti vartamāne` ityādi| sa punaranayoḥ pramāṇaparimāṇayorbhedaḥ `parimāṇaṃ tu sarvataḥ, āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syāt` iti prāgeva vyākhyātaḥ|`ḍāvatāvarthavaiśeṣyāt` iti| `ḍāvatau` iti pūrvācāryasaṃjñāpratipāditāpekṣo'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, te hi yattadetebyo ḍāvatumeva pratyayaṃ kṛtavantaḥ| viśiṣyata iti viśeṣaḥ, viśeṣasya bhāvo vaiśeṣyam| arthasya vaiśeṣyamarthasya viśiṣṭatvamityarthaḥ| pramāṇaśapabdasyānyo'rthaḥ, parimāṇaśabdasya cānyo'rtha iti bhinnārthatvamanayoḥ; tasmādarthavaiśeṣyāḍḍāvatau vidhātavye parimāṇaśabdasya nirdeśaḥ pṛthagucyate| ucyata iti kriyata ityarthaḥ| kimarthaḥ pṛthignirdeśaḥ kriyate? ityāha-`mātrādyapratighātāya` iti| pṛthignirdeśenārthabede siddhe sati mātrajādīnāṃ bādhā mā būdityevamarthaḥ pṛthagnirdeśaḥ kriyata ityāha| athaikatve tu prakṛtisāmānye mātrajādayo vidhīyamānā utsargā bhavanti, prakṛtiviśeṣāt? tu vatub? vidhīyamāno'pavādau bhavati, `apavādenotsargo bādhyate` iti yattadetebhyo mātra jādayo na syuḥ, tataśca tatpramāṇamasya tanmātramityādi na sidhyet, arthabhedyutsargāpavādabhāvo nāstīti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| kiñca - `bhāvaḥ siddhaśca ḍāvatoḥ` iti| `ḍāvatoḥ` iti pañcamī| arthabhede sati vatuppratyayāntānmātrajādīnāmutpattiśca siddhā bhavati| parimāṇe vatub? bhavati - yat? parimāṇamasya yāvāniti| tadantāt? parimāṇe mātrajādayo bhavanti - yāvat? parimāṇamasya yāvanmātram| athaikatve tu `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ` (vyā|pa|60) ti matupā'bihitatvādasyārthasya tadantānmātrajādayo na syu-| `tvāvataḥ, māvataḥ` iti| maparyantayoryuṣmadasmadoḥ <> [[7.2.98]] iti tvāmādeśau pūrvavadāttvam||`kiyān| iyān` iti| <> [[6.3.90]] iti kimaḥ kī| `idama īś` iti| `yasyeti` [[6.4.148]] lopaḥ| kena punaḥ kimidambhyāṃ vihitasya vatupo vakārasya ghatvaṃ vidhīyate? ityāha - `atha vā` ityādi| `yogavibāgena vā` iti| `kimidambhyām` ityetāvatā yogena vatupaṃ vidhāya tataḥ `vo ghaḥ` ityanena vatupo vakārasya ghatvaṃ vidhīyate| atha vagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti vakārasyaiva gho vidhīyate, nanu cānekāltvāt? sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, akāro hyatroccāraṇārtho varṇamātrameva, na tvādeśaḥ| kutaḥ punaretadvijñeyam? vyākhyānāt| tarhi vakāra evaṃ laghīyāniti yuktaṃ tasya sthānitvenopādanam| vakāre tvasthāninyupāttai yadyapi samudāyādeśaḥ, tathāpi na doṣaḥ; dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpaṃ bhaviṣyati||`saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇam` iti| kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| parimitiḥ parimāṇam| saṃkhyāpariccheda ityarthaḥ| pariccheda ti bhāve ghañ| `saṃkhyāparicchede vartamānāt` iti| paricchedopādhikāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ vartamānādityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ| yathā hrayamevārtho'sya vacanasyottaratra tathā vyaktīkariṣyate| tasya vakārasya ghatvamiti; `vo ghaḥ` ityanuvṛtteḥ| `pṛcchyamānatvāt` iti| yadā saṃkhyāyāḥ paricchede kiṃśabdo vartate| kadā ca vartate? yadā saṃkhyā paripṛcchyamānā bhavati| na hraparipṛcchyamānāyāḥ pariccheda upapadyate| yadā ca paripṛṭacchyamānā bhavati, tadā ca kiṃśabdaḥ paricchedaviśiṣṭāyāṃ vartata iti pṛcchyamānatvāt? `paricchedopādikāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ vartamānāt? kimaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti vijñāyate| pariccheda upādhiviśeṣaṇabhūto yasyāḥ sā paricchedopādhikā| paricachedaviśeṣaṇeti yāvat| tadanena saṃkyāparicchede vartamānāt? kima ityasya yo'rtho'bhimataḥ sa vyaktīkṛtaḥ| `kati` iti| jasaḥ <<ṣaḍbhyo luk>> [[7.1.22]] iti luk| `atha vā` ityādi| atra ca vyākhyāne `saṃkhyāparimāṇe` iti karmadhārayaḥ, nipātanādupasarjanasyāyaṃ paranipātaḥ| parimāṇaśabdaśca parimīyate'neneti karaṇasādhanaḥ| `evamātmikaiva` iti| asyārthaṃ paricchedasvabhāvetyanena vispaṣṭīkaroti| paricchidyate'neneti paricchedaḥ, sa svabhāvo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| `yatra` ityādinā yadarthaṃ parimāṇagrahaṇena saṃkhyā viśeṣyate taddarśayati| syādetat - nāstyeva sa viśeṣo yatra saṃkhyāyāḥ paricchedasvabhāvo nāsti, tadapārthakaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti? ata āha - `kṣepe hi` ityādi| `keyameṣāṃ saṃkhyā daśānām` iti| nātra saṃkhyā paricchedakatvena vivakṣitā| na hyatra paricchedo'sti; kṣepaparatvādvākyasya| kiṃśabdo'tra kṣepe vartate, na praśne||`catuṣṭayī` iti| caturo rephasya <> [[8.3.34]] iti saḥ; tasyāpi <> [[8.3.101]] iti mūrdhanyaḥ, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] ityādinā ṅīp||tayapratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā prakṛta evāsāvanuvarttiṣyate? ityāha - `tayagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadi tayabgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā tayapratyayādanya evāyamayac? pratyayo vijñāyeta, na tayabādeśaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi pratyayāntaraṃ syāt? tayaṣkāyryamayaco na syāt| kiṃ tat? <> [[1.1.33]] ityādinā jasi vibhāṣā sarvanāmasaṃjñā - dvaye, dvayāḥ; `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅop - dvayo| nanu ca pūrvasūtreṇaiva vihitasya tasya iha cādeśārthānuvṛttirvijñāyate| prayojanāntarābhāvāt, `dvitribhyām` iti| pañcamīnirdeśaḥ <> [[1.1.67]] iti ṣaṣṭhantaṃ sampādayiṣyate, atonenāntareṇāpi tayabgrahaṇaṃ tayapsthānitvaṃ labhyata eva? naitadasti; yadyanuvṛtatistayapo'nyāryā na syāt, tato'nuvṛttisamathryāt? tayapaḥ sthānitvaṃ vijñāyeta| tasya tvanuvṛttiruttarārthipi bhavati| <> [[5.2.44]] ityava yogavibāgena tayabvidhātavyaḥ| na cānuvartamānaḥ śakyate vidhātum| ata uttarārthāyāmanuvṛttau satyāṃ tayapsthānitvamayuktamiti tayabgrahaṇaṃ kriyate||`vacanasāmarthyāt` ityādi| yadyantodāttaḥ syādudāttavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| ayaci ca kṛte citsvareṇaiva `satiśiṣṭasvaro balīyān` (vā| 6.1.164) ityantodāttatvasya siddhatvāt| ādyudāttatvaṃ hranyathā na sidhyatīti tadrathaṃ kriyasāṇamarthabadvacanaṃ bhavatīti| `yadi laukiko saṃkhyā` iti| dvitrādivat| pūrveṇa yogena tayayo vidhānam, tasyāpareṇa yogena nityamayajādeśo vidhīyate| `ubhaye dedamanuṣyāḥ` iti| ubhāvavayavau yeṣāmityubhaye| kathaṃ bahutve devamanuṣyāṇāṃ dvāvavayavau bhavataḥ? yadyapyatra bahutvamasti, dvitvamapi tu prātipadikayorastyeva; atra hi dvau rāśī samudāyasyāvayavau - eko devanāṃ rāśiḥ, aparo manuṣyāṇāmityadoṣaḥ|| bāla-manoramātadasminnadhikamiti daśāntāḍḍaḥ 1822, 5.2.44 atha matvarthīyāḥ - tadasminnadhikaṃ tadadhikamasminniti vigrahe prathamāntāddaśanśabdāntātsamāsādasminnityarthe ḍapratyayaḥ syādityarthaḥ| pratyayavidhau tadantavidhipratiṣedhādantagraham| ata eva nirdeśātpañcamyarthe saptamītyāhuḥ| `aupaśleṣike'dhikaraṇe saptamī`ti bhāṣyam| `sāmīpikamadhikaraṇa`miti kaiyaṭaḥ| ekādaśa māṣā adhikā asminniti| asmādityarthaḥ| asmin upaśliṣṭā iti vā| na ca vyapadeśivattve kevaladaśanśabdādapi syāditi śaṅkyaṃ, vyapadeśidbhāvo'prātipadikene`tyukteḥ| bāla-manoramāubhādudātto nityam 569, 5.2.44 ubhādudātto nityaṃ| sa codātta iti| ādyudātta ityarthaḥ| antodāttatvasya cittvenaiva siddheriti bhāṣye spaṣṭam| atra `ayacpratyaya eva vidhīyate, natu tayapa ādeśaḥ` iti sthānivatsūtrabhāṣye spaṣṭam| `tayapa ādeśa` iti mūlaṃ tu vārtikānurodhena|**** iti bālamanoramāyām pāñcamikāḥ| ****atha parasmaipadaprakriyā|atha parasmaipadavyavasthāṃ nirūpayitumupakramate - śeṣātkartarīti|`pratyayārthena ca` ityādi| yathājātīyaḥ pratyayārthastathājātīya eva yadi prakṛtyartho vati evaṃ pratyaya ityate, nānyathā| pratyayārthena prakṛtyarthasya tulyajātīyatvaṃ darśayitumudāharaṇamupanyasyati - `ekādaśa kārṣāpaṇāḥ` iti| prakṛtyartho'pyekādaśa kārṣāpaṇā eveti prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārthena samānajātīyaḥ| `iha tu na` ityādi| atra hi kārṣāpaṇaśataṃ pratyayārthaḥ| prakṛtyarthastvekādaśa māṣāḥ| te ca kārṣāpaṇebhyo vijātīyā iti na bhavati pratyayaḥ| `śatasaharuāyoścaiveṣyate` iti| yat? `tadasmin` tasmaśca śate saharuo vā pratyaya iṣyate; nānyatara tiṃraśatyādau| kathaṃ punaranupāttameva sūtre labhyate? ityāha - `iti karaṇo vivakṣārthaḥ` ityādi| `katham` ityādi| yadi śate saharuo vādhikini pratyayena bhavitavyam, iha pratyayo na prāpnoti - ekādaśaṃ śatasaharuāmiti| atra hi śatasaharuāṃ saṃkhyāntarañcādhikam, na śataṃ nāpi saharuāmityabhiprāyaḥ| `śatānām` ityādi| anena śatasaharuāsya saṃkhyāntaraṃ nirasyāti| yadā śataśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhantaḥ saharuāśabdena samasyate tadā śatānāṃ saharuāṃ śatasaharuāśabdenocyate| yadā tu saharuāśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhantaśabdena samasyate, tadā saharuāāṇāaṃ śataṃ śatasaharuāśabdenocyate| nanu ca saharuāśabdasya paṣṭhantasya samāse saharuāśatamiti bhavitavyam? rājadantādiṣu darśanāt? tasya paranipāto bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `tatra śatasaharuāyorityeva siddham` iti| śatasaharuāvācyasyārthasya śatasaharuāyorevāntarbhāvāt| `adhike` ityādi| loke pratyayārthena samānajātāvadhike śatasaharuāyoreva pratyayākhyaṃ kāryamiṣṭam| yadā tvasamānajātyadhikaṃ bhavati, na ca śataṃ saharuāṃ vā pratyayārthena vivakṣitam, tadā neṣyate| athaikādaśaṃ śatasaharuāmityatra kasyādhikye sati ḍaḥ kartavyaḥ? ityāha - `yasya` ityādi| saṃkhyā saṃkhyānam, gaṇanamityarthaḥ| yasya saṃkhyā, tasyādhikye ḍaḥ kartavyaḥ| kasya ca saṃkhyā bhavati? adhikatvaṃ saṃkhyāyate yasya| yadā śatāni saṃkyāyate tadā - śatānāṃ saharuāmiti śatasaharuām, tadā śatādhikye ḍaḥ kartavyaḥ| ekādaśādhikānsmin? saharuā ekādaśaṃ śatasaharuāmiti| yadā tu saharuāāṇi saṃkhyāyate - saharuāāṇāṃ śataṃ saharuāśatmiti, tadā saharuāādhikye ḍaḥ kartavyaḥ| ekādaśasaharuāāṇyadhikānyasminnekādaśaṃ śatasaharuāmiti| atha kimarthaṃ taditi prathamāsamarthavibhaktirupādīyate? yāvatā `tadasya sañjātam` [[5.2.36]] ityanuvartata eva, tatra pratyayārtha evāsminniti nirdeṣṭavyaḥ? naivaṃ śakyam; tadanuvṛttau hi tatsambandhasyāsyeti pratyārthasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ prasajyeta| na ca ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyarthayorvirodhaḥ; tato'sminniti nirdeśāt? pūrvaḥ pratyayārtho na nivartate, tasyāṃ tvanuvṛttau ṣaṣṭharthe'pi pratyayaḥ syāt| tasmādasyeti nivṛttyarthaṃ punastaditi prathamāsamarthavibhaktirupādīyate| yadyevam, asyeti pratyayārthasya nivṛttatvāt? <> [[5.2.47]] ityatra ṣaṣṭharthe pratyayo na prāpnoti| iha nivṛttasyāpi maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvṛttirbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| anye tu jñāpakaṃ tadityasya varṇayanti| taditi prakṛte yat? tadityāha, tajjñāpayati - `tadasya sañjātam` [[5.2.36]] ityādau sūtre yannirdiṣṭaṃ tadihānuvartamānamapyaṅgabhāvaṃ na yātīti ṣaṣṭharthe pratyayo na bhavati||nanu ca <> [[5.1.59]] ityādau sūtre tiṃraśadādayaḥ śabdāḥ śatpratyayāntāḥ, tataśca pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva tadantāt? pratyayo labhyate, tat? kimantagrahaṇena? ityāha - `śadgrahaṇe'ntagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadyantagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā yasmāt? sa vihitastadādereva syān; nādhikāt| ato'dhikādapi yathā syādityevamarthamantagrahaṇam| yadi tarhi yasmāt? pratyayo vihitastadāderadhikārthamantagrahaṇaṃ kevalānna prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena kevalādapi bhaviṣyati| `saṃkhyāgrahaṇañca kartavyam` iti| saṃkhyā gṛhrate yena tat? saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| kiṃ punaḥ kartavyam? vyākhyānam| tatraivaṃ vyākhyānam - `saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap` [[5.2.42]] ityataḥ saṃkhyāyā ityanuvartate, tena saṃkhyādhikādeva bhaviṣyati, nānyādhikāt| `viṃśateśca` ityādi| viṃśatiśabdācca tadantācca prātipadikāṅḍapratyayo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatraidaṃ vyākhyānam - viṃśatiśabdāttāvat? sākṣāt? sūtropāttāta pratyayo bhavati, tadantādapi; cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāditi| `saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ ca` ityādau pūrva evārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi pūrvakameva||`guṇo yena nimīyate` iti| parivarttyate, vikrīyata ityarthaḥ| `so'pi` ityādi| na hi tasya bhāgatvamantareṇa nimeyasya guṇa ityeva nirdiṣṭasya bhāgatvamadhyavasātuṃ śakyam| yadā hi mūlasya bhāgatvaṃ nāsti, bhāgavyapadeśo na pravartata eva| tena yadyapi nimānasya bhāgatā noktā, tathāpi sāmarthyāt? sā pratīyate| `yavānāṃ dvau bhāgau nimānamasya` iti| nanu cobhayatrāpi parivartanam, tathāpi mūlya eva nimānaśabdo rūḍha iti yanmūlyatvena vivakṣitaṃ tadeva nimānaṃ bhavati, netarat| `yavānām` iti| bhāgāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| yadyevam, parāpekṣa uvaścicchabde taddhitasya vṛttirvirudhyate| nanūdaiādbhāge pratyayaḥ, nodaiāti, tatkathaṃ dvimayamudaiāditi pratyayāntasyodaiācchabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam? ityata āha - `bhāge'pi tu` ityādi| atra punarabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ| yathaivāṇādayo'patyāpatyavatsambandhe'pi vidhīyamānā abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyāt? prādhānyena sambandhinamācakṣate - aupagavo dākṣiriti, tathāyamapi bhāge vidhīmāno bhāgavantamudaiādādikamācaṣṭe| `guṇasyeti caikatvaṃ vivakṣitam` iti| guṇasyeti yaikasaṃkhyā sā vivakṣitā| nanu ca `taddhitāḥ [[4.1.76]] iti nirdeśe'pi bahuvacanamapramāṇam, tasyāvivakṣitatvāt` ityuktam, tatkathamihaikatvavivakṣā yujyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha hi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ kṛtvā guṇanimāna eva kartavyam, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati| so'yamevaṃ vaktavye sati yadguṇasyetyekavacanamuccārayati, tenaitat? sūcayati - vivakṣitamatraikatvamiti tenetyādinaikatvavivakṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati| ekatvavivakṣāyāṃ hretat? prayojanam - ekasya guṇasya nimāne vartamānādyathā syāt| `dvau bhāgau yavānāṃ traya udaiātaḥ` iti| atra trayāṇāṃ bhāgānāṃ nimāne dviśabdo vartata iti na bhavati pratyayaḥ| nanu ca satyāmapyekatvavivakṣāyāṃ naivānna pratyayena bhavitavyam, yataḥ `bhūyasaśca vācikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyaya iṣyate` iti vacanam| na hyatra dviśabdo bhūyaso vācakaḥ? evaṃ tarhi yavānāṃ yau dvau bhāgau, tāviha nimeyatvena vivakṣyete| ye traya udaiāto bhāgāste nimānatvena| tatra yadyekatvavivakṣā na syāt? tadā triṣūdaiādguṇeṣu vartamānāt? pratyayaḥ syāt| bhūyasaścetyapi pratyayārthāt? prakṛtyarthasya bhūyaso vācikāyāḥ pratyaya iṣyate, nānyataḥ| `iha na bhavati` iti| anabhiṣānāt| `tadasminnadhikam` [[5.2.45]] ityādeḥ sūtrāditikaraṇānuvṛttervā| yadi bhūyaso vācikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā iṣyate yavānāṃ dvau bhāgau nimānamasyetyatra na prāpnoti? ityata āha - `bhūyasa iti ca` ityādi| evamapi hi prāpnoti - dvau yavānāmaṣyadrdha udaiāta iti, asti hyatra pratyarthāt? prakṛtyarthasyādhikyam? ityata āha - `guṇaśabdaḥ` ityādi| guṇaśabdo hrayaṃ bhāgavacano'pi samatāmapi tasya bhāgasya brūte, na cāṣyadrdhaśapabdena samabhāga ucyate| `nimeye cāpi dṛśyate` iti| kena punarvihito dṛśyate? anenaiva| katham? dve atra vākye; tatraikasmin? vākye nimānaśabdaḥ karaṇasādhanaḥ - nimīyate'neneti nimānam; dvitīye tu karmasādhano nimīyata iti nimānam; <> [[3.3.113]] iti karmaṇi lyuṭ| yadā karaṇasādhanastadā guṇasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭī, yadā tu karmasādhanastadā kartari| guṇo hi nimānakriyākaraṇamiti karttṛtvena vivakṣyate| bhavati hi karaṇasya karttṛtvena vivakṣā, yathā - sādhyasiśchinattīti| tatraikena vākyena nimāne partamānāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā nimeye'bhidheye pratyayo vidhīyate| apareṇa nimeye vartamānāyā nimāne'bhidheye'pi pratyayo'bhidhīyate| vākyabhedasya ca saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ nibandhanam - `saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap` [[5.2.42]] ityataḥ| evañca saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvartate| idamiha dvitīyam| tatra yadyatraikaṃ vākyaṃ syāddvitīyaṃ saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, sautrānumitābhyāṃ tu dve vākye kriyamāṇe tadarthavadbhavati| tasmāddve atra vākye| `dvau vrīhiyavau` ityādi| atra nodaiādbhāgasya dvau vrīhiyavau nimānatvena vivakṣitau, kiṃ tarhi? udaiātaḥ| evaṃ `dvauguṇau` ityādi| atra prathamāsamartho guṇasya nimānena vartate| na hi kṣīrasya bhāgadvayena tailasya bhāgo nimīyate| mayaṭaṣṭitkaraṇaṃ ṅībartham - dvau guḍasyaiko drākṣāyā dvimayī drākṣeti||iha dve saṃkhyāgrahaṇe anuvartate, tatra caikena `saṃkhyāvācinaḥ prātipadikāt` iti brāuvatā prakṛtirviśeṣitā| dvitīyena tu pratyayārtha viśeṣayitumāha - `yena` ityādi| saṃkhyānaśabdaṃ samuccārayan? saṃkhnāvacanaḥ saṃkhyānaśabdena pratyayārtho viśeṣyate iti darśayati| dvividho hi saṃkhyāśabadaḥ - saṃkhyānavacanaḥ, saṃkhyeyavacanaśca| tatra yadi saṃkhyeyavacanena pratyayārtho viśeṣyate, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt - saṃkhyeyaṃ muṣṭaādikaṃ yena pūryate dravyāntareṇātiriktaṃ kriyate sa ca pūraṇa iti, tataśca pañcānāṃ muṣṭikāṇāṃ ghaṭa ityatrāpi syāt| tasmātsaṃkhyāvacanenaiva pratyayārtho viśeṣayittuṃ yuktaḥ| `sampadyate` iti| pūyryata ityasyārthamācaṣṭe| etenaitaddarśayati - saṃkhyāvacanena pratyayārtho viśeṣyate| na muṣṭikāṇāmiva dravyāṇāṃ dravyāntareṇātiriktakaraṇaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ pūraṇam, kiṃ tarhi? sampattireveti| `iha na bhavati` ityādi| na hi ghaṭa upajāte pañcatvasaṃkhyā muṣṭikāṇā sampadayate| kiṃ tarhi? tatra pañcasaṃkhyakānāmeva dravyāntareṇātiriktatā||`ḍaṭo maḍāgamo bhavati` iti| atha pratyaya eva nāntāt? maṭ? kasmānna bhavati? narhati pratyayo bhavitum| pratyaye hi tasmin? sati ḍaṭo'nuvṛttirapārthikā syāt, sa hi pūrvameva vihitaḥ, na ca vihitasyānuvṛttirvidhānārthopapadyata iti| āgamārthe ca sā vijñāyate| nanu ca pañcama ityādau na kaścidviśeṣaḥ - maṭa āgamatve, pratyayatve vā; tadeva hi rūpam, sa eva hi svaraḥ, kiñcānuvṛttena, maṭa eva pratyayatvamastu? satyam, iha nāsti viśeṣaḥ; viṃśatitama ityādau tu vidyate| tathā hi <> [[5.2.56]] iti maṭpratyayaḥ syāt| [`mayaṭ` mudritapāṭhaḥ] viṃśatitamaprabhṛtayaḥ śabdāḥ pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttāḥ syuḥ| ḍaṭi tu pratyaye sati tasyādyudāttatve kṛte tataścāgamānudāttatve cāntodāttā bhavanti| tasmādutarārthe'nuvartamānasyehāpi ḍaṭa eva pratyayatvaṃ vijñāyate| kathaṃ punarḍaṭo maḍāgamaḥ śakyo vidhātum, yāvatā prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ prakṛtaṃ ḍaḍgrahaṇam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ? ityādi - `nāntāt` ityādi| yadyapi prathamāntaṃ ḍaḍgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpi ḍaṭa āgamasambandhena <> [[1.1.67]] iti nāntādityeṣā pañcamī ḍaḍiti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalapayatatyadoṣaḥ| `pañcamaḥ` iti| ṭilopo'tra na bhavati; maṭi kṛte satyabhasaṃjñakatvāt| nanu ca paratvāṭṭilopenaiva tāvadbhavitavyam? naitadasti; antaraṅgo hrāgamaḥ, sa hi pratyayasanniyogenocyate| ṭilopastūtpanne pratyaye bhasaṃjñāyā satyāṃ prakṛtipratyayāvāśritya bhavatīti bahiraṅgo bhavati| `ekādaśānāṃ pūraṇā ekādaśaḥ` iti| kathaṃ punarasmātprāptiḥ, yāvatā saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvartate, saṃkhyāsamdāyo'pi hi saṃkhyāgrahaṇena gṛhrate - saṃkhyāyate'nayeti kṛtavā| avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam; anyathā'daśatayā na syāt||`tadiha saptamyā` ityādi| pūraṇādhikāre hrayaṃ vidhīyamāno ḍaṭsanniyogana vidhīyate| tatra yadyapi saptamau nāsti, tathāpi ḍaṭi parato vijñāyate| tenārthādvibhaktivapariṇāmo bhavatīti ḍaḍiti yadvatteta tadiha saptamyā vipariṇamyate| `katipayaśabdo na saṃkhyā` iti| laukikatvābhāvāt? saṃkhyā na bhavati; loke'sya saṃkhyātvenāprasiddhatvāt| śāstrīyo'pi na bhavati; śāstre saṃkhyāsaṃjñā'vidhānāt| yadi na saṃkhyā, kaṃthamasya ḍaṭ, yatra paratasthugvidhīyate? ityāha - `tasya` ityādi| yadetaḍḍaṭi parataḥ katipayaśabdasya thugvidhānaṃ tata eva jñāpakāḍḍaṭpratyayo'sya bhavatītyavasīyate| `ṣaṣṭhaḥ` iti| ṣṭtvam| ṭilopo'tra na bhavati| thugvidhānasāmarthyāt| āgamasya pūrvāntakaraṇaṃ bhasaṃjñārtham| yadi parādiḥ kriyate tato bhasaṃjñā na syāt, tathā cāsatyām, <> [[1.4.17]] iti padasaṃjñā syāt| tataśca ṣaṣṭha ityatra jaśtvaṃ prasajyeta| `caturthaḥ` iti| atra rephasya <> [[8.3.34]] iti satvam| pūrvānte tu saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ na bhavati||`dviśabdāt? tīyapratyayo bhavati` iti| atha dviśabdāduttarasya ḍaṭastīyādeśaḥ kasmādeva na bhavati? jñāpakatvāt| yadayam? <> [[2.3.2]] iti ṭāpā nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati - nāyamādeśa iti| yadyevamanenaiva siddhatvāt? pratyayavidhānamanarthakam? na; svarārthatvāt| nipātanāddhi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ syāt| tīyapratyaye tu pratyayasvareṇa madhyodātto bhavati| kiñca, yadi pratyayo na vidhīyate `bādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti` (nī|pa|bṛ| 109) iti ḍaḍapi syāt| yadi punarayaṃ ḍaḍādeśaḥ syāt, tarhi kiṃ syāt? ḍaṭsvareṇa tīyaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ syāt, striyāṃ ca ṭittvānḍīp, tataśca dvitīyeti nirdeśo nopapadyate||`aṇa iti tatra vartate` iti| <<ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ>> [[6.3.111]] ityataḥ| nanu ca pareṇa ṇakāreṇāṇgrahaṇa ṛkāro'pyaṇ? bhaviṣyati? ityata āha - `pūrveṇa ca` ityādi| atra `trestu ca` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum, evaṃ hrucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt? - kimayamādeśaḥ, utta pratyaya? iti||`viṃśatyādibhyaḥ parasya` ityādi| nanu ca tīyapratyayena ḍaḍ? vyavahitaḥ, tatkathaṃ tamaḍāgamaḥ śakyo vijñātum? ata āha - `pūraṇādhikārāt` iti| pūraṇārthe yo vihitasatasya viṃśatyādibhyaḥ parasya tamaṅvidhīyate, sa nānyo ḍaṭaḥ sambhavatīti ḍaḍeva vijñāyate| `viṃśātyādayo laukikāḥ saṃkhyāśabdā guhrante` iti| vyāptenryāyāt| te punarviśatyekaviṃśatiprabhṛtayaḥ saṃgṛhītā bhavanti| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi paḍktyādisūtre [[5.1.58]] teṣāmasanniviṣṭatvāt|`śatādigraṇam` ityādi| saṃkhyādibhyaḥ śatādibhyo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ śatādigrahaṇam| atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā''rambhasāmarthyādeva nityo vidhirbhaviṣyati? bhavecchatādibhya ārambhasāmarthyādityevam| māsādibhyastvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇātuvṛttervibhāṣā syāt| nanu cāsvaritatvādeva nivarttiṣyate'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam? vispaṣṭārtha tarhi nityagrahaṇam||prākśatāt? ṣaṣṭaādāyo vijñeyāḥ| śatādīnāṃ svaśabdena tamaṭo vidhānāt||`matau` iti matvartha ucyate; sāhacaryāt| `matvarthena` ityādi| samarthavibhaktiḥ prathamā, prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam - astitvam, pratyayārthaḥ - asyāsminniti ca, sarvametanmatvarthagrahaṇena `ākṣipyate` iti| sannidhāpyate, upasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| yuktaṃ yanmatubgrahaṇe pratyayārtha ākṣipyate; tasya tadviṣayatvāt| samarthavibhaktyādi kathamākṣipyate? arthasāhacaryāt||atha vā pradhānānuvṛttitvāddguṇānām, prādhānyena pratyayārtha upasthāpite pratyayasāmarthyāt? tadapi guṇabhūtamupasthāpyata eva| ihāsyavāmādiśabdo'nekapadāntatvādvākyam| vākyasya cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti prātipadikasaṃjñā nāsti, atastebhyo na prāpnoti; aprātipadikatvāditi yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha-`anukaraṇaśabdāśca` ityādi| anukaraṇagrahaṇena ca vākyatvamasyavāmaprabhṛtīnāṃ nirasyati| na hranukaraṇaśabdānāmavayavabhūtāni padāni santi, tatkutasteṣāṃ vākyatvam? yataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā na syāt| `svarūpamātrapradhānāḥ` ityanenārthavattvaṃ teṣāṃ darśayati| anarthakatve hrarthavataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāvidhānāt? prātipadikatvaṃ na syāt| tathā ca sa eva pratyayābhāvaḥ prasajyeta| mātraśabdo'rthāntaravyavacchedāya| svarūpamātraṃ pradhānamabhidheyaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| caśabdo yasmādarthe| yasmādanukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpamātrapradhānāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti, tenānekadādapi pratyayākhyaṃ kāryaṃ siddham; tasya prātipadikatvāt| aprātipadakatvañca vākyatvādanarthakatvādvā bhavet| na cāsyavāmaprabhṛtīnāṃ vākyatvam; anukaraṇaśabdatvāt| nāpyanarthakatvam; svarūpamātreṇārthavattvāt| yadi hrasyavāmetyādāvanukaraṇaśabdenānekāni padānyasyāvayavabhūtāni santi tatkathaṃ tenānekapadādapi siddhamityuktam? paraprasiddhyā padasya| asyavāmādayo'pyevam| eṣāmanekāvayavāḥ prasiddhāḥ; tasmāt? tatprasiddhyaivamuktam; na tu vidyamānānekapadatvāt| atha kathamanukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpamātrapradānā bhavanti, yāvatānukāryameva teṣāmabhidheyam, atastadeva pradhānasvarūpam? naitadasti; iha hi prathamāsamarthādastinā samānādhikaraṇāt? pratyayo vidhīyate| anukaraṇaśabdāścānukriyamāṇenārthenārthavanto'pi pratyavamṛṣṭā itikaraṇena śabdaśabdena vā prathamāsamarthāstisamānādhikaraṇā bhavanti| arthe hi guṇībhūtānāṃ prathamāsamarthatvamastyupādhikatvañca nopapadyate| tathā hrasyavāmo'sminnastītyukte'nukaraṇapratyāyitasyānukāryasyaiva śattdasya prathamāsamarthatvamastyupādhikatvañca gamyate, na tvanukaraṇaśabdasya| tasmāditikaraṇena śabdaśabdena vā'vaśyambhāvo pratyavamarśaḥ| asyavāma ityasminnastyavāmaśabdo vāsminnastīti bhedānukriyamāṇapadārthatā nivartate, svarūpapadārthataivānujāyate| nanvevaṃ sati matvartho nopapadyate, anukāryā hrāmnāyaśabdāḥ sūktasāmnoḥ santi, na tu tadanukaraṇaśabdā laukikādayaḥ? naiṣa deṣaḥ; vākya svātantryahetoritikaraṇādeḥ sannidhau tena pratyavamṛśyamānā anukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpeṇārthavanto bhavanti, vṛttau tvanukāryeṇaiva; tatra svātantryahetoritikaraṇāderabhāvāt| vṛttāveva sūktasāmanī samatvarthavattayā vaktumiṣṭe, na vākya iti kimatra nopapadyate! asyavāmaśabdo'sminnastyasyavāmīyam| kayāṣubhāśabdo'sminnasti `kayāṣubhīyam`| yogaścāyaṃ matvarthīyānāmapavādaḥ||anantarasūtre sūktasāmnoreva cchasya vihitatvāt? prakaraṇāntare ca kvacidadhyāyānuvākayośchasyāvidhānāt? pṛcchati - `kena punaḥ` ityādi| na hrasatastasya lugupapadyate, āha evāyaṃ lukam| ata etadeva lugvacanaṃ jñāpayati - adhyāyānuvākayośchasya vidhānamastīti| `vikalpena ca` ityādi| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe, vikalpenaivetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarvikalpena labhyate? <> [[5.2.56]] ityanyarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| yadyevam, pūrvatrāpi vikalpena vidhiḥ prāpnoti? bhaṇḍkaplutinyāyenānuvṛttirbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ||pūrveṇa cche tasya ca pakṣe luki prāpte vimuktādibhyo'ṇvidhīyate||<> [[5.2.60]] iti cchasya ca luki prāpte goṣadādibhyo vunārabhyate||<> [[4.3.38]] ityaṇi prāpte vun? vidhīyate||ākarṣādiṣu yadvṛddhaṃ tataśche prāpte śeṣebhyastvaṇi kanvidhīyate| pratyayāntarakaraṇam - yadatrokārāntaṃ tasyātra guṇo mā bhūt, yaccekārāntaṃ tasya `yasyeti` [[6.4.148]] lopo mā bhūdityevamartham| vuni tu sati tadubhayaṃ prasajyeta| tata punarihāśiṣṭaṃ prasajyeta| tasya punarvani kani vā sati na kaścidviśeṣa iti na tatpratyayāntaraṃ prayojayati||`dhane kāmaḥ` iti| dhanaviṣaya icchetyarthaḥ||`prasite` iti| yadyapi sinotirayaṃ `ṣiñ? bandhane` (dhā| pā| 1477) iti bandhane paṭhate, tathāpyanekārthatvādihāsaktau vartate| `keśeṣu prasitaḥ` iti| <> [[2.3.44]] iti saptamī| āsaktiśca kriyāviṣayo dharma iti keśādisthānabalā kriyā keśādiśabdenocyate| ata evāha - `keśādiracanāyāṃ prasakta evamucyate` iti| `bahuvacanaṃ svāṅgasamudāyādapi yathā syāt` iti| asati hi tasmin, yathā janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena na gṛhrate, tathā svāṅgasamudāyo'pi svāṅgrahaṇena neti svāṅgasamudāyānna syāt, tasmastu sati bhavati; anyathā tasya prayojanābhāvāt| svarūpavidhinirāsastasya prayojanamiti cet? na; `adravam` (kāśikā 4.1.54) ityādinā svāṅgasya paribhāṣitatvena svarūpavidherasambhavāt||pūrveṇa kani prāpte ṭhagvidhīyate| `ādyūno'vijigīṣuḥ` iti| `vivo'vijigīṣāyām` [[8.2.49]] ityavijigīṣāyāmeva vivo niṣṭhātakārasya natvavidhānāt| `udarakaḥ` pūrveṇa kanena bhavati||`sasyena iti sahayogalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, itthambhūtalakṣaṇe vā| `sasyaśabdo'yaṃ guṇavācī` iti| sasyaśabdo hrayaṃ dhānyavacano'pyasti, yathā - śāliḥ sasyam, yavāḥ sasyamiti; tasya grahaṇaṃ mā vijñāyītyevamarthamidamuktam - `idamabhidhānam` iti| sasyaka ityetat? kanpratyāntam||`karmaṇi dvitīyaiva bhavati` iti| karmaṇi dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ kṛdyogalakṣaṇā tadapavādā ṣaṣṭhaārabhyate| tasyāścāvaśyake ṇinipratyaye `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamaṇryayoḥ` [[2.3.70]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ| tena nirapavādāddvitīyaiva bhavati||`acirāpahmatam` iti| aciraśabdo'lpakālavacanaḥ, tasyāpahmataśabdenāpahmato gataḥ kālo'syeti <> [[2.2.5]] iti samāsaḥ| `pañcamīsamarthāt` iti| nirdeśādeva| na hīha kācit? prakṛtā vibhaktiranuvartate, pañcamīnirdeśaśca śruyate, tasmānnirdeśādeva pañcamīsamarthāt? pratyayo vijñāyate| sā punaḥ pañcamyapaharaterapāyavacanatvāt? tadyogena tantramapādānameva bhavatītyapādānalakṣaṇā veditavyā||kimarthaṃ punarivam, yāvatā saṃjñāyāṃ vyutpādyate, saṃjñāyāmeva tu brāāhṛṇakoṣṇike? na; viṣayāntare'pi| tameva viṣayaṃ darśayitumāha - `yatra` ityādi| gatārtham||`kriyāviśeṣaṇāt` iti| kriyāviśeṣaṇasya hi karmatvaṃ pratipāditam| `kāriṇi` iti| tācchīlye ṇiniḥ| tasya ca prayoge ṣaṣṭhī pratiṣiddhā, tasmāt? karmaṇi dvitīyayaiva bhavitavyam| kriyāviśeṣaṇācchītādiśabdāddvitīyāsamarthātpratyayo vijñāyate| tena neha śotoṣṇaśabdo sparśaviṣaye vartamānau pratyayamutpādayataḥ| kva tarhi? māndye, śaighrye ca; yasmādāvaśyake ṇiniḥ| na sa padārtho'sti yaḥ śītoṣṇasparśau niyogataḥ karoti| tuṣārātapāvapi hi nāvaśyaṃ kurutaḥ; pratibandhasambhavāt| karttṛśaktistu padārthānāṃ niyateti sā śaktiḥ karttṛtve kaścinniyogato mandaṃ karoti, kaścit? śīghramiti yujyata evāvaśyakatvam||`adhyārūḍhaśabdasyottarapadalopaḥ` iti| uttarapadamārūḍhaśabdastasya lopo nipātyate| kathaṃ punaradhiko droṇaḥ khāryāmityasya prathamāntasya droṇaśabdasya prayogaḥ, adhikā khārī droṇeneti tṛtīyāntasya ca? ityata āha - `kartari karmaṇi ca` ityādi| `gatyarthakarmakaśliṣa` [[3.4.72]] ityādinā sūtreṇa ruheḥ kartari karmaṇi ca kto vihitaḥ, tena kartari kartari karmaṇi cādhyarūḍhaśabdo vartate, tataśca tasyārthe vyutpādyamāno'dhikaśabdo'pi tatparyāyo bhavaṃstayorevārthayorbhavati| tatra yadā kartari vartate tadā droṇaśabdāt? prathamā bhavati, na tṛtīyā| yadā karmaṇi vartate tadā kartturanabhihitatvādadhikaśabdena droṇaśabdāt? tṛtīyā bhavati| karmaṇastvabhihitatvāt? khārīśabdāt? prathamaiva bhavati, na dvitīyā| `adhikā khārī droṇena` iti| nanu cādhiko droṇaḥ khāryāmasyāmityatra karmaṇo'nabhihitatvāt? khārīśabdāddvitīyā prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayam? `yasmādadhikam? [[2.3.9]] `tadasminnadhikam` [[5.2.45]] iti ca nirdeśaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati - adhikaśabdena yoge pañcamīsaptamyāveva vibhaktī bhavata iti||`anukaḥ` iti| anuśabdāt? kan| `abhiko'bhīkaḥ` iti| atrāpyabhiśabdāt||nirdeśādeva tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktirlabhyata ityāha - `pār(āśabdāt? tṛtīyāsamarthāt` iti||`ayaḥśūladaṇḍājinābhyām` iti| tṛtīyāntanirdeśādevārthāt? tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktilaṃbhyata ityāha - `tṛtīyāsamarthātabhyām? iti||pūraṇapratyayāntānāṃ sāmānyanirdeśo'yam| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavatītyuktam| kathaṃ pratyayaḥ svārthe bhavatīti? anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavantīti (pu| pa| pā| 90) kṛtvā| `dvikaṃ, trikam` iti| tīyasya luk| `catuṣkam` iti| pūraṇapratyayasya ḍaṭaḥ sathukaśca luk, catūrephasya `visarjanīyasya saḥ [[8.3.34]] , tasya `idupadhasya cāpratyayasya` [[8.3.41]] , iti ṣatvam| `tāvatithena` ityādi| pūraṇapratyāntāt? prātipadikāt? tṛtīyāsamarthādgṛhṇātītyetasminnarthe kanpratyayo bhavatīti vaktavyam| pūraṇapratyayasya ca nityaṃ luk| `ṣaṭkaḥ` iti| ṣakārasya jaśtavaṃ ḍakāraḥ, tasyāpi cartva ṭakāraḥ| atra ca ḍaṭaḥ sathuko luk| `pañcakaḥ` iti| atrāpi ḍaṭaḥ| atheha kasmānna bhavatīti - dvitīyena hastena daṇḍaṃ gṛhṇāti? ityāha - `itikaraṇo vivakṣārthaḥ` ityādi| suboṣam||nanu ca na śṛṅkhalamātreṇa karabho badhyate, kiṃ tarhi? rajjavādikena ca, tatkathaṃ śṛṅkhalaṃ bandhanamucyate? ityāha - `yadyapi` ityādi| yadyapi tatra rajjvādikamapyaparamasti, tathāpi śṛṅkhalamasya tantrīkaraṇaṃ prati sādhanaṃ bhavatyeva, na hi tena tadbhavati| tataḥ śṛṅkhalaṃ bandhanamucyate| rajjvādikamapi yadi bandhanaṃ bhavati, bhavatu! na hyatrāvadhāryate - śṛṅkhalameveti||`sasādhanakriyāvacanāt` iti| sādhanam=manaḥ; kriyā=gamanam; saha tena gamanakriyā| tadvacanāt? sasādhane gamane vartamānādityarthaḥ| `tadvati` iti| tacchabdena kriyā pratyavamṛśyate| sasādhanakriyāvatītyarthaḥ| `utsukaḥ` iti| utkaṣṭita ityarthaḥ||`arthalabhyā` ityādi| artho'dhikaraṇādiḥ| tenātra saptamīprabhṛtiranuktāpi samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| `prayojanaṃ kāraṇaśabdenovyate kālagrahaṇaṃ pṛthaṅna kartavyam, kālo'pi rogasya kāraṇaṃ bhavati? naitadasti; na hravaśyaṃ kālo rogasya kāraṇaṃ bhavati| tatra yadā hrasau rogasya kāraṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi tato yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kālagrahaṇam| `dvitoye'hni bhavo dvitīyakaḥ` iti| tatra kāraṇāntarādvātādeḥ kutaścidbhavato jvarasya kālaḥ kevalamadhikaraṇabhāvena vivakṣitaḥ, na tu hetubhāvena| kathaṃ punaḥ kālādanyataḥ pratyayo dvitīyādibhyaḥ śabdebhyo bhavati, na hrete kālaśabdāḥ prasiddhāḥ, sāmānyaśabdā hrete, śabdāntarasannidhānāt? tu kāle vṛttireṣāṃ gamyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vākye hreṣāṃ śabdāntarasannidhau kali vṛttiḥ, vṛttigataśca prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayānāṃ viśeṣaṇam; sannihitatvāt| na vākyagataḥ; viprakarṣāt| `viṣapuṣpairjanitaḥ` iti| tṛtīyā| `uṣṇaṃ kāryamasya` iti| atra kāryakāraṇasambandho vivakṣitaḥ| sa cedaṃśabdādevotpannayā ṣaṣṭaābhihita ityuṣṇaśabdāt? prathamaiva bhavati| iha kālaprayojanaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ pratyayo'bhihitaḥ, na kālaprayojanaśabdābhyām; kālaviśeṣavācibhyo bhavan? kriyāyāḥ kartari jvare prayojanaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ prayojanamiti; kāryakāraṇavivakṣāyāñca kāryasambandhini| na cāyaṃ prakāraniyamaḥ sūtre uktaḥ, tatkathaṃ labhyate? ityata āha - `uttarasūtrādiha saṃjñāgrahaṇamapakṛṣyate` iti| tena tasmin? satyayamartho bhavati - pratyayāntaścet? saṃjñā bhavati, tasmaścārthe sati pratyayāntaṃ yadi saṃjñā bhavatyevaṃ pratya utpadyate, nānyatheti| saṃjñāgrahaṇasannidhānādiha sarvaprakāro'yaṃ niyamo labhyate| na hi vinā tena prakārema pratyayāntaṃ saṃjñā bhavati| nanu cottarasūtre saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva śeṣabhūtam, tatkathaṃ tato'pakraṣṭa śakyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ubhayorapi yogayostaccheṣabhūtam| katham? yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate - `tadasminnannaṃ prāye` tataḥ `saṃjñāyām` iti; tena saṃjñāgrahaṇamubhayeṣāṃ śeṣo vijñāsyate||`annaṃ cetprāyaviṣayam` iti| prāyo viṣayo yasya tattathoktam| viṣayagrahaṇe `prāye` iti saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayi| `pratyayo bhavati` iti| anyathā guḍāpūpāḥ prāyeṇānnamiti vavakṣāyāḥ kārakāṇi bhavantītiprāyasya viṣayabhūtasya karaṇatvena vivakṣitatvāt tṛtīyā| `guḍāpūpikā` iti `pratyayasthāt kāt pūrvasyātaḥ` [[7.3.44]] itīttvam|`vaṭakebhya inirvaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - iha saṃjñāgrahaṇasya pratyayāntopādhikatvādyatra pratyayāntaṃ saṃjñā bhavati tatra pratyayena bhavitavyam| na ca vaṭakaśabdaḥ kanpratyayāntaḥ kasyacit saṃjñā, tena tataḥ kan na bhaviṃṣyati tarsmiścāsati matvarthīya inirbhaviṣyatīti| `vaṭakino` iti| `ṛmnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] ||saṃjñāgrahaṇena pūrveṇa kanaḥ prāptāvasatyāṃ vākyenābhidhāne prāpte matvarthīye matubādāvidamucyate| `vkaulmāṇī` iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp||`nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ` iti| nanu ca nakāra id yasya tarsminniti parataḥ svara ucyate, na ca samudāyānubandhe nakāre nitparatvamasti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na evet nit, tatpuruṣo'yam| tena nakāra itsaṃjñe parataḥ pūrvasya svaro bhaviṣyati| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate? ityāha - `chando'dhīte` iti| asya vākyasyārthe śrotiṃrayanniti nipātyate| `chandaso vā` ityādi| pūrvatra vākyārthe padamavidyamānaprakṛtipratyayavibhāgaṃ nipātitam; idānīṃ tu prakṛtipratyayau nipātyete tadavīta ityasminnarthe| atra yadyapi nidita bahuvrīhiḥ, tathāpi svaraḥ sidhyatyeva; ghanpratyayasya nitaḥ parasya vidyamānatvāt|`katham` ityādi| yadi cchabdaḥśabdasya śrotraśabda ādeśo ghaṃśca pratyayaḥ `tadadhīte` ityasminnarthe nipātyate, nipātanena bādhitatvādatrārthe cchāndasa iti na siṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ||`śrāddhaśabda` ityādi| śāstroktena vidhinā niṣpādyasya kasyaciveva kriyāviśeṣasya śrāddhaśabdaḥ saṃjñā| karmaśabdo'yaṃ kriyāvācī| śraddhā yatra karmaṣyasti tacchrāddham, <> [[5.2.101]] iti ṇapratyayaḥ| `tatsādhane` ityādi| bhūktatvaṃ karmaṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ na sambhavatīti tatsādhane bhavatādau varttitvā śrāddhaṃ pratyayamutyādayatīti vijñāyate| tatsādhāne tu tasya vṛttiḥ, tādathryāt; yathā - pradīpārthāyāṃ mallikāyāṃ pradīyapaśabdasya| `samānakālagrahaṇam` iti| samānaḥ kālo gṛhrate yena tatsamānakālagrahaṇam| vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kimartham? ityāha - `adya bhukte` ityādi| yasminnahani śrāddhamanena bhuktaṃ tasminneva śrāddhika iti syātṣa adya bhakte āo mā bhūdityevamartham| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - ihāpi vetyanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena yasminnevāhani śrāddhaṃ bhuktaṃ tasminneveṣyate; nānyatreti||`pūrva gataṃ pītaṃ bhūktam` iti| pūrvaśabdo'tra kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt? karma bhavatīti dvitīyāsamarthāt? pratyayo vijñāyate| `pūrvo` iti| `sau ca` [[6.4.13]] iti dīrghaḥ||sahaśabdo vidyamānavacanaḥ| ata evāha - `vidyamānaṃ pūrvam` iti| <> [[6.3.82]] iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| `kṛtapūrvo kaṭamiti` nanu ca niṣṭhaā karmaṇo'bhihitatvāddvitīyā'tara na prāpanoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; neyaṃ karmaṇi niṣṭhā, kiṃ tarhi? bhāve| yadāpi karmaṇi tadāpi na doṣaḥ; niṣṭhayā hi sāmānyaṃ karmābhihitam, na viśeṣakarma| tasmādviśeṣakarmaṇo'nabhihitatvāddvitīyā bhaviṣyati| nanu ca pūrvaṃ kṛtamityanekapadāvayavatvācca vākyamidam| vākyasya cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti prātipadikasaṃjñā nāsti| tatkathamataḥ pratyayaḥ? ityāha - `supsupā` ityādi| `yogadvayena ca` ityādi| yadi `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena` (śāka| pa| 65) ityeṣā paribhāṣā na syāt? tadā `sapūrvātpūrvādiniḥ` ityekayogaṃ kuryāt? kiṃ yogavibhāgena! ekayoge hi sati kevalādapi vyapadeśivadbhāvena pratyayo bhaviṣyati| tadevamekayogena siddhe yat? <> [[5.2.86]] iti pṛthagyogaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati - astīyaṃ paribhāṣā `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena` (śāka| pa| 65) iti| yadi vā `grahaṇavatā` (vyā| pa| 89) ityādikā paribhāṣā na syāt? `sapūrvācca` itīmaṃ yogaṃ na kuryāt| <> [[5.2.86]] ityanenaiva hi kṛtapūrvītyādāvapi bhaviṣyati tadantavidhinā| tadeyaṃ pūrvayogeṇaiva pūrvaśabdādapi siddhe pratyaye yat? `sapūrvācca` itīmaṃ yogaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati - astīyaṃ paribhāṣā `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirna bhavati` (vyā| pa| 89) iti||`iṣṭo yajñe` iti| kathaṃ punaratra sapatamī; yāvatā yajñasya karmatāyāṃ dvitīyayā bhavitavyam? ityāha - `ktasyenviṣayasya` ityādi|kiṃ punaratrevaṃ nipātyate? paryavasthātṛśabdaṃ vyavasthāpya tadavayavasyāvasthātṛśabdasya pamtha ādeśa ekatra kriyate, aparatra tasyaiva pariśabdaḥ, paścādinipratyayaḥ||`anupadī` iti| paścāt? padasyānupadam, paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| tasmādinipratyayo nipātyate||`saṃjñāgrahaṇam` ityādi| viśiṣṭa evābhidhadheye pratyayāntasya vṛttirabhidheyaniyamaḥ` (vā| 802) iti ṭilopaḥ| `saṃjñagrahaṇam` ityādi| asati hi saṃjñāgrahaṇe yathograhaṇe yathopadraṣṭā sākṣiśabdenocyate, tathā dātā grahītā cocyeyātām, etāvapi hi draṣṭārau bhavata eva| saṃjñāgrahaṇādupadraṣṭaivocyate| dātṛgrahītṛbhyāṃ yo'nyo draṣṭā samīpe sa upadraṣṭā| nanu ca `svāmīārādhipatidāyādasākṣi` [[2.3.39]] iti nipātanādeva sākṣiśabdaḥ sādhurbhāviṣyati, abhidheyaniyamo'pi laukikatvādasya padasya lokokta eva vijñāsyate, tadapārthakamidam? naitadasti; na hi tasmin? nipātane sākṣiśabdasya nakārāntatā śakyate vyavasātum, pramāṇābhāvāt| loke na svābhidheye pratīyamāne pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| tasmānnakārāntatāpratipattigauravaparihārārthaṃ cedamucyate||cikitsya iti śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ| `vākyārthe` ityādi| `parakṣetre cikitsyaḥ` ityasya vākyasyārthe kṣetriya ityetat? padavacanamavidyamānaprakṛtipratyayavibhāgaṃ nipātyate| cakāro'ntodāttārthaḥ| `parakṣetrādvā` ityādi| vāśabdaḥ prakārāntaraṃ dyotayati| atha vā - parakṣetraśabdāt? tatreti saptamīsamarthāt? cikisya ityatrārthe pratyayo nipātyate, paraśabdasya ca lopaḥ| `parakṣetraṃ janmāntaraśarīram` iti| ihatyāccharīrādanyatvādasādhya ityanena paraśabdasyārthaṃ darśayati| sasyārthaṃ hi yat? kṣetraṃ saṃskṛtaṃ tadanutpādyatvāt? tṛṇānāṃ parakṣetraṃ bhavati| `sarvaṃ caitat? pramāṇam` iti| sarvasyācāryeṇa pratipāditatvatāt||`rūḍhireṣā` ityanenanāvayavārthaṃ tyājayati| kathaṃ punarjāyate rūḍhireṣā? ityāha - `tathā ca` ityādi| yadyeṣā rūḍhirna syāt, vyutpatteraniyamo na syāt; arūḍhiśabdeṣu niyatatvādeva tadarthasya| rūḍhiśabde tvasmin? yujyate vyutpatteraniyamaḥ| rūḍhiśabdānāṃ hi yathākathañcidvyutpattiḥ kriyate parikalpitenāvayavārthena| kathaṃ punarātmā cakṣurādinā karaṇena śakyo'numātum? ityāha - `nākarttṛkam` ityādi| anenāvinābhāvaṃ darśayati| itikaraṇao hetau| yasmāt? karaṇādīnāṃ pravṛttirnivṛttirvā katrradhīnā, tasmādyatra tāni tatrāvaśyaṃ katrrā bhavitavyam| cakṣurādinā karaṇenāvinā bhāvenāliṅgenātmā'numīyate| kathaṃ punastadātmanā sevitam? ityāha - `taddvāreṇa` ityādi| dvārema hi viṣayeṣvātmano jñānamutpadyate| tasmādviṣayān? jñātumātmā cakṣurādīnadriyaṃ sevate| `yathāyatham? iti| yathāsvam| yo yasyendriyasya viṣayastat? tasmai dattam| `itikaraṇaḥ prakārārthaḥ` iti| evaṃ prakārāntareṇāpi vyutpattiḥ karttavyetyetaditikaraṇaḥ prakārarthaṃ dyotayati ata evāha - `sat sambhave` ityādi| indreṇa viṣayā nīyante sambadhyanta itīndriyamityevamādikā sati sambhave tathā vyutpattiḥ kartavyā|`vāśabdaḥ` ityādi| asati hi vāśabde `indraliṅgam` ityevamādīnāṃ vikalpaprakārāṇā pāratantryaṃ vijñāyeta| parasparāpekṣāyā samuccitāyā eva vyutpatteḥ kāraṇamiti| vāśabdastavindraliṅgamitīndradṛṣṭamiti cetyevaṃ sambadhyamānasteṣāṃ svātantryaṃ darśayati| tenaikaikaḥ prakāraḥ prakārāntaranirapekṣo vyutpattādaṅgabhāvamupayāti||`pratyayārtho` iti| nanu ca yad? yasya bhavati tata tasminnasti, yadyasminnasti tat? tasya bhavati, yathā - vṛkṣe śākhā, vṛkṣasya śākheti; tatrānyataranirdeśenaiva siddham, tatkimarthaṃ dvau nirdiśyete? naitadasti; na hi ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyarthayoravaśyambhāvo samāveśaḥ, tathā hi gāvo gaṅgāyāṃ bhavanti, na ca te tasyāḥ; tathā deśāntaragato'pi putro devadattasya ca bhavati, na cāsau tatra| tasmādubhāvapi nirdeṣṭavyau| `astīti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam` iti| nanu ca sambhave vyabhicāre ca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo bhavati nīlotpalavat, na cāstitvasya vyabhicāro'sti, yathoktam - `na sattāṃ padārtho vyabhicarati` iti| tasyā vyavacchedyābhāvādapārthakamidaṃ viśeṣaṇam? naitadasti; viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādeva viśiṣṭaiva sattā viśeṣaṇatvenopāttā, na sattāmātramiti pratīyate| sā punarviśiṣṭasattā sappratisattaiva| asti ca tasyā vyabhicāra iti prasajyata eva viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ sampratisattā viśeṣaṇatvenopāttā? tasyāmeva pratyayo yathā syāt? bhūtabhaviṣyatsattāyāṃ mā bhūdityevamartham| tena gāvo'syāsan, gāvo'sya bhavitāra ityatarna bhavati| nanu ca gomānāsīta, gomān? bhaviteti bhūtabhaviṣyatsattāya#ā#ṃ matupaṃ vidhāya kathaṃ prayujyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, dhātusambandhe'yathākāloktānāmapi pratyayānāṃ sādhutvavidhānādevaṃ prayujyace; na bhūtabhaviṣyatsattāyāṃ pratyayavidhānāt| `astyarthopādhikaṃ cedbhavatītyarthaḥ` iti| vatrmānasattāviśiṣṭaṃ yadi tatra bhavatītyarthaḥ| `gomān` iti| `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num| halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrdhaḥ| `vṛkṣa vān` iti `mādupadhāyāśca` [[8.2.9]] ityādinā vatvam|`viṣayaniyamaḥ` iti| viṣaye pratyayasya bhāvo viṣayaniyamaḥ| sa punarviśiṣṭaviṣayo bhūmādiriti darśayannāha - `bhūmanindā` ityādi| bahorbhāvo bhūmā| `pṛthvādibhya imanic` itīmanic| `bahorlopo bhū ca vahoḥ` [[6.4.158]] iti bhūbhāvaḥ, ikāralopaśca| gāvo bahavo'sya santīti gomān| ekasya dvayorvā vidyamānatve'pi gomāniti na vyapadiśyate| nindāyāṃ-kakudāvartīti| niṣphalatvānninditaḥ| praśaṃsāyām - praśastaṃ rūpaṃ yasyāsti rahūpavānityucyate| nityayoge-kṣīrameṣāmastīti kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāḥ| nityaḥ kṣīrasambandho yeṣāṃ ta ucyante| `atiśāyane udariṇī kanyā` iti| yasyā atiśayenodaramasti saivamucyate| `saṃsarge daṇḍī` iti| daṇḍasaṃsarga ucyate| teneha gṛhasthite vidyamāne'pi daṇḍe daṇḍīti nābhidhīyate||`anyanivṛttyartham` iti| anyasyeniprabhṛtermatvarthīyasya nivṛttirarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattathoktam| `katham` ityādi| rasādibhyaḥ punarvacanamanyanivṛttyartham| tato rūpiṇī kanyetyādi na sidhyatīti bhāvaṛḥ| `prāyikam` ityādi| anyanivṛtterbāhulyenārthaḥ - so'syāstīti prāyikameva yuktaṃ bhavatīti| bāhulyenāsyānyanivṛttitvena rūpaṇītyādau kvacidanyo'pi bhavatīti kathaṃ punarasya prāyikatvaṃ labhyate? ityāha - `itikaraṇaḥ` ityādi| itikaraṇaśceha vivakṣārtho'nuvarte| tena yatadra tu matubantādeva lokasya vivakṣā bhavati, tatra tenānyanivṛttiḥ kriyate; na sarvatra| `atha vā` ityādi| parihārāntaram| ādiśabdena cakṣurādīndriyaparigrahaḥ| guṇāditi gaṇe paṭhate| ca guṇagrahaṇaṃ sarveṣāmeva rasādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam| tena ye rasanādīndriyagrāhrāḥ| `teṣāmevāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ` iti| guṇavacanāntebhyo rasanādīndriyagrāhrebhyo'nyanivṛttiranena kriyate, nānyebhya-| syādetat - rūpiṇītyādāvapīndriyagrahrā ye guṇāstebhyo matvarthīya utpannaḥ? ityāha - `rūpiṇo, rūpikaḥ` ityādi| rūpiṇī, rūpika ityatra śobhāguṇo gamyate, na cakṣugrrāhreṇa rūpeṇa| `rasiko naṭaḥ` ityatrāpi bhāvaguṇo gamyate, na tu rasanendriyagrāhreṇa guṇena| bhāvāḥ śṛṅgāravīrabībhatsādayo racanādharmāḥ|`ekācaḥ` iti| ekākṣarāditi| eko'j? yasya tasmānmatubeva bhavatīti - dhīmān, svavāniti||`kaṇikālaḥ` iti| kaṇikādiśabdo'yaṃ prāṇyaṅgasya vācakaḥ, nālaṅkāraviśeṣasya| prāṇyaṅgādeva hīṣyate, ata āha - `prāṇyaṅgāditi vaktavyam` iti| prāṇyaṅgatvādevākārāntallajbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - itikaraṇo vivakṣārtho'nuvartate| tena prāṇyaṅgadeva bhaviṣyatīti, nānyasmāt| anabhidhānādvā'prāṇyaṅgānna bhaviṣyatīti| nanu caikāco lacaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ siddham, tatkimarthaṃ cakāraḥ? ityāha - `pratyayasvareṇaiva` ityādi| cūḍālaśabdāt? prathamaikavacanāntāt? parato'siśabde vyavasthite tasya <> [[8.1.28]] iti nighātaḥ, soḥ <> [[8.2.66]] iti rutvam, <> [[6.1.113]] ityutvam,ādguṇaḥ` [[6.1.84]] , tasya ca <> [[8.2.5]] ityudāttatvam, <> [[6.1.109]] iti pararūpamekādeśaḥ| asati tu vakāre `svarito vānudātte'padādau` [[8.2.6]] iti svaritaḥ syāt| atastadbādhanārtha cakāraḥ kriyate||yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena lajvikalpeta, tena pakṣe yathāprāptameva syādityakārāntāt? sidhmāderiniṭhanau syātām| ata imaṃ doṣaṃ parihartumāha - `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena` ityādi| anekārthatvānnipātānāmanyatarasyāmiha samuccate vartate| tathā ca vārtikakāreṇoktam - `anyatarasyāmiti samuccayaḥ` iti| matubiha svaritatvāt? sannihita iti sa eva samuccīyate, na tu yathāprāptaṃ pratyayāntaramityeke| anye tvāhuḥ - `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthameva| na ceniṭhanāvubhau kriyete; tayormahāvibhāṣayaiva siddhatvāt| tarhi pratyayāntaraṃ pakṣe vidhīyate? tadapi na; yathāprāptamāpādayittuṃ sannihitapratyāsatteḥ matubeva| tadevamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe sati matubeva vikalpyata ityabhiprāyeṇānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena samuccīyata ityuktam` iti| `na tu pratyayo vikalpyate` iti| nanu ca laco bhāvābhāvau kriyete ityarthaḥ| `tasmāt` ityādi| yata evamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena matup? samuccīyate, na tu pratyayo vikalpyate, tasmādye'trākārāntāḥ paṭhante tebhya iniṭhanau na bhavataḥ| `pāṣṇaśramanyordīrghaśca` iti| pāṣṇa, dhamani iti śabdābhyāṃ lajbhavati, tayośca dīrghaḥ - pārṣṇīlaḥ, dhamanīlaḥ| `vātadantabalalalāṭānāmūṅ ca` iti| vātādīnāṃ, tasya ca laca ūṅagagamaḥ| vātūlaḥ| dantūlaḥ| balūlaḥ| lalāṭūlaḥ| `jaṭāghaṭākalāḥ kṣepe` gamyamāne| jaṭālaḥ, ghaṭālaḥ, kalālaḥ| kṣepa iti kim? jaṭāvān| `kṣudrajantūpatāpācca` iti| kṣudrajantūpatāpācca` iti| kṣudrajantuḥ=nakulādiḥ| upatāpaḥ=rogaḥ||`kāmavati balavati cārthe` iti| matvantayornirdeśena kāmabaśabdāvarśāadyakārāntāvupāttāviti darśayati| nanu ca vatsāṃsaśabdau naiva kāmabalayorvartete, kiṃ tarhi? vayoviśeṣe prāṇyaṅgaviśeṣe ca, tatkathaṃ tābhyāṃ kāmavān? balavāṃścocyate? ityāha - `vṛttiviṣaye` ityādi| kathametajjñāyate? ityāha - `na hyatra` ityādi| vatsaśabdasya vākye yo vayoviśeṣalakṣaṇo'rthaḥ prasiddhaḥ, aṃsaśabdasya ca yaḥ prāṇyaṅgalakṣaṇaviṣayaḥ sa yasmādatra vṛttau na vidyate na jñāyata ityarthaḥ| atha vā - na vidyata iti nāstītyarthaḥ| anena vākye yau tayorathā prasiddhau vayaḥprāṇyaṅgaviśeṣātmakau, tayorvṛttāvabhāvo darśitaḥ| idānīṃ yau tayorabhimatāvartho tayorbhāvaṃ darśayitumāha - `vatsalaḥ` ityādi| `snehavān` iti| kāmavānityarthaḥ| tadevaṃ yasmādvatsāṃsaśabdayorvākye vayaḥprāṇyaṅgalakṣaṇo'rtho na vidyate, tataścavatsalāṃsalaśabdābhyāṃ yathoktaḥ snehavān? balavāṃścocyate, tato jñāyate - vatsāṃsaśabdau vṛttiviṣaye kāmabalayorvartamānau tadvati pratyayamutpādayata iti| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ sarvatra cātra prakaraṇe matupsamuccayārthe vartate| tato matupā bhavitavyamiti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha - `na cāyam` ityādi| anenaiva ca hetunā vākyamapi na bhavatīti veditavyam| vkāye hi naivāyamarthaḥ sambhavatipāmādiṣu `aṅgāt` iti paṭhate, tatra kalyāṇagrahaṇamaṅgaviśeṣaṇam| kalyāṇāni śobhanānyaṅgānyasyāḥ santītyaṅganā| kalyāma iti kim? aṅgavatī| `śīkīpalālīdadravāṃ hrasvatvañca` iti| śākyādīnāñca pratyayo bhavati hrasvatvañca - śākinaḥ, palālinaḥ dadruṇaḥ| mahacchākaṃ śākī, mahāpalālaṃ palālauti kecit| nānājātīyānāṃ śākānāṃ samāhāraḥ śākī, palālānāṃ samāhāraḥ palālīti| `viṣvak` ityādi| viṣvakśabdānna pratyayo bhavati, uttarapadalopaśca| sa cākṛtasandheḥ akṛtayaṇādeśasya| viṣvañcatīti viṣuśabda upapade'ñcate; `ṛtvik` [[3.2.59]] ityādinā kvin, anunāsikalopaḥ, tato viṣu+ac? iti sthite viṣvañco yasya santīti na pratyayaḥ, akṛtayaṇādeśasyottarapadalopaḥ - viṣuṇa iti bhavati| viṣuṇaśabdo'yaṃ nipātyate| nānārthe vartate| `lakṣmyā acca` iti| lakṣmāśabdānnapratyo bhavati, akāraścāntādeśaḥ lakṣmīrasyāstīti lakṣmaṇaḥ| `jaṭā ghaṭa` ityādi| jaṭādibhyaḥ kṣepe gamyamāna ilacpratyayaḥ| jaṭilaḥ, ghaṭilaḥ, kalilaḥ| kṣepa iti kim? jaṭāvān, ghaṭāvān, kalāvān||prajñāśabdānmatupi picchādipāṭhādilaci ca prāpte, itarebhyastu matupi ṇo vidhīyate||atra sūtre dve prakṛtī upātte, pratyayārthāvapi dvāveva prakṛtāvanuvartete| tathā ca <> [[5.2.98]] <> [[5.2.104]] ityevamādiṣvapi keṣucidyogeṣu yathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamiti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha - `pratyayārthayostu` iti| kasmāt?
