punariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? <> [[5.2.98]] ityatrāṃśaśabdasya paranipātāllakṣamavyabhicāracihyāt| aṃsaśabdasya hi `ajādyadantam` [[2.2.33]] iti pūrvanipāte balaśabdasyāpi `ladhvakṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ nipatati` (vā| 108) ityasmin? prāpte yo'yaṃ paranipātaḥ sa lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ darśayanniha matupprakāraṇe yathāsaṃkhyaṃ lakṣaṇasya vyabhicārayati| tena pratyayarthayoḥ sarvatra matupprakaraṇe yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| prakaraṇa ityetat? kutaḥ? prakaraṇāpekṣatvāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnasya| etadapi kutaḥ? vyākhyānāt| dvayorlakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnayorupādānādvā yogāpekṣatāyāṃ tvanyatarasyaivopādānaṃ kuryāt| `asantatvāt` iti| tapaḥśabdādasantatvāt? <> [[5.2.121]] ityevamādinā vinipratyaye siddhe saharuāśabdāccākārāntatvāt <> [[5.2.115]] itīnipratyaye siddhe, punarivaṃ vidhānaṃ vakṣyamāṇenāṇā bādhā mā bhūdityevamartham| `saharuāāttu` ityādi| <> [[5.2.115]] iti ṭhannapi prāpnoti, so'pi bādhyate| etana saharuāśabdāt? ṭhano bādhānamiti punarvacanamiti darśayati||`aṇprakaraṇe` ityādi jyotsnādirākṛtigaṇaḥ| yebhyo matubarthe'ṇ? dṛśyate te jyotsnādayo draṣṭavyāḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdaścāyaṃ pratipādane vartate| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena jyotsnādibyo'pi bhaviṣyatīti| `kauṇḍalaḥ` iti| kuṇḍale yorhati sa evamucyate| anyastu kuṇḍalītyeva bhavati||`ādeśa ihodāharaṇam` iti| deśa uttarasūtreṇa lubilacorvidhāsyamānatvāt||akārāntatvādiniṭhanoḥ prāptayoḥ <> [[5.2.117]] `svāṅgāt` iti pāṭhādilaci dantaśabdādurajvidhīyate||yathāsambhavaṃ matupīniṭhanośca prāptayorūṣādibhyo ro vidhīyate| `madhuraḥ` iti| madhuśabdo'tra rasaviśeṣe vartate| `raprakaraṇe` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdaḥ pratipādane vartate| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - <> [[5.2.105]] ityataścakāro'tra vartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena mukhaprabhṛtibhyo'pi ro bhavati| `nagapāṇḍupāṃśu` [`nagapāṃśupāṇḍubhyaḥ kāśikā] ityādi| nagapāṃśuprabhṛtibhyaśca ro bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tāmeva cakārasyānuvṛttimāśritya kartavyam||dyauśca druśca dyudrū, tābhyāṃ matupi prāpte mo vidhīyate| dhaurasyāstīti dyumaḥ, <> [[6.1.131]] ityuttvam| kecit - `dyuśabda prakṛtyantaramahno nāmadheyam, tata idaṃ pratyayavidhānam` ityāhuḥ| `rūḍhiṣu matup? punarna vikalpyate` iti| rūḍhiśabdārthasya matupā'nabhidhānāt||iniṭhanoḥ prāptayormatupi cedamārabhyate| nanu ca prakṛtamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamastyeva, tatkimarthaṃ punarivaṃ kriyate? ityāha - `nanu ca prakṛtam` ityādi| `vaprakaraṇe` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| keśaśabdādyathā vapratyayaḥ, evamanyebhyo'pi tathā vapratyayo dṛśyate, tasmādvaktavyaṃ vyākhyeyam| tathā vyākhyānaṃ kartavyaṃ yathāsāvanyebhyo bhavatītyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - ihāpi sa eva cakāro'nuktasamuccayārtho'nuvartate, tenānyebhyo'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ|`hrasvādapi bhavati` iti| kathaṃ punardīrghasya grahaṇe hrasvādapi bhavatīti? `tatra tulyā hi` hatyādi| yādṛśī dīrghasyeha saṃhitā hrasvagrahaṇe'pi tādṛśyeva dṛśyate| tasmāt? hrasvasyāpi grahaṇamiha na virudhyata iti bhāvaḥ| tatra caitat? syāt - yadyapi tulyā saṃhitā, tathāpi kṛtayaṇādeśo'yameka eva śabdaḥ, tasya svarūpa ityanyatarasya parigrahaṇena bhavitavyam| tatra yadi dīrghatya grahaṇaṃ hrasvānna prāpnoti, atha hrasvasya grahaṇaṃ dīrghanna prāpnotītyata āha - `ubhayathā` iti| ubhayaprakāraṃ hrācāryeṇa praṇītaṃ sūtram| tasmādubhayorapi grahaṇamityadoṣaḥ| atha saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatetikaraṇasya cānuvṛtterasaṃjñāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati, yathā dyudrabhyāṃ mapratyayaḥ? evaṃ tarhi tasyaivetikaraṇasya prapañcaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇamiti draṣṭavyam||iniṭhanorapavādo'yam||rajaḥśabdāt? <> [[5.2.121]] iti vinau prāpte, itarebhyastu matupi valajvidhīyate| `valacprakaraṇe` ityādi| vapratyayasya vyākhyānenedamapi vyākhyātaprāyam| atra `vale` [[6.3.118]] iti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? `vanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyām` [[6.3.116]] ityataḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ||dantaśabdādiniṭhanoḥ prāptayorvalajvidhīyate| śikhāśabdādinipratyayo vakṣyate <> [[5.2.116]] ityatra `śikhādibhya inirvācyaḥ` (ma| bhā| 2|398) iti| adeśārthaṃ śikhāgrahaṇam, śikhāvalā sthūṇetyatra yathā syāt| deśe tu <<śikhāyā valac>> [[4.2.89]] ityanenaiva cāturarthika eva siddhaḥ| yadyevam, idameva vaktavyam, kiṃ tena? naitadasti; tadapi hi vaktavyameva - nirvṛttādiṣvartheṣu yathā syāt| atrāpi saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ tasyai vārthasyānuvādārtham| itikaraṇānuvṛrttyavābhidheyaniyamasiddheḥ||`strītvamatantram` iti| apradhānam, avivakṣitatvāt? strīliṅganirdeśastu vaicitryārthaḥ||ata ityakārastaparo gṛhrate| ata evāha - `akārāntāt` ityādi| athācchabdasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate - acchabdāt? prātipadikāditi? adityayuktaṃ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavitum; svarūpagrahaṇe hi rasādibhyo matupo vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| sa hīniṭhanorbādhanārthaṃ vidhīyate| na ceha svarūpagrahaṇe tebhyastau pratyayau prāpnuta iti kiṃ tadvidhānārthena matupo vidhānena!`taparakaraṇaṃ kim? śraddhāvān` (iti)| nanu ca vrīhrādiṣu mālādaya ākārāntāḥ paṭhante, te ca niyamārthā bhaviṣyanti - etebya evākārāntebhya iti? naitadasti; tulyajātīyasyaivaṃ niyamaḥ syāt, ḍāpcābantābhyāṃ syātāmevetīniṭhanau| tasmādakārastaparaḥ kartavyaḥ| `kāryī, iti| kṛta iniḥ| `taṇḍulikaḥ` iti| jāteriniṭhanau||`śikhādibhyaḥ` ityādi| ubhayatrādiśabdaḥ prakāre| śiṣṭaprayoge yebhya inireva dṛśyate, te śikhādayo draṣṭavyāḥ, te hi tebhyaṣṭhanaṃ vihitavantaḥ| eṣa tu viṣayavibhāga itikaraṇānuvṛttereva gṛhrate| `vācya` iti| asya tu vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| `yavakhadādiṣu` iti viṣayasaptamī| `evaṃ tarhi` ityādi| tundādiṣu vrīhiśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇe satīha tasya grahaṇamanarthakaṃ jñāyata iti sāmadhryāt? tatra vrīhigrahaṇenārthagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| arthagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayitumāha - `śālayo'sya santi śālikaḥ` ityādi| `śīrṣānnañaḥ` iti| naña uttaralasya śīrṣannityetasya pratyayo bhavati| nipātanācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ - aśīrṣī, aśīrṣikaḥ| anye tu śīrṣanniti śabdāntaraṃ paṭhanti| tasya tu pāṭho bhāṣāyāmapi yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| anyathā <<śīrṣaṃśchandasi>> [[6.1.60]] iti vidhānāt? bhāṣāyām? aśīrṣikaḥ, aśīrṣavāniti na syāt||yathāsambhavaṃ matubādiṣu prāpteṣvidamārabhyate| `cakārādiniṭhanau matupca` iti| etena pratyayacatuṣṭayaṃ tundādibhyastviniṭhanāvapi|`svāṅgādvivṛddhau` iti| svāṅgadvivṛddhau vartamānāt? pratyayo bhavati| vṛddhau mahāntau karṇāvasya staḥ - karṇilaḥ, karṇikaḥ, karṇī, karṇavān||matubādiṣu prāpteṣu ṭhañvidhīyate| sa ca samānādhikaraṇatatpuruṣādekapūrvādbhavati, na tu sarvata ekapūrvāt| etaccetikaraṇātuvṛtterlabhyate| ekañca tacchataṃ caikaśatam, tadasyāstīti aikaśatikaḥ| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe - ekaśatavān|`katham` ityādi| yadi `ataḥ` [[5.2.114]] ityetadanuvartate, gośakaṭīśabdānna sidhyati, tasyānakārāntatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `tato bhaviṣyati` iti| tadantādbhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| eṣo'rthaḥ - ekagopūrvādadantāt| prātipadikāṭṭhañ? vidhīyata iti sāmarthyāllabhyate| atha vā - tato hetorbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `avaśyaṃ ca` ityādiḥ asatyāṃ hrata ityanuvṛttau dvandvopatāpagahrrādiṣu (5.2.129; 5.2.116) yogeṣu citrakalalāṭikādiśabdebhyo'pi pratyayaḥ syāt| `nityagrahaṇam` ityādi| asati hi nityagarahaṇe'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ matupsamuccayārthaṃ sarvatrānuvartata iti matubati syāt| tasmādabādhanārthaṃ nityagrahaṇam| `kathamekadravyavattvāt` iti| yadi nityagrahaṇaṃ matubbādhanārtham, evam, na hreka dravyavattvādityatraikapūrvāddravyaśabdānmatup? sidhyatīti manyate| `ekena` ityādi| ekaśabdasya dravyavattvādityanena `supsupā` [[2.1.4]] iti samāsaṃ kṛtvā sādhutvamasya pratipādanīyamityarthaḥ||`dvayobhayahmadayāni` ityādi| avadhāraṇamiha draṣṭavyam| dvayādīnyeva dīrghatvaṃ prayojayanti, netarāṇi; svata eva dīrghatvāt| `tadetatsarvaṃ bahulagrahaṇena sampadyate` iti| vaktavyaśapabdastu vyākhyāne vartate ityabhiprāyaḥ||`ūrṇāyuḥ` iti| padatvena bhasaṃjñābhāvādyasyeti lopo na bhavati||atha minireva kasmānnocyate? jaśtve kṛte vāggmīti sidhyati; nanu ca <> [[8.4.45]] ityanunāsikaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyavasthitavibhāṣāṃ vijñāsyate| evaṃ tarhi gakāramadhikaṃ kurvannetat? sūcavati - gminirayamiti| yaḥ samyagbahu bhāvate tatrāpi vakṣyamāṇāvālajāṭacau bādhitvā gminireva bhavati| evaṃ hraṣikaṃ bhavati yadyapavādaviṣaye'pi kvacidbhavati, nānyā| evañcā lajāṭacau kutsitaṃ yo bahu bhāvate tatraiva pāriśeṣyādbhavata iti veditavyam||`kutsite` iti| vaktavyaśabdastu vyākhyāne vartata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `vaktavyam` iti| kutsitaṃ yo bahubhāṣate tatrālajāṭacau bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ pūrvasūtra eva kṛtam||`ekācaḥ` iti rasādiṣu [[5.2.94]] pāṭhānmatupi prāpta idamārabhyate| `aiāryavācinaḥ iti| dhanavacano'yaṃ svaśabda aiāryavācī| tathā ca-dhanayogādaiāryaṃ taducyate|`svavān` iti| ātmādāvarthāntare svaśabdo vartate||yathāsambhavaṃ matubādiṣvajvidhīyate| `ākṛtigaṇaścāyam` iti| avṛtkṛtatvāt| ādiśabdaścāyaṃ prakāre| `svāṅgāddhīnāt` iti| hīnasvāṅgavṛtteḥ prātipadikādajbhavati - khañjaḥ pādo'stīti śuklam| nanu ca śuklaśabdo guṇavacanaḥ, tatrābhedopacāreṇāpyetat? sidhyati? evaṃ tarhi dravyavṛtterapi varṇavācinaḥ prātipadikādyathā syādityevamarthaṃ varṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| śuklaguṇayuktāḥ prāsādāḥ śuklāḥ, te'smin? santi śuklaṃ nagaram| pratyayasvareṇaivāntodāttatve siddhe cakāro'rśo'syāstīti `svarito vānudātte'padādau` [[8.2.6]] iti svaritabādhanārthaḥ||`tadviṣayebyaḥ` iti| tacchabdenopatāpagarhāveva parāmṛśyete| te upatāpagarhe viṣayo yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| prāṇisthavācināṃ sarveṣāmeva dvandvādīnāmivaṃ viśeṣaṇam| `prāṇyaṅgānneṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi na bhavati? cakārānuvṛtteḥ| `siddhe pratyaye` iti| <> [[5.2.115]] ityanenaiva| `ṭhanādibādhanārtham` iti| inireva yatā syāt, ṭhanādirmā bhūdityevamarthaṃ punarvacanam| ādiśabdena matub? gṛhrate| ita uttare yogā niyamārthā veditavyāḥ||`vātātisārābhyām` iti| yadyapi pañcamī, tathāpyarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavati| āgamasambandhe ṣaṣṭhībhāvena vipariṇamyate| ata evāha - `tasyanniyogena ca tayoḥ kugāgamaḥ` iti| atha pratyayasyaivāgamaḥ kasmānna bhavati? kugāgamavatā pratyayenārthaṃsyānabhidhānāt| svarūpaṃ na sidhyatīti ca|`piśācācceti vaktavyam` iti| piśācaśabdādinipratyayo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[7.4.78]] ityato bahulagrahaṇamanuvartate, tena piśācaśabdādapi bhaviṣyati||`vayasi dyotye` iti| kathaṃ punarvayo dyotyate, yadi pañcamādayaḥ śabdāḥ kāle vartamānāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti| ata eva teṣāṃ kāle vṛtiṃta darśayitumāha - `pañcamo māso'syāsti` iti| `siddhe sati` ityādi| pūraṇapratyayānāmakārantatvādiniḥ siddha eva, tasmin? siddhe punarivaṃ vacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ jñāyata iti| `inireva bhavati` iti| niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati||`inipratyayo niyamyate` iti| pūrvavanniyamo veditavyaḥ| `tadiha` ityādi| yato vrīhṛdiṣu mālāśabdaḥ paṭhate, tasmādyadiha kṣepe mālāśabdasya punarvacanaṃ tanmatupo bādhanārtham, na tu ṭhanaḥ| sukhādibhya iti nocyata iti; anenaiva nivarttitatvāt| mālāśabdo hi śikhādiṣu, tatrāntarbhāvinaḥ kṣepādanyatrenirbhavatyeva| śikhāditvānmatup? ca; matupastasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena samuccitatvāt - mālī, mālāvāniti||hastena hastamātraṃ pratīyate, na ta jātiḥ| puruṣaśabdaprayogāt? puruṣajātirgamyate||`samudāyena cedbrāhṛcārī bhaṣyate` iti| etena samudāyopādhitvaṃ brāhṛcāriṇo darśayati| vidyāgrahaṇārtha yadopanīyate tataḥ sevitavyo yo niyamaviśeṣastadbrāhṛā, taccarati brāhṛcārī, āvaśyake ṇiniḥ| tatra niyamaviśeṣacaraṇe brāāhṛṇādīnāmeva trayāṇāṃ varṇānāmadhikāraḥ, na śūdrasyetyāha - `brāhṛcārīti traivarṇiko'bhipretaḥ` iti| triṣu varṇeṣu bhavaḥ, tatrāntarbhūtatvāt? traivaṇikaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sa evābhipreta ityāha - `sa hi` ityādi||iha kasmānna bhavati - puṣkarāṇi padmānyasmin? deśe santīti? itikaraṇānuvṛtteḥ|`arthāccāsannihite` iti| asannihitagrahaṇe tasya cāstitvena virodhaḥ| yadi hrasannihito'rthaḥ, na nāma vidyate; yadi vidyate, kathamasannihitaḥ? tasmādviśeṣaṇopādānādastotyetadviśeṣaṇamutsṛjyāsannidhānopādhikādarthāt? pratyayo vidhīyate| abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyācca| `arthī` iti| abhilāṣavānevocyate| na sarvo'sannihito'rthaḥ pratyayāntena tadvimarśādasannihitavān, ataḥ pratyayo vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ, kathaṃ punaranucyamāno labhyate? <> [[7.4.78]] ityato bahulagrahaṇena yathā `aṣṭrāmekhalādvayobhayarajāhmadayādīnāṃ dīrghaśca` (bā| 586) ityevamādikaṃ kāryaṃ sampādyate, tathedamapi| `tadantācca` ityādi| asannihitamityanuvartate, asannihitopādhikādarthādinipratyayo bhavatītyetadarthaṃrūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu kṛtaprāyam|`yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pratyayo vikalpyate - balādibhyo matubvikalpo bhavatīti, tato matupā mukte yathāprāptaminiṭhanāvapi syātām, inireva ceṣyate, sa kathaminireva labhyate, yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇeneniḥ samuccīyate, na matubiti vikalpena? ityevaṃ cetasi kṛtvāha - `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena` ityādi| nanu yadīniṭanau dvāvapi syātām, sūtrārambho'narthakaḥ syāt, vinā'pyanena pratyayasya siddhatvāt, tasmānmatupo'pi vikalpasyānena doṣaḥ? naitadasta; ārambhasāmarthyādiniṭhanoranyataro bhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyate, na tvinireva| tasmādinisamuccayārthamevānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||`prathiminī, dāminī` iti| prathimin, dāmin - ityetābhyāminiḥ, <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopaḥ, `ṛnnebhyo ḍīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp| atrāpi saṃjñāgrahaṇamitikaraṇasyaiva prapañcaḥ||`udakasukhayorvācako` iti| yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kamityudayakasya vācakaḥ, śamiti sukhasya| `śaṃyuḥ` iti| <<mo'nusvāraḥ>> [[8.3.23]] , tasya <> [[8.4.59]] iti parasavarṇaḥ, masyānunāsiko yakāraḥ| tenānusvāraparasavarṇau siddhau bhavataḥ` iti| tayoḥ padādhikāre vidhānāt| yadi punaḥ padasaṃjñā na syāt, tatastasyāmasatyāṃ padanibandhanayoranusvāraparasavarṇayorabhāvāt - kamyuḥ, śamyurityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sampadyate||tundiśabdāt? tundādiṣu `svāṅgādvivṛddhau` [[5.2.116]] iti pāṭhādilacīniṭhanormatupi prāpte, baleḥ pāmādipāṭhānne matupi, vaṭermatupyeva bo vidhīyate||`ahamiti śabdāntaram` iti| asmadaḥ <> [[7.2.94]] iti, tyadādyatve ca kṛte yacchabdarūpaṃ sampadyate, tasmādanya evāhamavyutpannaḥ śabdaḥ, na tu tadityevaṃ śabdānyatvaṃ darśayitvā'rthāntaraṃ darśayitumāha - `ahaṅkāre vartate` iti| `ahaṃyuḥ, śubhaṃyuḥ` iti| pūrvavadanusvāraparasavarṇau|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ pañcamādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ* * *atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥtṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ bāla-manoramāahaṃśubhamoryus 1920, 5.2.140 ahaṃśubhamoryus| ahaṃyuḥ puṃstvamārṣam| vaṭibha iti| `vaṭa veṣṭane`| vaṭanaṃ vaṭiḥ| so'syāstīti vigrahaḥ| bāla-manoramāahaṃśubhamoryus 481, 5.2.140 ahaṃśubhamoryus| ahaṃyuḥ śubhaṃyurityatra sublukamāśaṅkyāha - ahamityādīti| sittvaṃ padatvārtham| tena padatvādanusvāre parasavarṇaḥ sidhyati| ***** iti bālamanoramāyam matvarthīyāḥ| *****atha nāmadhātuprakriyā|`vibhaktisaṃjñāste vedivyāḥ` iti| vibhaktirityeṣa śabdaḥ saṃjñā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| nanu ca vibhaktiśabdaḥ suptiṅāṃ saṃjñā, saṃjñā ca pradeśavākyeṣūccāritā saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayatīti suptiṅāṃ vibhaktisaṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| yathā vṛddhiśabdaḥ svābhidheye laukike'rthe guṇībhūto'pyādaic? prati saṃjñātvamanubhavati, tathā vibhaktiśabdo'pi tasilādīn? prati saṃjñātvena veditavyaḥ| atha tatraiva kasmānnocyate - `supo vibhaktiśca prāgdiśaśca` iti, evaṃ sati punarvibhaktigrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ na bhavati? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi nyāse sati `kuta ārabya prāgdiśīyāḥ? iti na jñāyate| kiñca `digādibhyo yat` [[4.3.54]] , <> [[4.3.112]] iti cānekaṃ śāstre diggrahaṇamityavadhirapi sandihreta| `kiṃsarvanāmabahubhyaḥ` [[5.3.2]] ityevamādeśca kārahrasyāvadhidarśanārthaṃ punariha `prāgdiśaḥ` iti vācyameva syāt| tasmādyathānyāsameva sādha| `tataḥ, yataḥ` iti| <> [[7.2.84]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[7.2.102]] ityatvam, <> [[1.3.4]] iti sakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣeṣaḥ, <> [[1.1.38]] ityavyayatvādvibhakta#erluk| `kutaḥ` iti| `ki tihoḥ` [[7.2.104]] iti kimaḥ kubhāvaḥ| `tyadādividhayaḥ` iti| tyadādayo'tra dibhaktinibandhanāḥ| `tataḥ` iti| tyadādividheratvasyodāharaṇam| `iha iti| idamo vibhaktisvarasya| idamaḥ saptamyantāt? <> [[5.3.11]] iti hapratyayaḥ, <> [[5.3.3]] itīśādeśaḥ| <<ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ>> [[6.1.171]] iti idamaḥ parasyodātatvaṃ vibhaktitve sati siddhaṃ bhavati| atra tu pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhamādyudāttatvam| tasmāccodāharaṇadigiyaṃ pradarśita| idaṃ tvatrodāhāraṇaṃ yuktam - `itaḥ` iti| ivamastasil, pūrvavadiś| atacra hrasati vibhaktitve liti pratyayāt? pūrvapadādyudāttatvaṃ [`pūrvamādyudāttatvaṃ`-mudritapāṭhaḥ (vārāṇasī-1967)] syāt| tasmistu `ūḍidam` [[6.1.165]] ityādinedamaḥ parasya tasa ādyudāttatvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| nanu ca satyapi vibhaktitve paratvāllitsvareṇa bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `liti` [[6.1.187]] ityatra hi `ūjidam` [[6.1.165]] ityādikaṃ sūtramanuvarttiṣyate litsvarabādhanārtham| nanvevamapi naiva vibhakterudāttatvaṃ sidhyati? tatra hi <> [[6.1.168]] ityatastṛtīyādigrahaṇamanuvartate, na ca tasilādayastṛtīyādigarahaṇena gṛhyante| tṛtīyaikavacanamāranya ā pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteryāvān? pratyayo vibhaktisaṃjñaḥ sarvo'sau tṛtīyādiḥ| `ataḥ param` ityādi| sāmarthyaṃ hi nāma sambandhārthatā; sā ca pratiyoginamapekṣata eva yana sahaikārthībhāvo bhavati tasmin? pratiyogini sati, nānyathā| prāthamyamapi pratiyogyapekṣameva| dvitīyaṃ hi pratiyoginamapebhya prathamamityucyate| ita uttaraṃ pratyayāḥ prakṛtyartha eva bhavantīti, na tadviṣau dvitīyasya pratiyoginaḥ sambhavaḥ; tadabhāvāt? sāmarthyaprāthamyayorapi nāstyeva sambhavaḥ; tayoḥ pratiyogyapekṣatvāt| yataścaitadevam, tataḥ `sāmarthyādhikāraḥ prathamagrahaṇañca nopayujyate` iti dvayamapi nivṛttm| yadyevam; vāvacanasyāpi nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti, ekayoganirdiṣṭatvāt? ityāha - `vāvacanaṃ tu vartata eva` iti| tasya svaritatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `tena vikalpena` ityādi| tenottarasūtre vāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ phalaṃ darśayati||`kutra` iti| <> [[5.3.10]] , pūrvavat? kubhāvaḥ| `prakṛtiparisaṃkhyānam` iti| prakṛtiparigaṇanam| `vaiyākaraṇapāśaḥ` iti| `yāpye pāśap` [[5.3.47]] | ayaṃ cāvadheḥ paro vya ityanyābhyo'pi prakṛtibhyo bhavati| `sarvanāmatvādeva siddhe` iti| sarvanāmatvaṃ kimaḥ sarvādiṣu pāṭhāt| `kimo grahaṇam` ityādi| kiṃśabdo'yaṃ dvyādiṣu paṭhata iti tasya `dvyādibhyaḥ` iti paryudāsaḥ kriyate| tasmāt? sarvanāmno'pi svaśabdenopādānam| yadyevaṃ dviśabdāt? pūrvaṃ kiṃśabdaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ, evaṃ hi tasya pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ na kartavyameva bhavati? satyametat; na sūtrakārasyeha gaṇapāṭha iti nāsāvupālambhamarhati| api ca tyadādīnāṃ yadyatparaṃ tattacchiṣyata iti kimaḥ sarvaireva tyadādibhiḥ saha vivakṣāyāṃ śeya iṣyate - `tvañca kaśca` kau, bhavāṃśca kaśca kau; sa caivaṃ pāṭhe na sidhyatīti yathānyāsamevāstu| `bahugrahaṇe saṃkhyāgrahaṇam` iti| kathamiha sarvanāmasaṃjñayā sarvādayaḥ saṃjñino nirdiśyante? tasmāt? taiḥ saha nideśādbahuśabdasyāpi bahugaṇādi [[1.1.22]] sūtreṇa yasya saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā tasyaiva saṃjñitā tasyaiva saṃjñino grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| `bahoḥ sūpāt` iti| atra vaipulyavācī bahuśabdaḥ||`śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ` iti| asakati hi tasmin? <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] syāt| tataścedrūpasya hali lope [[7.2.113]] kṛte, `ādguṇe` [[6.1.84]] caitaḥ, ehetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| nanu cedamastyadādyatve [[7.2.102]] kṛte'to guṇe [[6.1.94]] pararūpatve cedrūpalope cāntyasyāpyādeśa itaḥ, iheti sidhyatyeva? sidhyedyadi prāk? tyadādyatvaṃ labhyeta; na tu tallabhyam, itvameva hi tāvadantaraṅgaṃ syāt| itvaṃ hi tasilādipratyayaṃmātramapekṣata ityantaraṅgam, tyādyatvamaṅgasaṃjñāṃ parasya pratyayasya vibhkitatvaṃ cāpekṣata iti bahiraṅgam, tasmācchākaraḥ kartavyaḥ||`rathoḥ` iti varṇayorivaṃ grahaṇam| tatra `yasmin? vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vā| 14) iti rephādau thakārādau ca kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityādi - `rephādau` ityādi| rephasyākāra uccāraṇārtha iti kathaṃ jñāyate? idamaḥ parasya prāgdiśīyasyākāravato rephasyābhāvāt||`śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ` iti| nanu cāntyasya sa bhavan? yadi tāvadakṛte tyadādyatve bhavati tato dakārasya bhavannanarthakaḥ prasajyeta, tyadādyatvenāpi hi tasyākāro labhyata eva; atha tyadādyatve kṛte'kārasya sthāne bhavannanarthaka eva prasajyate na hrakārasyākāravacane prayojanamasti, kṛtavāṃśca; tatra vacanādasatyapi śakāre sarvādeśo bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; asti hrakārasyākāravacane prayojanam| kim? ataḥ, atretyatra yo'nyaḥ prāpnoti sa mā bhṛditi| kaḥ punarasau? liti pratyayāt? pūrvasyodāttaḥ| tasmācchakāraḥ kartavyaḥ| `thamuḥ [thamupratyayaḥ punaretada upasaṃkhyeyaḥ - kāśikā] punarupasaṃkhyeyaḥ` iti| tasyāvidyamānatvat| upasaṃkhyeya iti pratipādya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - eta eva thakārādāvādeśavacanaṃ jñāpayati - bhavatyetadasthamuriti| kuto nu khalvetat? jñāpakāt| thamu bhaiviṣyati, na punarthaṃ evāsau <> [[5.3.23]] ityaviśeṣavihitasthakārādistasminnevādeśaḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; idamasthakārādiviśeṣa iṣyate| `etadaḥ` ityattrāpi hredama ityanuvartate, tacca nādeśavidhānārtham; ādeśasya pūrvameva vihitatvāt| tasmāt? pratyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tata etena thakārādi viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ - idama ityevaṃ yo vihita idaṃśabdenaiva yo vihitasthakārādiriti, thamureva caivaṃ vihitaḥ, na thāliti yuktamuktamādeśavacanaṃ jñāpayati - bhavatyevaitadasthamuriti||`dīti` dakārādiyaṃ saptamī| tatra dakāramātrasya prāgdiśīyasyābhāvāt? `yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vā| 14) ityato dakārādau vidhijrñāyata ityāha - `prāgdiśīye dakārādau` ityādi| `sarvadā brāāhṛāṇī` iti| <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] , tataṣṭāp|| bāla-manoramāātmanaśca 948, 5.3.6 tatrātmanaścetyaṃśaṃ vyākyātu pṛthagupādatte - ātmanaśceti| cakārāttṛtīyāyā alugiti cānukṛṣyata ityāha - ātmanastṛtīyāyā alugiti| `uttarapade pare` iti śeṣaḥ| pūraṇa iti vaktavyamiti| nā'tra pūraṇaśabdo gṛhrate, kiṃtu svaritatvabalena pūraṇādhikāravihitapratyayagrahaṇāt `pratyayagrahaṇe` iti tadantavidhirityabhipretyāha - pūraṇapratyayānte iti| ātmanāpañcama iti ātmā pañcama ityarthaḥ| prakṛtyāditvātprathamārthe tṛtīyā| yadvā ātmakṛtapañcamatvavānityarthaḥ| karaṇe tṛtīyā| karotikriyāntarbhāveṇa tasyāḥ `tṛtīyā tatkṛte`ti samāsaḥ| pakṣadvayamapīdaṃ bhāṣye sthitam| nanu saṅkharṣaṇapradyumnā'niruddhāstrayo viṣṇuvyūhāḥ| janārdanastu eṣāṃ niyanteti viṣṇupurāṇādau sthitam| tatredamāhuḥ paurāṇikāḥ - `janārdanastvātmacaturtha eve`ti| tatra tṛtīyāyā aluki `ātmanācaturtha` iti bhavitavyamityata āha - janārdanāstviti| bahuvrīhiriti| ātmā caturtho yasyeti vigrahe bahuvrīhirityarthaḥ| ekasyāpyaupādhikabhedaṃ parikalpya vṛttipadārthatvamanyapadārthatvaṃ ca vivakṣaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ| tadidaṃ bhāṣye spaṣṭam| bāla-manoramāsarvasya so'nyatarasyāṃ di 1927, 5.3.6 sarvasya so| `di` iti saptamyekavacanaṃ prāgdiśīyaviśeṣaṇam| `yasminvidhi`riti tadādividhiḥ| tadāha - prāgdiśīye dakārāviti| sadā ityudāharaṇam|`tasila pratyayo bhavati` iti| ādeśā evāmī tasilādayaḥ pañcamyādīnāṃ sthāne kasmātra kriyante, evaṃ hi vibhaktitasaṃjñā na kartavyā bhavati? aśakyā eta ādeśāḥ kartum; ādeśatve hreṣāmavyāyāt? tyapi [[4.2.103]] - tatastyaḥ, yatastya ityatra <> [[2.4.71]] iti luk| labhante hi sthānivadbhāvena subādeśāḥ subāśrayaṃ kāryam| tata iti, <> [[3.1.4]] ityanudāttaḥ| kuta iti, `dheṅiti` [[7.3.111]] iti guṇaḥ| etarhīti, `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghaḥ| tatreti, `bahuvacanejhalyet? [[7.3.103]] ityetvam| kutreti, <> [[7.3.119]] ityauttvam| tataḥ, tatreti, <<ṅasiṅyoḥ smātsminau>> [[7.1.15]] iti smātsminau| tasmānnādeśā amī kriyante| yadyevam, `tasu upakṣaye` (dhā| pā| 1212) ityasmāt? tasyannityatra dhāturūpasya pañcamyāḥ parasya `taseśca` [[5.3.8]] iti tasilādeśaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; svārthikavijñānānna bhaviṣyati| svārthikā hrete tasilādayaḥ, tanmadhye tasilādeśo vidhīyamānastathā vijñāyate yathā svārthe kriyāmāṇaḥ, svārthikatvaṃ nātikrāmati| `apādāne cāhīyarūhoḥ` [[5.4.45]] ityanena vihitastasya sva#ārthikasya sāthāne bhavaṃstasilapi svārthika eva bhavati| dhātustu prātipadikādarthāntare vartata iti tadādeśo bhavaṃstasil? svārthiko na bhavati||`kuta āgata` iti| <> [[5.4.45]] iti paratvāt? tasau kṛte tasyānena tasil| nanu ca kṛte'pi tasili tadeva rūpam, tatkimarthamādiśyate? ityāha - `tasestasilvavacanam` ityādi||`sarvobhayārte vartamānābhyāmiṣyate` iti| teneha na bhavati - pariṣiñciti, abhiyātīti| atra cānabhidānaṃ hetuḥ|ya ata vā - `sarvasya` [[5.3.6]] ityādeḥ sūtrādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena sarvobhayārthaṃ eva vartamānābhyāṃ bhavati, nānyatra||`kva` iti| `kvāti` [[7.2.105]] iti kimaḥ kvādeśaḥ `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ [[1.3.4]] iti pratiṣedhasya `ivamasthamuḥ` [[5.3.24]] ) ityukāreṇānityatvasya jñapitatvāditsaṃjñā takārasya| dānīmastu pratiṣedhānnāstītsaṃjñā; prayojanābhāvācca||`pañcamīsaptamyapekṣamitaratvam` iti| tadanantaramitaraśabdasya jñātatvāt| atha dṛśigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `itarābhyo'pi` ityetāvataiva siddham? ityāha - `dṛśigrahaṇam` ityādi| prāyiko vidhiryatā syādityevamarthaṃ vṛśigrahaṇam| tasmistu sati śiṣṭaprayoge'nugamyamāne yatra dṛśyate tatra bhavati, nānyatretyeṣo'rtho labhyate| tena prāyikatvaṃ vidheḥ sidhyati| `tena` ityādi| dṛśigrahaṇe tu sati yatretarābhyaḥ śiṣṭaprayogo dṛśyate tābhya eva tasilādibhirbhavitavyam| bhavadādiyoga evetarābhyo dṛśyante, tenetaratraiva tadvidhānam| yadi hranyebhyo'pi tasilādayo bhavanti, pūrvaṃ pañcamīsaptamībhyāṃ vidhānamanarthakam? naitadasti; niyogato hi tābhyāmiṣyate, itarābhyo bhavadādiyoge| etacca pūrvasmin? vidhāvasmiśca satyubhayaṃ labhyata iti kuta ānarthakyam!||`saptamyā ityanuvartate` iti| tasyāḥ svaritatvāt| `na tvitarābhyaḥ` iti| tadvipharyayāt| `tralāderapavādaḥ` iti| yatāsambhavam| tatra kiṃśabdāt? `kimo't` [[5.3.12]] iti prāptasyātpratyayasyāpavādaḥ| keṣāñcinmatena taralo'pi| tacchabdādapi `tayodardāhilau ca cchandasi` [[5.3.20]] iti| śeṣebhyastu tralaḥ| `kadā` iti| kimaḥ kādeśaḥ||`hasyāpavādaḥ` iti| <> [[5.3.11]] iti prāptasya| `lakāraḥ svarārthaḥ` iti| `liti` [[6.1.193]] pratyayāt? pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| nanu ca yathā ita ityatra - `ūḍidam` [[6.1.165]] ityādinā vibhaktisvaro bhavati, tathehāpi tenaiva bhavitavyam? naitadasti; tathā hi yuktamita ityatra yadvibhaktisvaro bhavatīti; tasilo littvasya paritaḥ, abhita ityatara caritārthatvāt, asya tu hilo litkaraṇamakṛtārtham| tadyadi vibhaktisvarema bādhyeta tasyānarthakyaṃ syāt| tasmāllitsvara eva bhavati||dānīñceti yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ - <> [[5.3.19]] ityatra dānīmeva yathā syāt, pūrvasūtravihitaḥ pratyayo mā bhūditi||`anarthakam` iti| vaicitryārtham| anyasyābhāvādanarthakaṃ vaicitryeṇa sārthakameva| `vihitatvāt` iti| `sarvaikānya` [[5.3.15]] ityādinā||`idā`| <> [[5.3.3]] | tathā varṇavyatyayena dakārasya dhakāraḥ| `idānīṃ, tadānīṃ iti| dānīmpratyayasyodāharaṇam||tasilādiṣu prāpteṣu hilpratyayo vidhīyate| `kahi` iti| <> [[7.2.103]] | `kadā, yadā, tadā` iti| `sarvaikānyakiyattadaḥ kāle dā` [[5.3.15]] ||`samāne'hani sadyaḥ` iti| nimittanimittinoḥ samāne sādhāraṇe'hani nipātanametat| tadyathā - sadyaḥ prāṇaharaṇaṃ marmaṇi tāḍanamiti| yasminnevāhani marmaṇi tāḍanaṃ tasminnevāhani prāṇaraṇamityarthaḥ| `udārī ca` iti| ucca āriśceti udārī| `parasmādedyavi` iti| paraśabdādedyavipratyayo bhavatyahanyabhidheye||`sāmānyasya [`sāyāsya viśeṣo bhedakaḥ=prakāraḥ`-kāśikā]`yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ` iti| `thā hetau ca` [[5.3.26]] iti vakṣyati, sa kima eva yathā syāt, idamo mā bhūditi||`digdeśakāleṣu vartamānebhyaḥ` iti| kathaṃ punarthe diśāṃ śabdāste deśe kāle vartante? svabhāvāt| yathaiva hi te diśa svabāvādeva vartante, na hetvantarāt,; tathā deśakālayorapi| yadyavam, triṣu vartamānāḥ kathaṃ diśā vyapadiśyante - dikśabdebhya iti? kathaṃ tarhi vyapadeṣṭavyam, digdeśakālaśabdebhya iti? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vyapadeśasyaitat? phalam - aindraāṃ diśi nivasatītyatra mā bhūditi| etaccānyatamenāpi labhyata ityanenaiva vyāpadeśo yuktaḥ, yena vyapadeśālladhu sūtraṃ bhavati| diśā ca vyapadeśe laghu bhavati, dikśabdasyālpāctaratvāditi diśāṃ tena vyapadeśaḥ| evamapi dikśabdasya diśi vṛtteḥ viśeṣaṇamayuktam, avasyaṃ hi dikśabdo diśi vartate, tatraivaṃ kartavyam - deśakālayoriti? naitadasti; evaṃ hru cyamāne satyupalakṣaṇameva hi dikśabdaḥ syāt, pratyastu deśakālavṛttibhya eva syāt, na digvṛttibhyaḥ| diggrahaṇe tu tebhyo'pi bhavati| iha tiruāo vibhaktayaḥ, trayaścārthā digādayaḥ, tatra sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyam - iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāmapākartumāha - `yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyate` iti| tatkathamihekavacananirdeśe kartavye bahuvacananirdeśaḥ? pratyekaṃ digādivṛtterbahulavibhaktyantāt? pratyayaḥ kartavya iti sūcanārthaḥ| evañcāyaṃ bahulavibhaktyantāt? pratyayaḥ kṛto bhavati, yadi digvṛtterapi saptamīpañcamīprathamāntādeva bhavati - deśavṛtterapi, kālavṛtterapi| atha vā-`thā hetau ca` [[5.3.26]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa ca śrutimeva samuccinoti| tena digādivṛtteḥ pratyekaṃ saptamīpañcamīprathamāntāt? pratyayo bhavati, na yatāsaṃkhyam! yathāsaṃkhyaṃ hi samuccayo virudhyateta| atha vā - `svaritatve sati yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati` ityuktam, na ceha yathāsaṃkhyārthaṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyeta, tena yathāsaṃkyaṃ na bhaviṣyati|`purastāvadhastāt` iti| pūrvādharaśabdābhyāmastātiḥ| <> [[5.3.40]] iti vakṣyamāṇena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pur, adha - ityetau pūrvādharaśabdayorādeśau| `aindraāṃ diśi vasati` iti| aindrīśabdaḥ sāmānyenendrasambandhivastumātramācaṣṭe, dikśabdasannidhau tu diśi vartate, tena dikśabda iti loke na prasiddha itadi na bhavatyataḥ pratyayaḥ| `pūrvaṃ grāmaṃ gataḥ` iti| pūrvaśabdo'tra grāmasya deśātmakatvāddeśe vartate, na tvatra saptamyādivibhaktyantaḥ, kiṃ tu dvitīyānta| `pūrvasmin? gurau vasati` iti pūrvaśabdo'tra digādyupalakṣite gurau vartate, na digādiṣu||`akāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ` iti| yadyatrākāro na kriyate, tadā `ṣaṣṭhī tasarthapratyayena` [[2.3.30]] iti sūtraṃ kartavyam, evañca sati tasilo'pi grahaṇaṃ syāt| tataśca tato hetunetyatrāpi tṛtīyāṃ bādhitvā ṣaṣṭhī syāt| tasmādakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ kartavyaḥ| atha yadā dakṣiṇottaraśabdau diśi vartete, tadā ṭāpśravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartho'kāraḥ kasmānna bhavati? `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ` (vā| 104) iti puṃvadvacanenaiva ṭāpo nivarttitatvāt| nanu cāsatyakāre pratyayasvarema siddhatvāccakāro'pi naiva kartavyaḥ, tatra, `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe tu na dvyanubandhakasya` (vyā| pa| 52) iti tasilo grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati? evamapi <> [[5.4.44]] , <> [[4.3.112]] , `tasiśca` [[4.3.113]] ityanyataragrahaṇaṃ syāt| tasmādviśeṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ kartavyaḥ||`ātiśca pratyayaḥ` iti| ayamapyastāterapavādaḥ| `dakṣiṇapaścāduttarapaścāt` iti| dakṣiṇāparasyāṃ diśi vasatīti dakṣiṇapaścāt? evamuttarapaścāt| `ardhottarapadasya ca` iti aparasyeti sambadhyate| `vināpi pūrvapadena paścabhāvo vaktavyaḥ` iti| aparasyārddhottarapadasyeti prakṛtena sambandhanīyam| atra sarvatra vaktavyaśabdo vyākhyāne dartate| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - uttarasatrāt? siṃhāvalokitena cakāro'trāvatiṣṭhate, sa cānuktasamuccāyārthaḥ| tena dikpūrvapadasyāparaśabdasya paścabhāva ityevamādikaṃ kāryaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati||uttaradakṣiṇābhyāṃ <> [[5.3.28]] <<enabanyatarasyāmadūre'pañcamyāḥ>> [[5.3.35]] , <> [[5.3.36]] , <<āhi ca dūre>> [[5.3.37]] , <> [[5.3.38]] ityebhiryogairatasujādiṣu prāpteṣvadharādapyastātāvātirvidhīyate, tasyāstātirbādhyata eva| atasujādayastu vacanātpakṣe bhavantyeva| atra ca yadyapyuttarādīnāṃ saptamyādīnāṃ ca vibhaktīnāṃ digādīnāṃ copādhīnāṃ tritvam, tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| kutaḥ? tadarthasya svaritatvasyāpratijñānāt| ladhvakṣarasyādharaśabdasyāpūrvanipātāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnādvā'sya lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ darśayan? yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamiha nāpekṣyata iti sūcayati| tena vibhaktibhistāvadyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| upādhibhistu dakṣiṇaśabdasya kāle vṛttyasambhavācca||`adūre cedavadhimānavadherbhavati` iti| kathaṃ punarevaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā sūtre'vadhiśabdo na śrūyate, nāpyavadhimān? dikaśabdānāmavadhyapekṣā pravṛttirbhavati| avadhimānaṣyavadhimapekṣya bhavatīti sāmarthyādanuktī'pyeṣa viśeṣo labhyata iti| `adhastādvasati` iti| <> [[5.3.40]] iti vakṣyamāṇenāstātau parato'dharaśabdasyādeśaḥ| `prāgaseḥ` iti| `asi puradhavaścaiṣām` [[5.3.39]] iti vakṣyamāṇaḥ| keciddikśabdamātrāt? pratyayaṃ manyanta iti teṣāṃ matena pūrveṇa vasatītyādyapi bhavati| yadi dikśabdamātrāt? pratyo bhavatītyañcātyantādapi syāt? bhavatu, <> [[5.3.30]] iti lumbhaviṣyati? naitadasti; `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān? vidhīn? bādhante` (vyā| pa| 10) ityastāterevātrānena luk, nānyasya| evaṃ tahrranyatarasyāmiti vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam| tenāñcatyantānna bhaviṣyati| pakāraḥ <> [[2.3.31]] iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, svarārthaśca||tadyuktāt| saṃdiṣṭārthayā dūtavācā yatprayuktaṃ karma tadabhidhāyinaḥ karmanśabdātsvārthe aṇṇityarthaḥ| karmaiva kārmaṇamiti| `a`nniti prakṛtibhāvānna ṭilopaḥ| dūtavākyaṃ śrutvā tathaiva yatkriyate karma tatkārmaṇamucyate| tadāha - vācikaṃ śrutveti|`ājāhī pratyayau bhaktaḥ` iti| nanu cānantaryādāhireva prāpnoti? nana; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa hi vyavahitamapyācaṃ samuccinoti| tenā''japi bhaviṣyatīti||pūrvādastātau prāptestātāvavārādapi vibhāṣātasucīdamārabhyate| atha `eṣām` iti kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā yeyaṃ pūrvādiṣu ṣaṣṭhī saiva pratyayaṃ vidhāya sthāne ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate, sambandhabhedācca ṣaṣṭharthabhedaḥ? satyametat; tathāpi sukhapratipattyarthameṣāmityuktam||nanu cāsinā badhitatvāt? pūrvādibhyo'stātinā na bhavitavyam? ityāha - `idameva` ityādi| gatārtham||`prakāravacane ca jātīyar` [[5.3.69]] iti, tasyāyamapavādaḥ| `vidhā=prakāraḥ` ityaktaḥ <> [[5.3.23]] ityatra, sa ca dravyaguṇaviśeṣo'pyasti; tatra yadi so'pi gṛhreta dravyaguṇayorliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yīgādvā ptyayāntamaliṅgamasaṃkhyaṃ ca na syāt| evañca tasyāvyayatvaṃ na syāt, tacceṣṭam; tathā hi - dhāpratyayo'vyayeṣu paṭhate - tasilādistaddhita edhācparyanta iti| kriyāviṣaye tu tasmin? gṛhramāṇe na doṣaḥ; kriyāyāḥ sarvadā liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmayogādityetat? cetasi kṛtvā''ha - `sa ca` ityādi| kriyādhātuvācyo vikledanādirarthaḥ, sa ca viṣayo'sya sa tathoktaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyoktau viśeṣasya grahaṇaṃ labhyate? arthagrahaṇasya hretadeva prayojanam - prakāraviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syāditi, anyathā hi `vidhāyām` ityevaṃ hi brāūyāt| yadi tarhi prakāraḥ kriyāviṣayo gṛhrate, navadhā dravyam? nadadhā guṇa ityatra na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ? atrāpi kriyā'vyāhartatavyā| navadhā dravyam, navadhā guṇa upapādya vigṛhrate ceti||`aikadhyaṃ kuru` iti| adhikaraṇavicāla udāharaṇam| aikadhyaṃ bhuṅkte` iti| vidhārthe| atra dhāgrahaṇamanuvartate, na ca tatra vidhyarthā vṛttiyuktā; pūrvameva vihitatvāt| tasmādanuvṛttisāmarthyāt? sthānitvaṃ dhāpratyayasya vijñāyata ityāha - `prakaraṇādeva labdhe` iti| dhāpratyayasya sthānitva iti śeṣaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati dhāgrahaṇe vidhārthe vihitasya na bhavati? ityāha - `anantarasyaiva hi` ityādi| asati hi punardhāgrahaṇe `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā| pa| 19) ityadhikaraṇavicālārthe yo vihitastasyaiva syāt, na tu vidhārthe yo vihitastasya| punardhāgrahaṇe tu sati dhāmātrasyādeśaḥ siddho bhavati||`matidvaidhāni` iti| nanu ca svārthikāḥ prakṛtidharahṛānanuvartanta iti liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmatra na bhavitavyam? naiva doṣaḥ; ativartante hi kadācit? svārthikāḥ prakṛtidharmān? yathā - catvāra eva varṇāścāturvaṇryamiti||yāpyaśabdo'yaṃ gamayitavye vartate - grāmāntarāt? yāpya iti; astyaśakyapratīkāre - yāpyo roga iti, asti kutsite - yāpyo'yamiti, kutsita iti gamyate| pāśappratyayāntāt? kutsita eva pratīyata iti tadabhidhāyina eva yāpyaśabdasyevaṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktatam| ata evāha - `yāpyaḥ kutsita ityucyate` iti yāpyante=apanīyante tasmādguṇā iti yāpyaḥ, <> [[3.3.113]] ityapādāne kṛtyaḥ| `tatra kasmānna bhavati` iti| yadyapyasau vyākaraṇe pravīṇaḥ tathāpi duḥśīlatvādbhavitavyameva tatretyabhiprāyaḥ| `yasya` ityādi| guṇo viśeṣaṇam? dravyaṃ viśeṣyam, tatra dravye yadyapi bahavo guṇāḥ santi, tathāpi yasya guṇasya bhāve dravye śabdo niviśate vartate pratyāsattestasyaiva kutsāyāṃ śabdena bhavitavyam; na tu vaiyākaraṇasya duḥśīlatvaṃ pravṛttinimittam| kiṃ tarhi? vyākaraṇasya parijñānam, adhyayanaṃ vā| na ceha duḥśīlatvena bhavitavyaṃ pratyayena||`pūraṇapratyayo yastīyaḥ` iti| <> [[5.2.48]] iti pūraṇādhikāre vihitatvāt, pūraṇābhidheyatvādvā| upacārema pratyo'pi tīyaḥ pūraṇa ityucye| `bhāge` iti| aṃśa ityarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ punaridam, yāvatā kṛte'pyani rūpaṃ tadeva? ityāha - `svarārthaṃ vacanamiti| vibhāge nitsvareṇādyudāttaṃ yathā syāt| `pūraṇagrahaṇamuttarārtham` iti| uttaratra pūraṇapratyayāntātpratyayo yathā syāt| tasya ca vyavacchedāya kriyamāṇaṃ pūraṇamihāpyarthavat? syāt, sa ca nāstīti nehārthatā tasyopapadyate| nanu ca `mukhapār(ātaserīyaḥ`, (vā| 460) `pār(ātīyaḥ` ityapūraṇo'pi so'sti? ityata āha - `mukhatīyādiranarthakaḥ` iti| arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa| 1) arthavāniha tīyo gṛhrate, na ca mukhatīyādiranarthavān| ataḥ satyapi pūraṇagrahaṇe tasya grahaṇaṃna bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ||yathāsaṃkhye hi ṣaṣṭhādanyathā prāptaṃ cetyan| na ca pūrveṇaiva siddha iti ṣaṣṭhagrahamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādubhayābhyāmubhayaṃ bhavati||cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ceti||`ākinicaḥ kano vā lugvijñāyate` iti| pratyāsatteḥ| na tu prakāraṇāntaravihitasya; viprakarṣāt| `sa ca` ityādi yadi nityaḥ syāt? tadvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādvidhānasāmarthyāt? pakṣe bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasahāyagrahaṇaṃ saṃkhyāśabdanirāsārthaṃ kriyate? ityāha - `tadupādāne hi` ityādi| asatyasahāyagrahaṇe saṃkhyāvācino'pyekaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syāt| tasmistu sati dvibahnorna syāt| na hi dvayorbahuṣu vā caikatvasaṃkhyā vidyate| asahāyatā tu śatasyāpi bhavati; tulyajātīyānyasyābhāvāt - śatamasahāyamiti| tenā sahāyārthasya grahaṇe dvibahvorapi pratyayaḥ sidhyati| atha kasmādākinijvadhīyate, na akanijityevocyeta, atrāpi savarṇadīrghatveneṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva? na sidhyati; <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam, yasyeti [[6.4.148]] lopaśca prāpnoti| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; asti hrakāroccāraṇasya prayojanam| kim? bhasaṃjñāyāmanyaḥ padasaṃjñānibandhano'vagraho mā bhūditi| tasmādākinijeva viṣeyaḥ||kimarthaṃ punaretau samānārtho śabdāvupadiśyete, nānyatara evopadiśyeta? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hratikrāntakālaviśiṣṭe'rthe vartamānāt? pratyagrahamiṣyate, sa cātikrāntaḥ kālo'nyataroktau naiva gṛhrate| tathā hi - bhūtaśabdo vartamāne'pyarthe vartate, yathā - bhūtavāniti, pūrvaśabdastu digdeśayorapi| tasmādanyataroktāvatikrāntakālo na pratīyate| ata evā''ha - `bhūtapūrvaśabdo'tikrāntakālavacanaḥ` iti| atha cakārasya `cuṭ` [[1.3.7]] itītsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati? anityatvāttasya vidheḥ| anityatvaṃ tu tatraiva pratipāditam||iha ṣaṣṭhantaṃ yattdviśeṣaṇaṃ parārthatvādapradhānam, itarat? punastenaivopakriyamāṇatvādviśeṣyaṃ pradhānam| pradhānena ca kāryasampratyaya itadi yatā ṣaṣṭhantāt? pratyavidhāne sampratati ṣaṣṭhantapratiyogini pradhāne pratyayo vijñāyato, ma prakṛtyarthe; tathā bhūtapūrvagrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva jñāyate, na prakṛtyarthasyetyetadālocyā''ha - `ṣaṣṭhantāt` ityādi| pratyayārthastu ṣaṣṭhantasya yaḥ pratiyogī sa veditavyaḥ||`atiśāyanam` iti| lyuṭ| yadyapi śetiḥ kevalaḥ svapne vartate, tathāpyatipūrahvasya prakarṣe vṛttiḥ, ata evā''ha - `prakarṣaḥ` iti| nanu cātiśayanamiti bhavitavyam? ityāha - `nipātanāddīrghatvam` iti| nipātanaṃ tvatiśāyanaśabdasya katham? sādhutvaṃ vijñāyate ityevamartham| `prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ caitat` iti| pratyayāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ svāthikānāṃ dyotyaṃ bhavatīti na vācyam; tasya prakṛtivācyatvākat| `paṭiṣṭhaḥ, laghiṣṭhaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.154]] iti ṭilopaḥ| `gariṣṭhaḥ` iti| `priyasthirasphirorubahulaguru` [[6.4.157]] ityādinā guruśabdasya garādeśaḥ| `prakarṣapratyayāntādapareṇa pratyayena na bhavitavyam, ekenaiva pratyayasya dyotitatvāt` iti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha - `yadā ca` iti| yatra prathame prakarṣe ātiśāyaniko vihitaḥ`; tatra tenaiva dyotitatvāddvitīyo mā bhūta prakarṣapratyayaḥ| prakarṣāntaratve ātiśāyanapratyayāntādyuktamevāpareṇātiśāyikena pratyayena bhavitum, tadadyotitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| iṣṭhani parataḥ <> [[5.3.60]] , pūrveṇa saha <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | iṣṭhanpratyāntāt? tamapprakarṣapratyayaḥ| atra pratiyogyapekṣo yaḥ prakarṣaḥ pūrvasmāt? prakarṣāt? sa prakarṣa iṣṭhanpratyayena dyotitaḥ| nanu ca nāsyātiśāyikasya vidhāyakaṃ vākyamasti, yena tasmin? vihite tadantādaparaḥ prakarṣa ātiśāyāniko vidhīyeta, idameva hrekaṃ vākyam, tatrānenaiva vidhīyamāne prakarṣapratyayo tadantāyāḥ prakṛterasambhava ityayukta ātiśāyikādaparasyātiśāyikasya bhāvaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha vidhīyamānapratatyayabhedāddve ete vākye, tatraikeneṣṭhan? vidhīyate, apareṇa tu tadantāt? tamap||`dvayorarthayorvacanaṃ dvivacanam` iti| etenānvarthasya dvivacanasya grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati yadi hi pāribhāṣikaṃ dvivacanaṃ, gṛhreta, `asmākaṃ ca devadattasya devadatto'bhirūpataraḥ ityatra pratyayo na syāt; pāribhāṣikatasya dvivacanasyābhāvāt| anvarthasya tu grahaṇe sati bhavati dvyarthatopapadasya| tathā hi - asmākamityanenaiko'rtha ucyate, ekasminnevārthe <> [[1.2.59]] iti bahuvacanasya vidhīnāt| devadattasyetyanenāpi dvitīyo'rtha ucyata iti bhavatyeva tadanvarthadvivacanamupapadam| tadevamanvarthasya grahaṇe sarvatra sidhyatīti tasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti manyate| `vibhaktavyaḥ` iti| pṛthak? kartavya ityarthaḥ| yaḥ punaratiśayyamānastasyopapadatvam, nātiśayituḥ; tataḥ pratyavidhānāt| nanu ca `ṛhaloṇryat` [[3.1.124]] iti ṇyati kṛte vibhāgya iti bhavitavyam, kathaṃ vibhajya iti nirdeśa upapadyate? ityāha - `nipātanādyadbhavati` iti| iha dve upapade, evaṃ prakṛtī ca pratyayāvapi dvāveva, tataśca yathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhāntiḥ syāt, atastannirāsārthamāha - `yathāsaṃkhyām`cāracihnāt| sa hi lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ darśayan? yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīha nāpekṣeteti sūcayati| `paṭīyān? iti| pūrvavaṭṭilopaḥ, <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| (6.1.70; 8.2.23)| `māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhatarāḥ` iti <> [[2.3.42]] ityanena pañcamī| pāṭaliṃputrakebhya ityedatra vibhajyopapadam, pāṭaliputrakā hi māthurebhyo vibhajyante=pṛthak? kriyante| nanū caitadapi `dvivacanopapade` ityeva siddham, asti hyatra dvivacanamupapadam, tathā hi - māthurāṇāmeko rāśiḥ, aparaḥ pāṭaliputrakāṇām, tau ca dvivacanenocyete, tasmādvibhajyagrahaṇamanarthakam? naitadasti; yadyapyatra rāśyapekṣā dvyarthatā'sti, tathāpi nāsau śabdenopādīyate| kiṃ tarhi? avayavabhedaḥ| ata eva māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya iti bahuvacanam| iha rāśyapekṣāpi dvyarthatā nāstīti - sāṅkāśyakebhyaḥ pāṭaliputrakebhyaśca māthurāḥ sukumāratarā iti| tasmādvibhajyagrahaṇamapi kartavyam||`pācakataraḥ` iti| kartṛśaktimato dravyasyābhidhānāddravyavacano'yaṃ pācakaśabdaḥ| athaivakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvatā siddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo vināpi tena niyamārtho bhavatiityāha-`evakāraḥ` ityādi| asati hrevakāre viparītamavaṣāraṇaṃ vijñāyate - ajādī eva guṇavacanāditi, tataśca yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti prakṛtiniyamaḥ syāt| evaṃ ca guṇavacanasyājādyoniyatatvāt? tatastarabādirnaṃ syāt| evakāre tu prakṛtyanantaramuccāryamāṇe sati pratyayārthaniyamo'yaṃ bhavati na prakṛtiniyama iti paṭutaraḥ, paṭutama iti siddhaṃ bhavati| etayorapi siddhyarthaṃ `guṇavacanādiṣṭhannīyasunau` iti sūtraṃ na kṛtam| tadā vidhyarthatvādetau taraptamaporapavādatvādbādhakāviti tayorabhāve paṭutaraḥ, paṭutama iti na sidhyet||`karipṭhaḥ` iti| karttṛśabdāt? tṛnnantādiṣṭhan, <> [[6.4.154]] iti tṛśabdalopaḥ| `dohīyasī` iti| dogdhrīśabdāt? tṛnnantādīyasun, tṛśabdasya lope kṛte nimittābhāvādghatvādinivartate, <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp||nanu cājīdī iti prathamāntam, tatkathamajādyoḥ parata ādeśo labhyate? ityāha - `ajādī` itaci| `tadviṣayaḥ` iti| sa praśasyaśabdo viṣayo yasya sa tadviṣayaḥ| <> [[5.3.58]] itatyanena yo niyamaḥ sa tadviṣaye na pravartata iti darśayati| `evamuttareṣvapi` iti| <> [[5.3.62]] ityevamādiṣu| ayamanayoḥ ayamanayoḥ śreyāniti dvivacanopapada īyasun? ayamasmāt? śreyāniti vibhajyopapade| pūrvatra nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī [[2.3.41]] , uttaratra <> [[2.3.42]] iti pañcamī||yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyanivṛttyarthaḥ, uttarārthaśca| uttaratra vṛddhaśabdasya jyādeśa eva yathā syāt, śrādeśo mā bhūviti||`vṛddhaśabdasya` iti| `vṛddha` ityetasya śabdasyetyarthaḥ| etena `vṛddhasya` iti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ darśayati| nanu ca vṛddhaśabdaśca saṃjñā kṛtā - <> [[1.1.73]] iti, atastatpratyāyitasyaiva saṃjñino grahaṇaṃ na svarūpasya, <> [[1.1.68]] iti vacanāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ, `praśasyasya` ityetadihānuvartate, tena vṛddhaśabdo viśeṣyate - praśasyasya vṛddhasyeti| svarūpagrahaṇe vayo'dhike ca śabdārthe praśasyatā yujyate, na pāribhāṣikagrahaṇe| atha vā - sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.49]] jyaśabdasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva sthāno vijñāyate, antaratamaśca tasya vṛddhaśabda eva, tena tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| `tayośca` ityādi| yathā <> [[5.3.60]] ityatra niyamābhāvenājādyoḥ pratyayayoḥ sattvaṃ jñāpitam, tathehāpi jñāpyate| niyamābhāvastvajādyoḥ parataḥ pūrvavadādeśaviṣānādeva veditavyaḥ||`nimittyoḥ` ityādi| nimittau pratyayau, tayoḥ parata ādeśavidhānāt| kasmāt? punariṣyamāṇo na bhavati? alpācyatasya paranipātāt| sa hi lakṣaṇāntarānapekṣatāmācaṣṭe| tena yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīha nāpekṣyate| yadyevam, sthānyādeśayorapi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti? mā bhūdyathāsaṃkhyam, āntaratamyādvyavasthā bhaviṣyati| nanu ca vyavasthākāri cellakṣaṇāntaraṃ nāpekṣyate, sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣāpi [[1.1.50]] na prāpnoti? naitadasti; nirveśānyathātvaṃ hi nirdeśakṛtā vyāvasthā nāstītyetadeva bodhayati, yā tvarthakṛtā vyavasthā tāṃ na nivartayati| api cādeśapratipattaye <<ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā>> [[1.1.49]] ityeṣā paribhāṣā niyogato'pekṣaṇauyā| taccheṣabhūtā `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ [[1.1.49]] iti paribhāṣā kathaṃ śakyā nāpekṣitum||atrāpi nimittayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ neṣyate, tasya hrabhāvaḥ `ajādyadantam` [[2.2.33]] ityalpaśabdāsya pūrvanipāte paranipātāllakṣaṇānapekṣāccihnillabhyate, yuveti svarūpagarahaṇamiṣyate, na jīvattvaṃ vaṃśasya| kasmāt? ihāpi `praśasyasya` [[5.3.60]] ityetadanuvartate, tena yuvaśabdo viśeṣayitavyaḥ - praśasyasya yūna iti| svarūpagrahaṇe sarvalokābhimatayauvanākhyavayaḥsambandhe śabdārthe praśaṃsopapadyate, na pāribhāṣikagrahaṇe| atha vā - sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.49]] kannityādeśasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva sthāniti vijñāyate, antaratamaśca yuvaśabda eva| tasmāt svarūpasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| `anyatarasyāṃ` grahaṇamihālpaśabda eva prayojayati, na yuvaśabdaḥ, tasya vināpi tena vikalpaḥ siddha eva; `sthūlaṭūrayuvahrasvakṣiprakṣudrāṇāṃ yaṇādiparaṃ pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ` [[6.4.156]] iti vacanāt| na hi nitya ādeśe yaṇādeḥ parasya lopaḥ sambhavati, nāpi pūrvabhāgo guṇabhāk| `yaviṣṭhaḥ, yavīyān` iti| sthūladūrādisūtreṇa [[6.4.156]] yaṇādeḥ paraṃ lupyate, pūrvasya ca guṇo bhavati||matupā sāhacaryāt? matvarthīya eva vinipratyayo gṛhrate - <> [[5.2.102]] , <> [[5.2.121]] iti; ābhyāṃ caitadeva lugvacanamajādyobhaviṃ jñāpayati| `ruāgviṇau`| iti| asmāyādisūtrema [[5.2.120]] viniḥ| `ruājiṣṭhaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.163]] iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopābhāvaḥ||`svārthikāśca` ityādi| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ prasaṃsādi, tasya dyotakāḥ svārthikā bhavanti, na tvathantirasya vācakāḥ| yadi praśaṃsāyāṃ varttmānādrūpabvidhīyate, nindāyāṃ vartamānānna prāpnoti-vṛṣaṣalarūpo'yam, caurarūpo'yamiti| vṛṣalādayo hi śabdāḥ sadā nindāvacanāḥ; na kadācitpraśaṃsāyāṃ vartante, yathā kākādayaḥ śabdāḥ? ityata āha - `prakṛtyarthasya` ityādi| prakṛtyarthasya vaiśiṣṭaṃ paripūrṇatvam, tasmin? sati praśaṃsā bhavati| evañca yadā vṛṣalādiśabdānāmapi padārthasya paripūrṇatā bhavati, tadā te praśaṃsāyāṃ vartante iti tebhyo'pi pratyayo bhavati| palāṇḍubhakṣaṇena surāpāṇena ca prakṛtyarthasya paripūrṇatā bhavati, tadā te praśaṃsāyāṃ vartante iti tebhyo'pi pratyayo bhavati| palāṇḍubhakṣaṇena surāpāṇena ca prakṛtyarthasya paripūrraṇatāṃ darśayati| vṛṣalaśabdasya hi śūdro vācyaḥ| sa yadā palāṇḍvādikamapi sādhujanagahitamabhyavaharati tadā pa rapūrṇatvaṃ tasya śūdratvam| śūdraḥ=sarvāśī, sarvavikrayīti| cauraśabdārthasyāpi suguptavastvapahāreṇa paripūrṇatā bhavati| nanu ca `svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvartante` (vyā|pa|74) iti prakṛtyarthasya ye liṅgavacane te svārthikapratyayāntasyāpi bhavata iti bhāvaḥ| tataśca pacatorūpam, pacantirūpamityatra dvivacanabahavacanābhyāṃ bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `kriyāpradhānam` ityādi| ākhyātasya yadyapi kriyā sādhanañcobhayaṃ vācyam, tathāpi tasya kriyaiva pradhānamarthaḥ| yaśca pradhānaṃ prakṛtyarthastasyaiva liṅgavacanaṃ svārthikairanuvartayituṃ yuktam| kriyāpradhānamekaiva ca kriyā| tena rūpappratyayāntādākhyātāddvivacanabahavacane na bhavataḥ| napuṃsakaliṅgamapi tarhi na syāt, kriyāyā aliṅgatvāt? ityata āha - `napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ tu` ityādi| tatraiva hetumāha - `lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya` iti| yadi tarhi hrokā kriyā, pacataḥ, pacantīti dvivacanabahuvacane na sidhyataḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi hrekā kriyā, sādhanaṃ hranekam, atastadāśraye dvivacanabahuvacane bhaviṣyataḥ| rūpappratyayāntāt? tarhi syātām? tiṅntenoktatvānna bhaviṣyataḥ| ekavacanaṃ tu bhaviṣyati; tasyautsargirakatvāt, `ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate` iti vacanāt||vibhāṣāgrahaṇeneha bahuc? sambadhyate, na purastādityetat; tena bahucaḥ pūrvatvaṃ na viklpyata iti nityameva tadbhavati, ata evāha - `sa tu purastādeva` iti| evakārema tuśabdasyāvadhāraṇārthatāṃ darśayati| yadi punastuśabdo' vadhāraṇārtho na kriyate, tato na jñāyate - kiṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇena bahuc? sambadhyate, atha purastāditayetaditi! tu śabdena tvavadhāraṇārthena purastāditatyetasmin? niyamite pāriśeṣyādvibhāṣāvacane bahujevābhisambadhyata iti vijñāyate| `citkaraṇamantodāttārtham` iti| kasya punarantodāttatvaṃ citkarādbhavati? saprakṛteḥ samudāyasya;`citaḥ saprakṛterba hvakajartham` (vā|6.1.169) iti vacanāt| yadyevam, paṭava iti subantādutpattau jasa udāttatvaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bahucyutpanne sati `arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipadikam? [[1.2.45]] iti prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyām, `supo dhātuprātipādikayoḥ` [[2.4.71]] iti subluk? tāvat? kriyate, tasmin? kṛte paścādudāttatvaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ paṭuśabde ya ukārastasya bhavati| yastu punaḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ subluki ca kṛte anyo jas? utpadyate, tasyodāttatvaṃ nāśahkanīyam, na hrasau prakṛtyekadeśaḥ| nanu cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti bahucpūrvasya prātipadikasaṃjñayā na bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tulyajātīyasya niyamaḥ| kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ? yathājātīyakānāṃ samāsaḥ| kathañjātīyakānāṃ samāsaḥ? bhadasaṃsargavatām| bhedasaṃsargau ca pṛthagarthānāmeva bhavataḥ| dyotakānāñca pṛthagarthavattā na sambhavati| atha kasmāt? subluk? tāvat? kriyate, paścādantodāttatvam, yāvatā paratvādantodāttatve nai va pūrvaṃ yuktaṃ bhavitum? naitadasti; nityo hi luk, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt| sa hi kṛte'pyantodāttatve prāpnoti, akṛte'pi; antodāttatvaṃ tvanyasya luki kṛte prāpnoti| anyasyākṛte śabdāntarasya prāpnuvan? vidhiranityo bhavati, tasmāllugeva tāvat? kriyate| `bahuguḍā drākṣā` iti| kathaṃ punaratreṣadasamāptiḥ, yāvatā guḍaśabdena guḍajātirucyate, tadādhāro vā dravyam| tatra jātistāvadekā, niravayavā ceti sarvasminnāśraye samāptā, dravyamapi yat? tayā sambaddhaṃ tat? sarvataḥ pūrṇatvāt? samāptameva| tasmādīṣadasamāptirayuktamiha viśeṇam, asambhavāt? sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca bahuguḍā drākṣeti drākṣāśabdena na prāpneti, tasyārthāntaratvāt? strīliṅgamapi `svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvartante` (vyā| pa| 74) iti nopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha śabdāduccāritāddvayaṃ pratīyate - śabdo'rthaḥ, jātidrravyañca; abhidheyasambandhenāśabdārthabhūtā api guṇāḥ, yatraitadubhayamasti tatra samāptiḥ| yatra tvanyatarannāsti tatreha guḍaśabdo guḍajātihīne mādhuryādiguṇahīne vā dravye vartate ityupapadyata īṣadasamāntiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamapyupadyata eva| katham? yadā tāvajjātihīne kenacit? sādhamryeṇa drākṣādiśabdābhidheye varttitvā guḍaśabdaḥ pratyayamutpadayata, tadā drākṣāśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati; ubhayorekārthavṛttitvāt| yadā tu guṇahīne guḍajītīya eva, tadāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyam, gaurvāhīka iti yathā, tathā bhaviṣyati guṇahīno'pi guḍaśabdaḥ| guḍo bahuguḍaśabdenottyate, tena ca tulyā drākṣeti sā'pi bahuguḍaśabdenābhidāyiṣyate| strīliṅgamapi copapadyate; tasya lokāśrayatvāt| api ca `svārthikāḥ prakṛteliṃṅgavacanānyanuvartante (vyā| pa| 74) iti prāyikametata| tena kadācidativartatante'pi, yathā kuṭīraḥ, śamīra iti| <> [[5.3.88]] iti svārthikaśca| `vibhāṣāvacanāt` ityādinā vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya prayojanamācaṣṭe| asati hi vibhāṣāgrahaṇe tiḍanteṣu kṛtāvakāśāḥ kalpabādayo bahucā subantādviśeṣavihitena bādhyeran? tasmistu satadi pakṣe te'pi bhavanti| nanu ca bhinnadeśena bahucā nāsti teṣāṃ virodhaḥ, tatkuto bādhā? asatyāṃ vā bādhāyāṃ kṛte'pi bahuci tairbhavitavyameva, paradaśasyānavaṣṭabdhatvāt? naitadasti; na hravaśyaṃ deśakṛta eva sāmānyaviśeṣayorvirodho bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? arthakṛto'pi| bahucaśca kalpabādibhiḥ samānortha iti bahucā dyotitatvāt? tasyārthasya kalpabādayo na bhavaviṣyanti| na hi dyotite punardyotanamasti, yathābhihite nābhidhātavyam| atha subgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā prātipadikagrahaṇamanuvartate, na ca prātipadikāt? subantādvā bahuca utpattau kaścidviśeṣo'sti? ata āha - `subgrahaṇam` ityādi| asati hi subgrahaṇe `tiṅaśca` [[5.3.56]] iti prakṛtatvāt? tato hi pratyayaḥ syāt| atastannivṛttyarthaṃ subagrahaṇam||`tasya vacane` iti| uktau, dyotana ityarthaḥ| `prakāravati cāyam` ityādinā thāljātīyarorviṣayabhedaṃ darśayati| viṣayabhede sati viśeṣavihitenāpi tālā jātīyaro bādhanaṃ na bhavati| thālpratyāntāt? jātīyar? siddho bhavati - kathañjātīya iti||tiṅantādayaṃ pratyayo neṣyate| `akajiṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punaretayorbhāvābhāvau labhyete? ityāha - `tiṅaścetyanuvṛttam` ityādi| uttaratraivetyavadhāraṇena tvihānuvṛttamapi kapratyayena sambandhanīyamiti darśayati| tacca pūrvasūtrādvacanagrahaṇe'pyanuvartamāne yata utpadyamānena pratyayenājñātāderarthasya vacanaṃ bhavati, tatraiva tena bhavitavyam| na ca tiṅntādutpadyamānenāpi kapratyayena so'rthaḥ śakyate dyotayituṃ, akacā tu śakyate| tasmāt? `tiṅśca` [[5.3.56]] ityetadanuvṛttamuttarasūtreṇākacā sambandhanīyam, neha kapratyayena| prāggrahaṇamapidyotanārtham, ivagrahaṇamavadhyartham; anyathādhikāraparimāṇaṃ na jñāyate||`kasyāpavādaḥ` iti| nanu ca bhinnadeśatvāt? kākacorvirodho nāsti, na cāsati virodhe bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, tataḥ kathaṃ kasyāpavādaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; naivāvaśyaṃ deśakṛta eva virodho bhavati, api tvarthakṛto'pītyuktam - `akacpratyayena samānorthaḥ` iti| akacā dyotitatavāt? tasyārthasya kapratyayo na bhaviṣyati| yadyatra prātipadikādityanuvṛtteḥ prātipadikasya prāk? ṭerakajvidhīyate, tvayakā mayaketyādi na sidhyati? atha supa iti prāk? ṭervidhīyeta, evamapi yuṣmakābhiriti na siṣyati? ityata āha - `prātipadikātsupaḥ` iti| `dvayamapi` ityādi| nanu ca dvayānuvṛttāvapi kvacit? subantasyaiva prākṭerbhavati, kvacit? prātipadikasya - ityeṣā vyavasthā na labhyate? ityāha - `tatra` ityādi| vacanagrahaṇaṃ vyavasthārthamihānuvartate| tena yatra prātipadikasya prākṭerutpadyamānenārthadyotanaṃ śakyate kartum, tatra prātipadikasya prāk? ṭerbhavati; yatra subantādutpannenārthadyotanaṃ śakyaṃ sampādayituṃ, tatra subantasyaiva| akacaścitkaraṇamantodāttārtham| taddhi saprakṛteḥ samudāyasya| tathā ca vakṣyati - `citaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajartham` (vā| 6.1.169)| `tūṣṇīmaḥ kāmpratyayo vaktavyaḥ` iti| yathāsambhavaṃ kutsādiṣvartheṣu| cakāro deśavidhyarthaḥ| `śīle ko malopaśca` iti| śīlamiti na svabhāva evocyate, kiṃ tarhi? niyamo'pi| tathā hi - śīlavān? bhikṣurityabhidhīyate, yaḥ samyaṅniyamamanupālayatīti| tena yo'pi niyamaparatayā vācaṃ niyamayati so'pi tūṣṇīka ucyate||`akacsanniyogena` ityādi| kathaṃ punarakacsanniyogenetyeṣa viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā na sūtre taduktam? ityāha - `cakāraḥ` ityādi| cakārasyaitadeva prayojanam - akacsanniyogena kakārasya dakāro yathā syāditi bhāvaḥ||`ajñātaviśeṣo'jñātaḥ` iti| yadi yasyātyantamajñānaṃ so'jñātaḥ syāt, evaṃ sati sarvathā vastuvijñānā bhāve prakṛtireva na syāt, na hi sarvathā'vijñāto'rthaḥ prayogamarhati; tasmāt? svena rūpeṇa jñātasya yasya dharmāntaratvamajñātaṃ sa ihājñāto'bhimata iti jñāyate - avijñātaviśeṣo'jñāta iti| asyaivārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha - `svena` ityādi| svarūpamaātvādi, viśeṣarūpaṃ svasvāmisambandhādi||`kāruṇṇena` ityādi| abhyupapattiranugraha eva| `svapitaki, āsitaki` iti| <> [[7.2.76]] iṭ, adāditvācchapo luk||`sāmadānādirūpāyo nītiḥ` iti| ādiśabdena bhedadaṇḍayogrrahaṇam; tautvanukampāyāṃ na sambhavata iti sāmadānādirekaiva nītirguhrate, `ehaki` iti| iṇa āṅapūrvālloṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanasya `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] iti hirādeśaḥ| nanu pūrveṇaivātrāpi pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ, atrāpayanukampā gamyata eva, tata kimartham? ityāha - `pūrveṇaiva` ityādi| pratyāsanno'nukampāsambandho yasyānukampayamānasya sa tathoktaḥ| pratyāsannatvaṃ tu sambandhasaryānukampyānaṃprati; tadāśrayatvādanukampāyāṃ vidhīyamānaḥ pratyāsatteryasyānukampayā pratyāsannaḥ sambandhastataḥ eva yukto vidhātumiti pūrvemānukampyamānādeva pratyo vihitaḥ, na tu vyavahitāt? punarghānādeḥ| ataḥ samprati tato'pi yathā syādityevamarthamidam| `vyavahitāt` iti| viprakṛṣṭādityarthaḥ| viprṛṣṭatvamatadāśrayatvādanukampāyāḥ| na hi tasyāṃ dhānādirāśrayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? anukampyamāno devadattādiḥ||`devikaḥ` iti| `yajñikaḥ` iti| `ṭhājāvūdhrvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ` [[5.3.83]] iti dattaśabdasya lope kṛte <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralopaḥ| pratyudāharaṇe sarvatra ka eva veditavyaḥ| `madrabāhukaḥ` iti| madrau bāhū yasya sa madrabāhuḥ| nedaṃ manuṣyanāma, kiṃ tarhi? viśeṣaṇam| manuṣyagrahaṇaṃ kimartham? devahastako hastītyatra mā bhūt| nāma grahaṇaṃ kimartham? mṛgakaḥ, matsyaka ityatra mā bhūt||`deviyaḥ` iti| ghan? pūrvavallopaḥ| `devilaḥ` iti ilac| `devikaḥ` iti| ṭhan| `devadattakaḥ` iti kaḥ||upaḍa ityādau upendradattaśabdātpratyayaḥ| vikalpārthaṃ prāggrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `vetyeva hi` ityādi| atra he vetyanuvartate, tasmāttenaiva vikalpasya sampāditatvāt? tadarthagrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate||`nāmagrahaṇam` iti| asati hi nāmagrahaṇe jātisvarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt| ataḥ svarūpagravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ jātigrahaṇam||`vyāghrājino nāma kaścit` iti| vyāghrasyājinam, vyāghrājinamivājinaṃ yasyeti vyāghrājinaḥ| `saptamyupamānapūrvasya bahuvrīhiruttarapadalopaśca` (vā| 99) iti bahuvrīhāvuttarapadalope kṛte vyāghrājina ityeṣa śabdaḥ sampadyate| athājinalopaścetyevaṃ kasmānnoktam, kimuttarapadagrahaṇena? naivaṃ śakyam; vyāghramahājinau nāmakaścit, so'nukampitaḥ - vmāghraka ityatrājinaśabdasya lopa ucyamāne mahacchabdasya nivṛttirna syāt| uttarapadasyatu lope vidhīyamāne bhavati| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu| mahadajinaṃ mahājinam, vyāghrasya mahājinamiva mahājinamasyeti pūrvavaduttarapadalopī bahuvrīhiḥ, tataḥ kan||`asmin? prakaraṇe` ityādi| anenāsmin? prakaraṇe yau vihitau ṭhājādī tatra lopī bhavati, yau tu prakaraṇāntare tatra na bhavatīti darśayati| etaccaitatprakaraṇa vihitayoṣṭhājādyorihānuvutterlabhyate| athodhrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `dvitīyādacaḥ` iti pañcamī, tasmādantareṇāpyūṣrvagrahaṇam, <> [[1.1.67]] ityūdhrvaṃ yacchabdarūpaṃ tasyaiva lopo bhaviṣyati? ityata āha - `udhrvaṃgrahaṇam` ityādi| asatyūdhrvaṃgrahaṇe <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti dvitīyādaco yaḥ parastasyāderlopaḥ syāt, tasmistadu sati sarve nivartate| ataḥ sarvasya lopo yathā syādityevamarthamūdhrvaṃgrahaṇam| atha ṭhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā ṭhasyekādeśe kṛte'jādāvityeva siddham? ityata āha - `ṭhagrahaṇam` ityādi| uko dvitīyatve satyakṛta evekādeśe ṭhāvasthāyāmeva dvitīyādūdhrvasya lope kṛte `isusuktāntāt? kaḥ` [[7.3.51]] iti kavidhiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ ṭhagrahaṇam| tatraitat? syāt? codyam - ikādeśe kṛte'jādilakṣate ca dvitīyādūdhrvasya lope sthānivadbhāvāṭṭhagrahaṇena grahaṇāt? kādeśo bhaviṣyati? ityāha - `ajādilakṣaṇe hi` ityādi| ihādeśavidhau tatra ṭhagrahaṇaṃ varṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt, saṅghātagrahaṇaṃ vā; tatra varṇagrahaṇe'lvidhitvāt? sthānivadbhāvo nopapadyate| sahghātagrahaṇe yadyapyupapadyate, tathāpi `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya` (vyā|pa|12) ityajāditvasannipātakṛtamukaḥ ṭhapratyayenānantayryamiti tadajāditvavighātaṃ na kuryāt| tataśca yathā - mathitaṃ paṇyamasya māthitika ityatra yasyeti [[6.4.148]] lope satyapi takāreṇa ṭhasyānantaryye kādeśo na bhavati, tatā vāyudatto vāyuka iti na syāt| tasmāduko dvitīyatve kavidhānārthaṃ ṭhagrahaṇam| `uvarṇāllaḥ` iti| tasya ca lopa ityarthaḥ| sa cādereva bhavati, na sarvasya| athavā - la ityādeśaevāyaṃ sarve lasya vidhīyate| ca cānekāltvātsarvasyaiva bhavati|`dvitīyādacaḥ` iti| dvitīyalope kartavye sandhyakṣarasya dvitīyatvaṃ bhavati yadā, tadādeḥ śabdarūpasya lopo bhavatīti vaktavyam| sandhyakṣarādūdhrvasya lopo'pi prāpte sandhyakṣarasyaikākṣarapūrvapadānāmityādi dvitīyādaca ūṣrvasya lopaḥ uktaḥ, tadapavādaḥ| `ekākṣara` iti| akṣaraśabdaścāyamacyapi vartate| ekākṣaramekāca pūrvaṃpadaṃ yeṣāṃ te, teṣāmuttarapadalopo vaktavyaḥ| `vāgāśīḥ` iti| vācyāśīrasyeti kṛtvā vaiyadhikaraṇye bahuvrīhiḥ| anukampito bāgāśīriti vigṛhraṭhaci kṛte dvitīyādaca ūdhrvasya lopaḥ syāt| tasmin? sati vācā+ika iti sthite yasyeti [[6.4.148]] lope kṛte <> [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadbhāvātpadasaṃjñā na syāt| tasmāt? tasyāntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā, <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam - vāgika iti syāt| āśīḥśabdasya tasya paralope kṛte tasyānajādeśātvāt? sthānivadbhāvo nāstīti bhasaṃjñā bhavatyeva, tatastayā padasaṃjñāyā niṣidvāyāṃ padanibandhanakutvādi na bhavatīti vācika iti sidhyati| `katham` ityādi| yadyekākṣarapūrvapadānāmuttarapadasya lopa ucyate, ṣaḍika iti na sidhyati| atrāpyuttaralope kṛte bhasaṃjñāyānupajātāyāṃ padasaṃjñāyāṃ bādhitāyām? <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti ṣaṣaḥ ṣakārasya jaśtve kṛte ṣaḍika iti na sidhyati||`sa cākṛtasandhīnām` iti| yadyasvarasandhau lopo bhavatyevaṃ sidhyati, nānyathā| tasmādakṛtasvarasandhīnāmeva śevalādīnāṃ lopo bhavatīti vaktavyam||`dīrghapratiyogī hrasvaḥ` iti| sa punaryamapekṣya dīrgho bhavati sa veditavyaḥ| nanu ca dīrghatvāpacaye sati hrasvo bhavati; yatra dīrghatvāpacayastatrālpatāstīti pūrveṇaiva siddham? na sidhyati; na hrayaṃ niyogaḥ - yatra dīrghasyāpacayastatrālpatvena bhavitavyamiti, tathā hi - satyapyapacaye mahattvaguṇayuktaṃ yadvastu tadamahadeva bhavati, na cālpam||`kuṭīraḥ| śamīraḥ` iti| svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanṛvartate iti prakṛtigatenaiva strīliṅgena bhavitavyam, na pulliṅgena? ityata āha - `svārthikatve'pi` ityādi||yadi tanutve vatsādiśabdebhyaḥ pratyayo vidhīyate, ye śarīre kṛśā vatsādayastatrāpyaviśeṣeṇa pratyayaḥ prasajyeta, viśeṣānupādānāt? ityata āha - `yasya guṇasya` ityādi| guṇo viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣyaṃ dravyam| vatsādiśabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ vayoviśeṣādi| yasmin? sati vatsādayaḥ śabdā dravye viśeṣye niviśante=pravartate, tasyaiva vatsādiśabdasya pravṛttinimittsya tanutve pratyo bhavati, na tanutvamātre; tat? punaḥ pratyāsatteḥ| vatsādibhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ pratyaye vidhīyamāne anyat? pravṛttinimittaṃ na pratyāsannama, tatastasyaiva tanutve yuktaṃ pratyayena bhavitavyam|`tasya tanutvaṃ dvitīyavayasaḥ prāptiḥ` iti| tṛtīyavayaḥprāptikāle dvitīyasya vayasaḥ| ukṣaśabdasya pravṛttinimittasya niścitaṃ tanutvamavaśiṣyate| `tasya tanutvamanyapitṛkatā` iti| gardabhapitṛktetyarthaḥ| tarhi gardabhādaāāyāmutpanno'ātara ityucyete| `tasya tanutvaṃ bhārodvaharne mandaśaktitā` iti| bhārodvahanaṃ prati yaḥsamartho na syāt? sa ṛṣabhatara ityucyate| yadā tu tasya bhārodvahane sāmarthyaṃ mandaṃ bhavati=hīyate, tadā tanutvaṃ bhavati||`nirdhāryamārṇebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ` iti| `nirdhāryamāṇavācibhyaḥ ityetat? kuto labhyate? tata evotpanne pratyaye nidhariṇasya gamyamānatvat| `mahāvibhāṣā` ityādi| `samarthānāṃ prathamāt` [[4.1.82]] `niṣariṇe` ici| viṣaye pratyayo yathā syāt| `dvayoriti samudāyānnirdhāraṇavibhaktiḥ#ḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhī, saptamī vā| sā punastasya `yataśca nirdhāraṇam? [[2.3.41]] ityenena| `#ekasyeti nirdeśaḥ nirdhāryamāṇanirdeśaḥ` iti| ekasminnirṣāryamāṇe yathā syāt| nanu ca samudāyādekadeśasya pṛthak? karaṇaṃ nirdhāraṇam, dvayorityavayavasamudāyo nirdiṣṭo yata ekadeśo nirdhārayitavyaḥ, sa caikadeśe nirdhārayitavye eka eva sambhavati; ato'ntareṇāpyekagrahaṇamekasyaiva nirdhāraṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti niṣphalamekagrahaṇam? naitadevam; asati hi tasmin? dvayoriti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate, dvau cennirṣāryete kutaściditi, tataścehāpi pratyayaḥ syāt - asmin? grāme kau devadattayajñadattāviti| tasmādekagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||`jātiparipraśnaviṣayebhyaḥ` iti| jātiparipraśno yathāsambhavaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| `katamo bhavatāṃ kaṭaḥ` iti| `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha` (ma| bhā| 2|225) iti tasya jātitvam| sā ca kaṭhajātiḥ kiṃ śabdena paripṛcchyate| kiṃśabdo'tra jātiparipraśnaviṣayo bhavati| `yatamo bhavatāṃ kaṭhastatama āgacchatu` iti| yattacchabdāviha jātiviṣayāveva, na paripraśnaviṣayo bhavati| `yatamo bhavatāṃ kaṭhastatama āgacchatu` iti| yattacchabdāviha jātiviṣayāveva, na paripraśnaviṣayau; asaṃbhavāt, na hi tābhyāṃ paripraśnaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? kiṃśabdena| ata eva vakṣyati - `paripraśnagrahaṇaṃ kima eva viśeṣaṇam, na yattadoḥ, asambhavāt` iti| `vāvacanamakajartham` iti| pakṣe'kajapi yathā syāt| yadyevam? vākyaṃ na sidhyati, yadā hi ḍatamaj? na bhavatyakacaiva bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `mahāvibhāṣā` ityādi| atra ca mahīvibāṣā pratyayavikalpārthā'nuvartate, tayā pratyaye vikalpite pakṣe vākyamapi bhaviṣyati| `jātigrahaṇaṃ tu sarvaiḥ sambadhyate` iti| jātiḥ savatraiva bhavati, tatra jātyādinā kiṃ śabde viśeṣyamāṇe sāmadhryādeva tasya paripraśnaviṣayatvaṃ labhyate? naitadasti; sa hi kṣepe'pi vartate| tatrāsati paripraśnagrahaṇe yadā ātau kṣepe vartate, tadā pratyayaḥ syāt||`svasmin? viṣaye` iti| ātmīye viṣaye| tatra dvayorekasya nirvāraṇaṃ ḍataraco viṣayaḥ bahūnāmekasya nirdhāraṇe ḍatamacaḥ| cakāro'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ| asati hi tasmin? `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā| pa| 19) iti ḍatamajeva syāt; dvayonirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarajityanuvṛtteḥ, bahūnāṃ nirdhāraṇe ḍatamajityanuvṛtteḥ| vikalpārthaṃ prāggrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `vikalpo'nuvartata eva` iti| anantarasūtrādvetyanuvartata eveti viklapa ityuktam, tenaiva pratyayavikalpaḥ siddhaḥ| tasamāt? pūjārthameva prāggrahaṇam, na dikalpārtham||`vyākaraṇakena` ityādi| kathaṃ punavryākaraṇamavakṣepaṇam, tasyādhyayanaṃ śāstravihitam, vedāṅgatvāt? tathāpi yatrāñaye tadavakṣepaṇamupasaṃharati, taṃ prati tasyāvakṣepaṇatvamupapadyate; doṣahetutvāt| `parasya` ityādinā <> [[5.3.74]] ityavakṣepaṇe kannityasya vibhāgaṃ darśayati||`tadviśeṣaṇaṃ pratikṛtigrahaṇam` iti| pratakṛtiviṣayaṃ yatra sādṛśyaṃ tatra prayogo yathā syāt| gaurivagavaya ityatrāsti sādṛśyam, na tu pratikṛtiviṣayam; na hi gaurgavayapratikṛtiḥ| kāṣṭhādimayaṃ hi yat? praticchandekaṃ tat? prakṛticyate||cañce iti tṛṇapuruṣa ucyate| sādṛśyācca manuṣyaścañcā| `lupi yuktavadvyaktiyacane` [[1.2.51]] iti prakṛtigatameva liṅgaṃ bhavati| nanu ca `manuṣyalūpi pratiṣedhaḥ` (vā|21) iti vacanādyuktavadbhāvo na prāpnoti? naitadasti; viśeṣaṇānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, na lubantasya||`devapadyaḥ` iti| devānāṃ panthā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `ṛkpaḥ [[5.4.74]] ityādinākāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, kan, tasya sup||`itaḥ prabhati` ityādi| tatra pratikṛtau <> [[5.3.96]] iti kani prāpte, itaḥ prabhṛti pratyayā bhavanti| apratikṛtau tavasaṃjñāyāṃ vākyenaivābhidhāne prāpte| saṃjñāyāṃ tu pratikṛtāvaprakṛtau ca ḍhañeva; vastiḥ=vṛtivikāraḥ| `vāsteyī` iti `ṭiṅḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp||`idārthaviṣayāt? samāsāt` iti| ivaśabdasyārtha ivārthaḥ=sādṛśyaṃ viṣayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| yadi ivārthaviṣayāt? samāsāccho vidhīyate, śastrośyāmā, puruṣavyāghra ityatrāpi prapnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, na hyatra samāsa ivārthe vartate, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvapadamuttarapadaṃ vā - śastrīva śyāmā, puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iveti| athāpyekadeśasyevārthe vartamānatvāt? samāso'ṇīvārthaṃ ucyate, tathāpi samāsenaivoktatvānna bhaviṣyati, yastu samāsaḥ sa ka ivārthe vartete? samāsārthāvapara ivārtho yatrāsti tatrāyaṃ pratya uktaḥ| `parasminnivāyaṃ eva` iti| `iva` ityabhikārāt| `atarkitopanatam` iti| abuddhipūrvamupasthitamityarthaḥ| `citrikaraṇam` iti|vismayakaraṇamityarthaḥ| `tatkatham` iti| kena prakāreṇātarkitopanataṃ citrīkaraṇamiti? - imamarthaṃ pṛcchati - tatkamityādi| `samāsaścāyam` ityādi| yadetadivārthaviṣayāt? samāsāt? pratyayavidhānam, ata eva jñāpakādavasīyate - samāso bhavati| kathaṃ punaretajjñāpakamiti? āha - `na hrasya` ityādi| ivārthaviṣayasya samāsasāmānyasya lakṣaṇaṃ nāstīti| tasmādyadetat? tataḥ pratyayavidhānam, etadeva tadbhāvasya jñāpakamupapadyate| atha vā - kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñāpakena tadbhāvaḥ pratipādyata iti? āha - `na hrasya` ityādi| `sa caivaṃ viṣaya eva` iti| ivārthaviṣaya evetyarthaḥ||`anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena` ityādi| pūrvasūtreṇa [[5.3.108]] vihitatvāṭṭhagevānantaraḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ samuccayārtham| atastena `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) iti sa eva prāpyate||`imatha` iti| imetīdamā samānārthaṃ prakṛtyantaramasti| tata idaṃ pratyayaviṣānam||`pūrvāt? iti| pūrvaśabdo'vayavavācī| grāmaṇīḥ pūrvo yasya tat? grāmaṇīpūrvam| pratiṣedhena ca svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti vijñāyate| pūgaśabdena svarūpe gṛhramāṇe grāmaṇīpūrvataḥ prāptireva nāsti; grahaṇavatā prātipādikena (vyā|pa|89) tadantavidhaḥ pratiṣedhāt| `lohaṣvajāḥ` iti kan| atra devadattaśabdaḥ pūrvagrāmaṇīravayava iti na pratyayaḥ||āyudhajīvi| bāhīkeṣviti| bāhīkākhyagrāmaviśeṣeṣvityarthaḥ| kṣaudrakya iti| kṣudrako nāma kaścidāyudhajīvināṃ bāhīka deśavāsināṃ saṅghaḥ| sa eva kṣaudrakyaḥ| mālavya iti| mālavo nāma kaścidvāhīkeṣu āyudhajīvināṃsaṅghaḥ| sa eva mālavyaḥ| ṭittvānṅībiti| evaṃ ca astriyāmiti nātra sambadhyata iti bhāvaḥ| tadviśeṣeti| vyākhyānāditi bhāvaḥ|`vāhīkeṣu` iti| nirdhāraṇe [[2.3.41]] saptamī| `vāhokeṣu madhye ya āyudhajīvisaṅghaḥ` iti| nidharimñca samānajātīyasyaiva bhavatatyāyudhajīvisaṅgho'pi vāhīka eva vijñāyate| atha vā - deśavācino vāhokaśabdādadhikaraṇa evaiṣā saptamī; vāhikadeśaviśeṣa āyudhajīvisaṅgho vasatīti|`brāāhṛṇe tadviśeṣagrahaṇam` iti| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ata eva pratiṣedhāt| yadi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, brāāhṛṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| prāptipūrvako hi pratiṣedho bhavati| brāāhṛṇaśabda āyudhajīvisaṅgho vāhīkeṣu na vidyata iti kiṃ brāāhṛṇapratiṣedhena! brāāhṛṇaviśeṣavācitastu ye gopālaprabhṛtayaḥ śabdāstadvācyā āyudha jīviṅghā vāhīkeṣu bhavanti; tatra yadi pratiṣedho na kriyeta, tadā tebhyo'pi syāt| atastannivṛttyartho'rthavān? viśeṣagrahaṇe pratiṣedho bhavati| tasmāt - `brāāhṛṇe tadviśeṣagrahaṇam, rājanye tu svarūpāgrahaṇameva` iti| tadvācyasyāyudhajīvisaṅghasya vāhīkeṣu sattvāt; `sva rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā` iti vacanācca| `tena` ityādi| yasmād? ṅībarthotra ṭakāraḥ kṛtastena `astriyām` [[5.3.113]] iti nānuvartate| tadanuvṛttau ñyaṭpratyayāntaṃ striyāṃ na bhavatīti ṅībarthaṃ ṭitkaraṇanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādastriyāmiti nivṛttam, ataḥ striyāmapi bhavati| `kauṇḍībṛsī` `kṣaudrakī` iti| <> [[6.4.150]] iti yakāralopaḥ||yadi vāhīkeṣu vṛkaśabdasya vācya āyudhajīvisaṅgho bhavati, tato ñyaṭi prāpte'nyatrāptāpta eva kasmiścit? pratyayavidhānaṃ veditavyam| `vṛkāviva` iti| vṛkaśabdo'tra jātivacanaḥ||`teṣu ceyaṃ smṛtiḥ` iti trigartaṣaṣṭhāḥ smayryante jñāyante'nayeti smṛtiḥ| sā punaḥ - `āhustrigartaṣaṣṭhān` iti| ayamevāptapraṇītaślokaḥ eṣu ca trigartaṣaṣṭheṣu prathamapañcamau śivādyaṇantau, śeṣāstviñantāḥ| kecidataddhitāntameva pañcamaṃ paṭhanti| teṣāṃ brāhṛguptaśabdādeva ccho bhavati||kigartha punariha yaudheyādayaḥ paṭhante, yāvatā lukpratiṣedhārthaṃ caturthe yaudheyādayaḥ samāmnātā eva, ta eva ceha gṛhyante? satyametat; vicitrā hi gaṇānāṃ kṛtirgaṇakāresyeti punaḥ paṭhitāḥ| par(āādiṣu satvacchaśabdo paṭhate| sa ca satvacchabdaparakṛtirmatuppratyayānto veditavyaḥ||`abhijito'patyamityaṇ` iti| `prāgdīṣyato'ṇ` [[4.1.83]] ityautsargikaḥ| evamuttratrāpi| `gotrapratyayasyāṇo grahaṇamiṣyate` iti| tatkathaṃ jātināmna ityanuvartate? tenāṇantaṃ yajjātināma tadeva grahīṣyate| yaśca gotrra'ṇ? vihitastadantameva jātināma bhavati; `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha` (ma| bhā| 2|225) iti ātitvāt| `ābhijito muhūtatatt#ṃ#ḥ, ābhijītaḥ sthālīpākaḥ` iti| ekatra <> [[4.2.3]] ityaṇ, aparatra <> [[4.2.24]] iti||iti śrībodhisattvadeśīpācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ pañcamasyādhyāyasyatṛtīya pādaḥ||* * *atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥcaturthaḥ pādaḥpratipadikāditi vartate, tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ pādaśatasyagrahaṇam, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhirbhavatadītyāha - `pādaśatāntasya` iti| ādiśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| na ca saṃkhyāśabdaḥ padaśataśabdayoravayava upapadyate; pṛthāgbhāvādanāraṃbhakatvāt| na hi pṛthagbhūtamanārambhakaṃ śabdāntarasyāvayavo yujyate, yathā ghaṭaśabdaḥ paṭaśabdasya| viparite tu yujyate, yathā - paṭasya samudāyātmanaḥ tantvādikāraṇaṃ samadeśamavayadamāhaḥ| tasmāt? `saṃkhyādeḥ` ityetadapi prātipadikasya vijñāyate, na pādaśataśabdayorityāha - `saṃkhyādeḥ` ityādi| ānantayryalakṣaṇā ceyaṃ ṣaṣṭho, yathā - gāpoṣṭakaṃ [[3.2.8]] iti gāpoṣṭakpratyayo bhavatītyanantaramiti śeṣaḥ| `tatsanniyogena ca` iti| cakārasya sanniyogārthatvāt| `antasya` iti| alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.51]] | `punaḥ` ityādi| nimitte bhavo naimittikaḥ, adhyātmāditvāṭṭhañ (vā| 456), na naimittiko'naimittikaḥ| lopaḥ syāvityevamarthaṃ punarlopavacanam| vunāpi saha lopo vidhīyamānaḥ paranimittaṃ nāpekṣata ityanaimittiko bhavati| yasyeti [[6.4.148]] lopaḥ| `paranimittakaḥ` iti| īti taddhite ca parasminnimitte vidhānāt? tasya sthānivadbhāvāt, <> [[1.1.57]] iti lopasya sthānivadbhāvena pācchabdarūpasya vihitatvāt| anacko hi pācchabdaḥ sthānyupāttaḥ, tasya cānackatvaṃ sthānivadbhāve sati hīyate| asya tvanaimittikatvānna sthānivadbhāva iti padbhāvo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `dvau dvau pādau` iti| pīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavati||`damanaṃ daṇḍaḥ` iti| nanu daṇḍaśabdo'yaṃ yaṣṭaādāvapi vartate? satyam; tathāpīha damane vartamānasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam, damanasyaiva pratyayāntena gamyamānatvāt| `dānaṃ vyavasargaḥ` iti| yadyevam, tat? pūrvayoga udāhṛtaṃ dattaṃ tadā copapadyate yadyayaṃ yogo'dhikavidhānārtho bhavati; na tvapavādaḥ; tasmānnārtho'nena yogena? ityata āha - `avīpsārthaḥ` ityādi| tena dānamātre'nena vun| dānavīpsāyāṃ pūrvayogena punarbhavatyeva||`jātayaro'pavādaḥ` iti| etena yathā prakāravacane vidhīyamāno jātīyar? prakāravati na prakāramātre, tathāyamapīti darśayati; anyathā hi jātīyaroyaṃ viṣayabhedādapavādo nopapadyate, atha kimartha <> [[5.3.69]] ityasyaivānantaraṃ sthūlādibhyaḥ kan? na vidhīyate? kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? kan? prakāravacanaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati? naivaṃ śakyam; sthūlādīnāṃ hi prakārasyājñātādīnāṃ ca yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ paratvāt? ke kṛte kanna syāt; śabdāntaratvāt| athāpi syāt? evamapi sthūlaka ityādyudāttatvaṃ syāt, iha tu kano vidhāne paratvāt? paratvāt? kani kṛti tataḥ ka ityantodāttatvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| `cañcadbṛhatoḥ` ityādi| sthālādiṣu cañcadbṛhatorapāṭhāt? tanna prāpnoti| tasmādupasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyam| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena cañcadbṛhatorapi bhaviṣyatīti| `sthālāṇumāṣeṣu` iti| kecidetāścataruāḥ prakṛtasya iti varṇayanti| sthūlakaḥ aṇukaḥ| māṣakaḥ| iṣukaḥ| apare tu sthūlāṇuśabdau prakṛtī, māṣeṣvityayaṃ tapādhinirdeśa ityāhaḥ| anye tvānantayryādaṇuśapabdasyaiva māṣagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇamācakṣate| ādyameva darśanaṃ nyāyyam; tathā hi - sthūlakādayaḥ tadviśeṣamam| kṛṣṇakāstilāḥ| `yava vrīhiṣu` iti| yava iti prakṛtiḥ, vrīhiṣviti tadviśeṣaṇam| yavako vrīhiḥ| `pādyakālavadātāḥ surāyām` iti| apare punarānantayryadavadātaśabdasya surāgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ pādyakālayorna viśeṣaṇatvaṃ bhavatītyāhuḥ| `gomūtrādācchādane` [`gomūtra ācchādane`-kāśikā] iti| gomūtraśabdaḥ prakṛtiḥ, ācchādane iti tadviśeṣaṇam| gomūtraprakārakamācchādanaṃ gomūtrakam| `surāhau` [`surāyā ahau`-kāśikā] iti| sureti prakṛtiḥ ahāviti viśeṣaṇam| surāvarṇo'hiriti surakaḥ| `jīrṇaśāliṣu` iti| patramūle ityete śabdarūpe samastavyaste pratyayamutpādayataḥ - patrakam, mūlakam||`aśeṣasambandhaḥ` iti| aśeṣasya svena sambandhinā bhedanādīnāṃ vyāptirityarthaḥ| `bhinnakam` iti| na tu yasyāśeṣasya bhedena sambandhaḥ, api tvekadeśasya tadbhinnakamityucyate| bhinnamityatrāśeṣasambandha eva gamyate| yadyaśeṣaṃ bhidikriyāvyāptaṃ ghaṭādi tadbhinnamityabhidhīyate||`sāmivacane` iti| sāmyucyate yena tat? sāmivacanam| `sāmikṛtam` iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, viśeṣaṇasamāso vā| `prakṛtyābhihitatvāt` iti| pratiṣedhānarthasye hetuḥ| anatyantagatiṃ gamayituṃ kan? vidhīyate| sā ca sāmiśabdenaiva gamiteti kanaḥ prāptireva nāsti| ato'narthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| svārthamātreṇaiva kano vidhāyakaṃ lakṣaṇamastīti manyamāna āha - `kena punaḥ` ityādi| yadetat pratiṣedhavacanam, etadeva jñāpayati - bhavati svārthe kan? iti, anyathā pratiṣeṣavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| ardhakṛtam| nemikṛtam||`kannanuvartate` iti| svaritatvāt| `na pratiṣedhaḥ` iti| viparyayāt| `bṛhatikā` iti| ke'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] iti hrasvaḥ||`avidyamānāni ṣaḍakṣīṇyasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ` iti| tataḥ `bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ [[5.4.113]] iti ṣac| rājaśabdāt? saptamī| rājanyathīti vigṛhra <> [[2.1.40]] iti samāsaḥ|`tamabādayaḥ` iti| `atiśāyena tamabiṣṭhanau` [[5.3.55]] ityevamādayaḥ| `prāk? kanaḥ` iti| <> [[5.3.64]] ityayam| `ñyādayaḥ` iti| `pūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt? [[5.3.112]] ityādayaḥ| `prāgvṛnaḥ` iti| `pādaśatasya` [[5.4.1]] ityādisūtreṇa vihitatvāt| `āmādayaḥ` iti| `kimettiṅavyayaghāt` [[5.4.11]] ityevamādayaḥ| `prāṅmayaṭaḥ` iti| <> [[5.4.21]] ityataḥ| `bṛhatījātyantāḥ` iti| `bṛhatyā ācchadane` [[5.4.6]] ityetat? sūtraṃ kanamupalakṣayati| jātyantaśabdenāpi <> [[5.4.9]] ityetat| bahuvacananirdeśo'ṣaḍakṣādisūtrāvihitasya parigrahārthaḥ||`sasthānena` iti| karaṇe tṛtīyā| sthānena sthānavācyenārthena tulyaparyāyeṇa sthānāntaṃ yadyarthavadbhavatyevaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyathā| kathaṃ punaḥ sthānaśabdena tulyatvamucyate? ityāha - `samānam` ityādi| yasya samānaṃ sthānaṃ sa sasthāna ityucyate| yaścaivaṃvidhaṃ sa yadapekṣaṃ tasya samānaṃ sthānaṃ sa tena tulyo bhavatīti| `pitṛsthānīyaḥ` iti| pitṛsthānamiva sthānaṃ yasyeti `saptamyupamāna` (vā| 99) ityādinottarapadalopo bahuvrīhiḥ| `gosthānama` iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'yam| bhavati hretat? sthānāntaṃ prātipadikam, na tu sthānena tulyārthenārthaktaḥ| yathā sthānāntāt? pratyayo bhavati, tathā tatpuruṣeṇāpi svasthānaśabdenārtha upasthāpite tenārthenārthavataḥ sthānāt? pratyayena bhavitavyam; viśeṣānupādānāt| tataśca tulyañca tat stānāntaṃ pratipadikaṃ sthānavācyenārthenārthavaditiyaścodayet? taṃ pratyāha - `itikaraṇo vivakṣārthaḥ` iti| itikaraṇo hyatra vivakṣārthaḥ kriyate, tenāyamartho labhyatetataścedvivakṣā bhavatīti| bahuvrīhrarthenārthavataḥ sthānāt? pratyayotpattau lokasya vivakṣā bhavati, na tatpuruṣārthenārthavataḥ| tasmāt? sthānāntasyārthamutpādayituṃ bahuvrīhireva sthānaśabdārthamutpādayati; na tu tatpuruṣaḥ| tena na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ| `cacchabdaḥ smabandhārthaḥ` iti| sthānāntasya sasthānasambandho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ cecchabdaḥ; anyathā pratyayaṃ prati pañcasyā sthānāntasya nirdeśāt? sthānāntasya sasthānena sambandho na syāt| na hi pañcamyantena tasya sambandhaḥ śakyate karttum| cecchabde tu sa cet? sthānenārthavadvatītyupapadyate, na tu sambandhaḥ| `dvayorvibhāṣayormadhye nityavidhayaḥ` iti| yadi nityā na syuḥ, pūrvaiva vibhāṣottaratrānuvarttiṣyata ityuttaraṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt||`adravyaprakarṣe` iti| nanu ca dravyasya na prakarṣo'sti; tathā ca bhāṣye uktam - `na vai dravyasya prakarṣo'sti` iti, ataḥ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ? ityata āha - `yadyapi` ityādi| dṛśyate cādheyadharmasyādhāra upacāraḥ, yathā - mañcāḥ ṛśantīti| tasmādādhārādheyayoḥ kriyāguṇayordharmaḥ prakarṣaḥ| sa yadādhāradravya upacaryate tadāsau dravyadharmatvādupacāreṇa dravyadharmo bhavati| ato'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| `kriyāguṇayoreva` ityādi| kriyāyā guṇasya prakarṣo yadā dravye nopacayaṃte kriyāguṇayoreva prakarṣaḥ, tatraiva pratyayaḥ| yadi tu dravye upacaryate tato dravyaprakarṣa iti vacanāt| `kintarām` iti| vastuno bahavo viśeṣāḥ, tatra praśnaḥ kiṃśabdārthaḥ| `pūrvāhṇetarām` iti| <> [[6.3.17]] iti sampamyā aluk| nanu ca pūrvāhṇaḥ kālaḥ, kālaśca dravyam, dravyaprakarṣe pratyayena na bhavitvyam; adravyaprakarṣa iti pratiṣedhāt? naiva doṣaḥ; na hyatra prātipadikārthaḥ prakarṣe vartate, kiṃ tarhi? vibhaktyarthaḥ, sa ca guma eva; dravyaśaktisvarūpatvāt? kārakāṇām| atha vā - vacanasāmarthyāt? kālaprakarṣe bhavati| na hi kālādanyasyasmādekārāt? paro gha#o bhavati| `kālanāmnaḥ` iti parataḥ saptamyā alugvidhānāt| `uccaistarām` iti||`anugadatītyanugādī` iti| grahāditvāṇṇiniḥ| āvāśyake vā, tācchīlye vā, asmādeva nipātanācca||`vyāvakrośī` iti| `kraśa āhvāne` (dhā| pā| 856) ityasmāṇṇaca, laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, ṇajantādañ| sa ca kṛdagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā| pa| 126) sagatikādbavati| tena sagatikameveha pratipadikasaṃjñāṃ pratipadyate, na karmavyatihāra iti pratiṣedhādeva vṛddhipratiṣedhayorādivṛddhireva bhavati| `ṭiṅḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| `vyāvahāsī` iti| `ata upadāyāḥ` [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `tataḥ` iti| ṇajantāditi yāvat| `svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvartante (jai|pa|vṛ| 95) iti kṛtvā| `evaṃ tarhi` ityādinā strīgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ darśayati| `tena` ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanam| `ativartante'pi` iti| vyabhicarantyapītyarthaḥ| apiśabdādanuvartante'ṇīti| yadi svārthikānāṃ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānuvṛttivyabhicāro jñāpyate, tato guḍādibhyaḥ puṃliṅgādyanugatebhyaśca svārthe kalpabādayo bhavati, teṣāṃ puṃlliṅgavacanaṃ ca tadaiva bhavet? tataśca guḍakalpā drakṣetyevamādi nopapadyate| tasmastu jñāpite liṅgāntarañca bhavatīti| tena sarvametadupapannaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdenāpi tailakalpā, cāturvaṇryam, trailokyamityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam||`sāṃrāviṇam` iti| `ru śabde` (dhā| pā| 1034) ityetasmādinuṇ, <> [[7.2.115]] iti vṛddhiḥ, inuṇantādaṇ| sa ca pūrvavat? sagatereva bhavati| <> [[6.4.164]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `sāṃkūṭinam` iti| `kūṭa dāhe` (dhā| pā| 1890) iti, `mṛjūṣ? śuddhau` (dhā| pā| 1066), <> [[7.2.114]] , `śamityāṣṭābhyo ghinuṇ` [[3.2.141]] | ghakāre lupte yadyapīnuṇ? bhavati, tathāpi tasmādaṇ? na bhavati; `sthānāntādvibhāṣā` [[5.4.10]] ityato vivakṣārthasyetikaraṇasyānuvṛtteḥ||`visārī` iti| pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ| `vaisāriṇaḥ` iti| pūrvavatprakṛtibhāvaḥ||`paunaḥpunyamabhyāvṛttiḥ` iti| paunaḥ punyenātra sāhacaryādekakarttṛkāṇāṃ tulyajātīyānāṃ sopalakṣyate, ata evāha - `ekakarttṛkāṇām` ityādi| ekakarttṛkāṇāmityatra hi saṃkhyeyānukṛṣṭa upasaṃkhyātaguṇastanmātre vartate| saṃkhyāśabde'ta eva vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| kriyāgaṇanamabhyāvṛttirbhavatyeva| `pañcakṛtvo bhuṅkte` iti| kriyāyāḥ pañcotpattīḥ karotītyarthaḥ| `bhūrīn? vārān? bhuṅkte` iti| yadi saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tato yathā pañcādibhyaḥ saṃkhyāśabdebhyaḥ pratyayo bhavati, tathā bhūyryādibhyo'pi syāt;
