saṃkhyāgrahaṇānna bhavati| `abhyāvṛttiḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavati` ityādī| nanu ca dravyaguṇayorapi sambhavati - punaḥ punardaṇḍī, punaḥ punaḥ sthūla ityādi? naitadasti; atra sāmarthyāt? kriyābhyāvṛttiḥ - punaḥ punardaṇḍī bhavati, punaḥpunaḥ sthūlo bhavatīti| tasmādabhyāvṛttiḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavati, na dravyaguṇayorapi| punaḥ punardaṇḍīti - atra sāmarthyāllabhyā kriyeti kriyāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam| `ekasya sakṛccetyatra` ityādi| ekaśabdena hrekaiva kriyāvyaktirākhyāyate| na caikasyāṃ kriyāvyaktāvabhyāvṛttiḥ sambhavati, kiṃ tarhi? anekāsu kriyāvyaktiṣu| tathā ca prāguktam - ekakarttṛkāṇāmityādi| tasmādekasya sakṛcca kriyaiva gaṇyate, nābhyāvṛttiḥ| tasmādasati kriyāgrahaṇe ekaśabdāt? kriyāgaṇane pratyayo na labhyate| tasmāduttarārthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `pañcapākāḥ` iti| `kriyāgaṇane` ityetāvatyucyamāne'trāpi syāt, asti hyatra kriyāgaṇanam| abhyāvṛttirhi bhinnakālānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ bhavati, iha tvabhinnakālā eva pākā gaṇyante, atastadvyāvṛttiḥ| nanu ca kriyāpyatra nāstyeva, dhātvarthasya siddhatākhyo yo dharmastasmin? ghaño vidhānāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāpi siddhatā kriyāpradeśeṣu kriyāgarahaṇena gṛhrata eva; dharmadharmiṇorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt| anyathā kārakasya gatiḥ, kārakasya vrajyetyatra `tumunṇvuṇau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām` [[3.3.10]] iti ṇvul? na syāt| `akriyamāṇe` ityādi| dvividhāḥ saṃkhyeyevartamānebhyaḥ saṃkhyeyavacanebhya eva pratyayaḥ syāt| `śataṃ vārān? bhuṅkte śatakṛtvo bhuṅkte` iti| atra so'yamityabhisambandhena kriyābhyāvṛttau saṃkhyeye śataśabdo vartate| ata eva sāmānādhikaraṇyam| śataṃ vārāniti saṃkhyāne partamānebhyo na syāditi darśayitumāha - `iha na syāt` iti| kuta etadityāha - `saṃkhyānamātravṛttitvāt` iti| mātraśabdaḥ saṃkhyeyaṃ vihāya śataṃ vārāṇāmiti syāt||`caturbhuktam` iti| `rāt? sasya` [[8.2.24]] iti sakāralopaḥ| `cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ` iti| prakṛterantodāttatvaṃ yatā syāditi| pratyayasya tu cakāraḥ svarārthaṃ nopapadyate; tasyānackatvāt| catuḥśabdameva prakṛtaṃ prati cakārasya svarārthatvam, nottarayoḥ; tayorudāttatvāt| catuḥśabdastu `cateruran` (da|u|8|78) ityuranpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ||`sakṛdbhuktam` iti| `saṃyogāntasya` [[8.2.23]] iti pratyayasakāralopaḥ| cakāro'ntodāttārthaḥ| asati tu tasmina `iṇbhīkāpāśalyatimarcibhyaḥ kan` (da|u| 3|21) iti kanpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇaikaśabda ādyudātta iti sthānivadbhādādeśo'pyādyudātta eva syāt, cittvādantodātto bhavati| athaikaḥ pāka ityatra kasmānna bhavati, asti hyatra kriyāgaṇanam? ityāha - `ekaḥ pākaḥ` ityādi|| bahuśabde'pi sāmānya eva; prakāre'pi vṛtteḥ| tatrānekakriyābhyāvṛtteraviprakarṣa eva tāvannyāyyaḥ, prakaraṇādyapekṣaśca| kṛtvasujāpi na śaknotyasmin? viṣaye varttitum| tasmādvibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam||`prācuryeṇa prastutaṃ prakṛtam` iti| kṛtaḥ punarayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā prastutamātravacanaḥ prakṛtaśabdaḥ vacanagrahaṇādiha prakṛta iti vaktavye vacanagrahaṇam - yādṛśasya loke prakṛtasya mayaṭo vacanaṃ pratyayāntena dṛṣṭaṃ tatraiva mayaḍathā syādityevamartham| loke ca mayaṭpratyayāntaṃ rannamayādiśabdaiḥ prakṛtasya prācuryamucyata iti vacanagrahaṇādeva viśeṣo labhyate| `apare tu` ityādi| atra prakṛtyarthādarthāntara eva pratyayaḥ| prakṛtaśabdena prastutamātramucyate| na tu prācuyryaviśiṣṭaṃ prakṛtamityeṣa viśeṣaḥ|`ubhayathā` ityādi| ubhayathāpyasminnarthe sūtrasya praṇayanādityarthaḥ||`upadeśapāramparye vartate` iti| ha smopādhyāyaḥ kathayati, iti ha sma pitā kayayatītyatraivā prayogadarśanāt||`caturthosamarthāt` iti| tādarthye caturthī; upasaṃkhyānāt| `caturthī tadarthārtha` [[2.1.35]] iti caturthe bhavatīti jñāpakādvā| `tādarthye catuthryā bhavitavyam` iti caturthīsamarthāt? pratyayo vijñāyate| tadartha eva tādathryamiti svārthe ṣyañaṃ darśayati| kathaṃ punaḥ svārthe ṣyañ? ityāha - `cāturva ṣryādi` ityādinā| cātuvaiṇryādisiddhyartha svārthe ṣyaja upasaṃkhyānaṃ kṛtam, ayaṃ tu cāturvaṇryāditvāt? svārthe ṣyaña| `agnidevatāyai` iti| agniścāsau devataḥ ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ||`chabdasyaḥ` iti| saptavaśākṣarasamāhārābhiṣāyinaśchapdaḥśabdāt? svārthe yatpratyayo bhavati| `dvitīyābahuvacanasyāluk` iti| apśabdāddvitīyābahuvacanāntādyati kṛte `supo dhātuprātapadikayoḥ` [[2.4.71]] iti supo luki`ṛtau` ityādi| uṣṇaśīte śabdarūpe kanamutpādayata ṛtāvabhidheye - uṣṇaka ṛtuḥ śītaka ṛtuḥ| anyatra uṣṇaḥ, śīta ityeva bhavati| `paśau lunaviyāte` iti| lūnaviyāte śabdarape kanamutpādayataḥ paśāvabhidheye - lūnakaḥ paśuḥ, viyātakaḥ paśuḥ| paśoranyatra lūnam, viyātam| `aṇu nipuṇe` iti| aṇuśabdo nipuṇārthaḥ kanamutpādayati - putrakaḥ| anyatra putraḥ| `snāta vedasamāptau` iti| snātaśabdaḥ kanamutpādayati vedasamāptau vivakṣitāyām| yasya vedaḥ samāptaḥ sa snātaka ityucyate| vedasamāptāvapiti kim? nadyāṃ snātaḥ| `śūnya rikte` iti| śūnyaśabdaḥ kanamutpādayati rikte tacche'bhidheye - śūnyakaḥ, tukcha ityarthaḥ| anyatra śūnyam| `dāna kutsite` iti| dānaśabdaḥ kutsite kanamutpādayati - kṛtsitaṃ dānaṃ dānakam| anyatra tu dānam| `tenu sūtre` iti| tanuśabdaḥ pratyamutpādayati sūtre - tanukam| anyatra tanuḥ| `īyasaśca` iti| īyaspratyāntāt? kan? bhavati - śeyaskaḥ| `kumārīkrīḍanakāni ca` iti| kumārīṇāṃ yāni krīḍanakāni tāni kanamutpādayanti - kandukam||`lākṣādinā rakte` iti| nanu ca lākṣādinā ya ādhīyate lohito varṇaḥ, tasyānityatvāt? pūrvasūtreṇaiva siddham? yadā hi te yogaviśeṣeṇa tathāvidhaṃ sthairyamutpadyate; yataḥ svāśrayaṃ na jahāti tadā nityatvānna prāpnoti, tadarthamidamucyate||`upāyādhyasvatvañca` iti| upāyaśabdaṭhakamutpādayati, hrasvatvañca pratipadyate - aupayikaḥ||`vyāhmataḥ` iti| ukta ityarthaḥ| `anyena` iti| sandeṣṭrā| na hi pūrvaṃ sā vāk? saṃdiṣṭā| tena hi pūrvaṃ sandiśatā sandeśavāk? bhavati| yayā sandiṣṭo'rtho'bhidhīyate, sā ca sandeśavāgucyate||`karmaśabdāt` iti| etena karmaṇa iti svarūpasya grahaṇam, nepsitatamasyeti darśayati| nanu ca karmaśabdasya saṃjñāśabdatvādīpsitatamasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, na svarūpasyeti? naitadasti; iha hi `sthānāntāt` [[5.4.10]] ityādeḥ sūtrāditikaraṇo'nuvartate, tenāyamartho labhyate - tataścedvivakṣā bhavatīti| karmaśabdācca pratyayotpattau loke vivakṣā bhavati, nepsitatamāt| na hi tata utpannenāṇā vyāhmatārthavācā yuktaṃ karma śakyate dyotayitum, karmaśabdāttūtpannena śakyate| tasmāt? svarūpasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| `kārmaṇam` iti| `an` [[6.4.16]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `tathaiva` iti| yathaiva vyāhmatārthayā vācā pratipāditam - evaṃ kartavyamiti, tenaiva prakāreṇetyarthaḥ| `aṇprakaraṇe` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatrevaṃ pratipādanam - prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvāt? kulālādayastatraiva draṣṭaṣyāḥ| tena <> [[5.4.38]] ityaṇ? bhaviṣyatīti| yadyevam, bhāṣāyāmapi syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `vibhāṣā bahoḥ` [[5.4.20]] ityādisūtrādvibhāṣetyanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā chandasyeva bhaviṣyati, na bhāṣāyāmiti| `sānnāya` [sānnayya-kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] ityādi| sānnāyānujāvarānuṣūkānuṣṭubhacātuṣprāśyarākṣodhvavaiyātavaikṛtavārivaskṛtāgrāyaṇāgrahāyaṇasāntapanāśchandasi bhāṣāyāñceṣyante| tasmātsānnāyādayaḥ| eṣāṃ prakṛtayaḥ prajñādiṣveva draṣṭavyāḥ| atra cāgrāyaṇāgrahāyaṇa - ityatrekārāntābhyāmāgrāyaṇyagrahāyaṇīśabdābhyāmanyatrākārāntebhyo'nujāvarādibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ| sānnāyyaśabdasya cehāntodāttārtha grahaṇam| rūpaṃ tu `pāyyasānnāyya` [[3.1.129]] iti nipātanādeva siddham||ṣa`auṣadhaṃ pibati` iti| phalādau vartamānādoṣadhiśabdāt? pratyayaḥ, sa ca jātirna bhavati; `ākṛtigrahaṇā jātiḥ` (kāśikā| 4.1.63) ityāderlakṣaṇasyābhāvāt| oṣadhayaḥ kṣetre rūḍhā bhavanti| atra phalapākāntā jātiḥ, tatrauṣadhiśabdo vartate||`prajānātīti prajñaḥ` iti| <> [[3.1.135]] | nanu ca yaḥ prajānāti tasya prajñāstīti <> [[5.2.101]] iti matvarthenaiva ṇena siddham, tat? kimarthaṃ prajñāśabdādaṇ? vidhīyata iti? asya codyasya nirākaraṇāya striyāṃ viśeṣaṃ darśayannāha - `stro prājñī` ityādi| `videḥ śatrantasya grahaṇam` iti| na tu <> [[7.1.36]] ityādi| `śrotra śarīre` iti| śarīre yaḥ śrotraśabdo vartate tasmādaṇ? bhavati-śrautram| anyatra śotram| `juhvat` iti| juhvacchabdāt? kṛṣṇamṛge vartamānādaṇa bhavati - jauhvataḥ| juhvadityevānyatra| anye `kṛṣṇa mṛge` iti pṛthak? paṭhanti| kṛṣṇaśabdādaṇ? bhavati mṛge'bhidheye - kārṣṇo mṛgaḥ, kṛṣṇa evānyatra| juhvacchabadādaviśeṣeṇāsmin? pāṭhe pratyayaḥ| `satvantu` iti| sacchabdo yo matuppratyayāntaḥ saḥ satvāneva sātvataḥ| `prajñādirayamākṛtigaṇaḥ| tāmevāsyākṛtigaṇatāṃ bodhayitumanuktasamuccayārthaścākāḥ kṛtaḥ| tena kulālakukkuṭādibhyo'ṇ? siddho bhavati|kimarthaṃ punastikan? vidhīyate, na takanneva vidhīyeta, nityaśca strīpratyayo'yam, tatra ṭāpi kṛte `pratyayasthāt? kāt` [[7.3.44]] itīttvenaiva siddham? yatra tarhi lugbhāvaḥ kriyate, tatra na siddhyet - pañcabhirmṛttikābhiḥ krītaḥ pañcamṛttika iti| tatra hi `aṣyadrdhaparvadvigoḥ` [[5.1.28]] ityādinā''rhīyasya ṭhako luki kṛte `luk? taddhitaluki` [[1.2.49]] iti strīpratyayasyāpi luk| tatra yadi takan? vidhīyate, tadā ṭāpo'bhāvādikāro na na śrūyeta, prakrayāgauravaṃ syāt; ikagārasya śāstrāntareṇa vidhīyamānatvāt||`ityevamādīni` iti| ādiśabdenāpādānādikaraṇaviṣayodāharaṇaparibhāṣāgrahaṇam - bahubhyo hyatrāgacchati bahuśa āgacchatati, alpaśa āgacchatīti| bahuśo nidadhāti| `bahūnāṃ svāmī` ityatra śeṣasya vivakṣitakārakābhidhāyī bahuśabdo na bhavati| `arthagrahaṇāt` ityādi| asati hrarthagrahaṇe bahavalpaśabdābhyāmeva pratyayaḥ syāt?| tasmastu sati paryāyebhyo'pi bhavati| `bahvalpārthāt` ityādi| vahvalpārthāt? pratyaye vidhātavye maṅgalavacaṭanaṃ kartavyam| bhaṅgalavacanena ceha vyākhyānamucyate, vyākhyāyate teneti kṛtvā| kathaṃ punaḥ kāraṇasya maṅgalavacanaṃ kartavyam? ityāha - `yatra` ityādi| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - iha praśaṃsāgrahaṇamanuvartate, praśaṃśāyāṃ pratyayena bhavitavyam, tacchābhyudayikeṣu| bahuśo dadāti, nālpaśaḥ - evaṃ praśaṃsā bhavati| idameva vacanamābhyudayikeṣu bahuśo loke dānaviṣayeṣu; anyatā tenāsya grahaṇānvṛttermaṅgale gamyamāne pratyayo na bhavatīti| atha vā - ihāpītikaraṇānuvṛttermaṅagala eva bhavati, nānyatreti| śasaḥ sakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhavati; prayojanābhāvāt||pratiyoge| vihiteti| `pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayo`riti prate karmapravacanīyatve tadyoge `pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmā`diti pañcamī vihitetyarthaḥ| pradyacumnaḥ kṛṣṇataḥ pratīti| kṛṣṇasya pratinidhirityarthaḥ| ādyādibhya iti| ayaṃ sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ| apādāne cā'hoyaruhoḥ| `ahīyarūho`riti chedaḥ| `hīyate` ityādau karmaṇi lakāre yagantasya ekadeśasya `hīye`tyanukaraṇam| hīyaruhoḥ saṃbandhi yanna bhavati tanminnapādāne ityarthaḥ| atigrahā vyathane atikramya graha iti| lokavṛttamatikramya tadvilakṣaṇatayā pratīyamānatvamityarthaḥ| cāritreṇeti| caritrameva cāritram, tena hetunā itaravilakṣaṇatvena dṛśyate ityarthaḥ| phalitamāha - anyānatikramya vartata iti| `vyatha bhayasaṃcalanayo`riti calanārthāllyuṭi vyathanaśabdaḥ| tadāha - avyathanamacalanamiti| kṣepe iti| `udāhyiyate` iti śeṣaḥ| kṣepo nindā| hīyamānapāpayogācca| hīyamāneti| hīyamānayuktāt pāpayuktāccetyarthaḥ| nanu pūrvasūtre kṣepagrahaṇādeva siddhe kimarthamidamityata āha - kṣepasyā'vivakṣāyāmiti| tattvakathane ityarthaḥ| ṣaṣṭaā vyāśraye ṣa| nānāpakṣasamāśrayaṇe iti| sarvasādhāraṇyaṃ vihāya ekapakṣāśraya iti yāvat| pakṣaḥ - svīyatvena parigrahaḥ| devā arjunato'bhavanniti| arjunasya pakṣe āsannityarthaḥ| rogāccā| rogasya pratīkāraḥ - cikitsā| pravāhikāta iti| viṣūcikāpratīkāramityarthaḥ|`pradyumno vāsudevataḥ prati` iti| `pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt` [[2.3.11]] iti pañcamī, tatastasiḥ| taserikāro mukhamukhārthaḥ| nanu ca sakārasyetsaṃjñā mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ syāt? naitadasti; prayojanābhāvādeva hi tasyetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati| `ādyādibhya upasaṃkhyanam` iti| ādyādibhyasataserupasaṃkhyānamiti pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena ādyādibhāstasirbhaviṣyatīti| anuktasamuccayārthatve cakārasya `tasyādita udāttamardhahrasvam` [[1.2.32]] iti nirdeśaḥ||`grāmādāgacchati` iti| `ghruvamapāye'pādānam` [[1.4.24]] ityapādānasaṃjñā| `caurebhyo bibheti` iti| `bhitrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ` [[1.4.25]] iti| `adhyayanāt? parājayate` iti| <> [[1.4.26]] iti| `sārthāddhīyate` iti| `ohāk? tyāge` (dhā| pā| 1090), laḥ karmaṇyātmanapadam, yak, `ghumāsthā` [[6.4.66]] ityādisūtreṇettvam| nanu cākarttṛkaṃ karma nāsti, `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma` [[1.4.49]] iti vacanāt; sārthaścātra na karma, kiṃ tarhi? apādānam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; karmasaṃjñāyāṃ hi karttṛgrahaṇaṃ svātantryopalakṣaṇārtham| kṛta etat? kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt| kartari ca dvayamasti - svātantrayam, kartṛsaṃjñā ca| tatra saṃjñāyāḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇatvaṃ nopapadyate| yaddhi tasyāḥ kāraṇaṃ tenaiva sā yuktā viśeṣayitum| na ca tasyāḥ karttṛsaṃjñā kāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi? svātantryam;tasya karttṛsvarūpatvāt| bhavati kriyāṃ prati yadā kāraṇabhāvaḥ; karmaṇā ca naiva kriyā viśeṣyate, tadāyamartho bhavati - svātantryasya kriyāyā yadīpsitatamaṃ tatkarmasaṃjñaṃ bhavatīti| sārthasyāpi devadattena tasyābhidhānam| tasya tasmastvasatyapādānamapi na syādeva| tasmāddevadattaḥ karma| jahātereva sārthasyāpādānena bhavitavyam| tatrāpādānasyāpi sataḥ sārthasya hānakriyāyāṃ yat? svātantryaṃ tatkriyāvivakṣayaiva devadattasya karmasaṃjñā bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ yakā nirdeśaḥ kriyate, na `hāruhoḥ` ityevocyeta? ityata āha - `vikāranirdeśaḥ` ityādi| vikriyate tasmin? rūpamiti vikāraḥ, sa punariha yageva - hīyeti| tatra hi dhumāstādisūtremekārasya [[6.4.66]] vidhānāt? vikriyate jahāte rūpam| atha vā - vikṛtiḥ=vikāraḥ, tena vikāreṇa nirdeśaḥ| kathaṃ nāma? jahāteḥ pratipattiryathā syāt, jihītermā bhūdityevamartham; anyathā hi jīhīterapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| vikāranirdeśe tu yasyedṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti na bhavatyeṣa prasaṅgaḥ| `bhūmita ujjihote` iti| jihīterihāgrahaṇāt? tatsambandhino'pādānādbhavatyeva| hāṅo ṅitvādātmanepadam, `bhṛjāmit` [[7.4.76]] ityabhyāsasyettvam, <<ī halyaghoḥ>> [[6.4.113]] iti dhātorīttvam| `kathaṃ mantro hīnaḥ svarato varṇato vā` iti? yadāha - jahāteḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate tatastasminna prāpnetī tyabhiprāyaḥ| `naiṣā pañcamī` iti| pañcamyā avihitatvā|, upacāreṇa tasiḥ, naiṣā pañcamītyuktam| kiṃ tarhi? tṛtīyeti| atrāpi tṛtīyāyā vihitatvāt| tṛtīyetyuktastasiḥ| tenaitat? sūcayati - nāyamiha tasiranena sūtreṇa pañcamyā vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `atigrahāvyathanakṣe peṣvakartari tṛtīyāyāḥ` [[5.4.46]] ityanuvartamānaṃ `hīyamānapāpayogacca` [[5.4.47]] iti tṛtīyāyā iti| sā ca tṛtīyā hetau karaṇe vā draṣṭavyā||`atikramya` iti| anenātiśabdo'trātikrame vartata iti darśayati| `acalanamadhyathanam` iti| `vyathabhayacalanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 764) iti paṭhate, tasyeha calane vṛttimācaṣṭe| vṛtteneti hetau karaṇe vā tṛtīyā||`vṛttena hīyate, vṛttataḥ pāpaḥ` ityatra vṛttasya hīyamānena pāpena yoge tṛtīyā hetau, karaṇe vā| kṣepavivakṣāyāmidamudāharaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `kṣepasya ca` ityādi||`pravāhikātaḥ` iti| pravāhikāśabdāt? pratīkārāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, tatastasiḥ||`kāraṇasya vikārarūpeṇābhūtasya` iti| kāraṇam=prakṛtiḥ, tasyaivottaramavasthāntaram=vikāraḥ| tena vikārarūpeṇābhūtasyājātasyetyarthaḥ| kutaḥ punarayamabhūtatadbhāvaviśeṣo labhyate? abhūtagrahaṇādiha hi bhāvaḥ=janma, sattā vā| yadi hi sattā bhāvaḥ syāt, bhvastibhyāmeva sambandhaḥ syāt, na karotinā| na hi yat? kriyate sā sattā| dhātutrayopādāne ca sati yasminnarthe gṛhramāṇe tribhirapi dhātubhiryogo'sti sa evāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ; sa ca janmaiva, na sattā| kṛgarahaṇādeṣa viśeṣo labhyate| `tadātmanā bhāvaḥ` iti| tacchabdena vikāraḥ parāmṛśyate, sa eva vikāraḥ; ātmā=svabhāvaḥ, tena vikārātmā=abhūtatadbhāvaḥ| api tu labdhasattākasyaiva kāraṇasya prāgapratipannavikārasyottarakālavikārabhūmāvāptirabhūtatadbhāva ityuktaṃ bhavati| tena yatra prakṛtirna vivakṣyate, tatra pratyo na bhavati, yathāśuklaṃ karotīti pratyudāharaṇe| na hi prakṛtāvatra vivakṣitāyāmevaṃvidho'bhūtatadbhāvo gamyate| tacchabdena prakṛtivikārayorabhedavivakṣā pratipādyate| tena yatra prakṛtivikārarūpamāpadyamānā tasmādabhinnā vivakṣyate, tatraiva pratyayo bhavati; na tu yatra kāraṇataḥ kāryasya bhedo vivakṣyate| yatra tu bhevaḥ, yathā - paṭaṃ karotīti, na tatra| `sampadyateḥ kartā sampadyakartā` iti| kathaṃ punastiṅntena samāsaḥ? kathaṃ ca tiṅo lopaḥ? sautratvāt? nirdeśasya sattvāt sarvamidamupapadyate| atha vā - sampūrvāt? paderata eva nipātanādyatpratyayaḥ, tadantasyāyaṃ viśeṣamasamāsaḥ| tat? tiṅntasya vṛttikaraṇe tvarthapradarśanamātraṃ kṛtam; na punaretadvigrahavākyam| `sampattiḥ` iti vaktavye, `sampadyakarteri` ityuktaṃ vaicitryārtham? `śūklīkaroti` iti| <> [[7.4.32]] itīttve `cvau` [[7.4.26]] iti dīrghatvam| cavyantasyāvyayatvāt? sorlopaḥ| `nātra prakṛtivivakṣitā` iti| vikāramātrasya vivakṣitatvāt| yatra ca prakṛtirna vivakṣvate, nātrābhūtatadbhāvo gamyata iti na bhavati pratyayaḥ| `abhūtatadbhāvasāmatryāllabdhameva` ityādi| yo hravikārarūpeṇa bhūto vikārātmānā bhavati, sa niyogatastena rapeṇa sampadyamānaḥ sampadyakartā bhavatītyetat? sāmarthyāt? svarūpāntareṇa sampadyate| tat karttṛsaṃjñakameva bhavatīti nāyaṃ niyogata ityabhiprāyeṇāha - `kārakāntarasampattau mā bhūt` iti| `adevagṛhe` ityādi| atra devagṛhasya devatārādhanatvenābhūtasya prāguttarakālaṃ devatādeyasambandhena tadātmakatvamāpadyamānasya bhavatyayamabhūtatadbhāvaḥ; sa tvadhikaraṇasya, na karttuḥ| tathā hi - tadrūpāntaramāpadyamānamapi na karttṛsaṃjñam, kiṃ tarhi? adhikaraṇasaṃjñameva; anyathā saptamī na syāt| cvau ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| cakāraḥ prakṛtaderantodāttārthaṛḥ| vakārasya <> [[6.1.67]] iti lopaḥ||`atra viśeṣaṇasambandhāt` ityādi| abhūtatadbhāvādīni sarvāṇi viśeṣaṇānīha pūrvasūtrādanuvartante| tasmāt? sarvaviśeṣaṇasambandhāt? pūrveṇaivāruḥprabhṛtibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ siddha iti nāsau didhīyate, lopamātraṃ tu na prāpnoti| atastadartha vacanam| yadi punaranenaiva pratyayavidhiḥ syātad, durmanīkarotītyādau pratyayo na syāt; grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidheḥ pratiṣedhāt? (vyā|pa| 89) pūrveṇa tu tadantādapi bhavati; tatra grahaṇavatprātipadikasyābhāvāt| `unmanīkaroti` ityevamādau bahuvrīheḥ pratyayaḥ||`vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ cveḥ prāpakam` iti| samuccayārthatvāt| samuccayārthatvaṃ tvanekārthatvānnipātasya| yadyevam, cakāra eva kasmānnohraḥ? vaicitryāt? sūtrakṛteḥ|atha pratyayadikalpārthameveti vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `pratyayavikalpastu` ityādi||`sa tu kṛbhvastibhireva yoge bhavati` iti| kṛbhvastibhirityeva yoga ityanena sambandhasyava tasyehānuvṛtteḥ| abhividheḥ kārtsnyasya cāvaśyaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhavitavyam; anyathā sūtradvayārambho niṣphalaḥ syāt, ekenaiva siddhatvāt|sa ca viśeṣo na jñāyate, ityatastat? pṛcchati - `atābhividheḥ` ityādi| `yathāsyāṃ senāyām` ityādi| atha śeṣāṇāṃ śastrāṇāmekadeśena hrātmanā sambandhamātraṃ vivakṣitam, na sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpattiḥ| `varṣāsu sarva lavaṇamudakasātsampadyate` iti| atrāpi sarvāsāṃ lavaṇavyaktīnāmekadeśenodakātmatāvikāreṇa sambandhamātraṃ vivakṣitam| na tvekasya sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpattiḥ| `kātsnyaṃ tu` ityādi| yatra hrekasyāpi dravyasya sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpattiḥ, na tvekadeśena, tatra kārtsnya bhavati| tatra yadi pūrvo yogo nārabyeta, yatraikadravyaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ kātsnyaṃ tatra pratyayogo na syāt; abhividherabhāvāt| athāyaṃ nārabhyeta? yatra sarvāḥ prakṛtaya ekadeśena vikāramāpadyante na syat| tasmādubhayamārabdhadhyam||`tadadhīnaṃ tadāyattam` iti| tasyāyattaṃ tadāyattam| tacchabdena svāmisāmānyamucyate| adhīnaśabdenāpīśitavyasāmānyam| anantaroktamevārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha - `tatsvamikamityarthaḥ` iti| sa svāmī yasya tat? tatsvāmikam| atrāpyanyapadārthapradhānatvādṛbahuvrīhiḥ| īśitavyasya cānyapadārthatvāt? tasya pradhānabhāvaḥ| svāminastu tadupalakṣaṇatvādguṇabhāvaḥ| `svāmisāmānyam` ityādi| svāmisāmānyamīārasāmānyam, īśitavyasāmānyamitatatatatyetadubhayaṃ tadadhīnaśabdenocyate| kathaṃ kṛtvā? iha `adhirīśvare` [[1.4.96]] ityadhiśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tena yoge `yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceāra` [[2.3.9]] iti ca saptamī| sa ceāra īśitavyāpekṣita iti sāmarthyādīśitavyābhidhānamadhiśabdena yoge bhavati| adiśabdaścāyaṃ śauṇḍādiṣu paṭhate, tatra <> [[2.1.40]] iti samāse kṛte pūrvapadasya svābhisāmānyamartho bhavati, uttarapadasya ceśitavyasāmānyam| avaḍakṣādisūtreṇa [[5.4.7]] khapratyaye kṛte sa evāyamartho bhavati, tasya tatsvāmikatvādityevaṃ ca kṛtvā| svāmisāmānyamīśitavyāsāmānyaṃ tadadhīnaśabdenocyate| tatra svāmisāmānyaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, īśitavyasāmānyaṃ tu pratyāyartha ityata āha - `svāmiviśeṣavācinaḥ` ityādi||`rājasādbhavati rāṣṭam` iti| pūrveṇa sātireva bhavati||atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `dibhāṣā sāti kārtsnye` [[5.4.52]] ityatra vibhāṣāgrahamanuvarttiṣyata eva, vikalpena pratyayo bhaviṣyati? ityāha - `bahulagrahaṇādanyatrāpi labhyate` iti| tasmādvibhāṣāyāṃ prakṛtāyāṃ yadbahulavacanaṃ kṛtam, tadanyatrāpi yathā syādityabhiprayaḥ||`avyakatasyānukaraṇamavyaktānukaraṇam` iti| yadyapyanukaraṇe varṇaviśeṣo rūpeṇa na prakāśate, tathāpi dhvaneḥ samānatayā tanmātrasādṛśyena sa tavanukriyata iti tasyāpyanukaraṇamityucyate| dvyajarddhaṃ bhavati tasmāt? pratyayo bhavati, yasya na tato'pi nyūnataramekājbhavati| yadyakṛte dvivacane yasya dvyajavarādrdhatā tato ḍājbhavatīti jñāyate, tataḥ paṭadityāderna syāt; na hyatra dvyajavaramarddhaṃ bhavatītyetacchetasi kṛtvā''ha - `yasya ca` ityādi| nanvevaṃ sati ḍāci parabhūte tadāśraye dvirvacane kṛte dvyajavarādrdhatā bhavati, tasyāñca satyāṃ ḍājitītaretarāśrayaḥ prasajati| itaretarāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi śāstre na prakalpante? ityāha - `ḍāci bahulam` ityādi| yadyeṣā parasaptamī syāt, syādeṣa doṣaḥ; na caiṣā parasaptamī, kiṃ tarhi? viṣayasaptamī| `paṭapaṭākaroti` iti| paṭacchabdāḍḍāci vivakṣite viṣayabhūte buddhisthe'nutpanna eva pūrvaṃ tāvaddvivaicanaṃ paṭacchabdasya kriyate, tasmin? kṛte dvyajavarādrdhatāyāmupajātāyāṃ ḍāci ṭilopaḥ, <> [[6.1.100]] iti pūrvasya takārasya pararapatvalam, `damadamākaroti` iti| vamacchabdasya pūrvavadddhirvacanam, tato ḍāc| `dṛṣatkaroti` iti| atrāpi dvirvacane kṛte dvyajavarādrdhata bhavatīti| nāvyaktasyedamanukaraṇam| `śratkaroti` iti| bhavatyetadavyaktānukaraṇam, na dvyajavarādrdham| kṛte'pi hyatra dvirvacane ekājavaramarddhaṃ sampadyate| `kharaṭakharaṭākaroti` iti| kharaṭavityetasyānukaraṇasyātra paṭadityetasyānukaraṇasyeva pūrvavadddhirvacanam, tato ḍāc| yadi `dvyajadrdham` etāvaducyeta, iha pratyayo na syāt, na hyatra dvyajadrdhatāsti| avaragrahaṇe tu satīhāpi bhavati| tatra hi dvyaco'drdhādyasya nyūnataramadrdha tata eva pratyayena bhavitavyam, anyatastu sarvato bhavitavyameva; anyathā'varagrahaṇamanarthakameveti dvyajadrdhādityevaṃ brāyāt| `paṭiti karoti` iti| <> [[6.1.98]] ityacchabdasya pararūpatvam| yadyatra ḍāc? syāt, tasya ḍājantasya paramiti śabdamuccārya karotiranantaraḥ syāditi, na ca tatparam; taccāniṣṭam| atha cakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvalatāntodāttatvaṃ kṛtvādasya pratyayasvareṇaiva siddham? ityata āha - `cakāraḥ` ityādi| paṭapaṭā asi iti sthite <> [[8.1.28]] ityasiśabdasya nighāte kṛte `svarito vānudātte'padādau` [[8.2.6]] iti svarita ekādeśaḥ prāpneti, na ca svarita iṣyate, tadartha cakāraḥ| `svārthiko vijñeyaḥ` iti| vyatiriktasyārthasyābhāvāt| kena punaḥ svārthiko yakāraḥ? anenaiva nipātanena||nanu kṛbhbastiyoga ityataḥ karotiranuvartate, tat? kimarthaṃ kañgrahaṇam? ityādi| dhātutryaṃ prakṛtam, tatrāsati kṛñgrahaṇe yathā kṛño bhavati, tathā bhvastyorapi syāt| tasmāt? kṛño grahaṇaṃ bhvastinivṛttyartham||`saṃkyāyāḥ` iti sāmīpyasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| `guṇāntāyāḥ` iti pratyayavidhau saṃkhyāvācinaḥ śabdasyetyanena saṃkhyāśabdasya ṣaṣṭhantatāṃ darśayati| antaśabdo'vayavavacano'pyasti, tasyeha grahaṇe saṃkhyāśabdena sambandho na syāt, na hi saṃkhyāśabdasya guṇaśabdo'vayava upapadyate - iti matvā sāmīpyavacano'yamanta śabda iti darśayannāha - `guṇaśabdo'nte samīpe` iti| `yatra` iti| anena prakṛtinirddiśyate| `sā` ityādi| sā prakṛtiḥ saṃkhyā guṇāntenābhidhīyata ityarthaḥ| guṇaśabdo'nte yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `tādṛśāt` ityādinā tathābhūtāt? saṃkhyāśabdāt? sāmīpyavarttiguṇaśabdādityarthaḥ| nanu ca sāmīpyavacanāntaśabde saṃkhyāyāḥ pūrvaḥ paro vā guṇa iti viśeṣo nāvadhāyryate, tathā ca yatrāpyasau pūrvastatrāpi syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāmīpye'yaṃ vartamāno niyatadeśameva parāśrayaṃ vā yat? sāmīpyaṃ tadācaṣṭe, na sāmīpyamātram; yathā - avayave vartamāno nāvayavamātramabhidhatte, kiṃ tarhi? viśiṣṭaveśamevādayavam - `dviguṇaṃ vilekhanaṃ karoti` iti||saha tpatreṇa sapattraḥ| nirgataṃ pattraṃ yasmānniṣpattraḥ| atipīḍanamtibādhanam||`nikuṣlān? karoti` iti| nirdiṣṭaṃ kulaṃ yasyeti sa niṣkulaḥ| kulaśabdo'tra bandhuṣu vartate|| `ārādhyacittānuvartanam` iti| svāmyāderanabhimatānuṣṭhānenābhimatānanuṣṭhānena vā cittasya pīḍanaṃ duḥkham=prātilomyam| tadapi prāṇidharma eva||`svāmyādeścittapīḍanam` iti| svāmyāderanabhimatānuṣṭhānenābhimatānanuṣṭhānena vā cittasya pīḍanaṃ duḥkham=prātilomyam| tadapi prāṇidharma eva||`śūlākaroti māṃsam` iti| pacatītyarthaḥ||`madrākaroti` iti| maṅgalapūrvaṃ muṇḍanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| `bhadrācceti vaktavyam` iti| bhadraśabdācca ḍājbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[5.4.60]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena bhadrādapi bhaviṣyatīti||`samāsāntāḥ` ityayamadhikāraḥ` iti| vakṣyamāṇena `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt` [[5.4.73]] ityādinā bahuvrīhrāditvena samāsaviśeṣādvidhāsyante; yatrāpi bahuvrīhrādigrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tatra saṅghātaḥ prakṛtitvena nirdiśyate| yatā - `ac? pratyanvavapūrvāt? sāmalomnaḥ` [[5.4.75]] iti, tataśca sāmarthyādeva samāsāntāḥ pratyāya vijñāsyante, tatka samāsagrahaṇena? yatraitadubhayaṃ nāsti - yathā - `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe` [[5.4.74]] iti, tadarthaṃ samāsāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| antaśabdo'yaṃ sāmīpyavacano'pyasti, yadi tasyeha grahaṇaṃ syāt? pratyayaparatvenaiva ḍajādīnāṃ sāmīpyasya siddhatvādantaśabdo'narthakaḥ syāditi matvā''ha - avayavavacano'yamantaśabdo gṛhrata iti darśayannāha - avayavā iti asya paryāyeṇa vṛtiṃta kartumāha - `ekadeśāḥ` iti| ekadeśaśabdamihāśrayatā prāksamāsavidheḥ samāsārthāduttarapadāt? vakṣyamāṇāḥ pratyayā bhavanti, paścāt? samāsaḥ - ityuktaṃ bhavati| evaṃ hi te samāsasyaikadeśā bhavanti yadi prāk? samāsavṛtteḥ syāt| samāsāntān? kṛtvā paścāt? tadantena samāsaḥ kriyate| evañca taiḥ saha samāsasaṃjñā bavatītyupapadyate ḍajādīnāṃ samāsāvayavatvam| ataścaitadevaṃ vijñeyam| yo'bhimanyatesamāse kṛte ḍajādibhirbhavitavyamiti, tasya `na kapi` [[7.4.14]] ityatra yadvakṣyati vṛttikāraḥ - `samāsārthe hru ttarapade kapi kṛte paścāt? samāsena bhaktivyam` iti, tadvirudhyate| nanu ca samāsārthāduttarapadāḍḍajādiṣu kṛteṣu paścāt? tadantena samāsaḥ kriyate - ityasminnapi pakṣe samāno doṣaḥ, yataḥ <> [[5.4.72]] ityevamādiṣu nañaḥ paro yaḥ pathinśabdastadantāt? tatpuruṣādvibhāṣā samāsānto bhavatītyevamādayo nirdeśā virudhyanta eva? naitadasti; tadavirodhasya `ṅyāpprātipadikāt` [[4.1.1]] ityatra pratipāditatvāt| `tadgrahaṇena gṛhyante` iti tacchabdena samāsaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| samāsāvayavatve sati teṣāmapi tadanupradeśo bhavati| ataste| samāsagrahaṇena gṛhranta iti| atha samāsāvayavatve pratyayasya kiṃ prayojanam? ityāha - `prayojanam` ityādi| `adhirājam, uparājam` iti| yatākramaṃ vibhaktyarthe sāmīpye'vyayībhāvaḥ| <> [[5.4.107]] , `anaśca` [[5.4.108]] iti ṭajantasyāvyayībhāvagrahaṇena grahaṇāt? <<nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ>> [[2.4.83]] iti vibhakteraluk, amantabhāvaśca bhavati| dve purī samāhmate iti <> [[2.1.51]] iti samātaḥ| sa ca <> [[2.1.52]] iti dvigusaṃjñaḥ, `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathām` [[5.4.74]] ityakārapratyayāntasya dvigugrahaṇena grahaṇāvakārāntāt? <> [[4.1.21]] iti ṅīp? siddho bhavati| kośaniṣadinīti| kośaśca niṣacceti samāhāradvandvaḥ, `dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt? samāhāre` [[5.4.106]] iti ṭac? tasya dvandvagrahaṇena grahaṇāt? kośaniṣadamasyā astīti <> [[5.2.128]] prāṇisthādinirbhavati, `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp| ruāktvacinīti| pūrveṇa tulyam| `vidhuraḥ` pradhuraḥ` iti| vigato dhuraḥ, pragato dhura iti <> [[2.2.18]] iti prāditatpuruṣasamāsaḥ| pūrvavadakārasyeha tatpuruṣagrahaṇena grahaṇāt? `tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyā` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ siddho bhavati| pūrvapadaṃ punaratara nipāta ādyudāttaḥ| asati tu samāsāntatve pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatā syāt| `uccairdhuraḥ, nīcairdhuraḥ` iti| uccairdhūrasyeti nīcairdhūrasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| pūrvavadakārapratyayaḥ, tasya bahuvrīhigrahaṇena grahaṇāt? `bahuvrīhau prakṛtayā pūrvapadam` [[6.2.1]] iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarastvihāntodāttaḥ| sanutar, uccais, nīcais, śanaisa, ṛdhak, ṛte, yugapat, ārāt, pṛthagityete sanutarprabhṛtayo'ntodāttāḥ, svarādiṣu pāṭhāt||`surājā, atirājā` iti| śobhano rājā, atiśayitaḥ rājeti vigṛhra `kugatiprādayaḥ [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| `sugauḥ` iti| pūrvavatsamāsaḥ| atra <> [[5.4.92]] iti ṭac? prāpnoti; asmādvacanānna bhavati| `paramarājaḥ, paramagavaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.61]] iti samāsaḥ| `susakthaḥ` iti| `bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgāt? ṣac` [[5.4.113]] iti ṣac||`kiṃrājā` iti| nindito rājeti vigṛhra <> [[2.1.64]] iti samāsaḥ| kiṃrāja ityatra praśne kiṃśabdaḥ, na kṣepe, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| nanu `lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|3) iti pratipadokto yaḥ kimaḥ samāsaḥ <> [[2.1.64]] ityanena vihitaḥ sa eva grahīṣyata iti kṣepagrahaṇamanarthakam? evaṃ tarhi kṣepagrahaṇenai tadeva jñāpayati - iyaṃ paribhāṣā nāvatiṣṭhata iti| tena bahuvrīhāvapi pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati - ninditā dhūrasya kindhuraṃ śakaṭam, nirdharaṃ śakaṭamiti||`arājā` iti| tatpuruṣa'yam| `anṛco māṇavakaḥ, adhuraṃ śakaṭam` iti| dvāvapi bahuvrīhi| pūrvavadakāraḥ||apatham` ityatra pūrvavadakāraḥ| `apathaṃ napuṃsakam` [[2.4.30]] iti napuṃsakaliṅgatā||bahuvrīhāviti subvyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamī| `saṃkhyāvyayāsanna` [[2.2.25]] ityādinā yo bahuvrīhiḥ, tasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti| tasyaiva saṃkhyeye vṛttiḥ| yattarhi vārthe vartate - dvitrāḥ, pañcaṣā iti, yaśca sujarthe - dvidaśāḥ, tridaśā iti, tatra na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tāvapi saṃkhyeye vartata eva; saṃkhyeyatayaiva vārthasya sujarthasya cābhidhānāt| daśānāṃ ca samīpe upadaśāḥ| viśateḥ samīpe upaviṃśāḥ| viśateḥ samīpe upaviṃśāḥ| `tiviṃśateḍiti` [[6.4.142]] iti tilopaḥ, dvayorapyakārayoḥ <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam| daśānāmāsannā `āsannadaśāḥ`| daśānāmadūrā `adūradaśāḥ` daśānāmadhikā `adhikadaśāḥ` dvau vā trayo vā `dvitrā`| pañca vā ṣaṅvā `pañcaṣāḥ`| sarvatra `saṃkhyāvyayāsanna` [[2.2.24]] ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ| `citraguḥ iti| <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvaḥ| nanu ca nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā|pa|65) bahugaṇaparatiṣedhāt? tatsadṛśavijñānena saṃkhyottarapada eva bahuvrīhivijñāsyate, evañca citraguprabhṛtiṣu prāptireva nāstīti kiṃ saṃkhyāgrahaṇena? syādetadevaṃ yadi bahuśabdaḥ saṃkhyeyapadameva syāt; sa ca vaipulyavacano'pyasti, tenāsati saṃkhyeyagrahaṇe saṃkhyottarapadagrahaṇaṃ na syāt| `upabahavaḥ, upagaṇāḥ` iti pūrvavadvahuvrīhīḥ| `atra` ityādi| upagaṇā ityatra satyasati vā ḍāci rūpaṃ prati viśeṣo nāstīti| svare tu vidyate - ḍaci hi satyantodāttatvaṃ syāt, tasminnasati pūrvapadaprakṛtibhāvenādyudāttaṃ bhavati| `saṃkhyāyāḥ` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatpuruṣasya saṃkhyāvāci yaduttarapadaṃ tato ḍacaḥ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - <> [[5.4.59]] ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ tena saṃkhyāyāstutpuruṣasya ḍajbhaviṣyatīti| `nistraśādyartham? iti| ādiśabdaḥ prakāre| `nistriśāḥ`[`nistraśāni, nistraśaḥ` ityeva mūlopātte pade] iti| <> [[2.2.18]] iti tatpuruṣaḥ| ḍacaścitkaraṇamantodāttārtham| anyathā hi pratyayasya samāsaikadeśatvāt? pratyasvaro bahuvrīhisvareṇa bādhyate||`sāmarthyāt` iti| yasya yena sambandho'sti tat? tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati; dhura #eva cākṣema sambandho'sti, netareṣām| ataḥ samathryāt? tasyaivānakṣa ityetadviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate, na ṛgādīnām| `anakṣe` iti ca ṣaṣṭharthe saptamī subbyatyayena| ata evāha - `anakṣasambandhinī` ityādi| akṣeṇa sambandho'vayavāvayavilakṣaṇaḥ, so'syā astītyakṣasmabandhinī| sā dhūryasyāṃ tasyā na bhavati| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate - akṣe'bhidheye na bhavatīti? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāna ihaiva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt - dṛḍhā dhūrasyākṣasya dṛḍhadhūrakṣa iti| iha tu na syāt - akṣasya dhūrakṣadhūriti, evaṃ tarhi vijñāyate - akṣe pūrvapade na bhavatīti? evamapyaśakyaṃ vijñātum; tathā hrevaṃ vijñāyamāna ihaiva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt - akṣadhūriti| iha tu na syāt - dṛḍhadhūrakṣa iti| yathā vṛtti kārema vyākhyātaṃ tathobhatrāpi bhavati| akṣasambandhinī yā dhūḥ, tadantatvāt? samāsasya| `adrdharcaḥ` iti| ṛcodrdhamiti `ardhaṃ napuṃsakam` [[2.2.2]] iti samāsaḥ| `adrdharcā puṃsi ca [[2.4.31]] iti napuṃsakaliṅgatā ca| `bahavṛcaḥ` iti| bahava ṛco'sya santīti bahuvrīhiḥ| `lalāṭapuram` iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'yam| atha vā - lalāṭaṃ pūriveti <> [[2.1.56]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `nāndīpuram` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| yadyapyakārāntena puraśabdena samāse kṛta etat? sidhyati, tathāpi vyañjanāntena pūḥśabdena yadi samāsaḥ kriyate, tadā vyañjanāntasya śravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ puro grahaṇam| `dvīpam` iti `antarīpam` iti `samīpam` iti| dvirgatā āpo'smin, antargatā āpo'smin, saṅgatā āposminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| <<dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt>> [[6.3.97]] itīttvam| `rājadhūrā` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `mahādhuraḥ` iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, <<ānmahataḥ samānādhikaraṇajātīyayoḥ>> [[6.3.46]] ityāttvam, `striyāḥ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `sthalapathaḥ, jalapathaḥ` iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| saptamīti [[2.1.40]] yogavibhāgāt? sapatamīsamāso vā| ṛgantasya yo bahuvrīhirnañpūrvapadaḥ, tasya māṇavaka evābhidheye pratyaya iṣyate, yo bahupūrvapado bahuvrīhirṛgantaḥ, tasya caraṇā khyāyāmeva iṣyata iti darśayati - `anṛco māṇavako jñeyaḥ` ityādi| etacca <> [[5.4.72]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahānuvṛttevryavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ copalabhyamiti veditavyam| `anṛkkaḥ, bahavṛkkaḥ` iti| <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kapa| <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam - cakārasya kakāraḥ||`pratisāmam` iti| pratigataṃ sāma pratisāmam| prādisamāsaḥ| pratigataṃ vā sāmāsyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| gataśabdo gatārthatvādvṛttau na prayujyate| atha vā - sāma pratīti yathārthe `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādināvyayībhāvaḥ| anugataṃ sāmāneneti bahuvrīhirvā| `avasāmam` iti| pūrveṇa tulyam| `anulomam` ityādau pūrveṇa tulyam| `valomam` ityādi pūrvavataprādisamāsādayo veditavyāḥ| `kṛṣṇodakpāṇḍupūrvāyāḥ` iti| kṛṣṇodakpāṇḍuśabdāḥ pūrve yasyā bhūmestasyā acpratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ| kṛṣṇā bhūmirasmin? deśe kṛṣṇabhūmo deśaḥ| udīcī bhūmirasmin? deśa udagbhūmaḥ| pāṇḍurmūmirasmin? pāṇḍubhūmaḥ| godāvayryāśca nadyāścācpratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ te cennadagodavaryau saṃkhyāyā uttare bhavataḥ| pañcānāṃ godāvarīṇāṃ samāhāraḥ; <> [[2.1.20]] iti samāhāre'vyayībhāvaḥ - pañcagodāvaram, pañcanadam| `bhūmerapi` ityādi| na kevalaṃ nadīgīdāvarībhyām, api tu bhūmerapi saṃkhyāpūrvāyā iṣyate| `dvibhūmaḥ` ityādau sarvatra bahuvrīhiḥ| `tat` ityādi| etat? kṛṣṇabhūmādyapi yogavibhāgaṃ kṛtvā''cāryāḥ sādhayanti||`adarśanāt` iti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| `kabarākṣam, gavākṣam` iti| rūḍhiubdāvetau, nātrāvayavārthe'bhiniveśaḥ kāryaḥ| kabarākṣaṃ gavākṣamiti na sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| syādetat - darśanapratiṣedhāt? siddhametat, dṛśyate'neneti; na darśanam, na ca kabarākṣema dṛśyate, nāpi gavākṣeṇa? ityata āha - `tenāpi` ityādi| darśanaśbdo'yaṃ cakṣuṣi prāṇyaṅge prasiddhaḥ| tathā hi darśanaṃ prayuṅkte cakṣugrrāhramapi| tasmāt? prasiddhivaśena cakṣuṣparyāyo darśanaśabdaḥ, sa ihāśrīyate||bāla-manoramāakṣṇo'darśanāt 931, 5.4.76 akṣṇo'darśanāt| `adarśanā`diti cchedaḥ| dṛśyate'neneti darśanaṃ - cakṣuḥ| karaṇe lyuṭ| acakṣurvācina iti phalitam| tadāha - acakṣuḥparyāyāditi| gavāmakṣīveti| akṣiśabdastatsadṛśe lākṣaṇikaiti sūcayitumivaśabdaḥ prayujyate| mukhyavṛttyā cakṣurvācakatvā'bhāvādac| puṃstvaṃ lokāt|bāla-manoramātatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ saṅkhyāvyayādeḥ 776, 5.4.76 atha tatpuruṣeṣvasādhāraṇasamāsāntān vaktumupakramate - tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ| `acpratyanvavapūrvā`dityato'jityanuvartate, `samāsānta` ityadhikṛtam| tena samāsasya antāvayava iti labhyate| pratyayaḥ paraśca ityadhikārādacpratyayasya tatpuruṣātparatve'pi tasya tadavayavatvādaṅgulerityavayavaṣaṣṭhī| aṅguleriti tatpuruṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ, tadāntavidhiḥ| tadāha saṃkhyāvyayāderiti| saṅkhyā ca avyayaṃ ca saṅkhyāvyaye, te ādī yasyeti vigrahaḥ| dvyaṅgulamiti| taddhitārtha` iti dviguḥ| pramāme dvayasajdaghnañmātracaḥ `pramāṇelo dvigornitya`miti luk| dvyaṅguliśabdādaci tasya taddhitatvāttasmin pare `yasyeti ce`ti ikāralopaḥ| niraṅgulamiti| `nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe` iti samāsaḥ ac ilopaḥ|`samāse vyavasthā'pi` ityādi| samāsavyavasthā=samāsaniyamaḥ - kvacidvahuvrīhireva, kvaciddvandva ityevamādikā nipātanādeva veditavyā; vyavasthābhedasyānyasyābhāvāt| apiśabdādanyadapi ṭilopādi kāryaṃ nipātanādeva veditavyam| `saptamyarthavṛttayoḥ` ityādinā hi saptamyarthavṛttayoravyayayorādheyapradhānayoḥ samāso vidyate| tasmānnipātanādeva ca bhavatīti veditavayam| apiśabdāt? samāso'pi nipātanādeva| `ahardivam` iti| <<ro'supi>> [[8.2.69]] iti nakārasya rephaḥ| `nanu ca` ityādi| arthagatyartho hi śabdaprayogaḥ| paryāyaṇāñcaṃkenaivārthasyoktatvāt? dvitīyasya prayogo na sambhavati| ahardivāśabdau paryāyau, tat? kathamanayodrvandvaḥ! na kathañciditi bhāvaḥ| vīpsādyotanārthamuktasyāpi prayogo na virudhyata iti manyamāna āha - `vīpsāyām` ityādi| cārtha utpadyamāno dvandvo vīpsāyāṃ na prāpnotītyato nipātyate| eko| eko'vyayībhāvaḥ| `sākalye` iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādinā| `sarajasam` iti| <> [[6.3.81]] iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ|`niḥśreyasam` iti| prādisamāsaḥ| `niśreyaskaḥ` iti| niścitaṃ śreyo'neneti bahuvrīhiḥ, <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap| `ṛgyajurunmugdhaḥ` iti| ya unmugdhatvādṛco yajūṃṣi manyate sa ṛgyajuriti bahuvrīhiṇocyate| `tato'vyayībhāvaḥ` iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādinā sāmīpye| `ṭilopābhāvaḥ` ityādi| upaśuna ityatra <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopābhāvo nipātanādeva| āyuvamaghonāmataddhite` [[6.4.133]] iti taddhitādanyatra samprasāraṇamucyamānaṃ taddhite na prāpnotīti tadeva nipātanādeva bhavatīti| `caturocprakaraṇe` ityādi| triśabdādupaśabdāt? paro yaścaturaśabdastasmādaca upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tat? pūrvamiva yogavibhāgamāśritya kartavyam| trayo vā catvāro vā `tricaturāḥ` iti| caturṇā samīpe `upacaturāḥ`| `saṃkhyāvyayāsanna` [[2.2.25]] ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ| tatra `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt` [[5.4.73]] iti ḍaci prāpte'jvidhīyate||`brāhṛvarcasam, hastivarcasam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau| varcaḥśabdo'yaṃ dīptivacanaḥ| `palyarājaśabdābhyāñceti vaktavyam` [`palyarājabhyām - kāśikā] (iti)| palyaśabdādrājaśabdācca paro yo varcasśabdastasmāccājbhavatītyevamartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ cāsya pūrvameva yogavibhāgamāśritya kartavyam||`avatamasam` iti| avahīnaṃ tamasā, avahīnaṃ vā tama iti prādisamāso vā'yam| evaṃ saṅgataṃ tamasā, saṅgataṃ tamaḥ - `santamasam`| andhaṃ karotīti ṇic, tadantāt, andhayatītyandham| andhañca tat? tamaśceti `andhatamasam`| yadandhaṃ tamaḥ karotīti tadevamucyate||`āovasīyam| āḥśreyasam` iti| āovasīyaḥ, āḥ śreya iti vigṛhra mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt? samāsaḥ| `svabhāvācca` ityādi| yadyapi āḥśabdo'nyatra kālaviśeṣe vartate, tathāpīha samāsa uttarapadārthasya praśaṃsāṃ stutimāśīrviṣayāṃ pratipādayati| kutaḥ? svabhāvāt| śabdānāṃ hrarthābhidhānaṃ svābhāvikam| tatra svabhāva evātra hetuḥ| `āovasīyasamityasyaivāyaṃ paryāyaḥ` iti| asyetyanena ca āḥśreyasamityeṣa śabdo nirdiśyate||`anurahasam` iti| rahaḥśabdo'yamaprakāśe vartate| anugataṃ rahasaḥ, anugataṃ raha iti vā prādisamāsaḥ| anugataṃ raho'sminniti bahuvrīhirvā| `avarahasam` iti| avahīnaṃ rahasā'vahīnaṃ raha iti vā prādisamāsaḥ| avahīnaṃ vā raho'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| taptañca tadrahaśceti `taptarahasam` viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| yadutpannaṃ raho lote na kenacidavagamyate, tat? taptarahasamityucyate| tapatamiva taptam, yathaiva hragninā taptaṃ na kenacidavagamyate, tathedamiti||`saptamīsthāt` iti| saptamyāṃ tiṣṭhatīti saptamīsthaḥ, <> [[3.2.4]] iti kapratyayaḥ| yaśca saptamyarthe vartate, evaṃ saptamīstho bhavatītyāha - `saptamyarthe vartate` iti| `pratigatamuraḥ pratyuraḥ` iti| `atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā` (vā| 91) iti samāsaḥ||`āyāme'bhidheye` iti| āyāmaḥ=daiṣryam| matvarthīyākārāntaścāyam| āyāme cetyabhideya ityarthaḥ| anyatā'nugavaṃ yānamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt| yānamāyāmaḥ| `anugavaṃ yānam` iti| gāvo yathā tathā yānamāyātamityarthaḥ| `gavāṃ paścāt` iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādināvyayībhāvaḥ paścādarthe ca| pūrvavadgośabdasya hrasvaḥ| anuśabdātpratyaye vidhātavye yadanugavamiti nipātanaṃ tatprasiddhyupasaṃgrahārtham| tena yadgavā bāhraṃ gobhiśca tulyāmāmaṃ tatraiva bhavati, nānyatra||dvistāvā tristāvā vediḥ| [[6.4.148]] lope kṛte tāvacchabśadasya ṭilopo nipātyate| `samāsaśca` iti| dvitriśabdayornipātyate| `yāvato prakṛtau` ityādinā napātanasya phalaṃ darśayati| prakṛtivikṛtiśabdau kāryaviśeṣavacanau| karmaviśeṣe hi kaścit? yāgākhyaḥ prakṛtiśabdenocyate, kaścidvikṛtitaśbadena||`prādhvam` iti| prādisamāmaḥ| tatra prādhvamiti `atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā` (vā|91) iti samāsaḥ| niṣkrāntamadhvana iti `nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā` (vā|95)`atyadhvam` iti| prādhvamityanena tulyametat| upasargaścātra na gatyupalakṣaṇam| kuta etat? kriyāyogābhāvāt||`mātraco lopaḥ` iti| `pramāṇe dvayasac` [[5.2.37]] ityādinā vihitasya| `niraṅgulam` iti| niradhvamityanena tulyametat| `atyaṅgulam` iti| etadapyatyadhvamityanena tulyam| `pañcāṅguliḥ` iti bahuvrīhiḥ||`ahagrrahaṇaṃ dvāndvārtham` iti| iṣṭiriyam| na tatpuruṣārtham; mukhyārthe tatpuruṣasyāsambhavāt| dvandvārthe padārthaṃ pratyāśrayaḥ| tathā hi - yadyaharguṇā rātrirahaḥ śabdenīcyate, rātriguṇaṃ vāho rātriśabdena gauṇyā kalpanayā, tadāhaśca rātriśceti samānādhikaraṇastatpuruṣaḥ sambhavatyeva| tasmādiṣṭiriyam| etāvaduktaṃ syāt - dvandva iṣyata iti| atra ca jñāpakam - <> [[2.4.28]] iti dvandve samāsantasya rātriśabdasya nipātanam| `ahorātraḥ` iti| <> [[2.4.29]] iti puṃlliṅgatā| `ahan` [[8.2.68]] iti `rūparātrirathantareṣūpasaṃkhyānam` (vā| 924) iti nakārasya rutvādguṇaḥ| `sarvarātraḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.49]] ityādinā samānādhikaraṇastatpuruṣaḥ| `dvirātraḥ` iti <> [[2.1.51]] ityādinā samāhāre dviguḥ, <> [[2.1.23]] iti tatpuruṣasaṃjñā| `atirātraḥ` iti| atyadhvamityanena tulyamet| `nīrātraḥ` iti| `rori` [[8.3.14]] iti rephalopaḥ| <<ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ>> [[6.3.111]] iti dīrghaḥ||`rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac? iti ṭacpratyayaṃ vakṣyati` iti| atha parakṛta evāci kasmādādeśo na vijñāyate? aśakyastatrāyaṃ vijñātum, na hrahaḥśabdātāt? tatpuruṣāt? kenacidajvihitaḥ, tat? kathamādeśasya nimittaṃ syāt| atha `ac? [[5.4.75]] iti yogavibhāgenājvidhīyate? evamapyetadvacanemanarthakaṃ syāt; aci kṛte `allo'ponaḥ` [[6.4.134]] ityanenāhnādeśasya siddhatvāt| na ca ṭilopaḥ prāpnotīti mantavyam; <> [[6.4.145]] iti niyamāt| tasmādacyeva ṭilopāpavādo'yam| ādeśo'yamayuktaḥ| kiṃ punastat? sāmarthyam, yato'haḥśabdaḥ pūrvatvena nāśrīyate? ityāha - `na hrahaḥśabdāt` - ityādi| `dvyahnaḥ` iti| dvayorahnorbhava iti <> [[2.1.51]] ityādinā samāsaḥ, `tatra bhavaḥ [[4.3.53]] ityaṇ, tasya <> [[4.1.88]] iti luk| `ātyahnaḥ` iti| atyadhvavatsamāsaḥ| `nirahnaḥ` iti| atrāpi niradhvavat? samāsaḥ| `sarvāhṇaḥ` iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyatīti| `uttarmakābhyāñca` [[5.4.90]] iti||`dvyahaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.145]] iti ṭilopaḥ||`puṇyāham` [`puṇyāhaḥ` - kāśikā] iti| viśeṣaṇam? [[2.1.56]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `ekāhaḥ` iti| atrāpi `pūrvakālaika` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā| kathaṃ punaḥ `uttamaikābhyām` puṇyaśabdāt? pratiṣedho labhyate? ityata āha - `uttamaśabdo'ntyavacanaḥ` ityādi| `ahaḥsarvekadeśa` [[5.4.87]] ityādau sūtre puṇyaśakhabdasyānte nadiṣṭatvāt| `agtyaḥ` iti| uttamaśabde'pi pratiṣedhārtha ihāntyavacana upāttaḥ| tasmāt? puṇyaśabdamācaṣṭe| atha puṇyagrahaṇameva kasmānna kṛtam, laraghu hrevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati? ityāha - `puṇyagrahaṇameva` ityādi| vaicitryaṃ hi sūtrakṛteriṣyate, taccottamagrahaṇe sati sampadyate| yasmādvaicitryārthamuttamagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam na puṇyagrahaṇam| `keci` ityādi| puṇyagrahaṇe kartavye yaduttamagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tatprayojanam - uttamaśabdasyāpi saṃkhakyātasya pratiṣedhapratipattiryathā syādityevaṃ kecidvarṇayanti| bhavati tatsāmīpyāt? tācchabdyam - gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādi| tasmācchakta uttamaśabdaḥ sāmīpyādupottamaśabdamabhidhātumiti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ| `tena` ityādinā pratiṣedhasyopottamaśabdapratipatteḥ palaṃ darśayati||`paramāhaḥ, uttamāhaḥ` iti <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ| `madrarājaḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| kathaṃ punā rājaśabdagrahaṇe rājñīśabdasya prāpnoti? ityata āha - `liṅgaviṣṭiparibhāṣayā` ityīdi| `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati` (vyā|pa|29) ityevā liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā| `ladhvakṣarasya` iti| savarṇadīrgho'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya prathamaprayogasarya sa tathoktaḥ| atraha ladhvakṣaraṃ pūrva nipatatīti sakhyurahno vā pūrvānipāte prāpte yo'haśabdasya paranipātaḥ sa rājaśabdasya savarṇadīrdhārthaḥ| prayogastu kvacinnaitajjñāpayati - akāravata eva rājaśabdāṭṭaj? bhavati| īkārāntānna, īkārasyākāreṇa savarṇadorghāntasyā sambhavāt||pañcagavamiti| `taddhitārtha` [[2.1.50]] iti samāhāre dviguḥ| `pañcaguḥ` ityatrāpi taddhinārthe| `rājagavam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| <> [[2.4.71]] iti supo luk| `rājagavīyati` iti| <> [[3.1.8]] , subluk, <> [[7.4.33]] itīttvam| astyatra luk, sa tu supaḥ; na taddhitasya| paravyatyayenātra pañcamyarthe saptamī| kuta etat? pañcamyantena gośabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt||sa ceduraḥśabdo'grasyākhyā bhavatītyenena darśitam| `aāorasam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| aāānāṃ pradhānamityarthaḥ| `hastyurasam, rathorasam` iti||`upānasam` iti| upagatamana iti prādisamāsaḥ| `mahānasam` iti| mahadana iti <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā karmadhārayasamāsaḥ| `amṛtāśmaḥ, piṇḍāśmaḥ` iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsau| evaṃ `kālāyasam` `lohitāyasam` iti| `maṇḍūkasarasam, jalasarasam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau| `sadanaḥ` iti| mahānasavatsamāsaḥ||`bahūnāṃ sādhāraṇa ityarthaḥ` iti| grāmaśabdasya janapadasamudāye vṛtteḥ| `kauṭatakṣaḥ` iti| pūrvavatsamāsaḥ||`atiāḥ` iti| prādisamāsaḥ||`ākarśaāḥ` iti| atra āā upamānam| `aāā loṣṭaḥ` iti| atrāāśabdo'prāṇini loṣṭe vartate, na tūpamānam| `vānaraāā` iti| upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ` iti samāsaḥ| atra prāṇini vānaraoti śabdo vartate||`uttarasaktham` iti| uttaraṃ sakthna iti pūrvāparādiśūtreṇa [[2.1.57]] samāsaḥ| atha vā - uttaraṃ sakthīti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `mṛgasaktham` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `pūrvasaktham` iti| uttarasakthamityanena tulyametat| `phalakasaktham` iti| `viśeṣaṇam` [[2.1.56]] ityādinā samāsaḥ||`dvināvam? trināvam` iti| <> [[2.1.51]] ityādinā dviguḥ| `dvināvadhanaḥ` iti| dve nāvau dhanaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhau kṛte pūrvayoḥ padayostenaiva sūtreṇottarapade dviguḥ| pañcanāvapriyam? iti| pūrveṇa tulyametat? dvināvarūpyam, dvināvamayam` iti| tenaiva sūtrema taddhitārthe dviguḥ| pūrvavadrūpyamayaṭau| `rājanauḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `pañcanauḥ` iti ārhīyasya [[5.1.19]] ṭhakaḥ `adhyardhapūrvaṃ` [[5.1.28]] ityādinā luk||`ardhanāvam` iti| nanu ca `paravalliṅgaṃ dvandatatpuruṣayoḥ` [[2.4.26]] iti strīliṅgenātra bhavitavyamiti? ata āha - `paravallihgaṃ na bhavati` ityādi||`dvikhāri` iti| `trikhāri` iti| pūrvavadupasarjanahrasvaḥ| kvacidardhakhārīti pāṭhaḥ| atraicorupasarjanahrasvatve kṛte `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke` (ga| sū|51) iti bahvādipāṭhān? ṅīṣa||`dvābyāmañjalibhyāṃ krīto dvyañjaliḥ` iti| pūrvavadarhīyasya luk| `devyañjalipriyaḥ` iti| pūrvavaduttarapade dviguḥ||`hasticarma` ityādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| `sutrāmāṇam` iti| śobhanastrāmā iti prādisamāsaḥ, <> [[6.3.137]] iti pūrvapadasya dīrghaḥ, dvitīyai kavacanam? `sarvanāmasthāne ca` [[6.4.8]] ityādinopadhādīrghatvam, `aṭ? kupvāṅ` [[8.4.2]] ityādinā ṇatvam| `anehasām` iti| anehaḥśabdāt? puṃlliṅgāt? ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam| vāvacanamityanuvartata iti śeṣaḥ| vāvacanaśabdeneha prāggrahaṇaṃ vivakṣitam; tena vikalpya ucyante, pratyāyyate pratyayo'neneti kṛtvā| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - ` `khāryāḥ prācam` [[5.4.101]] ityataḥ prāggrahaṇamanuvartate` iti| prāggrahaṇānuvṛttau tu yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati - `brāhṛsāma` iti| `devacchandaḥ` iti| ubhayatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ||`jānapadākhyāyām` iti| bhāvapradhāno'tra jānapadaśabdaḥ| ata eva vṛttāvāha - `samāsena cedbrāhṛṇo jānapadatvamākhyāyate` iti| bhavati hi bhāvapratyayamantareṇāpi bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ, yathā - <> [[1.4.22]] iti| kathaṃ punabrrāhṛṇo jānapadatvaṃ śakyaṃ viśeṣayitum, yāvataikamiha brāhṛgrahaṇam, tena ca samāso viśeṣitaḥ? naitadasti; tantreṇa dvau brāhṛśabdāvṛccaritau - tatraikena samāso viśeṣyate, apareṇa jānapadatvam, yasya tatpuruṣasya janapadaśabdaḥ purvapadam| pūrvavat? samāsaḥ||`uparājam, pratirājam` iti| upaśaradaṃ pratiśaradamitivadavyayībhāvaḥ| `avyātmam` iti| ātmanyadhīti vibhaktyarthe| `pratyātmam` iti| pūrvavadābhimukhye||nadīgrahaṇena svarūpaṃ gṛhrate, na saṃjñā| yadi saṃjñā gṛhreta, paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇīgrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt| nanu ca niyamārthametat? syāt? īkārāntasyāpi nadyoḥ paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇyoreva bhavatīti? naitadasti; yadyetat? prayojanaṃ syāt? `paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇī` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| `tasmāt` svarapagrahaṇamiti| `upanadi` iti <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvaḥ||`antagiram` iti| girerantarita vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| antaḥ śabdo hi saptamyarthavṛttitvādvibhaktyarthe vartate| vikalpārthameva senakagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `vikalpo'nuvartata eva` iti| vikalpārthatvāt| vikalpyate vānena saḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpa ityuktam, tadiha <> [[5.4.109]] ityato'nuvartate| tasmāt? tenaiva vikalpasya siddhatvāt? pūjārthameva senakagrahaṇamuktam, na vikalpārtham| nanu ca `vibhāṣayodrvayormadhye nityā vidhayo bhavanti` (kā| pa| vṛ| 11) iti pūrvasya vidhenityatāṃ sampādayituṃ vikalpārthameva senakagrahaṇaṃ syāt ? naitadasti; yadi hi pūrvo vidhinityaḥ syāt, jhayantānāṃ śaratprabhṛtiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt, `jhayaḥ` [[5.4.111]] ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| tasmānna vikalpārthaṃ senakagrahaṇam; pūjārthameva||`saṃjñāyāmiti samudāyopādhiḥ` iti| etena yadi prakṛtipratyayasamudāyaḥ kasyācit? saṃjñā bhavatyevaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyatheti darśayati| `druṇasaḥ` iti| `pūrvapadāt? saṃjñāyāmagaḥ` [[8.4.3]] iti ṇatvam| vardhre bhavā strī vārdhrī, sā nāsikā yasya sa `vārdhrīṇasaḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.39]] iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ| gauriva nāsikāsya gonasaḥ| aca ścitkaraṇaṃ bahuvrīhisvarabādhanārtham| `kharaṇāḥ khuraṇāḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ| śitarnāsikāsya `śitināḥ`| ahiriva nāsikāsya `ahināḥ`| arceva nāsikāsya `arcanāḥ`| <<ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam>> [[6.3.63]] iti hrasvaḥ||upasargagrahaṇaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇārtham; nāsikāṃ prati kriyāyogābhāvāt| `vergro vaktavyaḥ` iti| viśabdāt? parasya nāsikāyā graśabda ādeśo bhavatīti vaktavyam| vigraḥ| pratyayo'jeva||`ṭilopādikam` iti| ādiśabdena suśabdaśca karmaviśeṣaṇaṃ gṛhrate| `śobhanaṃ prātarasya` iti| śobhanamityetadiha karmaṇo viśeṣaṇam| śobhanaṃ prātaḥkāle karmāsyetyarthaḥ| evamuttaratrāpi śobhanamityetatkarmaṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ vedivyam|`akārānto'pi halaśabdo'sti; tatra yadā tena samāsaḥ tadā hala iti bhaviṣyati, yadā tvikārāntena tadā haliriti, tadanarthakaṃ haligrahaṇam? nānarthakam; bhinnārthatvāt| tena yo mahaddhalaṃ haliḥ, tasmin? viṣaye vivakṣite, ahala iti na sidhyati, ahala iti yadākārāntena samāsaḥ kriyate, pūrvavat? prakṛtebhāvenādyudāttatvaṃ ceṣyate, <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap? prasajyeta| tasmādyuktaṃ haligrahaṇam||`evaṃ tarhi nityagrahaṇenānyatrāpi sūcyate` iti| grantādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti kṛtvā| asicaścitkaraṇaṃ duṣprajāḥ, durmedhā ityantodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt? aprajāḥ, ityādau tu nārthaścitkaraṇena; <> [[6.2.172]] ityanenaivottarapadāntodāttatvasya siddhatvāt||`asamastaḥ` [nāsti - kāśikāyām] iti| asamāsaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| `paramasvadharmaḥ` iti| svaścāsau dharmaśceti svadharmaḥ, paramaścāsau svadharmaśceti paramasvadharmaḥ| `yadyevam? ityādi| yadi kevalagrahaṇena dharmo viśeṣyate paramasvadharmaśceti na, paramasvadharahṛeti syāt| `kevalāt? pūrvapadāt` iti| dharmasya asahāyāt? pūrvapadādityarthaḥ| `na padasamudāyāt` iti| paramo dharma iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| atra vyākhyāne tripade bahuvrīhau na bhavati prasaṅgaḥ, padasamudāyāddhi paramo dharmaśabdo na kevalāt? pūrvapadāt| anicaścitkaraṇaṃ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā'ntodāttameva yathā syāt||jambhavacanena tṛṇamiva jambho'sya, soma iva jambho'syeti vigrahītavyamiti| nanu tṛṇaṃ jambho'sya, somo jambho'syetyevaṃ vigrahītavyam, na hi tṛṇaṃ jambhaḥ, na ca somaḥ| abhyavahārahravacane tu - tṛṃ jambho'sya, somojambho'syetyavameva vihagrahaḥ kāryaḥ; tṛṇasomayorabhyavahārahthatvāt||`tatra tenedamiti sarūpe` ityayaṃ bahuvrīhirgṛhrate` iti| asyaiva karmadhyatihāre vṛtteḥ `keśākeśi` (iti) <> [[6.3.137]] iti dīrghaḥ| tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣvicpratyayasya pāṭhādavyayībhāvasaṃjñā, avyayībhāvaśca samāso'vyayasaṃjño bhavatīti| tena sublugbhavatīti bhāvaḥ| icaścitkaraṇaṃ viśeṣārtham| yadi hyatra cakāro na kriyate, tadā tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣvapīkāramātraṃ paṭhaeta, tadekāramātrasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt||`dvidaṇḍaādibhya iti tādathrya eṣā caturthī` ityādi| dvidaṇḍaādayo hi pratapadikeṣvicpratyayāntā eva paṭhanta iti tebhyaḥ punarijvidhātuṃ na śakyate, vidhīyamāno'pi niṣpyojanaḥ syāt, tasmānneyaṃ pañcamī, kiṃ tarhi? tādarthye caturthī| dvidaṇḍaādyarthamicparatyayo bhavatītyanena tādathryaṃ darśayati| asyaivārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha - `tattathā bhavati` ityādi| evaṃ brāuvāṇena `dvidaṇḍaādibhyaḥ pratyayo bhavati, na dvidaṇḍādibhyaḥ` ityuktam| evaṃ te sidhyanti; nānyathā| atha kimarthaṃ samudāyānāṃ nipātanaśuddhā eva prakṛtīḥ prātipadikeṣu paṭhitvā tataḥ pratyayo didhīyate? ityata āha - `samudāyanipātanācca` ityādi| prātipadikeṣu prakṛtīḥ paṭhitvā tābhyaḥ pratyayamātraṃ vidhīyate, tato niyamaḥ syāt - samudāyanipātanādyatrārathaviśeṣe te prasiddhāstatraiva viśeṣyante| tatraiva bhavantītyarthaḥ| `dvidaṇḍi praharati` iti| dvau dḍau yasmin? praharaṇe| `iha bhavati` iti| dvidaṇḍītyetacchabdarūpamatrārthe sādhurna bhavatītyarthaḥ| `bahuvrīhredhikārāt? tatpuruṣānna kvacit? pratyayavidhānaṃ syāt| samudāyanipātanāt? tu kvacit? tatpuruṣādapi bhavati| yadā pratyayasya lopo bhavatyavyayobhāvasaṃjñā, tadā na prapnotītyata āha - `pratyayalakṣaṇena` ityādi||`jānuśabdasyādeśo bhavati` iti| kathaṃ punajrñāyate - ādeśo'yam? na pratyama iti? yadi pratyayaḥ syāt, `jānunaḥ` ityekavacanenaiva nirddeśaṃ kuryāt; ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanenaiva nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tasmādāveśo'yaṃ na pratyaya iti vijñāyate| ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanena nirdeśo'sandehārthaḥ kṛtaḥ - sthānaṣaṣṭhītvamasandigdhaṃ yatā vijñāyeteti| jānuna ityuccamānaṃ sandehaḥ syāt - kimiyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī, uta pañcamīti||`anaṅādeśo'yaṃ bhavati` iti| kathaṃ punarvijñāyate - ādeśo'yaṃ na pratyaya iti ? yadyeṣa pratyayaḥ syāt? ṅitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? ādeśo hrasminnantyādeśārthaṃ ṅittvamarthavadbhavati| tasmānṅittvādevāyamādeśo bhavatīti vijñāyate| `kuṇḍodhnī` iti| anaṅi kṛte <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam, <> [[4.1.25]] iti ṅīṣ? <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] | `strīgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam` iti| strī gṛhrate yenābhidheyanityatvena tataḥ strīgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| etaduktaṃ bhavati - tathā vyākhyānaṃ kartavyaṃ yathā striyāmabhidheyāyāmanaṅ bhavatīti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - `ūdhrvādvibhāṣā` [[5.4.130]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyasthitavibhāṣā, tena striyāmeva bhavati, nānyatreti| anaṅ'kārāditvamuttarārtham| iha vināpi tena sidhyatyeva||`śāṅgadhanvā` iti| anaṅi kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ, `sarvanāmasthāne ca` [[6.4.8]] iti dīrghaḥ||`niṅādeśo bhavati` iti| ādeśatvamasya pūrvavad? ṅittvādeva vijñāyate| `yuvajāniḥ` iti| lopo vyorvali` [[6.1.64]] iti yalopaḥ| `striyāḥ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ||`ikā ādeśo bhavati` iti| kathaṃ punajrñāyate - ādeśo'yaṃ na pratyaya iti? `gandhasya` iti ṣaṣṭhaā nirdeśāt| yadi hi pratyayaḥ syāt? asandigdhārthaṃ `gandhāt` iti pañcamyā nirdeśaṃ kuryāt, ṣaṣṭhaā tu nirdeśaḥ| tasmādādeśo'yamiti vijñāyate| `gandhasyettve` ityādi| gandho dvividhaḥ| guṇo gandhaḥ, so'nyapadārthasyaikānto na bhavati| yastu śobhano gando'syeti sugandha āpaṇika iti tatra dravyagandho gandhaśabdenocyate, taccāpaṇikasyaikadeśo bhavati| tatra guṇagandhe yathā syāt, dravyagandhe mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ gandhasyettve vidheye tadekāntagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| tadityanena bahuvrīhrarthaḥ sāmarthyānnirdiśyate| tasyaikānta ekadeśo vā dharmo'vayavastadekāntaḥ saṃgṛhrate| yena tadekāntagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| etaduktaṃ bhavati - tādṛśaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kartavyaṃ yenettvavidhāviha gandho'nyapadārthasyaikadeśāt? tata āśrayitavya iti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[5.4.133]] ityato vāgrahamamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena yatra gandho'nyapadārthasyaikadeśabhūtastatraivettvaṃ bhavati, nānyatreti| atha vā - astyayaṃ gandhaśabdo dravyavacanaḥ - gandhān? vikrīṇīta iti| asti guṇavacano yathā - gandhavatī pṛthivī| tatra guṇavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na dravyavacanasya| tasmāddravyavacano bahavacanānta eva dravye vartate - gandhāna vikrīṇīte, gandhāḥ paṇyamasyeti| iha gandhasyetyakavacanenaiva nirdeśaḥ| tasmādavasīyate - guṇavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti| guṇavacanasya tu grahaṇe tatra guṇo gandho'nyapadārthasyaikadeśo bhavati, tena tadekāntabhūtasyaiva gandhasyettvaṃ bhavati||`lopo bhavati samāsāntaḥ` iti| kiṃ punaḥ syāt? samāsānto na syāt? <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityādereva syāt| samāsāntatve satyantaśabdo'yaṃ niyatadeśamevāvayavamācaṣṭa ityantasyaiva bhavati| evañca samāsānto bhavati yadyantasya bhavati, nānyathā| nanu ca lopasyābhāvarūpabatvāt? samansānto nopapadyate? ityāha - `sthānidvāreṇa` ityādi| sthānino'kārasya samāsāntatvādupacāreṇa lopo'pi samāsānta ucyata iti darśayati||`kumbhapadīprabhṛtayaḥ kṛtapādalopāḥ samudāyā eva paṭhante` iti| yadyevam, kathamidaṃ netavyam? ityāha - `tatraivam` ityādi| tatra teṣu kumbhapadīprabhṛtiṣu kṛtapādalopeṣu paṭhiteṣvevaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kumbhapadyādiviṣayeya yathā kumbhapadyādayaḥ sambhavantīti| kimarthaṃ punaḥ samudāyā eva paṭhante, na kumbhapadādīn? śabdān? prātipadikeṣu paṭhitvā tebhyaḥ parasya pādaśabdasya lopo vidhīyeta? ityāha - `samudāyapāṭhasya ca` ityādi| yadi kumbhādibhyaḥ parasya pādasya sa lopa ucyeta, `kṛtapādalopāḥ samudāyā eva na paṭhaeran` iti niyamo na labhyeta| tatastriṣvapi liṅgeṣu syuḥ, striyāmeva ceṣyante| samudāyapāṭhe sati striyāṃ ṅīppratyaya eva viṣayabhūte bhavati| `nānyadā` iti| `kumbhapadī` iti| <<pādo'nyatarasyām>> [[4.1.8]] iti ṅīpi viṣayabhūte pādasya lopaḥ tato ṅīp, tasmin? <> [[6.4.130]] iti padbhāvaḥ| `yaccehopamānapūrvam` iti - kumbhapadī, jālapadītyevamādi| `saṃkhyāpūrvapadañca` iti - ekapadī śatapadītyevamādi| `tasya siddhe` iti| upamānapūrvasya pūrveṇaiva siddhe saṃkhyāpūrvasya tūttareṇa| `aṣṭāpadī` ityasmin? paṭhate| tatra nipātanaṃ dīrghatvārtham| <> [[6.3.125]] iti vā||anupamānārthamidam||`dvidan` iti| ṛkārasyogitkāryārthatvāt? `ugidacām? [[7.1.70]] iti num; halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau (6.1.70, 8.2.23) `sudanto dākṣiṇātyaḥ` ti| śobhanatvamiha gamyate, na vayaḥ||avayo'rtham, asaṃkhyāpūrvapadārthañca vacanam| `ubhayatodataḥ` iti| śāsantametat||acchando'parthametat| aya iva dantā asyā `ayodatī` iti| śāsantametat|| `samadantī` iti| `nāsikodara` [[4.1.55]] ityādinā ṅīṣ||`striyām` iti nivṛttam| rokaḥ=rocanam, dīptiḥ| `ruca dīptau` (dhā| pā|745), bhāve ghañ, `cajoḥ kughiṇṇyatoḥ` [[7.3.52]] iti kutvam| avidyamāno roko'syetyarokaśabdasya vyutpatiṃta hmadi kṛtvā tasyārthaṃ darśayitumāha - `aroko nirdīptiḥ` iti||`kālādikṛtā` iti| ādiśabdenāhārādayo gṛhyante||anavasthārthamidam| parvate'nyapadārte mukhyaṃ kakuṭaṃ na sambhavati; ucyate cedam - trikakut? parvata iti| tatra sāmarthyātkakudākāre parvataśikhare sādṛśyāt? kakudaśabdo vartate, tasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ kakudākārāṇi śṛṅgāṇi tasya sarvasya trikakudabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti? ata - `na ca` ityādi| `ucyate` iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `saṃjñaiṣā` ityādi| etena yasyaiṣā saṃjñā trikakucchabdenocyata iti taddarśayati| etacca nipātanāt? <> [[5.4.143]] ityataḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhyate| nanu cābhidheyaniyamo'pi tata eva labhyata iti parvatagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam? naitadasti; śailīyamācāryasya yat? prasaddheṣvapi nityareṣvabhidheyanimittamācaṣṭe, yathā - <> [[3.1.116]] iti,kiṃ punaryatra prasiddhirnāsti! sā tu laukikī||`utkākut, vikākut` iti| antyasya lope kṛte <<vā'vasāne>> [[8.4.56]] iti cartvam| nanu ca <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityādilopena bhavitavyam, tatkathamantyasya bhavati? antyavacano hravayavavacano'pi, sa niyatadeśāvayavamācaṣṭa ityuktam| tatra yadyādeḥ syāt, samāsāntatā nopapadyate||`idamapi pūrvavat? kapi siddhe nityārthameva| `bahudaṇḍikaḥ` iti| <> [[8.2.7]] iti nalopaḥ||śeṣaḥ kabapekṣo vā syāt - yasmādbahuvrīheḥ kabna vihitaḥ sa śeṣa iti? samāsāntāpekṣo vā - yasmādbahuvrīheḥ samāsānto na vihitaḥ sa śeṣa iti? tatra yadi kabapekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ syāt - anṛcaḥ, vyāghrapāt, sugandhirityatrāpi syāt| na hrataḥ kenacit? kabvihita iti kabapekṣe śeṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāsāntāpekṣayā śeṣa iti darśayannāha - `yasmādbahuvrīheḥ samāsānto na bhavati sa śeṣaḥ` iti| kathaṃ jñāyate - samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣa iti? śeṣagrahaṇāt| tatra yadi kabapekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ syāt, śeṣagrahaṇanarthakaṃ syāt| ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi śeṣaviṣaya eva vikalpo bhaviṣyati; anyathā yadi yato'pi pūrvevidhivākyaiḥ kabvihitastato'pyanena vibhāṣā vidhīyate, vidhivākyānāmānarthakyamāpadyeta| tasmāccheṣagrahaṇāt? samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣo vijñāyate| `bahūkhaṭvakaḥ` iti <<āpo'nyatarasyām>> [[7.4.15]] iti hrasvaḥ| `bahukhaṭvaḥ` ityatrāpi <> [[1.2.48]] iti| `katham` ityādi| yadi samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ; anṛkkaṃ sāma, bah? vṛkkaṃ sūktamityatra kabna sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `viśeṣe sa iṣyate` iti| sa hrakāraḥ samāsānto viśeṣe māṇave caraṇākhyāyāṃ ceṣyata iti tatrākāro vihitaḥ| na cāpi tatraiva viśeṣa kabvihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? viṣayāntare - sāmani, sūkte ca| tatra bahuvrīheḥ samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ| tena ca priyapathaḥ, priyamadhura iti `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ` [[5.4.74]] ityādinā'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ śeṣagrahaṇam, yāvatā yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ samāsāntā vihitāḥ, tābhyasta eva bādhakā bhaviṣyanti? naitadasti; niravakāśā hi viṣayo bādhakā bhaviṣyanti, sāvakāśāśca samāsāntāḥ| ko'vakāśaḥ? pratipadopāttaprakṛtayaḥ; yābhyaḥ samāsāntā arthaviśeṣe samāsaviśeṣaṃ prati pratipadamupādāya vihitāḥ so'vukāśaḥ; viśeṣa prakṛtibhyaḥ prasaṅge satyubhayaprāptau paratvāt? kapratyayaḥ syāt| tasmāccheṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||`sarvā prāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate` iti| nanu `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā| pa| 19) iti śeṣalakṣaṇasyaiva kapaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; kabatrānuvartate, na śeṣāditi| tenāyaṃ kabmātrasya pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| `bahavaḥ śreyāṃsaḥ` iti| `dvivacanavibhajyopapade` [[5.3.57]] ityādineyasun, <> [[5.3.60]] iti śraḥ| `hrasvatvamapi na bhavati` iti| <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvatvaṃ prāpnoti, tadapi na bhavati| kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `īyaso bahuvrīheḥ` ityādinā| nātra puṃvadvacanena strīpratyayasya nivṛttirabhipretā, kiṃ tarhi? hrasvatvaprakaraṇāt? tadabhāvaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati - yathā puṃvadbhāve satīkārasya hrasvonabhavati evamīyasaḥ parasya strīpratyayasyāpi na bhavati||`nadyutaśca` [[5.4.153]] iti prāptasya kapo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `vadi abhivādanastutyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-11) iti yadyapi vadirabhivādane vartate, tathāpīha stutāveva vartamāna āśrīyate, ata evāha - `vanditaḥ stutaḥ` iti|| `ayamapi pūrvavat? prāptasya kapaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ||iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ pañcamādhyāyasyacaturthaḥ pādaḥ||samāptaścāyaṃ pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ* * *ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥprathamaḥ pādaḥiha kecit? svārthā eva vidhayo bhavanti, na padārthāḥ, tadyathā - `aṇkuṭilikāyāḥ` [[4.4.18]] iti kuṭilikāśabdādaṇ? vidhīyamānaḥ svārtho bhavati| kecit? punaḥ svārthāḥ, parārthaśca tadyathā - <> [[3.3.16]] iti padādibhyo ghañ? vidhīyamānaḥ svārtho bhavati, svaritaliṅgāsaṅgāduttareṣu yogeṣvanuvartamānaḥ parārthaśca| kecit? punaḥ parārthā evādhikārā bhavanti, na svārthāḥ, yathā - <> [[4.1.82]] iti; tat? kimayaṃ svārtha eva? athobhayārtha evādhikāraḥ? uta parārtha eveti sandehāpanayanāya parārthatāmevāsya darśayitumāha - `ekāceti ca` ityādi| etadgrahaṇakaṃ vākyam, asya ca `ita uttaram` ityādi| vivaraṇam| siṃhāvalokitanyāyena pūrvatrāpyadhikārāṇāmanuvṛttirbhavati, atastannivṛttirasvaritatvādvijñeyā| kasya punaḥ `ekāco dve bhavataḥ` ityevaṃ tadveditavyam? ityata yadyeṣā dhātorev? samānādhikaraṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt, tadā pacādīnāmeva dvirvacanaṃ syāt, na jāgarttyādīnām, na hi tatraikāceti manyamāno naiṣaikāceti sāmānādhikaraṇā ṣaṣṭhī - dhātorekāceti, api tvavayavayogā - dhātoryo'vayava ekāceti darśayitumāha - `dhātoravayavasya` iti| `jajāgāra` ityatra jāgityetaddvirucyatade, `papāca` ityatra pacchabdaḥ; pūrvatra <> [[7.2.115]] iti vṛddhiḥ, uttaratra <> [[7.2.116]] iti| `iyāya` iti| `iṇ? gartau (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1045) <> [[7.2.115]] iti vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ <<dvirvacane'ci>> [[1.1.59]] iti sthānivadbhāvādikāro dvirucyate, āyādeśaḥ, `abhyāsasyāsavarṇo` [[6.4.78]] itīyaṅ| `āra iti| `ṛ gatau` (dhā| pā| 1098) ṛ ityetasya dvirvacanam, `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattvam? raparatvam, <> [[7.4.70]] iti dīrghaḥ, sarvarṇadīrghatvañca| ekāceti tatpuruṣo'yaṃ vā syāt? ekaścāsāvacceti ekāc, bahuvrīhirvā eko'ñ? yasyeti? tatra yadyayaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ syāt, iṇādīnāmeva dviruktiḥ syāt - iyāya āretyevamādau; pacādīnāṃ tu papācetyādau na syāt, teṣāmajjhalsamudāyātmakatvādityetanmanasi kṛtvā''ha - `ekāceti bahuvrīhanirdeśo'yam` iti| bahuvrīhiṇā vivakṣitasyārthasya nirdeśaḥ=kathanam| bahuvrīhernirdeśaḥ=kathanam, uccāraṇaṃ vā bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam - bahuvrīhenirdeśo'yamiti? `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ`, [[7.4.60]] <<śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ>> [[7.4.61]] ityevamādiliṅgāt| nanu ca tatpuruṣasyāpi liṅgamasti - <> [[7.4.69]] itīṇo'bhyāsasya dīrghavidhānam? naitadasti; bahuvrīhāvapi hrasmin? vyapadeśivadbhāvādiṇo dvirvacane'bhyāsasya dīrghavidhānamupapadyata eva, na tu tatpuruṣe'smin? halādiśeṣādikāryamupapadyateḥ pacādīnāmajjhalsamudāyānāṃ dvirvacanānupapatteḥ| tasmādbahuvrīhereva liṅgamasti, na tatpuruṣasyeti bahuvrīhinirdeśa evāyam| yadyevam; bahuvrīherevānyapadārthapradhānatvādupalakṣaṇavinirmuktasya śuddhasyaivānyārthasya bahuvrīhiṇābhidhānādacāvayavena ya upalakṣito'nyapadārthastasyaivānackasya dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, na tūpalakṣaṇabhūtasyāpi| na hrupalakṣaṇaṃ kāryopayogi bhavati| tathā hi yathā citragurānīyatāmityukte yasya citrāgāvaḥ santi sa eva ānīyate, na tūpalakṣamabhūtā gāvo'pi| ata eva tasya nirāsāya tadguṇasaṃvijñāno'yaṃ bahuvrīhirita darśayannāha - `tatra` ityādi| `samudāyaḥ samāsārthaḥ` iti| saha tenopalakṣaṇabhūtenācāvayavena samudāya evānyapadārtha ityarthaḥ| `ubhyantaraśca` iti| tadantarbhūta ityarthaḥ| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe| abhyantara evetyarthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt? samudāye samāsārthe'vayavo'bhyantaro bhavati, tasmāt? sāckasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ bhavati| loke'pi kvacidupalakṣaṇasya samāse'ntarbhāvāt? kāryopayogitvaṃ dṛṣṭameva, yathā śukalavāsasamānayetyukte sahaiva śuklena vāsasānīyate| pacityatra yanaivācā samudāya ekāc? tenaiva tadavayavo'pyacchabdaḥ paśabdaśceti, tataāāvayavānimapi pratyekaṃ dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti| yathā yanaiva hastenāvayavena bāhurhastavān? bhavati, tenaiva devadatto'pi hastavān? bhavati; tathā pacatau ghātau yenaivākārema pacchabdaḥ samudāya ekāc? tenaiva tadavayavo'pyacchabdaḥ paśabdaśteti| tataścāvayavānamapi pratyekaṃ dvirvacanaṃ prāpnotyeva| dvirvacanañca kāyiṇa ekācaḥ, sāmānyena nirdeśāt| evañca samudāyasya tadavayavanāñcaikācāṃ pṛthagdvirvacane kṛte'nṣyaṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt, ata etaddveṣyamapākartumāha - `tatra` ityādi| teṣu samudāyeṣvekākṣu madhye pṛthagavayavaikāco na dvirucyante| kiṃ tarhi? samudāyaikājeva| avayavaikājiti karmadhārayaḥ| `samudāyaikāc` iti| ayamapi karmadhāraya eva| kutaḥ punarayaṃ sāmānyābhidhāne viśeṣo labhyate? ityata āha - `tathā hi` ityādi| yadyapi samudāyī'vayavaścaikāc, tathāpi yasya dvirvacane kṛte sarveṣāmanugraho bhavati tasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ yuktam| evaṃ śāstrahāninaṃ bhavati; sarveṣāmeva śāstravihitakāryasya niṣpatteḥ| ayamevānugraho yā śāstravihitakāryasya niṣpattiḥ| samudāyasyaiva dvirvacane kṛte sarveṣāmanugraho bhavati| yathā vṛkṣaḥ pracalan? sahāvayavaiḥ pracalati, tathaikayaiva śāstrapravṛttyā samudāyo dvirucyamānaḥ sahāvayavaidvirucyate, na hi vināvayavaiḥ samudāyo dvirvaktuṃ śakyate; tasya tadātmakatvāt| avayavānāṃ tu dvirvacanaṃ naikayā pravṛttyā sarveṣāṃ karttu śakyate| na taddviruktau sarveṣāmanugraho bhavati| katham? sarveṣāṃ hi teṣāmekājvyapadeśa eko'jiti hetuḥ; tatra yadā yenācaiko'vayava ekājiti vyapadiṣyate, tadā tenaiva tasyākṣiptatvānna śakyate'para ekājiti vyapadeṣṭum| tataścaikasya dvirvacane vidhitsite tadedānīṃ tenācā ya ekagāc? kaścidavayavastasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ syāt, netarasya; anackatvāt| atraitat? syāt? `ekācaḥ` [[6.1.1]] iti sarveṣāṃ paṣṭhaā nirdiṣṭatvāt? sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ dvirvacanaṃ kartavyam, na ca tadyugapat? sambhavati, ata ekasya tāvat? kriyate| ekasmin? kṛte punaḥ pravṛttyantareṇāparasyāpi kariṣyata` iti? etacca na; yasya hravayavasya pūrvaṃ dvirvacanaṃ kṛtaṃ tenaiva sahāco dviruktatvānna yujyate punastasyāvayavāntarema dvirvacanaṃ karttum| akṛtadviruktasya hi dvirvacanaṃ kriyate, na dviruktasya; anyathā hranavasthā syāt| `anabhyāsasya` [[6.1.8]] iti vacanāccāyuktamevaikasminnavayave dvirukte'parasya dvirvacanaṃ kartum| ato nāvayavadvirvacane sarveṣāmanugrahaḥ sambhavati| tatra yasya dvirvacanaṃ na sambhavati tasya śāstrahāniḥ syāt| tadayuktamavayavānāṃ pratyekaṃ dvirvacanam| athaiṣāṃ yugapadavayavānāṃ dvirvacanaṃ na sambhavatīti prayogāntare paryāyeṇa kariṣyate pūrvoktadoṣaparihārārtham? evamapi yadā paceracchabdasya dvirvacanaṃ syāt, tadā papācetyevamādi na sidhyet| kiñca `ṇijir? śaucapoṣaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1093) ityastrāllaṭ, jhi, śap, tasya juhotyāditvāt? śluḥ, `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvarvacanam| tatra yadi niśabdamātrasya dvirvacanaṃ kriyate tadā `ṇijāṃ trayāṇām` [[7.4.75]] iti guṇaḥ| atredānīm? `adabhyastāt` [[7.1.4]] ityadādeśa iṣyate - tenijatīti rūpaṃ yathā syādityevamartham, sa ca na prāpnoti; jakāreṇa vyavahitatvāt| na hi jakārasyābhyastasaṃjñā, kiṃ tarhi? niśabdasya; dviruktatvāt, jakārasya cādviruktatvāt| anenijuriti - atra laṅādeśasya jheḥ `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] iti jus? na prāpnoti; pūrvasmādeva hetoḥ| nenijadityatra <> [[7.1.78]] iti numpratiṣadho na syāt, ata eva hetoḥ| na ca śakyate vaktum - vacanasāmarthyādvyavadhāne'pi bhaviṣyatīti; yadā samudāyasya dvirvacanaṃ tadā vacanasya sāvakāśatvāt| yadā tvikārasahitasya jakārasaya dvirvacanaṃ tadā nenijatītyādikaṃ rūpameva na syāt| tasmādayuktamavayavānāṃ dvirvacanam| ataḥ samudāya eva dvirvaktavyaḥ| atha papācetyatra kathaṃ dvirvacanam, yāvatā `ekāco dve prathamasya [[6.1.1]] ityucyate, na cātraikācaḥ prathamavyapadeśo'sti, prathamaśabdo hraprathamāpekṣo bhavati, sambandhiśabdatvāt; satsvanekeṣu yasmāt? pūrvo nāsti sa prathamaḥ, yaḥ punareka eva nāsau prathamavyapadeśaṃ labhate, ekaścātraikāc| tenātra dvirvacanaṃ na syāt, jajāgāretyādāveva syāt? iyāya, āretyatrāpi kathaṃ dvirvacanam, yāvataikācastaducyate, na caikāctvamasti, ajvyatiriktasyānaca ekājvyapadeśahetorabhāvāt? ityata āha - `papācetyatra` ityādi| ekasaṃkhyāvyavacchinnasvarasambanadhahetuko vyapadeśaḥ, sa yasyāsti sa vyapadeśī| jāgarttyādiṣu dhātuṣu jāgityevamādiḥ| `tena tulyaṃ vartate` [[5.1.114]] iti vyapadeśivat, tasya bhāvo vyapadeśivadbhāvaḥ| ekāctvamapītyapiśabdādadvitīyatvamapīti| tato'nena jajāgāretyatra yathā vāstave prathamatve jāg? ityetasya prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ bhavati, tathā paramārthato satyapi prathamatve prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ bhavati vyapadeśivadbhāvena papācetyatra pacchabdasya| iyāya, āretyatrāpyasati vāstava ekāctve dvitīyatve ca vyapadeśivadbhāvena dvirvacanaṃ bhavati; yathā - aṭiṭiṣatītyatra vastuta evaikāco dvitīyasya ṭiśabdasyeti|na cai tadvaktavyam - `yasmādaprathamasyāpi pac? ityevamprakārasya vyapadeśivadbhāvena dvirvacanaṃ bhavati` iti| atra `liṭabhyāsasyobhayeṣām` [[6.1.17]] iti vacanaṃ jñāpakam, asatyapi vāstava ekāctve dvitīyatve ca punavryapadeśivadbhāvena ceṇprabhṛtanāṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavatati| atrābhyāsasya dīrghavidhānārtham? <> [[7.4.69]] iti vacanaṃ jñāpakam| iha `ādaśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye vartante na tu saṃkhyānamātre` iti dviśabdo'tra saṃkhyeye vartate| tacca saṃkhyeyaṃ śabdarūpaṃ vā syāt? uccāraṇaṃ vā? tatra yadi śabdarūpaṃ saṃkhyeyaṃ syāt? tadā `dve` ityanena dviśabdarūpe bhāvyamānatayā nirdiśyete iti| ata ekāca ityasya ca scāne yogalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho bhavati, ataḥ `sthāne dvirvacanam` ityeṣa pakṣo bhavati| tadaikāceti sthānaṣaṣṭhī jāyate| atha punaruccāraṇaṃ sakhyeyaṃ tadā sthānyādeśasambandho na bhavati| uccāraṇaṃ nāma śabdānugato dharmaḥ| yadyasāvadeśo vidīyate tadā nivṛttidharmā sthānī bhavatīti śapabdasya sthānino nivṛttyā bhavitavyam, tataścoccāraṇamapi na syāt; tasya taddharmatvāt| tasmāduccāraṇe saṃkhyeye sthāne dvirvacanaṃ na sambhavatīti `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam` ityeṣa pakṣo bhavatīti| tadaikāceti `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, sā hraikājuccāraṇakriyayā vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt? karma bhavati| tatra yadi `sthāne dvirvacanam` ityeṣa pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā jighāṃsatīta hantaḥ kutvaṃ na syāt| samudāyasya hi sannantasya samudāyaḥ sannanta ādeśaḥ, tatra kṛta āśrīyeta, tadā jīghāṃsatīti hanteḥ kutvaṃ na syāt| samudāyasya hi sannantasya samudāyaḥ sannanta ādeśaḥ, tatra kṛta etannāsti| ayaṃ pratyayaḥ iyaṃ prakṛtiriti sandigdhatvāt? prakṛtipratyayasya hantirnaṣṭo bhavatīti <> [[7.3.55]] iti kutvaṃ hantihakārasya na syāditīmaṃ sthānedvirvacanapakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dviṣprayogo dvirvacanamiti pakṣamāśrityāha - `dviṣprayogaśca` ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇe| dviṣprayoga evetyarthaḥ| na sthāne dviṣprayoga ityarthaḥ| atha dviṣprayogadvirvacane kathamayaṃ doṣo na bhavati? ityāha - `āvṛttisaṃkhyā hi` ityādi| punaḥ punaruccāraṇamāvṛttiḥ| tat? punaḥ saṃkhyāvyavasthitasyaiva dhātorvidhīyate| `tena` ityādi| yasmādāvṛttiḥ sakhyāvyavasthitasyaiva dhātorvidhīyate, tena sa eva śabdo vyavasthita eva dviruccāryate, na tu tasya stāne śabdāntaraṃ vidhīyata iti kutaḥ punaḥ pūrvoktadoṣāva saraprasaṅgaḥ!yadi tarhī dviṣprayogo dvirvacanamityeṣa pakṣa ākṣīyate, evaṃ ca sati <> [[7.2.67]] ityatrādivān, āśivān, pecivān, śekivān, ityudāhṛtya yadvakṣyati - `dhātvabhyāsayorekādeśe kṛta evābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayoḥ kṛtadvirvacanā eta ekāco na bhavanti` iti, tanna yujyate; akṛte'pi dhātvabhyāsayorekādeśe'kṛtayorapi caitvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtadvirvacanānāmaṣyeṣāmekāctvāt| sthāne dvirvacane hi śabdāntaramevā nekājādiśyata iti syādeṣāṃ kṛtadvirvacanānāmanekāctvam, na tu dviṣprayogapakṣe| tatra hi sa eva śabdo dviruccāryate| na cāsau śatakṛtvo'pyuccāryamāma ekāctvaṃ jahāti, kiṃ punardvirucyamānaḥ| yadapi niyamasya vyavacchedyacaṃ darśayituṃ bibhidvānityādi tatropanyasiṣyati, tadapyayuktameva; bhiviprabhṛtīnāmeva yathoktādeva hetoḥ kṛtadvirvacanānāmapyekāctvāt| yadapyādgrahaṇamanekājarthamityabhidhāsyati, tadapyayuktameva; tata eva hetorākārāntānāṃ kṛtadvirvacanānāmapyanekāctvānupapatteḥ| tasmāt? sthāne kṛtadvirvacanapakṣo'pyaṅgīkartavyaḥ| evaṃ tahrranyathā vyākhyāyate| iha pakṣadvayaṃ pūrvoktaṃ, sambhavati| tatra kiṃ dviṣprayogo dvirvacanamityeṣa pakṣa āśrīyate? uta sthāne dvirvacanapakṣaḥ - iti praśnāvasara idamāha - `dviṣprayogaśca dvirvacanam` iti| cakāraḥ sthāne dvirvacanamityamumarthaṃ dyotayati| nanu ca <<ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā>> [[1.1.49]] iti vacanāt? sthāne dvirvacanapakṣemātra [dvirvacanapakṣe nātra - mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] bhavituṃ yuktam, tat? kathaṃ dviṣprayogapakṣo'pyupapadyata ityata āha - `āvṛttisaṃkhyā hi` ityādi| yadi śabdāntaraṃ tasya sthāne vidhīyate tadā sthānyādeśasambandhe pratisthāne dvirvacanamityeṣa pakṣo jāyata ityaktam| yadā tvāvṛttisaṃkhyā vidhīyate tadetaraḥ pakṣo bhavatīti| edapi pratipāditaṃ prāk| tasmāt? dviṣprayogapakṣo yadāṅga#īkartumiṣyate, tadāvṛttisaṃkhyā dve iti vidhīyate, tena sa eva śabdo dviruccāryate, na tu śabdāntaraṃ tasya sthāne vidīyate| tasmāddviṣprayogadvirvacanapakṣo'pyaṅgīkartavyaḥ| atha kathaṃ sthāne dvirvacanamityeṣo'pi pakṣa āśrīyate, yāvatā jighāṃsatītyatra hanterhakārasya kutvaṃ na prāpnotītyuktam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ucyate cedam - abyāsācca [[7.3.55]] hanteḥ kutvaṃ bhavatīti| na ca tasya sthāne śabdāntara evādeśe kṛte hantirasti| tatra vacanasāmarthyādādeśaikadeśe hantipratirūpake hantiśabdo vijñāsyate| anye tvanayoḥ pakṣayordoṣā ya āśaṅkyante te bhāṣya evotkṣipya pratikṣiptāḥ| iha tvativistaragranthabhayānna likhyante||`prathamadvirvacanāpavādo'yam` iti| nanu ca <> [[6.1.1]] ityanena prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate, <> [[6.1.2]] ityanena tu dvitīyasya; tat? kathamanyasyocyamānamidamanyasya bādhakaṃ syāt? sati khalu sambhave bādhakaṃ bhavati, asti ca sambhavo yadubhayaṃ syāt| syādetat -ghātorityeṣā ṣaṣṭhī, tasayā dvitīyenaikācā prathamena ca sambandho nopapadyate, ato nāstyubhayasambhava iti? etacca nāsti; anyaddhi vākyaṃ prathamadvirvacanasya vidhāyakam, anyacaca dvitīyadvirvacanasya| tatra vākyabede ca sati kimiti sambandho nopapadyate, tasmāt? kṛte'pi dvitīyadvirvacane prathamadvirvacanaṃ sambhavatyevetyuktaṃ bādhanam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha dvīpam, antarīpamityatra <<dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt>> [[6.3.97]] itīttvam, <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityanaināntasyālaḥ prāptam? <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityanenādervidhīyate, tatra yathā satyapi sambhave'nantyavikārontyavikāraṃ bādhate, tathā dvitīyadvirvacanaṃ prathamadvirvacanaṃ bādhiṣyate| yadi tarhi prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanamanena bādhyate, vyañjanasyāpi prathamadvivacanasambandhino dvirvacanaṃ bādhyeta| tadyathābhūtasyaiva prasaṅgastathābhūtasyaiva dvirvacananivṛttirbhavati| kimbhūtasya ca prathamadvirvacanasya prasaṅgaḥ? savyañjanasya| tatra yathā prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati, evamekājvyapadeśino vyañjanasyāpi na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayaṃ <> [[6.1.3]] iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati -vyañjanasya dvirvacananivṛttirna bhavati| anyatā hi nadarāṇāṃ dvirvacanapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt, prāptyabhāvāt| `aṭiṭiṣati; aśiśiṣati` iti| aṭeraśeśca sanīṭi kṛte ṭiṣśabadaḥ, śiṣśabdaśca dvirucyate| `aririṣati` iti artteḥ sanniṅguṇaraparatveṣu kṛteṣu riṣśabdo dvirucyate| `sthānivadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti` iti| <> [[6.1.9]] ityanena sannantasya dvirvacanamucyate, iṭ? ca sambhaktaḥ| tasmādasau dvirvacanasya nimittamityabhiprāyaḥ| sthānivadbāve ca sati repharahitasyeṣo dvirvacane kṛte savarṇadīrghatve cārīṣatītyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| `kāryī` iti| dviruktireva kāryam, tadasyāstīti kāryī| syādetat -yadyapyasau kāryī tathāpi kārye| syādetat -yadyapyasau kāryī tathāpi kāryaṃ prati nimittamevetyādaha -`na ca` ityādi| kathaṃ punajrñāyate etat? kāryī nimittatvenāśrīyate iti? ata āha -`tathā hi` ityādi| tathā hīti yasmādityarthe| itikaraṇaḥ prakāre| yasmāt? kṅinnimittayoḥ guṇavṛddhyoḥ <> [[1.1.5]] iti pratiṣedho vidhīyamānaḥ śayitetyevamprakāraviṣaye na bhavati, tato jñāyate -na hi kāryī nimittatvenāśrīyata iti| yadi hrāśrīyeta, tadā śīṅo ṅitvāt? tannimittācca guṇavṛddhyoḥ <> [[1.1.5]] iti vidhīyamānaḥ śayitetyatra guṇapratiṣedhaśca syāt, śāyaka ityatra vṛddhipratiṣedhaśca| nanu ca yena vinā yanna bhavati tat? tasya nimittam, yathā -vṛṣṭermeghaḥ| yathā ca pratyayena vinā guṇavṛddhī na bhavatastathā kāryeṇāpi; tat? kathaṃ śīṅo guṇabuddhipratiṣedho neha bhavati? ityata āha -`na hi kāryiṇaḥ` ityādi| atrāśrīyata ityadhyāharyam| satyam, kāryapi śīṅnimitam, tasya guṇaṃ prati vṛdiṃdha draṣṭavyam| itikaraṇo'nantaro'syapratividhānasya svarūpaṃ darśayati| kathaṃ punajrñāyata#e -na hi kāryī nimittatvenāśrīyata iti? `dīdhīvevīṭām` guṇavṛddhyoḥ <> [[1.1.5]] iti phāryo pratiṣedhaḥ siddha #eveti tayorguṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| `atra kecidajāderiti karmadhārayāt? pañcamīmicchanti` iti| `accāsāvādiścetyajādiḥ, tasmādajādeḥ` iti| evaṃ varṇayantaḥ karmadhārayāt? pañcamīmicchanti| yadi tarhi karmadhārayādiyaṃ pañcamī teṣāṃ dvitīyagrahaṇamanarthakam; yasmāt? tṛtīyasya prāptireva nāsti| yeṣāṃ bahuvrīheriyaṃ ṣaṣṭhabhimatā, teṣāmakriyamāṇe dvitīyagrahaṇe tṛtīyasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ prāptireva nāsti| yeṣāṃ bahuvrīheriyaṃ ṣaṣṭhabhimatā, teṣāmakriyamāṇe dvitīyagrahaṇe tṛtīyasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ prāpnotīti tannivṛttyarthaṃ yuktaṃ dvitīyagrahaṇam| yeṣāṃ ca karmadhārayādiyaṃ pañcamyabhimatā teṣāṃ dvitīya grahaṇamanarthakam; <> [[1.1.67]] ityanenānantarasyaiva dvitīyasya bhaviṣyati, na tṛtīyasya, vyavahitatvāt? ityata āha -teṣām` ityādi||`tadantarbhāvāt` iti| avayavānāṃ samudāyābhyantaratvāt? tadantabhaviḥ| `avayavabhūtāḥ` iti| ādiśabdasya niyatadeśāvayavavācitvādviśiṣṭadeśāvayavabhūtā ityeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| `andiviṣati` iti| `undī kledane`, (dhā|pa|1457) sanīṭa ca kṛte diṣśabdasya dvirvacanam| `aḍḍiḍiṣati` iti| `adḍa abhiyoge (dhātupāṭhaḥ-348) ityatra yaḥ saṃyogaḥ sa dakārādiḥ, tasya ṣṭutvena dakārasya ḍakāraḥ, ṣṭutvañca dvirvacane'siddham, tena sanīṭi kṛte viṣśabdo dvirucyate tataḥ ṣṭutvam| `arciciṣati` iti `arca pūjāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-204), ciṣśabdasya dvirvacanam| `īcikṣiṣate` iti| `īkṣa darśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-610) sanīṭi ca kṛte kṣiṣśabdasya dvirvacanam? <> [[7.4.60]] , <> [[7.4.62]] iti cutvam| `prāṇiṇiṣati` iti| `āsa prāṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1069), `ana ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1070) prapūrvaḥ| `didrāsati` iti| `drā kutsitāyāṅgatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1054)| `kecidajādeḥ` ityādi| teṣāṃ matenājāderuttare ye nakārādayaḥ saṃyogādibhūtāste na dvirucyanta iti śūtrārthaḥ| kiṃ punastadanuvartanasya prayojanam? ityata āha -`tasya` ityādi| dakārastu dvirucyata eveti karmadhārayapañcamyantānuvṛttau hi <> [[1.1.67]] ityanantarāṇāmeva nakārādīnāṃ dvirvacanapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam; nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāt| dakārastatra yadyapi rephadakārayoryaḥ saṃyogastadādibhūtaḥ, tathāpi nakāreṇa vyavahitaḥ| tasmāddakāro'pi dvirucyata eva| `indidrīyiṣati` iti| indraśabdāt? kvaci kṛte <> [[7.4.33]] itīttvam, kyajantāt? san, iṭ, <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ| `ubjijiṣati` iti| `ubja ārjave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1303)| `yadā bakāropadha ubjarupadiśyate tadāyaṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| dakāropadeśe tu na vaktavyaḥ `na ndrāḥ` ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| `batvaṃ tu tadā dakārasya vidhātavyam` iti| ubjita, ubjijiṣatīti yathā syāt| tadapi batadvamakutvaviṣaye vidhātavyam; anyathā'bhyudgaḥ, samudga iti na sidhyet| dakāropadhasyaiva yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ| batvamātraṃ vaktavyam? tadapi na vaktavayam; tatra <> [[7.3.61]] iti nipātanādeva liṅgāv? batvaṃ labhyate| na cābhyudgaḥ, samudga ityatrāpi prasajyeta, akṛtvaviṣayatvānnipātanasya; yatra kutvaṃ nāsti tatraiva batvaṃ vijñāyate, na tu kutvaviṣaye| `yakāraparasya` ityādi| yakāraḥ paro yasmāt? tasya pratiṣedho na syādityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatra kaiścidevaṃ vyākhyāyate -bahiraṅgo rephaḥ, `guṇo'rttisaṃyogādyoḥ` [[7.4.29]] `yaṅi ca` [[7.4.30]] iti guṇo'ṅgasya vidhīyamāno yaṅi bhavati bahiraṅgaḥ, tadāśrito repho'pi bahirahga eva, tataśca so'ntaraṅge pratiṣe'saddhaḥ| tasmāt? tasaya dvirvacanapratiṣedho na bhavatīti| yadyevam, indidiṣatīti numo'pi pratiṣedho na prāpnotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyati hretat -numviṣāvupadeśivadvacanamiti| naiyāyikāstvanyathā varṇayanti -<> [[6.1.3]] iti| taiḥ kimuktam?
