saṃyogāt? pūrve nakārādayo na dvirucyante sa cedbhavati yakārāntaḥ saṃyogaḥ` iti tenārāyryata ityatra saṃyogasya yakārāntatvāt? pratiṣedho na bhavatīti| `arāyryate` iti| `yaṅi ca` [[7.4.30]] iti guṇe rapatve ca ryaśabdasya dvivacanam, halādiśeṣaḥ [[7.4.60]] <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] iti dīrghaḥ| nanu cārterahalāditvādyaṅā na bhavitavyam, sa hi `dhātorekācaḥ` [[3.1.22]] ityādinā halādereva dhātorvidhīyate? ityāha -`artteḥ` ityādi| `vyañjanasya` iti| īṣryatevryañjanaṃ yadekāc? dvirvacanaṃ kartavyam| tacca vyañjanaṃ yakāraḥ, tasyeṭi kṛte sāckasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ kartavyamam| `ekācaḥ` iti| sanaḥ| sa hīṭi kṛte tṛtīya ekāj? bhavati| tasya dvirvacane kṛte `sanyataḥ` [[7.4.79]] itīttvam| pūrvaṃ pūrvamiṇamāśritya sarvasakārāṇāṃ ṣatvam| `kaṇḍūyiyiṣati` iti| `asūyiyiṣati` iti| `kaṇḍūñ`, `asūñ` iti kaṇḍvādiṣu paṭhaete, tataḥ <> [[3.1.27]] |`vā nāmadhātūnām` iti| subdhāturnāmadhāturabhidhīyate| `aāīyiyiṣati` iti| aāśabdāt? kyajantāt? sanīṭi ca kṛte yiṣśabdasya dvirvacanam| `āśiāīyiṣati` iti| āīśabdasya dvirvacanam, hrasvatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ [[7.4.60]] | `yatheṣṭam` iti| prathamādīnāmanyatarasya yasyeṣyate tasya kartavyamiti||abhyāsaśabdo'yamāvṛttivacano loke prasiddha eva| sā cāvṛtatiḥ prathamasya nāstītyabhyāsapradeśeṣu parasya grahaṇe prāpte pūrvasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāvityevamarthaṃ tasyābhyāsasaṃjñā vidhīyate| pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ, yathā -pūrvaṃ kāyasya paśoriti| avayavāścāvayavino bhavanti, sa ceha yadyapi na nirdiśyate, tathāpi `dve` [[6.1.1]] ityunuvṛttestadvācyasyaivārthasya pūrvo vijñāyata ityāha -`dve iti prathamantaṃ yadanuvartate` ityādi| nanu ca `dve` iti prathamantamanuvartate, ṣaṣṭhantena cehārthaḥ, na hraṭanyathā pūrvaśabdena sambhandhaḥ śakyate darśayitumityata āha -`tadarthāt` ityādi| arthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti| tadiha ṣaṣṭhantaṃ jayata ityarthaḥ| atha punaratrāvayavāvayavilakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, yathā vṛkṣasya śākheti? evamapi yadi `dve` ityanuvṛttedrvayoryaḥ pūrvastasyābhyāsasaṃjñā vidhīyate tadā <> [[8.1.1]] ityatrāpi prakāraṇe ye dve vihite tayoryaḥ pūrvastasyāpyabhyāsasaṃjñā prāpnotītyata āha -`tatra` ityādi`| `pūrvo'vayavaḥ` iti| pūrvaśabdo vyavasthāvacano'pyasti, atastadvyavacchedārthamavayavagrahaṇam, papācetyatrābhyāsasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `hrasvaḥ [[7.4.59]] ityabhyāsasya hrasvatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ [[7.4.60]] , prakṛticarāṃ prakṛticaro bhavantīti cartvam| `pipakṣati` iti| `juhoti` iti pūrvavaddhakārasya cutvam, tasya <> [[8.4.54]] cakāraḥ| `apipacat` iti| paceṇryantāccleścaṅ, ṇilopaḥ, `ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ` [[7.4.1]] dvirvacanam, `sanvallaghuni` [[7.4.93]] itīttvam, <> [[7.4.94]] iti dīrghaḥ| sarvāṇyabhyāsasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanānyetāni||iha ubhegrahaṇaṃ saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ kriyate| sa ca saṃjñinirdeśaḥ `dve` [[6.1.1]] ityanuvṛtterantareṇāpyubhegrahaṇaṃ prakalpyata eva, tat? kimarthaṃ dve ityanuvartamāna ubhegrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha - `dve ityanuvartamāne` ityādi| yadyubhegrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā pratyekamabhyastasaṃjñā pravartate| pratyekamapi hi tayoḥ pravartamānāsau pravṛttaiva bhavati| tathā hi dvāvānīyeyātāmityukte pratyekamapyānayanena tāvānītau bhavataḥ| tasmāt? samudāye saṃjñāyāḥ pravṛttiryathā syādekaikasya mā bhūdityevamarthamubhegrahaṇam| `samudite` iti| sahite samudābhūte ityarthaḥ| nanu ca yatrābhyāsaḥ śrūyate tatraiva yathā syāt, yatra tu na śrūyate tatra mā bhūta| īpsanti, īpsan, aipsannityādau viṣaye mā bhūdityevamarthamubhegrahaṇaṃ syāt? naitadasti; abhyāsagrahaṇaṃ hranuvartate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate - dve abhyastasaṃjñe bhavataḥ, abhyāsaścedastīti| evacca sati vināpyabhegrahaṇaṃ yatrābhyāsaḥ śrūyate, tatraiva bhaviṣyati, nānyatra| tasmādvṛttikāropadarśitamevobhegrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ yuktam| `dadati` iti| dadāterlaṭ, jhi, śap, <> [[2.4.75]] `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam| atrābyastasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `śnābhyastayorātaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ, `adabhyastāt` [[7.1.4]] iti jheradādeśaḥ| `dadhātu` [`dadhatu` - kāśikā] iti| loṭ, `eruḥ` [[3.4.86]] `samudāya udāttatvaṃ yathā syāt` iti| ubhegrahaṇe hrasati pratyakamabhyastasaṃjñā syāt| tasmāt? <> [[6.1.189]] ityādyudāttamapi pratyekaṃ syāt| athapi <> [[6.1.158]] iti nāsti yaugapadyasambhavaḥ, evamapi paryāyeṇa syāt? tasmāt? `amyastānāmādiḥ` [[6.1.189]] ityetat? kāryaṃ samudāye yathā syāt, pratyekaṃ paryāyeṇa vā mā bhūdityevamarthamubhegrahaṇam||`jakṣityādayaḥ` iti| eṣa nidaśo jakṣeḥ śtibantasyādiśabdena bahuvrīhāvapi kṛte bhavati, dvandve'pi -yadā jakṣeranajantasyetyādiśabdasya ca dvandvaḥ kriyate| vākye'pi yadānayoranantaroktayorubhayorapi prayogo bhavati, tadā tatra bahuvrīhau gṛhramāṇe yadi tadguṇasaṃvijñāno'yaṃ bahuvrīhirāśrīyeta, tadā vevīṅo grahaṇaṃ na syāt; athātadguṇasaṃvijñāno'yam, tadā jakṣerna syāditīmaṃ bahuvrīherāśrayaṇe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvetarayoḥ pakṣaroranyataramāśrityāha -`jakṣityayaṃ dhāturityādayaśca` ityādi atretiśabde'tikrāntapratyavamarśī| jakṣityayaṃ dhāturanantaramatikrānta iti sa eva tena pratyavamṛśyate| iti ādiryeṣāṃ ta ityādayaḥ, jakṣādaya ityarthaḥ| te punarjāgṛprabhṛtayo vevīṅparyantāḥ| `seyaṃ saptānāṃ dhātūnāmabhyastasaṃjñā` iti| jakṣityetadupalakṣitānāṃ jāgartiprabhṛtīnāṃ ṣaṣṇāṃ jakṣitirityetasya ca saptamasya tebhyaḥ pṛthagnirdiṣṭasya| nanu ca dīdhyate, vevyata ityatrādādeśaḥ <<ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ>> [[7.1.5]] ityanenaiva siddhaḥ, śeṣaṃ cābhyasta kāryamākāralopādikam? -paramakāroṣagandhīputra iti; kārīṣagandhaśabdāddhi ṣyaṅ vihitaḥ, na paramakārīṣagandhaśabdāt? ata idaṃ dveṣyamapākarttu māha -`ṣyaṅiti strīpratyayagrahaṇam` iti <> [[4.1.3]] ityadhikṛtya vihitatvāt| patiputraśabdau| iha ca tatpuruṣemāvyabhicārāt? sannidhāpitaṃ yaduttarapadaṃ tat? putrapatiśabdābhyāṃ viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantarvidhirbhavatīti putraśabdānte patiśabdānte cottarapade samprasāraṇaṃ bhavatīti kasyacit? bhrāntiḥ syāt, astāṃ nirākarttumāha -`putrapatyoḥ` ityādi| evaṃ manyate -tatpuruṣo'tra putrapatyoḥ ṣyaṅścādhikaraṇabhūto nirdiśyamānastatpuruṣāvayavatvaṃ putrapatyoḥ khyāpayati, tadyathā -vṛkṣe śākheti| vṛkṣaḥ śākhāyā adhikaraṇatvena nirdiśyamānaḥ śākhāyāḥ vṛkṣāvayavatvaṃ bodhayati; tatra pratyāsatteḥ| yatra tatpuruṣe ṣyaṅ kāryabhāgavayavaḥ sthitaḥ, tasyaiva tatpuruṣasya yāvavayavau putrapatī tayoreva grahaṇam, na tu putrapatyādāvuttarapade yau putrapatiśabdau tau tasyaiva ṣyaṅaḥ pūrvapadasya tatparuruṣasyāvayavau| ati tu tatpuruṣāntarasyāpi putrakulaśabdasya patikulaśabtadasya ca| tasmāt? tadādau tāvanna bhavatyatiprasaṃgaḥ| tadante'pi na bhavatyeva; yasmādiha putrapatigrahaṇaṃ yacca tatapuruṣeṇa sandhāpitamuttarapadaṃ tayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacāraḥ| tatra yadīhottarapadaṃ putrapatiśabdābhyāṃ viśiṣyeta tadā syāt? tadantavidhiḥ, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhirbhavatīti kṛtvā| na ceha tābhyāṃ tadviśiṣyate, api tu tāveva tena; tataśca tadantaravidherabhāvāt? kevalayorevedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti kutastadanto'tiprasaṅga? nanu ca yadyuttarapadena putrapatī viśiṣyete tena tayostadantatā vijñāyate, tataścottarapadapadāntayoreva grahaṇaṃ, na kevalayoḥ, evañca tadādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ? naitadasti; na hi putrapatiśabdāvuttarapadāntau sambhavataḥ| yasmādayamantaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| na ca putrapatiśabdayorahuttarapadamavayavaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? samāsasya, na ca tau samāsau| tasmānannaivaṃ vijñāyate - uttarapadāntayoḥsa putrapatiśabdayoriti, kiṃ tarhi? putrapatyorevottarapadayoḥ kevalayoriti| -vyavasthitavibhāṣayā hrasvo neti| atra tu vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| syādetat| karīṣaṃ -gomahiṣādiṣurīṣam, karīṣagandha iva gandho yasya saḥ karīṣagandhiḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ strī -kārīṣagandhyā, paramā cāsau kārīṣagandhyā ca paramakārīṣagandhyā, tasyāḥ putraḥ paramakārīṣagandhīputra ityatrāpi ṣyaṅaḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ, tasya dīrghaśceti sthitiḥ| atra saṃprasāraṇaṃ durlabham| ṣyaṅaḥ karīṣagandhiśabdādeva vihitatvena paramakārīṣagandhyāśabdasya pūrvapadasya ṣyaṅantatvā'bhāvātpratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa vihitastadādestadantasya ca grahaṇādityata āha -strīpratyaye ceti| ṣyaḥ striyāṃ vihitatvātsa strīpratyayaḥ| tataśca `strīpratyaye cānupasarjane ne`ti parabhāṣayā tadādiniyamā'bhāvātparamakārīṣagandhyāśabdo'pi ṣyaṅanta eveti tatra saṃprasāraṇe dīrghe ca `paramakārīṣagandhīputra` iti rūpamiti bhāvaḥ| iyaṃ paribhāṣā `ṣyaṅaḥ saṃprasāraṇa`miti prakṛta sūtrebhāṣye paṭhitā| tatrānupasarjanagrahaṇasya prayojanamāha -upasarjane tviti| kārīṣagandhyāmatikrāntaḥ atikārīṣagandhyaḥ, `atyādayaḥ`iti samāse, upasarjanahrasvaḥ| tasya putro'tikārīṣagandhyaputraḥ| atra `strīpratyaye tadādiniyamo ne`ti niṣedha#o na bhavati, anupasarjana eva strīpratyaye tasya niṣedhasya pravṛtteḥ| ṣyaṅ tvayaṃ strīpratyayo'tra upasarjana eva| atastatra tadādiniyamasattvādatikārīṣagandhyaśabdo naiva ṣyaṅanta iti na saṃprasāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ|`bandhunīti napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ` ityādi| bandhunīti śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakaliṅgana nirdeśaḥ kṛta ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha - `puliṅgābhidheyo'yam` ityādi| nanu bandhāviti puliṅgenaiva nirdeśaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ/ paryāyeṣu mā bhūt| evaṃ hi kriyamāṇe'rthapradhāno'yaṃ nirdeśa ityādiḥ syāt, tataśca paryāyeṣvapi prasajyeta| arthapradhāne nirdeśe svarūpaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhata ityuktam| `mātac` ityādi| nanu ca mātajiti śabdarūpaṃ nāstyeva, na hrasya svatantrasya kvacit? prayogo labhyate, kathaṃ tatra samprasāraṇaṃ karttaṃ śakyam? ityata āha `asmādeva` ityādi| `tatra` ityādi| yadi ca <> [[6.2.1]] iti bahuvrīhisvaraḥ syāt, citkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmānmā bhūt? tasyānarthakyamiti citkāraṇasāmarthyām? bahuvrīhisvara` `citaḥ` [[6.1.157]] ityantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ bādhate| nanu ca mātṛśabdo bahuvrīhāvuttarapadaṃ na sambhavatyeva, `nadyutaśca` [[5.4.153]] iti nityaṃ kapā bhavitavyam, tat? kathaṃ tatrottarapade bahuvrīhau ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇamupapadyate? ityāha - `mātṛmātṛkayośca` ityādi| yadi ca nityaṃ kap? syāt? mātṛmātṛkayorbhedenopādānaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtañca| tasmādbhedenopādānāt? kab? vikalpena kriyate, na kevalaṃ mātajādeśa ityapiśabdasyārthaḥ||ādiśabdo'yaṃ yajinaiva sambadhya iti, na vacyādibhiḥ pratyekam| yadi hi pratyekamabhisambandho'bhimataḥ syāt? `vaca bhāṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1063) ityadhītya `ñiṣvap? śaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1068) ityadhīyatām, tatra vacyādīnāmityevaṃ svaperapi sidhyatīti pṛthagupādānaṃ na kartavyaṃ jāyate| nanvevam, <> [[7.3.98]] ityatra svapegrrahaṇaṃ ca syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; śakyate hi rudādīnāmādau svapimadhītya `svapaśca pañcabhyaḥ` ityevaṃ sūtraṃ praṇetum| tasmādyuktamuktam - yajinaiva sambadhyata iti| vaceḥ svapinā sāhacayryāddhātunirdeśārtha ikāraḥ, na viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| tena ca brāñādeśasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha - `vaca paribhāṣaṇe, brāuvo vaciriti ca` iti| `uktaḥ` iti| <> [[6.1.108]] iti paraparvatvam| `iṣṭaḥ` iti| vraścādinā [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, tataḥ ṣṭutvam| `ūḍhaḥ` iti| `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam, <<ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ>> [[8.4.41]] iti ṣṭutvam, <<ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ>> [[8.3.13]] iti ḍhakāralopaḥ, <<ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ>> [[6.3.111]] iti dīrghatvam| `uṣitam` iti| `śāsivasighasīnāñca` [[8.3.60]] iti ṣatvam| `saṃvītaḥ āhūtaḥ, śūnaḥ` iti| `halaḥ` [[6.4.2]] itī dīrghaḥ| `śūnaḥ` ityatra <> [[8.2.45]] niṣṭhānatvam| atheha kasmānna bhavati - vācamicchati vācā taratīti ṭhak? vācyati vācika iti? yadyapi vaceḥ `kvibvacipracchyāyatastukaṭaprujuśrīṇāṃ dīrgho'saprasāraṇañca` (vā|288) iti vā dīrghaḥ kṛtaḥ, tathāpi `ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati` ityasti prāptirityāha - `dhātoḥ` ityādi| yatra dhātuḥ sāmānyavācinā dhātuśabdena nopādīyate, api tu svaśabdenaiva, tatra tatpratyaye dātorityevaṃ yo vihitaḥ pratyayastatraiva kāryaṃ vijñāyate| etacca bhrauṇahatyeti nipātanaṃ kurvan? jñāpayati - taddhitatvārtha nipātanam| yadi ca dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaya eva kāryaṃ na vijñāyeta, tatvanipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt| <<hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ>> [[7.3.32]] ityanenaiva tatvasya siddhatvāt| `vācyati vācikaḥ` ityatra yadyapi `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati` (vyā|pa|132) iti, tathāpi dhātorityevaṃ nāsau pratyayo vihitaḥ| tathā hrekatra supa ityevaṃ pratyayo vihitaḥ - <> [[3.1.8]] iti, itaratra ca `prātipadikāt` ityevaṃ ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārāt? (4.1.1|)| tasmādiha vaceḥ svarūpagrahaṇāt? tatpratyaya eva kāryasaṃvijñānaṃ na bhavati||`gṛhītam` iti| `graho'liṭi` [[7.2.37]] iti dīrghaḥ| `jarīgṛhrate` iti| yaṅi samprasāraṇaṃ dvirvacanam| `rīgṛdupadhasya` [[7.4.90]] iti rīgāgamaḥ| vayirayamastyevātmanepadī -`aya vaya gatau (dhātupāṭhaḥ-474,475) asti ca parasmaipadī -`vetro vayiḥ` [[2.4.42]] iti; tatra grahrādibhiranātmanepadibhiḥ sāhacaryādanātmanepadī gṛhrate? ityāha -`vayirliṭi` ityādi| tasmācca parasya liṭaḥ `asaṃyogālliṭ? kit` [[1.2.5]] iti kittvena bhavitavyam? ityata āha -`tasya` ityādi| `yadyevam` iti| yadi veñādeśasya vayegrrahaṇamityarthaḥ| `yajādiṣu veñ? paṭhate` iti| tataśca pūrvasūtreṇaiva tasya sthānivadbhāvāt? samprasāraṇaṃ siddhamityabhiprāyaḥ| `naivaṃ śakyam` iti| vijñātumiti śeṣaḥ| nānayopapattyā vayigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātumityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam? ityāha -`liṭi tasya` ityādi| syādetat -vidhipratiṣedhayorvirodhādekatra vidhireva bhaviṣyati, na pratiṣedha iti? ata āha -`atra yataiva` ityādi| syādetat -vidhipratiṣedhayorvirodhādekatra vidhireva bhaviṣyati, na pratiṣedha iti? ata āha -`atra yathaiva` ityādi| yadi virodhādekatrāsambhavaḥ, paryāyo'stu, na tu dvayoranyatra caritārthatvādekenaiva bhavitavyam| nāpareṇetyeṣo'rtho labhyata iti bhavāḥ| `naiṣa doṣaḥ` iti| kathaṃ naiṣa doṣaḥ? ityata āha -`liṭi` ityādi| `liṭi vayo yaḥ` iti yakārasya samprasāraṇapratiṣedho liṅgam -vidho veñograhaṇena vayigrahaṇaṃ bhavatītyasyārthasya| asati vidhau grahaṇe prāpterasambhavāt? pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| veña ityatra pratiṣedhe vayegrrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti atrāpyetadeva pratiṣedhavacanaṃ liṅgam| sati hi veñgrahaṇe veña ityanenaiva pratiṣedhasya siddhattvāt, panaḥ <> [[6.1.38]] iti| anantaroktamarthamabhyanujānāti| yadi satyametat, tarhi kimarthaṃ vayigrahaṇam? ityāha -`eṣa eva` ityādi| tena spaṣṭīkaraṇārthaṃ vayigrahaṇamityācaṣṭe| `vidhyati` iti| divāditvācchyan| `uṣṭaḥ` iti| tasantametat, adāditvācchapo luk? vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, ṣṭutvam| `vicati` iti| tudāditvācchaḥ|vṛkṇa iti pūrvavannatvam, `skoḥ` [[8.2.29]] iti salopaḥ| `jhalādirniṣṭhā na bhavati` iti| tenātra ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| jhalācau hi tadvidhīyate; <> [[8.2.26]] ityato jhalgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `kṛtve tu kartavye tadasiddhameva` iti| na hi yathā ṣatvādau niṣṭhādeśasya siddhatvamucyate, tathā kutve'pi, tena tat? pravartata eva| `vṛścati` iti| pūrvavacchaḥ| `varīvṛścyate` iti| `rīgṛtvata iti vaktavyam` (vā|880) iti rīgāgamaḥ| `pṛṣṭaḥ` iti| pūrvavat? ṣatvam| `yajayāca` [[3.3.90]] ityādinā naṅi vihite praśna ityatra samprasāraṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha -`naṅi` ityādi| `bhṛṣṭaḥ` iti| pūrvavat? ṣatvam| `bhṛjjati` iti| pūrvavacchaḥ| `barībhṛjyate` iti| pūrvavad rīk| `sakālasya` ityādi| nanu skhoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca` [[8.2.29]] iti tasya lopena bhavitavyam?? naitadasti; jhali padānte ca sa ucyata iti||`uvayitha` iti| krādiniyamādiṭ? prāptaḥ <<upadeśe'tvataḥ>> [[7.2.62]] iti pratiṣiddhaḥ <<ṛto bhāradvājasya>> [[7.2.63]] iti niyamāt? punarbhavati| `graheraviśeṣaḥ` iti| yasmāt? sati samprasāraṇe halādiśeṣeṇa [[7.4.60]] rephanivṛttau jagrāheti graheryadrūpaṃ bhavati, satyapi samprasāraṇa uratvaraparatvahalādiśeṣeṣvapi kṛteṣu tadeva bhavati| `jijyau` iti| <<āta au ṇalaḥ>> [[7.1.34]] | `jijyatha` iti| <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ| `vṛścateḥ satyasati vā yoge nāsti viśeṣaḥ` iti| yadyanyārtho yoga ārabhyate na vṛścatyarthaḥ, tato vṛścatyarthametadvacanaṃ na bhavatīti satyapyetasminnanyārthavacane vṛścaterabhyāsasya naiva samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam| na hrasati tadarthe vacane kenacit? prakāreṇa samprasāraṇamupapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ tataścāsatyasmin? yoge vavraśceti yadrūpaṃ bhavati satyapi tadeveti nāsti vṛścaterviśeṣaḥ| etacca vṛttikāramatenoktam| bhāṣyakāramatena tvāha -`yogārambe` ityādi| tasyāyaṃ bhāvaḥ -sati vaca'nenyārtho kriyamāṇe tasya vṛścatyarthatāpi bhavati; vṛścaterahapi grahrādiṣvantarbhāvāt| tataśca tadartho'pyayaṃ yogārambha iti tadabhyāsasyāpi samprasāraṇena bhavitavyamiti tuśabdo vṛttikāramatādviśeṣaṃ darśayati| `yadi samprasāraṇamakṛtvā` ityādi| nanu cobhayagrahamasya prayojanaṃ vakṣyati -halādiśeṣaṃ [[7.4.60]] paramapi bādhitva#ā samprasāraṇameva yathā syāditadi, tat? kuto'sya pakṣasya sambhavaḥ? ubhayagrahaṇarahite yoge satītyabhiprāyaḥ| `atha rephasya` ityādi| ubhayagrahaṇasahite yoge satīti bhāvaḥ| `uradatvasya sthānivadbhāvāt` iti| kena punaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ? <> [[1.1.57]] iti| kaḥ punarasau? pratyayo'caḥ paraḥ, yannimittamoratvaṃ syāt| ahgasya yo'bhyāsa iti vijñāyamāne sāmarthyāt? pratyaya āśrito bhavati; vinā tenāhgavyapadeśābhāvāt? vṛttikāramataṃ ceṣitavyam; anyathā tatrobhayagrahaṇābhāvāt? halādiśeṣeṇa [[7.4.60]] prāgeva samprasāraṇādrephe nivarttite vakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ syāt| tataśca uvraścetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| `pṛcchatibhṛjjatyīraviśeṣaḥ` iti| graheriva veditavyaḥ| `akidartham` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamakidarthaṃ midaṃ vyākhyeyam? ityata āha -`kiti` ityādi| yasmāt? kiti paratvāt? samprasāraṇa kṛte kṛtasamprasāraṇasya punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāddvirvacane kṛte'ntareṇāpyetadvacanam, ūcaturityādi siddhyatyeva| tasmānnedaṃ kidartham, api tvakidarthameveti| atha kimarthamubhayeṣāmityucyate, yāvatā svaritaliṅgāsaṅgādevobhayeṣāmityasyānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati? na cānuvṛttau satyāṃ ṅiti vacyādīnāmapi samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnotītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam; yadi vacyādīnāmapi ṅiti samprasāraṇaṃ syādyogavibhāgo'narthakaḥ syāt; maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vā vracyādīnāmanuvṛttirbhaviṣyati, tatkuto'sya doṣasyāvasaraḥ? ityāha -`adhikārādeva` ityādi| adhikārādevobhayagrahaṇe siddhe punarubhayeṣāṃgrahaṇāt? punaḥśrutirbhavati| tasyāścaitadeva prayojanam - yatra samprasāraṇaṃ cānyacca prāpnoti tatra samprasāraṇameva yathā syāt, mā bhūdanyaditi| tena vivyādha, vivyadhitha ityatra halādiśeṣaṃ [[7.4.60]] paramapi bādhitvā samprasāraṇameva bhavati; anyathātra paratvāt? prāk? pravartamānena halādiśeṣeṇa yakārasya nivṛttau kṛtāyāṃ vakārasya samprasāraṇamāpadyeta, tataśca -uvyādha uvyadhithetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt||`svāpeḥ` iti| `āplṛ vyāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 1260) ityasyāpi suparvasyekā nirdeśaḥ sambhavati, atastadgrahaṇāśaṅkānirākaraṇāyāha - `svapeṇryantasya grahaṇam` iti| ṇyantasya grahaṇaṃ caṅgrahaṇādvijñāyate, na hraṇyantāccaṅ? sambhavati| `asūṣupat` iti| <> [[3.1.26]] iti ṇic| `dvirvacanāt parvamatra samprasāraṇam` iti| paratvāt| `svāpyate` iti| karmaṇi lakāraḥ, <> [[3.1.67]] | `svāpitam` iti| <> [[6.4.52]] iti ṇilopaḥ| nanu ca grahrādi [[6.1.16]] sūtrāt? ṅitotyanuvartate, na ca svāpeścaṅo'nyo ṅidasti, tatra sāmarthyācacaṅyeva bhaviṣyatīti na kartavyameva caṅgrahaṇam? ityata āha - `ṅititi kevalam` ityādi| grahrādisūtre hrubhayaṃ sannihitam - kidgrahaṇam, ṅidgrahaṇañca, tatrobhayoraviśeṣeṇa sannidhāne ṅidgrahaṇamevānuvartate, na kidgrahaṇamiti mandadhiyā durbodham| ataḥ sukhapratipattye mandabuddheścaṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti bhāvaḥ||`svapnak` iti| <> [[3.2.172]] ||atha kimarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇam, yāvatā hrasvādeśe'pi `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghatvena cekīyata iti siddhatyeva? ityāha -`dīrghoccāraṇam` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ `yaṅi ca` [[7.4.30]] ityucyamāne ādeśo yaṅluki syāt? pratyayalakṣaṇena syāt| athāpi <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣidhyate? evamapyasmādeva dīrghoccāramādyaṅluki bhavatīti vijñāyate, anyathā tadapārthakaṃ syāt!`cekītaḥ` iti| tasantametat| <<yaṅo'ci ca>> [[2.4.74]] iti yaṅo luk||`sphātiḥ` iti| <> [[3.3.94]] vali [[6.1.64]] yalopaḥ| `sphātībhavati` iti| sphāyaterniṣṭhāntāccavau kṛte `asya cvau [[7.4.32]] itītve satīdaṃ rūpaṃ bhavatīti manyamāno yaścodayet - atha kathaṃ sphātībhavatītyetadrūpam, yāvatā'trāpi niṣṭhāyāmasminnādeśe sphītibhavatītyevaṃ bhavitavyamiti? taṃ pratyāha - `sphātībhavatītyetadapi` ityādi| etadapi sphātiśabdāt? ktinnantāccvau kṛte `cvau ca` [[7.4.26]] iti dīrghatve ca ktinnantasyaiva rūpam| ato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ||`sāmānyena grahaṇam` ti| dvayorapyāttve kṛte pūrvasya `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ [[6.1.62]] iti satve samānatvādrūpasya| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā (vyā|pa|3) ca nehopatadiṣṭhate; ubhayolakṣiṇikatvāt| athātra -<> [[8.2.43]] iti niṣṭhānatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha -`samprasāraṇe` ityādi| na tvasya pūrvatrāsiddhatvāt? pūrvaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ kriyata iti, tatra kṛte ca yaṇvattā nāstīti natvaṃ na bhavati| `prastya ityevaṃ siddhe` iti| nanu caivamucyamāne praśabdasyāpi samprasāraṇaṃ syāt, tataśca prastīta iti rūpaṃ syāt, tat? kimucyate -prastya ityevaṃ siddha iti? `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya` (vyā|pa|63) iti na bhavatyeṣa doṣa iti manyate| `ihāpi yathā syāt` iti| kasmāt? punarna prāpnoti? saṃśabdena vyavahitatvāt| kiṃ pūrvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe śabdārthaṃ eva tathāvido bhavati yenātrāpi bhavati? atha granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ sūcayatītyābhiprāyeṇāha -`tat? katham` iti| prathamakalpaṃ darśannāha -`prapūrvasya` iti| `ṣaṣṭharthe bahuvrīhiḥ` iti| pūrvaśabdo'yamavayavavacana iti ṣaṣṭharthe bahuvrīhirbhavati| avayavavācini pūrvaśabde dhāturanyapadārtho nopapadyate| na hi dhātoḥ praśabdo'yamavayavo bhavati, api tu dhātūpasargasamudāyasya| tasmāt? sa evānyapadārtho yukta ityāha -`praḥ pūrvo yasya` ityādi| `tadavayavasya` iti| tasyāvayavastadavayava iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tacchabdena dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ parāmṛśyate| `vyadhikaraṇaṣaṣṭhyau` iti| `prapūrvasya` iti| styāvayavāpekṣayā yo'yamavayavāvayavisambandhastatra ṣaṣṭhī, `styaḥ` ityeṣā tu yaṇavayavāpekṣayā yaḥ sambandhastatra| tena bhinnābhideyatvāt? `satyaḥ`, `pravūrvasya` iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| syādevam, prasaṃstīta ityatra prapūrvasamudāyāvayavaḥ styāśabdo na sambhavati ityata āha -`tatra` ityādi||`dravamūrttau dravakāṭhinye` iti| anena dravamūrttiśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| dravāvasthāyā uttaro'vasthāviśeṣaḥ kāṭhinyākhyo'tra dravamūrttiśabdenocyate| `sparśe ca` iti| rūpādisahacarito guṇaḥ sparśa ityucyate| `śītamudakam` iti| kathaṃ punaratra sāmānādhikaraṇyam, yāvatā śītaśabdena guṇaviśeṣo'bhidhīyate| vāyvādiśabdena tu dravyaviśeṣa ityata āha -`guṇamātre` ityādi| yathā -śuklādiśabdā kadācidguṇamātre vartante, yatā -paṭasya śukla iti; kadācittu tadvati dravye so'yamityabhedasambandhatadvānmatublopānmatvarthīyākārapratyayāntatvādvā śuklaḥ paṭa iti, tathā śītaśabdo'pi| tena yadā tadvati dravye vartate, tadobhayorekadravye niveśitatvādupapadyate sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti bhāvaḥ| `saṃśyānaḥ` iti| `saṃyogādeḥ` [[8.2.43]] ityādinā natvam||`seyamubhayatra vibhāṣā` iti| dravamūrttisparśaviṣaye pūrveṇa prāpte, anyatrāprāpte| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `vibhāṣā'bhyavābhyām` ityevocyeta? ata āha - `pūrvagrahaṇasya` ityādi| kriyamāṇe pūrvagrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavatītyāha - `na kila` ityādi| ayaṃ hi dvividho'pi samudāyo nābhipūrvaḥ; nāpyavapūrvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? sampūrvaḥ| tena pūrvagrahaṇādatra na bhavati| kriyamāṇe'pi pūrvagrahaṇe prāpnotyeveti manyamānaḥ kilaśabdamarucisūcanārthaṃ prayuktavān| tāmeva prāpti darśayannāha - `yo'tra` ityādi| samūśabdāt? paro yo dhātūpasargasamudāyastadāśrayo vikalpaḥ kasmānna bhavati, bhavati hrasāvabyavapūrva ityasti prāpti? ata āha - `yatnāntaramāstheyam` iti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇamiha kriyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate, teneha na bhavatīti yatanāntaram| `pūrvagrahaṇasya cānyatprayojanaṃ vaktavyam` iti| tat? punarabhisaṃśīnam, abhisaṃśyānam, avasaṃśīnam, avasaṃśyānam - ityatrāpi vikalpo yathā syādityevaṃ tadveditavyam| etacca pūrvagrahaṇae kriyamāṇe yatopapadyate tathā <> [[6.1.23]] ityatra `prapūrvasyeti ṣaṣṭharthe bahuvrīhiḥ` itya#ādinā vyākhyātam||``śrā pāke` ityasya dhātoḥ` iti| `śrā pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1053) ityadādau paṭhate ghaṭādau (dhātupāṭhaḥ-810) ca mitsaṃjñārtham| kaiściccurādāvapi, `śrai pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-919) iti bhvādau, tatrehāviśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ prāptam| śrāyaterapi hi kṛtāttvasyaitadrūpaṃ bhavatyeva| nipātanācca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā (vyā|pa|3) pratibandhaṃ na karoti| `ṇantasyāṇyantasya ca` iti| viśeṣānupādānāt| tathā coktam - śrāśrapyoḥ śṛtamiti|yadi vibhāṣetyanuvartate kṣīrahaviṣorapi pakṣe śrāṇam, śrapitamiti syāt; tābhyāmanyatrāpi pakṣe śṛtamiti prasajyeta? ityata āha - `vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam` iti| `yadāpi` ityādi| prayojakavyāpāraḥ preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādiḥ kārye kāraṇopacāraṃ kṛtvā prayojakaśabdenoktaḥ| sa hi prākṛtādarthādbāhro bhavati, tatra tasyānantarbhāvāt| tatra yadā <> [[3.1.26]] iti dvitīyo ṇijutpadyate, tadāpi kṣīrahaviṣorapi nipātanametanneṣyate; vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādeva| tathā coktam - śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hatoriti| hetumāṇṇico'nyatretyarthaḥ| dvitīyagrahaṇaṃ yadaikameva bhavati, tadeṣṭattvāc? śrapitaṃ kṣīraṃ devadattena yajñadatteneti tatprayojako hetuśca` [[1.4.55]] iti cakārāddevadattayajñadattayoḥ karttṛ saṃjñāvidhānādubhayatrāpi kartari tṛtīyā| `śrapitam` iti| śrāterṇica kṛte `arttihyī` [[7.3.36]] ityādinā puk, `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[6.4.92]] kṣīraṃ svayameva śrāti sma - tadyadā devadattadena prayujyate sma tadā `hetumati ca [[3.1.26]] iti prathamo ṇic| so'pi śrapayan? yadā yajñadattena prayujyate sma tadā dvitīyaḥ| <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti pūrvasya ṇerlopaḥ, tataḥ kṣīre prayojye karmaṇi niṣṭhā - śṛtamiti| `ṇyantasyāṇyāntasya ca nipātyete` iti pratijñāte sati yuktaṃ ṇyantasyāpyetannipātanam - yeṣāṃ śrātiścurādāvapi paṭhate ityabhyupagamaḥ| ye tu curādāvasya pāṭhaṃ na pratijānate teṣāṃ kathaṃ ṇyantasyetannipātanaṃ yujyate, na ca śakyate vaktum - teṣāmapi hetumaṇṇyantarayaitannipātanaṃ yujyate; `śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hetauḥ` iti bhāṣyakāravacanāditi yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `śrātirayam` ityādi| karmabhāvāpanne'pi yo'rthaḥ saukayryāt? svātantryeṇa vivakṣyate sa karmakartā, karma kartā bhavatīti kṛtvā| karma cāsau kartā ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, sa yasya viṣayaḥ sa karmakarttṛviṣayaḥ| arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ paceḥ karmakarttṛviṣayatvaṃ veditavyam| tasya yo'rthaḥ pacyamānakarttṛkatvaṃ vikledanamātraṃ tatrāyamakarmakaḥ - śrātirvartate| yadā tu sa ṇyanto bhavati tadā prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha| prakṛtau bhavaḥ prākṛtaḥ, sa punaryaḥ prakṛtyantasya pacerarthaḥ paktṛkarttṛko vikledanopasaṃhārādiḥ sa iha veditavyaḥ| devadattādipaktṛkartṛkaṃ prākṛtaṃ pākākhyaṃ pacyarthamāhetyarthaḥ| tatra dvayorapi śṛtamiṣyata iti yo'ṇyantaḥ śrātiḥ karmakartṛviṣayeṇa pacinā samānārthastratrāpīṣyate| yo'pi ṇyantaḥ prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha tatrāpīṣyate| tatra śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ svayameveti prathamasyodāharaṇam| śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ devadatteneti dvitīyasya| nanu ca `śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hetoḥ` iti bhāṣye uktam, tat? kathaṃ dvayorapīṣyate? evaṃ manyate - yadidaṃ bhāṣye uktam - `śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hetoḥ` iti, tatra `anyatra hetoḥ` ityanena sarvasya hetumaṇṇicaḥ paryudāso na vidhitsitaḥ anyathā vipratiṣiddhamidaṃ syāt, asati hi śrāteścurādau pāṭhe yadi śrapeḥ śṛtamiti nipātyate, kathamanyatra hetoriti paryudāsaḥ! athānyatra hetoriti paryudāso na tarhi śrapeḥ śṛtamiti nipātanamupapadyate| na hi śrāteścurādāvasata pāṭhe śrāterhetumaṇṇicaṃ tyatkvā'nyastato ṇijasti| tasmādyasya hetumaṇṇico na kenacit? prakāreṇa svārthikatvamupapadyate sa eva bhāṣyakārasya paryudāsaviṣayatvenābhīṣṭaḥ| sa punaryo bāhre prayojake dvitīyo ṇijutpadyate sa vijñeyaḥ| yasya tu kenacit? prakāreṇa svārthikatvamupapadyate, sa eva bhāṣyakārasya paryudāsaviṣayatvena na prakalpyate, tasyaitannipātanamiṣṭameva| sa punaryasminnutpanne śrātiḥ prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha sa vijñeyaḥ, śakyate hi tasya pacinā prakṛtyarthena samānārthatvāt? svārthikatvamupacāreṇābhidhātumiti| tadevamiha pāṭhe'pi curādau śrāteṇryantasyāpyetannipātanaṃ yujyata eveti||`pīnam` iti| <> [[8.2.45]] iti niṣṭhānatvam| `ityamapi` ityādi| apiśabdena na kevalaṃ pūrvasūtre yā vibhāṣā saiva vyavasthitavibhāṣā, api tveṣāpīti darśayati| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha -`tena` ityādi| sopasargasya tu naiva bhavatītyasyāpavādamāha -`āṅpūrvasya` ityādi| nityaścāyamandhūdhasoḥ pībhāvaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣaiva||`vibhāṣeti nivṛttam` iti| uttarasūtre punarvibhāṣāgrahaṇāt| anyathāpīdameva tatrānuvarttiṣyata iti tanna kuryāt| ata evocyate -dvayordibhāṣayārmadhye ye vidhayaste nityā bhavantīti| `pyāyaḥ pītyetaccaśabdenānukṛṣyate` iti| itarathā hi samprasāraṇasya prakṛtatvālliṅyaṅoḥ pyāyaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ vijñāyeta| caśabde tu satyanantareṇaivapībhāvena sambandhaḥ sukhamavasīyate| nāprāpte dvirvacane pībhāvo vidhīyate| tena tasya bādhakaṃ prāpnotīti kasyacidāśaṅkā syāt| atastāṃ nirākarttumāha -`paratvāt` ityādi| virodhe hi sati bādhā syāt, iha tu virodho nāsti| ataḥ paratvāt? pībhāve kṛte punaḥprasaṅgavajñānāt? siddhamiti dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti||`śuśāva` iti| liṭi ṇali samprasāraṇe kṛte vṛddhyāvādeśau| `śiāāya` iti| yadā na samprasāraṇaṃ tadā vṛddhyāyādeśau| `śuśuvatuḥ, śiiāyatuḥ, iti| yadā samprasāraṇaṃ tadovaṅ, anyadeyaṅ| `aprāptam` iti| kenacivavihitatvāt| `liṭabhyāsasyobhayeṣām` [[6.1.17]] ityubhayatrobhayagrahaṇādanyat? kāryaṃ pravartamānamapāsyābhyāsasya samprasāraṇameva yathā syādityetadubhayeṣāṃgrahaṇasya prayojanamuktam| tataśceyamapi vikalpaṃ bādhitvā nityaṃ samprasāraṇa meva syāditi kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt? atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `yadā ca` ityādi| atra āyatervibhāṣā samprasāraṇamucyate, yadi kadāciddhātorna samprasāraṇaṃ bhavati tadābyāsasya syāt? tataśca āyateḥ samprasāraṇaṃ pākṣikaṃ na kṛtaṃ syāt| syādetat - liṭparasya śakyateridaṃ vikalpena kāryaṃ vidhīyate, tasya ca tadastyeveti? asamyagetat; dviṣprayoge hi dvirvacane kriyāmātraṃ bhidyate, na dhāturūpamiti kutaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ kāryasambandhaṃ prati bhedaḥ? tasmādyadā dhātorna bhavati tadābhyāsasyāpi na bhavatyeva||`ṇau ca saṃścaṅoḥ` iti bhinnādhikaraṇe saptamyau - saṃścaṅoḥ parato yo ṇistasmaṇṇau parato yaḥ āyatiriti| `śuśāvayiṣati` iti| āyaterṇic, san, samprasāraṇam, vṛddhirāvādeśaḥ `śu` ityetasya dvirvacanam| `aśūśavat` iti| luṅ, cleścaṅ, samprasāraṇādikam, pūrvavaṇṇilopaḥ, `ṇau caṅi` [[7.4.1]] iti hrasvaḥ, dvirvacanam, <> [[7.4.94]] iti dīrghaḥ| nanu ca āyaterṇici tadantācca sani kṛte caṅi cāntaraṅgatvāt? pūrvavṛddhyāyādeśābyāṃ bhavitavyam, tataḥ samprasāraṇena| tathā ca sati śuśuyayiṣatīti sanpare ṇau bhavitavyam, caṅpare tu - aśūśuyaditi, tat? kathaṃ śuśāvayiṣati, aśūśavaditi codāhṛtam? ityāha - `samprasāraṇam` ityādi| ādiśabdenāyāveśaḥ parigṛhrate| samprasāraṇāśrayaṃ punaratra <> [[6.1.108]] iti parapūrvatvam| `tenāpi vṛddhyādikaṃ bādhyate` iti| nanvevamapi vṛddhyāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ śāvityasya dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti na kenacit? ṇau sthānivadbhāvo vihitaḥ? ityata āha - `oḥ puyaṇjyapare` ityādi| yatra caitajjñāpakaṃ tathā tasyaiva vṛttāvupapādayiṣyāmaḥ||`nicikyu` iti| `eranekācaḥ` [[6.4.82]] ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| `nicāyya` iti| lyabantametat| dīrghoccāraṇaṃ cikīvānityatra dīrghasya śravaṇārtham| idaṃ kvasau rūpam||`akāralopaśca` iti| dhātoravayavo yo'kārastasya nipātanāllopaḥ| `apāspaddhaithām` iti| apākārasya `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti savarṇadīrghatvam| `viṣayavibhāgamicchati` iti| sa ca nipātanasāmarthyālallabhyata iti veditavyam| yadikvacidapyekasmin? śrābhāvo dṛśyate, tadarthaṃ tarhi yatnāntaramāstheyam| na hi śrātā ityanenaitadapi siddhayati; sūtre bahuvacananirdeśāt| ata āha -`tasya` ityādi||yeṣāṃ samprasāramuktaṃ teṣāṃ yāvanto yaṇaḥ sambhavanti teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ prāptamiti pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate| nanu cālo'ntyaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.51]] antyasyaiva bhaviṣyati, nānantyasya? naitadasti; na hranayā paribhāṣayā śakyamihopasthātum| vicasvapiyajādīnāmantyasya yaṇo'sambhavāt| evaṃ tarhi `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya`(vyā|pa|63) ityantyasadeśasya kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati -antyasadeśo yo yaṇ? tasyaiva kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati, naitarasya? naiṣāsti paribhāṣā; prayojanābhāvāt| yadāha -tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā santi prayojanātīti| tasmāt? kartavyametat? sūtram| nanu ca pūrvaparayorekayogalakṣaṇaṃ samprasārahaṇam, tato yadi tat? parasyābhinirvṛttaṃ tadā pūrvasyāpyabhinirvṛttameva, na cābhinirvṛttasya nivṛttiḥ śakyate karttum, nāpyanabhinirvṛttasya nimittatvenāśrayaṇaṃ yujyate, tato'smādeva pratiṣedhavacanāt? tat? parasya tāvat? kriyate; tatra kṛte tu pūrvasyāpi prāptaṃ pratiṣidhyate| atha samprasāraṇamityanuvartamāne punaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ kimartham? ityāha -`samprasāraṇam` ityādi| asati punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇe `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā| pa|19) iti prakṛtasyaiva samprasāraṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, na videśasthasya| tasmādvideśasthasyāpi bhinnaprakāraṇavihitasya pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇam| `yūno yūnā` iti| samprasāraṇe kṛte parapūrvatve kṛte ca <> [[6.1.101]] | nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇe tatra pratiṣedho na syāt, savarṇadīrghatvasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāve satyukāravyavahitatvāt? ata āha -`samprasāraṇagrahaṇasāmarthyadeva` ityādi| yadi sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt, anarthakaṃ punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| abhyupetya punaḥ parihārāntaramāha -`sati vā` ityādi| samprasāraṇagrahaṇasāmarthyādevātrāśrūyamāṇo'piśāstarāntareṇa sthānivadbhāvamāpanno yo'j? vyavadhānaṃ karoti, tanmātreṇa vyavadhānaṃ nāśrayiṣyate -mā bhūt? samprasāraṇagrahaṇamanarthakamiti| nanu ca `yūnaśca kutsāyām? [[4.1.165]] , `vṛddho yūnā` [[1.2.65]] iti nipātanādeva yūnaḥ, yūnetyatra samprasāraṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tat? kimetannivṛttyarthena punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇena? naitadasti; abādhakanyapi nipātanāni bhavantītyuktam| api caitadviṣayameva nipātanaṃ vijñāyate, tathā ca -yūnaḥ, yūnā yūnītyatra samprasāraṇaṃ syādeveti| `ārevān` iti| rayirasyāstīti matup| samprasāraṇe kṛte `ādguṇaḥ`; [[6.1.84]] , <> [[8.2.15]] iti vatvam||vayedrvau yaṇau, tatra pūrvaṇa vakārasya samprasāraṇapratiṣedhe prāpte yakārasyānena samprasāraṇaṃ liṭi pratiṣiddhyate| tatra pratiṣiddhe yakāraḥ samprasāraṇabhāgna bhavatīti vakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ bhavati dhātorabhyāsasya ca; tatra dhātogrrahrādisūtreṇa [[6.1.16]] abhyāsasya `liṭabyāsasyobhayeṣām` [[6.1.17]] ityanena| atha kimarthaṃ lihgrahaṇam, yāvatā vayerādeśasya liṭo'nyatra sambhavo nāsti, tadvidhau `liṭanyatarasyām` [[2.4.40]] ityato liṅgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ, tatsāmarthyādeva liṭi bhaviṣyati? ityata āha -`liṅgrahaṇamuttarārtham` iti| `veñaḥ` [[6.1.39]] iti pratiṣedho liṭi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ liṅgrahaṇam||`yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ` iti| uttaratra vyeña eva vibhāṣā samprasāraṇaṃ yathā syāt, `jyā` ityasya mā bhūdityevamartho yogavibhāgaḥ||`dhātoriti vartate` iti| <> [[6.1.8]] ityata; tasya ca dhātorevaiceti viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣamena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha - `ejanto yo dhātuḥ` iti| `upadeśe` iti| ādyuccāraṇe gaṇapāṭha ityārthaḥ| `cetā, stotā` iti| nanu ca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayaivātra (vyā|pa|3) na bhaviṣyati, tat? kimupadeśagrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhi upadeśagrahaṇamatetajjñāpayati - anityaiṣā paribhāṣeti| etena `arttihyī` [[7.3.36]] ityādisūtre lākṣaṇikasyāpyākārasya grahaṇe sati krāpayatītyādāvapi puk? siddho bhavati| `śa id? yasya so'yaṃ śit` iti| yaśca <> [[3.4.81]] ityeśādeśaḥ sa śidbhavati, tataśca śiti pratiṣedhe kriyamāṇa eśyapyāttvaṃ na prāpnoti| atrāyādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvena `glai` ityasya dvirvacane `jaglāya` ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt - iti manyamāna āha - `katham` ityādi| `glai ityādau <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ| `naivam` ityādinā parihāraḥ| śa eva it? śiditi vijñāyamāne satyalgrahaṇameva bhavati| tatra `yasmin? vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) paribhāṣayā śidādau pratyaye pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam, na caiś? śidādiḥ; kiṃ tarhi? śa#idantaḥ śidantasyaivoccāraṇāt| tasmādatraiśi pratiṣedho na bhavati| aśitīti paryudāso vā? prasajyapratiṣedho vā? tatra yadi paryudāsaḥ, tadā śito'nyadāttvanimittamāśritaṃ syāt| evañca yāvadāttvasya nimittaṃ na bhavati tāvadāttvena bhavitavyamiti; anākārāntatvāt| `sugalaḥ` ityādāvākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ kapratyayo na syādityeccetasikṛtvā''ha - `aśati` ityādi| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha - `tena` ityādi| prasajyapratiṣedhe hrāttvasya śiti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, na tu kiñcinnimittmāśrīyata iti tadanaimittikaṃ bhavati| ataḥ prāgeva pratyayotpatterāttvaṃ bhavatītyākārāntalakṣaṇa) pratyayaḥ siddhyati, tena `suglaḥ` ityādi| siddhaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdena suglaḥ, suglā - ityādegrrahaṇam| tatra hi striyām? `ātaścopasarge [[3.3.106]] ityaṅ||`vyeñ saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1007)| athāliṭīti kasmānna jñāyate, tulyā hi saṃhitā? naitadasti; yadi hrevaṃ syāt, `liṭi vyaḥ` iti niyama eva kṛtaḥ syāt -liṭaevāttvam, nānyatreti| lakṣyasthityā ca viparītaniyamo bhaviṣyati| dvivacanabahuvacanayoḥ samprasāraṇe pūrvarūpatva āttve ca satyasati vā nāsti viśeṣa ityekavacanāntamudāhṛtam| `saṃvivyayirthaḥ` iti| thali valādilakṣaṇasyeṭaḥ `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] ityādinā pratiṣedhaḥ| punarapi krādiniyamārthaḥ prāptaḥ, so'pi `acastāsvat? [[7.2.61]] ityādinā pratiṣiddhaḥ, punaḥ <<ṛto bhāradvājasya>> [[7.2.63]] iti niyamādvikalpe prāpte `iḍarttivyayatīnām` [[7.2.66]] iti nityaṃ kriyate||`visphāraḥ, visphālaḥ` iti| bhāve ghañ, `halaśca` [[3.3.121]] iti karaṇādhikaraṇayorvā||`ḍukrīñ? dravyavinimaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1473) `iṅ adhyayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1046) `ji jaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-561)| anupadeśārtha ārambhaḥ| krāpayatītyādāvātve kṛte `arttihyī` [[7.3.36]] ityādinā puk| kimarthamidamucyate, na `krapa kutsāyāṃ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-771), `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-397,398), `āplu vyāptau (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1260) ityasya cādhipūrvasya ṇici kṛte krāpayatītyādikaṃ rūpaṃ siddham, anekārthatvāddhātunāṃ kroṇātyādyarthe krapādayo varttiṣyante? ucyate; krīṇātyādīnāṃ ṇici prayogāntaranivṛttyartham| atha karoteḥ` īṅ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1143) ityasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? ucyate; karotestāvanna sambhavati, eca ityadhikārāt| ata eva vṛttikṛtā `ecaḥ` ityanuvarttitam| vacanasāmarthyādvā tasya hi vṛddhyaivāttvaṃ siddham? naitadasti; niyamārthahi syāt - āttvameva, na punā raparatvāmiti? naitadasti; `vidhiniyamasambhave vidhireva jyāyān` (vyā|pa|130) iti krīṇātereva grahaṇam| na karoteḥ, tasya niyamārthatvāt| krīṇātestu vidhyarthatvāt| `īṅ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1143) ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ na sambhavati; jayatinā harasvāntena sāhacayryāt| iṅ? hrasvānto grahīṣyate, na dīrghāntaḥ; śabdaparavipratiṣedhāt| jayatinā sāhacayryam, na krīṇātinā| vyākhyānato vā viśeṣo'vaseyaḥ||`annaṃ sādhyati` iti| annaṃ niṣpādayatītyarthaḥ| atra hi sidhiḥ pāralaukikerthe jñānaviśeṣe vartata iti| asyārthaṃ -`tāpasaḥ sidhyati` ityādinā spaṣṭīkaroti| `upasaṃhāran` iti| niṣpādayannityarthaḥ| `iha kasmānna bhavati` ityādi| evaṃ manyante -brāāhṛṇebhyo dāsyāmītyanenābhiprāyeṇa yo'nnaṃ sādhayati sa jamāntare bhavan? phalamabhyudayalakṣaṇaṃ prāpnoti, tasmāt? pāralaukike'rthe sidhiratra vartata iti paryudāsena bhavitavyamiti| sidhyateratrārtho niṣpattirityādinehalokārthatāṃ tvasya darśayati| `tasyāḥ prayojanamannam` iti| annamuddiśya pravṛttatvāt| `tasya` iti| annasya| `na punaḥ siddhireveti` iti| artālliṅgavipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā na punaḥ siddhireva pāralaukikīti sambandhanīyam| siddhirniṣpattirityarthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt? siddho dhāturvartate| atra siddhiḥ pāralaukikī na bhavati, tasmānnātrātvaṃ paryudasyate| syādetat? yadyapi sākṣāddhātuḥ paralokārtho na bhavati, pāramparyeṇa tu bhavatyeva, tasmādbhavitavyameva pratiṣedhena ityāha -`sākṣāt` ityādi| yadi sākṣādavyavadhānena paralokārtho yaḥ siddhyaterarthaḥ, tatrāpi pāralaukika itīdaṃ vacanaṃ na kṛtārthaṃ syāt, tadā pāramparyeṇāpi yaḥ paralokārthastatra vyāpriyeta -mā bhūdvacanavaiyathryamiti| idaṃ tu jñānaviśeṣe sākṣāt? paralokārthe sidhyatyarthe caritārtham, tato notsahata evaṃvidhaviṣayamavagāhitum| na śaknotyevamprakāre viṣaye ni,#edhaḥ pravarttitumityarthaḥ| atha siddhyateḥ śyanā nirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na sidherityevocyeta, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati? ityāha -`siddhyateḥ` ityādi||`upadeśa` [[6.1.44]] ityanuvṛtteḥ prāgeva pratyayotpatterāttvena bhavitavyamiti, ata ātvavidhānakāle lyapaḥ paratvaṃ na sambhavatīti tasmāllyapīti viṣayasaptamīyaṃ vijñāyata ityāha -`lyapi viṣaye` iti| eceti yadyapi prakṛtaviśeṣaṇaṃ prāgāsīt, tathāpīhopadeśādhikārānmīnātiprabhṛtīnāṃ copadeśāvasthāyāmeco'sambhavāt? sāmarthyādviṣayaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha -`ecaśca viṣaye` iti| `upadeśe` ityasya prāgityādinārthamācaṣṭe| `pramāya` iti| `samāse'nañ` [[7.1.37]] iti lyap| kaḥ punarupadeśāvasthāyāmevāttvavidhāne'rthaḥ sampadyate, yadarthamupadeśāvasthāyāmāttvaṃ kriyate? ityāha -`upadeśa eva` ityādi| ivarṇāntalakṣaṇaḥ `erac` [[3.3.56]] ityaca, ākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ <<āto yuc>> [[3.3.128]] `upadāyaḥ` iti| upadeśa evāttve kṛte satyaco nimittaṃ vihitamityusarga eva `bhāve` [[3.3.18]] iti ghañ? siddho bhavati| `āto yuk? ciṣkṛtoḥ` [[7.3.33]] iti yuk| `īṣadupadānam` iti| upadeśāvasthāyāmāttve khalapavādo yuc? siddho bhavati||`tayorubhayorapi yakā nirdeśaḥ smaryate` iti| ācāryaiḥ| atha daivādikasyāyaṃ śyanā nirdeśaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? ata eva nirdeśāt| yadi daivādika evātra nirdeṣṭumabhīṣṭaḥ syāt, anubandhena līṅa iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| tasmāt? sādhāraṇenāgantukena yakāyamubhayornirdeśaḥ| `īṣatpramayaḥ` iti| `īṣadduḥsuṣu` [[3.3.126]] ityādinā khal| `nimayo vartate` iti| `erac` [[3.3.56]] ityac| `atra tu liyo vyavasthitavibhāṣayā vijñānāt? siddham` iti| `liyaḥ` ityupalakṣaṇamātram, itarayorapi siddha eva; vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya pūrveṇāpi sūtreṇa sambandhāt| vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt? pralambhanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca ṇau nityamāttvaṃ bhavati| vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādeva| `ullāpayate, apalāpayate` iti| `liyaḥ sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayoḥ` [[1.3.70]] ityātmanepadam||`cikhāda` iti| `pugantalaghūpadhasya` [[7.3.86]] iti guṇe kṛta ākāraḥ| yadi khādirapi khiderarthe vartate, tato'yaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'karttum; khādestu - cakhādeti bhaviṣyati, khidestu - cikhedeti||`apagāramapagāram` iti| `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavataḥ` (vā|887) iti dvitvam||<> [[6.1.48]] ityatra pradeśa idaṃ noktam; nityaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham||yadi `vā gatigandhanayoḥ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1050) ityayaṃ dhātuḥ prajane vartate, tataḥ śakyate'pi yogo'vaktum; vāterhi -vāpayatīti bhaviṣyati, vīyatestu -vāyayatīti||`hatubhaye` iti| <> [[2.1.37]] iti pañcamīsamāso'yamityāha -`tato yadbhayam` iti| kiṃ punastato bhayam? ityāha -`sa yasya bhayasya` ityādi| athāttvapakṣe ṣugāgamaḥ kasmānna bhavati? asti hyatrāpi prāptiḥ -`ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati` (vyā|pa|16) ityata āha -`sa ca` ityādi| <> [[7.3.40]] ityatra hi bhī+ī i ta īkāreṇa praśliṣṭasya nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ -īkārāntasyaiva ṣug? yathā syāt, ākārāntasya mā bhūdīti| tathā liyo grahaṇam, tasyāpyāttvapakṣe `līlornuklukāvanyatarasyāṃ snehavipātane` [[7.3.39]] iti nugna bhavati| īkārapraśleṣanirdeśādeveti prasaṅgena vyutpāditam||`bhayaśabdena dhātvarthasāmyāt` ityādi| yaśca bibhetarartho yaśca smayateḥ, tau dvāpi sadṛśau; cittavikāra svabhāvatayā| dvāvapi tau cittasaṃkṣobhalakṣaṇau, ato dvayorapi yat? sāmānyaṃ tat? sādṛśyam| tasmādbhayaśabdenātra smayaterartho'bhidhīyate| dṛśyate hi sādṛśyādarthāntare'pi śabdānāṃ vṛttiḥ, yathā - siṃho māṇavaka iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha - `na hi` ityādi| <> [[6.1.56]] ityanuvartate| ucyate cedaṃ viśeṣaṇam| na ca mukhye bhaye smayatervṛttisti| tatra sāmarthyāt? kenacit? sādṛśyena smayatyartha eva bhayaśabdenātrābhidhīyata iti vijñāyate||`ruāṣṭā, draṣṭā` iti| umāgame kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ, vraścādi [[8.2.36]] sūtreṇa ṣatvam| `laghūpadhaguṇāpavādau'yam` ityādi| nanu cāsati sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavati, asti ca sambhavo yadubhayaṃ syāditi, tatra guṇe kṛte'māgamo bhaviṣyati? naitadevam; sāmānyavihito guṇaḥ viśeṣavihitastvamāgamaḥ, sāmānyavihitasya ca viśeṣavihito bādhako bhavati, yathā - brāāhraṇebhyo dadhidīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇjanyāyeti| yathā sāmānyavihitasya dadhidānasya viśeṣavihitaṃ takradānaṃ bādhakaṃ bhavati tathehāpi yuktā'māgamamena guṇasya bādhā| `aruāākṣīt, adrākṣīt` iti| <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam, `asti sico'pṛkte` [[7.3.96]] itīṭ, <> [[7.2.3]] iti vṛddhiḥ, <<ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si>> [[8.2.41]] iti katvam| `vṛddhiramikṛte bhavati` iti| atha prāgeva vṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `pūrvantu bādhyate` iti| yathaiva hi viśeṣavihitatvādamāgamena sāmānyavihito guṇo bādhyate, tathā vṛddhirapi sāmānyavihitaivāmāgame kṛte paścāt? punaḥprasahgavijñānāt? siddhamiti sāpi bhavati| guṇastvamāgame kṛte na bhavati; nimittasya vihitatvāt| na hramāgame kṛta upadhā laghvī guṇabhāvinyupapadyate| atheha kasmānna bhavati - rajjusṛṅbhyām, devadṛgbhyāmiti; satyapi dhātvadhikāre `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati (vyā|pa|132) iti bhyāmpratyayamakitamāśrityāmāgamaḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha - `dhātoḥ` ityādi||kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamādeśo neṣyate? ityāha - `so'pi hi` ityādi| yataḥ śiraḥśabdo'pi cchandati prayucyate, tato nāyamādeśaḥ prayujyate| ādeśe hi sati śiraḥśabdasya cchandasi viṣaye prayogo na syāt, nivṛttidharmatvāt? sthāninaḥ| yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamihānuvartate tadādeśe'pyadoṣaḥ| `śīrṣā` iti| <> [[6.4.7]] iti dīrdhaḥ| kvacit? śīṣrṇeti paṭhate, tat? tṛtīyāntaṃ draṣṭavyam| <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] ityakāralopaḥ| `śīrṣṇaḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhaekavacanāntametat||ihāpi śasprabhṛtayo nimittatvenopādīyante, te ca prakṛtyā vinā nopapadyanta iti bhāvaḥ| teṣu prakṛtyantarādvihiteṣu vidhīyamānāḥ padādaya ādeśā vijñāyante| na ca sthānino'nupādānādiyamenādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, yatasteṣvādiśyamāneṣu śasprabhṛtayo'nurūpameva pādādikāṃ svārthikīṃ prakṛtimākṣipantītyāha -`pādadantanāsikā` ityādi| padityādyudāharaṇeṣu pado data iti śasante| `yūṣṇaḥ, doṣṇaḥ, yaknaḥ, śaknaḥ` ti ṣaṣṭhaekavacanāntāni| <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] ityakāralopaḥ| `māsi, niśi, āsani` iti saptamyekavacanāntāni| āsanītyatra `vibhāṣāṅiśyoḥ` [[6.4.136]] iti pakṣe'kāralopo na bhavati| śeṣāṇi tṛtīyaikavacanāntāni| `pādau, nāsike` iti prathamādvivacanānte| kasmāt? punaranyatarasyāmityetadanuvartayanti? ityāha -`tena pādādayo'pi` ityādi| yasmāt? pādādayo'pi prayujyante tasmādanyatarasyāmityanuvartayanti|vyavasthāvācini prabhṛtiśabda āśroyamāṇe śasprabhṛtibhyo'nyatrādeśo na sidhyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha -`prakārārthe prabhṛtiśabdaḥ` iti| `doṣaṇī` iti| kecidāhuḥ -prathamādvivacane doṣannādeśaḥ, auṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ -doṣaṇīti ṅībantametat, ṅīpi viṣayabhūte doṣannādeśaḥ, tataḥ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] |`nasyam` iti| hitārthe `śarīrāvayavādyat` [[5.1.6]] | `nastaḥ` iti| <> [[5.4.45]] tasiḥ| `naḥkṣudraḥ` iti| nāsikā kṣudrā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `nāsikyo varṇaḥ` iti| bhavārthe `śarīrāvayavāt` [[5.1.6]] iti yat| nāsikyaṃ nagaramiti atra hitārthe yat||`siñciti` iti| <<śe mucādīnām>> [[7.1.59]] iti num| `ṣoḍaśa` iti| ṣaṭ? vā daśa vāsyeti `saṃkhyāyāvyaya` [[2.2.25]] ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ, `saṃkhyeye ṅac` [[5.4.73]] ityādinā samāsānto ṅac| `ṣoḍan` iti| ṣaṭ? dantā asyeti bahavrīhiḥ, <> [[5.4.141]] iti dantaśabdasya datrādeśaḥ| `ṣaṣa uttvaṃ datṛdaśadhāsūttarapadādeḥ ṣṭutvaṃ ca` (vā|765) iti ṣaṣa utvam, uttarapadādeśca ṣṭutvam -ḍakāraḥ| `ṣaṇḍaḥ` iti| prātipadikāntametadavyutpannam| `ṣaḍikaḥ iti| anukampitaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulidatta iti `bahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhac` [[5.3.78]] iti ṭhac? ṭhājādāvūdhrvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ` [[5.3.83]] ityaṅgulidattaśabdasya lopaḥ| nanu ca `liṭi dhātoḥ` [[6.1.8]] ityato'tra dhātugrahaṇamanuvarttiṣyate, tadiha kiṃ punardhātugrahaṇena? evaṃ tarahhi etajjñāpayati -tannivṛttamiti| tasya hranuvṛttau `lopo vyorvali [[6.1.64]] ityayamapi lopo dhātvavayavasyaiva vijñāyate| knūyī (dhā|pā485), ktaḥ -knūtaḥ kṣmayī (dhātupāṭhaḥ-486), ktaḥ -kṣmāta ityatraiva syāt; gaudharaḥ, pacerannityatra na syāt| nanvevamapi dhātugrahaṇamanarthakameva, yasmādupadeśa iti vartata eva, na ca prātipadikānāmupadeśaḥ, keṣāṃ tarhi upadeśaḥ? dhātūnām? naitadasti; upadeśādhikāro|yupadeśagrahaṇena ṣakāro viśiṣyate, ṣaṣaśca ṣakāra upadeśo bhavati| `ṣaṣa uttvaṃ datṛdaśadhāsūttarapadādeḥ (vā|765) iti sūtre pāṭhāt| tasmāt? dhātugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `kaṣati` iti| bhvādau kaṣasidhetyādihisārtho dhātuvarge paṭhate| `laṣati` iti| `laṣa kānto`(dhātupāṭhaḥ-888) anayorādigārahaṇasya bhavati| nanu copadeśasāmarthyādevātra na bhaviṣyatīti, anyathā hrupadeśasya vaiyathrya syāt? naitasti; asti hranyatūpadeśasya prayojanam| kiṃ tat? -<<śeṣe vibhāṣā'kakhādāvaṣānta upadeśe>> [[8.4.18]] ityatra keṣegrrahaṇaṃ mā bhūta; leṣatuḥ, leṣuriti ṣatvaṃ yathā syāt| kimarthaṃ punaḥ ṣādayo upadṣṭāḥ, na sādayo hrupadiśyeran, evaṃ hretat? sūtraṃ na kartavayaṃ bhavati? ityata āha -`ādeśapratyayoḥ` ityādi| ṣatvavyavasthāṃ=ṣatvaniyamaḥ| <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] ityanena sahādīnāmeva ṣatvavyavasthā yathā sthādityevamartham| ṣādapaḥ kecidupadiṣṭāḥ anyathā sahādīnāṃ ṣatvārtha yatnāntaraṃ kartavyaṃ syāt| tacca guru bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| yadyapi ṣakārādiṣu sandeho na bhavati, sakārādiṣu ca bhavatyeva| atra hi na jñāyate -kiṃ ṣopadeśā eva santaḥ <> [[6.1.64]] ityanena kṛtasatvā uccāritāḥ? uta sakārādaya eva? iti sandihra pṛcchati -`ke punaste` iti| `ye yathā paṭhante` iti| ṣādayo ye yathā paṭhante sannidhānāt? ta eva ṣopadeśā avagantavyāḥ| `ajdantyaparāḥ` ityādi| ajdantyau parau yeṣāmiti te'bdantyaparāḥ| paraśabdo'trāvayave vartate| taccācdantyayoḥ paratvamavayavāntarāpekṣaṃ vijñāyamānaṃ sannidhānāt? sakārāpekṣaṃ vijñāyate| `smisvidisvañjisvapayaśca` iti| `ṣmiṅīṣaddhamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-948), `ñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1188), `ṣvanja pariṣvaṅge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-976) `ñiṣvap? śaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1068) ete svarūpeṇākhyāyante; makāravakārayorajdantyatvābhāvāt| kecit smisvadisvadisvañjisvapayaśceti svidisthāne svadiṃ paṭhanti, teṣāṃ `teṣāṃ svada [`ṣvada` -dhātupāṭhaḥ ] svarda āsvādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-18,19) iti svadirapi ṣopadeśa eva| `sṛpisṛjistṛstyāsekṛsṛvarjam` iti| `gamlu suplṛ gatau (dhātupāṭhaḥ-982,983), `sṛja visarge (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1178), `stṛñ? ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1252), `ṣṭa styai śabdasaṅghātayoḥ`, (dhātupāṭhaḥ-911,910) `seka [sekṛ, ruoka -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] sekṛ śraki ślaki gatyarthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-81,82,84,85), `sṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-935) etān? varjayitvā ye'nye'jdantatyaparāste ṣopadeśāḥ| `subdhātu` ityādi| subdhātuḥ kyajādyantaḥ| `ṣṭhic? nirasane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-560), `ṣvakka [atratyāḥdhātavaḥ kecana dhātupāṭhe na santi] vukka makkatikka ṭikka ṭīkka vagi lagi gatyarthāḥ -eṣāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyo vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -subdhātautāvat? ṣoḍīyatītyādau naiva dhātvādiḥ ṣakāraḥ, tathā hrādiravayavaḥ| ārambhakaścāvayavo bhavati, subdātuḥ sabantena kyacā cārabhyate| na ca ṣakāreṇāpi varṇāntareṇeti kutastasya ṣakārāditvam? sahādayastu ṣakārādibhireva varṇerārabhyanta iti yuktaṃ teṣāṃ ṣakārāditvam| ṣṭhiverapi nipātanānna bhavati, kiṃ tannipātanam? `ṣṭivuklamucamāṃ śiti` [[7.3.75]] iti| yasya hi satvaṃ bhavati tamayaṃ pradeśeṣu kṛtasatbamevoccārayati yathā pradeśe -`sthādhvoricca` [[1.2.17]] iti| ṣvakkerapyajdantyaparā ityanena nivarttitatvānna bhavati| vakārasya dantyauṣṭhatvādajdantyagrahaṇena na gṛhrate| atha vā yādityāt? ṣṭhivuṣvakkorna bhaviṣyati, yakārastu luptanirdiṣṭatvānna śrūyate| atha vā -anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamatrānuvartate sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate, tena subdhātvādīnāṃ na bhavatīti| `ṣaṣṭhīvati` iti| `ṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti` [[7.3.75]] iti dīrghaḥ| `ṣvakkate` iti| anudāttettvādātmanepadam| atha ṣṭhivo dvitīyavarṇaḥ kiṃ ṭhakāra iṣyate? uta thakāraḥ? yadi ṭhakārastadā siddham -ṭeṣṭhīṣyata iti, na sidhyati -teṣṭhīvyata iti, <> [[8.4.54]] iti ṭakāra evāntaratamaṣṭhakārasya sthāne prāpnotīti kṛtvā; atha thakārastadā siddham -teṣṭhīvyata iti, etanna sidhyati -ṭeṣṭhīvyata iti, āntaratamyādvidhīyamānasthakārasya sthāne takāra eva prāpnotītyata āha -`ṣṭhivu ityetasya` ityādi| byāsasya dvairūpyaṃ yathā syāditi| kecidācāryema śiṣyā `ṭhakāro'yam` ityupadiṣṭāḥ| apare punaḥ `thakāro'yaṃ ṣṭutvena ṭhakāraḥ śrūyate` itīmamarthaṃ grāhitāḥ| ubhayaṃ caitat? prayojanam| anye punarahuḥ -ṣṭhivurdivādiṣvapi punaradhīyate, tatraikasya dvitoyasthākāraḥ, aparasya tu ṭhakāra iti| teṣṭhīvyata iti <<śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ>> [[7.4.61]] śeṣaḥ||`subdhātorayamapi neṣyate` iti| pūrvasmadeva hetoḥ| `upasargādasamāse'pi` ityādi| atra pūrvānusāreṇa pūrvapakṣo vijñeyaḥ| `nṛtīnandi` ityādi| `nṛtī gātravikṣe#epe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1116), `ṭunadi samṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-67), `narda gadrda śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-56,57), `nakka vakka [`dhakka` -ghātupāṭhaḥ] nāśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1593,1594), `naṭa avasyandane` [avaspandane -ghātupāṭhaḥ] (dhācapā|1545) curādiṇijantaḥ, `nāthṛ nādhṛ yāñcopatāpaiāryāśīḥṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-6|7), `nṛ naye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-809,1495)||`liṭi dhātoḥ` [[6.1.8]] ityasya dhātugrahaṇasya dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyādihāpyanuvṛttiriti manyamānasya dhātorevāyaṃ vali vyalopo vidhīyata iti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastaṃ nirakarttumāha -`dhātoriti yat? prakṛtam` ityādi| `didivān` iti| diveḥ kvasau rūpam| `ūyī` iti| `ūyī tantusantāne (dhātupāṭhaḥ-483) `knūyo` iti| `knūyī śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-485) `gauderaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.129]] ḍhasyaiyādeśaḥ, yakāralopaḥ| `paceran` iti| sīyuḍakārasya lopaḥ| `jīveḥ` iti| `jīva prāṇadhāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-562) ityasya| `riuāveḥ` iti| `riuāvu gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1109) ityetasya| `āruomāṇam` iti| auṇādiko'yaṃ manin| kathaṃ punaretadihodāharaṇam, yāvatā paratvāt? `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyo bhavati` (vyā|pa|39) iti balīyastvāt? `cchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] ityādinoṭhādeśenātra bhavitavyam? ityata āha -`uṇādayo bahulam` ityādi| bahulagrahaṇasya sarvavidhivyabhicārārthatvānna bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅga iti|paścāllopagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe pakārāt? pareṇādhyardhamātroccārayitavyā bhavati, akagāro hi mātrā, visajaṃ nīyastvardhamātraḥ| pūrvaṃ tu lopagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe mātrādvayamuccārayitavyaṃ jāyate; okārasya dvimātrikatvāt| tatra lāghavārthaṃ paścādeva lopagrahaṇaṃ karttu yuktam, tat? kiṃ pūrvaṃ kriyate? ityata āha -`pūrvam` ityādi| anyastu pūrva kāryinirdeśo yuktaḥ, paścāt? karyanirdeśa iti pūrva vyogrrahaṇe kartavye kimartha lopagrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti pūrvapakṣaṃ varṇayati, sa cāyuktaḥ `lugaṇiñoḥ` [[2.4.58]] ityatra kāryasyāpi pūrva nidaśāt| `verapṛktalopāt` ityādi| kaṇḍūyaterlolūyateśca kvipi kṛte vali lopāt? paratvāt? kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvācca pūrvaṃ verapṛktalopa eva syāt| asmaśca sati nimittābhāvāt? varṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇābhādvavali lopo na syāt? tasmāt? pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇaṃ kriyate -vali lopa eva pūrvaṃ yathā syāt| pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇe hrayamarthaḥ sūcyate -verṛktalopat? pūrva vali lopa eva kartavyamiti| `kaṇḍūḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ| kvilugupadhātvacaṅgaparanihyasikutveṣu na sthānivat` (1.1.59 vā|2) ityakārasya sthānivadbhāvo na bhavati vali lopaḥ| atha vraścakaḥ, vraścana ityatra rephe vali parato vakagāralopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`vraścādīnām` ityādi| yadyeṣāmapi lopaḥ syāt, vakāroccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| ataścoccāraṇasāmarthyādvraścādīnāṃ vali lopo na bhavati| syādetat -vṛścati, vavraścetyatra samprasāraṇe halādiśeṣe ca vakārasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syāt, tat? kuta upadeśasya vaiyarthyam? ata āha -`vṛścati` ityādi| yathā vraścaka ityādau lopasya prāptiḥ, evaṃ vṛścatītyādāvapi samprasāraṇādau kārye kṛte'pi; tasya bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatvāt| tatra samprasāraṇaṃ ṅitpratyayāpekṣatvāt? bahiraṅgam| halādiśeṣe'bhyāsāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, vali yalopastu varṇamātrāśrayatvādantaraṅgaḥ| tasmāt? sarvatraiva vraścervakāralopaḥ prāpnoti| kriyate cāsyo padeśaḥ, ata upadeśasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti tadevāvasthitam||`veḥ` ityādi| kvibāderanyasya verapṛktasaṃjñakasayābhāvāt? kvibādaya eva gṛhyante, kathaṃ punarverityucyamāne kvibādīnāṃ sāmānyena grahaṇamupapadyate, yāvatā prakārādayasyeṣāṃ viśeṣā anubandhāḥ santi? iti codyanirāsāye damuktam -`viśeṣānanubandhānutsṛjya` iti| `brāhrahā, bhrūṇahā` iti| `sau ca` [[6.4.13]] iti dīrghaḥ `ghṛtaspṛk` iti| <> [[8.2.62]] iti kutvam| `ardhabhāk`iti| <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam| darvirityādau <> [[3.3.1]] iti bahulagrahaṇādeva lopo na bhavatīti śakyate vaktum, ataḥ prapañcārtham| vaicitryārthaṃ vā'pṛktagrahaṇam||yadi lopa iti ihānuvartamānaṃ śāstrīyeṇārthenaivārthavat? syāt tadā tena halityasya prathamāntasya sāmānādhikaraṇyena sambandho nopapadyate| śāstrīyasya hi lopaśabdasyārthaḥ - darśanābhāvaḥ=ādarśanam, na ca haladarśanaṃ bhavati| na ca `halṅyābbhyaḥ` iti pañcamī haliti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| sāmarthyādvā halityasya ṣaṣṭhantatayā vipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati, ataḥ ṣaṣṭhantasya lopaśabdena sambandho bhavaṣyatīti śakyaṃ prakalpayitum; akṛtārthatvāt? prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhībhāvasyānupapatterityetadālocyāha -`tadiha` ityādi| `lupyata iti lopaḥ`| karmaṇi ghañ| etena laukikārthenārthavattvaṃ lopaśabdasya darśayati| lupyata iti nirudhyata ityarthaḥ| laukikenārthenārthavatā karmasādhanena lopaśabdena halityetasya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabāva upapadyate| lopaśabdena hi lupyamānaṃ varṇamātramucyate| ` sutisyapṛktaṃ hal` iti| anena ca tadeva viśiṣyate| `dīrghāt` iti| etacca ṅyāporeva viśeṣaṇam; sambhavāvyabhicārāt, na tu halantasya; asambhavāt| `ukhāruāt; parṇadhvat? iti| `ruānsu dhvansu adhaḥpatane;, (dhātupāṭhaḥ-754,755) ukhāyāṃ ruāṃsate parṇāni dhvaṃsata iti kvip? `aniditām` [[8.4.55]] cartvam -takāraḥ| `kumārī` ti| <> [[4.1.20]] iti ṅīṣ| `gaurī` iti| <<ṣidgaurādibhyaśca>> [[4.1.41]] iti ṅīṣ| `śāṅrgaravī` iti| <<śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn>> [[4.1.73]] iti ḍāp| `kārīṣagandhyā iti| `yaṅścāp` [[4.1.74]] | `halantādeva tilopaḥ silopaśca` iti| nanu ṅyābantādityekāreṇa darśayati, na hi ṅyābantāt? parau tisī sambhavataḥ, dhātoreva parasya lakārasya tayorvidhānāt| `abibharbhavān` iti| guṇe raparatve ca kṛte tilopaḥ| `ajāgarbhavān` iti| <<jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu>> [[7.3.85]] iti guṇaḥ| bhavānityanuprayogastiśabdābhivyaktaye| `abhinaḥ` iti| bhiderlaṅ `daśca` [[8.2.75]] iti rutvam, <> [[6.1.113]] ityuttvam, inamo'kāreṇa saha `ād? guṇaḥ, [[6.1.84]] <> [[6.1.109]] iti pūrvarūpatvam| `grāmaṇīḥ` iti| grāmaṃ nayatīti `satsūdviṣa` [[3.2.61]] ityādinā kvip| `niṣkauśāmbiḥ` iti nirgataḥ kauśāmbyā iti prādisamāsaḥ, <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvatvam| `atikhaṭavaḥ` iti| khaṭvāmatikrānta iti pūrvavat? samāse kṛte hrasvaḥ| `abhaitsīt` iti| `vadavraja` [[7.2.3]] iti vṛddhiḥ, apṛkta iṭ| nanu sīti sāmānyena nidaśāt? sico'pi garahaṇam, ato na yuktamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam? ata āha -`tisahacaritasya` ityādi| tiṅtiśabdena sāhacaryāt? tiṅ eva segrrahaṇam, na siceti kimatrāyuktam| `bibheda` iti| ṇalo'kāro'tra bhavatyapṛkataḥ, na tu hal? iti nāsau lupyate| `saṃyogāntalopenaiva siddham` iti| rājetyādikamudāharaṇamiti śeṣaḥ| kathaṃ punarna sidhyati? ityata āha -`rājā, takṣā` ityādi| yathā pacannityatra saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvānnalopo na bhavati; tathā rājā, takṣetyādāvapi na syāt| saṃyogāntalopāsiddhatvaṃ cātra pāramparyeṇa hetuḥ| tasmin? sati hi sau parataḥ pūrvasya padasaṃjñā na bhavati; `asarvanāmasthāne` [[1.4.17]] iti pratiṣedhāt| tasyāṃ cāsatyāṃ padasyetyucyamāno nalopo na syāt, nalope cāsati rājetyādikaṃ rūpaṃ na sidhyet| `datvam` iti| na syāditi prakṛtena sambandhanīyam| datvamapi hi saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvādasatyāṃ padasaṃjñāyāṃ na syāt| atha vā -saṃyogāntalopo'tra na pravartata eva, tasya `skoḥsaṃyogādyorante ca` [[8.2.29]] iti saṃyogādilopo'pavādabhūta iti sa eva syāt, yathā -kāṣṭhaṃ takṣṇotīti kāṣṭhataṅityatra| tasmaśca sati vibhaktisakārasya rutvavisargau syātāmiti kuto dattvam! `uttvam` iti| na syādityapekṣate, etadapi saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvāt| alabdhapadavyapadeśasya na syāt| `rātsasya` [[8.2.24]] iti `niyamāt` iti| <> [[8.2.23]] ityanenaiva siddheḥ| `rātsasya` [[8.2.24]] iti `niyamāt` iti| <> [[8.2.23]] ityanenaiva siddheḥ| `rātsasya` [[8.2.24]] iti niyamārthamidam -rātsasyaiva lopo yathā syāt, nānyasyeti| tataścābibharbhavānityatra takārasya lopa eva na syāt| tasmāt? saṃyogāntalopena na sidhyatīti halantāllopa ucyate| asyaivārthasya sukhopagrahaṇārthaṃ `saṃyogāntasyalope hi` ityādi| saṅgrahaślokasyopanyāsaḥ| hiśabdo hetau| yasmāt? saṃyogāntalopa āśrīyamāṇe nalopādikaṃ kāryaṃ na sidhyatīti| kiñca -te=tava, bhavataḥ saṃyogāntalopavādinaḥ rāttu rephāttu parasya takārasyābibharbhavānajagarbhavānityatra naiva lopaḥ syāt| tasmādvalantāt? sutisīnāṃ lopo vidhīyate||`haliti ca` iti| vartata ityapekṣate| yadi haliti nānuvarteta, tadā he kuṇḍa+su iti sthite lopāt? paratvādambhāve kṛte <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityakāralope `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghatve ca he kuṇḍamityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `apṛktamiti nādhikriyate` iti| yadi hrapṛktamihānuvarteta, tarhi he kuṇḍetyatra lopo na syāt; apṛktasaṃjñāyā abhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punajrñāyate -apukta iha nānuvartate? ityāha -`tathā ca` ityādi| tathā ceti hitau| yasmāt pūrvasūtre'pṛktagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamato'vasīyate -nātra prakaraṇe'pṛktagrahaṇasyānuvṛttirastauti; anyathā hi <> [[6.1.67]] ityata evāpṛktagrahaṇamanuvarttiṣyata iti punarapṛktagrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre na kriyeteti| `sa cet? sambuddherbhavati` iti| yadi sambuddheḥ sambaddho bhavatītyarthaḥ| etena sambuddherityasyāvayavaṣaṣṭhantatāṃ darśayati| `he agne, he vāyo` iti| `hrasvasya guṇaḥ` [[7.3.108]] | `he nadi, he vadhu` iti| `ambārthanadyohryasvaḥ` [[7.3.107]] iti hrasvatvam| `halmātrasya makārasya lopaḥ` iti| halityanuvṛtteḥ| he kataradityatraikādeśe kṛte hrasvāt? sambuddherhal? bhavatīti tasya lopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`he katarat` ityādi| `adḍḍatarādibhyaḥ` [[7.1.25]] ityatra dviḍakāranirdeśāt? ḍicchabda ādeśo bhavatīti ḍitvāṭ? ṭilope hyasavo nāstīti na bhavati lopaḥ| athaiṅgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā he agne ityādāvapi prāgeva sambuddhiguṇād? hrasvādityevaṃ lope na bhavitavyam? ityata āha -`eṅgrahaṇam` ityādi| nityatvāt? paratvācca sambuddhigumo balīyāniti tanaiva tāvat? bhavitavyam, tatra kṛte hrasvāt? paraḥ sambuddherhal? na sambhavatīti lopo na prāpnoti, ata eṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| nanu ca vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyate -hrasvādvihitāyāḥ sambuddheriti? naitadasti; ekā hīyaṃ pañcamī, tatra yadi hrasvādvihiti viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate tadaiṅantādapi vijñāyeta| tathā ca -he gaurityatrāpi syāt| tasmādeṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||`jasśasoḥ śiḥ` [[7.1.20]] iti yaḥ śirādeśastasyāyaṃ lopo vidhīyate| `yā kṣetrā, yā vanā` iti| śerlope kṛte pratyalakṣaṇena <> [[7.1.72]] iti num, <> [[6.4.8]] iti dīrghaḥ, `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya [[8.2.7]] iti nalopaḥ| veti kartavye bahulagrahaṇaṃ sarvavidhivyabhicārārtham| `tena sarve vidhayaśchandasi viklpyante` (pu|pa|vṛ|56), ityupapannaṃ bhavati||kṛtātra pratyayena dhāturupasthāpyate, hrasvena ca sa eva viśeṣyate, ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyato hrasvānto dhāturāgamī vijñāyata ityāha -`hrasvāntasya dhātoḥ` ityādi| `agnicit` iti| <> [[3.2.91]] iti kvip| `somasut` iti| <> [[3.2.90]] ityubhayatropapadasamāsaḥ| `prakṛtya`ityādau prādisamāsaḥ| `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap` [[7.1.37]] iti lyap| atha grāmaṃ nayatīti -grāmaṇi brāāhamaṇakulamityatra napuṃsakahrasvatve kṛte hrasvāśrayastuk? kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`grāmaṇi brāāhṛṇakulam` ityādi| hrasvatvaṃ hi napuṃsakārthavṛttiprātipadikamapekṣata iti bahiraṅgam, antaraṅgastu tuk; varṇamātrāpekṣatāvt| `āsiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge (vyā|pa|42) iti tugnātra bhavati||`saṃhitāyām` iti viṣayasaptamīyam| tena yadi kāryinimittayoḥ saṃhitā viṣayabhūtā bhavati, tahrrevaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati; nānyartheti veditavyam|`che` iti yadyapyakāravataśchakārādeṣā saptamī tathāpi cchakāra eva kevalastuko nimittam, akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ| etacca <<ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ>> [[3.1.36]] ityāmpratiṣedhādavasīyate| yadi hrakārasahitaśchakārastuko nimittaṃ syāt, tadā ṛcchestugabhāvādasati gurumatvaṃ āmaḥ prasaṅgo nāstīti pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt| `icchati` iti| <> [[7.3.77]] tuk? cutvam| pūrvasmastugvidhau hrasvānta āgamī, ataḥ sa evātrāgamīti kasya cid? bhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `hrasva eva` ityādi| evaṃ manyate - hrasvānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro'tra kriyate - hyasava evāgamī yathā syāt, tadanto mā bhūdityevamartham`; anyathā svaritatvādanantarattvācca pūrvasūtre ya āgamī, sa evehāpi vijñāsyata ityanarthakaścakāraḥ syāt, hrasva evāgamini sati kimiṣṭaṃ sidhyati, yatastadarto'yaṃ yatnaḥ kriyate? ityāha - `tena` ityādi| yadi hrasvāntasya tuk? syāt? tadā cicchidaturityādau tasyābhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ syāt| hrasve tvāgamini nāyamabhyāsasya haliti na bhavatyeva doṣaḥ| kathaṃ punahryasva āgamini tugabyāsagrahaṇena gṛhrate? ityāha - `nāvayavāvayavaḥ` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādavayavasya yo'vayavaḥ sa samudāyasyāvayavo na bhavati| tasmāt? hrasva evāgamini tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇena na grahaṇaṃ bhavati| nāvayavāvayavaḥ samudāyasyāvayavo bhavatītyatra caitat? sūtravihitastugityābhiprāyo veditavyaḥ| yadi hraviśeṣeṇāvayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo na syāt, evaṃ sati `śerate` ityatra ruṅāgamaḥ sāvaidhātukasyāvyavasya jhādeśasyāto'vaya iti so'pi samudāyasya sārvadhātukasyāvayavo na syāt| tataḥ <<śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ>> [[7.4.21]] iti guṇo na syāt; ruṭā sārvadhātukasya vyavahitatvāt? sa hravayava uktastameva vyavadadhyāt, sa samudāyaṃ tu na vyavadadhātyeva| tasmāt? pūrvokta evābhiprāyo vṛttikārasya veditavyaḥ| kasmāt? punaretat? satravihito'vayavāvayavaḥ samudāyasyāvayavo na bhavati? hrasvānukarṣaṇārthacakārakaraṇa sāmarthyāt| sa hi cakāro hrasvānukarṣaṇārtha evamarthaḥ kriyate - hrasvamātra āgamini tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇenāgrahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttirmā bhūditi| yadi caitatsūtravihito'pyavayavāyavaḥ samudāyāvayavaḥ syāt, tadā hrasve'pyāgamini tukastu tadavayavayasyāpyabhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttyā bhavitavyamiti cakāro hrasvānukarṣaṇārtho niṣphalaḥ syāt| tasmādayameva tugavayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo na bhavati, anyastu bhavatyeva| yuktaṃ caitat| tathā hi bāhoryo'vayavo hastaḥ sa devadattasyāpyavayavo bhavatyeva, anyathā hastāvan? devadatta iti prayogo na syāt|`iko yaṇādeśo bhavati` iti| ikāṃ yaṇāṃ ca sāmyāt? yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavatīti veditavyam| yaśca savarṇo'c? tatra dīrghavidhānasāmarthyāt? asavarṇe'ci yaṇādeśo vijñāyata iti| ika iti kim? vāgatretyatra kutvādeva siddhatvādyaṇādeśo mā bhūditi| acīti kim? dadhi karoti| `plutapūrvasya` iti| plutaḥ pūrvo yasmāt? sa plutapūrvaḥ| vaktavyaḥ=vyākhyeyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -`iko yaṇaci` ityatra tantreṇa dvau yogāvṛccāritau; tatraiko yaṇādeśārthaḥ, aparastvikaḥ plutapūrvasya savarṇadīrghabādhanārtho bhaviṣyatīti| bho yidam -bho+i+idamiti sthite `guroranṛto'nantasyāpyekaikasya prācām` [[8.2.86]] ityanena dūrāddhūte'rthe bhośabdasya plutaḥ kṛtaḥ, tataḥ savarṇadīrghatve prāpte yaṇādeśaḥ||`kayete, yayete` iti| ke+ete, ye+eta iti sthite'yādeśaḥ| `vāyāvavaruṇaddhi` iti| vāyau+avaruṇaddhīti sthita āvādeśaḥ||yīti darṇagrahaṇam, tena `yasmin? vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) iti yakārādau pratyaye kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha -`yakārādau pratyaye` iti| yadyapīha sthānī na nirdiṣṭaḥ, tathāpyāvādeśa okārasya sthāne, āvādeśo'yaukārastha sthāne bhavatīti veditavyam| katham? pūrvayoge hi yaddharmā vānta ādeśo dṛṣṭaḥ, ihāpi tadaddharmevānuvartate| kaśca pūrvayoge taddharmā dṛṣṭaḥ? avādeśasyaukārasya sthānitvam| āvādeśasyāpyaukārasya sthānitvam, ata ihāpi svadharmamajahato'nuvṛttasya vāntādeśasya pūrvaka eva sthāni vijñāyate| `bābhravyaḥ` iti| babhrūśapabdādapatye'rthe `madhūbabhvrobrrāāhṛṇakauśikayoḥ [[4.1.106]] iti yañ? `orguṇa-` [[6.4.140]] iti guṇaḥ| `māṇḍavyaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.105]] iti yañ| `śaṅkavyam` iti| śaṅkuśabdāt? `tasmai guṇaḥ| `māṇḍavyaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.105]] iti yañ| `śaṅkavyam` iti| śaṅkuśabdāt? <> [[5.1.5]] iti <> [[5.1.2]] iti yat| `nāvyaḥ` iti| nāvā taryata iti `nauvayodharmaviṣa` [[4.4.91]] ityādinā yat| `raiyati` iti| <> [[3.1.8]] iti kyac| `goyānam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `goryūto chandasi` ityādi| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -`vānto yi` iti yogavibhāgo'tri kriyate tena gośabdasya yūtau parataścandasi viṣaye'vādeśo bhavati|`adhvaparimāṇe ca` iti| `gauryūtau` iti vartate| tatrāpi vaktavyaśabdasya sa evārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi tadeva| idaṃ ca sāmānyena vacanam, tena bhāṣāyāmadhvaparimāṇe bhavati||pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam| `tannimittasya` iti| tacchabdena yakārādipratyayaḥ pratyavamṛśyate, sa nimittaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `lavyam` iti| `aco yat` [[3.1.97]] iti yat? tameva vakāramāśritya `sārvadhātukārthadhātakayoḥ` [[7.3.84]] ityokāro vidhīyamānastannimitto bhavati| `avaśyalāvyam` iti| <> [[3.1.125]] iti ṇyat, <> [[2.1.72]] iti samāsaḥ, `lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye` (kāśikā|6.1.149) iti makāralopaḥ| atrāpi ṇyatamāśritya <> [[7.2.115]] iti vidhīyamāna aukārastannimitto bhavatati| `prātipadikasaya niyamo mā bhūt` iti| asati hi dhātugrahaṇe prātipadikasyāpi niyamaḥ syāt| nanu ca prātipadikasyāpi niyama etannimittsyaiva bhavati, nātanimittasyetyarthaḥ syāta, tathā ca - pūrvasūtrasyārambho'narthakaḥ syāt, nirviṣayatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yo hi dhātoriti kimiti pṛcchati sa pūrvayogasyārambhaṃ pṛthaṅ? necchatyeva| sa hrevaṃ manyate - <> [[6.1.79]] tannimittasyaivetyeko yogaḥ kartavya iti| tatra ko doṣa iti prātipadikaniyame sati yadi kaściddoṣa āpadyeta tatastannivṛttaye kriyamāṇaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ śobhata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `bābhravya ityatraiva syāt` iti| etastannimittatvāt| `iha tu na syāt - gavyam, nāvyam` iti| atannimittatvādecaḥ| `upoyate` iti| veña eca ātve kṛta upapūrvāllaṭ, <> [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam, <> [[3.1.67]] iti yak, yajāditvāt? sasprasāraṇam, <> [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ, upākāreṇa saha <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] `auyata` iti| tasyaiva dhātorlaṅ, pūrvavadātmanepadādi, āḍajādīnām` [[6.4.72]] ityaṭ, `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ| ayamaukāraḥ pūrvaka okāraśca etadubhayamapyatannimittam, etasya mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tannimittagarhaṇam| nanu cāntaraṅgo yaṇādeśo varṇamātrāśrayatvāt, bahiraṅgastvekādeśa ubhayapadāśrayatvāt, tataśca `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) ityasiddhatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati? evaṃ tahrrotajjñāpayati - neyamiha paribhāṣopatiṣṭhata iti| tenākṣadyūrityatra bahiṅgo'pyūḍādeśo'ntaraṅge yaṇādeśe kartavye nāsiddho bhavati| anyathā yadyayamartho na jñāpyeta tadākṣairdīvyatati kvipi kṛte `cchvoḥ śuḍa - nunāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] ityūḍādeśe kṛte tasyāsiddhatvāt? yaṇādeśo na syāt| `lauyamāniḥ` iti| lūyamānasyāyatyamityarthe `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] itīñ? <> [[7.2.117]] iti vṛddhiḥ, sā ca taddhitanimittā, na tu yakārādipratyayanimittā| siddhe hi vidhirārabhyamāṇaḥ vināpyevakārakāraṇaṃ niyamārtho bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha - `evakāraḥ kim` iti| iṣṭato'vadhāraṇārthamevakārakāraṇaṃ kriyata iti darśayannāha - `dhātvavadhāraṇam` ityādi| evakāre tannimittaśabdānantaramuccāryamāṇe yata evakārakāraṇaṃ tato'nyatrāvadhāraṇārthamiti dhātvadhāraṇaṃ bhavati| asati hrevakārakāraṇe dhātereva tannimittasyeti tannimittāvadhāraṇamapyaniṣṭaṃ vijñāyeta| tasmāddhātvavadhāraṇaṃ yathā syāt, tannimittāvadhāraṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamevakārakāraṇam| kiṃ punardhātvavadhāraṇe satīṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sidhyati yatastadiṣyate? ityata āha - `tannimittsya hi` ityādi| dhātvavadhāraṇe hi sati tannimittsyāniyatatvādadhātośca bhavati bābhravya iti dhātośca bhavati - lavyam, avaśyalāvyamiti| yadi tannimittāvadhāraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt? tadā dhātoreva tannimittasyeti| tato bābhravya ityatra na syāt, na hi babhrūśabdo dhātuḥ| tasmādvātvavadhāraṇamitīṣyate||``kṣi` `ji` ityetayordhātvoḥ` iti| kṣigrahaṇena `kṣi kṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-236) `kṣi vāsagatyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1407) kṣiṣ? [`kṣīṣa hiṃsāyām` -dhātupāṭhaḥ| `kṣi hiṃsāyām` (1276) -dhātupāṭhaḥ] hiṃsāyām? (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1506) ityeṣāṃ grahaṇam, jigraṇe tu `ji jaye (dhātupāṭhaḥ-561) ityetasya| nanu ca `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|53) ityanayā paribhāṣayā `kṣiṣ? hiṃsāyām` ityasya grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ nipātanāt? bhaviṣyati| kiṃ hi nipātanānna labhyate? yathaiva hi tato'nyadalākṣikaṃ kāryaṃ kiñcidbhaviṣyati, tathedamapi syāt| arthagrahaṇaṃ karmaṇyapabi yatā syāt; anyathā śakerakarmakatvāt? bhāva eva nipātanaṃ vijñāyate -kṣayyaṃ devadatteneti| karmaṇi tu na syāt -kṣayyo vyadhiriti, na hrakarmakebhyaḥ karmaṇi kṛtyapratyaya upapadyate| arthagrahaṇena tu kṛtyārtha upalakṣyate| kṛtyāśca karmaṇyapi vihitāḥ, tena tatrāpi nipātanādvijñāyate||`krayyaḥ` iti| atra pratyayārthaśca karma vidayate; karmaṇi kṛtyavidhānāt| prakṛtyarthaśca vinimayaḥ, krīṇātervinimayārthatvāt| tatra pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam, `prakṛtipratyau pratyayārthaṃ saha brāūtaḥ` iti kṛtvā| prakṛtyarthastūpasarjanam, pratatyayārthaviśeṣaṇamiti kṛtvā| tatra yadi pradhānatvāt? tadityanena pratyārtho nirdiśyeta tadāyamarthaḥ syāt -sa krayyo'rtho yasya śabdasya sa tadarthaḥ, tasminnabhidheye ṛyya ityeṣa śabdo nipātyata iti? ayuktaścāyam; na hyatra krayyaśabdasya krayyārthaḥ kaścicchabdo'bhidheyo'sti, tatastasyāpratīteḥ| athaivaṃ vijñāyeta -sa evārthastadartha iti? evamapi tadarthagrahaṇamanarthakam| avaśyameva hi krayyaśabdo yatpratyayāntastasmin? yatpratyayārthe vartate| tasmāt? tacchabdena pradhānanirdeśe sati tadarthagrahaṇasyānarthakyam| ato guṇabhūto'pi prakṛtyartho nirdiśyata iti matvā''ha -`tadarthe krayārthaṃ yat? tasminnabhidheye` iti| tasmai idaṃ tadartham| krayārthamityanena krīṇātyarthastacchabdena nirdiśyata iti darśayati| krayaṇaṃ krayaḥ, viniyama ityarthaḥ| krayārthamityatrāpi caturthīsamāsa eva -krayāya idaṃ krayārtham| `krāyārtha yaḥ prasāritaḥ` iti| vinimayārthaṃ ya upanyasta ityarthaḥ| `kreyaṃ no dhānyam` iti| kretavyam=grahītavyam, svīkartavyamitadyarthaḥ| `na cāsti kravyam` iti| na cātra krayārthamupanyastaṃ dhānyamastītyarthaḥ|`vī ityetasya` iti| gatiprajanādiṣu yo vī paṭhate tasya, `ajevryaghañapoḥ` [[2.4.56]] ityajeryo vī ādeśastasya vā| `hyadayyā āpa upasaṃkhyānam` iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| hyadayyā hatyasya pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam -cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena hyadayyā ityapi bhaviṣyatīti||atha pūrvaparagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] ityādādādityeṣā pañcamī acītyasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; <> [[1.1.67]] iti vacanāt| tathācītyeṣā saptamyādityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; <> [[1.1.66]] iti vacanāt| tatrāntareṇāpi pūrvaparagrahaṇaṃ pūrvaparayodrvayorapi bhaviṣyati? ityāha -`pūrvaparagrahaṇam` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati pūrvaparagrahaṇe dvayorapi yugapadādeśo na sidhyati? ityata āha -`ekasyaiva hi` ityādi| evaṃ manyate -acatyeṣā saptamī yaṇādeśādividhau caritārthā; ādityeṣāṃ tu pañcamī na kvaciccaritārthā, ataḥ sā saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayet| tatrāsati pūrvaparagrahaṇe'ca eva sthāne guṇaḥ syat| <> [[6.1.88]] ityatra ca gaṇavidhāvāditi pañcamī kṛtārthe ti tasyā ecīti saptamyakṛtārthā ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayet| evaṃ ca vṛddhiravarṇasyaiva prasajyeta| <> [[6.1.91]] ityatara dvayorapi pañcamīsaptamyorakṛtārthatvāt? paryāyeṇa parasparaṃ ṣaṣṭhīparakalpaneti paryāyeṇaiva vṛddhiḥ syāt| yat? punaḥ parasyābhimataṃ pañcamī saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati, saptamyapi pañcamyāḥ, tato'ntareṇāpi parvaparagrahaṇaṃ dvyorapyādeśo bhaviṣyatīti? tannirāsāyāha -`nobhe` ityādi| nivṛttidharmā hi sthānī bhavati, śrūyamāṇasya ca ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanaṃ prati nimittabhāvaḥ| kathaṃ pūrvaparau nivarteyātām? ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanaṃ ca prati nimittabhāvamupagacchetātam? ata evānivṛtternimittabhāvasya cāsambhavānnobhe saptamīpañcamyau yugayatprakalpike bhavataḥ| tasmādekasyaiva syāt, nobhayoḥ| athaikagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `bhrasjo ropadhayo ramanyatarasyām` [[6.4.47]] ityatra vināpyekagrahaṇameka eva sambhavati, tathāpyatraikagrahaṇena vināpyeka eva bhavaṣyatītyāha -`ekam` ityādi| ramāgamena hi mitvāt? `midacontyātparaḥ` [[1.1.47]] ityaco'ntyāt? pareṇa bhavitavyam| na ca dvayo ramorbhṛjjātavaco'ntyāt? pareṇa sambhavo'sti| tato yuktaṃ tadvināpyekagrahaṇam| eka eva ram? bhavatīti guṇādistvādeśaḥ| sambhavati ca sthānibhede satyekaikasya sthānino guṇādiḥ pṛthagādeśaḥ tatrāsatyekagrahaṇe pṛthagādeśaḥ syāt| tasmāt? pūrvaparayodrvayoḥ sthāninoḥ pṛthagadeśo mā bhūdityevamarthamekagrahaṇam| asati punarekagrahama ādeśaśca dvayaṃ prāpnotītyamumarthaṃ sopapattikaṃ pratipādayitumāha -`sthānibhedāddhi` ityādi| yatā <> [[8.2.42]] iti sthānibhedāddhetorbhinnaṃ chinnamityevamādiṣu dvāvevādeśau bhavataḥ, tathā khaṭvendra ityevamādiṣvapi dvāvādeśau syātām||antādivadityukte na jñāyate - ko'syātideśasyārtha ityatastatparijñānāyāha - `yathā` ityādi| `ityeṣo'tideśasyārthaḥ` iti| itiśabdvo'tikrāntapratyavamarśī-atidiśye'nenetyatideśaḥ, sa punaḥ `antadivacca` ityeṣa eva yoga ityeṣo'nantarokto'syātideśasyārtha ityarthaḥ| `varṇāśrayavidhāvayamantādivadbhāvo neṣyate` iti| kathametajjñāyate? ityāha - `tathāhi` ityādi| `obhisa ais? [[7.1.9]] ityakāravarṇāśrayo vidhiḥ; tatra kartavye khaṭvābhirityatra savarṇadīrghatvaṃ pūrvasyānatavanna bhavati| <<āta au ṇalaḥ>> [[7.1.34]] ityākāravarṇāśrayo'yaṃ vidhiḥ| tatra kartavye varṇāśraye juhāvetyatra <> [[6.1.33]] iti hvayateḥ samprasāraṇe kṛte yat? pūrvarūpatvamākārasya tannādivadbhavakati| eṅaḥ padāntādati` [[6.1.105]] ityeṣa vidhireṅvarṇāśrayaḥ| tatra kartavye - asyai aā ityatra `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ parasyādivanna bhavati, tadabhāvādāyādeśaḥ, <> [[8.3.19]] iti yakāralopaḥ, tat? kimetadvaktavyam - varṇāśraye nāntādivaditi? na vaktavayam| katham? atādrūpyātideśāt| neha tādrūpyamatidiśyate, rūpāśrayāścaite viṣayaḥ, tenātādrūpyānna bhaviṣyanti| kimarthaṃ punarayamantādivadbhāvo vidhīyate, yāvatā pūrvaparāvuktāvekādeśasya sthāninau, atra sthānivadbhāvādeva tadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha - `pūrvaparasamudāya ekādeśasya sthānī` iti| kathaṃ jñāyate? ityāha - `sa hi` ityādi| yena hi yo nivarttyata ādeśena sa tasya sthānīti, tadyathā - <> [[2.4.52]] iti| atra bhūvo'stiḥ, samudāyaścehaikādeśena nirvarttyata iti sa eva tasya sthānī, na pūrvaparau samudāyinau| syādetat - avayavasya samudāyābhyāntaratvāt? samudāya ādeśena nivarttyamāne'vayavāvapi nivarttyete, tasmāt? tayorapi sthānitvam? ityata āha - `tatra` ityādi| itikaraṇau dvāvapi hetau| tatra samudāye sthāninyavayavayoryat? sthānitvaṃ tadānumānikam, samudāya ekādeśasya ādeśena nivarttyamāne tayorapi nivartanaṃ nāntarīyakamiti kṛtvā| na hi vināvayavanivartanena samudāyaḥ śakyate nivartayitum, tasya tadātmakatvāt| samudāyasya tu pratyakṣaṃsthānitvam| `pūrvaparayoḥ` iti sthānaṣaṣṭhantasya sākṣāc? śravaṇāt? `śrutānumitayoḥ śrautaḥ sambandho garīyān` (cāṃ|pa|pā|49) iti <<sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau>> [[1.1.56]] ityanena yasya pratyakṣaṃ sākṣāt? śrutam, sthānitvaṃ tadāśrayameva kāryamādeśe vidhīyate| avayavayoścānumānikaṃ sthānitvaṃ na pratyakṣam, atastadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ nātidiśyate| tena tadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ sthānivadbhāvādeśe na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca| tadarthamayamantāvivadbāvo vidhīyate||ihāsiddhavacanenakādeśasyābhāvo vā kriyate? tatkāryasāmarthya vā pratipādyate? siddhamapi hi vastu siddhakāryaṃ kartumasāmarthyādasiddhamityucyate, yathā - putrakāryakaraṇe'sāmarthyāt? putro'pyaputra iti| tatra yadyanenaikādeśasyābhāvaḥ kriyate tadādhītyetyatra tugna syāt, na hīha hrasvo'sti; ekādeśena nivarttitattvāt| na cāsiddhavacanenaikādeśe nivarttite hrasvasya prādurbāvo bhavati, na hi devadattasya hantari hate punardevadattasya prādurbhāvo bhavatītimamādye pakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāryasāmarthyamekādeśasyāsiddhatvaśrutyā pratyāyyata iti darśayannāha - `siddhakāryaṃ na karotītyarthaḥ` iti| siddhasya niṣpannasya yat? kāryaṃ tadekādeśaḥ siddho niṣpanno'pi na karotītyayamasya vacanasyārthaḥ| `asiddhavacanam` ityādinā sūtrasya prayojanamācaṣṭe| ādeśe ca kṛte yatkāryaṃ taddhetukaṃ prāpnoti tadādeśalakṣaṇam, ādeśo lakṣaṇaṃ nimittamasyeti kṛtvā| tasya pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthamasiddhavacanam| utasṛjyate nivarttyata ityutsargaḥ, sthānyabhidhīyate| utsargo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tadutsargalakṣaṇam, tadbhāvo yathā syādityevamarthañcāsiddhavacanam| `ko'sicat` iti| sicerluhi cliḥ, <> [[3.1.53]] iti cleraṅ, kiṃśabdāt? parasya sakārasya rutvam? <> [[6.1.113]] ityuttvam, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] iti guṇaḥ, <> [[6.1.109]] iti parapūrvatvam, `paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvāt` ityādi| asicadityatra yo'kārastaṃ pratyekādeśasya <> [[6.1.85]] ityanenādivadbhāvaḥ| ayañcāpadāditve hetuḥ| `asiddhattvānna bhavati` iti| asiddhattve hi sati sakāro'trādireva padasya bhavati, tena `sātpadadyoḥ` [[8.3.111]] iti ṣatvapratiṣedho bhavati| `ko'sya` iti| idamaḥ ṣaṣṭhaekavacanam, <> [[7.2.102]] ityatvam, `ṭāṅasiṅsāminātsyāḥ` [[7.1.12]] iti syabhāvaḥ <> [[7.2.113]] itīdrūpasya lopaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| etadādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyodāharaṇam| utsargalakṣaṇabhāvasya tu `adhītya, pretya` iti| nanu ca bahiraṅga ekādeśo dvipadāśrayatvāt; antaraṅgādeva ṣatvatukau, ekapadāśrayatvāt, tatra `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) ityanayā paribhāṣayaivātrāsiddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nirarthakamidaṃ vacanam? evaṃ tarhi saiva paribhāṣā'tra prakaraṇe ṣatvatukoniyamyate| tenākṣadyūrityatra bahiraṅgalakṣaṇo'pyūḍādeśo'ntaraṅgayaṇādeśe kartavye nāsiddho bhavati| `samprasāraṇa` ityādi| samprasāraṇe ṅau iṭi ca ya ekādeśastasyāsiddhatvaparatiṣedo vaktavyaḥ| `brāhṛhūṣu` iti| brāhṛāṇaṃ hvayatīti kvip, yajāditvāt? samprasāraṇam, <> [[6.1.108]] ti parapūrvatvam, `halaḥ` [[6.4.2]] iti dīrghaḥ| saptamībahuvacanam| `parivīṣu` iti veñaḥ paripūrvasaya pūrvavat? kvidādiṣu kṛteṣu rūpam| `apacecchatram` iti| pacerlaṅyuttamapuruṣaikavacanamiṭ, `kartari śap` [[3.1.68]] iti śapa; `ādaguṇaḥ` [[6.1.84]] iti guṇaḥ||`tavalkāraḥ; khaṭvalkāraḥ` iti| kathaṃ punaratra laparatvam? ityāha -`ḷkārasya sthāne` ityādi| etacca `ḷkāraṛkārayoḥ savarṇasajñā vaktavyā` (vā|3) ityupasaṃkhyānāt? `uraṇ? raparaḥ` [[1.1.50]] ityatra rapratyāhāragrahaṇāllabhyate| uktaṃ hrakṣarasamamnāye -`hakārādiṣu varṇoṣvakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, lakāre tvanunāsika itsaṃjñakaḥ pratijñāyate` iti| tatra rephādārabhya laṇakāreṇa pratyāhāre sati ḷkārasya ṛkāragrahaṇena gṛhītasya sthāne'ṇ? vidhīyamāno laparaḥ sampadyate||sambhave vyabhicāre ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati, tau ca sambhavavyabhicārāvetādeva dhātau staḥ, netaratretyāha -`tadetadejgrahaṇam` ityādi| `praṣṭhauhaḥ` iti| praṣṭhaṃ bahatīti <> [[3.2.63]] iti `vahaśca` [[3.2.64]] iti ṇvipratyayaḥ <> [[6.4.132]] ityūṭh? samprasāraṇasaṃjñakaḥ, <> [[6.1.108]] iti parapūrvatvam, tato vṛddhiḥ| `etyedhatyoreṅi pararūpāpavādaḥ` iti vṛddhirvidhīyata iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| atha <> [[6.1.95]] ityasyāpyāṅi pararūpāpavādo vṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati, nāprāpte hi pararūpa iyaṃ vṛddhirārabhyata iti mā yathaiṅi pararūpaṃ bādhate tathāṅi pararūpamapi bādheta, tataścehāpi syāt -ā+itaḥ=etaḥ, upa+etaḥ=upetaḥ? ityata āha -`omāṅoścetyetat` ityādi| atraiva kāraṇamāha -`yena nāprāpte yo vidhirārabhyate sa tasya bādhako bhavati` (iti)| nāprapta eṅi pararūpe iyaṃ vṛddhirārabhyata iti yuktaṃ yat? tasya bādhikā bhavati| āṅi pararūpe tu prāpte cāprāpte caiṣā vṛddhirārabhyate| ā+itaḥ=etaḥ, pra+etaḥ=pretaḥ, paretaḥ ityatra prāpta āṅi pararūpe tu prāpte cāprāpte caiṣā vṛddhirārabhyate| ā+itaḥ=etaḥ, pra+etaḥ=pretaḥ, paretaḥ ityatra prāpta āṅi pararūpe upa+eti=upaitīti -atra tvaprāpte| tasmādeṣā vṛddhirāṅi pararūpatvaṃ na bādhate| `purastādapavādāḥ` ityādinā parīhārāntaramāha -`purastādapavādā anantarān?
