vidhīn? bādhante nottarān` (vyā|pa|9) iti, iyaṃ ca vṛddhiḥ purastādapavādaḥ, asyāścaihi pararūpamevānantaram, atastadeva tayā bādhyate, nāṅi pararūpam, tasyāntaratvāt| `akṣāt` ityādi| `vaktavyā` iti| vyākhyeyetyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -uttarasūtre cakāro'dhikavidhānārthaḥ| tenākṣaśabdādūhinīśabde parato vṛddhirbhaviṣyatīti| evamuttaratrāpi vaktavyaśabdasyārthaḥ, vyākhyānamapyevameva veditavyam| akṣāṇāmūhaḥ, so'syāstīti matvarthīyaḥ iniḥ| `ṛnnebyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp -`akṣauhiṇo`|`svairam` iti| `īra gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1018) īraṇamīraḥ, bhāve ghañ? svasya īraḥ svairaḥ| kriyaviśeṣaṇatvāt? svairamiti vṛttau napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ| kriyā tu kācidatrādhyāhartavyā| atha vā sva īro yasya kulasya tat? svairaṃ kulam| napuṃsakasya kulāderanyapadārthatvānnapuṃsakaliṅgatvam| `svairī` [svairiṇī -kāśikā] iti| svamīrituṃ śīlamasyeti <> [[3.2.78]] iti ṇiniḥ| ūḍha, ūḍhiriti śabdau niṣṭhāktinnantau| `praiṣaḥ` iti| `iṣa gatirahisādāneṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1127) `iṣu icchāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1351) iti vā, abhyāṃ prapūrvābhyāṃ yadā ghañ? tadā praiṣaḥ, yadā tu ṇyat? tadā praiṣya iti| `sukhārttaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsaḥ||`ekṣata` iti| `īkṣa darśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-610) iti laṅ| `aikṣiṣṭa` iti| luṅ| `aikṣiṣyata` iti| lṛṅ| `aumbhīt` iti| `ubha umbha pūraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1319,1320) iti luṅ, iṭ, astisico'yukte` [[7.3.96]] itīṭ| `īṭi` [[8.2.28]] iti sico lopaḥ| `aubjīt` iti| `ubja ārjave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1303)| `ādhrnot` iti| `ṛṣu vṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1271) iti laṅ, <> [[3.1.73]] iti śnuḥ| `cakāro'dhikavidhānārthaḥ` iti| na tu vṛddheranukarṣaṇārthaḥ; tadanuvṛtteḥ svaritatvādeva siddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| adhikavidhānārtha ityasyārthaṃ vākyāntareṇa trispaṣṭīkarttumāha - `usyomāṅośceti pararūpabādhanārthaḥ` iti| usiomi āṅi ca yat? pararūpaṃ prāpnoti tadbādhanārtha ityarthaḥ| cakārema hi dvirvṛddhividhānaṃ vijñāpayati| tatra yaddvitīyaṃ vidhānaṃ tad? bādhakabādhanārthaṃ bhavati| tena <> [[6.1.96]] iti yatpararūpaṃ prāpnoti, yacca <> [[6.1.95]] iti tadapi bādhitvā vṛddhireva bhavati| `auruāīyat` `auṅkārīyat` iti| uruāśabdādoṅkāraśabdācca <> [[3.1.8]] , <> [[7.4.33]] itīttvam, kyajantālluṅ, āṭ? <> [[6.1.96]] iti pararūpe bādhake prāpte cakārasyādhikavidhānārthatvādvṛddhireva bhavati| `auḍhīyat` iti| oḍhāśabdāt? kyajantalluṅ, āḍāgame kṛte <> [[6.1.95]] iti pararūpe bādhake prāpte cakārasyādhikavidhānārthatvādvṛddhireva bhavati||`upācrchati` iti| `ṛccha gatandriyapralayamūrtibhāveṣu` (dhā|pa|1296) `pragatā ṛcchakā asmāddeśāt? pracchako deśaḥ` iti| atra `yaṃ prati kriyāyuktā prādayastaṃ prata gatyapasargasaṃjñakā bhavanti` iti gamiṃ prati praśabdo gatyupasargasaṃjñakaḥ, na ṛcchatiṃ paratīti bhavati pratyudāharaṇamidam| `vā supyāpiśaleriti vikalpaḥ syat` iti| etenottarārthatāṃ taparakaraṇasya darśayati| atha dhātagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvata sambandhiśabdā hi niyataṃ pratyayoginamupasthāpayanti, tadyathā -putrādaśabdāḥ, upasargaścāyaṃ dhātvapekṣatvāt? sambandhiśabdaḥ tatropasargagrahaṇādeva dhātugrahaṇaṃ sidhyati? ata āha -`upasargagrahaṇādeva` ityādi| yadi dhātugrahaṇaṃ na krayeta, tadā parācrchatītyatra `ṛtyakaḥ` [[6.1.128]] iti paratvāt? śākalyasya matena parakṛtavadbhāvaḥ lyāt| tasmāt tasya śākalyasya prakṛtivadbhāvasya nivṛttyarthaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ kriyate| kathaṃ punaḥ kriyamāṇe dhātagrahaṇe śākalyasya prakṛtavadbhāvanivṛttirlabhyate? yogavibhāgakāraṇāt| sati hi dhātugrahaṇe yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate -upasargāvṛtti vṛddhirbhavatīti; tato dhātāviti, ihopasargāditi vartate| tato dvitīyo yogo bādhakabādhanārtho vijñāyate| atha <> [[5.1.118]] ityatra yathā prādyupalakṣaṇārthamupasargagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, tathehāpi kasmānna vijñāyeta? aśakyatvāt| `upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe` ityatra hi dhātorupasthānaṃ na sambhavatīti yuktaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇārthamupasargagrahaṇam| iha hi dhātorupasthānaṃ sambhavatītyayuktam||dhātāvityanuvartate, supīti cocyate, na ca subanto dhāturasti, tatra samathryāddhātvekadeśe vartamānaṃ supatyetadiha viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha -`subantāvayave dhātau` ityādi| `upālkārīyati` iti| kathaṃ punarṛtītayucyamāne lukāre vṛddhiḥ pravartate? ityāha -`ṛkāraḷkārayoḥ` ityādi| ṛkāraḷkārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñā vihiteti ṛkāro gṛhramāṇa ḷkāramapi grāhayatīti tatrāpi vṛddhirbhavati| `āpiśaligrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham` iti| atha vikalpārthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `vetyucyata eva` iti| yadyapyācāryagrahaṇenaiva pūjā, vikalpaścobhayaṃ sampadyate; tathāpyācāryagrahaṇasya prādhānyena pūjāṃ khyāpayituṃ vāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ||`gāmpaśya` iti| kathaṃ punaretadudahmatam, yāvatā `goto ṇit` [[7.1.90]] iti ṇittve sati paratvāt? vṛddhyātra bhavitavyam? ityata āha -`dyośabdo'pyokārāntaḥ` ityādi| taparakaraṇaṃ hi varṇanirdeśeṣu prasiddhamiti `gotaḥ` iti taparanirdeśa okārāntopalakṣamārtho vijñāyate, tataśca dyośabdādapi paraṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ ṇidvadbhavati| yadyevam, tat? kimiti vṛddharnātra bhavati? ityāha -`tena` ityādi| yadi dyośabdāt? parasya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇittvaṃ na syāt, tato dyāṃ paśyetyatra sāvakāśamātvaṃ gāṃ paśyetyatra paratvādvṛddhyā bādhyeta| yadi tu dyośabdādapi paraṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ ṇidbhavatīti, tadā dyāṃ paśyetyatra vṛddhiḥ prāpnotyeva| tato nāprāptāyāṃ vṛddhāvidamātvaṃ vidhīyamānamanavakāśatvādvṛdiṃdha bādhate| tataśca yukatameva gāṃ paśyetyetadudāharaṇam| athehāpyacinavam, asunavamityatra cinoteḥ sunoteśca laṅi mipi vikaraṇasya guṇe kṛte mipaḥ `tasthasthamipām` [[3.4.101]] ityādināmbhāve caukārasyātvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`ami` ityādi| śasā sāhacaryāt? subadhikārādvā supa evāma idaṃ grahaṇam| ato nātrātvasya prasaṅgaḥ| citraguṃ paśyetyatra tu hrasvatve kṛta okārābhāvāt? <<sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau>> [[1.1.56]] iti sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhādātvaṃ na bhavati||`upelayati` iti| `ila preraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1660) curādiṇic| `prokhatīti| `ukha nakha` (dhā| pā| 128,134) ityukhirgatyartho bhyādau paṭhate| yadi `vā supi` [[6.1.89]] ityanuvartayanti, evaṃ sati tena sahāsyaikavākyatāyāṃ subadhātorevānena vikalpena pararūpaṃ kriyate, asupi tu pararūpaṃ na syādevetyāha - `tacca` ityādi| ekavākyatve hi satyeṣa doṣaḥ syāt| na cātraikavākyatā, kiṃ tarhi? vākyabhedaḥ| tena tadihānuvartamānaṃ subdhātāveva vikalpaṃ karoti, itaratara tu nityameva pararūpaṃ pravartate| tatrāvarṇāntādupasargādasubantāvayave dhātāveṅādau pūrvaparayoḥ pararūpamekādeśo bhavatītyekaṃ vākyam, avarṇāntādupasargāt? subantāvayave dhātāveṅādau pūrvaparamorvā pararūpamekādeśo bhavatīti dvitīyam| tatra pūrveṇa vākyenāsubantāvayave dhātāvupelayatatyādau nityaṃ pararūpaṃ didhīyate| dvitīyena tu subantāvayave dhātāvupeṅakīyatītyevamādau vikalpena pararūpaṃ vidhīyate| vākyabhedastu `eṅi pararūpam` iti tantreṇa sūtradvayoccāraṇāllabhyate| sūtradvaye tūccāryamāṇe satyeka eva <> [[6.1.92]] ityedanuvartamānamapi labhyānurodhānnābhisambadhyate, dvitīye tu sambadhyata eva| tena vākyadvayaṃ pūrvoktaṃ sampadyate| `vaktavyam` iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānām - uttarasūtre cakāro'dhikavidhānārthaḥ, tena śakandhvādiṣu pararūpaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| uttaratrāpa vaktavyaśabdasyāyamartho vyākhyānaṃ caitadadeva veditavyam| `eve cāniyoge` iti| niyogaḥ=niyojanam, vyāpāraṇamityarthaḥ| na niyogo'niyogaḥ=anavakḷptiḥ| tatraivaśabde pararūpaṃ veditavyam| evaśabdo'niyame vartate| yadā tameva kevalaṃ niyamaṃ vyāpāreṇāviśiṣṭaṃ brūte tadā pararūpaṃ bhavati| yadā tu vyāpārema viśiṣṭaṃ tadā vṛddhireva| `bimboṣṭhī` iti| `nāsikodarauṣṭha` [[4.1.55]] iti ṅīṣ| `tiṣṭha devadattauṣṭhaṃ paśya` iti vākyametat? na tu samāsaḥ| devadattaśabdāt? <> [[6.1.69]] iti sorlopaḥ||`adyoḍhā` iti| adya+oḍhā| nanu ca `ādaguṇaḥ` [[6.1.87]] ityanenāṅo nivarttitatvādidamāṅa udāharaṇaṃ yujyate? āṅmāṅorekādeśastvāṅgrahaṇena guhrata ityadoṣaḥ| pūrvameva hīdamuktam -`dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭayoḥ sthāne yo bhavati labhate'sāvanyataravyapadeśam` iti| kimarthaṃ punarāṅo grahaṇam, yāvatā prāgevāṅaḥ pūrvema saha <> [[6.1.101]] iti dīrghatve kṛte tataḥ pareṇa saha <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] iti guṇe cādyoḍhetyādi siddhameva? na sidhyati, yataḥ `dhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgam` (vyā|vṛ|37) iti pūrvamādguṇena bhavitavyam, tathā ca sati vṛddhiḥ syāt| ata āṅo'pi grahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `iha tvakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ bādhyate` iti| asya vidheraviśeṣavihitatvāt, akaḥ savaraṇe dīrghasya ca sāmānyavihitatvāt| viśeṣavihito'pi sāmānyavihitasya bādhako bhavatīti pratipāditametat||`bhindyuḥ` iti| bhiderliṅ, jhi, yāsuṭ? <> [[3.4.108]] iti jus, śnam, <<śnasorallopaḥ>> [[6.4.111]] ityakāralopaḥ, `liṅaḥ salopo'nantayasya` [[7.2.79]] iti sakāralopaḥ, bhindyā+usiti sthite'nena pararūpatvam| `aduḥ` iti| dadāterluṅ, jhi, `ātaḥ` [[3.4.110]] iti jherjas, `gātisthāṭa [[2.4.77]] iti sico luk, adā+usiti sthite'nena pararūpatvam| `koruāā, koṣitā` iti| nanu cātraikasmin? pratyudāharaṇe `arthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya` (vyā|pa|1) ityanayā paribhāṣayaiva na bhaviṣyati, uruāāśabdo hi samudāyo'rthavān, na tūsityeṣa tadavayavaḥ| dvitīye tu `lakṣaṇapratapadoktayoḥ pratapadokatasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na tu lākṣaṇikasya` (vyā|pa|3) ityanayā paribhāṣayā'pi na bhaviṣyati, lākṣaṇiko hi tatros? tathā hi vaserniṣṭhāyāṃ <> [[7.2.52]] yajāditvāt? samprasāraṇe kṛte -uṣiteti, tatra pararūpaṃ na sampadyate, tat? kimapadāntādityanena? evaṃ tahrretadatiricyamānamapadāntagrahamamarthavadanarthavattvādikaṃ viśeṣamanapekṣyosmātre pararūpaṃ bhavatītyamumarthaṃ dyotayati| tena nānarthake `usyapadāntāt` ityetadbhavati| bhindyurityatra hi yāsuḍādiḥ samudāyo'rthavān, na tu tadavayava us| lākṣaṇike'pi bhavatīti -babhuṣaḥ paśyeti| `bhā dīptau`, (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1051) liṭaḥ kvasuḥ; śas, <> [[6.4.131]] iti samprasāraṇam; <> [[6.1.108]] iti pūrvarūpam, babhā usa as? iti sthite'nena pararūpatvam| etat? sārvadhātukapakṣa udāharaṇaṃ veditavyam| ardhadhātukapakṣe hrakāralopenaiva siddham| sānubandhake'pi bhavati -adhura#iti| kva tarhi syāt? babhūriti| nanu cānarthakye satyapadāntagrahaṇasyāyamarthaḥ parikalpyeta, asti cāsyoktasūtre prayojanam, kiṃ tat? apadāntādyathā syādiha mā bhūditi -daṇḍāgramiti? naitadasti; yadyetadeva prayojanamabhimataṃ syāt, tadottarasūtra evedaṃ kuryāt| iha karaṇāttu yathoktārthapratipādanaparataiva tasyāvagamyate| adhikārāccottarārthatāpi bhavatyeva| koṣitetyatra `vasatikṣūdhoḥ` [[7.2.52]] itīṭ, `śāsavasighasīnāṃ ca` [[8.3.60]] iti ṣatvam, tasya cāsiddhatvāt? pararūpatvaprāptirveditavyā| `caṛḥ` iti| kṛtro liṭausi rūpam| `abibhayuḥ` iti| `ñibhī bhaye` (dhā|pa|1084) laṅ, śap, <> [[2.4.75]] iti śluḥ, dvirvacanam, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] iti jherjus? `jusi ca` [[7.3.83]] iti guṇaḥ||`pace, yaje`- ityatra <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, tena tasyā eva pararūpatvamapabāda ityabhiprāyaḥ| `ādgumaḥ` [[6.1.84]] ityata ādityanuvartata eveti manyamāna āha - `ata iti kim` iti| dīrghanivṛtyartha iha taparasyākārasya nirdeśaḥ kriyata iti darśayitumāha - `yānti, vānti` iti| `apace` iti| laṅyātmanepadottamapuruṣaikavacana iṭ, atara <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | pararūpe tu sati sa guṇo na labhyate||prathamaśabdo'yaṃ sanniveśaviśeṣāpekṣe'bhidheye vartate| pareṣvabhisamīkṣiteṣu yasmātpūrvo nāsti sa prathamaśabdābhidheyaḥ| iha ca `prathamayoḥ` iti sāmānyena nirdeśānna jñāyate - kayoḥ prathamayorivaṃ grahaṇamityatastatparijñānāyāha - `prathamāśabdaḥ` ityādi| prathamaśabdo'yamiha śāstre vibhaktiviśeṣa rūḍhaḥ, supāṃ yadādyaṃ trikaṃ tatra prasiddhaḥ| tathā hi - `sapūrvayoḥ prathamayorvibhāṣā` [[8.1.26]] , `saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyaḥ` [[5.3.27]] ityevamādiṣu nirdeśeṣu prathamāśabdena sa eva vibhaktiviśeṣo nirdiṣṭaḥ| tasmādrūḍhiśabdatvādiha prathamāśabdo vibhaktiviśeṣe vartata iti vijñāyate| nanu ca strīliṅgo yaḥ prathamāśabdaḥ sa iha śāstre vibhaktiviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ, asya ca strīliṅgataiva sandigdhā? naitadasti; prathamaśabdopādānādeva strīliṅgo'yamupātta ityavasīyate| yadi hi puṃlliṅgasyedamupādānaṃ syādeyaṃ sati pratyayagrahaṇeva syāt| yadi ca pratyayagrahaṇamabhīṣṭaṃ syāt? tadaujasorityevaṃ brāūyāt| na caivamucyamāne dvitīyāsambandhino'pyaukārasya grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ; iha jasā sāhacaryāt? prathamāsambandhina evaukārasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāsyate| tasmāt? strīliṅgasyedaṃ grahamamityasandigdhametat| nanu ca yadi prathamāśabdo'yamiha śāstre vibhaktiviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ, evaṃ sati vibhaktiviśeṣa eka ityekavacanenaiva bhavitavyam, tat? kathaṃ prathamayoriti dvivacanam? ityata āha - `tatsāhacaryāt` ityādi| tena prathamākhyena vibhaktiviśeṣeṇa sāhacaryāddvitīyāpi vibhaktiḥ prathametyuktā, tataśca dvitvāddvivacanameva nyāyyam| tadetena prathamayoriti vibhaktyoridaṃ garahaṇaṃ na pratadyayayoriti darśayati| `vṛkṣāḥ `lakṣāḥ` iti| kathamidamudāhṛtam? yāvatā <> [[6.1.97]] ityanena pararūpeṇātra bhavitavyam? taddhi nāprāpate vabhaktyantara ārabhyamāṇaṃ yathā'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ bādhate, tathā `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ` iti dīrghatvamapi bādheta? ityata āha - `ato guṇe` ityādi| atraivopapattimāha - `purastāt` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt? `purastādapavādā anantarān? vidhīn? bādhante nottarān` (vyā|pa|9) iti tasmāt? <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpam? <> [[6.1.101]] dīrghatvaṃ bādhate; tasyaiva tadanantaratvāt| `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarmaḥ` iti dīrghatvaṃ tu na bādhyate; viparyayāt| `agnī ityatra` ityādi| asati pūrvagarahaṇe agnī itayatra parvaparasamudayaḥ sthānī, tasya cāntaratamo dīrgha ādeśo nāstītyavayavāntaratamo yastena bhavitavyam| avayavau cātra dvau - pūrvaḥ, paraśceti; tatra ca pūrvasyaiva bhavitavyamiti niyamo na labhyate, niyamakaraṇābhāvāditi tayoḥ paryāyeṇa bhavannādeśaḥ pakṣe parasavarṇo vā syāt| atastannivṛtyarthaṃ pūrvagrahaṇam| savarṇagrahaṇaṃ tu vipratiṣedhanirāsārtham| asati hi tasmin? dīrgha ityanuvartamāne'gnī ityatra vipratiṣiddhitvamāpadyeta yadi pūrvo na dīrghaḥ; atha dīrgho na pūrvaḥ| yadi pūrvo na dīrghaḥ; atha dīrgho na pūrvaḥ| yadi ca pūrvaśabdena pūrvākṛtirucyet, dīrghādanuvṛtteḥ pūrvasyeti ṣaṣṭhī vā kriyeta| tathā ca savarṇagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartam| kriyamāṇaṃ vā tat? sukhapratipatyartha veditavyam| `dīrghagrahaṇaṃ trimātre sthānini` ityādi| agni au+iti sthite, asati dīrghagrahaṇa ekādeśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ sthānina āntaratamyāt? trimātraḥ prāpnoti; sthāninastrimātrakatvāt| tathā hi - agniśabdasyekāra ekamātraḥ aukāro dvimātra ityetatsamudāyātmakaścātra sthānī| tasmāt? trimātre sthāninyantaratamastrimātra ādeśo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ dīrghagrahaṇam| dīrghagrahaṇe hi sati tenādeśe viśiṣyamāṇe trimātrasyādeśaprasaṅgo na bhavati; dvimātrasyaiva dīrghasaṃjñāvidhānāt||`tasmāt? pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt` iti| etena tasmādityanenāntaraḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrgho nirdiṣṭa iti darśayati| `śaso'vayavasya sakārasya` iti| anena śasa iti sakārāvayavāpekṣayāvayavaṣaṣṭhīti puṃsīti pratyayārthasyedaṃ vā viśeṣaṇam -`puṃsāṃ [puṃsi -mu| pāṭhaḥ] cedbahutve śasutpanna iti| prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ vā -puṃśabdāccet? paraḥ śasiti| tatra yadā pratyayārthasya viśeṣamaṃ tavā `sarva ete` ityāderayaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ -vṛkṣān, agnīnityādikaṃ yuktamudāharaṇam; pusāṃ bahutve'tra śasa utpannatvāt| ṣaṇḍakān? paṇḍakāniti -etadudāharaṇadvayamayuktam, na hratara puṃsāṃ bahatve śas? utpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? napuṃsakānāmityata āha -`sarva ete` ityādi| sarvagrahaṇena na kevalaṃ vṛkṣādayaḥ śabdā puṃlliṅgena sāmānyaviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭaṃ svārthaṃ pratipādayanti, api tu ṣaṇḍakapaṇḍakaśabdāvapīti darśayati| svārthaḥ panareṣā puṃstvena sāmānyaviśeṣeṇāvacchinnaṃ vṛkṣādikaṃ dravyam| tadevaṃ yataḥ sarva ete puṃlliṅgaviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyinaḥ, tenaitebhya utpadyamānaḥ śas? puṃsāmeva bahutve utpadyata iti pūrvapakṣo nirākṛto bhavati| yadā tu prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ tadāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ -vṛkṣānityādikamityudāharaṇamupapadyate, tatra hi puṃśabdāt? paraḥ śas? bhavati; sthūrān, ararakāniti idamudāharaṇadvayaṃ nopapadyate; tathā hi sthūrāyā apatyāni ararakāyā apatyānīti <> [[4.1.105]] iti yañ, <> [[2.4.64]] iti luki kṛte strīpratyayasyāpi `luk? taddhitalaki` [[1.2.49]] iti luk -sthūra, araraka, ityetābhyāṃ strīśabdābhyāmutpanno'tri śas? strīśabdābhyāṃ paro bhavati, na napuṃsakaśabdābhyām? ityata āha -`sarva ete` ityādi| prakṛtireva hyatra taddhitalugantā pratyayārthe vartate, sa ca pratyayārthaḥ, puṃlliṅgena viśiṣṭaḥ| tasmānna kevalaṃ vṛkṣādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃlliṅgena viśiṣṭaṃ vṛkṣādikaṃ svārthaṃ pratipādayanti, api tu sthūrārarakaśabdāvapīti pūrvapakṣaḥ pratikṣipto bhavati| ayaṃ tarhi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe doṣaḥ -cañceva cañcā pumāṃsa iti| <> [[5.3.96]] kan? <> [[5.3.98]] iti lup; yadā lubantāccañcāśabdāt? pusāṃ bahutve śas? utpadyate tadā cañcāḥ paśyetyatra natvaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āha -`iha tu` ityādi| naiva hyatra puṃbahutve śas? utpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? strībahutve; puṃso'pi yuktatadbhāvena strītvātideśāt| tato'tra natvaṃ na bhavati| dīrghagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtam, tasya cehārthavaśena pañcamyantasyopasthāne satyantareṇāpi tasmādityetadvavacanaṃ dīrghādevottarasya śaso natvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha -`iha tu` ityādi| naiva hyatra puṃbahutve śas? utpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? strībahutve; puṃso'pi yuktavadbhāvena strītvātideśāt| tato'tra natvaṃ na bhavati| dīrghagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtam, tasya cehārthavaśena pañcamyantasyopasathāne satyantareṇāpi tasmādityetadvavacanaṃ dīrghādevottarasya śaso natvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha -`tasmāditi kim` iti| `etān? gāścarataḥ paśca` iti| <<auto'mśasoḥ>> [[6.1.93]] ityātvam| yadyanantaradīrghapratyavamarśī tacchabdenopādīyeta, tadā'viśeṣeṇa dīrghamātrānnatvaṃ vidhīyamānam -etān? gāścarataḥ paśyetyatrāpi syāt, bhavati hrayamākāro dīrghaḥ| tasmāt? tacchabde tu na doṣaḥ; na hrayamananatarasūtravihita ākāraḥ||`khaṭve` iti| `auṅa āpaḥ` [[7.1.18]] iti śībhāvaḥ| `kuṇḍe` iti| atrāpi <> [[7.1.19]] iti, tatra kṛte <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] iti guṇaḥ||`āt` iti nānuvartate, tenā'yaṃ dīrghāmātrāt? pūrvasavarṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ| atha khaṭvā ityatra kathaṃ <> [[6.1.102]] iti dīrghatvam? dīrghāditi vacanaṃ spaṣṭārtham| nanu cāsati tasmin? vṛkṣā ityatrāpi syāt? naitadasti; yadi hyatrāpi syāt, tadā pūrvasatre `ici` ityetadapārthakaṃ syāt| iha tarhi syāt -agnaye iti? iṣṭatvādadoṣaḥ| atra hi paratvāt? `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] iti guṇa eva bhavati| uttarārtha tarhi syāt -<> [[6.1.106]] iti dīrghādyathā syāt? naitadasti; vāgrahaṇasya tatra vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt -dīrghādeva bhaviṣyati na hrasvāt| `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] ityetadapi spaṣṭārthameva| nanu cāsati `jasi ca` ityetasmin? yuvatīḥ paśya, paddhatīḥ paśyetyādau śasyapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt? jñāpakānna bhaviṣyati, yadayaṃ <> [[6.1.103]] iti puṃgrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati -śasi pratiṣedho na bhavatīti| taddhi napuṃsake pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvāsambhavāt? strīnivṛttyarthameva kriyate| yadi ca stiriyāmapyayaṃ yuvatīḥ paśyetyādau pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tadā pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvābhāvānnatvasya pratiptireva nāstīti kiṃ puṃgrahaṇena? uttarārthaṃ tarhi jasgrahaṇam? naitadasti; vāgrahaṇasya tatra vyavasthitavibhāṣātvavijñānādeva jaso'nyatra na bhaviṣyati||`mārutīḥ` iti| maruddevatā āsāmiti <> [[4.2.24]] ityaṇ? `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp; savarṇadīrghatvam| `vārāhīḥ` [vārāhī - kāśikā padamaṃjarī ca] iti| varāhasya vikāra ti <> [[4.3.135]] ityaṇ, pūrvavanṅīp| `upānahī` iti| <<ṣidgaurādibhyaśca>> [[4.1.41]] iti ṅīṣ||pūrvasavarṇadīrghatve prāpte vacanamidam| dīrgha iti cehānuvartate, anyathā hīdaṃ vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā prakṛtaṃ yat? pūrvaṃgrahaṇaṃ tadevehānuvarttiṣyata iti? ata āha -`pūrvagrahaṇam` ityādi| yathājātīyakaḥ pūrvastathājātīyaka eva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ pūrvagrahaṇam| evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayitumāha -`pūrvasavarṇāntaratamo mā bhūt` iti| pūrvasavarṇaścāsāvantaratamaśceti karmadhārayaḥ| asati hi pūrvagrahaṇe yat? pūrvakaṃ pūrvagrahaṇaṃ tenaivānuvarttitavyam, tasmiścānuvartamāne tatasambaddhaṃ savraṇagrahaṇapi anuvarteta, tathā ca <<sthāne'ntaratamaḥ>> [[1.1.50]] ityanayā paribhāṣayā pūrvasya yaḥ savarṇaḥ sa eva parasajyeta| kiṃ punarevaṃ satyaniṣṭaṃ syāt, vṛkṣamityādau dvimātrasya sthānino dvimātra eva syāditi cet? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt, <> [[6.1.102]] ityanena siddhatvādityata āha -`kumārimityatra hi` ityādi| kumārīśabdasyekāro dvimātraḥ, amo'kāro mātrikaḥ; tatsamudāyātmakaścātra sthānī, tatra pūrvasavarṇo vidhīyamānastrimātralasya sthānino'ntaratamastrimātra eva syāt, pūrvagrahaṇe tu sati yathājātīyaka eva pūrvaḥ, tathājātīyaka eva dvimātro bhavati| `vā chandasītyeva` ityādi| yadi tarahi <> [[6.1.106]] ityanuvartate, tena sahāsyaikavākyatāyāṃ bhāṣāyāṃ parapūrvatvaṃ na sidhyati? naitadasti; yasmāt? tadihānuvartamānaṃ pūrvavadvākyabhedena cchandasyeva vikalpaṃ karoti, na bhāṣāyām||samprasāraṇasya yaṇādeśo mā bhūdityevamarthamidaṃ parapūrvatvaṃ vidhīyate| yadi cātra yaṇādeśaḥ syāt, tadā saṃprasāraṇavidhānāmanarthakaṃ syāt? tasmāt| samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyādeva yaṇādeśo na bhaviṣyati, tat? kimarthamidaṃ vidhīyate? ityāha -`sabhprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyāt` ityādi| samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyādyaṇādeśo na bhavatīti vigṛhītasyākṛtasaṃhitākāryasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti parapūrvatvaṃ vidhīyate| `vā cchandasītyeva` ityādi| atrāpi pūrvavadvākyabhedo draṣṭavyaḥ; anyathā bhāṣāyāṃ na syāt| `yajyamānaḥ` [yajyamānau -kāśikā] iti| parapūrvatvābhāvapakṣe yaṇādeśaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra yaṇādeśaḥ, yāvatā vigṛhītasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam, idānīmeva hruktam -samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyādvigṛhītasyaiva śravaṇe prāpte parapūrvatvaṃ vidhīyate? ityata āha -parapūrvatvavidhāne` ityādi| anārabdhe hi parapūrvatve vigṛhītasyaiva śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, mā bhūt? samprasāraṇasya vaiyyathryamiti kṛtvā| sati tu parapūrvatve yatra parapūrvatvam -iṣṭamityādau, tatrārthavat? samprasāraṇam| ataḥ parapūrvatvābhāvapakṣe yaṇādeśo bhavatyeva| atheha kasmānna bhavati -śakahvau śakahvarthamiti; atra hi śakaṃ hvayatīti kvip, yajāditvāt? samprasāraṇam, parapūrvatvam, tasya `agtādivacca` [[6.1.85]] iti samprasāraṇagrahaṇena grahaṇāt? samprasāraṇāsamprasāraṇayorekādeśasya samprasāraṇasya vyapadeśabhāvatvāt, aukāre'rthaśabde ca parato vyavasthite <> [[6.1.108]] iti parapūrvatvaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āha -`antaraṅge cāci` ityādi| yo'yaṃ hvayaterecaḥ sthāne vihita ākāraḥ sa samprasāraṇasyāntaraṅgaḥ pratyāsannaḥ; ubhayorapyekadhātvantargatatvāt| aukāro'rthaśabdākāraśca viprakṛṣṭaḥ| viprakṛṣṭastu deśataḥ kālataśca, yadāha -`brāāhre` iti| yasya dhātoḥ samprasāraṇamavayavaḥ, tatrānantarbhāvādbāhraḥ| kālataśca, yadāha -`paścāt? sannipatite` iti| pūrvarūpavidhānakālādutarakālaṃ sannihita ityarthaḥ| tatra sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭayoracoḥ pratyāsatterantaraṅgo yo'c? tatredaṃ vacanaṃ pravartate, tatara caritārthamiti viprakṛṣṭa aukārādau paścāt? sannihate na bhavati||`agne'tra` iti| <> [[7.3.106]] iti guṇaḥ||`eṅa uttarayoḥ` ityādi| eṅa uttarau yau ṅasiṅasau tayoḥ sambandhyavayavo yo't? tasmin? parata ityarthaḥ| `agnerāgacchati` iti| `gheṅiti` [[7.3.111]] iti guṇaḥ| atha kasmādatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati, eṅāvapi hi dvau, ṅasiṅsāvapi dvāveveti prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, na hyatra ṅasiṅasoḥ parataḥ kāryaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? tatsambandhina iti, sa caika eva| athāpi sambandhibhedena bhedaḥ syāt? evamapyadoṣaḥ, cakāro'tra samuccāyarthaḥ kriyate| evaṃ ca samuccayo bhavati yadyakaikasyaiṅo ṅasiṅasoḥ pratyekamapi parataḥ parapūrvatvaṃ bhavati; nānyathā| <<īdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ>> [[6.3.27]] , <> [[3.1.125]] iti ca nirdeśastadabhāvaṃ jñāpayati| lakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnena vā| alpāctarasya ṅasaḥ paranipātena yathāsaṃkhyābhāvo'vasīyate||`dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭayoḥ sthāne` ityādi| kiṃ punarhoturityādāvaniṣṭaṃ syādyadi raparatvaṃ na kriyeta? na kiñcit; nyāyatastu prāpnoti raparatvamapi, tadavaśyaṃ kartavyam| tameva nyāyaṃ nyāṃ darśayitum -`dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭayoḥ sthāne` ityuktam| ṛta iti tapakaraṇaṃ dirghanivṛttyartham| tena `unyorgraḥ` [[3.3.29]] <<pre stro'yajñe>> [[3.3.32]] ityādau na bhavati| udityetadapi taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyarthameva, āntaratamyāddvimātrasya sthāne dvimātra eva prāpnoti| nanu ca `bhāvyamano'ṇ? savarṇān? na gṛhṇāti`(vyā|pa|35) iti savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti tat? kimetannivṛtyarthena taparakaraṇena? evaṃ tahrretajjñāpayati -bhavatyatra hrukarema bhāvyamānena savarṇasya grahaṇamiti| tenāmū, amūbhyāmityatra <<adaso'serdādu do maḥ>> [[8.2.80]] iti dīrghasya sthāne dīrgha ūkāro bhavati||`khyatyāditi khiśabdakhīśabdayostiśabdatīśabdayośca kṛtayaṇādeśayoridaṃ grahaṇam` iti| yamādeśe kṛte tulyaṃ rūpamiti viśeṣābhāvāt| atha kasmādatrākārāntayoreva khyaśabdatyaśabdayoridaṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati? kevalasya khyaśabdasya tyaśabdasyāsambhavāditi cet? na; yadi kevalau na staḥ, tadantānāṃ tarhi mukhyagosaṃkhyādīnāmapatya gārhapatyādīnāñca grahaṇamastu? naitadasti; evaṃ hi -<> [[7.1.92]] , <> [[4.1.33]] iti nirdeśau nopapadyeyātām| `saha khena vartata iti sakhaḥ` iti| <> [[2.2.28]] iti bahuvrīhiḥ, <> [[6.3.82]] iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| `sakhīyati` iti| <> [[7.4.33]] itīttvam| `sakhīḥ` iti| kvip? <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ <> [[6.1.66]] iti yakārasya ca| `lunam` iti| `lvādibhya` [[8.2.44]] iti niṣṭhānatvam| nanu ca nāyaṃ tīśabdaḥ, tatkathaṃ tasyodamudāharaṇamityata āha -`niṣṭhānatvam` ityādi| atheha kasmānna bhavati -atasakherāgacchati, senāpaterāgacchatīti, asati hyatrāpi khiśabdaḥ tiśabdaśca? ityata āha -`vikṛtanirdeśāt` ityādi| yo'yaṃ khyatyādityāgantukenākārema yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā vikṛtanirdeśaḥ kṛtastasyaitadeva prayojanam -yatra yaṇādeśaḥ, tatraiva yathā syāt| na cātra yaṇādeśo'sti, ato na bhavati, anyathā hi vikṛtanirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt| nanu ca ladhvarthaḥ syāt, anyathā hi `khitikhītībhyaḥ` ityucyamāne gauravaṃ syāt? evaṃ manyate -yadi yatara yaṇ? na bhavati, tatrāpi bhavitavyam, tadā khītībhyāmityevaṃ brāūyāt| na caivamucyamāne hrasvantābhyānna prāpnoti; khiśabdāt? `sakhyuryaḥ`, [[5.1.126]] tiśabdāt? <> [[4.1.33]] iti nirdeśābhyāmeva siddheḥ atra hi sakhipatiśabdayogrrahaṇam, na sakhīpatīśabdayoḥ| na hīha patīśabdasya yajñena saṃyogo'sti, nāpi `saha khena vartate` ityādinā prakārema vyutpādito yaḥ sakhīśabdastata utpanno yaḥ pratyayaḥ sa prakṛtyarthābhidhāne samartho bhavati; yato'bhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavanti| tasmādvikṛtanirdeśasya pūrvoktameva prayojanamiti| atha sa yaṇādeśo'tara kasmānna bhavati yasmin? satyuttvena bhavitavyam? `gheṅiti` [[7.3.111]] iti guṇena bādhitatvāditi cet? na; `śeṣo dhyasakhiḥ [[1.4.7]] iti dhisaṃjñāpratiṣedhāditi cetyata āha -`sakhīśabdasya` ityādi| atra ca `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti` (vyā|pa|89) iti pratiṣedho hetuḥ|parasyeti kimartham? pūrvaparayormā bhūt| itaścārabhya pūrvaparayorityetannānuvartate||`ukārānubandhakasya` iti| yadi ruśabdaḥ samudāyaḥ sthāno syāt, tadā mahātaruvanamityatrāpi `haśi ca` [[6.1.110]] ityutvaṃ prasajyeta| kiñca <> [[8.2.66]] ityukārānubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tatra hru kāro'sya sūtrasaya viśeṣaṇārthaḥ kriyate, sa iha samudāye sthāninyanarthako jāyate| tasmādukārānubandhavata idaṃ grahaṇam| nanu cottve kartavye <> [[8.2.1]] iti ruttvamasiddham, tadasato roḥ kathamuttvaṃ śakyate vidhātum? ityata āha -`rutvamapyāśrayāt? siddham` iti| yadi rutvamasiddhaṃ syāt, tadā sthānitvena rorāśrayaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; kasyacidukārānubandhaviśiṣṭasya rorasambhavāt| tasmādāśrayādeva rorasiddhatvaṃ nāstīti| `tasyāpi` iti| yatrāpi parato roruttvamucyate tasya `suruāotā 3 atra` iti <> [[8.2.84]] iti plutaḥ| `devadattā 3 atra` iti| atrāpi `guro'nṛto'nantasyāpyekaikasaya prācām` [[8.2.86]] ityanena| atha kimarthaṃ `aplutādaplute` ityucyate? na hrato'tīti ca taparakaraṇasya varṇasya nirdeśe kriyamāṇe plutātparasya plute vā parataḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha -`plutasya` ityādi| nanu ca siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu, yadayam? `plutapragṛhrā āci` [[6.1.125]] iti prakṛtibhāvaṃ śāsti? evaṃ manyate -prakṛtibhāva evaitajjñāpakaṃ syāt| athāpi kathañcit? svarasandhiviṣayaṃ jñāpakaṃ syāt, tathā rodattvaṃ svarasandhirna bhavati| athāpi saṃhitā kāyryaviṣayaṃ jñāpakaṃ syāt, tathāpi roruttvaṃ maṃhitākāryyaṃ na bhavati| yena hi varṇāḥ sandhīyante tat? saṃhitākāryam, na cottvena varṇāḥ saṃhitā bhavanti; punarapyādguṇādyapekṣaṇāditi||pūrvatrātītyanuvṛtterhaśyuttvamaprāptamevānena vidhīyate| cakāraḥ `aplutāt? [[6.1.109]] ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| teneha na bhavati - suruāotā 3 vehīti||`prakṛtyā` iti| karaṇe tṛtīyā| `antaḥpādam` iti| saptamyantametat| vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaṃ vidhāya tataḥ saptamī, tasyāḥ `tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam` [[2.4.84]] ityambhāvaḥ kṛtaḥ| `eṅaḥ` ityādi| pañcamyantasyaiṅaḥ prakṛtyā bhavatītyanena sambandho nopapadyate| tasmādihārthādeṅgrahaṇaṃ prathamāntamupajāyate| `prakṛtiḥ` ityādinā prakṛtiśabdasyāmācaṣṭe| prakṛtiśabdo hi loke svabhāve prayujyate, yatā -dustyajā prakṛtiriti, kāraṇe'pi yathā -dadhnaḥ kṣīraṃ prakṛti rati, tadihāpi sa evārthastasya vijñāyate| antarityavyayamadhikaraṇabhūtamiti| ata evāntaḥ-pādamityavyayībhāvo bhavati| `pādaśabdena` ityādi| kathaṃ punarṛkpādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ labhyate, yāvatā pādaśabdaḥ sāmānyavācī? evaṃ manyate - <> [[6.1.106]] ityataḥ chandograhaṇamiha maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvartate, tena ṛkpādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| atha <> [[6.1.122]] ityataḥ sūtrāt? prākchandasyeva kāryaṃ vijñāyate| evaṃ hi tatra sarvatragarahaṇamarthavadbhavati yadi cchandasi pūrvaṃ vidhānaṃ bhavati| evamavayavānāparthamākhyāya `avakārayakāra` ityādinā samudāyasyārthamācaṣṭe| avidyamānau vakārayakārau yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `svabhāvena` ityādi| yadā prakṛtiśabdaḥ svabāve vartamāno gṛhrate, tadāyamarthaḥ -eṅ? svabhāvena bhavati| svabhāvaparatyāgena saṃhitākāryaṃ nopapadyata iti| yadā tu kāraṇe vartamānasya prakṛtiśabdasya parigrahastadāyamarthaḥ -eṅ? kāraṇātmanā bhavatīti| kāraṇaṃ parapūrvatvādeḥ kāryasyaiṅa, tasya ya ātmā svarūpaṃ tenaivātmanaiṅ? bhavatītyetaduktaṃ bhavati -prāk? saṃhitākāryādyadeṅo rūpaṃ tenaiva tadavatiṣṭhata iti| anantaroktamevārthadvayaṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha -na `vikāramāpadyate` iti| evaṃ hi svabhāvena bhavati, yadi svabhāvādandathālakṣaṇā vikārāvasthā notpadyeta| tadaivaṃ kāraṇātmanāpi bhavati, yadi vikārabhāvaṃ notpadyate| yadi kāryātmanā na vipariṇamatītyarthaḥ| `no cennimittakāyaṇau` iti| nimittaṃ paratvaviśiṣṭo'kāraḥ| tatra hi parataḥ prakṛtibhāvo vidhīyate| kāryī tveṅ, tasya hi kāryaṃ prakṛtibhāvo'sti| `te agre aścamāyuñjan` iti| asya ṛkpādasya madhye ya eṅ ekārasteśabde'greśabde ca tasaya tadanantare prakṛtibhāvat? <> [[6.1.109]] iti pūrvarūpaṃ na bhavati, ayādeśaśca| `upaprayanto adhvaram` iti| atrāpi prayanta iti śabdaukārasyaiṅo'dhvaraśabdasyānantare prakṛtabhāvāt? pūrvarūpaṃ na bhavati, avādeśaśca| evaṃ `sujāte aā` ityādāvapi prakṛtibhāvāt? pūrvarūpā dakāryasyābhāvo veditavyaḥ| `ete'rcayanti` iti| atrete śabde ya eṅ ekāraḥ sa padānte vartate| tadanantarastvakāraḥ pādādau, na pādamadhye| `te'vadan` iti| atra teśabde ya eṅ tasya prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati; tadanantarasyāto vakāraparatvāt| `avadan` iti| vadaterlaṅi prathamapuruṣabahuvacanāntam| `te'yajān` iti| atrāpi teśabde ya eṅ tasya prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati| tadanantarasyāto yakāraparatvāt| `anvagni` ityādi| sarvamatrāsti, na tvanuśabda ukāra eṅ bhavati, nāsya prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `kecit` ityādi| yadi tarhi `nāntaḥpādamavyapare` iti sūtraṃ paṭhanti, evaṃ sati parapūrvasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt, nāyavoḥ; tathā hi -parapūrvatvameṅo'nantaravihitam? ityat? āha -`te saṃhitāyām` ityādi| yadi parapūrvatvaṃ saṃhitākāryaṃ viśeṣaṇamapekṣyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, tadāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt| yadā tu saṃhitādhikāravihitaṃ kāryaṃmātramapekṣya pratiṣedho vidhīyate, tadā sarvasyaiva saṃhitādhikāravihitasya kāryasya pratiṣedho yukta iti teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ||`no avyāt` iti| asmādo dvitīyabahuvacanāntasya <> [[8.1.21]] iti nasi rutve <> [[6.1.113]] ityuttve `ād? guṇaḥ` [[6.1.84]] iti guṇe kṛte `no` iti bhavati| `ava rakṣaṇe` (dhā|pa|600) ityasmādāśiṣi liṅi yāsuṭi tipi `itaśca` [[3.4.97]] itīkāralope <> [[8.2.29]] iti sakaralope ca kṛte `avyāt` iti bhavati| `avadyāta` iti| avadyaśabdo'yaṃ pañcamyekavacanāntaḥ| `avakramuḥ` iti| avapūrvāt? kramerliṭausi rūpametat| anye tu luṅi varṇayanti - <> [[7.4.78]] iti cleḥ śluḥ, `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam, jusbhāvaśchāndasaḥ| `avantu` iti| avaterloṭ, jherantādeśaḥ, `eruḥ` [[3.4.76]] ityuttvam| `avasyavaḥ` iti| avateḥ `sarvadhātabhyo'sun` (da|u|9|49) iti asun - avas? iti, tataḥ <> [[3.1.8]] iti kyac, tadantāt? <> [[3.2.170]] ityupratyayaḥ, tato jas, `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] iti guṇaḥ - okāraḥ, <<eco'yavāyāvaḥ>> [[6.1.78]] ityavādeśaḥ||`uro antarikṣam` iti| uraḥśabdasyottvam, `ād? guṇaḥ` iti guṇaḥ| `okārāntamurośabdaṃ [`ukārāntamuruśabda` -kāśikā] sambuddhyantamadhīyate` iti| uruśabdasya <> [[7.3.106]] iti guṇe kṛte `uro` iti bhavati||āpo -ityevamādīni sarvāṇyetānyanukaraṇānyavibhaktikāni; `supāṃ suluk` [[7.1.39]] ityādinā tebhya utpannāyā vibhakterluptatvāt| atrāpo iti prathamābahuvacanāntasyānukāraṇam| `juṣāṇo` iti| prathamaika vacanāntasya| `vṛṣṇo` iti| ṣaṣṭhaekavacanāntasya| `vaṣiṣṭhe` iti| saptamyekavacanāntasya| `amba, ambāle` ityetayorviśeṣaṇam| ambikeśabdāt? pūrve ambikepūrve, asmādeva nipātanāt samāsaḥ| nanu ca `ambe` iti sambuddhyantasyānukaraṇam? tataśca <<ambā'rthanadyorhrasvaḥ>> [[7.3.107]] iti hrasvenaittvāpavādena bhavitavyam, tat? kathamambe ityatraittvam? ityata āha -`asmādeva` ityādi| ambāle ambike -ityetayostu yuktamevaittvam| vakṣyati hi hrasvavidhāne -`ambārthaṃ dvyakṣaraṃ yadi` (vā| 7.3.107) iti||`aṅga ityādau ca` iti| itikaraṇenāntarokto'ṅgaśabdaḥ pratyavamuśyate| `tadādau cākāre` iti| samānādhikaraṇe saptamyau| tacchabdenātikrāntapratyavamarśinetikaraṇasyārthamācaṣṭe -tadādāviti| aṅgaśabdādāvityarthaḥ| `yaḥ pūrvaḥ` iti| `eṅ` iti sambadhyate| cakāro'ṅgaśabdasyādau yo'kārasatatrāpa parataḥ pūrvasyaiṅaḥ prakṛtibhāvo yathā syāditi samuccayārthaḥ kriyate| tatra hrasatyaṅgaśabdākāre parato'ṅgaśabdasya ya eṅ tasyaiva prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt| yastvaṅgaśabde parato'naṅgaśabdasyaiṅ tatra na syāt| `prāṇo aṅge` ityādi| atra prāṇo-śabde ya eṅ aṅgaśabdādāvakāre prakṛtyā bhavati| `aṅga aṅge adīdhyat` iti| atrāṅgaśabde ya eṅ tasyāṅgaśabdādāvakāre'dīdhyacchabdādau prakṛtibhāvo bhavati||`kudhapare` iti| akāraviśeṣamametat| kudhau parau yasmāt? sa tathoktaḥ| dhakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `ayaṃ so agniḥ` iti| agniśabdaḥ `aṅgernirnalopaśca` [aṅgernalopaśca - da|u|] (da|u|1|20) iti nipratyayānto vyutpādita iti pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, śaṣo'nudātta ityakārasyānudāttatvam| `ayaṃ so adhvaraḥ` iti| adhvaraśabdo'pi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tadādirapyakāro'nudātta eva| `ādyudātto nipātyate` iti| ṛḍajtrendrāgravajraviprakuvracuvrakṣurakhurabhadrograbherabhelaśukaraśuklagauravanarerāmalāḥ (da|u|8|46) ityanena| `so'yam` iti| ayaṃśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tasyādiranudāttaḥ||`yadrudrebhyo'vapathāḥ` iti| aṭaḥ svareṇādyuvātto'yamavapathāḥśabdaḥ||`atīti nivṛttam` iti| yadyapītyanuvarteta tadā gavaudanādau na syāt, tasmādatītyetadasvaritatvā nnivṛtam| halyapi tarhi prāpnoti? ityata āha -`acītyetatpunaranuvartate` iti| <> [[6.1.77]] ityataḥ; sā punastasyānuvṛttirmaṇḍūkapalutinyāyena veditavyā| na hi <> [[6.1.108]] ityataḥ pareṇa ye yogā asmādyogāt? pūrvaṃ teṣu `ati` ityasyānuvṛttirasti| tathā ca pūrvamuktam -`acīti cāyamadhikāraḥ <> [[6.1.108]] iti yāvata` iti| `gavāgraham, gavājinam` iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, tatpuruṣo vā| `gavoṣṭram` iti dvandvaḥ| `ādyudāttaścāyam` ityādi| iha gāvo'gramasyeti bahuvrīhau kṛte pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca ca prāpnoti, avaṅādeśaśca, tatrāntaraṅgatvādavaṅbhavati, sa ca bhavan? prātipadekasvareṇāntodāttasya gośabdasya sthāna āntarayato'ntodātta eva syāt| tasmin? sati paścāt? prakṛtisvare kṛte'ntodāttatvaṃ pūrvapadasyāpadyeta, ādyudāttaśceṣyate, tasmādādyudātto'yamādeśo nipātyate| yadyevam, tatpuruṣādāvapi sa eva nipātanasvaraḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha -`anyatra tu` ityādi| anyatreti -tatpuruṣe, dvandve ca| gośabdasyāyamādeśa iti tatsambandhyeva śabdāntaraṃ nipātanasvareṇa bādhyate, na samāsasvaraḥ| tasmādvahuvrīheranyatra tatpuraṣādau samāsāntodāttatvena nipātanasvaro bādhyate, `sphoṭāyanagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham` iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vikalpārthaṃ na bhavati? ityāha -vibhāṣetyeva hi vartate` iti| kimarthaṃ punaravaṅ vidhīyate? ageva na vidhīyeta, tatrāpi hravādeśena sidhyatyeva? sidhyati; <> [[6.1.109]] iti pūrvarūpatvaṃ prāpnoti| nanu cāki vihite sati tadanto na bhavati? āgamasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt|na hrokārasya prāk? pravṛttā padāntatā nāstīti śakyaṃ vaktum||`indraśabdasthe` iti| ya indraśabde tiṣṭhati sa indaraśabdasyaḥ, sa punarya indraśabdasthāvayavaḥ sa veditavyaḥ| pūrveṇa vikalpaḥ siddha eva, tatrārambhasāmavryādeva nitye vidhāvasmallabdhe nityagrahaṇamuttarārtham||`devadattā 3 atra tvasi` iti| <> [[8.2.84]] iti plutaḥ| nanu ca <> [[8.2.1]] ityasiddhaḥ plutaḥ, tadasatasatasaya kathaṃ śakyate parakṛtibhāvo vidhātum? ityata āha -`āśrayāt` ityādi| āśrayaṇamāśrayaḥ| tadetat? prakṛtibhāvakāryaṃ vidhātuṃ plutasya kāryiṇa āśrayaṇam| asmādevātra prakṛtibhāve kartavye siddhaḥ plutaḥ, anyathā tasya kāryitvenāśrayaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `agnī` ityādi| `īdūdeddvivacanam` [[1.1.11]] ityādinā atra pragṛhrasaṃjñā| athācīti kimartham, yāvatā'cītyanuvartata eva? ityata āha -`acītyanuvartamāne` ityādi| ādeśasya nimittaṃ yo'c? tasya parakṛtibhāvanimittatvena parigraho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punarajgrahaṇam| ādeśastvatra yatrāci prakṛtibhāvaḥ -jānu+u asya rujati jānū atya rujatīti| na hi ja nuśabde ya ukāro yaśca tadanantaraḥ pragṛhrasaṃjñakastayoḥ savarṇadīrghatvaṃ prati pragṛhrasaṃjñakādukārāta parasyākārasya nimittabhāvaḥ| iha ca na bhavati -jānvasya rujatīti| tena pūrvaparayorukārayorya ekādeśaḥ, sa yadyapi <> [[6.1.85]] ityādivadbhāvāt? pragṛhrasaṃjñakokāragrahaṇena gṛhrate, tathāpi yaṇādeśo'kāre parato bhavatyeva| na hyatrāpyakāra ekādeśanimittam| yadi tu viśiṣṭācparigrahārthaṃ punarajgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā'ñmātre prakṛtibhāvo vidhīyamāna ihāpi syādeva| pragṛhrasaṃjñā punarakārapūravasyokārasya <> [[1.1.14]] ityanena| `nityagarahaṇam` ityādi| yadi nityagrahaṇamihānuvartate, tadāgnī+itītyādau asya vidheḥ kṛtārthatvātta vāyū+atretyādau paratvācchākalau vidhiḥ prasajyeta| tasmāt? prakṛtibhāva eva yathā syāt -ityevamarthaṃ nityagrahaṇamihānuvartate||`āṅaḥ` iti| ṅidviśiṣṭasyākarasyopādānam| īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādābhividhau ca yaḥ` -tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, vākyasmaraṇayoryaḥ tasya mā bhūdityevamartham| asati prakṛtibhāve vihite'pyāṅo'nunāsikatve syādeva svarasagdhiḥ| anunāsikavidhānaṃ tvādeśasya sānunāsikatvārthaṃ syādityetanmanasi kṛtvā''ha -`na ca prakṛtyā bhavati` iti| `ātarat` iti| taraterāṅapūrvāllaṅ, aḍāgamaḥ, aṭā saha savarṇadīrghatvam||`hrasvaśca tasyekaḥ sthāne bhavati` iti| yadyevam, `prakṛtyā` [[6.1.111]] ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro na kartavyaḥ, hrasvavidhānasāmarthyādeva hi svarasandhirna bhaviṣyati? atraitat? syāt -dīrghāṇāmeva hrasvavidhānasāmarthyāt? svarasandhirna syāt| hrasvānāṃ tu syādeva, na hi teṣāṃ hrasvā bhavanti| prayojanābhāvādityetacca nāsti; hrasvānāmapi hi svarasandhibādhanārthaṃ hrasvo bhavatyeva| kṛtakāri khalvidaṃ śāstram, parjanyavat; nākṛtakāri dahanavat| evaṃ tarhi cakāreṇaitadākhyāyate -kvacid? īṣā+akṣādau prakṛtibhāva eva bhavati, na hrasvatvamiti| tena yaduktāmīṣā akṣādau prakṛtabhāvamātramiti, tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati| yaṇādeśena saha vikalpārthaṃ śākalyagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi` ityādi| yaṇādeśasya hrasavarṇa evājviṣayaḥ; savarṇe tu <> [[6.1.101]] iti dīrghavidhānāt| ayamapi ca śākalo hrasvo vidhīyate| ata evāsmin? viṣaya ārambhasāmarthyādevāsya vidheryaṇādeśena saha vikalpaḥ siddha iti na tadarthamācāryagrahaṇam| `sinnityasamāsayoḥ` ityādi| ekāpi saptamī dvidhā bhidyate; apekṣābhedāt| sidapekṣayā parasaptamī, nitsasamāsāpekṣayā viṣayasaptamī| sicca nityasamāsaśceti dvandvaḥ -sa idyasya sa sit| nityādhikāre vihitaḥ samāso nityasamāsaḥ| śākalyasyāyaṃ vidhiḥ śākalaḥ -<> [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ? <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralopaḥ, <<āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti>> [[6.4.151]] iti yakāralopaḥ| śākalasya pratiṣedhaḥ śākalapratiṣedhaḥ| `vaktavya` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam, <> [[6.1.122]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena sinnityasamāsayoḥ śākalapratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| `ṛtviyaḥ` iti| ṛtuḥ prāpto'syeti `ṛtoraṇ` [[5.1.104]] <> [[5.1.106]] iti ghas| `vyākaraṇam` iti| <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| atra hi <> [[2.2.17]] ityato nityagrahaṇānuvṛtternitayasamāso'yam| `kumāryarthama` iti| kumāryā idaṃ kumāryarthamiti| `arthaśabdena saha` samāsavacanaṃ sarvaliṅgatā ca` (vā|78) ityayamapi nityasamāsa eva| sarvatra śākalavidhau pratiṣiddhe yaṇādeśo bhavatyeva||`savarṇārthamanigarthañca vacanam` iti| anyatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| yadi savarṇārthaṃ vacanam, kathaṃ tarhi khaṭvaśrya ityudāharaṇam, na hyatra savarṇo'cparaḥ naitadasti; `anigarthañca` iti yaduktaṃ tasyodāharaṇam| ata evāka ityupāttaṃ sūtre; anyatheka ityanuvartanīyaṃ syāt| satyasmin? yoge savarṇārthe'pyako'nenaiva yukto hrasvaprakṛtibhāvo paratvādatyasyodāharaṇasyopanyāsaḥ||ṛṣau=vede bhava ārṣaḥ, tasmādanyo laukiko'nārṣaḥ| `samudāyāt` iti| vākyādityarthaḥ| kuta etata? padarahitasya vakyasyāprayogāt| vākyasya ca samudayātmakatvāt| `avacchidya` iti| pṛthak? kṛtvetyarthaḥ| `svarūpe vyavasthāpyate` [svarūpe'vasthāpyate - kāśikā] iti| śabdapadātmakatāyāṃ vyavasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| `aplutavat` iti| aplutena tulyaṃ vartata ityaplutavat| yena sādhamryeṇāplutavadbhavati taddarśayitumāha - `plutakāryam` ityādi| tadanena plutakāryasyārthaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, na tu plutasyeti darśitaṃ bhavati| `suślokā 3` iti| <> [[8.2.84]] iti plutaḥ| `suślokā` iti| plutakāryasyākaraṇādekādeśo bhavatyeva| nanu caikādeśenāpi na bhavitavyam, tasyāpi plutakāryatvāt? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vacanasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt| tasmāt? plutasaṃśabdanenaiva plutasya yatkāryaṃ vihitaṃ tasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ, na sarvasya plṛtakāryasya| na caikādeśa evaṃ vihitaḥ| `vatkaraṇaṃ kim` iti| kāryamātrasya pratiṣedhe sati plutasya dhavaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ vatkaraṇaṃ syāt| satyapi ca kāryamātrasya prakṛtibhāvasya pratiṣedhenaiva plutaśrutyā bhavitavyam; ekadeśena nivarttitatvāt| tat? kasmāt? plutasyaiva pratiṣedho na kriyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| plutapratiṣedhe vakṣyamāṇaṃ doṣaṃ cetasi kṛtvā''ha - `pluta ityucyamāne` ityādi| `tatra ko doṣaḥ` iti| yo vatkaraṇe sati na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `pragṛhrāśraye` ityādi| pragṛhra āśrayo yasya tasmin? pratibhāve sati pragṛhrasaṃjñako yaḥ plutastasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt, yadi pluta eva pratiṣidhyeta| vatkaraṇe tu sati plutakāryasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho bhavati na plutasyaiva| tatra plutāśraye prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe'pi pragṛhrāśrayasyāpratiṣiddhatvādasatyekādeśa eva doṣo na bhavati| `agnī iti`| `idūdeddvivacanam` [[1.1.11]] ityādinā pragṛhayasaṃjñā, `guroranṛta` [[8.2.86]] ityādinā plutaḥ||`aci parataḥ` iti| etena `upasthite` ityetannivṛttam; asvaritatvāditi sūcayati| `astu hī 3` iti| `asu kṣepaṇe`, (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1209) loṭ, sip| `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] iti sehiḥ, vyatyanena śluḥ| `kṣiyāśīḥ-praiṣeṣu tiṅākāṅkṣam` [[8.2.104]] iti plutaḥ| `tadupasthite nivṛttyartham` iti| tatra pūrveṇāplutavadbhāvasya nityaṃ prāpatatvāt| `anuyasthite prāptyartham` iti| tatra kenacidaprāptatvāt| `īkārāt` ityādi| kathaṃ punarikārādanyatrāpīṣyamāṇo'pyeṣo'plutavadabhāvo labhyate? <<iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca>> [[6.1.127]] ityato'nuvṛttasya cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt||`sānubandhakatvāt` iti| kasya dhātoranantaram? prakṛtatvāt? tasyaiva| dīvyatirghātuḥ sānubandhaḥ, pratipadikaṃ tu divityetanniranubandhakam, niranubandhakasya ca sūtra upādānam; tasmāt? `niranubandhakasya grahaṇe na sānubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|53) iti prātipadikasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na dhātoriti| `dyukāmaḥ` iti| divikāmo'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ, divaṃ kāmayata iti vā| `śīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇo vaktavyaḥ` (vā|229) iti ṇapratyayaḥ| `dyumāna` iti| dyaurasyāstīti <> [[5.2.94]] | `vimaladyu dinam` iti| vimalā dyaurasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `akṣadyūbhyām, akṣadyūbhiḥ` iti| akṣaśabda upapade dīvyaterdhātoḥ kvip, `cchṣoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] ityūṭh| atha tapakaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā yadyapi `ṛta ut` [[6.1.111]] ityatra tapakaraṇena `bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān? gṛhlāti` (cāṃ|pa|pā|44) iti jñāpitam, tathāpyatrāntaryato'drdhamātrākālasya vyajañjanasya mātrika eva bhaviṣyati; na dīrghaḥ? ityata āha -`tapakaraṇam` ityādi| yadyapyanena dīrgo na prāpnoti, lakṣaṇāntareṇa tu dyubhyāṃ dyubhiḥ -ityatroṭh? prāpnoti, ataḥ sa mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ taparakaraṇam| syādetat| nanu coṭhprāptireva nāsti, kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena taparakaraṇena? ityata āha -`dyubhyām, dyubhiḥ` iti| `atra hi` ityādi| uttvasyāvakāśo yatra jhalādiḥ kvipparo na vidyate -vimaladyu dinamiti, ūṭho'vakāśaḥ -akṣadyūbhyāmiti; dyubhyāmityādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvādūṭh prāpnoti, taparakaraṇāduttvameva bhavati| yadi tarhi prāptasyoṭho nivṛttye taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate, evaṃ sati `cachvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] ityatara kathaṃ `dyubhyām? dyubhiḥ` iti pareṇa codite yadvakṣyati -`ūṭhi kṛte `diva ut` iti paratvānmātrākālo bhaviṣyati` iti, tadvirudhyate; tasyoṭhi kṛte'bhinivṛtte tasya sthāne mātrākāla ukāro bhaviṣyatītyayamarthaḥ? nāsti virodhaḥ; `ūṭhi kṛte` ityasya hi granthasya pūrveṇa codyagranthena saha sambandhaḥ, netareṇa parihāragranthena| tatra `kecidatra kṅitīti nānuvartayanti` ityasmin? darśanāntare upanyaste `kathaṃ dyubhyāṃ dyubhirityūṭhi kṛte` iti deśyam| tatrāyaṃ codayiturabhiprāyaḥ -yadi kṅitīti nānuvarteta, tadā dyubhyāṃ dyubhiritayatarāpyūḍeva kartavayaḥ, tataścoṭhi kṛte kathaṃ dyubhyāṃ dyubhiriti sidhyati, yāvatā dyūbhyāṃ dyūbhiriti bhavitavyamityasya deśyasya `diva ut` iti taparatvānmātrākālo bhaviṣyatītyeṣa parihāraḥ| atrāpyayaṃ parihartarabhiprāyaḥ -taparakaraṇasyaitadeva prayojanam -ūṭh? mā bhūdati; anyathā tadanarthakaṃ syāt, tasmāduttvameva kartavyam? na tūḍbhāva iti| ye tu `kṅiti` ityanuvartayanti, teṣāṃ taparakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham||`sampūrvasya kvacidabhūṣaṇe'pīṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo labhyate? <> [[4.2.16]] ityācāryapravṛtteliṅgāt||`samavāyaḥ samudāyaḥ` iti| samavapūrvādimo bhāve `erac` [[3.3.56]] ityac| samavāya iti saṅghāt? ityarthaḥ| `samudita ityarthaḥ` iti| bhāve niṣṭhā||`sataḥ` ityādi| labdhasattākasyārthasya purvotpannobhyo guṇebhyo yo'nyo guṇastadguṇāntaram, tadādhīyata utpādyate yena tadguṇāntarādhānam| tatpunaḥ kimartham? ityāha - `ādhikyāya` ityādi| kiṃ tat? ityāha - `samīhā` iti| tadevaṃ vidyamānasya vastana ādhikyāya vṛddhaye vṛddhasya caiva tādavasthyāya tasyā vṛddhāvasthāyā aparihāṇāya guṇāntarādhānaṃ yayādhīyate samīhayāṃ ceṣṭayā sa pratiyatna ityucyate| `vikṛtam` iti| jātavikriyamityarthaḥ| `gamyamānārthasya vākyasya svarapeṇa` iti| `samudāyeṣu hi pravṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartante` (vyā pa|sū|85) iti pratīyamāno'rthaḥ prakaraṇādivākyasyaikadeśo vākyaśabdenoktaḥ| gamyamānārthasyāpi sukhapratipattaye svarūpeṇopādānaṃ vākyādhyāhāraḥ||`lavanaviṣaye` ityādi| anena lavanaṃ kiraternābhidheyatayā viśeṣaṇam, api tu tadarthasya viṣayabhāvaneti darśayati| kena punaratra ṇamul, yāvatā `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul? ca` [[3.4.22]] ityādinā śāstreṇa sa ābhīkṣṇyādāvapyarthe vidhīyate| na cātra so'rto vivakṣitaḥ, nāpi pratīyata ityāha - `ṇamulatra` ityādi| `vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatreva vyākhyānam - `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam? [[3.3.113]] ityato bahulavacanāt? bhaviṣyati||`hiṃsāyāṃ viṣaye` iti| etena kiraternābhidheyatvena hiṃsā viśeṣaṇam| api tu tadarthasya viṣayabhāveneti darśayati| `pratiskīrṇam` iti| `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttvam, raparatvañca, `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] ityādinā niṣṭhānatvam, `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] itī dīrghatvam| `tathā` ityādinā kiraterarthasya hiṃsāviṣayatāṃ darśayati| `anubadhnāti` iti| anugacchatītyarthaḥ||`tasmin? viṣaye` ityādi| anenāpyālekhanaṃ kiraternābhidheyatayā viśeṣaṇam, api tu tadarthasya viṣayabhāveneti darśayati| `apaskirate` iti| <> [[3.1.77]] iti śaḥ, pūrvavaditvaṃ rapatvam| `ālikhya` ityādinā lekhanasya kiratyarthasya viṣayatāmudbhāvayati| ālikhyeti ākṛṣyetyarthaḥ| catuṣpācchakunisādhanasya lekhanasya sāmānyenopādānādihāpi prāpnoti -apakirati āaudanapiṇḍamāśita iti, ata idamālekhanaviśeṣaṇamāha -`harṣajīvikā` ityādi| harṣaḥ=pramodaḥ| jīvikā=prāṇadhāraṇopāyaḥ| kulāyaḥ=āśramaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ harṣādaṣvātmanepadaṃ bhavati, na tviha pratyudāharaṇe? ityāha -`harṣajīvikākulāyakaraṇeṣveva` ityādi|nanu ca sūtre napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśānnapuṃsakaliṅgatāyāṃ phalajātāveva bhavitavyam, nānyaliṅgatāyām, auṣadhajātau bahuvacana eva bhavitavyam, nānyatra, bahuvacanena nirdeśāt; tat? kathaṃ kustumbuvarityatra pulliṅgatayāmekavacane ca bhavati? ityata āha -`sūtranirdeśe` ityādi| napuṃsakagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇamātram| bahuvacanamapi hratantrameva sūtre| tathā coktam -`sūtre [sūtranirdeśe napuṃsakaliṅgamavivakṣitam -kāśikā| padamaṃjarī ca] liṅgavacanamatantram? `tasyāvivakṣitatvāt` [nāsti -kāśikā] iti||`aparasparāḥ` iti| apare ca pare ceti dvandvaḥ| santataśabdādbhāvapratyaya utpanne sāntatyamiti bhavitavyamityabhiprāyeṇāya -`kimidam` ityādi| satataśabdādevāyaṃ bhāvapratya utpanna iti darśayannāha -`satatasya bhāvaḥ` ityādi| `kathaṃ satatam` iti| evaṃ manyate -samo makāralopasya lakṣaṇaṃ tāvadiha śāstre nāsti| atha sātatya ityetadeva nipātanam, tataśabde parataḥ samo makārasya lopo bhaviṣyatītyasyārthasya jñāpanaṃ kalpyeta, evaṃ sati santatamiti na sidhyati? ityata āha -`samastate vikalpena` ityādi| ayamabhiprāyaḥ -sātatyaśabdaṃ pūrvācāryalakṣaṇaprasiddhamuccārayatā pūrvācāryalakṣaṇamapyāśritam| atastena samo makārasyātra lopo vidhīyate| etañca kṛtvā'vaśyamprabhṛtīnāmapi kṛtyādiṣu lopaḥ siddho bhavati| atastadeva pūrvācāryalakṣaṇaṃ darśayati -`lumpet` ityādi| antyamiti śeṣaḥ| avaśyaṃśabdasya kṛtyapratyayānte parato lumpet? antyalopamasya kuryādityarthaḥ| avaśyakartavyam| tumunpratyayāntasyāpyāntyaṃ lumpet, kāmamanasośca śabdayoḥ parataḥ -karttuṃ kāmo'syeti karttukāmaḥ, harttu mano'syeti harttumanāḥ| samśabdasya cāntyaṃ lumpedvikalpena hitatayoḥ śabdayoḥ parataḥ -sahitam, satatam, santatam| <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| māṃsaśabdasyāntyaṃ lumpet, kva? paci| `ḍupacaṣ? pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-996) ityetasmin? dhātau| kiṃ viśiṣṭe? `yuṅghañoḥ` iti| lyuṭi ghañi ca pratyaye parato yaḥ pacistasminnityarthaḥ| atrāpi vāgrahaṇaṃ sambadhyate| māṃspacanam, māṃsapacanam| māṃspākaḥ, māṃsapākaḥ| `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate` (vā|86) iti samāsaḥ| samāse'yaṃ lopaḥ pūrvācāryāṇāmabhiprāyaḥ, saṃhitāyāṃ ca| tena vākye vicchidyapāṭhe na bhavati||`tasya ca ṣatvam` iti| anādeśapratyayasakāratvāt? suṭaḥ ṣatvaṃ na prāpnotītyatastadapi nipātyate| `gāvaḥ padyante` ityādinā deśasya sevitatvaṃ darśayati| `asevite` ityādi| nanu ca goṣpadaśabdaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ, tat? kasmādasevite'goṣpadādīnītyādyudāhyiyate? ityāha -`asevite` ityādi| nanu ca goṣpadaśabdaḥ sūtra upātaḥ, tat? kasmādasevite'goṣpadādīnītyādyudāhyiyate? ityāha -`asevite` ityādi| kriyate cedamasevitagrahaṇam, na ca tatra goṣpadaśabdaḥ sambhavati; tasmādasevite'goṣpadārthaṃ nipātanaṃ vijñāyate| `yadyevam` iti| yadyasevite'goṣpadārthaṃ nipātanamityarthaḥ| `nārtha etena` iti| asevitagrahaṇena| kathaṃ tena vinā sidhyati? ityāha -`goṣpadapratiṣedhāt`tyādi| `satyamevaitat` iti| goṣpadaparatiṣedhādityādi yaduktaṃ tasya satyatāmāha, na tu `nārthaṃ etena` ityasyārthaḥ| yadi tarhi satyamevaitat` tat? kimarthaṃ sevitagrahaṇamiha kriyate? ityāha -`yatra tu` ityādi| nañsamāse'goṣpada ityeṣa tatpuruṣaḥ svabhāvāduttarapadarthasadṛśamarthamācaṣṭe` abrāāhṛṇavat| tataśca na goṣpadamagoṣpadamiti tatpuruṣe kṛte yatra sevitasaya sevanasya prasaṅgo'sti tatraivāgoṣpadamityetat? tathāpi bhavati` iti| apiśabdo na kevalaṃ yatra sevataprasaṅgo'sti tatraivāgoṣpadamityamumarthaṃ dyotayati| kasmāt? punaratrāsevitagrahaṇāt| tatrā'pi bhavatītyata āha -`yāni hi` iti| `evam` iti| asevitagrahaṇārthakaḥ prakāraḥ pratyavamṛśyate| asevitagrahaṇe hi sati mā bhūt? tasya vaiyathryamita bahuvrīhirayaṃ bhāvasādhanenāsevitaśabdena vijñāsyate| avidyamānaṃ sevitamasminniti bahuvrīhiścātyantābhāve'pi bhavatīti yeṣu gavāmatyantāsambhavastānyaraṇyānyāsevitaśabdenocyante| tataśca tatrāpyagoṣpadamiti bhavati| `goṣpadapūram` iti| <> [[3.4.32]] iti ṇamul| nanu ca goṣpadamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam, tasya ca gosambandhi padamarthaḥ, na tu pramāṇam, tat? kathaṃ goṣpadamātraṃ kṣetramityādi udāharaṇaṃ pramāṇe yujyatade? ityata āha -`nātra` ityādi| na hyatra svārthapratipādanārthameva goṣpadamityupādīyate| kiṃ tarhi? kṣetrāderiyattāṃ paricchettum| tasmāt? kṣetrāderiyattā tena paricchidyate= pramīyata iti bhavati pramāṇam| na cātra pramāṇaśabdenāyāma ucyate, kiṃ tarhi? paricchedamātram| kuta etat? nipātanasāmarthyāt| nipātanaṃ hi vastvaprasiddhamapyupādatte||`ātmayāpanāya` iti| ātmayāpanam=prāṇadhāraṇam| tadarthaṃ yat? sthāpanaṃ tat? pratiṣṭhetyucyate| `āsapadam` iti| āṅaḥ parasya padasya suṭ? nipātyate| `āpadam` iti| <<āṅ maryādāvacane>> [[1.4.89]] ityāṅaḥ karmapravacanīyatvam, tadyoge `pañcamyapāṅ? paribhiḥ` [[2.3.10]] iti pañcamī, tadantena <<āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ>> [[2.1.13]] ityavyayībhāvasamāsaḥ||yadyanitye'śāātika āścaryamiti nipātyate, tato, ghaṭādiṣvapi syādityetaṃ doṣaṃ parijihīrṣurāha -`anityatayā` ityādi| adbhutam=citramityucyate| yalloke'dbhutaṃ taccitram, tasya bhāvo'dbhutatvam| tasya cānyatrābhāvādanityatā viṣayabhūtā, na hi tatra tato'nyatra sambhavati| tasmāt? tayā viṣayabhūtayā'dbhutatvamupalakṣyate| `āśascaryaṃ yadi sa bhuñjīta` iti| `anavakḷptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛtte'pi` [[3.3.145]] ityanavakḷptāvasambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ| bhojanaṃ kasyacidviśiṣṭakālādāvadṛṣṭapūrvam| atastatra bhavat? tadadbhutaṃ bhavati||`rathāvayavaḥ` iti| anenādiśabdasthāvayavavacanamācaṣṭe||nanu ca `viṣkiraḥ śakunau vā` ityetāvataiva suṅviklapaḥ siddhaḥ, tatra kimarthaṃ vikiragrahaṇam? ityata āha -`śakunāveva vikiraśabdasya prayogo yathā syādanyatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vikirāgrahaṇam` (iti)||pāraskaraprabhṛtayo rūḍhiśabdā yathākathañcidvayutpādyāḥ| nātrāvayavārthaṃ pratyabhiniveṣṭavyam| pāraṃ karotīti paraskaraḥ <> [[3.2.20]] iti ṭaḥ| rayaṃ pātīti `rathaspā`| `ātonupasarge kaḥ` [[3.2.3]] | kārya karotīti karoteḥrḍuḥ, kāryasya ca kirādeśaḥ -`kiṣkuḥ`| kimapyantardaghātīti dadhāteḥ pūrvavat? kaḥ, kimo rdvirvacanam, pūrvasya ca makārasya lopaḥ -`kiṣkindhā`| `tadbṛhatoḥ` ityādi| tat, bṛhat -ityetayoryathākramaṃ karapatiśabdayoḥ parataścore devatāyāñcābhidheyāyāṃ suṅ? bhavati, antyasya ca takārasya lopaḥ| tat? karotīti `kiṃ yattadbahuṣu` (vā|242) ityajvidhānam, tasakaraścauraḥ, tatkaro'nyaḥ| bṛhatāṃ patirbṛhaspatirdevatā, bṛhatpatiranyaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ cauradevatayorityupādhirupādīyate, yāvatā saṃjñāgrahaṇādeva tatparigrahaḥ siddhaḥ, na hranyasya taskarabṛhasapatiśabdau saṃjñā? ityata āha -`saṃjñāgrahaṇam` ityādi| `prāttumpatau` ityādi| `tupa tumpa tṛptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1309,1360) iti parataḥ praśabdāt? parasya suṅbhavati gavi kartari| `prastumpati gauḥ`| pratumpatyevānyaḥ `yaduktam` iti bhāṣye| yadi tarhi pāraskaraparabhṛtirākṛtigaṇaḥ, <> [[6.1.152]] ityārabhya pūrvaṃ sūtraṃ na paṭhitavyam, tasyāpyanenaiva saṅgrahāt? satyametat; prapañcārthaṃ tu paṭhitavyam||`ekavarjam` iti| ekaṃ varjayitvetyarthaḥ| `dvitīyāyāñca` [[3.4.53]] iti ṇamulpratyayaḥ| yadyayamadhikārārthaḥ syāt, tat? ṣāṣṭhika eva svaraḥ saṅgṛhītaḥ syāt| ye tvanye svarāḥ <> [[4.4.108]] , <> [[7.1.75]] ityevamādayaḥ saptādhyāyyām, te na saṃgṛhītā syuḥ| paribhāṣāyāṃ tvasyāṃ te'pi saṃgṛhītā bhavanti| sā hrekadeśe sthitāpi sakalaṃ śāstramabhijvalayati, yathā veśma pradīpa ivetyālocyāha - `paribhāṣeyam` iti| vidhyaṅgaśeṣabhūtā ceyam| paribhāṣā hi kāryavākyānāṃ śeṣabhāvagatā| yasya padādayavasya svarita udātto vā vidhīyate tatra śeṣamanudāttaṃ bhavati| `svaravidhiviṣayā` iti| svaravidhirviṣayo'syā iti vigrahaḥ| `yatrānyaḥ` iti| anudāttāpekṣamanyatvam| `tatrānudāttaṃ padam` iti| nanu ca <> [[1.2.30]] ityanudāttaśabdo viśiṣṭaguṇe'vasaṅgītaḥ, tatrājjhalalakṣaṇañca padam, padaśabdasyārthastat? kathamatra sāmānādhikaraṇyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; anudāttāckamanudāttaṃ padamihābhimatam, tena pada evānudāttaśabdo vartate| katham? matvarthīyākārāntatvāt| anudāttā asya santītyanudāttam| arśa āderākṛtigaṇatvādatrāc| ekavarjamityuktam, sa tveko na jñāyate yo varjanīyaḥ, tasyābhivyaktaye pṛcchati - `kaḥ punaḥ` ityādi| yasya codāttaḥ svarato vā vidhīyate sa evāko vajryate| yadi hrasāvapi na vajryate tasya tat? svaravidhānamanrathakaṃ syāt| `gopāyati, dhūpāyati` iti| `gupū rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-395) `dhīpa santāpe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-396) `gupūdhūpa` [[3.1.28]] ityādinā''yaparatyayāntasya `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ [[3.1.32]] iti dhātusaṃjñā, `dhātoḥ` [[6.1.156]] iti dhātoścāntodāttatvam, āyapratyayāntasyāntyayakārākārasya dhātusvaratvam| `dhātusvaraṃ śnāsvaro bādhate` iti| satiśiṣṭasvaratvāt, satiśiṣṭasaya valīyastvāt| tathā hru katam - `satiśiṣṭasvaro balīyāniti vaktavyam`| (vā|6.1.174) iti| `lunāti, punāti` iti| `pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[7.3.80]] iti hrasvaḥ| śnāpratyayasya ca pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam| `śnāsvaram` iti| bādhata iti sambadhyate| nanu paratvāt? tibādiṣu kṛteṣu vikaraṇairbhavitavyam, ataḥ sati sārvadhātukasvare śnāsvarasya śiṣyamāṇatvāt? tasya satiśiṣṭatvam; evañca śnāsvareṇaiva bādhā yuktā tatasvarasya? evaṃ manyate yat? <> [[6.1.186]] ityādinā tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukatvaṃ śāsti tajjñāpayati - śiṣṭo'pi vikaraṇasvaraḥ sārvadhātukasvareṇa bādhyata iti| `lunītaḥ, punītaḥ` iti| `ī halyadhoḥ [[6.4.113]] itītvam| `tassvaramāmsvaraḥ` iti| bādhata iti sambandhaḥ| bādhakatve tasya hetuḥ satiśiṣṭatvameva| `lunītastarām` iti| `tiṅśca` [[5.3.56]] iti tasantāttarap, tadantāt? `kimetiṅvyaya` [[5.4.11]] ityādinā''mupratyayaḥ| kimarthaṃ punarayamekavarjapadasvaro vidhīyate? ityāha - `āgamasya` ityādi| āgamādīnāṃ pṛthak? svaro mā mudityevamarthamekaṃ varjayitvā padānudāttvaṃ vidhīyate| `āgamasvaraḥ prakṛtisvaraṃ vādhate` iti| satyasminnekavarjaṃ padaṃ svare| asati tavasmin? parakṛterāgamasya ca pṛthageva svaraḥ syāt| `catvāraḥ` iti| prakṛtisvaraḥ punarādyudāttatvam| tathā hi `caterurana` (da|u|8|78) ityuranpratyayāntaścatuḥśabdo vyutpādyata iti sa nitsvareṇādyudātto bhavati| `anaṅvāhaḥ` iti| anuḍuho'pyevaṃ vyutpattiḥ kriyate| `ana prāṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1070) asmāt? `sarvadhātubhyo'sun` (da|u|9|49) ityasunpratyayāntatvādanaḥśabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| ano bahatotyanasi vaheḥ kvip? `uścānasaḥ` (da|u|9|49) ityasunparatayayāntatvādanaḥśabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| ano bahatotyanasi vaheḥ kvip? `uścānasaḥ` (da|u|9|107) ityanasyupapade vaherdhātoḥ kvip, anaścokārādeśaḥ| vaheryajāditvāt? samprasāraṇam, upapadasamāsaḥ, `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam| tasmādanuḍuho'pyevaṃ vyutpāditasya syādādyudāttatvam| vikāraḥ=ādeśaḥ| `anaṅsvaraḥ prakṛte` iti| dadhyasathiśabdāvādyudāttau| tathā hi `asu kṣepaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1209) `asisañjibhyāṃ kthin` (da|u|1|10) iti kthinpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇāsthiśabda ādyudāttaḥ| dadhiśabdo'pi kinpratyayāntatvādādyudātta eva| dhādhātoḥ `ādṛgamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ? ca` [[3.2.171]] iti kinpratyayaḥ, tatra dvirvacane kṛta ākāralope ca dadhīti bhavati| `asthidadhi` [[7.1.75]] ityādinā'naṅi kṛte tasya yaḥ svaraḥ sa ca kartavayaḥ, tasyāpyasatyasminnasthidadhiśabdayoranaṅaśca prathagevodāttatvaṃ tu syāt| asmastu satyanaṅa eva bhavati| `prakṛteḥ` ityādi| `gopāyati, dhūpāyati` iti| atra prakṛterguperdhūpeśca `dhātoḥ` [[6.1.156]] ityantodātttve āyapratyayāderapyākārasya pratyayādyudāttatvam| gopāyadhūpāyaśabdayorapi <> [[3.1.32]] iti dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyām? `dhātoḥ` [[6.1.156]] ityantodāttameva prāpnoti| evaṃ pṛthak? svaraprasaṃge yakārākārasyaiva dhātusvaro bhavati, na gupidhūpyoḥ, nāpi pratyayākārasya| `kartavyam` iti| dhātorantodāttatve pratyayasyādyudāttatve ca prāpte pratyayādyudāttatvameva bhavati, na tu dhātusvaraḥ| athāniyamenaikasvarasya varjayamānatā kasmānna bhavati, na hyatra sūtre kaścidvyavasthāheturupāttaḥ, na ca vinā vyavasthāhetunā sā labhyate? ityāha - `paranityāntaraṅga` ityādi| yatra parādisvarāḥ prāpnuvanti, tadvipakṣāśca, tatra parādīnāṃ balīyastvāt? tata eva varjayaṃ na, itare tu nivarttyante| yatra tu paranityāntaraṅgāpavāde'pi kvacidiṣṭaṃ na sidhyati, tatra satiśiṣṭena vyavasthā bhavati, tasya hi valīyasatvamuktam| ataḥ satiśiṣṭetarasvaraprāptau satiśiṣṭa eva vajryate, metaraḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ satiśiṣṭe na vyavasthā? ityata āha - `yo hi` ityādi| kathametajjñāyate? ityāha - `tathā hi` ityādi| `gopāyati` iti| atrāyapratyayasya pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam| sa ca svaro dhātusvarasyāpavādo'pi sannāyapratyayāntasya dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ punastena dhātusvareṇa satiśiṣṭena bādhyate| `kārṣṇottarāsaṅgaputraḥ` iti| bahuvrīhiṃ kṛtvā tatpuruṣaḥ kartavyaḥ| `bahuvrīhisvaraḥ` iti| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] ityādinoktaḥ| pūrvakaṃ jñāpakaṃ cetasa kṛtvā''ha - `vikaraṇasvarastu` ityādi| `vibhaktisvarāt` ityādi| `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80) iti nañudāttaḥ| tatra tatpuruṣa samāse kṛte `tatpureṣe tulyārthaṃ` [[6.2.2]] ityadivā prakṛtasvarādudāttatvameva bhavati| yadā tu nañsvarādvibhaktisavaraḥ prāpnoti nañsvaraśceṣyate, tasmādvibhaktisvaro `balīyāniti vaktavyam| balīyastve sati kiṃ bhavati? ityāha - `atistara ityatra` ityādi| <> [[6.1.166]] ityanena vibhakterudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| tadbalīyastvāt? satiśiṣṭamapi nañsavareṇa bādhyate| vibhaktasvarasya tu - tiruāḥ, trisṛṣvityeṣo'vakāśaḥ| `vibhaktinimittasvarācca` ityādi| vibhaktirnimittaṃ yasya sa svaro vibhaktinimittasvaraḥ| `yasya vibhaktirnimittamāmaḥ` iti| āmo vibhaktinimittatvaṃ, <> [[6.1.199]] ityataḥ sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tasya `yadudāttatvam` ityādinā balīyastvasya phalaṃ darśayati| vibhaktinimittasvarasya - catvāraḥ, anaṅvāha itatyeṣo'vakāśaḥ| `vākye hi` ityādi| devadattaśabda āmantritasvareṇādyudāttatvam, gośabdo hi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tasya <<auto'mśasoḥ>> [[6.1.93]] ityākāro'pi sthānivadbhāvenodātta eva| tathā vibhaktyā sahaikādeśe'pi <> [[8.2.5]] iti vacanāt| abhiśabdo'ntodāttaḥ, tasya `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80), `upasargāścābhivarjam` (phi|sū|4|81) ityādyudāttavidhāne varjitatvāt? prātipadikasvara eva bhavati| āṅupasargasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| ajityeṣa tu loḍantaḥ `tiṅṅatiṅa` [[8.1.28]] iti nidhātenānudāttaḥ| śuklaśabdo hi prātipadikasvareṇāntodātta iti tasya <> [[8.2.5]] iti ṭāpā sahaikādeśe kṛte'ntodātta eva bhavati| evamamipūravatve kṛte veditavyam| tadevaṃ padagrahaṇādvākya ekaikasmin? pade pṛthageva svaro bhavati| yadyanudāttaṃ padamekavarjaṃ bhavati, evaṃ sati yāvat? padasaṃjñā na bhavati tāvadekaṃ varjayitvā pariśiṣṭasyānudāttatvena bhavitavyam, tataśca kuvalyā vikāraḥ, kauvalamityatra <> [[4.3.140]] ityenenāñpratyayo na syāt| yata kuvalaśabdoyaṃ `grāmadīnāñca` (phi|sū|2|38) ityādyudāttaḥ, gaurāditvānṅīṣi vihate'pi padavyapadeśābhāvādādyudāttatvaṃ na parityajatītyāha - `parimāṇārthaṃ cedam` ityādi| padamatra gauṇamabhipretam? na mukhyam; anyathā padādhikāre sati punaḥ padagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāduttarakālaṃ yasya padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati, tadiha padamabhipretamiti veditavyam| asati padagrahaṇe na jñāyate - kiyatāmacāmanudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti| padagrahaṇe tu satyekasmin? pade yāvanto'castāvatāmanudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyeṣo'rtho jñāyate, tasmāt? paramāṇārthamiti| natu subantasya tiṅntasya vā pratipādanārtham| tena prāgeva padavyadaiśādanudāttatvena bhavitavyamiti na bhavati pūrvoktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ| syādetat - yadyapi padamityanena mukhyaṃ padaṃ na pratyāyyate, tathāpi padādhikāreṇa tadiha sannidhāpyata iti tadavastha eva sa doṣaḥ? ityata āha - `padādhikārasya nivṛtiṃta karoti` iti| etat? padagrahaṇaṃ gauṇamarthaṃ pratipādayan? mukhyapadadhikāraṃ nivartayati| tena kimiṣṭaṃ bhavati? ityāha - `tena` ityādi| `tathā ca` iti| evaṃ ca satītyarthaḥ prāgeva padavayapadeśāt svaravidhānatulyakālameva pariśiṣṭatasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti| amumevārthaṃ draḍhayitamāha - `garbhiṇī` ityādi| garbho'syā astītīniḥ, `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp| garbhaśabdo'yaṃ kuvalaśabdavadādyudāttaḥ| tatra yadīnipratyayasyodāttatvasamakālamevānudāttatvaṃ bhavati tato garbhiṇīśabdasyānudātatāditvāt? `anudātatāderañ? [[4.2.44]] ityañ? prāpnotīti tadbādhanārthaṃ yujyate tasya bhikṣādiṣu pāṭhaḥ| tasya tūttarakālaṃ padasaṃjñāyāmupajātāyāmavaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ syāt| evaṃ sati garbhiṇī śabda ādyudāttaḥ syāt| tataścāṇo bādhanārta bhikṣādiṣu na paṭhaeta, paṭhate ca| tasmāt? tato vijñāyate - prāgeva padavyapadeśāt? svaravidhisamakālamevāvaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ labdhāyāṃ padasaṃjñāyāmavaśiṣṭasyānudātttve vidhīyamāne kuvalaśabdāvañ? na sidhyati, kathañca garbhiṇīśabdasyānudāttādilakṣamasyāño bādhanārtho bhikṣādiṣu pāṭhaḥ prāgeva padavayapadeśāt? svaravidhisamakālamevāvaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyasyārthasya jñāpakaḥ? ityāha - `kuvalagarbhaśabdau` ityādi| ādyudātttve hranayoryadi padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāmavaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ syāt, kuvalīśabdasya ca syāt? tataśca kuvalīśabdādvikāre'rthe'ñ? na syāt| garbhiṇīśabdasyādyudāttatvādañ? prāpnoti, tatastadbādhanarthaṃ bhikṣādiṣu na paṭhaeta, paṭhate ca, tasmādavasīyate - prāgeva padavyapadeśādavaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavati||`praskaṇvahariścandrau` iti| prakṛṣṭaḥ kaṇvo'syeti prasakaṇvaḥ| hariścandro'syeti hariścandraḥ| vyutpattimātarametat? kṛtam, na tvatrāvayavārtho'sti| rūḍhiśabdau hretau pratyastamitāvayavārthau kvacideva ṛṣiviśeṣe vartete| nanu ca hariścandre `hrasvāccandrottarapade` [[6.1.151]] ityanenaiva suṭ? siddhaḥ, tatkimarthaṃ hariścandragrahaṇam? ityata āha -`hariścandragrahaṇam` ityādi| `prakaṇvaḥ` iti| pragataḥ kaṇvo'smāditi prakaṇvaḥ| haririva candro'syeti haricandraḥ||`uñchaḥ, mlecchaḥ, jañjaḥ, jalpaḥ` iti| `uchi uñche (dhātupāṭhaḥ-295) `mleccha avyaktāyāṃ vāci` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1662), `jaja jaji yuddhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-242,243), `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-397,398)| jañjeḥ kutvābhāvo nipātanāt| `japo vyadha ityavantau` iti| tatra `vyaghajaporanupasarge` [[3.3.61]] ityabantatvam| badhaśabdo hi <> [[3.3.76]] iti| `tayordhātusavaraḥ prāptaḥ` iti| `dhātoḥ` [[6.1.156]] ityudāttatvam| `vyadhaḥ` iti| `vyadha tāḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1181)| atrāpi vyadhajaporityabantatvam, pūrvavaddhātusvaraḥ prāptaḥ| `kālaviśeṣe` iti| kṛtadvāparādau| `rathādyupakaraṇe ca` iti| ādiśabdena halādegrrahaṇam| `garaḥ` iti| `gṛ nigaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1410)| `ṛdorap` [[3.3.57]] ityabantaḥ| `viṣam` ityanena dūṣyaśabdasya viśeṣe vṛtiṃta darśayati| `anyatrādyudātta eva` iti| dhātusvareṇa| `vedavegaveṣṭabandhāḥ` iti| `vida jñāne (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1064) `vicir? pṛthagabhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1442) `veṣṭa veṣṭane` (dhāyapā|255) `bandha bandhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1508)| ebhyo yathāyogaṃ paryādyupasargapūrvebhyaḥ kvip, prādasamāsaḥ| `anyatra madhyodāttaḥ` iti| vartaniśabdo hi `arttisṛghṛ` (da|u|1|2) ityato'nipratyaye'nuvartamāne `vṛteśca` (da|3.1.6) ityanena `vṛtu vartane (dhātupāṭhaḥ-758) ityetasmādanipratyayamutpādya vyutpādyate| tasmāt? pratyayasvareṇa madhyodātto bhavati| `daraḥ` iti| `dṛ vidāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1493) ṛkārāntatvādabantaḥ| `sāmbatāpau bhāvagrarhāyām` iti| sahāmbayā vartata iti sāmbaḥ, <> [[6.2.1]] iti prakṛtisvareṇa sahaśabdasya `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80) ityudāttatve prāpte bhāvagarhāyāmantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| sāmbo bhikṣate| bhikṣaṇamatra bhāvagrarhā| tapanaṃ tāpaḥ `tapa santāpe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-985) ityasmādghañ| ādyudāttatve prāpte vacanam| tāpo dasyūnāṃ dhārmikeṣu bhāvagarhāyāmiti kim? sāmbastiṣṭati, tāpo mahān? grīṣmasya| anayorādyudāttatvameva| `uttamaśaāttamau` iti| etau tamappratyayānto| pittvāt? pratyayasyānudāttatve ucchabdasya `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80) ityudāttatvamityata ādyudāttatve prāpte'ntodāttārthamuttamaśabdaḥ paṭhate| śaācchabdo'pi pratipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tato madhyodāttatve prāpte'ntodāttārthameva paṭhate| `sarvatra` iti| bhāvagarhāyām, anyatra ca| `bhakṣa -mantha` ityādi| `bhakṣa bhakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1557), [bhakṣa adane -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `mantha viloḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-42) `bhujakauṭilye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1417), [bhujo -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `diha upacaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1015)| nanu bhakṣiścurāditvāṇṇyanta iti tat? `erac` [[3.3.56]] ityacā bhavitavyam, tat? kathamasau ghañantaḥ? ityāha -`bhakṣiṇryanto'pi` ityādi| atraiva kāraṇamāha -`erajaṇyantānām` iti||`kumārau` iti| <> [[4.1.20]] iti ṅīp, <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralopaḥ| `kumāraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ` iti| prātapadikasvareṇa| evamuttaratrāpyantodātatatā veditavyā| `ṅīp` iti| `anudāttaḥ` iti| pittvāt| `prāsaṅgyaḥ` iti| `tadvahati` [[4.4.76]] ityādinā prāgghitīyo yat| `prasaṅgaśabdaḥ` ityādi| `ṣanja saṅge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-987) ityasmādghañamutpādya prāsaṅgaśabdo vyutpādyate, tasya <> [[6.2.139]] iti `tatpuruṣe` [[6.2.122]] iti varattamāne <> [[6.2.144]] ityantodāttatvaṃ vihitam, ato|sāvantodāttaḥ| `naitadasti` iti| `udātto luptate` iti yaduktaṃ tasya pratiṣedhaḥ| kasmānnaitadastītyāha -`svarite hi` ityādi| svaravidhisamakālameva śiṣṭasyānudāttattvaṃ bhavatīti prātipadikametat| tasmāt? svarite vidhīyamāne pariśiṣṭasyānudāttatvena bhavitavyam| tat? kuta udāttalopaḥ? na kutaścidityarthaḥ| `tadetat` ityādi| yasmādevamanudāttagrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ na sambhavati, tasmādanudāttagrahaṇametadāderanudāttasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham; anyathā hrasyānarthakyameva syāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamāderanudāttasyodātto na sidhyati, yatastadarthamanudāttagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha -`anta iti hi` ityādi| avadhāraṇamātraṃ draṣṭaṣyam| antasyaiva syāt, nāderityarthaḥ| kva punarāderudāttārthamanudāttagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha -`mā hi dhukṣātām` ityādi| duherluṅ, ātmanepadamātāmāthām, tataśca <<śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ>> [[3.1.45]] iti cleḥ ksādeśaḥ, `tāsyānudātta` [[6.1.180]] ityādinā lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvam, <> [[7.3.72]] ityakāralopaḥ, ksasyākāraḥ pratyayasvareṇodāttaḥ, <> [[8.2.32]] `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam, ghakārasya kakāraḥ, ṣatvam| atrāsatyanudāttagrahaṇa ātāmāthāmākārasyādibhūtasyānudāttatvaṃ na syāt, sati tvasminnākārasyādibhūtasyodāttatvaṃ syāt| hiśabdasya prayoge `hi ca` [[8.1.34]] iti nighātapratiṣedho na syāt| nighāte hi tiṅntasyāsatyudāttalopo na syāt| māṅprayogo'pyaṭaḥ <> [[6.4.74]] iti pratiṣedho yathā syāt| aṭi hi tasyodāttatvāccheṣasyānudāttatvaṃ syāt, tathā ca satyanudāttasthākāralopaḥ syāt, nodāttasya| `bhṛgavaḥ` iti| bhṛgorapatyāni `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇi` [[4.1.114]] ityādinā ṛṣyaṇa, tasya `atribhṛgukutsa` [[2.4.65]] ityādinā bahuṣu luk| nanu cātrāpi vibhaktāvutpannāyāmudāttasya lopaḥ, tasmādihāpi bhavitavyameva? ityata āha -`prāk? subutpatteḥ` ityādi| na hi gotrapratyayasya lugvidhau vibhaktirnimittatvenāśrīyate| tasmāt? prāgeva gotrapratyayasya luk, tato nātrānuvāttatvam| `baidī, aurvī` iti| vidasyāpatyam, urvasyāpatyamiti `anṛṣyānantaryye bidādibhyo'ñ` [[4.1.104]] ityañ, ñitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ `ṭiḍhḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp||`ūrṇoti` iti| adāditvācchapo luk||`bhaṅaguram` ityādau pratyayasvarasyāpavādo'ntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| `kuṇḍināḥ` iti| atra tu sthānivadbhāvaḥ svarasya| kuṇḍinośabdasyāyamādeśaḥ, sa ca pratyayasvareṇa madhyodātta iti tadādeśo'pi madhyodātta eva sāt| kuṇḍamasyāstītīniḥ, tadantāt? striyāṃ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] itī ṅīp| kuṇḍinyā apatyāni bahunīti gargāditvāt? yañ? [[4.1.105]] , tasya bahuṣu luk| pariśiṣṭasya kuṇḍinajādeśaḥ| `citi pratyaye` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyāntodāttatvaṃ labhyate? yathā labhyate tathākhyāyate -iha cita iti samudāyasambandhe'vayavādeṣā ṣaṣṭhī| cito'vayavasya sambandhī yaḥ samudāyaḥ tasyāntodāttatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| atha vā cita iti matvarthīyācpratyayāntametat -cidasyāstīti citaḥ, tasyāntodāttatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| tena prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyāntodāttatvaṃ sidhyati| yadi tarhi cita iti matvarthīyākārapratyayāntametat, tarhi subvyatyayena ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prasaṅge prathamā bhaviṣyati| `bahupaṭavaḥ` iti| īṣadasamāptāḥ paṭava iti `vibhāvā supo bahuc? purastāttu` [[5.3.68]] iti bahuc| `uccakaiḥ` iti| `avyayasarvanāmnāmakac? prākṭeḥ [[5.3.72]] ityakac||`kauñjāyanāḥ` iti| `kuñjādibhyaścphañ` [[4.1.98]] iti cphañantāt? <> [[5.3.113]] ityāgatasya apratyayasya `tadrājasya bahuṣu` [[2.4.62]] ityādinā luk| `kimartham` iti| purveṇaiva siddhamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `paramapi` ityādi| cphaño hi cakāraḥ <> [[5.3.113]] ityatra viśeṣaṇena caritārthaḥ| ñakāro'pi vṛddhau| yadyevaṃ nocyeta tadā paratvānñitsvaraḥ syāt| tasmāttamapi bādhitvāntodāttatvameva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate||pratyayasvarasyāpavādo'yam| `ākṣikaḥ, śālākikaḥ` iti| `tena dīvyati` [[4.4.2]] ityarthe ṭhak||`tiruāstaṣṭhanti` iti| <> [[7.2.99]] iti tiruāādeśaḥ, <> [[7.2.100]] iti ṛkārasya rādeśaḥ| `udāttasvaritayoḥ` ityādi| triśabdaḥ prātapadikasvareṇāntodātta iti tadādeśo'pi tisṛśabdo'ntodātta eva| tatra ṛkārasyāntodāttasya sthāne vihito rapha udāttayaṇ? na bhavati| tataḥ parasya jasaḥ `udāttasvaritayoḥ` [[8.2.4]] ityādinā svaritaḥ prāpnoti, ato'syāyamapavādaḥ| atha jasgrahamaṃ kimartham, tisṛke'pyatra mā bhūditi cet? syādetat -triśabdāt? saṃjñāyāṃ kani kṛte tatra ca `tisṛbhāve kanyupasaṃkhyānam` (vā|837) iti tiruāādeśe tisṛketyatrāpi syāt? asati jasgrahaṇa iti naitadasti; nitsvaro'tra bādhako bhaviṣyati| nāprāpate svarāntare tisṛsvara ārabhyate, sa yathaiva `anudāttau suptitau` [[3.1.4]] ityetatsvaraṃ bādhate tathā nitsvaramiti cet? naitadasti; yasmādyena nāprāpte tasya bādhanaṃ bhavati| na cāprāpte `anudāttau suptitau` [[3.1.4]] ityetasmin? tisṛsvara ārabhyate, nitsvare punaḥ prāpte cāprāpte ca| atha vā madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān? vidhīn? bādhante` (vyā|pa|10) ityeva tisṛsvare `anudāttau suptitau` [[3.1.4]] etyetaṃ bādhiṣyate, na nitsvaram| śasādinivṛttyarthaṃ tarhi jasgrahaṇamiti cet? etadapi nāsti; śasi tāvadbhavitavyamevāntodāttena -`udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt? [[6.1.168]] iti| anyāni sarvāṇi bahuvacanāni halādīni, tatra <<ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ>> [[6.1.179]] iti| anyāni sarvāṇi bahuvacanāni halādīni, tatra <<ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ>> [[6.1.179]] iti <> [[6.1.180]] ityudāttatvena bhava#itavyam| bahuvacanaviṣayatvācca tisṛśabdasaya dvivacanaikavacane na staḥ| tatrāntareṇa jasgrahaṇaṃ jasa eva bhaviṣyatītyata āha -`jasgrahaṇam` ityādi| eke bhāṣyakārādayaḥ| asati jasgrahaṇe tisṛ atikrāntāviti prādisamāse kṛte atitiruāāvityatrāpi syāt, tanmā bhūdityeṣa doṣa ityupasamastārthaṃ jasgrahaṇamicchanti||`cateruran` (da|u|8|78) ityuranpratyayāntatvāccatuḥśabda ādyudāttaḥ, tasya hi śasi parato'nenānto dāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| atheha kasmānna bhavati - cataruāḥ paśyeti, cataruāādeśe'pi caturaḥ kṛte sthānivadbhāvena na prāpnoti? ityata āha - `cataruāādeśa` ityādi| cataruāādeśa kṛta ādyudātatanipātanaṃ kariṣyate, sa nipātanasvaraḥ śasi svarasya bādhaka ityādyudāttatvanipātanācyatannaḥ paśyetyatrāyaṃ svaro na bhavati| atha vā purāvāt? <> [[7.2.100]] iti rādeśe kṛta ṛkārasaya tāvanna bhavitavyam| akārasyāpi <> [[1.1.57]] iti yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvadṛkārema vyavadhāne sati na bhavitavyameva| nanu ca `na padāntadvirvacana` [[1.1.58]] ityādinā svaravidhau pratiṣidhyate sthānivadbhāvaḥ? naitadasti; uktaṃ hi tatra `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivat` (kā|vṛ|1.1.59) iti, na cāyaṃ lopājādeśaḥ||sāviti prathamaikavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt? saptamībahuvacanasya vā? ubhayorvā? tatra yadi prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tvāyā tvayi ityatrāpi syāt| bhavati hi yuṣmacchabdasaya <> [[7.2.94]] iti tvādeśe kṛte prathamaikavacane parata ekāctvam| sāmānyenobhayagrahaṇe'pyeṣa doṣaḥ| saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇe nāyaṃ doṣaḥ prasajyet, yuṣmāsvityatra yuṣmacchabdasyānekāctvamityetat? sarvaṃ hmadi kṛtvā''ha -`sāviti saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇam` iti| `yādbhyām` iti| yācchabdācchatrantāt? tṛtīyā| `rājñe` iti| bhavati rājañśabdo bhasaṃjñake parato lope kṛta ekāc, na tula sau rājasviti; tatrānekāctvāt? `vāktarā, vāktamā` iti| taraptamabiti bhavati vā tṛtīyādiḥ, na tu vibhaktiḥ| atha kasmāt? saptamībahuvacanagrahaṇam? ityāha -`saptamībahuvacanasya` ityādi| `tvayā tvayi` iti| yuṣmadasmadoḥ <> [[7.2.91]] <> [[7.2.97]] iti tvādeśaḥ| pariśiṣṭasya `yo'ci` [[7.2.89]] iti yakāraḥ||`indro dadhīcaḥ` iti| dadhyañcatīti `ṛtvik` [[3.2.59]] ityādinā kvin? anunāsikalopaḥ, ṣaṣṭhaekavacanam, `acaḥ` [[6.4.138]] ityakāralopaḥ, `cau` [[6.3.137]] iti dīrghaḥ| `tṛtīyādiḥ` ityādi| yadi sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tadā śaso na syāt; tasyātṛtīyāditvāt| athāpi tṛtīyādigrahaṇaṃ nivarttyata, evamapi sarvanāmasthāne'pi syāt| `pratīcaḥ` iti| pūrveṇa tulyam||`praṣṭhauhaḥ` iti| `vahaśca` [[3.2.64]] iti ṇviḥ, <> [[6.4.132]] ityūṭh, <> [[6.1.89]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `ūṭhyupadhāgrahaṇam` iti| upadābhūta ūḍ? gṛhrate yena tadupadhāgrahaṇam` iti vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kimartham? ityata āha - `iha mā bhūt` iti| tatraidaṃ vyākhyānam - `antodāttāt` [[6.1.163]] ityādisutrādihānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate, tenopadhābhūtādeva bhavitavyamiti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti| `akṣadyuvā` iti| akṣairdīṣyatīti kvip? `cchñoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] iti vakārasyoṭh, yaṇādeśaḥ| `ābhyām` iti| idamastyadādyatvam, <> [[7.2.113]] itīdrūpasya lopaḥ| `atho ābhyām` iti| <> [[2.4.32]] ityaśādeśaḥ| `niśparyantā iha gṛhyante` iti| etadapi pūrvavadvyavasthitavibhāṣayā labhyate, tasyāṃ hi satyāṃ niśparyantebhya eva bhavitavyam| teṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti ta eva gṛhyante| `nipadaḥ` iti| śasi parataḥ pādasya padādeśaḥ| `dataḥ` iti| atrāpi dantaśabdasya dadādeśaḥ| `āsan` iti| atrāsanśabdasya saptamyekavacane'sannityayamādeśaḥ| `udan` iti| atrāpayudakaśabdasyodannādeśa-| `adbhiḥ` iti| pakārasya takāraḥ, tasya jaśtvam - dakāraḥ| `rābhyām` iti| <> [[7.2.85]] ityāttvam||`aṣṭābhiḥ` ityādi| <> [[7.2.84]] ityāttvam| `aṣṭasu` iti| nanu cātrāpi bhavitavyamevātvena, na hi tadvidhau vikalpapratipādakaṃ vacanamasti, nāpi prakṛtam? ityata āha -`idameva` ityādi| yadi hi nityamātvaṃ syādiha dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, vyāvarttyābhāvāt, kṛtātvasya ca ṣaṭsaṃjñāmiti? idameva hi dīrghagrahaṇamaṣṭano jñāpayatīti sambandhanīyam| kathaṃ punajrñāpayati? ityāha -`anyathā hi` ityādi| dīrghagrahaṇaṃ hrevamarthaṃ kriyate -yatrātvaṃ nāsti tatrāyaṃ svaro mā bhūditi| yadi kṛtvapātvasayāṣṭanaḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñā na syāt, tadātvapakṣe ṣaṭsaṃjñāyāmasatyāṃ sāvakāśo'ṣṭanaḥ svaraḥ, tatrāpi ṣaṭsvaraḥ prāpnotīti kṛtvā| tataśca yadi dīrghagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadānavakāśatvādyadātvapakṣe'ṣṭanaḥ svaro na bhavati, tadetarasminnapi pakṣe syāt| atastannivṛttye dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇamarthavadbhavati| kṛtātvasyāṣṭanaḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñāyām -aṣṭānāmityatra `ṣaṭcatubhryaśca` [[7.1.55]] iti nuṭ? siddho bhavati||`tudati, nudati` iti| tudāditvācchaḥ| `lunatī, punatī` iti| `śnābhyasatayorātaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ| pratyayasvareṇa śatrantamihāntodāttaṃ veditavyam| `tasya` ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? <> [[8.2.3]] ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt| `bṛhanmahatoḥ` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipadanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam -`ḍaāśchandasi` [[6.1.172]] ityataḥ siṃhāvalokitanyāyena bahulagrahaṇamupatiṣṭhate, tena bṛhanmahadbhyāmapi bhavatīti||<<udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya>> [[8.2.4]] iti prāpte vacanam| `tṛnnanto'yamādyudātaḥ` iti| nitsvareṇa| `bahutitavā` iti| vahavastitavo yasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ, tayā bahutitaveti| titauśabdo'yaṃ <> [[6.2.175]] ityantodāttaḥ| `nakāragrahaṇaṃ kartavyam` iti| nakāro gṛhrate yena tannakāragrahaṇaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - ihāpi pūrvavadbahulagrahaṇamanuvartate| tenodāttasya sthāne yo nakārastato'pi na bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā - nakārasyātra praśleṣaḥ - halpūrvāt? <> [[6.1.175]] iti, tathā cāyamartho bhavati - udāttayaṇa udāttanakāracceti| tenodāttanakārādapi bhaviṣyatīti| `vākpatnī` iti| patiśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| tatra <> [[4.1.34]] iti nakārāntādeśaḥ, `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp||`brāhṛbandhvā` iti| brāhṛā bandhurasyā iti vigṛhra bahuvrīhiḥ| tasmāt? `ūṅutaḥ` [[4.1.66]] ityūṅ| `tena saha ya ekādeśaḥ so'pyudāttaḥ` iti| <> [[8.2.5]] iti vacanāt| `svaryate` iti| svaritaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| `kuduttarapada` ityādi| ūkāro'tra dātusvareṇāntodāttaḥ| saḥ <> [[6.2.139]] ityudātatastiṣṭhati prakṛtisvareṇa||pitvānmatupo'nudāttatve prāpte'yaṃ vidhirārabhyate| `akṣaṇvatā` iti| akṣamasyāstīti matup, <> [[7.1.76]] ityanaṅ, <> [[8.2.16]] iti nuḍāgamaḥ, pūrvasaya nakārasya <> [[8.2.7]] iti lopaḥ| `śīrṣaṇvatā` iti| śīrṣanniti `śīrṣañśabdaḥ` śīrṣaścandasi` [[6.1.59]] iti nipātitaḥ| `vasuśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| sa hi `bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanidhanimimasjibhya uḥ` (da|u|1|92) iti vartamāne `dhānye nit` (da|u|1|94) ityato nidgrahaṇe `śṛsvṛsvihitrapyasivasihaniklidibandhimanibhyaśca` (da|u|1|95) iti vyutpādyate| tena nitsvareṇādyudātto bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati - maruto'sya santi marutvāniti, marucchabdo'pi `mṛgrerutiḥ (da|u|6|1) ityutipratyayāntatvāt? pratyayasvareṇāntodātta ityastyatra prāptiḥ, ato nakārema vyavadhānānna bhavatīti cet? na; tasya luptatvāt| athāpi svarasiddhau nalopasyāsiddhatvam? evamapi `svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavat` (vyā|pā|37) iti nāsti vyavadhānam? ityata āha - `svarividhau` ityādi| kathaṃ punajrñāyate - nāśrīyata iti? nuṅgrahaṇāt| nuḍāgamo hrayaṃ matupa eva bhakta iti tadgrahaṇenaiva gṛhrate| yadyeṣā paribhāṣā''śrīyeta, tadā nakārasya vyañjanasyāvidyamānatvād? hrasvādityeva sidhyati nuṅgrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtaṃ ca| tato jñāyate - neyamiha paribhāṣāśrīyata iti| `vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| uttaratrāpi vaktavyaśabdasyāyamevārthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvavadbahulagrahaṇānuvṛttimāśritya kartavyam||`nām` iti| sanuṭkasya ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya grahaṇam| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ matupā hrasvo viśeṣyate? ityāha -`anyathā hi` ityādi| samprati bhavaḥ sāmpratikaḥ, adhyātmāditvaṭṭhañ| `tisṛṇām` iti| atra <> [[6.4.4]] iti dīrghatvapratiṣedhāt? sāmpratikaḥ, adhyātmāditvaṭṭhañ| `tisṛṇām` iti| atra <> [[6.4.4]] iti dīrghatvapratiṣedhāt? sāmpratika eva hrasvo vidyate| na tu sāmpratike sati bhūtapūrvagatiryuktā| atra yadi matupā hrasvo na viśeṣyeta? iha naiva syāt -agnīnāmiti| `nāmi` [[6.4.3]] iti dīrghatve kṛte na syāt; hrasvābhāvāt| tasmādbhūtapūrve'pi hrasvo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ matupā hrasvo viśeṣyate| `dhenvām, śakaṭyām` iti| yadi sanuṭkasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadānīṃ saptamyādeśasyāpyāmo grahaṇaṃ syāt, tataśca dhenvāmityādāvapi syāt| sanuṭkasya grahaṇe tuna bhavati, tasminnasati dhenuśakaṭiśabdayoḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttayorantyasya yaṇādeśe kṛte <> [[6.1.174]] ityādanāntodātto nityo bhavati| `trapūṇām` iti| trapuśabdo vasuśabdavadādyudāttaḥ||`antodāttādityetannivṛttam` iti| yadyetadanuvarteta, pañcānām, saptānām, caturṇāmityatra na syāt| pañcādīnāṃ śabdādīnāṃ `nraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ (phi|sū|2|28) ityudāttatvāt? `nraḥ` iti rephanakārāntayoḥ saṃkhyāśabdayogrrahaṇam||`triprabhṛtīnāmantyamuttamam` iti| uttamaśabdasyāvyutpannasyeha grahaṇam| sa ca svabhāvāt? triprabhṛtīnāmantyamāheti kṛtvā| `tatsamīpe yat? tadupottamam` iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādinā'vyayībhāvaḥ||pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam||`sau` iti| prathamaikavacanasya suśabdasya grahaṇaṃ vā syāt?
