saptamī bahuvacanasya vā? tatra yadi saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, kebhyaḥ, tebhya ityatra na syāt, kiṃtacchabdayoḥ saptamībahuvacane parato nāvarṇāntatvamupapadyate; kṛte'pi tyādādyatve `bahuvacane jhalyet? [[7.3.103]] ityettvavidhānāt| prathamaikavacanasya tu grahaṇe satyatrāpi bhavati| tasmādasaptamyāṃ eva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti matvā''ha -`prathamaikavacane yadavarṇāntam` iti| anantaramiha pratiṣedhyaṃ na bhavatīti sarvasya ṣāṣṭhikasvarasya pratiṣedho'yaṃ vijñāyata itatyāha -`ityetebhyo yaduktaṃ tanna bhavati` iti| śobhanā gāvo'syeti suguḥ, `gostriyoḥ` [[1.2.48]] ityādinā hrasvaḥ, <> [[6.2.172]] ityuttarapadasyāntodāttatvam| `śunā` iti `āyuvamaghonāmataddhite` [[6.4.133]] iti samprasāraṇam| `pūrvavat? prāptiḥ` iti| śunā, ābhyāmityatra <> [[6.1.168]] ityādinā prāptiḥ| `paramaśunā` iti| atrāti <> [[6.1.169]] ityantodāttatvaṃ tu samāsasvareṇa| `rājā, paramarājaḥ` iti| atrāpi pūrvavatprāptiḥ| `añcatiḥ kvinnantaḥ` iti| yadyevam, tarhi tatra nakāralopena na bhavitavyaṃ tasyaiva sanakārasya grahaṇaṃ kartavyam| kimarthaṃ sanakārasya grahaṇam? ityāha -`tasya` ityādi| etadapi kimartham? ityāha -`yatrāsya` ityādi| nanu ca sarvatraiva lopena bhavitavyam, tat? kathaṃ nalopasyābhāvaḥ ityāha -`nāñceḥ` ityādi| `prāñcā` iti| pūrvavat? prāpatiḥ| prāñcatīti kvin| `prācā` iti| pūrvavallopadīrghatve| `kruñcā` iti| `kruca kruñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ` [ kutva krucca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-185,186), kvin? kruñceti nipātanānnalopābhāvaḥ| `paramakruñcā` iti| samāsasvareṇāntodāttatvam| `paramakṛtā` iti| atrāpi| `kṛtirvā` iti| `kṛtī chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1435) ityeṣaḥ||nṛśabdāt? <> [[6.1.168]] iti, `na goānsāvarṇa` [[6.1.176]] iti nitye pratiṣedhe ca prāpte vibhāṣeyamārabhyate||`cikīṣryam, jihīṣryam` iti, `na goānsāvarṇa` [[6.1.176]] iti nitye pratiṣedhe ca prāpte vibhāṣeyamārabhyate||tāsiprabhṛtīnāṃ samāhāradvandvena nirdeśaḥ| `adrupadeśāt` iti| upadiśyata ityupadeśaḥ, śāstravākyeṣu khilapāṭhe ca yaḥ prathamamuccāryate sa ityarthaḥ| accāsāvupadeśaścetyadupadeśaḥ| karmasādhanasyopadeśaśabdasyāśrayaṇam, bhāvasādhanasya vā, nānena sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ| `lasārvadhātukam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `adupadeśāt` iti| pūrvavat? karmasādhanenopadeśaśabdena karmadhārayaḥ| varṇagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayatityakārantopadeśādityarthaḥ| `kartā` iti| karoterluṭ, ātmanepadaparathamapuruṣaḥ, tasya ḍāraurasaḥ| ekavacane ṭerlopaḥ| dvivacanabahuvacanayoḥ `ri ca` [[7.4.51]] iti sakārasya| `āste` ityevamādiṣu `śete` ityevaṃparyanteṣvadāditvācchapo luk| `vaste` iti| `vasa ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1023)| `sūte` iti| `ṣūṅ? prāṇigarbhavimocane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1031)| `śete` iti| śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ` [[7.4.21]] iti guṇaḥ| `tudataḥ nudataḥ` iti| tasante ete| evaṃ `pacataḥ, paṭhataḥ` ityete api| nanu ca vyañjanānto'yamupadeśe śap, nakārāntaḥ, tat? kathamihānudāttatvaṃ bhavati? ityāha -`anubandhasya` ityādi| ekāntaḥ=ekadeśaḥ; naikānto'nekāntaḥ, tadgrahaṇena gṛhrata iti yāvat, anekāntasya bhāvo'nekāntatvam| tato hetorakārāntopadeśa eva śap, na vyañjanāntaḥ| tena pacate -ityādāvanudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| akārāntatvaṃ tu śabakārasya vyapadeśivadbhāvāt| `pacamānaḥ, yajamānaḥ` iti| śānac| kathaṃ punarihānudāttatvam, yāvatā mukā'tra vyavadhānam? ityāha -`yadyatra` ityādi| mugāgamo'yamakāramātrasya vā syāt? akārāntāṅgasya vā? tatra yadyakāramātrasya tadā'dupadeśagrahaṇenaiva tasya grahaṇamiti lasarvadhātukamadupadeśādanantarameva bhavati, vyavadhānābhāvāt, na hi svāvayavo vyavadhāyako bhavati| tenāntaraṅgatvāt? siddho nighātaḥ| `atha` ityādinā dvitīye pakṣe nidhātasyāsiddhatvāt? pratipādayati -`tathāpi` iti| evamapītyarthaḥ| lasarvadhātukasyetyasya siddho nighāta iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| `asiddhaḥ` ityasyāpi mugityanena prakṛtena| itikaraṇo hetau| tadayamarthaḥ -yasmāllasārvadhātukānudātte bahiraṅgatvānma#ugasiddhaḥ, tasmādevamapi sārvadhātukasyānudāttatvam| bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu muko bahvapekṣatvāt| sa hrakārāntaviśiṣṭamaṅgamāśrayati, ānañca pratyayaviśeṣam| aṅgāvayavamadupadeśaṃ lasārvadhātukāmātraṃ nidhātaḥ| tasmādasāvantaraṅgaḥ| svaravidhitvācca, ukagtaṃ hi svaravidherbhāvye'ntarahgattvam| nanu cādye pakṣe muki kṛte nighāto na sidhyati, adupadeśāditi taparakaraṇāt, muki ca kṛte kālasyātiricyamānatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyavamapi kṛte'rdhamātrādhikā bhavati, tathāpyupadeśagrahaṇāt? sidhyatyeva, upadeśe mātrikasyaivoccāraṇāt| `citsvaro'pyanena` ityādi| citsvarasyāvakāśaḥ -<> [[3.2.148]] calanam, copanamiti, tāsyādibhyo'nudāttasyāvakāśaḥ -āste, śeta iti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti -pacamāno yajamāna iti paratvāllasārvadhātukānudāttatvameva citsvaraṃ bāghitvā pravartate| `cinutaḥ, cinvanti` iti| nu <> [[1.2.4]] iti śnurapi ṅideva, tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupapadyate? ityāha -`ṅidayam` ityādi| <> [[1.2.4]] ityanena pūrvasya kāryamatidiśyate, na parasya| tathā coktam -siddhaṃ tu pūrvasya kāryātideśāditi| tasmāt? pūrvasya kāryaṃ prati ṅitvaṃ bhavati, na tu parasyeta kimatra nopapadyate| `iha ca` ityādi| pacāvaḥ pacāmaḥ ityatra hi <> [[7.3.101]] iti dīrghatve kṛte na syāt? asatyupadeśagrahaṇe| tasmastu sati śabakāro'pi mātrika evopadiṣṭa iti yadyapyuttarakāla dīrghatvaṃ bhavati tathāpi nighāto na bhavatīti| `iha ca mā bhūditi -hataḥ; hatha` iti| atra `anudāttopadeśa` [[6.4.37]] ityādinā'nunāsikalope satyupadeśātparaṃ lasārvadhātukaṃ bhavati, tatrāsatyupadeśagrahaṇa ihāpi syāt| asmistu sati na bhavati, na hi hantiravarṇānta upadiśyate| kiṃ tarhi? vyañjanāntaḥ| `pacamānāḥ` iti| <> [[3.2.129]] na ca sa lādeśaḥ, api tu pratyayaḥ| lasarvadhātukatvaṃ tvasya na vidyate| `śiśye` iti| śīṅo hrātmanepade rūpam, `eranekācaḥ` [[6.4.82]] ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| `liṭ? ca` [[3.4.115]] ityārdhadhātukametat| `śiśyāte` iti| liṭaātāmi rūpam| nānudāttatvam, asārvadhātukasaṃjñāvidhānāt| `hyu te, yadadhīte` iti| `hyu ṅ? apanayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1082) `iṅ? adhyayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1046) yacchabdasya prayogaḥ `nipātaiyaidyadi` [[8.1.30]] iti nighātapratiṣedho yathā syāt||`mā hi kārṣṭām` iti| heḥ, māṅaśca prayogo prayojanaṃ pūrvamevoktam| `aparo'ntodāttaḥ` iti| pratyayasvareṇa| `aparo madhyodāttaḥ` iti| pratyayasvareṇaiva| nanu ca valādiriha pratyayaḥ, iṭ? cāgamaḥ, āgamānāṃ cānudāttatvaṃ bhavati, tasmādihāpyantodāttenaiva bhavitavyam, tat? kathaṃ madhyodāttatvam? ityāha - `sicaścitkāraṇāt` ityādi| sicaścitkaraṇenānudāttatve bādhite citsvara eva bhavatīti yuktaṃ madhyodāttatvam| `sica ādyudātta` ityādi| sica ādyudāttatve kartavye'niṭo vidyamāno sicaḥ paro yaścitpratyayastasyodāttatvaṃ vaktavyam| `mā hi kārṣam` iti| pakṣe sarvānudāttaṃ padaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamidam| pakṣe tūdāttatvena mukte sarvānudāttameva padaṃ bhavati||`sārvadhātukagrahaṇam` ityādi| `aci` ityetat? saptamyantaṃ lasārvadhātukasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśaṣaṇam, na ca prathamāntasya saptamyantena sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate| tasmāt? `aci` ityanena sambandhādviviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyalakṣaṇāllasārvadhātukagrahaṇādityāha -`saptamyantamupajāyate| `svapādirā vṛtkaraṇāt` iti| yadyapyetadevam, tathāpi `ñiṣvap? śaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1068) `āsa prāṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1069), `ana ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1070) ityeta eva ye, te iha svapādigrahaṇena gṛhyante| pare'pi ye jakṣityādayo'bhyastasaṃjñāḥ, teṣu paratvāt? <> [[6.1.189]] ityanena nityamādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `hiṃsanti` iti| `tṛha hisi hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1455,1456), rudhāditvāc? śnam, <<śnasorallopaḥ>> [[6.4.111]] ityakāralopaḥ <<śnānnalopaḥ>> [[6.4.23]] iti parasya nakārasya| `svapyāt` iti| liṅ? adāditvācchapo luk| `svapitaḥ` iti| <> [[7.2.76]] itīṭ||pratyayasvareṇa prāpte tadapavādo'bhyastānāṃ dhātūnāmādervidhīyate| dadhatītyādau `śnābhyastayorātaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ, <> [[6.1.5]] ityabhyastasaṃjñā| `jakṣati, jāgrati` iti| atrāpi <> [[6.1.6]] iti sarvatra `adabhyastāt` [[7.1.4]] iti jheradādeśaḥ| `jakṣitaḥ` iti| pūrvavadiṭ| athādigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `ādiḥ siconyatarasyām` [[6.1.187]] ityata ādirityanuvartate? ityata āha - `ādiriti vartamāne ityādi| pūrvakaṃ hrādigrahaṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sambaddham, atastanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmānnityarthaṃ punarādigrahaṇaṃ kriyate||anajādyarthamidam| ajādau tvanudātte pūrvaṇaiva siddham| `jihīte, mimīte` iti| atra `tāsyanudāttet` [[6.1.180]] ityādinā lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvam| `bhṛñāmit` [[7.4.76]] ityabhyāsasyettvam| `anudātte` iti śāstrīyasyānudāttasyāyaṃ nirdeśa iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt? atastannirāsārthamāha -`anudātta ti bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ` iti avidyamānamudāttamasminnityanudāttam| kimarthaṃ punarbahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ? ityāha -`lopapaṇādeśārthaḥ` iti| lopayaṇādeśayoḥ kṛtayorapyādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| `mā hi sma dadhāt| dadhātyatra` iti| smaśabdasya prayogaḥ smottare laṅ? yathā syāt| atra yadi śāstrīyasyāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ syāt, `itaśca` [[3.4.100]] itīkāralāpe kṛte yaṇādeśe codāttaṃ na syāt, śāstrīyasyānudāttasyābhāvāt| bahuvrīhinirdeśe cātrāpi bhavati; udāttasyehāvidyamānatvāt||`iṣśībhyāṃ van? (da|u|8|126) iti prakṛtya `sarvanīdhṛdhariṣvalaṣvaśivapaṭvapreṣvā asvatantre` [`sarvanidhṛṣvariṣvaliṣpaśipahrasvapadvapraheṣvā atantre` -da|u|] (da|u|8|127) iti sarvaśabdo'ntodātto nipātitaḥ| tena tasya supyādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| antodāttatvanipātanaṃ tu sarvasya vikāraḥ sārvaṃ ityatra <> [[4.2.44]] yathā syāt| `pratyayalakṣaṇenāpi` ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate, yāvatā sarvastoma ityatra <> [[2.4.71]] iti lumatā luptam, tataśca <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣalasya pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvartate, sa ca samuccayārthaḥ| tena pratiṣedhaviṣaye'pyeṣa svaro bhaviṣyati| `sarvasvaro'nakackasya` ityādi| yo'yaṃ sarvaśabdasya svaro vidhīyate sa tasyāvidyamānākackasya bhavatītyetadartharūp vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -<<ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām>> [[6.1.187]] ityato'nya tarasyāṃgrahaṇamiha maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānurtate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tenānakackasya bhavati||<> [[6.1.190]] ityādyudātte prāpte pratyayāt? pūrvasya bhīhyaprabhṛtīnāmudātto vidhīyate|`lakāretsaṃjñake` iti| lakāra itsaṃjñako yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `cikīrṣakaḥ` iti| sannantāṇṇvul| tatra <> [[6.4.48]] itkāralope kṛte ṇvulaḥ pūrvasyekārasyodāttatvam| `bhaurikavidham` iti <> [[4.2.54]] iti vidhalpratyayaḥ| bhaurikirviṣayo deśa iti `aiṣukāribhaktam` aiṣukārirviṣayo deśa iti| pūrvasūtreṇaiva bhaktalpratyayaḥ||litsvare prāpte ṇamuli parata ādyudāttatvaṃ vikalpena vidhīyate| tena mukte pakṣe litsvaro'pi bhavatyeva| anekācaśca dhātavo vikalpaṃ prayojayantīti| ye tvekācasteṣāṃ litsvareṇānena vā viśeṣo nāsti| `loluyaṃ lolūyam, `popūyampopūyam` iti| yadantāṇṇamul, tasya `ābhīkṣṇe dve bhavataḥ` (vā|887) iti dvirdacanam| `anudāttaṃ ca [[8.1.3]] ityāmreḍitasyānudāttatvam||`kartṛyaki` iti| sārvadhātukaṃ kartṛśabdenoktam| abhidhāne'bhidheyopacārāt| tatra yaḥ kartari yak? sa kartṛyak, `saptamī` [[2.1.40]] iti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| `lūyate kedāraḥ svayameva` iti| lunāti kedāraṃ devadattaḥ, kedāro lavanakriyayā vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt? karma| yadā tu saukāryāt? tasyaiva karttṛtvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā'sau kartā bhavati; `karmavat? karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ` [[3.1.87]] ityatideśāt? yagātmanepadañca| `stīryate` iti| `stṛ ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1252) [stṛñ? ācachādane -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] <<ṝta iddhātoḥ>> [[7.1.100]] , `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] itī dīrghaḥ| `lasārvadhātukanighāte kṛte` iti| `adupadeśabhaktayaka eva svaro bhavati` iti| pratyayalakṣaṇaḥ| atheha kathaṃ bhavati -jāyate svayameva, sāyate svayameva, khāyate svayameveti, yāvatā <> [[6.4.43]] ityātve kṛte satyuttarakālaṃ janādayo'jantā bhavanti, na tūpadeśa? ityāha -`janādanām` ityādi| janādīnāṃ hrātvavidhāvanudāttopadeśagrahaṇamanuvartate| tena teṣāmupadeśa evāttvaṃ draṣṭavyam| `jāyate svayameva` iti| kathaṃ punarakarmakartā, yāvatā janirakarmakaḥ? antarbhāvitaṇyarthaṃ sakarmako bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `lūyate kedāro devadattena` iti| atra śuddhakarmaṇyātmanepadavidhānāt? kartṛyagna bhavati||`anyatarasyām` [[6.1.188]] ityanuvartamāne vāgrahaṇaṃ kāryiṇo vikalpārtham| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena kāryaṃ vikalpyate vāgrahaṇena tu kāryiṇaḥ| teneḍādayaḥ paryāyeṇa kārya pratipadyante| `lulavitha` iti| krādiniyamādiṭ| `yayātha` iti| `acastāsvatthalyaniṭo nityam` [[7.2.61]] itīṭo vā pratiṣedhaḥ||`vāsudevakaḥ` iti| vāsudeve bhaktirasyetyarthe vun| atheha gargā, vidā iti <> [[2.4.64]] iti bahuṣu luki kṛte, cañceva cañcetyatra ca <> [[5.3.96]] ityutpannasya kanaḥ <> [[5.3.98]] iti lupi kṛte kasmānna bhavati, lupte'pi pratyaye `pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam? [[1.1.62]] ityasti prāpti? ityata āha - `pratyayalakṣaṇamatra neṣyate` iti| tat? kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo na bhavati? <> [[6.1.204]] ityatra vakṣyamāṇājjñāpakāt| atha vā <> [[1.1.63]] ityanena yannāma kiñcidaṅgasya kāryamaṅgādhikāre vihitameva, tena pratiṣedhādiha pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ svīkāryaṃ na bhaviṣyati| evamuttarātrāpi pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvo veditavyaḥ| `yañi kani ca lupte` iti| cakārādvidādhañi ca||`devadatt` iti| dadāteḥ <> [[3.3.174]] ityāśivi ktaḥ, `vo vad? ghoḥ` [[7.4.46]] iti dhātordadādeśaḥ| dattaśabdasya devaśabdena <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsaḥ| `sapirāgaccha` iti| `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] iti vibhakterluk| `saptāgacchata` iti| atrāpi `ṣaṅbhyo luk` [[7.1.22]] iti ca||`pathimathiśabdo` ityādi| `gameriniḥ` (da|u|6|57) ityata inipratyaye vartamāne `manthaḥ` (da|u|6|62) itīnipratyayaḥ, ato mathiñśabdo vyutpādyate, `parame kit` (da|u|6|61) ityataḥ kidgrahaṇānuvṛttermanatheranunāsikalopaḥ| `patastha ca` (da|u|6|63) iti pathiñśabdo'pīnitpratyayānta iti tenetau pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau| `panthāḥ` iti| <> [[7.1.85]] ityakarāntādeśaḥ| `ito't? sarvanāmasthāne` [[7.1.86]] itīkārasyāttvam, <> [[7.1.87]] iti thasya nthādeśaḥ|`pathaḥ paśya` iti| <> [[7.1.88]] iti ṭilopaḥ| tatra kṛte <> [[6.1.161]] ityantodāttatvam| `pathipriyaḥ` iti| panthāḥ priyo yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `vā priyasya` (vā|114) iti priyaśabdasya pakṣe paranipātaḥ||`kartavā` [`kartavai` iti kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `kṛtyārthe tavaikenkenyatāvanaḥ` [[3.4.14]] iti tavaipratyayaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ paryāyanivṛttaye yatnaḥ kriyate? ityāha -`ekavarjam` ityādi||`kṣayaḥ` iti| `kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1407) ityasyedaṃ rūpamiti||`jayaḥ` iti| `ji jri abhibhave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-946,947) ityasya jayate rūpametat| `jayo brāāhṛṇānām` iti| bhāve `erac` [[3.3.56]] ||`vṛṣaḥ, janaḥ, jvaraḥ, grahaḥ, hayaḥ, gayaḥ` iti| `vṛṣu mṛṣu secane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-706,707) `janī prādurbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1149) `jvara roge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-776) `graha upādāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1533) `hi gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1257) `kai gai` śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-916,917) `sarvaṃ ete'cpratyayāntāḥ` iti| pacāditvāt| etena citsvare prāpte pāṭha eṣāmiti darśayati| `nayaḥ, tayaḥ, ayaḥ, aṃśaḥ, vedaḥ, sūdaḥ, aśaḥ` iti| `ṇīñ? prāpaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-901) `tāyṛ santānapālanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-489) kvacit? `tayaḥ` ityasya sthāne `cayaḥ` iti paṭhate, sa cinotedrraṣṭavyaḥ| `iṇ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1045)| atha vā aya vaya maya caya (dhātupāṭhaḥ-474)-478) ityādeḥ| `aṃśa samādhāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1918), `vida jñāne` `(dhātupāṭhaḥ-1064) `ṣūda rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1717) `aśa bhojane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1523)| `sūdaḥ -igupadheti kapratyayāntaḥ` iti| `ete'pi` iti yaduktam, tasyāyamapavādaḥ| `guha` iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-896)|`śamaraṇau saṃjñāyām` iti| `śam? upaśame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1201) `aṇa raṇa` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-444,445) iti śabdārthaḥ| saṃjñāyā anyatrāntodāttādeva bhavataḥ| `sammatau bhāvakarmaṇoḥ` iti| śamaraṇāditi vartate| sammatāvarthe vivakṣite śamaraṇau bhāvakarmaṇoryathākramamādyudāttau bhavataḥ| `mantraḥ` iti| `matri guptabhāṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1679) kecittu -`sammatau bhāvakarmaṇormaṇormantraḥ` iti paṭhanti| tasya mantre viṣayībhūta ityeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| `śāntiḥ` iti| `śamu upaśame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1201) <> [[3.3.174]] iti ktic| `kāmaḥ, yāmaḥ` iti| `kamu kārtau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-443) `yama uparame` (dhā|pā984)| `ghañantau` iti| `karṣātvato dhaño'nta udāttaḥ` [[6.1.159]] ityetasmin? prāpte'sya pāṭhaḥ| `kalpaḥ` iti| `kṛpū sāmarthye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-762)| `pādaḥ` iti| `pada gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1169)| `vṛṣādirākṛtigaṇaḥ` iti| tadeva cākṛtigaṇatvaṃ jñāpayituṃ cakāraḥ kṛtaḥ||`yadyevam` iti| yadi kano lubityarthaḥ, kano'pu lupi satyapi pratyayalakṣaṇenaiva siddhameṣāṃ hi nitsvareṇādyudāttatvam, tadapārthakamityabhiprāyaḥ| `etadeva` ityādi| yadi hi kvacit? svaravidhau pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ syāt, kartavyamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt| pratyayalakṣaṇena siddhatvāt, kṛtañca| tasmādetajjñāpayati - pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ syāt, kartavyamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt| pratyayalakṣaṇena siddhatvāt, kṛtañca| tasmādetajjñāpayati - pratyayalakṣaṇamiha svaravidhau na bhavatīti| kvacidgrahaṇaṃ kvacittu bhavatīti pradarśanārtham, tathā hi <> [[6.1.191]] ityatroktam - pratyayalakṣaṇenāpyayaṃ svara iṣyata iti| `tathā ca` ityādinā jñāpanasya prayojanamāha| `agnirmāṇavakaḥ` iti| bhavatyagniśabda upamānam| tathā hragnireveti gamyate, nāsau māṇavakasya saṃjñā||`guptaḥ` iti `gupū rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-395)| `buddhaḥ` iti| `budha avagamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-858)| `devaḥ` iti| devaśabdaḥ pacādyajantatvādantodāttaḥ| bhīmaśabdo'pi magantatvāt? [[6.1.218]] ityato'nayatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate; sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena nañkunipātānāmeva bhaviṣyatīti| `svātvākālakaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.72]] samāsaḥ <> [[1.1.40]] iti pūrvapadasyāvyayatvam| `muhūrtasukham` ityādau <> [[2.3.5]] iti dvitīyā| `sarvarātraśabdo'pyacpratyāntaḥ` iti| sarvā ca rātriśceti `pūrvakālaika` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā samāse `ahaḥ sarvaika` [[5.4.87]] ityādinācapratyayavidhānāt||`ruhe raśca lo vā` iti| atra `hmaśyābhyāmitan` (da|u|6|12) itītano'nuvartanāt| `paramakṛṣṇaḥ` iti| atra samāsāntodāttatvameva||`śambagādham` iti| gādhyata iti gādhaḥ, `gādhṛ `pratiṣṭhālipsayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-4) [pratiṣṭhālipsayogrranthe ca -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ardharcāditvāt? [[2.4.31]] pakṣe napuṃsakatvam| `artilūdhūsū` iti| anena sūtraikadeśena <> [[3.2.184]] ityetatsūtramupalakṣyate| `madhyodāttaḥ` iti| pratyayasvareṇa| `aśūpruṣi` iti| `aśūpruṣilaṭikaṇighaṭiviśibhyaḥ kan` (da|u|8|125) [aśūpruṣipluṣilaṭikaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhya) kvan -da|u|] iti sūtramupalakṣayati| nanu cāyāmaḥ=pramāṇam, `āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syāt` iti vacanāt; na ca śambagādhamityādistatpuruṣaḥ pramāṇavācī, kiṃ tarhi, iyattāvācī? ityāha -`pramāṇam` ityādi| iyato bhāva iyattā, sā paricchidyate yena sa iyattāparicchedaḥ, sa evātra pramāṇaṃ veditavyam| na punarāyāma eva| tat? katham? pramīyate'neneti pramāṇamiti kriyāśabdo'tra pramāṇaśabdo gṛhrate, na tu rūḍhiśabdaḥ; lakṣyānurodhāt| tena yeneyattā paricchidyate tat? sarvaṃ pramāṇam| `svaravyaṅgyaṃ ca` iti| asya svare yo'yaṃ prakṛtibhāvo vidhīyate tena vyaṅgyaṃ dyotyamityartha-| `eteṣām` iti| śambagādhādīnām||dāyaḥ=bhāgaḥ, aṃśa ityarthaḥ| dāyamādatta iti dāyādaḥ| mūlavibhujāditvāt? kaḥ (vā|232)| dāyādasya karma dāyādyam| kiṃ punastat? dāya eva| sa hi dāyādirādīyamānaḥ karma bhavati| `udātta iti ca tanna vartate` iti| `mantre vṛṣa` [[3.3.96]] ityādeḥ sūtrāt| nanu ca nipūrvaḥ sūtre dhāturudāttaḥ tat? kathaṃ kevalādbhavati? ityāha -`bahulavacanāt` ityādi| yadi `svāmīārādhipati` [[2.3.39]] ityādinā ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate| saptamyeva hi vidhātavyā, na ṣaṣṭhī, tasyāḥ `śeṣe` [[2.3.50]] ityeva siddhatvāt? ityata āha -`tasyāstu` ityādi| yadi saptamyeva vidhīyate, tato'sau viśeṣavihitatvāt? ṣaṣṭhaā bādhikā vijñāyeta, na tvevaṃ vijñāyeteti punaranayaiva śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhabhyanujñāyate, na tvapūrvā vidhīyate| tenāpratipadavihitatvādbhavatyeva samāsaḥ| `paramadāyādaḥ` iti| atra pūrvapadaṃ pūjāvāci, na dāyādyavāci||kāryasidiṃdha prativadhnāti vihantīti pratibandhi| tācchīlya āvaśyake vā ṇiniḥ| `viśeṣaṇasamāse kṛte` iti| nanu ca viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇye bhavati; na cedaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, kathaṃ punaratra pūrvapadaṃ pratibandhi bhavati? ityāha -`gamanam` ityādi| acirakālabhāvini gamane kāryasiddhirniṣpadyate| `kṛcchrayogi ca` iti| kṛcchram=duḥkham, tadyogini gamane gantā prāpyamarthaṃ duḥkhenābhihanyamāno na prāpnoti tasmāccirakālabhāvi kṛcchrayogi vā yad? gamanaṃ tat? kāryasiddheḥ pratibandhi jāyate||`vyājaḥ` iti| chadmetyarthaḥ| `mūtrapadena` iti| mūtravyājenetyarthaḥ| `ṣṭranpratyayāntaḥ` iti| `sivimucyoṣṭerūcca` (da|u|8|83) [ṣivimucyoṣṭerū ca-da|u|] ityatra ṣṭrannityasyānuvṛtteḥ| `mūtrayateḥ` iti| `mūtra pararuāvaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1909)| uccāraśabdo'pi ghañantaḥ| ``thāthādi` ityādi| `ghañantatvāt||`kuḍaādihetuke` ityāda| kuḍaādihetuke vartante; kārye kāraṇopacārāt| bhavati kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ, yathā -`sarvamidaṃ purātanaṃ karma bhujayate` iti| `kavateḥ` iti| `ku śabde (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1042)| `ādyudāttaḥ` iti| <<yato'nāvaḥ>> [[6.1.213]] ityanena| `ḍakpratyayāṃnto'ntodātta ityapare` iti| te `kavateḍark` (da|u|8|20) iti sūtramadhīyate||`rajjuśāradam, `dṛṣacchāradam` [dṛṣacchāradāḥ -kāśikā] iti| yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| `śāradaśabdo'ya pratyagravācī` iti| pratyagrambhinavam, acirakālabhāvītyarthaḥ| etena nānārthavācitvaṃ śāradaśabdasya darśayati| `nityasamāsaḥ` iti| mahāvibhāṣāyāḥ prakṛtāyā vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt| `anupahatam` iti| rajobhiḥ| anupahatatvaṃ tu sadyauddhṛtatvāt| `upratyayāntaḥ` iti| `sṛjerasuṃ ca` (da|u|1|100) ityatra `bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanidhanimimasjibhya uḥ` (da|u|1|92) [bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanimimasjibyaḥ uḥ -da|u|] ityata ukārapratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `adipratyayāntaḥ` [adikpratyayāntaḥ -mudritakāśikā, ādipratyayāntaḥ -mudritanyāsaḥ] iti| `dṛṇāteḥ ṣug? hrasvaśca` (da|u|6|45) ityatra `śṛdṛbhaso'diḥ` (da|u|6|42) ityato'dipratyayānuvṛtteḥ|`paramaśāradam` iti| śaradi bhavaṃ śāradam| `sandhivelādyṛtunakṣatrebhyo'ṇ` [[4.3.16]] iti sūtreṇotpanno'yaṃ śabdaḥ||`jātivācino niyataviṣayāḥ` iti| niyato viṣayo yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ| niyataviṣayatvaṃ tu jātiviśeṣatva eva vartamānatvāt| adhvaryuprabhṛtīnām? `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ` (kā|vṛ|4.1.63) iti caraṇatvājjātitvam| `yatpratyayāntaḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.101]] iti| `kaṭhaśabdaḥ pacādyaci vyutpāditaḥ` iti| `kaṭha kṛcchrajīvane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-333) ityasmāt| `tadevam` iti| yasmādedaṃ kālāpaśabdo'ṇantaḥ, tasmāt? pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `ṭhaki satyantodāttaḥ` iti| `kitaḥ` [[6.1.159]] ityanena||`pitṛsadṛśaḥ` iti| `tulyārtheḥ` [[2.3.72]] ityādinā ṣaṣṭhī, tṛtīyā ca, <> [[2.1.31]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `pitṛmātṛśabdāvuṇādiṣvantodāttau nipātitau` iti| `naptṛneṣṭṛtvaṣṭṛhotṛpotṛbhātṛjāmātṛpitṛduhitṛ` (da|u|2|3) ityatra| atha sadṛśagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā mātṛsādṛśa pitṛsadṛśa ityatra `tatpuruṣe tulyārthaṃ` [[6.2.2]] ityeva siddham? ityata āha -`ṣaṣṭhīsamāsārthañca` ityādi| tulyārthe hi prayoge ṣaṣṭhapi vidhīyate| tatra yadā mātṛsadṛśa iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ kriyate, tadapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ sadṛśagrahaṇam| sati tvasyārambhe tṛtīyāsamānase'pi sadṛśagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityata āha -`iha` ityādi| `dāsyāḥ sadṛśaḥ, vṛṣalyāḥ sadṛsa` iti atra <<ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe>> [[6.3.21]] ityaluki kṛte ṣaṣṭhīsamāsastatsadṛśagrahaṇaṃ prayojayati; aluki sati rūpaviśeṣasya vidyamānatvāt| yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsārthaṃ sadṛśagrahaṇamiha kriyate, tṛtīyāsamāso na kartavayaḥ; viśeṣābhāvāt? naitadasti; tatrāpi hi kartavya eva yatra ṣaṣṭharthe nāsti tadarthaḥ, yathā -vidyayā sadṛśo vidyāsadṛśa iti, na hyatra ṣaṣṭhartho vidyate, kiṃ tarhi? tṛtīyārthaḥ, vidyayā hetunā sadṛśa ityarthaḥ| `atra` ityādi| tatra dāsīśabdasya ṅībudāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodāttārthaḥ| `daśi sevane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1786) [dasi āpyāyane -dhā|pā] iti, `daṃśeṣṭaṭanau na ā ca` (da|u|9|103) iti ṭapratyayānto nakārasya cākārādeśaḥ| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp, `yasyeti` [[6.4.148]] lopaḥ <> [[6.1.161]] ityudāttatvam| vṛṣalīśabdaḥ `jāterastrīviṣayāt` [[4.1.63]] iti ṅīṣanto'ntodātto bhavati pratyayasvareṇa||`prācyasaptaśamaḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `prācyaśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| yatpratyayāntatvāt? `yato'nāvaḥ [[6.1.207]] iti| `gāndhāriśabdaḥ kardamāditvādādyudātto madhyodātto vā` iti| `kardamādīnāñca` (phi|sū|3|10) ityatrādigrahaṇaṃ cānuvartate, tatra yadāderudātto vidhīyate tadā''dyudātto bhavati; yadā tu dvitīyasya tadā madhyodāttaḥ|gamanīyam=gantavyam| paṇyam=vyavahartavyamiti| `madravāṇijaḥ` iti| madreṣu yo vyavaharati sa evamucyate| `saptamīsamāsaḥ` [saptamīsamāsāḥ - kāśikā] iti| `saptamī` [[2.1.39]] iti yogavibhāgāt| `rakpratyayāntatvāt` iti| `sphayitañci` (da|3.8.31) ityādinā made rakaṃ vidhāya vyutpāditatvāt||`tulyapramāṇe vartate` [tulyapramāṇaṃ -mudripāṭhaḥ] iti| tulyaṃ pramāṇaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ| `asvapadavigrahaḥ` iti svapadavigrahaḥ kasmānna bhavati? tāśaṃ hi -vākyaṃ kartavyaṃ yathā samāsārthaḥ pratīyate| `bhakṣāmātram` iti| asya ca bhikṣāyāstulyapramāṇamityeṣo'rthaḥ| na cāyaṃ svapadavigraheṇa śakyaḥ pratipādayitum; mātraśabdasya tulyapramāṇavṛttitvāt| sa hi samāsa eva tulyapramāṇe vartate, na vākye| ata evoktam -`mātraśabdo'yaṃ vṛttiviṣayaḥ` ityādi| vṛttiriha samāsavṛttireva viṣayaḥ| `apratyayā'ntodāttaḥ` [apratyayāntodāttaḥ -kāśikāmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| ṭāpā sahaikadeśa udāttanodāttatvāt|`tatra sukhapriyaśabdau` ityādi| tacchabdena sukhapriyayoḥ pratyavamarśaḥ, tayoḥ suśapriyayoḥ heturāyatyām=janmāntare prītikaraḥ| tatra sukhapriyaśabdau vartate| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha -`taddhi hitam` ityādi| hi tadā cetyarthaḥ| tatpuruṣe prakṛtibhāvocyaṃ vidhīyate| eṣa hi tatpuruṣo hitavācī bhavati, yadi sukhapriyaśabdāvṛttarapade hitahotau vartate| hitañca kim? yadāyatyāṃ prīti karoti| kathaṃ punaḥ sukhāpriyaśabdau taddhetau vartate kāraṇe kāryopacārāt, yathā -naḍvalodakaṃ pādaroga iti||atha prītau cetīdaṃ grahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā sukhapriyayoḥ prītyavyabhicārāt| evaṃ prītau gamyamānāyāṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha -`sukhapriyayoḥ prīti` [prītyetyādi -mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| prītigrahaṇamantareṇāpi siddhe sukhapriyayoḥ prītyavyabhicārādyadiha prītigrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tadatiśayitā yā prītistasyā yathā syādityevamartham| `brāāhṛṇacchātraśabdau pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau` iti| brāāhṛṇaśabdo'ṇantaḥ| chātraśabdaḥ `chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ` [[4.4.62]] iti ṇapratyayāntaḥ| `kanyāśabdaḥ svaritāntaḥ` iti| adhnyādiṣu (da|u|8|14) tathā bhūtasyaiva pāṭhāt| `rājasukhaṃ rājaprīyam` iti| atra yadyapi sukhapriyayoḥ prītyavyabhicāritvāt? prītirgamyate, tathāpyatiśayena yā prītiḥ sā na gamyata iti bhavati pratyudāharaṇam||`dhānyamantaḥsvaritam` iti| ṇyadantatvāt? titsavareṇa| `vṛṣalyā bhartetyarthaḥ` iti| vṛṣalyāḥ kāmayiteti yāvat||`bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ` [[3.2.179]] iti kvipā bhūśabdo dhātusvareṇāntodāttaḥ| evaṃ vākśabdaḥ, vacaḥ `kvibvacipracchi` (da|u|10|2) ityādinā kvip| `cit` iti| `citau saṃjñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-39) ityasmāt? <<anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate>> [[3.3.130]] iti kvip| `nṛtiśṛdhyoḥ kūḥ` (da|u|1|174) ityadhikṛtya `andūdṛmbhūjambūkaphelūkarkandhūdidhiṣūḥ (da|u|1|176) didhiṣūśabdaḥ kūpratyayānto'ntodātta iti||`śaki śaṅkāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-86) ityetasmāt? <> [[3.3.103]] ityakārapratyayaḥ| kecittu ghañantasaya śaṅkaśabdasya grahaṇamiti varṇayanti| `bādhu loḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-5) ityasmādāṅpūrvāt? dhañi `ābādhaḥ`| atyarthamantikaṃ `nedīyaḥ`| antikaśabdasya <> [[5.3.63]] itīyasuni paratonedādeśaḥ| `astitvādhyavasāyaḥ` iti| asatitvaniścaya ityarthaḥ| `gamanāśaṅkam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇatvānnapuṃsakaliṅgam, lokāśrayatvādvā liṅgasya||`āḍhao bhūtapūrvaḥ` iti| yaḥ pūrvamāḍha āsīt? sa evamucyate| samāse gamyamānārthatvādbhūtaśabdo na prayajyate, yathā -dadhyodana ityatropasiktaśabdaḥ| `paramapūrvaḥ` iti| atra <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `atra paramaścāsau pūrvaśceti samāsaḥ` iti| itikaraṇo'rthanirdeśārthaḥ| paramaścasau pūrvaśceti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ pūjyamānatālakṣaṇaḥ, tasminniha pratyudāharaṇe samāsa ityarthaḥ| `na tu paramo bhūtaḥ` iti| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| paramo bhūtapūrva iti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ paramapūrvakālalakṣaṇaḥ, tasminnevātara samāsa ityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam? ityāha -`tathā ca` ityādi| caśabdo hi hītyarthe| ayaṃ samāso na bhavati| evaṃ satyadāharaṇamevedaṃ bhavati, na pratyudāharaṇam, pūrvaśabdasya bhūtapūrvavācitvāt| yastu prāyeṇa pustakeṣu pāṭho'tra `paramaścāsau bhūtapūrvaśceti vigraho na tu paramo bhūtapūrvaḥ` iti; sa pramādapāṭho veditavyaḥ; vākyadvaye'pi bhūtapūrvayorgamyamānatvāt||saha viṣayā savidhaḥ, <> [[2.2.28]] iti bahuvrīhiḥ, <> [[6.3.82]] iti sahasaya sabhāvaḥ| evaṃ sanīḍādiṣvapi bahuvrīhiḥ sabhāvaśca veditavyaḥ| madrasavidhamityādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| nanu ca saha viṣayetyevamādāvarthe savidhādayaḥ śabdā vyutpādyante, tat kathameṣāṃ sāmīpye vṛttiḥ? ityāha -`saha viṣayetyavamādikā` ityādi| ādiśabdena saha nīḍena saha maryādayetyevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam| evakāro'vadhāraṇārtho'bhidheyavyavacchedaṃ karoti -vyutpattinimittameva, nābhidheyamiti| `samīpavācinastvete` iti| atrāpi tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārtha eva| vasamīpavācina eva, na tu saha vidhayetyevamādivākyārthavācina iti||`vispaṣṭakaṭukam` iti| kaṭuśabdāt? <> [[5.3.87]] | `supseti samāsaḥ` iti| atha `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam` [[2.1.57]] iti vispaṣṭakaṭukamityatra vigṛhra kasmāt? karmadhāraya eva na kriyate? ityāha -`vispaṣṭādayo hyatra` ityādi| karmadhārayo hi sāmānādhikaraṇye sati bhavati| na ceha sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti| tasmādvispaṣṭādayo'tra kaṭukādeḥ śabdasya yat? pravṛttinimittaṃ kaṭukatvādi tasya viśeṣaṇam, na tadvato dravyasya| kaṭukādibhiśca śabdaiḥ kaṭukatvalakṣaṇo [kaṭukasyāstilakṣaṇo yasyāsti -iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] guṇo yasyāsti tadguṇavaddravyamabhidhīyate| tato vaiyadhikaraṇye nāsti karmadhārāyaḥ| tasmādyathoktena vidhinā samāso'tri kartavyaḥ| `vispaṣṭaḥ` [vispaṣṭaśabdaḥ -kāśikā] iti| `spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-887) ityasya niṣṭhāyām? `dastaspaṣṭacchannajñaptāḥ` [vā dāntaśāntapūrṇadastaspaṣṭacchannajñaptāḥ -pā|sū|] [[7.2.27]] iti spaṣṭaśabdo nipatitaḥ, tasya viśabdena gatasamāsaḥ| `vicitraśabdaḥ` ityādi| `citra citrī karaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1917) curādi, tasmādghaña, viśeṣeṇa citraṃ vicitram, prādisamāsaḥ| `avyayasvareṇa` iti| `tatpuruṣe tulyārthaṃ` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā vihitena| avayayaṃ punaratra viśabdaḥ, tasya ca `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80) ityādyudāttatvam| `vicittaśabdam` iti| citī saṃjñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-39) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ cittam| vigataṃ cittamasyeti bahuvrīhi| `bahuvrīhisvareṇa` iti| `citī saṃjñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-39) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ cittam| vigataṃ cittamasyeti bahuvrīhi| `bahuvrīhisvareṇa` iti| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] iti vihitena| `vyaktaśabdaḥ` ityādi| añjervipūrvasya niṣṭhāyāṃ gatisvara udāttaḥ, tatrekārasya sthāne yo yaṇ? sa udāttayaṇ? bhavati, tataḥ parasyakārasyānudāttasya svaritaḥ| `sampannaśabda` ityādi| padeḥ sampūrvasya niṣṭhāyāṃ sampannaśabdaḥ kartari ceti| `paṭupaṇḍitaśabdau pratyayasvareṇa` iti| antodāttagrahaṇamekavacanāntaṃ yat? prakṛtaṃ tasya vipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā'ntodāttāviti sambandhaḥ kartavyaḥ| pāṭayateḥ `phalipāṭinamijanīnāṃ guk? pāṭinākidhaśca` [phalipāṭinamimanijanāṃ gukpaṭinākidhataśca -da|u|] (da|u|1|103) ityupratyayaḥ, paṭiśabdaścādeśaḥ -paṭuḥ| `paḍi gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-281) asmānniṣṭhāyāṃ `paṇḍitaḥ`| `kuśalaḥ` iti| kuśā~llātīti `lā''dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1058) ityasmāt? <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] iti kaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ, <> [[6.2.139]] ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| `capalaśabdaścitsvareṇa` iti| antodatta ityapekṣate| kathamayamantodāttaścitsvareṇa? ityāha -`kalastṛpaśca` (da|u|8|107) ityataḥ kalapratyayānto vyutpādyate| tatra `bṛṣādibhyaścit` (da|u|8|109) ityataścidgrahaṇamanuvartate| tena citsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `nipuṇaśabdaḥ` ityādi| `antodāttaḥ` iti| prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `puṇeḥ` iti `puṇa karmaṇi śune` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1333) ityasmāt? `igupadhājñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ [[3.1.135]] iti kapratyayaḥ||`gamanaśreṣṭham` iti| `lyuṭ? ca` [[3.3.115]] iti lyuṭ; viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| atiśayena praśasyaḥ śreyaḥ| dṛṣṭhannīyasunoḥ <> [[5.3.60]] iti śrādeśaḥ| `vacanajyeṣṭham` iti| atrāpi| tayoreva pratyayayoḥ parataḥ praśasyaśabdasya jyādeśaḥ| `gamanakaniṣṭham, gamanakanīyaḥ` iti| iṣṭhannīyasunoḥ parato yuvaśabdasyālyaśabdasya ca <> [[5.3.64]] iti kanādeśaḥ| nanu ca `śrajyakanām` iti katham? itikaraṇo hetau| yasmācchrajyakanāmihādeśānāṃ grahaṇaṃ te cājādau pratyaye praśasyādīnāṃ vidhīyanta iti kevalānāmasambhavaḥ| tasmāt? sāmarthyāt? tadvaduttarapadaṃ gṛhrate||`kumāraśramaṇā` iti| `prātapadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam` (vyā|pā|21) iti kumārīśabdo'tra samasyate| evaṃ hi śramaṇaśabdena strīliṅgena sāmānādikaraṇyamupapadyate; nānyathā| `kumāraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ` iti| `kumāra krīḍāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1877) ityasmāt? pacādyaci vyutpāditatvāt| `kecit? punaḥ` ityādi| kathaṃ punarlakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyāṃ (vyā|pa|3) satyāmaviśeṣeṇeti labhyate? evaṃ manyate -cakāro'tra kriyate| sa cāsyaiva vidheḥ samuccayārthaḥ| tena sarvatrāviśeṣeṇa bhavati| evaṃ hi samuccayo bhavati, nānyatheti| ye tu <> [[2.1.70]] ityatraiva samāsamicchanti, te pūrvavidhyapekṣayā cakāramiha samuccayārthaṃ varṇayanti||`pratigata enasā` iti| anena `avādayaḥ kruṣṭādyarthe tṛtīyayā` (vā|92) iti tatpuruṣatvaṃ pratyenaḥśabdasya darśayati| `pratigatameno vā yasya` iti| anena bahuvrīhitvam| `kumārapratyenāḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ| nanu ca neha sūtra udāttagrahaṇamasti, tat? kathamudāttasvaro labhyate? ityāha -`udātta ityetadiha` ityādi| kiṃ punastatsāmarthyam? ityāha -`pūrvapada` ityādi| na hi prakṛtisvarādanya eva svara ucyate| kiṃ tarhi? prakṛtisvara eva; yataḥ prakṛtyeti vartate| tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate -prakṛtibhāvena kamāraśabdasya yaḥ svaraḥ prāptaḥ sa āderbhavatīti| evañca sāmarthyādudātto labhyate| sa eva hi kumāraśabdasya prakṛtibhāvena svaraḥ||`taddhitārthe dvigoryap` iti| <> [[5.1.81]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[5.1.82]] iti yap| `ṭhaño luk` iti| prāgvatīyasya| `pañcakapalaḥ` iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ puroḍāśa iti <> [[4.2.16]] ityaṇ, tasya <> [[4.1.21]] ityādinā luk| `ete samāsāḥ` iti| pañcakapāla ityevamādayo daśaśarāvaparyantāḥ| `kṛtāṣpratyayalopā` iti| kṛto'ṇpratyayalopo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| pañcadaśaśabdāvatra `graḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ` (phi|sū|2|28) ityudāttau| `pañcāāḥ` iti| taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| `ārhādagopuccha` [[5.1.19]] ityādinā ṭhak| `adhyardhapūrva` [[5.1.28]] ityādinā luk| pañca śarāvāṇyasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| atheha kathaṃ bhavati - pañcāratnyo daśāratnya iti, yavātā yaṇādeśe kṛte guṇe ca nātregantamuttarapadam? ityāha - `pañcāratnyaḥ` ityādi| yad? yaṇguṇau hrajādau vibhaktau parata iti tāviha bahiraṅgau, svarastvantaraṅga; prāgvibhaktyutpatterbhāvāt, `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vya|pa|42)| tena pañcāratnya ityatrāpi dvigusvara igantalakṣaṇaḥ pravartate| `sthānivadbhāvādvā` iti| <> [[1.1.57]] iti pūrvasvare kartavyo yo guṇaḥ sthānivadbhāvenegantalakṣaṇaḥ pravartate| nanu ca svaravidhau `na padanta` [[1.1.58]] ityādinā sthānivadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate? naitadasti; `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivat` ityuktatvāt? (kā|1.1.59) na caivamiko yaṇguṇau lopājādeśau| `pañcāratnyaḥ` iti| aratniśabdo'tra `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ` (ga|sū|50) `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke` (ga|sū|51) iti bahvādiṣu pāṭhānṅīṣantaḥ| ihāpi pūrvavat? taddhitārthe dviguḥ, mātracastu lopaḥ||pūrvoṇegantādiṣūttarapadeṣu bahuśabdasyāpi nityaṃ prakṛtisvare prāpte vikalpo'yamucyate| `bahuratniḥ` iti| pūrvavat? samāsādi| `bahumāsyaḥ` iti| pūrvavadyap| bahukapālādayaḥ samāsāḥ, ihapi <> [[4.2.16]] ityatrāpi taddhitārthe kṛte'ṇpratyayalopā draṣṭavyāḥ| `bahuśabdo'ntodāttaḥ` iti| sa hi `kubhrraśca` (da|u|1|107) ityanuvartamāne `bahi mahi vṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-633,634) ityasmāt| `landhibrrāhrornalopaśca` (da|u|1|114) iti kupratyayaṃ vidhāya vyutpādyate, tena pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `yatra yaṇādeśaḥ` iti| bahvaratnirityatra||abahvartho'yamārambhaḥ| `pañcadiṣṭiḥ` iti| pañcāratnirityanena tulyam||`sāṅkāśyasiddhaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.41]] iti samāsaḥ| `sāṅkāśyakāmpilyaśabdauṇyapratyayāntatvāt` iti| `vucchaṇ` [[4.2.79]] ityādinā saṅkāśādilakṣaṇaṃ cāturārthikapratyayaṃ vidhāya vyutpāditatvāt| `ūkaśabdaḥ` ityādi| `kṛdādhārārcikalibhyaḥ kaḥ (da|u|3|18) ityadhikṛtya `sṛdṛbhūśuṣimuṣibhya kak` [kit - da|uṃudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] (da|u|u|19) iti kakpratyayaḥ kid? vidhīyamāno'vaterapi bhavatīti| tanokaśabdaḥ kakpratyayāntaḥ| `jvaratvara` [[6.4.20]] ityādinā vaterūṭh| `nidhanaśabdo nighāñaḥ kyupratyaye madhyodāttaḥ` iti| nidhanaśabdo'yaṃ `kṛpṛvṛjimandi nidhāñaḥ kyuḥ` (da|u|5|26) [`nidhāñbhyaḥ` mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ - da|u| saptamyekavacane <<iko'ci vibhaktau>> [[7.1.73]] iti numaṃ kṛtvā śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ veditavyam| kyurityetasmin? śabdarūpe pratyayasaṃjñakaṃ ityarthaḥ| `kumbhīkalasīśabdau ṅīpantau` iti| tenāntodāttāviti bhāvaḥ| ṅīṣantatā tu `jāterastrīviṣayāt` [[4.1.63]] ityādinā vihitena ṅīṣā veditavyamā| `bhrāṣṭraśabdaḥ ṣṭranpratyayāntaḥ` iti| `ṣṭran` (da|u|8|79) iti vartamāne `bhrasjigaminamihaniviṣyaśāṃ vṛddhiśca` [`viśyaśāṃ` iti mudritanyāsapāṭhaḥ]rājanyavācīni yānyasamastāni bahuvacanāntāni tadavayavako yo dvandvaḥ sa rājanyabahuvacanadvandava ityuktaḥ| `āāphalkacaitrakarodhakāḥ` iti| āāphalkāśca caitrakāśca rodhakāśceti dvandvaḥ| tatra rodhakaśabdamapekṣya caitrakaśabdasya pūrvapadatvam, caitrakaśabdamapekṣya āāphalkaśabdasya, tayorapi prakṛtibhāvaḥ| ata eva tayodrvayorapi svaraṃ darśayitumāha -`āāphalkaśapabdaścaitrakaśabdaśca` ityādi| `śiniśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| sa hi -`vījyājvaribhyoniḥ` (da|u|1|18) iti nipratyaye'nuvartamāne `vahiśriśrudruglāhātvaribhyo nit` (da|u|1|21) [vahiśriyuśruglāhātvaribhyo -da|u|] iti vidhīyamāne śīṅo'pi bhavati| bahulavacanād? hrasvatvaṃ ca tata eva| tenādyudātto bhavitā nitsvareṇa| `tadapatyeṣu` iti| tasya śineḥ śrattriyasya yānyapatyāni teṣvityarthaḥ| `abhedena` iti| upacareṇetyarthaḥ| `haimāyanāḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak| nanu ca rājanyaśabdo'yaṃ kṣatriyajātivacanaḥ, tathā coktam -`rājño'patye jātigrahaṇam` (vā|392) iti; rājanyo bhavati kṣatriyaścet` iti| yaścāndhakavṛṣṇiṣu vartate dvandvaḥ sa tu kṣatriyavācināmeva bhavati; andhakavṛṣṇīnāṃ kṣatriyatvāt| tataśca dvaipyahaimāyanā ityuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇam| ayamapi hi rājanyavācināmeva dvandvaḥ; andhakavṛṣṇiṣu vartamānatvadityata āha -`andhakavṛṣṇayaḥ` ityādi| `andhakavṛṣṇiṣu` ityetāvataiva kṣatriyagrahaṇe siddhe yadrājanyagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tasyaitat? prayojanam -viśiṣṭā ye'bhiṣiktavaṃśyāsteṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| vidyayā janmanā vā prāṇināmekalakṣaṇaḥ santānaḥ=vaṃśaḥ, iha tu janmanā ya ekalakṣaṇaḥ so'bhipretaḥ, tatra bhavo vaṃśyaḥ, digāditvāt? [[4.3.54]] | yat| tatraitat? syāt| dvaipyahaimāyanā apyabhiṣiktavaṃśya eva kṣatttriyāḥ? ityata āha -`ete ca` ityādi| `saṅkarṣaṇavāsudevau` iti| saṅkarṣaṇaśca vāsudevaścetyekavacanāntayorayaṃ dvandvaḥ| `vṛṣṇikumārāḥ` iti| tatpuruṣo'yam| `kurupāñcālāḥ` iti| atra sarvamasti, tathāpyandhakavṛṣṇigrahaṇānna bhavati; tatrāvṛtteḥ||`ekādaśa` iti| ekaśca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ| `dvādaśa` iti dvyaṣṭanaḥ saṃkhyāyāmabahuvrīhraśītyoḥ [[6.3.46]] ityāttavam||ācārya upasarjanaṃ pradhānaṃ yasya sa tatoktaḥ| ante vasatītyantevāsī| gauṇaścāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ| dvandvasya yānyavayavabhūtāni tānyācāryopasarjanavācīni| tasmādantevāsivācitvāccābhidheya upacāreṇa tānyācāryopasarjanāntevāsiśabdābhyāmucyante| tadavayavo'pi dvandvāvayavadharmeṇācāryopasarjanāntevāsīti cocyate| `āpiśalirācāryaḥ` iti| `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] | `āpiśalireva vā chātrā āpiśālāḥ` iti| pūrvavadaṇ| `ubhayathā` ityādi| ubhayaprakāreṇāpi vyutpattāvacāryopasarjanaścāntevāsī bhavati| tathā hi - ubhayatara śiṣyā eva pradhānabhūtā evamucyante, ācāryastu tadviśeṣaṇatvāduyasarjanībhūtaḥ| āpiśalaśabdo'ṇantatvāt? pratyayasavareṇāntodāttaḥ| pāṇininā proktamiti <> [[4.2.114]] `tadadhīte` [[4.2.58]] ityaṇ, tasya luk| pāṇinīyaśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ| `pāṇinīyarauḍhīyāḥ` iti| roḍhasyāpatyaṃ rauḍhiḥ, `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] rauḍherācāryasya cchātrā iti `iñaśca` [[4.2.111]] ityaṇaḥ prāpatasya `na dvyacaḥ` [[4.2.112]] iti pratiṣedhe kṛte <> [[4.2.114]] | atha vā - rauḍhinā proktaṃ rauḍhiyam, tataśca `tadadhīte` [[4.2.58]] ityaṇ, tasya pūrvavalluk - rauḍhīyāḥ| rauḍhīyaśabdo'pi pūrvavanmadhyodāttaḥ| kāśakṛtsnena proktamityaṇ? tadadhīyate kāśakṛtsnāḥ, pūrvavadaṇo luk| `chāndasavaiyākaraṇāḥ` iti| bhavatyayamantevāsinā dvandvaḥ, na tvācāryopasarjanaḥ| tra hrantevāsina eva chāndasavaiyākaraṇābhyāmucyante, na tvācāryopasarjanībhūtāḥ| chando'dhīyate cchāndasāḥ, vyākaraṇamadhīyata iti vaiyākaraṇāḥ| tatra te ca yata ācāryādadhīyate tasyāntevāsinaḥ| `āpiśalapāṇinīye śāstre` iti| āpiśalinā proktamāpiśalam| pāṇininā proktaṃ pāṇinīyam| yatra śāstre prādhānyenocyeta tatra pratyayasya vidhānādācāryaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ; tadviśeṣaṇatvāt| ācāryatvaṃ tasyeha śāstarāpekṣam| na hrācāryatāntevāsyapekṣaiva bhavati, api tu śāsatrāpekṣāpi||`aṇantāvetau` iti| tena pratyayasvareṇāntodāttāviti bhāvaḥ| uttaratrāpyaṇantasyānodāttatā veditavyā| `sauvarṇiriñantaḥ` [`sāvarṇiḥ -kāśikā] iti| ñitsvareṇādyudātta ityabhiprāyaḥ| evamuttaratrāpīñantasyādyudāttata veditavyā| māṇḍūkeyaśabdaḥ `ḍhak? ca maṇḍūkāt` [[4.1.119]] iti ḍhagantaḥ| `avanteḥ` ityādi| avanterapatyāni bahunīti <> [[4.1.171]] iti ñyaṅ, tasya `tadrājasya` [[2.4.62]] ityādinā luk| avantīnāṃ nivāso janapadaḥ <> [[4.2.69]] iti cāturthiko'ṇ| tasya <> [[4.2.81]] iti lup| `avantayaḥ, tathāśmakāḥ` iti| yathāvantaya iti kṛtastathāśmakā ityatrāpi| atra kṣattriyavācino janapadavācinaśca śabdāḥ| taddhite'patyeṣu yo bahuṣatpadyate tadantācaca nivāse cāturarthikaḥ| tasya lup? kṛtaḥ| tathāśmakā ityatrāpi| etāvanmātramatidiśyate| aśmakasyāpatyāni bahūni, <> [[4.1.173]] ityādineñ, tasya luk? pūrvavat, teṣāṃ nivāse'ṇ, tasya pūrvavallup| avantiśabdo ghṛtāditvādantodātta ityeke| citsvareṇetyapare, te hi `bhuvo jhic` (paṃ|u|330) bahulavacanādavaterapi jhijbhavatīti varṇayanti| `yuvadvandvo'yam` iti yudasaṃjñakapratyayāntayorayaṃ dvandva ityarthaḥ| `phailaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.118]] ityaṇ| `śyāyarṇaśabdo bidādiḥ` iti tena tato'ptyavivakṣāyāmañ? bhavatīti bhavāḥ| `strī` iti| `śāṅrgaravādyaño ṅīn` [[4.1.73]] | `śyāparṇeyaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.120]] | `bahucacanamatantram` iti| avivakṣitatvāt| `tena` ityādinā bahuvacanāvivakṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati| `kapirantodāttaḥ` iti| prātipadikasvareṇa| `tena` ityādi| yasmāt? kapiśabdo'yaṃ luganta; tena bahuvacanamatrāśrīyata eva| `ṛṣyaṇ` iti| `ṛṣyandhaka` [[4.1.114]] ityādinā| `yūni ya iñ` iti| `ata iñ` (śra4.1.95) ityanena| `pāñcālī` iti| <> [[4.1.168]] ityañ| tadantāt? pūrvavanṅīp| `pāñcāleyī` [pāñcāleyaḥ -kāśikā] pūrvavaḍḍhak| evaṃ `vārcalayī` ityatrāpi| `śākalyaḥ` iti| gargāditvāt? yañ| śākalyaśabdo ñitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `śaṇakabābhravāḥ` iti| śaṇaṃ karotīti `kai gai śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-916,917) ityasmāddhāttoḥ <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] , tena pratyayasvareṇa śaṇakaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `bābhravaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.146]] | `ārcābhinaḥ` iti| proktārthe ṇiniḥ, tasmādadhyetaryaṇ, tasya <> [[4.2.64]] iti luk| evamuttaratrāpi proktapratyayāntādadhyetṛpratyayasya lugveditavyaḥ| `mudgalaḥ kaṇvādiḥ` iti| gargādyantargaṇaḥ| `tadapatyasya` iti| maudgalāḥ` iti| maudgalyaśabdāt? <> [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ, <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralopaḥ| `āpatyasya ca taddhete'nāti` [[6.4.151]] iti yakārasya| ārcābhiśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `kunte surāṣṭrasya` ityādi| `kamu kāntau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-443) ityasmāt? pūrvavat? ktic, bahulavacanāduttvam| kunti śobhanaṃ rāṣṭramasyeti surāṣṭraḥ| kunterapatyāni bahūni <> [[4.1.171]] ; surāṣṭrasyāpatyāni bahūni, janapadaśabdādinā [[4.1.166]] aṇ, tayoḥ `tadrājasya` [[2.4.62]] ityādinā bahuṣu luk| tataḥ kuntīnāṃ nivāso janapadaḥ <> [[4.2.69]] iti cāturarthiko'ṇ, `tasya janapade lup` [[4.2.80]] iti lup| kuntayaśca surāṣṭrāśca kuntisurāṣṭrāḥ| evaṃ kunteḥ surāṣṭrasya cāpatyeṣu bahuṣu tannivāse janapadadvandvādayaṃ bhavati| kuntiśabdāścitsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `cintisurāṣṭrāḥ` iti| cintiśabdo'pyāntodātta eva| so'pi `citi samṛtyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1535) ityasmāt| kticpratyayāntaḥ| kecidavantikuntiśabdau <> [[3.3.174]] iti kticpratyayāntau vyutpādayanti| `pacādyanpratyayāntau` iti| `taḍi harṣe` (dhā|pa|280) ityasmāt? kevalādavapūrvācca pacādyac| `vaṣṭi bhāgurirallopamavāpyorupasaragayoḥ` ityavaśabdākārasya lopaḥ| `yaño luk? kriyate` iti| <> [[2.4.64]] iti| `avimattakāmaviddhā` iti| `madī harṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1208) ityasmādvipūrvānniṣṭhā -vimattaḥ, na vimatto'vimatta iti| `tatpuruṣe tulyārthaṃ` (6.2.2|) ityādinā pūrvapadasaya prakṛtibhāve kṛte nañsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `bahvacaḥ` iti| anena sūtraikadeśena `bahvaca iñaḥ prācayabharateṣu` [[2.4.66]] ityetat? sūtramupalakṣayati| `śalaṅku śalaṅkañca` iti| naḍādiṣvetat paṭhate| asyāyamarthaḥ -śalaṅkuśabdaḥ phakamutpādayati śalaṅkādeśañcāpadyata iti| `bābhravadānacyutāḥ` iti| brābhrorapatyaṃ bābhravaḥ, aṇantaḥ| dānacyutaśabdādiño bahvaco lugiti pūrvavat| `kaṭhakālapāḥ` iti| kaṭhaśabdaḥ pacādyaci vyutpāditatvādantodāttaḥ| lokākṣasyāpatyaṃ `laukākṣi)` tasaya cchātrā `laukākṣāḥ`| `strīkumām` iti| `satyāyaterḍraṭ` (paṃ|u|4|165) tadantāt? `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp, tatra pratadyayasvareṇāntodāttākārasya <> [[6.4.148]] iti lopaḥ, <> [[6.1.161]] iti ṅīpa udāttatve kṛte strīśabdo hrudāttaḥ| `tasya cchātrā mīdāḥ` iti| `iñaśca` [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ| `tathā paippalādāḥ` iti| pippalāvasyāpatyaṃ paupyalādiḥ, tasya cchātrāḥ paippalādāḥ| `vatsajarat` iti| `vṛtṛvadihanikamikaṣibhyaḥ saḥ` (da|u|9|21) [vṛtṛvadihinikamikaṣiyumucibhyaḥ saḥ -da|u|] iti vadeḥ saḥ, anena vatasaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ, <> [[3.2.104]] | jarat, tayodrvandvaḥ| `sauśrutaparthavāḥ` iti| suśrutasya chātrāḥ sauśrutāḥ| `pṛthośchātrāḥ pārthavāḥ` iti| ubhayatra <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| `jarāmṛtyu` iti| jṛṣityetasmāt? <<ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ>> [[3.3.104]] ityaṅ, jarā, tasya pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvam| mriyateḥ `bhṛjaḍimṛṅbhyāṃ yuktyukau` (da|u|1|135) iti tyuk, mṛtyuḥ||`mahacchabdo'ntodāttaḥ` iti| `vartamāne pṛṣadbṛhanmahat` (da|u|6|5) ityantodāttasya tasyoṇādiṣu nipātanāt| atheha kasmānna bhavati| mahato vrīhirmahadvrīhiḥ? ityāta āha -`tasya` ityādi| etacca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) labhyate| atha kimarthaṃ pravṛddhaśabda iha paṭhate, yāvatā niṣṭhānto'sau, tatra <<karmadhāraye'niṣṭhā>> [[6.2.46]] iti vakṣyamāṇenaiva sidadham? ityata āha -`karmadhāraye'niṣṭha` ityādi| tathaiva hi paribhāṣayā <<śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ>> [[2.1.59]] iti tena pratipadoktenāyaṃ samāsaḥ| tatra `karṣāraye'niṣṭhā` [[6.2.46]] ityanena prakṛtibāvasyāvidhiḥ| na ca mahāpravṛddha ityayaṃ pratipadoktena niṣṭhāntena karmadhārayaḥ; tatra yadi pravṛddhaśabdo'tra na paṭhate, tatra parataḥ prakṛtibhāvo na syāt| tasmāt? tasyeha pāṭhaḥ kriyate| yogaścāyaṃ samāsasvarasyāpavādaḥ||`kṣudhaṃ lātīti kṣullaḥ` iti| <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] iti kapratyayaḥ| `torli` [[8.4.59]] iti parasavarṇaḥ||`sarvadhātubhyaḥ ṣṭran` (paṃ|u|4|158) ityasmāt? ṣṭrannitayanuvaratamāne uṣikhanibhyāṃ kit? (paṃ|u|4|161) ityevaṃ vyutpāditatvāt||`goḥ sādaḥ` ityanena vākyaśeṣeṇa gosādaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsatvaṃ darśayati| `gāṃ sādayatīti ca` [vā -kāśikā] iti| etenāpyupadasamāsatvam; saverviśaraṇārthatvāt? gośabde karmaṇyupapade kṛte gosāda iti bhavati| gośabdaḥ `gamerḍos` (da|u|2|11) [gamerḍoḥ -paṃ|u;da|u|] iti ḍospratyayāntatvāt? pratyayasavareṇāntodāttaḥ||atra `kurugārhapata` ityevamādayaḥ paṇyakambalaparayantāḥ samastā-| tatra kurugārhapata -riṣataguru -ityetāvavibhaktikau| itare tu asūtajaratītayevamādayaḥ prathamaikavacanāntāḥ| sā ca prathamā subadhyatyayena ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne veditavyā| `dāsībhārāṇām` iti bahuvacanaṃ gaṇasya sūcanārtham| ata evāha -`dāsābhārādīnāṃ ca` iti| `kuruśabdaḥ kupratyayāntaḥ` iti| `kubhrraśca` (da|u|1|107) ityataḥ `ku` ityadhikṛtya `kṛgrorucaca` (da|u|1|109) iti kupratyayāntatvena vyutpāditatvāt|`kuruvṛjyorgārhapata iti vaktavyam` iti| kuruvṛjiśabdayorgārhapataśabda uttarapade prakṛtibhāvo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -kuruśabdasya tāvat? `kurugārhapata` [[6.2.42]] iti sūtadra evopādānādbhaviṣyati| vṛjiśabdasyāpi cakārasyehānuktasamuccayārthatvāditi| `vṛjiśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| vṛjerin| `igupadhāt? kicca` (da|u|1|48) ityevaṃ vyutpāditatvāt| `riktaguruḥ` iti| riktaguruśabdasya samānādhikaraṇasamāsatāṃ darśayati| evaṃ `asūtā jaratī` ityanenāpyasyāsūtajaratīśabdasya| `aślaulā dṛḍharūpā` ityanenāślīladṛḍharūpaśabdasāya| na sūtetyasūtāśabdo'pi nañsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| evamaślīlāśabdo'pi| na ślīlā'ślīlā| `sidhmāderākṛtigaṇatvāllac` iti| <> [[5.2.97]] iti <> [[5.2.96]] ityato lajitayasyānuvṛtteḥ| `kapilakāditvācca latvam` iti| <> [[8.2.18]] ityatra `kapilakādīnāñcopasaṃkhyānam` (vā|915) iti latvasyopasaṃkhyānāt| kathaṃ punajrñāyate - śrīryasyāsti tacślīlaśabdenīcyate? ityāha -`aślīladṛḍharūpā` ityādi| na ślīlamaślīlamiti aślolaśabdasyārthaḥ pratiṣidhyate| tatra yadi ślīlaśabdasya śrīryasyāsti sa ityartho na syādaślīladṛḍharūpetyatra niḥśrīkā nocyeta, ucyate ca, tato jñāyate śrīmadadvastu ślīlaśabdenocyata iti| `saṃkhthānamātreṇa śobhanā` iti| dṛḍhatvācca saṃsthānasya| śrīrahitatvācca saṃsthānamātreṇa śobhanā| mātraśabdaḥ śrīmattāyā vyavacchedakaḥ| `lāvaṇyarahitā` ityanena niḥśrīketyasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| `pāre vaḍaveva pārevaḍavā` iti| kena punaratra samāsaḥ? na hīvārthe samāsasya kiñcillakṣaṇamasti| athāpi kathañtit? samāsaḥ syāt| evamapi <> [[2.4.71]] iti vibhaktilopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`nipātanādeva` ityādi| `titilino'patyam` iti etenāpatyārthe titiliñśabdāt? taddhitotpattimiha darśayati| `chāttrā vā` [chāttro vā taitilaḥ -kāśikā] iti| titilana ityapeśrate| etenāpi <> [[4.3.120]] ityarthe taitilā iti| pūrvavadupasaṃkhyānāṭṭilopaḥ| `yadantatvāt` iti| `avadyapaṇya` [[3.1.101]] iti yadantasya nipātanāt| `ādyudāttaḥ` iti| <<yato'nāvaḥ>> [[6.1.213]] ityanena| `paṇyakambalaḥ saṃjñāyāmiti vaktvyam` [`saṃjñāyāṃ vaktavyam` iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| paṇyakambalaśabdaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ pūrvapadaprakṛtisavaro bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ, tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -<> [[6.2.28]] ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| saṃjñāyāmeva paṇyakambalaśabdaḥ pūragvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati, nānyatreti| `anyatra samāsāntodāttatvameva` iti| nanu ca paṇyaśabdo'yaṃ kṛtyapratyayāntaḥ `tatpuruṣe` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā tavasmin? paṇitavye pūrvapadasya prakṛtisavareṇaiva bhavitavyam, tat? kathaṃ samāsantodāttatvam? ityāha -`pratipadokte hi` ityādi| <> [[2.1.68]] iti yaḥ kṛtyasamāsaḥ pratipadoktaḥ tatra `dvitīyākṛtyāḥ` [[6.2.2]] iti pūrvapadasya prakṛtibhāvo vihitaḥ| na cāyaṃ pratipadoktaḥ samāsaḥ| `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa [[2.1.56]] iti samānyena vihitatvāt| kuta etat? kambalaśabdasya jātiśabdatvāt| `dvitīyākṛtyā` ityanena sūtraikadeśena `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` ityādikaṃ sūtramupalakṣayati| `dāsībhāraḥ` iti| dāsīśabdaḥ pūrvamuktasvara| `devahūtiḥ` iti| pacādyajantatvādantodāttaḥ| `oṣaśabdo ghañantatvāt` iti| `uṣa dāhe` (dā|pā|696) ityasya ghañi vyutpāditatvāt| `candre māṅo ḍit` [candre mo ḍit -da|u|,paṃ|u| -`candre mo'siḥ` -kāśikāmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] (da|u|9|88) ityasiparatyayānto'yam| `mithune'siḥ pūrvavacca sarvam` (da|u|9|82) ityato'sipratyayasyānuvṛtteḥ| `candraśabdastu rakpratyayāntatvāt` iti| `sphāyitañci` (da|u|8|31) ityādinā sūtreṇa rakpratyayāntatvena vyutpāditatvāt| `sa sarvo dāsībhārādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ` iti| dāsībhārāderākṛtigaṇatvāt||`tadarthe` iti| tasmai idam, catuthryantam, tasya yorthastadartha ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaryūpaśabda ādyudātta? ityāha - `kusuyubhyāñca` ityādi| `pānīviṣibhyaḥ paḥ` (da|u|7|2) ityataḥ `paḥ` ityanuvartamāne `kusuyubhyāñca` (da|u|7|5) [kuyubhyāñca - mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti yūpaśabdaḥ papratyayānto vyutpādyate| tatra `suśṛbhyāṃ nicca` (paṃ|u|3|26) ityato niditi vartate, tenādayudātto bhavati| dīrghatvaṃ tu `stuvo dīrghaśca` (paṃ|u|3|25) ityato dīrghagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `kalapratyayāntaḥ` iti| `vṛṣādibhyaścit? (da|u|8|109) ityatra `kalastṛpaśaca` (da|u|8|107) ityataḥ kalapratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `rathaśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| hanikuṣinīramikāśibhyaḥ kthan` (da|u|8|107) ityataḥ kalapratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `rathaśabda ādyudattaḥ` iti| `hanikuṣinīramikāśibhyaḥ kthan` (da|u|8|107) ityataḥ kalapratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `rathaśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| `hanikuṣinīramikāśibhyaḥ kthan` (da|u|6|27) iti kathanpratyayāntatvāt| `vallīśabdo ṅīṣaḥ svareṇāntodāttaḥ` iti| ṅīṣpratyayastu gaurāditvāt| [[4.1.41]] veditavyaḥ| `prakṛtivikārabhāve` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyenocyamānaḥ prakṛtivikārabhāve labhyate? pūrvavadanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tasya ca vyavasthitavibhāṣātvādvakṣyamāṇajñāpakāt||`mātṛpitṛśabdāvantodāttau` iti| `naptṛneṣṭṭa` (da|u|2|3) ityādau tṛjantayostayornipātitatvāt| `litsvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ` iti| `devāt? tal` [[5.4.27]] iti talpratyayantatvāt| kimarthaṃ punaretat, na `caturthī tadathe` [[6.2.43]] ityevaṃ siddham, arthaśabdo'pi tadarthamevottarapadaṃ bhavati? ityāha -`tadarthaviśeṣā eva` ityādi| evaṃ manyate -arthaśabdo'pi vṛttau viśeṣavācī bhavatīti| yuktañcaitat| tadā mātrarthamityukte mātrādibhyo vyāvṛttarūpaṃ viśiṣṭameva mātrarthaṃ vastu pratīyate| `aādhāsaḥ` ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati||`aāśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| kvanparatyayāntatvat| `manuṣyaśabdo'ntasvaritaḥ` iti| `manordhātāvañyatau ṣukca` [[4.1.161]] iti yatpratyayāntatvāt| `pariśiṣṭamantodāttam` iti| tat? punargośabdaḥ, tāpasaśabdaśca| tatra `gamerḍos` (da|u|2|11) [gomarḍoḥ -da|u; paṃ|u|] iti ḍospratyayāntatvādgośabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| tāpasaśabdo'payaṇpratyayāntatvāt| sa hi `tapaḥsaharuāābhyāṃ vinīnī` [[5.2.102]] `aṇ? ca` [[5.2.102]] ityaṇpratyayānto vyutpādyate| atha `gorakṣitam` iti kathamidamasyodāharaṇam, yāvatā gobhyo rakṣimiti tādarthye caturthī, tatra hi yogata uttarapadena bhavitavayam? ityata āha -`gobhyo rakṣitam` ityādi| na hyatra gavārthaṃ rakṣita ityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? gobhyo rakṣitaṃ dīyate ityetadadhyāhāryam| tasmāt? sampradāna eṣā caturthī, tat? kutastādathryam!||`śreṇikṛtāḥ` ityādi| <<śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ>> [[2.1.59]] iti samāsaḥ| `śreṇiśabda ādyudāttaḥ` iti| nitsvareṇa| sa hi `vījyājvaribhyo niḥ` (da|u|1|18) ityato niriti vartamāne `vahiśriśruyudruglāhātvaribhyo nit` (da|u|1|21) [`vahiśriyuśruglāhātvaribhyo nit` da|u|] ityevaṃ vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| `pūgaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ` iti| `mudigrorgaggau` (da|u|3|66) iti bahulavacanāt? pūño'pi gak| tena pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `kṛtākṛtam` iti| kṛtañca tadakṛtaṃ ceti <> [[2.1.60]] iti samāsaḥ| ekadeśasya kṛtatvāt? kṛtam, tadaivaikadeśasyākṛtatvādakṛtam||hīnam=tyaktam, na hīnamahīnam| `kaṣṭaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ` iti| ktapratyayāntatvāt? pratyayasvareṇa| `kṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣa` [[7.2.22]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `bahuvirīhisvareṇādyudāttaḥ` iti| triśabdo hi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| tatra `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] iti prakṛtisvare kṛte bahuvrīhisvareṇa triśakalaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| grāmaśabdo'pi ādyudātta eva| tathā hrasau `artistusuhusṛdhukṣi` (da|u|7|26) ityato manparatayaye'nuvartamāne `avateṣṭilopaśca` (da|u|7|27) `grasaterā ca` (da|u|7|28) iti manpratyayānto vyutpādyate| `kāntārātītaḥ` iti| kāntāramatītavān, tyaktavānityarthaḥ| kāntārātītaśabdo'tri hīnaśabdavacī|`dvitīyānupasarga iti vaktavyam` iti| dvitīyāntamanupasarge ktante prakṛtisvaraṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi tasyaivānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasyānuvṛtiṃta vyavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ cāśritya kartavyam||`tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityeva siddhe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare ca kṛtsavareṇa thāthādisvareṇa [[6.2.143]] bādhite tatpratipādanārtha vacanam| `ahihataḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsaḥ| `ahirantodātto vyutpādataḥ` iti| āṅpūrvāddhanteḥ `janighasibhyāmiṇ` (da|u|1|58) iti vartamāne `vāterḍicaca` iti ḍiditi ca `āṅiśrihanibhyāṃ hrasvaśca` (da|u|1|66) ityanenāhiriṇanto vyutpāditaḥ| `kecidādayudāttamicchanti` iti| te `samāne khyaḥ sa codāttaḥ` (paṃ|u|4|136) ityudāttagrahaṇamapyanuvartayanti| `rakpratyayāntaḥ` iti| `sphāyitañci` (da|u|8|31) ityādinā rakpratyayāntatvena vyutpāditatvāt| `mahārājaṣṭacpratyayāntaḥ` iti| `sphāyitañci` (da|u|8|31) ityādinā rakpratyayāntatvena vyutvāditatvāt| `mahārājaṣṭacparatyayāntaḥ` iti| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac` [[5.4.91]] iti ṭacpratyayāntatvāt| `dātralūnā` iti| <> [[3.2.181]] ityanuvartamāne `dāmnīśas` [[3.2.182]] ityādinā ṣṭran? pratyayānto dātraśabdo vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| sarvatra `tayoreva kṛtyatakhalārthāḥ` [[3.4.70]] iti karmaṇi ktaḥ||`prakṛtaḥ` iti| kugatiprādayaḥ` [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| prādayo'bivarjitā ādyudāttagaṇe nipātyante, tena praśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `abhyuddhṛtaḥ` iti| atra abhiśabdasyānantarasya na bhavati; atrocchaśabdasya ktāntena samāsaṃ kṛtvā paścādabhiśabdasyoddhṛśabdena samāsaḥ kartavyaḥ| atha vā -<> [[2.2.18]] ityatra subgrahaṇasya nivartitatvādanekasaryāpi samāso bhavati| `samudāhṛtaḥ` iti| atrāpi samudorantarayorna bhavati| `kārakapūrvasya ti` ityādi| dūrādāgata ityatrāṅī gatisamāse kṛte satyanena prakṛtisvaraḥ, tata udātto bhavati| tato dūrādāgata iti <> [[2.1.39]] ityādinā pañcamīsamāsaḥ, tasmin? kṛte <> [[6.2.139]] iti vartamāne `thāthaghañ` [[6.2.143]] ityādinotatarapadasyāntodattatvaṃ vidhīyate| sa ca gatisvare sati vidhīyata iti śiṣṭatvena sa eva bhavati| <> [[6.3.2]] ityaluk| atha kathaṃ `samudghṛtaḥ` ityādi pratyudāharaṇamupapadyate, yāvatā `kṛdgrahaṇe gatakārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|126) iti gatiriha niṣṭhāgrahaṇenaiva gṛhrate, evañcānantara eva samuddhṛta ityatra samśabdaḥ, samudāhṛta ityatrāpi samucchabdau? ityata āha -`anantaragrahaṇasāmarthyāt` iti| anantaragarahaṇena hrevamarthaḥ kriyate -samuddhṛtamityādau mā bhūditi| yadi paribāṣeyamihaśrīyateta, tadā hi uddhṛta ityādau gatiranantara eveti vyāvatryābhāvādanantaragrahaṇamapārthakaṃ syāt|`prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ` iti| <<ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca>> [[3.4.71]] iti karattari hi kvapratyayaḥ||`prakartum` iti| tumun| `prakarteti tṛnnantaḥ` iti| tṛjantāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| `kṛtsvarabādhanārtham` ityādi| avyayasvarāpavādaḥ <> [[6.2.139]] iti kṛtsvaraḥ prāpnoti, atastadbādhanārthaṃ vacanam| `prajalpākaḥ` iti| `jalpabhikṣa` [[3.2.155]] ityādinā ṣākan| `tṛjantaḥ` iti| tṛnnantāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| atha nidgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? prakṛṣṭamṛṣṭamṛttikā prabhṛttikā ityatara mā bhūditi cet? naitadasti; tathā hi -yatkrayāyuktāḥ prādayaḥ taṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñakāḥ bhavanti, (jai|pa|vṛ|99) mṛttikāśabdaścāyaṃ nāmadheyatvāt? kriyāvacī na bhavati, tena taṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñā nāstyeva? ityata āha -`kṛdgrahaṇam` ityādi| `kṛti` ityanena saṃjñāsambandhakālo lakṣyate, tena kṛtsaṃjñāvelāyāṃ yastādirityeṣo'rthaḥ sampadyata iti kṛdgrahaṇamupadeśe tādyarthaṃ bhavati; kṛtsaṃjñāpratipattikālasyopadeśakālatvāt| tasmāt? punarupadeśe yastādistadarthaṃ yatnaḥ kriyata ityāha -`iha` ityādi| yadi tadupadeśagrahaṇaṃ tādyartha na kriyeta, tadā pralapitetyatra na syāt; iṭā tāditāyā vihatatvāt| yasmaśca satadyupadeśa eva tādirbhatīti yadyapyuttarakālaṃ tāditā vihanyate, tathāpi bhavatyeva| `āgantuḥ` iti| `sitanigamimasi` (da|u|1|122) ityādanā tan? pratyayaḥ||`anta udātto bhavati` iti| kathaṃ punarudātto bhavatītyeṣo labhyate, nehodāttagrahaṇamasti? na hyatrāpūrva eva svaro vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? <> [[6.2.139]] iti prakṛtibhāvenāderyaḥ svaraḥ prāpnoti na eva, tat? kathaṃ prakṛtyeti vartate? tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate -tavāparatyayāntasya yaḥ prāpnoti so'ntyasya bhavatīti| sa codātta eveti samāthryādudātto labhyate| yugapadgrahaṇaṃ paryāyanivṛttyartham| `anvetavā` [āmvetavai -kāśikā] iti| anupūrvādeteḥ `kṛtyārthe `tavaikenkenyatvanaḥ` [[3.4.14]] iti tavaipratyayaḥ, guṇaḥ| `paripātavā` [paripātavai -kāśikā] iti| paripūrvāt? vibāteḥ| `abhicaritavā` [abhicaritavai -kāśikā] iti| abhipūrvāccarateḥ| `abhirantodāttaḥ` iti| prātipadakasvareṇa|`vapratyaye` iti| vakāraḥ pratyayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `prāṅ` ityādi| prāñcītīti `ṛtvik` [[3.2.59]] ityādinā kvinpratyayaḥ, sa ca vakāramātra eva; kakārādīnāmanubandhatvāt; teṣāṃ cānaikāntatvāt| `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num, ekavacane halṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogāntalopau [[8.2.23]] , `kvin? pratyayasya kuḥ` [[8.2.62]] iti nakārasya kutvaṃ ṅkāraḥ| dvivacanabahuvacanayostu <> [[8.4.40]] iti ścutvaṃ ñakāraḥ| upasargākāreṇa saha <> [[6.1.101]] | `parāṅ` ityādi| parāśabda ādyudāttaḥ| tena `svarito vānudātte padādau` [`svarite vā'nudāte'padādau` iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ -nyāsaḥ kāśikā, padamaṃjarī ca] [[8.2.6]] ityeṣa vidhirna bhavati| `pratyaṅ` iti| atra pratiśabdasyegantatvāt? parakṛtibhāvo na bhavati| nanu ca yaṇādeśe kṛte so'pyaniganta eṣa? sthānivadbhāvādigantavyapadeśaḥ kṛte'pi yaṇādeśe bhaviṣyatītyadīṣaḥ| svaravidhau sthānivadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti cet? naitadasti; `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśau na sthānivat, anyastu sthānivadeva` (kā|vṛ|1.1.59) ityuktametat| `udañcanaḥ` iti| lyuṭ| atrāpyuttarapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| `coraniganto'ñcatau` ityādi| corityanena `cau` [[6.1.216]] ityanena yadantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate tadupalakṣayati| coritayasyāvakāśaḥ -dadhīcaḥ, yatra gatirna bhavati; anigantasavarasyāvakāśo yatrāñcaterakāranakārau na lupyete -parāṅ, parāñcāditi; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti -parācaḥ parāceti anigantaḥ svaro vati vipratiṣedhena| pratiṣedhaśabdastatrādhyāhāryaḥ||igantārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `udātatasavaritayoḥ` ityādi| nirudāttaḥ `upasargāścābhivarjam` (phi|sū|4|81) iti, tena tadakārasthāne yo yaṇādeśaḥ sa udāttayaṇ| tena `udāttasvaritayoḥ` [[8.2.4]] ityādinā tataḥ paramañcaterakāraḥ svarito bhavati| adhyaṅityādau tu na bhavati; ādeśādyudāttatvāt, yaṇādeśa udattayaṇ? na bhavatīti kṛtvā|| samāsasvarāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ| `īṣatkaḍāraḥ` iti| <<īṣadakṛtā>> [[2.2.7]] iti samāsaḥ| yadāyaṃ prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati, tadā samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `īṣadbheda ityevamādau kṛtsvara eva bhavati` iti| paratvāditi bhāvaḥ| ādiśabdena īṣatkara ityādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `īṣadduḥsuṣu` [[3.3.126]] ityādinā khal||hiraṇyaparimāṇaṃ parimāṇavad hiraṇyamityarthaḥ| iha tu tadvāciśabdarūpaṃ gṛhrate| `dvisuvarṇadhanam` iti| suvarṇaśabdo hiraṇyaparimāṇaviśeṣavācī| dve suvarṇe parimāṇamasyeti `taddhitārtha` [[2.1.50]] iti samāsaḥ| <> [[5.1.57]] iti <> [[5.1.18]] `adhyardhapūrva` (5.1.28 ityādinā luk, tato dhanaśabdena saha karmadhārayaḥ| dvisuvarṇaśabdaḥ samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `bahuvrīhāvapi` ityādi| yadvā -dvisuvarṇa dhanaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ; tadapi paratvādvikalpa eva bhavati; na tu `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] ityeṣa nityo vidhiḥ| `prasthadhanam` iti| ayamapi karmadhārayaḥ| bahuvrīhirvā| prasthaśabdo bhavati parimāṇaṃ, na tu hiraṇyasya, kiṃ tarhi? dhānyādeḥ| `kāñcanadhanam` iti| yadi parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā `hiraṇyam` ityetādaducyamāna ihāpi syāt; kāñcanaśabdasya hiraṇyavācitvāt| hiraṇyavācyapi parimāṇavācī na bhavatīti na bhavatyeṣa prasaṅgaḥ| ayamapi samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ||`aciropaśleṣaḥ` iti| acirakālasambandha ityartha-| asyaivārtha prasiddhatarārthena pradarśayatumāha -`abhinavatvam` iti| `prathamavaiyākaraṇaḥ` iti| prathamaśca vaiyākaraṇaśceti `pūrvāpara` [[2.1.57]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| tatra yattadvaiyākaraṇatvaṃ vyākaraṇasyādhyetṛtvam| anenācirakālasambandho'dhyeturgamyate| abhinavavaiyākaraṇādinā'cirakālopasampattimudāharaṇe darśayati| `ādyo mukhyo yaḥ saḥ` iti| anenāpi pratyudāharaṇaviṣayasya prathamaśabdasyānyārthatāṃ ca pakṣe'ciropasampatterabhāvaṃ ca| ayamapi samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi||`kiṃyattado nirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac` [[5.3.92]] `vā būnāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac` [[5.3.93]] iti katarakatamaśabdau vyutpādyete, tena tau citsvareṇāntodāttau| `katarakaṭhaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.63]] iti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ| etadarthamapi karmadhārayagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`iha tu` ityādi| katarakatamaśabdayorhi yaḥ pratipadasamāsaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) vijñāyate| sa ca karmadhāraya eva| tasmāt? pratipadoktatvādevaitatsamāsasya karmadhārayatvam| tasmannaitadarthaṃ karmadhārayagrahaṇamupapadyate||`āryabrāāhṛṇaḥ` iti| āryaścāsau brāāhṛṇaśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `āryaśabdo ṇyadantaḥ` iti| `ṛhaloṇryat` [[3.1.124]] iti ṇyati vyutpāditatvāt| `antasvaritaḥ` iti| titsvareṇa| pratyudāharaṇe tu samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati||rājabrāāhṛṇam` [`rājabrāāhṛṇaḥ` -kāśikā] iti| pūrvavat? samāsaḥ| pratyudāharaṇe'pi pūrvavat| rājaśabdaḥ kvaninpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ| `pṛthagyogakaraṇamuttarārtham` iti| uttaro vidhī rājaśabdasyaiva yathā syāt| āryaśabdasya mā bhūditi||`rājña) pratyenāḥ` iti| <<ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe>> [[6.3.21]] iti vibhakteraluk||nityaśabda ābhīkṣṇye, na kūṭasthe| kuta etat? kta ityucyate, ktaśca dhātorvidhīyate, dhātuśca kriyāvacanaḥ| kriyāpāśca kauṭasthyaṃ nopapadyate; kṣaṇikatvāt? kriyāyāḥ| tasyāstu paunaḥpunyādyapekṣayā yuktamābhīkṣṇyam| `kālāḥ [[2.1.27]] iti dvitīyāsamāso'yam` iti| dvitīyā tu <> [[2.3.5]] iti| atha vā -karmaṇyeva| karmasaṃjñā tu `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hrakarmaṇām` (ma|bhā|1.4.51) iti vacanāt| `nityaśabdaḥ` ityādi| anena `dhruva upasaṃkyānam` (vā|434) iti nernityaśabdo vyutpādyate tyadantaḥ| tataśca tyapaḥ pittvenānudāttatvānneścodāttatvādādyudātto bhavati| `satatamiti yadā karmaṇi ktastadā thāthādisvareṇāntodāttaḥ` iti -ayukto'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ| yadā hi karmaṇi ktastadā <> [[6.2.49]] iti gateḥ prakṛtibhāve satyādyudāttena satataśabdena bhavitavyam| tasmāt? `satatamiti yadā bhāve ktastadā thāthādi [[6.2.143]] svareṇāntodāttaḥ` ityayaṃ tatrānavadyaḥ pāṭho veditavyaḥ| tathā hi satataśabdo'pi thāthādisvareṇāntodāttaḥ [[6.2.143]] | bhāve hīyaṃ niṣṭheti gatisvaro na bhavatītyuktam| yadā tu kramaṇi ktastadā tu gatisvareṇa satataśabda dyudātta eva bhavati| `samo vā hitatatayoḥ` (vapā|6.1.149) iti samo makāralopaḥ| `muhūrtaprahasitaḥ` iti| atra thāthādisvara [[6.2.144]] eva bhavati prahasita iti haserakarmaktāvat? kartari ktaḥ| samāsasvare dvitīyāpūrvapadaprakṛtisavareṇa bādhite sati thāthādisvaraḥ prāpnoti| atastadapadādo yogaḥ||saptamīnirdiṣṭagrahaṇamanuvartate| tena śilpinītyarthagrahaṇam| grāma iti svarūpagrahaṇameva| `grāmanāpitaḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttaro'pi||`karmadhāraye` ityādi| rājanāpitaḥ` iti| karmadhārayo'yaṃ vā syāt, ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo vā? tatra yadā karmadhārayastadā rājaśabdasya nāpita upacāreṇa vṛttiḥ| upacārastu rājaguṇāropanibandhanaḥ, atastenaivottarapadasya praśaṃsā bhavati| kathaṃ punarnāpitaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena rājanāpitaśabdenocyate? ityāha `rājayogyatayā tasya` ityādi| sa hi svakarmaṇi pravīṇatvādrājānaṃ prati yogyo bhavati| ato'pi rājanāpita iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsenocyate| atra pakṣe tasyaiva yogyatayottarapadasya praśaṃsā veditavyā||`adiḥ` ityādinādyadhikārasyāvadhiṃ darśayati| `udāttaḥ` ityādināpyudāttādhikārasya||hārītyāvaśyake ṇiniḥ| saptamītyanena sāhacaryādhārīti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati| ata evāha -`hārivāci parvapadam` iti| `dhamrye` ityatrāpi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; aharaṇa iti pratiṣedhāt| ata evāha -`dhamryavācini` iti| `ācāraniyatam` iti| ācāre niyatamiti; tato'nyatrābhāvat| ācāre niyatam, ācāreṇa vā niyatamācāraniyatam| yadācāravaśādavaśyakartavyaṃ tadācāraniyataṃ bhavati| kathaṃ punarācāraniyataṃ dharmayamucyate? ityāha -`dharmo hranuvṛttaḥ` ityādi| anuvṛtta iti vyavasthita ityarthaḥ| `tasmāt` iti| dharmādanapetamiti| anugatamityarthaḥ| `tena` iti| dharmeṇa| `prāptam` iti| labhyamityarthaḥ| ubhayathāpyarthe `nauvayodharma` [[4.4.91]] ityādinā yat| itikaraṇo hiśabdaśca hetau| yasmādācāraviśeṣo dharma ucyate, yacca tasmāddharmādanapetam| yadvā tena prāpyaṃ taddhamryam| tenācāraniyataṃ dhamryamityucyate| <> [[8.2.11]] iti saptamīsagāsaḥ` iti| yadyevam, vibhakterluk? prāpnoti? ityata āha -`kāranāmni ca` ityādi| `yājñikāāḥ` ityādau tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `kvacit` ityādinā stūpeśāṇa ityādyudāharaṇeṣu śāṇāderyasyācāraniyatatāṃ darśayat? uttarapadasya dhamryavācitvaṃ darśayati -`yājñikādīnāmaāādi` iti| kvacidayamācāre vyavasthita ityanena dātavyamityanena ca sambandhaḥ| yājñikādayo hi hāriṇaḥ, te deyamaāādikaṃ svīkurvanti| `stamberamaḥ` iti| mtambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ` [[3.2.13]] ityac, upapadasamāsaḥ, <> [[6.3.14]] iti vibhakteralugbhavati| atra stamberama ityatra stamba ityet? saptamyantam, na tu ramaśabdo dhamryavācī| `karmakaravarddhitakaḥ` iti| atra karmakaro hārī bhavati, sa hi varddhitakaṃ svīkaroti| na tu varddhitakaśabdo dhamryavācī| na hi kvacidayamācāro vyavasthitaḥ karmakarāya varddhitako dātavya iti| `vaḍavāyā ayaṃ vāḍavaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| `bījaniṣekāt` iti| garbhādhānam=bījaniṣekaḥ| atra vāḍavo'āo hārī sa hi haraṇaṃ deyaṃ svīkaroti| haraṇam=deyaṃ dhamryam| kvacidayamācāro vyavasthitaḥ -yenāona vaḍavāyāṃ garbha ādhīyate tasya bījaniṣekāduttarakalaṃ śarīrapuṣṭarthaṃ yogyāśanādikaṃ dātavyamiti| tena haraṇaśabdo dhamryavācī bhavati| tathāpyaharaṇa iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati| tataśca kṛtsvare prāpte <> [[6.2.150]] ityuttarapadaṃ lyuḍantamantodāttaṃ bhavati| nanu ca paratvādevāyaṃ svaro bhaviṣyati, tat? `gatikārakopapadāt? kṛt? [[6.2.138]] iti kṛtsvareṇottarapadasyāntasvaritatvaṃ syāt| asmastu satyayameva hārisvaro bhavati| stūpeśāṇa ityādau yatra sampamyantaṃ pūrvapadaṃ tatra <> [[6.1.223]] ityasyāpavāde `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtitvare prāpte pūrvavadādyudāttamidamucyate| pūrvapadāni ca prāyeṇāntodāttāni, tathā hi -`sṭūpa samucchrāye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1672) ityasya caurādikasya pacādyaci stūpaśabdo vyutpādyate, tenā'sāvantodāttaḥ| saptamyā sahaikadeśe vikṛte'ntodātta eva bhavati| <> [[8.2.5]] iti| `maki maṇḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-89) ityetasmāt? vidāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1493) ityasmāt? `śṛdṛbhaso'diḥ` (da|u|6|42) iti, `dṛṇāteḥ ṣug? hyasavaśca` (da|u|6|45) iti dṛṣacchabdo vyutpādyate, tena so'pyantodāttaḥ| `yājñikāāḥ` ityādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| tatra samāsasvare prāpte hārivācinaḥ pūrvapavasyādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamarthamidam| atra ca pūrvapadānāmuttarapadānāṃ cāsamāsāvasthāyāṃ yaḥ svaraḥ sa nā''khyāyate; samāse kṛte tasya prayogasamavāyitvāt| nāpi samāse kṛte tasya prāptirasati| sa `prakṛtibhāvena tasmin? prāpte satīdamārabhyate` ityasyārthasya pradarśanārthamākhyāyate| ata eva ca pūrvatrāpi nākhyātaḥ||yuktaḥ=samāhitaḥ, kārye tatpara ityucyate| `goballavaḥ` iti| adhikāranāma, so'syāstīti `vaprakaraṇe'nyebhyo'pi dṛśyate (vā|580) iti vapratyayaḥ, gavāṃ ballava iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atrāpi samāsasvara eva prāpte pūrvapadādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| `gomaṇindaḥ` iti| maṇiṃ dadātīti <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] , <> [[6.3.14]] iti vibhkteraluk, tato gavāṃ maṇinda iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atrāpi samāsasvara eva prāpte'yaṃ vidhiḥ| `gosaṃkhyaḥ` iti| gāṃ sañcaṣṭa iti <> [[3.2.7]] iti kaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ `gatikārakopapadāt` [[6.2.139]] iti kṛtsvare prāpte pūrvapadasyodāttārthamihāpi vacanam! nanu ca paratvāt? thāthādisvaraḥ [[6.2.143]] prāpnoti, tasmādgoballavādau kathamidaṃ vacanamiti, yuktasvaraṃ kṛtsavara eva bādheta? evaṃ tarhi pūrvavipratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ; paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvāt| goballava ityevamādayaḥ samāsāḥ sarve yuktavācina iti darśayannāha -`yukta iti samāhitaḥ` ityādi| anena `yuja samādhau` (dhā|pa|1177) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ yukta ityetaddarśayati||adhyakṣaśabdo'pi samāse yuktavācyeva, tatra pūrveṇa nityamādyudāttatve prāpte vibhāṣeyamārabhyate| ādyudāttatvena mukte samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| gavāmadhyakṣa iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ||pāpamiti svarūpagrahaṇam| śilpinītyatrārthagrahaṇam| arthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, grāmaśilpinītyatra śilpigrahaṇādarthagrahaṇaṃ prasiddham, ata ihāpyarthagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate? nityaṃ samāsasvare prāpte vikalpena pūrvapadasyādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, tenamukte samāsasvara eva bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati -pāpasya nāpita iti? ata āha -`pāpaśabdasya pratipadoktaḥ` iti| `tasmāt? ṣaṣṭhī samāse na bhavati` iti| pratipadokte hi samāse sati lakṣaṇa pratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati; nānyasya||`gotrādhikārādanyatra gotragrahaṇe lokikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhate` (kā|vṛ|4.2.40) ityuktam| loke cāpatyamātre prasiddham, teneha tasyaiva grahaṇam, na tu pāribhāṣikasya| antevāsī=śiṣyaḥ| tatrāntevasigrahaṇādarthagrahaṇaṃ prasiddham| ata ihāpyartha eva gṛhrate, na svarūpam| māṇavabrāāhṛṇayoḥ svarūpameva| manorayaṃ māṇavaḥ, asmādeva nipātanāṇṇatvam| `abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti` (pu|pa|vṛ|99) iti pakṣe mānava ityapi bhavati| brāhṛṇo'yaṃ brāāhṛṇaḥ| yastu `apatye kutsite mūḍhe manorautsargikaḥ smṛtaḥ` (kā|vṛ|4.1.161) iti māṇavakaśabdo vyutpādyate, yaśca brāhṛṇo'patyaṃ brāāhṛṇa ityarthe brāāhṛṇaśabdaḥ tayorgotragrahaṇenaiva siddham| kṣepaḥ nindā| `jaṅghāvātsyaḥ` iti| `sup? supā` [[2.1.4]] iti samāsaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra kṣepaḥ? ityāha -`yo jaṅghādānam` ityādi| jaṅghādānaṃ kimapyācāraniyataṃ deyamucyate, taddadānyahamityato'bhiprāyeṇa vātsyaḥ sampadyate| vātsyo'hamityabhyupagacchati yaḥ saḥ jaṅghāvātsya ityevaṃ nindyate| avātsyasyāpi sato jaṅghādānaṃ prati vātsyatvābhyupagamāt| vātsyaśabdo'yaṃ gargādiḥ| `bhāryāsauśrutaḥ` iti| suśruto'patyaṃ sauśruta ityaṇ, bhāryāpradhānaḥ sauśruto bhāryāsauśrutaḥ| `samānādhikaraṇādhikāre śākapārthivādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamuttarapadalopaśca` (vā|83) iti samāsaḥ| suśrutasya bhāryāpradhānatayetyanena samānādhikaraṇenātra samāsa iti darśayati| suśruto'patyamityanenāpi sauśrutasyāṇpratyayāntatvam| `vaśābrāāhṛkṛteyaḥ` iti| tenaivopasaṃkhyānena samāsaḥ| atrāpi vaśāpradhānatayā brāhṛkṛtāpatyasya kṣepaḥ| `kumārīdīkṣāḥ` iti| `sup? supā` [[2.1.4]] iti samāsaḥ| evaṃ `kambalacārāyaṇīyāḥ` ityatrāpi| dākṣiṇā proktaṃ dākṣaṃ śāstram| `iñaśca` [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ, dākṣamadhīyate tadvettīti vā punaraṇ, tasya <> [[4.2.64]] iti luk| caraśabdo naḍādiḥ, carasyāpatyaṃ cārāyaṇaḥ, tena proktaṃ cārāyaṇīyam| <> [[4.2.114]] , `tadadhīte` [[4.2.58]] iti pūrvavadaṇ| pāṇinā proktaṃ pāṇanīyam, tataḥ pūrvavadadhyetaryaṇ? samāsaḥ| bhikṣālābhakāmo māṇavo bhikṣāmāṇavaḥ| `dāsībrāāhṛṇaḥ` iti| dāsyāḥ kāmayitā brāāhṛṇo dāsībrāāhṛṇaḥ| evaṃ `vṛṣalībrāāhṛṇaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.32]] iti bahulavacanādakṛtāpi samāsaḥ| `tṛtīyā` [[2.3.18]] iti yogavibhāgādvā| `dāsīśrotriyaḥ` iti| dāsībrāāhṛṇa ityanena tulyam| samāsasvarāpavāyo yogaḥ||aṅgaśabdo'yaṃ kāraṇavācī| ārambhakaṃ yat? tadaṅgamucyate| aṅgānīti bahuvacanaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārtham| surāvajryaṃ madyam=maireyamityabhidhīyate| `guḍamaireyaḥ, madhumaireyaḥ` iti| ṣṭhāsamāsaḥ| `guḍavikārasya mairayasya guḍo'ṅgam` iti| tatkāraṇatvāt| ayamapi samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ||ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārtham| nanu ca bahuvacanādeva svarūpavidhirna bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; bahuvacanaṃ hretadarthasyaiva bahutvamācakṣīta -bahvarthavṛttiryo bhaktaśabda iti| api ca bahuvacanena svarūpavidhau bādhite'nnādaya eva ye bhaktaśabdena samāsārthaparyāyāste gṛhreran, na tu bhakataviśeṣavācino bhikṣādayaḥ| ākhyāgrahaṇe tu svarūpavidau bādhite bahuvacanena tadviśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ sampadyate| tasmā idaṃ tadartham| tacchabdena bhaktākhyānāmartho nirdiśyate| `bhikṣākaṃsaḥ` ityevamādayaḥ `caturthī tadarthārtha` [[2.1.35]] iti caturthīsamāsāḥ| nanu ca prakṛtivikṛtigrahaṇaṃ tatra codyate, na ceha prakṛtivikārabhāvaḥ? ktapratyayam| tena dvāvapi pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] iti prakṛtibhāvenāntodāttādeva bhavataḥ| samāsasavarāpavādo yogaḥ||upamānaśabdo'yaṃ gavādibhiḥ pratyekamabhimasambadhyate; anyathaikavacanāntasya bahuvacanāntaiḥ samānādhikaraṇena viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo na syāt| tha vā subvyatyaye bahuvacanasyaiva sthāna idamekavacanaṃ draṣṭavyam| `dhānyagavaḥ` iti| <> [[5.4.92]] ṭaca samāsāntaḥ| atra citsvare prāpte pūrvapadasyādyudāttatavaṃ vidhīyate| `bhikṣābiḍālaḥ` ityevamādau samāsasvare| upamānārtho'pi` ityādi| yo'yamatrodāharaṇe upamānārthaḥ sambhavati, sa tatra yojayitavyaḥ| `yathāprasiddhi ca` iti| yasyopamānasyārthasya ca loke prasiddhiḥ sa tathā yojayitavyaḥ| tatra diṅmātramupamānārthayojanasya darśayitumāha -gavākṛtiḥ=gosaṃsthānam, tayā sanniveśitaṃ goryatsaṃsthānaṃ tena sanniveśitaṃ vyavasthāpitaṃ dhānyagavaśabdenocyate; tulyākṛtitvāt| evamanyatrāpi yat? kiñcit? sādṛśyaṃ yojyam| yathā goracanāviśeṣāvayavānāmevaṃ yasya hiraṇyasya taddhiraṇyaṃ hiraṇyagavaśabdenocyate| yathā biḍālā alpapramāṇāstathā hi bhikṣā, yathā vā biḍālāḥ kvacidbhavanti na sarvatra tathā bhikṣāpi| evaṃ śrāṇābiḍālayoḥ sādṛśyamevañjātīyakaṃ yojayitavyam| siṃhākṛtyā sanniviṣṭaṃ tṛṇaṃ tṛṇasiṃhaḥ| yathā saindhavaṃ śuklamevaṃ saktuḥ saktusa#aindhavaḥ| evaṃ pānasaindhavaḥ||`ake iti pratyayagrahaṇam| tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (nī|pa|vṛ|31) tadantasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha -`akapratyayānta uttarapade` iti| `jīvikāvācini` iti| jīvikā=jīvakaḥ tadvācinītyarthaḥ| jīvikāśabdo hrarśāaderākṛtigaṇatvānmatvarthīyākārāntaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ| ata eva vṛttau dantalekhanādibhiryeṣāṃ jīvikā ta evamucyanta ityāha -`dantalekhalaḥ` iti| likerṇvul, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṣaṣṭhī punaḥ <> [[2.3.65]] iti karmaṇi| `avaskaraśodhakaḥ` iti| `śudha śaucakarmaṇi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1191) [`śauce` -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ityasmāṇṇyantāṇṇvul| `ramaṇīyakārakaḥ` ityatrāpi karoteḥ| `ramaṇīyakartā` iti| pūrvavat?
