tantusantāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1006) iti| tantūn? vayatīti hvāvāmaśca` [[3.2.2]] ityaṇ, `āto yuk? ciṇkṛtoḥ` [[7.3.33]] iti yuk| `ayaskāraḥ` ti| `ataḥ kṛkami` [[8.3.46]] ityādinā visarjanīyasya sakāraḥ| pratyudāharaṇeṣu kṛtsvara eva bhavati||`gopālaḥ` iti| `pā rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1056), pūrvavadaṇ| `aniyuktārtha ārambhaḥ` iti| niyukte <> [[6.2.75]] ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| `gorakṣaḥ` iti| `rakṣa pālane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-658)||`pūṣpahārī` iti harateḥ `vrate` [[3.2.80]] <> [[3.2.81]] iti vā ṇiniḥ||`śabdārthaprakṛtau` iti| śabdārthaḥ prakṛtiryasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `upamānaṃ niyamyate` ti| yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇaṃ bhavati| iha ca śabdārthaprakṛterevakāraḥ, tasmādupamānaniyamo bhavati, atastanniyamyate| `uṣṭrakośī` iti| `kruśa āhvāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-856) [āhvāne rodane ca -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ityasmāt? `kartaryupamāne` [[3.2.79]] iti ṇiniḥ| ṇininaiva sādṛśyasyoktatvādvṛttāvivaśabdo na prayujyate| `dhvāṅkṣarāvī` iti| `ru śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1034) pūrvalakṣaṇāṇṇiniḥ| `kharanādī` iti| `ṇada avyakte śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-54)|`upamānagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadyupamānagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā pūrvasya yogasyāsya ca viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyeta| yadi yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyādviṣayāntaramya kalpyeta, tathāpīṣṭo viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyeta| upamānagrahaṇe tu sati pūrvasya sāmānyaṃ viṣayaḥ, asya tu viśeṣa upamānamiti viṣayavibhāgo niścīyeta| tena viṣayavibhāgārthamupamānagrahaṇam| `vṛkavañcī` iti| `vañcu pralambhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1703)| `vṛkaprekṣī` iti| `īkṣa darśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-610) prapūrvaḥ| atra kṛtsvara eva bhavati| `prakṛtireva` ityādi| yadi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā śabdārthāt? paro yo ṇinistadanta uttarapada ityevaṃ vijñāyeta? tataśca gardabhoccārī kokilābhivyāhārītyasyāpi syāt; bhavati hyatrāpi dhātūpasargasamudāyācchabdārthāt? paro ṇiniḥ, atastadantamutatarapadam| tasmādiha mā bhūditi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ kriyate, teneha na bhavati| prakṛtigrahaṇe sati yatropasarganirapekṣā gatyarthatvāt, harateśca haraṇārthatvāt| yadvā -yo'tra śabdārtho dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ, na tasmāṇṇinervidhānam| yadi pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam, evaṃ siddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo niyamāya bhavatītyanarthakamevakārakaraṇam? ityāha -`evakārakaraṇam` ityādi| asati hrevakāra upamāna eva śabdārthaprakṛtāvityevamavadhāraṇaṃ syāt, tataśca śabdārthaprakṛtireva niyamyeta -śabdārthaprakṛtau yadi bhavatyupamāna eva bhavati, nānupamāna iti| tataścānupamāne na syāt| tasmādupamānāvadhāraṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthamevakāraḥ kriyate| kiṃ kāraṇam? ityāha -`śabdārthaprakṛtau tu` ityādi| tuśabdo hetau| tasmāt? śabdārthaprakṛtāvupamānamanupamānaṃ cādyudāttaṃ bhavati| tasmādupamānāvadhāraṇārthamevakārakaraṇam| upamānaniyame hi sati śabdārthaprakṛteraniyatatvāt? tatrāviśeṣeṇa sarvasyādyudāttatvaṃ labhyate| `siṃhavinardī` iti| upamānasyodāhaṇam| `puṣkalajalpī` iti| anupamānasya| puṣkalajalpītyatra `vratte` [[3.2.80]] <> [[3.2.81]] iti vā ṇiniḥ||kṛtsvarāpavādo yogaḥ| `kṛṭījaḥ` iti| kuṭaāṃ jāta iti `saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ [[3.2.97]] iti ḍapratyayaḥ||ayamapi kṛtsvarapabādo yogaḥ|`dagdhajāni` iti| atra kṛtsvara eva bhavati||`nivasantaśabdo'yamauṇādiko gṛhrate| `jṛviśibhyāṃ jhac` (da|u|6|17) iti vartamāne `tṛbhūvahivasibhāsisādhigatimaṇḍijinandibhyaśca` (da|u|6|19) [tṛbhṛvahivasibhāsisādhigāḍimaṇḍijivandibhyaśca -da|u|] iti vasernipūrvājjhac| nivasatīti nivasantaḥ| kecicchannantasya vasacchabdasaya grahaṇaṃ varṇayanti| `mallagrāmaḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `devagrāmaḥ` iti| vāṭakaparikṣipte gṛhasamudāye grāmaśabdo vartate| tasmāddevasvāmika ityarthaḥ| etena svasvāmibhāvasambandhā yā sā'tra ṣaṣṭhī samasyate, na tu kriyāvāsasambandheti darśayati; anyathā devaśabdaḥ pūrvapada nivasantavācyeva syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `dākṣyādayo nivasanti yasmin` ityādinā pratyudāharaṇe pūrvapadasya nivasantavācitvaṃ darśayati||samāsasavarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi| `na bhūtādhikasañjīva` [[6.2.91]] ityādeḥ sūtrādye yogāsta samāsasvarāpavādā draṣṭavyāḥ| `dākṣīghoṣaḥ`ityevamādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| `yānayatra` ityādi| kathaṃ punaretalalabhyate, yāvatā'nivasanta iti prakṛtam? ityata āha -`anivasantaḥ` iti| `apare` ityādi| teṣāṃ matena yānyatra nivāsanāmadheyāni teṣu nivasadvācīnyapyudāttā bhavanti||`yadā śālāntaḥ` ityādi| `vibhāṣā senāsurā` [[2.4.25]] ityādinā śālāntasya tatpuruṣasya vibhāṣā napuṃsakatvamuktam? iha ca śālāśabdasya strīliṅgasya grahaṇam| tatra yathā samāso napuṃsakaliṅgo na bhavati tathā <> [[6.2.123]] ityanena paratvāduttarapadādyudāttatvena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt| atastannirāsāya `yadā śālāntaḥ` ityādegrranthasyopanyāsaḥ| yo napuṃsakaliṅgaḥ śālāntatatpuruṣo na bhavati so'syāvakāśaḥ -chāttriśālā, ailiśāleti| yastu napuṃsakaliṅgo na chāttrādipūrvapadastatpuruṣaḥ sa `śālāyāṃ napuṃsake` [[6.2.122]] ityasyāvakāśaḥ -brāāhṛṇaśālam, kṣattriyaśālamiti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti -chāttriśālamiti, pūrvavipratiṣedhenāyameva svaro bhavati||prasthaśabdo yadi vyutpādyate `ghañarthe kavidhānaṃ sthāsnapāvyadhihaniyudhyartham` (vā|306) iti, tadā thāthādisvare [[6.2.143]] prāpte| atha na vyutpādyate, tadā samāsāntodāttatve| `indraprasthaḥ` ityādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ||`suhranagaram` ityādayo'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā eva| kimarthaṃ prācāmityevaṃ nocyate, [nocyeta -mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ladhu hi prācāmiti vacanamanudīcāmiti vacanāt? naivaṃ śakyam; madhyadeśanagare virāṭanagaramityatra na syāt| pūrvapadādyudāttatve prāpte pratiṣedho'mucyate, na samāsa eva bhavati||`madrāśmagrahaṇam` ityādi| ubhayatrāpi dvyac? tryajiti ca prāptirasti| tasmāt? saṅghātārthaṃ vigṛhītārthañca vacanam| kathaṃ punaḥ saṃghātavigṛhītārthatvaṃ labhyate? ekāśeṣaṃ kṛtvā madrāśma iti nirdeśāt| madrāśmā ca madrāśmānau cetyekaśeṣaḥ| ekaśeṣe sati madraśabdasya kevalasya, madraśabdasya ca saṅghātasya pratiṣedha upapadyate| ādyudāttasya prakaraṇamityādyudāttaprakaraṇam, prakāntam| tatra divodāsā dīnāṃ chandasyādyudātto bhavatītyeta dartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānāṃ tu -<> [[6.2.66]] ityevamādau ye'smin? prakaraṇe cakārāḥ, teṣāmanyatamasyānuktasamuccayārthatāmāśritya kartavyam||`guṇakārtsnye` iti| guṇakārtsnya guṇasya sarvatrābhāvaḥ| `sarvaotaḥ` iti| `pūrvakālaika` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ| atra samudāyaguṇasya sarvatra bhāvaḥ| na tu tadavayave tatra sarvaśabdo vartata iti guṇakārtsnyasya vṛttirbhavati| `paramaotaḥ` iti| kathaṃ punaratra guṇakārtsnye paramaśabdo vartate, yāvatāsau prakarṣavācī, anyaśca prakarṣaḥ, anyacca guṇakārtsnyam? ityata āha -`āśrayavyāptyā` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādāśrayavyāptyā paramatvamutkarṣe bhavati, nānyathā| evaṃ hi tasyotkarṣa upapadyate yadi sarvamāśrayaṃ vyāpnoti| tasmādguṇakārtsnyaṃ iha paramaśabdo vartate| `sarvasauvarṇaḥ, sarvarājataḥ` iti| suvarṇasya vikāraḥ sauvarṇaḥ, rajatasya vikāro rājataḥ -nātra guṇakārtsnyam, kiṃ tarhi? jātiyuktasya vikāravaṣayaṃ kārtsnyam| sarva hi vikāradravyaṃ prakṛtibhāvena vyāpnotīti dravyakārtsnyamiha, tatra ca sarvaśabdo vartate| `sarveṣāṃ otataraḥ sarvaotaḥ` iti| atra guṇakārtsnye| kathaṃ punaratra samāsaḥ, yāvatā `pūraṇagaṇasuhita` [[2.2.11]] ityādinā guṇavacanena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ? athāpi kathañcit? samāsaḥ syāt, evamapi otataraśabdena samāse kṛte sarvaotataramiti vaktavyam? ityata āha -`guṇāt? tareṇa samāsaḥ` ityādi| aupasaṃkhyānikāviha samāsataralopāviti darśayati| samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi yogāḥ| <> [[6.2.101]] ityataḥ prāk? samāsasvarāpavādo veditavyaḥ||`añjanāgiriḥ` ityevamādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| añjanabhañjanaśabdayoḥ `vanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyām` [[6.3.116]] iti dīrghatvam| `śāpiṇḍimauṇḍiśabdau` iñantau| `cikhilliśabdaḥ` matvarthīyenipratyayāntaḥ||`vṛddhakumārī` iti| <> [[2.1.57]] iti samāsaḥ| `jaratkumārī` iti| jaratī cāsau kumārī ceti `pūrvakāla` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| ubhayatra <> [[6.3.42]] ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ| nanu ca kumārīśabdaḥ prathame vayasi vartate, tathā hi <> [[4.1.20]] iti ṅībatra vihitaḥ, vṛddhājaratīśabdau carame vayasi vartate, tatkathamiha sāmānādhikaraṇyam? ityata āha - `kumārīśabdaḥ puṃsā sahāsamprayogamātraṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāya prayuktaḥ` iti| asamprayogaḥ=asambandhaḥ| tanmātrapravṛttinivṛttisamudāyāvayavaḥ sāmānye pravṛttaḥ| kumārīśabdo yathā vṛddhādibhiḥ vayoviśeṣavacanairviśeṣyate tadā taiḥ samānādhikaraṇo bhavati| vayoviśeṣo'ntyaṃ vayaḥ| kathaṃ punarviśeṣavacanaṃ sāmānye vartate? vayograhaṇasāmarthyāt| yadi vṛddhakumārīśabdaḥ prathame vayasi vartate vayograhaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| yatara kumārīśabdaḥ prayujyate prathamavayovācī, tatra niyogato vayo gamyata eveti kiṃ vayograhaṇena! tasmādvayograhaṇasāmarthyāt? yathoktena prakāreṇa vayaḥsāmānye pravartate| vayograhaṇena hi tasmādviśeṣādapanīyāsau sāmānyavṛttirāśrīyate| `tacca vaya iha gṛhrate` iti| yatra vartamāno viśeṣavacanaiḥ saha samānādhikaraṇo bhavati, tacca vayo gṛhrate| caśabdādanyacca yauvanādīnakumāratvameveti, na prathamavaya ityarthaḥ| `paramakumārī` iti| atra samāsāt? pūjyamānatā; pūjyamānatvaṃ tu darśanīyatvāt| darśanīyā kanyetyarthaḥ| na hyatra samāso vayo'bhidhānaparaḥ| nāpayuttarapadaṃ vayaḥsāmānye vartate||`miśram` iti| dravyāntarasampṛktamityarthaḥ| `guḍamiśram` iti| śākapārthivāditvā(vā|83)duttarapadalopisamāsaḥ| `śītodakam` iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| pūrvapadamatra guṇopasarjanamudakaṃ brūte| uttarapadamapi jātyupasarjanam| tathaiva tenaikameva vastu jātiguṇābyāmucyata iti kevalodakavācisamāsaḥ||`gargatrirātrādayaḥ` ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| tisṛṇāṃ rātrīṇāṃ samāhārastriratraḥ| `ahaḥsarvekadeśa [[5.4.87]] ityādināc? samāsāntaḥ| `atirātraḥ` iti| rātrimatikrānta iti prādisamāsaḥ||`gopālasabham` ityevamādayo'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ, `sabhārājā'manuṣyapūrvā` [[2.4.23]] iti napuṃsakatvam| `rājasabhā, brāāhṛṇasabhā` ityatra `amanuṣyapūrvā` iti pratiṣedhānnapuṃsakatā na bhavati|atheha kasmānna bhavati -ramaṇīyā sabhā'sya brāāhṛṇakulasya ramaṇīyasabham? ityata āha -`pratipadoktam` ityādi| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) yat? pratipadoktaṃ napuṃsakaṃ tadiha gṛhrate| na ceha tathāvidhaṃ napuṃsakatvam| atra tu `abhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti` (vyā|pa|73) iti brāāhṛṇakulasyābhidheyasya napuṃsakatvāt| na tat? pratipadoktam||`lalāṭapuram` ityevamādayaḥ ṣaṣṭīsamāsāḥ||`ariṣṭapuram? gauḍapuram` iti| etāvapi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāveva| `pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| evaṃ manyate -ariṣṭagauḍayoriti vaktavyam, evamapyucyamāne'riṣṭagoḍayoḥ puraśabda uttarapade'ntodāttatavaṃ sidhyatyeveti| `ihāpi yathā syāt` iti| yadi pūrvagrahaṇaṃ na kriyet? tadāriṣṭaṃ śritastasya puramariṣṭaśritapuramiti| gauḍānāṃ bhṛtyā gauḍaśabdau| pūrvagrahaṇe tu sati bahuvrīhirlabhyate -ariṣṭagauḍau pūrvau yasmin? samāse so'riṣṭagauḍapūrva iti| tenāriṣṭaśritapuram, gauḍabhṛtyapuramityatrāpi yaduttarapadaṃ tasyāpyantodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva| atrāpi hrariṣṭaśabdo gauḍaśabdaśca pūrvaḥ| pūrvaścāyamavayavavacanaḥ||`kusūlabilam` ityevamādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi `bahuvrīhau viāṃ saṃjñāyām` [[6.2.106]] ityataḥ prāgyogāḥ samāsasvarāpavādāḥ veditavyāḥ||`pūrveṣukāmaśamī` iti| <> [[2.1.50]] iti samāsaḥ| evaṃ `apareṣukāmaśamī` ityatrāpi| `pūrvakṛṣṇamṛttikā` iti| pūrvā cāsau kṛṣmamṛttikā ceti `pūrvāpara` [[2.1.57]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| evaṃ `aparakṛṣṇamṛttikā` ityevamādāvapi| adhirāmamadhikṛtya kṛto grantha ādhirāmam| <> [[4.3.87]] ityaṇ| atha yatā -cānarāṭe rūpagrahaṇaṃ tathā grāmādiṣvapi kasmānna bhavati? arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavatītyuktam| iha cānarāṭa eva śabdapradhāno nirdeśa, grāmādiṣvarthapradhāna eva| atha śabdagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na digityevocyate? ityata āha -`śabdagrahaṇam` ityādi| asati hi śabdagrahaṇe pūrvādhirāmam, pūrvayāyātamityatra na syāt| kasmātiha kālavācī pūrvaśabdaḥ| digvāciśabdagrahaṇe sati dikśabdamātragrahaṇaṃ bhavati| tasmāt? kālavācino'pi dikśabdasya parigraho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ śabdagrahaṇam||`ācāryopasarjanaśca` iti| supāṃ surbhavatīti saptamyekavacanasya sthāne prathamaikavacanam, etaccāntevāsiviśeṣaṇam| `ācāryopasarjanāntevācinyuttarapade` iti| ācārya upasarjanampradhānaṃ yasya antevāsinaḥ sa tathoktaḥ| ācāryopasarjanaścāntevāsī cācāryopasarjanāntevāsī, taṃ vaktuṃ śīlaṃ yasyottarapadasya tadācāryopasarjanāntevāsivāci| `pūrvapāṇinīyāḥ` iti| `pūrvāpara` [[2.1.57]] ityādinā samāsaḥ pāṇinerācāryasyāntevāsinaḥ pāṇinīyāḥ, atrāntevāsinaḥ prādhānyenocyante pratyayāntena; ācāryastu tadviśeṣaṇatvādupasarjanabhāvenetyācaryopasarjanāntevāsivācyuttarapadaṃ bhavati| `pūrvakāśakṛtsnāḥ` iti| kāśakṛtsnasyeme kāśakṛtsnāḥ, autsargiko'ṇ|`pūrvapāṇinīyaṃ śāstram` iti| pāṇinā proktaṃ pāṇinīyam, atrācāryopasarjanaśāstravācyuttarapadam, na tvācāryopasarjanāntevāsivāci||`uttarapadavṛddhau` iti| uttarapadādhikāravihitā vṛddhiruttarapadavṛddhiḥ, iha tu tadvaduttarapadaṃ gṛhrate| tamevārthaṃ darśayitumāha -`uttarapadasyotyevam` ityādi| kathaṃ punaruttarapadavṛdadhāvityucyamāna eṣo'rthaḥ śakyate vijñātum? taducyate; uttarapadaṃ svaryate, svaritenādhikāro lakṣyate, tenottarapadasyetyadhikṛtya yā vihitā vṛddhistāsyāstāvadgrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| pūrvapadasyedamantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| pūrvapadaṃ ca sambandhiśabdatvāduttarapadamupasthāpayati| na ca vṛddhimātra uttarapadamupapadyata iti sāmarthyādvṛddhiśabdasāhacaryāduttarapadaṃ vṛddhimupalakṣayati| tenottarapadādhikāre vṛddhimatyuttarapada eṣa svaro bhavatīti vijñāyate| `sarvapāñcālakaḥ` iti| `pūrvakālaika` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `pūrvapāñcālakaḥ` ityādau `pūrvāpara` [[2.1.57]] ityādinā| `janapadalakṣaṇo vṛñpratyayaḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.121]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[4.2.124]] ityato janapadagrahaṇe ca <> [[4.2.125]] ityanena vañ|`susarvādrdhāt` ityādi| `sarvapāñcālakaḥ` iti| `susarvardhājjanapadasya` [[7.3.12]] ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `pūrvapāñcālakaḥ` ityādau tu <<diśo'madrāṇām>> [[7.3.13]] iti| eṣā cottarapadādhikāravihitā, tatra cottarapadasyetyanuvṛtteḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamuttarapadādhikāra uttarapadagrahaṇena lakṣyata ityevaṃ vijñāyate? ityāha -`adhikāra lakṣaṇāt` ityādi| yadyuttarapadagrahaṇenottarapadādhikāro lakṣyeta, tadā vṛddhimātravatyuttarapade vaitadvuño hru vāttatvaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ syāt| tathā ca sarvabhāsaḥ, sarvakāraka ityatrāpi syāt| adhikāralakṣaṇe tu na bhavati, na hrudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ syāt| tathā ca sarvabhāsaḥ, sarvakāraka ityatrāpi syāt| adhikāralakṣaṇe tu na bhavati, na hruttarapadādhikāravihitā vṛddhiḥ| `bhāsṛ dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-624) bhāsata iti bhāsaḥ, pacādyac| karotīti kārakaḥ, ṇvul, <> [[7.2.115]] iti vṛddhiḥ, sā cottarapadādhikāravihitā na bhavati||`pūrvapadakṛtisvaratvenādyudāttatvaṃ prāptam` iti| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] | ityādinā vio ca te devā viāvevā iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, tatpuruṣo'yam| atra samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `viādevaḥ` iti| atra pūrvapadaprakṛtisparatvenādyadāttatvameva bhavati| viāśabdasaya kvanpratyayantasya nitsvareṇādyudāttatvam| `viāāmitraḥ` iti| `bahuvarīhau viāṃ saṃjñāyām` [[6.2.106]] iti pūrvapadāntodāttasyāvakāśaḥ -viādevaḥ, viāyaśā iti| <> [[6.2.165]] ityuttarapadāntodāttatvasyāvakāśaḥ -kulamittram, kulājinamiti; viāāmittraḥ, viāājina ityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, <> [[6.2.165]] ityetattu bhavati vipratiṣedhena||`bandhuni` iti| śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakaliṅganirdeśaḥ, anyathā bandhuśabdasya puṃlliṅgatvāt? `bandhau` iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| `gārgībandhuḥ, vātsībandhuḥ` iti| gargavatsaśabdābhyāṃ gargāditvāt? [[4.1.105]] yañ? tadantāt? `yañaśca` [[4.1.16]] iti ṅīp| gārgīvātsīśabdau ñitsvareṇādyudāttau| `brāhṛbandhuḥ` iti| atra prakṛtibhāva eva bhavati pūrvapadasya| brāhṛśabdaścāyaṃ `manin` (da|u|6|73) ityanuvartamāne `bṛherno'cca` (da|u|6|74) iti bhaninpratyayānto vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| `gārgīpriyaḥ` iti| gārgīśabdo'pi prakṛtibhāvenādyudātta eva bhavati||`prakṣālitapādaḥ` iti| `kṣala śaucakarmaṇi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1597) asmāṇṇayantāt? ktaḥ| pakṣālitaśabdaḥ <> [[6.2.49]] ityādyudāttaḥ| `pradhautamukham` iti| `dhāvu gatiśuddhyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-601) asmāt? ktaḥ| <> [[6.4.19]] ityūṭh, <> [[6.1.89]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `yadi mukhaśabdaḥ` ityādi| mukhaśabdo'yaṃ svāṅgavācyapi| tatra yadyayamiha svāṅgavācī tadānena pūrvapadāntodāttatvameva| mukte pakṣe <> [[6.2.167]] ityuttarapadādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| atra niṣṭhopasargapūrvamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteryadā'ntodāntatvaṃ bhavati tadā <> [[6.2.49]] ityetat| tena svāṅgavācini mukhaśabde trayaḥ svarā bhavanti| anena pūrvapadāntodāttatvam, <> [[6.2.167]] ityanenottarapadantodāttatvam, <> [[6.2.49]] iti prakṛtibhāvāt? pūrvapadasyādyudāttatvam| `na cet` ityādi| yadi mukhaśabdo'tra svāṅgāvacī na bhavati tadā <> [[6.2.167]] ityasyāyaṃ viṣayo na bhavatauti <> [[6.2.49]] iti vidhinā mukte pravartate| tena svāṅgavācini mukhaśabde dvau svarau bhavataḥ -pūrvapadasyādyudāttatvam, antodāttatvañca| `prasecakamukham` [prasecakamukhaḥ -kāśikā] iti| atra pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| prasicyata iti prasecakaḥ <> [[3.3.113]] iti karmaṇi ṇvul, <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ, `tatpuruṣe tulyārthe` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā'vyayaprakṛtibhāvaḥ| tena prasecakaśabda ādyudātta iti| `śuṣkamukhaḥ` iti| <<śuṣaḥ kaḥ>> [[8.2.51]] iti niṣṭhāyāṃ kādeśaḥ| pratyayasvareṇa śuṣkaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| bahuvrībau prakṛtibhāvena nityamevāntodātto bhavati||varṇam=śukalādi, lakṣyate'neneti lakṣaṇam=cihnam, varṇañca lakṣaṇañca varṇalakṣaṇam| dvandva ekavadbhāvaḥ| arthagrahaṇaṃ ceha varṇalakṣaṇayoḥ; arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| `otakarṇaḥ kṛṣṇakarṇaḥ` iti| otakṛṣṇaśabdāvantodāttau| tathā hi -`śitā varṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-742) ityasmāt? pacādyaci otaśabdo vyutpādyate| kṛṣmaśabdo'pi `iṇsiñcidīṅyuṣyavibhyo nak` (da|u|5|35) [iṇsiñdīṅuṣvavibhyo nak -da|u|] ityanuvartamāne `kṛṣervarṇe` (da|u|5|37) iti nakpratyaye| `dātrākarṇaḥ` iti| <> [[3.2.181]] iti vartamāne `dāmnīśas` [[3.2.182]] ityādinā ṣṭranpratyayaḥ, tena dātraśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `śaṅkūkarṇaḥ iti| `kṛgrorucca` (da|u|1|109) [kṛgrorucca -da|u|] ityanuvartamāne `kharuśaṅkupīyunīlaṅguligu (da|u|1|120) iti kupratyayāntaḥ śaṅkuśabdo'ntodātto nipātyate| `dhāpṛvasyajyatibhyo naḥ` (da|u|5|39) ityadhikṛtya `kṛvṛcchasidrūpanyanisvapibhyo nit` (da|u|5|42) [kṛvṛjṛsidrupanyanisvapibhyo nit -da|u] iti karṇaśabdo vyutpādyate, bhinnacchinnadraruāuvasvastikasya` [[6.3.114]] iti sūtramupalakṣayati|`otapādaḥ` ityādi| pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati -sthūlakarṇa iti, sthūlenāpi hi karṇena lakṣyata eva tataśca lakṣaṇādityeva siddham? ityata āha -`paśūnāṃ vibhāgajñāpanārtham` ityādi| tena sthūlakarṇa ityatra na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyenoktau viśeṣasaya grahaṇaṃ labhyate? varṇagrahaṇājjñāpakāt| yadi lakṣaṇamātrasyeha grahaṇabhimataṃ syādvarṇagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, varṇo hi lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva| tenāpi lakṣyata iti kṛtvā, kṛtaśca| tasmāt? tadeva jñāpayati -viśiṣṭamiha lakṣaṇaṃ guhrata iti| yat? punarviśiṣṭaṃ vyākhyānāt? tadvijñeyam| `otapādaḥ` iti| `iātā varṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-742) ityasmātad? pacādyaci otaśabdo vyutpādyate, tenāntodātto'yam| `kūṭaśṛṅgaḥ` iti| `kūṭa dāhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1890) [kūṭa paritāpe (paridāhe ityanye) dhātupāṭhaḥ-] iti, asmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ [[3.1.135]] kaḥ, tena kūṭaśabdo'pyantodātta eva| `śobhanakarṇaḥ` iti| `śubha śumbha śobhārthe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1321,1322) asmāt? <> [[3.2.149]] iti yuc| citsvareṇa śobhanaśabdo'pyantodāttaḥ| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāpadādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi yogāḥ prāgavyayībhāvasaṃśabdanāt| tena sarvatra pratyudāharaṇeṣu pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ pratyudāhāryaḥ||`kuñci karṇaḥ, maṇikarṇaḥ` iti| `kuci śabde tāre` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-184) [kuca -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `aṇa raṇa vaṇa bhaṇa maṇa` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-444|448) iti maṇirbhvādau paṭhate ābhyām? (vā|577) iti rapratyayaḥ, tena kharaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ||`kaṇeṣṭhaḥ` (paṃ|u|1|105) iti ṭhapratyayāntatvāt? kaṇṭhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `ḍityapṛṣṭhagūthayūthaprothāḥ` (da|u|6|37) [titha -da|u; paṃ|u|] iti pṛṣṭhaśabdo'ntodātto nipātyate| `iṇśībhyāṃ van` (da|u|8|126) ityato vanpratyaye'nuvartamāne `śevayahvajihvāgrīvāpvamāvāḥ` (da|u|8|128) iti grīvāśabdo'ntodātto nipātyate| atyantaṃ hanita gacchatīti hanteryaṅ, dvirvacanam, nugato'nunāsikāntasya` [[7.4.85]] iti nuk, <> [[7.3.55]] iti kutvam, jaṅghanya iti sthite pacādyac? <<yaṅo'ci ca>> [[2.4.74]] iti yaṅo luk; ṭāp, citsvareṇa jaṅghāśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| atha vā -`hanterac? jaṅgha ca` [[2.4.74]] iti yaṅo luk; ṭāp, citsvareṇa jaṅghāśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| atha vā -`hanterac? jaṅgha ca` (paṃ|u|5|31) [`ac? tasya jaṅgha ca -paṃ|u|] iti hanteracpratyayo jaṅgha ityayamādeśa ityevaṃ vā jaṅghaśabdo vyutpādyate| eṣāṃ kaṇṭhādīnāṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ| `śitikaṇṭhaḥ` iti| `sarvadhātubhya in` (paṃ|u|4|117) iti vartamānaṃ `kramitamiśāḍistambhāmata icca` (paṃ|u|4|121) [śati -paṃ|u|] iti śitiśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `nīlakaṇṭhaḥ` iti| `nīla varṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-522), [`nīla varṇe -dhā|pa|] asmāt? ghañ, tena nīlaśabdo'pyādyudāttaḥ| `kharakaṇṭhaḥ` iti| kharasyeva kaṇṭho'syeti vigrahaḥ| khamasyāstīti `raprakaraṇe khamukhakuñjebhya upasaṃkhyānāt? (vā|577) rapratyayaḥ, tena kharo'ntodāttaḥ| `uṣṭrakaṇṭhaḥ` iti| uṣṭrasyeva kaṇṭho'syeti `ṣṭran` (da|u|8|79) iti vartamāne `uṣakhanibyāṃ kit` (da|u|8|82) iti `uṣa dāhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-696) ityasmāt? ṣṭran, kicca| tenoṣṭraśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `kāṇḍapṛṣṭhaḥ` iti| kāṇḍaṃ pṛṣṭhamasyeti kāṇḍaśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasyānisantasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityudāttaḥ| `nākapṛṣṭham` iti| nāsyākamastīti `na bhrāṭ` [[6.3.74]] ityādinā prakṛtibhāvānnalopābhāvaḥ| <> [[6.2.172]] ityuttarapadāntodāttavidhānānnākaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ `gopṛṣṭham` i| goriva pṛṣṭhamasyeti| gośabda uktasvaraḥ| `ajapṛṣṭham` iti| ajasyeva pṛṣṭhamasyeti `aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-230) asmāt? ghañ| tena nīlaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `daśagrīvaḥ` iti| daśa grīvā asyeti daśaśabdaḥ `nraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ` (phi|sū2|28) ityādyudāttaḥ| `aāgrīvaḥ` iti| aāsyeva grīvā'syeti| gośabdo'āśabdaścoktasvaraḥ| `nārījaṅghaḥ` iti| nārī jaṅghā yasyeti| śaṅrgaravādiṣu `nṛnarayośca` (ga|sū|57) iti paṭhayante, tenādyudāttaḥ| `tālajaṅghaḥ` iti| tālo jaṅghā yasyeti `tala pratiṣṭhākaraṇe (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1598) [pratiṣṭhāyām -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] curādiḥ, tasmāt? ca` (paṃ|u|1|124) iti ca `śṛṇātehryasvaśca` (paṃ|u|1|125) iti ganpratyayāntaḥ śṛṅgaśabdo vyutpādyate| tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| udgataśabdasthāthādi [[6.2.143]] svareṇāntodāttaḥ| `dvyaṅgulaśṛṅgaḥ` iti| dve aṅgulī pramāṇamasyeti taddhitārthe dviguḥ `pramāṇe dvayasac` [[5.2.37]] ityādinā vihitasya mātraca āgatasya lopaḥ| `pramāṇe lo dvigornityam` (vā|558,559) iti <> [[5.4.86]] ityac? samāsaḥ| vaserācchādanārthāt? ṣṭran? vastram, tenādyudāttam| `kambalacīram` iti| `ghṛtādīnāñca` (phi|sū|1|21) iti kambalaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ||`pala rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-839), [pala gatau -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `kalastṛpaśca` (da|u|8|107) iti vartamāne `vṛṣādibhyaścit` (da|u|8|109) iti kalapratyayasya citvāt? palaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `roderṇiluk? ca` (da|u|8|39) iti vidyamāne `bahulamanyatrāpi saṃjñācchandasoḥ (da|u|8|40) iti bahulavacanāṇṇiluk, ca| `pānī viṣibhyaḥ paḥ` (da|u|7|2) ityadhikṛtya `stuvo dīrghaśca` (da|u|7|4) iti ca `suśṛbhyāṃ nicca` (da|u|7|6) [muśṛmyāmūrca -da|u|] iti sūpaśabdaḥ papratyayānto vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| `iṇbhīkāpāśalyatimarcibhyaḥ kan` (da|u|3|21) iti bahulavacanāt? `śo tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1270) asmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ, tena guḍaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `dhṛ `kṣaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1096) ityasmāt? `añcighṛsibhyaḥ ktaḥ` (da|u|6|9) ti ktaḥ, tena ghṛtamantodāttam| `mudigrorgaggau` (da|u|3|66) iti mudergak? tena mudgo'ntodāttaḥ||kūlaśabda uktasvaraḥ, `ṣūda kṣaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1717) ityasmāt? `igupadāt? kaḥ` [[3.1.135]] , tena sūdo'ntodāttaḥ| `sthala sthāne` () ityasmāt? pacādyac, tena sthalamantodāttam| karṣaśabdaḥ `karṣātvato dhaño'nta udāttaḥ` ityantodāttaḥ| `dākṣikūlam` ityādi| dākṣimāhakiśabdāviñantāvādyudātau| devaśabdaḥ pacādyajantatvādādyudāttaḥ| bhājīśabdo jānapadādisūtreṇa [[4.1.42]] ṅīṣantatvādantodāttaḥ| dāṇḍāyanaśabdo naḍāditvāt? [[4.1.99]] phagantaḥ, tena `kitaḥ` [[6.1.159]] ityantodāttaḥ| nanu ca sūtre sthalaśabda upāttaḥ, tatkathaṃ sthalīśabda uttarapadamādyudāttaṃ codāhyiyate? ityāha -`sthalagrahaṇam` ityādi||rājño bhāvaḥ, karma vā rājyam, ṣyantatvādādyudattam| brāāhṛṇakṣatriyaśabdau uktasvarau| `celarājya` ityādi| celarājyasvarasyāvakāśaḥ -bhāryācelam, brāāhṛṇarājyamiti, `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.1.2]] ityādinā vihitasya svarasyāvakāśaḥ -niṣkauśāmbiriti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti -kucelam, kurājayamiti, avyayasvaro bhavati pūrvapratiṣedhena| ādiśabdena vagryādisvaraparigrahaḥ||vagryādayo digādiyadantāḥ| teṣu ye dvyacaste <<yato'nāvaḥ>> [[6.1.213]] ityādyudāttāḥ| pariśiṣṭāstu <> [[6.1.185]] ityantasvaritāḥ| vasudevasyāpatyam? `ṛṣyandhaka` [[4.1.114]] ityādināṇ, tena vāsudevaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `araja arjane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-224) ityasmāccurādiṇijantāt? `ajerṇiluk? ca` (da|u|5|57) ityunaṇpratyayaḥ| tenārjuno madhyodāttaḥ| `ityevamādayaḥ` iti| ādiśabdena pakṣaśabdāt? pare ye paṭhante teṣāṃ grahaṇam||`kaunaṭiputraḥ` iti| putraśabda uktasvarahaḥ| kunaṭasyāpatyaṃ kaunaṭiḥ, tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| dāmakamāhiṣakaśabdāvapi kannantāvādyudāttau| `gārgīputraḥ, vātsīputraḥ` iti| gārgayavātsyaśabdābhyām? `yañaśca` [[4.1.16]] iti ṅīp| tena gārgīvātsīśabdau ñitsvareṇādyudātau| sarvatrāsmastatpuruṣādhikāre pratyudāharaṇe <> [[6.1.223]] ityantodāttatvaṃ veditavyam||pūrveṇācāryādibhyo'pi parasya putraśabdasyādyudāttatve prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| tathā ca samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `ākhyāgrahāt` ityādi| ākhyāgrahaṇamācāryādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| tathā cākhyāgrahaṇe'niraste tasyācāryādeḥ paryāyāṇaṃ viśeṣaṇāñca grahaṇaṃ bhavati| `ācāryaputraḥ` iti svarūpasyodāharaṇam| `upādhyāyaputraḥ` iti paryāyasya| `śākaṭāyanaputraḥ` iti viśeṣasya| `rājaputraḥ` iti svarūpasya| `īāraputraḥ` iti paryāyasya| `nandaputraḥ` iti viśeṣasya| `ṛtvikputraḥ` iti svarūpasya| `yājakaputraḥ` iti paryāyasya| `hotuḥputraḥ` iti viśeṣasya| `saṃyuktaputraḥ` iti svarūpasya| `sambandhiputraḥ` iti paryāyasya| `syālaputraḥ` iti| viśeṣasya| `jñātiputraḥ` iti svarūpasya| `bhrātuṣputraḥ` iti viśeṣasya| `kasyādiṣu ca` [[8.3.48]] iti ṣatvam| tatrācāryaśabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇāntasvaritaḥ| sa hi carerāṅpūrvasya ṇyati vyutpādyate| upādhyāyaśabdo'ntodāttasthāthādisvareṇa [[6.2.143]] , sa `iṅaśca` [[3.3.21]] iti ghañanto vyutpādyate| rājaśabda ādyudattaḥ, kaninpratyayāntatvāt| īāraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ; `stheśabhāsa` [[3.2.175]] ityādinā varacpratyayāntatvāt| nandaśabdo'pyantodāttaḥ; ajantatvāt| ṛtvikśabdaḥ `ṛtvigdadhṛk` [[3.2.59]] ityādinā kvin? pratyayāntaḥ| kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| yājakaśabdo ṇvulantaḥ, tena litsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| hotṛśabdastṛnnantatvādādyudāttaḥ| saṃyuktaśabdaḥ `gatirantaraḥ` [[6.2.49]] ityādyudāttaḥ| `syala vitarkage` () asmāccurādiṇijantātt? pacādyaci syālaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `jñā` ityasmāt? <> [[3.3.174]] iti jñātiśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `tṛnstṛcau śaṃsikṣadādibhyaḥ` (da|u|2|1) iti prakṛtya bhātṛśabdastṛnnnanto vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| saṃyuktaśabdo'yamastyeva rūḍhiśabdo yo vivāhakṛtena sambandhena syālaāśurādiṣu vartate, asti kriyāśabdo yaḥ sarvatra kenacit? sambandhena vartate; tatreha rūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇam| kuta etat? ācāryānīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇāt| yadi hi kriyāśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tadā saṃyuktagrahaṇenaiva niṣiddhattvādācāryādīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt| te'pi hi vidyādikṛtena sambandhena saṃyuktā bhavantyeva| tasmādrūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇam| tena kriyāśabdo yaḥ saṃyuktaśabdastasmāt? pratiṣedo na bhavati||`cūrī dāhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1158), asmānniṣṭhā, te cūrṇamantodāttam| kariṇaḥ pātīti <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] pakārasya pakṣe vakāro nipātyate -karipaḥ, karivaḥ| kṛtsvareṇa thāthādisvareṇa vāntodāttaḥ| `maheritaṇ? ca` (da|u|5|19) bahulavacanācchakerapi bhavati, śākinam, pratyayasvareṇa madyodāttam| `śakādibhyo'ṭac` (da|u|5|2;paṃ|u|4|81) [śakādibhyo'ṭan -|dau;paṃ|u|] śakaṭam| tadvahatīti śakaṭavaṇ? śākaṭam| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| drāgdrūtaṃ kṣīyata iti drākṣā, pṛṣodarāditvāt| antodātto'yaṃ śabdaḥ| `tusa hyasa hlasa rasaśabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-710, 711,712,713), tato bahulavacanāt? `hasimṛgriṇavāmidamilūpūdhurvībhyastan` (da|u|6|7,paṃ|u|3|86) [hasimṛgriṇvamidamitamilūpūdhūrvibhyastan -da|u; hasimṛgaraṇvāmidamūlapūrvibhyastan -paṃ|u|] iti tan, nipātanāddīrghaśca| tūstamādyudāttam| `kutsitaṃ dunotīti `kvibavacipracchi` ityādau sūtre (vā|288) kvibiti yogavibhāgaḥ| `dudu upatāpe` (dā|pā|1256) ityasmādapi kvip, `bahulavacanāt? anityatvādvāgamaśāsanasya` (vyā|pa|99) tugabhāvaḥ, pūrvapadasya ca bahulavacanādeva mum -kundu, tanmimīta iti `māṅmāne` (dā|pā|1088) ityasmāt? kaḥ, kundumo'ntodāttaḥ| `uṣikuṭidalikacikhajibhyaḥ kapan` (da|u|7|9) tena dalapa ādyudāttaḥ| `atyavicamitaminami` (da|u|9|44) ityādinā'sac -camasaḥ, tato jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ? [[4.1.63]] camasī| `caka tṛptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-783) ityasmāt? kavip, cak| `kanī dīptikāntigatiṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-460) [kana dīptikāntigatiṣu -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] tasmādac, kanaḥ| cakakanaḥ| colasyāpatyaṃ caulaḥ, <> [[4.1.170]] ityādinā'ṇ| ete cūrṇādayaḥ| `mudgacūrṇam` iti| `mudi grorgaggau` (da|u|3|66) iti mudgo'ntodāttaḥ| `masūracūrṇam` iti| `maserūran` (da|u|8|95) masūra ādyudāttaḥ| `matsyacūrṇam` iti| matsyaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `tatroyagraha iti ṣaṣṭhantameva` iti| anena tulyārthatāṃ sūtrayordarśayati| kathaṃ punarupagrahaḥ ṣaṣṭhantameva gṛhrate? ityāha -`pūrvācāryopacāreṇa` iti| pūrvācāryā hi ṣaṣṭhantamupagraha ityevamupacaranti sma| teneha pūrvā cāryopacāreṇa hetunā ṣaṣṭhantamevopagraha iti gṛhrate| samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ evamuttare'pi trayaḥ||`celakheṭakaṭukakāṇḍam` [[6.2.126]] ityādiṣu caturṣu yogeṣu sanniviṣṭāni kāṇḍādīni ṣaṭ? gṛhyante| yadyevaṃ taireva yogaireṣāmādyudāttatvaṃ siddham, tatkimarthamidam? yatra tairvihita tato'nyatrāpi yathā syāt? prāṇiṣaṣṭhaāśca mā bhūdityevamarthañca| `darbhakāṇḍam` iti| `dṛdalibhyāṃ bhaḥ` (paṃ|u|3|151) iti bhapratyayānto darbhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `tṛṇadhānyānāñca dvyaṣām` (phi|sū|2|27) iti vā| `śarakāṇḍam` iti| śaraśabdo'pyanantareṇaiva `dvyaṣām` ityādyudāttaḥ| evaṃ kuśaśabdo'pi| tathā tilaśabdo'pi| palalamūlakaśabdāvuktasvarau| nadaḍati pacādiṣu paṭhate, tena ṭittvānnadaśabdānṅīp? <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralopaḥ, <> [[6.1.161]] iti ṅīpa udāttatvam| tena nadīśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `pāṭalāpālaṅkāmbāsāgarārthānām` (phi|sū|1|2) iti phiṣā samudraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `rājasūdaḥ` iti| śūdaśabdaḥ ṣaṅbhyaḥ paraḥ paṭhate| tenātra samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| sarve ca te darbhakāṇḍādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ||`kuṇḍaśabde'tri kuṇḍasādṛśyetana vane vartate` iti| yathā kuṇjaṃ kasyacidudakāderāśrayastathā vanamapi| ataḥ kuṇjasādṛśyenātra kuṇḍaśabdo vane vartate| bhavati hi sādṛśyena tācchabdyaṃ yathā -agnimaṇivaka iti| `mṛtkuṇḍam` iti| atra kuṇḍa ākāraviseṣo mṛdvikāre vartate, na vane| tena samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati||bhagālamityarthagrahaṇam; arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya, arthapradhāne hi nirdeśa svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatītyuktam| arthagrahaṇe ca sati tadvācināmetat? kāryaṃ vijñāyate| ata evāha -`bhagālavāci` ityādi| `kumbhībhāgālam` iti| kumbhīśabdaḥ `jāterastrīviṣayādayoṣadāt` [[4.1.63]] iti ṅīṣantatvādantodāttaḥ| `bhagālādayo madhyodāttāḥ` iti| `lagāvante dvayośca bahavaṣo guruḥ` (phi|sū|2|42) iti phiṣaiṣāmākārasyodāttatvavidhānāt||`śitipādaḥ` iti| śitiśabdaḥ `varṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānām` (phi|sū|2|33) iti phiṣādyudāttaḥ| `aṃsauṣṭhaśabdau` ityādi| `ama roge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1720) ityasmāt? `amaḥ san` (paṃ|u|5|21) iti sanpratyayārnto'saśabdo vyatpādyate| oṣṭhaśabdo'pi `uṣikuṣigarttibyasthan` (da|u|6|29) iti thanpratyayāntaḥ| tenaitau pratyayasya nitvādādyudāttau| `darśanīyapādaḥ` iti| darśanīyaśabdo'nīyar? pratyayantaḥ| tena <> [[6.1.217]] iti madhyodāttaḥ| tato'tra pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| evamuttareṣvapi pratyudāharaṇeṣu| kathaṃ punaḥ kakudaśabdo nityaṃ bahvaj? na bhavati? ityāha -`kakudasyāvasthāyāṃ lopaḥ` ityādi| `śitilalāṭaḥ` iti| `lala īpsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1687), asmāt? <> [[3.3.1]] ityāṭapratyayaḥ, tena lalāṭaśabdo madyodāttaḥ| `śitipādaḥ` iti| śiteḥ pāda ityatra samāsasvara eva bhavati| `śitibhasat` iti `śṛdṛbhasodiḥ` (da|u|6|42) iti bhasacchabdo vyutpādyate| tato'yamantodātta-||`prakārakaḥ, prahārakaḥ` iti| ṇvul| `prakaram` ityādiṣu lyuṭ| `īṣatkaraḥ` ityādiṣu `īṣadduḥsuṣu` iti khal| yadatrāvyayapūrvapadaṃ tatra `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[2.2.17]] iti samāsaḥ| `kārakāt` iti| ṣaṣṭhī tu `karttukarmaṇoḥ kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti karmaṇi kārake veditavyā| idhmādayo hi vraścanakriyāyā vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt? karmabāvamanubhavanti| `īṣatkaraḥ` ityādau tu <> [[2.2.19]] iti samāsaḥ| tatra praśabdaḥ `upasargāścābhivarjam` (phi|sū|4|81) ityādyudāttaḥ| idhmaśabdo hi `iṣiyudhīndhi` (da|u|7|31) ityādinā makpratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ| `śo tanūkaraṇe` (dā|pā|1145), palaṃ śyatoti [śyatoti -mudrītaḥ pāṭhaḥ] <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] | palāśaḥ kṛtsvareṇathāthādisvareṇa [[6.2.143]] vāntodāttaḥ| śaderṇijantasya `śaderagatau taḥ [[7.3.42]] iti takāre kṛte lyuṭi `śātanaḥ` iti bhavati| `śmani śrayaterḍan` (da|u|1|161) iti latve kṛte `kalpanaḥ` iti bhavati| īṣacchabdo'ntodāttaḥ; svarādiṣu tathābhūteṣu tathāṃbhūtasyaiva pāṭhāt| sudurāvādyudāttau; prādiṣu tathābhūtayoḥ pāṭhāt| `sarvatraivātra litsvaraḥ` iti| sa punaḥ pratyayāt? pūrvasyodāttatvam| `devadattasyeti seṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī` iti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ nirākaroti| karmaṣaṣṭhaāṃ hrasyāṃ kārakameva devadattaḥ syāt, tathā ca pratyudāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate| atha kārakagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, nirgataḥ kauśāmbyā niṣkauśāmbirityatra mā bhūditi cet? naitadasti; tathā hi -yātkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñā bhavanti (jai|pa|vṛ|99), na hi kauśāmbīśabdaḥ kriyāvācī, tat? kutastaṃ prati niso'tra gatisaṃjñā? ityata āha -`kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham` iti| yadi tarhi kṛdgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, prapacatitarāmityatra parakṛtisavaro na prāpnoti| tataśca samāsasvaraṃ bādhitvāvyayasvara eva syāt? ityata āha -`prapacatitarām` ityādi| atra hi pacatiśabdādatiśayavivakṣāyāṃ taraptapamau| tatasatarabādyante <> [[2.2.18]] iti praśabadasya samāsaḥ| samāse tu kṛte pūrvapadasya `tatpuruṣaṃ tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā prakṛtisvaraḥ| paścāt? `kimettiṅvyaya` [[5.4.11]] ityādināmuḥ| āmantasaya ca <<ādyudāttaśca>> [[3.1.3]] iti pratyayasavaraḥ prāpraḥ, so'vyayasavare sati satiśiṣṭaḥ, sataśiṣṭasya ca balīyastvamuktam| tena yadyapyanenāmantasya kṛdgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe sati prakṛtisvaro bhavati, tathāpyāmsvaro bhavatyeva; tasya satiśiṣṭatvāt| atha kathaṃ taravādyantena samāsaḥ? kathaṃ ca na syāt? `gatikārakopapadādīnāṃ kṛddhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāksuba#utpatteḥ` (hai|pa|pā|88) iti vacanāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atra hi dve darśane gatikārakopapadāt? kṛdbhireva samāso bhavati, sa ca prāk? subutpatterityekaṃ darśanam; gatikārakopapadānāmaviśeṣeṇa samāso bhavati, kṛdbhistu prāk? subutpatteriti dvitīyam| tatra dvitaye darśane yujyata eva tarabādyantena samāsaḥ| tatra kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamityanena sambaddham| eka ācāryāḥ kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamityeva vyācakṣata ityarthaḥ| `prapacati deśyādyartha tu` ityādi| tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmād? vyākhyānādviśeṣadyotanāya| prapacatideśya ādiryasya sa prapacatideśyādiḥ| ādiśabdena prapacatideśīya ityasya grahaṇam| prapacatideśyādāvarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat? prapacatideśyādyartham| `kṛdgrahaṇaṃ dṛśyate` iti| evaṃ <<īṣadasamāptau kalpabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ>> [[5.3.67]] ityatra `tiṅśca` [[5.3.56]] ityanuvṛtteḥ prapacatiśabdād? deśyadeśīyarau| tadantena ca praśabdasya gatisamāse kṛdgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta| tathā prapacatideśyaḥ, prapacati veśīya ityatrāpyuttarapadasya prakṛtisvaraḥ syāt, na ceṣyate| tasmādiha mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇaṃ dṛśyata eva| tasmādetanna vispaṣṭārtham| tadapi tu prapacatideśya ityādau viṣaye mā bhūdityevamartha mityabhiprāyaḥ||vanaśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasyānisantasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttaḥ| patiśabdo'pi pratyayasvareṇa| sa `pāterḍatiḥ` (da|u|1|27) iti ḍatipratyayāntaḥ| `bṛhadityantodāttam? kāryamucyate, na cāyamatrārthaḥ sambhavati, pralapitādīnāmakṛtārthatvāt? prakṛte pralapanādau karoterapravṛtteḥ| abhūtaprādurbhāva eva hi karotirvartate, na pralapanādau| kasmānna pralapanādikṛtam? ityetaccodyamapākarttumāha -`kṛtamiti kriyāsāmānyām` ityādi| na hi karotirabhūtaprādurbhāva eva vartate? kiṃ tarhi? kriyāsāmānye'pi| tacca kriyāsāmānyaṃ pralapanādapyasti| tena tena pralapanādyapi kṛtaṃ bhavati| `tṛtīyā karmaṇītyasya` iti| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarabhāva iti| yadītyādinā yadā bhāve niṣṭhā, tadāsyānupayogaṃ darśayati||`kārakāt` [[6.2.147]] iti vartate, `anaḥ` iti pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (pu|pa|vṛ|44) tadantasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate? ityāha - `anapratyayāntam` ityādi| `odanabhojanam` ityādau sarvatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṣaṣṭhī tu kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi| `rājabhojanāḥ` ityādau tu kartari| odanaśabdaḥ `laghāvante` (phi|sū|2|42) ityādyudāttaḥ| bhojanamityādikaṃ tūttarapadaṃ litsvareṇādyudāttam| payaḥśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|42) ityādyudāttaḥ| bhojanamityādikaṃ tūttarapadaṃ litsvareṇādyudāttam| payaḥśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudātta eva| candanapriyaṅgukāśabdo dvandvaḥ, tena samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `lepanam` iti| `lipa upadāhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1433) [lipa upadehe - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ityasyaivaṃ rūpam| rājaśabda uktasvaraḥ| ācchādanaśabdaḥ `chada apavāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1935) ityasya rūpam| `karmaṇi ca yena` ityādinaikenaiva yogena bhāvavacanaḥ karmavacanaśca lyuṅbhavatīti darśayati| `hastahāryam` iti| hastaśabdaḥ `hasimṛgriṇavāmidamipūdhurvībhyastan` (da|u|6|7|;paṃ|u|3|86) [hasimṛgriṇvamidamitamilūpūdhūrvibhyastan - da|u; hasimṛgriṇvāmidamalūpūdhūrvibhyastan - paṃ|sa|] iti statpratyayāntaḥ, tenādyudāttaḥ,| hāryaśabdastu `ṛhaloṇryat` [[3.1.124]] iti ṇyadantastitsvareṇāntasvaritaḥ| `dantadhāvanam` iti| `dhāvu gatiśuddhoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-601) ityasmātkaraṇe lyuṭ| dantaśabdaḥ `svāṅgaśiṭām` phi|sū|2|29) ityādyudāttaḥ| `nidarśanam` iti| dṛśerbhāve lyuṭ| `avalekhanam` iti| atrāpi likheḥ| `sarveṣu pratyudāharaṇeṣu` ityādi| etena `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛt? [[6.2.138]] ityasyāyamapavāda iti darśayati||manktinniti pratyayagrahaṇam| tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (pu|pa|vṛ|44) tadavatasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha -`mannantaṃ ktinnantañca` iti| rathavatrmetyādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| rathaśabdaḥ kthanpratyayānta ādyudātta ityuktam| `vṛtu vartane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-748) ityasmānmanin| tena vatrmaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| śakaṭaśabdaḥ payaḥśabdaśca nittvādādyudāttaḥ| pāṇinyāpiśaliśabdāviñantatvāt| kṛtiśabdo'pi ktinnantatvāt| karaṇasādhanaścāyaṃ vyākhyānaśabdo lyuṅantaḥ| kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ| chandaḥśabdaḥ `sarvadhātubyo'sun` (paṃ|u|4|188) [`asan` ityeva sūtram -da|u|] iti pratyayagrahaṇam| tatra kṛte `canderādeśca cchaḥ` (paṃ u|4|218) ityasunpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ| ayantyanenetyayanam, ṛcāmayanam| ṛcāmiti karṇi ṣaṣṭhī| ṛgayanaśabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇa madyodāttaḥ| `rājaśayanam` ityādi| serate'sminniti śayanam, āsate'sminnityāsanam? tābhyāṃ rājabrāāhṛṇaśabdayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| rājabrāāhṛṇaśabdābuktasvarau| śayanāsanaśabdau litsvareṇādyudāttau| atra kṛdyogalakṣaṇā pūrvavadeva kartari ṣaṣṭhī| evaṃ `gosthānamaāsthānam` ityatrāpi| gavāāśabdāvuktasvarau| tiṣṭhatyasminniti sthānam, litsvareṇādyudāttam| `brāāhṛṇayājyaḥ` ityādau kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| yājakādiṣu ye ṇvulantāḥ paṭhante, teṣu ye'nupasargāḥ -yājakapūjakasnāpakā iti, ta ādyudāttaḥ| ye tu sopasargāḥ -pariveṣakādhyāpakodvartakotsādakā iti, te kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttāḥ| hotabhartṛśabdo tṛnnantau prayojayataḥ| yau tu tṛjantau tayoḥ kṛtsvareṇāntodāttvaṃ siddham| `gokrītaḥ, aākrītaḥ` ityādi| `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā [[2.1.31]] iti samāsāvetau| krītaśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `kṛtsvarāpavādo yogaḥ` iti| krītaśabdādanyeṣu manktitanvyākhyānādiṣu| krītaśabde tu `tṛtīyā karmaṇa` [[6.2.48]] ityasyeti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasya| `vyākhyānaśayanāsanasthānānāmabhāvakarmārtha grahaṇam` iti| bhāvakarmavacanasyānantasya <> [[6.2.150]] ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| `prakṛtiḥ, prahmatiḥ` iti| atra `tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūravapadasya prakṛtisvaratvameva bhavati| gatisamāsāvetau||`adhyanapuṇyam` ityādi| adhyayanaśabdo lyuḍantaḥ kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ| puṇyam? `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttam| vidyate'ne'neti vedaḥ, ghañ| tena vedaśabdaścādyudāttaḥ|`tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` ityādi| etat? `uṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni` (hai|pa|pā|103) ityevaṃ pakṣamāśrityoktam| idānīṃ vyutpattilakṣaṇamāśrityāha - `uṇādīnāṃ tu` ityādi| vyutpattipakṣe hi puṇyaśabdaḥ `puño yaṇṇug? hrasvaśca` (paṃ|u|5|15) iti yatpratyayānto vyutpādyate| tatra yadīda nārabhyeta tadā <> [[6.2.139]] iti kṛtsvareṇādyudātto'dhyayanamityādau puṇyaśabdasya syāt| tasmāt? tadapadādo'yamantodāttaviṣirityabhiprāyaḥ| `vedena puṇyaṃ vedapuṇyam` iti| vyutpattipakṣe `tṛtīyā` [[2.1.30]] iti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| pūrvapadaparakṛtisvaratvañca| avyutpattipakṣe <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsaḥ, kṛtsvareṇa puṇyaśabdasyādyudāttatvaṃ ca||`māṣonam` iti| <> [[2.1.31]] ityādinā tṛtīyā samāsaḥ| evaṃ `kārṣāpaṇonam` ityādāvapi| `kaṣa khaṣa śiṣa jaṣa jhaṣa śaṣa vaṣa maṣa` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-685-692) ityasmādghañ, tena māṣaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `iṇsiñjidīṅuṣyavibhyo nak` (da|u|5|36) iti, tenonaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| kārṣasyāpaṇaḥ kārṣāpaṇaḥ| kārṣāpaṇaśabdaḥ samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| vigataḥ kalo'syeti vikalaḥ| bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvena vikalaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `asikalahaḥ` iti| `aca iḥ` (da|u|1|67) iti vartamāne `khanikaṣyañjyasi` (da|u|1|68) ityādinā sintodāttaḥ `kala gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1865), asmāt? pacādyac| kalayatīti kalaḥ, kalaṃ hantīti `anyeṣvapi dṛsyate` [[3.2.101]] iti ḍaḥ| tena kalahaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `atra kecit` ityādi| tahrrartha iti svarūpagrahaṇam, evaṃ satyūnaśabde'pi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ prasajyet, tataśca tadarthānāmanyeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt? ityata āha -`unaśabdenaiva` ityādi| ūnaśabdo'nyamatānāṃ viśeṣaṃ darśayati| anye hi -arthagrahaṇe nānarthakānāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti manyante| kecittu-ūnaśabdenaivārthanirdeśārthenārthanirdeśaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe svarūpagrahaṇaṃ [svarūpaṃ grahaṇam -iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] bhavatītyuktam| iha cona ityarthapradhānanirdeśaḥ| tenonaśabdo'rthanirdeśārthaḥ` ityāhuḥ| tasmāt? tatraiva tadarthānāṃ grahaṇam| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādūnaśabdenaivārthanirdeśārthana tadarthānāṃ grahaṇam, tasmādatra kecidartha iti svarūpagrahaṇamicchanti| `dhānyārthaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.30]] iti samāsaḥ| `dhane dhānye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1104), asmāṇṇyat| dhānyamantasvaritam| atha dhāne sādhu dhānyam, `prāgdhitādyat` [[4.4.75]] tena <<yato'nāvaḥ>> [[6.1.213]] iti dhānyamādyudāttam| atrārthaśabdaḥ `prāmādīnāñca` (phi|sū|2|38) ityādyudāttaḥ| tṛtīyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? anūnam, akalaha ityatra mā bhūditi cet? naitadasti;iha hi pratipadoktaparibhāṣayo(vyā|pa|3)nārthakalahādīnāṃ pratipadokto yaḥ samāsaḥ sa eva parigṛhrate| tat? kimanūmakalaha ityetannivṛtyarthena tṛtīyāgrahaṇena? ityata āha -`pratipadoktam` ityādi| gatārtham|`guḍamiśrāḥ` iti| pūrvavat? <> [[2.1.31]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| guḍaśabdaḥ `igupadha` [[3.1.135]] iti `guḍa rakṣāyām` (dā|pā|1370) ityasmāt? kaḥ, tenāntodāttaḥ| `sphāyitañci` (da|u|8|31) ityādinā ragvidhīyamāno bahulavacanān? miśerapi ragbhavati, tena mitraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| tilaśabdaḥ `tṛṇadhānyānāñca dvyaṣām` (phi|sū|2|27) ityādyudāttaḥ| pramiśram, sanmiśramityasya prāpnoti, atastannivṛttaye'nupasargagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha -`iha` ityādi| atha vā -miśraśabdena tṛtīyāsamāsa ucyamānaḥ kathaṃ sopasarge labhyate? ityāha -`iha` ityādi| yadi tadihānupasargagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tahrranyatra miśraśabdagrahaṇe sopasargasya grahaṇaṃ nāstītīhānupasargagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `tena` ityādi| jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `brāāhṛṇamiśro rājā` iti| <> [[2.1.31]] ityādinaiva samāsaḥ| `brāāhṛṇaiḥ saha saṃhitaḥ` ityanena pratyudāharaṇe sandhiṃ darśayati| `aikārthamāpannaḥ` iti| anantaroktamevārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| ekaḥ=abhinno'rtho yasya sa ekārthaḥ, tadbhāva aikāthryam| tadāpannaḥ prāpta ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punajrñāyate -sandhiśabdasyāyamarthaḥ? ityāha -`sandhiḥ` ityādi| paṇabandhaḥ=paribhāṣaṇam -yadi me bhavānidaṃ kuryāt? tato'hamapi bhavata idaṃ kariṣyāmītyevañjātīyakam| tena paṇabandhena yadaikāthryaṃ tat? sandhirucyate| tasmāt? pratyudāharaṇe sandhau sati brāāhṛṇaiḥ saha saṃhita aikāthryamāpannaḥ -ityeṣo'rtho vijñāyate| `kecit? punarāhuḥ` ityādi| gṛhramāṇo viśeṣo yasyāṃ pratyāsattau sā gṛhramaṇaviśeṣā sandhiriti kecidevamāhuḥ, tatraiva syāt| evaṃvidhaḥ sandhiḥ pratyudāharaṇe nāstītyata āha -`atra rājño brāāhṛṇau saha` ityādi| yadyapi rājñā brāāhṛṇaiḥ saha pratyāsattiḥ=deśasāmīpyamasti, tadhāpi satyāmapi tasyāṃ mūrtivibhāgo mūrtiviśeṣo rājño brāāhṛṇānāñca gṛhrata ityeva| itikaraṇo hetau| yata evam, tena brāāhṛṇaiḥ saha miśro rājeti pratayudāhyiyate| `udāhaṇeṣvavibhāgāpattireva` iti| etena gṛḍamiśrā ityādau tu sandherabhāvaṃ darśayati| yathā hi vilīnena miśrā dhānādayo bhavanti, tathāsya guḍāḥ, teṣāṃ ca mūrttivibhāgo na gṛhrate; na tatra sandheravibhāgāpattiriti| na vibhāgo'vibhāgaḥ, tasyāpattiḥ=prāptiḥ| yadā paṇabandhenaikāthryaṃ sandhistadodaharaṇeṣu tasyābhāvo veditavyaḥ sa hi paribhāṣaṇaviśeṣaṇalakṣaṇaḥ| na cāsau guḍamiśreṣu dhānāsvacetaneṣu vidyate; tasya prāṇidharmatvāt||`sampādyādyarthāstaddhitāḥ` iti| taddhitapratyayāḥ| tasmāt? pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (pu|pa|vṛ|44) tadantavidhijrñāyate| `guṇaprataṣedhe` iti| yasmin? vākyārthe taddhita utpadyate sa taddhitasya pravṛttinimittaṃ vidhīyate -yathoktam -`upakāri siddhamaṅgam, sādhyo'nupakārakastvaṅgī` iti| aṅgī, guṇa iti paryāyāvetau| guṇasya pratiṣedho guṇapratiṣedhaḥ| etacaca naño viśeṣaṇam, guṇapratiṣedhe cennañvartata ityarthaḥ| `kārṇaveṣṭakikam` iti| karṇaveṣṭakabhyāṃ śobhata ityarthaḥ| <> [[5.1.99]] iti <> [[5.1.18]] , na karṇaveṣṭakikamakārṇaveṣṭakikamiti| atra karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ sampadyata iti vākyārthe taddhitāntasya pravṛttinimittaṃ yo guṇastasya pratiṣena nañvartate| tat? punaḥ pravṛttinimittvam| `chaidikaḥ` iti| chedamarhatīti `ārhādagopuccha` [[5.1.19]] ityādināṃ ṭhak| `vatsīyaḥ` iti| `prakkrītācchaḥ` [[5.1.1]] | `sāntāpikaḥ` iti| <> [[5.1.101]] iti <> [[5.1.18]] | `vigārdabharathikaḥ` iti| `tadarhati` [[5.1.62]] ityārhīyaṣṭhañ| viśabdena prādisamāsaḥ| viśabdo'yamiha gārdabharathika ityasya guṇapratiṣedhe vartate| atra `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| evamuttaratrāpi| nañyasati, asmin? pratyudāharaṇe'pi yat? pūrvapadaṃ prakṛtisvaraḥ pratyudāhāryaḥ| `gārdabharathikadanyo'gārdabharathikaḥ` iti| atra gārdabharathikādanyatra nañvartate, na tu gārdabharathikatvasya pratiṣedhe; paryudāsatvādasya| `guṇa iti taddhitārthapravṛttinimittam` ityādi| taddhitārthaḥ -karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ sampādītyevamādivākyārthaḥ, tatra yat? pravṛttinimittaṃ taddhitāntasya śabdasya sampāditvādi tat? guṇa ityucyate| ādiśabdena tadarhatvādegrrahaṇam| taddhitāntamalamarthañca parigrahrate| `tatpratiṣedhaḥ` ityādi| tasya pratiṣedho yatra samāsa ucyate tatrāyaṃ vidhiḥ| kathaṃ tasaya guṇasya pratiṣedha ucyate? ityāha -`karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ na sampādi mukham` iti| etena sarveṇa prasajyaparatiṣedhe'yaṃ vidhiḥ, na paryudāsa iti darśayannagārdabharathika ityatara pratyudāharaṇe'sya vidherabhāvaṃ darśayati| `pāṇinīyam` iti| `vṛddhācchaḥ` (4.2.125| `apāṇinīyaḥ` iti| atrādhyetaryarthe yastaddhitastadantamuttarapadam| na sampādyarhahitādyamalamarthā ye taddhitāstadantam| `voḍhā` iti| pūrvavad? dhatvaḍhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopā vidheyāḥ, <> [[6.3.112]] ityottvam| `avoḍhā` iti| atrāhārtho ya kṛdataḥ sa uttarapadam| tena taddhitagarahaṇādantodāttatvamuttarapadasya na bhavati| avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| pūrvapadaprakṛtasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi yogā draṣṭavyāḥ| `prāgbahuvrīhāvidametat` [[6.2.161]] ityādiyogāt||`pāśyā` iti| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvam| `adantyam` iti| <<yato'nāvaḥ>> [[6.1.213]] ityādyudāttatvam| evam - `akaṇryam` ityetadapi tadvadevādyudāttam| `pādyam` iti| `pādārdhābhyāñca` [[5.4.25]] iti yat| `dantyādanyadadanatyam` iti| atra dantyādanyatra nañ? vartate, na tu tadantasya pratiṣede| `adeyam` iti| <> [[3.3.169]] ityatrārhārthe yat, `īdyati` [[6.4.65]] itīttvam| atheha kasmānna bhavati - vāmadevena dṛṣṭaṃ sāma vāmadevyam? ityata āha - `niranubandhaka` ityādi| gatārtham||`apacaḥ` iti| pacādyac| `avikṣipaḥ` iti| <> [[3.1.135]] `apaco'dīkṣitaḥ` ityādi| dīkṣitaparivrājakau śāstre pratiṣiddhatvānna pacataḥ; na tvaśaktatvāt| tenātra vrataṃ gampate, na tvaśaktiḥ||atrākrośe doṣavacanamākrośaḥ| agamyamānāyāmapyaśaktau yathā syāditi vacanam||`adevadatto'pajñadattaḥ` iti| devadattayajñadattaśabdāvantodāttau| prātipadikasvareṇa| yo devadattaḥ san? tat? kārya na karoti sa evamākruśyate| evaṃ `aviṣṇumittraḥ` ityatrāpi veditavyam||kṛtya, uka, iṣṇujiti pratyayagrahaṇam| tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (pu|pa|vṛ44) tadantopasthāpanaṃ bhavati| cārvādīni prātipadikānyeva| `akartavyam` iti| yadā tavyadantastadā kartavyaśabdo'ntasvaritaḥ| yadā tavyāntastadā madhyodāttaḥ| `akaraṇīyam` iti| anīyarpratyayāntatvāt? <> [[6.1.217]] iti ritsvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ karaṇīyaśabdaḥ| `anāgāmṛkam, anapalāṣukam` iti| `laṣapatapada` [[3.2.154]] ityādinokañ| āgāmukāpalāṣukaśabdau kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttau| `analaṅkariṣṇuḥ` iti| `alaṃkṛñ` [[3.2.136]] ityādineṣṇuc| alaṅkariṣṇuśabdaścitsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| evaṃ `nirākariṣṇu` śabdo'pi| ekānubandhakagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā(vyā|pa|42)iṣṇujgrahaṇe dbyanubandhakasya khiṣṇuco grahaṇena na bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `iṣṇujgrahaṇe kartari bhuvaḥ` [[3.2.57]] khiṣṇujityasya dvyanubandhakasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati` iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| atraiva kāraṇamāha - `ikārādervidhānasāmarthyāt` iti| khiṣṇuca ikārādervidhānasyaitadeva prayojanam - iha sūtre sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, anyathā tadapārthakaṃ syāt, udāttatvādbhavata#e#ḥ tataḥ parasya khiṣṇuca iṭaivekārāditvat|`acāruḥ` ityādi| `dṛsanijanicaribhyo ñuṇ` (da|u|1|88) [dṛsanijanicaricaṭirahibhyo ñuṇ - da|u; dṛ|u; dṛsanijanicaricaṭibhyo ñuṇ - paṃu|] tenādyudāttaścāruśabdaḥ| sādyuśabdo'ntodātta; `kṛvāpā` (da|u|1|86) ityādinoṇpratyayāntatvāt| yudhā carati yaudhikaḥ, <> [[4.4.1]] `kitaḥ` [[6.1.159]] ityantodāttaḥ| `anaṅgamejayaḥ` iti| avyayasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| atra dvitoye nañsamāse samāsāntodāttatvamiti nañsamāsaḥ syāt| `atrāpi` ityādi| kasmācchabdasya naña uttarasyādyudāttatvavidhānāt| atrāpi dvitīyena nañsamāsenāntodāttatvamiti| vartamāna, vardhamāna - ityedamādayaḥ śānajantatvādantodāttāḥ| vikārasadṛśaśabdaḥ samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| gṛhapatikaśabdaḥ <> [[5.3.87]] iti kannantatvādādyudāttaḥ| `vaderānyaḥ` (da|u|8|9), vadānyaśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ||tṛnniti pratyayagrahaṇam, tena pūrvavat? tadantasyopasthānam| annādīni prātipadikāni| `akartā` iti| tācchīlikastṛn| tena nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ karttṛśabdaḥ| annaśabdo'pi `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|26) iti| `kṛtyasūbhyāṃ ksnaḥ` (da|u|5|49) iti `tijerdīrghaśca` (da|u|5|50) iti tīkṣṇaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `in` (da|u|1|46) iti vartamāne `igupadhātu kit` (da|u|1|48), tena śuciśabda ādyudāttaḥ||`prathamapūraṇayoḥ` iti| prathame svarūpagrahaṇam| pūraṇagrahaṇe pūraṇe'rthe ye pratyayā vihitāste gṛhyante, prathamasāhacaryāt| atha vā -pūraṇagrahaṇaṃ svayryate, svaritena cādhikāragatirbhavati| tena <> [[5.2.48]] ityadhikṛtya ye pratyayā vihitāsteṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati| `idamprathamaḥ` iti| prathamo'ntodāttaḥ| `pratheramat` (da|u|7|46) ityamacparatyayāntatvāt| idamādayastyadādiṣvantodāttā nipātyante; `idandvitīyaḥ idantṛtīyaḥ` iti| dvestīyaḥ` [[5.2.53]] <> [[5.2.55]] iti tīyapratyayāntatvānmadhyodāttau dvitīya tṛtīyaśabdau| `anena prathama idaṃ prathamaḥ` iti| atra `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| `yatprathamaḥ` iti| yat? prathamameṣāmiti bahuvrīhriḥ| atra `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| evamuttareṣvapyasmin? bahuvrīhradhikāre pratyudāharaṇeṣu veditavyam| `idaṃ pradhānā ityarthaḥ` iti| etenāntarokte pratyudāharaṇe prathamaśabdaḥ pradhānavacanaḥ, na tvekasaṃkhyāvacana iti darśayan? gaṇānābhāvaṃ darśayati|`uttarapadasya` ityādi| iha sūtre `prathamapūraṇayoḥ` iti tvanyavibhaktyoruttarapadanirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, na bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tenottarapadasyaiva kāryitvam, na bahuvrīheḥ| tataśca yadā kabutpadyate tadā <> [[6.2.173]] antodāttaṃ bhavati| kappratyayo hi [`kapratyayo hi` -mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] samāsādhikāre vihitatvāt? samāsasyaivāntau bhavati, nottarapadasya| na hruttarapadaṃ samāsaḥ, tena `kabuttarapadakrameṇa gṛhrate` ityuttarapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ kapo na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvasya| `idamprathamakāḥ` iti| <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap| `bahuvrīhau parakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāpavādau yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi bahuvrīhradhikāre'smin? yogā draṣṭavyāḥ||`dvistanā, trisatanā` iti| dvitriśabdau prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttau| `stanagadī devaśabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1859,1860) curādiradantaḥ, tasmādghañ, tena stanaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `catuḥstanā` iti| `careruran` (da|u|8|78) ityuranpratyayāntatvāccatuḥśabda ādyudāttaḥ| darśanīyaśabdo'nīyarpratyayāntaḥ <> [[6.1.217]] iti madhyodāttaḥ| `dviśirāḥ` iti| śiraḥśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttaḥ||`devamittro brāhṛmittraḥ` iti| devabrāhṛśabdāvuktasvarau| `amicimidiśasibhyaḥ ktraḥ` (da|u|8|86) iti mittraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `vṛkajinaḥ` iti| prakṛtivikārayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvādvṛkavikāre vṛkaśabdo'tra vartate| vṛkamajinamasya vṛkājinaḥ| vṛkaśabdaḥ `prāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām? (phi|sū|2|30) [`prāṇināṃ kupūrvam` -phi|sū|] ityādyudāttaḥ| `śyāstyāhveñavibhya inac` (da|u|5|12) ityadhikṛtya `ajeraja ca` (da|u|5|14) itīnajādeśaśca| tenājinamantodāttam| `kūlājinaḥ` iti| ku iti nipātaḥ, tasminnupapade `lā ādāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1058) ityetasmāt? <> [[3.2.101]] ita ḍaḥ, <> [[6.3.137]] iti pūrvapadasaya dīrghatvam| tena kūla ityantodāttaḥ| `kṛṣṇājinaḥ` iti| `iṇsiñjidīṅuṇyavibhyo nak`(da|u|5|35) ityadhikṛtya `kṛṣervarṇe` (da|u|5|37) iti nak| tena kṛṣṇo'ntodātta-| `priyamittraḥ` iti| prīṇātīti priyaḥ, `igupadha` [[3.1.135]] ityādinā kaḥ| tena priyo'ntodāttaḥ| `mahājinaḥ` iti| `nartamāne pṛṣadbṛhanmahajajagacchatṛvacca`(da|u|6|5) ita mahacchabdo'ntodātta||`gauramukhaḥ` iti| `gurī udyamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1396) etasmādac| tadantadapi prajñāderavṛtkaraṇāt? `parajñādibhyaśca` [[5.4.38]] ityaṇ, tena gauro'ntodāttaḥ| `udi dṛṇāterajalau [dṛṇāterajalau -mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] pūrvapadāntyalopaśca` (paṃ|u|5|19) iti prakṛtya `ḍit? khanermuṭ? sa codāttaḥ` (paṃ|u|5|20) iti khanerajalāvityetau pratyayau bhavataḥ, tau ca ḍitau, muṭ? codāttaḥ| tena mukhaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `bhadaramukhaḥ` iti| `ṛjendra` (da|u|8|46) ityādisūtreṇa bhadraśabdo vyutpādyate| tena bhadra ityantodāttaḥ| `dīrghamukhā śalā` iti| mukhaśabdenātra dvārapradeśaḥ śālāyā ucyate| `svāṅgamadravalakṣaṇamiha gṛhrate` iti `adravaṃ mūrttimat? svāṅgam` (kā|vṛ|4.1.54) ityādi yatparibhāṣitaṃ svāṅgamadravādilakṣaṇaṃ tadiha gṛhrate| tena dīrghamukhā śāletyatra na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||pūrveṇa prāptasyāntodāttatvādayaṃ pratiṣedha ucyate| `uccairmukhaḥ` iti| uccairityete svarādau paṭhante, te'ntodāttā iti nipātyante| `prāṅmukhaḥ` iti| prāṅityetat? kvinnantamādyudāttam, tatra <<aniganto'ñcatau vapratyaye>> [[6.2.52]] iti pūrvapadasaya prakṛtisvaraḥ| `pratyaṅamukhaḥ` iti| atra kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| `gomukhaḥ mahāmukhaḥ` iti| gomahacchabdāvantodāttāvityuktam| `sthūlamukhaḥ` iti| `sthūla paribṛṃhaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1904), curārdiḥ, tasmāt? pacādyac| tena sthūlaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `muṣṭimukhaḥ` iti| muṣeḥ ktic| tena muṣṭiśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `pṛthumukhaḥ` iti| `kubhrraśca` (paṃ|3.1.23) ityadhikṛtya prathimradibhrasjāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ `salopaśca` (paṃ|u|1|29) iti kupratyayaḥ| tena pṛthurantodāttaḥ| `vatsamukhaḥ` iti| `vṛtṛvadini` (da|u|9|21) ityādinā saḥ| tena vatso'ntodāttaḥ| `gomuṣṭi` ityādi| uttarasūtreṇa niṣṭhādipūrvapadasyopamānalakṣaṇo'pi yaḥ prāpnoti so'pyanena bādhyate| asya pratiṣedhasyāvakāśo yatra gavādyupamānaṃ na; gaurmukhamiva yasya, muṣṭirmukhamiva yasya, vatso mukhamiva yasyeti sarvatra gavādyupameyam, nopamānam| uttarasūtreṇa niṣṭhādipūrvapadasyopamānalakṣaṇasya vikalpasyāvakāśo yatra gavāderanyadupamānam -siṃhamukhaḥ, vyāghramukha iti| yatra gavādyupamānaṃ tad? yatra pūrvapadaṃ tatrobhayaprāptāvupamānalakṣaṇaṃ bādhitvā'yameva ptiṣedho pūrvapratiṣedhena||`śāṅgarajagdhaḥ` iti| guṇāteritervā <<śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām>> [[3.2.14]] ityac? śaṅgaraḥ, tato'pi prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvādaṇ| tena śāṅgaraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `palāṇḍubhakṣitaḥ` iti| `pala gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-839) <> [[3.3.1]] ityāṇḍupratyayaḥ tena palāṇḍuśabdo madhyodāttaḥ| `surapītaḥ` iti| `susūdhāgudhibhyaḥ kran` (da|u|ya8|42) iti surāśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `māsajātaḥ` iti| `masī parimāṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1221) [`pariṇāme`dhātupāṭhaḥ-] asmādghañ, tena māsa ādyudāttaḥ| `saṃvatsarajātaḥ` iti| `aśeḥ saraḥ` (da|u|8|50) [`saran` -da|u|pa|u| (3|70)] ityadhikṛtya `vaseśca` (da|u|8|51) `sampūrvāccit` (da|u|8|52) iti| tena saṃvatsaro'ntodāttaḥ| `dvyahajātaḥ| tryahajātaḥ` iti| dvitriśabdāvantodātatāvityukatam| `sukhajātaḥ` iti| khanateḥ supūrvāt? <> [[3.2.101]] iti ḍaḥ| tena sukhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| evaṃ dṛḥkhaśabdo'pi veditavyaḥ| tena tṛpraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `kṛcchrajātaḥ` iti| `kṛtecchaḥ krū ca` (da|u|8|38,paṃ|u|2|21) [`kṛte cchak? ca -da|u| `kṛteśchakrū ca` -paṃ|u|] iti kṛcchraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `asu kṣeṇape` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1209) asmād? `bahulamanyatra#ā'pi` (da|u|8|40) iti rak, tenāslamantodāttam| `vṛtṛvadahanikamikaṣibyaḥ saḥ` (da|u|9|21) [kaṣiyumucibhyaḥ -da|u|] iti bahulavacanādamerapi bhavati| aṃso vṛṣāditvādādyudāttaḥ| `alakam` iti| alateḥ <> [[3.3.118]] , tataḥ kanniti kannanto'plakaśabdaḥ| tenādyudāttaḥ| `kṛvṛdāribhya unan` (paṃ|u|3|53), tena karuṇaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `rañjeḥ kvun` () iti bahulavacanāt? kṛperapi bhavati| tena kṛpaṇamādyudāttam| `soḍhaḥ` iti ktāntam| tenaitadantodāttam| pūrvavadghatvaḍhatvādayaḥ kartavyāḥ| `pratīyam` iti| pratigatā āpo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ṛkpūḥ` [[5.4.74]] ityādinā'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, <<dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt>> [[6.3.97]] itīttvam| `putrajātaḥ` iti| atra bahuvrīhisvara eva bhavati| `amicimidiśasibhyaḥ ktraḥ` (da|u|8|86) `puvo hrasvaśca` (paṃ|3.4.164) tena putraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| kathaṃ punarjātaśabdasya paranipātaḥ, yāvatā `niṣṭhā` [[2.2.36]] iti pūrvanipātenātra bhavitavyam? ityata āha -`āhitāgnyāditvāt` ityādi| putrajātaśabdo'yamāhitāganyādiṣu ṣaṭhate, tena `vā''hitāganyādiṣu` [[2.2.37]] iti jātādiśabdasaya paranipātaḥ| `vastracchannaḥ` iti| vastramācchādanam, ācchādyate'neneti kṛtvā| vastraśabda uktasvaraḥ| channaśabdaḥ `chada apavāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1833) ityasya ṇyantasya niṣṭhāyāṃ `vā dantaśānta` [[7.2.27]] ityādinā nipātitaḥ| `vasanacchannaḥ` iti| vaserācchādanārthāllyuṭ| tena vasanamādyudāttam| `kuṇḍalakṛtaḥ` iti| kuṇḍaśabdo'yaṃ `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttaḥ| `kuṇḍamitaḥ` iti| `māṅ māne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1142), `dyatisyati` [[7.4.40]] ityādinettvam| atha kathameteṣu bahuvrīhiṣu `niṣṭhā` [[2.2.36]] ityanena niṣṭhāntasya parvanipāto na bhavati? ityāha -`eteṣu` ityādi| yasmādetat? kṛtam, tasmājjātyādibhyaḥ parasyāntodāttatvabidhānām| etasmādeva jñāpakānniṣṭhāntasya pūrvanipāto na bhavati; anyathā hretadantodāttatvavidānaṃ nopapadyate||jātaśabdo'pi ktānta iti tasyāpi jātyādibhyaḥ parasya pūrveṇa nityamantodāttatve vikalpo'yamucyate| `dantajātaḥ` iti| `hasimṛgriṇvamidami`(da|u|6|7) ityādinā tan -dantaḥ| tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| `stanajātaḥ` iti| stanaśabda uktasvaraḥ|`ayavo deśaḥ` ityādi| yavavrīhimāṣāḥ `tṛṇadhānyānāñca dvyaṣām` (phi|sū|2|27) ityādyudāttaḥ| `samāsasya` ityādi| iha samāsaḥ prakṛta uttarapadaṃ ca| tatra yadyuttarapadasyaitadantodāttatvaṃ syāt? anṛco bahvṛca ityatra `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ` [[5.4.74]] ityādinākāre samāsānte kṛte tataḥ pūrvasya ṛkśabdasyottarapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ prasajyeta| samāsasya tvantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānamakārasyaiva bhavati; tasya samāsāvayavatvāt| samāsāvayavatvaṃ tu <> [[5.4.68]] ityādhikṛtya vidhānāt| tasmāt? samāsāvayavasyaitadantodāttatvamiṣyate| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamupi labhyate? <> [[6.2.173]] ityatra pūrvagrahaṇāt| taddhi pūrvagrahaṇamanena samāssayāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ samāsāvayavasya kapa eva mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate| yadi tūbhayapadasyaitadantodāttatvaṃ syāt, tadāntareṇāpi kapipūrvagrahaṇaṃ kapipūrvasyottarapadasya sāt, na kapaḥ; na hi kabuttarapadasyāvayavaḥ, tataśca pūrvagrahaṇanarthakam| idaṃ tāvat -`samāsāntāḥpratyayāḥ samāsasyaivāvayavāḥ, nottarapadasya` ityetaddarśanamaṅgīkṛtyoktam| idānīṃ `uttarapadasyāpi te'vayavāḥ, ityetaddarśanamāśrityāha -`samāsāntāśca` ityādi| uttarapadaṃ ceti śeṣaḥ| etadantodāttatvamiṣyata iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| atha vā -uttarapadasyaivaitadantodāttatvamiṣyate| kutaḥ? samāsāntā uttarapadāvayavā bhavantītyato hetoḥ| tenānucaḥ bahvṛca ityatra kṛte samāsānte'ntodāttatvaṃ bhavati, taccottarapadasya bhavet| tasyaiva samāsāntasya bhavati, tasyottarapadāvayavatvāditi bhāvaḥ| sānte'ntodāttatvaṃ bhavati, taccotatarapadasaya bhavet| tasyaiva samāsāntasya bhavati, tasyottarapadāvayavatvāditi bhāvaḥ| yadi hi samāsāntā uttarapadāvayavā na syuḥ, tata uttarapadāvayavasyantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ samāsāntasya na syāt| uttarapadāvayavatve hi samāsāntānāṃ tasyaiva samāsāntasya bhavati| kathaṃ punaḥ samāsāntānāmuttarapadāvayavatvam? samāsārthāduttarapadāt? pūrvaṃ samāsāntaṃ vidhāya paścāt? tadantena samāsavidhānāt| tathā hi `na kapi` [[7.4.14]] ityatra vakṣyati `<> [[1.2.48]] itayayamapi hyasavaḥ kapi na bhavati| samāsārthe hruttarapade kapi kṛte paścāt? kabantena saha samāsena bhavitavyamamiti strīpratyayāntaṃ samāsaprātipadikaṃ na bhavati` iti| samāsāntapratyayāntena ca padena yadi samāsaḥ kriyate, tadā `tanmadhye patitāstadgrahaṇena gṛhyante` (vyā|pa|21) iti samāsāntaḥ pratyayaḥ uttarapadāvayavā bhavanti| yadyavam, samāsāvayavatvaṃ teṣāṃ nopapadyate? naitadasti; avayavāvayavo'pi hi samudāyāvayavo bhavati, tathā hi -`devadattāyāḥ sarve'vayavā alaṅkriyantām` ityukte devadattāvayakasya ye'vayavā aṅgulyādayasye'pyalaṅktiyante||pūrveṇa kapa evāntodāttatve prāpte kapi pūrvasyodāttatvamanena vidhīyate| `akumārīkaḥ` ityādi| <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap| kumārīśabda udāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodāttaḥ| vṛṣalīśabdo'pi jātilakṣaṇena ṅīṣā| brāhṛbandhūrapyūṅantatvāt? pratyayasvareṇa||`hrasvo'nto'sya` ityādi| anena hrasvānta ityasyaiva bahuvrīheranyapadārtha uttarapadaṃ samāso veti darśayati| `ayavako deśaḥ` iti| atra kapi parato yava ityetat? hrasvāntamuttarapadam, ayava ityayaṃ vā samāsaḥ| tatrāntyādvakārāt, pūrvamakṣaraṃ yakārākāra udātto bhavati| anayā diśānyatrāpari veditavyam|atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā <> [[6.2.173]] ityataḥ pūrvamiti vartata eva? ityata āha -`pūrvamiti vartamāne` ityādi| dvitīye hi pūrvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe vākyabhedena pravṛttibhedo bhavati; pūrvagrahaṇasāmarthyāt, anyathā hi tadapārthakaṃ syāt| tatraikaya pravṛttyā hrasvante'ntyāt? pūrvamantodāttaṃ vithadhīyate| aparayā tu hrasvānte'ntyāt? pūrvamantodāttaṃ na bhavatīti niyamaḥ| tena kapi pūrvamantodāttaṃ na bhavati| `tena` ityādinā niyamo na syāt, tadātrāntyāt? pūrva udāttabhāvo nāstīti kapi pūrvamantodāttaṃ syāt| <> [[6.2.173]] ityanena niyame tu sati na bhavati| tena <> [[6.2.172]] iti kabantasyaivāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati| yathā ca sa bhavati tathātraivopapāditam||<> [[6.2.172]] ityādibhiryogairnaña uttarasya yat? svaravanidhānaṃ tadbahorapi yathā syādityevamarthamidam| naña iva nañvat| bahorbhāvo bhūmā, pṛthvāditvādimanic, <> [[6.4.158]] iti bhūbhāvaḥ| uttarapadasya bhūmeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| athātideśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na `nañsubahubhya uttarapadabhūmni` ityevocyeta; na caivaṃ yoge kriyamāṇe nañsvorapyuttarapadabhūmnītyetadviśeṣaṇamāpādyate; sambhavāpekṣatvādasya, yathaiva hi<> [[6.1.68]] ityatra dīrghagrahaṇaṃ sambhavāpekṣaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ ṅyāporeva bhavati na halaḥ; tathaitadapi bahoreva bhaviṣyati na nañsvoḥ, na hi tayoruttarapadārthabahutve bṛttiḥ sambhavatīti? evaṃ tarhi yadapi videśasthaṃ nañopalakṣitaṃ bahuvrīheḥ svaravidhānam, tadapyasmādatideśādyathā syādityevamartho'yamatideśaḥ kriyate| tena <> [[6.2.116]] ityuttarapadādyudāttatvamapi bahoratidiśyate| `bahumanāḥ` iti| atrottarapadabahutve bahuśabdo na vartate||pūrvoṇātiprasakto'tideśa iti guṇādinā pratiṣidhyate -`bahuguṇā rajjuḥ` iti| bahvavayavā ityarthaḥ| `guṇa āmantraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1894) curādiḥ, tasmādghañ| tena guṇaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `aśeḥ saraḥ` (da|u|8|50) [`saran` -da|u|(paṃ|u|-3|70)] ityanenākṣaraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| chando mīyate'neneti cchandomānam| kṛtsvareṇa chandomāne mānaśabda ādyudāttaḥ; tasya ghañantatvāt| śobhanamuktaṃ sūktam| prādisamāsaḥ| thāthādisvareṇa [[6.2.143]] sūktaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| adhīyate'smādityadhyāyaḥ| `iṅaśca` [[3.3.21]] iti ghañ| sūktavadadhyāyo'ntodāttaḥ||upasargāt? prādyupalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam| svaṅgaṃ prati kriyāyogābhāvāt| prādigrahaṇameva tu na kṛtaṃ vaicitryārtham| dhruvaśabdo'yamavayavepyasti, yathā <<dhruvamapāye'pādānam>> [[1.4.24]] iti, ekasvarūpepyasti, yathā dhruvamasya śīlamiti; tadihaikasvarūpe vartamāno gṛhrata iti darśayitumāha -`dhruvamityekarūpamucyate` ityādi| `satatam` ityādinā dhruvatvaṃ pṛṣṭhasya darśayati| pṛṣṭhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `pṛṣu mṛṣu vṛṣu secane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-705|706,707) ityasya thaki vyutpāditatvāt| `darśanīyalalāṭaḥ` iti| darśanīyaśabdaḥ <> [[6.1.217]] iti madhyodāttaḥ| `lala īpsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1687) ityasmāt? <> [[3.3.1]] ityāṭapratyayaḥ| tena lalāṭaśabdo madhyodāttaḥ| `praśākho vṛkṣaḥ` iti| <> [[3.3.1]] iti vacanāt? `śo tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1145) ityasmāt? khaḥ, ṭāp, savarṇadīrghatvam, <> [[8.2.5]] | tena śākhāśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| udbāhuḥ krarīśati` iti| atra bāhorekarūpatā nāstītyudhruvatvam| na hrasau nityamūdhrvabāhureva krīśati, api tu kadācidadho bāhurapi| `utparśuḥ` iti| `svṛśeḥ āṇśunau pṛ ca`(paṃ|u|5|27) [āṇ? śuno pṛ ca -mu|pāṭhaḥ] iti śunpratyayāntaḥ parśuḥ| tenāyamādyudāttaḥ||`samāsamātre` iti| mātragrahaṇena bahuvrīhernivṛtti sūcayati| `pravaṇe` iti| yadāyaṃ bahuvrīhistadā prakṛṣṭaṃ prakṛtaṃ vā vanamasyeti vigrahaḥ| yadā tu tatpuruṣaḥ, tadā prakṛṣṭaṃ vanaṃ pragataṃ vā vanamiti vigrahaḥ| `nirvaṇe` iti| atrāpi yadā bahuvrīhiḥ, tadā nirgataṃ vanamasyeti vigrahaḥ| yadā tu tatpuruṣastadā niragato vanāditi tatpuruṣastu <> [[2.2.18]] iti| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi samāsamātraparigrahārthaṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta? ityata āha -`bahuvrīhāveva hi syāt` iti| `rañjeḥ kyun`(da|u|5|24-paṃ|u|2|80)| [`rajeḥ` -da|u|] bahalavanāt? `vanu yācane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1470) ityasmādapi bhavati| tena vanamādyudāttam||`antaḥ` iti svarādiṣvantodātto nipātyate| `antarvaṇo deśaḥ` iti| antarvanaṃ yasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ, `vane'ntaḥ` iti śauṇḍādipāṭhāt? [[2.1.39]] saptamīsamāso vā| `pranirantaraḥ` [[8.4.5]] ityādananā ṇatvam| `anupasargārtha ārambhaḥ` iti| upasargāt? pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt||antaḥśabdaḥ `hasimṛgriṇvamidamilūpūdhurvibhyastan` (da|u|6|7) iti tanpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ||pūrveṇa nivibhyāmapyutatarasayāntodāttatve prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| `pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratave kṛte` iti| yadā bahuvrīhistadā <> [[6.2.1]] iti prakṛtisvaratvam| yadā tu tatpuruṣastadā `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā||`parikūlam, paritīram` iti| kūlatīraśabdāvuktasvarau <<kūlatīratūlamūlaśālā'kṣasamamavyayībhāve>> [[6.2.121]] ityādau sūtre| `parimaṇḍalam` iti| paritaḥ=sarvato maṇāḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalam| `maṇi bhūṣāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-321) -asmāt? `kalastṛpaśca` (da|u|8|107) iti bāhulakāt? kalapratyayaḥ, `vṛṣādibhyaścit` (da|u|8|109) iti ca| tena maṇḍalamantodāttam| `bahuvrīhirayam` ityādi| yadā bahuvrīhistadā -paritaḥ kūlamasya, paritastīramasyeti tena maṇḍalamantodāttam| `bahuvrīhirayam` ityādi| yadā bahuvrīhistadā -paritaḥ kūlamasya, paritastīramasyeti vigrahaḥ| yadā tu prādisamāsastadā parigataṃ kūlam, parigataṃ tīramiti| yadā punaravyayībhāvastadā -pari kūlāt, pari tīrāditi| avyayībhāvastu <> [[2.1.12]] ityanena| pari kūlāditi pañcamī `pañcamyapāṅaparibhiḥ` [[2.3.10]] iti karmapravacanīyayoge| karmapravacanīyatvaṃ tu pareḥ <> [[1.4.88]] iti| yuktaṃ yadbahuvrīhau tatpuruṣe cedamantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate; tatra hi samāsāntodāttatvasyāpavādaḥ, pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prāpnoti| avyayībhāve tvayuktam; tatra hi samāsāntodāttatvenaiva siddham| na hi tasyāpavādaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ kenacit? prāpta ityata āha -`avyayībhāvapakṣe'pi hi` ityādi| yadāpyavyayībhāvapakṣaḥ, tadāpi `paripratyupapā` [[6.2.33]] ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prāptonenāntodāttatvavidhānena bādhyata iti kimatrāyuktam| `yaccaivaṃsvabhāvam` ityādi| abhito bhavanaṃ yasya svabhāvastadabhitobhāvigrahaṇena gṛhrate, na tu tadviparītasvabhāvam||`prakoṣṭham` iti| `uṣikuṣigārtibhyasthan` (da|u|6|29) iti kuṣesthan| tena kroṣṭhaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `pragṛham` iti| `gehi kaḥ` [[3.1.144]] iti kapratyayaḥ| tena gṛhamantodāttam| `pradvāram? iti| `nabviṣayasyānisantasya` (phi|sū|2|26) iti dvāramādyudāttam| `prapadam` iti| padaṃ dvāravadevādyaṭudāttam| `prahastam` iti| `hasimṛgriṇvamidami` (da|u|6|7) ityādinā hasestan| tena hastaśabda ādyudāttaḥ||`nirudakam` iti| niṣkrāntamudakamasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ, niṣkrāntamudakāditi vā prādisamāsaḥ| udakaṃ kāyatīti <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] , <> [[6.3.57]] ityudabhāvaḥ| tenodakamantodāttam| `nirupalam` iti| `viṭapaviṣṭapaviśipolapāḥ` (da|u|7|12) ityupalaśabdo'ntodātto nipātyate| `nirupalamityanye` iti| upapūrvāllāteḥ <<ātaścopasarge>> [[3.3.106]] iti kaḥ| tenopalaśabdasthāthādi [[6.2.143]] svareṇādyudāttaḥ| `nirmakṣikam, nirmaśakamityadīnām` iti| maśakamakṣikāśabdā(vā)dyudāttāntodāttau| tatra hi `athādiḥ, prāk, śakaṭeḥ`(phi|sū|2|24), `atha dvitīyaḥ prādīṣāt` (phi|sū|3|50) [`dvitīyaṃ` -phi|sū|] iti vartate| `eṣām` ityādi| yadi prādisamāsastadā nirgatamudakaṃ nirgataṃ vodakāditi vigrahaḥ| yadā tu bahuvrīhistadā nirgatamudakamasmāditi| athāvyayībhāvo'pyeṣāṃ kasyānna bhavati? ityāha -`avyayī bhāve tu` ityādi| bahuvrīhiprādisamāsayostu samāsāntodāttatvena na sidhyati| tathā hi -<> [[6.2.1]] iti samāsasvarāpavādaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bahuvrīhāvuktaḥ| prādisamāse'pi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā| `niṣkālakaḥ` iti| kālaśabdaḥ kanpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ| `niṣkālikaḥ` iti| niṣkrāntaḥ kālikāyā iti prādisamāsaḥ| kālīti jānapadādisūtreṇa [[4.1.42]] [`dvitīyaṃ` -phi|sū|] ṅīṣāntatvādantodāttaḥ, tataḥ svārthike kani kṛte'pyādyudātta eva bhavati| `niṣpeṣaḥ` iti| `viṣlṛ sañcūrṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1452) asmādghañ| tena peṣaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `tarīṃ pāti` iti| <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] iti tarīpaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| kutsitastarīpa iti kutsitagrahaṇena dustarīpaśabde duḥśabdaḥ kutsāyāṃ vartata iti darśayati| `nistarīpa iti kecit` iti| te ca nirgatastarīpa iti vigṛhra prādisamāsaṃ kurvanti| `apare nistarīka iti` iti| paṭhantīti sambandhaḥ| `nirajinam` ityādi| `ajinamantodāttam` ityuktam| `pareḥ` ityādi| hastapādakeśāḥ `svāṅgaśiṭāmadantānām` (phi|sū|2|29) ityādyudāttāḥ| śiṭām=sarvanāmnāmityarthaḥ| karṣaśabdaḥ <<karṣātvato ghaño'nta udāttaḥ>> [[6.1.159]] ityantodāttaḥ||`abhimukhaḥ` iti| mukhaśabda uktasvaraḥ| abhiśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `bahuvrīhirayam`ityādi| yadā bahuvrīhistadā -abhigataṃ mukhamaneneti vigrahaḥ| yadā tu prādisamāsastadā abhigato mukham, abhigato vā mukheneti| kasmādayamavyayībhāvo na bhavati? ityāha -`avyayībāve tu` ityādi| `vacanamidamabahuvrīhrartham` iti| yadā mukhaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavati tadā'dhruvārtham, asvāṅgārtha ceti| adhruvamasvāṅgañca mukhaṃ bahuvrīhāvapi yadā bhavati| `abhimukhā śālā` iti| abhigataṃ mukhaṃ yasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| atra <> [[6.2.177]] iti na sidhyati; mukhaśabdasyāsvāṅgavācitvāt||`avyayībhāvo'pyatra prayojayati` iti| na kevalaṃ bahuvrīhitatpuruṣāvityapiśabdārthaḥ| tatra yadā bahuvrīhistadā -apagataṃ mukhamasmāditi vigrahaḥ| yadā tu prādisamāsastadā apagataṃ mukhamiti| yadā punaravyayībhāvastadā -apamukhāditi, mukhaṃ varjayitvetyarthaḥ| avyayībhāvastu <> [[2.1.12]] ityanena| kathaṃ punaravyayībhāvaḥ prayojayati, yāvatā samāsāntodāttatvenaiva siddham? ityāha -`tatrāpi hi` ityādi| prakṛtisvaratvamityatrādhyāhāryam| tatrāpyavyayībhāva `paripratyupāpā` [[6.2.33]] ityādinā pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvaratvamuktaṃ samāsasvarāpavādaḥ| tasmādavyayībhāvo'pi prayojayati| `yogavibāga uttarārthaḥ` iti| `uttarasūtre'pādityasyaivānuvṛttiryathā syāt, abhermā bhūt| avyayapūrvādapi prakṛtisvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi yogāḥ `dvitribhyāṃ paddanmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau` [[6.2.197]] ityato yogāt? prāgveditavyāḥ||sphigadīnāṃ nāmaparyantānāṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ| `sīranāmāni ca` iti| halādīni| `apasphigam, apapūtam` iti| prādisamāsaḥ, bahuvrīhirvā| sphigapūtaśabdau `svāṅgaśiṭāmadantānām` (phi|sū|2|29) ityādyudāttau| kecittu sphigaśabdaṃ dhṛtāditvā(phi|sū|1|21)dantodāttamicchanti| `rāsnāsāsnāsthūṇāvīṇāḥ` (da|u|5|47) iti vīṇāśabda ādyudātto nipātyate| `añjū` ityetadasmādasun| tenañja ādyudāttaḥ| `śīṅkruśiruhijikṣisṛdhṛbhyaḥ kvanip` [kvan -iti mu| pāṭhaḥ,] ityadhikṛtya `aderdhaca` [aderdhaśca -da|u|] ityadhvā| tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| `upasargādadhvanaḥ` ityādi| `acpratyanvavapūrvāt? sāmalobhnaḥ` [[5.4.75]] ityato'jhaṇe'nuvartamāne <> [[5.4.85]] ityanenāc? samāsānto vidhīyate| tena tasmin? samāsānte'cpratyayasya cittvādeva siddhamantodāttatvam| nanu ca nityaḥ samāsāntaḥ, tat? kimucyate -yadā samāsānto nāstīti? ata āha -`anityaśca` ityādi| yadi nityaḥ samāsāntaḥ syādadhvagrahaṇamiha na kṛtaṃ syāt; acpratyayasya cittvādevāntodāttasya siddhatvāt; kṛtaṃ ca, tasmādetadeva jñāpayati -`samāsāntavidhiranityaḥ` iti| tena `tatropāsitalokabhartari` ityevamādayaḥ prayogā upapannā bhavanti| `pluṣikuṣiśuṣibhyaḥ ksiḥ` (da|u|1|11) [`pluṣiśuṣikuṣibhyaḥ ksiḥ` -da|u|]`anujyeṣṭhaḥ` iti| <> [[5.3.62]] itīṣṭhani parato vṛddhasya jjyādeśaḥ| jeṣṭhaśabdo nitsavareṇāṇādyudāttaḥ| `anumadhyamaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.8]] iti madhyamaḥ, pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ prādisamaso'm` iti| atra hi yo'sau jyeṣṭhamanugato madhyamañca sa prādhānyena prādisamāsenocyate, jyeṣṭhamadhyamau tu guṇabhāvena| tasmāt? pūrvapadārthapradhāno'yam| `anukanīyān` iti| īyasuni parato yuvaśabdasya <> [[5.3.64]] iti kanādeśaḥ| kanīyaśabdo nitsvareṇādyudātta-| `anugato jyeṣṭho'nujyeṣṭhaḥ` ti| uttarapadārthapradhāno'yam| tena pradhānavācitvaṃ jyeṣṭhaśabdasyāsti||`pṛ? pālanapūraṇayoḥ` (dā|pā|1489) - asmāt? `puraḥ kuṣan` (da|u|9|14) iti kuṣanpratyayaḥ| tena puruṣaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `anvādiṣṭo'nvācitaḥ` iti| apradhānaśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ| yathā bhikṣāmaṭa gāñyānayetyatra gorānayanam, yathā vā - `karttuḥ kyaṅ? salopaśca` [[3.1.11]] ityatra salopaḥ| `kathitānukathito vā` iti| yaḥ kathitāt? paścāt? kathitaḥ sa kathitānukathitaḥ| yo vā kiñcit? pāk? kathayitvā paścāt kathyate kathyate sa kathitānukathita ityucyate| `anugataḥ puruṣo'nupuruṣaḥ` iti| yaḥ paścādbhavaḥ puruṣa sa evamucyate||`akṛtpade` iti| akṛcca padaṃ cākṛtpade -prathamādvivacanāntametat| `atyaṅkuśo nāgaḥ` iti| aṅkuśaśabdaḥ `sānasiparṇasi` (da|u|10|17) [sānasidharṇasiparṇasi -da|u| sānāsivarṇasiparṇasi -paṃ|u|paṃ|u|4|107) ityādinā `aki lakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1024) asmāt? pacādyac, ṭāp, <> [[8.2.5]] | tena kaśāntodāttā| `atipadā śakvarī` iti| <> [[3.3.125]] iti paderghaḥ| ghitkaraṇena hi jñāpitam -tatra gho'nyasmādapi bhavatīti| tena padamantodāttam| `atikārakaḥ` iti| karoterṇvul| atra `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūrvapadasyāvyayasvaro bhavati| `aterdhātulopaḥ` iti| yatra dhātorlopastatrāteruttarapadamantodāttaṃ bhavatīti vaktavyam| kimartham? ityāha -`iha` ityādi| yadyaterdhātulopa iti nocyeta, tadihāpi syāt -śobhano gāgryo'tigāgrya iti| bhavati hyatrāteruttarapadamakṛdantam| iha ca na syāt -atikrāntaḥ kārakādatikāraka iti| `nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā` (vā|94) iti prādisamāsaḥ| atra hi kṛdantaḥ kārakaśabdaḥ uttarapadam| tatra yadyaterdhātulopa ti nocyate tadihāpi na syāt| evaṃ tūcyamāna ihāpi bhavati, asti hyatra kramerdhātorlopaḥ| lopaḥ punastasya samāse gamyamānārthatvādapratyujyamānasyādarśanam||`nidhānamaprakāśatā` iti| na nidhānamanidhānam| `nirmūlam, nyakṣam` iti| `mūla pratiṣṭhāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-529)-asmāt? pacādyac| tasmānmūlaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `vṛtṛvadihani kamikaṣibhyaḥ saḥ` (da|u|9|21) [kamikaṣiyumucibhyaḥ - da|u|] ityadhikṛtya `aśerdevane` (da|u|9|24) iti sapratyayāntatvādakṣaśabdo'pyantodāttaḥ| `nitṛṇam` iti| `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|26) iti tṛṇamādyudāttam| `bahuvrīhirayam` ityādi| yadā bahuvrīhistadā - nigatāni mūlā nyasyeti vigrahaḥ| yadā prādisamāsastadā nigataṃ mūlamiti| avyayībhāvaḥ kasmādayaṃ na bhavati? ityāha - `avyayībhāve tu` ityādi| bahuvrīhau tu samāsāntodāttatvāpavādaḥ `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā` [[6.2.1]] ityādinā pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara uktaḥ| tatpuruṣe'pi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā; tena tayorvinā'nena vacanenāntodāttatvaṃ na sidhyati| avyayībhāve tu samāsāntodāttatvenaiva sidadham, na hi tatra tasyāpavādaḥ uktaḥ| `nivāgvṛṣalaḥ; nidaṇḍaḥ` iti| atra pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| vākśabdaḥ `kvibvacipracchi` (da|u|10|2) ityādinā kvibanto vyutpādita ādyudāttaḥ| `damu upaśame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1203) - asmāt? `ñamantāṅṅaḥ` (da|u|5|7) iti| tena daṇḍaśabdo'pyantodāttaḥ| `niśabdo'tri nidhānārthaṃ brāvīti` iti| aprakāśatāṃ brātītītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra niśabdo nidhānārthaṃ brāvīti? ityāha - `prādayo hi` ityādi| vṛttiśabdeneha samāsavṛttyādirguhrate| prādayo hi svabhāvenaiva vṛttiviṣaye sasādhanāṃ kriyāmāhuḥ| tasmādiha samāsavṛttau viṣayeyāsāvaprakāśanātmikā kriyā nidhānaśabdavācyā vāksādhanā, daṇḍasādhanā ca tāṃ niśabdo brāvīti||pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāpavādo yogaḥ| `pratyaṃśuḥ` iti| prādisamāsaḥ| `kubhrraśca` ityadhikṛtya `mugayvādayaśca` (da|u|1|121) ityaṃśuśabdo nipātitaḥ| tenāntodāttaḥ| janerghañ| tena jana ādyudāttaḥ| rājañśabdo'pi kaninpratyayāntatvāt| `rājaśabdaḥ` ityādi| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac` [[5.4.91]] iti yadā'nityatvāṭṭaj? nāsti, tadā rājaśabda iha pāṭhe prayojayati| atha tasmin? samāsānte sati kasmānna prayojayati? ityāha -`tasmin? hi sati` ityādi| anityatvaṃ tu samāsāntavidheḥ pūrvameva jñāpitam| rājaśabdasya ceha pāṭhaḥ samāsāntavidheranityatvaṃ jñāpayati| `uṣa dāhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-696) -ityasmāt? ṣṭran| tena uṣṭraśabada ādyudāttaḥ `śiṭa santāpe` [`khiṭa trāse` -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-302) -asmāṇvul| tena kheṭakaśabdo'pyādyudāttaḥ| `ajiraśiśira` (da|u|8|27) ityādinā kiracpratyayānto'jiraśabdo nipātitaḥ| tenāntodāttaḥ| `dro kutsāyāṃ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1054) -asmādāṅpūrvāt? <<ātaścopasarge>> [[3.3.106]] ityaṅ? nipātanāt? pūrvapadasya rephāntatā| tataścāvyayarūpahānādasatyasmāt? pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratve ārdetyantodāttā bhavati| `śru śravaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-942) ityasmāllyuṭ| tena śravaṇaśabdo litsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `vṛtestikan` (da|u|3|28) iti prakṛte `kṛtibhidilatibhyaḥ kit` (da|u|3|29) iti tikan, ṭāp| tena kṛttikāśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `ṛdha` -ityetasmādac, ghañ? vā| tenārdhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ, ādyudātto vā| `pura agragamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1346) -asmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ [[3.1.135]] kaḥ| tena puraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `pratigatā aṃśavo'sya` ityādi| atra bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati||`upadevaḥ` iti| prādisamāso'yam| devaśabdaḥ pacādyajantatvādantodāttaḥ| `upasomaḥ` iti| atistusuhusṛ` [[6.4.149]] ityādinā man| tena somaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `huḍṛ huḍṛ gatau` (dhā|pa|352,353) asmāt? pacādyac| tena hoḍaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| ajinamantodāttamityuktam, advyajarthaṃ cāsya grahaṇam| gauraśabdaḥ prajñadyaṇantatvādādyudāttaḥ| tiṣyeṇa yuktaḥ kālastaiṣaḥ, <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] | `sūryatiṣya` [[6.4.149]] iti yalopaḥ| naiṣataiṭāvaṇantau| tenāntodātto| `raṭa paribhāṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-297) -asmādac| ralayorekatvādrephasya lakāraḥ| laṭaḥ| `luṭa viloḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-314) -asmāt? pacādyac| tena laṭaloṭāvapyantodāttau| `śavayahvajihvāgrīvāpvāmīvāḥ` (da|u|8|128) iti jihvāntodāttā nipatyate| `iṇsiñji` (da|u|5|35) [iṇsiñ -da|u|paṃ|u| (3|2)] ityadhikṛtya `kṛṣervarṇe (da|u|5|37) iti kṛṣernak, ṭāp? savarṇadīrghatvam, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ [[8.2.5]] | tena kṛṣṇāśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `adhnyādayaśca` (da|u|8|14) iti kanyāśabdo'ntasvarito nipātyate| `guḍa ghanatve` [`guḍa rakṣāyām` -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1370) -asmādigapadhalakṣaṇaḥ [[3.1.135]] kaḥ| tena guḍo'ntodāttaḥ| kalpavāhaśabdau vṛṣāditvādantodāttau||`susthaṇḍilaḥ` iti| sthānaṃ sthiramasminniti sthaṇḍilam| pṛṣodarāditvādādyudāttaḥ| `susphigābhyām` iti| sphigaśabdaḥ ādyudāttaḥ| `supratyavasitaḥ` iti| pratyavasitaśabdasthāthādi [[6.2.143]] svareṇāntodāttaḥ| nanu ca suśabdenāpi saha samāse kṛte thāthādisvareṇaivāntodāttatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat? kimarthamudāhṛtam? evaṃ manyate -satyanyārthe'syārambhe paratvādanenaivātrāpyantodāttatvaṃ yuktamiti| yadi suśabdo'tra pūjāyāmeva vartate, avakṣepaṇaṃ tarhi kasyārthaḥ? ityāha -`vākyārthastvavakṣepaṇam` iti| atraiva kāraṇamāha -`asūṇyā tathābhidhānāt` iti| iha khalvidānīṃ `assva susthaṇḍilaḥ` ityevamprakāraṃ vākyaṃ yasmādasūyayā prayujyate, tasmādvākyārthasyaivāvakṣepaṇam| `sutṛṇeṣu` iti| atra guṇodbhāvanecchayābhidhānam, nāsūyayā| tenāvakṣepaṇaṃ nāsti, pūjaiva tu vidyate||`utpucchaḥ` iti| pucchaśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttaḥ| `seyamubhayatra vibhāṣā bhavati` iti| yadotpucchaśabdo'cpratyayānto na bhavati tadā samāsāntodāttatvam| yadā samāsāntodāttatvāpavādaḥ `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūrvapadasyāvyayasya prakṛtisvaraḥ, tadā tenāprāptesminnantodāttatve vibhāṣeyam| yadā tu pucchamudasyatītyasyārthasya vivakṣāyāṃ <> [[3.1.20]] ti ṇiṅaṃ vidāya tadantādutpucchayateḥ pacādyaci kṛte utpuccha ityetacchapabdarūpaṃ bhavati, tadā thāthādisvareṇa [[6.2.143]] nityamantodāttatve prāpte'yaṃ vikalpaḥ| tena prāpte vibhāṣeyam| `udastaṃ pucchamasyotpacchaḥ` iti| bahuvrīhiprakṛtisvara eva bhavati||`dvitribhyām` iti| digyogalakṣaṇā [[2.3.29]] pañcamī| `pāddanmūrdhasu` iti| `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam` [[2.3.37]] iti bhāvalakṣaṇā saptamī| bahuvrīhīḥ kāryī| ata āha -`dvi tri ityetābhyām` ityādi| `dvipāt, tripāt` iti| <<pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ>> [[5.4.138]] , <> [[5.4.140]] ityakāralopaḥ| pādaśabdo ghañantatvādādyudātta iti pācchabdaścādyudāttaḥ eva bhavati| `dvidan` iti| `vayasi dantasya` [[5.4.141]] iti datrādeśaḥ| dantaśabda ādyudātta ityuktam| tena datrādeśo'pi sthānivadbhāvenādyudātta eva bhavati| `dvimūrdhā` iti| mūrdhaśabdaḥ `ānnukṣanpūṣanplīhan` (da|u|6|55) ityādinā ranpratyayānto nipātyate| tenādyudāttaḥ| `mūrdhan` ityādi| <> [[5.4.115]] [`ṣo` iti mu| pāṭhaḥ] iti ṣaḥ samāsāntaḥ prāpnoti, sa na kṛtaḥ| tenātra nānta eva mūrdhaśabdaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamakṛtasamāsānta eva mūrdhañśabda upāttaḥ? ityāta āha -`tasya` ityādi| yadi kṛtasamāsānta upādīyeta tadā satyeva samāsānte'ntovāttatvaṃ syāt, asati na syāt| tasmādasatyapi samāsānte'ntodāttatvaṃ yathā syādityetat? prayojanamakṛtasamāsāntanirdeśasya| nanuca nityameva samāsantena bhavitavyam, tat?
