kutastasyāsattvam? ityata āha -`etadeva` ityādi| yadidamasya prayojanasya sampādanārathamakṛtasamāsāntasya mūrdhanśabdasyopādanām, etadeva jñāpakam -anityaḥ samāsānto bhavatīti| tena dvimūrdhatyādiprayoga upapanno bhavati| yadi tahrrakṛtasamāsānta iha mūrdhanśabda upāttaḥ, evaṃ sati yadā samāsāntaḥ kriyate tadāntodāttena na bhavitavyam| kṛtasamāsāntasya śabdāntaratvādityata āha -`yadyapi` ityādi| iha hi bahuvrīhiḥ kāryī, tadekadeśitvaṃ ca samāsāntasya| ekadeśo'syāsatītyekadeśī, sa bahuvrīhirekadeśī yasya samāsāntasya sa tadekadeśī, tadbhāvasatadekadeśitvam| etena bahuvrīhravayavatvaṃ samāsāntasya darśayan? kṛtasamāsāntasya śabdāntaratvaṃ nirasyati| tadevaṃ yasmādiha bahuvrīhiḥ kāryī tadekadeśitvañca samāsāntasya, tasmādyadāpi samāsāntaḥ kriyate tadāpi pakṣe'ntodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva| `kalyāṇamūrdhā` iti| kalyāṇaśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttaḥ| `dvayormūrdhā` iti| atra nityameva samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati||`sakthamiti` iti| `bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgāt? ṣac` [[5.4.113]] ityanena ṣac? samāsānto yasya sa sakyiśabdo'tra gṛhrate| `akrāntāt` iti| kraśabdo anto yasya saḥ krāntaḥ| na krānto'krāntaḥ| `gaurasakyaḥ` iti| gauraśabdaḥ prajñādyaṇantatvādantodāttaḥ| `ślakṣṇasakthaḥ` iti| `kṛtyaśūbhyāṃ ksnaḥ` (da|u|5|49) iti prakṛte `śliṣeraccopadhāyāḥ` (da|u|5|51) ksnapratyayāntaḥ ślakṣmaśabdaḥ| tenāntodāttaḥ| `cakrasakthaḥ` iti| `karoteḥ kin? dve ca` (da|u|8|103) [`karotedrve ca` -da|u|] iti cakraśabda ādyudāttaḥ||`paraśabdenātra sakthaśabda eva gahrate` iti| pratyasatteḥ, sa hi pūrvasūtre sannihitatvāt? pratyāsannaḥ| yadyevum, paraśabdagrahaṇamanarthakam, sakthaśabda eva hyatrānuvarttiṣyate? naitadasti; bahuvrīhigrahaṇapyatrānuvartata iti tasyāpyādyudāttatvamāśaṅkyeta| `añjisaktham` iti| añjiśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| athāpyañjaśabdāgmatvartha iniḥ kriyate, evamapyantodātta eva| `lomaśasaktham` iti| <> [[5.2.100]] iti śapratyayāntattvāllomaśaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `ṛjubāhuḥ` iti| `kubhrraśca` (da|u|1|107) ityadhikṛtya `arjidaśikamyamipaśibādhāmṛjipasitugdhugdīṃrghahakārāśca` (da|u|1|112) iti kupratyayāntau ṛjubāhuśabdau| tenāntodāttau| `vākpatiścitpattiḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāvetau| atrottarapadamādyudāttaṃ bhavati; bahulagrahaṇāt| vibhāṣāgrahaṇe hi prakṛte bahulagrahaṇena yat? sidhyati taddarśanārthamupanyastaḥ|`vyatyayo bahulaṃ tataḥ` iti| yata evaṃ bahulagrahaṇenānena kārya sidhyati, tena vyatyayo bahulaṃ bhavati| nanu ca pūrvameva svarāṇāṃ vyatyayo vihitaḥ? satyametat; tasyaiva tu prapañco'yam| `parādirudāhṛtaḥ` iti| vākpatiścitpattiriti| atra ca paragrahaṇenottarapadamuktam| `antodāttaprakaraṇe` iti| `antaḥ` <> [[6.2.144]] ityādau| `pūrvapadāntodāttaprakaraṇe` iti| `antaḥ` [[6.2.92]] , `sarvaṃ guṇakātrsanye [[6.2.93]] ityādau| `pūrvapadādyudāttaprakaraṇe` iti| ādirudāttaḥ -`saptamīhāriṇau dhamya'haraṇe` [[6.2.65]] ityādau| `evamādi sarva saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavati` iti| bahulagrahaṇena| yatastena vibhāṣāgrahaṇe prakṛte bahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityabhiprāyaḥ| tricakrādīnāṃ pūrvameva pūrvottarapadasvara ukta iti punariha nocyate|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ||- - -atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥtṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ`stokānmuktaḥ, alpānmuktaḥ` iti| `karaṇe stokālpakṛcachrakatipayasyāsatvavacanasya` [[2.3.33]] [`karaṇe ca` -pā|sū|] iti pañcamī, <> [[2.1.39]] iti samāsaḥ| nanu ca <> [[6.2.178]] ityataḥ samāsagarahaṇamanuvartiṣyate, samāse ca niyataṃ sannihitamuttarapadam, ato'ntareṇāpyuttarapadagrahaṇamuttarapadaṃ labhyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha -`uttarapadamiti kim` iti| `niḥstokaḥ` iti| `nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā` (vā|94) iti prādisamāsaḥ| evaṃ manyate -asatyuttarapadagrahaṇe samāse ye stokādaya uttarapadabhūtāḥ pūrvapadabhūtā vā, tebhya uttarasyāḥ pañcabhyā alugbhavatītyetāvanmātraṃ labhyate, na tūttarapade parato ye stīkādaya ityeṣa viśeṣaḥ| tataśca niḥstoka ityatrāpyaluk? syāt| bhavati hyatrāpi samāsavartinaḥ stokādeḥ śabdāduttarā pañcamīti| nanvevamapi na kartavyemevottarapadagrahaṇam, lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā(vyā|pa|3) pratipadaṃ `stokādibhyaḥ karaṇe ca` [[2.3.33]] ityādisūtreṇa yā pañcamī vihitā, tasyā eva grahaṇam| natu <> [[2.3.28]] ityanena sāmānyalakṣaṇena yā pañcamī vihitā, tasyā eva grahaṇam| na tu <> [[2.3.28]] ityanena sāmānyalakṣaṇena yā pañcamī vihitā tsayāḥ| avaśyañca salakṣamapratipadoktaparibhāṣā'śrayitavyāḥ; anyathā hi stokādapetaḥ stokāpeta ityatrāpyaluk, syāt, evaṃ sati niḥstoka ityatrālukprāptireva nāsti, na hyatra stokaśabdāt? pratipadivihitā pañcamī, kiṃ tarhi? sāmānyalakṣaṇavihitā| tata kiṃ tannivṛttyarthenottarapadagarahaṇena? ityāha -`anyārtham` ityādi| ānaṅādyarthamidamuttarapadagarahaṇam| asati caitasmin? <<ānaṅ ṛto dvandve>> [[6.3.25]] ityānaṅ, `hotāpātṛbhyām` ityatra yathā pūrvapadasya bhavati, tathottarapadasyāpi syāt| tathā <<iko hrasvo'ṅyo gālavasya>> [[6.3.61]] iti hrasvo yatheha bhavati -`grāmaṇiputraḥ` iti, tathehāpi syāt -`grāmaṇīḥ` iti| nanu yadyanuttarapade'pi hlasvaḥ syāt, tadā `hrasvo yatheha bhavati -`grāmaṇiputraḥ` iti, tathehāpi syāt -`grāmaṇīḥ` iti| nanu yadyanuttarapade'pi hrasvaḥ syāt, tadā `hrasvo yatheha bhavati -`grāmaṇiputraḥ` iti, tathehāpi syāt -`grāmaṇīḥ` iti| nanu yadyanuttarapade'pi hlasvaḥ syāt, tadā `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` iti, tathehāpi syāt, `grāmaṇīḥ` iti| nanu yadyanuttarapade'pi hrasvaḥ syāt, tadā `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; anenaiva siddhatvāt? nānarthakam; anigantārthatvānnityārthatvācca| kiñca, asatyuttarapadagrahaṇe kṛtam| yadyevam, yadarthamidaṃ tadvidhāveva kartavyam, iha kimartha kriyate? ityāha -`ihāpyaluko nivṛttim` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| anyārthaṃ tāvadavaśyamidamuttaragrahaṇam| iha tu kriyamāṇe satyayaṃ viśeṣaḥ -niḥstoka ityatarāpyalug? nivṛttaḥ kriyate| tena lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā(vya|pa|3) nāśrayitavyā bhavati| atha kutaḥ prātimāvadhikārau? ityāha -`alugadhikāraḥ` ityādi| vidheyāntaraṃ vidheyāntarasya nivartakaṃ bhavatītyānaṅ? vidhīyamāna utatarapade'lukaṃ nivartayati, tasmāt -`alagadhikāraḥ prāgānaṅaḥ`| uttarapadādhikāraḥ `prāgaṅgādhikārāt` iti| uttarapade parato yat? kāryaṃ vīdhīyate tasya sambandhiśabdatvāt? pūrvapadaṃ vidhibhāk| ato'ṅgaṃ vidhibhāktvena vijñāyamānamuttarapadādhikāraṃ nivartayati| aṅgasya hi yat? kāryaṃ tat? pratyaye parato vidhīyate, nottarapade| na hruttarapade'ṅgasaṃjñā bhavati| atha vā -uttarapada iti saptamīnirdeśādanantara evottarapade bhavitavyamānaṅā| yadi cātra vibhakteraluk? syāt? tadā vyavadhānādānantarya na syāt| na ca vyavadhāne'pi vacanasāmarthyādānaṅsyāditi śakyate parikalpayitum| evaṃ hi <> [[1.1.66]] iti nirdiṣṭagrahaṇamānantaryārtha bādhyeta, aniṣṭaṃ ca rūpamāpadyeta| na cāniṣṭārthā śāstre prakḷpatiryuktā| tasmādalugadhikāraḥ prāgānaṅaḥ| aṅgasya pratyaye parato'bhāvāduttarapade paratastanna bhavatyeva, ata uttarapadādhikāraḥ prāgaṅgādhikārāt||stokādaya iti prātapadikagaṇeṣu na paṭhante| tasmāt? sūtraparipaṭhitā eveha grahītavyā iti darśayannāha -`stokāntikadurārthakṛcchrāṇi` ityādi| atha `karaṇe` ca` [[2.3.33]] ityādau sūtre ye paripaṭhitāḥ stākādayaste kasmānna gṛhyante? evaṃ manyate -`ṅaseḥ stokādibhyaḥ` iti vaktavye `pañcamyāḥ` iti bahutarākṣaranirdeśenaitat? sūcitam -yeṣu stākādiṣu gṛhramāṇeṣu bahutaralakṣyasaṃgraho bhavati te grahītavyāḥ` iti| stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇītyeteṣveva [`dūrārtha` iti nāsti mudrite nyāsapāṭhe] gṛhramāṇeṣu bahutaralakṣyasaṃgraho bhavati, tatrārthagrahaṇāt; na tvitareṣu| tasmādeṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ nyāvyamiti| kathaṃ punaratra luk? prāpnoti, yasmin? prāpte pratiṣedho'yaṃ kriyate? ityāha -`samāse kṛte` ityādi| samāse kṛte sati tasya <> [[1.2.46]] iti prātipadikatvam, ataḥ <> [[2.4.71]] iti supo luki prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamekavacanāntānāṃ stokādīnāmalugudāhyiyate, na dvivacanabahuvacanāntānām? ityāha -`dvivacanabahuvacanāntānām` ityādi| vṛttau hi viśeṣaṇapadānyekatvādikāṃ saṃkhyāṃ vihāyābhedaikatvasaṃkhyāṃ pratipadyante| sā punaḥ sakhyānamātramanupāttasaṃkhyāviśeṣaṃ sāmānyabhūtam; yata evamato vivakṣitārthānabhidhānādadvivacanabahuvacanāntanāṃ samāso na bhavatyeva| abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavantīti| `tena` ityādi| yata evaṃ dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ stokādīnāṃ samāso na bhavati, tena stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ, stokebhyo mukta ityatra na kadācidaikapadyamaikasvarya ca bhavati| stokābhyāmityasmāddhi padānmukta ityetat? padamanyadevātyantabhinnam, tathā stekebhya ityasmān? mukta ityetat| svaro'pyatrāneka eva| tathā hi -`stokābhyām` ityetat? prātipadikasvarema madhyodāttam, `muktaḥ` ityetat? pratyayasvareṇāntodāttam| evam? `stokebhyo muktaḥ` ityatrāpi nānāsvaratā veditavyā| mūlodāharaṇe tu samāse satyekapadyaṃ bhavati, svaro'pyeka eva| tathā hi -thāthādi [[6.2.143]] sūtreṇātrāntodāttatvam| yadi dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ samāso na bhavatīha tarhi kathaṃ bhavati -goṣucaraḥ varṣāsuja iti? vivakṣitārthābhidhānāt| anabhidhānaṃ hrasamāse heturuktaḥ, iha tu vivakṣitārthasyārthasya bahuvacanasyābhidhānamastyeva| yatra hrabhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate, tatra saṃkhyāviśeṣasyābhidhānaṃ na bhavati, na cātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| tataśca vivakṣitārthābhidānādabhedaikatvasaṃkhyā nopapadyate| tathā hi -goṣucara ityatra gośabdo'psu vartate, sa cāpo'bhidadhāno bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭa evābhidadhāti, apśabdavat| varṣāsuja iti -varṣāśabdo'pi kālaviśeṣe bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭa eva vartate| ataḥ prāpipadikenaiva bahutvasaṃkhyāyā āśritatvānnātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| yadi tu jāyeta, tadā bahutvasaṃkhyā nivarteta, tataśca gośabdasya varṣāśabdasya ca yaḥ prātipadikārto'bhipretaḥ sa iha na gamyeta| tasmānmābhūdgośabdavarṣāśabdayorabhipretasyārthasyānavagatiriti nātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| tataśca vivakṣitārthābhidhānād goṣucaraḥ, varṣāsuja ityatra bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| `brāāhraṇācchaṃsina upasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam` iti| brāāhṛṇācchaṃsīti yo'yaṃ śabdastasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaratra na sidhyati? pañcamīti| brāāhṛṇaśabdenātrādhyayanaviśeṣa ucyate, taṃ śaṃsati=kathayati yaḥ saḥ brāāhṛṇācchaṃsīti tācchiliko ṇiniḥ| atra brāāhṛṇaśabdāt? <> [[2.3.2]] iti dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ pañcamyupasaṃkhyeyā| alukpunaḥ <> [[6.3.14]] ityeva siddhaḥ| yadā tu brāāhṛṇādākṛṣyāvayavamarthaṃ vā śaṃsatīti vivakṣyate, tadā pañcamyapi nopasaṃkhyeyā| <> [[2.3.28]] ityevameva tasyāḥ siddhatvāt| kathaṃ punaratrāsatā pañcamyarthena vyutpattiḥ kriyate? ityāha -`kratvigviśeṣa` ityādi| rūḍhiḥ=prasiddhiḥ, saṃjñeti yāvat| tasyā ityanena rūḍhimātraṃ pratyavamṛśyate, na tu brāāhṛṇācchaṃsītyayaṃ rūḍhiśabdaḥ| rūḍhiśabdaḥ kasyācideva ṛtvigviśeṣasya vācakaḥ, tatraiva tasya saṃjñātvena praṇītatvāt| tasmāt? tasyāpyasatā satā vāvayavārthena vyutpattiḥ kriyate| tatra yadi brāāhṛṇaṃ śaṃsatītyayamartho vivakṣyate, tadā pañcamyarthasyāpādānasyābhāvādasatāvayavārthena vyutpattiḥ kriyate| yada#ā tu brāāhṛṇādavayabārthaṃ vā gṛhītvā śaṃsatītyayamartho vivakṣyate, tadā pañcamyarthasya bhāvāt? satā||ojasākṛtamityādau <> [[2.1.32]] ityanena samāsaḥ| `añjasa upasaṃkhyānam` iti| añjasa uttarasyāstṛtīyāyā aluk? upasaṃkhyānam=pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam -<<ājñāyini ca>> [[6.3.5]] ityatra cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāñjaḥśabdāduttarasyāstṛtīyāyā alugbhavatīti| anyadapi cātra pratpādanamuttaratra kariṣyāmaḥ|`puṃsānujaḥ` ityādi| puṃsānujo januṣāndha ityatrāpi tṛtīyāyā alukpratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ pūrvavat| puṃsā hetunānujaḥ puṃsānujaḥ| januṣā hetunā andhaḥ januṣāndhaḥ| `tṛtīyā` [[2.1.30]] iti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| januriti janmano nāmadheyametat||`manasājñāyī` iti| tacchiliko ṇiniḥ, `āto yuk? ciṇkṛtoḥ` [[7.3.33]] iti yugāgamaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ||pūraṇagarahaṇiha svaryate, svaritena cādhikārāvagatirbhavati| tena pūraṇagrahaṇadhikṛtya pūraṇagrahaṇamadhikṛtya pūraṇapratyayā vihitāsta eva pūraṇagrahaṇena gṛhyante, na tu svarūpam| `uttarapade` [[6.3.1]] ityanuvartate ca, tataḥ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho|pa|sū|7) pūraṇapratyayānta uttarapade kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityālocyāha -`pūraṇapratyayānta uttarapade` ityādi| `pañcamaḥ` iti| pañcānāṃ pūraṇaḥ <> [[5.2.48]] iti ḍaṭ, tasya <> [[5.2.49]] | `ṣaṣṭhaḥ` iti| ṣaṇṇāṃ pūraṇa iti <<ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk>> [[5.2.51]] , ṣṭutvam| `ātmanāpañcamaḥ` ityādau kena tṛtīyā, na hyatra karaṇādistṛtīyārtho'sti, karaṇādi hi kārakam, kriyāyāśca kārakraṃ bhavati, na ceha kācit? kriyā vidyate? ityāha -`tṛtīyāvidhāne` ityādi| bhavatvevam, tṛtīyāsamāsāstu katham, na hyatra samāsalakṣaṇamasti? ityata āha -`tṛtīyāvidhāne` ityādi| bhavatvevam, tṛtīyāsamāsastu katham, na hyatra samāsalakṣaṇamasti? ityata āha -`tṛtīyeti ca` ityādi| atha vā -<> [[2.3.18]] ityanenaivātra tṛtīyā, <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsa iti darśayannāha -`ātmanā vā` ityādi| atra kartara karaṇe vaiṣā tṛtīyā -kṛtaḥ pañcama iti| kṛte samāse kṛtaśabdo na prayajyate; tadarthasya vṛttāvantarbhāvāt| `katham` ityādi| atrāpyātmanā caturtha iti bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `bahuvrīhirayam` ityādi parihāraḥ| tatpuruṣe hrātmanācaturtha iti syāt, na cāyaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? bahuvrīhiḥ| sa ca prathamāntayoreva padayoriti na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu cānyapadārthe bahuvrīhirucyate, anyapadārthaśca vyatirikto bhavati| yathā citrā -gāvo yasya saḥ citraguriti, na ceha kaścidvyatirikto'nyapadārtho'sti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avyatirakto'pyanyapadārtho bhavati vayapadeśivadbhāvena| yathā -śobhanaśarīraḥ śilāputraka iti||`yudhiṣṭhiraḥ` iti| <> [[8.2.11]] iti samāsaḥ, <> [[8.3.95]] iti ṣatvam| atha gaviṣṭhira ityatra kathamaluk, na hi gośabdo halantaḥ, nāpyadantaḥ? syādetat -go+i+sthira iti sthite'ntaraṅgatvādavādeśe kṛte halantatvādbhaviṣyati, etacca nāsti; yataḥ `antaraṅgānapi vidhīn? bahiraṅgo lug? bādhate` (vyā|pa|128) iti, avaśyaṃ caitadabhyupeyam; anyathā hi nadyāṃ kukkuṭikā nadīkukkuṭika, bhūmyāṃ pāśo bhūmipāśa ityatrāpi yaṇādeśe kṛte'luk? prasajyeta? ityata āha -`gaviṣṭhira ityatra tu` ityādi| `hmaddyubhyām` iti| asaṃjñārthamidam| vaktavyamiti vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ cottaratra kariṣyate| atha vehāpi kriyate -ihāntagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, vināpi tena sapatamyā prātipadike sannidhāpite haladantatā labhyata eva, tasamādadhikamihāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tadadhikaṃ kriyamāṇametat? sūcayati -adhikenāyamalugbhavatīti| tena kvacidasaṃjñāyāmalugbhavatīti| `hmadispṛgdivispṛk` iti| <<spṛśo'nudake kvin>> [[3.2.58]] `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ` [[8.2.62]] ti śakārasya khakāraḥ, tasya <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti jaśtvam -gakāraḥ, tasyāpi <<vā'vasāne>> [[8.4.56]] iti cartvam -kakāraḥ| atra cāyamarthaḥ -hmadayaṃ spṛśati, divaṃ spṛśatīti| tathā hi bhāṣye uktam -`dvitīyārthe saptamī caiṣā draṣṭavayā, hmadayaṃ spṛśati, divaṃ spṛśatīti `hmavispṛk, divispṛka` iti| kathaṃ punaḥ dvitīyārthe sā bhavati? ata eva bhāṣyakāravacanāt| atha vā -hmadayaṃ yaḥ spṛśati sa hmadaye spṛśatyeva, divaṃ yaḥ spṛśati sa divi spṛśatyeva atra `adhikaraṇe` [[2.3.36]] ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati saptamī| ākhyāgrahaṇe prakṛte punaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham||vaṇigbhiḥ karṣakaiḥ paśupālaiśca rājñe deyo bhāgo rakṣānibandhanaḥ=kāraḥ, tasya nāma kāranāma| `kūpeśāṇam` ityādau `rsaṃjñāyām` [[2.1.43]] iti samāsaḥ| `haledvipadikā` iti| dvau dvau pādau deyau dvipādikā, `pādaśatasya` [[5.4.1]] ityādinā vun, alontyalopaśca, <> [[6.4.130]] iti padādeśaḥ| `kāraviśeṣasya` ityādināsya sūtrasya niyamārthatāṃ darśayati| niyamavikalpāḥ -niyamaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ| `kāranāmni ca` ityādinā teṣāṃ niyamavikalapānāṃ svarūpaṃ darśayati| ete ca niyamavikalpāḥ kāranāmni, prācām, halādāvityeṣāṃ padānāmiha niyamavākya upādānālalabhyante| yadyādyo niyamo nābhipretaḥ syāt? tadā `kāranāmni` iti na brāūyāt| evaṃ yadi dvitīyo niyamamo nābhipretaḥ syāt? tadā `prācām` ityevaṃ noktaṃ syāt| tathā yadi tṛtīyo niyamo nābhīṣṭaḥ syāt? `halādau` ityevaṃ noktaṃ syāt| atha kimarthaṃ nāmagrahaṇam, na pūrvayogāt? saṃjñāgrahaṇamanuvartate? pūrvayoge saṃjñāyā upādheḥ prāyikatvasūcanārthaṃ nāmagrahaṇam| tena hmadispṛk, divispṛgityatrāsaṃjñāyāmapyaluksiddho bhavati||`antācceti vaktavyam` iti| antaśabdāccottarasyāḥ saptamyā alugbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - pūrvayogāccakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccārthaḥ| tenāntaśabdādapyuttarasyāḥ saptamyā alugbhavatīti||svāṅgamadravādilakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ yat? tadiha gṛhrate| `kaṇṭhekālaḥ` iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `vyadhikaraṇānāmapi `bahuvrīhirbhavatyeva` iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `samānādhikaraṇa` (vā|97) ityetat? prāyakam| `akṣaśauṇḍaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.40]] iti samāsaḥ| `aṅgulitrāṇajaṅghāvalo` saptamītatpuruṣau||`svāṅgāt` [[6.3.11]] iti nivṛttam, sāmānyena vidhiḥ| `bandhe` iti| badhnāteretadrūpam| <> [[6.3.19]] ityanena tatpuruṣe badhnātau pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyanti| tatra viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyate -tatpuruṣe kva ca pratiṣedhaḥ? ityatastatparijñānārthamāha -`bandha iti dhañanto gṛhrate` iti| bandhanaṃ banadhaḥ, bhāve ghañ| anena dhañante badhnātau vibhāṣā| pratyayāntare tu pratiṣedha iti darśitaṃ bhavati| kathaṃ punajrñāyate -ghañanto'yamiti? ādyudāttatvāt| `hastebandhaḥ` iti| tatpuruṣaḥ, bahuvrīhirvā| `ubhayatra` iti| prāpte cāprāpte ca kathaṃ punarubhayatra vibhāṣeyam? ityāha -`svāṅgāddhi` ityādi||`stamberamaḥ, karṇejapaḥ` iti| `stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ` [[3.2.13]] ityac, `upapadamitaṅ` [[2.2.19]] iti tatpuruṣaḥ| `kurucaraḥ, madracaraḥ` iti| <> [[3.2.16]] vibhāṣāyāṃ prakṛtāyāṃ bahulagrahaṇaṃ kvacitpravṛttyādīnāmarthānāṃ saṃgrahārtham| tenālukpravṛttiḥ kvacideva bhavati -`stamberamaḥ` ityādau| kvacidapravṛttireva -`kurucaraḥ` ityādau| kvacidubhayam -`sarajim, sarojam` ityādau| kvacidanyadeva -`brāāhṛṇācchaṃsī` ityādau| saptamyā aluguktaḥ pañcamyā api bhavati| tathā kṛdanta uttarapade'luguktastaddhite'pi bhavati -apsu bhavo'psavya iti| digāditvādyat -<> [[6.4.146]] iti guṇaḥ, <> [[6.1.79]] iti vāntādeśaḥ|tadevaṃ sarvatra bahulagrahaṇena siddhamiti `brāāhṛṇācchaṃsina upasaṃkhyānam` (vā|716) ityādi| yaduktam, yacca vakṣyate -`apoyoniyanmatuṣu saptamyā aluk` (vā|721) ityādi, tat? sarva na vaktavyaṃ bhavatīti| yadyevam? stokānmukta ityādapi sarvamanenaiva siddhamiti `pañcamyāḥ stākādibhyaḥ` [[6.3.2]] iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati? satyametat; asyaiva prapañcārthaṃ tadveditavyam| evañca sati susaṃgṛhītaṃ lakṣyaṃ bhavati| tathā cāha -ta eva viṣayāḥ susaṃgṛhītā bhavanti yeṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prapañcaśca||`prāvṛṣijaḥ` iti| <> [[3.2.97]] , `ṭeḥ` [[6.4.143]] iti ṭilopaḥ, `apapadamatiṅa` [[2.2.19]] iti samāsaḥ||`gha` iti tarapatamaporgahaṇam, `kāla` iti kālavācinaḥ śabdasya, `tana` iti ṭauṭauloranādeśasya satuṭkasya| `pūrvāhṇetarām` iti| ahnaḥ pūrvamiti vigṛhaya `pūrvāpara` [[2.2.1]] ityādinaikadeśisamāsaḥ| `rājāhaḥ - sakhibhyaṣṭac` [[5.4.91]] iti ṭac? samāsāntaḥ, `ahno'hana etebhyaḥ` [[5.4.88]] ityahnādeśaḥ| `ahno'dantāt` [[8.4.7]] iti ṇatvam| asmaśca pūrvāhṇe asmaśca pūrvāhṇe, asmistvanayoratiśayena pūrvāhṇe pūrvāhṇetara iti| `dvivacana` [[5.3.57]] ityādinā tarap| `pūrvāṅṇetamām` iti| `atiśāyane` [[5.3.55]] ityādinā tamap, <> [[1.2.46]] iti prādipadikatve sati subluk? prāptaḥ pakṣe pratiṣidhyate| `pūrvāhṇetane` iti| `pūrvāhṇetare` ityatrārthe <> [[4.3.24]] iti ṭauṭaulau tuḍāgamaśca, `yuvoranākau [[7.1.1]] ityaṭanādeśaḥ| `rātritarāyām` iti| asyāñca rātrāvasyāñca rātrāvanayoratiśayena rātrāviti vigrahaḥ| nanu ca `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt? sa vihitastadādestadantasya` (pu|pa|vṛ|44) iti tadantagrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti ghasaṃjñakapratyayānte tanapratyayānte cottarapade parato'lugudāhartavayaḥ, tat? kasmāt? pratyayamātre sa udāhṛtaḥ? ityāha - `uttarapadādhikāre` ityādi| kutaḥ punaretadityāha - `lekhagrahaṇāt` ityādi| <> [[6.3.50]] ityatrāṇo lekhaśabdasya cāṇantasya bhedanopādanam| tatra yadyuttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantaravidhiriṣyate tadā lekhagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt; aṇgrahaṇenaiva tadgrahaṇasya siddhatvāt, kriyate ca| tasmāllekhagrahaṇādvijñāyate - `uttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirneṣyate` (pu|pa|26) iti| `tene` iti| tadantavidherihāniṣṭatvena| `kāla iti na svarūpagraham` iti| nāmagrahaṇāt| tasya hretadeva prayojanam||`kheśayaḥ` iti| <> [[3.2.15]] ityac| `grāmevāsaḥ` iti| vasanaṃ vāsaḥ, bhāve ghañ| `grāmevāsī` iti| tācchīliko ṇiniḥ, vrate vā| `pūrvāhṇaśayaḥ` iti| nanu ca svarūpagrahaṇe sati kālaśaya iti pratyudāhāryam, naivedaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam| kiṃ tarhi? arthagrahaṇam| ata eva vṛttāvuktam -`akālavācinaḥ` iti| kathaṃ punararthagrahaṇaṃ labhyate? pūrvasūtrādiha nāmagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| yadyevam, tadā nārthaḥ kālagrahaṇena <> [[6.3.17]] ityetadanuvartiṣyate, tasya ca nañā saha sambandhaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ -kālanāmno neti, tatrāyamarthaḥ -`nensiddhabadhnātiṣu ca` [[6.3.19]] [`nensiddha` iti prācīnamudritapāṭhaḥ] ityatra neti vaktavyaṃ na bhavati, netyetadeva hranuvarttiṣyate? naivaṃ śakyam; `na śayavāsavāsiṣi` ityucyamāne hraluka evāyaṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyeta, tasyātra vidheyatayā prastutatvāt| tasmāt? kālasyaiva pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kālagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| vaktavyamiti vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvameva kṛtam||<> [[6.3.14]] iti prāptasyāluko'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `innanta uttarapade` iti| nanu ca `uttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnaṣyate` (pu|pa|26) iti jñāpitametat, tatkathamiha tadantamuttarapadaṃ gṛhrate? saptamyāḥ parasyenpratyayasyāsambhavāt| dvividha eva hīnpratyayaḥ - kṛt? taddhitaśca| tatra kṛddhātorevotpadyate iti na saptamyāḥ parasyenpratyayasyāsambhavāt| dvividha eva hīnpratyayaḥ - kṛt? taddhitaśca| tatra kṛddhātorevotpadyate iti na saptamyāḥ paraḥ sambhavati| taddhito'pi naiva kaścit? saptamīsamarthādutpadyata ityasāvapi naiva saptamyāḥ paraḥ sambhavati| tasmādinnantameva gṛhrata yuktamuktametat| `sthaṇḍilavartī` iti| `vrate` [[3.2.80]] iti ṇiniḥ; <> [[2.2.19]] iti samāsaḥ| `sāṅkāśyasiddhaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.41]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `cakrabaddhaḥ` iti| baddhaśabdo niṣṭhāntaḥ, `saptamī` [[2.1.40]] iti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| bandhaśabdena `cakrabandhaḥ` iti| `siddha` [[2.1.40]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `tat? pacādyacapratyayāntaṃ draṣṭavyam` iti| atha bandha ityetacchabdarūpaṃ ghañantaṃ kasmānna gṛhrate? ityāha `ghañante hi` ityādi||ayamapi `tatpuruṣe` [[6.3.13]] ityādinā prāptasyālukaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| `samasthaḥ` iti| same tiṣṭhatīti kaḥ <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityakāralopaḥ|`kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭhaḥ` [`kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭhā` iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ `kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭhaḥ` kāśikā mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ - vārāṇasī| `kṛṣṇobhyāreṣṭhaḥ` - kāśikā - saṃ|pa|pāṭhaḥ] iti| `sthaḥ kaḥ ca` [[3.2.77]] iti kvippratyayaḥ||`caurasyakulam` iti| ākrośapratipādanaparametat, na tvanena tasya sambandho vivakṣitaḥ| `vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvameva kṛtam| `paśyatoharaḥ` iti| paśyata iti <<ṣaṣṭhī cānādare>> [[2.3.38]] iti ṣaṣṭhī| haratīti haraḥ pacādyac| `amuṣya` iti| adasastyadādyatvam, <<adaso'serdādu do maḥ>> [[8.2.80]] ityuttvamatve, uttvasyāsiddhavāt<<ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ>> [[7.1.12]] iti ṅasaḥ syādeśaḥ| tathā `amuṣyakuliketi` (iti)| yathā amuṣyaputriketyatra bhanojñāditvāt? [[5.1.132]] vuñ, tathātrāpītyarthaḥ| `devānāmpriyaḥ` iti| prīṇātīti priyaḥ, <> [[3.1.135]] iti kapratyayaḥ iyaṅādeśaḥ| `śunaḥśepaḥ` iti| `āyuvamaghonāmataddhite` [[6.4.133]] iti samprasāraṇam||vidyā ca yoniśceti vidyāyonī, tatkṛtaḥ sambando yeṣāṃ te vidyāyonisambandhāḥ| kṛtaśabdasya vṛttāvaprayogaḥ; gamyamānārthatvāt, yathā - guḍadhānā ityatra miśraśabdasya| `ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyastatpūrvottarapadagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam` iti| tadityanena vidyāyonisambandhā ubhaye'pi nirdiśyante, teṣāṃ pūrvapadabūtānāmuttarapadabhūtānāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ kartavyam| gṛhrate yena tat? grahaṇam, yena te gṛhyante tādṛśaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kiṃ punastadvyākhyānam? kimarthaṃ tatkartavyam? ityāha - `vidyāyonivācinyeva` ityādi| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - ihoṅgitenonmiṣitena mahatā sūtraprabandhenācāryāṇāmabhiprāyā lakṣyante, `ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ` ityeṣa mahān? sūtraprabandhaḥ, yadi hravidyāyonisambandhavācinyuttarapade'lugabhīṣṭaḥ syāt, evaṃ satyavidyāyonisambandhādityevaṃ brāūyāt| atha vā - sambandhagrahaṇamapi na kuryāt, na hi kiñcidṛkārāntaṃ vidyāvāci yonivāci vā'sambandhamasti, tatrāntareṇāpi sambandhagrahaṇaṃ vidyāyonisambandhavācina iti vijñāsyate, tat? kiṃ sambandhagrahaṇena! tadetasmānmahataḥ sūtraprabandhādvidyāyonisambandhavācinyuttarapada ācāryasyāyamalugabhīṣṭa iti lakṣyata iti| `hotuḥ` iti| `ṛta ut` [[6.1.107]] ityuttvam, raparatvam, `rātsasya` [[8.2.24]] iti sakāralopaḥ||`ṛkārāntānāṃ vidyāyonisambandhavācināṃ yo dvandvaḥ` ityādi| atha ṛkārāntasaya dvandva ānaṅ bhavatītyevaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum; ihāpi prasajyeta - pitṛpitāmahāviti| ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ| iha hi varṇānāmupadeśaḥ - kāryārthaḥ, śravaṇārtho veti, nakāraścāyaṃ na kvacit? śrūyate, sarvatraiva hrasya `nalopaḥ prātapadikāntasya` [[8.2.7]] iti lopena bhavitavyam, nāpi kiñcit? kāryamasyopalabhyate, tat? kimarthaṃ nakārasyoccāraṇam? ityāha - `nakāroccāraṇam` ityādi| asati nakāra ṛkārasyā sthāne'ṇeva śiṣyate, tataśca `uraṇ? raparaḥ` [[1.1.50]] iti raparatvaṃ syāt| nakāre tu sati nāyamaṇeva śiṣyate, api tavaṇ? cānaṅ ceti na bhavati rapatvaprasaṅgaḥ| na hi yatrāṇ? anaṇ? ceti śiṣyate tatra raparatvaṃ bhavati| yathā `sudhāturakaṅ? ca` [[4.1.97]] iti saudhātakirityatra| tasmādatra raparatvanivṛttyartha nakāroccāraṇam| atha pitāputrau, mātāputrau ityatara kathamānaṅādeśaḥ, na hyatra ṛkārāntānāṃ dvandvaḥ? ityāha - `putra ityatrānuvartate` iti| <<putre'nyatarasyām>> [[6.3.22]] ityataḥ putra ityetadatrānuvartata ityabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tu putra ityanuvartate, tadā <> [[6.3.24]] ityatra putre'pi vibhāṣā prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena tadanuvartate| ata evātretyuktaṃ tatraivānuvartate, na parvatreti pratipādanārtham| nanvevamapi putraśabda uttarapade pūrpadamātrasyānaṅ prāpnati; kāryiṇehānirdeśāduttarapadaśabdena ca pūrvapadamātrasyākṣiptatvāt, na ca śakyate vaktum - ṛta iti vacanādṛkārasya bhaviṣyatīti, tasmādekamiha ṛta iti vacanaṃ dvandvasya viśeṣaṇam, na kāryiṇaḥ? ityāha - `ṛta iti ca` iti| atrānuvartata iti sambandhaḥ| <<ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ>> [[6.3.23]] ityata ṛta ityanuvartate, tat? kāryiṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| nanu tat? pañcamīnirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ? naiṣadoṣaḥ; putra ityeṣā saptamī ṛta ityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati - <> [[1.1.66]] iti| nanvevamapi virodhaḥ, tathā hi - yadi putraśabda uttarapadam, kathaṃ tadā ṛkārāntānāṃ dvandvaḥ, ṛkārāntānāṃ dvandvo na tarhi putraśabda uttarapadamiti? naitadasti; anya eva hi sa dvandvo yasya ṛta ityetadviśeṣaṇam| anyaśāca sa yasya putraśabda uttarapadamiti ko'tra virodhaḥ||anukārārthamavidyāyonisambandhārtha ca vacanam| nanu ca `ānaṅṛto dvandve` [[6.3.24]] ityato dvandvagarahaṇamanuvartata eva, tat? kimarthamiha punadrvandvagrahaṇam? ityāha -`dvandva ityanuvartamāne` ityādi| pūrvakaṃ hi dvandvagrahaṇaṃ samāsaviśeṣapratipattyartham, idaṃ tu prasiddhasāhacaryārtham -yeṣāṃ loke vede ca prasiddhaṃ sāhacaryameṣāṃ punaḥ -parigraho yatā syādityevamartham| atha kriyamāṇe'pi punadrvandvagrahaṇe kathamayamartho labhyate? ityāha -`atyantasahacarite` ityādi| `dvandvaṃ rahasyamaryādāvacanavyutkramaṇa` [[8.1.15]] ityatredamucyate| `atyantasahacarite lokavijñāte dvandvamityetannipātyate` iti| tenāyamartho labhyata iti darśayati| `vede ca ye sahavāpanirdiṣṭāḥ` iti| sahavāpaḥ=sahadānam, tatra nirdiṣṭāḥ sahavāpanirdiṣṭāḥ ke punarekahavisambandhinaḥ? ya ekaṃ hūyamānaṃ haviḥ prati sampradānatvena nirdiṣṭā ekatra mantre -indrāvaruṇābhyāṃ chāgaṃ havirnirvapāmītyādau, te veditavyāḥ| `ubhayatri` ityādi| pūrvapadatva uttarapadatve ca sati vāyorānaṅādeśasya pratiṣedho vaktavyo vyākhyeyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -<> [[6.3.24]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena vāyoruttarapadatve pūrvapadatve ca sati na bhaviṣyatīti||ānaṅādeśāpavādo'yamīkāro vidhīyate| takāra uccāraṇārthaḥ||`agneḥ` [[6.3.26]] ityanuvartate, `devatādvandve` [[6.3.25]] iti ca| <<īdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ>> [[6.3.27]] iti nivṛttam| vṛddhiśabdena sāhacaryāt? kṛtavṛddhyuttarapadaṃ gṛhrate| ata evāha -`kṛtavṛddhāvuttarapade` iti| `āgnivāruṇīm` iti| autsargike'ṇi kṛte `ṭiṅḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp| atrāpi takāra uccāraṇārthaḥ||`devatādvandva uttarapade` iti| devatādvandve yaduttarapadaṃ tatra parata ityarthaḥ||ānaṅopavādaḥ| athākāraḥ kimarthamuccāryate, sakārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārtha iti cet? na; prayojanābhāvādevetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyatītyāha -`akāraṇoccāraṇam` ityādi| asati hrakāre'ntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ sakārasya <> [[8.2.66]] iti rutvaṃ vikāraḥ syāt, tasyāpi `kharavasānayorvisarjanīvaḥ` [[8.3.15]] tasyāpi `kupvoḥ ka pau ca` [[8.3.37]] ityupadhmānīyaḥ syāt| akāra syoccāraṇe tu sati na bhavati, katham? akārasyoccāraṇena yadvikṛtasya sakārasyopādānaṃ tasyaitadeva prayojam -avikṛtasyāsya prayogo yathā syāditi -dyāvā divasamityādikam| vākmetat|iha ca sūtre dvandvagrahaṇam, uttarapadagrahaṇaṃ cānuvartate| dyāvā ityayamādeśo vākye na prāpnotītyāha -`katham` ityādi| `kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ` iti| tatrāyaṃ yatnaḥ -<> [[6.3.14]] ityato bahulagrahaṇamanuvartate tena dyāvā ityayamādeśaśchandasi vākye'pi bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā-cakārotra kriyate, tasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādbhaviṣyati| dyāvāśabdastu svaritatvādevānuvarttiṣyata iti nārthastadanukarṣaṇārthena cakāreṇa| atha vā -dikśabdena samānārtho dyāvāśabdaḥ prakṛtyantaramasti, tasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ| ādeśavacanaṃ tu divaḥ prayoganivṛttyarthamiti||`ānaṅo'pavādaḥ` [nāstīdaṃ vākyaṃ kāśikāyām] iti evamuttarāvapi yogau| uṣāsānaktam` iti| uṣāṃśca naktañceti vigrahaḥ||atra trayaḥ pakṣāḥ sambhāvyante -`striyāḥ` iti strīśabdena pratyayagrahaṇaṃ vā, arthagrahaṇaṃ vā, śabdagrahaṇaṃ veti| tatra yadi `striyāḥ` iti| strīpratyayagrahaṇaṃ svaryate, tadā svaritenādhikārāvagatiḥ [[1.3.11]] bhavatīti stryadhikāravihitāḥ pratyayā gṛhyante, yathā -<> [[1.2.48]] ityatra| atha tu `strī` ityanena strītvaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamabhidhīyate, tadārthagrahaṇam| yadi tu stryarthavācī śabdaḥ strītyanenocyate, tadā śabdagrahaṇam| tatrādyapakṣe'yaṃ sūtrārthaḥ -bhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ strīpratyayo'nūṅuttarapade puṃpadbhavati, nivartata iti yāvat, tadā `striyāḥ` iti prathamārthe ṣaṣṭhā| kathaṃ punaḥ puṃvadityanena strīparatayayasya nivṛttiḥ śakyate vijñātum? bhavatīti vākyaśeṣādhyāhārāt| atra ca pakṣe paṭvī bhāryā'syeti paṭubhāryaṃ ityatra strīpratyayanivṛtteruttarapadanimittāyāḥ pūrvasmin? yaṇādeśe vidhātavye sati <> [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadbhāve sati yaṇādeśaḥ syāt| iha ca -gāgryo vṛndārikā gargavṛndārikā ityatra `tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām` [[2.4.62]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[2.4.64]] iti yaño lugna prāpnoti| puṃvadbhāvena hi stropratyayasya nivṛttiḥ kriyate, na tvarthasya strītvasya; tataścārthasyānivartitatvāt? kena punaryañna śrūyeta -ityevamādayaḥ pratyayapakṣe doṣā bhāṣye vistareṇoktāḥ| iha cātigranthavistarabhayānnocyante| arthapakṣe tūttarapade parato bhāṣitapuṃskasyānūṅpratyayāntasya strīśabdasya yorthastasya pumarthotidiśyate| bhāṣitapuṃskāditi pañcamī ṣaṣṭharthe -stryarthaḥ puṃvadbhavatīti| pumarthe cātidiṣṭe tadvacanaḥ śabdaḥ pravartate| atra pakṣe <> [[6.3.66]] iti hrasvatvasyāsya ca puṃvadbhāvasya vipratiṣedho na prāpnoti; bhinnaviṣayatvāt| tathā hi -śabdasya hrasvatvam, arthasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ; tataśca kālimmanyetyatra <> [[1.4.2]] iti hrasvatvaṃ na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca vipratiṣedhaḥ| tathā hi -puṃvadbhāvasya vipratiṣedho na prāpnoti; bhinnaviṣayatvāt| tathā hi -śabdasya hrasvatvam, arthasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ; tataśca kālimmanyetyatra <> [[1.4.2]] iti hrasvatvaṃ na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca vipratiṣedhaḥ| tathā hi -puṃvadbhāvasyāvakāśo yatra khidantamuttarapadaṃ nāsti -darśanīyabhāyaṃ iti, hrasvasyāvakāśo yatra puṃvadbhāvo nāsti -kālimmanyaḥ pumāniti; kālimmanyā strītyatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, tatra paratvāt? hrasvatvaṃ bhavati| tadevamādyayoḥ pakṣayordoṣavattāṃ manyamānastṛtīyapakṣamāśrityāha -`bhāṣitaḥ pumān? yena` ityādi| yo hraviśeṣeṇa kvacidbhāṣitapuṃskaḥ śabdaḥ sa ihāśrīyeta, tadā droṇībhārya ityatrāpi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāditi manasi kṛtvā''ha -`samānāyamākṛtau` ityādi| `ekasmin? pravṛttinimitte` iti| anena samānāyāmākṛtāvityasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| ākriyate=gṛhrate, paricchidyate yenārthastat? śabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ jātyādikamihākṛtiśabdenocyate| `bhāṣitapuṃskāt` ityetāvatyukte `samānāyāmākṛtau` ityeṣa viśeṣo na śakyo labdhumityabhiprāyeṇāha -`tadetadevam` ityādi| taditi vākyopanyāse| etasya vacanasyārtharūpamevamprakāram| kathaṃ bhavati? naivaṃ kathaṃcidityarthaḥ| yadi bhāṣitapuskaśabdasya bahuvriheḥ śabdo'nyapadārthatvenāśrīyeta -bhāṣitaḥ pumān? yena śabdena sa bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ śabda iti, tadā samānāyāmākṛtāvityeṣa viśeṣo na labhyate, sarva eva hi śabdaḥ kvacadākṛtau pumāṃsaṃ bhāṣitvā''kṛtyantare striyaṃ bhāṣata iti kṛtvā| arthe tvanyapadārthatvenāśrīyamāṇe labhyata eva ityeṣa viśeṣa ityālocyāha -`bhāṣitaḥ pumān? yasminnarthe` ityādi| śabdasya yat? pravṛttinimittaṃ jātyādikaṃ tadanyapadārthaḥ| kena punaḥ śabdena tatra bhāṣitaḥ pumān? pratyasatteryat? tasya pravṛttanimittaṃ tenaiveti vijñāyate; anyathā hi bhāṣitapuṃskagrahamanarthakaṃ syāt, vyavacchedyābhāvāt| sarvatraivābhidheye|rthe yena kenacit? śabdena pumān? bhāṣyate| antato'rthaśabdenāpi tasyārthasya bhāṣitapuṃskasya yaḥ prātapadikaḥ śabda so'pyabhidhyadharmasyābhidhāna upacaradbhāṣitapuṃska ityucyate| sa punaḥ pratyāsatteryasya yo'rthaḥ pravṛttinimittaṃ tatara yena pumān? bhāṣata iti sa eva veditavyaḥ| yaśca bhāṣitapuṃskasya pravṛttinimittasya vācakaḥ sa niyogata ekasmin? pravṛttinimitte pumāṃsaṃ bhāṣitvā striyaṃ bhāṣate| yathā mūlodāharaṇeṣu -darśanīyādayaḥ śabdā iti, samāthryādyena śabdena samānāyāmākṛtau pumān? bhāṣita ityeṣa viśeṣo labhyate| `anūṅ` iti yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt, ūṅo'nyo'nūṅiti -tato nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā|pa|65) tatsadṛśānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ pratyayānāṃ grahaṇe sati tadantasyaiva puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt, aiḍaviḍavṛndārikā, dāradavṛndāriketyatra na syāt| iḍaviḍo'patyaṃ strīti `janapadaśabdāt? kṣatriyādañ` [[4.1.168]] ityatprratyayaḥ| darado'patyamiti `dvyañmagadha` [[4.1.170]] ityādināṇ? tayoḥ `ataśca` [[4.1.177]] iti luk, tata iḍaviṭ? cāsau vṛndārikā ceti, daraccāsau vṛndārikā ceti `vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ` [[2.1.62]] iti samāsaḥ, tatredānīṃ `puṃvatkarmadhāraya` [[6.3.42]] ityādinā puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti; ūṅsadṛśapratyayānatarābhāvāt, tataśceḍaviṭśabdasyaiḍaviḍaśabdo daracchabdasya dāradaśabdo na syāt| prasajyapratiṣedhe sati tu bhavati; atrā'pyūṅabhāvasya bhāvādityālocya prasajayapratiṣedho'yamiti darśayannāha -ūṅo'bhāvo'nūṅiti| `bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ` iti| yadyayamasamāsaḥ syānna bahuvrīhiḥ, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt -bhāṣitapuskāduttarasyāvidyamānoṅaḥ stryarthavṛtteḥ śabdasyottarapade parataḥ puṃvadbhavatīti| evañca sati yathābhūtārthavācī strīśabdastathābhūtārthavācyeva puṃśabdasyādeśo bhavatīti sāmarthyāduktaṃ bhavati, tataścāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ -aṅgārakā nāma śakunayaḥ teṣāṃ kālikā nāma striyaḥ, tata etāśca kālikāvṛndārikāśceti samāse kṛte satyetacchabdo bhā,#itapuṃska iti tasmāduttarasya kālikāśabdasyānūṅo'rthato'ntaratamo'ṅgarakaśabdaḥ puṃśabdādeśaḥ prasajyeta; anyasyāntaratamasyābhāvāt| tataścaitadaṅgārakavṛndārikā iti hi syāt, etatkālikāvṛndārikā itīṣyate| bahuvrīhau tu satyaniṣṭaprasaṅgo na bhavati, tatra hi bhāṣitapuṃskasya śabdasyānūṅaḥ pūṃvadbhāvena bhavitavyam, na ca kālikāśabdo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ -ityetatsarvamālocya bahuvrīhirayamiti darśayannāha -`bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ? yasmin? strīśabde` iti| `yadi bahuvrīhirayam` [`yadi -nāsti kāśikāyām] iti| evaṃ sati <> [[2.4.71]] iti pañcamyā luk? prāpnoti? ata āha -`alugnipātanāt` ityādi| nanu cālaukikatvādasya vākyasya nipātanādityayamaparīhāraḥ, nipātanaṃ hi laukikaṃ bhavati, tahrrevaṃ lukāpyatra na bhāvyam? atha lugbhaviṣyatītyevāvasīyate'lugapi bhavatītyavasīyatām| `darśanīyabhāryaḥ` iti| darśanīyā bhāryā'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ| <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvatvamuttarapadasya| darśanīyatvaṃ nāmātra sāmānye viśeṣo darśanīyaśabdasya pravṛttinimittam| tamekamevārthamupādāyāsī puṃsi striyāṃ ca vartate -darśanīyo devadattaḥ; darśanīyā bhāryeti| tasmāt? samānāyāmākṛtau darśanīyaśabdo bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati; striyāñca vartate, na cāsmādūṅ| ato bhāryāśabde strīliṅga uttarapade'sya strīśabdasya `puṃśabdasyeva rūpaṃ bhavati| [`puṃśabdasyaiva` -mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] evaṃ `ślakṣṇacūḍaḥ` ityādāvapi yojanīyam| `grāmaṇidṛṣṭiḥ` iti| atra sarvamasti, na tu grāmaṇīśabdaḥ striyāṃ vartate, kiṃ tarhi? napuṃsaka iti na bhavati puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `droṇībhāryaḥ` iti| droṇaśabdena bhāṣitaḥ pumān, na tu samāne pravṛttinimitta| yasmāt? parimāṇaviśeṣaṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāya puṃsi parimāṇini vartate| jātiviśeṣaṃ tūpādāya striyāṃ gavādanyāṃ vartate| yatra gāvo'danti sā gavādanī droṇīśabdenocyate| tasmānna droṇaśabdaḥ samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ| `katham` ityādi| yadi samānāyāmākṛtau yo bhāṣitapuṃskastasya puṃvadbhāva ucyate, evaṃ ca `garbhibhāryaḥ` ityādau puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti| garbhaprabhṛtīnāṃ śabdānāṃ bhinnāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| anavayavabhūtāntarvartivastuviśeṣasambandhe hi sati strī garbhiṇītyucyate| vrīhistvantarvarttyavayavastuviśeṣasambandhe sati garbhītyucyate| tasmāt? puṃsi striyāṃ ca vartamānasya garbhiśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ bhidyate| prasūtaprajātaśabdayorapi pravṛttinimittaṃ kriyakṛtirbhinnā| striyāṃ hi vartamānau tau garbhavimokṣaṇaṃ pravṛttinimittamupādaya vartate, puṃsi tu garbhādhānam| `kartavyo'tra prayatnaḥ` iti| kecidvyācakṣate -upasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyamiti| apare punarāhuḥ -striyā puṃvaditi yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ| atha vā -`kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ` ityanenedaṃ darśayati -yadyapi striyāṃ vrīhau ca garbhatvabhedaḥ, tathāpi sa nāśrayitavyaḥ| yattu tatrāvayavānavayavabhedamutsṛjya sāmānyenāntarvarttivastuviśeṣasambandhamātram, tadevāśrayitavyam| atastadapekṣayā striyāṃ vrīhau ca vartamānasya garbhiśabdasaya tulyameva pravṛttinimittamiti| evaṃ prasūtaprajātaśabdayorapyapatyādhānavimokṣaṇabhedaṃ tyaktvā'yamapatyavāniyamapatyavatītyapatyavatsambandhamātramākṣitamityetadvyākhyānami#īti pratyantaḥ kartavya iti| `brāhṛbandhūbhāryaḥ` iti| brāhṛbandhūśabdāt? `ūṅutaḥ` [[4.1.66]] ityūṅ| `kalyāṇīpañcamāḥ` iti| `ap? pūraṇīpramāṇyoḥ` [[5.4.116]] ityapsamāsāntaḥ, pañcānāṃ pūraṇīti ḍaṭ, tasya <> [[5.2.49]] , tataḥ `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīpi kṛte pañcamī bhavati| `pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam` iti| pradhānaṃ pūraṇī gṛhrate yena vyākhyānena tadvyākhyānaṃ pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇam, tat? kartavyam -pradhānaṃ yā pūraṇī tasyāṃ pratiṣedho yathā syāt, apradhānabhūtāyāṃ tasyāṃ mā bhūditi| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -iha `dvandve dhi` [[2.2.32]] iti priyādiśabdasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipātalakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnena sūcitaṃ vyabhicāryayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kvacideva vartate, na sarvatreti| tena yatraiva pradhānabhūtā pūraṇī tatraiva bhavati, nānyatreti| tena yatrāsau bhavati tatra tasyā eva pradhānabhūtāyā pūraṇyā grahaṇaṃ yuktam| kva pūraṇyāḥ prādhānyam? yatra tasyāḥ samāse'bhidheyatvenāntarbhāvaḥ, yathānantaroktapratyudāharaṇe| tatra hravayavena vigrahaḥ| samudāyastvavayavabhedādabhinnaḥ, samāsārtha eva| `tatra` iti| yathaivaṃ prathamā, dvitīyā, tṛtīyā, caturthī cābhidhīyate, tathā pañcamyapi| `kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ pakṣaḥ` iti| atra tu tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ pakṣa evānyapādrathaḥ pradhānam, pañcamī tu rātriḥ| asmin? pakṣe'nyapadārtho'numeyaiva, na tvabhidheyā| yathā vṛkṣaśabde mūlādayaḥ, tatastadvadarthamapyanabhidheyatvādartho'pradhānam| athāp? samāsāntaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`appūraṇīpramāṇyo` ityādi| atha dṛḍhabhaktiḥ, śobhanabhaktirityādau kathaṃ puṃvadbhāvaḥ yāvatā priyāditvāt? pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam? ityāha -`dṛḍhabhaktirityevamādiṣu` ityādi| astrīvācinaḥ pūrvapadasya vivakṣitatvāddṛḍhabhaktirityevamādi lakṣyaṃ siddhamityevaṃ samādheyam| dveṣyaṃ parihartavyamityarthaḥ| dṛḍhaśabdo'trādāḍharnivṛttiparaḥ prayuktaḥ| atrādāḍharnivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ liṅgaviśeṣopādānamanupakārakameveti| ataḥ strītvamiha na vivakṣitam| tasmādastrīliṅgasya dṛḍhaśabdasyāyaṃ prayoga ityabhiprāyaḥ||anuttarapadārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `tataḥ` iti| <> [[5.3.7]] | tasya <> [[5.3.1]] iti vibhaktisaṃjñakatvāt? tyadādyatvam? ṭāp, anena puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `tatra` iti| <> [[5.3.10]] | śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| `tasilādiṣu` ityādi| `tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ` ityucyamāne tasilādiṣvanantarbhūteṣvapi kvacit? puṃvadbhāva iṣyate, sa na prāpnoti| tatrāntarbhūte'pi kvacinneṣyate, evaṃ satyaniṣṭamapi prāpnoti| tasmāt? parigaṇanaṃ kartavyam| tatra tatasorudāharaṇamuktam| śeṣāṇāṃ tūcyate - iyaṃ ṣaṭvī, iyaṃ paṭvī iyamanayoratiśayena paṭvī - `dvivacana` [[5.3.57]] ityādinā tarap - paṭutarā| iyamāsamatiśayena paṭvī - `atiśāyane` [[5.3.55]] ityānā tamap - paṭutamā| paṭvī bhūtapūrvā - <> [[5.3.53]] ṅīp, paṭucarī| paṭvīprakārā - prakāravacane jātīpar? [[5.3.69]] - paṭujātīyā| īṣadasamāptā paṭvī - <<īṣadasamāptau kalpabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ>> [[5.3.67]] paṭukalpā paṭudeśyā, paṭudeśīyā| praśastā paṭvī - `paśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap` [[5.3.66]] - paṭurūpā| yāpyā paṭvī - `yāpye pāśap` [[5.3.47]] - paṭupāśā| ajāyai hitā - `ajāvimyāṃ thyan` [[5.1.8]] ajathyā| thyaṃstasilādibhyaḥ pūrvaṃ paṭhate| sarvaprakaraiḥ sarvathā, <> [[5.3.23]] | tasyāṃ rātrau tadā - <> [[5.3.15]] | asyāṃ rātrau etahiṃ - `idamorhil` [[5.3.16]] | tatredamaḥ <> [[5.3.4]] ityetādeśaḥ, praśastā vṛkī vṛkatiḥ| praśastā jyeṣṭhā jyeṣṭhatātiḥ - `vṛkajyeṣṭhābhyāṃtiltātilau ca cchandasi` [[5.4.41]] iti tillātilau| etau ca kṛtvāsucaḥ paro paṭhaeti| tasilādiṣu parigaṇanaṃ kartavyamiti bhāvyakārasya matametat, na tu sūtrakārasya| na cāsati parigaṇane kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| yeṣu hi tasilādiṣvanantarbhūteṣu puṃvadbhāva iṣyate, teṣūtatarasūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādbhaviṣyati| yeṣu tasilādiṣvantarbhūteṣu neṣyate, tatra <> [[6.3.37]] iti neti yogavibhāganna bhaviṣyatīti|doṣaḥ khalvapi parigaṇane - daracchabdāt? kapratyaye dāradiketyatra puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti; kapratyayasyāparigaṇitatvāt| `śasi bahvalpārthasya` iti| śasi pratyaye parataḥ bahvarthasyālpārthasya ca puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ, vyakhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tasyaiva cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāmāśritya kartavyam| `bhasyāḍhe taddhite` ityādi| `hāstikam` iti| <> [[4.2.47]] iti ṭhak| yadyatra puṃvadbhāvo na syāt? tada yasye [[6.4.148]] tīkāralope kṛte tasya <> [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadbhāvāta <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopo na syāt? puṃvadbhāve tu sati hastiśabda evāyaṃ bhavati| nanu ca ṭhakchaso (vā|732) rityanenaivātra sidhyati puṃvadbhāvaḥ? na sidhyati; na sidhyati; chasā sāhacaryāt? <> [[4.2.115]] [`bhavataṣṭhakchasau` - iti sūtram] ityanaiva vihitasya tatra ṭhako grahaṇāt, na sarvasya| `katham` ityādi| yadi ca ḍhe parataḥ puṃvadbhāvasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, tadāgnāyī devatāsyeti <> [[4.2.33]] iti ḍhaki kṛta āgnāyeya iti bhavitavyam, tatkathamāgneya iti bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| agneḥ strītyasyāṃ vivakṣāyāṃ <> [[4.1.37]] ityanenāgniśabdānṅīpi kṛta aikāre cāntādeśe'gnāyīti bhavati| `kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ` iti| yatnaḥ kena punaḥ kartavyaḥ? yaḥ `bhasyāḍhe taddhite` (vā|731) ityupasaṃkhyānamicchati| na tu yaścakāramanuktasamuccayārthamuttarasūtre karoti| sa hrevamāha - yatraiveṣyate tatraiva cakāraḥ puvadbhāvaṃ samucacinoti, nānyatreti| kaḥ punarasau yatna iti? kaścidāha - `apatyagrahaṇaṃ ḍhasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kartavyam - yo'patye'ḍhe` iti| tenāyamartho bhavati - ḍhasya taddhete puṃvadbhāvo bhavatyapatyārthapratyayaṃ varjayitvā| na cāgneyaḥ, sthālopāka ityapatyārthe ḍhapratyayaḥ, kintu sāsya devatetyarthe, ato'tra bhavatyeva puṃvadbhāva iti| anyastvāha - `bhasyāḍhe taddhite` (vā|731) iti vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau| yaścātra nañ? so'lpārthe vartate, yathā alpalavaṇā yavāgūralavaṇetyucyate| tatrāyamartho bhavati - bhasya taddhite puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyo'lye ḍhaprātyaya iti| tenāgneyaḥ, sthālīpāka ityatra puṃvadbhāvo bhavati| śyaineya, rohiṇeya ityatra tu na bhavatīti| `ṭhakchasośca` ityādi| atha ṭhaggrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā ṭhasyekādeśe kṛte `bhasyāḍhe taddhite` (vā|731) ityanenaiva siddhaḥ| ṭhāvasthāyāmeva yathā syādityevamartham| kimevaṃ sati bhavati? `isusuktāntāt? kaḥ [[7.3.51]] iti kaḥ siddho bhavati; anyathā hi yadīkādeśe kṛte puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt? tato yathā māthitika ityatrekādeśo na bhavati, tathā bhāvatkā ityatrāpi na syāt| `bhāvatkāḥ, bhavadīyāḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.115]] iti ṭhakchasau||`etāyate, śyetāyate` iti| etaśyetaśabdābhyāṃ `varṇādanudāttāt? topadhāt? to naḥ` [[4.1.39]] [`etaotaśabdābhyām` -mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ityanena ṅīp, takārasya nakāraḥ| enīvācarati, śyenīvācarati -`karttuḥ kyaṅ? salopaśca` [[3.1.11]] iti kyaṅ, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghatvam| `ayamasyāṃ darśanīyamānī` [`darśanīyamānī ayamasyāḥ` -kāśikā] iti| darśanīyāmimāṃ manyate'yamiti| `manaḥ` [[3.2.82]] iti ṇiniḥ| `darśanīyamānanīyamasyāḥ` iti| darśanīyāmimāṃ manyata iti pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp| [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ striyāṃ samānādhikaraṇa ityanuvartamāne'striyāmasamānādhikaraṇe ca māninyuttarapade puṃvadbhāva udāhyiyata ityāha -`mānino grahaṇam` ityādi| kathametajjñāyate? ityāha -`iha tu` ityādi| yadyuttarapadaṃ striyāṃ vartate samānādhikaraṇaṃ ca bhavati -darśanīyāmātmānaṃ manyate darśanīyamāninītyevamādau| tatra yasmāt? `striyāṃ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] ityanenaiva siddham, ato mānino garahaṇamastryartham| asamānādhikaraṇāccetyetadavasīyate; anyathā hi tadanarthakaṃ syāt||purveṇa prakāreṇa prāptasya puṃvadbhāvasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `pācikābhāryaḥ, kārikābhāryaḥ` iti| pācakakāraka śabdabhyāṃ ṇvulantābhyāṃ ṭāp| `pratyayasthāt? kātpūrvasyāta idāpyasupaḥ` [[7.3.44]] itīttvam| atra `striyāḥ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] ityādinā prāptiḥ| `madrikābhāryaḥ vṛjikābhāryaḥ` iti| madreṣu bhavā, vṛjiṣu bhaveti `madravṛjyoḥ kan? [[4.2.130]] iti kan| atrāpi `striyāḥ puṃvat? [[6.3.33]] ityādinā prāptiḥ| `madrikākalpā; vṛjikākalpā` iti| atra <> [[6.3.35]] ityanena prāptiḥ| `madrikāyate` ityādau <> [[6.3.36]] iti prāptiḥ| `vilepikāyā dhamryam` iti| `lipa upadehe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1433) ityasmāṇṇvul| `vailepikam` iti| `aṇ? mahiṣyadibhyaḥ` [[4.4.48]] ityaṇ| atra `bhasyāḍhe taddhite` (vā|731) iti vā prāptiḥ| `kopadhapratiṣedhe` ityādi| asmin? kopadhapratiṣedhe taddhitavugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| taddhitasambandhī vusambandhī kakāra upadhā yasya tatraiva pratiṣedho yathā syāt| iha mā bhūt -`pākabhāryaḥ` iti| pākaśabdo'yaṃ `arbhakapṛthukapākā vayasi` (da|u|3|50) ityanena kanpratyayānto nipātitaḥ| atrāsati vugrahaṇa ihāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| yadi taddhitavugrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tarhi <> [[8.2.1]] ityatra yadvakṣyati -`śuṣkajaṅgha` ityatra -<<śuṣaḥ kaḥ>> [[8.2.51]] ityasyāsiddhatvāt? `na kopadhayāḥ` [[6.3.36]] iti pratiṣedho na prāpnotītyasiddhādhikārasya prayojanam` iti tannopapadyate, asatyapi `śuṣaḥ kaḥ` ityasyāsiddhatvenaivātra <> [[6.3.37]] iti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam, na hyatra taddhitasambandho kakāraḥ nāpi vusambandhī? darśanabhedamāśritya tathā'bhidhānādadoṣaḥ| idaṃ hi vārtikakāramatamāśrityoktam| tat? punaḥ ślokavārtikakārasya sūtrakāramatānusāriṇo darśanamāśritya vakṣyati||kathaṃ punaḥ saṃjñāśabdasya puṃvadbhavasya prāptiḥ, yāvatā bhāṣitapuṃskasya puṃvadbhāva uktaḥ, na ca yaḥ saṃjñāśabdaḥ striyāṃ vartate sa bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati, ekadravyaniveśitvāt? saṃjñāśabdānām? naitadasti; na hrayaṃ niyoga ekadravyaniveśitvāta saṃjñāśabdānām? naitadasti; na hraṃ niyoga ekadravyaniveśibhireva saṃjñāśabdairbhavitavyamiti| tathā hi -devadattādiśabdo'nekadravyadānakriyādisambandānnaikavastusaṃjñābhūta eva laroke prayujyamāna upalabhyate, śāstreṣvapi svādiśabdaḥ| yā tvekadravyaniveśinī saṃjñā tāṃ prati naivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyata ityasāraṃ codyam| nanu bhavantu saṃjñāśabdā anekārthavṛttayaḥ bhāṣitapuṃskāstvekasyāmākṛtau, kathaṃ tarhi teṣāṃ kiñcit? pravṛttinimittamasti, yadṛcchāśabdatvāt? etadapyasāram; yatasteṣāmapi keṣāṃcit? kiñcit? pravṛttinimittamastyeva, saptaparṇādiśabdavat| yatrāpyetannāsti, tatrāpi svarūpameva pravṛttinimittamupādāyābhidheye vartante| tatrābhinne pravṛttinimitte yairbhāṣitaḥ pumān? te bhāṣitapuṃskā iti kimatrānupapannam? `dattābhryaḥ` iti| atra yāsau dānakriyākṛtistasyāmeva dattāśabdo bhāṣitapa#u#ṃskaḥ| `guptābhāryaḥ` iti| atrāpi guptāśabdo gopanakriyākṛtau svarūpe vā pravṛttinimitte| ubhāvapi bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdau `dattāyate guptāyate` iti| kathamete pratiṣedhasyodāharaṇe upanyaste, yāvatā satyapi puṃvadbhāve `akṛtsārvadhātukayodīrghaḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghatvenobhayamapyetat? siddham? evaṃ manyate `saṃjñāpūrvo vidhiranityaḥ` (vya|pa|64) iti, tatra yadi puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syāt, tadā dīrghatvābhāvo'numīyate| tasmin? pakṣe dattayate guptayata ityapi syāditi| `na kopadhāsaṃjñāpūraṇīnām` ityekasminneva yoge kattavye yogavibhāgaḥ <> [[6.3.37]] ityasya pratiṣedhasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ kṛtaḥ| tena yaduktam -`kopadhapratiṣedhe taddhitavugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? (vā|733) iti, tanna kartavyaṃ bhavati||vṛddhinimittaṃ ñaṇakāḥ| `ruāaudhnībhāryaḥ` iti| ruāudhne bhavā, <> [[4.3.53]] ityaṇ| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| evaṃ `māthurībhāryaḥ` ityatrāpi| `madhyamabhāryaḥ` iti| madhye bhavā, <> [[4.3.8]] iti mapratyayaḥ| `kāṇḍalāvabhāryaḥ` iti| kāṇḍaṃ lunātīti <> [[3.2.1]] pūrvavanṅīp| `tāvadbhāryaḥ` iti| tāvacchabdāt? tatparimāṇamasyā iti `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup` [[5.2.39]] <<ā sarvanāmnaḥ>> [[6.3.91]] iti dakāramyākāraḥ, <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp| tāvatī bhāryā'sya tāvadbhāryaḥ, yadi vṛddhinimittasyeti tatpuruṣo gṛhreta tadātrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, bhavati hi vatub? vṛddherākārāsya nimittam| bahuvrīhiparigrahe tu na doṣaḥ; na hi vatupi ñakārādikaṃ vṛddhernimittamasti| `kāṣāyī` iti| `tena raktam` [[4.2.1]] ityaṇ| `lauhī` iti| <<prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ>> [[4.3.154]] ityañ, pūrvavan? ṅīp| `khādireṣaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.141]] ityañaṇoranyataraḥ| khādirī īṣā yasya sa khādireṣaḥ||`dīrghakeśī` iti| `svāṅgāccopasarjanādasaṃyogopadhāt` [[4.1.54]] iti ṅīṣ| `ṣaṭvī` iti| paṭuśabdāt? `voto guṇavacanāt` [[4.1.44]] iti ṅīṣ| `akeśabhāryaḥ` iti| avidyamānāḥ keśā asyā akeśā <> [[4.1.57]] iti ṅīpi pratiṣiddhe ṭāveva bhavati||`kaṭhībhāryaḥ` iti| kaṭhaśabdāt? `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt? [[4.1.63]] iti ṅīṣ| jātitvaṃ tvasya `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha` (4.1.63; mā| bhā|2|225) iti lakṣaṇena|`ayam` ityādi| `bhasyāḍhe taddhite` (vā|731) ityaupasaṃkhyāniko yaḥ puṃvadbhāvastasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho neṣyate| yasmādasya pratiṣedhasya bādhanārthamuttarasūtre puṃvaditi yogavibhāgaḥ kartavya ityabhiprāyaḥ||nanu ca karmadhāraye `striyāḥ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ siddhaḥ, jātīyadeśīyaśabdayorapi <> [[6.3.35]] ityādinā, tat? kimartho'yamāraṃbhaḥ? ityata āha - `pratiṣedhāryo'yamāramabhaḥ` iti| paratiṣedhaviṣayaḥ pratiṣedhaśabdenoktaḥ| sāhacaryāt? pratiṣedho'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasyeti sa tathoktaḥ| yatra viṣaye pratiṣedha uktastatra puṃvadbhāvaḥ prayojanamityarthaḥ| atha vā - arthaśabdo nivṛttāviha - vartate, yathā - maśakārtho dhūma iti| tenāyamartho bhavati - pratiṣedhanivṛtyartho'yamārambha iti|`bhāṣitapuṃskādityeva` iti| yadi `bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ` [[6.3.33]] iti ca nānuvartate, tadā'bhāṣitapuṃskārthamanūṅarthañcedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt, na pratiṣedhārtham| evaṃ ca khaṭvāvṛndārikā, brāhṛbandhūvṛndāriketyātrāpi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt| tasmādbhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅityanuvartanīyam|`kukkuṭaādīnām` ityādi| uttarapadasyāntāderastrītvādasāmānādhikaraṇyācca puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnotītyupasaṃkhyāyate| `na vā` ityanenopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe - na vā vaktavyaḥ, kasmāt? astrīpūrvapadasya vivakṣitatvāt| astrīliṅgasya pūrvapadasya vivakṣitatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| asyaivārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha - `strītvena vinā` ityādi| atra hi mayūrādijātyantarasyā nivṛttirvivakṣitā| jātyantaranivṛttiparāyāṃ deśanāyāṃ liṅgaviśeṣopādānamanupakārakameva| vināpi tena jātyantaranivṛttiḥ śakyata eva kartam| tathā hi - mṛgamāṃsamityukte antareṇāpi liṅgaviśeṣopādānaṃ jātyantarasaya vyavaccheda upapadyate - mṛgajātisambandhi māṃsam, nānyajātisambandhīti| tasmāt? strītvamatrānupakāritvānna vivakṣitam, ataḥ strītvena vinā pūrvapadasyārtho'tri kukkuṭāṇḍādau jātisāmānyena strītvadaviśeṣavihito vivakṣita ityarthaḥ| tataścāstrīliṅgā evātra kukkuṭādayaḥ śabdā aṇḍādibhiḥ śabdaṃ samasyanta iti bhāvaḥ| kaḥ punarasau pūrvapadārthaḥ? kukkuṭādijātyā vyavachinnaṃ dravyamātram|`puṃvadbhāvāt` ityādi| atra khiti puṃvadbhāvādghrasvatvaṃ vipratiṣedhena bhavatīti pūrvameva vyākhyātam| ghādiṣu tu vyākhyāyate| ghādiṣu ṅyo hrasvo bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ - nartakitarā, nartakitamā, nartakirūpā, nartakikalpeti; puṃvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ - darśanīyatarā, darśanīyatamāṃ, darśanīyarūpā, darśanīyakalpeti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti - paṭvitarā, paṭvitamā; paṭvirūpā, paṭvikalpeti; vipratiṣedhena hrasvatvaṃ bhavati| `ke'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] iti hrasvasyāvakāśaḥ - nartakiketi; ajñātādāvarthe `prāgivāt? kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] pūrvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ - dāradiketi| daracchabdasyātra ke parataḥ `tasalādiṣvākṛtvāsucaḥ` [[6.3.34]] iti puṃvadbhāvena dāradaśabdo bhavati| ataṣṭāpi kṛte `pratyayasthāt? kāt` [[7.3.44]] ityādinettvamihobhayaṃ prāpnoti| `paṭvikā` iti| atra vipratiṣedhena hrasvatvaṃ bhaviṣyati| kena punaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ, yāvatā tasilādiṣu parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam, na ca tatara kapratyayaḥ parigaṇitaḥ? etat? bhāṣyakāraḥ praṣṭavyo yaḥ parigaṇanaṃ karoti, na tu sūtrakāraḥ| pūrva yasya siddhaye'nūṅiti prasajyapratiṣedha āśritastaddarśanārthamāha - `iha` ityādi| `tatra tadrājapratyayasya` ityādi| tatreḍaviṭ, pṛthu ityetābhyāṃ <> [[4.1.168]] iti vihitasyāñastadrājapratyayasya `ataśca` [[4.1.175]] iti luk| darad? uśijityetābhyāṃ tu <> [[4.1.170]] ityādinā vihitasyāṇaḥ| iḍaviṭ? cāsau vṛndārikā ceti vigṛhra samāsa iti| `viśeṣaṇa` ityādinā, `atraiḍaviḍādayaḥ` [nāsti - kāśikā] iti ādiśabdena dāradaḥ, pārathaḥ, auśija ityete gṛhyante||celaḍabrāuvagotraśabdānāṃ kutsārthatvāt? `kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ [[2.1.52]] iti samāsaḥ| matahataśabdābhyāṃ tu <> [[2.1.57]] ityanena| celaḍiti pacādau paṭhate, ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ| yadi `brāuvaḥ` iti pacādyajantametat? evaṃ sati `brāuvo vaciḥ` [[2.4.53]] iti vacyādeśo guṇaśca prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavatīti? yaścodayetat, taṃ pratyāha -`vacyādeśo guṇaśca nipātanānna bhavati` iti| `āmakalakītarā, kuvalītarā` iti| āmalakakuvalaśabdau vṛkṣe nityaṃ strīliṅgai| phale tu napuṃsakaliṃgāvityubhāvapyabhāṣitapuṃskau, tābhyāṃ gaurāditvānṅīṣ||`bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ` [[6.3.33]] iti nivṛttam| `kaśca śeṣaḥ` iti| yadi pūrvasūtreṇa yasya hrasvo na vihitaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tato yadbhāṣitapuṃskaṃ yacca bhinnāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskaṃ naicāc? tasyāpi śeṣatvaṃ syāt, tataścāmalakītarā, droṇītaretyatrāpi vikalpena hrasvatvapaṃ syāt| na hyatra hrasvatvaṃ pūrvasūtreṇa vihitamityabhiprāyeṇā''ha -`aṅī ca yā nadī ṅyantaśca yadekāc` iti| etena śrutāpeśrayā'tra śeṣatvāmāśrīyate, na tu yasya hrasvo na vihitaḥ, tadapekṣayeti darśayati| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? śeṣagrahaṇāt| antareṇāpi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śeṣasyaiva vikalpena hrasvatvaṃ bhaviṣyati| tathā hi yadi ṅyo'nekāco bhāṣitapuṃskasyāpi vibhāṣā hrasvaḥ syāt, tadā pūrvayoga evedamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt| iha kāraṇādyasya pūrveṇa hrasvo na vihitastasyaiva pākṣikaṃ hrasvatvamantareṇāpi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śeṣasyaiva bhaviṣyatītyavasīyata iti kiṃ śeṣagrahaṇena? tat? kriyate `ṅyo'nekācaḥ` [[6.3.43]] iti pūrvasūtre yo'c? śrūyate tadapekṣayā śeṣo vijñāyata ityevamartham| na camalakītarā, drīṇītaretyatra śrutāpekṣayā śeṣatvamupapadyate; ṅyo'nekāctvāt| tasmānna bhavatyatra hrasvatvaprasaṅgaḥ| `strītarā` iti| styāyaterḍaṭ? ḍitvāṭṭilopaḥ, valilopaśca [[6.1.64]] , ṭitvān? ṅīp| vaktavayaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt? kṛnnadyā na bhaviṣyatīti| `lakṣmītarā` iti| `avitṛstṛtantribhya īḥ` (da|u|1|82) `rlakṣermuṭ? ca`, (da|u|1|84) itīkārapratyayānto lakṣmīśabdo vyutpāditaḥ| kṛnnadyayaṃ bhavati||`śreyasitarā` iti| īyasuni parataḥ <> [[5.3.60]] iti praśasyaśabdasya śrādeśaḥ, <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp| `viduṣītarā` iti| videḥ parasya laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, tasya <> [[7.1.36]] iti vasvādeśaḥ, <> [[6.4.131]] parapūrvatvam, pūrvavanṅīp| `puṃvadbhāvo'pyatra pakṣe vaktavyaḥ` iti| śreyastarā, vidbattareti pakṣe yathā syāt| `vidbattarā` iti| `vasuruāṃsu` [[8.2.72]] iti sakārasya dakāraḥ `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti takāraḥ| `prakarṣayogāt` ityādinopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe| śabdānāṃ vyutpattau pravṛttau ca na vastusannidhānaṃ pradhānaṃ kāraṇam, api tu vivakṣaiva| na caivaṃ pūrvaṃ prakarṣayogāt? strītvaṃ vivakṣitam| tasmādastrīpratyayāntādevātiśāyikena bhavitavyam| ātiśāyikapratyayāntāttu strīpratyayeneti siddhaṃ śreyastaretyādi rūpam| nanu ca ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ tadantāt taddhitavidhānārthamityuktam, tatkathamastrīpratyayāntāt? taddhitaprakarṣapratyayo yujyate? naitata; atra viṣaye strotvataddhitārthayoryugapadvivakṣāmabhipretya taduktam, na tu yatra viṣaye prāk? prakarṣārthena sambandhāt? strītvasya vivakṣā nāsti tamabhipretyeti kimatra na yujyate||`mahādevaḥ, mahābrāāhṛṇaḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ| `mahābāhuḥ` iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| `lakṣaṇoktatvāt` ityādinā paramatamāviṣkṛtya nirākaroti| syādetat -uttarapadena samāsaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ, samāse hi satyuttarapadaṃ bhavati, sa ca samāso lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) mahato yaḥ pratipadoktaḥ <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā sākṣādviśeṣavihita sa eva gṛhrate, na tu yo lākṣaṇikaḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇoktaśca samāsaḥ -mahatputra iti? atra `ṣaṣṭhī` [[2.2.8]] iti sāmānyalakṣaṇena vihitatvāt, tasmādatra na bhaviṣyatīti| yadyevam, bahuvrīhāvapi na syāt; tasyāpi lākṣaṇikatvāt| `tadartham` ityādi| bahuvrīhāvapyāttvaṃ yatā syādityevamarthaṃ samānādhikaraṇagraha~ kartavyam| tatra satadyeṣā paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| yadyupatiṣṭhate samānādhikaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; mahato yaḥ pratipadoktaḥ samāsastasya samānādhikaraṇapadatvāt| tasyāścānupasthāne sati bahuvrīhāvapyāttvaṃ bhavati| asati tu samānādhikaraṇagrahaṇe tayā paribhāṣayehopasthātavyam| tataśca yatā mahatputra ityatra na bhavati, tathā bahuvrīhāvapi mahābāhurityatra na syāt| `amāhan? mahān? sampanno mahadbhūtaścandramā iti yatrārthe cvyanto mahacchabdo vartate tatraiva bhūtaśabdo'pi, tasmāt? sāmānādhikaraṇye satadyāttvena bhavitavyam` -iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākattumāha -`amahān? mahan` ityādi| `mahadbhūtaḥ` iti| mahacchabdāt `abhūtatadbhāve` [[5.4.50]] ityādinā cviḥ, tasya <<ūryādicviḍācaśca>> [[1.4.61]] iti gatisaṃjñakatvādbhūtaśabdena <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| `gauṇatvāt` ityādi| loke hi śabdāduccaritādgauṇamukhyārthasambhave sati mukhyārthaṃevaṃ sampratyayo bhavati, na tu gauṇe'pradāne| tathā hi -`gaurānīyatām` ityukte sāsnādimānevānīyate, na tu bāhīka iti| tasmādihāpi mahacchabdāduccāritānmukhya eva mahadarthe sampratyayo bhavati, na gauṇe| gauṇaścātra mahadarthaḥ| tadabhidhānācca mahacchabdo'pi gauṇa iti na bhavatyāttvam| nanu ca mahattvena yuktaścandramā mahāneva, tadayuktaṃ mahadarthasya gauṇatvam? naitadasti; sarvatraiva hi cvyantenārtha āśritapūrvāvastha upacaritottarāvastha ucyate, tasmādihāpi candramā amahattvapūrvāvastho mahacchabdenocyamāna upacaritamahattvānugatottarāvastha eva ucyata iti yuktāsya gauṇatā| yadi gauṇatvānmahacchabdasyāttvamiha na bhavati, tadā puṃvadbhāvo'pi na syāt, amahatī brāāhṛṇī mahatī sampannā mahadbhūteti; vṛddhyāttve ca gauṇasya gośabdakhya na syātām, gaurvāhīkastiṣṭhatīti vṛddhirna syāt? <> [[7.1.90]] iti gauṇād? gauśabdāt? parasya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇittve'sati gāṃ vāhīkamānayetyatra <<auto'mśasoḥ>> [[6.1.93]] ityāttvaṃ na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; puṃvadbhāvastāvat? `striyāḥ puṃvat` [[6.3.33]] iti yogavibhāgādbhaviṣyati| yogavibāgaścāvaśyaṃ kartavyo garbhibhārya ityādyarthaḥ, mahatyā ghāso mahāghāsa ityādyarthaśca; so'nyārthaḥ kriyamāṇa etadartho'pi bhaviṣyati| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi yogavibhāge naivātra puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, mahadarthasya gauṇatvāt, yogavibhāgasya cānyatra caritārthatvāt? evaṃ tarhi <> [[6.3.42]] iti sūtre dvitīyaḥ puṃvaditi yogavibhāgaḥ kiṣyate, sa gauṇārtho bhaviṣyati| vṛddhyāttvābhāvadoṣo'pi na prasajati; yasmādvākyāt? tatra gauṇatvaṃ pratīyate| padsaya tu mukhya evārthaḥ, na ca padasaṃskāravelāyāṃ vākyārtho'pekṣyate| `mahādāttve` ityādi| samānādhikaraṇa āttvapuṃvadbhāvau vidhīyamānau vyadhikaraṇe na prāpnutaḥ| tasmādvayadhikaraṇe'pyuttarapade ghāsādau mahadāttavasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam| upasaṃkhyānamityasya pratipādanamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam -<<ānmahataḥ samānādhikaraṇajātīyayoḥ>> [[6.3.46]] ityatrāpi `āt` iti yogavibhāgaṃ kariṣyati, tena mahatyā ghāso mahāghāsa ityādāvāttvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| sa cāvaśyaṃ yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ -aṣṭākapālamityādyartham, so'nyārthaṃ kriyamāṇa etadartho'pi bhavati| `puṃvadvacanaṃ ca` ityādi| ghāsakaraviśiṣṭeṣvityapekṣyate| puṃvadbhāvasya vacanaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kartavyam, tacca pūrvameva kṛtam| `aṣṭanaḥ kapāle` ityādi| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tacca pratipādanaṃ pūrvameva kṛtam| `aṣṭākāpālam` iti| aṣṭasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtamiti `taddhitārtha` [[2.1.50]] ityādinā samāsaḥ, <> [[4.2.16]] ityaṇ, tasya <> [[4.1.88]] iti luka| `aṣṭakapālaṃ brāāhṛṇasya` iti| aṣṭānāṃ kapālānāṃ samāhāroṣṭakapālam, samāhāre dviguḥ| atra pātrāditvāt (vā|159) striyāṃ na bhāṣyate| tena <> [[4.1.21]] iti ṅīb? na bhavati| `gavi ca yukte` ityādi| gośabde cottarapeda yuktārthe gamyamāne'ṣṭanśabdasyāttvasya pratipādanaṃ kartavyam| tacca pratipādanaṃ pūrvameva kṛtam| `aṣṭāgavena śakaṭena` iti| aṣṭhau gāvo yuktā asminniti tripado'yaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| yuktaśabdastu gamyamānatvādvatau na prayujyate, yathā dadhyodana ityatropasiktaśabdaḥ| yadi ca bahuvrīhirayam, tadā <> [[5.4.92]] iti ṭac? samāsānto na prāpnoti; tatpuruṣādhikārāt? mā bhūt? ṭac? `ac? pratyanvavapūrvāt` [[5.4.75]] ityatra ajiti yogavibhāgāt? bhaviṣyati, yathā -kṛṣṇabhūmaḥ, padyanāma ityādau| atha vā -aṣṭānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāro'ṣṭagavam, aṣṭagavena yuktamaṣṭāgavam| na caivaṃ yuktaśabdasya prayogaḥ prasajati; padaikadeśasya prayogāt, yathā -satyabhāmā bhāmā, bhīmaseno bhīmaḥ, balabhadro bala iti| `ekādaśa` ityatrāpi tata eva yogavibhāgādāttvaṃ veditavyam| yogavibhāgasya ca liṅgam -`prāgekādaśabhyaḥ` [[5.3.49]] iti nirdeśaḥ| `tapakara~ vispaṣṭārtham` iti| atha bhinnakālānāṃ nivṛttyartha kasmānna bhavati? bhāvyamānenāṇā savarṇānāmagrahaṇāt| guṇāntarabhinnānāṃ tarhi grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? guṇānāmabhedakatvāt||saṃkhyātānudeśo'tra na bhavati| yadi hi syādaṣṭano'śītau pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tathā ca tasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt| pratiṣiddhe hrāttve savarṇadīrghatvena bhavitavyam| alpāctaratvāccāśītiśabdasya pūrvanipātekartavye paranipātena lakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnena sakhyātānudeśābhāvaḥ sūcitaḥ| `dvādaśa` iti| dvau ca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ| atha vā dvābhyāmadhikādaśeti samānādhikaraṇādhikāre śākapārthivādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamuttarapadalopaśca` (vā|83) ityuttarapadalopī tatpuruṣa samāsaḥ| evaṃ `dvāviṃśatiḥ` ityādāvapi veditavyam| `dvaumāturaḥ` iti| dvayormātrorapatyamiti vigṛhra taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tataḥ `māturutsaṃkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ` [[4.1.115]] ityaṇ; ukāraścāntādeśaḥ| `dvitrāḥ` iti| dvau vā trayo veti vigṛhra `saṅkhyayāvyaya` [[2.2.25]] ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ, `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye` [[5.4.73]] ityādinā ḍac? samāsāntaḥ, ṭilopaḥ| `dvidaśāḥ` iti| pūrvavaḍḍac, bahuvrīhiḥ| dvirdaśeti vigrahaḥ| subarthe'yaṃ samāsaḥ| atra hi daśasambandhinyāvṛttirdaśaśabdena lakṣyamāṇā dviśabdena saṃkhyāyate| tena dvau daśakāvityayamartho veditavyaḥ| samāsaḥ subarthaṃ gamayituṃ samartha iti vṛttau suj? na prayujyate| `dvyaśītiḥ` iti| pūrvavaddvandvaḥ; uttarapadalopī vā tatpuruṣaḥ| `prāk? śatāt` ityādi| śatāt? prāgayā saṃkhyā tadvācinyuttarapade dvyaṣṭana āttvaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - `vibhāṣā catvariṃśata` [[6.3.48]] ityatra vakṣyamāṇavibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ siṃhāvalokinatanyāyenehāpyupatiṣṭate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena prāk? śatādyā saṃkhyā tadvācinyattarapade bhaviṣyati| śatādivācini tu na bhaviṣyati| evamuttarayorapi yogayoḥ prākśatāt? kāryaṃ bhavatīti veditavyam|sarvagrahaṇaṃ dvyaṣṭanorapi yathā syādityevamartham; itarathā hi `anantarasyā vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) iti trereva syāt| maṇḍukaplutinyāyena dvyaṣṭana ityetadapīhānuvartiṣyate, tato'yamadoṣa iti cet? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthaṃ sarvagrahaṇamiti||`hmalleśaḥ`| <> [[3.2.1]] `hmadyaḥ` iti| `prāgdhitād? yat` [[4.4.75]] | `hārdam` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] iti prāgdīvyato'ṇ| `hmallāsaḥ` iti| lasanaṃ lāsaḥ, bhāve ghañ| `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate` (vā|86) iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `lekha ityaṇantasya grahaṇam` iti| etacca kātyayanaprabhṛtīnāṃ pramāṇabhūtānāṃ vacanādbijñāyate| kātyāyanenoktaṃ yat - `aṇgrahaṇe svarūpagrahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam, kṛtaḥ? lekhagrahaṇāt` iti| bhāṣyakṛtāpyuktam - `sarvatraivottarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe svarapagrahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam, kutaḥ? lekhagarahaṇāt` iti| etacca vacanadvayaṃ kathamupapadyate? yadi lekha ityaṇantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati, nānyathā| atha ghañantasyāpi lekhaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? ityāha - `ghañi tu` ityādi| `etadeva` ityādi| aṇgrahaṇādeva tadantasya lekhaśabdasya grahaṇe siddhe tasya pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ kriyaṇāṇametajjñāpayati - uttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantaṃ na gṛhrata iti| teneha yadaṇgrahaṇe gharūpādisūtre ca [[6.3.42]] ghādipratyayagrahaṇe pratyayamātraṃ gṛhrate, na tadantavidhiriti bhāvaḥ||`sauhādryam` iti| śobhanaṃ hmadayamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| tataḥ ṣyañ| `hmadayaśabdena` ityādi| hmadayaśabdeneha samānarthe hmacchabde sati yadā hmacchabadasya prayogaḥ, tadā hmacchoka iti bhaviṣyati, yadā hmadayaśabdasaya tadā hmadayaśoka iti, tataśca tenaiva prakṛtyantareṇa siddhe vikalpavidhānamidaṃ na kartavyam| etat? kriyate tu prapañcārtham| sa eva siddhaprayogo'nena sūtreṇa kathyata iti||`padājiḥ` iti| `aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-230)| `padātiḥ` iti| `ata sātatyagamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-38)| `ajyatibhyāñca pāde ca` ityauṇādika iṇpratyayaḥ` iti| atra `janighasibhyāmiṇ` (da|u|1|58) ityata iṣgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| yadauṇādika iṇpratyayaḥ, evaṃ sati tatra `ajevryaghañapoḥ` [[2.4.56]] iti vībhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`tatra` ityādi| `padagaḥ` iti| `antātyantādhvadūrapāra` [[3.2.48]] ityādau sūtre `ḍaprakaraṇa'nyatrāpi dṛśyate iti vaktavyam` (vā|256) ityuktam| tena pādaśabde'pyupapade gamerḍapratyayaḥ| `padopahataḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsaḥ, pūrvatra tūpapadasamāsaḥ| akārānto'yamādeśaḥ| prathamāyāśca lukaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśa| `pādaśabdo'yam` ityādi| <<karṣātvato ghaño'nta udāttaḥ>> [[6.1.159]] ityantodāttatve prāpte pādaśabdasya vṛṣaditvādādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, tataśca tasya sthāne padādeśo vidhīyamāna āntaratamyādādyudātta eva syāt? antodāttaśceṣyate| tasmādāntodātto nipātyate upadeśāvasthāyāmeva| `tena` ityādināntodāttanipādanasya phalaṃ darśayati| `padājiḥ, padātiḥ` ityādināpyupadeśagrahaṇasya| yadi <> [[6.2.139]] iti prakṛtasvare kṛte padaśabdasyāntodāttatavaṃ nipātyate, tadā tasya satiśiṣṭatvaṃ syāt, tataśca padājiḥ padātiḥ padaga ityeṣu kṛtsvaro bādhyate; satiśiṣṭasvarasya balīyastvāta| upadeśāvasthāyāṃtvantodāttatvanipātane kṛtsvara eva satiśiṣṭo bhavati| atastena samāsasyaivāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati na padaśabdasya||`padyāḥ` iti| <> [[4.4.83]] iti yat| `pādyam` iti| pādaśabdāt? `tādarthye yat` [[5.4.24]] ityanuvartamāne `pādārghābhyāñca` [[5.4.25]] iti yat| `padbhāve` ityādi| padbhāve kartavye'smaścaratyarthe ya ik? tasmin? kṛte padbhāvasyopasaṃkhyānam=pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - paditi yogavibāgāt? siddhamiti| parpādiṣveva `pādaḥ pacc` [[4.4.10]] iti pāṭhāt? siddhamiti vā| `śarīrāvayavasya` [`śarīrāvayavavacanasya - kāśikā] ityādi| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate? kecidāhuḥ - pūrvasūtre sāmarthyāccharīrāvayavasaya pādaśabdasya grahaṇam| tatrājyātiprabhṛtīni trīṇyuttarapadāni gamanārthāni, caturthaṃ tu hananārtham| teṣu gamanādhiṣu prāṇyaṅgasyaiva pādaśabdasya karaṇabhāvaḥ sambhavati, naitarasya| tasmāt? tatra prāṇyahgavācinaḥ pādaśabdasya grahaṇam, ihapi tadevānuvartata iti yuktam - śarīrāvayavasya grahaṇamiti| yadyevam, tadā `ṛcaḥ śe` [[6.3.55]] ityatrāpi śarīrāvayavasya grahaṇaṃ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṛksambandhina śarārāvayavavacanasyāsambhavāt| caturthabhāgavacanaḥ pādaśabdo'tri grahiṣyate| `tena` ityādi| yata evaṃ śarārāvayavavacanapādaśabdasyeha grahaṇam, tena `paṇapādamāṣa` [[5.1.34]] ityādo sūtre yaḥ pādaśabdastasya na padādeśo bhavati; na hrasau śarīrāvayavavacanaḥ, ki tarhi? parimāṇavacanaḥ| kuta etat? paṇādibhiḥ parimāṇavacanaiḥ sāhacaryāt| `dvipādyam, tripādyam` iti| <> [[5.1.37]] ityarthe yatpratyayaḥ||`paddhimam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `patkāṣiṇaḥ` iti| <> [[3.2.78]] iti ṇiniḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ| `paddhatiḥ` iti| pādābhyāṃ hanyata iti paddhatiḥ| ktinnantena hatiśabdena <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsaḥ||`śe` iti taddhitasya śaspratyayasyāvayavabhūto yaḥ śaśabdastasyeha grahaṇam; ṛkpādāt? parasayāsambhavāt| nanu ca pāde śete iti `adhikāraṇe śeteḥ` [[3.2.15]] ityaci kṛte pādaśa itayatra śīṅsambandhī śaśabdaḥ sambhavati? naitadasti; na hi ṛkpāda upapade śeterdhātoracā bhavitavyam; tatra tu śayanagsambhavat, anabhidhānādvā| yo'pi <> [[5.2.100]] iti śo vidhīyate, so'pi naiva ṛkpādat? paraḥ sambhavati; tatrānabhidhānāt| lomādiṣu tasyāpāṭhācca||ghoṣaśabdaśabadaśabdābyāṃ [`ghoṣaśabdaśabdābhyāṃ -mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, miśraśabde ca <> [[2.1.31]] ityādinā tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| `niṣke ceti vakatavyam` iti| niṣkaśabde cottarapade pādaśabdasya padityayamādeśo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -<> [[6.3.54]] ityataścakāro'trānuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| atha vā -sūtre `vā` iti yoga vibhāgaḥ kriyate tena niṣke cottarapade bhaviṣyatīti||`udamegho nāma yasyodameghiḥ putraḥ` iti| pituraprasiddhatvādudameghasya tadapatyena samākhyātuṃ yasyodameghiḥ putra ityuktam| etena yasyaudameghirapatyaṃ sa udamegho veditavyamiti darśayati| evam - `udavāho nāma yasyaudavāhiḥ putraḥ` ityatrāpi veditavyam| udamegha iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, udakapūrṇo vā meghaḥ - śākapārthivāditvā(vā|83) nmadhyamapadalopī tatpuruṣaḥ, udakaṃ bahatati udavāhaḥ - <> [[3.2.1]] | `vaktavayaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - ihāpi sa eva cakāro'nuvartate anuktasa muccayārthaḥ, na cānyat? samuccetavyamastīti| udabhāvamevāsāvudakaśabdasya saṃjñāyāṃ samuccinoti| tatra kasya samuccinoti? yasya na prāpnoti| kasya na prāpnoti? uttarapadabhūtasya| tena saṃjñāyāmuttarapadasyāpyudakaśabdayoda ityayamādeśo bhavati| `lohitodaḥ, kṣīrodaḥ` iti bahuvrīhi-||yadyekaśabdaḥ sukhyāvacana iha gṛhrate, tadānarthakaṃ tasya grahaṇaṃ syāt| na hi kvacit? dvau bahavo vā hala ādibhūtāḥ sambhavanti, yadvyavacchedārthamekagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tasmādasahāyavacano'yamekaśabdaḥ| evamapi yaḥ kaścidaviśiṣṭa eko'sahāyo hal? ādiryasya tadekahalādyuttarapadaṃ gṛhreta, tadodakasthānamityatrāpi syāt| atrāpi hi sakāro'sahāya eva ekahal| yadyaneke varṇā yugapaduccāryeran, uccaritā vā varṇā na pradhvaṃseran, tadā sasahāyasyāpi syādāditvam| na caivam; yato varṇā na yugapaduccāryante, te coccāritapradhvasinaḥ| tasmānnāstyeva kvacit? kiṃcidanekahalāditvaṃ yadvyavacchedārthamekahalādāvityucyate| uktaṃ cedam| ato'smādeva vacanādviśiṣṭamātraikahalāditvaṃ vivakṣitamityetat? sarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā tadeva viśiṣṭaṃ darśayitumāha -`eko'sahāyaḥ` ityādi| yaścātulyajātīyenāpyacā vinaiko hal? sa ādiryasyeti tadekahalādi| tulyajātīyena cavyavahitenāpi yasya tadekahalādīhāśrīyeta tadā na kvacit? syāt; tathāvidhasyottarapadasya pūrayitavyavācino'bhāvāt, ucyate cedam| tasmādvacanaprāmāṇyāt? tulyajātīyena halā'nantareṇāvyavahitena vinā yo vartate so'sahāya eva#ehaikaśabdenāsahāyavācinā vivakṣita iti gamyate| evaṃdidho halādiryasya tadekahālādi| na caivaṃvidhaḥ sthānaśabdasyādirhalastītyekahalādigarahaṇena sthānaśabdo nivartate| `pūriyatavyavācini` iti| udakādinā dravyeṇāntavryāptavyaḥ pūrayitavya ityucyeta| tadvaktuṃ śīlamasyeti tācchīliko ṇiniḥ||dravadravyasaṃpṛktāḥ saktavo mantha ityucyate| tatra manthaśabdo'yaṃ yadyavyutpannaṃ prātipadikam, tadodakena mantha iti `tṛtīyā` [[2.1.30]] iti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| atha vyutpādyate -madhyata iti manthaḥ, tadā <> [[2.1.32]] iti samāsaḥ| sakatvodanābhyāṃ <> [[2.1.34]] iti samāsaḥ| binduvajravīvadhaiḥ `ṣaṣṭhī` [[2.2.8]] iti bhārahāragāhairaṇantaiḥ <> [[2.2.19]] iti||`grāmaṇiputraḥ` iti| grāmaṃ nayatītī `satyūdviṣa` [[3.2.61]] ityādinā kvip| `agragrāmābhyāñca nayateḥ` (kātyā|vā|5064) iti ṇatvam| `gārgīputraḥ` iti| `yañaśca` [[4.1.16]] iti gāgryaśabdānṅīp, <> [[6.4.148]] ityakārasya lopaḥ, <> [[6.4.150]] iti yakārasya ca| atha dikalpārthameva gālavagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`anyatarasyām` ityādi| `kārīṣagandhīputraḥ` iti| karīṣagandhyāyāyaḥ putra iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ `ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam` [[6.1.13]] ityādinā samprasāraṇam, <> [[6.1.108]] iti parapūravatvam, `halaḥ` [[6.4.2]] (iti) samprasāraṇasya dīrghaḥ| `iyaṅuvaṅbhāvinām` ityādi| iyaṅuvaṅau bhāvinau yeṣāṃ te tathocyante| `śrīkulam` iti| iyaṅbhāvina udāharaṇam| `bhrūkulam` iti| uvaṅbhāvinaśca| `kaṇḍībhūtam, vṛṣalībhūtam` iti| avapyayānām| kāṇḍavṛṣalaśabdābhyāṃ `abhūtatadbhāve` [[5.4.50]] ityādinā cviḥ, <> [[7.4.32]] itītvam| `bhrūkuṃsaḥ` iti| bhrūścāsau kuṃsaśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| evaṃ `bhrukuṭiḥ` ityatrāpi| `vaktavyam` iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -pṛṣodarāditvādbhrukuṃsādīnāmakāro bhaviṣyatīti||`ekarūpyam` iti| `hetumanuṣyabhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ` [[4.3.81]] iti rūpyaḥ| `ekamayam` iti| `mayaṭ? ca` [[4.3.82]] iti, mayaṭ| `ekatvam, ekatā` iti| <> [[5.1.119]] iti tvatalau| yadaikaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāparo bhavati tadaitadudāharaṇam| yadā saṃkhyeyaparo bhavati| tadā `tvalorguṇavacanasya` (vā|730) iti puṃvadbhāvenaiva siddham| nanu ca guṇamuktavān? guṇavacanaḥ, yaśca guṇamātramabhidhāya tadviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamāha sa guṇavacano bhavati| tadyathā -kṛṣṇaḥ paṭaḥ, śuklaḥ paṭa iti; ayaṃ punarekaśabdo na kvacidapi dravyavyatiriktaṃ guṇamāha, sarvadā saṃkhyeye dravye vartata iti kṛtvā, tat? kuto'saya puṃvadbhāvaḥ? ayuktamidamabhidhīyate; tathā hi -prasiddhamāmāśrityaikādayaḥ saṃkhyeyavacanā ityucyante, na tveṣāṃ saṃkhyāne vṛttirnābhyupeyeti| tathā hi -<> [[1.4.22]] ityatra tvekaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāyāmeva prayukto na saṃkhyeye dravye| `liṅgaviśiṣṭasya` ityādi| puṃlliṅgo ya ekaśabdaḥ sa svabhāvata eva hrasvānta iti na tadgrahaṇaṃ prayojayati, api tu strīliṃgaviśiṣṭasyaiva| tasyaiva hi hrasvatvaṃ vidhīyamānamarthavadbhavati| nanu naitasyāpyekaśabdasya ya ekārastasya hrasvatvaṃ vidhīyamānamarthavadbhavati, tat? kimucyate liṅgaviśiṣṭasyaikaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ prayojayati? ityāha -`acā gṛhramāṇam` ityādi| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacāraḥ| tathā hruktam -viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvayoryatheṣṭatvāditi| tatra yadi gṛhramāṇenaikaśabdenājviśiṣyate -ekaśabdasya yo'jiti, tadaikasambandhina ekārasya harasvatvaṃ vidhīyamānamarthavadbhavati| puṃlliṅgasyāpyekaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ prayojati| na cātra gṛhramāṇenājviśiṣyate; ekārasya hyasavasyāniṣṭatvāt| na hraniṣṭārthā śāstre prakḷptiryuktā (bho|pa|sū|107), tasmādācā gṛhramāṇa ekaśabdo'tra viśiṣyate| tena liṅgaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇam| ekaśabdasya hrasvo bhavati, kiṃ viśiṣṭascācaḥ? ajantasyetyarthaḥ| tatrālo'ntyasyaiva hrasvatvena bhavitavyam, tacca ṭābantasyaiva sārthakam, na puṃlliṅgasya; na hi hrasvasyaiva hrasve vidhīyamāne kaścidarthaḥ sidhyati| itikaraṇo hetau| yata eva#ācā gṛhramāṇa ekaśabdo'tra viśiṣyate, tena liṅgaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇamekaśabdasya prayojayati||`revatiputraḥ` iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| evaṃ `rohiṇiputraḥ` ityādāvapi| kumārīṃ dadātīti `kumāridā`| urvī dadātīti `urvidā`| <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] | `phālgunī` ityādi| phālgunī cāsau paurṇamāsau ceti phālgunī paurṇamāsau, `viśeṣaṇam` [[2.1.56]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| evaṃ `jagatīcchandaḥ` ityatrāpi|`śilavaham, śilaprastham` iti| śilāśabdasaya vahaprasthaśabdābhyāṃ `ṣaṣṭhī` [[2.2.8]] ityanena samāsaḥ| `lomakāgṛham, lomakāṣaṇḍam` iti| atrāpi lomakāśabdasaya gṛhaṣaṇḍaśabdābhyām| `ajakṣīreṇa iti| atrāpyajāśabdasya kṣīraśabdena| `ūrṇamṛt` [`ūrṇamṛdā` -kāśikā| ūrṇamravā -padamañjarī] iti| ūrṇāsahitā mṛd? ūrṇamṛt| śākaparthivāditvāduttarapadalopī samāsaḥ||`saṃjñāyāmasambhavācchandasyevodāharaṇāni bhavanti` iti| evakāreṇa saṃjñāyā vyavacchedaḥ kriyate| na hi tvapratyaye ṅyāpohryasvatve kṛte kasyacit? saṃjñā gamyate| tena saṃjñāyāmasambhavācchandasyevodāharaṇāni bhavanti||`iṣṭakacitam` iti| `kartṛkaraṇe` [[2.1.31]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| `iṣīkatūlam` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `mālabhāriṇī` iti| mālāṃ bharttuṃ śīlamasyā iti tācchīlye ṇiniḥ [[3.2.78]] , <> [[2.2.19]] iti samāsaḥ| `iṣṭakādibhistadantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati` iti| bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterityabhiprāyaḥ||`kālimmanyā, hariṇimmanyā` iti| kālīmātmānaṃ manyate hariṇīmātmānaṃ manyata iti <<ātmamāne khaśca>> [[3.2.83]] iti khaś, divāditvācchyan, anena hrasvatvam, uttarasūtreṇa mum| ihājantasya hrasvatvamabhyupagamyam; anyathā vāṅmanya ityatrāpi syāt| ajantasya hrasvavidhāne sati paratvānmumi kṛte'najantatvādhyasvo na prāpnotīti yo manyeta taṃ pratyāha - `mumā hrasvo na bādhyate` iti| atraiva hetumāha - `anyathā hi` ityādi| hrasvaḥ śiṣyate=vidhīyate yena tat? hrasvaśāsanaṃ `khityanavayayasya ` ityetadvavacanam| yadi hi mumā hrasvo bādhyeta, tato hrasvaśāsanāmidamanavakāśaṃ syāt, tatastasyānarthakyameva syāt| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti mumā hrasvo na bādhyate| tena virodhābhāvādubhayaṃ bhavati - hyasavaḥ, mum? ca| kathaṃ punarmumā hrasvasaya bādhā śaṅkitā? kathaṃ vā hrasvaśāsanasyānavakāśatvam, yāvatā khityajantasyāviśeṣeṇa mum? vidhīyate, hrasvatvaṃ bādhā śaṅkitā? kathaṃ vā hrasvaśāsanasyānavakāśatvam, yāvatā khityajantasyāviśeṣeṇa mum? ca| kathaṃ punarmumā hrasvasya bādhā śaṅkitā? kathaṃ vā hrasvaśāsanasyānavakāśatvam, yāvatā khityajantasyāviśeṣeṇa mum? vidhīyate, hrasvatavaṃ tu sāmarthyāddīrghasya, na hi hyasavasya hrasvavidhānamarthavadbhavati, evaṃ ca stanandhayādiṣu kṛtārthatvānmumeva hrasvenāpavādena kālimmanyādiṣu bādhyeta? evaṃ manyate - apavādaviṣaye'pi mumā vidhānārthaṃ mumśāstrasyāvaśyamāvṛttiḥ kartatavyā; anyathā kālimmanyetyatara mum? na syāt| tataścāpavādaviṣaye'pi mumā pravartamānena hyasavasya bādhā sambhāvyeta| anavakāśatvaṃ cātaevāpavādaviṣaye'pi mumpravṛtteriti| atha kathamatra khidantasya garahaṇam, yāvatā jñāpitametaduttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhīrnāsti? (pu|pa|pā|26) tyata āha - `anavayayasyetyetadeva` ityādi| yadyatra khitpratyayamātraṃ gṛhreta na tadantam, tatonavyayasyeti pratiṣedho'pārthakaḥ syāt| na hravyayāt paraḥ khit? pratyayaḥ sambhavati; dhātoreva tasya vidhānāt| tataścānarthakatvādanavyayasyetyetannoktaṃ syāt| uktañca - tasmādetadevai tajjñāpayati - khidantasyātra grahaṇamiti||`aruntudaḥ` iti| arustudatīti `viṣvaruṣostudaḥ` [[3.2.35]] iti khaś? saṃyogāntalopaḥ, tudādītvācchaḥ, ato guṇe [[6.1.94]] pararūpatvam| `dviṣantapaḥ` iti| dviṣantaṃ tāpayatīti <> [[3.2.39]] iti khac, `khaci hyasavaḥ` [[6.4.94]] iti hrasvatvam| `vidvanmanyaḥ` iti| vidvāṃsamātmānaṃ manyata iti, <<ātmamāne khaśca>> [[3.2.83]] iti khaś, `vasuruāṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ` [[8.2.72]] iti sakārasya dakāraḥ, <> [[8.4.45]] iti tasya nakāraḥ| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `yena vidhastadantasya` [[1.1.72]] ityanena tadantasyaiva bhaviṣyati? ityāha - `antagrahaṇam` ityādi| kṛtamajantakāryaṃ yasya sa kṛtājantakāryaṃ āgamī, tasyaivavidhasya pratipattiḥ pratītiryathā syādityevamarthamantagrahaṇam| antagrahaṇena hi kāryāntarasyānte'vasāne mum? kartavaya ityeṣo'rthaḥ sūcyate| ato'jantakārye hyasavatve kṛte paścānmum? bhavati| nanu ca mumā hrasvo na bādhyata ityanenaiva bhaviṣyatati sopapatiko'yamarthaḥ pratipāditaḥ, tat? kimarthametadantagrahaṇam? naitadasti; tena hi niravakāśād? hrasvaśāsanasya mumā hrasvo na bādhyata ityetāvanmātraṃ pratapāditam, na tu kṛtājantakāryasya mum? bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ, tataḥ paratvānmumi kṛta satyanajantasyāpi hrasvatvaṃ prasajyeta| atra ko doṣaḥ? khityantaharasavabhāvī nāstīti| yathā kālimmanya ityatra mumi kṛte satyanajantasyāpi hrasvatvaṃ bhavati, tathā vāṅmanya ityatra syāditi| tasmādantagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||atra yadi `pratyayavacca` ityetāvaducyeta, tadā gāmmanya ityatra <<auto'mśasoḥ>> [[6.1.93]] ityāttvaṃ na sāt, iha ca strīmmanya iti -atrāpi <> [[6.1.107]] iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ, iha ca narammanya iti nṛśabdasya <<ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ>> [[7.3.110]] iti guṇaḥ| sāmānyātideśe viśeṣasyānatideśādvacanaṃ tviyaṅuvaṅarthameva kevalaṃ syāt, iyaṅuvaṅāvajādau pratyayamātrasāmānyena vidhīyamānau sāmānyātideśe'pi bhavata iti kṛtvā| `ampratyayavacca` ityevamucyamāne satyāttvādayo bhavanti, teṣāmapyampratyaya iṣṭatvāt| etat? sarvaṃ buddhau kṛtvāha -`ampratyayavacca` iti| etadeva vivṛṇoti -`dvitīyaikavacanavacca` iti| kathadhaṃ punarayamartho labhyate, yāvataikamamgrahaṇam, tena cābhāgamo niradiśyate, pratyayavaccetyetadaniṣṭaṃ syāt| atha pratyayastena viśiṣyata āgamo na nirdiṣṭaḥ syādityata āha - `amiti hi` ityādi| ekamapayamgrahaṇamārabhyamāṇaṃ yasmādubhayametat? sampādayati tasmādayamartho labhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `śriyammanyaḥ; bhrūvammanyaḥ` iti| `aciṃ śnudhātu` [[6.4.77]] ityādine yaṅvaṅau| `lekhābhrummanyaḥ` iti| pūrvasūtreṇa mumāgamaḥ| `atheha` ityādi| śriyamātmānaṃ brāāhṛṇakulaṃ manyata ityupakramya=prastutya khaśpratyaye vihite kathaṃ bhavitavyam -kiṃ śriyammanyamati bhavitavyam, uta śrimanyamiti? kathaṃ punaretatapakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyate, yata evaṃ pṛcchati? śabdānāṃ dvidhā pravṛttidarśanāt| tathā hi -keṣāñcit? svaliṅgāparityāgeṇāpyarthāntare pravṛttirdṛṣṭā, yathā bhūtaśabdasya -bhūtamithaṃ brāāhṛṇīti; keṣāñcit? svaliṅgapitayāgenā'pi sā dṛṣṭā, yathā praṣṭhaśabdasya -praṣṭhīti| tatra śrīśabdo brāāhṛṇakule vartamāno yada svaliṅgaṃ na paratyajati, tadā śriyammanyamiti bhavitavyam; atha svaliṅgaṃ parityajaya napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ gṛhṇāti tadā `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] ityamo luki kṛte `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti hrasvatve ca śrimanyamiti bhavitavyamiti -evamimau dvāvapi pakṣau sambhāvyete| ata ubhayapakṣasambhave na jñāyate -kathaṃ bhavitavyam? atastatparijñānārthaṃ praśnaḥ| `śrimanyamiti bhavitavyamiti bhāṣye vyavasthāpitam` [`sthitam` -kāśikā] iti| nanu ca śrīśabdo'yaṃ strīliṅgo'rthāntare'pi vartamānaḥ svaliṅgamajahadeva vartate, tathā ca prayogo'pi dṛśyate -śiro ma#e śrīḥ, yaśo me śrīriti; tat? kathaṃ śrimanyamiti bhāṣye vyavasthāpitam? ityāha -`tatra` ityādi| yathā praṣṭhādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃyogāt? striyāṃ vartamānāḥ paratyakatasvaliṅgā eva vartante -praṣṭhī, pravarī, gaṇakīti; tathā śrīśabdo'pyatra kulaviṣaye vartamāna iti bhāṣyakārasya matam| atasatanmatena `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] ityamo luki kṛte -śrimanyamiti| nanu ca nāprāpte lukyayamārabhyate, yathaiva <> [[2.4.71]] itīmaṃ lukaṃ bādhate, tathā `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] itīmamapi lukaṃ bādheta? api ca lugekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅgo viparyayāccāmāgamo bahiraṅgaḥ, tataḥ `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) ityantaraṅge luki kartavye bahiraṅgo'māgamo nāstyeva, tat kuto'tra luk? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān?
