kiśoraṇāñca madhye dhenavo'nubadhyantām` ityukte baḍavā eva pratīyante| tasmādaṅahalorupadāne'pi yasmādaṅa vihitastasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam|yadi tarhi yato'ṅa vihitastasyedaṃ grahaṇam, evaṃ sati yathāśāste, āśāsyamāna ityatra na bhavati, tathā kvippratyaye'pi na syāt? ityata āha -`kvippratyaye ti` ityādi| `kṣiyāsīḥ` ityādi| atha vā naiva tasyā hrapi kviṣpratyaya ityevaṃ vaktavyamiti| viklapartho vāśabdaḥ| atha taśabdaḥ kimarthaḥ, āntaratamyāddīrgho mā bhūditi cet? naitadasti; `bhāvyamāno'ṇ? savarṇānna gṛhṇāti` (vyā|pa|35) iti na bhaviṣyati? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthaḥ| athāsandehārthaḥ kasmānna bhavati? `śāsa yaṅaṅaloḥ` ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt -kimayamikāraḥ kṛtayaṇādeśo nirdiṣṭaḥ? āhosvidīkāraḥ? atha vā yakāra iti? nāsti sandehaḥ, yadayam? <> [[1.2.53]] iti nirdeśaṃ karoti, tato niścīyate -ikāroyam, na hīkāraḥ, nāpi yakāra iti||yadyatra `upadhāyāḥ` [[6.4.24]] iti vartate, tato yathā pūrvasūtre `śāsaḥ` [[6.4.34]] ityavayavabhūtā ṣaṣṭhī, tathehāpi syāt? evañcopadhāyā evāyamādeśaḥ, prasajyeta, sarvādeśaśceṣyata iti manasi kṛtvāha -`upadhāyā iti nivṛttam` iti| taddhi upadhāgarahaṇaṃ kṅidgrahaṇena sambaddham, iha ca kṅidgrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam| tasmāt? `upadhāyāḥ` [[6.4.24]] ityasyāpi nivṛttirbhavati| `kṅiti` ityetadapi nivṛttam` iti| `anudāttopadeśa` [[6.4.37]] ityādau sūtre punaḥ kṅidgrahaṇāt| `tena` ityādinā kṅidgrahaṇe nivṛtte yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate taddarśayati -yadyatra `kṅiti` [[6.4.24]] ityetadanuvartetatato `vā cchandasi` [[3.4.88]] iti yasaminpakṣe herapittvaṃ na bhavati tasmin? pakṣe <> [[1.2.4]] iti vacanāt? ṅittvaṃ nāstīti śābhāvo na syāt| kṅidgrahaṇe tu nivṛtte'pittvapakṣe'pi bhavatyeva| syādetat -vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācchāsa uttarasya heḥ pittvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tato nārthaḥ kṅidgrahaṇena nivarttitena? ityata āha -`śādhītyetat` ityādi| yadi śāsa uttarasya heḥ pakṣe pittvaṃ na syāt, tadā śādhītyetat? satiśiṣṭatvena pratyayasvareṇāntodāttameva syāt| ādyudāttamapi cchandasīṣyate| tacca heḥ pittve sati dhātusvareṇa sampadyate, nānyathā| tasmādavaśyaṃ cchandasi yakṣe pittvaṃ vidheyam| atha `ā hau` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, akore'pi hi <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti sakārasya vihite savarṇadīrghatvena śādhītyetat? siddhaṃ bhavati? na siddhyati; pūrvasūtreṇopadhāyā ittvaṃ syāt| na cāyaṃ tasya bādhako yujyate; asati ca sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavati, asti ca sambhavo yadubhayaṃ syāt, atrāsti sambhavaḥ| tasmādakāre'ntyasya vihita upadhāyā ittvaṃ syādeva|| `hanteḥ` iti| spipā nirdeśo yaṅalugnivṛttyarthaḥ -`jaṅghahi`||`anunāsika` iti ṣaṣṭhaā bahuvacanasya lukaṃ kṛtvā'vibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ| ata evāha -`anunāsikāntānām` iti| <> [[6.4.15]] iti dīrghatve prāpte lopo'yaṃ vidhīyate| atra lope kṛte dīrghatvaṃ na prāpnoti; vihitanimittatvāt| `yami rami gami nami hani manyatayaḥ` iti -`yama uparame` prati te nimittabhāvaṃ nopayāntīti pāriśeṣyāt? ktinyeva vanateranunāsikalopena bhavitavyam| `sanoterāttvaṃ vakṣyati` iti| tena tasyānunāsikalopodāharaṇaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| āttvaṃ punaḥ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1468)| `ghṛtaḥ` iti| `ghṛṇu dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1469) `vataḥ` iti| `vanu yācane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1470) `mataḥ` iti| `manu avabodhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1471) `atata, atathā` iti| tanoterluṅa| ātmanepadaprathamamadhyamaikapuruṣavacane| <> [[2.4.79]] iti sico luk| `śāntaḥ, tāntaḥ, dāntaḥ` ti| śamitamidamīnāṃ rūpāṇi| ete nānudāttopadeśāḥ| `iha ca` ityādi| gamiramibhyāṃ ktini kṛte tayornitsvareṇādyudāttatve'nudāttatvābhāvādasatyupadeśagrahaṇe lopo na syāt, asmastu sati bhavati| kiñca -asatyupadeśagrahaṇe śāntaḥ, dānta ityatrāpi syāt| bhavati hi śamiḥ satiśiṣṭapratyayasvare kṛte <> [[6.1.158]] iti śeṣasyānudāttatve'nudāttaḥ| upadeśagrahaṇāttu na bhavati, na hramupadeśe'nudāttaḥ||ajhalādyartha ārambhaḥ| `prayatya` iti| prādasamāse kṛte `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap? [[7.1.37]] <> [[6.1.71]] ||`yantiḥ` ityādi| `ktickatau ca saṃjñāyām` [[3.3.174]] iti ktic| atra cānudāttopadeśādiprahaṇamanuvartate, tena `kāntiḥ śāntiḥ` ityatra dhīrghapratiṣedho na bhavati| anunāsakalopasya tvatra prāptireva nāsti; udāttopadeśatvāt| `anunāsikalope pratiṣiddhe` ityādinā dīrghagrahaṇasya prayojanamācaṣṭhe| nanu ca prakaraṇāpekṣayā yadasminaprakaraṇe vihitaṃ tanna bhavatīti vijñāyamāne'ntareṇāpi dīrghagrahaṇaṃ dīrghasyāpi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, tat? kiṃ dīrghagrahaṇena? evaṃ tahrratajjñāpayati - astīyaṃ paribhāṣā `anantarasaya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) iti||ayamapyajhalādyartha ārambhaḥ| `adhvagato harayaḥ` iti| adhvānaṃ gacchantīti kvip, tadantajjas| `gamādīnām` ityādi| gamādīnāmanunāsikalopaḥ kvau bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena gamādīnāṃ bhaviṣyati, na tu gamereva kevalasyeti| `saṃyat` iti| saṃpūrvād? yameḥ kvip| `paritat` iti| paripūrvāt? tanoteḥ, <> [[6.3.116]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `ū ca` ityādi| cakārādanunāsikalopaḥ| kvacid? `ūṅa ca` iti paṭhate, tatra ṅakārasya prayojanaṃ cintyam| alo'ntyaparibhāṣayaivātra bhaviṣyati| `agregūḥ` iti| gameḥ, bhrameścānunāsikalope kṛte'kārasyokāraḥ||`abjāḥ` iti| apsu jāyata ityupapadasamāsaḥ, pakārasya jaśtvam -bakāraḥ| `goṣā` iti| `ṣaṇu dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1464) `vijavā` iti| `jana janane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1105), `janī prādurbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1149) iti vā| `agregāva` [`agrejāvā` iti kāśikā pāṭhaḥ] iti| <> [[6.3.14]] iti saptamyā aluk| athānunāsikagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatānudāttopadeśetyādeḥ [[6.4.37]] sūtrādanunāsikagarahaṇamanuvartata eva? ityāha -`anunāsakasyeti vartamāne` -ityādi| taddhi prakṛtamanunāsikagrahaṇamanudāttopadeśagrahaṇena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmādadamanyadanunāsikagrahaṇaṃ kriyate -anunāsikamātrasya yathā syāt| atheha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham? hrasva evocyeta, hrasve'pi kṛte satyakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena siddhyatyeva; <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpattvaṃ prāpnoti, ato na siddhayatītyetannāśaṅkanīyam, akāravidhānasāmarthyāt; yadi hi `ato guṇe` pararūpatvaṃ syāt, tadā prakṛtaṃ lopagrahaṇameva vidadhyāt? tato hrasva eva kartarvyaḥ| naitadasti; hyatve hi sati `ghuṇa dhūrṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-437) [`bhramaṇe` -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ityasmādvanipi vihite `dhvāvā` iti na siddhyet? tato dīrghasyaiva vidhānaṃ yuktam||`jhali kṅiti cānuvartate` iti| yathākramaṃ sano jhalaśca viśeṣaṇam? sūtropāttena tu jhalgrahaṇena na śakyate san? viśeṣayitum, viśeṣaṇaṃ hraprādhānaṃ bhavati, viśeṣyantu pradhānam| `sañjhaloḥ` iti cārya dvandvaḥ| tatra sarveṣāṃ dvandvapadānāṃ prādhānyādanyo'nyaṃ pradhānaguṇabhāvo nopapadyate| sangrahaṇañcākṅidartham| `tadiha` ityādi| yasmāt? sanoteḥ pakṣa iḍāgamastasmāt? tata eva paro jhalādiḥ san? sambhavatīti tadarthameva sangrahaṇam, na tu janakhanārtham| na hi tābhyāṃ paro jhalādiḥ san? sambhavati, tayornityaṃ seṭtvāt| yadyevaṃ, sanoteḥ sani kṛtārthatvādāttvaṃ na syāt, anyatra niṣṭhādau jhalādau kṅitipratyaye `anudāttopadeśaḥ` [[6.4.37]] ityādinā nalopaḥ syāt? ityata āha -`anyatra` ityādi| sanotestanotyādiṣu pāṭhasyāvakāśo'nyat? tanādikaṃ kāryam -<> [[2.4.79]] ityādi, āttvavidhau ca sangrahaṇasyāvakāśaḥ -san, siṣāsatīti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti -sātaḥ, sātavāniti| atrānunāsikalopaṃ bādhitvā''ttvaṃ bhavati vipratiṣedhena| nanu cobhayaḥ siddhayorvipratiṣedho bhavati, iha ca `asiddhavadatrā bhāt` [[6.4.22]] ityubhayamapyasiddham, tat? kuto vipratiṣedhaḥ? ityata āha -`ghumāsthāgā` ityādi| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam? halgrahaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam -halādāvīttvaṃ yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt -<<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] godāḥ, kambalada iti yadi cātra vipratiṣedhaḥ? ityata āha -`ghumāsthāgā` ityādi| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam? halgrahaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam -halādāvīttvaṃ yatha#ā syāt, iha mā bhūt -<<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] godaḥ, kambalada iti| yadi cātra vipratiṣedho na syād? halgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| astvatrettvam, tasyāsiddhatvāllopo bhaviṣyata| paśyati tvācāryaḥ -bhavatīha prakaraṇe vipratiṣedha iti; yato halgrahaṇaṃ karoti| nanu cāsati halgrahaṇe'jādāvapīttvaṃ syāt, tataścepaṅaḥ prasajyetetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpamāpadyeta| tasmādaniṣṭanivṛttyarthatvāddhalgrahaṇasya na yujyate jñāpakatvam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; asiddhatvādevettvasyeyaṅādeśo na bhaviṣyati| vyavasthārthaṃ tarhi halgrahaṇaṃ syāt, asati hi tasminnīttvasyāsiddhatvā dāllopaḥ, ākāralopasyāsiddhatvādīttvamīti cakravadvyavasthā syāt? etadapyaprayojanam, yadi vyavasthārthaṃ halgrahaṇaṃ syāt, naivāyaṃ halgrahaha~ kurvīta| aviśeṣeṇekāramuktvā tasyājādau lopamapavādaṃ vidadhyāt| tat? kathamidamastu <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] iti? tataḥ `dhumāsthāgāpājahātisām` [[6.4.66]] ākāralopo bhavatīṭayajādau ca kṅiti| kimarthamidam? pratyayamātre dhvādīnāṃ yadīttvaṃ vakṣyate, tasyāyamiṭajādau ca kṅityapadādaḥ, tataḥ `īt` [[6.4.68]] itīttvaṃ bhavati ghādīnāmanaci kṅiti, tataḥ <> [[6.4.67]] `dānyasya saṃyogādeḥ` [[6.4.68]] <> [[6.4.69]] , <> [[6.4.70]] ; tato parataḥ śena bhavitavyam| śe ca sati pūrvavipratiṣedhād? grahijayādi [[6.1.16]] sūtreṇa samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam| yuḍapi naiva prayojayati, dīṅo hi divāditvāt? sārvadhātuke śyanā bhavitavyam| tato'jāditvābhāvādeva yuḍāgamasyābhāva eva| `ārdhadhātuke` iti yadārdhadhātukasāmānyaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā sāmānye paurvāparyāsambhavāt? viṣayasaptamīyam| yadārdhadhātukavyaktistadā parasaptamī| pratipāditañcāsmabhiḥ `na dhātulopaḥ` [[1.1.4]] ityatra jñāpakadvāreṇa parasaptamītvaṃ viṣayasaptamītvañcāsyeti||ramayaṃ yadi rephopadhayoḥ sthāne syāt? mittvamanarthakaṃ syāt? athāyaṃ ramāgamo'co'nyāt? paro bhavati rephopadhayoḥ avaṇamāpadyeta? ityetaccodyamāśaṅkyāha -`ropadhayoḥ` ityādi| mittvādramanenāvaśyamaco'ntyāt? pareṇa bhavitavyam, anyathā tadanarthakaṃ syāt| tatra yadi rephopadhayoḥ śravaṇaṃ syāt? `ropadhayoḥ` iti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt| tasmāt? ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśa eva tayornivṛttimācaṣṭe| tasyā hretadeva prayojanam -ṣaṣṭhaā nirdiruyamānasya yo dharmo nivṛttiḥ, sā yathā syāt| na hranyat? ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasya prayojanamasti| tasmānmittvādaco'ntyāparo bhavati rama| ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasāmarthyād? rephopadhe sthānidharmanivṛtiṃta pratipadyete| `bhraṣṭā` iti| `bhrasja pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1284) vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam| `bhrajjanam` iti| sakārasya jaśtvam -dakāraḥ, tasyāpi ścutvam -jakāraḥ| atheha kasmānna bhavati -bhṛṣṭaḥ, bhṛṣṭavān? ityāha -`bhṛṣṭaḥ, bhṛṣṭavān` ityādi| ramo'vakāśaḥ -bharṣṭā, bhraṣṭāḥ sumprasāraṇasyāvakāśaḥ -`bhṛjjati` iti, ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti -bhṛṣṭā, bhṛṣṭavāniti, grahrādisūtreṇa [[6.1.16]] samprasāraṇameva bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena| pūrvavipratiṣedhaśceṣṭavācitvāt? paraśabdasya labhyate| `barībhṛjyate` iti| yaṅ| `rīgṛdupadhasya` [[7.4.90]] iti rogāgamaḥ| `atra upadeśa` [[6.4.45]] ityato hi yadantarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtaṃ, tat? sanādisambaddham, iha ca sanādernivṛttiḥ| atastannivṛttau tasyāpi nivṛttirāśaṅkyeta| anantarayogasya cānyārthatvāt, tatrānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya prayojanābhāvāt| atha bhrasjo bharjetyevaṃ kasmānnoktatam? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum| evaṃ hrucyamāne `prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅalugantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati` (vyā|pa|77) iti yaṅlugantādārthadhātuka utpanne satyabhyāsasya bhrasjo bharjjādeśaḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; upadeśagrahaṇena bhrajjiṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ -`upadeśa yo bhrajjiḥ` iti| śtipā nirdeśo'tra vā kariṣyate -bhṛjjaterbhajaṃ iti; tena yaṅaḥlugantasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati| etamapi `bhujjayate` ityatra prāpnoti, bhavati hyatropadeśe bhrasjiriti? naitadasti; atra hi pūrvavipratiṣedhāt? samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam, yathā -bhṛṣṭa ityatra| evaṃ tarhi vaicitryārtha tathā noktam||`dhinutaḥ, kṛṇutaḥ` iti| `hivi divi dhivi prāṇanārthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-591,592,593), `kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-598) iditvānnum, laṭ, tas, <> [[3.1.80]] ityupratyayaḥ, akāraścāntādeśaḥ, tasyānena lopaḥ| atha tapakaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā dhātetyatra mā bhūt? nanu ca <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] iti niyamārtha bhaviṣyati -ākārasyeṭaevājādau kṅiti lopo bhavati? naitadsita; viparītaniyamo'pi sambhāvyeta -āta eveṭi kṅiti nānyasyeti| tathā ca cikīrṣitetyatra na syāt| tasmād? viparītaniyamasambhāvanānivṛttyartha taparakaraṇam| vispaṣṭārthaṃ vā| `vṛddhidīrdhābhyām` ityādi| <> [[7.2.115]] ityasyāvakāśa -kārayati, hārayati, ato lopasyāvakāśaḥ -cikīrṣitā, jihīrṣiteti; ihomayaṃ prāpnoti -cikīrṣakaḥ, jihīrṣaka iti, ato lopa eva bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena| <> [[7.4.25]] ityasyāvakāśaḥ - cīyate, lūyata iti, ato lopasyāvakāśaḥ sa eva; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti -cikīṣryate, jihīṣryata iti, lopa eva bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena||`bebhiditā` iti| yaṅntādārdhadhātukaṃ tṛc, tasmin? parato yaśabdasya lopaḥ| `yasya` itīdaṃ varṇanirdeśo vā syāt? yakārākāragrahaṇaṃ vā? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta tadorṣyitā, mavyitetyatrāpi syāditi dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrītyāha -`yasyeti saṅghātagrahaṇam` iti| kuta etat? nirdeśāt| yadi varṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt, tadā `yo halaḥ` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| yadi tarhi saṅghātagrahaṇam? evaṃ tarhi <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityantyasya syādityata āha -`tatrālo'ntyasya` ityādi| kasmānna pravartate? ityāha -`ato lopaḥ` ityādi| pūrveṇāpyalo'ntyasya lopaḥ siddhaḥ, tatrārambhasāmarthyāt? sarvasya bhavati| `hala iti vā` ityādinā parīhārāntaramāha| `halaḥ` iti pañcamīnirdeśaḥ, tatra `hala uttaro yo yaśabdastasya lopaḥ` ityucyamāne <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti vacanād? yakārasyaivanena lopo bhavati| akārasya tu <> [[6.4.48]] ityanena| `īrṣyitā, mavyita`[`bhavyitā` iti nyāsamadritapāṭhaḥ] iti| `sūkṣryaṃ ikṣyaṃ īṣrya īṣryārthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-509,510,511), `mavya bandhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-508)| atra saṅghātātmako yaśabdo na bhavatīti na pravartate [[3.1.10]] iti kyajeva, yadā samidivācaratīti tadā `kartuḥ kyaṅ? salopaśca` [[3.1.11]] iti kyaṅ -ityeṣa yathāyogaśabdārthaḥ||`ṇeḥ` iti| ṇiṅaṇicorviśeṣakarāvanubandhāvubandhāvutsṛjya yat? samānyaṃ `adhikaraṇe` iti| ktapratyayo'yamiti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| prakṣīyatesminniti prakṣīṇam - adhikaraṇabhūtaṃ dravyamucyate| `kṣitamiti bhāve` iti| asyāpi pūrvavatsambandhaḥ| karmaṇi na pratyudāharati; kṣiyo'karmakatvāt||`kṣitāyuḥ` iti| pūrvavat? kartari ktaḥ| evamutaratrāpi| `kṣitakaḥ` iti| anukampāyāṃ kan| ākośadainyābhyāmanyatra pūrveṇa nityaṃ bhavati| aṇyadartha iti kim? kṣitaṃ jālmasya, kṣitakamasya tapasvinaḥ||`syasicsīyuṭtāsiṣu` iti saptamyā pratiyogino nirdeśācciṇīva ciṇvaditi saptamīsamarthādvatirvijñāyate, yathā -mathurāvat? pāṭaliputre prakāra iti| `bhāvakarmaviṣayeṣu` iti| anena `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ityasya viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| bhāvakarmaṇī viṣayau yeṣānte tathoktāḥ ke punaḥ syādayo bhāvakarmaviṣayāḥ? ye syādayo lādeśena bhāvakarmaṇorvivakṣitayorbhavatanti| cakāro'tra sanniyogārthaḥ kriyate| tena yadā ciṇvadbhāvo ityādi| `kasya` iti| ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya hrāgamā bhavanti, syādayaśceha saptamyā nirdiṣṭāḥ; na cānya āgamīśrūyata iti praśnaḥ| yadyapi te saptamyā nirdiṣṭāḥ, na cānya āgamī śrūyata iti praśnaḥ| yadyapi te saptamyā nirdiṣṭāḥ, tathāpi yathā <> [[3.3.76]] iti pañcamī nirdiṣṭo'pi hantiḥ pratyayamutpādyadeśena sambandhamanubhavan? ṣaṣṭhantatāṃ pratipadyate tathā syādayo'pi yadāgamena sambandhamanubhavanti tadā ṣaṣṭhantatāṃ pratipadyanta ityabhiprāyeṇāha -`syasic` ityādi| atraiva hetamāha -`te hi prakṛtāḥ` ityādi| iḍayamāgamaliṅgaḥ, tasyāvaśyamāgaminā bhavitavyam, tat? kimaśrutānāmāgamitvaṃ parikalpya, tasyaiva vidhīyatāmuta prakṛtānāmeva syādīnāma#iti? yuktaṃ yat? prakṛtānāmeva vidhīyate; aśrutaprakalpanāyā garīyastvāt| nanu cāṅgamapi prakṛtam, tasya kasmānna kriyate? ityata āha -`aṅgasya` ityādi| aṅgasya na kriyate, lakṣyavirodhāt| yadyaṅgasya syāt, tadeṭi kṛte lakṣyāvaradhādaniṣṭaṃ syāt| na hranaṇṭārthā śāstre prakḷptirayuktā| tasmānmā bhūllakṣyavirodha iti yadyapyaṅgamapi prakṛtam, tathāpi syādīnāmeva kriyate, nāṅgasya| iha dvau pakṣau sambhavataḥ -ciṇnimittaṃ yatkāryaṃ, yadāhatya ciṇi vidhīyate tadvātidiśyate| yadvā ciṇiyaddṛṣṭaṃ ciṇṇimattamaciṇṇimittñca tat? sāmānyena| tatra yadi parvakaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā `āto yuk? ciṇkṛtoḥ` [[7.3.33]] iti yugāgamaḥ| `viṇṇamulordorgho'nyatarasyām` [[6.4.93]] iti dīrghatvañca -ete dve evāṅgakārye'tiviśye syātām| nānyāt? vṛddhyādikam, na hi tadāhatya ciṇi vidhīyate| āhatya=uccāryetyarthaḥ| yaddhi sākṣācciṇaṃ nimittamupādāya vidhīyate tacciṇyāhatya vidhīyate, na caivaṃ vṛddhyādikaṃ vidhīyate| atha dvitīyastato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ; vṛddhyādīnāmapi ciṇi dṛṣṭatvāt| yadi ciṇi yaddṛṣṭaṃ tadatidiśyate, tarhi haniṇiṅāmādeśā api prāpnuvanti, teṣāmapi tatra dṛṣṭatvāditi? anenābhiprāyeṇāha -`kāni punaḥ` ityādi| dvitīye pakṣe yo doṣastamuttaratra parihariṣyāmīti cetasi kṛtvā ciṇi yaddṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ tannimittamitaradvā tadiha sāmānyena nirdiśyata iti darśayannasya yogasya yāni prayojanāni teṣāṃ saṃgrahaślokasamāha -`vṛddhiściṇvat` ityādi| `cāyiṣyate` ityatra vṛddhiḥ prayojanam| cinoterluṭ, syapragatayayaḥ| <> [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam, atredānīṃ ciṇvadbhāvād? vṛddhirbhavati yathā -ciṇi <> [[7.2.115]] iti vṛddhirbhavatya cāyīti, evamuttaratrāpi ciṇvadityetasya pratyekamabhisambandhaṃ kṛtvā yathāyogamatideśo yojanīyaḥ| `acāyiṣyate` iti| luṅaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| yuk? ca prayojanam -`dāyiṣyate` ityatra| dīrghaścokto yo mitāṃ vā ciṇoti sa ca| prayojanaṃ śamiṣyate, śāmiṣyata ityatra| śameḥ `janijṛṣknasurañjo'mantāśca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-817) iti mitsaṃjñā, sa ca ṇyantaḥ <> [[3.1.32]] ityatropadiṣṭa ityupadeśe'janto bhavati| yattu hanteḥ `ho hanteñcinneṣu` [[7.3.54]] iti kutvaṃ vidhāsyate, tacca prayojanaṃ `ghāniṣyate` ityatra| haniṣyata ityatra tu <<ṛddhanoḥ sye>> [[7.2.70]] itīṭ| santyetāni prayojanāni, kintvaneneṭi kṛte śamiṣyate, śamiṣyata ityatra <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti ṇilopo na siddhyatiḥ seṭtvāt| ata āha -`iṭ? cāsiddhaḥ` ityādi| `asiddhavadatrā bhāt` [[6.4.22]] ityasiddhe'yaṃ ciṇvadiṭ, tena ṇilopo bhaviṣyati| syādetat -ye'nudāttopadeśāścinotyādayastebhyaḥ pareṣāṃ syādīnāmaneneṅvidhīyata iti yuktamasiddhatvam, ye tūdāttopadeśāḥ śamiprabhṛtayastemyaḥ paratvāt? `ārdhadhātukasyeṅvalādeḥ` [[7.2.35]] iti valnimitteneṭā bhavitavyam, sa ca siddha eva; tasmastu tadavastha eva doṣaḥ? ityata āha vighāto'syāstīti vighātī| vighātaḥ=nimittābhāvādapravṛttiḥ| tadevaṃ nityatvādudāttebhyo'pyanenaiva ciṇvadiṭā bhavitavyam, ayañcāsiddha iti na bhavati ṇilopābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| `grāhiṣyate` iti| <> pūrvastasya vidhī kartavye sthānivadbhāvena bhavitavyam, ādiṣṭāccātrācaḥ pūrva eṣo'bhyāsaḥ, tat? kute'tra sthānivadbhāvaḥ| `iyarti` iti| `ṛ gato` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1098) juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ, abhyāsasya `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattvam, `artipiparttyośca` [[7.4.77]] itīttvam, tata iyaṅādeśaḥ| `īyatuḥ, īyuḥ` iti| `ūvatuḥ uvuḥ` iti| `asaṃyogālliṭ? kit` [[1.2.5]] iti| kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ, tena savarṇo'jna bhavati|`iyāja` iti| `uvāpa` iti| yajivapyoḥ `liṭabhyāsasyobhayeṣām` [[6.1.17]] iti samprasāraṇam||`striyāḥ` iti| <<āṇnadyāḥ>> [[7.3.112]] , `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt` [[4.1.63]] iti nirdeśānnedaṃ strīpratyayānāṃ grahaṇam, nāpi stryarthavṛtteḥ śabdasyeti niścitya strīśabdasyaiva svarūpeṇa grahaṇamiti darśayitumāha -`strī ityetasya` ityādi| itikaraṇaḥ strīśabdasya svarūpapadārthatā darśayati| atha ṣaṣṭhībahuvacane kasmānna bhavatītyāha -`strīṇām` ityādi| paratvāt? ṣaṣṭhībahuvacane nuṭā bhavitavyam, tasmaśca satyajādiḥ paraḥ pratyayo na bhavatītīyaṅa na pravartate| atha kimarthaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ kriyate? na, `aci śnudhātustrībhruvām` ityeka eva yogaḥ kriyeteti? ata āha -`prathagyogakaraṇam` ityādi| <<vā'mśasoḥ>> [[6.4.80]] ityatra strīśabdasyaiva vikalpo yathā syāt, dhātubhruvormābhūdityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogakaraṇam||atra pakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyate -`iṇaḥ` iti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt, dhātugrahaṇaṃ vā? tatra `erac` [[3.3.56]] iti, <> [[3.1.125]] iti, `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityavamādibhyo nirdeśebhya eva nedaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇam| ataḥ pariśeṣyāddhātugrahaṇamevedaṃ vijñāyate| ṇakāroccāraṇamigiṅornivṛttyartham| ye tu `iṇvadikaḥ` (vā|167) iti sāmānyenātideśamicchanti, teṣāmiṅa eva nivṛttyartham| ikastvadhiyantīti bhavitavyameva yaṇā| atha `neṇaḥ` ityeva kasmānnoktam, iyaṅādeśe'ci pratiṣiddhe sati <> [[6.1.77]] iti yaṇ? bhaviṣyati? satyametat; uttarārthantu yaṇgrahaṇam| `yanti` ityadyudāharaṇeṣvadāditvācchapo luk| `āyan` iti| laṅ? jho'ntādeśe saṃyogāntalopaḥ, asiddhatvādajāditvādāṭ| atheha kasmānna bhavati -ayanam? āyaka iti? ata āha -`iyaṅādeśāpavādo'yam` iti| nanu yatheyaṅi prāpto'yamārabhyate, tathā guṇavṛddhyorapi, tat? kuta etallabhyate -ayamiyaṅo'pavādaḥ, na guṇavṛddhyorityāha -`madhye'pavādāḥ` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt? `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvānvidhīnbādhante nottarān` (vyā|pa|10), tasmādiyaṅa eva pūrvasya vidherayamapavādaḥ, na tu parayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ yataścaitadevaṃ tena guṇavṛddhibhyāṃ tu paratvādbādhyate| asyāvakāśaḥ -yanti, yantviti| `guṇavṛddhyoḥ -cayanam, cāyaka iti; ayanam, āyaka ityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti| paratvādyaṇaṃ bādhitvā guṇavṛddhī bhavataḥ||`tena saṃyogo viśeṣyate` iti| nanu cānyapadārthe gūṇībhūtatvādupasarjanamatra saṃyogaḥ| nacopasarjanaṃ viśeṣaṇena sambandhamanubhavati| tathā hi śobhano rājapuruṣa ityukte puruṣasyeva pradhānasya śobhanatvena yogo gamyate, nopasarjanasya rājñaḥ; naitadasti; dhātorityanuvṛttisāmarthyādupasarjanamapi saṃyogaviśeṣaṇena sambandhamanubhaviṣyati, anyathā dhātvānuvṛttirapārthikā syāt| na tvivarṇaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇamihānuvṛttaṃ syāt? naitadasti; yadadhātorivarṇāntaṃ tasya hi bhavitavyameva yaṇādeśena <> [[6.1.77]] ityanenena| `ninyatu; ninyuḥ` iti| nayatorliṭ| iyaṅādeśe prāpte yaṇādeśaḥ| `unnyau unnyaḥ` iti| unnayatīti <<satsūdviṣadruhaduhayujavidabhidacchidajinīrājāmupasarge'pi kvip>> [[3.2.61]] ityādinā kvip| evaṃ `grāmaṇyau, grāmaṇyaḥ` ityatrāpi| `agragrāmābhyāñca` (vā) iti ṇatvam| `asaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadyeriti| nocyeta, tato'saṃyogapūrvaṅgasya viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, evañca yavakriyau, yavakriya ityatrāpi syāt| bhavati hretadaṃsayogapūrvamaṅgam, tasmāt? `eḥ` ityucyate| asaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamikārasya viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syādaṅgasya mā bhūdityevamartham| nanu ca `yvoḥ` iti prakṛtam, tatra yadyeriti nocyeta, tadovarṇāntasyāpi syāt; tataśca luluvatuḥ, luluvuriti na siddhyet| tasmāduvarṇāntasya mā bhūdityevamarthameriti syādityata āha -`luluvatuḥ, luluvuḥ` ityādi| ihairorityucyamāne, anenaivovarṇasyāpi siddhe sati <> [[6.4.83]] iti niyamarthaṃ syāt -uvarṇāntasya yadi bhavati tadā supyeva, nānyatreti| tataścāsmādeva niyamāt? lluluvatuḥ, luluvuriti siddhyatīti erityetaduvarṇāntanivṛttyarthaṃ nopapadyate| tasmāt? pūrvoktamevāsya prayojanaṃ yuktam| `yavakriyau yavakriyaḥ` iti| yavān? krīṇātīti <<anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate>> [[3.2.178]] iti kvip| atrekārasya dhātvavayavasaṃyogapūrvatvānna bhavati| `ihāpi na syāt` iti| yadi dhātunā saṃyogo na viśiṣyeteti śeṣaḥ| kvacidihāpi yathā syāditi pāṭhaḥ| tatra prakṛtatvādyaṇādeśa iti vijñāyate| yadi dhātunāsaṃyogo na viśiṣyeta, tadā dhātvavayavo'dhātvavayavo vā saṃyogaḥ pūrvo yasmādbhavati tadantasya na bhavatīti vijñāyate| tataśconnyau, unnya ityatrāpi na syāt; saṃyogapūrvatvādivarṇasya| dhātunā saṃyoge viśeṣite tu bhavati| na hyatrevarṇo dhātvavayavasaṃyogapūrvaḥ| tasmādihāpi yathā syādidi dhātunā saṃyogo viśiṣyatade| `gatikārakābhyām` ityādi| atha kathamidaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? pūrvagrahaṇāt| iha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ na karttyam, `eranekāco'saṃyogāt` ityevocyeta| tatra, dhātvavayavasaṃyogādya ivarṇaḥ paro na bhavati tadantasyāṅgasya yaṇbhavati -ityevaṃ vijñāyamāne siddhyatyeveṣṭamiti kiṃ pūrvagrahaṇena? tat? kriyate pūrvācāryaiḥ -yasya vihito'yaṃ yaṇ? tasyaiva kartavyo nānyasyetyasyārthasya sūcanārtham| pūrvācāryāśca kvibantasya gatikārakapūrvasyaiva kṛtavantaḥ, nānyasyeti| tasmādihāpi gatikārakābhyāmanyapūrvasya na kriyate| atha vā `vāmśasoḥ` [[6.4.80]] ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena `vā ityanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena gatikārakābhyāmanyapūrvasya na bhaviṣyatīti| asmaśca vyākhyāne pūrvagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthaṃ veditavyam| `paramaniyau` iti| <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā samāsaḥ| atra paramaśabdo na gatiḥ, na ca kārakamiti tat? pūrvasya na bhavati||`khalapvau` iti| khalaṃ punātīti <<anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate>> [[3.3.130]] iti kvip| `śatasvau` iti| atrāpi śataṃ sūtra iti <<satsūdviṣadruhaduhayujavidabhidacchidajinīrājāmupasarge'pi kvip>> [[3.2.61]] ityādinā kvip| `sakṛllvau` iti| `torli` [[8.4.59]] iti parasavarṇaḥ| `kaṭapruvau` iti| `prūṅ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-957), [`pruṅ` -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `kvib? vacapracchyāyatastukaṭaprujuśrīṇāṃ dīrgho'samprasāraṇañca` iti kvip, dīrghatvañca| `oḥ` iti spaṣṭārtham| anukārāntanivṛtyarthantu na yujyate; `yvoḥ ityanuvṛtteḥ| ikārasya ca pūrveṇaiva siddho yaṇ -unnyau; grāmaṇyāviti||<> [[6.4.85]] iti pratiṣedhe prāpte tadapavādo'yamārabhyate| `varṣābhyau` iti| varṣāśabdādbhavateḥ kvip| `punarbhvaśceti vaktavyam` iti| `napunarbhvityetasyāci supi yaṇādeśo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -cakāro'tri kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena punarbhvityasyāpi bhaviṣyatīti| `kārāpūrvasyāpīṣyate` iti| so'pi tata eva cakārādbhavatīti veditavyam||bhrūgrahaṇena tadantasya grahaṇam, na kevalasya| kevalasya hrekāco yaṇādeśaprāpatyasambhavādanarthakaṃ vacanaṃ syāt| uvaṅādeśapratiṣedhārthatvānnānarthakamiti cat? na; evaṃ hi <> [[6.4.84]] iti yaṇādeśavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, yadi hrayaṃ yaṇādeśasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt -evaṃ hi tat? sarthakaṃ bhavati, nānyathā? naitadasti; uvaṅaparatiṣedhārthe'pi hrasmastanniyamārthaṃ syāt| evaṃ tarhi yaṇo yatrānuvṛttistasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedho yujyate| sa cānekāco vihita iti kevalasya grahaṇaṃ na prāpnotīti yuktamuktam -bhūgrahaṇena tadantasya grahaṇamiti| `pratibhuvau, pratibhuvaḥ` iti| `bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ` [[3.2.179]] iti kvip| `sudhiyau` iti| śobhanaṃ dhyāyatīti <<anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate>> [[3.3.130]] iti kvip, `dhyāyateḥ samprasāraṇañca` (vā|292) ityupasaṃkhyānāt? samprasāraṇam||`yaṇ` [[6.4.81]] iti, `anekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya` [[6.4.82]] , `oḥ` [[6.4.83]] iti cānuvartete| nanu ca `hurityetat? śnupratyayāntañcāṅgamukārāntatāṃ na vyabhicaratyeva, tat? kimartham? `oḥ` itīhānuvartate? asaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamukārasya viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamartham; anyathā `huśnuvorevaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta| tataśca `takṣṇuvanti` ityādāveva pratiṣedho vijñāyeta| `rādhnuvanti` ityādau tu yaṇādeśaḥ syādeva| juhoterapi - `juhvati` ityatra saṃyogapūrvatvādyaṇādeśo na syāt| nanu ca dhātugrahaṇamanuvartate, tatraivaṃ vijñāsyate - dhātvavayavaḥ saṃyogaḥ pūrvaḥ `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati` (vyā|pa|132) iti kṛtvā| anyathāpyavayavavacanaṃ pūrvaśabdamāśrityaivaṃ vijñāyate - dhātvavayavaḥ saṃyogo yasya pūrvo na bhavatīti? evamapi rādhnuvantītyatra yaṇādeśaḥ syāt, na hyatra śnupratyayasya dhātvavayavaḥ saṃyogapūrvaḥ| tasmāt? `o` ityetadanuvartanīyam, tadviśeṣaṇe huśnuvau| tatrāsaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇaṃ śnupratyayasyāvavasyokārasya viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam, juhotyavayavasya; tasyāvyabhicārāt| `śnupratyayāntasyāsaṃyogapūrvasya` iti| vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| śnupratyayāntasyāṅgasya yo'vayavo'saṃyogapūrva ukāraḥ, tasyetyarthaḥ| `anekācaḥ` ityetajjuhoteḥ śnupratyayāntasya samāndhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam| `sārvadhātuke` iti juhotyartham, na śnupratyayāntārtham; avyabhicārāt| `juhvati` iti| `adabhyastāt` [[7.1.4]] ityadādeśaḥ| `yoyuvati, roruvati` iti| `yu` `ru` ityetābhyāṃ yaṅa, tasya <<yaṅo'ci ca>> [[2.4.74]] iti luk, <> [[7.4.82]] ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ, pūrvavajjheravādeśaḥ| `idameva` ityādi| kathaṃ punaridaṃ jñāpakam? ityāha - chandasi` ityādi| yadi cchandasyeva yaṅluk? syāt, tadā `candasyubhayathā` [[6.4.86]] ityārdhadhātukatvādeva yoyuvati, roruvatītyatra na bhaviṣyatītyanarthakameva huśnugrahaṇaṃ syāt| yadā tu bhāṣāyāmapi yaṅlugasti, tadārdhadhātukatvābhāvādasati huśnugrahaṇe yoyuvatītyadau prāpnotīti tannivṛttyarthamupapadyate huśnugrahaṇam| tasmādetadeva jñāpayati - bhāṣāyamapi yaṅluṅastīti| tena bebhidīti, cecchidītītyādi bhāṣāyāmapyupapannaṃ bhavati| syādetat - yaṅlugāntādanyat? yaduvarṇāntamanekāc? saṃyogapūrvaṃ tannivṛttyarthametadbhaviṣyatīti? nedaṃ jñāpakamityata āha - `na ca` ityādi| nanu cedaṃ vidyate - yuvan? aruvanniti? naitadasti; yadyapyetadasaṃyogapūrvam, anekājna bhavati; aṭo'siddhatvāt||`abhūvan` iti| `gātisthā` [[2.4.77]] ityādinā sico luk| jherantādeśe kṛte saṃyogāntalopaḥ| `abhūvam` iti| `tasthastha` [[3.4.101]] ityādinā mipo'mbhāvaḥ| `babhūva` ityādi| `bhavateraḥ` [[7.4.73]] ityabhyāsasyāttvam| `indhibhavatibhyāñca` [[1.2.6]] iti liṭaḥ kittvam, tena guṇabuddhī na bhavataḥ| kimarthaṃ punarbhaveteḥ parasya liṭaḥ kittvamārabhyate, yāvatā `ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati` (vyā|pa|16) iti kṛtayorapi guṇavṛddhyorvuk? prāpnotyakṛtayorapi, vuki kṛte'nigantatvādalaghūpadhatvādanajantatvācca nāsti guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptiḥ, tataḥ kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvādvuki kṛte guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptireva nāstītyanarthakaṃ kittvam? naitadasti; vugapyanitya eva, na hrasau kṛtayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ prāpnoti, orityanuvṛtteruvarṇāntasya vukā bhavitavyamiti kṛtvā| atrobhayoranityayoḥ paratvāt? guṇavṛddhī syātām| tasmāt? kittvamārabdhavyam| kimarthaṃ punaḥ orityanuvartate? bobhāva, bobhaveti guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayorvṛṅa mā bhūdityevamartham| nanu ca kittve satyatrāpi guṇavṛddhibhyāṃ na bhavitavyam? naitadasti; na hi yaṅalugantād? bhavateḥ parasya liṭaḥ kitvaṃ bhavati, `indhibhavatibhyāñca` [[1.2.6]] ityatra bhavatīti śtipā nirdeśāt||`nigūhayati` iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-896), hetumāṇṇic| `nigūhakaḥ` iti| ṇvul| `sādhunigūhi` iti| <> [[3.2.78]] iti ṇiniḥ| `nigūhaṃ nigūham` iti| `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul? ca` [[3.4.22]] iti ṇamul, `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavataḥ` (vā|887) iti dvirvacanam| `nigūhaḥ` iti| bhāve ghañ| `alo'nyasya mā bhūt` iti| uttaratra ityabhiprāyaḥ| iha tvorityanuvatrya vināpyupadhāgrahaṇena śakyata evāyamarthaḥ pratipādayitumityetadeva manasi kṛtvā paraṃ pṛṣṭavān - `upadhāgrahaṇaṃ kiṃ? iti; ittarārthañcopadhāgrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇamatrāpyalo'ntyasya vidhiṃ nivartayati| tena prayojanābhāvāt? orityetannānuvartate| atha kimartham? `gohaḥ` iti vikṛtanirdeśaḥ kriyate, na `guhaḥ` ityevocyeta, laghu hrevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati? ityāha - `goha iti vikṛtagrahaṇam` ityādi| ūttvasya viśiṣṭaviṣayo yathā syādityevamartham| `goha` iti vikṛtasya kṛtokārastha grahaṇamityarthaḥ| etadeva vyaktīkarttumāha - `yatra` ityādi| asya kaścidamumarthamācaṣṭe| etaduktaṃ bhavati - guṇe kṛte ūttvena bhavitavyamiti lakṣyate; etaccāyuktam; evaṃ hi vyākhyāyamāne `ayādeśapratiṣedhārthaṃ `nigūhra gataḥ` iti `kecidicchanti` ityuktvā yadvakṣyati - `uttvasyāsiddhatvāt? `lyapi laghūpūrvāt` [[6.4.56]] iti ṇerayādeśaḥ syāt` iti, tannopapadyate| yadi gūṇaṃ kṛtvokārasyottvaṃ vidhīyate, tataśca satyūkārasyāsiddhatvenaiva laghupūrvatvamupapadyate, okārapūrvatvāt; tat? kuta ūkārasyāsiddhatve'yādeśaprasaṅgaḥ? tasmādayamatrārthaḥ - yasmin? viṣaye guhergoha ityetadrūpaṃ sambhāvyate tatra yathā syāt| yatra pratyaye guṇaḥ sambhavati tasmin? kṛte'kṛta eva guṇe yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi| tasmādvikṛtanirdeśasya viśiṣṭaviṣayopalakṣaṇārthatvāt? guṇaviṣaye sammukhībhūta evākṛta eva guṇa ūtvena bhavitavyam| evañca sati `ūttavasyāsiddhatvāt` ityādikaḥ prasaṅgagrantho yujyate, nānyathā| nanu ca guṇanimitte pratyaya utpanne paratvād? guṇenaiva bhavitavyam, tatkathamakṛta eva guṇa ūttvaṃ bhavet? kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt| taddhi kṛte guṇe prāpnotyakṛte'pi, vikṛtanirdeśasya viśiṣṭaviṣayopalakṣaṇārthatvāt| na tūttve kṛte guṇaḥ prāpnoti, alaghūpadhatvāt| tasmād? guṇāt? pūrvamūttvena nityatvādbhavitavyam| ata eva dīrghoccāraṇamarthavadbhavati, nānyathā| yadi guṇe kṛte satyayamādeśaḥ syāt, dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| āntaratamyādeva dīrghasya dīrgho bhaviṣyati| jñāpitaṃ hi `diva ut` [[6.1.131]] iti tapakaramena - `bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān? gṛhṇati` (cāndra|pa|44) iti| yadanyat? prāpnoti tannivṛttyarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇamiti cet? syādetat - `ajugūhat` ityatra `ṇau caṅyapadhāyāḥ` [[7.4.1]] iti hrasvo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇamiti| kutaḥ punareṣa niyamo'tra hrasvatvena na bhavitavyamiti? na hīha kātyāyanasya bhāvyakārasya vā vacanamasti, nāpi śiṣṭaprayogaḥ, yata eṣa niścayaḥ syāt| `yathālakṣaṇamaprayukteṣu` iti cocyata| tasmāt? `ajūguhat` ityevaṃ bhavitavyam| yadi guṇe kṛte'yamādeśaḥ kriyeta, tataḥ kimaniṣṭaṃ syāt? dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| atrāpi dīrghoccāraṇaṃ vaicittryārthaṃ prakalpyeta? evamapi prakriyāgauravaṃ syāt| tasmāddīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyādakṛta eva guṇa ūttvena bhavitavyam| ca>> [[3.1.74]] iti śṛbhāvena inupratyayena ca bhavitavyam, pūrdhītyatra kryāditvāt? śnāpratyayena, uruṇaskṛdhītyatra `tanādikṛñbhyaḥ uḥ` [[3.1.79]] ityupratyayena; apāvṛdhītyatatra yadi vṛṅa tadā kryāditvāt? śnāpratyayena, atha vṛñ? tadā svāditvāt? śnupratyayena; evañcaitāni rūpāṇi na sidhyanti? ityata āha -`ato'nyatara` ityādi| śṛṇudhītyetasmādudāharaṇādanyeṣūdāharaṇeṣu <> [[3.1.85]] iti śap, tasyāpi <> [[7.4.78]] iti luk||`vā chandasi` ityādi| <> [[1.2.4]] ityapitaḥ sārvadhātukasya ṅittvaṃ vidhīyate, chandasi viṣaye <> [[6.1.106]] ityanena heryadapittvaṃ tadvikalpyate| tena pakṣe tasya ṅittvaṃ na bhavati| atha rārandhīti kathaṃ parasmaipadam, yāvatā ramirayamātmatmanepadī? kathaṃ vātra śapaḥ śravaṇaṃ na bhavati? kathañcābyāsasya dīrghatvam, kathañca `anudāttopadeśa` [[6.4.37]] ityādinā makāralopo na bhavati? ityāha - `rārandhi` ityādi| `śapaḥ śluḥ` iti brāuvāmena `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanamityuktaṃ bhavati| makāralopābhāvastvaṅittvāde siddha iti nāsau yatnasādhya ityabhiprāyaḥ| `yameḥ śapaḥ` iti| `bahulaṃ chandasi [[2.4.73]] ityanena| `yoteḥ śapaḥ śluḥ` iti| <> [[7.4.78]] ityanena||`ciṇa uttarasya pratyayasya` iti| atha pratyayasyaitatkuto labhyate? <> [[6.4.1]] ityanena pratyayasya sannidhāpitattvāt| yadi ciṇa uttarasaya pratyayasya lugbhavati, akāritarām, akāritamāmityatra taraptamamorluk? kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `akāritarām` ityādi| yo'sau taśabdasya luk, tasya taraptamaporluki kartavye `asiddhavadatrābhāt` [[6.4.22]] ityasiddhatvam| atastaśabdena vyavadānācciṇo'nantarau taraptamapau na bhavata iti tayorlugna bhavati| nanu cānyasyānyāsmennasiddhavacanādekasya tatraivāsiddhatvaṃ nopapadyate? ityata āha - `ciṇo lugityetat` ityādi| `ciṇo luk` ityabhedenāpi śrutamidaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ viṣayasya lakṣyasya bhedādbhidyate, vyaktau padarthe prativyakti lakṣaṇaṃ bhidyata iti kṛtvā, tena bhede satyupapadyata evāsiddhatvam| akāri, ahārīti sthite atiśayavivakṣāyāṃ taraptamapau `tiṅaśca` [[5.3.56]] ityanena, tadantāt <> [[5.4.11]] ityāmau kṛte, akāritamām, akāritamāmiti bhavati||`gaccha` iti| gamerloṭ, <> [[7.3.77]] iti chatvam| `dhāva` iti| `dhāvu gatiśuddhyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-601) atha vā sartteḥ `pāghrā` [[7.3.78]] ityādinā dhāvādeśaḥ| `yuhi, ruhi` iti| adāvitvācchapo luk| `lunohi, punīha` iti| `pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[7.3.80]] iti hrasvatvam, `ī halyadhoḥ` [[6.4.113]] itīttvam| nanu cettve kṛte satyanakārāntatvānna etenāsaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamakāraviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| sa evaṃ vidha ukāraḥ pratyayasya viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha -`tadantāt` ityādi| kimarthaṃ punastadantadidhirabyupagamyate? `sun? cinvityatra yathā syāt astvetat? prayojanam, ayaṃ tu doṣaḥ -tanu, kurvityatra na prāpnoti, atra hrukāra eva pratyayaḥ na tadantaḥ? atrāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena tadantattvaṃ pratyayasyāstītyadoṣaḥ| `kuru` iti| dhātorguṇe raparatve ca kṛte `ata utsārvadhātuke` [[6.4.110]] ityuttvam| `taruṇuhi` iti| `tūnūkaraṇe takṣaḥ` [[3.1.76]] iti śnuḥ|`cchandovāvacanam` iti| abhidhāne'bhidheyopacārādvārtho vikalpo vāśabdena vivakṣitaḥ| ucyate vyākhyāyate'neneti vacanam, vārthasya vacanaṃ vāvacanam, chandasi vāvacanaṃ chandovāvacanamiti `saptamī` [[2.1.40]] iti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| `chandasi veti vaktavyam` iti| chandasi viṣaye vikalpenāyaṃ vidhirbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -uttarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣaḥ, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena chandasi viṣaye vikalpenāyaṃ vidhirbhavatīti| `dhinuhi, kṛṇuhi` iti| `hivi divi, dhivi, prīṇanārthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-591-593), `kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-598) iditvānnum, <> [[3.1.80]] ityupratyayaḥ, akāraścāntādeśaḥ, tasya `ato lopaḥ [[6.4.48]] iti lopaḥ||`yo'yamukāro'saṃyogapūrvaḥ` iti| etenāsyetyanena prakṛta ukāraḥ pratyavamṛśyata iti darśayati| nanu ca `ataḥ` [[6.4.106]] ityanuvṛtterukārasyaiva lopo vijñāsyate, tatkim? `asya` ityanena? ṣaṣṭhīprakḷptyarthamasyetyetaditi cet? na; `mvoḥ` ityeṣaiva hi saptamyakṛtārthā `utaḥ` ityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ pūrvayoge kṛtārthāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati, <> [[1.1.66]] iti vacanāt| syādetat| yadi `mvoḥ` ityeṣā saptamī vijñāyate, etadeva tu na vijñāyate -kimiyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī uta saptamīti? tasmāt? ṣaṣṭhīprakḷpyarthamasyetyuktam| `lugittyanuvartamāne` ityādi| yadi prakṛta eva luk? kriyate tadā sarvasyaiva pratyayasya luk? syāt, nāntyasya; yataḥ pratyayādarśanasya lugityeṣā saṃjñā vihitā, na tu pratyayāvayavasyādarśanasya| sarvasya tu luki kṛte `sunvaḥ sunmaḥ` iti na sidhyati? lopagrahaṇādadoṣaḥ| tatra hrukāramātrasya lopaḥ <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti vacanāt| tasmādantyasya lopārthaṃ lopagrahaṇam| kiñca kurvaḥ kumaṃ ityatra guṇo luki sati na syāt; <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇāpratiṣedhāt| lopa#e tu sati bhavati| tato guṇārthamapi lopagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||`karoterukārapratyayasya` iti| nanu cakāreṇa pūrvasūtra ukāro'nukṛṣṭaḥ, `cānukṛṣṭañcottaratra nānuvartate` (vyā|pa|76) tat? kathamukārasya lopo labhyate? naivam; pūrvasūtre hrukārasya sannidhānamasyetyanenaiva labhyata iti tatra tasya cakāreṇa yā'nukṛṣṭiḥ saitadarthaiva veditavyā| `ukāralopasya` ityādinā kurvaḥ kumaṃ ityatra sopapattikāṃ dīrghaprāpta darśayati, <> [[8.2.79]] ityanena ca tatpratiṣedham| nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi nityo vidhirbhaviṣyati||`cakāro lopasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ||`ukārapratyayāntasya` ityādi| ukāraḥ pratyayo'nto yasya sa tathoktaḥ| ukārapratyayāntaśca karotiḥ sārvadhātukattvaṃ na vyabhicarati, anenābhiprāyeṇāha -`sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ kim` iti? `bhūtapūrve'pi` ityādi| asati sārvadhātukagrahaṇe karoterukārapratyayāntasya kṅiti pratyaye parata uttvamucyamānaṃ yatra kṅit? sārvadhātukaṃ parabhūtaṃ tatraiva syāt -kurutaḥ, kurvantītyādiṣu; kurvitra herluki kṛte kṅitpratyayasyābhāvāt? <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāttu na syāt| tasmādbhūtapūrve'pi sārvadhātuke yathā syādityevamarthaṃ sārvadhātukgrahaṇ| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā yadyapi bhāvyamāna ukāraḥ savarṇānāṃ grāhako bhavati, tathāpyāntaratamyānmātrikastha sthāne mātrika eva bhaviṣyati? ityata āha -taparakaraṇam` ityādi| asati hi taparakaraṇa ukārapratyayamāśritya <> [[7.3.84]] iti guṇe kṛte raparatve ca yaduttvaṃ tasyokārasya <> [[7.3.86]] iti guṇaḥ syāt| tasmāt? taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate -hrasvasyaiva śravuṇaṃ yathā syāt, lakṣamāntareṇa yo dīrghaḥ| prāpnoti sa mā bhūditi||`rundhaḥ` iti| <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti takārasya dhakāraḥ| `staḥ` iti| adāditvācchapo luk| atha śnasoriti ko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, yāvatā <> [[6.1.101]] iti dīrghatve kṛte `śnasoḥ` iti nirdeśena bhavitavyam? ityāha -`śnasorityākārasya pararūpatvam` ityādi| atra taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, āstām, āsannityatrāḍāgamasya mā bhūditi cet? naitadasti; iha hi laṅi kṛte lāvasthāyāmāḍāgamātpūrvamantaraṅgatvāllādeśaḥ kriyate| tatra kṛte vikaraṇaḥ kṛtākṛtaprasāṅgitvādāḍāgamaṃ bādhate| āḍāgamasya tvaśabdāntaraprāpteranityatvam| tathā hi kṛte vikaraṇe vikaraṇāntasyāṅgasya tena bhavitavyam, akṛte dhātumātrasya| kṛte vikaraṇe yadyapyāḍāgamākāralopayodrvayorapi kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvam, tathāpi paratvādakāralopaḥ kriyate, tasmin? kṛte tasyāsiddhatvādāṭ, tasyāsiddhatvādeva ca lopo na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ taparakaraṇena? evaṃ tahrretajjñāpayati -`ābācchāstrīyamasiddhatvamanityam` iti| tena `vugyuṭāvuvaṅayaṇoḥ siddhau bhavataḥ` ityetadvaktavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati||`lunate` iti| <<ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ>> [[7.1.5]] ityādeśaḥ| `lunatām` iti| loṭ? `āmetaḥ` [[3.4.90]] | `alunata` iti| laṅa| mimate` iti| `māṅa māne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1088) [`māne śebde ca` -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] abhyāsasya `bhṛñāmit` [[7.4.76]] itīttvam| evaṃ `sañjihate` ityatrāpi `ohāṅa gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1089) ityasya| `bibhrati` iti| pūrvāditvam| `alunāt` iti| nanu cāsati kṅitītyasminnītvenātra bhavitavyam, tat? kuto lopasya prasaṅga? naitadasti; īttvamapi hi kṅitītyanuvatryam, tatra yadi `kṅiti` iti nānuvartate tadā syādeva lopaḥ| nanvādgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, `śnābhyastayorataḥ` ityevocyeta, evaṃ hrekamātrayā laghu bhavati? ityata āha -`ādgrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| jagarteḥ <> [[6.1.6]] ityabhyastasaṃjñāyāmapi ṛkāralopo na bhavati -jāgratīti| etacca śnetyakārāntena sāhacaryādabhyastasyākārāntasyaiva grahaṇāllabhyate||`lunītaḥ, punītaḥ; `lunītha, punītha` iti| tasthasau| `mimīte` iti| ātmanepadaikavacanam| `mimīṣe` iti| `thāsaḥ sa` [[3.4.80]] | `mimīdhvam` iti| dhvam| `lunanti, punanti` iti| jhipratyayaḥ| nanu ca yadyapyajādāvapīttvaṃ syāt, lopo'navakāśaḥ syāt? ato'navakāśatvāllopa īttvaṃ bādhidhyate, tat? kiṃ `hali` ityanena? naitadasti; asati halgrahaṇe vacanādubhayaṃ syāt| ghusaṃjñakeṣvāllopaḥ prasajyeta| tasmāt? `hali` iti vaktavyam| `datt#H` iti| `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cattrvam| `dhattaḥ` iti| dhāño dvirvacane kṛte <> [[8.4.54]] ityabhyāsasya jaśatve ca <> [[8.2.38]] iti bhaṣbhāvena dakārasya dhakāraḥ, dhātostvākāralope kṛte jaśtvacarttve||`daridrati` iti| <> [[6.1.6]] ityabhyastasaṃjñā, tenābhyastalakṣaṇa ākāralopo bhavati| `vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -<<śnasorallopaḥ>> [[6.4.111]] ityato maṇḍūkalputinyāyena lopagrahaṇamanuvarttya sārvadhātuke, hali, vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena yatraiveṣyate yat? tat? tatraiva bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti| `siddhaśca pratyayavidhau` iti| tathāsau kartavyau yathā pratyayavidhau=pratyayavidhānakāle, siddhaḥ=niṣpanno bhavati| etaduktaṃ bhavati -ārdhadhātuke pratyaye viṣayabhūte'nutpanne eva lopaḥ kartavya iti| evaṃ hrasau pratyayavidhau siddho bhavati, nānyathā| `siddhaśca pratyayavidhau` ityasyopādāne yat? phalaṃ tad? `ākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ` ityādinā darśayati| yadyārdhadhātuka utpanne sati lopaḥ kriyate, tadā `śyādvyadhāruāu` [[3.1.141]] iti sūtreṇa ṇapratyayaḥ syāt; daridrāterākārāntatvāt| tataśca `āto yuk? cimkṛtoḥ` [[7.3.33]] iti yuki kṛte, `daridrāya` ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| `siddhaśca pratyayavidhau` ityucyamāne tu prāgeva pratyayotpatterlopaḥ, tasmin? syanākārāntatvāt? pacādyajeva bhavati| tena `daridraḥ` itīṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| `na daridrāyake lopaḥ` ityādinā ślokena yatrārdhadhātuke lopo neṣyate yatra vikalpena ceṣyate kaiścit, taddarśayati| `daridrāyake` ityatra ṇvulante śabde sisādhayiṣite lopo `sanīvantardha` [[7.2.49]] ityatra `tanipatidaridrāṇām` ityupasaṃkhyānādvikalpeneṭ| `adyatanyām` iti| luṅītyarthaḥ `luṅo'dyatani` iti pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| `adaridrāsaut` iti| `yamaramanamātāṃ sak? ca` [[7.2.73]] iti sagiṭau, `asti sico'pṛkte` [[7.3.96]] itīṭ, `iṭa īṭi` [[8.2.28]] iti sico lopaḥ| nanu ca <<āto dhātoḥ>> [[6.4.140]] ityākārālope kṛte daridra iti nirdeśena bhavitavyam, tat? kathaṃ daridrasyeti nirdeśa ityāha -`daridrasyeti nirdeśaḥ` ityādi| `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti` ityataḥ <<ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam>> [[6.3.63]] iti bahulavacanācchāndasamiha hrasvatvam| tapakaraṇaṃ ityabhiprāyaḥ| `bibhītaḥ` iti| `ñi bhī bhaye` (dā|pā|1084) juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ| halādāvityeva -bibhyatīti| ittvavidhānasāmarthyādeva `eranekācaḥ` [[6.4.82]] iti yaṇādeśo na syāt| sārvadhātuka ityeva -bhītaḥ, bhītavān| kṅitīti kim? bibheti||īttvāpavāda ittvamārabhyate; anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| pakṣe tadapi bhavatyeva| sārvadhātuka ityeva -hīnaḥ, hīnavān| iha kecit? `sārvadhātuke` [[6.4.110]] ityasyānuvṛtiṃta pratyācakṣate| katham? `hali parata īttvettve prāpnutaḥ, dvirvacanaṃ ca; tatra yadi paratvādīttvettve syātāṃ tataścevarṇantatābhyāsasya syāt; tasmādabhyasta grahaṇamanuvartanīyam, tasmaścānuvartamāne sārvadhātukānuvṛttirapārthikā` iti| etaccāyuktam; antaraṅgatvāt| `dvirvacanenaiva prāgīttvettvābhyāṃ bhavitavyam, tat? kuto'bhyāsasyevarṇāntatāprasaṅgaḥ! antaraṅgatvantu dvirvacanasyālpāpekṣatvāt| taddhi ślumātramapekṣate| ittvettvayośca bahvapekṣatvādbahiraṅgatā, bahavapekṣā ca; tayoḥ punaraṅgasya halādau kṅiti sārvadhātuke vidhānāt| jahāteriti nirdeśāt? jihīta ityatadra jihāterna bhavati| `pṛthagyogakaraṇamuttarārtham` iti| `āca hau` [[6.4.117]] ityeṣa vidhirjahātereva yatā syāt, bibhetermā bhūditi||cakāra ittvānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇayoranukarṣaṇārthaḥ||`abhyāsalopaśca` iti dhusaṃjñakārthamabhyāsalopagrahaṇam; na tvastyartham; asterabhyāsambhavāt| `dehi cehi` iti| dāñdhāñorete rūpe| anyeṣāntu ghusaṃjñakānāmudāharaṇaṃ na sambhavati; vikaraṇena hevryavadhānāt| asambhavācca yathāyogam| tatra `do` ityetasya śyanā hiśabdo vyavadhīyate, daṇo dheṭastu śāpā, deṅaḥ punarātmanepaditvāda herasambhavaḥ| `edhi` iti| sakārasyaittve kṛte tasyāsiddhatvāt? `hujhalabhyo herdhiḥ [[6.4.101]] iti dhibhāvaḥ| nanu ca <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityalāmantyasya lopena bhavitavyam, tat? kathaṃ sarvasyābhyāsasya lopo bhavati? ityata āha -`śidayam` ityādi| `lopaśca` ityatra dvau śakārau nirdiṣṭau| tatraiko lopasya samabandhī, dvitīyastu vibhakteḥ| yaśca lopasya sambandhī tasyetsaṃjñā pratijñāyata iti śidayaṃ lopo bhavati| tena sarvasyābhyāsastha lopo bhavati| `ā ca hau` [[6.4.117]] ityato hograhaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena śakyate'nuvartayutum| tatranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau `anyatarasyām` ityetasyāpyanuvṛttirityāśaṅkā syāt, atastannivṛttyarthaṃ `hau` ityuktam| cakārasya sanniyogarthatvāllopo bhavatyettvañca||`ekahalmadhye` iti| ekaśabdo'yamasahāyavācī| ekaśca ekaśca ekau, ekau ca tau halau cetyekahalau, ekahalormadhya iti dvivacanāntasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| dvyoreva hi halormadhyaṃ sambhavati, naikasya| atra yadi liṭaādaśo na viśiṣyate tato nematuḥ, nemu; sehe sehāte, sehira ityatra na syāt| astihyatrāpyaṅgasyādeśa ādirityetaccetasi kṛtvā liṭaādeśaṃ viśeṣayitumāha -`liṭi parataḥ` ityādi| liṭi parabhūte ya ādeśo vidhīyate sa ādiyaṃsyāṅgasya ityasyedaṃ vivaraṇam -`asahāyayo rhalormadhye` iti| tatyetyanantarokto'kāraḥ sambadhyate| tasyāṅgasyāvayavasyākārasyetyarthaḥ| sthānaṣaṣṭhī cem -tasya sthāna ekāra ādeśo bhavati| `reṇatuḥ, reṇuḥ` iti| -kāśikā|] iti| `rāśṛ śabde` [rāśṛ śabde -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-626) ātmanepadī| `śaśramatuḥ śaśramuḥ` iti| `śramu tapasi khede ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1204)|kecittu tatakṣatuḥ, ityanaimittike ete bhavataḥ, tataśca prāgeva liḍutpattestābhyāṃ bhavitavyam| tena tadādi yadaṅgaṃ talliṭaādeśādi na bhavati| yadi tarhi liṭā'deśo viśiṣyata evaṃ satyaṅgamaviśeṣitaṃ syāt, tataśca babhaṇatuḥ, babhaṇurityatrettvaṃ kasmānna bhavati, <> [[8.4.54]] iti jaśtve kṛta ādeśāditvāditi cet? na; ettve kartavye jaśtvasyāsiddhatvāt| tasmādbhavitavyamevaittvena| vipratiṣedhasya tu yatra `kuhoścuḥ [[7.4.62]] iti ścutvaṃ kriyate -cakaṇatuḥ, cakaṇuḥ, jahasatuḥ, jahasurityādāvavakaśaḥ syādityata āha -`iha` ityādi| kathametajjñāyate -nāstyasiddhatvam? ityāha -`tathā ca` ityādi| tadaiva phalibhajyorettvavidhānādadasīyate -jaśtvacattrvayorasiddhatvamiha nāstīti| `rūpābhede ca` ityādi| `śabdarūpasya sthānino'bede sati ya ādeśaḥ sa iha nāśrīyate` ityasyārthasya <> [[6.4.126]] iti śasidadyoḥ pratiṣedhavacanaṃ jñāpakam| <> [[8.4.54]] ityanena prakṛtijaśāṃ prakṛtijaśaḥ, prakṛticarāṃ prakṛticaro bhavantīti śasaḥ śakārasya śakāro bhavati, daderdakārasyāpi dakāra; tenobhāvapi tāvādeśādī bhavataḥ| tatra yadi sthānyabhede sati ya ādeśaḥ so'pīhāśrīyeta, tata ādeśāda#itvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti śasidyorettvapratiṣedho na vidhīyeta; vihitaśca, tasmādetadeva pratiṣedhavacanaṃ cakaṇaturityevamādīnāmettvaṃ na bhavati, tathā pecatuḥ, pecurityevamādīnāmapi prakṛtijaścarādīnāṃ na syāt| prakṛtijaśaḥ prakṛticaraścādayo yeṣānte tathoktāḥ| `ahaṃ papaṭha, ahaṃ papaca` iti| atra sthānivadbhāvena pittvāt? kittvaṃ nāsti, tenaittvābhyāsalopau na bhavataḥ| vṛddhirapi na bhavati; <<ṇaluttamo vā>> [[7.1.91]] iti pakṣe ṇittvābhāvāt| ṇittvapakṣe tu paratvādvṛddhyā iti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ, tena yatra yatrettvamiṣyate tatra tatra bhaviṣyatīti| evañca kṛtvā `naśimanyoraliṭaettvam` (vā|793) ityādyapi nopasaṃkhyeyam; yogavibhāgenaiva siddhatvāt| vaktavyaśabdasya -`kṣipakādiṣu` ityādi| kṣipakādiṣvittvasya pratiṣedho vakṣyate| asya ca kṣipakādiṣu prakṣepaḥ, tenettvaṃ na kriyate| `cānaśi` iti| `tacchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaśa` [[3.2.129]] `muk? na kriyate` iti| <<āne muk>> [[7.2.82]] iti muk? prāpnoti, sa na bhavati `anityamāgamaśāsanam` (vyā|pā|95) iti kṛtvā| chāndasatvādvā -`sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante` (bho|pa|99) iti| `chāndasaṃ hrasvatvam` iti| `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam` [[6.3.63]] iti ṅyāporvidhīyamānaṃ hrasvatvaṃ bahulavacāt? `perirannityatrāpi vati| pacerliṅ, sīyuṭ, jhasya ran, śap, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | paceranniti prāpta ettve hrasvattve ca kṛte peciranniti bhavati||`teratuḥ teruḥ` iti| `ṛcchatyṛtām` [[7.4.11]] iti guṇaḥ| `phelatuḥ, pheluḥ` iti| `phala niṣpattau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-530), `ñi phalā viśaraṇe` vikalpārthaṃ vacanam, itareṣāmaprāpte| tatra rājṛprabhṛtīnāṃ caturṇāmavarṇasyaittvasya pratiprattaye <> [[6.4.123]] ityatra `ata ityetadihopasthitam` ityādinā yaduktaṃ tadyathāsambhavaṃ rephasya guṇabhaktatvāt| tathā ca bhāṣyam -`arbhavati guṇo bhavati, ārbhavati vṛddhirbhavati -rephasahito guṇavṛddhisaṃjño bhavati` iti||`t` ityayamādeśo bhavati` iti| `nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam` cediti yat? prakṛtaṃ tadihāpi sambadhyate| `arvantau` iti| ṛkārasyogitkāryārthatvāt? `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num| `arvati` iti| <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp| `ārvatam` iti| apatyārthavivakṣāyāmaṇ| nanu ca nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā|pa|65) sādṛśyāt? soranyatra vibhaktādeva bhavitavyam? naitat; asāviti prasajyapratiṣedho'yam| ata eva vṛttikṛtoktam -`suścet? tataḥ paro na bhavati` iti| anyathā soranyo yaḥ sup? sa cet? tataḥ paro bhavatīti brāūyāt| athāpi paryudāsaḥ? evamapyadoṣaḥ; anityatvānnañivayuktaparibhāṣāyāḥ| anityatvantu tasyāḥ <> [[6.3.132]] ityatra vibhaktigrahaṇādvijñāyate| yadi hi sā nityā bhāvāyāmapi tasya prayogo dṛśyate| athāpi vanippratyayāntaḥ syāt? evamapi bahulavacanāt? `yasyeti` [[6.4.148]] iti lopo na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `maghonī` iti| `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] | `māghavanam` `bāhvantāt? saṃjñāyām` [[4.1.67]] ityūṅa, tadantāt? <> [[4.1.120]] | `kādraveyaḥ` iti| `kadrūkamaṇḍalvośchandasi saṃjñāyām` (4.1.71,72) ityūṅa tadantāt? pūrvavaṅḍhak||atra yasyeti yakārasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā syāt, ivarṇāvarṇayorvā? atra yadi yakārasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, uttarasūtre punaryagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, etadeva hi tatrānuvarttiṣyate| tasmādivarṇāvarṇayoridaṃ grahaṇam| tatra varṇagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayatīti tadantavidhirvijñāyate -ityataccetasi kṛtvā''ha -`ivarṇāvarṇāntasya` ityādi| `dākṣī, plākṣī` iti| dākṣiplākṣiśabdābhyāṃ <> [[4.1.65]] iti ṅīṣ| `sakhī` ityatrāpi `sakhyaśiāīti bhāṣāyām` [[4.1.62]] iti nipātanāt| nanu cātra savarṇadīrghatvenāpyetat? siddham, tat? kimarthamatra lopa vidhīyate? ityata āha -`savarṇadīrghatve hi` ityādi| `atikrāntā sakhī enam` iti `prādibhyo dhātujasya` (vā|101) iti bahuvrīhiruttarapadalopaśca, upasarjanahrasvatvam| tatra yadi savarṇadīrghattvaṃ kriyeta, na tu lopastadā sakhīkārekārayorekādeśaḥ sakhiśabdasyāntavadbhavatīti `śeṣo dhyasakhi` [[1.4.7]] itaci dhisaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| tataścātisakherāganacchatīti `gheṅiti` [[7.3.111]] iti guṇo na syāt| lope satyupasarjanahrasvatve sati yadyapi praviśiṣṭaṃ rūpam, tathāpi lākṣaṇikam| ato lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) tanna gṛhrata iti na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ| tasmāllopa eva kartavyaḥ| `dauleyaḥ` ityudāharaṇatraye `itaśṭacāniñaḥ` [[4.1.122]] ityapatyārthe ḍhak| `kumārī iti| <> [[4.1.20]] iti ṅīp| `gaurī` iti| <<ṣidgaurādibhyaśca>> [[4.1.41]] iti ṅīṣ| `śāṅrgaravī` iti| `śāṅrgaravādyaño ṅīn` [[4.1.73]] | `bālākiḥ saumitriḥ` iti| bālakasumitrābhyāṃ bahvāditvādiñ| `yasyetyādau` iti| ādiśabdenottaro vidhiḥ parigṛhrate| vaktavya iti vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -<> [[6.4.136]] ityetatsūtrādvibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena cānena sūtreṇa lopo vidhīyate, yaścottarasūtreṇa, tāvubhāvapi na bhavata iti| `kāṇḍe, kuḍaye` iti| `auṅa āpaḥ` [[7.1.18]] iti, <> [[7.1.19]] iti śobhāva iti, tatra yasyetyakāralopaḥ prāpnoti| `saurye` iti| <> [[4.3.112]] iti sūryaśabdādaṇ, tadantādauṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ, tatrānenākāralopaḥ prāpnoti, uttarasūtrema yakāralopaśca| `iyaṅvaṅabhyām` ityādi| iyaṅuvaṅoravakāśaḥ -śriyau, śriyaḥ, bhruvau bhruvaḥ, lopasyāvakāśaḥ -kāmaṇḍaleyaḥ, mādrabāheya iti; vātsapreyaḥ, laikhābhreya ityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, lopo bhavati vipratiṣedhena| `vatsaprīḥ` iti| kvibantametat||yadyatra bhasaṃjñayā sūryādayo viśiṣyeran - `sūryādīnāṃ bhasaṃjñakānāmiti, tadā saurī, balāketyatra lopo na syāt| na hi sūryaśabda iha bhasaṃjñaka iti, kiṃ tarhi? anyedavāṇantaṃ śabdāntaramiti buddhau nidhāyānāśritarūpabhedasya lopena sambandhaḥ sūryādibhiḥ sambandhibhiryakāro viśiṣyata iti darśayannāha - `sūryativyāgastyamatsya - `ityetevām` ityādi| `bhasya` iti| bhasaṃjñakasya| yo yakāra upadhā, tasya lopo bhavati sa cedyakāraḥ sūryādīnāṃ sambandhī bhavati - ayamatarārtho vivakṣitaḥ| te tu sūryādayo bhatvena na viśiṣyatante| tena yadāpi teṣāṃ bhasaṃjñā na bhavati, tadāpi tasyopadhāyakārasya lopo bhavatyeva yadyasau yakāraḥ sūryādīnāṃ sambandhī bhavati| `saurī, balākā` iti| nanu cātrākāralopasya vyāśrayatvenāsiddhatvaṃ nāstītyupadhāyakāro na bhavatītyetaduktam? ityāha - `aṇi yo yasyeti lopaḥ` ityādi| atra hi dvau yasyetilāpau - eko'ṇiparataḥ, apara īkāre| tatra prathamo vyāśrayaḥ, tathā hi - lopo'ṇamāśritya bhavati, yalopastvīkāram? ato vyāśrayatvādasiddhatvābhāvastasya yuktaḥ| itarastvīkāramāśritya bhavati samānāśraya eva, tataśca tasyāsiddhattvādupadhāyakāro bhavati| `bhasyāṇantasya` ittayādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇe darśayati| `taiṣam, taiṣī` iti| <> [[4.2.3]] ityaṇ, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| `ṛṣitvādaṇi kṛte` iti| `ṛṣyandhaka` [[4.1.114]] ityādinā `matsyacarī` iti| matsyo bhūtapūrvaḥ - <> [[5.3.53]] pūrvavanṅīp| bhavatyatra matsyacara iti bhasaṃjñakamatsyasambandhī yakāraḥ, natvasau bhasaṃjñakasyopadeti lopo na pravartate| atha kimarthaṃ yagrahaṇam, yāvatā sūryādibhirūpadhāyāṃ viśiṣyamāṇāyāmantareṇāpi yagrahaṇaṃ yakārasyopadhābhūtasya lopo vijñāsyate, yakāra eva hi teṣāmupadhā, na tu varṇāntaram? ityata āha - `yagrahaṇamuttarārtham` iti| `vaktavyam` iti vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānantvihāpi pūrvavadvibhāṣāmāśritya kartavyam| `mātsyam` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| `saurīyam` iti| aṇantāt? <> [[4.2.114]] | evaṃ `āgastīyam` iti| `sauryam` iti| sūryo devata'syeti `sā|ḍasya devatā [[4.2.23]] ityaṇ| `āgastyaḥ` iti| apatyārthe ṛṣyaṇ| `nakṣatrāṇi` iti| nakṣatrasambandho yo'ṇ? tasminnityarthaḥ| `kakārādeḥ śabdasya` iti| kakārasyākārasyetyarthaḥ| `ādyudāttatvañca` iti| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatve prāpte satyādyudāttārthaṃ vacanam| `antitaḥ` iti| <> [[5.4.45]] iti tasiḥ| `tādeśca` iti| tikaśabdasyetyartha| cakārāt? kādeśca| `antamaḥ` iti| atiśāyane tamap` [[5.3.55]] | `antiṣat` iti| `satsūdviṣa` [[3.2.61]] ityādinā kvip| `ye ca` iti| dṛśyata iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `antimaḥ` iti| <> [[4.4.110]] iti yaḥ, <> [[4.4.98]] iti vā| kecit? sarvameva lopavidhānaṃ chandasyevecchanti||`taddhita iti nivṛttam` iti| uttarasūtre taddhitagrahaṇāt| tenāyamītyeva vidhiḥ| `gārgī` ityādi| gargādiśabdebhyo yañantebhyaḥ `yañaśca` [[4.1.16]] iti ṅīp| `kārikeyī` iti| <> [[4.1.120]] , tadantāt? `ṭiṅḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| `vaidhī` iti| <> [[4.1.48]] iti ṅīṣ||`gārgakam` iti| <> [[4.2.39]] ityādinā gāgryaśabdādvuñ, tatra yaño lopaḥ| `sāṅkākhyakaḥ` iti| `kāmpilyakaḥ` iti| pūrvavat? saṅkāśakampilaśabdābhyāñcāturārthikaḥ `duñchaṇ` [[4.2.79]] ityādinā ṇyaḥ, tadantājjātādau śaiṣike'rthe <> [[4.2.121]] iti vuñ| atha taddhitagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, <> [[6.4.144]] iti taddhitagrahaṇamanuvarttiṣyate? ityata āha - `taddhitagrahaṇam` ityādi| somī devatasyeti <> [[4.2.30]] , `ṭiṅḍhāṇaña` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| tatra parato'napatyayakārasyāpi <> [[6.4.150]] ityanena lopo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam; anyathā yadi tadeva prakṛtaṃ taddhitagrahaṇamihānurteta, tadā tatsambanddhamīdgrahaṇamanuvarteta| tathā cobhayamihānuvartamānaṃ pūrvayāge'pyanuvartata| tathā ca pūrveṇaiva yogena siddhe satyubhayatra taddhita ī, ti ca niyamārtho'yamārambhaḥ syāt - āpatyasyevānākārādau taddhite lopo bhavati īti ca nānāpatye ca| evañca yathānapatyasya sāṅkaśyaka ityatra lopo na bhaviṣyati, tathā saumī iṣṭirityatrāpi na syāt; niyamena vyavarttitatvāt| iha tu taddhitagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe pūrvayoge taddhitagrahaṇasya nivṛttirākhyāyate| tena parvayogena taddhitamātrasya yakārasyānapatyasya cāpatyasya cāviśeṣeṇa lopo vidīyate| saumī iṣṭirityatrāpi lopo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam| nanu ca yadyubhayatra taddhita iti cāyaṃ niyamaḥ syāt? sūtradvayasyārtho'pārthakaḥ syāt| `hala āpatyasyānāti` ityekameva yogaṃ kuryāt| tasmāt? sūtradvayasyārambhasāmarthyādanyatarasyaivehānuvṛttirbhavatiṣyati, na tūbhayasyāpi| iha tvetāvān? sandehaḥ syāt - kiṃ taddhitagrahaṇamihānuvartate, utedgrahaṇamiti? atrāpi taddhitagrahaṇamanuvartate, nedgrahaṇamiti; vyākhyānāt| saravasandeheṣvidamupatiṣṭhate `bhavati vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattirna hi sandehādalakṣaṇam` (pu|pa|vṛ 120) iti| taddhitagrahaṇe ca kevala ihānuvartamāne taddhitaviṣaya evāyaṃ niyamo bhaviṣyati, na tvīdviṣaya iti| tathā cāsatyapi punariha taddhitagrahaṇa iti niyamābhāvāt? pūrvasūtreṇa saumī iṣṭirityatrāpi lopaḥ siddhyatyeva| tat? kathamidamuktam - taddhitagrahaṇītyanapatyasyāpi lopārthamiti? sukhena lopaḥ pratīyata ityetadarthamidamityabhiprāyo draṣṭavyaḥ| tataścāyamatrārthaḥ sampadyate - pratipattigauravaparīhārārthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam|`gāgryāyaṇaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.101]] iti phak| `kārakeyiḥ` iti| kārikāyā apatyamiti `strībyo ḍhak` [[4.1.120]] , tatastasyāpatyam, `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] kārikeyiḥ||ataddhitārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `kya` iti kyackyaṅoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam| `gārgīyatīti| <> [[3.1.8]] , <> [[7.4.33]] itīttvam| `gārgīyaḥ` iti| `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca` [[3.1.11]] iti kyaṅa, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ| `gārgībhūtaḥ` iti| `abhūtatadbhāve` [[5.4.50]] iti cviḥ, <> [[7.4.32]] itīttvam||`bilvakadibhyaḥ` iti| āgantukenākāreṇa nirdeśaḥ| `bilvakīyā` iti| <> [[4.2.90]] <> [[4.2.91]] iti cāturarthikaśchaḥ, kugāgamaḥ| `bailvakāḥ` iti| `prāgdīṣyate'ṇ` [[4.1.83]] | atha chagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā kṛtakugāgamā bilvakīdayo gṛhītāḥ, ebhyaśchapratyayaḥ sambhavatītyantareṇāpi chagrahaṇaṃ chasyaiva lopo bhavitavyatīti? ata āha -`chagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadi chagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā sanniyogaśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā (ha|bhā|14) chakāre nivartamāne kuko nivṛttiḥ syāt| tasyāśca paribhāṣayā etedeva chagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam| atha luggrahaṇaṃ kimartham, prakṛta eva lopo vidhīyate? ityata āha -`luggrahaṇam` ityādi| yakāragrahaṇamekadeśopalakṣaṇārthaṃ draṣṭavyam| sa hi lopa upadhāyā ityanena sambaddha iti tasminnanuvartamāne `ya upadhāyāḥ` [[6.4.149]] ityetadapyunuvarteta, chasyeyādeśe kṛte yakāramātrasya syāt| athāpi `upadhāyāḥ` ityetannānuvarteta? evamapi <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] itīkāramātrasya syāt| `luggrahaṇam` iti| lugiti pratyayādarśanasyaiṣā saṃjñā, na tu pratyayasyaikadeśasyādarśanasyeti| luggrahaṇe sati sarvasyaiva luk? siddhyati| tadrathaṃ hi luggrahaṇam||`tuḥ` iti| viseṣakarānanubandhānutsṛjya tṛṃstṛcoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam| `kariṣṭhaḥ` iti| karotestṛn| tadantādatiśāyana iṣṭhan, tṛśabdasya lopaḥ| `vijayiṣṭhaḥ` iti| vipūrvājjayatestṛn| `vahiṣṭhaḥ` iti| atrāpi vahestṛn| tadantādiṣṭhan, `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam| tṛśabdasya lope kartavye <> [[8.2.1]] ityasiddham, tena pūrvalopa eva kriyate, tasmin? kṛte jhali yadānte ca vidhīyamānaṃ ḍhatvaṃ nimittābhāvānna pravartete| `dohīyasī` iti| duhestṛjantādīyasun, <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp| atrāpi lope kartavye `dāderdhātordhaḥ` [[8.2.32]] ityetadapyasiddhamiti pūrvaṃ lopaḥ, tasmin? sati pūrvavaddhatvaṃ na pravartate| atha <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityantyasyāyaṃ lopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `sarvasya` ityādi| tatraiva kāraṇamāha - `antyasya` ityādi| yadyantyasya syādvacanavaiyathryamāpadyeta; `antyasya ṭeḥ` ityevaṃ siddhatvāt| tasmādantyalopavacane prayojanaṃ nāstīti sarvasya tṛśabdasya lopo yatā syādityevamarthamidaṃ vacanaṃ vijñāyate| yadi tarhi tṛśabdasya lopārthaṃ vacanamanantaro lugeva kasmānna vidhīyate, evaṃ tarhi sarvasya sukhameva lopo'vasīyate, pratyayādarśanasya lugvidhānāt? ityata āha - `lugityetattu` ityādi| kaḥ punastatra sati doṣaḥ syāt? ityata āba - `tathā hi` ityādi| yadi lugityetadihānuvartata, tataḥ `antaraṅgānapi vidhīn? bahiraṅgo lug? bādhate` (vyā|pa|128) iti kṛtvā pūrvaṃ lukā bhavitavyam, tataśca <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇaniṣedhaḥ syāt; kariṣṭhaḥ, vijayiṣṭha ityatrārdhadātukalakṣaṇo guṇo na syāt| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti lugityetadihānuvartate| athemanijgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tṛśabdāt? para imānijna sambhavati| tathāpi <> [[5.1.122]] <> [[5.1.123]] ityanena yogadvayena sa vihitaḥ, na tṛśabdāntaṃ kiñcit? pṛthvādiṣu dṛḍhādiṣu vā madhye paṭhate, nāpi varṇavācyastītyata āha - `itarau tu` ityādī||`ṇāviṣṭhavat` iti| <> [[6.3.35]] iṣṭhani puṃvadbhāva uktaḥ, <> [[6.4.161]] iti rabhāvaḥ, `ṭeḥ` iti ṭilopaḥ, `sthūladūrayuvahrasva` [[6.4.156]] ityādinā yaṇādiparasya lopaḥ, pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ, <> [[5.3.65]] iti luk, <> [[5.3.64]] iti kan| `priyasthira` [[6.4.157]] ityādinā prādaya ādeśāḥ -etāni kāryāṇi yatheṣṭhani bhavanti, tathā ṇāvapi yathā syuriti ṇāviṣṭhavat? prātipadikasya kāryaṃ bhavatīti vaktavyam| prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum, anyasyātideśasyāsambhavāt| vatiriha sādṛśyārthaḥ, tena yasyeṣṭhani yatkāryaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tato'nyasyātideśasyāsambhavāt? tadvyavacchedārtha prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam| tat? kriyate visapaṣṭārtham| kecittu brāuvate pratyayasya kāryāṇāmatideśo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam| tat? kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| kecittu brāuvate pratyayasya kāryāṇāmatideśo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ prātipadikagrahaṇ, tena bahumācaṣṭe bahayatatyatra <> [[6.4.159]] iti yiṇṇa bhavati? etaccāyuktam; iṣṭhavadityatra hi saptamī samarthādvatirdihitaḥ, ṇāditi pratiyogini sapatamīśravaṇāt| teneṣṭhani yatkāryaṃ vihitaṃ tadatidiśyate, na tviṣṭhasya yatkāryaṃ tadapi| na ca yiṅ? iṣṭhani yat? kāryam, api tviṣṭhana eva| tasyaiha prāptireva nāstīti kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena prātipadikagrahaṇena! `enīm` iti| etacchabdāt? `varṇādanudāttāttopadhāt` [[4.1.39]] ityādinā ṅīṣ, takārasya ca nakāraḥ| `etayati` iti| ṇau kṛte puṃvadbhāvena ṅīṣnakārāvubhāvapi nivartete| nanu ca ṅīṣā vyavahito'tra ṇiriti ṇāvatideśaḥ kriyamāṇastadvyavadhāne na prāpnotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iṣṭhanyapi hi ṅopā vyavadhānaeva prātipadakasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ| tasmādihāpi vyavadhāne'pi tadvadeva bhaviṣyati|`ruāgviṇam` iti| <> [[5.2.121]] iti viniḥ| ruājayatītyatra `saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ` (vyā|pa|64) iti <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhirna bhavati| `ahgavṛtte punaraṅgavṛttāvavidhirniṣṭhitasya` (vyā|pa|38) iti vapā| prāpayatītyevamādau bhavatyevāniṣṭhitatvāt| atra `arttihro` [[7.3.36]] ityādinā puk| nanu bhāradvājīyapāṭhe prādayo na siddhyanti; api tu ruājayati vasayatīti luk, kanayatītyatra ca kannityata āha -`tadetadubhayamapyudāharaṇamātram` ityādi| tadetadbhāvadvājīyapāṭhe anyeṣāñca prayojanamupadarśitam, na tvetadudāharaṇamātraparigaṇanam| etāvadeva prayojanamiti yasmāt? prādayo'pīṣyante| nanu `prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-ga|sū|186) iti curādigaṇa eva paṭhate, tat? kasmāt? punariha ṇāviṣṭhavadbhāva ucyate? asyaiva prapañcārthamityeke| gaṇe vā sa vaktavyaḥ| `asau itaraḥ` iti vikalpapradarśanārthamityanye||yadyapi pūrvaṃ bhāvasādhano lopaśabda upāttaḥ, tathāpīha karmasādhano gṛhrate; yaṇādiparimiti nirdeśāt| bhāvasādhane hi tasmin? `karttṛkarmaṇaoḥ kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti ṣaṣṭhī syāt| karmasādhane tu karmaṇastenaiṣābhihitatvāt? prathamaiva yujyata iti manyamāno lāpaśabdasya karmaśabdasya karmasādhanatāṃ darśayannāha - `yaṇādiparaṃ lupyate` iti| kathaṃ punastasyaiva bhāvasādhanasya sataḥ karmasādhanatopapadyate? kaḥ punarāha - `tasyaiva` iti! pratisūtraṃ hranuvartamāno lopaśabdo bhidyate| nanu ca yaṇādau parasmin? lupte sāmarthyāt? tatpūrvasyaiva guṇo vijñāsyate, tat? kimarthaṃ pūrvagrahaṇam? ityāha - `pūrvagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham` ti||kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ priyorugurudīrghāṇāmevemanijudāhyiyate, nānyeṣām? ityāha -`priyorubahulagurudīrghāḥ` ityādi| `priyādibhya evemanic? sambhavati, nānyebhyaḥ` ityevamparametadvākyamityarthaḥ| anyathā yadyapi priyādaya eva pṛthtrādiṣu paṭhante, varṇāvācino vā syuḥ, tadodāhyiyetemanic? teṣāmityakāraṇamedimanico'trodāharaṇaṃ syāt||`bahoruttareṣām` iti| etena prathamasya bahoḥ pañcamyantatāṃ darśayati, tasya ca vahorityanenāpi dvitīyasya ṣaṣṭhantatām| `bhūyān` iti| <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] itīkārasyava lopaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ bahoriti punagrrahaṇam? ityāha -`bahoriti panaḥ` ityādi| asati hi bahoriti grahaṇe bahuśabdasya sthānitvaṃ na pratīyeta; pañcamyantena nirdeśāt| tasmāt? sthānitvapratipattaye punarbahorityacyate| `anyathā hi` ityādi| yadi bahoḥ iti nocyeta, tadā pratyayānāmeva bhūbhāvaḥ syāt; <> [[1.1.67]] iti vacanāt| nanu pṛthagnirdeśādeva pratyayānāṃ na bhaviṣyati, anyathā `bhūlopau` ityayaṃ brāūyāt? naitadasti; asti hranyat? pṛthagnirdeśasya prayojanam| kim? pṛthaksthānikau yathā stātām, ādermā bhūtāmiti| yadi `bhūlopau` ityevamucyeta, tadā <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityādyasyaiva varṇasya paryāyeṇa bhūlopo syātāmiti| ato bhinnasthānikau yatā syātāmityevamarthaḥ pṛthagyoganirdeśaḥ syāt| tasmādyuktamuktam -`anyathā hi pratyayānāmeva bhūbhāvaḥ syāt` iti| cakāro'tra sanniyogārthaḥ||`lopāpavādo yiṅāgamaḥ` iti| nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt| `tasminnikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ` iti| prayojanāntarābhāvāt| cakāraḥ `bahośca bhūḥ` ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ||`jyāyān` iti| <> [[5.3.60]] `jya ca` [[5.3.61]] iti jyādeśaḥ| `lopasya yiṭ? ca` iyādi| yadyatra lopo yiṭā na vyavadhīyate tadā tenaiva jyāyānityetat? siddhyatīti kṛtvā''diti nocyetetyabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punarādityanucyamāne lopena siddhayati? ityata āha -`lope hi sati` ityādi| atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatāntaratamyādeva dīrghasya dīrgha eva bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; na hi `bhāvyamāno'ṇ? savarṇān? na gṛhṇāti` (vyā|pa|35) iti||`kartavyam` iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -uttarasūtre yadvibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tadihāpi sambadhyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena pṛthvādīnāmeva bhaviṣyati| yadyevam, `halāderlaghoḥ` ityetanna kartavyam, vyavasthitavibhāṣayā halāderlaghośca bhaviṣyati? satyametat; tadvispaṭārthaṃ kriyate| `tata iha na bhavati` ityādi| akriyamāṇe tu parigaṇane kṛtayatītyādāvapīṣṭhavadbāvena syādeveti bhāvaḥ||`ruājiṣṭhaḥ` iti| atra prakṛtivadbhāvena ṭilopo na bhavati| nanu ca <> [[5.3.65]] ṭilopaṃ bādhiṣyate, nāprāpte tvasmastvasyārambhāt? naitadasti; dvau ṭilopau -eko vinmatvantasya, anyo luki kṛte satyavaśiṣṭasya; tatra yo'sau vinmatvantasya ṭilopastasminnāprāpte lugārabhyata iti yuktaṃ yadasau taṃ bādhate| yastvavaśiṣṭasya ṭilopastasya prāglukprāptyasambhavādaprāpta eva tasminnārabhyamāṇaḥ kathaṃ paścādupajātaprāptikaṃ lopaṃ bādheta| tasmādārabdhavyamidam| `prakṛtyāke rājanya` ityādi| kiṃ vaktavyametat? na; kathaṃ tarhi `turiṣṭhemeyastu` [[6.4.154]] ityetannivṛttam| sāmānyenayaṃ prakṛtivadbhāvo vidheyaḥ, vibhāṣati cānuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena yatra yatreṣyate tatra sarvatra bhaviṣyati, yatra tu neṣyate tatra na bhaviṣyatyeva| evam? <> [[6.4.164]] ityevamādikaṃ prakṛtibhāvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāditi cet? na; prapañcārthatvāt| `rājanyakam` iti| `rājño'patyam` iti| `rājño'patyam` iti `rājaruṣasurādyat` [[4.1.137]] tasmātsamūherthe <> [[4.2.39]] ityādinātra vuñ| `mānuṣyakam` iti| manorapatyamiti <> [[4.1.161]] iti yeṣāṃ mate'patyārthe yat, teṣāṃ pūrvasūtreṇa vuñi kṛte lopaḥ prāpnoti, sa prakṛtibāvānnivartate| yeṣāntu matena jātimātre yat, nāpatye, teṣāṃ nārthaḥ prakṛtibhāvena; anāpatyayakāratvādeva hi lopo na bhaviṣyati||`sāṅakūṭinam, sāṃrāviṇam, sāmmārjinam` iti| `kūṭa dāhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1890), [paritāpe (paridāhe) -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `ru śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1034), `mṛjū śuddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1066) `abhividhau bhāve inuṇ` [[3.3.44]] , <> [[7.2.114]] sāṃkūṭin, sāṃrāvin, sāṃmārjin -iti sthite <> [[5.4.15]] iti svarthe'ṇ| `maidhāvaḥ` iti| <> [[5.2.121]] ityādinā viniḥ, tadantāt? prāgdīvyato'ṇapatyārthe||apatyārtho'yamārambhaḥ; anapatye pūrarveṇaiva siddhatvāt| innantatvādeṣām||ayamapyapatyārtha ārambhaḥ| `śāṅkhinaḥ` iti| śaṅkhamadravajraśabdebhyo matvarthe itiḥ, tadantāt? pūrvavadaṇ||`anapatye` iti| nivṛttam| sāmānyenāṣmatre vidhiḥ| `sāmanaḥ, vaimanaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| `sautvanaḥ` iti| `ṣuñ? abhiṣave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1247) <> [[3.2.103]] iti ṅavanipa, <> [[6.1.71]] ||`sāmanyaḥ, vemanyaḥ` iti| <> [[4.4.98]] iti yat||`ātmanīnam` iti| `ātmanviājanabhogottarapadāt? khaḥ` [[5.1.9]] | `adhvanīnam` iti| atrāpi `advane yatkhau` [[5.2.16]] iti khapratyayaḥ| `pratyātmam` iti| ātmānaṃ pratīti `avyayaṃ vibhakti` [[2.1.6]] ityādinā yathārthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| tataḥ `anaśca` [[5.4.108]] iti ṭac| `prādhvam` iti| pragatamadhvānamiti prādisamāsaḥ, <> [[5.4.85]] ityac||`cārmaṇaḥ` iti| `parivṛtto rathaḥ` [[4.2.9]] ityarthe <<prāgdīvyato'ṇ>> [[4.1.83]] | `vā hitanāmna iti vaktavyam` iti| hitanāmaśabdasya va pratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityrathaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -ihāpi tadeva vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena hitanāmno vā pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati||yadyetadekameva sūtraṃ syāt tato nimamārtha vā smāt? vidhyarthaṃ vā? yadyapatya iti vartate, tato'nantara sūtreṇaiva prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopaḥ siddhyatyeva, siddhe satyetanniyamārtha bhaviṣyati -`ajātāvevāpatyārthe yathā syāt` iti| tathā ca <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇi vihite brāāhṛo garbhaḥ, brāāhṛmastram, brāāhṛṃ haviḥ, brāāhṛī oṣadhiriti na siddhyati; apatyāṇo'bhāvāt| athāpatya iti nivṛttam, tato vidhyarthameva bhaviṣyati| apatye hi pūrvasūtreṇa prakṛtibāvaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ, tataśca `an` [[6.4.167]] itīti prakṛtibhāve prāpte'jāto brāāhṛ ityetaṭṭilopārthaṃ nipātyate| evañca vidhyarthe'smin? siddham - brāāhṛo garbhaḥ, brāāhṛṇastram, brāāhṛṃ haviriti; brāhṛṇa iyaṃ brāāhṛī oṣadirityetattu na siddhyet; `ajātau` iti pratiṣedhāt| apatye jātau ca <> [[6.4.170]] ) iti prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe sati <> [[6.4.144]] iti bhavati ṭilopaḥ -brāāhṛo nārada iti, tathehāpi syāt -brāhṛṇo'patyamiti brāāhṛṇa iti| evamekayoge doṣaprasaṅgamabhivīkṣya tat? parijihīrṣurāha -`ya#ogavibhāgho'tra kriyate` iti| yogavibhāge sati yadi `apatye` ityanuvṛtterapatya eva ṭilopo nipātyate, pūrvavat? siddhe sati niyamārthameva nipātanaṃ syāt, tataśca sa doṣastadavastha eva syāt, yaḥ prāṅaniyamapakṣe uktaḥ| tathā ca yogavibhāgakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādapatyādhikāro'pi yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyādapatyādanyatara `brāāhmaḥ` ityetannipātyate| evamanapatye'pi `brāāhmaḥ` iti nipātanāt? `brāāhṛo garbhaḥ, brāāhṛstram, brāāhṛ havirityetat? siddhyati| tataḥ `ajātau` ityayaṃ dvitīyo yogaḥ| <> [[6.4.170]] iti prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe yaḥ <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopaḥ, sa mā bhūdityevamartho'patya ityeveti| etenāsmindvitīye yoge `apatye` ityanuvartata ityācaṣṭe| `ajātau` iti ca prasajyapratiṣedho'yam| tatra jāterapatyārthena sambandhaḥ, nañsatu bhavatinā| tamevārthaṃ vṛttau darśayannāha -`apatye jātāvaṇi brāāhṛṇa iti lopo na bhavati` iti| jātiviśiṣṭe|patye vivakṣite'ṇi parato brāāhṛṇa ityatra ṭilopo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| apatya ityeva -`brāhṛo oṣadhiḥ` iti| pratyudāhaṇavyājena yogavibhāge jātimātravivakṣyāṃ brāāhṛī oṣadhirityetadapi siddhaṃ bhavatīti darśayati||`yadyevam` iti| yadi ṇakāro'tra pratyayaḥ, evaṃ sati kimarthamidam? naivāsya prayojanaṃ kiñcidityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam? ityāha -`nastaddhita ityevaṃ hi` ityādi| yaddhi lakṣaṇena na prāpnoti tadarthaṃ nipātanamārabhyate, iha tu `nastaddhine` [[6.4.144]] ityevaṃ siddhaḥ, na hi ṇe kenacit? prakṛtibhāva ukto yatastatra ṭilopātanamārabhyamāṇamidamarthavatsyāt| aṇi hi prakṛtibhāvo'ṇantasyoktaḥ, na tu ṇe| anantaroktamarthamabhyupagacchati -yadi satyam, kimarthamidamityāha -`jñāpakārtham` ityādi| `aṇkṛtāni` ityādi| aṇi kṛtāni kāryāṇi aṣkṛtāni, `saptamau` [[2.1.39]] iti yogāvibhāgātsamāsaḥ| atha vā aṇā kṛtāni `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam? dhūtavān, dhūtvā; <<ūrṇāyā yus>> [[5.2.123]] ūrṇāyurityevamādāvapyanākau syātām, ato'syātiprasaṅganirāsāyāha - `anunāsikayaṇoḥ` iti| anunāsiko yaṇyayoriti bahuvrīhiḥ| santi hi yaṇaḥ sānunāsikāḥ niranunāsakāśca, tatra hi yayoranunāsiko yaṇ? tayoridaṃ grahaṇam| anunāsikayaṇau ca yau yuvū tau pratyayāveva, nāpratyayāviti darśayitumāha - `pratyayayoḥ` iti| anye ,tvapratyayanivṛttyarthaṃ pratyayayorityuktamiti varṇayanti, tadayuktam; anunāsikayaṇorityanenaivāpratyayanivṛtteḥ siddhatvāt| tana hrapratyayāvanunāsikayaṇau yuvū śāstre staḥ| tasmādanunāsikayaṇau yo yūvū tau pratyayāveva, nāpratyayāviti sambhavapradarśanārthaṃ pratyayayorityuktamiti vijñāyate| anunāsikayaṇośca pratyayogrrahaṇe satyaṅgasyeti sambandhalakṣaṇeyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī vitreyā| ṅgasambandhinoryuvoriti sambandhaḥ| sa punarnimittinimittabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| pratyayanimitto hraṅgasyātmalābha ityaṅgaṃ nimitti, pratyayo nimittam| `yorano vorakaḥ` iti| anena yathākramaṃ sthānyādeśasambandhamācaṣṭe`| `nandyādibhyo lyuḥ` iti|
