ādeśastuprakṛtipratyayāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgaḥ| `antaraṅgabahiraṅgayorantaraṅgaṃ balīyaḥ` (vyā|pa|94) iti pratyayādyudāttatvenaiva pūrvaṃ bhavituṃ yuktam, paścādādeśeneti, tatkathamucyate - adādeśe kṛte pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti? naitadasti uktaṃ hi `upadeśivadvacanaṃ kartavyam` iti| kiñca - ādeśo nityaḥ, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt| sa hi kṛte pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ punaranityam, śabdāntaraprāptyā| tathā hrakṛte'dādeśe jherikārasya prāpnoti, kṛte svadādeśākārasya `śabdāntarasya prāpnuvan? vidhiranityo bhavati` (vyā|pa|106)| `nityānityayornityaṃ balīyaḥ` (vyā|pa|93) iti balīyastvamasya| tadetannityatvādanayorbalapīyasoḥ paratvādadādeśena pūrvaṃ bhavitavyam, tataḥ pratyāyādyudāttatvena| tasmāt? suṣṭhūktam - ādese kṛte pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti||`cincete` iti| laṭ, svaritatvādātmanepadam| `cinvatām` iti| leṭ, jhaḥ ṭerettvam, `āmetaḥ` [[3.4.90]] | `acinvata` iti| laṅ, aḍāgamaḥ, <> [[6.4.87]] iti yaṇādeśaḥ| `punate, lunate` iti| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ| `cyavante, plavante` iti| atra śapi kṛte'nakārāntādaṅgāduttaro jhakāro na bhavati| nanu paratvādadādeśena bhavitavyam, paścādvikaraṇena? ityata āha - `nityatvādatadra` ityādi| nityatvaṃ tu kutākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt| vikaraṇo hi kṛte'pyadādeśe prāpnotyakṛte'pi, na tu tasmin? kṛte'dbhāvasya prāptirastītyanityatvamasya| `anakārāntena` ityādi| pratyayaḥ kasmādanakārāntenāṅgena na viśiṣyate? iti manyamāna āha - `iha` ityādi| yadi pratyayo viśiṣyeta śayāntaṃ - ityatrāpi syāt, bhavati hyatrāpyanakārāntādaṅgāduttaro jhapratyayaḥ| āṭā vyavahitatvānna bhavatīti cet? na; tasya tadbhaktatvānna hi tadekadeśena vyavadhānaṃ yuktam| jhakāre tu viśiṣyamāṇe na doṣaḥ; āṭā vyavahitatvāt| samudāyabhakto hrāṭ? samudāyameva na vyavadadhyāt| avayavaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva; na hravayavo'vayavāntarasyāvyavadhāyako dṛṣṭaḥ| `taṅyanataḥ`, `jhasyānataḥ` iti vā vaktavye `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ` iti vaicitryārtham||`jhādeśasyāto ruḍāgamo bhavati` iti| nanu na cehādgrahaṇamasti, yadapi prakṛtaṃ tadapi prathamāntam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśena cehārthaḥ, tat? kathaṃ jhādeśasyāto ruḍāgamo bhavatīti śakyaṃ vijñātum? naitadasti; <> [[1.1.67]] iti śīṅa ityeṣā pañcamī adityasyāḥ prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ parikalapayiṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `śerate` iti| `śūṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ` [[7.4.21]] | nanu cātra ruṭā vyavahitaṃ sārvadhātukam, tatkuto guṇaḥ, na hrayaṃ sārvadhātukabhaktastat? kathaṃ vyavadhāyako na syāt, acachabdasya sārvadhātukāvayavasyāyamavayava iti tadgrahaṇena gṛhrate, na sārvadhātukagrahaṇena; avayavāvayavasya samudāyānavayavatvāt; tathā hi - `che ca` [[6.1.73]] ityatroktam - `nāvayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo bhavati` iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avayavāvayavo'pi samudāyāvayavo bhavatyeva| tathā hi - devadatto'laṃktiyatāmityukte devadattasya ye'vayavā hastapādāyastavayavāścaṅgulyādayo'laṃkriyante| tasmāt? sārvadhātukāvayavasyācchabdasya yo'vayavo ruḍāgayaḥ, so'pi sārvadhātukāvayava iti tadgrahaṇena gṛhrate, ato nāsti vyavadhānam|yatpunaḥ `che ca` [[6.1.71]] ityatroktam - nāvayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo bhavatīti, tat? tatsūtravihitameva tugāgamamabhipretyoktam, sa tugavayavāvayavo'pi samudāyagrahaṇena na gṛhrata iti kṛtvā| kasmāt? punarna gṛhrate? hrasvānukarṣaṇasāmarthyāt| tatra hi cakāreṇa hrasvo'nukṛṣyate - hrasvamātrasyāgamitvaṃ yathā syāt, hrasvantasya mā bhūditi| yadi hrasvāntasyāgamitvaṃ syāt, cicchidatuḥ, cicchidurityatra tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ syāt| yadi ca tatsūtravihitastugavayavāvayavaḥ samudāyagrahaṇena na gṛhrate, tadā hrasvamātrasyāyamitve halādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ syādeva; hrasvavayavasya tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāt| tataśca hrasvānukarṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| atha kimarthamadādeśasya ruṅ? vidhīyate, na jhakārasya vidhīyatām, tatrāyamarthaḥ - ata #iti ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayitavyā na bhavati; jha ityasya ṣaṣṭhantasya prakṛtatvāt? ata āha - `ruḍayam` ityādi| yadi kakāramanubandhamāsanya pūrvāntaḥ kriyata, tadā śerata ityatra guṇo na syāt; anigantatvāt| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti ruḍayaṃ parādiḥ kriyate; parādirapi kriyamāṇo yadi jhakārasyaiva syāt? kimaniṣṭaṃ syāt? ityāha - `yadi` ityādi| jhakārasyaiva ruṭ? syāt? tadā'dādeśo na syāt| tato yathā śayāntai - ityatrāṭā vyavahitatvādadādeśo na bhavati; tathā śerate ityatrāpi na syāt; ruṭā vyavahitatvāt| tasmādasya doṣasya parihārārtham - ata eva ruḍāgamo vidhīyate, na jhakārasyeti kecidvyācakṣate, etaccāsamyak; jhakārasya kriyamāṇo ruṭ? tasyaiva bhakto bhavati, tatkathaṃ tena vyavadhānaṃ bhavet! na hi svāvayavena vyavadadhātyeva| tasmādasadvyākhyanametadityanyathā vyākhyāyate - adādeśo na syādityatra jhakārasyetyetadapekṣate, tadayamartho bhavati - yadi ruḍāgamo jhakārasyaiva syāt? tadādādeśastasyaiva na syāt| kasya tarhi syāt? tasyaiva ruṭaḥ syāt; <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti vacanāt| anekāltve'pi sarvādeśo na bhavati; ruṭa ānarthakyaprasaṅgāt| ruṭo vidhānasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti cet? naitadasti; uttarārtha ruṅavidhānaṃsyāt| <> [[7.4.78]] ityatra rujāgamo yathā syāt| na hṛdṛśrannityataṭā sidhyati| tasmājtākaśravaṇaṃ ruṅvidheḥ prayojanam| tadetasya doṣasya nirāsāyādādeśasya ruṅvidhīyate; na jhakārsaya| `śīṅaḥ` ityanubandhena nirdeśe yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ - vyatiśesyata iti||`saṃvidrate, saṃvidate` iti| `vida jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1064)| `samobhyṛcchi` [[1.3.29]] ityādinā'tmanepadam, adāditvācchapo luk| `saṃvidratām, saṃvidatām` iti| loṭ| derettve kṛte `āmetaḥ` [[3.4.90]] ityām| `vetteriti lugvikaraṇasya grahaṇaṃ kim` iti| evaṃ manyate - vidheriti sāmānyanirdeśena sarvavidīnāṃ grahaṇamastu, laghu hrevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati, satyapi sarvavidhīnāṃ grahaṇe lugvikaraṇādeva bhaviṣyati, nānyataḥ, vikaraṇena vyavadhānāt| yadyaviśeṣeṇa vidīnāṃ grahaṇa syāt? `vida vicāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1450) ityasmādapi raudhādikāt? syāt, na hyatra vikaraṇo vyavadhāyakaḥ; dhātvantaḥpātitvāt? ityata āha - `iha` ityādi| `vinte, vindāte, vindate` iti| anudāttettvādātmanepadam, <<śnasorallopaḥ>> [[6.4.111]] | atra tu `vindate` iti bahuvacanāntaṃ pratyudāharaṇam| ekavacanadvivacanayorupanyāso vidervicāraṇārthasya rūpamiti pradarśanārthaḥ; anyathā `vindate` ityetācatyucyamāne lābhārvasya viderekavacanāntamidaṃ rūpamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt| śtipā nirdeśādyaṅluki na bhavati - saṃvevidate, vyativevidate|| `aduhya` iti| svarirettvādātmanepadam| nanu ca vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtterevāduhyatetyādi siddham, kiṃ bahulavacaneneti yaścodayet? taṃ pratyāha - `bahulavacanāt` ityādi| vibhāṣānuvṛttyā hi vikalpamātraṃ labhyate, na tvanyatrāpi bhavati| bahulavacanādanyatrāpi bhavati| tena vibhāṣāyāṃ prakṛtāyāṃ bahulavacanamiti bhāvaḥ| `adṛśran` iti| dṛśerluṅ, jherantādeśaḥ, `irito vāṭa [[3.1.57]] iti cleraṅ, tasya ruṭ? `itaśca` [[3.4.100]] itīkāralopaḥ, `saṃyogantasya` [[8.2.23]] iti takārasya ca, <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam| athātra `ṛvṛśoraṅi` [[7.4.16]] iti guṇa kasmānna bhavati? <> [[1.1.5]] iti pratiṣedhāditi cet? na; tasaya ṅityeva vidhānāt| sārvadhatukasya ṅitamāśritya pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnotīti cet? na; ekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhavatīti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ` iti||bahulagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| śakyate hi maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena bahulagrahaṇamanuvartayitum||avidyamānaḥ kakāro yayostavakau| `ebhiḥ` iti| idamastyadādyatvam, `bahuvacane jhalyet` [[7.3.103]] ityettvam, <> [[7.2.113]] itīdrūpasya lopaḥ| `amībhiḥ` iti| adasa ettve kṛte `eta īdavahuvacane` [[8.2.81]] itīttvam, dasya ca matvam| `imakaiḥ` iti| `avyayasarvanāmnāmakacprakṭoḥ` [[5.3.71]] ityakac, `daśca` [[7.2.109]] iti dakārasya matvam| `amukaiḥ iti| `adaso'sordādu do maḥ` [[8.2.80]] iti matvotve| atha `nedamadasoḥ` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, kimakoratyanena, akorityanucyamāne sakakārayorapi atiṣedhaḥ syāditi cet? naitadasti; idamadasorhi pratiṣedha ucyamānaḥ kaḥ prasahgo yā sakakārayoḥ syāt? naiva prāpnoti śabdāntaratvādityāha - `akorityet` ityādi| jñāpakasya prayojanam - akajvatāṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñā sarvādīnām, svarādīnāñcāvyayasaṃjñā| atha `idamadasoḥ kāt` iti kasmānnoktam, tatra pūvaṇaiva siddhe niyamārtha bhaviṣyati - idamadasoḥ sambandho yo bhis? tasya kādeva parasyais? bhavati, ityevaṃ vijñāyamāne niyame sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ niyame sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva, laghu ca sūtraṃ bhaviṣyati? satyametat; kintvasmin? sūtravinyāse `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhrate` (vyā|pa|21) ityeṣā na jñāpitā syāt| viparītaniyamo'pi bhandadhībhirāśaṅkyeta - idamadasoreva kāditi| tatrāyaṃ niyamārthaḥ syāt - idamadasoreva yaḥ kakārastasmāt? parasya bhisa aisbhavatīti| tato viākaiḥ, sarvakairityatra na syāt; niyamena vyāvarttitatvāt| iha ca syādeva - ebhiḥ, amībhiriti| niyamenāvyāvarttitatvāt| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu||`atijarasinā` ityādi| pūrvavat? samāse kṛte hrasvatve ca jarasādeśaḥ| `kecit` iti| sūtrakāramatānusāriṇaḥ| yadi hratijarasinetyetat? sūtrakārasya sādhutvenābhimataṃ na syāt, ṭetyetasya nādeśameva kuryāt| tatrāpyetve kṛte vṛkṣeṇetyādi sidhyati| kathametatvamiti cet? evamettvavidhau yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate| idamasti - `bahuvacane jhalyet` [[7.3.103]] , tataḥ `osi ca` [[7.3.104]] , tataḥ <<āṅi cāpaḥ>> [[7.3.105]] iti; tatrāṅīti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ - āṅi parato'ta etvaṃ bhavati - vṛkṣeṇa, plakṣeṇa; tataḥ `āpaḥ`, <> [[7.3.106]] iti| nanu ca nādeśe satīdama idrūpasya hali lopaḥ prasajyeta, tataścāneneti na sidhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; <> [[7.2.113]] ityatra <> [[7.2.101]] ityato'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavastitavibhāṣā vijñāyate tena nādeśe kṛte satīdrūpasya lopo na bhavati| tadevaṃ nādeśenaiva vṛkṣeṇetyādi| sidhyati| tataḥ sa eva kartavyaḥ, nenādeśaḥ; kṛtaścāsau, ato'vagamyate - nūnaṃ sūtadrakārasyāti jarasinetyetatsādhutvenābhimatam, yasya siddhyarthaminādeśaṃ kṛtavānititi| tathā yadyatijarasādityasya sādhutvamabhīṣṭaṃ na syāt? ṅaseradbhāvaṃ vidadhyāt| tatrāpi akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena [[6.1.97]] vṛkṣādityevamādi siddhyatyeva| nanu cākaḥ savarṇāvapavādaḥ <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti, tat? kathaṃ siddhyati? naitadasti; akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati pararūpam, anyathā takārameva vidadhyāt| atra hi <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityakārasya takāre vihite saṃyogāntalope vṛkṣādityevamādi sidhyatyeva| atra hi <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityakārasya takāre vihite saṃyogāntalope vṛkṣādityevamādi sidhyatyeva| tasmādakāroccaraṇasāmarthyāt? pararūpatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatītyadbhāvo vidheyaḥ, kimādbhāveneti? vihitaścādbhāvaḥ, tato'vasīyate - nūnamatijarasādityasya sādhutvaṃ sūtrakārasyābhimataṃ yatsiddhyarthamādbhāvaṃ vihitavāniti| evaṃ sūtrakārasya matamanusarantaḥ kecidatijarasinā, atijarasādityasya sādhutvamicchanti| `yathā tu` ityādi| bhāṣye hi - `atha kimarthaminādeśa ucyate, na nādeśa evocyeta` ityevaṃ granthasandarbheṇenādeśaṃ pratyakhyāya nādeśa eva vyavasthāpitaḥ| `atha kimarthamādipyucyate, na adevocyeta` ityevamādinā granthasandarbheṇa ādādeśaṃ pratyākhyāya adādeśa eva vyavasthāpitaḥ| yadi cātijarasinā, atijarasādityasya sādhutvamiṣṭaṃ syādinādeśamādbhāvaṃ ca bhāṣyakṛnna pratyācakṣīta| na hi prayojane sati pratyākhyānaṃ yuktam, kṛtañca tayoḥ pratyākhyānam, tato'vagamyate - `naitadivyate` iti||`ṅeḥ` iti| catuthryakavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇam| kasmānna bhavati saptamyekavacanasya grahaṇam? yadi hi tasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tadā - atyantasaṃyoge, bhāve apavarge, kārakamadhye - ityevamādi na siddhyati| tasmādetebhyo nirdeśebhyo nedamiha saptamyekavacanasya grahaṇam| ataḥ pariśeṣyāccaturthyekavacanasya grahaṇaṃ na niścīyata iti| <> [[5.1.5]] iti nirdeśācca liṅgādattaratrāpyetadevānuvartate| `vṛkṣāya` iti| `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghaḥ|nanu `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya` (vyā|pa|12) iti paribhāṣayā upasthāne sati sannipātalakṣaṇo yavidhirakāravidhātaṃ prati nimittaṃ nopapadyate, kuto dīrghatvam? ityāha - `sannipātalakṣaṇaḥ` ityādi| anityatvaṃ tvasyāḥ prāgeva pratipāditam| atha ṅakāroccāraṇaṃ kimartham? ekāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi| yadi syāt, pace, yaje - ityevamādāvapi syāt| nanu ca <> [[6.1.97]] iti pararūpatve kṛte nimittābhāvānna bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; nāprāpte hrato guṇe pararūpatve'yamādeśa ucyate; sa yathā vṛkṣāya ityatra <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvaṃ bādhate tathā pace, yaje - ityatrāpi bādheta pratipadoktasyekārasya grahaṇādiha na bhaviṣyatīti cet? na; asyāpyekārasya pratipadoktatvāt| <<ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere>> [[3.4.79]] iti nirddeśādekāraḥ pratipadokto bhavati| tasmādviśeṣaṇārtho ṅakāra kartavyaḥ||`bhavate` iti| tyadādyatvaṃ na bhavati| `dviparyantāstyadādayaḥ` (vā|7.2.102) iti bhavacchabdasya tyadāditvābhāvādakārāntatā na bhavati| `atho atra` ityādi codyam| atra idam? e iti sthite `idamo'nvādeśe` [[2.4.32]] ityaśādeśe kṛte paramapi smaibhāvaṃ bādhitvā nityatvādekādeśo'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ [[6.1.97]] prāpnoti| nityatvaṃ punarasya kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt| ekādeśe ca kṛte'nakārāntatvāt? smaibāvo na prāpnoti| `tatra` ityādi parīhāraḥ| tatraikādeśe prāpte'ntaraṅgatvāt? pūrvaṃ smaibhāvo vidhīyate, paścādekādeśaḥ| antaraṅgatvaṃ tu smaibhāvasyaikapadāśrayatvāt| ekādeśasya dvipadāśrayatvāt? bahiraṅgatvam||ṅeralpāctarasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipāto vaicitryārthaḥ||pūrveṇa nityaṃ prāptayoḥ smātsminorvikalpārtha vacanam| nanu ca <> [[1.1.34]] , <> [[1.1.35]] , <> [[1.1.36]] iti navaiva sūtre pūrvādīni paṭhante, tadapārthakaṃ navagrahaṇam, naitadasti; na hīha sūtraparipaṭhitāni pūrvādīni gṛhyante, kiṃ tarhi? gaṇapaṭhitāni| kuta etat? jasi hi sūtraparipaṭhitānāṃ teṣāṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñā, na ṅasiṅyoḥ| `sarvanāmnaḥ` [[7.1.14]] cetīhānuvartate, kiṃ prayojanam? vidyamāne sve yajate, svād? bibhetītyatra mā bhūt| tasmāt? gaṇaparipaṭhitānyeva pūrvādīni gṛhyante; tatrāsati navagrahaṇe tyadādibhyo'pi syāt| tasmānnavagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||yuṣmadasmadoḥ ṣaṣṭhī| ṣaṣṭhaādiviśiṣyoriti| ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyābhiḥ saha tiṣṭhata iti ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsthau, tayoriti vigrahaḥ| ṣaṣṭhaādiviśiṣṭayoriti yāvat| ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsu paratastiṣṭata iti vigrahastu na bhavati, `padasye`tyadhikāravirodhāt| padasyetyanuvṛttaṃ hi dvivacanena vipariṇataṃ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsthayorityasya viśeṣaṇam| na hi ṣaṣṭhaādivibhaktiṣu parataḥ patvamasti| bhyāmādau tatsattve'pi taditaratra dvitīyādau tadabhāvāt| sthagrahaṇasya tu prayojanaṃ mūla eva vakṣyate|<> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhau prāptāyāmayamārambhaḥ| `auṅaḥ` iti prathamādvitīyādvivacanayoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam| `āpaḥ` iti ṭāḍḍāpcāpām| `khaṭve` iti| `ajādyataṣṭāp` [[4.1.4]] tiṣṭhataḥ, paśyeti yathākramamanuprayogayorupanyāsaḥ prathamāntatāṃ dvitīyāntatāñca pratipādayitumca anyathā khaṭve ityubhayatra rūpasya tulyatvāt? prathamāntatādau viśeṣe sandehaḥ syāt| `bahurāje` iti| karīṣasyeva gandho'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ, <> [[5.4.137]] itīc| karīṣagandherapatyamityaṇ, tasya `aṇiñoḥ` [[4.1.78]] ityādinā ṣyaṅādeśaḥ| `yaṅaścāp` [[4.1.74]] iti cāp| `aukāro'yam` ityādi| śīvidhau=śīvidhāne| aukāro'yaṃ sthānī ṅidgṛhīto ṅakārānuvandha upātta ityarthaḥ| ṅakāra idyasya sa ṅit| ṅiccāsmākaṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ matena śāstra aukāro nāsti| tataḥ ko'yaṃ prakāraḥ, kiṃśabda kutsāyāṃ vartate| kutsito'yaṃ sūtrapraṇayanaprakāra ityarthaḥ| kutsitatvaṃ tvasata evopādanāt| ṅakārāsañjanaprayojanapradarśanadvāreṇa kutsitatvaṃ sūtrapraṇayanasya nirakarttumāha - `sāmānyārthaḥ` iti| yadi hraukāro'nubandharahitaḥ sthānitvenopādīyeta, tataḥ `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|53) iti dvitīyādvivacanaṃ na gṛhreta| atha tsaya ṭakāro'nubandha upādīyeta, evamapi prathamādvivacanaṃ na gṛhreta| tasmāt? sāmānyena dvayorapi grahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ṅakāra āsajyate| nanu ca dvitīyādvivacane yaṣṭakāro nāsautasyānubandhaḥ, kasya tarhi? samudāyasya| pratyāharārthā hi ye'nubandhāste samudāyānubandhā eva vijñāyante, yathā - mahiṅo ṅakāraḥ, supaśca pakāraḥ| tasmānniranubandhakagrahaṇe dvayorapnubandhakatvāt? sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat? ki ṅakāreṇa? naitadasti; samudāyānubandhakatveṣa'vayavānubandhakatvamapi hreṣāṃ pratijñāyate| na hi samudāyānubandhakatve pratyayānubandhakatvaṃ virudhyate| hatsaṃjñako hranubandha ucyate, halaścāntyasyetsaṃjñā nidhīyate| auṭaśca ṭakāro yathā samudāyaṃ pratayantastathā pratyayaṃ pratyapi| tasmāt? tasya <> [[1.3.3]] itītsaṃjñāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ yathāsau samudāyaṃ pratyanubandhastathā pratyayamapi| prayojanābhāvāt? pratyayānubandhakatvamanupapannamiti cet? na; ihāsti prayojanam - dvitīyādvivacanasya sānubandhakatvaṃ yathā syāt| yadi tarhi pratyayānubandhastadā satyapi ṅakārāsañjane `tadanubandhakagrahaṇe nātadanubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|54) iti `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|52) iti ca prathamādvivacanasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, tasya hi ṅakāra evaiko'nubandhaḥ; dvitīyādvivacanasaya tu sa cānyo'pi ṭakāraḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, ṅakāroccāraṇasāmarthyāddvitīyādvivacanamapi grahīṣyate| antareṇaiva ṅakāraṃ prathamādvivacanasyaiva grahaṇe siddhe ṅakāra upadiśyate sāmānyārthaḥ| yadi ca satyapi ṅakāre prathamādvivacanameva gṛhrate ṅakāro'narthakaḥ syāt| kathaṃ punarasya ṅkārasyetsaṃjñā, yāvatopadeśe yo'ntyo hal? tasyetsaṃjñā vihitā, na cāyamupadeśe'ntyaḥ? bhavatu vā tasyetsaṃjñā, ṭakārasya auṭastarhi na syāt; kathaṃ hrekasminnupadeśe dvāvantyau syātām? naiṣa doṣaḥ, auṅiti vacanāt| dvayorapyaukārayorauṅityayamādeśo vijñāyate, tasya copadeśo'sti yathā `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ` [[2.4.54]] iti ñakāra upadeśe'ntya iti, yathā tasyetsaṃjñā tathā ṅakārasyāpi| ṭakārasya tu pūrvameva krameṇetsaṃjñā lopaśca kriyata iti nāsti da#oṣaḥ| yaścāsāvādeśa aukāraḥ sa eva śobhāṣasya sthānitvenanopātta iti veditavyam| `tasya ca` ityādinā - ṅakārāsañjane yo doṣaḥ prāpnoti taṃ darśayati| anubandhabhūtasaya ṅakārasyopādānamāsañjanam| ṅiti yat? kāryaṃ tat? `ṅitkāryam` - `saptamī` [[2.1.39]] iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| tatpanaḥ kāryaṃ `yāḍāpaḥ` [[7.3.113]] iti āṭ| yadi sāmānyārtho'yaṃ ṅakāra āsajyate, evaṃ sati ṅakārasyāsañjane ṅiti yatkāryaṃ tat? te=tava sūtrakārasya matena `śyāṃ prasaktaṃ` prāptam, `sa doṣaḥ`| `yāḍāpaḥ` [[7.3.113]] iti yāḍāgame sati khaṭve - iti rūpaṃ na sidhyet| ata śyāmiti kathamāmāṭau syātām? kathañca na syātām? anadītvāt; anadītvaṃ ca tasyāstryākhyatvāt? naitadasti; yathaiva hi khaṭvādayaḥ striyāṃ vartante tathā śīśabdo'pi| tathā cāha liṅgakārikākāraḥ - `īdūdantaṃ yaccaikāc? śaraddaraddṛṣatprāvṛṣaśca` iti| tasmāt? stryākhyatyādayamapi nadīsaṃjñaka eva; śrutitāmānādhikaraṇyāt| śrutau vartamānaḥ śīśabdo nadosaṃjñāṃ pratipadyate| śrutiḥ svarūpameva| `ṅittve` ityādi| `yāḍāpaḥ` [[7.3.113]] ityatra `dherṅiti` [[7.3.111]] ityato ṅidgrahaṇamanuvartate| tatra ṅiditi nāyaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ - ṅakāra id? yasya sa ṅiditi, kiṃ tarhi? tatpuruṣaḥ - ṅakāra eva id? ṅit| tasmādaukāro yo ṅit? tasminnabhyupete sati ṅitītyasminnirdeśe ṅakārasyetsaṃjñakasya varṇamātrasakya nirdeśaṃ vidyādavagacchet? prājñaḥ| mātraśabdastato'nyavyavacchedāya| yadi ṅitītyatra ṅakārasya varṇamātrasya nirddeśo na ṅakārānubandhasya pratyayasya tat? kimiti śyāṃ ṅitkāryaṃ na bhavati? ityāha - `varṇe` ityādi| varṇe parabhūte yat? kāryaṃ vidhīyate tat? `yasmin? vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) iti paribhāṣayā tadādau varṇādau vidyāt| tataśca yatra ṅakāra ādāvitsaṃjñakastatraiva bhavitavyaṃ yāṭā, na śyām| na hyatrādau ṅakāraḥ, kva tarhi? ante| evamayaṃ ṅittvamabhyupetya parīhāra uktaḥ| idānīṃ ṅittvamanabhyupetya parohārāntaramāha - `varṇaścāyam` ityādi| vārthe caśabdaḥ| varṇo vāyamiti yāvat| auṅityauvarṇau'yamupattaḥ pratyaviśeṣaṇārthaḥ, na tu pratyayaḥ| ahgādhikārādādantāt? paro yaḥ sāmarthyaprāptaḥ pratyayaḥ sa aukāreṇa viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatīti| tenāyamartho jāyate - aukārānte'sya pratyayasyeti| aukārāntatvaṃ vyapadeśivadbhāvāt| ṅakāraścāyaṃ nānubandhaḥ, mukhasukhārthastvayam, yathā - `ṛdorap` [[3.3.57]] ityatra dakāraḥ| varṇarūpatayā ca tathaukārasya grahaṇe sati dvayorapyaukārayoḥ śībhāvaḥ siddhau bhavati| pratyayagrahaṇe hi niranubandhaka (vyā|pa|53) paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate, na ceha pratyayagrahaṇam| kiṃ tarhi? varṇamātrasya| nanu ca dvāvapyetau pratyayau, tatkimiti nopatiṣṭate? satyam; yadyapi tau pratyau, tathadhāpi nātra śāstre pratyarūpeṇaukāra upāttaḥ? kiṃ tarhi? varṇarūpeṇeti, atastasyā nehopasthānam| ṅittvamanabhyupetya parīhārāntaramāha - `nirddeśo'yam` ityādi| neha vyākaraṇa aukārasaya ṅakāro'nuvagdha upādīyate| pūrvācāryāṇāṃ tu sūtre dve apyete dvivacane ṅitī paṭhaete| tathā hi `ābauṭāvauṅ` iti tatra sūtrapāṭhaḥ| atastatsatrānurodhenāyaṃ nirddeśaḥ, tasyeha grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| tasmānṅittvābhāvānnāsti ṅitkāryasya prasaṅgaḥ| na hi pūrvācāryasūtrānurodhenehānubandhakāryāṇi kriyante| `tena ṅittve'pyadoṣaḥ` iti| kiṃ punaryatra nāstyeva ṅittvamityapi śabdasyārthaḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - ṅittve'byupete sati ṅittve vidyādvarṇanirdeśamātram| `varṇe yatsyāt? tacca vidyāttadādau` ityevaṃ ṅitkārayaprasaṅganirāsāya yasmātad? parīhāra uktaḥ| yasmādvarṇaścāyamityanena, `nirdeśo'yaṃ pūrvasūtreṇa vā syāt` ityanena caukārayoṅittvabhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ| tena hetunā satyapi ṅittve'pyadoṣaḥ| kiṃ punarnāstyeva yatra ṅittvamiti||`dadhinī` iti| <<iko'ci vibhaktau>> [[7.1.73]] iti num||bahuvacanasya vasnasau| uktavidhayoriti| ṣaṣṭhaādiviśiṣṭayoryuṣmadasmadorityarthaḥ|`kṛtākāro'ṣṭanśabdo gṛhrate` iti| yatrātvaṃ tatrauśtvaṃ yathā syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `aṣṭau tiṣṭhanti` iti| ātve kṛta auśtvam| `aṣṭa tiṣṭhanti` iti| atrātvābhāvādauśtvaṃ na bhavati| kathaṃ punaratrātvābhāvaḥ, yāvatā na tatrātvavidhau vikalpasya pratipādakaṃ kiñcidanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇādikamasati? ityāha - `etadeva` ityādi| kṛtātvanirdeśasthaitadeva prayojanam - yatrātvaṃ tatraivauśatvaṃ yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi| yadi ca nityamātvaṃ syāt? tadā kṛtātvasya nirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt; vyavarttyābhāvāt? `aṣṭanaḥ` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| tadevaṃ laghunirdeśe sambhavati sati yat? kṛtātvasya nirdeśo garīyān? kriyate, tajjñāpayati - vikalpenātvaṃ bhavatīti| yadyapi cāyamarthaḥ <> [[6.1.172]] ityatrāpi jñāpitaḥ, tathāpi vismaraṇaśīlānāmanugrahāya punariha jñāpyate| athāṣṭaputraḥ, aṣṭabhārya ityatra kasmānna bhavati, <> [[2.4.71]] iti lukā bādhitatvāditi cet? na; ihāpi tarhi na syāt - aṣṭau tiṣṭanti, aṣṭau paśyeti| `ṣaṅbhyo luk? [[7.1.22]] iti lukā bādhitatvāt| athauśbhāvasya lugapavādatvādatra lukraṃ bādhitvā sa eva bhavati| pūrvatrāpi tarhi sa eva stāt, ata eva hetoḥ? ityāha - `ṣaṅbhyo lugityasyāpavādo'yam` iti| atraivopapattimāha - `nāprāpte` ityādi| `ṣaṅbhyo luk` [[7.1.22]] ityasamāse prāpnoti - aṣṭau tiṣṭhantītyādau, samāse ca - aṣṭaputra ityādau| tasmānnāprāpte aṣṭabhāryaḥ - ityatra sublukaiva bhavitavyamityauśatvaṃ na bhavati| `tadantagrahaṇam` ityādi| kiṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi labhyate? `aṅgādhikāre tasya taduttarapadasya ca` (pu|pa|vṛ|85) iti vacanāt| atha vā - aṣṭābhya ityarthapradhānanirdeśo'yaṃ bahuvacananirddeśādavasīyate| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe `aṣṭanaḥ` brāūyāt| arthācca śabdadvāreṇaiva jaśśasoḥ paratvaṃ vijñāyata iti kevalāccāṣṭano bhavati| tadantāccātadante'pi hi śabdadvereṇārthāt? parau jaśśasau bhavata iti| yadi tadantagrahaṇamatreṣyate, priyāṣṭana ityatrāpi prāpnoti? ata āha - `priyāṣṭanaḥ` ityādi| priyā aṣṭau yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| nanu ca vikalpenātvam| tatra yadātvaṃ na bhavati tadā mā bhūdauśtvam; yadātvaṃ tadā syādeva; vyavasthitavibhāṣayātrātvaṃ na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ||`pañca, sapta` iti| <> [[8.2.7]] iti nalopaḥ| `ṣaṭparadhānāt? tadantādapi bhavati` iti| atra pūrvako heturvakatavyaḥ| `yatra tu` ityādi| arthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ bahulavacanādavasitam| sa cārtho dvividhaḥ - pradhāno'pradhānaśca| tatra `pradāne kāryasampratyayaḥ` (vyā|pa|120) iti yatrārthasya prādhānyaṃ tatraiva bhavati, na tu yatrārthasyāprādhānyaṃ tatra| eṣa ca hetuḥ priyāṣṭāna ityatrauśtvābhāve'pi veditavyaḥ| `priyaṣaṣaḥ` iti| priyāṣaḍeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| atrānyapadārthasya prādhānyam, ṣaḍarthastu tatra guṇabhāvādapradhānaḥ||`su` iti yadyapi saptamībahuvacanamasti, tathāpyamā dvitīyaikavacanena sahacaryātprathamaikavacanameva gṛhrate| tadabrāāhṛṇakulamityatra paratvāt? tyadādayatvenaiva bhavitavyam, tyadādyatve kṛte lugna prāpnoti; `ato'm, [[7.1.24]] ityambhāvaprasaṅgāt, tasmāttyadādyatvātprāg? lugvaktavyaḥ? ityāha - `tadbrāāhṛṇakulamityatra` ityādi| luko'vakāśaḥ - dadhi, madhvityatra, tyadādyatvasyāvakāśaḥ - brāāhṛṇa iti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti - tadabrāāhṛṇakulamiti, lugbhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena| na ca pūrvavipratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ; iṣṭavācitvātparaśabdasya| `nityatvādvā` iti| vāśabdaḥ samuccaye| yadyapi luk, tyadādyatvañcobhayaṃ prāpnoti, tathāpi luka eva nityatvaṃ vijñāyate| kutaḥ? sāmarthāt| `lukā tyadādyatve bādhyate` ityatra hīdaṃ hetvantaramuktam| evañcedamatrārthe hetvantaraṃ sambhavati yadi luko nityatvaṃ bhavati, nānyathā, nityatvaṃ punaḥ kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt| tyadādyatvaṃ hi vibhaktāvucyamānaṃ kṛte luki vibhaktyabhāvānna prāpnoti| pratyayalakṣaṇena cāsya prāptinaṃ yuktā; <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratiṣedhāt| lukpunaḥ kṛte tyadādyatve prāpnotyakṛte'pi| nanu ca kṛte tyadādyatve lukaḥ prāptireva nāsti; `ato'm` [[7.1.24]] ityapavādavidhānāt| tasmātso'pyanitya eva? ityāha - `luko hi` ityādi| asati `ato'm` [[7.1.24]] iti lakṣaṇe'kārāntamapyaṅgaṃ luko nimittamāsīt, tadanena lakṣaṇenopajāyamānenāpavādavidhānāllukaṃ pratyanimittabhāvamāpadyate| lugnimittābhāvāpādanameva vighātaḥ| `na punastyadādyatvena` iti| luko nimittabhāvo vihanyata iti sambandhanīyam| yadi `ato'm` [[7.1.24]] ityapavādavidhāyi lakṣaṇāntaraṃ na syāt, kṛte tyadādyatve syādevākārāntamaṅgaṃ luko nimittam| tacca `ato'm` [[7.1.24]] ityapavādenaiva luko nimittaṃ vyāhanyate, na punastyadādyatvena| yadyevam? tatkimityanityo lugna bhavati? ityāha - `yasya ca` ityādi| lakṣaṇāntaratvaṃ lakṣaṇāntaratvaṃ punarambhāvaśāstrasya tyadādyatvaśāstrāpekṣayā veditavyam||pūrveṇa prāpatasaya luko'yamapavādaḥ| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham; na tu dīrghanivṛttyartham| dīrghasyābhāvāt| abhāvastu `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti hrasvavidhānāt| atha kimarthamambhāva ucyate, na makārādeśa evocyeta? na caivam; <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti dvitīyaikavacanākārasya makāre kṛte dvayormakārayoḥ śralaṇaṃ prāpnoti; ekasya saṃyogāntalopenāpahmatatvāt| nāpi `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti yañādau supi vidhīyamānaṃ dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti; `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya` (vyā|pa|12) iti vacanāt| akārāntasannipāte hi makāravidhiḥ, sa kathamakāravighātasya nimittaṃ syāt? evaṃ tarhi makārādeśe vighātavye'mā deśaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati - nityaiṣā paribhāṣeti| tenātijarasāt, atijarasairiti jarasādeśaḥ siddho bhavati||dviḍākāro'yaṃ nidrdaśaḥ - tatraiko ḍatarasambandhī dvitīyastvādeśambandhī| ḍatarādayaścaite sarvādyantaḥpātino gṛhyante; na tu `dvayorekasya ḍatarac` [[5.3.92]] ityevamādayaḥ pratyayāḥ| kuta etat? netarācchandasi` [[7.1.26]] iti pratiṣedhāt| pratyayagrahaṇe hītaraśabdāt? prāptereva nāstīti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| teṣāṃ ḍatarādīnāṃ madhye'ntyāni trīṇi prātipadikāni; ḍataraḍatamau ca pratyayau; tatra pratyagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho|pa|sū|7) tadantayogrrahaṇaṃ bhavati| `katarat` iti| `kiṃyattadornirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac` [[5.3.92]] | `katamat` iti| `vā bahunāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac` [[5.3.93]] | `katarat? tiṣṭhatītyatra` ityādi| asati hi ṅitkaraṇe katarat? tiṣṭhatītyatra <> [[6.1.101]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[6.1.102]] iti dīrghaḥ syāt, ataḥ sa mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ kriyate| atra hi kṛte dīrghatvaprasaṅgo na bhavati; ṭilopenā'ko'pahmatatvāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam - prathamaikavacanasyaiva ṅitkaraṇasya dīrghābhāvaḥ prayojanamucyate, na tu dvitīyaikavacanasya? ityata āha - `iha tu` ityādi| amo hi sthāne ya ādeśastasya <<sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau>> [[1.1.56]] iti sthānivadbhāvādami pūrvatvenāpi sidhyati - kataradityetat, tasmāt? tatra ṅitkaraṇasya dīrghatvābhāvaḥ prayojanamiti nocyate| `takārādeśa eva kasmānna kriyate` iti| yadyatra dīrghatvaṃ neṣyate tadā takārādeśa eva kartavyaḥ| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ - dīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ na kartavyamiti| `he katarat` ityādi| yadi takārādeśa eva kriyate tadā tasya sthānivadbhāvena sambuddhibhāvo'stīti <> [[6.1.69]] iti lopaḥ prāpnoti, ataḥ sa mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ takārādeśo na kriyate| `apṛktaśca` ityādi| <> [[6.1.68]] ityataścedapṛktagrahaṇaṃ sambuddhilope'nuvartate tadāmo doṣaḥ - he kuṇḍetyatra| nivṛtte'pṛktādhikāre ḍatarādiṣu doṣaḥ - he kataraditi| tasmāḍḍitkaraṇādevākāralope kṛte hyasavābhāvānna lopaḥ, na ca dīrghateti||pūrveṇādḍādeśasya prasakatasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| atha `ato'm` [[7.1.24]] ityasyānantaraṃ ` itarācchandasi` iti kasmānnoktam, evaṃ hi neti pratiṣedhaḥ kartavyo na bhavati, amādeśo'dḍādeśasyāpavādo bhaviṣyati? ityāha - `ato'mityasmādanantaram` ityādi| `yogavibhāgārtham` iti| netyekayogavibhāgo yathā syāditi| kimarthaṃ punaryogavibhāga iṣyate? ityāha - `ekatarāddhi` ityādi| ekaśabdāddhi sarvatra pratiṣedha iṣyate, sa ca neti yogavibhāgāllabhyate| tasmādyogavibhāga iṣyate| sa ca yathānyāse sidhyati; nānyatheti `netarācchandasi` ityucyate||yadi <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] ityantalopaḥ, tadāsya bhāve prāpta idaṃ vacanam| atha ṭilopaḥ, tadā vibhakteḥ śravaṇaprāpta ādeśārthaṃ vacanam| `tada svam, mama svam` iti| `tadamamau ṅasi` [[7.2.96]] iti maparyantayoryuṣmadasmadostavamamādeśau bhavataḥ| <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] iti dakaralope kṛte <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam| `śitkaraṇaṃ sarvādeśārtham` iti| asati śitkaraṇe <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityākārasyādeśo'kāraḥ syāt| nanu cākārasyākāravacane prayojanaṃ nāstītyantareṇāpi śitkaraṇaṃ sarvādeśo bhaviṣyati, antasya vā| tatra dvayorakārayorato guṇe pararūpatveneṣṭaṃ sidhyati? ata āha - `anyathā hi` ityādi| anyathā yadi śitkaraṇaṃ na syāt? tadā''deśa iti yo'yaṃ vyapadeśastasya yā prakḷptiḥ=niṣpattistadarthamādereva syāt; <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti vacanāt| syādetat - yadyādeśavyapadeśaprakḷptitaḥ kaścidarthaḥ sampadyate tadā syāt? tadarthamādereva vacanam, na ca tataḥ kaścidarthaḥ sampadyate tasmādayuktameveti? ityata āha - `tataśca` ityādi| caśabdo hetau| liṅ? sambhāvanāyām| tata ādeśavyapadeśaprakḷpteḥ `yo'ci` [[7.2.82]] iti kāryaṃ na syāt| etaddhi yatra vibhaktāvādeśo nāsti tatra vidhīyate; `anādeśe` [[7.2.86]] ityadhikārāt| tasmāt? prayojanavatyādeśavayapadeśaprakḷptiriti tadarthamādereva syāt, tataśceṭaṃ rūpaṃ na sidhyet| tasmāt? sarvādiśārthaḥ śakāraḥ kartavyaḥ||`ṅe ityavibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ` (iti)| `supāṃ suluk` [[7.1.39]] iti ṣaṣṭhaā luptatvāt| prathamayoriti ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanāntam - prathamā ca prathamā ca te prathame, tayoḥ prathamayoḥ| ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasyobhayatra tulyatvāt? prathamayoḥ pratyayayoḥ svaukārayogrrahaṇamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākartumāha - `vibhaktyoḥ` iti| etadeva spaṣṭīkartumāha - `prathamādvitīyayoḥ` iti| kathaṃ punardvitīyā prathamāśabdenocyate? upadeśe prathamāsāmīpyāt| bhavati hi sāmīpyāt? tācchabdyam, yathā - gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti| atha vibhaktyoridaṃ grahaṇaṃ na pratyayoḥ - iti kuto'yaṃ niścayaḥ? liṅgāt| tatpunarliṅgaṃ `dvitāyāyāñca` [[7.2.87]] ityattvavidhānam| taddhyādeśārthamucyate; anādeśe hi `yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe` nānyathā| nanu ca `yo'ci` [[7.2.89]] iti yatvabādhanārtham? `dvitīyāyāñca` [[7.2.87]] ityādvacanaṃ syāt? naitadasti; tadarthe dvivacane yakārameva viśeṣaṇaṃ vidadhyāt - `yo'cyadvitīyāyām` iti, `yo'cyanaci` iti vā drūyāta| ato dvitīyāyāmāttvavidhānaṃ jñāpakamevaitadvibhaktigrahaṇasya| `tabhyam, mahram` iti| maparyantayoryuṣmadasmadostabhyamahrāvādeśau| <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] , <> [[6.1.107]] | `tvam, aham` iti| <> [[7.2.94]] | `yuvām, āvām? iti| `yuvavau dvivacane` [[7.2.92]] iti yuvāvau, `prathāyaśca` [[7.2.88]] ityādinā'ttvam| `yūyam, vayam` iti| <> [[7.2.93]] | `tvām, mām` iti| tvamāvekavacane` [[7.2.97]] , `dvitīyāyāñca` [[7.2.87]] ityāttvam| atha kimarthamamādeśa ucyate, na makāra evocyate? sa caikāltvādāderbhaviṣyati, tatra parasya saṃyogāntalopena siddham, <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] iti ṭilopānna sidhyatīti cet? naiṣa doṣaḥ; seṣe lopo yadyapi ṭilopaḥ syāt, tathāpi <> [[7.2.94]] ityevamādīnāmakārāntatvāt? siddhyatyeva; te cāvaśyakamakārāntā vidheyāḥ, antodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| na ca makārādeśe `suci ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti; `aṅgavṛtte punaraṅgavṛttāvidhirniṣṭhitasya` (vyā|pa|38) iti vacanāt| evaṃ tarhi vaicitryārthamamādeśavidhānam| atha vā - makāra evādeśaḥ, akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ; na hranyathāsminnirdeśa ādāvante vā'kāramakṛtvā makāra ucacārayituṃ śakyate| `ṅetsuṭoḥ` iti| vaktavye `ṅe prathamayoḥ` iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham||pūrveṇāmādeśe prāpte śaso na vidhīyate| `yuṣmān? brāāhṛṇān| asmān? brāāhṛṇān` iti| <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityakārasya nakāraḥ, saṃyogāntalopaḥ, pūravavadāttvam| nanu caitadudāharaṇadvayamamādeśe kṛta āttve ca <> [[6.1.102]] iti dīrghatve ca <> [[6.1.103]] iti natvemaiva sidhyati? naitadasti; na hyatra pūrvasavaraṇadīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti, amipūrvatvena bādhitatvāt||`yuṣmabhyam, asmabhyam` iti| <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] ityantalopaḥ| yadi bhyamādeśo'yam, evaṃ sati tatra vihite śeṣelope ca `bahuvacane jhalyet` [[7.3.103]] ityettvaṃ prāpnoti, tataścāniṣṭarūpamāpadyeta? ityata āha - `bhyamādeśe kṛte` ityādi| vartanaṃ vṛttam, aṅge vṛttaṃ yasya tadaṅgavṛttaṃ kāryam, tasminnaṅgavṛtte kārye punarattarakālamaṅgavṛttāvaparasya kāryasya prāptau tasya kāryasyādidhiḥ;=avidhānam| niṣṭhitasyetyanena yatsamambandhinaḥ kāryasyāvidhirbhavati tadaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate| niṣṭhitam=parisamāptam, prayogārhamaṅgam| tatsambandhinaḥ kāryasyāvidhirbhavati, nānyasambandhina ityarthaḥ| `kecit` ityādi| teṣāmantyalope kṛte <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvaṃ bhavati| `yeṣāṃ tu` ityādi| yaiḥ <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] ityantalopaḥ kriyate, teṣāṃ matabhedaḥ - te hi kecidbhyamādeśamicchanti, kecidabhyamādeśam| yeṣāṃ tu śeṣelopaṣṭilopaḥ teṣāṃ matenāyamabhyamādeśa eva, na bhyamādeśaḥ; anyathā yuṣmabyamiti na sidhyevitayabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tarhi śeṣelopaṣṭilopaḥ, evaṃ sati <> [[6.1.161]] ityanenābhyamśabdasyāntodāttatvaṃ syāt? ityata āha - `udāttanivṛttisvaraśca` ityādi| pūrvapakṣavādinodāttanivṛttisvaravidhau <<karṣātvato ghaño'nta udāttaḥ>> [[6.1.159]] ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvartata iti manyamānena coditan| uttarapakṣavādinā tu `antagrahaṇaṃ tatra nivṛttamuccāraṇakramapratayāsattyā cāderevodāttatvena bhavituṃ yuktam` iti| manyamānena parihmatam||pūrveṇa prāptasya bhyamo'yamapavādaḥ||cakārodādeśānukarṣaṇārthaḥ, bhyasapekṣayā samuccayārtho vā| `ṅaseśca` iti| vaktavye, ekavacanakteti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham||`sama iti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamāgatasuṭkaṃ parigṛhrate` iti| yuṣmadasmadbhyāmuttarasyānyasya sāmaśabdasyāsambhavāt| āgataḥ samprāptaḥ suṭ? yatra yena vā tattathoktam| `atha` ityādau vākya `āgatasuṭkaḥ` ityāmpratyayāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgatvaṃ veditavyam! `atha kimarthamāgatasuṭkaḥ parigṛhrate` iti pṛṣṭasya sasuṭkasyādeśo yathā syāditi prativacanamāśahkyāha - `na hi` ityādi| <<āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ>> [[7.1.52]] ityatra <<ājjaserasuk>> [[7.1.50]] ityata āditi vartate, tenākārāntāt? sarvanāmnaḥ suṅ? vidhīyate| akārāntatā ca yuṣmadasmadoḥ <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] ityantalope sati bhavati| śeṣelopenāpyākamādeśe kṛte bhavitavyam| tasmādādeśavidhānakāle suṇna vidyate| tataśca sasuṭkasyādeśo yathā syādityetatprayojanaṃ nopapadyata ityanyadvaktavayamityabhiprāyeṇāha - `tasyaiva` ityādi| yadyasuṭko gṛhrate `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti` (vyā|pa|106) ityasuṭkasyaivādeśaḥ syāt| evañcābhinivṛtte sthānyādeśabhāve paścādbhavataḥ suṭaḥ kena nivṛttiḥ syāt? iṣyate ca tasyāpi nivṛttiḥ| atastasya bhāvino'pi nivṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ samuṭko gṛhrate| nanu ca yuṣmadasmadbhyāmuttarasyāmaḥ suḍeva na prāpnoti, akārāddhi sarvanāmnaḥ suṅ? vidhīyate, yuṣmadasmādośca tyadādyatvaṃ nāsti, `dviparyantāstyadādayaḥ` iti tyadādyatvasyābhāvāccheṣelopasya ca ṭilopādakārāntatā na sambhavati; ato bhāvino'pi suṭo nivṛttirnaiva prayojanamupapadyate? etaccodyamapākarttum? ``śeṣe lopaḥ` ityantalopaḥ` iti hmadi kṛtvā''ha - `kṛte hi` ityādi| atha kriyamāṇe samuṭkasya grahaṇe kathamasau nivartate, śāstrāntarāddhi prasaktasya śāstreṇa nivṛttiḥ kriyate, na cādeśavidhānakale suṭprasaṅgo'sti? ityāha - `sa ca sthānyantarbhūtatvāt` ityādi| yadyādeśavidhānakāle suṭaḥ prasaṅgaḥ sambhavet? tato bhāvī na nivartate, na cāsāvādeśakāle sambhavati| tasmādbhāvinaḥ suṭaḥ sasuṭkagrahaṇena sthānyantarbhūtatvādyasyāmavasthāyāṃ tasya prāptistasyāṃ prasaktaḥ sa nivartate; manyathā hi tasya sthānyantarbhāvo'narthakaḥ syāt| syādetat - yadi <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] ityantalopastataḥ samuṭakasyopādānamarthavadbhavati, yadā tu seṣelopaṣṭilopastadā nārthaḥ kasmānnāśrīyate, tasyānupapatteḥ| anupapattistu lakṣaṇābhāvāt| antyalopasyāsyaitadevāsti lakṣaṇamiti sa evāśritaḥ| yadyevam, yuṣmadbrāāhṛṇībhyogacchatītyantyalope sati `ajādyataṣṭāp` [[4.1.4]] iti ṭāpprasajyeta? `aliṅge yuṣmadasmadī` iti naiṣo'staprasaṅgaḥ| `dīrghoccāraṇam` ityādi| nanu cākamyapi akaḥ savarṇadīrghatve [[6.1.101]] na sidhyatyeva? na; sidhyati| `ato gaṇe` [[6.1.97]] iti pararūpatvamapavādaḥ prāpnotīti cet? na; akāroccāraṇasāmarthyāt| yadi ato guṇe` [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvaṃ syāt? tadākāroccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, kamityeva brāyādityata āha - `akami tu` ityādi| tuśabdo dīrghoccāraṇāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yadi hrakāroccāraṇasya prayojanaṃ na syāt, śakyate vaktum - akārocacāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti; asti ca tasaya prayojanam, kiṃ tat? `brāhuvacane jhalyet` [[7.3.103]] ityettvaṃ mā bhūt| tasmāt? satyapyakāroccāraṇa etattvanivṛttyarthe <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvaṃ syāt, na savarṇadīrghatvam| atastadarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kriyate||`tasyau` iti| <<śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ>> [[7.4.61]] iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ| `jaglau` iti| `kahoścuḥ` [[7.4.62]] iti cutvam| iha `pā` ityādibhyo ṇali paratravasthite yugapat? trīṇi kāryāṇi prāpnuvanti - dvivacanam, ekādeśaḥ, autvañca| teṣāñca tathā prāptānāṃ yugapatpravṛttiḥ sambhavatīti sāmarthyāt? prāptaḥ krama āśrīyate| tatra yena krameṇa tāni kartavyāni, taṃ darśayitumāha - `atra` ityādi| atretyanena papavityādīnyudaharaṇāni pratyayamuśyante| yadi dvirvacanādekādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ kriyate tadā <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhāvekādeśe kṛte nimittanimittinoviṃśeṣābhāvālliṭi parataḥ pūrvasyocayamānaṃ dvivacanaṃ na prāpnotīti tasya nirāsāyedamuktam - sthānivadbhāvo dvirvacanamiti| kena punaratra sthānivadbhāvaḥ? <<dvirvacane'ci>> [[1.1.59]] ityanena? naivam; dvirvacananimitte'pi parataḥ pūrvasyocyamānaṃ dvivacanaṃ na prāpnotīti tasya nirāsāyedamuktam - sthānivadbhāvo dvirvacanamiti| kena punaratara sthānivadbhāvaḥ? <<dvirvacane'ci>> [[1.1.59]] ityanena? naivam; dvirvacananimitte'ci parataḥ pūrvasaya sthānivadbhāva ucyate, na cātra dvirvacananimittaṃ paramacaṃ paśyāmaḥ| atra kcidāhuḥ - acītyupalakṣaṇam, aci ya ādeśo dṛṣṭaḥ sa dvirvacane kartavye sthānivadbhavatītīmaṃ sūtrārthamāśrityaitaduktam| iha sampratyanacparatve'pyekādeśakaraṇakāle'caḥ parasya nimittabhāvenaśrayaṇādacyayamādeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tasmādbhavitavyaṃ sthānivadbhāvena| anye tvāhu - `ekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhavatīti vaktavyam` ityanayeṣṭaā sthānivadbhāvaḥ| <<dvirvacane'ci>> [[1.1.59]] iti yogāvibhāgādvā sthānivadbhāvaḥ ityapare| kathaṃ punarayameṣāṃ kāryāṇāṃ krama upalabhyate? ityata āha - `ekādeśāt` ityādi| pā+a iti sthite'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ [[6.1.97]] prāpnoti, autvañca| tatraikādeśaḥ - daṇḍāgramityādau sāvakāśaḥ, autvaṃ tu na kvacit? sāvakāśam; atastāvadanavakāśatvāt? prāgautvaṃ kriyate, tatara kṛte vṛddhiḥ prāpanoti, dvavacanañca, tatra paratvādvṛddhirbhavati| dvivacanaṃ hi - papācetyādau sāvakāśam, vṛddhestvavakāśaḥ - khaṭvaiḍaketyādau| ato vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ paścādbhavati dvirvacanaṃ sthānivadbhāvena!`ṇalaḥ` iti| ṇakāroccāraṇaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| ṇalo ṇakāroccāraṇe hi ṇalpratyayo'stīti tasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati| tasmaścāsatyala ityucyamāne satyalpratyayasyābhāvāt? pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ vijñāyeta| lakāroccāraṇaṃ `śyādvyadha` [[3.1.141]] ityādinā vihitasya ṇapratyayasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham| atha `ekavacanasya` [[7.1.32]] ityanuvartate? tathā sati mukhasukhārtham||`jovatādbhavān` iti| <<āśiṣi liṅloṭau>> [[3.3.173]] iti loṭ? tip, śap? `eruḥ` [[3.4.86]] ityutvam, tasya tuśabdasya tātaṅ| jīvatāttvam` iti| sip, `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] iti hirādeśaḥ; tasya tātaṅ| `jīva tvam` iti| <> [[6.4.105]] iti herluk| atha jīvatāt? tvamityatra sthānivadbhāvena tātaṅo higrahaṇena grahaṇāllukkasmānna bhavati? `hujhalbhyo herghiḥ [[6.4.101]] ityato herityanuvartamāne punaḥ <> [[6.4.105]] iti grahaṇāt| tasya hretat? prayojanam - hirūpāvasthitasyaiva herlugyathā syāt| sthānivadbhāvena yacchabdāntaraṃ higrahaṇena gṛhrate tasya mā bhūt| atha `ṅicca` [[1.1.53]] iti vacanāt? tātaṅyamantyasya kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `ṅitkaraṇam` ityādi| gaṇapratiṣedhārtham - brāūyāt? bhavānityatra| vṛddhipratiṣedhārtham - mṛṣṭādityatra| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādguṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ tasmātsarvādeśastātaṅ bhavati| yadi hi tasyānyat? prayojanaṃ na syāt, syādevāntyasya tātaṅ| asti ca tasyānyat? prayojanaṃ guṇavṛddhiprataṣedhaḥ| tasmin? sati kiṃ `ṅicca` [[1.1.52]] ityantyasya bhavatu, atha <> [[1.1.55]] iti sarvasya vā? tatra paratvāt? sarvādeśenaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum| tasmāt? <> [[1.1.55]] iti sarvasya vā? tatra paratvāt? sardādeśenaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum| tasmāt? <> [[1.1.55]] iti sarvasyaiva syāditi sarvādeśo bhavati| nanu ca tusthānikasya tātaṅaḥ sthānivadabhāvena pittvaṃ prāpnoti; tataśca hali piti sārvadhātuke yatā brāvītvityatreṅ bhavati, tathā brāūtādbhavānityatrāṇīṭā bhavitavyam? - etaccodyamapākartamāha - `ṅittvācca` ityādi| asyeti tātaṅaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ nivartate? ityāha - `ṅicca` ityādi| cakāro hetau| tusthānikasya tātaṅo nāprāpte pittve ṅittvamārabhyata iti ṅittvena hi pittvaṃ bādhyate| tathāsau ṅidbhavata yadi sthānivadbhāvena prāptaṃ pittvaṃ nivartate| `tena` ityādi| yata evaṃ pittvaṃ nivartate tena pittvāśraya īṇna bhavati| grāmaṃ gacchatu bhavān| tvaṃ gaccheti| `loṭ? ca` [[3.3.62]] iti bidhyādau loṭ||yadyapi videriti sāmānyanirdeśo'yam, tathadhāpi jñānārthasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tasyaiva hi śatānantaraḥ sambhavati, nānyeṣāṃ vidīnām| tatra sattāvicāraṇārthayoḥ śaturasambhava eva; ātmanepaditvam| lābhārthasya tūbhayayaditvāt? sambhavatyasau, na tvanantaraḥ; śapratyayena vyavadhānāt| jñānārthasya tu lugvikaraṇatvācchaturvikaraṇakṛtaṃ vyavadhānaṃ nāsti, atastasyaiva grahaṇamityāha - `vida jñāne` iti| `vidvān` iti| ugittvānnum, <> [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate| tena pakṣe vidan, vidantau, vidanta ityādyapi bhavati| ecaca gamyamānatvādvṛttau noktam| atha kimarthamukāro'nubandhaḥ kriyate, numādyugitkāryaṃ yathā syāditi cet? na; tasya sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddhatvādityata āha - `sthānivadbhāvāt` ityādi| `kvaso'pi` iti| apiśabdādasyāpi| asatyukāre sāmānyārthe kvasoreva grahaṇaṃ syāt, nānyasya| atha <> [[6.4.131]] iti sūtraṃ kriyata evāsyaiva grahaṇārtham, na kvasoḥ; nanu ca satyapyukārakaraṇe sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate, ekānubandhakapari(vyā|pa|52) bhā,yāsyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na kvasoḥ? ityāha - `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe` ityādi| etat? paribhāṣāsūtram| na bhavati| nopatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na bhavati? ityāha - `tathā ca sati` ityādi| evañca satītyarthaḥ| yadi kriyamāṇe'pyukāra ekānubandhaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate, evaṃ satyukārakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| vinā'pi tena `vasaḥ samprasāraṇam` ityucyamāne kevalasyāsya grahaṇaṃ labhyata eva| tasmādukārakaraṇasāmarthyādiyaṃ paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate||`anañpūrve` iti| na nañ? kathañcaṃ na syāt? sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt? vārtametat; kartari ktvā vihitaḥ, sa eva ca paramottamaśabdābhyāṃ viśiṣyate, tat? kathaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ! atha kriyāviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tayorāśritya sāmānādhikaraṇyabhāva ucyate, evamapi <> [[2.1.57]] ityato bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterasāmānādhikaraṇye'pi samāso bhavati| nanu cānañpūrvāvetau samāsau, tat? na bhavati, na tatrāvyayena nañā sādṛśyamasti| atyantābhedādanavyayatvācca yathākramam| tasmād? yathā akṛtvā, ahatvetyetat? pratyudāharaṇamupapannarūpam, evaṃ paramakṛtvā, uttamakṛtveyapi| yadi tarhi anañiti nañsadṛśamadhyayaṃ parigṛhrate - snātvākālakaḥ, pītvāsthiraka ityādāvapi syāt, asti hyatrāpi nañsadṛśamadhyayaṃ pūrvapadam; ktvāpratyayasyāvyayatvādityāha - `snātvākālakaḥ` ityādi| mayūravyaṃsakādiṣu samāsasaṃjñārthamete samudāyāḥ paṭhante, tasmānnipātanāllyabādeśo na bhavati| `atha vā` ityādi| `samāse` ityadhikaraṇasaptamyāṃ satyāṃ snātvākālakādiṣu lyabādeśaprasaṅgo bhavatīti| tathā hradhikaraṇasaptamyāmayamartho bhavati - samāse'nañpūrve yaḥ ktvā vartate tasya lyabbhavati| evañca sati deśaviśeṣaparigrahābhāvādyathā samāsasyānte vartamānasya ktvo lyabbhavati, tathā madhye'pi syāt| tasmānna ceyamadhikaraṇasaptamī, kiṃ tarhi? nirghāraṇasaptamī| tasmaśca pakṣe `samāse` iti jātāvekavacanam, yathā - `kārake` [[1.4.23]] iti| atha vā <> [[3.1.85]] iti subvyatyayena bahuvacanasya sthāna ekavacanaṃ veditavyam| `tena` ityādi| yato nirdhāraṇa iyaṃ saptamī, tena ktvāntaḥ samāsa eva gṛhrate, na samāsāvayavaḥ - snātveti| nirghāraṇaṃ hi samānajātīyasyaiva bhavati, yathā - kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannakṣīratametyukte gaureva nirdhāryamāṇā pratīyate, tathā'trāpi `samāso'nañpūrve` ityukte samāseṣvanañpūrveṣu madye yaḥ ktvāntaḥ samāsaḥ sa eva nirdhāyamāṇaḥ pratīyate| tena samāsasyaiva ktvāntasya grahaṇamiti tasyaiva lyabādeśena bhavitavyam, na ca snātvākālakādiṣu ktvāntaḥ samāsaḥ| snātvākālakādayo yadyapi samāsāḥ, na tu ktvāntā iti lyabādeśo na bhavati| sa ca samāsaḥ <> [[1.1.72]] iti tadantavidhinā ktvānto gṛhrate| kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇena (vyā|pa|126) vā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho|pa|sū|7) tadantagrahaṇaṃ na śakyate vaktum| na hi ktvāpratyayaḥ samāsādutpadyate| tatra yadi kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|126) tadanto gṛhrate, nānākṛtyetyatra na syāt; na hrayaṃ gatikārakapūrvaḥ| ihaiva tu syāt - prakṛtya, pār(ātaḥkṛtyeti| asiti hyatrāpi gatiḥ kārakaśca pūrvo'vayavaḥ, <> [[1.1.72]] ityanena tadantavidhau gamyamāne sarvatra bhavatīti manyamāna āha - `sa ca` ityādi| atraivopapattimāha - `tathā ca` ityādi| yasmāt? kathaṃ cādiśabdena te śakyā lakṣayitum? ityāha `prakārārtho'yamādiśabdaḥ` iti| evamprakārā ya etatsadṛśāḥ śabdāste snātvyādayo veditavyaḥ||jaseriti pūrvācāryanirddeśaḥ| pūrvācāryā hi jasirityevaṃ vihatavantaḥ| `ye pūrvāso ye parāsa ityatra` ityādi codyam| etacca jātau padārthe| tatrānyatra caritārthatvācchāstrayostulyabalayorvirodhe sati paraspara pratibandhādapravṛttau prāptāyāṃ <> [[1.4.2]] iti kriyate - vipratiṣedhe paraṃ bhavati, tatra kṛte yadi pūrvamapi prāpnoti tadapi bhavatīti jātipadārthaḥ puna prasaṅgavijñānasya viṣayaḥ| `sakṛt` ityādinā parīhāraḥ| eva ca ṣyakto padārthe'nyatrākṛtārthatvāddvayorapi śāstrayorīdṛśe viṣaye paryāyeṇa pravṛttau prāptāyāmayaṃ niyama ārabhyate - vipratiṣedhe parameva bhavati, na pūrvamiti| tena punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānābhāvādbādhitaḥ śobhāvo na bhavati| na hrasati punaḥprasaṅge yadvādhitaṃ tadutsahate punarbhavitum||`ātmaprītau` iti| viṣayasaptamīyam| ata evāha - `ātmaprītiviṣaye kyaci` iti| ātmaprītirviṣayo yasya kyacaḥ sa tathoktaḥ| `aāsyati` iti| ātmano'āmicchatīti `supaḥ ātmanaḥ kyac` [[3.1.8]] anenāsuk, ato guṇe` [[6.1.94]] pararūpatvam| evaṃ `kṣīrasyati` ityādāvapi veditavyam| sarvatrātmaprītiviṣaye kyac| yo hrātmano'āādikamicchati sa niyogata ātmanaḥ protyarthamicchati| yadyevam, icchāyāṃ kyacvidhīyamānaḥ sarvatrātmaprītiviṣaye bhaviṣyatītīcchāyāṃ vaktavyam? tadā sarveṣām? `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ` [[7.1.54]] iti nuṭ? prasajyeta, tatrāpyetadevāmgrahaṇamanuvartate, ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasyaiveṣyate atastadeva gṛhrata ityāha - `tasya hi paratvāt` ityādi| suṭo nuṭaśca ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamavakāśaḥ, āṭprabhṛtīnāṃ tu caturarthyekavacanādiḥ ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ` [[7.3.116]] iti paratvādāḍādayo bhavanti| tatra <<āṇnadyāḥ>> [[7.3.112]] ityāṭ - kumāryāmiti| `yāḍāpaḥ` [[7.3.113]] iti yāṭ - khaṭvāyāmiti| `tarvanāmnaḥ syāṅḍhrasvaśca` [[7.3.114]] iti syāṭ - sarvasyāmiti| yastarhi ghāntādām? yathā syāt? ityata āha - `iha tu` ityādi| `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirddeśo balīyān` (śāka|pa|97) iti <> [[1.1.67]] iti `sarvanāmnaḥ` ityanayā pañcamyā āmītyasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaāṃ parikalpitāmāma eva suṭā bhavitavyamiti nāstīha nirddeśasya prayojanam||<> [[7.1.54]] iti prāpte vacanam| `trayāṇām` iti| `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghaḥ| nanu ca `ṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau` [[7.4.75]] iti nipātanādeva siddham, tatkimarthamidamārabhyate? ca` (paṃ|u|3|160) itīrmuṭ? ca| `brāhṛbandhūnam` iti| brāhṛā bandhurāsāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ūṅutaḥ [[4.1.66]] ityūṅ| `khaṭvānām` iti| `ajādyataṣṭāp` [[4.1.4]] | `bahurājānām` iti| `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām` [[4.1.13]] iti ḍāp| `kārīṣagandhyānām` iti| kārīṣagandherapatyamityaṇa| tasya `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ` [[4.1.78]] ityādinā ṣyaṅādeśaḥ, `yaṅścāp` [[4.1.74]] iti cāp||`pañcānām` iti| <> [[6.4.7]] iti dīrghaḥ, `nalopaḥ prātipadakāntasya` [[8.2.7]] iti nalopaḥ| `ṣaṣṇām` iti| <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti ṣakārasya ḍakāraḥ, <> [[8.4.45]] iti ḍakārasya ṇakāraḥ, <<ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ>> [[8.4.41]] iti nakārasya ṇakāraḥ| <<ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ>> [[1.1.24]] iti rephāntāyā api saṃkhyāyāḥ kasmānna vihitā ṣaṭsaṃjñeti, evaṃ satīha cutugrrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati? saṃkhyāpradhānasyaiva ṣaṭhsaṃjñakasya catuḥśabdasya ca grahaṇam| tasya cedaṃ prayojanam - yatra saṃkhakyāyāḥ prādhānyam, tena tadantādapi bhavati| arthapradhāne hi nirdeśe'rthagrahaṇetadbhavati, arthācca śabdadvāreṇaivāmaḥ paratvaṃ vijñāyate| ataḥ kevalebhyaḥ ṣadcaturbhyo bhavati, tadantācca| tadantādapi śabdadvāreṇaivāmaḥ paratvaṃ bhavatyeva| `upasarjanobhūtāyāstu` ityādi| bahuvacananirdeśādvi saṃkhyārthasyedaṃ grahaṇam| sa cārtho dvividhaḥ - pradhānaḥ apradhānaśca| tatra pradhāne kāryasampratyayādyatra saṃkhyāyāḥ prādhānyaṃ tatra tadantādapi bhavati| yatra tūpasarjanībhūtā saṃkhyā tatra na bhavati - priyaṣaṣāmityādau| anyapadārthasya hyatra prādhānyam, saṃkhyāyāstvaprādhānyam| `priyapañcñāma` iti| allope [[6.4.134]] kṛte <> [[8.4.40]] iti ścutvam||śrīgrāmaṇyoriti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| `nityārthaṃ `vacanam` iti| śrīśabdasya, na tu grāmaṇīśabdasya| tastu tu prāptyarthameva| yathaiva hi bhāṣāyāṃ nadīsaṃjñāpakṣe `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ` [[7.1.54]] iti sidhyati tathā chandasyapi| tasmānnitya yathā syādityevamartham| asati hrasmin? yadā nadīsaṃjñā, tadaiva syāt, nānyadā| `yadā sūtāśca` ityādi| etenaitaddarśayati - yadā sūtaśabdasya grāmaṇīśabdena saha karmadhārayaḥ kriyate tadā sūtagrāmaṇīśabdo na hrasvāntaḥ na nadyantaḥ, nāpyābanta iti na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca, tato yathā syādityavamarthaṃ vacanam| yadā sūtagrāmaṇīśabdayoḥ `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati` (pu|pa|vṛ|50) ityekavadbhāvī dvandvaḥ, tadā <> [[2.4.17]] iti napuṃsakatvāt, `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti hrasvatvaṃ kṛtvā bahūnāṃ sūtagrāmaṇīśabdānāmekaśeṣañca, tataḥ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanaṃ vidhīyate| tadā hrasvāntatvādeva siddhamiti nārthastavarthena vacanena||`ṛkpādānte vartamānāt` iti| chandasi ṛkpāda eva sambhavati, na ślokapāda iti ṛkpādagrahaṇam|| `kuṇḍitā, huṇḍatā` iti| `kuḍi dāhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-270), `huḍi saṅghāte` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-269) - ābhyāṃ tṛc, iṭ, `ṛduśanas` [[7.1.94]] ityādinānaṅ|`kimayaṃ dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva numu vidhīyate?
