bhavatītyavasīyate| kathaṃ punardhātūpadeśāvasthāyāṃ num? bhavatītyavasīyate, yāvatātropadeśagrahaṇaṃ nāsti? ityāha - `tathā hi` ityādi| `dhinvikṛṇṣyora ca` [[3.1.80]] ityupratyayavidhānakāle numanuṣaktayogrrahaṇaṃ sanumkayoreva prakṛtatavaṃ yathā syāt| evaṃ sanumkayoḥ parakṛtatvaṃ bhavati yadyupadeśāvasthāyāmeva num? bhavati, nānyathā| tasmānnumanuṣaktayogrrahaṇājjñāpakādavasīyate - dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num? bhavatāt| tasya hratat? prayojanam - upadeśāvasthāyāmeva num? yathā vijñāyeteti| na hi tannumarthaṃ prayujyate; num? bhavatīti| tasya hratat? prayojanam - upadeśāvasthāyāmeva num? yathā vijñāyeteti| na hi tannumarthaṃ prayujyate; numa bhavitavyam, tatra lakṣaṇavaśādeva `dhinvikṛccyora ca` [[3.1.80]] iti numanuṣaktayogrrahaṇam, tatkathamasyārthasya grahaṇaṃ jñāpakam? naitadasti; na hi <> [[3.1.80]] ityayamikā nirdeśaḥ, sa hi `rogākhyāyāṃ ṣvul? bahulam` [[3.3.108]] iti bahulavacanena sannidhānāt? kvacideva bhavati na sarvatra| evañca <> [[3.1.5]] ityevamādayo nirdeśā upapadyante| tasmāt? `dhinvikṛṇvyoḥ` [[3.1.80]] iti nāyamikā nirddeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? uccāraṇārthenekāreṇa, yathā - `indhibhavatibhyām` [[1.2.6]] ityatrekāreṇa nirddeśaḥ; anyathā `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ syāt| athāpi hi `dhinvikṛṇvyoḥ` [[3.1.80]] itīkā nirdeśaḥ syāt, evamapi yadi dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva numbhavatītyayamartho jñāpayituṃ nābhīṣṭaḥ syāt, tato lāghavārthamanitayatvādāgamaśāsanasya numamakṛtvaiva nirddeśaṃ kuryāt, yathā - <> [[7.1.1]] ityatra dvandvaikavadbhāvapakṣa uktam| tasmānnumanuṣaktayogrrahaṇaṃ jñāpakameva dhātugrahaṇādapyavasīyate| numupadeśāvasthāyāmeva bhavatīti darśayitumāha - `dhātugrahaṇaṃ ca` ityādi| dhātusaṃjñāpravṛttikālo dhātūpadeśakālaḥ, tatraiva num? bhavatītyevamarthamiha dhātugrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tasmādato'pi dhātugrahaṇādupadeśavasthāyā meva num? bhavatīti jñāyate, na hranyaddhātugrahaṇasya prayojanamastītyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca bhettā, abhaitsodityatrāghātvostāsiscoriditīrnum? mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ syāt? ityāha - `tāsisicoḥ` ityādi| yadi tāsisicoriditkāryaṃ syāt, tadekārasyetsaṃjñārthamanunāsikatvaṃ pratijñāyeta, na cāsti prayojanamiti na pratijñāyate; tataśca niranunāsiko'pratilabdhetsaṃjñaka uccāraṇārthaṃ evānayorikāraḥ paṭhata iti numaḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti, tat? kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena dhātugrahaṇena! nanu cāraṃsta, amaṃsta, manta#ā, saṃgantetyatra `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityanunāsikalopo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tāsisicoriditkāryam, tat? kimucyate iditkāryaṃ tāsisicornāsti? ityata āha - `araṃsta, amaṃsta` ityādi| <> [[1.2.14]] iti kittvavidhāvasyaitatprayojanam - āhatetyatrānunāsikalopo yathā syāt| yadi sijntasyānunāsikalopaḥ sārvadhātukaṅittvamāśritya syāt? <> [[1.2.14]] iti kittvamanarthakaṃ syāt, prayojanābhāvāt? naitadasti; asti hranyat? kittvavidhānasya prayojanam - `anudāttopadeśa` [[6.4.37]] ityādinā sicyanunāsikalopo yathā syāditi; `anidatām` [[6.4.24]] ityādinā sijantasya sārvadhātuke mā bhūditi| kaḥ punaratra viśeṣaḥ - sārvadhātuke ṅiti vā? sici kiti vā? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ - samānāśraye sicyanunāsikalopasyāsiddhatvādato lopo [[6.4.48]] na bhavati; sārvadhātuke tūpadhālope tasya vyāśrayatvenāsiddhatvābhāvādato lopaḥ syādeva| naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ; ato lopavidhau `anudāttopadeśa` [[6.4.37]] ityādeḥ sūtrādupadeśagrahaṇamanuvartate, tenārthadhātukopadeśe yadakārāntamaṅgaṃ tasya lopo vijñāyate; na cāhatetyatropadeśenkārāntametat| tasmāt? <> [[1.2.14]] iti kittvavidhānasāmarthyādaraṃstetyādau nakāralopo na bhavati| tadevaṃ sica iditkāryaṃ na bhavatīti pratipāditam| idānīṃ tāserapyanunāsikalopābhāva iditkāryaṃ na bhavatīti pratipādayitumāha - `mantā` ityādi| nakāralopo na bhavatīti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| upadhānakārasya `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityādinā lopa ucyate| na ca maktetyatra nakāra upadhā bhavati; ṭilopasyāsiddhatvāt| tasmāt? tāserapīditkāryaṃ na vidyate| tataśca yuktamuktam - `tāsisicoriditkārya nāsti` iti| atha numāgama iditkāryaṃ kasmānna bhavati? aniṣṭatvāt| na hraniṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ śāstre parikalpayituṃ yuktam| yadi tarhi tāserniranunāsika ikāraḥ uccāraṇārthaḥ, evaṃ tarhi <> [[3.1.33]] ityatra yaduktam - `iditkaraṇamanunāsikalopapratibandhartham`, tatkathaṃ na virudhyate? yathā na virudhyate tadā tatraivoktam| atha bhidirityevamādīnāṃ num? kasmānna bhavati, sti hreṣāmapīkāra itsaṃjñakaḥ? ityāha - `haritām` ityādi| bhidirprabhṛtayo hīritaḥ, na tviditaḥ; yasmāt? `ira upasaṃkhyānam` (1.3.7|vā) iti rephekārasya samudāyasya teṣāmitsaṃjñā, na pratyekamavayavasya| tatreditāmucyamāno num? kaḥ prasaṅgo yadiritāṃ syāt!syādetat - <<upadeśe'janunāsika it>> [[1.3.2]] itītsaṃjñekārasya, <> [[1.3.3]] iti rephasya, tasmādastyeva teṣāmidittvam? ityāha - `avayavasyāpi` iti| gatārtham||mucādayastudādau paṭhante `muclṛ mokṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1430) ityataḥ prabhṛtyā gaṇaparisamāpteḥ|`moktā` iti| tṛc, `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] itīṭprataṣedhaḥ, `co kuḥ` [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam| `ke punastṛmphādayaḥ` iti| evaṃ manyate - tṛmphādiṣu tṛphādayo niranuṣaṅgā api gaṇe paṭhante - `tṛphatṛnpha tṛptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1307,1308) ityevamādayaḥ| tatra yadi te'pi tṛphādigrahaṇena gṛhreran, tṛphatītyādi rūpaṃ nopapadyata ityata āha - `ye tatra sānuṣaṅgāḥ paṭhante, te tṛmphādayaḥ` iti| ādiśabdo'yaṃ prakārārthaḥ, prakārastu sādṛśyam, tasmāt? tṛmphatinā sānuṣaṅgeṇa ye sadṛśāḥ, ta evādigrahaṇenopalakṣyanta ityabhiprāyaḥ| `sānuṣaṅgāḥ` iti| nakāro'nuṣaṅgaḥ, tena saha vartanta iti sadṛśāḥ, ta evādigrahaṇenopalakṣyanta ityabhiprāyaḥ| `sānuṣaṅgāḥ` iti nakāro'nuṣaṅgaḥ, tena saha vartanta iti sānu,ṅgāḥ| yadi tarhi ye sānuvaṅgāḥ paṭhante te tṛmphādayaḥ, teṣāṃ numi kṛte parasyānusvāre kṛte tasya parasavarṇe dvayornakārayoḥ śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āhma - `teṣām` ityādi| kṛte hi nakāralope num? vidhīyate| ato na bhavatyeva doṣa iti bhāvaḥ| atha so'pi num? kasmānna lupyate? ityāha - `sa ca` ityādi| yadi so'pi lupyeta, numo vidhānamanarthakameva syāditi manyate| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `dhātoḥ` [[7.1.58]] ityanuvartate, `śe` iti yogavibha#āgaḥ kriyate, tena tṛ-mphādīnāñca num? bhaviṣyati| mucādīnāmityevamanarthakaṃ syāt, `śe` ityanena siddhatvāt? nānarthakam, `śe` ityasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthatvāt| evapaṃ hratiprasaṅgo na bhavati| kathaṃ mucādiṣveva tṛmphādayo na paṭhitāḥ? ye'tra niranuṣaṅgāḥ paṭhante teṣāṃ numāgamo mā bhūdityevamartham||`maṅktā` iti| `ṭumasjo śuddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1415), tṛc, pūrvavadiḍabhāvaḥ, kutvañca, antyājjakārāt? pūrvo num, `skoḥ` [[8.2.29]] ityādinā sakāralopaḥ, anusvatraparasavarṇo| `neṣṭā` iti| <> [[7.2.45]] iti yadeṇnāsti tadāyaṃ num, vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, ṣṭutvam| iṭpakṣe jhalāditvābhāvānnum? nāsti - naśiteti| `majjanam, naśanam` iti| lyuṭ, <> [[8.4.53]] iti jaśtvam - sakārasya dakāraḥ, tasya catvaṃ jakāra-| `masjeḥ` ityādi| yadi masjerantyādacaḥ paro num? syāt, asaṃyogaditvāt? malopo na prāpnoti, anupadhatvānna nalopaḥ, sa ceṣyate; anyathā magno mānavāniti na sidhyat| tasmādantyātpūrvamācāryā masjernumamicchanti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pyayamartho labhyate? naśeralpāctarasya pūrvanipātalakṣamavyabhicāracihnāt| sa hi lakṣaṇanirapekṣatāṃ sūcayan? <<midaco'ntyātparaḥ>> [[1.1.47]] ityetadapīha lakṣaṇaṃ nāpeśrata iti sacayati| tasmaścānapekṣite lakṣyānurodhādyatra masjernumi kṛte satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati tatraiva vidhīyate| tena masjerantyāsparvaṃ num? siddho bhavati| `magnaḥ` iti| <> [[8.2.45]] iti niṣṭhānatvam||`randhayati` iti| `radha hiṃsāsaṃrāddhyāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1193) hetumaṇṇic| `rabdhakaḥ` iti ṇvula| `sādhurandhī` iti| <> [[3.2.78]] iti ṇiniḥ| `randhaṃrandham` iti| `ābhīkṣaṇye| ṇamul` [[3.4.22]] , `ābhīkṣaṇye dve bhavataḥ` (vā|887) iti dvirvacanam| `randho vartate` iti| bhāve ghañ| atha randhayatītyādiṣu paratvāt? <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, sā kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha - `parāpi satī` ityādi| nityatvaṃ panaḥ kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnumaḥ| sa hi kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhau prāpnotyakṛtāyāmapīti nityaḥ; vṛdadhistu numi kṛte na prāpnotyakārasyānupadhatvādityanityā| `raddhā` iti| <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti takārasya dhakāraḥ, dhātudhakārasya jaśtvam - dakāraḥ||pūrveṇa prāptasya numaḥ pratiṣedha ucyate| `radhitā` ityādi| <> [[7.2.45]] itīṭ| `rarandhiva, rarandhima` iti| krādiniyamādiṭ? [[7.2.13]] `parasmaipadānām` [[3.4.82]] ityādinā vasmasorvamādeśau|nanu radhirayamasaṃyogāntaḥ paṭhate, tatra `asaṃyogālliṭ? kit` [[1.2.5]] iti kittve `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] iti nalopaḥ prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `numi kṛte` ityādi| `upadeśāvasthāyāmeva num? bhavati` ityuktametat, tenopadeśāvasthāyāmeva numi kṛte saṃyogāntatvaṃ jātamiti kittvaṃ nāstīti na bhavati nalopaḥ| `atha kvasau kathaṃ bhavitavyam` iti| kiṃ rarādhvāniti bhavitavyam, uta redhivāniti pṛcchati| apara āha - `redhivāt` iti| liṭaḥ <> [[3.2.107]] iti kvasuḥ, dvirvacanam, `ata ekahalmadhye` [[6.4.120]] ityādinaittvāṃbhyāsalopau, <> [[7.2.67]] itīṭ? num, <> [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ| `katham` ityādi| evaṃ manyate - yadeṅ? bhavati tasmaśca numā bhavitavyam, numi ca satyekahalmadhyatā nāstītyettve'byāsalopayoḥ punaḥ pratyāpattyā bhavitavyam, tataśca kṛtadvirvacana ekāṇna bhavatītīṭā na bhavitavyam; tasmādraradhvāniti yuktaṃ bhavitumiti| itarastu kṛtasayāpi numo'tri lopena bhavitavyam, tataścaikahalmadhyatābhāvo nopapadyate, kutaḥ punarettvābhyāsalopayoḥ pratyāpattiḥ? ityāha - `ettvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayoḥ` ityādi| kṛtadvirvacanānāmekācāṃ kvasoriṅ vidhīyate| `tato numāgamaḥ` iti| aci tadvidhānāt? tasyaupadeśikattvāśrayo lopa ityaupadeśikagrahaṇānnumi kṛte saṃyogāntatvādātideśikasya kittvasyāsambhavāt| `atha` ityādi| iṭi `neṭi` [[7.2.4]] ityucyamāne purveṇa siddhe sati niyamarthametadbhaviṣyati - liṭaeveḍādau, nānyasminniḍādāviti| tena rarandhiva, rarandhimetyādau bhaviṣyati, na radhitetyevamādau| tasmādiṭiliṭīti kasmānnoktam, evaṃ satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, laghu ca sūtraṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `liṭaeva` iti| niyamasvarūpaṃ darśayati| `nānyatra` ityanenāpi tasya vyavacchedyam| yato hetorniyamo na kriyate, taṃ darśayitumāha - `viparītam` ityādi| `iṭaeva liṭi` iti| viparītaniyamasaya svarūpakathanam| `nānyatra` ityanenāpi taddhyavacchedyaṃ darśayati| kasmādviparītamavadhāraṇaṃ neṣyate? ityāha - `tathā hi` ityādi| iṭaeva liṭītyasya niyamasyāniḍādirlliṅvyāvarttya itīḍādāveva liṭi bhavati, nāniḍādāviti| tataścāniḍāditvādrarandhetyatra num? na syāt| radhitetyatra pūrvema syādeva; niyamenāvyāvarttitatvāt| tasmāttaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā niyamo na kriyate||`ārebhe` iti| `rabha rābhasye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-974) liṭ, anudāttettvādatmanepadam| <> [[3.4.81]] ityeśū, pūrvavadettvābhyāsalopau||`pṛthagyogakaraṇamuttarārtham` iti| uttaratrūtreṇa labhereva kāryaṃ yathā syāt| rabhermā bhūditi| yadi `rabhilabhyoraśavliṭoḥ` ityeko yogaḥ kriyate, tato rabhirityanuvṛttiruttaratra syāt| ataśca tasyāpyuttaratra kāryaṃ prasajyeta||`yakārādau pratyaya` iti| anena `yi` ityasyāḥ saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayan? yakārādau pratyaye vavayabhūte'nutpanna eva num? bhavatīti darśayati| `prāk` ityādinā viṣayasaptamyāṃ satyāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate tadācaṣṭe| parasaptamyāṃ hi pūrvaṃ pratyayena bhavitavyam, paścānnumā, tataśca `adupadhāt` [[3.1.98]] iti yat? prasajyeta| viṣayasaptamyāṃ tu prāgutpannena numā'dupadhatvasya vihatatvāt? `ṛhaloṇryat` [[3.1.124]] ita ṇyadeva bhavati| kaḥ punaṇryati yata vā viśeṣaḥ; yāvatobhayatrāpi tadeva rūpamiti, vyatpratyaye'pi vṛddhyā na bhavitavyam, tathā ca prāguktam - `parāpi satī vṛddhirnityatvābhumā bādhyate` iti? ata āha - `tatra` ityādi| tatra ṇyati sati titsvaritatvāt? <> [[6.2.139]] iti prakṛtisvaraḥ; tenālambhya ityudāharaṇamantyasvaritaṃ bhavati| yati tu <<yato'nāvaḥ>> [[6.1.213]] ityādyudāttatve sati prakṛtivadbhāvenāpyudāttatvamityasti viśeṣaḥ| `labhyam` iti| yadantametat| `evamālabhya` ityetadapi| ālabhyata iti bhāve karmaṇi vā lakāraḥ| `anuṣaṅgalopaḥ kriyate` iti| `anidatām` [[6.4.24]] ityādinā||`praśaṃsāyām` iti| upalabhya iti stutau| atipraśaṃsya ityarthaḥ| `upalabhyam` iti| praptavyamityarthaḥ||`īṣatpralambhaḥ` iti `īṣadduḥsuṣu` [[3.3.126]] ityādinā khal| `duṣpralambhaḥ` iti| `idudupadhasya` [[8.3.41]] ityādinā ṣatvam| `vipralambhaḥ` iti| bhāve ghañ| nanu ca `labheśca` [[7.1.64]] ityanena num? siddhaḥ, tatkimartho'yamārambhaḥ? ityāha - `siddhe` ityādi| `anyatra na bhavati` iti tadvyavacchedyam| `upasargāt? khalghañoreva` ityeṣa tu viparītaniyamo'tra na sambhāvaniyaḥ; <> [[1.3.69]] iti nirdeśāt||`upasṛṣṭasya` iti| upasargeṇa sambaddhasyetyarthaḥ, `sulābhaḥ` iti| suśabdo'yamādhikyārthaḥ, nākṛcchrārthaḥ, yathā - suṣiktaṃ nāma kiṃ tavātreta| `durlābhaḥ` iti| `duśabdo nindārthaḥ, na kṛcchrārthaḥ, yathā - dubrrāhraṇa iti| tena ghañeva bhavati, na khal| `sudumryāmiti tṛtīyāṃ matvā kevalagrahaṇaṃ kriyate` iti| `sudibhryām` iti| tṛtīyāyāmabhyupetāyāṃ sudubhryāmupasṛṣṭasya labhernum? na bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ sampadyate| vyavahitenā'pyupasṛṣṭo bhavatyeva| tatrāsati kevalagrahaṇe supralambhaḥ, duṣpralambha ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| tasmāt? tṛtayāyāmabhyupetāyāṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| atha pañcatryāṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kriyeteti praśnāvasarata āha - `paccamyāṃ hi` ityādi| pañcamyāṃ hrasyāṃ nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvādanantarasyaiva pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam, iha ca praśabdena vyavadhānam, ataḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti, tat? kiṃ kevalagrahaṇena? yadyevam? na kartavyameva kevalagrahaṇam, pañcamīmenāṃ pratijñāsyāma iti? naitadasti; supralambhaḥ duṣpralambha iti - pratyudāhaṇadvayamabhipretyaitaduktam| `pañcamyāṃ hi vyavahitatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ` iti| atisulambha ityatra yadābhiśabdo'pyupasargastadā hrasati kevalagrahaṇe pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyeta; avyavadhānāt| tasmāt? sarvadhā kevalagrahaṇasya kartavyatvāt, kamavyatikrame ca prayojanābhāvāt? tṛtīyaiveṣā yuktā pratijñātum| atisulabhamityatrātinopargena suśabdena labhirupasṛṣṭaḥ, tasmāt? pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `atisulabhamityatra` ityādi| karmapravacanīyatvaṃ punaratiśabdasya <> [[1.4.95]] iti karmapravacanīsaṃjñāvidhānāt| yasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tasyopasargasaṃjñā nāsti; ekasaṃjñādhikārāt, karmapravavanāyasaṃjñayopasargasaṃjñāyā bādhatatvāt| kathaṃ punaḥ karmapracavanīyasya hi tasyāpi kevalatvamupapadyate? evaṃ manyate - kevagrahaṇāt? svaśabdopāttādanyat? tulyajātīyameva vyavacchedyam, na tu vijātīyam| tathā hi - `kevalabhyāṃ vijhātīyena karkaṭādinā sahitau praviśata eva| ata evānyopasargarahitābhyāmityanena tulyajātīyanivṛttayarthatā kevalagrahaṇasya darśitā| yadi tu sarvasya tulyajātīyasya vijātīyasyāpi kevalagrahaṇena nivṛttiḥ karttu śakyate, tadopasargagarahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, anyarahitābhyāmityevaṃ brāūyāt| tasmādvijātīyena kevalagrahaṇena nivṛttiḥ karttu śakyate, tadopasargagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, anyarahitābhyāmityevaṃ brāūyāt| tasmādvijātīyena sahitāvapi tau kevalāvevetyatisulabhamityatra karmapravacanīyasahitenāpi suśabdenopasṛṣṭasya bhavatyeva pratiṣedhaḥ| yatra tarhi pūjātikramaṇābhyāmanyatra vṛttiḥ, atiśabdasaya tatra karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā na bhavati, tadā katham? ityāha - `yadā tu` ityādi| pañcamīnirdeśe'pyevamarthaṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti; anyathā hyatra vyavadhānābhāvāt? pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyetetyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca prasulambhaḥ - ityevamarthaṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? naitadasti; uktaṃ hi bhāṣeya - `naiṣo'sti prayogaḥ` iti||`alābhi` iti| luṅ, `ciṇbhāvakarmaṇoḥ` [[3.1.66]] iti ciṇ, <> [[6.4.104]] iti takārasaya luk| `anupasṛṣṭasya` iti| upasargeṇāsambadadhasyetyarthaḥ||ugiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam - uk? id? yeṣāṃ tānyuginti, aṅgaviśeṣaṇañcaitat, ata āha - `ugitāmaṅgānām` iti| ajiti pratyāhārasya grahaṇamevedaṃ vā syāt, añcatervā luptanakārasya? tatra yadi pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt, <> [[7.1.72]] ityatra sūtre punarajgrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, taddhi pratyāhāgrahaṇam, nāñceḥ; jhalā sāhacaryāt| tasmādañcateridaṃ grahaṇamityālocyāha - `añcateśca` ityādi| `bhavān` iti| <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ| `śreyān` iti| praśasyaśabdāt? <> [[5.3.57]] itīyasun, <> [[5.3.60]] iti śrādeśaḥ, <> [[6.4.163]] iti prakṛtivadbhāvāṭṭilopābhāvaḥ, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] , <> [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ| nanu cātra nāṅgamugit, kiṃ tarhi? pratyayaḥ? naitadasti; aṅgamapyugideva| katham? avayavāvayavenāpi samudāyasya sambandho bhavatyeva, yathā - devaidattasyāṅgulirityatra devadattasyāvayavasya hastasya yo'vayavo'ṅgulistena devadattasya sambandhaḥ| tasmādihāpi pratyayasyāvayavo ya uk? itsaṃjñakastenāṅgasyāpi sambandho'styevetyaṅgamapyugideva| `prāṅ` iti| prāñcatati ṛtvigādisūtraṇa [[3.2.59]] kvin, numhalṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogāntalopau [[8.2.23]] , <> [[8.2.62]] iti kutvam - nakārasya ṅakāraḥ| `prāñcau, prāñcaḥ` iti| cutvam - nakārasya ñakāraḥ| athāñcatigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatogittvādeva tasya num? siddhaḥ? ityata āha - `añcatigrahaṇam` ityādi| ukhāruāt, parṇadhvat` iti| `ruāūnsu dhvansu `adhaḥ patane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-754,755), [`avaruāṃsane` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ukhāyāṃ ruāṃsate, parṇāni dhvaṃsate| `kvipca` [[3.2.76]] iti kvip, nalopaḥ, `vasuruāṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ` [[8.2.72]] iti sakārasya dakāraḥ, tasya <<vā'vasāne>> [[8.4.56]] cartvam - takāraḥ|`adhātoriti kim` iti| añcatigrahaṇādeva niyamārthāddhāterna bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| adhātoriti nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? paryudāsa iti manyamāna āha - `adhātubhūtapūrvasyāpi yathā syāt` iti| pūrvapakṣavādinā'dhātoriti prasajyaprataṣedho'yamiti manyamānena coditam| siddhāntavādinā paryudāsena parihmatam| `gomatyati` iti| gomacchabdāt `supa ātmanaḥ kyacṭa [[3.1.8]] | `gomatyaterapratyayaḥ` iti| aśrāvī pratyayo'pratyayaḥ, sa punaḥ kvip, <> [[6.4.48]] iti dīrghaḥ - gomān| kasmāt? punarasatyadhātugrahaṇe'tra na sidhyatītyata āha - `atra hi` ityādi| asatyadhātugrahaṇe'ñcatigrahaṇānniyamādyathokharuādityādau na bhavati, tathātrāpi na syāt| bhavati hrayamapi dhātuḥ - satadyapi dhātutve kvibantatve `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati` (vya|pa|132) iti kṛtvā| tasmādadhātugrahaṇaṃ kriyate - yo'pyavasthāntare'dhāturāsīt? tasya garahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| atha gomāniti kathamatra dīrghatvam? kathaṃ ca na syāt? adhātoriti pratiṣedhaḥ, nātvantasya| atra hradhātoriti kim? piṇḍaṃ prasata iti piṇḍagraḥ, carma vasta iti carmavaḥ - ityasantasyaiva pratyudāharaṇamupanayastam, nātvantasya| atha vā - cakārantatra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena kvaciddhātorayīti bhaviṣyati||`paryāsi, śroyāṃsi` iti| <> [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ| `bahupuri, bahudhuri` iti| bahvyaḥ puraḥ, bahvyo dhuro yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ṛkpurabdhūḥ pathāmānakṣe` [[5.4.74]] ityakāraḥ samāsānto na bhavati - `samāsāntavidhiranityaḥ` (vyā|pa|94) iti kṛtvā| `vimaladivi` iti| vimalā dyauryeṣāmiti tāni| vimaladivi vakāro dantyauṣṭhao jhal? na bhavati, jhalaḥ pūrveṇa paṭhitatvāt| `catvāri` iti| <> [[7.1.98]] ityām| iha yaduginnapuṃsakaṃ jhalantaṃ numi kṛte `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] ityādinā dvitīyo num? prāpnoti; sambhavati hi vidhānakālenekasya paratvam, yathā - pacatītyatra lakāravikaraṇayorekasmāddhātoriti| atra tudanti, nadantītyatra parasaya numo'nusvāre kṛte tasaya parasavarṇe ca dvayornakārayoḥ śravaṇamāpadyeta? bhavatu nāma, halparasya vyañjanasyaikasyānekasya śrutiṃ prati nāsti viśeṣaḥ śakyate vaktum| iha tvasti viśeṣaḥ - kurvanti, kṛṣantītyatra parasya numo'nusvārasavarṇayoḥ kṛtayoḥ pūrvasyājhalparatvādanusvāraparasavarṇau na sta iti aṭkupvādinā [[8.4.2]] ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti| ekasmastu numi tasyānusvāre parasavarṇe kṛte na bhavati ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ; parasavarṇasyāsiddhatvāt| tasmādugillakṣaṇasya numaḥ pratiṣedho vaktavya ityāha - `ugito jhalantasya` ityādi| jhalantalakṣaṇasya numo'vakāśo yadanuginnapuṃsakam - sarpīṣīti, ugillakṣaṇasyāvakāśo yadugidanapuṃsakam - gomān? yavamāniti; yadugijjhalantaṃ napuṃsakaṃ tasyobhayaprasaṅge sati paratvādanenaiva numā bhavitavyam, tasmin? sati punarugillakṣaṇo num? na bhavati - `sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadvādhitaṃ tadvādhitameva` (vya|pa|40) iti kṛtvā| `bhūyāṃsi` ita#i| bahuśabdādīyasun, <> [[6.4.158]] itīkārasya lopaḥ, bahośca bhūbhāvaḥ| `kurvanti, kṛṣanti` iti| śatrantāt? <> [[7.1.20]] iti śibhāvaḥ| `bahurji` ityādi| bahūrjītyasmin? nubhaḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[7.1.69]] iti vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena bahūrjītyatra na bhavati| `urja balaprāṇadhāraṇayoḥ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1549) [`balaprāṇanayoḥ` dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ityetasmāt? `bhrājabhrāsa` [[3.2.177]] ityādinā kvip, bahava ūrjo balāni yeṣāṃ tāni bahūrji brāāhṛṇakulāni| `antyātpūrvam` iti| antyo jakāraḥ, tasmātpūrvaṃ numamicchanti kecit - bahūrñjīti||`vibhaktau` iti vacanāt? `sarvanāmasthāne` [[7.1.70]] iti nivṛttam| `acīti kim` iti| evaṃ manyate - trapubhyām, trapubhirityatra vyañjanādau mā bhūdityevamarthamajgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, etaccāprayojanam; astvanna num, <> [[8.2.7]] iti lopo bhaviṣyati| itaro viditābhiprāya āha - `uttarārtham` iti| <> [[7.1.75]] ityajādau yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt - asthibhyām, asthibhiriti, evamarthamajgrahaṇam| ihāsaya karaṇasya yatprayojanaṃ tanmayā pṛṣṭam, atastadeva kathyatām? ityabhiprāyeṇāha - `yadyevam` ityādi| itaro viditābhiprāya āha - `iha tu karaṇasya` ityādi| trapuśabdāt? sambodhane prathamaikavacane kṛte yadyacīti nocyeta, tadātrāpi num? syāt, tadatra num? mā bhūdityevamarthamacītyucyate| syādetat - bhavatu nāma num, tasya `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] iti sorluki kṛte <> [[8.2.7]] iti nalopo bhaviṣyati? ityāha - `na ṅisambuddhyoḥ ityādi| `nanu ca` ityādi| evakāro'tra bhinnakramaḥ pratiṣedhānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| sa caupacārikamapi dibhakterastitvam? <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratiṣedhānnāstīti pratipādayati| dvividhaṃ hi vibhaktorastitvam - mukhyam, aupacārikañca| tatra mukhyaṃ śrūyamāṇāyā vibhakterbhavati, itarat? tu luptāyā api| kāryasyāstitvādvibhakterapyupacāreṇāstitvamucyate, yathā - astyatītaṃ karmeti tatrātītena karmaṇā yadāhitaṃ phaladānasāmarthyaṃ tasyastitvāt? tat? karmāntītyucyate| tadiha <> [[7.1.23]] iti vibhakterlaptatvānmukhyaṃ tāvadastitvaṃ nāsti| <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhādaupacārikamapi nāstveva| tatra vibhaktāvucyamāno num? kaḥ prasaṅgo yaḥ sarvathaivāsatyāṃ vibhaktau he trapo ityatra syāt! naiva prāpnoti; tasmānnaitadajgrahaṇasya prayojanam| `etadeva` ityādi| yadi hyatra pratyayalopalakṣamapratiṣedhaḥ syāt, ajgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, kutaśca, tasmādetadevājgrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati - pratyayalopalakṣaṇapratiṣedho'tregante napuṃsake sambuddhiviṣaye nāstīti| `tathā ca` ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanamāha| sambuddhiviṣayo gaṇaḥ <> [[7.3.106]] iti vartamāne yaḥ `hrasvasya guṇaḥ` [[7.3.108]] ityanena guṇaḥ sa veditavyaḥ| `taumburavaṃ cūrṇam` iti| tumburuṇo vikāraḥ `aurañ? [[4.2.70]] , <> [[6.4.146]] | kvacit - `iko'ci vyañjane mā bhūvastu lopaḥ svaraḥ katham` ityādikaṃ ślokadvayaṃ paṭhate| <<iko'ci vibhaktau>> [[7.1.73]] ityatrācīti kimarthamucyate, na `iko vibhaktau` ityevocyeta? prayojanamāha - `vyañjane mā bhūt` iti| prakaraṇānnumiti vijñāyate| trapubhyām, trapubhirityatra vyañjanādau mā bhūdityevarthamajgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| yadyevam, nārthastena, vyañjanādau numastu, na ca tasya śravaṇaṃ prasajyate; yasmāt? `nalopaḥ prātapadikāntasya` [[8.2.7]] iti nalopo bhaviṣyati| pañcatrapubhyām, pañcatrapubhirityatra kathaṃ svaraḥ? pañcabhistrapubhiḥ krītābhyāṃ krītairveti <> [[2.1.51]] iti taddhitārthe samāsa; <> [[2.1.52]] iti dvigusaṃjñā, `ārhādagopuccha` [[5.1.19]] ityādinā ṭhak, tasya `adhyadrdhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñāyām` [[5.1.28]] iti luk, tato vibhakto num, nakāralopaḥ, tasya `nalopaḥ supsavarasaṃjñātugvidhiṣu kṛti` (8.2.2|) ityasiddhatvāt? <> [[6.2.29]] ityanena pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na prāpnoti; anigantatvāt? `bhraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ` (phi|sū|2|28) ityādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| `bhraḥ` iti nakārarephāntayograhaṇamiti| `kharo ṣai` ityādi| vaiśabdo'kṣamāyām| pañcatrapuṇa ityatra śrūyamāṇe numi svaro bhavati| `lupte kiṃ na bhaviṣyati`? (iti)| bhaviṣyatyevetyarthaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ śrūyamāṇe numi svaro bhavati? svaravidhau vyañjanasyādidyamānatvāt| atha vā - samudāyabhakto hrasau num? notsate'vayavasya trapuśabdasyegantatāṃ vihintum| iha tarhi rāyamatikrāntābhyāṃ brāāhṛṇakulābhyām - atirābhyāmiti <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāse kṛte `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti hrasvatve ca kṛte yadi vyañjanādau num? syāt, tadā tasya lope kṛte nalopasyāsiddhatvāt? <> [[7.2.85]] iti halādāvucyamānamātvaṃ na prāpnoti, numā vyavadānāt, samudāyabhakto'sau samudāyameva na vyavadavyāt, avayavaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva| tathā priyāstiruāo'nayobrrāāhṛṇakulayoriti bahuvrīhau kṛte priyatisṛbhyāmiti - yadi vyañjanādau num? syāt, tadā <> [[7.2.99]] ityanena tiruāādeśo na prāpnoti, samudāyabhaktena numā triśabdasya vyavadhānāt? naitadasti; `rāyātvaṃ tisṛbāvaṃ [`tisṛbhāvaśca` - mūlapāṭhaḥ] ca vyavadhānānnumāpi hi` (iti)| bhavatīti śeṣaḥ| vyavadhānāditi lyablope pañcamī, yathā - prāsādāt? prekṣata iti| prāsādamāruhretyarthaḥ| tadayamarthaḥ - numā vyavadhānamapi prāpya rāya āttvaṃ tisṛbhāvañca bhavatīti| kasmāt? punarvyravadhāne tau bhavataḥ`? <> [[7.2.85]] ityatra rāyo yā vihitā vibhaktiḥ, triśabdācca yā vihitā vibhaktistasyāmiti vihitaviśeṣaṇapakṣasya tatraśrayaṇāt| atha vā - kiṃ vyavadhānacintayā, paratvādeva hi tau bhaviṣyataḥ, tayostu kṛtayoḥ `sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadvādhitaṃ tadvādhitameva` (vyā|pa|40) iti punarnum? na bhavati| numparatvamanaṅgīkṛtya `vyavadhānānnumāpi hi` ityuktam| ata evāpiśabdaḥ pakṣāntaradyotanāya prayuktaḥ| vyavadhāne ca yathā bhavati, tathoktameva| evaṃ tarhi numnuṭorvipratiṣedhārthamajgrahaṇamiti nuṭi kṛte numna kriyate| `hrasvanadyāyo nuṭ` [[7.1.54]] iti asyāvakāśaḥ - agnīnām, vāyūnamiti, igantanumo'va kāśaḥ - trapuṇe, jatuna iti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti - trapūṇām, jatūnāmiti, pūrvavipratiṣedhe nuḍāgamo bhavati, nuṭi ca sati `nāmi` [[6.4.3]] iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti, asmastu sata#i na syāt; anajantatvāt, yathā - varmaṇāmityatra| sa cāyaṃ vipratiṣedho'jgrahaṇe satyupapadyate| nuṭi kṛte num? na prāpnoti; anajāditvāt| numyapi kṛte nuṇna prāpnoti, hrasvāntābhāvādityevamabhayostulyayorvipratiṣedha upapadyate| akriyamāṇe'jgrahaṇe nuṭi kṛtepyakṛte'pi halādāvajādau ca numā bhavitavyamiti tasya nityatvam| numi kṛte hrasvāntatvābhāvānnuṭā na bhavitavyamiti tasyānityatvam| nityānityayoścātulyabalatvādayukto vipratiṣedha iti nityatvānnumaiva bhavitavyamiti| tasmādajgrahaṇaṃ vipratiṣedhārthamiti| atra parīhārāntaramāha - `nuḍ vācyaḥ` iti| lāghavārtham| nuḍarthaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ| tādadhryannudityuktaḥ| kriyamāṇe'pyajgrahaṇe vipratiṣedena numeva prāpnoti, tato'vaśyaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedhena nuḍ? vācyaḥ - `numaciratṛjvadbhāvebhyo nuṅ? bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena` (vā|11;7.1.96) iti| kriyamāṇe'pyajgrahaṇe pūrvavapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| akriyamāṇe tasmastenaiva yatnena nuḍ? bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ yatnadvayena, tasmādajgrahaṇamanarthakam? nanu ceṣṭavācī paraśabdaḥ, iṣṭavācitvādbhaviṣyati, alaṃ yatnena/ asadetat, avaśyaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ parigaṇayatavyaḥ, anyathedamiṣṭamidamaniṣṭamityetadeva na jñāyate| nanu ca trapūṇāmityatra pūrvaviprataṣedhena nuṭi kṛte num? mā bhūdityevamarthamajgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? naitadasti; astvatra num? tasya lopo bhaviṣyati| nalopasya dīrghavidhāvasiddhatvāt? `nāmi` [[6.4.3]] iti dīrghatvamanajantatvānna syāditi cet? mā bhūdanena, <> [[6.4.7]] ityanena bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi śucīnāmityatara <> [[6.4.12]] iti niyamāddīrghatvaṃ na syāt? naitadasti; lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vya|pa|3) pratipadoktasyennantasya sa na#iyamaḥ| ayañca numi kṛte satonnanta iti lākṣaṇikatvādevāsya niyamena pratyākhyānaṃ kariṣyate| evaṃ pratyākhyāte'jgrahaṇe ata uttarato'jgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayitu māha - `uttarārthaṃ tu` iti| tuśabdastahrrarte| tarhiśabdaḥ pakṣāntaropanyāse| yadyetat? prayojanaṃ nopapadyate, uttarārthaṃ tahrrajgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `iha tu karaṇasya yatprayojanaṃ taducyatām? ityāha - `iha` ityādi| apiśabdo'tra gamyamānārthatvānna prayuktaḥ| ihāpi prayojanamasti, kiṃ punastat? ityāha - `trapo` iti| he trapo ityasyodāharaṇasya sādhutvārthamajgrahaṇam| akriyamāṇe tvajgrahaṇe pratyayalopalakṣaṇamihāstīti na jñāpyeta; yataśca he trapo ityatra lupatāyāṃ sambuddhāvucyamāno guṇo na syāt, ajgrahaṇe satyatrāpi pratyayalopalakṣaṇo bhavati| tasmādetadarthamajgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, uttarārthañca||`igantaṃ napuṃsakam` iti| napuṃsakasyeka ityanuvartate| tacca yadyapi ṣaṣṭhantaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpyetadarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti prathamāntaṃ sampadyate| `puṃvadbhavati` iti| asyārthaṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha - `yathā` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ `puṃvadbhavati` ityanena pratiṣedhātideśaḥ śakyate vaktum| evaṃ manyate - puṃsi tṛtīyādiṣvajādiṣu na kiñcit? kāryaṃ vidhīyate yannapuṃsake'tidaśyeta| tasmānnapuṃsakāśrayasya kāryasya puṃsyabhāvāt? pratiṣedhātideśa evāyaṃ vijñāyate| evamapi num? eva prakṛtasyābhāvātideśaḥ pakṣe syāt, hrasvasya; tasyāprakṛtatvāt, tataśca hrasvāśrayāṇi guṇa nābhāva nuḍauttvāttvāni prasajyeran - <> [[7.3.111]] ityauttvāttvam - grāmaṇyāṃ brāāhṛṇakula iti? naitadasti; numabhāvamātrātideśe hratideśa evānarathakaḥ syāt| numa eva gālavasya matena pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt| tasmādatideśāsāmarthyād? hrasvābhāvo'pyatidiśyate| `grāmaṇībrrāāhṛṇaḥ, grāmāṇi brāāhṛṇakulam` iti| bhāṣitapuṃskatvadarśanārthamidamuktam, na tūdāharaṇam| idamatrodāharaṇam - `grāmaṇyā brāāhṛṇakulena` iti| atra puṃvadbhāvena hrasvo na bhavati, numapi| `eranekācaḥ` [[6.4.82]] iti hrasvatvam, <<āṅo nā'striyām>> [[7.3.120]] iti nābhāvaḥ| `grāmaṇīnām` iti| pūrvavipratiṣedhena nuṭi kṛte `nāmi` [[6.4.3]] iti dīrghatvam| nnuciśabdasya tṛtīyaikavacanaṃ nodāhṛtam; viśeṣābhāvāt| satyasati vā puṃvadbhāve <<āṅo nā'striyām>> [[7.3.120]] iti nābhāvena bhavitavyam| `śucaye` iti| puṃvadbhāvapakṣe na num, <> [[7.3.111]] iti guṇaḥ| `śucine` iti| puṃvadbhāvābhāvapakṣe num| `grāmaṇinī brāāhṛṇakule` iti| puṃvadbhāvābhāvādiha hrasvanumau bhavataḥ| `trapuṇe, jatune` iti| sarvakālaṃ napuṃsakatvamevānayoriti bhāṣitapuṃskatvābhāvaḥ| tenātra puṃvadebhāvābhāvānnumbhavatyeva| `iha kasmānna bhavati` iti| bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdasya bahuvrīheḥ śabdo'nyapadārthaḥ| poluśabdaścāyaṃ puṃsi vṛkṣe varttitvā pīlorvikāraḥ phalamiti vivakṣite sati `orañ` [[4.2.70]] ityāgatasyāñaḥ <> [[4.3.163]] iti luk? kriyate, tadā napuṃsake phale vartata iti bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati, na ceha kaścidviśeṣa upāttaḥ, tasmādbhavitavyamedātra puṃvadbhāveneti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `samānāyāmākṛtau` ityattaram| asyaivārthaṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha `tulya pravṛttinimitte` iti| atra `tasya puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate` ityadhyāhāryam| ākriyete vyutpādyete paricchidyete anayā vṛddhiśabdāditi `ākṛtiḥ`| śabdasya pravṛttikāraṇamihākṛtirabhipretā, na sannideśaḥ, nāpi jātimātram| tasmastu tulye pravṛttinimitte yadbhāṣitapuṃskaṃ tasya puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate| tathā ca - grāmaṇīśabdasya, śaciśabdasya ca samāse pravṛttinimatte puṃvadbhāva udāhṛtaḥ, yathā - grāmaṇīśabdasya puṃsi napuṃsake ca vartamānasya grāmanayanaṃ prati karttutvaṃ samānākṛtiḥ pravṛttinimittam| śuciśabdasyāpi śucitvaṃ guṇaḥ tatraivaitat? syāt| ihāpi samānaivākṛtiḥ? ityāha - `iha tu` ityādi| tu śabda#o grāmaṇīśabdāderviśeṣaṃ darśayati| anena pīluśabdasya bhinnāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskatvaṃ darśayati| vṛkṣākṛtiḥ=vṛkṣajātiḥ| phalākṛtiḥ=phalajātiḥ| tadevaṃ samānāyāmākṛtau yadbhāṣitapuṃskaṃ tasya puṃdadbhāvo vidhīyate| na tu pīluśabdaḥ samānāyamākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃska iti na bhavati tasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `tadetadevam` ityādi| yadetaduktam - `samānāyamākṛtau` ityādi, tadetadevamprakāramartharūpaṃ kathambhavati? na kathañcidityarthaḥ| `samānāyāmākṛtau` ityasya viśeṣasyānupādānādityabhiprāyaḥ| `bhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇāt` ityādinā yathaitadeva bhavati tathā darśayati| śabde hranyapadārthe samāśrīyamāṇe satyetannopapadyate| na cātra śabdo'nyapadārthatvenāśritaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? arthaḥ| so'pi na sarvaḥ, api tu pratyāsatteryasya śabdasya yat? pravṛttinimittaṃ sa eva vijñāyata iti sa eva bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdonocyate; anyathā sarva eva hrartho bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati, antato'rthaśabdenāpi bhāṣitapuṃskatvasambhavāt| tatra yadi yena kenacicchabdena yo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ sa ihāśrīyate, tadā bhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; vyāvarttyābhāvāt| tasmādyasya napuṃsakābhidhāyinaḥ śabdasya puṃvadbhāva iha vidhātumiṣṭastenaiva svamin? pravṛttinimitte pumān? bhāṣitaḥ, sa eva bhāṣitapuṃtko'trākṣīyate| `tedyogāt` ityādi| tena pravṛttinimittalakṣaṇenārthena yogāt? sambandhādabhidheyaṃ yannapuṃsakaṃ tadapi bhāṣitapuṃskamitayucyate| bhavati hi tadyogāt? tācchabdyam, yathā - yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti| yogaḥ punaratra samavāyasamavāyilakṣaṇaḥ; śabdapravṛttinimittasyārthasya napuṃsakena samavāyāt| `yat? tasya` ityādi| tasya napuṃsakasya yat? pratipādakaṃ śabdarūpaṃ tadāpi bhāṣitapuṃtkena napuṃsakena yogādbhāṣitapuṃskamityucyate| yogaḥ punaranayorvācyavācakabhāvaḥ| tatra yadyapi sūtre'rtho bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdenopāttaḥ, tathā'pyarthe kāryāsambhavāt? yathoktana prakāreṇa yo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ śabdastasyaivāyaṃ puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate, evañca sa vidhīyamānaḥ samānāyāmākṛtau yo bhavitapuṃskaḥ śabdaḥ sāmarthyāt? tasya bhavatīti vijñāyate| yo hrevaṃ bhāṣitapuṃskena śabdapravṛttinimittena sambaddhaṃ napuṃsakamāha sa niyogataḥ samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati| yathā sa eva grāmaṇīśabdaḥ, śuciśabdaśca| pīluśabdena yatra bhāṣitaḥ pumān? pravṛttinimitte vṛkṣākṛtau na tatsambaddhamasau napuṃsakamāha| kiṃ tarhi? phalākṛtisambandham| tasmāt? pīluśabdo na samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃska iti na bhavati tasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `kīlālapā` iti| `ato maninkvanibvanipaśca` [[3.2.74]] iti vic| kolālapāśabdo'yaṃ samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ - ubhayatrāpi vartamānaḥ kīlālapātvaṃ pravṛttinimittamādāya pravartata iti kṛtvā| igantastu na bhavatīti na bhavati puṃvadbhāva; tena hrasvatvaṃ bhavatyeva| tasmin? satadi <<ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ>> [[7.1.12]] itīnādeśe kṛte kīlālapeneti bhavati| yadi punaratra puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt? tadā hrasvatvaṃ na syāt, tataśca <<āto dhātoḥ>> [[6.4.140]] ityakāralope kṛte kolālāpeti syāt||<<iko'ci vibhaktau>> [[7.1.73]] iti numi prāpte'sdhyādīnāmanaṅa vidhīyate| ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| asthyādayaścaite `nabviṣayasyānisantasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttāḥ, śeṣamanudāttam| tatrānaṅ? vidhīyamānaḥ sthānivadbhāvādanudāttatvaṃ prāpnotītyudāttatvāmucyate - nabviṣayasyeti| napuṃsakaviṣayasyetyarthaḥ| `asthnā` iti| anaṅi kṛte <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] ityakāralopaḥ| `etaiḥ` ityādi| kathaṃ punarotallabhyate, yāvatā prakṛtasyāsthyādibhirviśeṣaṇādviśeṣaṇena tadantavidhiriti vijñānāt? `aṅgādhikāre tasya saduttarapadasya` (pu|pa|vṛ|85) iti vacanādvā yadyapi tadantavidhirbhavati, tathāpi satyapi tasminnasthyādyantatyānapuṃsakasya grahaṇaṃ nopapadyate, napusakasyetyanuvṛtteḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hyatra napuṃsakenāṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, api tu śrutatvādasthyādaya eva| evañca tadantasyāṅgasya liṅgāntarepi vartamānasyāsthyādīnāṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ vidyata eva| tena napuṃsake ye vartante'sthyādayastadantasyānapuṃsake'pi vartamānasya grahaṇamupapannaṃ bhavati| yadi tarhi tadantasya grahaṇam, kevalānāṃ na sidhyati? ayamapyadoṣaḥ; vyadeśivadbhāvāt? kevalānāṃ na bhaviṣyati| `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'yatipadikena` (śāka|pa|65) ityeṣā paribhāṣā pratyayavidhiviṣayetīha nopatiṣṭhata eva| napuṃsakenāsthyādiviśeṣaṇaṃ kim? yadā te paducchāśabdāḥ santo'pi liṅgāntare vartante tadā mā bhūt - dadhirnāma kaścit? tena dadhineti||`yato vihitaḥ` ityādinā'piśabdasya sarvopāṣiṇyabhicārārthatāṃ darśayati| `asthabhiḥ` iti| anaṅi kṛte nalopaḥ| `asthānyutkṛtya` iti| śasyanaṅ| `akṣaṇvatā` iti| atrāpi matupi <> [[8.2.16]] iti nulyam| dvitīyāntametat| `yadanasthaḥ` iti| asthi yasya nāstīti sāvanaṅa, `sarvanāmasthāne ca` [[6.4.8]] iti dīrghaḥ||cakāraśchandasītyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `akṣī te` iti akṣi au iti sthite <> [[7.1.19]] iti śībhāvaḥ, īkāre kṛte <> [[6.1.102]] itī dīrghaḥ, <> [[6.1.105]] iti pratiṣiddho'pi chāndasatvādbhavati| nanu savarṇe dīrghatvenā'pyetat? siddhyati? yadyapi rūpaṃ siddhyati, udāttatvaṃ tu na sidhyati| etenodatta īkāro vidhīyate| atha vā - rūpamapi na sidhyati| pūrvasavarṇāddhi paratvāt? pūrvaṃ numi kṛte naiva savarṇadīrghaḥ syāt| athākṣī ityatra <<iko'ci vibhaktau>> [[7.1.73]] iti num? kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `akṣī ityatra` ityādi| numo'vakāśaḥ - trapuṇe, jatuna iti ikarasyāvakāśaḥ - akṣībhyamiti; prathamādvivacana ubhayaprasaṅge paratvādīkāra eva bhavati| athedānomīkāre kṛte punaḥprasaṅgavijñānānnum? kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `sakṛdgato iti||`udatta, dadattau` iti| `śnabhyastayorāttaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ| akṣitijāgarttyāḥ <> [[6.1.6]] ityabhyastasaṃjñā| kathaṃ punarayaṃ numaḥ pratiṣedho vijñāyate, yāvatā `anantasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho ṣā` (vyā|pa|19) itīkārasya pratiṣedho yuktaḥ? ityāha - `śaturanantaraḥ` ityādi| lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihitasya prataṣedho bhavati, na tu śaturanantara īkāraḥ kenacidvihitaḥ| aṅgasyeti vartate, na ca numo'nyat? kāryaṃ śatuḥ sambhavati| ataḥ sāmarthyādvya vahitasyāpi `ugivacām` [[7.1.70]] iti numaḥ pratiṣedho vijñāyata iti||śatupratyayamātraṃ napuṃsake na vartata ityabhyastādahgādusaro yaḥ śatā tadantasya napuṃsakasya vikalpo vijñāyata ityāha - `abhyāstādaṅgāt` ityādi||`taduntī kule` iti| <> [[7.1.19]] iti śībhāvaḥ| `tudatī brāāhṛṇī` iti| <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp, `yātī brāāhṛṇī` iti| avāditvācchapo luk, <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīp| `kariṣyantī kule` iti| `lṛṭaḥ sadvā` [[3.3.14]] iti śatrādeśaḥ, <<ṛddhanoḥ sye>> [[7.2.70]] itīṭ| `atrāntaraṅgatvāt` ityādi codyam| akārāntādaṅgāt? pare śatari vyavasthite īkāre ca kiṃ num? kriyatām? uttaikādeśaḥ? atrāntaraṅgatvāt? <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpamekādeśaḥ| antaraṅgatvaṃ punastasya varṇāśrayatvākat? numastu bahvapekṣatvādbahiraṅgatvam| sa hrakarāntamaṅgaṃ śatṛpratyayāntaṃ tataśca parataḥ śīnadyorbhāvamapekṣate| `vārṇādāṅgam` (vya|pa|39) ityādīha nāsti; bhinnakālatvāt - śīnadyorhi parabhāve sati num? prāpnoti, ekādeśastu tataḥ prāgeva| `yatra ca vārṇāṅgayoryugapat? prāptiḥ, tatreyamupatiṣṭhate` ityuktaṃ prāk| vyapavargābhāvādavarṇāntādaṅgāduttarasya śaturiti śakyate vaktum| bhede hi satyavadhyavaśrimatoridamasmāduttaramidañca pūrvamityeva vyavahāro bhavati, nānyathā| syādetat - <> [[6.1.85]] ityantādivadabhāvenaikādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhavati parañca pratyādivadityekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantattvāt? parañca pratyādivattvādyujyata evāvarṇādaṅgāduttarasya śatuḥ? ityāha - `ubhayata āśraye` ityādi| atra hrakārāntamaṅgaṃ śatā cobhayamāśritam| `ubhayata āśraye` ityādi| atra hrakārantamaṅgaṃ śatā cobhayamāśra#itam| `ubhayata āśraye nāntādivat` (vyā|pa|51) iti nāstyantādivadbhāvaḥ| na hrekasyaikadā pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvaḥ parañca pratyādivadbhāva upapadyate| tathā hi - yadi pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhavati, tadā śatṛrūpaṃ na sampadyate; atha paraṃ pratyādivadbhavati, tadā'kārāntatā'ṅgasya na parikalpyate; ucyate cedamācchīnadyornumiti, na cavarṇāntādaṅgāduttaraḥ śatā kvacit sambhavati; tatra vacanaprāmāṇyādbhūtapūrvagatadirāśrīyate - avarṇāntāduttaro yaḥ śata pūrvamāsīditi| ata āha - `bhūtapūrvagatyā` ityādi| yadi hi bhūtapūrvagatirāśrīyate, avatī, dhnatītyādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt; atrāpyavarṇāntādaṅgāduttaraḥ śatā pūrvamāsīt? ityāha - `atra kecitsamādhimāhuḥ` iti| samādhiḥ=parīhāraḥ| parīhāraśca - śaturavayava iti| śaturavayavastakāraḥ| tatreha śatṛśabdo vartate, yathā - paṭo dandha ityatra paṭāvayave paṭaśabdaḥ, samudāyeṣu pravṛttāḥ śabdāḥ kvacidavayeṣvapi vartanta iti| sa ca śatravayava ekādeśe hi kṛte'varṇāntādaṅgāduttaro bhavatīti `antaraṅgatvādekādeśe kṛte` ityādinā yat? kṛtañcodyaṃ tat? parihmataṃ bhavati| kiṃ punaranackasaya takārasya num? ruthañca num? syāt? kathañca na syāt? <<midaco'ntyātparaḥ>> [[1.1.47]] iti vacanāt| mā bhūt? takārasya, tadantasya bhaviṣyati| evañca sūtrārthaṃ varṇayiṣyāmaḥ - avarṇāntādaṅgāduttaro yaḥ śatravayavastadantasyāṅgasya num? bhavatīti| aṅgagrahaṇañca dvirāvartayiṣyāmaḥ - avarṇāntādaṅgaduttaro yaḥ śatravayavastadantasyāṅgasya num? bhavatīti| aṅgagrahaṇañca dvirāvartayiṇyāmaḥ - śatravayavaviśeṣaṇārtham, aṅgakāryapratipattyarthañca| kathaṃ punastudatītyādī takārāt? pūrvasyāṅgatvam, yāvatā yataḥ pratyayo vihitastadādeḥ pratyaye parato'ṅgasaṃjñā, na ca takāraḥ pratyayaḥ asatyāñcāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ yaduktamavarṇāntādaṅgāduttaro yaḥ śatravayava iti tannopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva hi śatravayave śatṛśabado vartate, tathāṅgavayave takārāt? pūrvasminnaṅgaśabdaḥ| kiṃ punastadaṅgam? yasyāvayavaḥ śatrantam| tasya hi śaunadyoḥ parato'ṅgatsaṃjñā vidhīyate| ihāpi tarhi kasmānna bhavati - adatī, dhnatīti, atrāpi hravarṇāntādaṅgāduttaraḥ śatravayado bhavati? yadyatrāpi syāt, āditi viśeṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, śīnadyorityevaṃ brāūyāt| yatra ca śīnadyoḥ parataḥ śatrantamaṅgaṃ bhavati, tatra niyogata evākārāntādaṅgādusaro śatravayavo bhavati| tasmāt? `ātaḥ` iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt? viśeṣaparigraho vijñāyate - śatravayavadakārāt? pūrṣo yo'kārastadantāduttaro yaḥ śatravayava iti neha numaḥ prasaṅgaḥ| `avarṇāntādaṅgāduttare ye śīnadyau` iti| atrāpi pūrvavadaṅgāvayave'ṅgaśabdo vartate| nanu ca tudantītyādāvavarṇāntādaṅgāduttare śīnadyau na sambhavata eva; takāreṇa vyavadhānāt? ityāha - `tatra yena` ityādi| gatārtham| atha numyanuvartamāne kimartha punarnumgrahaṇam? neti, veti ca prakṛtam| tatra numgrahaṇamantareṇāniṣṭamapi vijñāyate - śīnadyorvibhāṣā numavarṇāntānna bhavatīti| kiñca syāt? kurvatī, tanvatītyatra vibhāṣā syāt, kariṣyantītyatra na syāt| kena punaḥ prāptasya numaḥ śonadyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate? etadeva jñāpayati - astiśīnadyordibhāṣā numiti| numgrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe vidhirevāyaṃ vijñāyata ityadoṣaḥ||`īdṛṅ, kīdṛṅ` [nāsti - kāśikāyām] iti| `tyadādidhu` [[3.2.60]] ityādinā kvin, <> [[6.3.90]] itīśkī - ādeśo, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau (6.1.70,8.2.23), <> [[8.2.62]] iti kutvām| `yāvṛṅ, tādṛṅ` iti| <<ā sarvanāmnaḥ>> [[6.3.91]] ityātvam| `sadṛṅ` iti| `dṛgduśavatuṣu` [[6.3.88]] iti samānasya sabhāvaḥ||`dyauḥ` iti| auttve kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ| ihākṣadyūrityakṣairdīṣyatīti kvipi kṛte tadāśraye cāntaraṅgatvāt? `cchvoḥ śūjanunāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] ityuṭh| ekadeśavikṛtasayānanyatvāddivśabdaṃ evāyamityūkagārasyottvaṃ prāpnoti, tat? kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `diviti prātipadikam` ityādi| astyevāyaṃ divśabdo dhātuḥ, asti cāvyutpannaṃ prātipadikam| tatra dhātuḥ sānubandhakaḥ, asya <> [[7.2.56]] ityuditkāryam| prātipadikaṃ tu niranubandhakam, na hi tasya kiñcidanubandhakāryamasti| tatra niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|56) dhāturiha gṛhrate| tenānnadyurityatra na bhavatyottvaprasaṅgaḥ| takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ||halṅyādilope prāpte nalope cāttvaṃ vidhīyate| `panthāḥ` iti| <> [[7.1.87]] iti nyādeśaḥ, `iti'sarvanāmasthāne` [[7.1.86]] ityattvam| nanu cāsya sthānyanunāsiko nakāraḥ, tatra <> [[1.1.70]] iti savarṇānāṃ grahaṇe satyāntaratamyādanunāsikenaivākāreṇa bhavitavyam| kimiha śuddho'yamudāhyiyate? ityāha - `sthāninyanunāsike'pi` ityādi| atraiva kāraṇamāha - `bhāvyamānaḥ` ityādi| yadi ca tapareṇāpi bhāvyamānenāṇā savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, evaṃ sati `viṅvanoranunāsikasyāt` [[6.4.41]] ityatrāpi na syāt, tathā <> [[6.4.42]] ityatrānunāsikākāro na syāt| evaṃ tarhi naivāyamākārastaparaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? dakāraḥ| dakārastu mukhasukhārthaḥ, sa cartvabhūtatvānna śrūyate| syādetat - yadyapi bhāvyamāno'ṇ? savarṇānna gṛhṇātīti (vyā|pa|35) savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tathāpyanunāsikaviśiṣṭasyoccāraṇādanunāsikenaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum? ityāha - `śuddho hi` ityādi| ayaṃ hrakāraḥ śuddho niranunāsika ucyate tasmācchuddha eveti nānunāsikaviśiṣṭaḥ| athāyaṃ kimarthaṃ dīrgha ucyate, na hrasva eva kriyatām, atrāpi `akaḥ savarṇe` [[6.1.101]] iti dīrghatvena sidhyatyeva? na sidhyati; <> [[6.1.97]] iti pararūpatvaṃ syāt| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti cet? na; asti hranyadakāroccāraṇasya prayojanam| kiṃ tat? nakārasya śravaṇaṃ na syāditi| lopo hi kriyamāṇe gauravaṃ syāt, tasmāddīrgho vidhīyate||atha `āt` [[7.1.85]] ityanuvartamāne kimarthamadvacanam, hrasvasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syāditi cet? naitat; kṛte hi hrasvatve sau paratau'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena [[6.1.97]] bhavitavyamanyatra <> [[6.4.7]] ityanena, tatkuto hrasvasya śravaṇam? ityāha - `āditi vartamāne` ityādi| ṣapūrvo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat? tathoktam| kathaṃ punarivaṃ ṣapūrvārthaṃ bhavati? ityāha - `ṛbhukṣaṇam` ityādi| yadi prakṛto dīrgha eva vidhīyate, tadā ṛbhukṣamindramityatra hrasvasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt| hrasvavidhāne tu <> [[6.4.9]] iti dīrghavidhānāt? pakṣe bhavati| sthāninyādeśe ca taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārthamityeke| pathīrityatra dīrghanivṛttyarthamitayanye| panthānamicchati <> [[3.1.8]] , `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] dīrghaḥ - pathīyati; pathīyateḥ kvip, <> [[6.4.48]] ityallopaḥ, <> [[6.4.50]] iti yakārasaya lopaḥ - pathīḥ||thaḥ, nthaḥ - iti dvāvapi sthānyādeśāvanackau| yatttvantha ityatrākāraḥ śrūyate sa uccāraṇārthaḥ| satyapyādeśasyānekāltve `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti` (vyā|pa|106) iti thakāramātrasyādeśo vijñāyate, na sarvasya||`sarvanāmasthāne` ityādi| <> [[1.4.18]] pratyatra <> [[1.4.17]] ityataḥ `asarvanāmasthāne` ityanuvartamāne bhasaṃjñā vihitā, tatra yadi sarvanāmasthāne parataḥ pathyādīnāṃ ṭilopaḥ syāt, tadā bhasaṃjñakāste na syuḥ, atha bhasaṃjñakāste syustadā sarvanāmasathānaṃ paraṃ tebyo na syāditi bhasaṃjñakānāṃ sarvanāmasthānasya ca sahānavasthānalakṣaṇo virodhaḥ| tasmādyadyapyuttarārthaṃ sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇamanuvartate, tathāpīha nābhisambadhyate||asuṅo ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ| ukāra ugitkāryārthaḥ| `pumān` iti| `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] ityādinā num, <> [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| `iha paramapumān` ityādi| paramaścāsau pumāṃśceti <> [[2.1.61]] ityādinā samāse kṛte yāvadvibhaktirnotpadyate tāvadasuṅādeśena na bhavitavyam; tasya tadāśrayatvāt| samāsāntodāttatvaṃ tu na kiñcidapekṣata iti antaraṅgatvāt? prāgeva vibhakterantodāttatvaṃ bhavati| paścādutpannāyāṃ vibhaktāvasuṅ asvarasya vyañjanasya syāne bhavanna niyatasvaraḥ syāt? tataścāniṣṭo'pi svaraḥ prāpnoti, antodāttameva cottarapadamiṣyate, ādyudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti| `tadartham` ityādi| arthaśabdo nivṛttivācī, yathā - maśakārtho dhūma iti| tadarthaṃ tasyāniṣṭasya svarasaya nivṛttyarthamupadeśivadvavacanaṃ kartavyam, akṛte samāsāntodāttatvaṃ upadeśāvasthāyāmeva vibhaktyutpatteḥ prāgasuṅ? yathā syāt| tenāsuṅi pūrvaṃ kṛte paścāt? samāsāntodāttatvena paramapumānityayaṃ śabdo'ntodātto bhavati| yadyevam, pumānityayaṃ śabdo'pyantodāttaḥ syāt, upadeśāvasthāyāmevāsuṅi kṛte paścāt? prātipadikasvareṇa bhavitavyam? ityāha - `pumānityayaṃ punaḥ` ityādi| pumsśabdo'yaṃ punāteḥ `muksuno hrasvaśca` (da|u|9|48) [pāteḥ ḍumsun-da|u| pāteḍussun? paṃ|u|4|177] iti muksunpratyayānto vyutapāditaḥ| tena nitsvareṇāyamādyudātto bhavati, nāntodāttaḥ||ṇiditi saṃjñā vā'nena kriyate - gotaḥ paraṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ ṇidbhavati, ṇitsaṃjñaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ; atha vā - gotaḥ parasya sarvanāmasthadhānasya ṇakāra itsaṃjñako bhāvyate, tena gotaḥ parasakya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇakāra itsaṃjñako bhavatīti; ādeśo vā vidhīyate - gotaḥ parasya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇiṇakārānubandhavānādeśo bhavati; atideśo kriyate - gotaḥ ṇidbhavati, ṇidvadbhavatītyarthaḥ, vināpi vatinā vatyartho gamyate, yathā - gāṅakuṭādisūtre [[1.2.1]] | tatrādye paśe saṃjñoccāritā saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayatīti ṇitpradeśeṣu kṛtrimatvādasyaiva sarvanāmasthānasya grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, na ṇvulādīnām| dvitīye tu ṇakāra itsaṃjñakaḥ sarvanāmasthānasya prasajyeta| tṛtīye tu punarṇit? sarvanāmasthānaṃ na kvaciddṛṣṭamiti| ya evaite ṣvulādayasya evādeśāḥ prasajyerannityete doṣā ādyeṣu triṣu pakṣeṣu yathākramaṃ pratividheyāḥ| tatpratividhāne pratipattigauravaṃ syāt, atideśapakṣe tu na kiñcit? pratividheyam, ataḥ sa eva sādhuriti| tamevāśrityāha - `gośabdāt` ityādi| `ṇitkāryam` ityādinā ṇidbhavatītyasyārthaṃ vyācakṣaṇaḥ kāryātideśo'yamityācaṣṭe| gauriti vṛddhirṇitkāryam| `citraguḥ` iti| yatra bahuvrīhau kṛte <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvaḥ| tatrāsati taparakaraṇe `aṅgādhikāre tasya taduttarapadasya` (pu|pa|vṛ|85) iti vacanāttadantavidhimabhyupagamya sthānivadbhāvena gośabdāntametadaṅgaṃ bhavatīti ṇidbhāvaḥ prāpnoti| tapakaraṇe tu tatakālaniyame sati na bhavati; bhinnakālatvāt| <> [[1.1.70]] ityatrāṇgrahaṇasya nivṛttatvādanaṇo'pi tatkālaniyamo bhavatyeva| `katham` ityādi| satyapi taparakaraṇaṃ `hrasvasya guṇaḥ` [[7.3.108]] , `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] iti sambuddhijasorguṇe kṛte he citrago, he citragava ityatra prāpnoti| tatkālatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca lakṣamapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) na bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; yatra hi sthānivadbhāvastatraivā nopatiṣṭhate; adhyayā hi sthānivadbhāvo'narthakaḥ syāt| `aṅgavṛtte puna` ityādi parīhāraḥ| eṣa tu he citragavityatra parīhāraḥ, na tu citragava ityatra; aniṣṭhitatvāt| avādeśe hi kṛte niṣṭhitatvamatra bhaviṣyati, na ca guṇamātre; aprayogārhatvāt| ata evāvyāpakatvādasya parīhārasyāparituṣyan? parihārāntaramāha - `atha vā` ityādi| syādetat - atrāpi goḥ sambandhi sarvanāmasthānamānantaryalakṣaṇena bhavati sambandheneti/ ata āha - `yacca` ityādi| yadyānantaryalakṣaṇena goḥ sambandhi sarvanāmasthānaṃ gṛhrate tadā ṣaṣṭhaāśrayaṇāmanarthakaṃ syāt, pañcamyevāśrayitavyeti; kramavyatikrame prayojanābhāvāt| tasmāt? ṣaṣṭhaāśrayaṇasāmarthyādgośabdasyārthasya ya ekātvādayasteṣu yatsarvanāmasthānaṃ tadgoḥ sarvanāmasthānamityucyate| tat? punargośabdasyaikatvādīnāṃ veditavyam| ādiśabdena dvitvādipari grāhaḥ| tatraitat? syāt - citraguśabdādapi yat? sarvanāmasthānaṃ tadgośabdasyārthasyaikatvādiṣu vartate? ityāha - `citraguśabdāt` ityādi| yadi yadgoḥ sambandhi sarvanāmasthānaṃ tasya ṇidbhāvo vidhīyate, tadā taparakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, taddhi citragurityādau mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate| na cātra prāptiḥ, na hyatra goḥ sambandhi sarvanāmasthānam, kiṃ tarhi? anyapadārthasyetyāha - `taparakaraṇaṃ` tu ityādi| `kecit` ityādi| kimarthaṃ punasta evaṃ paṭhanti? ityāha - `dyośabdo'pi` ityādi| ya tvedaṃ na paṭhanti `gotaḥ` iti, teṣāṃ dyośabdāt? parasya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇidbhāvo na sidhyatītyāha - `gota ityetadeva` ityādi| kathaṃ punaretadokārāntopalakṣaṇārthaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum? ityāha - `varṇanirdeśeṣu` ityādi| yathā <> [[1.1.1]] , `adeṅguṇaḥ` [[1.1.2]] ityavamādiṣu yogeṣu varṇastaparo nirdiśyata iti taparakaraṇaṃ varṇanirdeśeṣu hi prasiddham| tasmādihāpi taparanirdeśāt? `gotaḥ` ityetadokārāntopalakṣaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti| ato vacanāt? taparakaraṇaṃ varṇanirdeśārtha mevetyasyaivaukārāntopalakṣaṇārthaṃ vijñāyate||`ṇitkāryaṃ vā bhavatotyarthaḥ` iti| anena ṇitkāryasya pakṣe'bāvāṇṇidvā bhavatītyucyate, na tu ṇittvasyaiva pratiṣedha iti darśayati| na tu ṇala upadeśāvasthāyāṃ siddhaṃ ṇittvaṃ tadvacanaśatenāpi śakyaṃ tiṣeddhumiti bhāvaḥ| `cakāra, cakara` iti| yadā ṇittvaṃ tadā <> [[7.2.115]] iti vṛddhiḥ, anyadārdhadhātukalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ| `papāca, papaca` iti| yadā ṇittvaṃ tadā `akata upadhāyāḥ` [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiḥ, anyadā tadabhāvaḥ||`asambuddhau` iti paryudāsaḥ - sambuddheranyā'sambuddhiḥ| `he sakhe` iti| `hrasvasya gaṇaḥ` [[7.3.108]] iti guṇaḥ||pūrveṇa ṇittve prāpte'naṅ? vidhīyate| tasya ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `sakhā` iti| <> [[6.4.8]] iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisulopaḥ, [[6.1.66]] , <> [[8.2.7]] iti nakārasya| ākāre vidātavye'naṅvacanaṃ sorlopo yathā syāt| akāravidhāne tasya lopo na syāt, yathā - panthā iti||ṛkārāntasya <<ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ>> [[7.3.110]] iti guṇe prāpte| itareṣāmapi halṅyādilope [[6.1.66]] kṛte rutvavisarjanīyasāntadīrgheṣu prāpteṣu| `uśanasaḥ sambuddhāvapi pakṣa iṣyate` iti| tatkatham? cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena tambuddhāvapyuśanaso'naṅ? bhaviṣyati| yadyevam, nityaṃ syāt? naitat; <<ṇaluttamo vā>> [[7.1.91]] ityadhikārāt? pakṣe bhaviṣyati| vyavasthita vibhāṣāvijñānāccānyeṣāṃ nityam|`nalopapratiṣedho'pi pakṣa iṣyate` iti| kathametallabhyate? tatra hi svarito vā'nudātte padādau` [[8.2.6]] ityatau vetyanuvartate, tenaivaṃ vijñāyata - na ṅisambuddhyornalopapratiṣedho vā bhavatīti| vyavasthitavibhāṣādijñānāccośanasaḥ sambuddhinakārasya lopo vā bhaviṣyati| anyeṣāṃ tu nityameva lopo na bhaviṣyatīti| `tathā coktam` ityādinā'nantaroktamarthamāgamavacanana draḍhayati| `sāntam` iti| yadā'naṅa na kriyate| `nāntam` iti| na tu nalopaḥ| `adantam` iti| yadā nalopaḥ kriyate| `taparakaraṇamasandehārtham` iti| asati hi tasminnuśanasi parato yaṇādeśe kṛte sandehaḥ syāt - kimṛkārantasya grahaṇam? utta rephāntasyeti||`kroṣṭuśapabdastunpratyayāntaḥ saṃjñāśabdaḥ` iti| `kruśa āhvāne` (dhā|856)[`ahvāne rodane ca` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ityetasmāt? `sitanigamimasisacyavighāñkṛśibhyastun` (da|u|1|122)[`pasi` - da|u] iti tunpratyayāntasya saṃjñāyāṃ vyutpāditatvāt| saṃjñā punariyaṃ jambukasya| `tṛjvadbhavati` iti| tṛcā tulyaṃ vartata iti tṛjvat| `rūpātideśo'yam` iti vakṣayati| tatra `tṛjvadbhavati` ityukte tṛcchabdasaya yadrūpaṃ tadatidiśyata iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt? atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `tṛjantasaya yadrūpam` ityādi| etacca `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātma vihitastadādestadantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati` (pu|pa|vṛ|44) ityato labhyate| yadyapi śāstrātideśe'pyadoṣo bahudhā bhāvye pradarśitāḥ - tasyāduṣṭatvena prātipādanāt, kāryātideśo'payadīṣavāneva vyākhyātaḥ - tasya śāstrātideśenābhinnatvāt; tathāpi śāstrātideśakāryātideśayorarūpārthatvādrūpe guṇābhāvaḥ| rūpasya tu prādhānyam; tābhyāṃ tasya saṃskāryatvāt| ato rūpātideśo'yaṃ yukta ityāha - `rūpātideśo'yam` ityādi| yadi tarhi tṛjantasya yadrūpaṃ tat? kroṣṭuśabdasyātidiśyate tadā yatkiñcideva tṛjantasya rūpam - vaktṛ, paktṛ - ityevamādyapi prāpnoti? ata āha - `pratyāsatteśca` ityādi| iha dhātvantarasya pacatiprabhṛte stṛjantasya rūpamasti, kruśerapi, tat? kimaśrutasaya dhātostṛjantasya yadrūpaṃ tadatidiśyate, utta śrutasya kruśeriti? tatra śrutasyaiva yadrūpaṃ tadevātideṣṭuṃ iti| cakāroccāraṇasāmarthyāt? svaro'pyativiśyate| anyathā `tṛvat` ityeva brāūyāditi bhāvaḥ| `kroṣṭā` iti| tṛjvadbhāve kṛte pūrvasūtreṇānaṅ| `kroṣṭārau` kroṣṭāraḥ` iti| <<ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ>> [[7.3.110]] iti guṇaḥ, raparatvam, aptrādisūtreṇa [[6.4.11]] dīrghaḥ| `kroṣṭan` iti| <> [[6.1.102]] iti dīrghaḥ| <> [[6.1.103]] iti natvam||`krīṣṭrībhiḥ` iti| tṛjvadbhāve kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ| kena punaḥ kroṣṭuśabdādīkāraḥ, tṛjvadbhāve kṛte `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] ityaneneti cet? na; anudāttatvaprasaṅgādityata āha - `kroṣṭuśabdaṃ kecit` ityādi| `pañcabhiḥ kroṣṭrībhiḥ krītaiḥ` iti| <> [[2.1.51]] iti samāsaḥ| `ārhādagopuccha` [[5.1.19]] ityādinā ṭhak, tasya `adhyadrdhapūrva` [[5.1.28]] ityādinā lak, `luktaddhitaluki` [[1.2.49]] iti strīpratyayasya luk, tasmallupte ye ṅīṣpratyaye kṛte tṛjvadbhāvaṃ kurvanti teṣāṃ tṛjavadbhāvo na bhavati, tasmāt? `prativiṣeyam` iti| pratividhānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratividhānam - cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena lupte'pi strīpratyaye bhaviṣyati| ye tarhi gaurādiṣu na paṭhanti teṣāmīkāraḥ katham? ityāha - `gaurādiṣu` ityādi| teṣāṃ pañcakroṣṭubhirityatra na kiñcit? pratividheyam; parasya strīpratyayasya nimittatvenānāśritatvāt| nanu ca teṣāmapi strīpratyayasya luptatvādasasyāmaṅgasaṃjñāyāmaṅgasyocyamānastṛṇvadbhāvo na prāpnotīti pratividheyameva? naitadasti; lupte hi strīpratyaye pratyayalakṣaṇenāṅgasaṃjñā bhavatyeva| <> [[1.1.63]] iti yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ so'ṅgādhikāra vihitasyaiva kāryasya| na cāṅgasaṃjñā'ṅgādhikāre vihitā| `kṛte'tideśe` ityādi| `iko'ci vibhaktau [[7.1.73]] ityanuvṛttervibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ tadāśrayāyāñcāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ striyāṃ vartamānasya kroṣṭuśabdasyātideśaḥ kriyate| tasmin? kṛte ṛkārāntatvāt? `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp` [[4.1.5]] iti ṅībbhavati| nanu ca ṅīppratyaye kṛte'ntodāttaḥ kroṣṭrīśabdo na sidhyati? ityāha - `tatra` ityādi| kroṣṭrīśabdo'ntodātto'tidiśyata iti tṛsambandhina ṛkārasya sthāne yaṇādeśo bhavannudāttayaṇ? bhavati, tataśca <<śaturanumo nadyajādī>> [[6.1.173]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[6.1.174]] ityantodātto bhavati kroṣṭrīśabdaḥ||<> [[4.1.3]] iti nānuvartate, teneyamaprāptavibhāṣā| `kroṣṭunā` iti| <<āṅo nā'striyām>> [[7.3.120]] iti nābhāvaḥ| `kroṣṭave` iti| <> [[7.3.111]] iti guṇaḥ| `kroṣṭuḥ` iti| `ṛta ut` [[6.1.107]] ityuttvam, raparatvam, `rāt? sasya` [[8.2.24]] iti salopaḥ| `kroṣṭoḥ` iti| pūrvavadguṇaḥ, <<ṅasiṅasośca>> [[6.1.110]] iti pūrvarūpatvam? `kroṣṭari iti| <<ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ>> [[7.3.110]] iti guṇaḥ| `krīṣṭau` iti| <> [[7.3.119]] ityattvam, auttvañca| `tṛjvadbhāvāt` ityādi| tṛjvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ - puṃsi kroṣṭro iti, numo'vakāśaḥ - trapuṇe, jatuna iti; priyakroṣṭune vanāyetyatrobhayaprasaṅge sati numbhavati pūrvavipratiṣedheneti| nuṭo'vakāśaḥ - agnīnām, vāyūnāmiti, tṛjvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ sa eva; kroṣṭranāmityatrobhayaprasaṅge sati nuṅ? bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedheneti| pūrvavipratiṣedhastu paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvā llabhyate||`sarvanāmasthāne` [[7.1.86]] iti svaryate, na `tṛtīyādiṣu` [[7.1.97]] iti| `āgamā anudāttā bhavanti` (vyā|pa|105) ityanudāttatve prāpte, udāttatvārthaṃ vacanam| `tadantavidhiratreṣyate` iti| `aṅgādhikāre tasya taduttarapadasya` (pu|pa|vṛ|85) iti vacanāt| `priyacatvāḥ` iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| `sarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānam` (vā|113) iti saṃkhyāyāḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte `vā priyasya` (vā|114) iti priyaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ||pūrveṇāmi prāpte vacanam| `he priyacatvaḥ| he priyānaḍhavan` iti| atra catuḥśabdasya kevalasya sambuddhirna bhavatīti datantasyodāharaṇam| anajuhastu yadyapi kevalasya sambhavati, tathāpi tadantavidhiratreṣyata iti tadantasyodāharaṇam||`kiriti, girati` iti| `kṛ? vikṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1409), `gu nigaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1410)| <> [[3.1.77]] | `āstīrṇam` iti| `stṛ? ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1484),[stṛñ - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] iti natvam, `raṣābhyām` [[8.4.1]] iti ṇatvam, `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghaḥ| `viśīrṇam` iti| `śṛ? hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1488)| `mātṛṇām, pitṛṇām` iti| `nāmi` [[6.4.3]] iti dīrghaḥ| satyapi ṛkārāntatve'dhātutvādiha na bhavati| nanu ca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayai (vyā|pa|3) vatra na bhaviṣyati, tatkimetannivṛttyarthena dhātugrahaṇena? ityāha - `lākṣaṇikasyāpi` ityādi| kimarthaṃ panarlākṣaṇikasya grahaṇam? ityāha - `cikrīrvati` ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi lākṣaṇikasyātra grahaṇaṃ labhyate? ata eva dhātugrahaṇājjñāpakāt| tasya hretat? prayojanam - mātṛṇām, pitṛṇāmityatra mā bhūditi| yadīha lākṣaṇikasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt? tadā mātṛṇām, pitṛṇāmityādau lākṣaṇikatvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti dhātugrahaṇamanarthakam| tasmāllākṣikasyāpyatra grahaṇam| tena cikīrṣatītyeva mādiṣu <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghatve satyapi bhavatyeva| taparakaraṇamasandehārtham| `ra` ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt - kimayaṃ rephasya nirdeśaḥ? utta yaṇādeśa ṝkārasyeti?ṝkārāntasya dhātorittvamuktam| upadhābhūtasya dhātoṝkārasya na prāpnoti, iṣyate; tadarthametat| `kīrtayati` iti| `kṛta saṃśabdane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1656) curādau ṇyantaḥ| nanu ca `ūtiyūtijūtisātihetikīrta yaśca` [[3.3.97]] iti nipātanādevettvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti kathaṃ tadartho yogarambhaḥ? naitadasti; ktinviṣaya eva nipātanaṃ syāt| evaṃ tarhi pūrvayoge dhātunā ṝkāraṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ, atra tatsthasyeti? etadapi nāsti; evaṃ sati ṝkāramicchati ṝkārīyatītyatrāpi syāt| tasmādvaktavyamidam| `kṛtaśca` iti vaktavye `upadhāyāśca` iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham| `kṛtaśca` ityucyamāne takārasya syāt? naitadanti; `ṝtaḥ` iti pūrvasūtre viśeṣaṇatvena prakakṛtam; na śakyate taddhi viśeṣyatvena vivakṣitumiti| tasya `upadhāyā ṝkārasyekārādeśo bhavati` ityeṣa vṛttigrantho virudhyate| atra hi ṛkārasya viśeṣyatā darśitā| tasmādyathāṅgasyaitat? kvacidviśeṣaṇam; tathā `ṝtaḥ` ityetadapi pūrvasūtre viśeṣaṇam, iha tu viśeṣyam||`ṝta iddhātoḥ] [[7.1.100]] itīttve prāpta uttvaṃ vidhīyate| `pūrttaḥ` [`pūrttāḥ` - kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `pṛ? pālanapūraṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1086), ktaḥ| `na dhyākhyā` [[8.2.57]] ityādinā prativiṣaddhatvānna niṣṭhānatvaṃ bhavati| `vuvūrṣati` iti| `vṛ? varaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1490)| `mumūrṣati` iti| `mṛ? hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1492)| `sūsvūrṣati` iti| `sthṛ? śabdopatāpayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-932), <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghatvaṃ ṛkārāntatvamasya| atheha kathamuttvam - `vṛṅ? sambhaktau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1509), `vṛñ? varaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1254) - prāvuvūrṣate, prāvuvūrṣatīti, na hyatra ṛkāra oṣṭhapūrvaḥ kiṃ tarhi? dantyoṣṭhapūrvaṃ iti? tadetadāha - `dantyauṣṭhapurvo'pyoṣṭhapūrvo bhavati` ityādi| yo hrubhayasthāne niṣpadyate labhate'sāvanyataravyapadeśam| tena dantyauṣṭhao yo bhavati so'pyoṣṭhao bhavatyeva| dantyauṣṭhapūrvo'payoṣṭhapūrva eva| atha samīrṇamityatra kasmānni bhavati, asti hyatrāpyoṣṭhagrapūrvatā? ityāha - `oṣṭhao hyatra` ityādi| oṣṭhao hyatrāṅgāvayavo'pi| tatreha pratyāsatteraṅgāvayavo gṛhrate, nopasargavayavaḥ| pratyāsannatvaṃ punāprasaṅgasya prakṛtatvāt? upasargasya tu nāsti pratyāsannatvam; viparyayāt| `ittvottvābhyām` ityādi| ittvottvayoravakāśaḥ - āstīrṇam, pūrta iti; guṇavṛddhyoravakāśaḥ - cayanam, cāyaka iti; ihomayaṃ prāpnoti - āstaraṇam, āstārakaḥ, niparaṇam, nipāraka iti, atra guṇavṛddhī bhavato vipratiṣedhena||`taturiḥ, jaguriḥ` iti| taratergirateśca `ādṛgamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ? ca` [[3.2.171]] iti kikinoranyataraḥ, tataścottve <<dvirvacane'ci>> [[1.1.59]] iti sthānivadbhāvāt `tṛ? gṛ`, iti dviracyate, `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattvam| `papritamam, vavritamam` iti| `pṛ, vṛ` ityetayoḥ kikinoranyataraḥ, yathadeśaḥ| kipratyayāntāt? `atiśāyane tamap` [[5.3.55]] ityādinā tamap|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ saptamādhyāyasyaprathamaḥ pādaḥ|| - - -atha saptamādhyāyaḥdvitīyaḥ pādaḥ<> [[7.3.84]] iti guṇe prāpte vacanamidamārabhyate| sicīti, parasmaipadeṣviti ca dve apyeti parasaptamyau; tatra sico'ṅgāpekṣaṃ paratvaṃ, parasmaipadānāṃ tu sijapekṣam| `parasmaipadapare` iti| parasmaipadaṃ paraṃ yasmāt? sa tathoktaḥ| `igantasya` iti| `iko guṇabṛddhī` [[1.1.3]] ityasyopasthāne satīkā'ṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha - `igantasyāṅgasya vṛddhirbhavati` iti| `acaiṣīt, anaiṣīt` iti| `ciñ? cayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1251), `ṇoñ? prāpaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-91), bhūte luṅ, <> [[3.1.44]] , `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ, aḍāgamaḥ, <> [[3.4.99]] ityanuvartamāne `itaśca` [[3.4.100]] itīkāralopaḥ, `astisico'pukte` [[7.3.96]] itīṭ, `iṣkoḥ` [[8.3.57]] ityanuvartamāne <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam| `alāvīt? apāvīt` iti| `pūrvavalluṅa, `ārdhadhātukasyeṅvalādeḥ` [[7.2.35]] itīṭ? pūrvavadīṭ, `iṭa īṭi` [[8.2.28]] iti sico lopaḥ| `akārṣāt` iti| udāharaṇaṃ subodham| nanu cātrāntaraṅgatvādguṇena bhavitavyam, antaraṅgatvaṃ punastasyārdhadhātukāpekṣātvāt; vṛddhestvādguṇaviśeṣaṃ parasmaipadaparaṃ sicamapekṣya bahiraṅgatvam? ata āha - `antaraṅgamapi` ityādi| yadyantaraṅgatvādṇaḥ syāt, tadaitadvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādvacanasāmarthyādvahiraṅgāpi vṛddhirguṇaṃ bādhate| yadyevam, tarhi yathā vacana sāmarthyādvṛddhirantaraṅgamapi guṇaṃ bādhate, tathovaṅādeśamapi bādheta tataśca nyanuvīt, nyadhuvīditi na sidhyet? ityata āha - `vyanuvīnnyadhuvīt` ityādi| yatra hi vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho nāsti, tatra vacanasāmarthyādvidhyantaraṃ bādhitvā'sau pravartate| iha tu ṅittve sati <> [[1.1.5]] iti vṛddhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, pratiṣiddhā ca sato notsahata upaṅādeśaṃ bādhitum| tena tasyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ `aci śnudhātu` [[6.4.77]] ityādinovaṅādeśaḥ kriyate| ṅittvaṃ punaratra `ṇū stavane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1397), `dhū vidhūnane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1398) ityetayoḥ kuṭādiṣu pāṭhādgāṅakuṭādisūtreṇa [[1.2.1]] yathā sāmarthyādvṛddhyā guṇo bādhyate, tathā pratiṣedho'pi bādhyeta eva? naitadasti; guṇe hi nāprāpte vṛddhirārabhyate, pratiṣedhe tu prāpte cāprāpte ca| tatra yena nāprāpti nānyena (vyā|pa|49) guṇasyaiva bādhā yuktā, na pratiṣedhasya| `acyoṣṭa, aploṣṭa` iti| `cyuṅ? chyuṅ? jyuṅ? (na staḥ - dhātupāṭhe) iyuṅ? pruṅ? pluṅ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-955,956,957)antaśabdo'yamastyavayavavacanaḥ, yathā vastrāntaḥ, vasanānta iti| asti ca samīpavācī, yathā - udakāntaṃ priyaṃ prothamanuvrajediti| udakasamopamityarthaḥ| atrāvayavavācino'ntaśabdasya grahaṇe ihāntagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? tasya hrupādanasyaitat? prayojanam - rephalakārāntasya yathā syāditi| etacca <> [[1.1.72]] ityanenaiva sidhyati| tasmāt? samīpavācina eva grahaṇamiti matvā''ha - `rephalakāro yāvato'ntau= samīpī` iti| yadi tarhi lrāvantau yasya samīpāvata ityanena nirdiśyate vṛddhibhāg? na nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt| evañca <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityantyasya syāt; akārasamīpabhūtasya lrāntasyāntyasya vṛddhibhāja iko'bhāvādityata āha - `ata eva sthāne` iti| evaṃ manyate - akārasya śrutatvādakārasyaiva sthāne vṛddhirvijñāyata iti| `akṣārīt` ityādi| `kṣara sañcalane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-851), `tsara chadmagatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-554), `jvala dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-804), `hvala hrala calane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-805,806) ityeteṣāṃ rūpāṇi| `ato halāderlaghorityasya vikalpasyāyamapavādaḥ` iti| etena niyamārthatāmasya yogasya darśayati| `nyakhorīt, nyamīlīt` ityādi| `khura chedane` (vā|yāṃ|1342), `mīla śmīla smīla śmīla nimeṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-517-520)| `mā bhavānaṭīt, mā bhavānaśīt` iti| `aṭa paṭa gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-295,296), `aśabhojane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1523) <> [[6.4.74]] ityāṭpratiṣedhārtho māṅyogaḥ| `bhavān` iti| ayaṃ sandehanirāsārthaḥ; ato'nyatra viśeṣābhāvāt| `avabhrīt` iti| `abhra vabhra mabhra cara gatyarthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-556-559)| `aāllīt` iti| `ālaālla āśugamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-549,550)| `na tāvataḥ samīpau` iti| bhakāralakārābhyāṃ vyavadhānāditi||anigantārtho'yamārambhaḥ| atha vadivrajyogrrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā halantatvādeva vṛddhiḥ sidhyati? ityata āha - `vikalapabādhanārtham` ityādi| `ato halādeḥ` [[7.2.7]] vikalpaṃ vakṣyati, tasya bādho yathā syāt| `apākṣīt` iti| `ḍupacaṣ? pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-996), <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam| `abhaistīt` iti| `bhidir? vidāraṇe (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1439), `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - dakārasya takāraḥ| `arautsīt` iti| `rudhira āvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1438)| `atra` ityādi| `vadivrajyoḥ ityeko yogaḥ, `acaḥ` iti dvitīyaḥ; evaṃ yogavibhāge sati halantagrahaṇamantareṇāpīṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva| `katham` iti| asambhāvayataḥ praśnaḥ| `vadivravyoḥ` ityādinā yathā yogavibhāge sati sidhyati tathā darśayati| tatra prathamayoge pūrvasūtrāt? `ataḥ` iti sthānyanuvartate| tenāvādīt, avrājīdityetāvatsidhyati| tato yadaceti dvitīyaṃ sūtram, tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvayoryatheṣṭatvāt? prakṛtenāṅgenājiviśidhyate - aṅgasya yo'jiti| tenāṅgasyāco yatra tatrāvasthitasya sici parato vṛddhirbhavati| apākṣīdityādyapi sidhyati| yadyevam, yogavibhāga eva kartavyaḥ, kiṃ halgrahaṇena? ityata āha - `tadetat` ityādi| halsamudayaparigrahaḥ kimartho yatasatadartho'yaṃ yatnaḥ kriyate? ityāha - `ihāpi` ityādi| `arāṅkṣīt` iti| `rañja rāge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1167)| `asāṅkṣīt` iti| `ṣanja saṅge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-987)| nanu cāṅgasya yo'c? tasya sici parato vṛddhirucyate, na cātrāṅgasambandhino'conantaraḥ paraḥ sic? sambhavati yasyānena vṛddhirvidhīyate| tathā hrakārāntasyāṅgasya tāvat? <> [[6.4.48]] iti lopena bhavitavyam| na ca vacanādato lopaṃ vṛddhirbādhiṣyata iti śakyate vaktum; yadi hrakārāntasyaiva vṛddhiḥ syāt? pratyāhāragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, `ataḥ` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| atha vā - tadapi sambhavati| akārāntasya tu kāmaṃ saṃbhavati yāvāprabhṛteḥ| na tu tasyāsti viśeṣaḥ satyāṃ vā vṛddhāvasatyāṃ vā| igantasya punaḥ `sici vṛddhiḥ` [[7.2.1]] ityādinaiva vṛddhirvihitā| sandhyakṣarāṇāṃ ca nāstyeva; <<ādeca upadeśe'śiti>> [[6.1.45]] ityāttvavidhānāt| udavoḍhām, udavoḍhamityatrāstīti cet? na; ḍhalopasyāsiddhatvāt| tadayaṃ na kyacidaco'nantaraḥ parasmaipadaparaḥ sic? sambhavati| ucyate cedaṃ vacanam; tato `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt` (vyā|pa|46) yathā'pākṣīdityādau vṛddhirbhavati, tathā'rāṅkṣīdityādāvapi vṛddhirbhaviṣyati, tato nārtho halgrahaṇena? ityata āha - `anyathā hi` ityādi| ekena varṇena sarvatra vyavadhānamasti| halsamudāyena kyacidevārāṅkṣīdityādau| apākṣīdityadau nāsti, tatrasati halagrahaṇe'nantaroktayā nītyā yatraikena varṇena vyavadhānamasti - apākṣīdityādau, tatraiva syāt, yatra tvarnekavarṇena vyavadhānamasti - arāṅkṣīdityādau, tatra na syāt, yathā'pipaṭhiṣīdityādau ādayayoracorvyavadhānānna bhavati| halgrahaṇe tu sati halsamudāyena vyavadhāne'pi bhavati; halgrahaṇasāmarthyāt| udavoḍhām, udavoḍhamityatra vahervṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati, ḍhalope kṛte'halantāditi cet? na; ḍhalopasyāsiddhatvāditi yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - kriyate evātra vṛddhiḥ| tasyāstvottvaṃ vidhīyata iti darśayitumāha - `udavoḍhām` ityādi| ādiśabdena dhātvādayo gṛhyante| vaherutpūrvālluṅ, tasthasau, tayoḥ `tasthasthamipām` [[3.4.101]] ityādinā tāntamādeśau yathākramam, halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ, `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam, <> [[8.2.26]] iti sico lopaḥ, `jhaṣastathorgho'dhaḥ` [[8.2.40]] iti ṣatvam, <<ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ>> [[8.4.41]] iti ṣṭutvam| <> [[6.3.112]] ityottvam| tatra hrottve punarvṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `tatra kṛte punaḥ` ityādi| ekaṃ hyatra vṛddhiśāstram, tena ca prāgeva kṛtā vṛddhiriti kṛtakāryatvādvṛddhiśāstrasya, punastanna vyāpriyata iti na bhavati punarvṛddhiḥ| sauḍhāmitrirityatra tarhi kathamottve kṛte vṛddhirbhavati? ityāha - `yatra tu` ityādi| yatra prāgvṛddhiḥ kṛtā tatra kṛtārthatvādvṛddhiśāstrasya punarna vyāpriyata iti na bhavati vṛddhiḥ, soḍhāmitrirityatra tu na kṛtā vṛddhiḥ| tasmādakṛtārthatvādvṛddhiśāstraṃ vyāpriyata iti bhavatyeva vṛddhiḥ| sā ca bhavtyokārasya bhavati, nākarasya vṛddhiriti; vṛddhividhānakāla okārasyaiva vṛddhibhājaḥ sannihitatvāt| saherniṣṭhā, tatra ḍhatvādiṣu kṛteṣu soḍha iti bhavati, soḍho'mitro'neneti soḍhāmitraḥ, tasyāpatyamiti `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] , `taddhiteṣvacāmāne` [[7.2.117]] vṛddhiḥ| <> [[1.1.72]] ityeva siddhe tadantatve'ntagrahaṇamasandehārtham| `halo'caḥ` ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt - kimajantasyāṅgasya halo vṛddhirbhavati? uta halantasyāceti||halantasyāceti yā vṛddhiḥ prāptā sā halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiranena pratiṣidhyate ‘anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā’ (vyā|pa|19) iti kṛtvā| ‘adevīt, asevīt’ iti| ‘divu krīḍādau’ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1107), ‘ṣivu tantusantāne’ [‘ṣivu’- dā|pā|] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1108)| vṛddhau pratiṣiddhāyāṃ ‘pugantalaghūpadhasya’ 7.3.86 iti guṇaḥ| ‘akoṣīdamoṣīt’ iti| ‘kuṣa niṣkarṣe’ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1518), ‘muṣa steye’ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1530)| ‘nanvatraitadantaraṅgatvāt’ [nanvatraitadapyantaraṅgatvāt - kāśikā] iti codyam| ‘naitadevam’ iti parihāraḥ| ubhayañcaitadgatārtham||`agrahīt` iti| graha upādāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 1533)| `asyamīt` iti| `sthamu svana dhvana śabde`(dhātupāṭhaḥ-826)-828) `avamīt` iti| `ṭu vama udgiraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-849)| `adyatīt` iti| `vyayavittasamutsarge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1932) `akṣaṇīt` iti| `kṣaṇu hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1465) aāsīditi| `āsaprāṇane` (dā|pā|1069)| `ajāgarīt` iti| `jāgṛ nidrākṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1072)| `aunayīt? ailayīt` `ūna parihāṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1888), [pariharaṇe - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `īla preraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1660), [`ila` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] curādiṇic| `nonayati` [[3.1.51]] ityādinā caṅi pratiṣiddhe sijeva bhavati, <<āḍajādīnām>> [[6.4.72]] ityāṭ, `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `aāyīt` iti| `ṭu ośyi gativṛddyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1010)| `aragīt, alagīt? iti| `rage lage saṅge [rage śaṃkāyām - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-785,786)| `asthāgīt` iti| `sthage saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-790) [`ṣṭage` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `akakhīt` iti| `kakhe hasane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-784)| `sā ca neṭīti na pratiṣidhyate` iti| anantarāyā halantakṣaṇāyā vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, na pūrvasyāḥ| atha kimarthaṃ ṇiiāgrahaṇam, yāvatāntaraṅgatvādevātra guṇena bhavitavyam, kṛte guṇe'yādeśena, tataśca yakārāntatvādeva tathoḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati? ityāha - `na ca` ityādi| idamantaraṅgatvaṃ sicyabhyupetyoktam| idānīmantaraṅgatvameva sici nāstīti darśayitamāha - `yadi` ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ṇiiāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? ityāta āha - `guṇāyādeśayoḥ` iti| yadi tarhi sicyantaraṅgatvaṃ nāsti, yaduktaṃ `antaraṅgamapi guṇameṣā vṛddhirvacanādvādhate` iti tadvirudhyate? nāsti virodhaḥ, adhyāropyo tathābhidhānāt| `atha` ityādi| atra vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ| atha jāgṛgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti pṛṣṭasya kiṃ kāraṇaṃ jāgṛgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti praśnāvasare yenābhiprāyeṇa pṛṣṭavāṃstamāviṣkarttumāha - `jāgro'viciṇ` ityādi| yathā jāgarayatītyādau <> [[7.2.115]] iti prāptāṃ vṛdiṃdha jāgartarguṇo bādhate tathā sicivṛddhimapi bādhidhyate, vṛddhyapavādatvādguṇaśāstrasaya| `gṛṇe kata` ityādi| akṛte hi gaṇe yā sici vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti sāpavādatvādguṇena bādhyate; akṛtārthatvādguṇaśāstrasya| na ca sā'nena vacanena bādhiṣyate; kiṃ tarhi? guṇe kṛte raparatve ca <> [[7.2.2]] ityuttarakālaṃ yā vṛddhi prāpnoti tasyāḥ pratiṣedho vidhīyate, na ca śakyā guṇena bādhituṃ sā| na hi <<jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu>> [[7.3.85]] iti śāstraṃ punaḥ pravarttitumutsahate; kṛtārthatvāt| na cānyadguṇalakṣaṇamastyuttarakālavṛddherbādhakam| tatra yadi jāgagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, <> [[7.2.2]] iti vṛddhi syāt| `atha` ityādi codakaḥ| yadi guṇe'pi kṛte punarvṛddhiḥ syāt, vṛddhiviṣaye guṇavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāt? guṇavidhānasāmarthyādyāpi guṇe kṛte raparatve ca paścāt? <> [[7.2.2]] iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti sā pratiṣidhyate, yathā - jāgarayatītyatra| guṇe kṛte raparatve ca yā prāpnoti <> [[7.2.116]] ityuttarakālabhādinī vṛddhiḥ, sā'pi na bhavati; guṇena bādhitatvāt| `tathā ca` ityādi| guṇāvidhānasāmarthyāduttarakālabhāvinyapi vṛddhirbādhyate; anyathā hi gūṇe kṛte raparatve ca `ata upadhāyāḥ` ityuttarakālabhāvinī vṛddhiḥ, sā'pi na bhavati; gaṇena bādhitatvāt| `tathā ca` ityādi| guṇavidhānasāmarthyādutarakālabhāvinyapi vṛddhirguṇena bādhyata iti, tadeva draḍhayati| evañca ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedho'rthavān? bhavati yadyuttarakālabhāvinyapi vṛddhirbādhyate; anyathā hi guṇe kṛte raparatve ca <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhyā bhavitavyam| ciṇṇaloryaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate so'narthakaḥ syāt| tasmāduttarakālabhāvinyapi vṛddhirguṇena bādhyata iti sthimetat| tataśca śakyameva jāgṛgrahaṇamakartam| evaṃ pratyākhyāte jāgṛgrahaṇe, itara āha - `tat? kriyate` ityādi| ya evaṃ pratipattuṃ na śaktaḥ, taṃ prati vispaṣṭārthaṃ jāgṛgrahaṇaṃ kriyate||nityaṃ vṛddhiprasaṅge prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam|| `neṭi` [[7.2.4]] iti pratiṣedhe prāpte vikalpārthamidamārabhyate| `akaṇīt, akāṇīt` iti| `aṇa raṇa vaṇa kaṇa bhaṇa kvaṇa` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-444-446,449,447,450) iti bhvādau paṭhate| `araṇīt? arāṇīt` iti| raṇirapi tatraiva|`nyakuṭīt` iti| `kuṭa kauṭilye (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1366)| `nyapuṭīt` iti| `puṭa saṃśleṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1367) nanu cātra kuṭāditvānṅittve sati <> [[1.1.5]] iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, tato naitanniyuyartham? `ataḥ ityetat? kartavyam? ityata āha - `ata ityetasminnasati` ityādi| yadi `ataḥ` iti nocyeta, tato'vaśyam? <> [[7.2.3]] ityanuvartayitavyam; anyathā hranirdiṣṭasthānikatvādika eva laghorvikalpena vṛddhiḥ syāt - adevīdityādau, akāṇīdityādau tvakārasya na syāt| ajgrahaṇānuvṛttau tu satyāmajlakṣameyaṃ vṛddhiḥ syāt, neglakṣaṇā; nirddiṣṭasthānikatvāt| yatra hi sthānī na nirddiśyate sa iglakṣaṇāyā vṛddherviṣayaḥ, na tu yatra sthāno nirdiśyate so'pi, tataśca <> [[1.1.5]] iti pratiṣedho na syāt; tatra `ikaḥ` ityadhikārāt| tasmānnyakuṭīt, nyapuṭīdityatra vikalpena vṛddhirmā bhūdityevamarthamata iti vaktavyam| `atakṣīt, arakṣīt` iti| `takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-655,656), `rakṣa pālane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-658)| iha sica ānantarye'kārasya vṛddhirucyate, na kvacidanantaraḥ sic? sambhavati| tatra `yena nāvyavacānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt` (vyā|pa|46) iti vyavadhāne'pi vṛddhyā bhavitavyam| evaṃ yathā akāṇīdityatra laghorakārasya bhavati, tathā acakāsīdityatrāpi laghorakārasya vṛddhyā bhaditavyameva? ityanenābhiprāyeṇāha - `atheha kasmānna bhavatyacakāsīt` iti| `cakāsṛ dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1074)| `yena` ityādi parīhāraḥ| `halā vyavadhānamāśritam` iti| halantasyetyanuvṛtterityabhiprāyaḥ|laghoriti kimiti yenaivaṃ pṛṣṭam, sa evaṃ laghugrahaṇaṃ pratyācikhyāsurāha - `atha punaḥ` ityādi| yadyevaṃ parikalpyate, vacanaprāmāṇyaddhalā vyavadhānamāśrīyate, na tvacā, `ato laghoḥ` iti vaktavyam, anyathā hratakṣīdityādāvapi syāt? atra hi halā vyavadhānam, nācā| atha punarivaṃ parikalpyate - `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahate'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāta` (vyā|pa|46) ityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrīyate, na punaranekeneti nārtho laghorityaneneti, na hrevaṃ parikalpyamāne'takṣīdityādau prāpnoti yadyanekena varṇena vyavadhānam? ityata āha - `tat? kriyate` ityādi||`ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ [[7.2.35]] itīṭaṃ vakṣyati, tasya yatra prakṛtilakṣaṇaḥ paratiṣedho nāsti tatrānena pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| purastāt? pratiṣedhakāṇḍasya prayojanaṃ krādiniyamasūtre [[7.2.13]] vakṣyati| `īśitā` ityādi pratyayāntare tviṭo bhāvena `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt` [[7.2.10]] iti yaḥ prakṛtinimittakaḥ pratiṣedhastadabhāvamevācaṣṭe| `īāraḥ` iti| `īśa aiārye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1020), `stheśabhāsa` [[3.2.175]] ityādinā varac| `dīpraḥ` iti| `dīpī dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1150), `namikamyi` [[3.2.167]] ityādinā raḥ| `bhasma` iti| `bhasa bharsanadīptyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1100)| <<āto maninkvanibvanipaśca>> [[3.2.74]] ityādau <<anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante>> [[3.2.75]] iti manin| `yācñā` iti| `ṭu yācṛ yācñāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-863)| `yajayāca` [[7.3.66]] ityādinā naṅ| `varamanādau prayojanam` iti yaduktaṃ tatra prarigaṇanatvamavadhārya ya evaṃ codayet - yadi varamanādāviti parigaṇanaṃ kriyate tadā `ṣaṇu dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1464), `ñamantāḍḍaḥ` (paṃ|u|1|104) - ṣaṇḍaḥ, `śamaḥ khaḥ` (paṃ|u|1|113) - śaṅkha ityādau pratiṣedho na prāpnotīti - taṃ prati nedaṃ parigaṇanamiti darśayitumāha - `varamanādāvityudāharaṇam` iti| `atha tatra` ityādi| tatrauṇādike ḍapratyaye samādhīyeteti parigaṇanapakṣabhādi codyaṃ parihyiyata ityarthaḥ| `sambavodāharaṇapradarśanārthametat` iti| atrāpi na parigaṇanametaditi sambadhyate| pratiṣedhasya sambhava udāhyiyate| yatra kṛti pratiṣedhaḥ sambhavati tasya pradarśanārthametaduktaṃ bhavati| yatra vasādau kṛtīdpratiṣedhaḥ sambhavati, tasya pradarśanārthaṃ varamanādāvityuktam, na punaretat? parigaṇanamiti| `rurudiva, rurudima` iti| atra kṛdgrahaṇādārdhadhātukasyeṭo na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ||`anudāttāt` iti| bahuvrīhirayam - nāsyodātto'stītyanudāttaḥ| anvarthaśabdo'yamanudāttaśabdaḥ| śāstrīye hranudātte gṛhramāṇa ekavarṇā eva dhātavo gṛhreran| tathā cānyevāṃ dhātūnāmanudāttapratijñānamanarthakaṃ syāt| iha cekājgrahamamupadeśaviśeṣaṇam| `upadeśe` iti| prakṛtipāṭha ityarthaḥ| `anudāttaśca` iti| upadeśa ityapekṣate; tenopadeśagrahaṇamubhayaviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| tasya prayojanaṃ pratyudāharaṇeṣvāviṣkariṣyati| `ye tathā gaṇe paṭhante` iti| etena gaṇapāṭhādeva te veditavyā iti darśayati| `ta eva` ityādinā dvitīyaṃ parijñānahetumāha| kāḥ punastā aniṭkārikāḥ? ityāha - `aniṭsvarāntaḥ` ityādi| yāvātan kaścit? svarānto'janto dhātuḥ sa sarvo'niṅbhavatotyetadadṛśyatām, avagamyatām| aniḍiti bahuvrīhiḥ - nāsmādiḍastīti| `aniṭ? svarāntaḥ` ityasyotsargasyāpavādamāha - `imāṃstu` ityādi| imāṃstvadantādīn? vakṣyamāṇān? seṭaḥ pravadanti| iṭā saha vartanta iti seṭaḥ| ke vadanti? tadvidaḥ seḍaniḍvida ityarthaḥ| `adantam` iti bahuvrīhiḥ - akārastaparo'nto yasya sa tathoktaḥ| taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyartham| `ṝdantam` iti| ayamapi bahuvrīhiḥ| taparakaraṇamasandehārtham| rantamityucyamāne, kimayaṃ rephasya nirdeśaḥ? utta ṝkārasya? iti sandeha - syāt| `ṝtāṃ ca` iti| ṝtāmiti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| ṛkārāntānāṃ madhye vṛṅavṛño seṭau pravadanti| taparakaraṇaṃ pādaparaṇārtham| pūrvamṛkārāntagrahaṇāgena hi hrasvasya grahaṇamihāvasīyate| `iāḍīṅivarṇeṣu` iti| nirghāraṇe saptamī| ivarṇānteṣu, madhye iāḍīṅau seṭau pravadanta| `ṭu oiā gativṛddhyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1010), `ḍīṅ? vihāyasāgatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-968)| `atha śīṅśriñāvapi` iti| `athetyānantarye| anayoḥ pūrvaktayoranantaraṃ śīṅśriñāvapi seṭau pravadanti| `ghīṅ? svapne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1032), `śriñ? sevāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-897)| `gaṇastham` iti| svarūpakhyānametat, na tu viśeṣaṇam - gaṇanivṛttyarthamiti; tasyāsambhavāt| `ūntam` iti| `lūñ? chedane` (dā|pā|1483), `pūñ? pavane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1482) ityevamādayaḥ| `uttāñca` iti| nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhī| `ru śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1034), `snu praruāvaṇe`[ṣṇu - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1038)| `kṣuvaṃ tathorṇotim` ityādi| `ṭu kṣu śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1036), `ūrṇuñ? ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1039), `yu miśraṇa` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1033), [miśraṇe'miśraṇe ca - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `ṇu stutau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1035), `kṣṇu tejane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1037)| `āvadhiṣṭa` iti| āṅpūrvāddhanterluṅ, `āṅoyamahanaḥ` [[1.3.28]] ityātmanepadam; <<ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām>> [[3.1.54]] iti vadhādeśaḥ| sa cāvadhīdityatra vṛddhirmā bhūdityevamarthamadantaḥ paṭhate| iṭ, <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ|atha kimarthamūrṇotirudātta upadiśyate? iṭpratiṣedho mā bhūditi cet? naitadasti; ekāco hīṭpratiṣedha ucyate, na cāsyaikācatvamasti? ityata āha - `vācya ūrṇorṇuvadbhāvaḥ` iti| `ekāctvam` iti| padāntasyāpi kutvābhāvaḥ, kutvasyānityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu `bahvacpūrvapadāt` [[4.4.64]] , `alpāctaram` [[2.2.34]] iti nirdeśādveditavyam| `iti` ityevamarthaḥ| `nipuṇam` iti| samyagaviparītamityarthaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇañcaitat| `samuccitāḥ` iti| udāttānudāttasaṅkīrṇāddhāturāśeḥ pṛthagvyavasthitā ityarthaḥ| `tataḥ` iti| svarāntadhātusamuccayanāduttarakālam| `halantānapi nibodhata`, avagacchatetyarthaḥ| `śakistu` ityādi| `śaklṛ śaktau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1261)| `ghasiśca` ityādi| nanu cādiṃ hadimityādeḥ svarūpagrahaṇe sati tasya sthāne `luṅsanorthaslṛ` [[2.4.37]] iti vihitasya ghaslādeśasyāpi syānivadbhāvenāniṭtvaṃ sidhyatyeva, tatkimarthaṃ ghasiḥ pṛthagupādīyate? ityāha - `ekāco nityaṃ mayaṭamicchantīti tadarthametat? kriyate - tvaṅmayaṃ vāṅmayam` iti| `kecit` ityādi| kecit? prayojanamapaśyanto mṛjeḥ sthāne vijiṃ paṭhanti| kiṃ karaṇamityāha - `nijādiṣu hi` ityādi| `vijir? prathagbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1094) iti nijādiṣu vijiḥ paṭhate, sa yasmādaniḍiṣyate tasmānbhṛjimapanīya tasya sthāne vijiṃ paṭhanti| kathaṃ jñāyate'sāvaniḍiṣyate? ityāha - `tathā ca` ityādi| `tantrāntare`[`granthāntare - iti pāṭhāntaram] iti| āpiśaliṣyākaraṇe| atha `sujivijī` ityasmin? pāṭhe `ovijī bhayacalanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1289) ityasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? īdittvāt| taddhyevamarthaṃ kriyate - `āodito niṣṭhāyām` [[7.2.14]] itīṭpratiṣedho yathā syāt| yadi ca tasyāpīha grahaṇaṃ syādanenaiva siddhatvādīdittvamanarthakaṃ syāt| `avadhīt` iti| `luṅi ca` [[2.4.43]] iti vādhādeśo'dantaḥ| sa cānudattasyādeśaḥ sthānivadbhāvenaiva bhavati| upadeśe'nudātta ekāca upadeśo na bhavatīti na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ| kathaṃ punarayamekājbhavati? ityāha - `vṛddhinivṛttyartham` ityādi| yadi hṛdanto vadhirnopadiśyeta, <> [[7.2.7]] iti vikalpena vṛddhiḥ syāt| adante tu sati na bhavati, tatra `yena cyavadhānamāśriyam| adantatve tu sati vadherakāralopasya purvavidhau sthānivadbhāvenāpi vyavadhānaṃ bhavati, na kevalaṃ halaiva| yā'pi halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ, sā'pyadantatve sati na bhavatyeva;akāralopasya sthānivadbhāvādahalantatvāt| tasmādvṛttyarthamadanto vadhirupadiśyate| nanu yadyapyadanta upadiśyate, tathāpi sthānivadbhāvenaikājiti vyapadeśe sati bhavitavyameva pratiṣedhena? `natadasti; evaṃ hrekājgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tathā hi -
