jāgṛdaradrācakātprabhṛtīnāmudāttatvāt? naikājgrahaṇaṃ te prayojayanti| sanādyantānāṃ dhātūnāmupadeśatvaṃ nāsti; lākṣaṇikatvātsamudāyasya| na cānyo'nekāj? dhāturūpadeśe'nudātto'sti ya ekājgrahaṇaṃ prayojayati| na cāsmin? vyapadeśe kartavye sthānivadbhāve'sti; alvidhitvāt| `iha ca yatā syāt` iti| asatyupadeśagrahaṇe` ekāco dhātoranudāttādiḍāgamo na bhavatītyeva sūtrārthaḥ; evañca laviṣyati, paviṣyatītyatreḍāgamo na syāt| bhavatyatra pratyayasvare kṛte śeṣānudāttatve dhāturanudāttaḥ| tathā ca - kartā kaṭān, karttumicchatītyatra tviḍāgamaḥ syādeva; tṛni tumuni ca kṛte nitsvareṇa dhātorudāttatvāt| upadośagrahaṇe tu sati tenādyāvasthā viśeṣyata iti na bhavatyeva doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| yadyapyuttarakālaṃ lunātipunātī anudāttau, tathāpyupadeśāvasthāyāmudāttāveva| tathā yadyapyattarakālaṃ karotirudāttaḥ, tathāpyupadeśavasthāyāmanudātta eva| atha bibhicchabdasya prakṛtepāṭho nāsti, nāpyekāctvam; tathāpi bhidestūbhayamidamasti| `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam` ityayamapi tatra pakṣa āśritaḥ, tena bhidireva tatra dvirucyate, tasya cobhayaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvāt? sidhyatyeva pratiṣedhaḥ||udāttārthaṃ ārambhaḥ| `lūnaḥ` iti| `lvādibhyaśca` [[8.2.44]] iti natvam| `tīrṇaḥ` iti| atrāpi `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] iti| `kecit` ityādi `glājisthasca ksnuḥ` [[3.2.139]] iti `bhuvaśceti vaktavyam` [[3.2.138]] [`bhuvaśca` - iti sūtram] ityatra bhavateḥ ksnupratyaye giti kṛte sati vidhīyamānasvād? gitīṭpratiṣedho na prāpnoti, tataśca bhūṣṇuriti na sidhyet| tasmād? bhūṣṇurityatreṭpratiṣedhārthaṃ kecit? ābhūti - vyāṅiprabhṛtayaḥ `śrayukaḥ kiti` ityatra dvikakāranirdeśeva hetunā cartvabhūto gakāraḥ praśliṣṭa ityevamācakṣate| yadi cartvabhūto gakāraḥ praśliṣṭaḥ, evaṃ sati <> [[8.2.66]] iti rutve kṛte cartvasyāsiddhatvāt? `haśi ca` [[6.1.114]] iti rorutvena bhavitavyam? na tu visarjanīyena, tataśca `śrayukaḥ kiti` iti nirdeśo na yujyate? ityetaccodyaṃ nirākarttumāha - `sautratvānnirdeśasya` ityādi| cartvabhūtasyāsiddhatvamanāśritya rorutvaṃ na kṛtam, visarjanīyaśca kṛta iti varṇayanti| kimarthaṃ punaste ksnupratyeya gittvaṃ pratijānate, yasmin? satīdaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kartavyaṃ jāyate? sthāsnuśabdasya siddhyartham| evaṃ hi te manyante - ksnoḥ kittve sati `dhumāsthāgādi` [[6.4.66]] sūtreṇa tiṣṭhaterīttvaṃ syāt, tataśca sthāsnuriti na sa#iddhyediti| `glājisthaśca ksnu ityatra` ityādi| gittve hi sati ksnoraṭpratiṣedhārthamevaṃ vyākhyāyate, na ca tasya gittvam| kiṃ tarhi? kittvameva| na ca kittve satīttvaṃ prasajyate, yasmāt? <> [[3.2.139]] ityatra sthā+ā ityakārapraśleṣaḥ kṛtaḥ| tiṣṭhateḥ ksnupratyayāntasyākārāntasyākārāntataiva yathā syātad, īkārāntatā mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| ākārāpraśleṣe hi satīttvāpavādastiṣṭhaterākārādeśo bhavati, atastena bādhitvādīttvaṃ na pravartate| tadevaṃ kittve satyakarapraśleṣāt? sthāsnuśabdasya siddhatvāt? na kiñcidetat| etadvyāsyānamasāramityarthaḥ| `tīrṇam` ityatrāpi kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasatyupadeśagrahaṇe'tri na syāt, yāvatā taratirayamugantaḥ paṭhate? ityāha - `ittve hi` ityādi| `ṛt? iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttve ca kṛta ugantatā vihatetyasatyupadeśagrahaṇe na syāt, tasmastu sati bhavati| yadyapyuttarakālaṃ taratiruganto na bhavati, tathāpyupadeśa eva| `mā bhūdevam` ityādi| codakaḥ| `kasya punaḥ` ityādotaraḥ| `ṝtaḥ`[`kṛtaḥ` iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti codakaḥ| `yadyevam` ityādītaraḥ| `sthānivadbhāvāt` iti| alvidhitvaṃ punarugiti pratyāhāragrahaṇāt| `tasmāt` iti| āha - yasmādedamasatyupadeśagrahaṇe tīrṇa ityatra pratiṣedho na prāpnoti, tasmādupadeśa ityanuvartanīyam| `tathā ca sati` ityādi| upadeśe'nuvartamāne satītyarthaḥ| `jāgarita ityatrāpi prāpnoti` iti| jāgarterupadeśāvasthāyāmugantatvāt| `tadartham` iti| jāgarita ityādāviṭpratiṣedhaprāptinivṛttyartham; arthaśabdasya nivṛttivācitvāt| yadi tarhi `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] ityanuvartate, prorṇutaḥ, prorṇutavanityatreṭpratiṣedho na prāpnoti; ūraṇoteranekāṇtvāt? ityata āha - `vācya ūrṇorṇuvat` ityādi| asyāḥ kārikāyāḥ pūrvamevārtho vyākhyāta iti na punavryākhyāyate||graheḥ sani cityamiṭi prāpte guherapyūdittvāt? `svarati` [[7.2.44]] ityādisūtreṇa vikalpe prāpte'syārambhaḥ| cakāraḥ `ukaḥ` [[7.2.11]] ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| nanu ca <> [[1.2.9]] ityugantānāṃ kideva san? tatra pūrveṇaiva pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ kimuka ityanukarṣaṇārthena cakāreṇa? naitadasti; na hīṭpratiṣedhamantareṇa sano jhalāditvamupapadyate, kutaḥ kittvam! anena tviṭi pratiṣiddhe jhalāditvaṃ sano jāyate, paścādguṇapratiṣedhārthaṃ kittvamiti kramaḥ| `jighṛśrati` iti| `rudavida` [[1.2.8]] ityādinā sanaḥ kittve sati grahrādi [[6.1.16]] sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam, `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam, <<ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si>> [[8.2.41]] iti katvam, `iṇkoḥ` [[8.2.57]] iti ṣatvam, `ekāco vaśo bhaṣ` [[8.2.37]] ityādinā bhaṣbhāvena gakārasya ghakāraḥ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam| `judhukṣati` iti| `rudavida` [[1.2.8]] ityādinā sanaḥ kittve sati grahrādi [[6.1.16]] sūtreṇa samprasaraṇam, `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam, <<ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si>> [[8.2.41]] iti katvam, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam| `jughukṣate` [`judhukṣati` - kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-896), `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityātmanepadam| `rurūṣati` iti| <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghaḥ| atha cakāreṇa yathegantamanukṛṣyate, tathā caikayoganirdiṣṭaḥ śrayatirapyanukṛṣyeta? ityata āha - `śrisvṛyūrṇurabhajñapi` ityādi| śrayateḥ `sanīdantargha` [[7.2.49]] itīṭo vikalpaṃ vidhāsyatītyatastasyehānuvattirapārthiketi nānukṛṣyate|`sakṛva, cakṛma` iti| `parasmaipadānām` [[3.4.82]] ityādinā vasmasorvamādeśau| `krādaya eva` iti| niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati| `liṭaeva krādayo'niṭaḥ` ityeṣa tu viparītaniyamo nāśaṅkanīyaḥ; <> [[4.3.38]] iti <> [[5.1.80]] ityādinirdeśāt| kena punasteṣāmiṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, yataḥ siddhe satyārambho niyamārtha ucyate? ityata āha - `anudāttopadeśānām` ityādi| anudāttopadeśā vṛṅvṛñbhyāmanye karotyādayaḥ, teṣāmeva `acaḥ` [[7.2.10]] ityādinā prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ| vṛṅvṛñostu `śrayukaḥ kiti` [[7.2.11]] iti pratyayāśrayaḥ, na tu prakṛtyāśrayaḥ; tayorudāttatvāt| `tat` ityādi| yata eva teṣāṃ yathāyogaṃ prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratyayāśrayaśca pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, tasmādubhayasyāpi pratiṣedhasya prayuktasyāyaṃ niyama ityarthaḥ| dhātvantarebhyo vyavacchidya karotyādīnāṃ pratiṣedhastheha niyamo veditavyaḥ| `kathaṃ punaretadvṛñaṃ prati thali niyamārthamupapadyate? sati hi pratiṣedhe niyamo bhavati| vṛñasthalīṭpratiṣadhaḥ| tasya hi nātra prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ; udāttatvāt| nāpi pratyayāśrayaḥ; thalaḥ kittvābhāvāt| tasmāt? vṛñaṃ prati thalīṭpratiṣedhārthataiva yuktā, na niyamārthatā? ityata āha - `vṛño hi` ityādi| vyavasthā=niyamaḥ| <> [[7.2.64]] iti nipātanāṭvṛño nigama eva thalīṭpratiṣedhena bhavitavyam, na bhāṣāyām| yata evaṃ vyavasthā tasmānnāyaṃ vṛñasthalīṭpratiṣedhaḥ; anyathā vavartheti nipātanasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt| tasmāt? pratiṣedhābhāvāt? vṛño'pyetat? sūtraṃ niyamārthameva vijñāyata ityekānta eṣaḥ| `studruruāuśruvāṃ tu` ityādi| apiśabdaḥ ārdhadhātukalakṣaṇo'pi ya iṭ? prāpnoti so'pi neṣyata iti darśanārthaḥ| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate, purastāt, pratiṣedhakāṇḍasya balīyastvāt| iha ca `na vṛdbhyāścatubhryaḥ` [[7.2.59]] ityasyānantaramidaṃ pratiṣedhakāṇḍaṃ karttuṃ yuktam| evaṃ dviṣpratiṣedhāśrayaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ syāt| yadayaṃ purastāt? pratiṣedhaṃ karoti, tasyaitat? prayojanam - iṣmātrasyānāśritaviśeṣavidhānasya pratiṣedho vijñāyate, purastāt? pratiṣedhe kriyamāṇe sati viśeṣamanāśrityeṇmātrasyāyamapavādo bhavati| tena yāvāniṭ? prāptastasya sarvasya pratiṣedho bhavati siddhaḥ| anyastvāha - `neṭi` [[7.2.4]] ityanuvartamāne punariṅgrahaṇasāmarthyāt, punaḥ pratiṣedhasāmarthyācca iṇmānnasya pratiṣedho vijñāyate| `kuño'suṭkasyeti vaktavyam` iti| karoteravidyamānasuṭaḥ ṣatiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimartham? sasuṭkasyeḍāgamo yathā syāt| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[2.2.32]] ityanena stuprabhṛtīnāmanyatamasya ghisaṃjñakasya pūrvanipātamakṛtvaitat? sūcitam - yateha pūrvanipātalakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicarati svaviṣaye na pravartate, tathedamapīti| tena yadā karotiḥ sasuṭkaḥ, tatra na pravartata iti| `sañcaskariva, sañcaskarima` iti| <> [[6.1.137]] iti suḍityanuvartamāne <<aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi>> [[6.1.136]] iti suṭ kriyate| `ṛto bhāradvājasya [[7.2.63]] ityetadapyasuyaṭkasyaiveṣyate` iti| `kṛñaḥ` iti sambadhyate| kathaṃ punarasuṭkasyaiva bhavatīti labhyate? yathā labhyate tacca śrūyatām - tatra hi <> [[7.2.56]] ityato vetyanuvartate maṇḍūkalputinyāyena, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tenāsuṭkasyaiva bhavatīti||`śūnaḥ` iti| vacyādi [[6.1.15]] sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam, `halaḥ` [[6.4.2]] iti dīrghaḥ| `lagnaḥ` iti| natvasyāsiddhatvāt? <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam| `uḍḍīnaḥ` iti| `ṅiṅ? vihāyasā gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1135)| `nanu ṅīṅa udāttatvānniṣṭhāyāmiṭ prāpnoti, tasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ; hi uḍḍayita ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāditi yo manyeta, taṃ pratyāha - `ṅīṅaḥ` ityādi| `oditām` iti| svādīnāmityarthaḥ| `svādaya oditaḥ` iti vacanāta| svādayaḥ `ṣūṅ? prāṇigarbhavimocane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1031) ityādayaḥ| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakaḥ? ityāha - `sa hi` ityādi| svadīnāṃ hroditāṃ madhye tasyaivamarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ - niṣṭhātakārasyaudita uttarasya natvaṃ yathā syāt| syādetat - iṭapi kṛte natvaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityāha - `natavaṃ ca` ityādi| <> [[1.1.67]] ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthasyānuvṛtterodito dhātoranantarasya niṣṭhātakārasya natvaṃ vidhīyate| tatra yadi ṅīṅa parasyā niṣṭhāyā iṭ? syāt, tadā satyapyodittve iṭā vyavahitatvānnatvena na bhavitavyam| nityoditāṃ madhye tasya pāṭho'narthakatvānna kṛtaḥ syāt, sa cāsti; tasmāt? sa eva pāṭho jñāpakaḥ? naitadasti; evaṃ hrānantaryaparibhāṣā bādhitā bhavati, śāstraṃ cāniṣṭaṃ syāt, etaccāyuktam; na hraniṣṭārthā śāstre prakḷpti(bho pa|sū|107) rasti| tasmādyathānantaryaparibhāṣā na bādhyate śāstrañca nāniṣṭaṃ bhavati, oda#itāṃ madhye ṅīṅa pāṭhaśca saphalo bhavati - sa prakaro'bhyupagantavyaḥ| tataścauditāṃ madhye ṅīṅaḥ pāṭo jñāpaka eva| aparaḥ prakāraḥ - <> [[8.2.45]] ityatraudita ityetaddvirāvartayiṣyate <> [[1.1.67]] ityasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā dvirupasthānārtham, tatrāsyā yaddvitauyamupasthānaṃ tasyaitat? prayojanam - ṅīṅo'pyanantarasyaiva niṣṭhātakārasya natvaṃ yathā syāditi| yadi ca ṅīṅo niṣṭhāyāmiṭ? syāt? iṭā vyavahitatvānnatvaṃ na syāt| na ca śakyate vaktum - vyavadhāne'pi pāṭhasāmarthyādbhaviṣyatīti| evaṃ hi paribhāṣāyā dvirupasthānamanarthakaṃ syāt? etaccāyuktam; tasmādoditāṃ madhye ṅīṅaḥ pāṭho jñāpaka eva| iāgrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, oditkaraṇādeva niṣṭhāyāmiṇna bhaviṣyati, odittvaṃ hi natvārthaṃ kriyate, natvaṃ ca niṣṭhāto'nantarasya vidhīyate; yadi ca tataḥ parasyā niṣṭhāyā iṭ? syāt? odittvamanarthakaṃ syāt? vaicitryārthaṃ iāgrahaṇaṃ veditavyam||`vidhūtaḥ` iti| `dhūñ? kampane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1836) `gūḍhaḥ` iti| `gūhū saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-986)| ḍhatvādiṣu kṛteṣu <<ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ>> [[6.3.111]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ| ateha kasmāt? pratiṣedho na bhavati - patita - patita iti, bhavati hi patirvibhāṣiteṭ? `sanīvantargha` [[7.2.49]] ityatra `tanipatidaradrāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam` iti vikaplenopasaṃkhyānāt? ityata āha - `dvitīyāśrita` ityādi||bhāvādikarmaṇoranantaraṃ vibhāṣāṃ vakṣyati, tato'nyatra kartari karmaṇi cāyaṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate| `āāstaḥ` ita| `āāsa prāṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1069)| `vāntaḥ` iti| `ṭu vama adgiraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-849)| <> [[6.4.15]] iti dīrghaḥ| `yogavibhāgakaraṇaṃ kimartham` iti| pṛṣṭasya `āditaśca vibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ` iti| yadyekayogaḥ kriyate, tato bhāvādikarmabhyāmanyatra pratiṣedho na syāditi prativacanamātraṅkyāha - `āditaśca` ityādi| `āditaśca vibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ` ityekayoge bhāvādakarmaṇorvibhāṣāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ tato'nyatra katrrādau <> [[7.2.15]] iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, tasmādapārthaka yogavibhāgakaraṇam| `jñāpanārtham` ityādinā'pārthakatvaṃ pariharati| `yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādheḥ` iti| ubhayatrāpi bahuvrīhiḥ| upādhiḥ=viśeṣaṇam| sa caitadarthaṃ upādhirvijrñeyaḥ| yadi yadupādhārvibhāṣā tadasyopādherapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tadā yogavibhāgāṃ na kuryāt| ekayogenāpi bhāvādikarmaṇorvihite vikalpe tato'nyatra <> [[7.2.15]] iti pratiṣedho labhyata eva, kṛtaśca yogavibhāgaḥ, tasmādetena yogavibhāgakaraṇena sūcitam - yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādherniṣedha iti| `tena` ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| atra viderlābhārthasya vibhāṣeti viśinā taudādikena sāhacarcāllābhārthasya taudādīkasya grahaṇam| <> [[7.2.15]] iti ca tasyaiva pratiṣedho bhavati, nānyasya| yadi yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādherniṣedha iti jñāpyate, `jṛvraścoḥ ktviḥ` [[7.2.55]] , <> [[7.2.56]] iti ktvāpratyaye bhāvaviṣaye vibhāṣite <> [[7.2.15]] iti bhāvaviṣaya eva niṣṭhāyāmiṭpratiṣedhaḥ syāt, na karttṛkarmaṇoḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; āśrīyamāṇo hi dharmo bhedako bhavati| na ca ktvāpratyaye niṣṭhāyāṃ vā bhinnamabhidheyaṃ nimittatvenāśritam| tasmādbhavatyevātra pratiṣedhaḥ| atra liṅgam - <> [[5.1.79]] iti nidrdaśaḥ||`minnamanena` iti| <> [[3.3.114]] | `meditam` iti| `niṣṭhā śīṅa` [[1.2.19]] ityādinā kittvapratiṣedhe guṇaḥ| `praminnaḥ` iti| praśabda ādikarma dyotayati| `ādikarma` iti| ādibhūtakriyākṣaṇa iti| tasmin? bhūtatvena vivakṣite yaḥ ktaḥ sa punaḥ <<ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca>> [[3.4.71]] ityanena kartari kārake bhavati| śakto ghaṭaḥ karttum, śakiko ghaṭaḥ karttumityasya siddhaye vibhāveti yogavibhāgo'tra kartavyaḥ| tatra `āditaḥ` [[7.2.16]] iti nānuvarattanīyam| `bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ` ityatra dvitīye yoge'nuvartamīyameva||`kṣubdhaḥ` iti| `kṣubha sañcalane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1239) ityasyeḍabhāvo nipātyate| `manthābhidhānaṃ cet` iti| samudāyena cenmantho'bhidhīyate| mantha iti dravadravyasampṛktāḥ saktava ucyante| `kṣugdho manthaḥ` iti| calito mantha ityarthaḥ| `kṣubhitaṃ mantena` iti| nātra mantho'bhīdhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? tatsādhanaṃ calanam| atha manthābhidhāne kṣubdhaśabdo nipātyate, kṣubdhā girinaṭī, kṣubdhā senā, kṣubdhaḥ samudraḥ - ityādi| nopapadyate? ityata āha - `kṣubdhā girinadī` ittayādi| calitamanthasādhamryādgirinadyādiṣu tathā vyavapeśa iti darśayati| yathā kṣubdhatvaṃ manthasya calanaṃ prati sādhanabhāvaḥ, tathā girinadyāderarthasya calanaṃ prati sādhanabhāvaḥ kṣubdhamanthasādhamryāt? kṣubdhaśabdena vyapadiśyate, yathā gosādhamryādgośabdena vāhīka ucyate| `svāntam, dhvāntam` iti| `svana dhvana śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-827,828)| iḍabhāvo nipātyate| evamuttareṣvapyudāharaṇeṣu veditavyam| bāhreṣu viṣayeṣvavikṣiptamanākulaṃ manaḥ=svaḥntamucyate| <> [[6.4.15]] iti dīrghaḥ| `svanitaṃ manasā` iti| manaḥ karttṛkaṃ svananamucyate, na tu manaḥ| `dhvanitaṃ tamasā` iti| atrāpi tamaḥkarttṛkaṃ dhvananamucyate, na tamaḥ| `lagnaḥ` iti| `rage lage saṅge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-785,786)[`rage śaṅkāyām` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] niṣṭhānatvaṃ nipātyate| `svaraścet` iti| svaraśapabdo'tra dhvanau vartate| `phāṣṭam` iti| `phaṇa gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-821)| pūrvavaddīrghaḥ ṣṭutvañca| kaḥ punarayamanāyāso nāma? ityāha - `yadaśṛtam` ityādi| aśṛtamityapakvam| apiṣṭamityacūrṇitam| udakasamparkaḥ udakasaṃyogaḥ| mātraśabdena niṣpīḍanādevryavacchedaḥ| `vibhaktarasam` iti| pṛthagbhūtarasamityarthaḥ| īṣaduṣṇaṃ koṣṇam| `tadalpaprayatnasādhyatvādanāyāsena lakṣyate` iti| āyāsaḥ prayatnādhikyam, tadyasminna vidyate so'lpaprayatnāsādhyo'nāyāsaḥ| teneha yadaśṛtatvādiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu tadalpaprayatnāsādhyatvādanāyāsena lakṣyate| tadanenānāyāsopalakṣato yo vastuviśeṣastatra phāṣṭamiti nipātyate, na tvanāyāsa eva| nānyatrāpi sarvatrānāyasopalakṣita iti darśayati| ayaṃ cārtho nipātanasāmarthyāllabhyate| yathaiva hranyat? kiñcidiḍabhāvādikaṃ nipatanasāmarthyāllabhyate tathā'rthaviśeṣe'pi| `bāḍham` iti| atra pūrvadad? ḍhatvādikāryam||`viyātasya bhāvo vaiyātyam` iti| yātam=yātiḥ, prāptiḥ virūpaṃ yātaṃ yasyāsanmārgaviṣayatvāt? sa viyātaḥ=avinīta ityucyate; tadbhāvo vaiyātyam| brāāhṛṇāditvāt? [[5.1.123]] ṣyañ| `ṣuṣṭaḥ` iti| `ñi dhṛṣā pragalbhye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1269)| `viśtaḥ` iti| `śasu hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-727), śaserapi `udato vā` [[7.2.56]] iti vikalpavidhānāt? <> [[7.2.15]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddha eveti sambadhyate| yadi tarhi siddha eva pratiṣedhaḥ tat? kimarthaṃ vacanam? ityāha - `niyamārtham` ityādi| vaiyātya eva vartamānoryathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūt| atha dhṛṣeḥ `vibhāṣā bhādivādikarmaṇoḥ` [[7.2.17]] iti vikalpe prāpte nityārtha vacanamiti kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `bhāvādikarṇaṇorapa , ityādi| atra cābhitrānaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetaḥ| `dhārṣitaḥ` iti| `dharṣitaḥ iti| pūrvavat? kittve pratiṣidde gūṇaḥ||`balavati` iti matubantanidrdaśenārśāaditvāt? sūtre matvarthīyākārānto balaśabdo nirddiṣṭa iti darśayati| `dṛṃheḥ` iti| `dṛhi vṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-834) ityasya| `atha vā - dṛhiḥ prakṛtyantaramasti` iti| `dṛha dṛhi dṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-733,734), iti kaiścit? pāṭhāt| `nakārasyābhāvāt` iti| nakārasyopadeśābhāvādanidittvācca nakārasyopadeśābhāvādanidittvācca nakārasyābhāvāditi| atha hakāralopaḥ kimarthaṃ nipātyate? nāḍhakāra eva nipātyatām, parasya ca dhatve ṣṭutve kṛte, ḍho ḍhe lope ca kṛte siddhaṃ dṛḍha iti| atrāpyayamarthaḥ - parasya ḍhatvaṃ nipātayitavyaṃ na bhavati, ṣṭunaiva siddhatvāt? ityata āha - `halopanipātanam` ityādi| yadi hakārasya ḍhakāro nipātyate tadā <<ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ>> [[8.3.13]] , tasya <> [[8.2.1]] ityasiddhatvaṃ syāt, siddhaścāsāviṣyate| tasmāt? pūrvatrāsiddhatvanivṛttaye halopo nipātyate, na ḍhakāra iti| kaḥ punarasiddhatve doṣo yatparihārāya pūrvatrāsiddhatvanivṛttyarthaṃ hakāralopo nipātyate, na ḍhakāraḥ? ityata āha - `ḍhalope` ityādi| yadi hi ḍhakāro nipātyate, tadā <<ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ>> [[8.3.13]] kartavyaḥ, tasmastu sati lope draḍhimetyādau <> [[6.4.161]] iti ropho na syāt; ḍhalopasyāsiddhatve <> [[1.4.11]] iti gurusaṃjñāyāmupajātāyāṃ laghusaṃjñāyā bādhitatvāt| `draḍhimā` iti| <> [[5.1.123]] itīmanic, `turiṣṭheyāḥsu` [[6.4.154]] iti ṭilopaḥ| `draḍhīyān` iti| `dvivacanavibhajyopaparade tarabīyasunau` [[5.3.57]] itīyasunpratyayaḥ| `draḍhayati` iti| draḍhamācaṣṭa iti `tatkaroti tada#ācaṣṭe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-ga|sū|187) iti ṇic, `ṇāviṣṭhavat? kāryaṃ prātipadikasya` (dā|813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvena rephaṭilopau| `paridraḍhayya gataḥ` iti| dṛḍhamācaṣṭe iti ṇic| rabhāve kṛte ṇyantasya pariṇā yogaḥ, tataḥ ktvā, prādisamāsaḥ, `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap` [[7.1.37]] iti lyap| `pāridraḍhī kanyā` iti| paridraḍhaśabdādiñ, <> [[4.1.65]] iti ṅīṣ| `ṣyaṅ? prasajyeta` iti| `aṇiñoranārṣayorgurūpottamayoḥ` [[4.1.78]] ityādinā| `dṛṃhitam` iti| dṛṃheḥ pratyudāharaṇam| `dṛhitam` iti dṛheḥ||`pūrveṇa samānam` iti| nipātanasyeḍabhāvādestulyatvāt| yathaiva hi pūrvasmin? sūtre ktapratyaye kṛte hakāranakārasyorlopa iḍabhāvaśca parasya ḍhatvaṃ nipātitam, tathehāpi tatsarva nipātyate| `vṛṃhernipātanam` iti| `vṛhi vṛddhau` [`bṛhi` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-736) ityasya| `vṛhiśca yadi prakṛtyantaramasti tatastasyāpi` iti| nipātanametaditi kṛtena sambandhaḥ| prakṛtyantarāstitvaṃ tu `vṛha vṛddhau`[`bṛha` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-735) iti kaiściduktam| `tadeva prayojanam` iti| pūrvatrāsiddhatvanivṛttiḥ| `parivrajhayati` iti| atra ḍhalope sati pūrvavadrepho na syāt| `parivraḍhayya gataḥ` iti| halopanipātane tu bhavantyete doṣāḥ| `parivraḍhamācaṣṭe` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ parivṛḍhaśabdena vigrahe kṛte ṇico vṛ śabdādevotpatatirlabhyate? ityāha - `saṃgrāmayateḥ` ityādi| `prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-ga|sū|186) ityanenaiva ṇici siddhe `saṃgrāme` ityasya sopasargasya gaṇe yaḥ pāṭhaḥ sa niyamārthaḥ - saṃgrāmayatereva sopasargāṇṇijutpattiryathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi| tadevaṃ saṃgrāmayatereva yasmāt? sopasargāṇṇijutpattiriṣyate, nānyasmāt| tasmād? yadyapi `parivṛḍhamācaṣṭe` iti vigrahaḥ kriyate, tathāpi vṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijutpattau satyāṃ lakāro bhavannayaṃ ṇij? yato vihitastadādereva bhavati pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā; <> [[3.1.32]] iti tadādereva dhātusaṃjñāvidhānāt| tena parestiṅantagrahaṇenāgrahaṇāt? tato'taṅantāt? padāt? parasya tiṅantasya padasya parivraḍhayatītyatra <> [[8.1.28]] iti nighātasvaraḥ siddho bhavati| yadi punaḥ parivṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijatpadyate tadā lakāro'pi nighāto na syāt| kiñca - yadā vṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijutpadyate na parivṛḍhaśabdāt, tadā ktvāpratyayo'pi vṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijantādbhavati| tena pariśabdasya ktāntena samrathena śabdāntareṇa <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāse kṛte parivraḍhayyetyatra lyabādeśaḥ siddho bhavati| parivṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijutpattau ktvāpratyayo'pi parivṛḍhaśabdādeva ṇijantādutpadyate, tataḥ samāso na syāt; kugatiprādayaḥ samarthena śabdāntareṇa samasyante, na cātra pareḥ paraṃ ktāntaṃ śabdāntaramasti| ekameva hīdaṃ ktāntaṃ pariṇā saha śabdarūpam; tatraiva pariśabdasyāntarbhāvāt| asati ca samāse <<samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap>> [[7.1.37]] ityādinā lyabādeśo na syāt| `parivṛṃhitam` iti| vṛṃheḥ pratyudāharaṇam| `parivṛhitam` iti| vṛheḥ||`kaṣṭaḥ` iti| kaṣiśiṣītyādihiṃsārthadhātuvarge kaṣiḥ paṭhate| kiṃ punaḥ kṛcchraṃ nāma? ityāha - `kṛcchraṃ duḥkham` iti| yadyevam, duḥkhe prāṇidharme pratiṣedha ucyamāno'gnyādau na sidhyate? ityāha - `tatkāraṇamapyagnyādikaṃ kṛcchramucyate` iti| kāraṇe kāryopacārāt, yathā - naṅvalodakaṃ pādaroga iti| cintyaṃ punaretat? kiṃ mukhye sati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam? uta neti? yadi tu kṛcchraśabdāṇṇijantāt? pacādyacamutvādya kṛcchrayatīti kṛcchra ityevaṃ vyutpādyate, tadā kṛcchraśabdo'pi mukhye'ganyādāvapīti na kiñciccintyam; na cāsyāṃ vyutpattau tatkāraṇamapyaganyādikaṃ kṛcchramityucyata ityetadvirudhyate| yaddhi kṛcchrayati tanniyogata eva duḥkhasya kāraṇaṃ bhavati||`viśabdanaṃ pratijñānam` iti| svābhiprāyasya śabdenāviṣkaraṇamityarthaḥ| `sāmānyena grahaṇam` iti| viśeṣānupādānāt| yadi `ghuṣiraviśabdene` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1726) [`ghuṣir? viśabdene - dhātupāṭhaḥ-]iti curādau paṭhate evaṃ sati ṇicā bhavitavyam, na ca ṇijantasyeṭi satyasati vā kaścidviśeṣo'sti| tathā hi - iṭi sati <> [[6.4.52]] iti ṇilope kṛte ghoṣitamiti yadrūpaṃ bhavatyasatyapīṭi ṇilopābhāvāt? tadeva| na ca tadantāviṭpratiṣedhasya praptirasti; `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] ityadhikārāt| bhauvādikasya (dhātupāṭhaḥ-653) [`ghuṣir? aviśbadena` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ghuṣerviśabdane vṛttireva nāsti; śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt; tatka viśabdanapratiṣedhena? ityata āha - `viśabdanapratiṣedhaḥ` ityādi| yadi ca nityo ṇic? syāt, tadā yathoktayā rītyā pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt, tataśca na kartavya eva syāt, kṛtaśca, tasmādayameva pratiṣedho jñāpayita - curādiṇijviśabdanārthasyānitya iti| `jughuṣuḥ` iti| anityapratijñāprayojanam| asati hranityatve ghoṣayāñcakruriti syāt||`ardeḥ` iti| `arda gatau yācane ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-55)||`vidūraṃ viprakṛṣṭam` iti| viśeṣeṇātiśayena dūraṃ vidūramiti kṛtvā, tato'nyadavidūram| tat? punaryadāsannaṃ yaccādūraṃ na tvativiprakṛṣṭaṃ taditi veditavyam| `tasya bhāva ādidūryam` iti| brāāhṛṇāditvāt? [[5.1.123]] ṣyañ| nanu ca `na nañpūrvāt? tatpuruṣāt` [[5.1.121]] ityuttarasya bhāvapratyayasya pratiṣiddhatvāt? ṣyañā na bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `etasmādeva` ityādi| uttaratvaṃ tu bhāvapratyayasya tvatalāpekṣayā veditavyam||`adhyayanam` iti| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahūlam` [[3.3.113]] iti lyuṭ| adhīyata ityadhyayanam - karmasādhano'dhyayanaśabdaḥ| bhāvasādhane hi vṛtto guṇo devadatteneti na syāt, vṛttaṃ guṇasya devadatteneti syāt| niṣṭhāviśeṣaṇañcaitat| adhyetavyābhidhāyinyāṃ niṣṭhāyāmityarthaḥ| `ṇiluk? ca` iti| ṇilugnipātanaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇa pratiṣedhārtham| lope hi pratyayalakṣaṇena guṇaḥ syāt| luki sati <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhādguṇo na syāt| `vṛtto guṇaḥ` iti| guṇaḥ kaścidevādhyayanaviśeṣa ihocyate| `vṛttirayamakarmakaḥ` iti| dṛtaṃ guṇasya, vṛttaṃ pārāyaṇasyeti bhāve niṣṭhādarśanāt| akarmakāṇāṃ hi bhāve niṣṭhā bhavati, na sakarmakāṇām| `sa ṇyarthe` ityādi| so'ntarbhāvitaṇyartho yadā bhavati tadā prakṛtyanto ṇyarthe vartamānaḥ sakarmako bhavati, yathā - vadrdhantu tvāṃ suṣṭutaya ityatra vṛdhiḥ| kathametadvijñāyate? ityāha - `tena nirvṛttam` ityādi| na caitadvaktavyam - akarmakā iti| `dhātavaḥ sopasargāḥ sakarmakā bhavanti` iti sopasargatvādiha vṛtteḥ sakarmakatvam| na tu ṇyarthavṛttitvāditi kṛto ṇyarthāvagatiḥ? yadi sopasargātvādiha vṛtteḥ sakarmakatvaṃ syānna ṇyarthavṛttitvāt, tato yathānubhūtaḥ kmabalo devadattadenetyatra ṇyartho na gamyate, tathā tena nirvṛttaḥ ityatrāpi na gamyeta; gamyate ca, tasmāṇṇayarthavṛttitvādeva vṛtteḥ sakarmakatvam| yadā ca ṇyarthavṛttarbhavati tadā prayojakavyāpārāpekṣayā'sya kartā karmabhāvabhāpadyata iti| tena prayojyena karmaṇā sakarmako bhavati| `tadvadihāpi` ityādi| yasmādevākarmako'pi sa na prakṛtyanta eva ṇyarthe vartamānaḥ sakarmako bhavati tasmādvṛtto guṇo devadattenetyatrāpi ṇyarthavṛttereva karmaṇi ktapratyayo bhaviṣyati| tataśca nipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt| vinā'pi tena siddhatvāt| kathamiti cet? vṛtteḥ kvāpratyaye <> [[7.2.56]] itīṅvikalpe kṛte niṣṭhāyām, <> [[7.2.15]] iti pratiṣedhāt| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ tadityāha - `tat? kriyate` ityādi| kadāciṇṇyartho'ntarbhāvitaṇyarthatayā prakṛtyaivābhidhīyate, tatra yadi nipātanaṃ na kriyeta, tadādhyayane'pi varttitamiti syāt| tasmādetannivṛttyarthaṃ tadityeke pratipannaḥ| `apare tu` ityādi| anye tu vattito guṇa ityapīcchanti| ṇyantasyāṇyantasya ca - vṛtto guṇa iti| tanmatena nipātanaṃ na kartavyameva| kriyamāṇaṃ vaicitryārthaṃ veditavyam||`dāntaḥ, śāntaḥ` iti| `śamu damu upaśame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1201,1203)| hetumaṇṇic, ṇilugiṭpratiṣedhayoḥ kṛtayoḥ <> [[6.4.15]] iti dīrghaḥ| nanu ca ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhāne sati na prāpnoti? naitadasti; na hi nipātanena lope sati tasya paranimittatvavyapadeśo vidyate, tat? kutaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ! `na padānta` [[1.1.57]] ityādinā dīrghavidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhācca| `damitaḥ, śamitaḥ` iti| `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[6.4.92]] iti hrasvatvam| `pūrṇaḥ` iti| `pūrī āpyāyane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1803)| divādiścurādiśca| `dastaḥ` iti| `tasu utkṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1212) [`upakṣaye` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `dasu ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1213)| atropadhā hrasvatvamapi nipātyate| `spaṣṭaśchannaḥ` iti| `spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-887), `chada apavāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ- 1935)| atrāpayupadhāhrasvatvamapi nipātyate| jñapta iti| `jñapa māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1624)[`jñānajñāpanamāraṇatoṣaṇaniśānaniśāmaneṣu - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] iti curādiḥ, `māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā micca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-811) iti ghaṭādiśca, tato ṇic| `iṭpratiṣedho ṇilukca` iti| cakārāt? kvacidupadhāhrasvatvamapi nipātyate||`ruṣa roṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1670), `ama gatyādiṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-465)| `ama roge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1720) ityetasya caurādikasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati; ekāca [[7.2.10]] ityadhikārāt| `ñi tvarā sambhrame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-775) sampūrvaḥ| pūrvokto dhuṣiḥ| āṅpūrvaḥ pūrvokta eva svaniḥ| `āsvāntaḥ` iti| pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| `tūrṇaḥ` iti| `jvaratvararuāvyavimavāmupadhāyāḥ` [[6.4.20]] ityūṭh| `sampūrva` ityādi| `ghuṣir? aviśabdene` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-653) ityasyāvakāśo'sampūrvatve satyaviśabdena - ghuṣṭā rajjuḥ, dhuṣṭau pādāviti| asya ca vacanasyāvakāśaḥ sampūrvatve sati viśabdane - saṃghuṣitaṃ vākyamāha, saṃghuṣṭaṃ vākyamāheti; sampūrvatve satyaviśabdana ubhayaprāptau paratvādanena viklapo bhavati - saṃghuṣṭau dantau, saṃghuṣitau dantāviti| `āṅpūrvasya` ityādi| `kṣubdhasvānta` [[7.2.18]] iti svanariṭpratiṣedhasyāvakāśaḥ| anāṅapūrvatve sati mano'bhidhāne svāntaṃ mana ityasyāvakāśaḥ, āṅpūrvatve satayamano'bhidhānam| `āsvanto devadattaḥ, āsvanito devadattaḥ` iti| āṅpūrvatve sati mano'bhidhāne svāntaṃ mana ityasyāvakāśaḥ, āṅpūrvatve satyamano'bhidhānam| `āsvanto devadattaḥ, āsvanito devadattaḥ` iti| āṅpūrvatve sati mona'bhidhāne paratvādayameva vikalapo bhavati - āsvāntaṃ manaḥ, āsvanitaṃ manaḥ||`cāyateḥ` iti| cāyṛ pūjāniśāmanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-880) iti| ayaṃ yogo yaścinoterapūrvasaya pūjāyāṃ vṛtiṃta na pratipadyate taṃ pratyārabhyate| yastu pratipadyate taṃ prati nārabdhabdha eva| tathā hi - cinoterapacita iti bhaviṣyatīti, cāyatestvavacāyita iti| `vaktavyam` iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tetredaṃ vyākhyānam - cakāro'tra kriyate| sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenāpacitirityetadapi nipātyata iti| etacca nipātayatā cāyateḥ ktini nityaṃ cibhāvo vaktavyaḥ||`hvṛ kauṭilye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-931) ityetasyānudāttatvādiṭpratiṣedho'styevetyādeśārtha vacanam||`hyu` ityetasyādeśasyābhāvo nipātyate` iti| pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasya| bahuvacananirdeśo bahavacana eva nipātanaṃ yathā syāt| tena kcanāntare hi aparihyutaḥ, aparihyu, aparihyutāvityeva bhavati||`iḍāgamo guṇaśca nipātyate` iti| cakārāt? `hyu` ityetasyādeśābhāvaśca||`grasu skanbhu stanbhu ityeteṣām` ityādi| `grasu glasu adane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-630,631), `skanbhu`, `stanbhu` [[3.1.82]] ityetau sautrau dhātū; `stambhustumbhuskambhuskumbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca` [[3.1.82]] iti sūtre pāṭhāt| `skabhitam, stabhitam` iti| `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityanunāsikasalopaḥ| `skabdhabh, stabdham` iti| <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti dhatvam, <> [[8.4.53]] iti jaśtvam| `uttabhitam` iti| <> [[8.4.61]] iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ| `anyopasargapūrvaḥ stabhitaśabdo na bhavatītīti| yadi syāt, utpūrvasya nipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt| `cateḥ, kaseśca` iti| `cate cade yācane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-865,866), `kasa gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-860)| nanu sūtre vikastaśabdādvahuvacanaṃ śrūyate, tataśca kathamasau vṛttādekavacanānta udahmataḥ? ityata āha - `nipātanaṃ bahutvāpekṣam| vikastā iti bahuvacanam` iti| sūtre grasitādīni nipātanāni kṛtadvandvāni, atastadapekṣayā bahuvacanaṃ kṛtam| vṛttau tvasamasta eka evāyaṃ vikastaśabdaḥ| na caitadarthasya bahuvacanaṃ vivakṣim, ata ekavacanānta evodāhṛtaḥ| `apareṣu` iti| viśastṛprabhṛtiṣu| `pratyekaṃ vibhaktinirdeśaḥ` iti| bahutvābhāvādbahuvacanam, tena tatra na kṛtamityabhiprāyaḥ| śaservipūrvasya śaṃseḥ śāseśceti| `śasu hisāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-727), `śansu stutau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-728) `śāsu anuśiṣṭau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1075)| `tarītāram? varītāram` iti| `vṛto vā` [[7.2.38]] iti dīrghaḥ| `varūtrīḥ` iti| <<ṛnnebhyo ṅīp>> [[4.1.5]] iti ṅīp, tadantājjas, <> [[6.1.106]] iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ| jasi pūrvasavarṇoccāraṇam` ityādi| nanu yaṇādeśe kṛte varūtrya iti bhavitavyam, kathaṃ `varūtrayaḥ` iti bhavati? ityāha - `chāndasam` ityādi| chāndasatvena hi hrasvatve kṛte `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] iti yaṇādeśāpavado guṇo vidhīyate| `prapañcārtham` iti| vistareṇānvākhyānamityarthaḥ| tathā hi `pacirvistāravacane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1651) iti tasyaivājantasya prapañceti bhavati| prapañcastu vispaṣṭārthaḥ| vistareṇa hranvākhyānaṃ spaṣṭaṃ bhavati| atha varūtrīśabdasya sidhyartha nipātanaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `vakhtṛśabdo hi` ityādi| jvalateriti `jvala dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-831), `kṣara sañcalane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-851), `ṭu vama udgiraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-849) `ama gatyādiṣu (dhātupāṭhaḥ-465)| `itikaraṇaṃ pradarśanārtham` iti evamprakārasyāmyasyāpi pradarśanārthamitikaraṇam| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha - `tena kvacit` ityādi| cakārasśchandasītyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tena cānukṛṣṭatvānnottaratrābhisambadhyate| tenottaratra vidhānamaviśeṣeṇa bhavati||`āste, śete, vaste` iti| `āsa upaveśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1021), `śīṅ? svapne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1032), `dasa ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1023)| adāditvācchapo luk, <<śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ>> [[7.4.21]] | ārdhadhātukagrahaṇādiha - sārvadhātukasyeṇna bhavatīti| nanu ca <> [[7.2.76]] ityetanniyamārtha vijñāyate - `rudādibhya eva sārvadhātukasya nānyebhya` iti| `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātukasyaiva` ityeṣā tu viparītaniyamāśaṅkā na kartavyā| yadi hrevaṃvidho niyamaḥ syāt, tadā rudādeḥ parasya sana iḍāgamo na syāt; niyamena vyāvarttitatvāt| tataśca `rudavida` [[1.2.8]] ityatra rudigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; <> [[1.2.10]] iti kittvasya siddhatvāt| tasmānnātra viparītaniyamāśaṅkā| `rudādibhya eva sārvadhātukasya, nānyebhyaḥ` ityeṣa niyamo bhaviṣyati, tato nārthaḥ sārvadhātukanivṛttyarthenārdhadhātukagrahaṇena? ityata āha - `rudādibhyaḥ` ityādi| <> [[7.2.76]] ityetasminniyamārthe vijñāyamāne kaścinmandabuddhiḥ pratipattā viparītaniyamaṃ sambhāvayet, tatrānantaroktayā nītyā'bhimataniyame pratipadyamāne `pratipattigauravaṃ bhavati` iti| itikaraṇo hetau| yata eva <> [[7.2.76]] ityetasminniyamārthe vijñāyamāne pratipattigauravaṃ bhavati, ato hetorārdhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? nārhatītyevamarthaṃ bhavitum| yadi hraṅgasya syāt, `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt` [[7.2.10]] iti pratyayasyeṭpratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt; prāptyabhāvā| <> [[1.2.18]] , `niṣṭhā śīṅ` [[1.2.19]] iti vacanācca| na hrasyeḍāgame sati ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ seṭtvamupapadyate| iha tarhi vṛkṣātvam, vṛkṣateti prātipadikapratyayasya mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? evamarthamapi nārhati bhavitum, `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] ityataḥ `dhātoḥ` ityanuvartate| nanvevamapi lūbhyām, lūbhirityatra prāpnotītyeva, na hyatra prakṛteḥ pratipadikatvena dhātutvaṃ vihanyate `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati` (vyā|pa|132) iti kṛtvā, tasmādiha mā bhūdityevamarthamārdhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ yuktam? naitadasti; <<ṝta iddhātoḥ>> [[7.1.100]] ityatra hi svarūpapadātmakasya dhātuśabdasya grahaṇam| ata ihāpi `dhāto` rityanuvartamānaṃ tathābhūtamevānuvartate| tena `dhātoḥ` ityevaṃvihitasyeṅvidhānāt? lūbhyām, lūbhirityatrāsatyārdhadhātukagrahaṇa iṭaḥ prasaṅgo na bhavati| tathā jugupsata ityevamādāvapi; na hyatra dhātorityevaṃ san? vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? gupādīn? dhātūn? svarūpeṇopādāya| tasmādetannivṛttyarthamapyārdhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti veditavyam| `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] ityatra svarūpapadātmakasya dhātuśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syāt| tadā tasyāpi `ṛtaḥ` iti viśeṣaṇaṃ na parikalpyeta| tasya dhātuśabde'sambhavāt? tadarthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityadovaḥ| atha vā - tatra tantreṇa dve dhādugrahaṇa upātte; tatraikamarthapadātmakam, aparaṃ svarūpapadātmakam| tatra yadarthapadātmakaṃ tatra tasyopayogaḥ, aparasya tvatreti na kaściddoṣaḥ| tasmāt? pratipattigauravaparīhārārthamevārdhadhātukagrahaṇam| atheṅgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <> [[7.2.8]] ityata iṅgrahaṇamanuvarattate? ityāha - `iḍiti vartamāne` ityādi| taddhiḍgrahaṇaṃ pratiṣedhena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tannivṛtyartha punariḍgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| nanu ca prāptau satyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, na ca valāderārdhadhātukasya kenacidiṭprāpnoti, ataḥ prāptyabhāvādeva vidhirayaṃ vijñāsyate, na pratiṣedhaḥ? naitadasti; etasmādeva pratiṣedhavacanādvidhirapyanumīyate| nūnamārdhadhātukasyeṅvidhirastīti yena valādeḥ pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| punariḍgrahaṇāt? tu vidhireṣa vijñāsyate||`snu praruāvaṇe` [`ṣṇu` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1038), `kramu pādavikṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-473) - anayorudāttatvādiṭi siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam - anātmanepadaviṣaya evānayoryathā syāt, anyatrā mā bhūditi| nanu ca snoterugantattvāt? kiti sani ca pratiṣedhavidhānāt? tasya vacanaṃ vidyarthamapi sambhavati? naitadasti; `ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ` [[7.2.35]] ityanuvartate| tenāsyāḥ prāpterviṣaye yogo'yamiti vijñāyate| na cāsyāḥ prāpteḥ sankitau viṣayau; tayorapavādaviṣayatvāt| ātmanepadanimitte iti prathamādvivacanāntam| snukramoretadviśeṣaṇamiti darśayitumāha - `na cet` ityādi| `kva ca tāvātmanepadanimitte` iti| kiṃ yatrātmanepadaṃ prati yogyatāmātramapi tayorasti tatrāpi tāvātmanepadanimitte? uta yatra tadāśrayamātmanepadaṃ bhavati tatra? evamartha pṛcchati - `yatra` ityādi| atraivaṃ vyākhyānam - yatra tadāśrayamātmanepadaṃ sambhavati tatra tāvātmanepadanimitte| kiṃ punastad? yatra tadāśrayamātmanepadaṃ bhavati? ityāha - `bhāvakarmakarttṛkarmakarmavyatīhāraḥ, krameśca` iti| eṣu hi stukramyāśrayamātmanepadaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdena sargādiparigrahaḥ| nimittam=kāraṇam| na cākurvat? kārya#ṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavati| yatra tvakurvatyapi kāryaṃ kusūlasya bījādau kāraṇamapi vyapadeśaḥ, tatrāsau yogyatayaupacārikaḥ| tasmādyatra snukramāvāśrityātmanepadaṃ bhavati, tatraiva bhāvakarmādau tayorātmanepadanimittaṃ mukhyaṃ vijñāyate| `tena` ityādi| yasmādevaṃ yatra tāvāśrityātmanepadaṃ bhavati tatra tayorātmanepadanimittatvam| tena satyātmanepade pratiṣedho'yaṃ bhavati, nāsati| na hrasatyātmanepade tayormukhyamātmanepadanimittatvamupapadyate| tataśca prasnavitā, prasnavitum, prasnavitavyam, prakramitā, prakramitum, prakramitavyamityatra yadyapyātmanepadayogyatvāt? snukramāvātmanepadasya nimittavyapadeśamāsādayataḥ, tathāpi pratiṣedho na bhavati| na hyatra mukhyamātmanepadanimittatvam; ātmanepadābhāvāt|`prāpnoṣīṣṭeti| āśiṣi liṅ? sīyuṭ, <> [[1.3.13]] ityātmanapadam, `suṭtithoḥ` [[3.4.107]] iti suṭ, ṣatvam, ṣṭutvam| `prakraṃsīṣṭa` iti| atra `propābhyāṃ samarthābhyāma` [[1.3.42]] iti kartarthātmanepadam| `prasnoṣyate` iti| `lṛṭ? śeṣe ca` [[3.3.13]] iti lṛṭ| `pracikraṃsate` [nāstīdamudāharaṇaṃ kāśikāyām| `pracikraṃsiṣyate` ityevāsti] iti| san, `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityātmānepadam| `sarvatraiva` ityādi| yuktaṃ prakraṃsīṣṭa, prasnīṣīṣṭetyādau snukramorātmanepadasya nimittatvam, tasmādātmanepadasya vidhānāt; pracikraṃsata ityatra tu kathaṃ kramirātmanepadasya nimittam, na hyatra kramimāśrityātmanepadaṃ bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? sanantaṃ dhātvantaram? ityāha - `sanantādapi` ityādi| sanantādapi hi yadātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityanena| tena tatrāpi pūrvavaditi vacanāt? pūrva dhātusvarūpamātmanepadasya nimittamāśrīyata iti| yadyapi sanantādātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate tathāpi kramestatra nimittābhāvo'styevetyabhiprāyaḥ| atha nimittagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamupādīyate, na `ātmanepade` ityevocyate? ityata āha - `nimittagrahaṇam` ityādi| sīyuṭ? ādiryasya sa sīyuḍādiḥ, tadātmanepade paraṃ yasmāt? sa tatparaḥ syapratyayaḥ, sa paro yasmāt? sa tatparaparaḥ sanpratyayaḥ; tayoḥ pratiṣedo yathā syādityavamarthaṃ nimittagrahaṇam| tatra sīyuḍādeḥ pratiṣedhārtham - prasnoṣīṣṭa, prakraṃsīṣṭeti; tatparaparasya ca pratiṣedhārtham - pracikraṃsiṣyata iti; atra hi nimittagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā `ātmanepade` ityeṣā parasaptamī vijñāyeta| na ca prasnīṣīṣṭa, prakraṃsīṣṭetyātmanepade parata ārdhadhātukamasti tathā hrātmanepadasyāgamaḥ sīyuṭ, tadekadeśātvadātmanepade parata uccārthamāṇaḥ pratiṣedho na syāt| pracikraṃsiṣyata ityatra `ātmanepade` ityetasyāṃ parasaptamyāṃ vijñāyamānāyāṃ <> [[1.1.66]] iti nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāt? syena vyavadhāne sati sana iṭpratiṣedho na syāt? nimittagrahaṇe tu sati bhavati| asti hyatra sarvatra snukramoryathāyogamātmanepadaṃ prati nimittabhāvaḥ| tasmānnimittagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| prasnavitrīyata ityata snauterātmanepadaṃ paraṃ copalabdham; ataḥ snautirātmanepadasaya nimittamiti pratiṣedhena bhavitaśyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - iha prasnavitevācarati` ityādi| kvacit? `prasnavitāramivācarati` iti pāṭhaḥ, sa tu nopapadyate| na hi karmaṇaḥ kyaṅ? vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? subantāt? karttuḥ| tasmāt? pramādakṛto'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ| prasnavitevācaratīti tṛjantāt, `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca` [[3.1.11]] iti kyaṅ, `rīṅṛtaḥ` [[7.4.27]] iti rīṅ| kyaṅantādātamanepadaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ ṅita ityevaṃ vidhīyate| sa ca snautirṅit? kiṃ tarhi? kyaṅantaḥ| tasmāt? kyaṅantamevātmanepadanimittaṃ na snautiriti na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ| `kramestu` ityādi| nimittagrahaṇāt? satyevātmanepade pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam, nāsatīti| kartari kṛti pratiṣedho na prāpnotītyupasaṃkhyāyate| `prakrāntā, upakrāntā` iti| <> [[1.3.42]] iti propāmyāmupasuṣṭāt? kramerātmanepadavaṣānādiha kramerātmanepadasya viṣayaḥ| `ātmanepadaviṣayaḥ` [ātmanepadaviṣayāt - mūlam] iti| ātmanepadaṃ viṣayo yasya sa ātmanepadaviṣayaḥ| `prakramitavyam, upakramitavyam` iti| <> [[3.4.70]] iti bhāve karmaṇi kṛtyaḥ| `niṣkramitā` iti| `idudupaṣasya` [[8.3.41]] iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam| niṣphūrvāt? kramerātmanepadasyābhāvādihātmanepadasya vaṣayo na bhavati| atha prasusnūṣati, prasnutaḥ, prasnutavānityatra kasmānna bhavati, na hyatra snautirātmanepadaviṣayaḥ? ityāta āha - `snauteḥ` ityādi| nanu `śrayukaḥ kiti` [[7.2.11]] , <> [[7.2.12]] itīṭpratiṣedhasya dhātvantaramugantamavakāśa iti paratvādidaivātra bhavitavyam, na pratiṣedhena? naitadasti; uktaṃ hi purastāt? pratiṣedhakāṇjasya balīyastvāt? prayojanamiṇmātrasthānāśritaviśeṣavidhānasya pratiṣedho yathā syāditi||`graha uttarasya` `graha` iti pañcamīṃ darśayati| yadyevam, tadeṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam; prakṛtameva tadanuvartate| taddhi prathamāntanirdiṣṭam, ṣīṣṭhīnirdeśena cehārthaḥ? naiṣa doṣakhaḥ; `grahaḥ` ityeṣā pañcamīti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; <> [[1.1.67]] iti vacanāt| `jagṛhiva, jagṛhim` iti| grahrādisūtreṇa [[6.1.16]] samprasāraṇam|tathā grāhitā, grāhiṣyata ityatra kathaṃ ciṇvadiṭo na bhavati? ityāha - `prakṛtasyaiva` ityādi| ārdhadhātukasyeti yaḥ prakṛta iṭ? tasyedaṃ daurghatvaṃ bhavati, na ciṇvadiṭaḥ; tasyāprakṛtatvāt| ciṇvadityanena ciṇvadbhāva upalakṣyate| tatsahacarita iṭ? ciṇvadityucyate| `grāhita` iti| <> [[3.3.15]] , <> [[3.1.33]] iti tāsiḥ, bhāvakarmaṇoḥ` [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam, `luṭa prathamasya` [[2.4.85]] ityādinā ḍādeśaḥ, ṭilopaḥ, `syasicsīyuṭtāsiṣu` [[6.4.62]] ityādineṭ? ciṇvadbhāvādvṛddhiḥ| atha jarīgṛhitā, jarīgṛhītumityatra yaṅantāt? tṛni tumuni ca yalopāllopayoḥ kṛtayordīrghaḥ kasmānna bhavati? uttarasūtre vāgrahaṇasyobhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣabhūtatvādvyavasthivibhāṣāvijñānāt| atha vā - vihitaviśeṣaṇapakṣo'tra vyākhyāyate| grahertho vihita iṭ? tasya dīrgho bhavati| na cātra grahervihita iṭ? kutastarhi? yaṅntāt| tasmānneha dīrghasya prasaṅgaḥ| atha `graha īḍaliṭi` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, kiṃ dīrghagrahaṇena? naivaṃ śakyām; evaṃ satīṭkāryamīṭo na syāt, tataścāgrahīdityatra `iṭa īṭi` [[8.2.28]] iti sico lopo na syāt, `neṭi` [[7.2.4]] iti pratiṣedhaśca; iha cāgrahīḍhvam, agrahīdhvamityatreṭaḥ <> [[8.3.79]] iti mūrghanyaśca; dīrgha iṭa ādeśe sati tasya sthānivadbhāvadiṭkāryamupapadyata iti dīrghaṃ eva vidhīyate||`variṣauṣṭetyādau [`vivariṣīṣṭa` - iti kāśikāyāmudāharaṇam]<> [[7.2.42]] itīṭ| `vistariṣīṣṭa` iti| karmaṇyātmanepadam||`prāvāriṣṭām` iti| `tasthasthamipāṃ tāntantāmaḥ` [[3.4.101]] iti tasastām, sāmānyavihita iṭ? sici vṛddhiḥ| `prāvāriṣuḥ` iti| `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] iti jherjus| vṛṅa udāharaṇaṃ nopanyastama; tasya parasmaipadāsambhavāt| `prāvariṣṭa, prāvarīṣṭa` iti| <> [[7.2.42]] itīṭ||`vuvūrṣate` iti| <> [[1.2.9]] iti sanaḥ kittvam, <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghaḥ, `udoṣṭhapūrvasya` [[7.1.102]] ityutvam, raparatvam| ateha kasmānna bhavati - cikīrṣati, jihīrṣatīti, asti dīrghatve kṛte prāptiḥ? ityata āha - `cikīrṣati, jihirṣati` iti| gatārtham||vṛta udāttatvādiṭi prāpte vikalpārtha ārambhaḥ| `ātmanepadeṣu` iti parasapatamīyam| sicaścaitadvi śeṣaṇam| yadyevam, liṅ? viśeṣito na syāt, tataśca liṅ? parasmaipadeṣvapi prasajyeta? naitadasti; `valādeḥ` [[7.2.35]] ityadhikārāt, liṅśca parasmaipadeṣu yāsuḍāditvābhāvāt| `ātmanepadapare` iti| ātmanepadaṃ paraṃ yasmāt? sa tathoktaḥ| etacca sijityanenaiva sambadhyate, na liṅityanema; sicameva pratyātmanepadagrahaṇasya viśeṣaṇabhāvāt| `vṛṣīṣṭa` iti| `uśca` [[1.2.12]] iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `āstīrṣīṣṭa`iti| pūrvavat? kittvadīrghatvādiḥ| `avṛta` iti| `hrasvādaṅgāt` [[8.2.27]] iti sico lopaḥ||ṛkārāntānāmanudāttatvāt? pratiṣedhe prāpte vikalpārtha vacanam| `dhvṛṣīṣṭa` iti| `dhvṛ hūcrchane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-139)| <> [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam| evamanyatrāpyātmanepadaṃ veditavyam| pūrvavat? kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `smṛṣīṣṭa` iti| `smṛ cintāyām? (dhātupāṭhaḥ-933)| `cyoṣīṣṭa` iti| `cyuṅ chyaṅ [nāsti - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] jyuṅityādi| (dhātupāṭhaḥ-955,956)| atra ṅittvāt? kartaryātmanepadam| `akṛṣata` iti| <<ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ>> [[7.1.5]] ityadādeśaḥ| atha saṃskṛṣīṣṭa samaskṛtetyatra kasmānna bhavati, bhavati hi karotiratra `saṃparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe` [[6.1.137]] iti suṭi kṛte saṃyogādiḥ? ityāha - `saṃskṛṣoṣṭa` ityādi| `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt` [[7.2.10]] ityata upadeśagrahaṇamanuvartate, tenopadeśāvasthāyāṃ yaḥ saṃyogādistata evaitena bhavitavyam, na ca karotirupadeśāvasthāyāṃ saṃyogādiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tata uttaram, ato na bhavati| `abhaktatvācca` ityādi| saṃskṛṣīṣṭetyatrāyaṃ parīhāraḥ, na samaskṛtetyatra| amra hraḍāgamaḥ `tadbhaktastadgrahaṇena gṛhrate` (vyā|pa|20) iti aṭo'pyaṅgagrahaṇena grahaṇāditi `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhrate` (vyā|pa|21) iti suṭo'pyaṅgagrahaṇena grahaṇāt? karotirapi saṃyogādirbhavatyeva| aṅgādhikārāccāṅgāvayavo'tri saṃyogo'pi gṛhrate; pratyāsatteḥ| na ca saṃskṛṣīṣṭetyatrāṅgāvayavaḥ saṃyogādiḥ, yaścāṅgāvayavo nāsau saṃyoge bhavati, tadiha na bhavatīṭprasaṅgaḥ| atra `sampukānāṃ satvam` (vā 936) iti vacanāt samo makārasya sakāraḥ, pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ| samaskṛtetyatra pūrvavat? sico lopaḥ| cakāra ātmanepadānukarṣaṇārthaḥ, tenottaratra vidhiraviśeṣema bhavati; cānukṛṣṭasyottaratrānanuvṛtteḥ||`svṛ śabdopatāpayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-932), `ṣūṅ prāṇigarbhavimocane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1031) ityādādikaḥ, `ṣūṅ prāṇiprasave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1132) iti daivādikaḥ| `ghūñ? kampane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1255,1487,1385) iti svādiḥ, kryādiḥ, curādiśca| tatra `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] ityadhikārādādyayogrrahaṇam, netarasya| ūditaḥ - `gāhū viloḍane (dhātupāṭhaḥ-649), `gupū rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-395) ityādayaḥ| eteṣāṃ svarateścānudāttatvāt? pratiṣedhe prāpte, itareṣāmudāttatvānnityamiṭi prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam| `vigāḍhā` iti| pūrvavaṅḍhatvādi vidheyam| atha vāvacanaṃ kimartham? yāvatā `iṭ? sani vā` [[7.2.41]] ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvartate? ityāha - `vetyanuvartamāne` ityādi| taddhi vāgrahaṇaṃ liṅsijbhyāṃ sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau tayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmāt? pūrvavāgrahaṇasambaddhayorliṅsicornivṛttyarthamanyadidaṃ vāgrahaṇamiti| nanu ca liṅsicoranuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmāt? pūrvavagrahaṇasambaddhayoraliṅsicornivṛttyarthamandidaṃ vāgrahaṇamiti| nanu ca liṅsicoranuvṛttau svaratigrahaṇa manarthakamāpadyate, pūrveṇaiva vikalpasya siddhatvāt? naitadasti; vacanaprāmāṇyāt? svaratigrahaṇaṃ nityārthaṃ vijñāyate| atha vā - svaritagrahaṇāt? `vā` ityetannivartate| atha sūtisūyatyorvikaraṇa nirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na `sū` ityebodhyeta? ityata āha - `sūtisūyatyoḥ` ityādi| `sū` ityucyamāne `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|53) iti `sū preraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1408) [`ṣū preraṇe` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] ityasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt| atastannivṛttyartho vikaraṇa nirdeśaḥ karaṇīyaḥ| yadyetat? prayojanam, sūṅiti nirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi sati nirdeśe kriyamāṇe `lugvakaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|50) iti sūyatereva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na sūteḥ| atastannivṛttaye vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ| asyāḥ paribhāṣāyā astitve'yameva nirdeśo jñāpakaḥ| asyāṃ hrasatyāṃ `sūṅ` iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| atha `dhūñ` iti sānubandhakasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pā|53) `ṣū vidhūnane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1398) ityasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, etaccāniṣṭam| ato vidhūnanārthasya nivṛttyarthaḥ sānubandhakanirdeśaḥ| `svarateḥ` ityādi| asya vikalpasyāvakāśaḥ - svaritā, svarteti; ṛddhanīḥ sye` [[7.2.70]] ityasyāvakāśaḥ - kariṣyati, hariṣyatīti; svaraterasyobhayaprasaṅge <<ṛddhanoḥ sye>> [[7.2.70]] ityetadbhavati vipratiṣedhena - svariṣyatīti| `kiti tu pratyaye` ityādi| `śrayukaḥ kiti` [[7.2.11]] ityasyāvakāśaḥ - sūtaḥ, sūtadāni, asya vikalpasyāvakāśaḥ - svartā, svariteti; sotā savitā; dhotā, dhaviteti; ihomayaprasaṅge `śrayukaḥ kiti` [[7.2.11]] iti nityaṃ [nityaḥ - kāśikā] pratiṣedho bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena - svṛtvā, sūtvā, dhūtvā`| etacca purastāt? pratiṣedhakāṇḍavidhānādeva siddham| uktaṃ hi prāk? purastāt? pratiṣedhavidhānasya prayojanam - iṇmātrasyānādhitadidhānaviśeṣasya pratiṣedho yathā syāditi| tadetat? purastāt? pratiṣedhavidhānaṃ pūrvadipratiṣedhena samānaphalakatvādiha pūrvavipratiṣedhaśabdenoktam||`ratha hiṃsāsaṃrāddhyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1193), `ṇaśa adarśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1194,) `tṛpa prīṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1195), `dṛpa harṣaṇamohanayoḥ` (dhā|1196),[`harṣamohanayo` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `druha jighāṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1197), `muha vaicittye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1198), `ṇṇuha ddhadgiraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1199) ṣṇiha prītau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1200) - ityete radhādayaḥ| eṣu tṛpyatidṛpyatyoranudāttatvādiṭpratiṣedhe prāpte śeṣāṇāmudāttatvānnityamiṭi prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam| `naṃṣṭā` iti| `masjinaśojhaṃli` [[7.1.60]] iti num| vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, ṣṭutvam| `traptaḥ` iti| <> [[6.1.59]] ityam, yaṇādeśaḥ| `tarpitā` iti| laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| drogkṣā, megdhā, snodhyā, snegdhetīḍabhāvapakṣe `vā druhamuhaṇṇuhaṇṇihām` [[8.2.33]] iti ghatvam, `jhaṣastathorṣo'dhaḥ` [[8.2.40]] iti dhatvam, <> [[8.4.53]] iti jaśtvaṃ gakāraḥ| `droḍhā, ñoḍhā, snoḍhā sneḍhā` iti| pūrvavaṅḍhatvādi vidheyam| `krādiniyamālliṭi radhādibhyaḥ paratvādvikalpaṃ kecidicchanti` iti| pakṣe raradhva, raradhmetyādyapi yathā syāt| `apare punaḥ` ityādi| etadeva hi pūrvavidheriṭpratiṣedhavidhānasya prayojanam - pratiṣedhasya balīyastvaṃ yathā syāditi| tasmāt? pratiṣedhaniyayamasyā balīyastvānnityamiṭā bhavitavyam| tatra pūrveṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥ - pūrvavidheriṭpratiṣedhavidhānasāmāthryāt? pratiṣedhasya balīyastvaṃ bhavati, na tu pratiṣedhaniyamasyeti| itareṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥ - pratiṣedhasya balīyastvāt? taddharmasya niyamasyāpi balīyastvaṃ bhavati, na tu pratiṣedhasyaiveti tasya balīyastve sati tatprāptiḥ, tena nityamiṭā bhavituṃ yuktamiti| pratiṣedhaniyamastu sa eva krādiniyamaḥ| `rarandhiva, rarandhima` iti| <> [[7.1.61]] iti num||kimarthamiḍiti vartamāne punariṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha - `iḍgrahaṇaṃ nityārtham` iti| asatīṅgrahaṇe hi vikalpasya prakṛtatvāt? pākṣika iḍavidhiḥ syāt| tasmānnityarthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| nanu ca siddhā vibhāvā pūrvasūtreṇa, āraṃbhasāmarthyādeva nityo'yaṃ vidhirbhavatiṣyati? ityāha - `ārambho hi` ityādi| pūrvasūtreṇeṭo vikalpitatvānniṣṭhāyāṃ, <> [[7.2.15]] iti pratiṣedhe prāpte nityo'yamārambhaḥ| tatra yadīṅgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā tasyaiva pratiṣedhasyāyamārambo bādhakaḥ syāt, tataśca vikalpa eva syāt, na nityo vidhiḥ| tasmānnityārthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| yadi hi nityārthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta tadā tena vikalpasya nivarttitatvāduttaratrāpi nitya eva vidhiḥ syādityata āha - `tatreva` ityādi| na cāneneṅgrahaṇena vikalpaḥ śakyate nivartayitum; tasya svaritatvādiṅgrahaṇasāmarthyāt| anuvartamāne'pi vāgrahaṇe nityo'yaṃ vidhirbhavati| yā tu tasyaiva vikalpasyānuvṛttiḥ, sottarārthā| tenottaratra vikalpa eva||`iṣu icchāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1351),[`iṣa` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] `ṣaha marṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-852); `lubha gārddhye (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1238), `lubha vimohane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1305) - dvayorapi grahaṇam; viśeṣānupādanāt| `ruṣa roṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1670), `ruṣa riṣa hiṃsāyām` dhātupāṭhaḥ-1230,1231)| sarva eṣaita udāttā iti nityāmiṭi prāpte vikalpārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `tadartham` iti| icchārthasyaiva vikalpo yathā syāditarayorma bhūdityevamartham| ye tūditaṃ na paṭhanti, te `vā` iti prakṛtasya vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt? sahinā bhauvādikena sāhacaryādvā icchārthasyaiva vikalpena bhaviṣyati, netarayoriti varṇayanti| `soḍhā` iti| ḍhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopeṣu kṛteṣu <> [[6.3.112]]ivantānāmiti| `divu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1107), `sivu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1108) ityevamādīnām| `ṛdhu vṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1245 `bhrasja pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1284), `dambhe` [`dambhane` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1270), `śriñsevāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-897), `svṛ śabdopatāpayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-932), `yū miśraṇe` [`miśraṇe'miśraṇe ca` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1033), `ūrṇu ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1039), `śriñ? bharaṇe` (), māraṇatīṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñapiṇryantaḥ| `ṣaṇu dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1464), `vana ṣaṇa sambhaktau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-463,444) - dvayorapi grahaṇam; viśeṣānupādānāt| atra bhrasjeranudāttatvāt, lvuyurṇubhṛñāṃ cogantatvāt? `sani grahaguhīśca` [[7.2.12]] iti pratiṣedhe prāpte, śeṣāṇāmudāttatvānnityamiṭi prāpte vikalpo'yamārabhyate| `dudyūṣati` iti| diveḥ san, `halāntacca` [[1.2.10]] iti sanaḥ kittvam, `cchvo śūḍanunāsike` [[6.4.19]] ityūṭhi yaṇādeśaḥ, dvirvacanam - `dyūṣa` ityetasya, <> [[7.4.60]] iti cartvam - dhakārasya dakāraḥ| `vibhrajjiṣati` iti| <> [[8.4.53]] iti sakārasya dakāraḥ, <> [[8.4.40]] iti ścutvam - dakārasya jakāraḥ| `bibhakrṣati` iti| bhrasjo ropadhāyā ramanyatarasyām` [[6.4.47]] ityakārāt? paro ramāgamaḥ `ropadhayoḥ` iti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśādrephasyopadhāyāśca sakārasya nivartakaḥ, <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam, `iṇkoḥ` [[8.3.57]] iti<<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam| `ghipsati, ghīpsati` iti| <> [[7.4.56]] itīttvamīttvañca, `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam, bhakārasya pakāraḥ, pūrvavadabhyāsalopaḥ, `halāntācca` [[1.2.10]] iti kittvādanunāsikalopaḥ| `ucchiśrīṣati` iti| <> [[1.2.9]] iti kittvam, <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghatvam, dvirvacanamabhyāsakāryam| `ādeśapratyayoḥ` [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam, dakārasya cutvam - cakāraḥ| <<śaścho'ṭi>> [[8.4.63]] iti śakārasya cchakāraḥ| `sisvariṣati` iti| dvirvacanam? `svṛ` ityetasya, `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattvam, raparatvañca| `susvūrṣati` iti| parvavaddīrghaḥ, `udoṣṭhapūrvasya [[7.1.102]] ityuttvam, raparatvam, `hali ca` [[8.2.70]] iti dīrghaḥ, dvirvacanam - `svūrṣa` ityetasya, abhyāsakāryam, `ādeśaparatyayoḥ` [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam| `yiyiviṣati` iti| <> [[7.4.80]] ityabhyāsasyettvam| `prorṇunūṣati` iti| `ajādedvitīyasya` [[6.1.2]] iti vacanāddvitīyasyaikācaḥ `nusa` ityetasya dviruktiḥ, rephasya pūrvanna dvirvacanam| `prorṇunaviṣati` iti| iṭa, pakṣe <> [[1.2.3]] iti yadā ṅittvaṃ tadovaṅ, anyadā tu guṇaḥ| `bhuñityetasya bhauvādikasya grahaṇam` iti| atha ṅubhṛñityasya jauhotyādikasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `śapā nirdeśāt` ityādi| yadi jauhotyādikasya bhṛño dhāraṇapoṣaṇārthasya grahaṇamabhimataṃ syāt, tadā `bhṛ` ityevaṃ nirdeśaṃ kuryāt, na tu `bhara` iti śapānirdeśam, kṛtaśca śapā nirdeśaḥ, tasmādbhauvādikasya grahaṇamiti gamyate| `bubhūrṣati` iti| pūrvaduttvadīrghatve| `jñīpsati` iti| `jñā` ityetasmāṇṇic, `arttihrau` ityādinā puk, pūrvadīttvābhyāsalopau| `siṣāsati` iti| `janasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ` ityātvam| `kecidatra` ityādi| keciditi vacanāt? kecinna paṭhantītyuktaṃ bhavati| ye tu na paṭhantite'tra tanipatidaridrāṇāmupasaṃkhyānaṃ kurvanti| `titaṃsati, titāṃsati` iti| `tenotervibhāvā` [[6.4.17]] iti pakṣe dīrghaḥ| `pitsati` iti| `sanimīmā` [[7.4.54]] ityādinesādeśaḥ, abhyāsalopaḥ, `skoḥ` [[8.2.29]] ityādinā salopaḥ| `didaridriṣati, didaridrāsati` iti| `daridrāterārdhadhātuke` (vā|789) ityādinā vikalpenākāralopaḥ||`kliṣṭvā` iti| vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam| `kliśitvā` iti| <> [[1.2.26]] iti kittvam| `ktvāpratyaye vikalpaḥ siddha eva` iti| ūditvāt? `svarati` [[7.2.44]] ityādinā yadi katvāpratyaye vikalpaḥ siddha eva, tatkimarthaṃ ktvāgrahaṇam? ityāha - `kliśa upatāpa ityasya tu` ityādi| `nityamiḍāgamaḥ prāpnoti` iti| upatāpārthasya kliśerudāttatvāt| `tadartham` iti| upatāpārtho yaḥ kliśistadartham| so'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat? tathoktam| atha vā - upatāparthasya kliśeryo nityamiḍāgamaḥ prāpnoti tadartham, tannivṛtyartha mityarthaḥ; arthaśabdasya nivṛttivacanatvāt||ugantatvāt? `śrayukaḥ kiti` [[7.2.11]] itīṭpratīṣedhe prāpte katvāniṣṭhayoḥ pakṣe prāptyarthaṃ vacanam| `pavitvā, paktiḥ, pavitavān` iti| <> [[1.2.22]] iti kittvapratiṣedhādguṇo bhavatyeva| `pūṅaḥ` iti sānubandhakasya grahaṇaṃ pūño nivṛttyartham|||`vasa nivāse` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1005), `kṣudha bubhukṣāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1190) - anayoranudattatvādiṭpratiṣedhe prāpte ktvāniṣṭhayoriṅvidhanārtha vacanam| `uṣitvā` iti| ktvā, iṭ, <> [[1.2.18]] iti kittvapratiṣedhe prāpte `muḍamṛva` [[1.2.7]] ityādinā kittvam, vacyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.15]] yajāditvāt? samprasāraṇam, `śāsivasicasīnāṃ ca` [[8.3.60]] iti ṣatvam| `kṣudhitvā` iti| atrāpi <> [[1.2.26]] iti pakṣe kittvam| `vasatīti vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ` ityādi| `vikaraṇanirdeśo dhātunirdeśārthe eva` ityuktam| atha `vasa ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1023) ityasya nivṛttyarthaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? iti yaścīdayet, taṃ pratyāha - `vasteḥ` ityādi| atha vāvastaḥ, vāvastavānityatra yaṅluṅnivṛttyarthaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? iti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `vasteḥ` ityādi| atha vāvastaḥ, vāvastavānityatra yaṅluṅnivṛttyarthaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? vihitaviśeṣaṇapakṣavijñānādapi yaṅluṅnivṛttiḥ śakyate karttumityabhiprāyaḥ| atheḍityanuvartamāne punariṅgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? ityāha - `punariṅgrahaṇaṃ nityārtham` iti| pūrvakamiṅgrahaṇaṃ vikalpena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmāttannivṛttyartha punariṅgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam||`añcitāḥ` iti| pūjitā ityarthaḥ| <> [[3.2.188]] iti ktapratyayaḥ| `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityanunāsikalopo na bhavati; <> [[6.4.30]] iti pratiṣedhāt| `asya` iti| `ktasya ca vartamāne` [[2.3.67]] iti ṣaṣṭhī||`lubhitvā, lobhitvā` iti| `ralo cyupadhāt` [[1.2.26]] ityādinā pakṣe kittādguṇābhāvo bhavatyeva| `gārdheye yathāprāptameva` iti| kvāpratyaye vikalpaḥ| niṣṭhāyāṃ <> [[7.2.15]] iti nityaḥ pratiṣedha iti||`jarītvā, jaritvā` iti| `jṛ? vayohānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1494) kraiyādikaḥ| `vṛto vā` [[7.2.38]] iti pakṣe dīrghaḥ| yastu `jṛṣa vayohānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1130) iti vivādau paṭhate, tasya sānubandhakatvādiha grahaṇaṃ nāstīti tasya jaurtvetyevaṃ bhavati| `vraścitvā` iti| `o vraścū chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1292)| <> [[1.2.18]] iti pratiṣedhād? grahijyetyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.16]] samprasāraṇaṃ na bhavati; kiti tasaya vidhānāt| atha ktvāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <> [[7.2.50]] ityata eva katvāgrahaṇamanuvartata eva? ityāha - `ktvāgrahaṇam` ityādi| taddhi ktvāgrahaṇaṃ niṣṭhaā saha sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyā adhyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| evaṃ ca sati niṣṭhāyāmapi syāt| tasmāt? niṣṭhānivṛttyarthamanyadiha ktvāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate||`kṛtī chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1435) iti taudādikaḥ, `kṛtī veṣṭane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1447) iti raudhādikaḥ - viśeṣānupādanāddvayorapi grahaṇam| `cṛtī hiṃsāsaṃgranthayoḥ` [`hiṃsāśranthanayoḥ` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1324), u chṛdir? dīptidevanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1445), `u tṛdir? hiṃsādānayoḥ` [`hiṃsā'nādarayoḥ` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1446)| ukārau <> [[7.2.56]] iti viśeṣaṇārtho| ikārarephāvapi <> [[3.1.57]] iti viśeṣaṇārthādeva| `nṛtī gātravikṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1116)| sarvevāmeṣānudāttatvānnityamiṭi prāpte sico'nyatra sakārādau vikalpārthaṃ vacanam| `se` ityetasyākāroccāraṇamatantram; avivakṣitatvāt| tena sye'pari vikalpo bhavati| atantratvaṃ tu punarasya `asici` iti sicaḥ pratiṣedhādvijñeyam| yadi hratantramakāroccāraṇam, evaṃ sati `svasici` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam? sandehabhayāt| evaṃ hrucyamāne `sye sici ca` ityeṣo'pyartha āśaṅkyeta| `se'sici` ityucyamāne tu saptamīdvayorupādānāt? sijvirjite sakārādāvityabhimato'rtho vijñāyate| nanvatrāpi sandehaḥ syāt - evamucyamāne kimarthaṃ sici na veti? yadi hi sicyapi syāt? tadupādānamanarthakaṃ syāt, sītyevaṃ brāūyāt| `katsyaiti` iti lṛṭ| `akatsryat` iti| luṅ| `cikṛtsati` iti| san, <> [[1.2.10]] iti kitvādguṇābhāvaḥ||`gamlṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-982)| gamirayamanudāttatvādaniṭ| yo'pi `sani ca` [[2.4.47]] iti `iṇ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1045) ityasya gamirādeśaḥ, yaśca `iṇvadika iti uktavyam` (vā|167) iti `ik? smaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1047) ityetasya, yaśca `iṅaśca` [[2.4.48]] iti `iṅ? adhyayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1046) ityetasya so'pi sthānivadbhāvādaniḍeva syāt| tebhyaḥ parasya sakārāderārdhadhātukasya sijvarjitasyeḍāgamo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ vacanam| `gamiṣyati, agamiṣyat` iti| anādeśasya gamerudāharaṇam| `jigamiṣati` iti| etat? tasyeṇādeśasya, igādeśasya vā|atheḍite vartamāne punariṅgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? ityāha - `iṅgrahaṇaṃ nityārtham` iti| taddhi [`taddhi pūrvakamiṅgrahaṇ| `udito vā` iti vāgrahaṇena prakṛtamiṅgrahaṇaṃ sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau` ityādiḥ mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] pūrvakamiṅgrahaṇaṃ <> [[7.2.56]] iti vāgrahaṇena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt, tathā ca vikalpeneṭ? prasajyeta| tasmāt tannivṛttyarthaṃ punariṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta| `saṃgaṃsīṣṭa` iti| sampūrvādgamerāśiṣi liṅ sīyuṭ, `samo gampṛcchi` [[1.3.29]] ityādinā''tmanepadam, <> [[3.4.107]] iti suṭ, dhatvam, ṣṭutvam| `sañjirgasate` iti| `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityātmaneṣadam| `adhijigāṃsate` iti| gameriṅādeśasya pratyudāharaṇam| atha sañcigaṃsata ityatra <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `gameriṅādeśasya` ityādi| taddhi dīrghatvamiṅādeśasya gameriṣyate, nānyasya| tathā hi tatroktam - gameriṅādeśasyeti vaktavyamiti| yadi parasmaipadeṣvityucyate, tadā kṛti parasmaipadaluki ca na prāpnoti? ityāha - `ātmanepadena` ityādi| `samānapadasthasya` iti| ekapadasthasyetyarthaḥ| `anyatra sarvatraiveṣyate` iti| etacca `kṛtyapi hi` ityādinā visapaṣṭīkaroti| `sañjigamiṣitā, adhijigamiṣitā` iti| kṛtyudāharaṇe dve| `jigamiva tvamiti` iti| etat? parasmaipadaluki| sannantatvādgamerloṭ, sip, `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] iti sehiṃrādeśara#ḥ, <> [[6.4.105]] iti luk| kathaṃ punaḥ parasmaipadeṣvityucyamāne kṛti parasmaipadaluki ca labhyate? evaṃ manyate - yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ; `gameriṭa` ityeko bhāgaḥ, tatra `se` ityanuvartate - sakārādāvārthadhātuke gameriḍāgamo bhavati| tataḥ `parasmaipadeṣu` iti dvitīyo yogo niyamārthaḥ| sa cāyaṃ niyamo yadyaviśeṣeṇa syāt? tadā pūrvayogo'narthakaḥ syāt| tasmāt? tulyajātīyāpekṣayā niyamaḥ, tulyajātīyaśca tiṅ - siṅviṣaye yadi bhayati tadā parasmaipadeṣveva, nātmanepadeṣviti| te kṛti parasmaipadaluki ca pūrvayoge na bhavatyeva; niyamenāvyāvarttitatvaditi| `padaśeṣakārasya panaḥ` ityādi| padaśeṣakāraḥ punarevaṃ manyate - parasmaipadeṣviti neyaṃ parasaptamī, kiṃ tarhi? viṣayasaptamī, parasmaipadaviṣaye yo gamirupalakṣitaḥ=upalabdhastasya sakārādāvārdhadhātuka iḍ? bhavatīti| evaṃ ca sati yogavibhāgamantareṇāpi tanmatena parasmaipadeṣu yo gamirupalakṣitaḥ, tasmādasatyapi parasmaipade sarvatra kṛti parasmaipadaluki ceḍ? bhavatyeva; parasmaipadaparatvena sakārāderārdhadhātukasyāviśetatvāt| tanmatena sañcirgasitā, adhijirgasitā vyākaraṇasyeti bhavitavyamiti; sampūrvasya, adhipūrvasya ca gameḥ parasmaipadeṣvanupalakṣitatvāt| tathā hi - sampūrvādgameḥ `samo gamyucchi` [[1.3.29]] ityādinā''tmanepadaṃ vihitam| adhipūrvādapi sthānivadbhāvāt? `anudāttaṅitaḥ` [[1.3.12]] ityanenātmanepadamiti||`vṛdbhyaḥ` iti bahuvacananirdeśādādyartho gamyate| ata evāha - `vṛdādibhyaḥ` iti| `vṛtu vartane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-758), `vṛdhu vṛdhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-759), `śṛdhu śabdakutsāyam` (dā|pā|760) `syandū ruāvaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-761) - ityete vṛdādayaścatvāra udāttaḥ| tatrādyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ nityamiṭi prapte, syandestūdittvāt? pākṣike prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| `vatsryati` iti| `lṛṭ? śeṣe ca` [[3.3.13]] iti lṛṭ, `vadbhyāḥ syasanoḥ` [[1.3.92]] iti vikalpena parasmaipadam| `vivṛtsati` iti| <> [[1.2.10]] iti sanaḥ kitvādguṇābhāvaḥ| vṛdhiśṛdhyordhakārasya `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - takāraḥ| `catubhrya iti na vaktavyam` iti| atra kāraṇamāha - `vṛtkaraṇaṃ hi` ityādi| tadeva yadi vṛdādiparisamāptyarthamapi vijñāyata iti tantreṇānekaśaktito vā śabdānāṃ na kiñcidaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti| evamapi viśāyamāna iṣṭasyaiva siddheratyabhiprāyaḥ| evaṃ pratyākhyāte catugrrahaṇe, prayojanamāha - `tatkriyate` ityādi| yadi catugrrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā spanderūdillakṣaṇo'ntaraṅgatvādvikalpaḥ syāt| antaraṅgatvaṃ tu tasaya valādyardhadhātukamātrāśrayatvāt| asya tu pratiṣedhasyārthadhātukaviśeṣāśrayatvādvaharaṅgatvam| tasmādantaraṅgamapi syanderūdillakṣaṇaṃ vikalpamayaṃ pratiṣedho yathā bādhetetyevamarthañca catugrrahaṇaṃ kriyate| kathaṃ punaḥ kriyamāṇe'pi catugrrahaṇe, ayamartho labhyate? ityata āha - `catugrrahaṇe` ityādi| sa syandiḥ paraḥ pradhāno yasya tat? tatparam, tadbhāvastātparyam, tena tātparyeṇa tatpradhānatayetyarthaḥ| `sannidhāpitaḥ` iti| upasthāpita ityarthaḥ| tasya caivaṃ sannidhāpitasya vikalpo'nena pratiṣedhena kathaṃ nāma bādhyetatyetadeva prayojanam| tataścatugrrahaṇādantaraṅgamapi viklapaṃ pratiṣedho bādhate| `atrapi` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ `parasmaipadeṣu` [[7.2.58]] ityanuvartamāne'nyatra sarvatra pratiṣedho labhyate? evaṃ manyate - gamerityanuvartate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate - gameḥ sakārādau yena prakāreṇa iṭ? tenaiva prakāreṇa vṛdādibyo neḍiti| tena yathā gamerātmanepadavarjanamanyatra sarvatraiveṅ bhavati, tathā vṛdādibhyo'pi pratiṣedha iti||`kṛpū sāmarthye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-762)| tasmādūdittvādvikalpeneṭi prāpte pratiṣedho'yamārabyate| `kalptā` iti| luṭ, `luṭi ca kḷpaḥ` [[1.3.93]] iti parasmaipadaṃ vikalpena, <> [[8.2.18]] iti latvam| `cikḷpsati` iti| pūrvavatkittvam| `kḷperapi` ityādi| ayamartho vṛdādīnāmanuvṛttarlabhyate, tadanuvattau satyāmevābhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate - yathā vṛdādīnā pratiṣedho bhavati, tathā'yamapi kḷperiti| yadi tarhi vṛdadīnāṃ grahaṇamihānuvartate, tadā vṛdādīnāmapi tāsau pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti? yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati| yadi vṛdādīnāmapi tāsau syāt, tadā `na vṛdbhyaḥ pañcabhyastāsi ca` ityekaraṇe kuryāt||krādiniyamādiṭi prāptejjantānāṃ tāsau nityāniṭāṃ thali pratiṣedho vidhīyate| `pātā` ityādi| luḍupanyāsastāsau nityāniṭtvapradarśanārthaḥ`; aniṭtvaṃ [`aniṭpratiṣedhāt` - ityeva mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ca `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] ityādineṭ? prataṣedhāt| `lūtvā, lulavitha` iti| tāsvaditi vacanādiha na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ| tasmasvanucyamāna[`tasmasatvanucyamāna ihāpi pratiṣedha syāt - bhavati, lunāti| kiti nityamaniṭaḥ `śrayukaḥ kiti` iti pratiṣedhāt` - iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ihāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| bhavati lunātiḥ kiti nityamaniṭ| `śrayukaḥ kiti` [[7.2.11]] iti pratiṣedhāt? `papiva, papima` iti| <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ| `aniṅgrahaṇaṃ nityamityanena` ityādi| nityamityanenāniṭtvaṃ dhātoḥ kathaṃ nāma viśeṣyetetyevamarthamaniṅgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| atha savitā, lulavatheti tāsau seṭasthalauṭpratiṣedho mā bhūdityevamarthamaniḍgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? nārhatyevamarthaṃ bhavitum| tathā hi - tāsvat? thalīṇna bhavatītyucyate; na ca yastāsau seṭ? tasya pratiṣedho bhavaṃstāsvaditi vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyate, yo hramijabhāvasthali vidhīyate tasya tāsāviḍamāvenaiva sādṛśyaṃ vatirācaṣṭe| evaṃ tu vatigrahaṇādeva tāsau seṭasthali pratiṣedho na bhaviṣyati; anyathā vatinā yat? sādṛśyaṃ samākhyayate tanna syāt| tasmādyuktamuktemevānidgraṇasya prayojanam| athākrayamāṇe'niṅgrahaṇe nityamiti kasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate? pratiṣedhasya| nanu ca nitya eva pratiṣedhaḥ prakṛtaḥ, tatra yadi nityagrahaṇe na pratiṣedho viśiṣyeta, tadā nityagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? naitadasti; pūrvasūtre pratiṣedhasyānityatvaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ syāt| avaṃ ca pūrvasūtreṇa pakṣa iḍāgamaḥ syādeva| tasmāt? pūrvoktamevāniḍgrahaṇasya prayojanam| `tāsau vibāṣiteṭ` iti| svaratyādisūtrema [[7.2.44]] dhūña iṅ? vikalpitaḥ| tasya nityagrahaṇādvibhāṣiteṭasthali nityamiḍāgamo bhavati| asati ca nityagrahaṇe pratiṣedhaḥ syādeva| pākṣikeṇāpīḍabhāvenāniṅvyapadeśo bhavatyeva| tathā hi - guhervibhāṣiteṭo'pi <<śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ>> [[3.1.45]] iti kso bhavatyeva - adhukṣaditi| atha vatinā nirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na tāsāvityevocyeta? ityata āha - `tāsvat` ityādi| asati vatinā nirdeśe yo'pi tāsāvasan? asattvācca nityamaniṭ, tasyāpi thali pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| vatinā nirdeśe tu sati, vateḥ sarvasādṛśyārthatvādyathābhūtasya tāsāviṇna bhavati tathābhūtasyaiva thalpapīṭā na bhavitavyamiti na bhavatyeva doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| yadi hi yastāsāvasat? asattvācca nityamaniṭ? tasyāpi thali pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| evaṃ ca sati tasāvasata iḍabhāvaḥ, itaratra tu sata iti yathābhūtasya tāsādiḍabhāvastathābhūtasthāpi thali na syāt| yo hi tāsāvasannasattvācca nityamaniṭ, tasya thali pratiṣedo na bhavati - jaghasitheti - uttarasūtreṇetyabhiprāya ityata āha - `uttarasūtre'pi` ityādi| tadevamuttarārtho vatinā nirdeśo'yaṃ bhavati| iha tu nārtho vatinirdeśena, anajantatvādeva ghaservayeśca paratiṣedho na bhavatīti| `jaghasitha` iti| `liṭanyatarasyām` (2.4.4|0) ityaderghaslādeśaḥ| `udayitha` iti| <> [[2.4.41]] iti vayirādeśaḥ; `liṭabhyāsasyobhatheṣām` [[6.1.17]] iti samprasaraṇam| kasmāt? pūnarghaseḥ, vayeśca tāsāvasattvānnityāniṭtvam? ityāha - `adādeśo hi` ityādi| nāstitvaṃ tayoḥ punastāsāvavidhānādveditavyam||anajantārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `iyaṣṭha` [`iyaṣṭa` iti padamañjarī] iti| pūrvavadabhyāsasya samprasāram, vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, ṣṭutvam| `cakarṣitha` iti| `kṛṣa vilekhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-990)| bhavatyayamakāravān, na tūpadeśe, kiṃ tarhi? paścādguṇe kṛte| upadeśagrahamiha śakyamakarttum, śakyata eva hi `ekāca upadeśe` [[7.2.10]] ityata upadeśagrahaṇamanuvartayitum? tat? kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| asati tasmin, pūrvasūtre tasyānupayogānnivṛtiṃta manyamānaḥ `tāsāvatvataḥ` ityevamapi kaścit? pratipadyeta| `rarādhitha` iti| `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1262,1263)| `jighṛkṣati` iti| <> [[7.2.12]] itīṭpratiṣedhādbhavati nityāniṭ, na tu tāsau, kiṃ tarhi? saci|`ānāñjatha` iti| `anjū `vyaktibhrakṣaṇādiṣu` [`vyaktimaraṣaṇakāntigatiṣu` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1458)| <> [[7.4.70]] ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ, `tasmānnuṅ? dvihalaḥ` [[7.4.71]] nuṭ, bhavatyayaṃ dhāturupadeśe'kāravān, na tu tāsau nityāniṭ; svaratyādisūtreṇa [[7.2.44]] vikalpiteṭkatvāt||`sasmartha` iti| `smu cintāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-933)| `dadhvartha` iti| `dhvṛ hūrchane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-939)| nanu yadyapyakārāntānāṃ madye vṛṅvṛñāvudāttau tatrāpi vṛṅasthalna sambhavatyeva, ātmanepaditatvāt| vṛñastu `vavartheti nigame` [[7.2.64]] nipātanādbhāṣāyāmiṭā bhavitavyameva, tasmāt? tayoriṭpratiṣedhārthametannopapadyate; ye tvanye ṛkārāntāḥ, teṣāmanudattatvāt? tāsau nityamaniṭtvāmiti `acastāsvat? thalyaniṭo nityam` [[7.2.61]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddha eva, paratvādguṇe kṛte raparatye cānajantatvānna sidhyatītyevametannāśaṅkanīyam; upadeśagrahaṇasya purastādanukṛṣṭasya `acaḥ` ityanenābhisambhandhāt; atha vā - `acaḥ` iti vihitaviśeṣaṇā pañcamī, tatraivaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ - ajantādyo vahitasthaliti, tasmādacastāsvadityanenaiva ṛkārantebhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkimartho'pyamārambhaḥ? ityāha - `siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ` iti| `nānyebhyaḥ` iti| ke punaste? ya ṛkārāntādanye'jantāḥ, anajantāścopadeśe'tvantaḥ| athaivaṃ kasmānniyamo na vijñāyate - ṛto bhāradvājyaiva, nānyeṣāmācāryāṇāmiti? evaṃ manyate - pūrvasūtrādayo'tvata iti canuvartate, tadanuvṛtteretadeva prayojanam - anena niyamena sannidhānāt? tasyaivājantasyānuvṛttasyātvataśca prakṛtasya dhātoḥ| tathā ca tadanuvṛttirapārthikā syāt| tasmāvṛta eva bhāradvājasyetyayameva niyamo vijñāyata ityāha - `tat` ityādi| taditi hetau| yasmādevaṃvidho'tra niyamaḥ - tasmādṛta eva bhāradvājasya pratiṣedho bhavati, nānyebhyo dhātubhya ti| tena yadyapi pūrvayogābhyāṃ nityamiṭpratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ, tathāṃ ca sāmarththāt? pūrvayogayorayaṃ vikalpo bhavati| yadyapi tatra vāgrahaṇam, ācaryagrahaṇaṃ ca kriyate, tathāpyarthāllabhyate| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, na `urbhāradvājasya` ityevocyeta? ityāha - `taparakaraṇam` ityādi| yadi hrurityevocyeta, tato'ṇ? savarṇān? gṛhṇātīti ṛkārāntānāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| tatastannivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇam| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadyukārāntānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt? ityata āha - `tathā hi` ityādi| tathetyevamarthe| hiśabdo yasmādarye| evaṃ yasmāt? taparakaraṇamantareṇāpi ṛkārānātānāṃ grahaṇe sati vidhyarthametat? sambhāvyeta| asati hi vidheye niyamo bhavati| ṛkārāntānāṃ grahaṇe sati teṣāmeva pratiṣedho vidheyaḥ syāt, na hi teṣāṃ pūrveṇa pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ| sarveṣāmṛkārāntānāṃ tāsau nityam; seṭtvāt?| taparakaraṇe tu sati takāreṇa dīrghanivṛttau kṛtāyāṃ vidheyatābhāvānniyamo'yaṃ sampadyate||babhūthetyādau sarvatra krādiniyamādiṭaḥ prāptasyābhāvo nipātyate| `babhūtha` iti| `bhavateraḥ` [[7.4.73]] ityabhyāsasyākārasyātvam| `babhūvitha` iti| <> [[6.4.88]] iti vuk| `ātatantha` iti| `tanu vistāre` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1463), āṅpūrvaḥ| `atenitha` iti| <> [[6.4.121]] ityettvābhyāsalopau| `jagṛbhma` iti| `bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ` (6|488) iti vuk| `ātatantha` iti| `tanu vistāre` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1463), āṅpūrvaḥ| `atenitha` iti| <> [[6.4.121]] ityettvābhyāsalopau| `jagṛbhma` iti| graherliṭ, `parasmaipadānām` [[3.4.82]] ityādinā maso mādeśaḥ, `grahijyā` [[6.1.16]] iti sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam| `vavapartha` iti| `vṛñ? vadaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1254)||`suja visarge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1414), `dṛśir? prekṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-988) - anayoḥ krādiniyamādiṭi nityaṃ prāpte vikalpārtha vacanam| `saruāṣṭha, dadraṣṭha` iti| vraścādinā [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, <> [[6.1.58]] itvam||`āditha, āritha` iti| `ada bhakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1011), `ṛ gato` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1098)| <> [[7.4.70]] ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ| `viṣyayitha` iti| `vyeñ? saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1007), liṭabhyāsatyobhayeṣām` [[6.1.17]] iti samprasāraṇam| kasmāt? punaratra vyeñaḥ `ādeca upadeśe` [[6.1.45]] ityāttvaṃ na bhavati? ityāha - `vyeño na vyo liṭi ityādi| `arterapi nityaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ` iti| <<ṛto bhāradvājasya>> [[7.2.63]] ityanena| `atreṅgraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham` iti| nanu ca nityamiḍāgamo yathā syādityevamarthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ syāt, na hīṅgrahaṇamantareṇāyaṃ śakyata iṅvidhirnityo vijñātam? ityāha - `vikalpavadhāne hi` ityādi| anena hi vikalpasyānantarasya vā vidhānaṃ kriyate, pūrvaparakṛtasya vā nityapratiṣedhasya? śakyate hrasāvapi maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvartayutam| tatra yadi pūrvako vikalpastadā'rttivyayatigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; <<upadeśe'tvataḥ>> [[7.2.62]] ityanenaiva vikalpasya siddhatvāt| athetaraḥ, evaṃ satyarttigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; `ṛto bhāradvājasyaiva` [[7.2.63]] ityanenaiva pratiṣedhasya siddhatvāt| yata evaṃ na vikalpasya vidhānamupapadyate tena nāpi pratiṣedhasya| asmādantareṇāpīṅgrahaṇaṃ nityo'yamiṅvidhiriti śakyate vijñātum| pratipattigauravaṃ punarevaṃ vijñāyamāne syāditi vispaṣṭārthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyate||`kṛtadvirvacanānāṃ dhātūnāmekācām` iti| kuta etadavasitam? ekājgrahaṇasāmarthyāt| na hi kaścidakṛte dvirvacane'nekājasti, yannivṛttyarthamekāngrahaṇaṃ kriyate| nanu ca jāgarttirasti, atastannivṛttyartha tat? syāt? naitadasti; na hrekamūdāharaṇaṃ prati yogārambhaṃ prayojayati| yadyetat? prayojanaṃ syāt, `jāgro na` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| tadāpyayamarthaḥ - pratipattigauravaṃ parihmataṃ bhavati| nanu corṇoternivṛttyarthamapi syāt? naitat; uktaṃ hi prāk - `vācyauurṇorṇuvadbhāvaḥ` (kārikā|7.2.11) iti| tasmādyuktamuktam - kṛtadvirvacanānāṃ dhātūnāmekācāmiti| `ādivānāśivān` iti| `ada bhakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1011), `aśa bhojane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1523)| liṭaḥ <> [[3.2.107]] iti kvasuḥ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakārthañca, `ata ādeḥ [[7.4.70]] iti dīrghatvam| savarṇadīrghatvam, iṭ, `ugidacam` [[7.2.70]] iti num, `sāntamahataḥ` [[6.4.10]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ, halṅyādi- [[6.1.66]] saṃyogāntalopau [[8.2.23]] | `pecivan, śokivān` iti| `ata ekahalmadhye` [[6.4.120]] ityādinaittvābhyāsalopau| `dhātvabhyāsayorekādeśe kṛte` ityādi| nanu ca ṣāṣṭhike dvirṣacanavidhau `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam` ityeva pakṣo vṛttikāreṇāśritaḥ, evaṃ cākṛte dātvabhyāsayorekadeśe'kṛtayorapi caitvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtadvirvacanā apyeta ekāco bhavanti| sthāne dvirvacane hi śabdāntaramanekājatidiśyata iti syādeṣāṃ kṛtadvirvacanānāmanekāctvam, na tu dviṣprayoge dvirvacane; tatra hi sa eva dhāturdvirucyate, na cāsau śatakṛtvo'pyuccāryamāṇa ekāctvaṃ jahāti, kiṃpunarddhirucyamānaḥ, tat? krimucyate - dhātvabhyāsayorekādeśa etvābhyāsalopayośca kṛtayoḥ kṛtadvirvacanā eta ekāco bhavantīti? āvṛttikṛtamekāco bedamāśrityaivamuktamityadoṣaḥ| bhavati hi dharmabhedādapi dharmiṇo bhedavyavahāraḥ? tathā hi, vaktāro vadanti - parudbhāvān? paṭurāsīt, paṭutaraścaiṣamaḥ, paṭutamaḥ parāri, so'nya evāsi saṃvṛtta iti| atha vā - sthāne dvirvacanapakṣo'pi tatrāśritaḥ, dviṣprayogaśca dvirvacanamiti kṛtvā| cakārāt? sthāne dvirvacanamapīti sthāne dvirvacanapakṣasyāpi tatra sūcanāt| ye tu tatpakṣabhāvino doṣaste tatra prativihitā eva| `tasthivān` iti| `śarpūrvāḥ khathaḥ` [[7.4.61]] iti khyaḥ śeṣaḥ; `ato lopa iṭi ca` [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ| `jakṣivān` iti| pūrvavadaderghaslādeśaḥ, iṭ? `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityādinopadhālopaḥ, <> [[7.4.62]] iti cutvam - dhakārasya jhakāraḥ, <> [[8.4.54]] iti jhakārasya jakāraḥ| parasya dhakārasya `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - kakāraḥ, `śāsivasi` [[8.3.60]] ityādinā ṣatvam| nanu cātra krādiniyamādiḍāgamaḥ siddha eva, tat kimartho'yamārambhaḥ? ityāha - `siddhe` ityādi| `krādiniyamāt? prasaktaḥ` ityādinā `siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ` (kāta|pa|59) ityetadeva spaṣṭīkaroti| `prasaktaḥ` iti| prāpta ityarthaḥ| `niyamyate` iti| dhātvantarebhyo vyāvarttyekājādiṣveva vyavasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| athādgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'kārāntā apyato lope kṛte kṛtadvirvacanā ekāco bhavantyeva, tatraikājgrahaṇenaiva siddham? ityāha - `ādgrahaṇamanekājgrahaṇārtham` iti| kathaṃ punasteṣāmanekāctvam? ityata āha - `dvirvacane` ityādi| iṇnimittatvādākāralopasyeṭi sati teṣāmākāralopena bhavitavyam, nāsati, ato yāvadiṇna kriyate tāvadākāralopābhāvāt? kṛtadvirvacanā ete'nekāca ityasatyādgrahaṇe [`ityasatyādigrahaṇe` - iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt| tasmādanekājarthamādgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| yadyevam, daridrāterapīṭ? prasajyeta? ityata āha - `daridrātestu` ityādi| daridrāteḥ kvaso sambhava eva nāsti, yataḥ `kāsyanekāngrahaṇam` (vā|305) iti vacanāddaridrāterāmā bhavitavyam, tasmaśca sati `āmaḥ` [[2.4.81]] iti lerlukā bhavitavyam? tatkuto'yamiṭprasaṅgaḥ! `daridrāñcakara` iti| `kṛñcānuprayujyate` [[3.1.40]] iti liṭparasya kṛño'nuprayogaḥ| abhyupagamyapi daridrāterāmo'bhāvaṃ parīhārāntaramāha - `athāpyāmna kriyate` ityādi| ākārāntānāṃ dhātūnāmiheṅvidhīyate| daradrāterārdhadhātuke `lopaḥ siddhaśca pratyayavidhau` iti vacanāt? prāgeva pratyayotpatterākāro lupta itīḍāgamo'smānnimittābhāvānna bhavati| kriyatāṃ nāmādgrahaṇam, ghasigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti, asya dvirvacane kṛte `ghasibhasohaṃli ca` [[6.4.100]] ityupadhālope kṛte caikāca ityevaṃ siddha iḍāgamaḥ? ityāha - `ghaserapi` ityādi| `anackatvāt` iti| dvirvacanābhāvahetuḥ| ekāco dvirvacanamucyate; `ekācaḥ` [[6.1.1]] ityadhikārāt| tasmādupadhālope kṛte'nackatvānna dvirvacanaṃ syāt, tataśca jakṣivāniti na sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| atha kriyamāṇe'pi ghasigrahaṇe kasmādeva doṣo va bhavati? ityāha - `kriyamāṇe` [`nāsti kāśikāyām| padamañjaryāṃ tu `kriyamāṇe tu` iti pratīkamupalabhyate] ityādi| subodham||pūrvasmānniyamādgamādīnāmiṅ? na bhavatīti vibhāṣeyamārabhyate| `jagmivān` iti| paratvādiṭ? tataḥ `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityādinopadhālopaḥ, tato dvirvacanam| `jaghanvāniti, jadhnivāna` iti| <> [[7.3.55]] iti kutvam - hakārasya ghakāraḥ| `lābhārthasya` iti| `vidlṛ lābhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1432) ityasya| `na jñānārthasya` iti| `vida jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1064) ityasya| `vida sattāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1171), `vida vicāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1450) - ityetayoścātmanepaditvādātmanepadeṣu kvasurna bhavatītyanupanyāsaḥ| `dṛśeśca` ityādi| `vṛśir? prekṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-988) ityasmācca pare kvasoriḍāgamo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - `vibhāṣā` iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena dṛśerapi bhaviṣyatīti| na caivaṃ sati `gamahanavidaviśām` ityasyānarthakyam; pūrvayogasyāsarvavaṣayatvasūcanāt| evaṃ hratiprasaṅgaḥ parihmato bhavati||`sanoteḥ` iti| `ṣaṇu dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1464) ityasya saniṃpūrvasya dvitīyāntasyoccāraṇena niyatā mānupūrvīmupalakṣayati| yatraiṣānupūrvī niyatā tatraiva yathā syāt| iyaṃ cānupūrvīṃ chandasyaiva niyateti tadviṣayamevaitannipānaṃ vijñāyate| ata eva vṛttikṛtā chāndasaḥ prayogo darśitaḥ| `senivāṃsam` iti| pūrvavadettvābhyāmyāsalopau| `vasvekā jāddhasām` [[7.2.67]] itīṭ||vibhāṣeti nivṛttam| ṛkārāntānāṃ hanteścānudāttatvāt? `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] ityādinā pratiṣiddhasyedaḥ sye vidhānārthametat| atha svarateḥ svaratyādisūtreṇa [[7.2.44]] pakṣa iṭ? athānena nityamityāha - `svarateḥ` sye vidhānārthametat| atha svarateḥ svaratyādisūtreṇa [[7.2.44]] pakṣa iṭ, athānena nityāmityāha - `svarateḥ` ityādi| svaraterdhātoryat? svaratyādi [[7.2.44]] sūtreṇa veṭtvaṃ vihitaṃ tasmādanena sye ṛkārāntebhyo vidhīyamānaṃ nityeṭtvaṃ bhavati vipratiṣadhena| añcārthaḥ svaratyādisūtra ukte'pi vismaraṇaśīlānāmanugrahāya punarihocyate| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham? dīrghāṇāṃ mā bhūditi cet? naitadasti; udāttatvāddhi teṣāṃ bhavitavyameveṭā| evaṃ tahrrasati taparakaraṇe yathā <> [[7.2.74]] ityatra svaratyādisāhacaryāt? `ṛḥ` ityetasya dhātogrrahaṇam, tathehāpi hantinā sāhacāryāt? `ṛ` ityetasya dhātogrrahaṇaṃ syāt| taparatve tu sati varṇagrahaṇametadvijñāyate| varṇanirdeśe hi taparatvaṃ prasiddham| varṇagrahaṇe ca varṇagrahaṇāni sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayantīti ṛkārāntānāmiṭa siddho bhavati||`anjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu` [`vyaktimarṣaṇakāntigatiṣu - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1458)| ūdittvādatra svaratyādisūtreṇa [[7.2.44]] vikalpe prāpte nityārtha vacanam| `āñjīt` iti| `itaśca` itīkāralopaḥ, <<astisico'pṛkte>> [[7.3.96]] itīṭ? `iṭa īṭi` [[8.2.28]] iti sico lopaḥ, <<āḍajādīnām>> [[6.4.72]] ityāṭ? `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `āñjiṣṭām` iti| `tasthasthamipām` iti jherjus||`ṣṭuñ? stutau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1043), `ṣuñ? abhiṣave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1247) - anayoranudāttatvāt? pratiṣedhe prāpte, dhūñastu svaratyādisutreṇa [[7.2.44]] vikalpe prāpte satīdamārabhyate||`yama uparame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-984), `ramu krīḍāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-853), `ṇama prahvatve śabde ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-981)| ākārāntāḥ `yā prāpaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1049) ityevamādayaḥ| sarveṣāmanudattatvādiṭpratiṣedhe prāpte'yamārambhaḥ| atra ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśādyamādīnāṃ sagbhavati, iṭ? punarārdhadhātukādhikārāt? sica eva| `vyaraṃsīt` iti| <> [[1.3.83]] iti parasmaipadam| dvivacanabahuvacanayoryuktamudāharaṇam; asti hi tatra sagiṭoḥ śrutau viśeṣaḥ; ekavacanasya tvayuktam, viśeṣābhāvāt - iti yo veśayet, taṃ prati tatrāpi vṛddhipratiṣedho viśeṣo'stīti darśayitumāha - `yamādīnām` ityādi| `āyaṃsta` [`ayaṃsta` - kāśikā, padamañjayamipi - `āyaṃsta` ityeva pratīkīddhāraḥ] iti| <<āṅo yamahanaḥ>> [[1.3.28]] ityātmanepadam| `araṃsta` iti| atrāpi `anudātta` [[1.3.12]] ityādinā||`ṇmiṅ? īṣaddhasane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-948), `pūṅ pavane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-966)| anubandhoccāraṇaṃpūñnivṛttyartham| `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ` (dā|pā|936) iti bhvādiḥ, `ṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1098) iti juhotyādiḥ - ubhayorapi grahaṇam; viśeṣānupādanāt| ṛkārāntānāṃ tvetadgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; uttaratra kiratyādīnāmiṭo vidhānāt| `anjū mrakṣaṇe` [`vyaktimarṣaṇakāntigatiṣu - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1458), `aśū vyāptau`[`vyāptau saṃdhe ca` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1264)| `aśa bhojane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1523) ityasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; udāttatvādeveṭ? siddha iti| tatrāñjeraśeścodittvādvikalpe prāpte, śeṣāṇāṃ tūgantatvāt? `sanigrahaguhośca` [[7.2.12]] iti pratiṣedhe prāpta idamārabhyate| `sismiyiṣate` iti| `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityātmanepadam| `pipaviṣate` iti| <> [[7.4.80]] ityābhyāsasyettvam| `aririṣati` iti| iṭi sati guṇe kṛte'jāderdvitīyasyaikāco dvirvacanam| `añjijiṣatīti `aśiśiṣati` [`aśiśiṣate` - kāśikā| nāsti - mudritagranthe] iti| añjernakāro na dvirucyate; <> [[6.1.3]] iti niṣedhāt||`rudir? aśruvimocane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1067), `ñi ṣvap? śaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1068), `āsa prāṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1069), `ana ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1070), `jakṣa adane`[`bhakṣahasanayoḥ - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1071)| rudādayo'dādiṣu paṭhante| `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān` (śāka|pa|97) iti `rudādibhyaḥ` ityeṣā pañcamī `sārvadhātuke` ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayati| saptamīnirdeśastadūttarārthaḥ| tena sārvadhātukasya valāderiṅ? vijñāyata ityata āha - `rudādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ` ityādi| `prāṇiti` iti| `aniteḥ` [[8.4.19]] iti ṇatvam| `svaptā` iti| sārvadhātukagrahaṇādārdhadhātukasyeṇna bhavati| sāmānyalakṣaṇa iṇna bhavatyeva; `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] iti pratiṣedhāt| anyebhyastu rudādibhya udāttatvādārthadhātukasyāpīṭā bhavitavyameveti svapereva pratyudāharaṇam||`se` iti| `supāṃ suluk` [[7.1.39]] iti ṣaṣṭhaā lakaṃ kṛtvā'vibhaktiko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ| `īśiṣe` iti| `īśa aiārye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1020), laṭ?
