anudāttetvādātmanepadam, `thāsaḥ seṭa [[3.4.80]] , adāditvācchapo luk| `īśiṣva` iti| loṭ, se, `savabhyāṃ vāmau` [[3.4.91]] iti vādeśe kṛte `ekadeśavikṛtamananya vadbhavati` (vyā|pa|16) itīhāpi bhavati||`dhve` iti| pūrvavadevāvibhaktiko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ| `īḍidhve` iti| `īḍa stutau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1019), pūrvavadātmanepadam, pūrvavacchapo luk| `īḍidhvam` iti| loṭ, <> [[3.4.91]] ityamādeśaḥ| `janiṣvam` iti| pūrvadātamanepadam| chāndasatvācchyanī lṛk? <> [[7.4.78]] ityanena| `upadhālopābhāvaśca` iti| `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityādinopadhālopaḥ prāpnoti, tadabhāvaśchābdasatvādeva, `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante` (pu|pa|vṛ|56) iti| `jana janana ityasya` ityādi| nanu sānubandhakatvādasyaiva[`cānubandhakatvāt` - mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|] grahaṇena bhavitavyam, na pūrvasya, uccāraṇārtho'kāraḥ, nānubandhaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha hi ladhvakṣaratvājjanaśabdasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipāto lakṣaṇavyabhicārāya| tena niranubandhakaparibhāṣāyā (vyā|pa|53) ihānupasthānādubhayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| `vyatijajñidhvam` iti| `kartari karmavyatīhāre` [[1.3.14]] iti ātmanepadam| `tatra` ityādi| tatraivaṃ sūtrapāṭhe `yasmin? vidhistadāvāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) iti sakāragrahaṇe sakārādeḥ seśabdasya grahaṇam| sa ca sakārādiśabdaḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñākaḥ seśabda eva sambhavati; anyasyā'sambhavāt| nanu ca svaśabdo'pi sambhavati? naitadevam; ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt? (vyā|pa|16) so'pi seśabda eva, atastadgrahaṇenāpi bhavitavyam| `ye tu `īḍajanodhrye ca` iti| sūtraṃ paṭhanti, te `īśaḥ sa` [[7.2.77]] ityasyaiva yogasyānukarvaṇārtha cakāraṃ kurvanti| teneśerapi dhveśabda iḍāgamo bhavati| yadi tarhīśerapi dhva iḍāgama iṣyate, tadā `īśīḍajanāṃ sedhvayoḥ` ityekameva sūtraṃ kasmānna paṭhanti, evaṃ pṛthagvibhaktirnoccārayitavyā, cakāraśca na kartavyo bhavati? ityāha - `vicitrā sūtrasya` ityādi| `dhva iti kṛtaṭerettvasya` ityādi| kṛtaṭerettvasyaitadeva prayojanam - yatra ṭerettvaṃ kṛtaṃ tatraiva yathā syāt| na ca laṅi ṭeretttavamasiti, atastatreṭā na bhavitavyam| yadyevam, loṭapi na bhavitavyam, amādeśe kṛte ṭerettvasyābhāvāt? ityāha - `loṭi punaḥ` ityādi||`sārvadhātuke yo liṅ` iti| `sārvadhātuke` [[7.2.76]] ityeṣātra nirdhāraṇe saptamī, jātāvekavacanam, yathā `kārake` [[1.4.23]] iti| atha vā - subvyatyayena bahuvacanasya parasaṅga ekavacanam| parasaptamītyeṣā na na bhavati - sārvadhātuke parataḥ; pūrvasya liṅo'sambhavāt| `kuryāt` iti| vidhyādisūtrema [[3.3.161]] liṅ, yāsuṭ, `itaśca` [[3.4.100]] itīkāralopaḥ, dhātorguṇaḥ, raparatve `ata ut? sārvadhātuke` [[6.4.110]] [[3.4.108]] , <> [[6.1.96]] iti pararūpatvam| `kurvīta` iti| ukārasya yaṇādeśaḥ| `kurvīran` iti| <> [[3.4.105]] | `kuryuḥ` kuryāḥ` iti| atrānantyagrahaṇājjusaḥ sipaśca na bhavati|`kriyāstām, kriyāsuḥ` iti| āśiṣi liṅ? [[3.3.173]] , `riṅśayagliṅkṣu` [[7.4.28]] iti riṅādeśaḥ| sārvadhātukagrahaṇādārdhadhātuke na bhavati| ārdhadhātukatvaṃ ca <> [[3.4.116]] ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñāvidhānāt| `kṛṣīṣṭa, hmaṣīṣṭa` iti| `uśca` [[1.2.12]] iti kittvam, guṇābhāvaḥ||sārvadhātukaṃ yat? prakṛtaṃ tadarthādiha vibhaktivipariṇāmena ṣaṣṭhantaṃ pratipadyate| ata evāha - `akārāntādaṅgāduttarasya sārvadhātukasya` iti| `paceta` [`paṭhet` - iti prācīnamudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| iyādeśe kṛte'kāreṇa saha <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] , <> [[6.1.66]] iti yakāralopaḥ| `cinuyāt` iti| <> [[3.1.73]] `yāyāt` iti| adāditvācchapo luk| `cikīṣryāt` iti| sanantādāśiṣi liṅ| `nanu cāto lopenātra bhavitavyam` iti| nārtho'nuvṛttena sārvadātukagrahaṇenetyabhiprāyaḥ| `pacedityatrāpi` ityādi| yadyapi paceditodamasyodāharaṇamabhimatam, tatrāpi <> [[7.3.101]] iti dīrghatvena bhavitavyamiti, tataśca sarvaviṣayasya vidhyantareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvādanavakāśo'yamiyādeśaḥ| tasmādavaśyamanena vidhyantaraṃ bādhitavyam| evañca yathā dīrghasyāyaṃ bādhakaḥ, tathā'to lopasyāpi syāt| tasmāt? sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvartayitanyamiti bhāvaḥ| `syādetadevam` ityādi| yadi ca dīrghatvaṃ `turustunnamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke` [[7.3.95]] ityataḥ sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvattyaṃ vidhīyate, tataśca syādetadevaṃ yaduktavānasi; iyādeśasyānavakāśatvāt| atha <> [[7.3.88]] iti tiṅgrahaṇamanuvarttya vidhīyate, tadā tiṅmātramabhāvi dīrghatvamiti liṅ? vidhīyamāna ityādeśe nāprāpte tasminnayamārabhyate, tataśca `yena nāprāpti` (vyā|pa|49) nyāyena tasyaiva bādhako bhavati, na tvato lopasya| iyo'to lope prāpte cāprāpte'yamārabhyate| ārdhadhātuke hi prāpte sārvadhātuke tvaprāpte|atha yeya iti ko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ, atra hi `yā` ityeṣa yaḥ sthānī tatra ṣaṣṭhaāṃ kṛtāyāmato yā as? iya iti sthite `āto lopaḥ` [[6.4.48]] iti `ātaḥ `dhātoḥ` [[6.4.140]] iti yogavibhāgādvā ākāralope kṛte `sasajuṣoḥ` [[8.2.66]] iti ṣaṣṭhīsakārasya rutve kṛte tsaya `bhobhayoaghoapūrvasya yo'śi` [[8.3.17]] iti yakāraḥ| tasyāpi `lopaḥ śākasyasya` [[8.3.19]] iti lope ca `ya iyaḥ` iti nirddeśena bhavitavyamiti, na tu yata iti| na hyatrādguṇo bhavitumutsahate; <> [[8.2.1]] iti yalopasyāsiddhatvāt? ityata āha - `yeya ityavibhaktiko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ` iti| yeya ityasmin? sthānyādeśasamudayena `yā` iti| yo'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ so'vibhaktikaḥ; `supāṃ suluk` [[7.1.39]] iti vibhakterluptatvāt| aṅgīkṛtya ca savibhaktikatvaṃ nirdeśasya parīhārāntaramāha - `yaḥ` iti| `vā` ityādi| kathaṃ puna lopasyāsiddhatvaṃ śakyamanāśrayitum? ityatrāha - `sautro'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ` iti| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt? `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante` (pu|pa|vu|56) iti `chandovat? sūtrāṇi bhavanti` (ma|bhā) iti, tasmāt, sautratvādasya nirddeśasyāsiddhatvamanāśritya <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] kṛtaḥ| ityādeśe'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ||`ātaḥ`, `ṅitaḥ` iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| āta iyādeśāpekṣayā sthāne ṣaṣṭhīti| ṅita iti ākārāpekṣayāvayavaṣaṣṭhī` ṅito hrakāramātrasyāsambhavāt| ṅita ityeṣo'vacavayoge ṣaṣṭho vijñāyate - ṅidavayasyeti ṅakāra idyasya sa ṅit, tasyāvayavo ṅidavayavaḥ| `pacete` pacethe` iti| laṭ, svaritettvādātmanepadam, ātāmathām, `sārvadhātukamapit` (1|2| 4) iti ṅittvam| `pacotām, pacethām` iti| loṭ, ṭerettve [[3.4.79]] kṛte `āmetaḥ` [[3.4.90]] ityām| nanu ca ṅidavayavo'trākāro na bhavati, yasmādgāṅakuṭādisūtre [[1.2.1]] ṅitīva ṅidvadityevamarvo'ṅgaukriyate, tathā <> [[1.2.4]] ityatrāpyayamarthaḥ, tathā hrasminnapi yoge tadeva ṅidgrahaṇamanuvartate, tasmaścārthe'ṅgīkriyamāṇe ṅiti yatkāryaṃ tadapi hi sārvadhātuke parataḥ pūrvasya lakṣyate, na tu tasyaivāpitsārvadhātukasyaṅitvam? ityāha - `sārvadhātukamapidityatra` ityādi| `pūrvasūtra eva` iti| gāṅkuṭādisūtre [[1.2.1]] yadyevamaṅgīkriyate - gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ paro yo'ñṇitpratyayo'sau ṅidavadbhavatīti, tadā kuṭādibhyaḥ parasya sano ṅittvaṃ bhavati, ṅittve sati `anudāttaṅitaḥ` [[1.3.12]] ityādinā''tmanedapaṃ syāt, tataścoccukuṭipatīti na sidhyet| tasmādetatsidhyarthaṃ ṅitīya ṅidvadityaṅgīkriyate| `sārvadhātukamapit? [[1.2.4]] ityatra tu tat? sārvadhātukaṃ ṅidbhavatītyeṣo'rtho'ṅgīkriyate| tasmādyuktamevākārasya ṅidavayavatvam| `pacante, yajante` iti| `bhavatyatra [`bhavatyaṅidavayavo` - mudritapāṭhaḥ] ṅidavayavo'ktādeśasyākāraḥ, tathāpyāta iti vacanātra bhavati| `pacāvahai, pacāmahai` iti| loṭ? vahimahiṅau| āḍuttamasya picca` [[3.4.92]] ityāṭ, uttamaśca pidbhavatīti| atra pittvānṅittvaṃ na bhavatīti āto ṅidadayavākāro na bhavati| `mimāte, mimāthe` iti| `māṅa māne` [`māne śabde ca` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1088), juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ| `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam, `bhṛñāyit` [[7.4.76]] ityabhyāsasyettvam, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ||`aṅgasyātaḥ` iti| vyādhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhao - āṅgasya yo't? tasaya mugagamo bhavatīti| tadihādgrahaṇaṃ tarhi kriyatām? na kartavyam; <> [[7.2.80]] ityato'ta ityanuvarttiṣyate| nanu ca pañcamīnirdiṣṭaṃ tatra, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ? naitadasti; ata ityeṣā tu pañcamī tatreyādeśe caritārthā, `āne` ityeṣā tu saptamyakṛtārthā| tasmādāna ityeṣā saptamyata ityasyāḥ pañcamī tatrepādeśe caratārthā, `āne ityeṣā tu saptamyakṛtārthā| tasmādāna ityeṣā saptamyata ityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ parikalpabayiṣyati, <> [[1.1.66]] iti niyamāt| nanu cākārovarṇo makāro'pi varṇa eva, mugayaṃ tvantaliṅgaḥ, antaścāvayavaḥ, na ca varṇo `varṇasyāvayavo [`varṇasyāvayavī - mudrita pāṭhaḥ] yujyate, tenānārabdhatvāt, tasmādayuktamuktam - ato mugāgamo bhavatati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sarvatraiva hi yasyāgamo vidhīyate, yaścāgamo vidhīyate tatsamudāyāpekṣayā''ditvamantatvaṃ vā vidhīyate| tasmādatto mugāgamo bhavatītyasyārtho'yaṃ vivakṣitaḥ - akārādirayaṃ samudāyo sakārāntaśca bhavatīti| `pacamānaḥ` iti| laṭ, tasya śānac| āne parato'hgasyāto mugāgamo bhavatītyukte samānādhikaraṇe ete ṣaṣṭhaāviti manyamāno'kārāntasya āne parato mugagagamo bhavatītīdaṃ sūtrārtha gṛhītvā ya evaṃ deśayet - yadyakārāntamaṅgamāgami, pacamāna ityatra `adupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudāttam` [[6.1.180]] ityanudāttatvaṃ na syāt; akārasya mukā vyavahitatvāt| akāro ya upadeśa ityevaṃ hi tatara vyavasthitam, na tvakārānto'yamupadeśa iti| na ca śakyate vaktum - aṅgabhakto'yaṃ nuk, ato nāsti vyavadānamiti; aṅgabhakto hrayamaṅgameva na vyavadadhyāt, akāraṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva| avayavo hi samudāyasya vyavadhāyako na bhavati| avayavāntarasya tu vyavadhāyako bhavatyevetyata āha - `akāramātrabhakto hrayam` ityādi| mātraśabdo'yamaṅgabhaktatvavyavacchedāya| aṅgañcātrākāraviśeṣaṇam| akāra evāgamī, nāṅgam| tasmāt? tadabhaktatvāt? tadagrahaṇenaiva mug? gṛhayata iti vyavadhānābhāvāllasārvadhātukamanudattaṃ bhavati| nanu cākārāntabhakte'pi muki bhavitavyameva <> [[6.1.186]] ityanudāttatvena, `svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavat` (vyā|pa|37) iti muko'vidyamānavattvādvyavadhānābhāvāt? evaṃ manyate - naiṣā paribhāṣā bhāṣyakārasya sammatā| tathā hi - tenemāṃ paribāṣāṃ pratyākhyāyeyamanyā paribhāṣā gṛhītā - `halaḥsvaraprāptau [`halsvaraprāptau - nī|pa|vṛ] vyañjanamavidyamānavat` (nī|pā|vṛ|68), iti| na cātra halaḥ svaraprāpatirasti, kiṃ tarhi? acaḥ| `yadyevam` ityādi| yadyakārabhakto'ya mukaṃ tadgrahahaṇena gṛhra ityevaṃ styavyavadhāyakatvādeva tasya pacamāna ityatrākārādanantarasyāna iti, tasya <<āto ṅitaḥ>> [[7.2.81]] itīyadeśaḥ prāpnotītyata āta - `taparakaraṇanirdeśānna bhavati` iti| akāro hyatra mātrākālastaparo niradiṣṭo muki satayardhamātro bhavati| ataḥ kālabhedānna bhaviṣyati| adhikamadrdha yasyāḥ sā'dhyadrdhā, adhyadrdhā mātrā yasyā so'dyadrdhamātraḥ| lasārvadhātukamanudāttamapi tarhi na prāpnotīti tadvidhāvapi taparanirdeśāt| `upadeśagrahaṇam` ityādi| upadeśagrahaṇa tatra kriyate prāgavasthopalaśraṇārtham| tena upadeśāvasthāyāṃ mātrākālastasya yadyapyuttarakālaṃ muki kṛte kālabhedo'sti, tathāpayupadeśāvasthāyāṃ mātrākālatvādbhavatyevātrānudāttatvam| `tathā ca` ityādi| yatastatropadeśādūdhrvaṃ satyapi kālabhede'nudāttatvena bhavitavyam, evañca kṛtvā yatrāpi <> [[7.3.101]] iti da#īrghatve kṛte kālabhedo'sti - pacāva ityādau, tatrāpi bhavati||`āsaḥ` iti pañcamyakṛtārthā `āne` [[7.2.82]] iti pūrvatra kṛtārthāyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; <> [[1.1.67]] iti vacanāt| tenānasyaivāyamādeśo vidhīyate, ityāha - `āsa uttarasyānaśabdasya` iti| `āsīnaḥ` iti| `āsa upaveśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1021)| anudāttettvādātmanepadam; <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] ityākārasyekāraḥ| adāditvācchayo luk| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham||`ā iti vyaktinirdeśo'yam` iti| śuddhāyā niranunāsikāyā ākārasya vyaktereva nirdeśa ityarthaḥ| athākṛtinirdeśe ko doṣaḥ syāt, yatastatparīhārārtho vyaktinirdeśo'yamāśritaḥ? ityata āha - `ākṛtinirdeśe hi` ityādi| jātirihākṛtirvivakṣitā, na tu saṃsthānam| jātinirdeśe sati śuddhāyā jāternirdeṣṭumaśakyatvāt? tadādhārabhūtāsu vyaktiṣu kāryaṃ vijñāyate| tatra yadīha jātinirdeśa āśrīyeta, tadā sarvāsvakāravyaktiṣu jātyāvāratvamupagatāsu <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti nakārasya vidhopamāna ākāra āntaratamyādanunāsikasya sthāne'nunāsika eva syāt| vyaktinirdeśe tveṣa doṣo na bhavati; ityādi na sidhyati, na hyatra vikalpābhidhāyi vacanamasti, napi prakṛtam? ityata āha - `vikalpena` ityādi| <> [[6.1.172]] ityanenāṣṭanī dīrghādasarvanāmasthānāvibhakterudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| yadi ca nityamāttvaṃ syāt, dīrghāditi viśeṣaṇaṃ nirarthakaṃ syāt| aṣṭābhya auś` [[7.1.21]] ityatra ca kṛtāttvasya nirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt| vyavacchedyābhāvadaṣṭana ityevaṃ brāūyāt| tasmāddīrghagrahena kṛtāttvanirdeśena vikalpenedamāttvaṃ bhavatīti jña#āpitam| tenāṣṭabhirityādyapi pakṣe upāttaḥ; ekavacananirdeśāt| anyathā hi bahvarthatvādaṣṭānāmityevaṃ brāūyāt| tasmāt? svarūpadhānoyam| tatrāṅge prakṛte'nena viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhirlabhyate| viśeṣaṇena hi tadantavidhirbhatītyuktam| `priyāṣṭā` [nedamadāharaṇaṃ mūle dṛśyate] iti| `sarvanāmasthāne` [[6.4.8]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ||`yuṣmat, asmat` iti| `pañcamyā at` [[7.1.31]] iti pañcamībhyaso'dādeśaḥ, <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] ityantalope kṛte <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam| yadi ca halītyadhikārādatrāpyāttvaṃ na syāt, tat? kimarthamanādeśagrahaṇam? ityāha - `uttaratra tu` ityādi| uttaratra `yo'ci` [[7.2.89]] iti sūtre'nādeśasya prayojanamiti| yadyevaṃ tatraiva kartavyam, iha kimarthaṃ kriyate? vispaṣṭārthamityabhiprāyaḥ||`tvām, mām` iti| <> [[7.2.97]] iti tvamādeśau| `yuvām, āvām` iti| `yavāvau1 dvivacane` [[7.2.92]] iti yuvāvādeśau| sarvatra `ṅe prathamaporam` [[7.1.28]] ityambhāve vibhakteḥ kṛto'mi pūrvavatvam? [[6.1.103]] ||idamapyādeśārthaṃ vacanam| `yuvayoḥ, āvayoḥ` iti| nanu ca `yo'ci` [[7.2.89]] iti yatvamatra vādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati? prathamādvivacane'pi tarhi śeṣelopo [[7.2.90]] bādhakaḥ syāt| tatra yathā vacanasāmarthyāccheṣelopo'nena bādhyate, tathā yatvamapi bādhyeta| `purastādapavādā anantarān? vidhīn? bādhante nottarān` (vyā|pa|9) iti yatvamapi bādhyeta| tasmāt? `prathamāyāḥ` iti vaktavyam| `tvam? aham` iti| <> [[7.2.94]] tvāhāvādeśau| `au` iti vaktavye prathamāyā dvivacanaṃ vaicitryārtham||`yuṣmadasmodāramādeśa ityatra` ityādi| <> [[7.2.86]] ityatra yadi pūrvasūtrād? [[7.2.85]] halgrahaṇamanuvartate, tadā'viśeṣema vidhīyamānaṃ yatvamutsargo jñāpyate| ātvaṃ tu vibhaktiviśeṣe halādau vidhīyamānamasyāpyapavādaḥ| evaṃ cāpyantareṇāpyajgrahaṇam, yakāro'jādāvevāvatiṣṭhate, tasmadacītyecchakyamakarttum? tat? kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| `svad? gacchati, mad? gacchati` iti| <> [[7.1.32]] iti ṅaseradādeśaḥ||`yānyadvivacanāni` iti| ekavacanabahuvacanānītyarthaḥ| `atra` iti| pañcamyādiṣu vibhaktiṣu| `teṣu lopo vidhīyate` iti| teṣāmeva śeṣatvāt| `tubhyam, mahram` iti| `tubhyamahrau ṅayi` [[7.2.95]] iti tubhyamahrāvādeśau bhavataḥ| `yuṣmabhyam` asmabhyam` iti| <> [[7.1.30]] iti bhyamādeśaḥ| `tava, mama` iti| <> [[7.2.96]] iti tavamamādeśau| `yuṣmākam, asmākam` iti| <> [[7.1.33]] iti| atha śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `lopaḥ` ityevocyeta, evamucyamāne satyaviśeṣeṇa lopaḥ syādityetacca nāśaṅkanīyam, aviśeṣeṇa hi lopo vidhīyamāna utsargo bhaviṣyati, tasyānādeśe vibhaktiviśeṣe yakārākārāpavādau, evañcāntareṇāpi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śeṣa eva lopo'vasthāpyate? ityata āha - `śeṣagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham` iti| `śeṣelope kṛte striyāṃ ṭāp? kasmānna bhavati` iti| antyalope kṛte satyadantatvāt? `ajādyataṣṭāp` [[4.1.4]] iti ṭāpā bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `sannipāta` ityādi| vibhaktyānantarye hi sati yuṣmadasmadī akārānte samupajāte| tatra yadi ṭāpamutpādayeyātām, tadā vibhakterānantarya tābhyāṃ vihataṃ syāt| na ca yo yatsannipātalakṣaṇaḥ sa tadvighātasya nimittaṃ bhavatīti na bhavati ṭāp| yadyevam, tyadādibhyo'pi na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayam? <> [[7.3.45]] iti nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati - bhavati tyadādibhyaṣṭāviti| ayañca strīliṅgatvaṃ yuṣmadasmadorabhyupetya parīhāra uktaḥ| idānīṃ strīliṅgābhāvādeva ṭābna bhavatīti darśayitumāha - `aliṅge` ityādi| `kecittu śeṣelopaṃ ṭilopamicchanti` iti| tvaṃ brāāhraṇī, ahaṃ brāāhṛṇī - ityatra ṭābmā bhūdityevamartham| yuṣmabhyam, asmabhyamityatra bhyamādeśe kṛte `bahuvacane jhalyet` [[7.3.103]] ityettvaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthañca| `katham` iti| evaṃ manyate - yatra vibhaktāvākāro yakāraśca na vihitaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tatra śeṣelopa ucayamānaṣṭilopo na labhyate| <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti paribhāṣayā'ntyasyaiva prāpnotīti vakṣyamāṇādeśāpekṣayā śeṣa ityasyārthaṃ `te ca` ityādinā spaṣṭīkaroti| `maparyantādyo'nyaḥ sa śeṣaḥ` iti| sa punaṣṭireva| atrāyaṃ śeṣolopaṣṭilopo bhavatīti lopaṃ prati śeṣasyādhikaraṇavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī| kimarthaṃ punarlopa ityucyate, yāvatā tyadādyatvenaiva siddham? na sidhyati; atyadāditvāt| tyadāditvaṃ hi dvaparyantāstyadādayaḥ` iti| tatra caitadeva śeṣelopavacanaṃ jñāpakam| tena bhavacchabdasya tyadādyatvaṃ na bhavati - bhavāniti||`yuvakām, āvakām` iti| `avyayasarvanāmnāmakacprākṭeḥ` [[5.3.71]] ityakaca| atra yadi maparyantasyeti nocyate, tato'vadheranupādānāt? sākackasyāpi syādityata āha - `sākackasya sarvasya mā bhūt` iti| asati maparyantagrahaṇe, avadheranupādanādanekālvāccādeśasya sarvasyaiva syāt| kaḥ punaḥ sarvādeśe doṣaḥ syāt? ityata āha - `tathā ca` ityādi| `aniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt` iti| akārasya `yo'ci` [[7.2.89]] iti yakāre kṛte tvyā, myā iti syāt| maparyantagrahaṇe tu sati yuṣmadasmadormaparyantasya sthānitvenādhikṛtatvādasyaiva vakṣyamāṇā ādeśā bhavantīti na kaściddoṣa iti| atha parigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na māntasyetyevocyateta, evamapi hrucayamāne'ntaśabdasya samīpavacanatvāt? tadguṇasaṃvijñānasya bahuvrīherāśrayaṇāt? siddhamiṣṭam? ityata āha - `māntasya` ityādi| etasmin? sākackasyādeśābhāve athavaitasmin? yuvakāmāvakāmityādike śabdarūpe māntasyetyevaṃ siddhaṃ yat? parigrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tadavadhidyotanārtham| yuṣṭadasmadoravayavasaya sthānino'vadhidyotanārtham| tasmānmānte yuṣmacchabde asmacchabde ca vakṣyamāṇaṃ kāryaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham| kadā? ityādi - `yadā ṇyantayoḥ` ityādi| tadācaṣṭa iti yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṇici kṛte `ṇāviṣṭhavat? kāryaṃ prātapadikasya` (vā|813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvāṭṭilopaḥ, tataḥ kvip, tatra <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti ṇico lope kṛte yadā māntatvaṃ vidyate yuṣyadasmadostadā mā bhūditi| asatyapi parigrahaṇe mānsyetyena yuṣmadasmadorityayavāvasthānaṃ labhyate, tataśca yatra mānte yuṣmadasmadī, tatraiva vakṣyamāṇā ādeśā bhaveyuḥ| parigrahaṇe tvavadhidyotanārthe sati niyogato vajryamānena bhavitavyam; na hi tena vanā'vadhiḥ sambhavati| tatra samudāyāvayavasthānīnirddiśyate| yatrācchabdo varjanīyo'sti tatraiva bhaviṣyati, na tu ma#āntayorayuṣmadasmādoreva| nanu ca vibhaktiparayoryuṣmadasmadorādeśā vidhāsyante, na ca māntavasthāyāṃ vibhaktiparatasti; ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvāt, tat? kiṃ māntasya nivattyarthena parigrahaṇena? ityāha - āha - `sthānivattvaṃ ca` ityādi| `kvau lupte na sthānivat` (vā|1.1.59) iti vacanāt? sthānivadbhāvo'tra nāsti| tasmādvidyata eva vibhaktiparatvamityabhiprāyaḥ||`dvivacane` iti| yadīdaṃ pāribhāṣikasya davivacanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, syāt, tadā tasmin? parata eva tāvādeśo bhavetām| tathā ca yadā samāse dvyarthe yuṣmadasmadī bhavataḥ, samāsārthasya tvanyasaṃkhyatvādekavacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vā samāsādbhavati, tadā na syātāmiti; yadā yuṣmadasmadī ekatve vā bahutve vā vartete samāsārthasya dvittve sati samāsāddvavacanaṃ vati, tadā yuvādau syātāmeva, etaccāniṣṭam` iti| dvayorarthayarvacanamuktiḥ=dvivacanam| `dvivacane ye yuṣmadasmadī` iti| `dvivacane` iti| viṣayasapatamīyam| tadeva viṣayasapmītvamasyā vyaktīkartumāha - `dvyarthābhidhānaviṣaye` iti| `dvayorarthayorabhidhānaṃ dvyarthābhidhānam, tadviṣaya ye yuṣmadasmadī te tathokte| `tayoḥ` ityādi| tayoryuṣmadasmadormaparyantāvayavaḥ sthānī, tasya yuvāvau bhavataḥ| `yadā` ityādinārthagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| yadi tarhi samāsādekavacanabahuvacanayorupajātayordvyarthābhidhānadiṣayatvādyuṣmadasmadoryuvāvau bhavataḥ, evaṃ sati <> [[7.2.94]] , `yūyavavau jasi` [[7.2.93]] , `tubhyamahrau ṅapi` [[7.2.95]] , `tadamamau ṅasi` [[7.2.96]] - ityeṣāmapi viṣaye syātām? ityata āha - `yadi tvāhau sau` ityādi| `atiyuvāmatyāvām` iti| `ātyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe` (vā|91) iti prādisamāsaḥ| tatra yo'sau yuṣmadasmadarthañcātikrāntaḥ sa ekasaṃkhyāvacchinno'rtha iti tatra yadyapyekavacanaṃ bhavati, tathāpi dvyarthābhidhānaviṣayatvādyuṣmadasmadoryuvāvau bhavata eva| atra hi `dvitīyāyāñca` [[7.2.87]] ityāttvam| `atiyuvān, atyāvān` iti| `śaso na` [[7.1.29]] iti natvam| `atyāvayā` iti| `yo'ci` [[7.2.89]] iti yatvam| `atiyuvābhiratyāvābhiḥ` iti| <> [[7.2.86]] ityāttvam| `atiyuvabhyamatyāvabhyam` iti| <> [[7.1.30]] | `atiyuvadatyāvat` iti| <> [[7.1.32]] iti ṅaseradādeśaḥ| bahuvacanasya tu `pañcamyā at` [[7.1.31]] ityanena| `atiyudākam, atyāvākam` iti| <> [[7.1.33]] | `atiyuvadatyāvat` iti| <> [[7.1.32]] iti ṅaseradādeśaḥ| bahuvacanasya tu `pañcamyā ut` [[7.1.31]] ityanena| `atiyuvākam, atyāvākam` iti| <> [[7.1.33]] `atiyuvayi, atyādayi` iti| pūrvavadyatvam| `atiyuvāsu atyāvāsu` iti| pūrvavadāttvam| `tvāhādīnāṃ viṣaye` ityādinā yaduktaṃ - `yadi tvahau [[7.2.94]] ityādinā''deśāntareṇa na bādhyete` iti, taddhispaṣṭīkaroti - `yadā tu` ityādinā| arthagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭamupapadyate taddarśayati - `atitvāmatamām` iti| atra yo yuṣmadasmadarthāvatikrāntau tau dvisaṃkhyau samāsārthāviti samāsādyadyami dvivacanaṃ bhavati, tathāpi yuṣmadasmadordvyarthatā nāstīti yuvāvau na bhavataḥ| tvamāveva bhaktaḥ| <> [[7.2.88]] ityāttvam| atha vā - dvitīyādvivacanametat, tataḥ `dvitīyāyāñca` [[7.2.87]] iti| `evasunneyam` iti| vacanāntareṣvapyādeśābhāvaṃ darśayati| yuṣmānatikrāntau paśya atiyuṣmām, atyasmām| atikrāntābhyāṃ tvāṃ kṛtamatitvābhyām, atimābhyām| atikrāntābhyāṃ yuṣmān? kṛtamatiyuṣmābhyāṃ kṛtam| tvāmatikrāntābhyāṃ dehi atitvābhyāṃ dehi, atimābhyāṃ dehi| atikrāntābhyāṃ yuṣmān? dehi atiyuṣmābhyāmatyasmābhyāṃ dehi| atikrāntābhyāṃ tvāmāgato'tisyābhyāmāgataḥ, atimābhyāmāgataḥ| atikrāntabhyāṃ yuṣmānāgato'tiyuṣmābhyāmāgataḥ, atyasmābhyāmāgataḥ| atikrāntayostvāṃ svamatitvayoḥ svam, atimayoḥ svam| yuṣmānatikrāntayoḥ svamatayuṣmayoḥ svam, atyasmayoḥ svam| atikrāntayostvāṃ nidhehi atitvayornidhehi, atimayornidhehi| atikrāntayoryuṣmānnidhehi, atiyuṣmayornidhehi, atyasmayornidehi||`paramayūyam` iti| `aṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca` (pu|pa|vṛ|85) iti vacanāduttarapadayorapi bhavataḥ| atha vā - `jasi` iti parasaptamīyam, tena samastayorapi jasi parata iti bhavataḥ| paramayūyamityādāvapi yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ jasaḥ paratvamastyeva||<> [[7.2.97]] iti vakṣyati, tasyāyamapavādaḥ| atha tvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, `ahaḥ sau` ityevocyeta, tvādeśo hi <> [[7.2.97]] ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; asati tvagrahaṇe yuṣmado'pyahādeśaḥ syāt| atha vā - atra `asmado'haḥ sau` iteyavocyeta? evamapi gauravaṃ syāt| tasmādyathānyā samevāstu||anantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇayostvamayoḥ prāptayorivaṃ vacanam||`ekavacana ityarthenirdeśaḥ` iti| etenārthasyevaṃ grahaṇam, na tu pāribhāṣikasyaikavacanasyeti darśayati| pāribhāṣikasya tu grahaṇe yo doṣaḥ sa `yuvādhau dvivacane` [[7.2.92]] ityatrokta ityabhiprāyaḥ| arthagrahaṇaṃ tviha vacanagrahaṇāllabhyate| yadīha pratyayagrahaṇamabhimataṃ syāt, `ekatve` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| vibhaktāviti vartate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate - ekatve yā vibhaktiriti| atha vā - etaditi na brāūyāt; ekavacane hi <> [[7.2.98]] ityenenaivādeśayoḥ siddhatvāt| `tvām, mām` iti| `dvitīyāyāñca` [[7.2.87]] ityāttvam| `yadā samāsa ekārthe` ityādinā'rthagrahaṇaṃ sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| yadāpi samāsāt? saṃkhyāntarayuktāddvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vā bhavati, tadāpyekārthayoryuṣmadasmadoretāvādeśo bhavataḥ| evaṃ sati <> [[7.2.94]] , `yūyvayau jasi` [[7.2.93]] , `tubhyamahrau ṅayi` [[7.2.95]] , <> [[7.2.96]] - ityeṣāmapyādeśāntarāṇāṃ viṣayaṃ syātāmityata āha - `ādeśāntarāṇāṃ tu` ityādi| pūrvavipratiṣedhasyeti vacanaṃ parasya vipratiṣedhasyāsambhavāt| asambhavastvanayoreva paratvāt| pūrvavipratiṣedhastu paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvāllabhyate| tatra <> [[7.2.94]] ityasyāvakāśo yatraikārthe yuṣmadasmadī na bhavataḥ - atikrānto yuṣmānityatitvamatyahamiti, tvamāvekavacana [[7.2.97]] syāvakāśo yatraikārthābhyāṃ vibhaktyantaraṃ bhavati - tvām, māmiti; atikrāntastvāmatitvamatikrānto māmatyahamityatrobhayaprasaṅge prāpte tvahau sau bhavataḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena| anyā diśā''deśāntareṣu prāpteṣu pūrvaṃ vipratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| `atikrānto tvāmatitvām, atimām` iti| atra yadyapi samāsāddvivacana bhavati, tathāpyekārthe yuṣmadasmadī iti bhavata eva tvamādeśau| pāribhāṣikasya tva#ekavacanasya grahaṇe na syātām; tasyehāvidyamānatvāt| `evamādyudāhartavyam` iti| atikrāntau tvāṃ paśyātitvām, atimāṃ paśya| atitvābhiratimābhiḥ kṛtam| atakrāntābhyāṃ tvāṃ dehratitvābhyāmatimābhyāṃ dehi| atikrāntebhyastvāṃ dehratitvabhyamatimabhyaṃ dehi| atikrāntayostvāṃ tvāmāgato'titvābhyāmatimābyāmāgataḥ| atikrāntebhyastvāmāgato'titvadāgato'timadāgataḥ| atikrāntayostvāṃ svamatitvayoḥ svam, atimayoḥ svam| atikrāntānāṃ tvāṃ svamatitvākaṃ svam, atimākaṃ svam| atikrāntayostvāṃ nidhehratitvayornidhehi, atimayornidhehi| atikrānteṣu tvāṃ nidhehratitvāsu nidhehi, atimāsu nidhehi||`ekavacane vartamānayoḥ` iti| ekārthābhidhānaviṣayoyorityarthaḥ| `tvadīyaḥ madīyaḥ` iti| <> [[1.1.74]] iti vṛddhasaṃjñakatvāt? <> [[4.2.114]] iti cchapratyayaḥ| `tvattaraḥ, mattaraḥ` iti| `dvivacanavibhadajyopapade tarabīyasunau` [[5.3.57]] iti tarap| `tvadyati, madyati` iti| <> [[3.1.8]] | `tvadyate, madyate` iti| `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca` [[3.1.11]] iti kyaṅa| nanu ca pūrveṇevadeśau siddhau, tat? kimartho'yamārambaḥ? ityata āha - `vibhaktāvityadhikārāt` ityādi| `nanu ca` ityādi deśakaḥ| prakṛtipratyayayoḥ pūrvottarapadayośca yā madhrye vartate sā'ntarvattinī vibhaktiḥ| naivaṃ śakyam` itītaraḥ| `lukā tasya bhavitavyam` iti, aśyatāyāṃ hetuḥ| <> [[2.4.71]] iti prāgevādeśābhyāṃ lukā bhavitavyamiti, tataśca tannimittāvādeśau na syātāmityabhiprāyaḥ| `bahiraṅgo luk` ityādi deśakaḥ| vibhaktimātraṃ hrādeśayorāśrayaḥ lukastu dhātutvaṃ prātipadikatvañcāparam| tadevaṃ dhātupratipadikatve yathāyogaṃ bāhrapratyayāpekṣatvāt? samāsāpekṣatvācca bahiraṅge kiṃ punastadapekṣayā luko bahiraṅgatā? `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) ityādeśāveva prathamaṃ bhaviṣyataḥ| `etadevetyādi` itaro'pi| `antaraṅgānapi vithīn? bahiraṅgo lugna bādhate` iti pūrveṇaiva siddhatvādadeśavacanaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtañca, tadeva jñāpayati - `antaraṅgānapi vidhīn? bahiraṅgo lug? bādhate` (vyā|pa|128) iti| kimetasya jñāpakasya prayojanam? ityata āha - `tena` ityādi| yadyayamartho na jñāpyate, tadā gomān? priyo'syeti gomatpriya ityantaraṅgatvāllukaḥ prāk? `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num? syāt, <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghatvam, tataśca saṃyogāntalope [[8.2.23]] kṛte gomānpriya ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prasajyeta| asmin? hayarthe jñāpite, antaraṅgamapi numādikaṃ bahiraṅgeṇa lukā bādhyata iti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| ekenādiśabdena gomantamicchati gomatyati, gomānivācarati gomatyate - ityādegrrahaṇam| dvitīyena dīrghatvasya halṅyādilopasya [[6.1.64]] | yadyantaraṅgatvād? halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.64]] syāt, pratyayalakṣaṇena numādikaṃ syāt, tataśca tadevāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| luki ca sati <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇaprataṣedhānna bhavati| `evaṃ ca` ityādi| yata evaṃ bahiraṅgo'pi lugantaraṅgānapi vidhīn? bādhane, evañca kṛtvā, <> [[7.2.94]] , <> [[7.2.93]] , `tumyamahrau ṅayi` [[7.2.95]] <> [[7.2.96]] - ityeta ādeśāḥ pratyaya uttarapade ca parato na bhavantīti| `atha` ityādi| asati prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati, asti cāsyat? prayojanam - evāṃ tvahaṭīnāmādeśāntarāṇāṃ bādhanam| satyetasmin? prayojane, etadarthamevedaṃ yuktaṃ vijñātum, na tu jñāpanārthamiti bhāvaḥ| `lakṣyasthityapekṣayā` iti| lakṣyasya vyutpādyasya sthitiḥ=sthānaṃ lakṣyasthitiḥ, tadviṣaye'pekṣā=lakṣyasthityapekṣā; tathā hetu bhūtayā| nedamādeśāntarāṇāṃ bādhanārthaṃ vijñāyate| gomatpriyo gomatyatītyevamādikaṃ lakṣyaṃ loke sādhubhāvenādasthitam| ādeśāntarabādhanārthe hretasmin` vijñāyamāne na saṃgṛhataṃ sāyat| jñāpanārthe tvetadapi saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavatatyetaddarśayati - `jñāpanārthe hretasmin` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ satyevaṃ prayojane satyāmapi lakṣyasthityapekṣāyāṃ jñāpakārthametat? śakyaṃ vijñātum? evaṃ manyate - prayojanamevaitanna bhavati; maparyantagrahaṇasya cakāreṇānukarṣaṇārthatvāt| tadanukarṣaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam - maparyantayorādeśau yathā syātāmiti| yadi cādeśāntarāṇāṃ bādhanārthametat? syāt, anukarṣaṇaṃ tasyāpārthakaṃ syāt| yadbādhanārthamet? sūtraṃ prakalpyate tānyādeśāntarāṇi maparyantasyaiva prayuktāni, nānyasya| tataścāntareṇāpi maparyantagrahaṇānuvṛttimutsargasamānadeśatvādapavādānāṃ maparyantasyaiva bhaviṣyata iti kiṃ maparyantasyetyanuvartanena! ādeśāntarāmabādhanārthe hretasmin? sarvādeśivṛttyarthaṃ maparyantagrahaṇamanuvartayituṃ yuktam| tasmādetasmānmaparyantagrahaṇānuvartanānnādeśāntarabādhanamasya prayojanam| ato jñāpakaṃ vijñāyate| nanu ca kimarthameṣāṃ tvāhādīnāṃ bādhanārthametanna vijñāyata iti pareṇa deśitam| tasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ - maparyantasyetatyetannivarttyādeśāntarabādhanārthametat? kasmānna bhavatīti? tatrāyamarthaḥ - maparyantagrahaṇasyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro na kartavyo bhavati| maparyantagrahaṇānuvṛttāvetadādeśāntarabādhanārthaṃ nopapadyate, tasminnivṛttau tūpapadyata eva||`trayaḥ` iti| `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] iti guṇaḥ| `catvāraḥ` iti| <> [[7.1.98]] ityām| `trīṇi` iti| <> [[7.1.20]] iti śibhāvaḥ, <> [[7.1.72]] num, <> [[6.4.7]] , `saravanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau` [[6.4.8]] iti dīrghaḥ|`striyāmiti caitat? tricaturorviśeṣaṇam` iti| tayoreva śrutatvāt| `nāṅgasya` iti| evakārasya vyavacchedyaṃ darśayati - `tena` iti| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena| yadi hi striyāmityanenāṅgameva viśeṣyate,[`viśeṣyeta` - mudritapāṭhaḥ] tato yadā tricatuśabdau puṃsi napuṃsake vā vartete, aṅgaṃ [`aṅge` - mudritapāṭhaḥ] tu striyām, tadāpyetāvādeśau syātām| `tricaturoḥ striyām` ityanena viśeṣyamāṇayorna bhavataḥ| `priyatriḥ` ityādi| striyā anyapadārthatvādaṅgaṃ striyāṃ vartate, tricatuḥśabdau liṅgāntare| yadā tvaṅgaṃ puṃsi napuṃsake vā vartate, tricatuḥśabdau tu striyām, tadā bhavata eva| priyāstiruāo bāhraṇyo'syeti priyatisā, priyatiruāau, priyatisnaḥ| priyatisṛ brāāhṛṇakulam, priyatisṛṇo, priyatisṛṇi| priyacatasṛ brāāhṛṇakulam, priyacatasṛṇī, priyacatasṛṇi| `tisṛbhāve` ityādi| triśabdāt? saṃjñāyāṃ kan` [[5.3.87]] iti kani kṛte vibhaktyabhāvānna prāpnotītīdamārabhyate| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratapādanam - pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'navartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena saṃjñāyāṃ kanyapi bhaviṣyati| `tisṛkā` iti| grāmasyaiṣā saṃjñā| `catasaryādyudāttatvanipātanam` iti| cataruāḥ paśyetyatra <> [[6.1.167]] ityantodāttatvaṃ prāpnoti, ādyudāttañceṣyate, tadarthamādyudāttatvanipātanaṃ kartavyam| nipātanasvareṇa bādhitatvādantodāttatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham| yathaivaṃ tarhi nipātanasvaraḥ śasisvaraṃ bādhate, tathā <<ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ>> [[6.1.179]] ityamena yadavibhakterādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate tadapi bādheta, tataścatasṛṇāmityatrāma udāttatvaṃ na syat? ityata āha - `catasṛṇāmityatra tu` ityādi| `halādigrahaṇasāmarthyāt` iti| tatraivāyaṃ hetuḥ| halādigrahaṇaṃ hi tatrājādinivṛttyartha kriyate| catuḥśabdaścāyaṃ huvacanaviṣayaḥ| sarvāṇi bahuvacāni prathamādvitīyāṣaṣṭhībahuvacanebhyo'nyāni halādīni| tatrāmo numaciratṛjvadbhāvebhyo pūrvavipratiṣedhena nuṭi kṛte bhavitavyamādyudāttatvena; halāditatvāt| jasastu <> [[6.1.170]] ityato'sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇasyānuvartamānatvādādyudāttatvaṃ [`grahaṇānuvartamānatvāt` - mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] na bhavati| tasmācchaso mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tatra halādigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| yadi ca nipātanasvaro na bhaviṣyati| tasmānmā bhūddhalādigrahaṇasya va#aiyathryam| iha halādigrahamasamathryādvibhaktisvareṇa nipātatasvaro bādhyata iti, tena catasṛṇāmityatrāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati||kimarthaṃ punaraci rādeśa ucyate, na yaṇādeśena siddhatvāt? ityata āha - `pūrvasavarṇa` ityādi| asati hretasmin? sūtre śasi <> [[6.1.102]] iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ syāt, <<ṅasiṅasośca>> [[6.1.110]] `ṛta ut` [[6.1.107]] ityuttvañca, sarvanāmasthāne ṅau ca <<ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ>> [[7.3.110]] guṇaḥ| tasmādeteṣāmapavādo'yaṃ rephādeśa ārabhyate| nanu yuktaḥ pūrvasavarṇasyottvasya cehāyamapavādo rephādeśaḥ, guṇasya tvayuktaḥ; yasmāt, `madhyepavādāḥ pūrvān? vidhīn? bādhante nottarān` (vyā|pa|10) iti? ata āha - `paramapi` ityādi| guṇasyāvakāśaḥ - kartārau, hartārau, kartarīti; rephasyāvakāśaḥ - tislaḥ paśyeti, tiruāstiṣṭhantīti; priyatiriuā nidhehīti| atrobhayaprasaṅge pūrvavipratiṣedhena repho bhavan? paramapi ṅisarvanāmasthānaguṇaṃ bādhate| `ṛta iti kim` iti| evaṃ manyate - tisṛcatasṛśabdāvahānuvarttiṣyete| tau ca ṛkārāntāvevetyalo'ntyaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.51]] ṛta eva bhaviṣyati| tisṛcatasloḥ pratipattyartham` iti| tisṛcatasa - ityetayoracyapi paratastricaturoḥ sthāne pratipattiḥ=prāptiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ `ṛtaḥ` ityucyam| `anyathā hi` ityādi| yadi `ṛtaḥ` iti nocyeta, tadā tayoreva tisṛcataruāorayamapavādo vijñāyeta, tataścājādau tau na syātām||`numo vidhānājjarasadeśo bhavati viprataṣedhena` iti| numo'vakāśaḥ - trapūṇi jatūni; jarasāveśasyāvakāśaḥ - jarasau; atijarāṃsi brāāhṛṇakulānītayatrobhayaprasahge vipratiṣedhena paro jarasādeśo bhavati| yadi hi pūrvaṃ num? syāt, numā vyavahitatvājjarasādeśo na labhyate, tathāpi vihitaviśeṣaṇapāśrayaṇena labhyate| evamapi `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti` (vyā|pa|106) iti jarāśabdasyādeśe kṛte sakārat? paro num? śrūyeta| [`śrūyate` mudrita pāṭhaḥ] athāpi samuskasyādeśaḥ syāt? evamapi kṛtakāryatvānnumśāstrasya punarapravṛtterādeśe kṛte punarnamna syāt, tathāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prasajyeta| athehātijarasaṃ brāāhṛṇakulaṃ paśyeti jarasādeśe kṛte `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] iti sukkasmānna bhavati? ityata āha - `iha` ityādi| jarāmatikrāntamiti prādisamāsaḥ, `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti hrasvaḥ, dvitīyaikavacanamam? iti sthita ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt(vyā|pā|16)kṛte'pi hrasvatve luk, ambhāvaḥ, jarasbhāvaḥ - ityetāni trīṇi kāryāmi yugapat? prāpnuvanti, tatra lugapavādatvāt? `ato'm` [[7.1.24]] ityambhāvena bādhyate, ambhāvo'pi paratvājjarasādeśena| atha kṛte jarasādeśe luk? punaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha - `punarlukśāstram` ityādi| na ca lukśāstraṃ punaḥ pravartate; bhraṣṭāvasaratvāt, tṛtīyābahuvacane kimatajaraibrrāāhṛṇakulairityevaṃ bhavitavyam; āhosavidatijarasam, atijarasairityevam? ityata āha - `atijarasam` ityādi| `gonarddīyamatena` iti| tathā hi bhāṣye uktam - `godardīya āha - `iṣaṭameṣaitat? saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavatīti - atijaramatijaraititi bhavitavyam` iti| kā punarasya yuktiḥ? ityata āha - `sannipātalakṣaṇa` ityādi| yadyambhāvaḥ, aisbhāvaśca jarasādeśasya nimittamātraṃ syāt, akārāntatā'ṅgasya tābhyāṃ vihatā syāt| etaccāyuktam; tasmannipāte hi tāvabhinirvṛttau notsahete sāṃ vihantum| `anye` iti| sūtrakāramatānusāriṇaḥ| kasmāt? punasta evaṃ manyante? ityata āha - `anityatvādasyāḥ` ityādi| anityatvaṃ punarasyāḥ - <> [[7.1.9]] ityatra pratipāditam||`syaḥ` iti| <> [[7.2.106]] iti takārasya sakāraḥ| `tyaḥ` iti| `jasaḥ sī` [[7.1.17]] iti śībhāvaḥ, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | `imau` iti| `daśca` [[7.2.109]] iti matvam| `asau` iti| <> [[7.2.107]] | `amū` iti| `adaso'serdādu do maḥ` 8.2.80) iti matvotve, <> [[6.1.102]] iti dīrghaḥ| `amī` iti| <> [[8.2.81]] itīttvam| atheha kasmānna bhavati - bhavāniti? ata āha - `dviparyantānām` ityādi| etacca <<śeṣe lopaḥ>> [[7.2.90]] ityatra prāgvi jñāpitam| `bhavān` iti| `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num, <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ| atheha saṃjñopasarjanībhūtānāmapi kasmānna bhavati tyādadau - tyad? atisyad, atityadaḥ? ityata āha - `saṃjñopasarajanībhūtāḥ` ityādi| sarvādyantaḥpātinastyadādayaḥ| sarvādayaścāsaṃjñībhūtā anupasarjanībhūtaśca paṭhante| tathā hi - teṣāṃ `sarvanāmāni` [[1.1.27]] iti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇasyaitat? prayojanam - sarveṣāṃ nāmabhūtānāṃ saṃjñā yathā syāt| ye tu kasyācideva saṃjñābhūtā upasarjanībhūtāśca, teṣāṃ mā bhūditi| tasmāt? saṃjñopasarjanībhūtāstyadādayaḥ pāṭhādeva paryudastāḥ, tyadādibhyo bahiṣkṛtā ityarthaḥ| tasmādatyadāditvāt? teṣāṃ na bhavati tyadādikāryam| `tyadādipradhāne śabde tu bhavatyeva` iti| tyadādayaḥ pradhānā yasmin? śabde sa tyadādipradhānaḥ, tatra bhavatyevāttvam; tasya pāṭhāpadaryudastatvāt| aparyudastatvaṃ tu sarvanāmasaṃjñāyastadantavidheḥ sarvāderabhyupagamāt||athākāra eva kimaḥ kasmānna vidhīyate, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati, akāro hi prakṛto'nuvartata iti, tatraivaṃ sutraṃ kartavyam, `kimo't` iti? ata āha - `sākackasyādeśo bhavati` iti| tenākāraḥ kimo na vidhīyate` iti| ayaṃ hrādeśaḥ `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhrate` (vyā|pā|21) akacaśca kimgrahaṇena grahaṇāt? sākackasyāpi bhavati; tenākāra eva kimaḥ sthāne na vidhīyate| yadi hi vidhīyeta, tadā'nakackasyādeśe kṛte yaścādakaci kaka ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ kimo'ttve kṛte ka iti bhavati, yāvatā makārasyāttve kṛte satakārasya yaṇādeśe kṛte kya iti syāt? naiṣa doṣa; ikārasyāpi hrattvaṃ vidhīyate, yadiha pūrvasūtrāt? `aḥ` ityanuvartate| nālo'ntyasyātvaṃ bhavati yat? punarihākāragrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tena `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya` (vyā|pa|63) itīkārasaya, tatra dvayorakārayoḥ parapūrvatve ka iti siddham| kyacit? pāṭhaḥ `imaḥ` iti| tatrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ - athākāra evemaḥ kasmānna vidhīyate? laghu hrevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati; prakṛtasyākārasyehānuvṛtteḥ, tatraivaṃ tāvat? sūtraṃ kartavyam - `imaḥ` iti| na caivaṃ sati `tima ṣṭima ādrībhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1123,1124) ityasya kvibantasya tīn, timau, tima ityatrāpi prasajyeta, tyadādibhirimo viśeṣaṇāt - tyadādīnāṃ ya imiti? na; `daśca` [[7.2.109]] iti matve kṛta idama imau ima ityatrāpi prasajyeta| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) nāpīma ityucayamāne <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti prasajyetetyāśaṅkanīyam, yasmānnānarthake'lontyavidhiḥ (vyā|pa|62)? ityata āha - `sākackasyāpi` ityādi| pūrva eva pāṭhaḥ sādhutaraḥ| itaratra tu pāṭha uttarasūtreṇa kvādeśa imaḥ kṛte dvayoḥ kakārayośca saṃyuktayoḥ śravaṇaṃ prasajyeta, taccāniṣṭam||pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ| tiśabdasya vibhakterabhāvādikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| takārasyaiva prayojanam| tatra `yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) takārādeśo vibhaktau kāryaṃ vidhīyate| ata āha - `takārādau` ityādi| `kutaḥ` iti| <> [[5.3.7]] | `kutra` iti| `kimo't` [[5.3.12]] ityatra parasūtrādvāgrahaṇaṃ purastādapakṛṣyate| tena pakṣe <> [[5.3.10]] iti tralyapi bhavati| `kuha` iti| `vā ha ca cchabdasi` [[5.3.13]] iti haḥ| eṣāñca tasiladīnāṃ <> [[5.3.1]] iti vibhaktisaṃjñā||kādeśasyāyamapavādaḥ| `kva` iti| `kimo't` [[5.3.12]] ityat| atha kimarthamādeśāntaraṃ vidhīyate, na prakṛtaḥ ku eva vidhīyatām, tatrāpi yaṇādeśo kveti sidhyatyeva; yogavibhāgaśca na kartavyo bhavati, `kutihātsu` ityeko yogaḥ kariṣyate? ityata āha - `ādeśāntaravacanam` ityādi| kuśabde hrādeśe sati yaṇādeśaṃ bādhitvā <> [[6.4.146]] iti guṇaḥ syāt| tasmāt? tannivṛttyarthaṃ kvādeśa ityucyate| evamapi pratyayavidhāveva `kimo ḍvat` iti ḍvatpratyayo vidheyaḥ, tatrāpi ṭilope kṛte kveti rūpaṃ sidhyatyeva| padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti kakārasya gakāraḥ prāpnotītyato na sidhyatīti cet? naitadasti; `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge (vyā|pa|42) iti ṭilopasyāsiddhatvājjaśtvaṃ na bhavati| ṭilopo hi ḍiti vidhīyate, tena ḍitamapekṣamāṇo bahiraṅgo bhavati| jaśtvaṃ tu padānte vidhīyamānaṃ nāparanimittamapekṣata ityantaraṅgamityata āha - `kimo ḍvaditi pratyayāntaram` ityādi| yadi ḍavaditi pratyayāntaraṃ vidhīyeta, sākackasya kveti rūpaṃ na sidhyati| asaci hi kṛte kakimiti sthite ḍvatpratyaye parataṣṭilope sati kakvetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syat| atpratyaye tu kvādeśo vidhīyamāno'nekāstvāt? sākackasya sarvādeśa eva bhavatīti na bhavatyaniṣṭarūpaprasaṅghaḥ| tasmāt? sākackārthaṃ ḍvaditi na pratyayāntaraṃ vidhīyate| sākacko'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat? sākackārtham||`sai` iti| kimidaṃ prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam? uta saptamībahuvacanasya? āhosvidubhayorapi? tatra prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam| tathā hi - dvayorapi sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| yadi syāt, sītryevaṃ brāūyāt| evaṃ hi sakārādau kāryaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ tayodrvayorapi bhaviṣyati| tasmādanyatarasya grahaṇam| tathā hi - <> [[6.1.133]] `so'ci lope cet` [[6.1.134]] ityevamādernirdeśāt? prathamaikavacanasyaiva grahaṇa yuktam| `he sa, sā` iti| he śabdo nipātasamudāyo'vadhāraṇārthe vartate| nanu ca tyadādyatvamatra bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; anavakāśā hi vidhayo badhakā bhavanti| sāvakāśaṃ cātvam| kovakāśaḥ? dviśabdaḥ-dvāviti| satyapi tasminnavakāśe yadyapi sakarasyāpyanantyovakāśaḥ, tathāpyantasya paratvāt? satvaṃ syāt| tataśca he sa ityatra <> [[6.1.69]] iti sorlopo na syāt| tatra halṅyādilope kṛte rutvavisarjanīyayoḥ kṛtayoraniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| setyatra tu `ajādyataṣṭāp` [[4.1.4]] iti striyāṃ ṭābna syāt| tasmāt? `anantyayoḥ` iti vaktavyam||`sau` ityeva| tyadādyatvāpavādo'dasa autvaṃ vidhīyate| `asau` iti| pūrvasūtreṇa dakārasya sakāraḥ, <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `yadā ca` ityādi| `sādutvañca` iti| cakāraḥ sanniyogārthaḥ| tena yasmin? pakṣe autvapratiṣedhaḥ, tasminneva pakṣe sāduttarasyākārasyottvaṃ vidhīyate| `uttarapadamabhūtānām` ityādi| iha paramāham, paramāneneti <> [[7.2.94]] , `ido'y? puṃsi` [[7.2.111]] , <> [[7.2.112]] iti samāsād? yā vibhaktiḥ, tasyāmeta ādeśaḥ bhavanto bahiraṅgā bhavanti; prāgeva tu vibhaktyutpatteḥ| akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ prāpnuvadantaraṅgam, tasmāt? pūrvaṃ tadeva syāt, paścādādeśāḥ syuḥ; tataśca paramaham, paramayam, paramanenetyaniṣṭāni rūpāṇi rūpaṇi syuḥ| tasmāduttapadabhūtānāmakṛtasavarasandhīnāṃ tyadīdīnāmādeśā vaktavyāḥ=vyākhyeyā ityarthaḥ| ācāryapravṛttijrñāpayati - pūrvottarayoḥ padayostāvat? kāryaṃ prathamaṃ bhavati, paścādekādeśa ti| yadayaṃ <> [[7.3.22]] iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam? indre dvāvacau, tatraikaḥ - <> [[6.4.148]] iti lopenāpahniyate, aparaḥ - ekādeśenetyanacka indraśabdaḥ sampannaḥ, tatra ko vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ! paśyati tvācāryaḥ - purvottarayoḥ padayostāvat kāryaṃ bhavati, paścādekādeśa iti; yataḥ <> [[7.3.22]] iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| tadetasmājjñāpakādakṛtasvarasandhīnāmuttarapadabhūtānāṃ tyadādīnāmādeśā bhavantīti| `avasaḥ sorbhavedautvam` ityādi| avadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyam| adaḥśabdāt? parasya sorevautvaṃ bhavet| bhavatu, mā vā bhūt| adaśśabdasya tyadādyatve kṛte <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhau kṛtāyāmasāviti sidhyatyeva, tat? kimarthaṃ sulope vidhīyate? nirarthakatavānnaivaṃ sorlopo vidheyaḥ, autvameva vidheyam| atra doṣamāha - `hrasvāllupyeta sambuddhiḥ` iti| he'sāvityatra <> [[6.1.69]] iti sorlopaḥ prasajyeta, tataśca sambuddhau he'sāviti na sidhyet? `na halaḥ prakṛtaṃ hi tat` iti| nāyaṃ deṣaḥ; halaḥ sambuddherlopa autve kṛte'ṇ? bhavati, na haliti, tatkuto lopaprasaṅgastatra! tarhi halgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam; yasmāt? prakṛtaṃ tat| <> [[6.1.68]] ityato halgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtameva| yadyapi tatra prathamānirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśena cehārthaḥ, tathāpi `eṅ? hrasvāt` [[6.1.67]] iti pañcamī halityasyāḥ prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalapyiṣyati; <> [[1.1.67]] iti vacanāt| athaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ - `āpa etvaṃ bhavet? tasmin` ityādi| tasminnokāre paratastyadādyatve kṛte striyāṃ ṭāpi - he asau brāāhṛṇītyatara <> [[7.3.106]] ityetvaṃ syāt, yathā hi he khaṭve ityatra? `na jñalītyanuvartanāt` iti| nāyaṃ doṣaḥ; `sambuddho ca` [[7.3.106]] ityatra `bahuvacane jhalyet` [[7.3.103]] ityanuvartate, tena jhalādau sambuddhāvetyena bhavitavyam| ca caukāre kṛte jhalādiḥ sambuddhirbhavati, kiṃ tarhi? ajādiḥ| `pratyayasthācca kādittvaṃ śībhāvaśca prasajyate` [`prasajyeta` - prā| mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| pūrvakaścakāraḥ tahrrarthe, itaraḥ samuccaye| ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ - asakau brāāhṛṇītyatrājñātādyarthavivakṣāyāmakaci kṛte ṭāpi ca `pratyayasthāt? kāt` [[7.3.44]] ityādinā kāt? pūrvasyetvaṃ prāpnoti? asau brāāhṛṇī ityatra `auṅa āpaḥ` [[7.1.18]] ityanena śībhāvo'dasastvavayava okāre kṛte ṭābeva nāstīti naitaddoṣadvayaṃ sambhavati| śībhāvadoṣaśca pākṣiko veditavyaḥ, yasmin? pakṣe sāmānyagrahaṇārtho ṅakāraḥ pratyayasyāsajyate| yadā tu pūrvasūtranirdeśastadā dvivacanayoreva śībhāvaḥ; tayoreva pūrvācāryairṅitvasya kṛtatvāt| anyasya prāptireva nāsti; āṅittvāt||alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.51]] makārasyaivānena makāreṇa bhavitavyam, na ca makarasaya makārādeśe kṛte viśeṣo'sti, tatkimarthaṃ makārasya makāraḥ ityucyate? - ityetaccodyaṃ nirākartumāha - `makārasya` ityādi| gatārtham||`idamaḥ` iti vartate, `sau` iti nivṛttam; uttarasūtre punaḥ `sau` iti vacanāt| tenāyaṃ vibhaktimātre dākārasya makāro bhavati||uttarasūtre puṃsīti vacanāt? striyāmayaṃ yakāraḥ| atha napaṃsake kasmānna vijñāyate? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum; napuṃsake hi `svamornarpusakāt` [[7.1.23]] iti sorlukā bhavitavyam| atra sāvucyamānaḥ kathaṃ tasmatlupte yakāraḥ syāt; pratyayalakṣameneti cet? na; `na lumataṅgasya` [[1.1.62]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratidhedhāt| tasmādyuktamuktam - `striyāmayaṃ yakāraḥ` iti||`anena` iti| tyadādyatve pararūpatve ca kṛta idrūpasyānādeśaḥ, <<ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ>> [[7.1.12]] itīnādeśaḥ, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | `anayoḥ` iti| `osi ca` [[7.3.104]] ityetvam, anādeśaḥ, sulopaḥ| `pakāreṇa` iti| atha kapaḥ pakāreṇa kasmānna bhavati? prayojanābhāvāt| nanu cehetyatra prāgdiśīyāyāṃ vibhaktau <> [[7.2.113]] yathā syāditīdamasti prayojanam? <> [[5.3.3]] itīśātra bādhakena bhavitavyam| atra ca `amehakvatisitrebhyaḥ` (kārikā 4.2.115) ityatra ihetyakṛtedrūpalopasya hakārāntasyedamo tirdeśo liṅgam||pūrveṇānādeśe prāpte halādāvidrūpasya lopo vidhīyate| `ābhyām` iti| tyadadyatvam; ato guṇe [[6.1.94]] pararūpatvam, `supi ;ṭa [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghatvañca| athālo'ntyaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.52]] ntyasyāyaṃ lopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `nānarthake` ityādi| abhyupetyānarthake'lo'ntyavidhiṃ parihārāntaramāha - `atha vā` ityādi| na cālgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, yatastadanuvartate? ityata āha - `anāpyakaḥ` ityādi| yadyapi tatra prathamānirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ, tathāpi halīti saptamī anniti ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; <> [[1.1.66]] iti vacanāt| evaṃ parihāro bhāṣyakāramatena boddhavyaḥ; asyāḥ paribhāṣayā anaṅgīkaraṇāt| atra darśane tu trayāṇāmakarāṇāṃ pararūpamekādeśaṃ kṛtvā dīrghatvādi vidheyam||`mārṣṭā` iti| `mṛjū śṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1066) vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, `ṣṭutvam| mṛjeḥ kvibantādvibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ kaṃsaparimṛṅbhyām, kaṃsaparimṛṅbhirityatra vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, na ca kvibāśrayaḥ <> [[1.1.5]] iti vṛddhipratiṣedho bhavitumutsahate; yasmāt? kṅitīti niṃmittasaptamī| na cātra kvibnimittā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, kiṃ tarhi? vibhaktinimttā| tasmāt? tasyāḥ pratiṣedho vaktavya ityata āha - `mujariti dhātugrahaṇam` ityādi| bhrauṇahatya [[6.4.174]] miti nipātanena jñāpito'yamarthaḥ - dhātāḥ kāryamucyamānaṃ dhātupratyaya eva bhavatīti, tena kaṃsamṛṅbhyāmityatra na bhavati| yo hi dhātorityevaṃ vihitaḥ sa dhātupratyayaḥ| na ca bhyāmādikaṃ dhātorityevaṃ vihitam, kiṃ tarhi? prātipadikādityevam, tasmānnāso dhātupratyayaḥ| `kaṃsaparimṛṅbhyām` ityādi| pūrvavat? ṣatve kṛta ṣakārasya jaśtvaṃ ḍakāraḥ||`niścāyaniṣpāvau` [`ekasataṇḍulaniścāyaḥ, dvau śūrpaniṣpāvau` - kāśikā] iti| niṣpūrvāccinīteḥ, punāteśca <> [[3.3.20]] iti dhañ| `idupadhasya cāpratyayasya` [[8.3.41]] iti visarjanīyaṣatvam| `kāraḥ, hāraḥ` iti| kṛñaḥ hmañaśca bhāve ghañ| `gauḥ, gāvo gāvaḥ` iti| `goto ṇit` [[7.1.90]] iti sarvanāmasthānasya ṇittvam| `sakhāyau, sakhāyaḥ` iti| atrāpi <> [[7.1.92]] iti| `jayateḥ, yauteśca` iti| `ji jaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-561), `yu miśraṇe` [`miśraṇe'miśraṇe ca` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1033)| `cyavateḥ` iti| `cyuṅa chyuṅ? jyuṅ? pruṅ? pluṅ? gatau`[nāsti - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-955-958)| ajgrahaṇamaniko'pi yathā syāt - goriti| nanu ṇitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva tatra bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; asti hranyat? ṇitkaraṇasya prayojanam, kiṃ tat? gāvau, gāva ityavādeśe kṛte <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiryathā syāt| yadyevam, gaurityatrāguṇaviṣaye vṛddhiriyaṃ kṛtārtheti kārayatītyādiṣu paratvādguṇena bādhyeta? ṇitkaraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti| etaccānuttaram; <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] ityevamādau ṇitkaraṇasya caritārthatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttijrñāpayati - guṇaviṣaye'pi vṛddhirabhavatīti; yadayaṃ jāgartarvṛddhiviṣaye pratiṣedhaviṣaye ca <<jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu>> [[7.3.85]] iti punarguma ārabhyate| yadi hi guṇaviṣaye vṛddharna syāt, tadā jāgarayatītyādiṣu guṇo'styeveti tadviṣaye guṇārambho'narthakaḥ syāt| vṛddhiviṣayatā cārambhasya ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedhādvijñāyate| atha yogavibhāgaḥ kimarthaḥ, na `ñṇityata upathāyāḥ` ityedocyeta? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; evaṃ hrucyamāne yadyapi gāvo, gāva ityatrāvādeśe kṛte cāyakaḥ, lāvaka ityatra guṇe kṛte'yavādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sidhyati - gauḥ, sakhāyau; jaitramityādau tu na sidhyati; ayavādeśayorguṇasya ca yathāyogamasambhavāt? smādyathāyogaṃ yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ||pāka ityādau bhāve ghañ, <> [[7.3.52]] iti kutvam| `rāgaḥ` iti| <> [[6.4.27]] ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `pācayati` iti| <> [[3.1.26]] iti ṇic| `cakāsayati` iti| upadhāgrahaṇādiha cakārādakārasya na bhavati| taparakaraṇaṃ lāghavārtham| asati hi sminnasyopadhāyā ityucyamāne gauravaṃ syāt| dīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ tu taparakaraṇaṃ na bhavati, na dīrghasya kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhau kaścidviśeṣo'sti||`acām` iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| `acāmāderacaḥ sthāne` iti| nanu cekparibhāvopasthānādika eva sthāne vṛddhyā bhavitavyam, tasmādikaḥ sthāna ityevaṃ vaktavyam, na tvacaḥ sthāna iti? evaṃ manyate - <> [[7.2.115]] ityataḥ sthāninirdeśārthaṃ dvitīyamajgrahaṇamanuvartate, tena yathā <> [[7.2.115]] ityatra sthāninirdeśādikparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate, tathehāpītyadoṣaḥ| `gārgyaḥ, vātsyaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.105]] | `dākṣiḥ, plākṣiḥ` iti| `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] | `aupagavaḥ, kāpaṭavaḥ` iti| prāgdīvyatīyo'ṇ? [[4.1.83]] |atha tvāṣṭraḥ, jāgata ityatara tvaṣṭṛjagadbhyāṃ `tasyevam` [[4.3.120]] ityaṇi kṛte yathākramaṃ <> [[7.2.115]] ityajlakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, <> [[7.2.116]] ityupadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `acāmādervṛddhirantyopadhāvṛrddhi bādhate` iti| kathaṃ punaranyasyocyamānā'nyasya bādhikā syāt? jñāpakāt| yadayamanuśatikādiṣu puṣkarasacchabdaṃ paṭhati, tajjñāpayati - yatrādivṛddhistatrānyā vṛddhirna bhavatīti| tasyānuśatikādiṣu pāṭhasyaitat? prayojanam - ubhayapadavṛddhiryathā syāt, puṣkarasado'patyaṃ pauṣkarasādiriti| `bāhavādibhyaśca` [[4.1.96]] itīñ| yadi cādivṛddhiranyasyā vṛddherbādhikā na syāt, upadhālakṣaṇenaiva vṛddheḥ siddhatvāt? pauṣkarasādiśabdasya, puṣkarasacchabdo'nuśatikādiṣu na paṭhaeta| paśyatyācāryaḥ - yatrādipadavṛddhistatrānyā vṛddhirna bhavatīti; yato'nuśatikādiṣu puṣkarasacchabdaṃ paṭhati| nanu ṭhagarthastatra paṭhaḥ, tatra hrupadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhirna prāpnotīti ṭhako'ñṇittvāt - puṣkarasadā caratīti pauṣkarasādika iti? naitadasti; yadi puṣkarasacchabdāccaratyarthe ṭhagutpadyate| kasmāt? punarnotpadyate? anabhidhānāt| abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavantīti| tasmājjñāpaka evānuśatikādiṣu pāṭhaḥ puṣkarasacchabdasya||yadyapi `taddhiteṣu` [[7.2.117]] iti bahuvacanāntaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpohaikavacananirdeśādekavacanaviṣayo bahuvacanasya vipariṇāmena vijñāyate, itayata āha - `kiti ca taddhite parataḥ` iti| `nāḍāyanaḥ, jārāyaṇaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.99]] iti phak| `ākṣikaḥ, śālākikaḥ ti| akṣiśalākāśabdābhyāṃ `tena dīvyata khanati jayati jitam` [[4.4.2]] iti ṭhak; <<ṭhasyekaḥ>> [[7.3.50]] ||iki bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ saptamādhyāyasyadvitīyaḥ pādaḥ- - -atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥtṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ<> [[7.2.117]] ityāntaratamyādaikāre vṛddhau prāptāyāṃ devikādīnāmākāro vidhīyate| `atra pakṣatrayaṃ sambhāvyate - 1| prakṛtenāṅgena devikādayo viśiṣyante - devikādīnāmaṅgānāmiti; 2| tairvāṅgam - `devikādyantasyāṅgasyeti, atha vā - 3| tairādyo'c - devikadīnāṃ sambandhināmacāṃ madhye ya ādirajiti| tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā devikākūle bhavāḥ śālayo dāvikākūlāḥ śālaya iti na sidhyet, na hratara devikāśabdo'ṅgam, kiṃ tarhi? devikākūlaśabdaḥ| nanu cāṅgasyetyavayavaṣaṣṭhī, tatraivaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ kariṣyate - aṅgasya ye devikādayo'vayavabhūtā iti, bhavati cehāvayavo'ṅgasya devikāśabdaḥ, tato'yamodoṣa iti cet? satyametat? kintvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt, sudevikāyāṃ bhavaḥ saudevikaḥ - ityatrāpi syāt| atha dvitīyapakṣa āśrīyeta, evamapi dāvikākūlāḥ śālaya iti na sidhyet| devikādibhiḥ prakṛte'ṅge viśeṣyamāṇe viśeṣaṇe ca tadantavidhiriti devikādyantasyāṅgasyeti bhavitavyam, na tadādeḥ| tasmāt? tadāderapi yathā sthāditi yatnāntaramāstheyamiti| tṛtīye tu pakṣa āśrīyamāṇe, vināpi yatnāntareṇa kevalasya tadādestadantasya bhavati| sarvatrācāmāderaco devikādisambandhitvāt| atastamevāśrityāha - `devikāśiṃśapādityavāḍdīrghasattraśreyasa ityeteṣām` ityādi| eṣāṃ devikādīnāmacāṃ madhya ādibhūto yo'j? vṛddheraikārasya prasaṅge tasyākāro vidhīyate|`pūrvaśāṃśapa` iti| pūrvavaduttarapadasya vṛddhiḥ| sāpyākāra eva bhavatītyuttarapadādhikāre devikādīnāmanuvṛtterlabhyate| `vahīnarasyedvacanaṃ kartavyam` iti| akārasya yā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti tadvādhanārthamet| ikāre kṛte yā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti sā tu bhavatyeva| `kecittu` ityādi| kuṇaḍavāḍavādayaḥ| vihīno naraḥ kāmakrodhābhyāmiti pṛṣodarāditvānnalopaḥ, vihīnarasyāpatyaṃ vaihīnariḥ - `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] ||kekayamitrayupralayānāmiti yādyapekṣayā'vayavaṣaṣṭhī| yāderityeṣāpītyādeśāpekṣayā sthānaṣaṣṭhī-ya ādiryasya sa yādiḥ| akārasahito yakāra ukārasahitaśca| kekayādīnāṃ yo'vayavo yādistasyeyādeśo bhavati| nanu ca mitrayuśabdaḥ paramaprakṛtiḥ, na gotram; `apatyaṃ potraprabhṛti gotram` [[4.1.162]] ityapatyaviśeṣasya gotrasaṃjñāvidhānāt, tatkathaṃ gotrāducyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ paramaparakṛterbhavati? ityata āha - `laukikaṃ hi` ityādi| kiṃ punarlaukikaṃ gotram? ityata āha - `loke ca` ityādi| iha laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhrate| loke ca ṛṣiśabdaḥ `gotram` ityabhidhīyate| mitrayuśabdaścāyamuṣivacanaḥ, tasmāt? tato'pi gotrāducyamānaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti| `prāleyam` iti| `ata āgataḥ` [[4.3.74]] ityaṇ||<> [[7.2.117]] ityādinā ñṇidādau taddhite vṛddhau prāptāyāṃ pratiṣedho'yamucyate, tatsanniyogenaijāgamau bhavataḥ| `yakārādaikāraḥ` ityādinā yatāsaṃkhyena sambandhaṃ darśayati| `vaiyasanam` iti| `asu kṣepaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1209)| vipūrvādviśeṣeṇāsyate kṣipyate yeneti karaṇe lyuṭ, prādisamāsaḥ, yaṇādeśaḥ, tata, <> [[4.3.53]] ityaṇ| tatra yakārāt? padāntāt? parasyākārasya vṛddhirna bhavati, tasmāt? pūrvamaijāgamaḥ| `vaiyākaraṇaḥ` iti| viśeṣeṇākriyante vyutpādyante śabdā aneneti karaṇe lyuṭ, vyākaraṇamiti, prādisamāsaḥ, tataḥ <> [[4.2.59]] ityaṇ, tatra parjanyavallakṣaṇapravṛttyā padāntādyakārāt? parasaya yā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti sā na bhavati, tasmāt? pūrvamaijāgamaḥ| `sauvaāḥ` iti| śobhano'āḥ svaāḥ, pūrvavat? samāsaḥ, tato'patyarthe śivādyaṇ? [[4.1.112]] | atra vakārāt? padāntāt? parasya vṛddhirna bhavati, tasmāt? pūrvamaijāgamo bhavati| `ārthiḥ` iti| nā artho yasya sa arthaḥ, tasyāpatyam? `uta iñ` [[4.1.95]] | `yāṣṭakaḥ` iti| `śaktiyaṣṭaorīkak` [[4.4.59]] | `yātāḥ` iti| iṇaḥ parasya laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, <> [[6.4.81]] iti yaṇ, tataḥ <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| tatrobhayatrāpi yakārasya padāntatā bhaviṣyataḥ, yathā - `brāāhṛṇebhyo dadhi dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya` iti dadhidānasya takradānāṃ bādhakam| athāpi bādhagau na syātām, tathāpi nityatvādaicoḥ kṛtayo paścādvṛrbhavantī tayoreva bhaviṣyatīti| na cātra śabdāntaraprāptyā tayorapyaicoranityatvamāśaṅkanīyam, na hi tau śabdāntarasaya vidhīyete, api tvabhakatāveva yvābhyāṃ pūrvau| yadyapi śabdātantarasya prāptiḥ syāt, tathāpi dvayoranityayoḥ paratvādaicoḥ kṛtayoḥ sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva` (vyā|pa|40) iti punarvṛddhirna bhavati| yadyapi punaḥprasaṅgavijñānādvṛddhiḥ syāt; tathāpīṣṭasiddhiḥ syādeva; viśeṣābhāvādityata āha - `pratiṣedhavacanam` ityādi| praklṛtiḥ=prakalpanam, vyavasyetyarthaḥ| yatra yvābhyāṃ parasya vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sa evaicorviṣayaḥ kathannāma prakalpetavyavatiṣṭhetetyevamarthaḥ| pratiṣedha ucyate, kimarthaṃ punarai corviṣayaparakḷptiḥ kriyate? ityata āha - `iha mā bhat` iti| yadi prataṣedhavacanenaicorviṣayanyavasthā na kriyeta, tadā dādhyaśviḥ, mādhvaiārityatrāpi syāt| ato mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti pratiṣedhavacanenaicorviṣayanyavasathā kriyate| dadhipriyo'āo dadhyaāḥ madhupriyo'āo madhyaāḥ| `sāmānādhikaraṇādhikāre śāpakapārthivādīnāṃ samāsa uttarapadalopaśca` (vā|83) iti madhyamapadalopau samāsaḥ| atha kriyamāṇe pratiṣedhavacane kasmādevātra na bhavati, yāvatā yvābhyāṃ parasya vṛddhirnāsti? ityata āha - `na hyatra` ityādi| prasaṅge hi sati vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhavati, nāsati; na cātra yvābhyāṃ parasya vṛddheḥ prasaṅgo'sti, ataḥ prateṣedho nāstyevetyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca `acāmādeḥ` [[7.2.117]] ityanuvartate, tena yvau viśiṣyete - acāmāderacaḥ sthāne yau yvāditi| na ca dadhyaiārityādāvevaṃvidhau tau sta iti| na cātraico bhaviṣyataḥ, ato nārthaḥ? naitadasti; evaṃ hayacāmādigrahaṇam, tena yadi yvau viśiṣyete tadā vṛddhiraviśeṣitā syāt| tataścehāpi vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt - dve aśītī bhṛto bhṛto bhāvī vā <> [[5.1.18]] dvyāśautika iti| atha vṛddhirviśiṣyate - acāmāderityevaṃ vā vṛddhiḥ, tato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| na hyatrācāmāderityevaṃ vṛddhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `saṃkhyāyā saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca` [[7.3.15]] ityevam| kiṃ tarhi yvau na viśeṣitau syātām? tataśca dādhyaiārityādāvaicau syātāmeva| tasmāt? tayorviṣayavyavasthārthaṃ neti vaktavyam| `uttarapadavṛddherapyayaṃ pratiṣedha iṣyate` iti| sa cottarapadādhikāre'syānuvartamānatvāllabhyate| `pūrvatraiyalinde` iti| atra `viśo'madrāṇām` [[7.3.13]] ityuttarapadavṛddhau prāptāyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| yadyuttarapadavṛddherapyayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, tadā dvyāśītika ityatrāpi <> [[7.3.15]] iti yā vṛddhiruttarapadasya āptetyasyā api pratiṣedhaḥ syādityata āha - `yatra tu` ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pyatra pratiṣedho na bhavati? uttarapadasyācāmādyenācā hi yvorviśeṣaṇatvāt| uttarapadasambandī yo'cāmādirac? tasya sthāne yo yvau tābhyāmuttarapadasya vṛddhirna bhavati| na ca dvyāśītika ityatrottarapadasyācāmāderacaḥ sthāne yakāra iti nātra vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhavatīti||`dauvārikaḥ` iti| <> [[4.4.69]] iti ṭhak| `dvārapālasyedaṃ dauvārapālam` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| prāyeṇa tu pustakeṣu `dvārapālasyevaṃ dauvārapālikam` iti| pāṭhaḥ, sa cāyuktaḥ; na hi tasyaida [[4.3.120]] mityatrārthe dvārapālaśabdāt? lakṣaṇena kenaciṭṭhagvihitaḥ| kvacit? punaḥ `dvārapālasyāpatyaṃ dauvārapālikaḥ` iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra `revatyādibhyaṣṭhak? [[4.1.146]] iti ṭhak| nanu| tatra dvārapālīśabdaḥ paṭhate, na tu dvārapālaśabdaḥ? evaṃ tarhi manyate - dvārapālaśabdastatra paṭhitavyaḥ, sa dvārapālīśabdamapi grāhayiṣyati; `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|29) iti| nyāyāt| ye tu tatra dvārapālaśabdaṃ na paṭhanti, te'patyārthe dauvārapāliritīñantamudaharanti| kathaṃ punadrvārasya gaṇe dvārapālasya bhavati? atrāpi dvārādibhirādyaco viśeṣaṇat - dvārādīnāṃ śabdānāmacāṃ madhye ya ādirajiti| vakṣyamāṇādvā tadādividhejñapikāt| `sauvaraḥ` iti| svaramadhikṛtya kṛto grantha iti `athikṛtya kṛte granthe` [[4.3.87]] ityaṇ| `sauvaryyaḥ` iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` (4.1.1|5) iti ṅīp| `vaiyalkaśaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.53]] ityaṇ| `sauvastikaḥ` iti| `tadāheti māśabdādibhya upasaṃkhyānaṃm` (vā|482) iti ṭhak| `sovargamanikaḥ` [`sauvargamikaḥ` - kāśikā] iti| `āhau prabhūtādibhya upasaṃkhyānam` (vā|483) iti ṭhak|`pūrveṇaiva siddham` iti| vakārasya padāntatvāt? tatraitat? syāt| yadyevaṃ vyutpattiḥ kriyate - svo'dhyāyaḥ svādhyāyaḥ, tadā'padāntatvānna prāpnoti, tasyāṃ vyutpattāvarthavān? svadhyāyaśabdasya pāṭhaḥ? ityata āha - `athāpyevam` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ svaśabdāt? svādhyāyaśabdasya sidhyati? ityāha - `tadādāvapi hi` ityādi| `sphaiyakṛtaḥ`[sphaikṛtaḥ - kāśikā] iti| <<ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca>> [[4.1.114]] ityaṇ| `sauvādumṛdavaḥ`[sovādumṛdavam - kāśikā] iti| atrāpi `tasyaidam` [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| evaṃ `śauvanam` ityatrāpi| `śauvam` iti| <> [[6.4.144]] iti ṭilopaḥ| `śauvādaṃṣṭraḥ` iti| <> [[6.3.137]] iti dīrghaḥ||`naiyagrodhaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.134]] ityaṇ| `nyaga rohatīti nyagrodhaḥ` iti| nyañcatīti ṛtvi [[3.2.59]] gādinā'ñcateḥ kvin, <> [[8.2.62]] iti kutvam - kakāraḥ, neryaṇādeśaḥ| nyakpūrvādrūheḥ pacādyac| tatra `nyaṅkvādīnāñca` [[7.3.53]] iti hakārasya dhakāraḥ, <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti kakārasya gakāraḥ, laghūpadhaguṇaḥ - evaṃ yadā nyagrodhaśabdo vyutpādyate tadā padāntatvādyakārasya `na yvābhyām` [[7.3.3]] ityādinaiva siddhe niyamārthaṃmetat - kevalasyaiva yathā syāt, tadādermā bhūditi| `avyutpattipakṣe vidhyarthametat` iti| apadāntatvādyakārasya||`yaduktam` iti| vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca| `vyāvakrośo` [`vyākrośī` iti mu| pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| `kruśa āhvāne` [`āhvāne rodane ca` - dhātupāṭhaḥ-] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-856), `likha akṣaravinyāse` (dā|pā|1365), `carca adhyayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1712) curādiḥ, `hase hasane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-721) - ebhyo vyavapūrvebhyo ṇac, tadantādañ| atra yathokte kārye pratiṣiddhe vṛddhireva bhavati, dvau pratiṣedho prakṛtyarthaṃ gamayata iti kṛtvā| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp||`svāgatikaḥ` iti| śobhanamāgataṃ svāgatam| `tadāhetyādau prabhūtādibya upasaṃkhyānam` (vā|483) iti ṭhak| `svādhvarikaḥ` iti| atrāpi `carati` [[4.4.8]] iti ṭhak| śobhano'dhvaraḥ svadhvaraḥ| `svāṅgiḥ` ityādi| `svāṅgiṇryāḍiḥ` iti| `ata iṅ` [[4.1.95]] | śobhanānyaṅgānyasya svaṅgaḥ, vigatānyaṅgānyasya vyaṅgaḥ, vigato'ḍo'sya vyaṅaḥ| vyavaharaṇaṃ vyavahāraḥ, bhāve ghañ| nanu ca vyavahāraśabdo'yaṃ kramavyatīhāre vartate, tatra `na karmavyatīhāre` [[7.3.6]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, tat? kasmādiha paṭhate? ityāha - `vyavahāraśabdo'yam` iti| kiṃ punarlaukikam? laukikaṃ punarvṛttaṃ yenācāreṇa vyavahārālloke vyāvahārika ityucyate tadveditavyam| `svāpateyam` iti| <> [[4.4.104]] | kathaṃ punaratra prāptiḥ, yāvatā nāsya vakāraḥ padantaḥ? ityāha - `dbārādiṣu svaśabdapāṭhādasya prāptiḥ` iti| tadādividhinetyabhiprāyaḥ| yatā tadādividhirbhavati tathā tatraivoktam||`āābhāstriḥ āādaṃṣṭriḥ` iti| ova bhastrā yasya, śuna iva daṃṣṭrā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, upasarjanahrasvatvam| kena punaḥ āādervṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti; yato'yaṃ pratiṣedha ucyate, na hrasya vakāraḥ padānataḥ? ityata āha - `āśabdo drārādiṣu paṭhate` iti| nanu ca kevalaḥ āśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭhate, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgau yatastadādeḥ syāt! `yasmin? vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) it tadadividhirti cet? naitadasti; saptamīnirdiṣṭai halgrahaṇe ca sati tadādividhirbhavati, na cātraitadubhayamastītyata āha - `tatra ca` ityādi| yadi tatra tadādividhirna syāt, tadaitat? pratiṣedhavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; prāptvabhāvādityabhiprāyaḥ| jñāpakasaya prayojanam - śauvādaṃṣṭro maṇirityādau vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| `ikārādigrahaṇaṃ kartavyam` iti| ikārāditaddhito gṛhrate, yena tadikārādigrahaṇaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamityāha - `āāgaṇikādyartham` iti| āāgaṇikādīnāmarthaḥ=prayojanaṃ yasmastat? tathoktam| arthastu teṣāmādivṛddhireva| tatraivaṃ vyākhyānam - iñgrahaṇamihekārādestaddhitasyopalakṣaṇārtham, tenānyatrāpi taddhite pratiṣedho bhavatīti| `tadantasya` iti| iñantasyānyannāyīti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'nyatra labhyate, yāvatā'nyatrāpi taddhita utpanna iñaḥ <> [[6.4.148]] iti lopena bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iñīti neyaṃ nimittasaptamī, kiṃ tarhi? parasaptamī| nimittasaptamyāmaṇnimittāya vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedho na syāt| parasaptamyāṃ tu yadyapi lopaḥ kriyate, tathāpi sthānivadbhāvāt? pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati| `āābhastram` iti| `iñaśca` [[4.2.111]] ityaṇ||pūrveṇa nitye prāpte pratiṣedhe vikalpa ucyate| `padāntasya` iti| padaśabdāntasyetyarthaḥ| `āāpadam` iti| śuna iva padamasyeti āpadaḥ, tasyedaṃ āāpadam| `śauvāpadam` iti| <> [[6.3.137]] iti dīrghaḥ||aṅgasyacāmāderaco vṛddhau prāptāyāmidamucyate| nanu ca `avayavādṛtauḥ` [[7.3.11]] ityadau pañcamīnirdeśādantareṇāpyuttarapadādhikāraṃ <> [[1.1.67]] ityuttarapadasyaiva bhaviṣyati, tat? kimuttarapadādhikāreṇa? itayata āha - `yatra` - ityādi| ādiśabdena `hmadbhagasindhvante pūrvapadasya` [[7.3.19]] , `anunnatikādīnāñca` [[7.3.20]] , `devatādvandve ca` [[7.3.21]] - ityevamādayo gṛhyante| eṣu pañcamīnirdeśābhāvādasatyuttarapadādhikāro'ṅgasayācāmāderaca eva vṛddhiḥ syāt, nottarapadasya| tasmāt? tadarthamuttarapadādhikāraḥ kriyate|yadyevam, iha <> [[7.3.11]] ityetannopanyasanīyam, atra pañcamīnirdeśasya vidyamānatvāt? iti codyamāśaṅkyānyārthaṃ kriyamāṇasya yatrāpi pañcamīnirdeśo'sti, tatrāpi prāsaṅkikaṃ kāryaṃmāha - `pañcamīnirdeśeṣvapi` ityādi| prayojanāntaramaparyāha - `vṛddheśca` ityādi| uttarapadādhikāre yā vihitā vṛddhirityeṣa vyapadeśo vṛddheryathā syādityavamakchañcottarapadādhikāraḥ kriyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ vṛddheravyapadeśaḥ prāthryate? ityāha - `uttarapadavṛddhau` ityādi| uttarapadādhikāre vihite vṛddhimatyuttarapade pūrvapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| `uttarapadavṛddhau sarvañca` [[6.2.105]] ityatrottarapadādhikāre yā vihitā vṛddhirityevaṃ vidhāyate| etatkathaṃ śakyate vijñātum? yadi vyapadeśārtha uttarapadādhikāraḥ kriyate, nānyathā| tasmādvyapadeśārthaścottarapadādhikāraḥ kartavyaḥ|| bāla-manoramāuttarapadasya 1376, 7.3.10 uttarapadasya| adhikāro'yamiti| saptame ādivṛddhiprakaraṇe etadādisūtrāṇi| bāla-manoramānañaḥ śucī�ārakṣetrajñakuśalanipuṇānām 1439, 7.3.10 nañaḥ śucīāraḥ| ādivṛddhiprakaraṇe uttarapadasya pūrvasya tu vetyanuvṛttāvidaṃ sūtram| āśaucam - āśaucamiti| aśucerāgatamityarthaḥ| `tata āgata` ityaṇi pūrvapadasyādivṛddhivikalpaḥ| uktrapadasya tu nityā ādivṛddhiḥ| evamagre'pi akṣetrajñāt akuśalāt anipuṇācca āgatamityartho bodhyaḥ| ānaiāryamityatra tu brāāhṛṇāditvādbhāve ṣyañ|`ṛtoḥ` [nāsti - mu| pustake] iti| nedaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? arthagrahaṭhaṇam| tathā hravayayavādityucyate, ṛtoścāyaṃ evāvayadhī bhavati| avayavithyenatau| vijñayamāne'rthanirdeśo'yaṃ vijñāyate, tataścāvayavavācinaḥ pūrvapadāduttarasyarttuvācinaḥ kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `avayavavācinaḥ` ityādi| `ekadeśisamāsaḥ` iti| pūrvāparādisūtreṇa [[2.2.1]] | nanu grahaṭhaṇavatā prāptipadhekena tadantavidhiḥ (vyā|pa|89) pratiṣidhyate, tatkathaṃ varṣāhemantābhyāṃ pratyayo vidhīyamānastadantābhyāṃ lakṣyate? ityāha - `tatra ṛtī vṛddhimadvidhāvavayavānām` iti|`paurvavarṣikaḥ` [paurvavārṣikam - kāśikā] iti| pūrvāśca tā varṣāśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaṃ kṛtvā bhavārthe taddhito vidheyaḥ| pūrvaśabdo'tra kālavācī, na tvavayavavācītyaṅgasyādivṛddhireva bhavatoti| athātrāpi tadantavidhinā ṭhak? kasmānna bhavapati? ityāha - `avayavapūrvasyaiva hi` ityādi||`janapadasya` iti| nevaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam, uttarasūtre `amadrāṇām` [[7.3.13]] iti niṣedhāt| uttarasūtrehīdameva janapadagrahaṇamanuvartate, tato'tra yadi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, madrāṇāṃ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt, tasmādarthasyedaṃ grahaṇam, tena janapadavacinaḥ kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityāha - `susarvārdhaṃ ityetebya uttarasya janapadavācinaḥ` ityādi| `supāñcālakaḥ` iti| śobhanāḥ pañcālā iti prādisamāsaḥ| `sarvapāñcālakaḥ` iti| `pūrvakālaika` [[2.1.48]] ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ| `ardhapāñcālakaḥ` iti| `ardha napuṃsakam` [[2.2.2]] ityardhaśabdena tatpuruṣaḥ| sarvatra śaiṣike jātādāvarthe taddhitaḥ| kathaṃ janapadāt? `janapadatadavadyośca` [[4.2.124]] ityucyamānaḥ pratyayastadantādbhavati? ityāha - `susarvārdhadikśabdebhyaḥ` ityādi||`janapadasya` [[7.3.12]] ityanuvartate, tena prācāmityetaddeśagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate na tvācāryagrahaṇamiti mātvā''ha - `prācāṃ deśe grāmāṇām` ityādi| `purveṣukāmaśamaḥ` iti| pūrvā cāsāviṣukāmaśamī ceti <> [[2.1.50]] iti samāsaḥ, tato bhavārthe <> [[4.2.107]] iti| `pūrvapāṭaliputrakaḥ` iti| pūrvasmin? pāṭaliputre bhava iti pūrvavat? taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| <> [[4.2.123]] iti vuñ| nanu caikameva pāṭaliputram, tatra pāṭaliputrāntarasya vyavacchedyasyābhāvāt, tatkathaṃ pūrvaśabdena pāṭaliputraśabdo viśiṣyate? pāṭaliputraikadeśe pāṭaliputraśabdo vartata ityadoṣaḥ| atha nagaragrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `grāmāṇām` ityevaṃ siddham, nagaramapi hi grāmo bhavatyeva; jananikāyanivāse grāmo rūḍhaḥ, nagarañca jananikāyanivāsa eva, ataśca nagaramapi grāmaḥ, yato ye grāme vidhayo neṣyante, nagare'pi te na kriyante| tathā hi - `abhakṣyo grāmyakukkuṭaḥ`, `abhakṣyo grābhyaśūkaraḥ` - ityukte nāgaro'pi na bhakṣyate; `grāme nādhyetavyam` ityukte nagare'pi nādhīyate, tasmānnagaramapi grāmaḥ| evañca kṛtvā - `udīcyagrāmācca bahvaco'ntodāttāt`, [[4.2.108]] , <> [[4.2.117]] , `dikśabdā grāmajanapadākhyānacānarāṭeṣu` [[6.2.103]] ityatra grāmagrahaṇena nagaragrahaṇamapi bhavatītyāha - `grāmatvādeva` ityādi| yadi tarhi nagaramapi grāmaḥ, tadā `viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ` [[2.4.7]] ityatra nagaragrahaṇaṃ prāpnoti? satyametat, tatra tu nagarāṇāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| sa eva ca sambandhabhedaḥ kuto hetorbhavati, yasya pratipattathe grāmanagarayorbhedenopādānaṃ kriyate! ityāha `dikpūrvapado hi` ityādi| yadi hi yathā dikpūrvapadaḥ pūrvottarasamudāyaḥ pūrveṣukāmaśamyādigrrāmanāmadheyam, tathā nagaranāmadheyamapi syāt, tataḥ sambandho na bhidyeta| yathā ca pāṭaliputrādiśabdarūpamuttarapadabhūtameva nagarasaya vācakam, tathā yadi grāmanāmadheyamapi grāmasya syāt, evamapi sambandho na bhidyeta? na caivam; anyādṛśa eva hi pūrvottarasamudayātamako grāmavācī śabdaḥ, anyādṛśaścotatarapadātmako nagaravācī śabdaḥ| tasmādgrāmanagarayorbhedāt? sambandhabhedo bhavati| evaṃ sambandhabhedahetuṃ darśayitvā sambandhabhedaṃ darśayannāha - `tatra` ityādi| `grāmavācinām` iti| pūrvoṣukamaśamītyevamādīnām| `avayavasya` iti| iṣukāmaśamī-kṛṣṇamṛttiketyevamādeḥ| `dikśabdāt` iti| purvādeḥ| `itaratra tu` ityādi| nagareṣu| `deśa uttareṣāṃ nagarāṇām` iti| atra vṛddhirbhavatītyabhisambandhaḥ kriyata ityetadapekṣyate|| pūrveṣukāmaśana ityevamādiṣu pūrvottarapadayorantaraṅgatvādguṇe kṛte dikśabdogrāmaścottarapadaṃ nāstīti vṛddhirna prāpnoti, vṛddhirhi taddhite kṛte tadāśrayeṇa bhavantī bahiraṅgā bhavati| prāgeva taddhitotpatterguṇaḥ prāpnuvannantaraṅgo bhavati| na ca vacanādvṛddhirbhaviṣyatīti śakyate vaktum, yatra hrekādeśo nāsti sa ca vacanasyāvakāśaḥ - pūrvakārṣṇamṛttika ityevamādau| na cāntāvivadbhāvo'sti; `ubhayata āśraye nāntādivat` (vyā|pa|51) iti pratiṣedhāt| ato'tra pūrvapadamuttarapadañcāśrīyate? iti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `purveṣukāmaśama ityevamādiṣu` ityādi| yathā <> [[7.3.22]] iti nirdeśanāyamartho jñāpitaḥ tathā <> [[7.2.107]] ityatra pratipāditaḥ| `grāmanagarāṇām` iti bahuvacanaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārtham||`dvisāṃvatsarikaḥ` iti| pūrvavat? taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| tataḥ prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ| `dviṣāṣṭikaḥ, dvisāptatikaḥ` iti| nanu ca <> [[5.1.80]] ityatra kālāditi| [[5.1.77]] vartate, na dviṣaṣṭaādiḥ kālaśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? saṃkhyāśabdaḥ, tatkathaṃ kālādhikāravihitaṃ pratyayamutpādayati? ityāha - `dviṣaṣṭaādiśabdaḥ` ityādi| kālavāciśabdastatra kālagrahaṇena gṛhrate, dviṣaṣṭaādiśabdo hi yadā varṣeṣu saṃkhyeyeṣu vartate, tadā kālavācitvāt? kālaśbdo bhavati| tataḥ kālādhikārīyaṃ pratyayamutyādayati| atha saṃvatsaragrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvataḥ <> [[7.3.17]] ityatra parimāṇaśabdena paricchedahetumātra gṛhrate, na tu prasthādivadārohapariṇāhaparicchedahetuḥ, anyathā hi śāṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt, na hi śāṇaḥ parimāṇamārohaparaṇāhaparicchedahetuḥ, ataḥ kālo'pi paricchedaheturbhavati, tataśca so'pi parimāṇamiti saṃvatsaraśabdasya `parimāṇasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ` [[7.3.17]] ityeva siddham? iti codyanirāsāyāha - `saṃvatsaragrahaṇam` ityādi| parimāṇagrahaṇena kālaparimāṇasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ saṃvatsaragrahaṇam| saṃvatsaragrahaṇenāsāvartho jñāpyate - `parimāṇagrahaṇe kālaparimāṇagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati` iti| tataśca yatra parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ tatra kalaparimāṇaṃ na gṛhrate| `tena` ityādinā parimāṇagrahaṇe kālaparimāṇasyāgrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| `uttarapadavṛddhirana bhavati` iti| `parimāṇāntasya` [[7.3.17]] ityādinā| `dvivarṣā` iti| dve varṣe bhṛto bhūto bhāvī vā, pūrvavaṭṭhak, tasya <> [[5.1.88]] ityanuvartamāne <> [[5.1.89]] iti luk| `paryudāso na bhavati` iti| ṅīppratiṣedhe kartavye tena pratiṣedhaḥ| pravartata eveti <> [[4.1.21]] iti ṅībna bhavati||`dve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma kariṣyatati daivārṣiko manuṣyaḥ` iti| atrādhīṣṭabhṛtayostaddhita utpanne bhaviṣyatā pratīyate, tasmāt? tayorapi pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākartumāha - `adhīṣṭabhṛtayoḥ` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na bhavati? ityāha - `gamyate hi` ityādi| tatra yadi śabdāntaram? `dve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma kariṣyati` iti prayujyate, tato bhaviṣyattā gamyate, nānyathā| tasmānnāsau taddhitārtha ityadhīṣṭabhṛtayorabhaviṣyatīti pratiṣedho na bhavati| nanu ca manuṣye'bhidheye <> [[5.1.89]] iti ṭhaño lukā bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ dvivārṣiko manuṣya iti sidhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hrasāvadiśeṣeṇa luk, kiṃ tarhi? viśiṣṭa #eva viṣaye| katham? tatara nityagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, pūrveṇaiva siddha ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ lugbhaviṣyatīti, tat? kṛtaṃ viśiṣṭe viṣaye bhūte yathā syāt, adhoṣṭādī mā bhūdityevamartham| tenādhīṣṭādau <> [[5.1.88]] iti vibhāṣaiva lugbhavati||saṃjñāyāḥ paratvaṃ na sambhavatītyataḥ saṃjñāśāṇayoriti viṣayasaptamīṃ darśayannāha - `saṃjñāyāṃ viṣaye` ityādi| `śāṇe cottarapade` iti| viṣaya ityapekṣate| yadyapyuttarapadasya[yadyuttarapadasya - mudrita pāṭhaḥ] śāṇasya paratvamupapadyate, tathāpi durghaṭamekasyāḥ saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvam, parasaptamītavañceti| tena śāṇaśabdamapyuttarapadaṃ prati viṣayasaptamyeṣā yuktā| `dvikauḍavikam` iti| `prāgvateṣṭhaña` [[5.1.18]] | anārhīyatvācca pratyayasya `adhyarthapūrvadvigoḥ` [[5.1.28]] iti lugna bhavati| `dvisauvarṇikaḥ` [dvisauvaraṇikam - kāśikā] iti| sa eva pratyayaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra vṛddhiḥ, yāvatā parimāṇāntasyetyucyate, suvarṇañca gurutvamānādunmānam, na parimāṇamiti? naiva doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttijrñāyati - `gurutvaparimāṇamapīha paricchedahetutvāt? pūrimāṇaṃ gṛhrate` iti; yadayam? `asaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ` iti śāṇapratiṣedhamāramate| atha `adhyardhapūrva` [[5.1.28]] iti lukkasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `vibhāvā` ityādi| `dvinaiṣkikam` iti| `asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ` (5|120) iti ṭhak| `pāñcalohitikaḥ` [pāñcalohitikam - kāśikā] iti| tasminneva ṭhaki kṛte `bhasyāḍhe taddhite` (vā|731) iti puṃvadbhāvena `varṇādanudāttāt, topadhāt? to taḥ` [[4.1.39]] ityanena vihitayorṅībnakārayornivṛtti| `dvaikulijikam` [dvaikulijikaḥ - kāśikā] iti| prāgvatīyaṣṭhañca||`saṃkhyāyāḥ` [[7.3.15]] iti nivṛttam| ``je` iti jātārtho nirdiśyate` iti| jātaśabdaikadeśasya `je` iti, tasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ| bhavati hi padaikadeśasyāpi prayogaḥ, yathā - bhomo bhīmasenaḥ, satyabhāmā bhāmeti| tasmājjātaśabdasyaikadeśasya prayogeṇa jātārtho nirdiśyata iti vijñeyam| `proṣṭhapadāsu` iti| `lupi yuktatavadvyaktivacane` [[1.2.51]] iti yuktavadabhāvaḥ| `bhadrayādāḥ` iti| bhadrapadena yuktaḥ kāla iti aṇādikāryaṃ pūrvavadvidheyam||`sauhārdam` iti| tasyedam` [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| yadā suhmadayaśabdādaṇ, tadā <> [[6.3.50]] iti hmadbhāvaḥ| `sauhādryaṃm` iti| <> [[5.1.124]] iti ṣyañ, <> [[6.3.51]] iti hmadbhāvaḥ| `saubhāgineyaḥ, dīrbhāginayaḥ` iti| `kasyāṇyādīnāminaṅa ca` [[4.1.126]] iti ḍhaki kṛta inaṅādeśaḥ| `saktusindhavaḥ` iti| śāpakapārthivāditvānmadhyamapadalopo samāsaḥ| `sāktusaindhavaḥ` iti| ordeśe [[4.2.118]] ṭhañi prāpte <> [[4.2.133]] ityaṇ| nanu ca kevalastatra sindhuśabdaḥ paṭhate, kathaṃ tadantādbhavati? ityāha - `tena` ityādi| kathaṃ punastena sindhuśabdena tadantavidhirlabhyate, yāvatā `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti` (vyā|pa|89) iti tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakārastatrānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena sindhuśabdāt? tadantādapi bhavati||`anuśatika` iti| śatena krītaḥ - <<śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate>> [[5.1.21]] iti ṭhan - śatikaḥ, anugataḥ śatikenānuśatikaḥ, tataḥ <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| ānuśātikam, ānuhauḍikam` iti| `carati` [[4.4.8]] iti ṭhak| `ānusāṃvatsarikam` iti| `tatra ca dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat` [[5.1.96]] ityatideśāt? `bahvaco'ntodāttāt` [[4.3.67]] iti ṭhañ| `āṅgāravaiṇavaḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.92]] ityaṇ| `āsihātyam` iti| <> [[4.3.53]] ityaṇ| `āsyahātyam` iti| <<vimuktādibhyo'ṇ>> [[5.2.61]] | `āsyahaitikam` iti pāṭhe `tadasya prayojanam` [[5.1.108]] iti prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ| nanu ca prātipadikāditi vartate, asyahatyāsyahetiśca padasamudāyo'yam, na prātipadikam, tatkathamataḥ pratyayaḥ? satyapi vā pratyaye kathaṃ vibhakteraluk? ityāha - `ata eva` ityādi| `vādhyaugaḥ` iti| `anuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ` [[4.1.104]] | `pauṣkarasādirānuhāratiḥ` iti| <> [[4.1.96]] itīṇ| `kaurukātyam` [kaurukātyaḥ - kāśikā] iti| garagāditvādayañ| `kaurupāñcālaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.53]] ityaṇ| nanu ca janapadaśabdā <> [[4.2.124]] iti vuñā bhavitavyam! ityata āha - `janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena` ityādi| kurupañcālaśabdo hi janapadamudāyavacanaḥ, na ca janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena gṛhrata iti kuto vuñprasaṅgaḥ? `audakaśauddhiḥ` iti| `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] |`aihalaukikaḥ, pāralaukikaḥ` iti| `lokottarapadasya` [lokottarapadācca - iti vartikam](vā|459) iti ṭhañ| etat? `samānasya tadādeśca` ityevamādikāyāṃ kārikāyāmiyamiṣṭiriti paṭhate| `sārvalaukikaḥ` iti| <> [[5.1.44]] | `sārvapauruṣam` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| `sārvabhaumaḥ` iti| <> [[5.1.41]] ityaṇa, añcā| `prāyaugikaḥ` iti| adhyātmāditvāt? (vā|456) ṭhañ| `pārastraiṇeyaḥ` iti| `kulaṭāyā va` [[4.1.127]] itīnaṅ| tatra <> [[4.1.120]] <> [[4.1.126]] ityanuvartate| `rājapauruṣyam` iti| brāāhṛṇāditvāt? [[5.1.123]] ṣyañ| `sautranāḍiḥ` iti| `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] `ābhigāmikaḥ` iti| abhigamamarhatītyārhīyaṣṭhak? [[5.1.62]] | `ādhidaivikam, ādhibhautikam` iti| bhavārthe'dhyātmāditvāt? (vā|456) ṭhañ| `cāturvedyam` iti| ṣyañ| svārthiko vaktavyaścāturvaṇryādisiddhyarthamiti svārthaṃ eva ṣyañ||`āgnimārutīm` iti| agniśca marucceti dvandvaḥ, tau devate asyāḥ - <> [[4.2.24]] ityaṇ; tataḥ pūrvottarayorvṛddhiḥ, <> [[6.3.28]] ityagniśabdasyānaṅviṣaya ikārādeśaḥ, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| `yo devatādvandvaḥ sūktasambandhī ityādi| yaḥ sūktaṃ bhajate sa sūktasambandhī, yasmai havirnirūpyate sa haviḥ sambandhīti| arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ dvandvasya viśeṣaṇam| `iha ca na bhavati` ityādi| kathaṃ panaḥ sāmānyokto satyāmayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate? evaṃ manyate - <> [[7.3.22]] ityatara neti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ, tena sūktasambandhino haviḥsambandhinaścānyatra na bhavatīti| `skāndaviśākhaḥ` iti| <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ| `brāāhṛprajāpatyam` iti| `dityadityādityapatyattarapadāṇṇyaḥ` [[4.1.85]] |`saimendraḥ, āgnendraḥ` iti| <> [[4.2.24]] ityaṇ, `devatādvandve ca` [[7.3.21]] ityānaṅādeśaḥ, pūrvapadasyādguṇaḥ| `aindrāgnam` iti| atrāpi pūrvavadaṇādikāryam| `indraśabde dvāvacau` ityādi| prāgevoktatvāt? subodham||`aindrāvaruṇam, maitrāvaruṇam` iti| `devatādvandve ca` [[7.3.21]] ityānaṅi kṛte dīrghāt? paro varuṇaśabdaḥ||yadyatra prācāmityatrācāryagrahaṇaṃ syāt, tataścottarasūtre [[7.3.26]] `vibhāṣitam` iti na brāūyātetadeva vikalpārthaṃ prācāṃgrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvarttiṣyate| tasmāddeśagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate ityāha - `prācāṃ deśe` ityādi| nagaragrahaṇeneha svarūpagrahaṇam; <> [[1.1.68]] iti vacanāt||`uttaram` ityanenottarapadaṃ lakṣyate; tasya cottarapadasya nityaṃ sannidhānāt? vibhāṣitatvaṃ nopapadyate| tasmāt? tatsambandhinyā vṛddhervibhāṣitatvāt? `vibhāṣitam` ityuktam| ata evāha - `uttarapadasya vibhāṣā bhavati` iti| vṛddhiriti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ||`ārdhadrauṇikam` iti| `arthaṃ napuṃsakam` [[2.2.2]] iti samāsaḥ, <> [[5.1.18]] | atha vāvacanaṃ kimartham, na vibhāṣitamiti [[7.3.25]] pūrvasūtrādanuvartaṣyate, uttaramityanena tat? sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttāvṛttarapadasyaiva vikalpaḥ syāditi cet? naitadasti; utatarapadamityetanna svariṣyate, tuśabdaśceha kriyate, sa niyamartho bhaviṣyati - pūrvasyaiva bhavati, nottarasyeti| evaṃ tahrrakayoge svaratatvakaraṇākaraṇāddhi vāvacanameva ladhīya iti punarvāvacanaṃ kriyate||pūrveṇa parimāṇasya vṛddhirucyamānā akārasyācamādeḥ prāpnotīti pratiṣidhyate| pūrvapadasya tu vikalpo bhavatyeva; pūrvasya tvityanuvṛtteḥ| `ārdhaprasthikaḥ` iti| `ardhaṃ napuṃsakam` [[2.2.2]] iti samāsaḥ, pūrvavat? pratyayaḥ|`kiñca syāt` iti| evaṃ manyate - ākāro hi vṛddhimāneva, tatara nāsti viśeṣaḥ satyasati vā vṛddhiparatiṣedhe, tadeva rūpam, ato'satyapi taparakaraṇe naiva kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata iti| `vṛddhinimittasya` ityādi| yasati taparakaraṇe tatkālārthe yadaniṣṭamāpadyate taddarśayati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syāt? ityata āha - `yatra hi` ityādi| vṛdiṃdha kurvanneva hi taddhito vṛddhinimittaṃ bhavati| tasmādyatra taddhite vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ kriyate sa vṛddhenimittaṃ na bhavati| tena vṛddhinimittasya taddhitasya puṃvadbhāvo na pratiṣidhyata iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt| kva? `yathā` ityādi| `vaiyākaraṇī bhāryā'sya` iti| vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ punaratra `na yvābhyām` [[7.3.3]] ityādinā| atha parasyeti kimarthaṃ, pūrvasya mā bhūditi? naitadasti; ata iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt? pūrvasya na bhaviṣyati| na hi pūrvasyārdhaśabdasyāto'nyo vṛddhimāk? sambhavati, `pūrvasya tu vā` [[7.3.26]] iti ca vikalpaśāsanamanarthakaṃ syāt, yadi tasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam - tadantavidhirmā bhūditi? tadantadidhau satīhāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt - ardhadrauṇikamiti| pūrvastu vidhiḥ - ardhena muṣṭinā krotamardhamauṣṭikam, ārdhamauṣṭikamityevamarthaḥ syāt, paragrahaṇe tu sati yadardhāt? paramanantaraṃ tadevāśritaṃ bhavatīti nāsti tadantavidhiprasaṅgaḥ||pravāhaṇaśabdasya ḍhe pratyaye parata uttarapadasyeti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| pravāhaṇaśabdasaya yaduttarapadamavayavastasyetyarthaḥ| `pravāhaṇeyaḥ` iti| vaheḥ prapūrvāṇṇic - pravāhayatīti pravāhaṇaḥ| ṇijantāt? <> [[3.3.113]] iti kartari lyuṭ, prādisamāsaḥ, <<ṇervibhāṣā>> [[8.4.30]] iti ṇatvam, tato'patyārthe ḍhak| kimarthaṃ punaruttarapadasya vṛddhirvidhīyate, yāvatā vṛddhimavevaitat? yadapyevam, tathāpi vṛddhiravidhātavyā; taddhitasya vṛddhinimittatvāt, <> [[6.3.39]] iti puṃvadbhāvaprataṣedho yathā syāt| yadi hruttarapadavṛddhirna vidhīyate, tato yasmin? pakṣe pūrvapade vṛddhirna vidhīyate tasmin? pakṣe pravāhaṇeyī bhāryā asyeti pravāhaṇeyībhāyaṃ ityatra puṃvadbhāvaprataṣedho na syāt; vṛddheranimittatvāt? taddhitasya| yathā - vaiyākaraṇabhāyaṃ ityatra| nanu cāsatyapi vṛddhinimittatve taddhitasya` <> [[6.3.41]] iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, asti hyatrāpi `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha` (ma|bhā|2|225) iti jātitvam? evaṃ tarhi etajjñāpayati - anityo'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti| tena hastinīnāṃ samūho hāstikamityatra `bhasyāḍhe taddhite` (vā|731) ityaupasaṃkhyānikasya puṃvadbhāvasya pratiṣedho na bhavati||`prāvāhaṇeyiḥ` iti| `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] | `prāvāhaṇeyakam` iti| `gotracaraṇādaṣuñ` [[4.3.126]] | atha kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā ḍhapratyayantasya pravāhaṇeyaśabdasyottarapadaṃ nityaṃ vṛddhimadedeti, tadarthastāvadārambho na yuktaḥ; pūrvapadasya vṛddhervikalpo yathā syādityevamartho'pi naivāsyārambho yujyate; iñādāvapi taddhite tannimittāṃ vṛdiṃdha bādhitvā pūrvasūtreṇa ca nimitta eva vikalpo bhaviṣyati, na hīñādāvutapanne taddhite ḍhasya paratvamapaiti? ityāha - `bāhrataddhita` ityādi| bāhrataddhino nimittaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| bāhṛtvaṃ punaritradestaddhitasya prāvāhaṇeyaśabde'nantarbhāvāt| saivaṃ bāhraṃ taddhitaṃ nimittamāśritya bhavantī bahiraṅgā| prāgeva tu brāāhṛtaddhitotpatterḍhāśrayo vikalpo bhavannantaraṅgastāṃ bādhituṃ na śaknoti| tataśca yadīdaṃ nārabhyeta tadā syādeva| tasmādvikalpārthamidamārabhyate||udāharaṇānyuttaratra vyutpādayiṣyante| `atra kecadahuḥ` ityādi| grahaṇakavākyam| asya `na nañpūrvāt? tatpuruṣāt` iti vivaraṇam| `na nañpūrvāt? tatpuruṣāt` [[5.1.120]] iti tvatalbhyāmanyo bhāvapratyayaḥ pratiṣedhyate, tatrottaraṃ bhāvapratyayamicchatā śūcyādibhya eva, na tu nañsamāsebhya uttaro bhāvapratyayaḥ kartavyaḥ| tasmin?
