kṛte paścānnañsamāsaḥ, tataścāṅgasyāmāderaco vidhīyamānā vṛddhirna prāpnoti| na hi pūrvaṃ bhāvapratyaye kṛte paścānnañsamāse nañ? aṅgasayācāmādirbhavati, uttarapadasyaivāṅgatvāt; ucyate cedaṃ vacanam, tatra vacanasāmarthyādaṅgasyāpi vṛddhirbhavati|`tadapare` ityādi| yaduktamiyaṃ pūrvapadasya vṛddhiraprāptaiva vibhāṣa vidhīyata iti, tadapara ācāryā na kṣamante| kiṃ kāraṇam? ityāha - `bhāvavacanādanyo'pi hi` ityādi| evakāro bhinnakramo vidyata ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| yadi nañsamāsādapatyādiṣvartheṣu vṛddhinimittaṃ bhāvavacanādaparastaddhito na vidyeta, evaṃ bahuvrīheśca nañsamāsādbhāvavacanādanyo'pi na vidyeta; tato yujyate'śuccādiśabdānāmanaṅgatvādaṅgādhikāropamardanena vṛddhivacanasyākṛtārthatvāt| na tvetadevam; vidyata eva hranyo'patyādivvartheṣu nañsamāsādvṛddhinimittasyaddhitaḥ - akuśalasyāpatyamākauśaliḥ, akuśalasyedamākauśalamiti| bahuvrīheśca nañsamāsādbhāvavacano'pi vidyata eva - nāsya śucayo vidayanta ityaśuciḥ, tasya bhāvaḥ, <> [[5.1.131]] ityaṇ - āśaucam| yata evamanyo'pi bhāvavacanāt? taddhito nañsamāsāddhidyate, vṛddhinimittako bahuvrīheśca nañsamāsādbhāvavacano'pi vidyate; tasmāt? tatra kṛtārthatvādvacanasyāṅgādhikārabādhanaṃ ca yucyate|yadapyuktam - `na nañpūrvāt? tatpuruṣādityṛttaro bhāvapratyayaḥ eva`(iti), tadapyayuktamiti darśayannāha - `akṣetrajño'nīāraḥ`[`akṣetrajñānīārau` - kāśikā] ityādi| etau hi dvau śabdau bāhṛṇādiṣu tatpuruṣāveva paṭhaete, tenābhyāṃ tatpuruṣābhyāmeva ṣyañ? bhavati, anyathā hi brāāhṛṇādiṣvanayoḥ pāṭhasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt| tasmādaṅgasyaiveyaṃ vṛddhirnityaṃ prāptā satī bhāvapratyaye, anyatra ca taddhite vikalpena vidhīyate yathāyogam| tatarāśaucamiti yadi tatpuruṣaḥ kriyate - na śuciraśutaciḥ, tadā <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇi kṛte vṛddhiḥ; atha bahuvrīhiḥ - nāsti śucirasyenyaśuciḥ, tato yadi bhāvārtho vivakṣyate tadā <> [[5.1.131]] ityaṇ; atha <> [[4.3.120]] ityartho vivakṣyate, tadā `prāgdīvayato'ṇ` [[4.1.83]] ityaṇ - ānaiāyryam, ākṣaitrajñyamiti| tatpuruṣābhyāṃ brāāhṛṇāditvāt? vyañi kṛte vṛddhiḥ| ākīśalamānaipuṇamiti yadi bahuvrīhirayāpi tatpuruṣaḥ, ubhayathāpi <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇeva| yadyapi kuśalanipuṇaśabdau brāāhṛṇādiṣu yudhādiṣu ca paṭhaete tathāpi tadantāt? tatpuruṣādvahuvrīherapi bhāvapratyayo nopapadyate; tadantavidherabhāvāt|`brāāhṛṇādiṣu nañsamāsāvetau draṣṭavyau` iti| tena nañsamāsābhyāṃ ṣyañ? bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `etau` iti| yathātathā - yathāpuraśabdau| ``yathā'sāvṛśyate` ityavyayībhāvasamāsau` iti| nanu ca `asādṛśya` [[2.1.7]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hyatra sādṛśyaṃ gamyate| tathā hi - yathātathamiti satyamucyate, yathā - puramiti purātanam| kathaṃ punajrñāyate'vayayībhāvasamāsau? ityāha - `tathā hi` ityādi| atra hi `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti napuṃsakāśraya hrasvatvaṃ kṛtam| napuṃsakatvaṃ cāvyayībhāvasya vihitam, tasmādavyayībhāvasamāsāviti jñāyate| `bhāṣye tu` ityādi| ayathātathābhāva iti hrasvatvamakṛtvā vākyaṃ yathā darśitāṃ tathā `supsupā` [[2.1.4]] iti samāso lakṣyate nāvyayībhāvaḥ| avyayībhāve hi napuṃsakāśrayaṃ hrasvatvaṃ syāt| asmastu pakṣe sautratvānnirdeśasya - `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti` (ma|bhā|) iti varṇavyatyayena dīrghasya sthāne hrasvo veditavyaḥ||`taddhiteṣviti nivṛttam` iti| asvaritatvāt| `tatsambaddhaṃ kitītyapi` iti| nivṛttamityapekṣate| tatsambaddhatvaṃ punastasya `kiti ca` [[7.2.118]] ityatra `taddhiteṣu` [[7.2.117]] ityanuvṛtteḥ| yadi punaḥ kitītyanuvartata, tato lakṣaṇe `jāyāpatyoṣṭak` [[3.2.52]] `amanuṣyakarttṛke ca` [[3.2.53]] iti ṭaki kṛte - jāyādhnastilakālaka ityatrāpi syāt| ñṇidgrahaṇaṃ tu pratyayamātreṇa sambaddham| ataḥ `taddhiteṣu` [[7.2.117]] ityetasmin? nivṛtte'pi tadanuvartata eva| `ghātayati` iti| hetumaṇṇic| `hau hanterñṇinneṣu` [[7.3.54]] iti kṛtvam| `ghātakaḥ` iti| ṇdula| `sādhughātī` iti| <> [[3.2.78]] iti ṇiniḥ| `ghātaṃghātam` iti| `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul? ca` [[3.4.22]] , `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavataḥ` (vā|887) iti dvirvacanam| `ghātaḥ` iti| bhāde ghañ? [[3.3.18]] | `adhāni` iti| luṅ, `ciṇ? bhāvakarmaṇoḥ` [[3.1.66]] iti ciṇādeśaśca; `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam, <> [[6.4.104]] iti takārasya luk| `jaghāna` iti| liṭ, tip, tasya ṇal, <> [[7.3.55]] iti kutvam-ghakāraḥ| atheha kasmānna bhavati - vṛtraṃ hatavāniti| `brāhṛbhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvip` [[3.2.87]] , tadantāt? <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ, <<ṣapūrvahandhṛtarājñāmaṇi>> [[6.4.135]] ityallopaḥ - vātrradhnaḥ, bhrauṇadhnaḥ? ityāha - `dhātoḥ` ityādi| dhātorityevamucyārya yo vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa dhātupratyayaḥ| dhātauḥ kāryamucyamānaṃ tatraiva dhātupratyaye bhavati| etacca bhauṇahatyamiti nipātanena [[6.4.174]] jñāpitam| tena vātrradhnaḥ, bhrauṇadhna ityādau na bhavati| na hyatra dhātorityevaṃ pratyayo vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? prātapadikādittyevam||`ciṇi kṛti ca` [`ca` nāsti - kāśikā] iti| ciṇgrahaṇamakṛdartham| akṛttvaṃ tu tasya dvitīyadhātvadhikāre'vihitatvāt| `adāyi, adhāyi` iti| dadātidadhātyoḥ pūrvavalluṅādikāryam| `dāyaḥ, dhāyaḥ` iti| dhañ| `dāyakaḥ, dhāyakaḥ` iti| ṣvul| `dadau, dadhau` iti| <<āta au ṇalaḥ>> [[7.1.34]] ityautvam| `cauṅiḥ, bālākiḥ` iti| cūḍābalākābhyāṃ bāhvādīñ| acāmāderityanuvṛtteratra na bhaviṣyatīti yo manyeta, taṃ pratyudāharaṇāntaramāha - `jñā devatā asyeti jñaḥ` (iti)| <> [[4.2.24]] ityaṇ| atra vyapadeśivadabhāvenācāmādirākāro bhavati| atrāsati ciṇkṛdgrahaṇe satyāmapyacāmāderityanuvṛttau syādevātra yuk| `vyapadeśivadabhāvo'prātipadikena` (śāka|pa|65) ityetacca pratyayavadhiviṣaya eva hruktam||`aśami, atami, adami` iti| `śamu upaśame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1201), `tamu kāṅakṣāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1202), `damu upaśame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1203), luṅādi pūrvavat| `śamakaḥ` ityādau ṇvul| `śamaḥ` ityādau ghañ| `yāmakaḥ, rāmakaḥ` iti| `yama uparame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-984), `ramu krīḍāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-856)| anudāttopadeśāvetau| atha kathamudyamoparamau? ityāha - `udyamoparamau` ityādi| `anugantaśyau` ityādi| sādhutveneti śeṣaḥ| nipātanādeto sādhutvena veditavyāvityarthaḥ|`śamī, tamī, damītyatra yathā syāt` iti| śamādibhyaḥ `śamityaṣṭābhyo dhinuṇ` [[3.2.141]] | asatyupadeśagrahaṇe'tra na syāt; pratyayasvare kṛte dhātoranudāttatvāt| upadeśagrahaṇe tu sati tenādyavasthā lakṣya iti yadyapyutatarakālamanudāttatvaṃ bhavati, tathāpi bhavatyeva pratiṣedhaḥ; upadeśāvasthāyāmudāttatvāt| `iha` ityādi| yadyupadeśagraharṇa na kriyate, tato yāmakaḥ, rāmaka ityatrāpi syāt; `liti` [[6.1.193]] iti pratyayāt? pūrvasyodāttatvavidhānāt| upadeśagrahaṇe tu na bhavati; upadeśe'nudāttatvāt| `anācamikamivamīnāmiti vaktavyam` iti| `kamu kāntau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-443), `ṭuvama udgirarṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-849), `cama chamu, camu, jhamu adane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-469,470,471,472) eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ dhātunāṃ pratiṣedho na bhavatotyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - camestāvadanācameriti sūtra evopādānāt? pratiṣedho na bhavatīti| itarayostu `dhāmadevāṅ ḍaḍaḍaau` [[4.2.8]] , <> [[5.2.65]] iti nipatanāditi| atha kathamāmaḥ? ityāha - `āma ti caurādikasya` ityādi| `ama roge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1720) ityasya caurādikasya ṇici vṛddhau, `erac` [[3.3.56]] ityaci kṛte-āma iti| na hi ṇicyapi vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhavati; tasyāciṇkṛttvāt| akṛttvaṃ tu pūrvavadveditavyam| nanu `janījṛṣksasurañjo'mantāśca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-817 anantaram? ga|sū|) iti mitsaṃjñāyāṃ satyām? `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[6.4.92]] ityaneneha ṇau bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `atra hi bhittvaṃ nāsti` iti| kathaṃ nāsti? ityāha - `nānye` ityādi| yastu bhvādiḥ `ama gatyādiṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-465) paṭhate, ama ityevaṃ tasya bhavitavyam| atha kathaṃ viśrāma iti, na cāyamasādhuriti śakyate vaktum, yataḥ `sūryaviśrāmā bhūmiḥ` iti prayogo da#ṛśyate? ityāha - `evamādikaṃ prayogam` ityādi||vadhirayaṃ hanādeśo'sti, tasyaidaṃ grahaṇamiti kasyacidāśaṅkā syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `vadhiḥ prakṛtyantaram` ityādi| prakṛtyantaramapi bhavan? yadayakārāntaḥ syāt, anarthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, dhopadhatvādeva na vṛddhirbhavatīti matvā''ha - `vyañjanāntasya` iti| kutaḥ punarvidhiḥ prakṛtyantaramastītyetadavasitam? ityāha - `bhakṣakaśca` ityādi| atha hanādeśasyaiva vadherayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `hanādeśasya` ityādi| `jajāna garbham` ityādi| chāndasaḥ prayogaḥ||artīti śtitā nirdeśaḥ| ṛkārāntasya grahaṇaṃ mā vijñāyīti, yathā - <<ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ>> [[7.4.16]] iti| `arpayati` iti| hetumaṇṇic, `pugantalaghūpadhasya` [[7.3.86]] iti guṇaḥ| `hyepayati, vlepayati` iti| `hrī lajjāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1085) `vlo varaṇe (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1502)| `knopayati, kṣmāpayati` iti| `knūyo śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-4|85), `kṣmāyī vidhūnane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-486)| <> [[6.1.66]] iti yakāralopaḥ| `dvayorapi dhātvogrrahaṇam` iti| viseṣābhāvāt| rotyetasyāpi `rī gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1500), `roṅ? śravaṇe` (dhā|pa|1138) - iti dvayorapi grahaṇamityapekṣyate| nanu ca `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|53) iti rīṅo grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atra hralpāctaratvāt? hrovlyātāmanyatamasya pūrvanipāte kartavye `alpāctaram` [[2.2.34]] ityetadanapekṣyārttiśabdasya pūrvaṃ nipātaṃ kurvatā'nyadapi kiñcidiha śāstravacanaṃ nāpekṣyata ityetat? sūcitam| tena niranubandhakaparibhāṣā nāpekṣyata iti rīṅo'pi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ punaḥ puk pūrvāntaḥ kriyate, na parādireva puṅ? vidhīyatām; puṭi sati guṇavidhau pugantagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, <> [[7.3.84]] ityevaṃ siddhatvāt? puṭi; avaśyaṃ puḍgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, anyathā hi <> [[7.2.115]] iti vṛddhiḥ syāditi cet? naitadasti; nāprāpte ṇico vṛrddhi prati nimittatve puṭaṃ pratyāgamitvamucyata ityuttarasya bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nāsti vṛddheḥ prasaṅgaḥ| ayaṃ tarhi parādau doṣaḥ - dāpyate, dāpyata iti - atra ṇerlopenāpahmatatvāt? pakārasya śravaṇaṃ na syāditi? eṣo'pyadoṣa-; na hi ṇilopaḥ sarvāpahārī bhavati, yena ṇernivṛttau puḍāgamo'pi nivartata| pratyayalaśraṇañcāstīti nivṛtte'pi ṇau puṭaḥ śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha - `pukaḥ pūrvāntakaraṇam` ityādi| dāpayaterluṅ, cliḥ, tasya `ṇiśridru ruāubhyaḥ kartara` [[3.1.48]] iti caṅi ṇilopaḥ, `ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ` [[7.4.1]] iti hrasvatvam, `caṅi` [[6.1.11]] iti dvirvacanam, `sanvallaghuni caṅpare` [[7.4.93]] itīttvam, <> [[7.4.94]] iti dīrghatvam - adīdapat| atra yadi puṭ? kriyate tadā hrasvatvaṃ na syāt; anupadhātvāt| puki tu sati bhavati| ato hrasvārthaṃ pukaḥ pūrvāntakaraṇam||`śo tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1145), `cho chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1146), `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1147), `hveñ? spardhāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1008), `vyeñ? saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1007), `veñ? tantusantāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1006), `pā pāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-925), `pai ovai śoṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-920,921)-iti dvayorapi| eṣāmākārāntatvāt? puki prāpte yuko vidhānam| `niśāyayati` ityādi| <<ādeca upadeśe'śiti>> [[6.1.45]] ityāttvam| `pāgraṇe` `pai ovai śoṣaṇe` ityetasyāpi grahaṇamijchanti` iti| yatra hrasya grahaṇaṃ neṣyate, tatra pibaterityāha; yathā - `lopaḥ pibaterīcca` [[7.4.4]] iti bhāvaḥ| atha `pā rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1056) ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `pā rakṣaṇa ityasya tu` ityādi| `lugāgamastu tasya vaktavyaḥ` iti| nanu ca `pāla rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1609) iti curādau paṭhate, tasya pālayatīti bhaviṣyati? satyametata; pukastu nivṛttyartho lugāgama upasaṃkhyāyate, anyathā hi pāteḥ pāyayatīti syāt| `dhūñprīñornugvaktavyaḥ` iti| `dhūñ? kampane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1835), `prīñ? tarpaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1836) iti - etayornugvaktavyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - dhūñ? vidhūnane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1398), `tṛpa prīṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1195) iti nipātanādetayorlugbhaviṣyatīti| `ete'pi` iti| yugādayaḥ| niśāyayatītyādiṣu <<ādeca upadeśe'śiti>> [[6.1.45]] ityāttvam| nyaśīśayadityādīni adīdapadityanena tulyāni, pūrvavalluṅādīni vidhāya vyutpādyāni| `adūdhanat` iti| anakārāntatvādiha sanvadbhāvo'bhyāsasya nāstīti| `apipriṇat` ityatrāpyalaghutvāddīrghatvaṃ nāsti| nanu ca śācchāsāhvāvyāḥ - ityeta ejantā gaṇe paṭhante, tatkathameṣāṃ kṛtāttvānāṃ grahaṇam? ityāha - `śācchāsāhvā`[`śāhvetyādi` - mudritapāṭhaḥ] ityādi| kathaṃ panaḥ kṛtāttvānāṃ grahaṇena pukaḥ prāptirākhyāyate? ākārāntānāṃ pugvidhānāt| `adhyāpayati` ityādinā jñāpasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| adhyāpayatīti <> [[6.1.48]] itvāttvam| ādiśabdena jāpayatītyādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yadu pukaḥ prāptimākhyātuṃ śāprabhṛtīnāṃ kṛtāttvānāṃ garahaṇaṃ kṛtam, tadā veño'pi kṛtāttvasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam? naivaṃ śakyam, vetyucyamāne `pai ovai śoṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-920,921) ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt| tasmādakṛtāttvasyaiva veño grahaṇaṃ yuktam||puki prāpti jugvidhīyate| `vā hatyetasya` iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1050) ityetasya| `vidhūnane'rthe` iti| kampana ityarthaḥ| nanu `vaja vraja gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-252,253) ityasya dhātoṇryantasyopavājayatīti siddham, tatkimarthametat? vāteḥ pugmā bhūdityevamarthaṃ juko vidhānam| `pai orva śoṣaṇa ityetasyaitadrūpam` iti| nanu ca lākṣaṇikasyākārāntatvām, ato jukā na bhavitavyam? naitadasti; idānomeva hruktam - etasmin? prakaraṇe lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā nāstīti||`snehavipātane'rthe` iti| kimidaṃ snehavipātanaṃ nāma? vigacchataḥ snehasaya pātanaṃ vyāpāraṇam| tathā hi - pātevryantasya bhāve lyuṭi kṛte vapītanamiti| `vilīnayati` iti| guṇāyādeśau| atha <> [[6.1.51]] ityattve kṛta ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādvilāpayatītyatra kasmānnugbhavati? ityāha - `lī` ityādi| lī+ī iti īkāro'tra praśliṣyate - īkārāntasyaiva yathā syāt? kṛtāttvasya na bhavati| `lī iti līlīṅogrrahaṇam` iti| nanu ca niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā `lī śleṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1501) ityetasyaiva kraiyādikasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam, na tu `līṅ? śleṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1139) ityetasya daivādikasya? evaṃ manyate - eka evāyaṃ dhāturvikaraṇadvayarthamātmanepadārthañca dvirupadiśyate| evañca kṛtvā `liyaḥ sammānanaśalinokaraṇayośca` [[1.3.70]] ityubhābhyāmātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti| `lā iti lāteḥ, kṛtātvasya ca loyateḥ` iti| grahaṇamiti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ||hetuḥ svatantrasya kartuḥ prayojakaḥ| vibhetyasmāditi bhayaḥ, hetuścāsau bhayaśceti hetubhayaḥ, tasmin? hetubhaye| `ñibhī bhaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1084) ityasya vṛddhau prāptāyāṃ <> [[6.1.56]] ityāttve ca prāpte pakṣe ṇau dhugvidhīyate| `muṇḍo bhīṣayate` iti| <> [[1.3.68]] ityātmanepadam| athāttve kṛte muṇḍo bhāpayata ityatra kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `atrāpi` ityādi||`sphāvayati` iti| `sphāyo, o pyāyī vṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-487,488)||kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā `śadlṛ śātane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1428) ityasmādeva nipātanāt? takāro bhaviṣyatīti? gateranyatra yathā syāt? gatau mā bhūditi cet? na; śātanaśabdo hi gateranyamarthamācaṣṭe| evaṃ tarhi etajjñāpayati - `abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti` (pu|la|pa|vṛ|99) iti| tena purāśabdāt? `sāyañciram` [[4.3.23]] ityādinā vidhīyamānayoṣṭauṭauloḥ `purāṇaprokteṣu` [[4.3.105]] iti nipātanena tudo bādhanaṃ na bhavatītita| tena purātanamityapi siddhaṃ bhavati||`ropayati` iti| `ruha janmani prādurbhāve ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-859)| kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā divādiṣu `rupa lupa vimohane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1236,1237) iti rupiḥ paṭhate, tasya ropayatīti bhaviṣyatī, ruhestu rohayatīti? janmārthe'pi ropayatīti prayogo yathā syāt; anyathā hi vimohanārthasyaiva syāt| anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ rupirjanmani varttiṣyata iti cet? naitadasti; anekārthā hi dhātavaḥ, na tu sarvārthāḥ| na hi rupyatītyukte anmārthaḥ prātīyate, kiṃ tarhi? vimohanārtha eva||`supaḥ paro na bhavati` iti| subantātparo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ cārthaḥ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā veditavyaḥ| `jaṭilikā, muṇḍikā` iti| ajñātādiṣvartheṣu `prāgivāt? kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] | `kārikā, hārikā` iti| ṇvul| `etikā` iti| etadaḥ `avyayasarvanāmnām` [[5.3.71]] ityakac, tyādādyatvam, <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam, ṭāp, akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvam? [[6.1.97]] | `śakā` iti| pacādyac, ṭāp| `sthagrahaṇa vispuṣṭārtham` iti| atra yatra kakāramātraṃ hi pratyayasatatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `kakāramātraṃ hi` ityādi| kāditi varṇagrahaṇam| akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ| na tu kevalaḥ kakāraḥ pratyayo'sti yannivṛttyarthaṃ sthagrahaṇaṃ syāt| `kāt? pratyayāt` ityucyamāne pratyayāvayave pratyayaśabdo varttiṣyate, ato'ntareṇāpi sthagrahaṇaṃ pratyayasthasya kakārasya grahaṇaṃ śakyate vijñātum| tasmādvaspaṣṭārthaṃ sthagrahaṇam| `maṇḍanā, ramaṇā` iti| nandyādabhyo layuḥ (3.1.134| `paṭuka` mṛdukā, gokā, naukā` iti| pūrvavat kaḥ| `rākā, dhākā` iti| `rālā'dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1057,1058) ityasmāddaṣāteśca `kṛdādhārārcikalibhyaḥ kaḥ` (da|u|3|18) ityauṇādikaḥ kapratyayaḥ|`atha` ityādi| codataḥ| `kakāraḥ` itītaraḥ| kakarasya śrutatvāt? tasyaivāpīti viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyaḥ| yenābhiprāyeṇa codakaḥ pṛṣṭavāṃstamāviṣkartumāha - `yadyevam` ityādi| yadyapītyanena kakāro viśiṣyate - āpi parato yaḥ kakāra iti| evaṃ sati kariketyatra na prāpnoti; kakārasyākāreṇāyo vyavahitatvāt| `ekādeśe kṛte` ityādītaraḥ| vyavasarge hi sati vyavadhānaṃ bhavati| na caikādeśe kṛte vyavasargo'stītyato nāsti vyavadhānam| `ekādeśaḥ pūrva` ityādi| codakaḥ| sthānivadbhāvastu <> [[1.1.57]] ityanena| `vacanāt` itītaraḥ| ucyate cedaṃ vacanam, na cāpyanantaraṃ kakāraḥ sakambhavatīti tatra vacanasāmarthyāt sthānivadbhāve kṛte naikena varṇena sarvatra vyavadhānamāśrīyate| yada tarhi vacanasāmarthyāt? kāriketyādau vyavadhāne'pi bhavati, tadārathakaṭaā, putrakāmyetyatrāpi syāt? ityata āha - `rathakaṭaādiṣu` ityādi| rathānāṃ samūhaḥ <> [[4.2.51]] iti kaṭac, tataṣṭāp| putramicchatīti `kamyacca` [[3.1.9]] iti kāmyacpratyayaḥ| `a pratyayāt` [[3.3.102]] tataṣṭāp| tatra śrutikṛtamanekena varṇena vyavadhānamitīttvaṃ na bhavati| `yena nāvayavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt` (vyā|pa|46) ityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrīyate| yena nāvayavadhānamapi tu sarvatra vyavadhānam, tenaikena varṇena vyavahite bhavittuṃ yuktam| sthānivadbhavakṛtamekena varṇena sarvatra vayavadhānamasti, saṅghātena tvasti nāsti ca| tasmāt? tadiha nāśrīyate| `subantādayam` iti| parivrājakaśabdāt? para ābiti pratyayalakṣaṇe subantatā veditavyā| `prasajyapratiṣedhaścāyam` iti| na cetsubantādāp? paro bhavati| kaḥ punaḥ parayudāse doṣo yataḥ sa sāśroyate? ityāha - `paryudāse hi` ityādi| yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt? supo'nyo'sap, tataścodāp? paro bhavatīti; tato bahuparibrāājaketyatrāpi syādevettvam, asubantāt? pūrvottarapadasamudāyāt? para ābiti kṛtvā| asubantatavaṃ punaḥ samudāyasya, tasmāt? sudanutpatteḥ; avayavāddhi parivrājakaśabdādatra subutpattiḥ, na tu samudāyāt| `avidyamānaḥ sub yasmin? so'yamasubityayamapi nāśrīyate` iti| bahuvrīhirapi nāśrīyata ityarthaḥ| kaḥ punastadāśrayaṇe doṣo yataḥ sa nāśrīyate? ityāha - tathā hi` ityādi| evaṃ tarhītyarthaḥ| bahuvrīhau pūrvottarapadayoḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena subantavyapadeśo'stīti nāsāvasupa, api tu vidyamānasubeva| tena bahucarmiketyatra nāsupaḥ para ābitīttvaṃ na syāt| bahūni carmāṇyasyāṃ vidyanta iti bahuvrīhiḥ| <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap, ṭāp| `māmikā` iti| mameyamiti <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ? `tavakamamakau` [[4.3.3]] iti mamakādeśaḥ| nanvaṇantānmamakaśabdāt? `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīpā bhavitavyam, tat? kathaṃ ṭābbhavati? `kevalamāmaketi niyamāt` ityādi| `narikā` iti| `kai ge śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-916,917)| <<ādeca upadeśe'śiti>> [[6.1.45]] ityattvam, <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] , tataṣṭāp| `dākṣiṇātyikā, ihatyikā` iti| dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi bhaveta <> [[4.2.98]] iti tyak| iha bhaveti <> [[4.2.104]] | ubhayatrājñātādiṣvartheṣu <> [[5.3.70]] | upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatrevaṃ pratipādanam - `udīcāmātaḥ, sthāne` [[7.3.46]] ityatra vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt? tyaktyayornityaṃ bhaviṣyatīti||yetayetasya `udīcāmātaḥ sthāne` [[7.3.46]] ityādinā vikalpe prāpte, setyasya pūrveṇa nitye prāpte pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate; prāptipūrvakatvāt? pratiṣedhasya| yadā tayorakajbhavati tadā'yaṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate| `yakā`, `sakā` iti| yattadoḥ pūrvavadakac, suḥ, tyadādyatvañca| `yāseti nirdeśo'tantram` iti| apradhānamityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam? ityāha - `yattadorupalakṣaṇārthametat` iti| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha - `ihāpi` ityādi| yāseti prathamaikavacanāntarūpam| tatara yadyayaṃ nirdeśastantraṃ syāt, prathamaikavacanantayogrrahaṇādvibhaktyantare yakām, takāmityatra na syāt, iṣyate ca tatrāpi| tasmādatantramayaṃ nirdeśo yattadoḥ prātipadikayorupalakṣaṇārthametat - ityucyate| `yāsayorittvapratiṣedhe` ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati - yattadoḥ pratiṣedha ityasmin? kriyamāṇe tyakanpratyayāntasya tyakanpratyayāntasya pratiṣedhapratipādanaṃ kartavyamiti| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - neti yogavibhāgo'tra kriyate, tena tyakanpratyayāntasya pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti| evamuttaratrāpyupasaṃkhaghyānaśabdasya pratipādanārtho veditavyaḥ| pratipādanamapyetadeva yogavibāgakaraṇamāśritaya kartavyam| `upatyakā, adhatyakā` iti| `upādhibhyāṃ tyakannāsannārūḍhayoḥ [[5.2.34]] iti tyakan| `pāvakā` iti| ṇvul| `alomakā` iti| nāsyā lomāni santīti bahuvrīhiḥ| <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap| `jīvakā, nandakā` ti| <<āśiṣi ca>> [[3.1.150]] iti vun| `devakā, yajñakā` iti| devadattayajñadattaśabdābhyāṃ `anukampāyāṃ kan` [[5.3.76]] iti kani kṛte `anajādau ca vibhāṣā lopo vaktavyaḥ` (vā| 614) ityuttarapadalopaḥ| `kṣipakā, dhruvakā` iti| `kṣipa preraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1285), `dhruva sthairye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-943), <> [[3.1.135]] | tadantādajñātādyarthe `prāgavātkaḥ` [[5.3.70]] | `tārakā` iti| taraterṇvul| `varṇakā` tāntavaḥ` iti| tantūnāṃ vikāra iti `orañ` [[4.3.137]] , <> [[6.4.146]] | tāntavaḥ=prāvaraṇaviśeṣaḥ| tatra varṇaketyupasaṃkhyātavyā| `varṇa varṇakriyādhistāraguṇavacaneṣu`[`varṇaṃ` - nāsti mudritanyasapāṭhe] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1938) iti caurādiko dhātuḥ, tato ṇvul - `varṇikā` iti| vyākhyatrītyarthaḥ| `vartakā` iti| `vṛtu vartane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-758), ṇvul| `varttikā` iti| adhyetrītyarthaḥ| `aṣṭakā pitṛdaivatye` iti| pitṛdaivatyam=vaidikakaramaviśeṣaḥ, tatrāṣṭaketyupasaṃkhyāyate| `aśū vyāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1264) ityasmāt? `iṣyasibhyāṃ takan` (da|u|3-30) iti takanpratyayaḥ, vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, ṣṭutvam| `aṣṭakā` iti| aṣṭau parimāṇamasyā iti <> [[5.1.57]] iti `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kam` [[5.1.22]] | `vā sūtakā` ityādi| upasaṃkhyātaśabdasaya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatraidaṃ pratipādanam - sūtakā, sūtikā - ityādayaḥ śabdā pṛṣodarāntaḥpātinaḥ, tena pṛṣodarāditvādevāyaṃ vikalpaḥ siddhaḥ||pūrveṇa nityamittve prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam| yakau pūrve| yasyāḥ sā yakapūrvā| ko'nyapadārthaḥ? samudāyaḥ| tathā hi, pūrvaśabdo'vayave vartate| sa cāvayavaḥ samudāyasya bhavati, nāvayavāntarasya| na hi varṇo varṇasyāvayavo bhavati| avayavāntarāpekṣastu tasya pūrvatvavyapadeśaḥ| tat? punaravayāntaraṃ prakṛtatvāt? sthānyakāra eva vijñāyate| strīliṅganirdeśastu tasya[tasyetyārabhya `tu` iti paryantaṃ mudritanyāse nopalakṣyate] samudāyasyārthadharmeṇa strītvena veditavyaḥ| prayojanaṃ tu tasya vakṣyate| `ātaḥ sthāne` iti| yo'kāra iti vyavahitena sambandhaḥ| `ibhyikā` ityādi| ibhyādiśabdebhyaḥ `prāgivāt? kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] , `ke'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] iti hrasvaḥ| `sāṃkāśyikā` iti| <> [[4.2.121]] | nātrātaḥ sthāne'kāra iti nityamevettvam| atha sthānagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatāt? ityeṣaiva ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogaṃ pratipādayiṣyati, <<ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā>> [[1.1.49]] iti vacanāt? ityata āha - `sthānagrahaṇam` ityādi|| akārasya sthāne lakṣaṇāntareṇa dihitasyākārasya saṃkīrtanamnuvādaḥ| atrāpi sthāne sambandhapratipattiryathā syāt - ityevamarthaṃ sthānagrahaṇam| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam - asati sthānagrahaṇe'nuvāde sambandhapratipattirna syāt? ityāha - `āta ityanena` ityādi| ādeśavidhau <> [[2.4.52]] ityevamādau <<ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā>> [[1.1.49]] ityeṣā paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate, na tvanuvāde; vidhivākyaśeṣabhūtatvādasyāḥ| na cātrākārasya sthāne'kāro'nena vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? lakṣaṇāntareṇābhinirvṛtto'nena viśiṣyate - ātaḥ sthāne yo'kāra iti| tena nātra tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasathānamiti tatra yadi sthānagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadātaḥ samīpo yo'kāra iti sāmīppasambandhapratipattiḥ syāt| atha vā pūrvavat? praśne kṛta ityāha - `āta ityanena` ityādi| ikārasya yaḥ sthānitvenopātto'kāraḥ sa āta ityanena viśiṣyate| evañca viśeṣyatvādakārasya pradhānyam; ākārasya viśeṣaṇatvādaprādhānyam| tatrāsati sthānagrahame yadyapa#i sā paribhāṣānuvāda upatiṣṭheta tathāpi pradhāne kāryasampratyayādāta ityasyā eva ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthānasambandho vijñāyeta, na tvāta ityasyāḥ| sthānagrahaṇe tu satyasyā api vijñāyate - etadarthaṃ sthānagrahaṇam| `aiākā` iti| pūrvavat? kaḥ, hrasvatvañca| atha `yakapūrvāyāḥ` iti strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ krimarthaḥ? ityāha - `strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ| asati tasminnākāramātrasthāne yo'kārastasya sthānitvaṃ vijñāyeta, tataśca yāteḥ śubhambhadraṃśabdayorupapadataḥ `vijupe cchabdasi` [[3.2.73]] iti `āto manibkvanibvanipaśca` [[3.2.74]] iti vic| tadantāt? kapratyaye śurbhayikā, bhadraṃyikā ityatrāpi vikalpaḥ prasajyeta| tasmāt? tannivṛttyarthaṃ strīliṅganirdeśaḥ| śubhambhadraṃśabdau makārāntau nipātau| `yakapūrvāyāḥ` ityādi| grahaṇavākyām| tasya `dhātvantayoryakārakakārayoḥ` ityādi| vivaraṇam| `vaktavyam` iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāddhātvantayorapi yakāravakārayoranantarasyākārasyettvapratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, sa na bhaviṣyatīti| `sunayikā, suśayikā` iti| ṇīñśīṅbhyāṃ `erac` [[3.3.56]] ityac| śobhano nayo'syāḥ, śobhanaḥ śayo'syāḥ - sunayā, suśayā, tataḥ `prāgivāt? kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] , `ke'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] iti hrasvatvam| `supākikā`, `aśokikā` iti| `ḍupacaṣ? pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-996), `śuca śoke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-183), bhāve ghañ| śobhanaḥ pāko'syāḥ, avidyamānaḥ śoko'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ, <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap, <<āpo'nyatarasyām>> [[7.4.15]] iti hrasvatvam||`bhastrakā, bhastrikā` iti| pūrvavat? kaḥ| `abhastrakā, abhastrikā` iti| pūrvavat? kapratyayaḥ, bahuvrīhiḥ, tatapuruṣo vā| atha kasmādeṣā - dve nañpūrve nodāhyiyete? ityāha - `eṣādve nañpūrve na prayojayataḥ` iti| prakṛtatvādittvapratiṣedhavikalpa iti vijñeyam| `kiṃ kāraṇam` iti| anena nañpūrvayoraprayojakatve kāraṇaṃ pṛcchati| `atra hi` ityādinā tatkaraṃ darśayati| `so'ntarvartinyā vibhaktyā` iti| yā'sau samāsārthā vibhaktistayā luptayā'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena sa āpsubantādevaitacchabdād? dviśabdācca paraḥ sampadyate, tenettvasya prāptireva nāsti; `asupaḥ` [[7.3.44]] iti pratiṣedhāt, tatka pratiṣedhavikalpena? tasmādeṣādve nañpūrve na prayojayataḥ| yadyevam, anayaiva yuktyā svaśapabdo'pi na prayojayet? ityata āha - `svaśabdastu` ityādi| yuktaṃ yadeṣādva nañpūrve na prayojayataḥ, atra vyavadhānābhāvāt? subantāt? para āb bhavatīti kṛtvā, na hi prāk? ṭerbhavannakaj? vyavadhāyako bhavitumarhati; svaśabdastu <> [[1.1.35]] iti vacanājjñātidhanayorasarvanāmasaṃjñakaḥ, tena tasmāt? kapratyayenaiva bhavitavyam, nākacā, tatra yadi nañsamāsaṃ kṛtvā kapratyayaḥ kriyate, tadantācca ṭāp, tadāsau subantāt? paro na bhavati; kapratyayena vyavadhānāditi asarvanāmaṃjñakaḥ svaśabdo nañpūrvo'pi vikalpaṃ prayojayati| `bhastretyayamabhāṣitapuṃskaḥ` iti| striyāmeva sarvadā vṛtteḥ| yadyevam, <> [[7.3.48]] ityanenaiva vikalpaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkimarthamihopādīyate? ityata āha - `tasya` ityādi| upasarjanamarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat? tathoktam| yadānupasarjanaṃ bhastrāśabdo bhavati, tadāyamabhāṣitapuṃska iti satyamuttarasūtreṇa siddho vikalpaḥ; tatrāpi nañpūrvāṇāmityanuṣṛtteḥ| yadā tūpasarjanaṃ bhavati, tadā bhāṣitapuṃskatvaṃ pratipadyata iti na sidhyati| tasmādupasarjanasya bhāṣitapuṃskasyāpi yathā syādityevamarthamiha bhastrāśabdasya grahaṇam| `abhastrakā, abhastrikā` iti| `alpe` [[5.3.85]] ityarthe `prāgivāt? kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] `atra` iti| upanyasta udāharaṇe| `upasarjanahrasvatve kṛte` iti| avidyamānā bhastrā'sayā iti bahuvrīhau kṛte <> [[1.2.48]] ityanena| `punaḥ` ityādi| abhastraśabdo hi bahuvrīhiḥ, sa puṃsyapi vartata iti bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati| tasmādyadā ṭāp? sa bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdādutpadayate| tasaya bhāṣitapuṃskādutpannasyāpi ṭāpo yaḥ `ke'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] iti hrasvo bhavati, nāsāvabhāṣitapuṃskādvihitasyātaḥ sthāne bhavati| tasmādabhāṣitapuṃskādityanena na sidhyati - ityabhiprāyaḥ| `nañpūrvāṇāmapītyapiśabdādanyapūrvāṇāṃ kevalānāṃ ca vidhirayamiṣyate` iti| tatrodāharaṇamāha - `nirbhastrikā` ityādi| nirgatā bhastrā yasyāḥ sā nirbhastrikā| vahvyo bhastrā yasyāḥ sā bahubhastrikā| ādiśabdena subhastrakā, subhastrikā; bhastrakā, bhastrikā-ityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yadi tahrranyapūrvāṇāṃ kevalānāṃ ca vidhiriṣyate, tadā `nañpūrvāṇām` iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| nañādipūrvāṇāṃ tadantavidhinā bhaviṣyati, kevalanāñca vyapadeśivadbhāvena; `grahaṇavatā pratipadikena tadantavidhirna` (vyā|pa|89) iti| `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātapadikena` (dhā|pa|pā|65) iti vacanānna sidhyatītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam, ubhe api hrete paribhāṣe pratyayavidhiviṣaye evetyata āha - `atra` ityādi| tadantavadhinā vyapadeśivadbhāvenātra siddhasyaiva prakaravidhernañpūrvāṇāmapīti vacanānuvādaḥ| kimarthaḥ? mandabuddhipratapattyarthaḥ| nañpūrvāṇāmapīti vacanamantareṇa yaḥ pratipattumanantaroktamarthamasamarthastasyāpi mandabuddheḥ pratipattiryathā syādityevamartham||nañpūrvāṇāmapītyanukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ| khaṭvakā, khaṭvikā` iti| pūrvavat? kaḥ| khaṭvāśabdo'yamādiṣṭaliṅgo nityaṃ striyāmeva vartata iti bhāṣitapuṃsko na bhavati| `akhaṭavikā` iti| na khaṭvā akhaṭveti nañsamāsaḥ| `paramakhaṭvikā` ityādi| <> [[2.1.61]] ityāpinā samāsaḥ| sarvatra `ko'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] iti hrasvaḥ| bahuvrīherbhāṣitapuṃskatvādatra na bhavitavyamanena vikalpeneti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarattumāha - `bahuvrīhau` ityādi| kathaṃ punarabhāṣitapuṃskādityucyamāne bahuvrīhau bhāṣitapuṃskādapi bhavati? ityāha - `atrāpyabhāṣitapuṃskāt` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yadyapi bahuvrīherbhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati, tathāpi yadā kapi <<āpo'nyatarasyām>> [[7.4.15]] iti hrasvaḥ kriyate, tadā'bhāṣitapuṃskādeva vihitasyākārasya sthāne yaḥ syādakārastasmādbhavatyeva vikalpaḥ| avidyamānā khaṭvā'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ, `śeṣādvibhādhā` [[5.4.154]] iti kap; tato hrasvaḥ| sa cābhāṣitapuṃskādeva vihitasyākārasya bhavati| tenākhaṭvakā, akhaṭviketi vikalpo bhavatyeva| `yadā tu` ityādi| avidyamānā khaṭvā'syā iti bahuvrīhau kṛta upasarḍajanahrasvatvam; tataṣṭāp| alpā akhaṭveti `prāgivat? kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] - `akhaṭvikā` iti| atra vikalpo na bhaviṣyati; bhāṣitapuṃskatvādvahuvrīhevihitasyātaḥ sthāne'kārasya vihitatvāt| prādisamāse'pi na bhavatīti darśayannāha - `tathā` ityādi| `atikhaṭvikā` iti| atrāpi prādisamāse kṛte, upasarjanahrasvatve ca, punastatpuruṣādbhāṣitapuṃskādvihitasyātaḥ sthāne vihito'kāra iti na pravartate vikalpaḥ||nañpūrvāṇāmapīta nivṛttam; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt| ittvāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ| `ke'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] iti hrasvapavādaśca| ācāryagrahaṇaṃ nityārtham| asati hi tasmin; `udīcām` [[7.3.46]] ityadhikārādvikalpaḥ syāt| ācāryagrahaṇe tu sati tena `udīcām` ityetasminnivarttite, nitya eṣa vidhirbhavatīti||atra yadyaviśeṣeṇa ṭhasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, paṭhitā, paṭhitumityādau dhātvantasyāpi syāt| ata etaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā pratyayasya ṭhasya grahaṇam, na tu ṭhamātrasyeti darśayitumāha - `aṅgasya nimittaṃ yaṣṭhaḥ` iti| aṅgasyeti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| atara yadyapi dhātvavayavo hraṅgasya sambandhī bhavati, tathāpi yadā yato hraṅgasyātmalābho yasminnaṅgamityetadbhavati, sa eva pratyāsatteraṅgasya nimittībhūtaḥ sambandhī gṛhrate, na tvarayavo'pi| `kaścāṅgasya nimittaṃ bhavati` iti| evaṃ manyate - yadi sāmānyenāṅgasya nimittaṃ yattadiha gṛhrate dhātvantasya ṭhasya syādeva, bhavanti hi avayavā aṅgasayāvayavino nimittam; taistasyārabhyamāṇatvādityāha - `pratyayaḥ` iti| asyāyamabhiprāyaḥ - satsvapyavayaveṣu yāvatpratyayo notpadyate tāvattasyāvayavino'ṅgātmalābho na bhavati, tasmastūtpanne sati bhavati; tasmātpratyaya evāṅgasya nimittam, nāvayava iti| `ākṣikaḥ, śālākikaḥ` iti| akṣairdīvyati, [`akṣairdīvyatītyarthe ṭhak - mu| pāṭhaḥ] śalākābhirdīṣyatītyarthe ṭhak| `lāvaṇikaḥ` iti| atrāpi lavaṇaṃ paṇyamasyeti <> [[4.4.52]] |iha ṭhasyeti varṇamātrasya grahaṇaṃ vā syāt? saṅghātasya vā? tatra pūrvasmina pakṣe ṭhasyeti nirdeśo nopadyate; itarasmastvoṇādike'tiprasaṅgaḥ - `kaṇeṣṭhaḥ` (da|u|5-6) kaṇṭha ityādau| iha tu mathitaṃ paṇyamasyeti māthitika iti ṭhasyekādeśe kṛte prakṛteśca <> [[6.4.148]] ityakāralope sati tāntatāyāmupajātāyāmikādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāṭṭhagrahaṇena grahaṇāt? `isusuktāntāt? kaḥ` [[7.3.51]] iti kādeśaḥ prasajyeteti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `ṭhagādiṣu` ityādi| ādiśabdena ṭhañādīnāṃ grahaṇam, yadi teṣu varṇamātramanackapratyayo'kārastūccāraṇārthaḥ, tadā <<ṭhasyekaḥ>> [[7.3.50]] ityatrāpyakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| evaṃ varṇamātraṃ sthānitvenopādīyate| ihāpyakāra uccāraṇārtha eveti varṇamātragrahaṇena yo doṣaḥ parasya codayiṣyataḥ sa varṇamātraṃ sthānitvenopādīyate| ihāpyakāra uccāraṇārtha eveti varṇamātragrahaṇena yo doṣaḥ parasya codayiṣyataḥ sa nirākṛtaḥ| satyapi varṇamātrasya grahaṇe, āgantukenoccāraṇārthenākāreṇa ṭhasyeti nirdeśasyopādānāt| `saṅghātagrahaṇe tu` ityādi| atha ṭhagādiṣu saṅghātaḥ sāckaṣṭhaśabdaḥ pratyayaḥ, evaṃ satyatrāpi sūtre saṅghātasyeti sthānitvena grahaṇaṃ yuktam| yastvasmin? pakṣe prathamo doṣaścodayitumiṣṭaḥ parasya, taṃ jihīrṣurāha - `tatra` ityādi| yo'pyasmin? pakṣe dvitīyo doṣastaṃ `mathita paṇyamasya` ityādinā''viṣkṛtya - `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiḥ` ityādinā pariharati| ajādisannipātena takārāntatopajātā, sā notsahate'jāditvaṃ vihantumiti na bhavati kādeśaḥ| `yasyeti ceti lopasya sthānivadbhāvādvāvādvā` iti| na bhavati kādeśa iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ; sthānivadbhāvena takārāntatayā vihatatvāt| sthānivadbhāvaḥ punaḥ <> [[1.1.57]] ityādinā| pūrvavidhau kartavye sthānivadbhavati, na cātra parvasya vidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvasmāduttarasya, tatkutaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ? ityāha - `pūrvasmādapi` ityādi| na kevalaṃ pūrvasya vidhiḥ pūrvavidhiriti ṣaṣṭhasamāso'bhimataḥ, api tu pūrvasmādvidhiḥ pūrvavidhiriti pañcamīsamāso'pītyabhiprāyaḥ||pūrveṇekādeśe prāpta isādyantāt? kādeśa ucyate| `sarpiṣkaḥ` iti| `tadasya pacyam` [[4.4.51]] iti prāgvahatīyaṣṭhak, rutvavisarjanīyau, visarjanīyasya <> [[8.3.44]] iti ṣatvam| `dhānuṣkaḥ` iti| `tadasya grahaṇam` [[4.4.57]] iti ṭhak| `yājuṣkaḥ` iti| `tena dīvyati` [[4.4.2]] iti ṭhak| `naiṣādakarṣukaḥ, śābarajambūkaḥ` iti| niṣādakarṣvāṃ jātaḥ, śābarajambāṃ jāta iti <> [[4.2.119]] , `ke'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] iti hrasvaḥ| `mātṛkam` paitṛkam` iti| māturāgatam, piturāgatamiti - <<ṛtaṣṭhañ>> [[4.3.78]] | `audaiātkaḥ` iti| <<udaśvito'nyatarasyām>> [[4.2.19]] iti ṭhak| śākṛtkaḥ, yākṛtkaḥ` iti| śakṛtā yakṛtā saṃsṛṣṭe [[4.4.22]] iti ṭhak| atheha kasmānna bhavati - āśiṣā caratītyāśiṣikaḥ, uṣā caratītyauṣikaḥ? ityāha - `isusoḥ` ityādi| `arcisucihusṛpichādichardibhya isiḥ` (da|u|9|30), `janerusiḥ` (da|u|9|37), `arttipṛvapiyajitanidhanitapibhyo nit` (da|u|9|39) ityādinā prakaraṇena yau vihitau tayorlakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) pratipadoktayorisusogrrahaṇam| tenāśiṣikaḥ, auṣika ityatrāpi na bhavati; lākṣaṇikatvādisusoḥ| tathā hrāṅapūrvāt? `śāsu icchāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1022) ityasmāt, `vasa nivāse` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1005) ityetasmācca kevalāt? kvipi kṛte <<śāsa idaṅhaloḥ>> [[6.4.34]] samprasāraṇe parapūrvatve ca kṛta isusati rūpaṃ pratipadyate| `āśiṣikaḥ, auṣikaḥ` iti| `śāsivasidhasīnāṃ ca| [[8.3.60]] iti ṣatvam| tasya tvasiddhatvāt? kādeśa prāptirāśaṅkitā| `doṣa upasaṃkhyānam` iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - `nañpūrvāṇāmapi` [[7.3.47]] ityato'pagarahaṇamanuvartate; sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena doṣo'pi bhaviṣyati||`pākaḥ, tyāgaḥ` iti| bhāve ghañ| `pākyam, vākyam` iti| ṛhalorṇyat [[3.1.124]] | nanu cātra ghiṇṇyatoḥ kāryiṇoścajoḥ sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti - cakārasya ghiti, jakārasya ṇyati, tatkathaṃ tyāgaḥ, rāga iti dhiti jakārasya kutvaṃ prāpnoti? naitadasti; jñāpakādatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| yat <> [[7.3.61]] , <> [[7.3.62]] iti ghañi jakārasya kutvābhāvaṃ nipātayati, `tena raktaṃ rāgāt` [[4.2.1]] iti ca nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati - yathāsaṃkhyamiha na bhavatīti ||adhiṇṇyadartho'yamārambhaḥ| `nāvañcaterityupratyayaḥ` iti| tatra `bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanidhanimimasjibhya uḥ` (da|u|1|92) ityanuvṛtteḥ| `madguḥ` iti| `ṭumasjo śuddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1415), <> [[8.4.53]] iti sakārasya dakāraḥ| `mimasjibhya uḥ` iti| anena `bhṛmṛśītṛcari` (da|u|1|92) ityādikamupalakṣayati| `bhṛguḥ` iti| `bhrasja pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1284)| `prathibhradi` (da|u|1|113) ityādike sūtra'ta eva sūtrā(da|u|1|92)dupratyayo'nuvartate| `dūrepākaḥ`[`dūrepākāḥ` - mu|pāṭha] iti| karmakartari pacādyac| `ukārāntāvapera` iti| adhīyata ityapekṣyate| `tañcateḥ` iti| `tancu tvancu gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-191,192) iti, `vancu pralambhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1703) `sphāyitañcivañci` iti sūtraikadeśaḥ `sphāyitañcivañciśakikṣipikṣudisṛpidṛpitṛpivanyundiiātivṛtyajinīpadimadimudikhidibhidichidimandicandidahidasidambhivahavasivāśiśīṅhasasidhiśubhibhyo rak` (da|u|8|31) ityetat? sūtramupalakṣayati| `vyatiṣaṅgaḥ` iti| `ṣanja saṅge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-987) `avasargaḥ` iti| `sṛja visarge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1178) pacādyaca| `medhaḥ` iti| `miha secane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-992)| ajeva| `āpākaḥ` iti| karmopapadādaṇpratyayaḥ `karmaṣyaṇ` [[3.2.1]] ityanena| `arhateḥ` iti| `arha pūjāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-740)| `daheḥ` iti| `dahabhasmīkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-992)| `ruheḥ` iti| `ruha bījajanmani prādurbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-859)|nanu ca nyaṅkvādayaḥ kṛtakutvāḥ prātapadikagaṇe paṭhante, tatkimarthamidam, yathaiva hi kutvādanyat? kāryaṃ bhavati nipātanāt? tathā kutvamapi bhaviṣyati? tasyaiva prātapadikapāṭhasyābhyanujñānārthamitadamucyate| asati hratasmin? pramādapāṭho vijñāyateta||`dhātayati` ityādyudāharaṇāni <<hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ>> [[7.3.32]] ityatra vyutpāditāni| `dhnanti` iti| laṭ, jherantādeśaḥ, `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityādinopadhālopaḥ| `dhnantu` iti| loṭ| `adhvan` iti| laṅ, `itaśca` [[3.4.100]] itīkāralopaḥ|`prahāraḥ, prahārakaḥ` iti| haraterghañṇavulau| iha ṇinnagrahaṇaṃ hantiviśeṣaṇaṃ vā syāt - ñṇinnakāraparasya hanteryo hakāra iti, hakāraviśeṣaṇaṃvā - ñṇinnakāraparasaya hakārasyeti sa ceddhanteriti? tatra yadi pūrvakaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, dhnantyādau na syāt, na hyatra nakāraparo hantiḥ; avayavena samudāyasya paurvāparyānupapatteḥ, anyasya nakārasyābhāvāt| athetaraḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, na kvacit? syāt, na hi hakārasya ñṇinnakāraparatā sambhavati| asambhavastu dhnantatyādāvakāralopasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāve satyakāreṇa vyavadhānāt, ghātayatītyādāvapi hakārāt? pareṇa hantyavayavenānaśabdena vyavadhānāt| atha vacanasāmarthyādvyavadhāne'pi kṛtvaṃ syāt, evamapi hananamicchatīti `supa ātmanaḥ kyaca` [[3.1.8]] , <> [[7.4.33]] itīttvam, kyajantāṇṇavul, <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopo hananīyaka ityatrāpi syāditi yaścodayet, taṃ prati pakṣāntaramāśrityāha - `ñṇitpratyayo'tra hanterviśeṣaṇam` ityāda| na hi sarveṣāṃ ñṇinnakārāṇāṃ hanta prati viśeṣaṇatvamupapadyate, nāpi hakāraṃ prati| tasmādyathāsambhavaṃ kiñcideva kasyacidviśeṣaṇam| ñṇitpratyayastu hanteḥ parataḥ upapadyate iti tasyāsau viśeṣaṇam - ñṇiti pratyaye parato'nantarasya hanteriti| nakārastu hanterviśeṣaṇa~ nopapadyate; pūrvoktāt? kāraṇāt| ikārasya tūpapadyata iti tasyaiva viśeṣaṇam - nakāre paratonantarasya hantihakārasyānantara iti| ayaṃ tu <> [[1.1.66]] iti nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāllabhyate| ānantaryāśrayaṇe tu - hantā, hantumityatrāpyatiprasaṅgo nirastaḥ| nanu cānantaryameva hakārasya ṇakāreṇa na sambhavati, akāralopasya sthānivadbhāve satyakāreṇa vyavadhānāt? ityata āha - `tacca` ityādi| `sannipātakṛtam` iti| śrutikṛtamityarthaḥ| nanu cāśrite'pi sannipātakṛtānantarye sthānivadbhāvaśāstreṇa yat? kṛtamanānantaryaṃ tadvihanyādeva kutvam? ityata āha - `sthānivadbhāvaśāstrakṛtaṃ tu` ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇamavidhātakam? ityāha - `vacanasāmarthyāt` iti| yadi sthānivadbhāvaśāsatadrakṛtamanānantarya vyavadhāyakaṃ bādhakaṃ syānnakāravacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; niravakāśatvāt| tasmādvacanasāmarthyānna vighātakam| `yadyapi` ityādinā yau dvau pakṣāvupanyastau, tatra dvitīye pakṣe yo doṣastasya parīhāraḥ| tatra nakāreṇa hakāre viśeṣyamāṇe yo doṣaḥ sa pūrvameva parihmataḥ| samprati tu ñṇitpratyayena hakāre viseṣyamāṇe yo doṣastaṃ pariharati| yo'yaṃ hanteravayavo hakārāt? paro'kārādirnakārāntaḥ, tena sarvatra ñṇitpratyayasya vyavadhānam| ananīyaśabdena tu cyavadhānaṃ sambhavati, na sambhavati ca tatra `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'ti vacanaprāmāṇyāt` (vyā|pa|46) iti ghātayatītyādau kutvaṃ bhavati| yena tvananīyaśabdena vyavadhānaṃ na sambhavati, sambhavati ca tena vyavadhāne hananīyaka ityatra na bhaviṣyati| ādye tu pakṣe yo doṣa uktaḥ, sa tasyānabhyupagamādevānavasaraḥ| hanteḥ śtipā nirdeśo dhātunirdeśārtha eva, na yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ| tatra hi <> [[7.3.55]] iti bhavitavyameva kutvena||`jighāṃsati` iti| san, <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghaḥ, dvirvacanam, <> [[7.4.62]] iti cutvam - jhakāraḥ; <> [[8.4.54]] iti jaśtvam - jakāraḥ, `sanyataḥ` [[7.4.79]] ittīttvam| `jaṅghanyate` iti| <<nugato'nunāsikāntasya>> [[7.4.85]] iti nuk| jaghāna` iti| uttamapuruṣeṇali yadā ṇitvaṃ nāsti tadedamudāharaṇam| ṇittvapakṣe tu pūrveṇaiva siddham| agra hananaśabdāt? kyaci kṛte tadantāt? sani jihananīyiṣatītyatra kasmānna bhavatīti, bhavati hravābhyāsāt? paro hantihakaraḥ? ityāha - ihābhyāsanimittapratyaye` ityādi| iha `hanteḥ` [[7.3.54]] ityanuvartate, aṅgasyeti ca| abhyāsenābhyāsanimittaṃ pratyayaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ, tasya pratyayaḥ viśeṣaṇimittatvāt, tatra tenābhyāsanimittena pratyayena hanteraṅgaṃ viśiṣyate| `abhyāsanimitte[abhyāsanimitte pratyeye hanteraṅgasya - kāśikā] pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ hantiḥ` iti| tenāpyevaṃvidhena hantinābhyāso viśiṣyate| yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya hanteraṅgasya yo'bhyāsaḥ - ityevaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve satyabhyāsanimitte sanādau pratyaye hanteraṅgasya yo'bhyāsastasmādeva kutvena bhavitavyam| `teneha [`tena` nāsti - kāśikā] na bhavati - `jihananīyiṣati` iti| na hratarābhyāsanimitte pratyaye sani hantiraṅgam, kiṃ tarhi? hananīyaśabdaḥ| yasmastu hantiraṅgam, lyuṭi sa nābhyāsanimittm||`prajighīṣati` iti| `hi gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1257) san, pūrvavaddīrghatvam| `prajedhīyate` iti| `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ, dvirvacanam, <> [[7.4.82]] ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| `prajighāya` iti| ṇal, vṛddhyāyādeśo| `prācīhayat` iti| hetumaṇṇica, `ṇiśri` [[3.1.48]] ityādinā caṅādeśaḥ, `ṇau caṅyupadhāyāḥ` [[7.4.1]] iti hrasvaḥ; `caṅi` [[6.1.11]] iti dvirvacanam| tacca `ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivadbhavati` (cāṃ|pa|21) iti hiśabdasaya <> [[7.4.94]] iti dīrghaḥ| `caṅyamyāsanimitte` ityādi| prājīhayadityatra caṅyabhyāsanimitte parato yo ṇic? tasmin? hinotiraṅgam, na tu tasminneva caṅyabhyāsanimitte; iha sūtre'byāsādhikārāt| abhyāsenākṣipte''bhyāsanimitte pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ hinotirityevaṃ vijñāyate, evañca vijñāyamāne kaḥ prasaṅgo yo vyadhikasya caṅi syāt? naivaṃ prāpnotīsyato nārtho'caṅīti pratiṣedhena| evaṃ pratyākhyāya caṅgrahaṇam, tasya prayojanamāha - `tatkriyate` ityādi| kiṃ punaranena jñāpyate? ityāha - `heracaṅi` ityādi| `heracaṅi` ityādi| `heracaṅi` ityanena caṅo'nyatra sanādau ṇyadhikasyāpi hinoteḥ kutvaṃ bhavatītyeṣo'rtho jñāpyate| `tena` ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `prajighāyayiṣati` iti| prahāyayitumicchatīti ṇyantāt? san||`jigīṣati jigāya` iti| <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti parasyāderjakārasya kutvam, `jyā vayohānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1499) ityasya liṭ| grahijyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.16]] samprasāraṇe kṛte parapūrvatve ca jiratyeṣa rapaviśeṣo bhavati| atastasyāpi kutvaṃ prāpnoti, jigrahaṇena grahaṇāt| na ca śakyate vaktum, `halaḥ` [[6.4.2]] iti dīrghatve kṛte jigrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt; (vyā|pa|16) anyathā hi jigīṣatītyatrāpi <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghatve kṛte jigrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati| atha vā - prāgeva dīrghāt? paratvāt? kutvena bhavitavyamiti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `jināteḥ` ityādi| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) `ji jaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-561) iti yaḥ paṭhate, tasyaivedaṃ pratipadoktasya grahaṇam, na jināteḥ| samprasāraṇe kṛte yajjīrūpaṃ sampadayate, tasya lākṣaṇikatvāt| `jijyatuḥ, jijyuḥ` iti| `liṭ, atus, us, <<eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya>> [[6.4.82]] iti yaṇādeśaḥ||<> [[7.3.52]] iti kutve prāpte pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate| `kūjaḥ, khajaḥ, garjaḥ` iti| `kūja avyakte śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-223), `kharja vyathane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-229) `garja śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-226)||`samājaḥ udājaḥ` iti| `aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-230)| <> [[3.3.69]] iti ghañ| `parivrājaḥ, parivrājyam` iti| `vaja vraja gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-252,253)| athājeṇryati kasmādudāharaṇaṃ nopanyastam? ityāha - `vībhāvasya` ityādi| tatra `ajevryaghañapoḥ` [[2.4.56]] iti vībhāvasya vidhānamiti; tena tasyodāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate, tato na darśitamityabhiprāyaḥ| cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena vajerapi pratiṣedho bhavati - vājaḥ, vācyamiti||`bhujaḥ` iti| `bhuja pālanābhyavahārayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1454), `halaśca` [[3.3.121]] iti dhañ| atra `ave tṛstrorghañ` [[3.3.120]] ityato ghañanuvartate| `nyubjaḥ` iti| yadā dakāropadha ucyate `udja ārjave` iti tadā dakārasya bakāro nipātyate| atha vā - `asiddhebha udjeḥ` [`iyavaraṭ` sūtrasthametat? vacanaṃ mahābhāṣye] ityanayeṣṭaā dakārasya bhakāre kṛte jaśtvena bakāro bhavati| yadi tu bakāropadhaḥ `ubja ārjave` iti tadā samudga itayatara bakārasaya dakāro vaktavyaḥ||`prayājaḥ, anuyājaḥ` iti| prapūrvādanupūrvācaca yajeḥ <> [[3.3.19]] iti ghañ? tasminna kutvaṃ nipātyate| `pradarśanārtham` iti| anyasyāpyevaṃprakārasyopalakṣaṇārthamityarthaḥ| tenānyatrāpi prayājānuyājaprakāre yajñāṅge kutvaṃ na bhavati| pradarśanārthatā punaḥ prayājānuyājaśabdayoryajñāṅgagarahaṇādveditavyā, taddhyevamarthaṃ kriyate| kathaṃ nāma prayājanṛyājagarahaṇasyopalakṣaṇārthatā pratīyeta! [pratīyate - prāṃu| pāṭhaḥ] anyathā hi nipātanasāmarthyādeva yajñāṅgaviṣayatā vijñāyata iti tanna kartavyameva syāt||`vañcam` iti| `vañcu cañcu tañcu tvañca mruñcu mlañcu bhrucu mlucu gatyarthāḥ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-189-196)| karmaṇi ghañ| vañcyaṃ vañcanti gantavyaṃ gacchantītyarthaḥ| `caṅkam` iti| `halaśca` [[3.3.121]] iti ghañ||`nyokaḥ` iti| nipūrvāt? `uca samavāye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1223) ityasmāt? `igupadhajñaprīkiraḥ kaḥ` [[3.1.135]] - nyucatīti nyokaḥ, nivasatītyarthaḥ| nyucantyasminniti `ghañarthe kavidhānam` (vā|306) iti vā kaḥ - nyokaḥ, nivasantyasminnityarthaḥ| `kimarthaṃ punaḥ` ityādi| evaṃ manyate - rūḍhiśabdo'yam, nātra kaścidavayavārtho'sti, vyatpattiḥ kevalaṃ kartavyā, sā ca `halaśca` [[3.3.121]] iti ghañyapi kṛte bhavatyeva, tato nārtho'nena yogeneti| `ghañi satyādyudāttaḥ syāt` iti| <<ñnityādirnityam>> [[6.1.197]] ityanena| atha divaukasaḥ, jalaukasa ityādau kathaṃ kutvamṣa yāvatā nātra kapratyayo'sti, nāpi dhiṇṇyatau, kiṃ tarhi? asunniti? ata āha - `divaukasaḥ` ityādi| gatārtham||`avaśyapacyam` ityādi| `ḍupacaṣ? pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-996), `vaca paribhāṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1842), `āvaśyakādhamaṇryayorṇiniḥ` [[3.3.170]] ityanuvṛttau <> [[3.3.171]] ityāvaśyake ṇyat| mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt? [[2.1.71]] samāsaḥ, `lubhyedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye tumkāmamanasorapi` (kāśikā 6.1.149) ityanayeṣṭaā'vaśyamo makāralopaḥ||`ṇye` ityeva| anāvaśyakārthamidam| `yājyam` ityādi| `yaja devapūjādau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1002), `ṭuyāc? yācñāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-863), `ruca dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-745), `vaca paribhāṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1842) prapūrvaḥ, `ṛca stutau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1302)| kathaṃ punaṝceṇryat, yāvatā `ṛdupadhāccākḷpi cṛteḥ` [[3.1.110]] iti ṇyadapadādeva kyapā bhavitavyam? ityāha - ṛdupadhāt` ityādi| atha pravacigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <<vaco'śabdasaṃjñāyām>> [[7.3.67]] ityanenaiva pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati? ityāha - `pravacigrahaṇaṃ śabdasaṃjñārtham` iti| syādetat| nāstyeva kaścicchabdo yasya vācyamiti nāmadheyam? ityāha - `pravācyo nāma` ityādi| `apare punaḥ` ityādinā matāntaraṃ darśayati| `etattu` iti| avivākyametadrūpam| kaḥ punarasau viśeṣaḥ? ityāha - `daśarātrasya` ityādi| yasmin? yājñikā na vibrāuvate, tasya daśarātrasya yaddaśamāhastatraivaitacchaśabdarūpamiṣyate, nānyatra| yadyevam, anarthakaṃ niyamārthaṃ pravacigrahaṇam, avaśyaṃ tasya viśiṣṭaviṣaye vuttiryathā syādityavamartho yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ, tata eva yatnāt? tatra kutvamapi bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; niyamāddhyanyopasargasya kutvapratiṣedho nivartate| abhidheyavyavasthā tu prasiddhivaśādeva vijñāsyate| `ṇyati pratiṣedhe` ityādi| ṇyati pratiṣedhe'smin? kriyamāṇe `tyaja hānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-986) ityasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasaya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam - cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena tyajerapi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti||prapūrvasya nipūrvasya ca `yujir? yoge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1444) ityasya ṣyati kutvābhāvo nipātyate, sa ceṇṇyacchakyārthe bhavati| śakyārthe punaṇryat `śaki liṅ? ca` [[3.3.172]] ityanena veditavyaḥ| tatra hi <> [[3.3.171]] ityanuvartate| atha kimarthaṃ punarnipātanam, yāvatā `ṇye` [[7.3.65]] ityanuvartata eva? tatra `prayujaniyujoḥ śakyarthe` iti vaktavye nipātanaṃ rūḍhartham| aguṇabhūtā yatra śakyārthatā tatra yathā syāt - prayojyo bhṛtyaḥ, niyojyo dāsa iti| svamini prayojyo niyojya iti na bhavati| na hi tatra prayojyaniyojyaśabdau rūḍhau, kiṃ tarhi? guṇabhūtādeva||`bhojyam` iti| `bhuja pālanābhyavahārayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1454) ityasya ṇyati bhakṣye'bhidheye kutvābhāvo nipātyate| `bhojyā yavāgūḥ` iti| nanu ca bhakṣirayaṃ kharaviśade'bhyavahārye vartate, na tu dravadravye, yathā - <> [[4.2.16]] ityatra, tatkathaṃ `bhakṣye` ityucyamāne yavāgvāṃ bhavati? ityāha - `iha bhakṣyam` ityādi| nāvaśyaṃ bhakṣiḥ kharavirāde vartate| tathā hi - dravadravye'pyasya prayogo drṛśyate| yathā - ababhakṣaḥ, vāyubhakṣaḥ, vāyubhakṣa iti| tasmādabhyavahāryasāmānye bhakṣirvartata iti yavāgvāmapi bhavati| `bhujo bhakṣye` iti vaktavye nipātanaṃ rūḍhartham| abhyavahārye bhakṣye karmaṇi yathā syāt? paripālanīye mā bhūt - bhogyā apūpāḥ| pālanīyā ityarthaḥ||`dadan` iti| `ḍudāñ? dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1091), liṅarthe leṭ? [[3.4.97]] , jherantādeśaḥ, [[7.1.3]] , <> [[3.4.97]] itīkāralopaḥ, <<leṭo'ḍāṭau>> [[3.4.94]] ityaṭ, śap, tasya juhotyāditvāt? śluḥ `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam, saṃyogāntalopaḥ, [[8.2.23]] `ṅamo hrasvāvaci ṅamuṇṇityam` [[8.3.32]] iti ṅmuḍāgamaḥ| `somodadadgandharvāya` iti| dadātespip, śeṣaṃ purvavat| `yadagniragnaye dadāt` iti| dadā+āditi sthite'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvam? [[6.1.97]] śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| yadyāḍāgame [`yadyaḍāgame` - prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] kṛte satyapi lope ca dadāditi sidhyati, kimarthaṃ tarhi vetyucyate? ityāha - `tatra` ityādi| syādetat - visṣṭārthaṃ tarhi vāgrahaṇaṇayuktam; vadādityasya rūpasyāsidiṃdha pratyāśaṅkāyā abhāvāt? ityata āha - `eṣā hi` ityādi| subodham|`niśyati` ityādi| `śo tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1145), `cho chedane`[`nāstyayaṃ dhātuḥ` - mudritagranthe] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1146) `do avakhaṇḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1148) `ṣo antakarmaṇi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1147)| atha kimarthaṃ iyanītyucyate, na `śiti` ityevocyeta, evaṃ hrucyamāne śyanyeva lopo bhaviṣyati, na hrokārāntācchyano'nyacchit? sambhavati, laghu caivaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ - `ṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti` [[7.3.75]] ityatra śidgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavatītyetadeva tatrānuvarttiṣyate? satyaṃ sidhyatyeva, kintu pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| tasmāt? pratipattigauravaparīhārārthaṃ śyanītyuktam| `otaḥ` iti| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham| na hranyadasya nivarttyaṃ vidheyaṃ vā sambhavati||`adhukṣātām, adhukṣāthām` iti| duherluṅ, cliḥ, `svaritañitaḥ` [[1.3.72]] ityātmanepadam, ātāmāthām, `śāla igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ` [[3.1.45]] iti ksādeśaścleḥ, tasyānena <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] lopaḥ, `dāderghātorghaḥ` [[8.2.32]] iti hakārasya dhakāraḥ, `ekāco vaśo bhaṣ` [[8.2.37]] ityādinā bhaṣ - dhakāraḥ, `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - dhakārasya kakāraḥ `iṇkoḥ` [[8.3.57]] iti ṣatvam| `adhikṣi` iti| uttamapuruṣaikavacanamiṭ| `adhukṣat` iti| tip, `itaśca` [[3.4.100]] itīkāralopaḥ| `adhukṣatām` iti| `tasthasthamipām` [[3.4.101]] ityādinā tasastām| kakārakta upādānam, iha mā bhūt - haṃsau haṃsāḥ, ṣatsau, vatsā iti||`duha prapūraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1014), `diha upacaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1015), `liha āsvādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1016), `guhū saṃvaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-896) - sarvaṃ ete svaritetaḥ| svaritettvāt? `svaritiñitaḥ katrrabhiprāye kriyāphake` [[1.3.72]] ityāmanepadinaḥ| `adugdha` iti| pūvavaddhakaraḥ, `jhaṣastathordho'yaḥ` [[8.2.40]] iti takārasya dhakāraḥ, <> [[8.4.53]] iti dhakārasya gakāraḥ| `adugdhām` iti| thās, pūrvavad? dhatvādi| `adugdhvam` iti| dhvam| `aduhvahi` iti| vahiḥ| `adigdha` iti| pūrvavad? ghatvādi| `alīḍha` iti| hakārasaya `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhakāraḥ pūrvavat, takārasya dhatvaṃ ṣṭutvañca, <<ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ>> [[8.3.13]] , `ḍhralopaḥ pūravasya [[6.3.110]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `nyagūḍha` iti| etadapi pūrveṇa tulyam| `vyatyapukṣata` iti| `puṣa puṣṭau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1182) vyatipūrvaḥ| `kartari karmaṇyatihāre` [[1.3.14]] ityātamanepadam, <<ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si>> [[8.2.41]] iti ṣakārasya kakāraḥ| `ajukṣāmāhi` iti| mahiṅa| atha luggrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā lopa ityanuvartata eva? ityāha - `lopa iti vartamāne` iti| yadi lopagrahaṇamanuvarttya lopo vidhīyate tat? <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityantyasya syāt| ki tu sarvasyaiva bhavati; pratyayādarśanasya luksaṃjñāvidhānāt| tasmāt? sarvasya ksasya lopo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ luggrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| `vahrartham` iti| uttamapuruṣadvivacanārthamityarthaḥ| vahirarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat? tathoktam| athānyārthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `anyatra tu` ityādi| yadātmanepadaṃ dantyādi tatsarvaṃ jhalādyeva| tatrāntyasyaivākārasya lope kṛte <> [[8.2.26]] iti sakārasaya lopeneṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva| syādetat - anyatrāpi lukā vinā na sidhyati; akāralopasya sakāralope kartavye `acaḥ parasmin? pūrvavidhau` [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadabhāvāditi? ata āha - `sthānivadbhāvo'pyakāralopasya nāsti` iti| kasmānnāsti? ityāha - `pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat` iti| tasmānnānyārthaṃ luggrahaṇam, api tu vahrarthameva| atra hrajhalāditvāt? <> [[8.2.26]] iti sakāralopo nāstīti na sidhyati|`nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi luggrahaṇe vahau lukā na bhavitavyameva, adantyāditvāt, na hi dantyauṣṭhao vakāro dantyagrahaṇena guhrate? ityāha - `dantyauṣṭhao'pi` ityādi| atraiva hetumāha - `yadi` ityādi| yadi dantyauṣṭhyau dakāro dantyagrahaṇena na gṛhret, tadā tāvityevaṃ brāūyāt, na dantya iti| tāvapyucyamāne sarvamiṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva| na hi tadargādanyaddantyamātmanepadasyāsti| tasmāddantyauṣṭhao'pi vakāro dantyagrahaṇena gṛhrate| tatredaṃ codyate - yaduktam - `anyatra hrantyasyaiva lope kṛte <> [[8.2.26]] iti sakāralopeneṣṭaṃ siddhyatyeveti, tadayuktam; na hi <> [[8.2.26]] ityanena sakāramātrasya lopo vidhiyate, kiṃ tarhi? sicaḥ, tathā hi tatraiva vakṣyati - `ayamapa sica eva lopaḥ`` iti? naitadasti; sijgrahaṇasya clyādeśasyopalakṣaṇārthatvācclertha ādeśastatsambandhina eva sakārasya lopo bhavatītyayaṃ tatrārtho veditavyaḥ||bahuvacananirdeśādaṣṭagrahaṇāccādyartho gamyata ityāha - `śamādīnām` ityādi| `śamu upaśame (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1201), `tamu kāṅkṣāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1202), `damu upaśame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1203), `śramu tapasi khede ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1204) `kṣamu sahane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1206), `bhramu anavasthāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1205), `klamu glānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1207), `madī harṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1208) - ityete'ṣṭau śamādayaḥ| `asyati` iti| `asu kṣepaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1209)| aṣṭābhyaḥ pareṇāyaṃ paṭhate| `bhramati` iti| `vā bhrāśa` [[3.1.70]] ityādinā śyan? yasmin? pakṣe nāsti tatredaṃ pratyudāharaṇam| śyangrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| śakyate hi <> [[7.3.71]] iti yat? prakṛtaṃ śangrahaṇaṃ talluggraṇeva vyavahitamapi maṇḍūkaplatinyāyenehānuvartayitum||`ṣṭhivu nirasane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1110) `klamu glāgau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1207), `camu chamu jamu jhamu adane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-469-472) āṅpūrvaḥ| `klāmati` iti `vā bhrāśa` [[3.1.70]] ityādinā śyano'bhāve śap| `klamigrahaṇaṃ śavartham` (iti| na tu śyanartham, tatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| `camerāṅpūrvasya` ityādinā kevalasyānyopasargapūrvasya vā mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ camerāṅpūrvasya grahaṇamiti darśayati||`krāmati` iti| `kramu pādavikṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-473)| `ākramate` iti| āṅpūrvaḥ| <<āṅa udgamane>> [[1.3.40]] ityātmanepadam| `ihotkrāma, saṅkrāma` ityādinā codyam| utpūrvāt? sampūrvācca kramerloṭa `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] iti hirādeśaḥ, tasya <> [[6.4.105]] iti herluki kṛte <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇaniṣedhāt? utkrāma saṅkrāma` ityatra dīrghatvaṃ na prāpnoti; na hrasati pratyayalakṣaṇe hau lupte kramaḥ parasmaipadaparatā sambhavati| `naiṣa doṣaḥ, ityādi parīhāraḥ| syādetat? lumatā lupte kramaḥ pratyaye hāveva karamiratrāṅgamityāha - `na ca kramiraṅgam` iti| śapā vyavahitatvāt| `kiṃ tarhi? `śapi` iti| śapa eva tato vyavahitasya vidyamānatvāt||`icchati` iti| <> [[3.1.77]] | `gacchati, yacchati` iti| `kartari śap` [[3.1.68]] |atha kimartham, `iṣu icchāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1351) ityetasyodito grahaṇam? ityāha - `iṣeḥ` ityādi| `iṣa gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1127) ityasya daivādikasyeṣyatītyatra mā bhūt| `iṣa ābhīkṣṇye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1525) ityasya kraiyādikasaya iṣṇātītyatra mā bhūdityevamarthamukārānubandha iṣiriha gṛhrate|ye tarhīṣimuditamiha na paṭhanti, teṣāmiṣyati, iṣṇātītyatrāpi prāpnoti? ityata āha - `ye tviṣimuditam` ityāda| ya iṣimukārānubandhaviśiṣṭamiha na paṭhanti; ta iṣyati, iṣṇātītyatra cchatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham, <> [[7.3.72]] ityato'jgrahaṇamanuvartayanti| anuvartamāne'pyasmin? yadi tena śitītyetadviśiṣyate - śita ccho bhavati, kiṃ viśiṣṭe? ajādāviti, tadeṣṇāterloṭsipo hītyādeśe kṛte <> [[3.1.83]] iti śnāpratyayasya śānajādeśe kṛte sati iṣaṇetyatra `yasmin? vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) iti tadādividhinā chatvaṃ syādeveti manyamāna āha - `tacca pradhānamangrahaṇaṃ śitītyanena viśiṣyata iti varṇayanti` iti| aci ccho bhavati sa cecchidbhavati| prādhānpaṃ punarajgrahaṇasya viśiṣyamāṇatvādeva| `tathā ca sati` ityādi| evamacītyasmin? pradhāne śitītyanena viśiṣyamāṇe tadādividhirna bhavati| kiṃ kāraṇam? ityāha - `yasmin? vidhiḥ` ityādi| na kevalaṃ <> [[1.1.72]] ityetadeva tadantavidhānaṃ viśeṣaṇeneṣyate, api tu `yasminvidhistadadāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) ityetadeva tadādividhānaṃ viśeṣaṇenaiveṣyate| tena ca tadādividherabhāvādaṣāṇetyatra chatvaṃ na bhavati| asatyapi tadādividhau śānajadeśasya yo'yamādirākārastatra śiti parataśchatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `na hrayam` ityādi| śakāraḥ samudāyānubandhaḥ, nākārasyācaḥ| tasmānnājeva śit, api tu samudāya eveti na bhavati cchatvam||`pā pāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-925), `ghrā gandhopādāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-926) `dhmā śabdāgnisaṃyogayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-927), `ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-928), `mnā abhyāse` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-929), `dāṇ? dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-930), `dṛśira prekṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-988); `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ, (dhātupāṭhaḥ-936), `ṛ sṛ gatau ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1298,1099); `śadlṛ śātane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1428), `ṣadlṛ vaśaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1427) taudādakaḥ, `ṣadlṛ? viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-854) bhauvādikaḥ - eṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ sthāne yathāsaṃkyaṃ pibādaya ādeśā bhavanti| nanu ca dvau sadī, tatra vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; eka eva hi sadirvikaraṇadvayārtha dviyapadiśyate| `śīyate` iti| <<śadeḥ śitaḥ>> [[1.3.60]] ityātmanepadam|`atha vā` ityādi| `pibaterlaghūpaghaguṇaḥ prāpnoti` ityatra parihārāntaram| yadyādyadātto na nipātyeta, tato dhātusvareṇāntodāttatve sati <> [[8.2.5]] iti śapā sahaikadeśe sati <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatve udātte kṛte pibatīti madhyodāttaṃ padaṃ syāt, ādyudāttañceṣyate, tasmādādyudātto nipātyate| sa nipātanasvaro dhātusvarasaya bādhako yathā syāt| `sarttaḥ` ityādi| vegaḥ=javaḥ; sa yasyāsti sa vegī, tasya bhāvo vegitā, tasyāṃ gatau sarterdhāvādeśamicchanti| sa ca `lugvā duhadiha` [[7.3.73]] ityādeḥ sūtrādvāgrahaṇānuvṛtteṣryavasthitavibhāṣātvāllamyata iti veditavyam| arttisartīti śitapā nirdeśo dhātunirdeśārtha eva, na yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ| na hi yaṅaluki śitparaḥ sambhavati; adādatvat? tato vihitasya śapo lugvadhānāt| <> [[7.4.78]] iti śapo lagna bhaviṣyatīti cet? na, chandasa yathādṛṣṭānuvidhānāt| arttiprabhṛteśchabdasi yaṅluki śabantasya prayogādarśanāt||`janerdevādakasaya grahaṇam` iti| dvau janī - daivādikaḥ `janī prādurbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1149), jauhotyādikaḥ `jana janane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1105) iti| tatraiha daivādikasya grahaṇam, netarasya| na hi tataḥ paraḥ śit? sambhavati, śluvidhānāt| dīrghoccāraṇasya prayojanamuttaratra vakṣyati||`vlī gatau vṛditi yāvat? kecidicchanti` iti| teṣāṃ tataḥ pareṇa paṭhitayoḥ `vrī varaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1504), `bhrī bhaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1505) - ityetayohryasvatvena na bhavitavyam - vrīṇāti, bhrīṇātīti| nanu lvādīnāṃ parisamāptyarthaṃ tadvṛtkaraṇam, anyathā ā gaṇāntāt? tebhyo niṣṭhānatvaṃ syāt, lvādiparisamāptyarthe ca tasminnāgaṇāntāḥ pvādayo yuktāḥ? ityata āha - `vṛtkaraṇam` ityādi| na hrubhayagaṇaparisamāptyarthatā kenacidvirudhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ|`apare` ityādi| lvādergaṇasyānantaratvāt? tatparisamāptyarthataiva vṛtkaraṇasya yukteti bhāvaḥ| teṣāmevamicchatāṃ vrī varaṇe, bhro bhaye - ityetayorapi bhavitavyaṃ hyasavatvena vriṇāti, bhriṇātoti; pvādiṣūbhayorantarbhāvāt| `jānātītyatra hrasvaḥ prāpnoti` iti| talyāpa pvādyantarbhāvādityāha - `jñājanorjā` ityādi| yadi `jā` ityādeśe kṛte hyasavaḥ syāt? tadā dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, `ja` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| tasmāt? dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyajjānātītyatra hrasvo na bhaviṣyati| nanu ca dīrghoccāraṇaṃ janyarthaṃ syāt, na hi janerja ityādeśe kṛte jāyata iti rūpaṃ sidhyati? ityata āha - `ja ityapi hrādeśe kṛte` ityādi| yeṣāntūbhayagaṇaparisamāptyarthaṃ vṛtkaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ kimarthaṃ jā iti dīrghoccāraṇam? jānātītyatra dīrgho yathā syāt? naitadasti; <> [[7.3.101]] iti dīrgho bhaviṣyati? nanu ca `aṅgavṛtte punarvṛttāvavidhirniṣṭhitasya` (vyā|pa|38) iti na prāpnoti? naitadasti; `niṣṭhitasya` ityucyate, na ca ja ityādeśe kṛte niṣṭhitamaṅgaṃ bhavati; aprayogārhatvāt| pratipattilāghavārthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇam||`pramiṇanti` iti| `hinu mīnā` [[8.4.15]] iti ṇatvam, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ| mīnāteriha vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ `mīñ? hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1476) ityasya kraiyādikasya grahaṇaṃ yathā sāt, `mīṅ? hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1137) ityasya daivādikasaya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham| `mīñaḥ` iti nirdeśo na kṛto vaicitryārthaḥ||`ñimidā snehane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-743,1243) iti bhauvādiko daivādikaśca, tatra divāderiha grahaṇam; itarasva hraṅittvācchapaḥ <> [[7.3.86]] ityevaṃ guṇaḥ siddhaḥ| `midyate` iti| <> [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam, <> [[3.1.67]] ||ikātra sannihitena prakṛtamaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhirbhavatītyata āha - `igantasya` ityādi| `ajuhavuḥ` iti| laṅ, `sijabhyastavidabhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] iti jherjus, śapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam| `abibhayuḥ` iti| `ñibho bhaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1084)| `abibharuḥ` iti| `ḍu bhṛñ? dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1087), `bhuñāmit` [[7.4.76]] ityabhyāsasyettvam| `cinuyuḥ sunuyuḥ` iti| liṅ, yāsuṭ? jherjus, <> [[3.1.73]] <> [[6.1.96]] iti pararūpatvām| `tatra nāprāpte` ityādi| sārvādhātukamāśrayo yasyatat? sārvadhātukāśrayam| ṅittvaṃ nimittaṃ yasya pratiṣedhasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa sarvatraiva jusi prāpnotīti tasminnāprāpte'yaṃ guṇa ārabhyamāṇastasyaiva bādhako bhaviṣyati; na tu yasya yāsuḍāśrayaṃ ṅittvaṃ nimittam, tasyāpi| atra hi prāpte cāprāpte'yamārabhyate| cinuyurityādau prāpte, ajuhavurityādāvaprāpte| cakāraḥ samuccaye| nānyat? samuccetavyamastītyasyaiva lakṣaṇasya punarāvṛttimācaṣṭe| tena prakṛtalakṣaṇasyāpi pratiṣedhaviṣaye bhavati| `adīdhayuḥ` iti| `dīdhīṅ? dīptidevanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1076), laṅ? vyatyayena parasmaipadam, jhiḥ, <> [[6.1.6]] ityabhyastasaṃjñā, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] iti jherjus, adāditvācchapo luk| tataḥ <> [[7.3.84]] iti guṇaḥ prāptaḥ, sa <> [[1.1.5]] iti pratiṣiddhaḥ, so'pyanena punaḥ prāptau <> [[1.1.6]] iti pratiṣiddhaḥ samuccayārthatvāccakārasya bhavati||`cetā, stetā` iti| tṛc| `ṛduśanaspurodaṃso'nehasāñca` [[7.1.94]] ityanaṅ, `sarvanāmasthāne` [[6.4.8]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoriti kim`? iti| evaṃ manyate - pratyaya iti vaktavyam, saṅīti vā, evaṃ hrucyamāne bhavatītyādau guṇaḥ siddha eva, saṅīti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ sanaḥ sakārādārabhya mahiṅo ṅakāreṇa| `agnitvam` iti| <> [[5.1.119]] iti tvapratyayaḥ| `agnikāmyati` iti| <> [[3.1.9]] iti kāmyac| `yadi ityādi| yadi pratyaya ityucyeta, tvākāmyacorapi syāt| athāpi saṅītyucyeta, kāmyaci syāt; tasyāpi pratyāhare'ntarbhāvāt||`jāgarayati` iti| ṇic| `jāgarakaḥ` iti| ṇvul| `sādhujāgarī` iti| tācchīlye ṇiniḥ| `jāgarañjāgaram` iti| `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul` [[3.4.22]] , `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavataḥ` (vā|887) iti dvirvacanam| `jāgaro vartate` iti| bhāve dhañ| etāni vṛddhiviṣaya udāharaṇāni| `jāgaritā, jagaritavān` iti pratiṣedhaviṣaye| kiṃ pūnaḥ kāraṇaṃ vṛddhiviṣaye pratiṣedhaviṣaye caivopanyastānyudāharaṇāni? ityata āha - `vṛddhiviṣaye pratiṣedhaviṣaye ca` ityādi| vṛddhipratiṣedhaviṣayādanyatra pūrvasūtreṇa guṇaḥ siddho bhavati| tasmādavṛddhipratiṣedhaviṣaye'yaṃ guṇa ārabhyate, tena tadviṣayāṇāmevodāharaṇānāsupanyāsaḥ| jāgarayatītyādau guṇe kṛte raparatve ca <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhyā bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirakarttumāha - `tasmin? kṛte` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tasmin? kṛte na bhavati? ityāha - `yadi hi` ityādi| yadyasmin? kṛte'pi guṇe <> [[7.2.116]] iti vṛddhiḥ syāt, jāgarayatītyādikaṃ rūpaṃ na syāt, tathā cānarthako guṇaḥ syāt; <> [[7.2.115]] ityanayaiva vṛddhyā siddhatvāt| `ciṇṇalośca` ityādi| ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedhasyetat? prayojanam - vṛddheḥ śravaṇaṃ yathā syāt| yadi tu kṛte'pi guṇe <> [[7.2.116]] iti syāt, ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ yāt; astvatra guṇaḥ, satyapi tasmin? punarupadhāyā iti vṛddhyā bhavitavyam, tataśca vṛddheḥ śravatraṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `ajāgāri` iti| luṅ, cliḥ, `ciṇbhāvakarmaṇoḥ` [[3.1.66]] iti cleściṇ, <> [[6.4.104]] iti takārasya luk| `jāgṛtaḥ, jāgṛthaḥ` iti| laṭ, tasthasau, tayoḥ <> [[1.2.4]] iti ṅittvam, adāditvācchayo luk| `vīti kecidikāramuccāraṇārthaṃ varṇayanti` iti| kiṃ punarevaṃ satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, yata evaṃ vyācakṣate? āha - `kvasāvapa` ityādi| yadi samudāyastha veḥ pratyayasyevaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, kvāsau guṇapratiṣedho na syāt| yadi tvikāra uccāraṇārtho varṇamātrasyaivedaṃ grahaṇam, tadā `yasmin? vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) iti tadādividhinā kvāsāvapi guṇapratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati| `jajāgṛvān` iti| liṭaḥ <> [[3.2.107]] iti kvasurādeśaḥ, `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num, `jajāgṛvān` iti| liṭaḥ <> [[3.2.107]] iti kvasurādeśaḥ, `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num, <> [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| `kecit` iti vacanāt - apara uccāraṇārthaṃ na varṇayantītyuktaṃ bhavati| ta evaṃ manyante - chāndasaḥ kvasuḥ, liṭ? ca chandasi sārvadhātukamapi bhavati; <> [[6.4.86]] iti vacanāt? tataḥ <> [[1.2.4]] iti ṅittvādeva paryudāso bhaviṣyatīti| `ajāgaruḥ` ityādi| evaṃ manyate - <<jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu>> [[7.3.85]] iti ṅittvādeva paryudāso bhaviṣyatīti| `ajāgaruḥ` ityādi| evaṃ manyate - `aviciṇṇalṅitsu` iti prasajyapratiṣedho'yam - viciṇṇalṅitasu na bhavatīti, tataścājāgarurityatrāpi `jusi ca` [[7.3.83]] ityanenāpi prāptasya guṇasyā pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti| evamahaṃ jajāgaretyatra <<ṇaluttamo vā>> [[7.1.91]] iti vacanāṇṇittvaṃ yadā nāsti tadā `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukāyoḥ` [[7.3.84]] iti guṇa iṣyate, so'smāt? pratiṣedhānna prāpnoti| `na` apratiṣedhāt` iti parihāraḥ| nāyaṃ doṣaḥ; kutaḥ? apratiṣedhāt| aprasajyapratiṣedhā dityarthaḥ| yadi prasajyaprataṣedho na bhavati, kastahrrayam? ityāha - `aviciṇṇālṅitsviti paryudāso'yam` iti| prasajyapratiṣedhe hi lakṣaṇāntareṇāpi prasaktasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, na paryudāse| tathā hi paryudāse viciṇṇalṅidbhyo'nyatra guṇo vidhīyate, na tu teṣu viciṇṇalādiṣu pratiṣidhyate| paryudāsaścāyam| tasmājjusi ṇali ca guṇo bhavatyeva| abhyupetyāpi prasajyapratiṣedhaṃ parahārāntaramāha - `atha vā` ityādi| `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā| pa|19) ityānantaryāt? jāgra iti yā prāptistasyā ayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, yā tu `jusi ca` [[7.3.83]] ityādinā lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāptiḥ sā na pratiṣidhyate| `ajāgaruḥ` iti| laṅ, <> [[6.1.6]] ityabhyastasaṃjñā, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] iti jherjus||pugantasyāṅgasya, laghūpadhasya cetyubhāvapi bahuvrīhī - puganto yasya tat? tathoktam, ladhvī upadhā yasya tallaghūpadham| `bhettā, chettā` iti| nanu ca pratyayāderhalo'ṅgāvayavasya cānantarye sati <> [[1.4.11]] iti gurusaṃjñayā laghusaṃjñāyāṃ vādhitāyāṃ guṇenātra na bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `pratyayādeḥ` ityādi| <> [[3.2.140]] , <> [[1.2.10]] iti knusanoḥ kitkaraṇasyaitadeva prayojanam - gṛdhnuḥ, vibhatsatītyādau guṇo mā bhūditi| yadi pratyayāderhalo'ṅgāvayavasya cānaktarye sati laghūpadhaguṇo na syāt? tayoḥ kittvaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtañca, tasmāt? knusano kittvaṃ kurvatā - pratyayāṅgāvayavayorhalorānantarye'pi laghūpadhaguṇo na vyāvarttyata iti jñāpitametat| nanu ca sanaḥ kittvaṃ sisṛkṣatītyatrāmāgamo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt? naitadasti; yadi hretat? prayojanamabhimataṃ syāt? tatraivaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt - sūjadṛśorjhalyamakitsanoriti| tasmāt sanaḥ kitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakameva yada laghūpadhalyānena guṇo vidhīyate| evaṃ sati <> [[1.1.3]] ityasyā upasthāne sati yatra tatra sthitasyeko guṇaḥ prasajyeta, tataścehāpi prāpnoti - bhinattīti, bhavati hratara laghūpadhamaṅgam| na ca śakyate vaktum - <<halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ>> [[1.1.7]] iti saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ laghūpadhametanna bhavatīti guṇo na bhaviṣyatīti| yajjñāpitametadidādhīmeva - pratyayāderaṅgāvayavasaya ca halorānantarye sati laghupadhaguṇo na vyāvarttyata iti? ata āha - `upadhā cātra` ityādi| ikparibhāṣayā hyatrakaḥ sanidhāpitatvādigevopadhā gṛhrate, tena bhinattītyatra guṇo na bhavati; na hyatrāṅgasyegupadhā, kiṃ tarhi? akāraḥ| `apare tu` ityādio| sūtrārtha varmayantī ta vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| puki antaḥ pugantaḥ - `saptamī` [[2.1.40]] iti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| antaśabdo'yamavayavavacanaḥ, puki parato'vayava ityarthaḥ| kasyāvayavaḥ? `aṅgasya` ityanuvṛtteḥ pugiti vacanātpugāgamavato'ṅgasya| na punaḥ puganta ikparibhāṣopaśtānādigeva veditavyaḥ| `ladhvī upadhā laghūpadhā` iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `pugantalaghūpadham` iti| samāhāradvandvo'yam| `sūtrārtham` iti| tūtrārthaikadeśe sūtrārthaśabdo vartate, na hretāvāneva sūtrārthaḥ, aparisamāptatvāt| aparisamāptistu pugantasya tasyāśca laghūpadhāyā guṇo bhavatītyasya sūtrārthasyaikadeśasyānabhidhānāt| `varṇayanti` iti| vyācakṣata iti| bhinattītyatra guṇo mā bhūdityevamartham| na hyatra sūtrārthe bhinattītyatra guṇaḥ prasajyeta| bahuvrīhau hrāśrīyamāṇe'ṅgasyānyapadārthasya yo nāma kaścidik? tasya yatra tatrāvasthitasya guṇaḥ prasajyeta| bahuvrīhau hayaśrīyamāṇo'ṅgasayānyapadārthasya yo nāma kaścidik? tasya yatra tatrāvasthitasya guṇaḥ prasajyeta| tatpureṣe tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, tatra hi laghūpadhegbhyāmaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, atastasyā eva guṇo vidhīyate - aṅgasya yā lagha#ūpadhā ik? tasyā guṇo bhavatīti| bhinattītyatrayā'ṅgasya laghūpadhā nāsāvik, yaścek? sa yadyapi laghurbhavati laghurbhavati na tvasyopadhā| tasmāt? tatpuruṣa āśrīyamāṇe neha guṇasya prasaṅgaḥ| sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayorityeva - `aganicittvam, agnicitakāmyati`| pugantagrahaṇaṃ laghūpadhārtham||`nenijāni, vevijāni, pariveviṣāṇi` iti`| `ṇijir? śaucapovaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1093) `vijir? pṛthagbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1094) `viṣu vyāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1095)-ebhyo loṭ, mip? <> [[3.4.89]] , <<āḍuttamasya picca>> [[3.4.92]] ityaṭ, <> [[2.4.75]] iti śapaḥ śluḥ, `śalau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam, <> [[7.4.75]] ityābhyāsasya guṇaḥ| `anenijam, avevijam, paryaveṣiṣam` iti| laṅ, `tasthastamipāṃ tāntantāmaḥ` tāntantāmaḥ` [[3.4.101]] iti mipo'mbhāvāḥ| `vedāni` iti| `vida jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1064)| `pūrvavalloḍādi yathāyogam, adāditāvācchapo luk| `nenekti` iti| laṭ, tip, <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam| atha pidgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'piti sārvadhātuke <> [[1.2.4]] iti ṅittve sati <> [[1.1.5]] iti niṣedhena bhavitavyamiti, na cānayoḥ pratiṣedhayoḥ kaścidviśeṣo'sti? ityata āha - `pidgrahaṇam` iti| <> [[7.3.92]] itīmaṃ vakṣyati, sa piti yathā syāt, apiti mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pidgrahaṇam| `nineja` iti| liṭ| sa ca `liṭ? ca` [[3.4.115]] ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñakaḥ| `juhavāni iti| `hu dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1083)| pūrvavalloḍādi| `ajuhavam` iti| pūrvavallaṅādi| atra `laghūpadhasya` [[7.3.86]] ityanuvṛtteḥ `sarvadhātukāryadhātukayoḥ` [[7.3.84]] itīgantasya yo guṇo vihitastasya pratiṣedho na bhavati|`bahulaṃ chandasīti vaktavyam` iti| chandasi viṣaye bahulaṃ guṇapratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - ihedaṃ sūtraṃ vibhajya dvau yogau kriyete, tatra `na` ityeko yogaḥ; `abhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke` iti dvitīyaḥ, tatra ca netyanuvartate, yañca yogaḥ pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthaḥ| tena cchabdasi bahulaṃ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| `jujoṣat` iti| `juṣī pratisevanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1288) leṭ, tip; <<leṭo'ḍāṭau>> [[3.4.94]] ityaṭ, tudāditvācchaḥ, tasya <> [[7.4.78]] iti śluḥ, `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam| laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| yadyabhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke guṇapratiṣedha idhyate, paspaśāte, cakāśīti, vāvaśīdityatropadhāhyasavatvamiṣyate, tanna prāpnoti; tasmādabhyastānāmupadhāhrasvatvameva vaktavyam, na guṇapratiṣedhaḥ; hrasvatve hi nenijānītyevamādi sidhyati; paśpaśāte ityādi ca? iti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `paspaśāte` ityādi| hi nenijānītyevamādi sidhyati; paspaśāte ityādi ca? iti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha - `paspaśāte` ityādi| `spaśiriti [`spāśiriti` - prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] gaṇaparipaṭhito dhātvantaramastyeva, tasmādyaṅ, tasya <<yaṅo'ci ca>> [[2.4.74]] iti luk, dvirvacanam, <<śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ>> [[7.4.61]] iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ; abhyāsasya hrasvatve kṛte <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] iti dīrghaḥ, <> [[3.1.85]] iti varṇavyatyayenopadhāyā abhyāsasya ca hrasvaḥ, leṭ, vyatyayenaivātmanepadam, āṭ| `cākaśīti` iti| `kāśṛ dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1162), <> [[7.4.62]] ityabhyāsasya cutvam, tip, `yaṅo vā` [[7.3.94]] itīṭ| `vāvaśīti` iti| `vāśṛ śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1163), śeṣaṃ yathāyogaṃ pūrvavat| `paspaśāte ityatrābhyāsahrasvatvaṃ ca` iti| cakārādupadhāhrasvatvañca| itaratra tūpadhāhrasvatvameva, nābhyāsasya hrasvatvam| `prakṛtyantarāṇāṃ vā` iti| `spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-887), `kaśa ganiśāsanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1024), `vaśa kāntau` (dhā|pa|1080) - etāni prakṛtyantarāṇi hrasvopadhāni santīti, ata eṣāmevaitāni rūpāṇi| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu||`abhūt` iti| `luṅ, `gātasthā` [[2.4.77]] ityādinā sico luk| `suvāvahai, suvāmahai` iti| `ṣūṅ? prāṇigarbhavimocane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1031), loṭ? vahimahiṅau, ṭeretvam, `eta ai` [[3.4.93]] , āditvācchapo luk, <<āḍuttamasya picca>> [[3.4.92]] ityāṭ? `aci śnudhātu` [[6.4.77]] ityādinovaṅ| atha kasmāt? sūterādādikasyopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ, na suvatisayatyostaudādikadaivādikayoḥ? ityata āha - `sūterlugvikaraṇasya` ityādi| nanu ca lugvikaraṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|50) `ṣū preraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1408) ityetasya śavikaraṇasya taudādikasya, `ṣūṅ? prāṇiprasave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1132) - ityasya daivādikasaya ca grahaṇaṃ yuktam? ityata āha - `suvatisūyatyoḥ` ityādi| tiṅīti saptamīnirdeśādanantare tiṅi pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam| na ca suvatisūyatibhyāmanantarastiṅ? sambhavati, vikaraṇena vyavadhānāt| tasmānna tayogrrahaṇamiti sūtereva grahaṇaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyaḥ| syādetat - vacanaprāṇāṇyādvikaraṇena vyavadhāne'pi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatītyatasyayoreva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti? ata āha - `vikaraṇasyaiva` ityādi| tayorhi <> [[1.2.4]] iti vikaraṇaṅittvam, tatra <> [[1.1.5]] ityanenaiva siddhaḥ pratiṣedha iti nirarthakaṃ tayogrrahaṇaṃ syāt, ato na tāviha gṛhrate| `bhavati` iti| tiṅīti vacanādihātiṅi śapi parato niṣedo na bhavati| `vyatibhaviṣīṣṭa` iti| āśiṣi liṅ? [[3.3.173]] | sa ca <> [[3.4.116]] ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñakaḥ, sīyuṭ, `kartari `kartari karmaṇyatihāre` [[1.3.14]] ityātmanepadam, suṭ? ṣatvam, ṣṭutvam| `atha` ityādi| `prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅlugantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati` (vyā|pa|79) iti yaṅluko'pi grahaṇe sati tatrāpi pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `bobhavīti` iti| <> [[7.4.82]] ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| `jñāpakāt` ityādi| yadi yaṅlukyapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, guṇābhāvārthaṃ nipātanaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtañca, tasmādeva jñāpayati - yaṅalukyayaṃ pratiṣedho na bhavatīti||guṇe prāpta utto vṛddhirārabhyate| yautītyādau pūrvavacchapo luk| `sunoti` iti| śnuḥ| `yavāni` iti| loṭ| uttamapuruṣai kavacanam| `yutaḥ, rutaḥ` iti| laṭ, tas| taparakaraṇaṃ sūtītyatra mā bhūdati| atha `api stuyādrājānañ` ityatra kasmānna bhavati, asti hyatrāpi yāsuṭastiṅbhaktatvāt? tiṅgrahaṇena grahaṇamiti prāptiḥ, na ca śakyate vaktum - <> [[1.1.5]] iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti; yasmādiglakṣaṇāyā vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho'sau, na ceyamiglakṣaṇā; sākṣānnirdeṣṭasthānikatvāt, `yasyā hi vṛddheḥ sthānī na nirdiśyate seglakṣaṇā` ityuktam? ityāha - `api stuyāt` ityādi| atra hi `yāsuṭ? parasmaipadeṣūdāttau ṅicca` [[3.4.103]] iti sārvadhātukaṃ ṅita; `ṅicca pinna bhavati` iti ṅittvena pittvasya bādhitatvāt| tasmāt? pityucyamānā vṛddhirihāpi na bhavati| atha `yoyoti, roroti` ityatra kasmānna bhavati, luki sati bhavati hretadaṅgadvayamukārāntam? ityāha - `nābhayastasya` ityādi| gatārtham| ādiśabdena nonotītyevamādīnāṃ[`cokotītyādīnām` - prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] grahaṇam||pūrveṇa nityāyāṃ vṛddhau prāptāyāṃ vikalpārtho'yamutyate| `prorṇoti` iti| pūrvavacchapo luk| `prorṇavāni` iti| loḍuttamapuruṣaikavacanama||vibhāṣeti nivṛttam| pūrveṇa prāptāyāḥ pākṣikyā vṛddherayamapavādaḥ| nanu halatyanuvartata eva, tatra sāmarthyādapṛkta eva bhaviṣyatīti na tadādī, na hi halādisamudāyo hal? bhavati, tatkimapṛktagrahaṇena ityata āha - `halītyanuvartamāne` ityādi| apuktagrahaṇaṃ hrevamarthaṃ kriyate - halītyanuvṛttestadādau mā bhūditi| yadi ceyaṃ paribhāṣā na syāt, apṛktagrahaṇamanarthakatvānna kuryāt| halyucayamāno guṇaḥ kaḥ prasaṅgo yastadādāvapi syāt? naiva prāpnoti; tasyā halātmakatvāt| kṛtañcedamapṛktagrahaṇam, atastonāstīyaṃ paribhāṣeti jñāpyate| atha `nāpṛkte` ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, kiṃ guṇagrahaṇena, vṛddhau pratiṣiddhāyāmutsargeṇa guṇenaiva sidhyati? naitadasti; antaroktāyā vibhāṣāyāḥ pratiṣedho vijñāyeta, tathā ca nityaṃ vṛddhiḥ syāt||`tṛha hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1455) iti rudhādiḥ, `tṛhū tṛbhū hiṃsārthāḥ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1348,1350) iti tudādī - tayorādyasyedaṃ grahaṇam, netarasya| tasya vikaraṇena vyavadhāvādanantaro hal? na sambhavatīti| `tṛṇeḍhi` iti| `ho ḍhaḥ` [[7.2.31]] , <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti dhatvam, <<ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ>> [[8.4.41]] iti ṣṭutvam, <<ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ>> [[8.3.13]] , tasyemāgamaḥ, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | `tṛṇekṣi` iti| `dhaḍhoḥ kaḥ si` [[8.2.41]] iti katvam| `atṛṇeṭ` iti| laṅ, tip, halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] , ḍhatve kṛte <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti jaśtvam - ḍhakārasya ḍakāraḥ, tasya `vāvasāne` [[8.4.55]] iti cartvam - ṭakāraḥ| nanu cātra luptatvāt? sārvadhātukasyemāgamena na bhavitavyam, lupto'pi tatra pratyayalakṣaṇena bhaviṣyatīti cet? na; varṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāstītyata āha - `varṇāśraye` ityādi| evaṃ manyate - `varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇam` (vyā|pa|96) iti nānena sarvadhā varṇāśrayasya pratyayalakṣaṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? <> [[1.1.62]] ityatra pratyayagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ vyākhyāyate| pratyaye lupte dvividhaṃ kāryaṃ vijñāyate - pratyayanimittam, apratyayanimittañca| tatra yat? pratyayanimittaṃ tat? pratyayalope yathā syāt, itaranmā bhūdityevamartham| tena gave hitaṃ gohitamityatra luptāyāṃ vibhaktāvavādeśo na bhavati| avādeśasya hracītyadhikārādvarṇo nimittam, na pratyaya eva| iha tvaṅgādhakārāt? pratyaya eva halādirāśrīyata itīmāgamasya pratyayanimittatā| tenāsau pratyayalakṣaṇena bhavatyeva| yadi hrasau pratyayanimittastatkathaṃ varṇāśraye'payatretayuktam? atṛṇeḍityatrodāharaṇe tyayasya varṇamātratvāt? pratyayaviśeṣaṇatvena vī varṇasyāśrayaṇādevamuktam, na tvapratyayanimittatvāt, varṇasyāpi takārasya pratyayatvāparitya#āgat| `tṛṇahāni` ityatra tadeva loḍuttapuruṣaikavacanam| `tṛṇḍhaḥ` iti| tas, `śnasoranlopaḥ` [[6.4.111]] , pūrvavaḍḍhatvādi, <> [[8.3.24]] ityanusvāraḥ, <> [[8.4.58]] iti parasavarṇo ṇakaraḥ| atha kimarthamiha tṛhīrāgataśnamko gṛhrate, na tṛha ityevocyeta? ityāha āha - `tṛṇaha` ityādi| yadyāgataśnamkasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato nāprāpte śnamyayamārabhyate, deśahetukaśca tayorvirodho'stīti śnama ṇamā bādhā syāt| asatyāmapi bādhāyāmaniṣṭā vyavasthā syāt - pūrvamim, paścāt? śnam; tataścāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| āgataśnamkasya grahaṇe saśnamkasya tṛherimi vidhīyamāne samāveśastayorbhavati, iṣṭā ca vyavaśthā sampadyate - pūrva śnam, paścādim; tasmāt? śnami kṛte satīmāgamo bhavedityevamarthamāgataśnamkastṛhirgrṛhrate||brāuvaḥ` ityeṣā pañcamyakṛtārthā pūrvatra kṛtārthāyāḥ `sārvadhātuke` ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati tasmāditayuttarasya` [[1.1.66]] iti vacanāt| tena halādeḥ pitaḥ sārvadhātukasyaivāyamiḍ? vijñāyata ityata āha - `brāū ityetasmāduttarasya halādeḥ` ityādi| kathaṃ pūnarhala āgamitvena tadādirlabhyate, `yasmine vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe` (vyā|pa|127) ityucyate, na tu yasya vidhiriti, asati hi tadādividhāvabrāvīdityādāveva syāt, brāvītītyādau na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; uttaratra hrapṛktagrahaṇāt? tadādividheḥ sambhavo gamyate, anyathā hrasati tadādividhau vināpyapṛktagrahaṇenāpṛkta eva bhaviṣyati, apṛktagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `brāvīti` iti| pūrvavacchapo luk| `brāvāṇi` iti| tadeva loḍuttamapuruṣaikavacanam| `brāūtaḥ` iti| laṭ, tas||`lālapīti` ityādi| lapivadirautibhyo yaṅ; pūrvayoḥ <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ, rautestu <> [[7.4.82]] iti guṇaḥ, <<yaṅo'ci ca>> [[2.4.74]] iti yaṅo luk| `varvartti, carkatti` iti| vṛñkṛñoryaṅluki `ṛtaśca` [[7.2.92]] ityabhyāsasya rugāgamaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ yaṅlukyevodāhyiyate, na yaṅante? ityāha - `halādeḥ` ityādi| yaṅante hi ṅittvādātmanepadam, na cātmanepadaṃ halādi pidasti| halādeḥ pitaḥ parasya sārvadhātukasyābhāvānneha yaṅantasyodāharaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? yaṅlugantasya| tatra hi halādi pit? sārvadhātukaṃ sambhavati, yaṅlugantasyādādau `carkarītañca parasmaibhāvam` iti pāṭhe sati parasmaipaditvāt, tena yaṅlṛkyevodāhyiyate| carkarītamiti yaṅlugantasaya pūrvācārayasaṃjñā||`tu` iti sautro dhāturvṛddhyarthe ityeke, hiṃsārthe ityapare| asya ca lugvikaraṇatvaṃ smaryate, tacca `bahula chandasi` [[2.4.73]] iti bahulagrahaṇena bhāṣāyāmapi lukasampādanāllabhyate| `śamīṣpam` iti| loṭ| `aśamīdhvam` iti| laṅ| `abhyamīti` iti| loṭ| `aśamīdhvam` iti| laṅ| `abhyamīti` iti| `ama gatyādiṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-465) laṭ, tip| kathaṃ punaḥ śamyamibhyāmanantaraṃ halādi sārvadhātukaṃ sambhavati, yāvatā śamevryavadhāyakenaiva śyānā bhavitavyam| amerapi śap? kriyate? ityāha - `śadhyamoḥ` ityādi| vikaraṇasyātra luk? <> [[7.4.78]] ityamena| `sārvadhātukāsu` iti| strīliṅganirdeśā| strīliṅgasya sārvadhātukāśabdasyāpiśalinā saṃjñātyena pracītatvāt| atha sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <> [[7.3.87]] ityataḥ sūtrāt?
