sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvartate? ityāha - `sārvadhātuka ityanuvartamāne` ityādi| taddhi sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ pitītyanena sambaddham| atastadanuvṛttau pidgrahaṇamapyamuvarteta tathā cāpiti na syāt| tasmādapityapi yathā syādiyevamarthaṃ tsārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ kriyate||`apṛkte` iti| subvayatyayena ṣaṣṭharthe saptadamī, tenāyamapṛktasyaiveṭ| astigrahaṇaṃ laṅarthay| `āsīt` iti| `asa bhuvi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1065), laṅ, adāditvācchapo luk, <<āḍajādīnām>> [[6.4.72]] ityāṭ| `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `akārṣīt` iti| sici vṛddhiḥ| `alāvīt, apādhīt` iti| `iṭa īṭi` [[8.2.28]] iti sico lopaḥ| `āttha` iti| atra brāuṣa uttarasya sipaḥ `brāuvaḥ pañcānāmadita āhobrāuvaḥ` [[3.4.84]] iti thali kṛte brāuvaścāhādeśe kṛte tasya sthānivadbhāve sati brāūñgrahaṇena grahamāt? thalo'pi sārvadhātukagrahaṇena grahaṇādīṭ? prāpnoti| `abhūt` iti| asteḥ sic, <> [[2.4.52]] iti bhūbhāve tasya sthānivadbhāve satyastigrahaṇena grahaṇādīṭ? prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `āhibhuvoḥ` ityādi| `īṭi pratiṣedhaḥ` iti| āherbhuvaśceṭi kartavye sthānivadbāvasya pratiṣedhaḥ| teneha na bhavati - ātva` iti| `āhasthaḥ` [[8.2.35]] iti hakārasya thakāraḥ, tasya `khari ca` iti takāraḥ| `abhūt` iti| `gātisthā` [[2.4.77]] iti sico luk||`sarvamāḥ` iti| asterlaṅ, pūrvavadāṭ, siyo halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] , sakārasya rutvavisarjanīyo|`gobhirakṣāḥ pratyañcamatsāḥ` iti| `kṣara sañcalane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-851), `tsara cchadmagato` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-554) inṅyādinā [[6.1.66]] sico lopaḥ, <> [[7.2.2]] iti vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavaddhisarjanīyaḥ| `abhaiṣīḥ` iti| `ñibhī bhaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1084), sici vṛddhiḥ| athābhaiṣīrmā putraketyatra kathamaḍāgamaḥ, yāvatā <> [[6.4.74]] iti pratiṣiddho'sau, iha cākṣāḥ, atsā ityat sica ījāgamaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `chābdasatvāt` ityādi| akṣāḥ, atasā ityatra ceḍāgamābhāva iti cchāndasatvāditi prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `vā chandasi` iti vaktavye bahulagrahamuttarārtham| uttarārthatāṃ cāsyottaratra pratipādapiṣyāmaḥ||`rudaḥ` iti subvyatyayena bahuvacanasyaikavacanama| etacaca `pañcabhyaḥ` iti bahuvacanādvijñāyate| <> [[7.2.76]] itīṭi prāpte tadapavāda īḍāgamo vidhīyate| `rudir? aśruvimocane` (dhā|pa|1067), `ñiṣvap? śaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1068), `āsa prāṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1069), `ana ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1070), jakṣa bhakṣahasanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1071)-ityete rudādaya ādādikāḥ| `arodīt` iti| laṅ| `prāṇīt` iti| `aniteḥ` [[8.4.19]] iti ṇatvam| `ajāgarbhavān` iti| `ajāgarbhavān` iti| jāgarttiḥ pañcabhyaḥ pareṇāyaṃ paṭhate| guṇe raparatve ca kṛte halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] ||pūrveṇeṭi prāpte'ḍāgamo vidhīyate| gāgryagālavagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham, na tu vikalpārtham| aḍīṭorādiliṅgatvādekaviṣayatvācca na sambhavati; samuccaya ityantareṇāpyācāryagrahaṇaṃ vikalpasya siddhatvāt||sarveṣāṃgrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham, na tu nityārtham; gāgryagālavagrahasyāvikalpārthatvāt||taparakaraṇamuttarārtham| khaṭvābhirityatra `bahuvacane jhalyet` [[7.3.103]] ityettvaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham| `aṅganā` iti| praśastānyaṅgānyasyāḥ santīti lomādinā [[5.2.99]] napratyayaḥ| `keśavaḥ` iti| keśā yasya santīti <<keśādvo'nyatarasyām>> [[5.2.109]] iti vapratyayaḥ| `kecidatra tiṅītyanuvartayanti` iti| <> [[7.3.88]] ityataḥ| teṣāṃ bhavavāniti kvasau sārvadhātuke dīrghatvena na bhavitavyamiti; kvasoratiṅantatvāt| `bhagavān` iti| bhavaterliṭ, kavasuḥ, <> [[6.4.86]] iti tasya pakṣe sārvadhātukatvam, tena `kartari śap` [[3.1.68]] bhavati, <> [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau (6.1.70; 8.2.23)| āditi vaktavye dīrghagrahaṇam - dīrgha eva yathā syāt, yadanyat? prāpnoti, tanmā bhūditi| kiñcānyat? prāpnoti? <> [[8.2.97]] , `anantarasyāpyekaikasya prācām` `praśnākhyānayoḥ` [[8.2.105]] iti plutaḥ| atha prakṛto'jāgamaḥ kasmānna vidhīyate? tatrāpyakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena [[6.1.97]] vahīti <> [[7.3.72]] iti lopaḥ syāt, atijarābhyāmityatrācīti jarasbhāvaḥ syāt; tannivṛttyartha dīrghagrahamaṃ kṛtam| sa cātra plutaḥ prasajyeta||nanu ca vṛkṣāṇāmityatra `nāmi` [[6.4.3]] iti dīrghatvaṃ bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat? kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena jhalgrahaṇena? naitadasti; `nāmi` [[6.4.3]] iti hragnīnāmityatra sāvakāśam, tatrāsati jhalgrahaṇe dīrghatvaṃ bādhitvā paratvādettvameva syāt| `pacadhvam, yajadhvam` iti| loṭ? ṭerettvam, <> [[3.4.91]] ityāmādeśaḥ||`āṅiti pūrvācāryanirdeśena` ityādi| ācāryā hi pūrva āṅiti tṛtīyaikavacananirdeśaṃ kurvanti sma| tasmāt? tadīyenāṅiti nirdeśena tṛtīyaikavacanaṃ gṛhrate| `khaṭvayā` iti ṭābantasyodāharaṇam| `bahurājayā` iti| jāvantasyodāharaṇam| `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām` [[4.1.13]] iti ḍāp| `kārīṣagandhyayā` iti| cābantasya| karīṣasyeva gandho'sya <> [[5.4.137]] itīt - karīṣagandhiḥ, <> [[4.1.92]] ityaṇ, tasya `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ` [[4.1.78]] ityādinā vyaṅ, tadantāt? `yaṅaścāp` [[4.1.74]] iti cāp| `kīlālapā` iti| kīlālaṃ pibatīti `ato maninkvanibvanipaśca` [[3.2.74]] iti vic, tadantāt? tṛtīyaikavacanam, <<āto dhātoḥ>> [[6.4.140]] ityakāralopaḥ|atheha kasmānna bhavati - khaṭvāmatikrāntenātikhaṭveneti, upasarjanahrasvatve kṛte sthānivadbhāvāt? tasya prāpnoti? ityāha - `ṅyābgrahaṇam` ityādi| kecidāhuḥ - ṅyābgrahaṇe dīrghagrahaṇamityetadvacanaṃ kartavyam, tena hrasvatve kṛte na bhavati apare tvāhuḥ - <> [[6.1.68]] iti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ, yāvacchāstre ṅyāpoḥ kārya tat? sarvaṃ dīrghayoryathā syā hrasvayormā bhūditi; tataḥ `sutisyapṛktam? [[6.1.66]] iti dvitīyo yogaḥ, tatra `halṅyāgbhyaḥ` ityanuvartata iti| cakāraḥ `opti ca` [[7.3.104]] ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ||pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ| ambārthāḥ=mātrarthāḥ| `ḍalakavatīnām` ityādi| ḍalākā yāsāṃ śrutīnāṃ santīti tā ḍalakavatyaḥ| asaṃyogāvayavabhūtā ḍalakā iha gṛhyante| anyathā he akka, he alla - ityatrāpi syāt| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyaya ityeṣo'rthaḥ| uttarayorapi vaktavyaśabdayorayamevārtho veditavyaḥ| tatraidaṃ vyākhyānam - <> [[7.4.78]] ityato bahulagrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvartate, tena sarvaṃ pratiṣedhādikaṃ kāryamapi bhaviṣyatīti| `arhate` iti| praśaṃsābhājanabhūtāyetyarthaḥ| `gārgomātā` iti| yo gāgryā mātrā ṣyapadeśena praśaṃsāmarhati sa evamucyate||hrasvagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtāṅgaviśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha - `hsvāntasya` ityādi| evamuttaratrāpi tadantavidhirveditavyaḥ| atha he kumāri, he brāhṛbandhvityevamādīnāṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `he kumāri` ityādi| yadi hrasvatve kṛte guṇaḥ syāt, hrasvakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| nanu ca guṇārthametat? syāt, asati hi tasmin? `hrasvasaya guṇaḥ` [[7.3.108]] iti guṇo na syāt, ahrasvāntatvāt? ityāha - `yadi` ityādi| evaṃ prakriyāgauravaṃ parihmataṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||`jasādiṣu` ityādi| ādiśabdaḥ prakāre| jasprakāreṣu pratyayeṣvityarthaḥ| `itaḥ prakaraṇāt` iti| `ambārthanadyohryasvaḥ` [[7.3.107]] ityevamādikāt| `chabadasīti vaktavyam` iti| chandasi viṣaye vā kāryaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tadeva bahulavacanamāśritya kartavyam| `ambe` ityādi| `ambārthanadyohryasvaḥ` [[7.3.107]] iti hrasvo na bhavati| `darvī` ityatra hrasvasya guṇaḥ| `śatakratvaḥ` ityatrāpi `jasi ca` [[7.3.109]] iti| `pao` iti| `dherṅiti` [[7.3.111]] iti guṇaḥ| `kikidīvyā` iti| atra <<āṅo nā'striyām>> [[7.3.120]] iti nābhāvaḥ||`taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham` iti| na hi ṅisarvanāmasthānayordīrgha ṛkāraḥ sambhavati yastapareṇa nivarttyeta||`sakhye, patye` iti| sakhipatiśabdau ghisaṃjñakau na bhavataḥ; `śeṣo dhyasakhi` [[1.4.7]] iti paryudāsāt; <> [[1.4.8]] iti niyamācca| `paṭvī` iti| `voto guṇavacanāt` [[4.1.44]] ṅīṣu| atra guṇo na bhavati; `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] ityataḥ supītyanuvṛtte `kurutaḥ` iti| karotestas, upratyayaḥ, dhātorguṇaḥ, raparatvam, `ata ut? sārvadhātuke` [[6.4.110]] ityuttvam| atrāpi supītyanuvṛttestasi parato vikaraṇāntasaya na bhavati guṇaḥ||`nadyāḥ` iti pañcamī, sā cākṛtārthā pūrvatra kṛtārthāyā ṅitītyasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| tena ṅita evāyamāḍāgamo vijñāyate, ityāha - `nadyantādaṅgāduttarasya` ityādi| `kumāryai` ityevamādau `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ| atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, na aḍevocyeta, <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhyā savarṇadīrghatvena siddhyatyeva; kumāryai, kumāryā ityatra <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvaṃ prāpnotītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam, pararūpatvaṃ hyatra vacanasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; asti hranyadavacanasya prayojanam| kiṃ tat? śriyai, śriyā ityatra <> [[6.1.168]] ityudāttatvaṃ mā bhūt| āgamā ādyudāttā bhavantītyanudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi| śakyate hrekādeśontādivadbhāvādāgamagrahaṇena grahītum| āgamānudāttatvañca yathā pratyayasvaram - lavitā, lavitumityādau bādhate, tathā vibhaktasvaramapi bādheta| tasmāt? `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhyarthametat||`khaṭvāyām` iti| <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhiḥ| khaṭvāyā ityatrākaḥ savarṇe [[6.1.97]] dīrghoccāraṇam - vṛddhisavarṇadīrghatve yathā syātām, pararūpatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti cet? na; asti hranyadakāroccāraṇasya prayojanam| kiṃ tat? jñāyai, jñāyā ityatra <> [[6.1.168]] ityanenodāttatvaṃ mā bhūt, āgamanudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi| atha khaṭvāmatikrāntāyātikhaṭvāyetyatra kasmānna bhavati, upasarjanahrasvatve kṛte tasya sthānivadbhāvādāvgrahaṇena grahaṇe sati prāpnoti? ityata āha - `atikhaṭvāya` ityādi| yadā tāvat? `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghatvaṃ na kriyate, tadā ṅyāvgrahaṇena dīrghagrahaṇamityetadvavacanānna bhavati| yadā dīrghatvaṃ tadā lākṣaṇikatvānna bhavati; `lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|3) iti vacanāt||yāṭo'pavādaḥ| ākāroccāraṇaṃ sarvasyā ityatra yathā syāt, anyathā pararūpatvaṃ prasajyeta| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna prasajyeta - ityetacca nāśaṅkanīyam, taddhi tasyāmityatra <<ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ>> [[6.1.171]] iti vibhaktyudāttatvaṃ mā bhūt, āgamānudattatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham||asarvanāmārthaṃ vacanam| ye tu `vāprakaraṇe tīyasya ṅitsūpasaṃkhyānam` (vā| 6) iti sarvanāmasaṃjñāṃ tīyasyopasañcakṣate ta idaṃ sūtraṃ pratyācakṣate; tenaiva siddhatvāt| taccopasaṃkhyānamavaśyaṃ kartavyam, smāyādayo ṅiti vikalpena yathā syuriti - dvitīyasmai, dvitīyāya, dvitīyasmin, dvitīya iti| anye tvanenaiva smāyādayaḥ sidhyantītyupasaṃkhyānameva pratyācakṣate| katham? `sarvanāmnaḥ` ityetadihānuvartate, syāḍiti nivṛttam, tenaivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate - sarvanāmno ṅiti yaduktaṃ tadvibhāṣa dvitīyātṛtīyābhyāṃ bhavatīti| tena syāyādayo'payanenaiva bhaviṣyantīti nārtha upasaṃkhyānena||`ṅeḥ` iti saptamyekavacanasya grahaṇam| etacca `striyām` ityevamādinirdeśādvijñāyate| `grāmaṇyām` iti| grāmaṃ nayatīti `satsūdviṣa` [[3.2.61]] ityādinā kvip, `agragrāmābhyāñca` iti ṇatvam| <<eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya>> [[6.4.82]] iti yaṇādeśaḥ| atha kumāryām, khaṭvāyām, sarvasyāmiti kathaṃ sidhyati, āmi kṛte `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ` [[7.1.54]] iti nuḍāgamena bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nuṭaḥ paratvādāṭ - yāṭ - syāṭo bhavanti| teṣa kṛteṣu nuṭaḥ prāptireva nāstīti, na hi dvayorādiliṅgayoḥ samuccaya upapadyate||nadīgrahaṇamihanuvartate| tena cedutau viśiṣyatete nadīsaṃkakau yādidutāviti| yadyevam, anarthakamidam, pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt? naitadasti; aukaro hi paratvaduttarasūtreṇa syāt, asmaśca satyāmeva bhavati||āṅa iti sthānyantaranirdeśādihārthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti ṣaṣṭhantaṃ yadgheriti prakṛtaṃ tadiha pañcamyantamupajāyata ityāha - `gheruttarasya` ityādi| atha kimaratham? `astriyām` ityucyate, `āṅo nā puṃsi` ityevocyeta; evamucyamāne trapuṇā jatunetyetanna sidhyatītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam; <<iko'ci vibhaktau>> [[7.1.73]] iti numaiva siddhatvāt? iti yo manyeta, taṃ nirākarttum - `amunā brāāhṛṇakulena ityasyopanyāsaḥ| atra hi tyadādyatve kṛte <<adaso'serdādu do maḥ>> [[8.2.80]] ityuttvamatve ca| tatra yadi puṃsītyucyate, tato'muneti napuṃsake na sidhyet; mubhāvasyāsiddhatvāt| numo'bhāvāt? `astriyām` ityucyamāne napuṃsake'pi nābhāvo bhavatītyamuneti siddhaṃ bhavati| na hi nābhāve kartavye mubhāvasyāsiddhatvam; <> [[8.2.3]] iti vacanādatyabhiprāyaḥ|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃkāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ saptamādhyāyasyatṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ- - -atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥcaturthaḥ pādaḥ`caṅpare ṇau parataḥ` iti| caṅ? paro yasmāṇṇeriti sa tathoktaḥ| `acīkarat` ityādi| kṛñ, hmañ, lūñ, pañityetebhyo hetumaṇṇic, tato luṅ, cliḥ,`ṇiśri` [[3.1.48]] ityādinā cleścaṅ, <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti ṇilopaḥ| atra dvirvacanopadhāhrasvatvayoḥ prāptayoḥ paratvādupadhāhrasvatvam, tato dvirvacanam, tataśca ṇau kṛtaṃ sathānivadbhavatīti kṛ, hma - ityādikamavikṛtadhāturūpameva dvirucyate| atra kṛ, hma - ityetayorabhyāsasya `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattve kṛte raparatve halādiśeṣe ca tataśca `sabvalladhuni` [[7.4.93]] ityādinā sanvadbhāvādittvam| pū, lū - ityetayorapi hrasvatve kṛte <> [[7.4.80]] itīttvam| sarvatra <> [[7.4.94]] iti dīrghatvam| `atra dvirvacanopadhāhrasvatvayoḥ prāptayoḥ` ityādi| acīkaravityādiṣūdāharaṇeṣu kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāddvirvacanaṃ nityamupadhāhrasvatvamapi, tayorubhayoḥ paratvādupadhāhrasvatvaṃ bhavati, tatra kṛte dvirvacanam - ityeṣa kāryāṇāṃ pravṛttikramaḥ| mā bhavānaṭiṭadityatra tu dvirvacanameva nityam, na hrasvatvaṃ tu dvitīyasyai kāco dvirvacane kṛte na prāpnoti; pareṇa ṭiśabdarūpeṇa vyavadhānāt| tasmānmā bhavānaṭiṭadityatra nityatvāddvitīyasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ prapnoti| dvirvacane hi sati ko doṣaḥ syāt? ityata āha - `tathā ca sati` ityādi| evañca dvirvacane kṛte caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasya hrasvabhāvyākāra upadhā bhavati| asati ca hrasvatve mā bhavānaṭiṭaditi rūpaṃ na sidhyati| māyoga āṇnivṛttyarthaḥ| āṭi tu sati nāsti viśeṣaḥ| satyasati vā hrasvatve `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhyā bhavitavyamiti| bhavacchabdaḥ sandehanirāsārthaḥ| `naiṣa doṣaḥ` iti| yo'nantaroktaḥ sa kathaṃ labhyate? ityāha - `oṇeṝditkaraṇam` ityādi| `oṇṛ apanayane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-454) ityetasya ṛditkaraṇasyaitatprayojanam - ṛdittvānnāglopi [[7.4.2]] ityādinā hrasvapratiṣedho yathā syāditi| yadi ca nityamapi dvirvacanamupadhāhrasvatvena na bādhyate, tadauṇaiṝditkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| dvirvacane hi kṛte pareṇa ṇiśabdarūpeṇa vyavadhānādeva hrasvo na bhaviṣyati, kimoṇeṝditkaraṇeneti? ācāryapravṛttijrñāpayati - nityamapi dvirvacanamupadhāhrasvatvena bādhyata iti; yata oṇeṝdatkaraṇaṃ karoti|`ṇāviti kim` iti| evaṃ manyate - ṇigrahaṇe cākṛte luṅcaṅādeśayoḥ kṛtayorṇilope cākṛte vṛddhyāvādeśayoścākṛtayoḥ, alū i+at? iti sthita ūkarasya hrasvo mā bhūdatyevamarthaṃ vā ṇigrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ūkārasya vṛddhau kṛtāyāmaukārasaya hrasvo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vā? etaccobhayamaprayojanam; atrāntaraṅgatvādvṛddhyāvādeśābhyāmeva bhavitavyam| antaraṅgatvaṃ punastayorṇijmātrāśrayatvāt; hrasvasya ca bahiraṅgatvaṃ caṅāśrayatvāditi| `caṅyupadhāyā hrasva ityucyamāne` ityādi| etāvatyucyamāne'sati ṇigrahaṇe caṅpare yadaṅgaṃ tasyopadhāyā hrasvo bhavatītyevamarthaḥ syāt| tathā cānavakāśo hrasvo'līlavadityatrāntaraṅgāmapi vṛdiṃdha bādhitvā vacanasāmarthyādṛkārasyaiva syāt| athāpi kathañcid? vṛddhirna bādhyate; evamapi vṛddhau kṛtāyāmantaraṅgamapyāvādeśaṃ bādhitvaukārasyaiva prasajyeta; anyathā hi vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt| `adīdapat` iti| atra dadāterṇici luṅi caṅi ca kṛte a dā i+at? iti sthite vacanaprāmāṇyādanavakāśo hrasvo'ntaraṅgamapi pukaṃ bādhitvā prasajyeta, tasamiṃśca sati pugvihatanimittatvānna syāt| `apīpacadityādau tu naiva hrasvaḥ syāt` iti| caṅi parata#o yadaṅgaṃ pāciprabhṛti tadīyāyā upadhāyāścākārāderahrasvabhāvinītvāt| ādiśabdo'pīpaṭhadityādiparigrahārthaḥ| tasmāṇṇāviti vaktavyam| `caṅīti kim` iti| eṣo'bhiprāyaḥ - kevale ṇau hrasvo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ caṅītyucyate; naitaccaṅagrahaṇasya prayojanamupapadyate; yasmādācāryapravṛttijrñāpayati - ṇāveva kevale hrasvatvaṃ na bhavatīti, yadayam? `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[6.4.92]] iti hrasvatvaṃ śāsti| tataḥ kārayati, hārayatītyādau na bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| yadyetasmājjñāpakāt? kārayatītyādau hrasvo na bhavati, tadā'cīkaradityatrāpi na syāt| athātra vacanasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati? evamapi kārayatītyādau syādeva| na hi `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ` [[6.4.92]] ityucayamāne satyacīkaradityādau na bhavatītyeva viṣayavibhāgaḥ śakyate vijñātum| tasmāt? caṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `upadhāgrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| evaṃ manyate - alo'ntyasya mā bhūdityevamarthamupadhāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, etaccāprayojanam; caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasyācīkaradityādāvapi ṇāvantaraṅgatvād? vṛddhyādiṣu kṛteṣu hrasvabhāvyajantyo na sambhavati yatrājantāṇṇijutpadyate, kiṃ punarapapaṭhavityādau yatra halantāṇṇijutpadyate! tasmādajantyo hrasvabhāvo nāstītyantareṇāpyupadhāgrahaṇaṃ vacanādanavtyasyaivopadhābhūtasya hrasvo bhaviṣyatīti| `acakāṅkṣat, avavāñchat` iti| `krākṣi vākṣi mākṣi kāṅkṣāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-667,668,669)| yadyapyajanto hrasvabhāvī nāsti, tathāpi vacanādanantyasyācokaradityādau yathā bhavati, tathā acakāṅkṣadityādāvapi syāt| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityupadhāgrahaṇaṃ kriyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu cāṅgasya yo'c? tasya caṅpare ṇau hrasvo vidhīyate, tatra yadyapyanantaro'j? na sambhavati, tathāpi `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt` (vyā|pa|46) ityekena varṇeneti yena nāvyavadhānam, api tu sarvadā vyavadhānameva; tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyādbhavitavyam| ekenaiva varṇena vyavadhānaṃ sarvatra sambhavati| saṅghātena tu vyavadhānaṃ sambhavati, na sambhavati ca| ihācakāṅkṣadityādau saṅghātenaiva vyavadhānam, ato nāstyeva hrasvaprasaṅga iti kimudhāgrahaṇena? ityāha - `tadetat` ityādi| upadhāgrahaṇamavaśyamuttarārthaṃ kartavyam| iha tu kriyamāṇe satyacakāṅkṣadityevamartham? `yena nāvyavadhānam` (vyā|pa|46) ityeṣā paribhāṣā nāśrayitavyā bhavati| upadhāgraṇenaivātra hrasvasya nivarttitatvādityeṣa guṇo labhyate| tenehaiva kṛtam, notraratra| `upadhāhrasvatve ṇerṇicayupasaṃkhyānam` iti| caṅpare ṇau parato yo ṇistasmin? parato'ṅgasyopadhāpā hrasvaḥ upasaṃkhyeyaḥ| `avīvadat` iti| vadeḥ <> [[3.1.26]] iti ṇic, tadantādvāditavantaṃ prayojitavāniti punaḥ <> [[3.1.26]] iti ṇic, tato luṅādiḥ,<<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti ṇilopaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇa na sidhyati, yāvatā ṇilope kṛte caṅpare ṇāvaṅgasyākāro hrasvabhāvinyupadhā bhavatyeva? ityāha - `yo'so` ityādi| `acaḥ parasmin? pūrvavidhau` [[1.1.57]] api ṇilopasya hrasvatve kartavye sthānivadbhāvāṇṇijavyavadhānād? hrasvo na prāpnoti| tena vā ṇilopenāglopyaṅgametadbhavati - tadetasmāddhetorna harasavatvaṃ prāpnoti| aglopītyādinānantaravakṣyamaṇipratiṣedhāt? [[7.4.4]] `ṇyākṛtinidaśāt? siddham` ityupasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe - `ṇau iti| ṇyākṛtiriti ṇijātirnirdeśayate, na tu ṇivyaktiḥ| tena vyaktau vyavadhānaṃ na bhavati, na hi jātau; ekatvāṇṇijāteḥ| na hi tayaiva tasyā vyavadhānamupapadyate| nanu cottarayā ṇyākṛtyā jātyādhārabhūtayā ṇivyaktyā ṇijātyāśraye'pi vyavadhānamupapadyata eva? naitat; tasyāmapi vyaktau jāteḥ samavāyāt| evaṃ tādadvyavadhāna#ṃ ṇyākṛtyāśraye nāsti| aglopitvamapi nāstyeva; na hyatra ṇijātivyatirekeṇā'nyo'gvidyate, yasya lopenāglopyaṅgaṃ syāt| na ca ṇyākṛterlopaśca; tasyāḥ śrūyamāṇatvāt| na hi śrūyamāṇāyā lope lapapadyate; <> [[1.1.60]] iti vacanāt| nanu ca jātivyatirekeṇāpi tadāśrayabhūtā vyakatiragvidyata eva; na jātivyaktyorananyatvamiti sāṃkhyoyasiddhāntasyehāśrayaṇāt| atha vā - ṇyākṛtinirdeśe satyupadhāhrasvatvasya ṇyākṛtanimittatvenā śroyate| tena gobalīvaradanyāyena tasyā ṇyākṛternimittatvenopāttāyā anyasyāko lopaḥ pratiṣedhanimittatvena vijñāyate, sa ceha nāsti| tasmāṇṇyākṛtinirdeśāt? siddham||agiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam| ako lopo'glopaḥ, sa eṣāmastīti tānyaglopīnyaṅgāni| `śāsu anuśiṣṭau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1075) ṛdidyeṣāṃ tāni ṛdinti `bādhṛ viloḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-5) ityevamādīni| `amamālat, amamātarat` iti| `tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe` (ga|sū|187) iti ṇic, `ṇāviṣṭhavatkāryaṃ prātipadikasya` (vā|813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvaḥ, `turiṣṭhemeyaḥsu` [[6.4.154]] iti ṭilopaḥ, tato luṅādiḥ| `atayararājat` ityādau, `prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca` (ga|sū|186) iti ṇic| `anvalulomat` iti| `satyāpapāśarūpa` [[3.1.25]] ityādinā ṇic|`ageva kevalo yatra` ityādi| iha dvividhamagalopayaṅgam - kvacidageva kevalo lupyate, amamāladityādaukvaciddhalacau, atyararājadityādau| ageva kevalo yatra lupyate tatrāglopasya sthānivadbhāvāt? siddham| sthānivadbhāve satyaglopasya vyavadhānādeva hyasavaprāptiḥ, tasmānna tadarthamaglopīti vacanam| itaratra tu halacorubhayorapyādeśa iti sidhyati, asthānivadbhāvāt| ajādeśasaya hi paranimittakasya sthānivadbhāva uktaḥ, na tu halacorādeśasya| tasmādyatra halacorādeśāstadarthamidaṃ vacanam| anyārthametat? kriyamāṇaṃ yatrāgeva kevalo lupyate tadarthamapi bhaviṣyatīti tadarthamasyodāharaṇamupanyastam| `aḍuḍhaukat` ita| `kaki vaki āki traki ḍhaukṛ traukṛ ṣvaṣka vaska maska ṭikṛ ṭīkṛ tikṛ raghi laghi gatyarthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-94,95,96,97,98,99,100,101,102,103,104,105,106,107,108)| <> [[8.4.54]] iti jaśtvam - ḍakāraḥ||bhrājirayaṃ bhvādāvanudāttet? paṭhate, ātmanepadī ṛkārānubandhaḥ phaṇādiṣu `ṭubhrāju ṭubhrāsu dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-823,824) iti paṭhate, phaṇādibhyaḥ purastācca `ejṛbhrejṛ bhrājṛ dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-179,180,181) iti| tantrāntargacakāryārthaḥ phaṇādiṣvavaśyamevāsya pāṭho'ṅgīkartavya iti tenaiva śabāderapi gaṇakāryasya siddhatvāt| anyatrāsya pāṭho'nārṣa eva lakṣyate| `bhāsṛ dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-624), `bhā, vyaktāyāṃ vāci` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-612) `dīpī dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-150), `jīva prāṇadhāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-562) `mīla śmīla smīla kṣmīla nimeṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-517,518,519,520), `pīḍa avagāhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1544) - eṣāṃ nitye hrasvatve prāpte vibhāṣeyamārabhyate| `abibhrajat` iti| yadhā hrasvatvam, tadā pūrvavatsanvadbāvenettvam| `abībhavat` iti| pūrvavaddīrghaḥ|atha bhrājabhāsayoṝditkaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tayorhi ṛditkaramasyaitat? prayojanam - ṛdittvāt? pūrvasūtreṇa hrasvapratiṣedho yathā syāditi| yadi vibhāṣayā ca tayohryasvatvaṃ vidhīyate tadā ṛditkaraṇamasya vaiyavryameva? ityata āha - `bhrājabhāsoḥ` ityādi| `apāṇinīyam` iti| pāṇineridaṃ pāṇinīyam, na pāṇinīyamapāṇinauyamiti; tenānabhyupagamāt; na tu tenākṛtatvāt| anyathā hi `bādhṛ viloḍane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-5) - ityevamādīnāmapi ṛditkaraṇamapāṇinīyaṃ syāt| pratipāditaṃ hi pūrvam? (4.1.106 tamasūtre) - gaṇakāraḥ pāṇinirna bhavatīti| tathā ca - anyo gaṇakāraḥ anyaśca sūtrakāraḥ||hrasvatve prāpte tadapavādaḥ pibaterlopo vidhauyate, īkāraścābhyāsasyeti| upadhādhikārādupadhāyā eva| paryāyeṇa lopekārau mā bhūtām - ityevamarthamadhyāsagrahaṇam| `apīpyat` iti| `pā pāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-925), ṇic, `śācchāsāhvāvyāvepām` [[7.3.37]] iti yuk| nanu ca nityatvāt? paratvācca pūrvamupadhālope kṛte'nackatvād? dvirvacanena na bhavitavyam? ityata āha - `upadhālope kṛte` ityādi| subodham| pibrāteḥ śtipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ - apāpayaditi| `pā rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1056, `pai ovai śoṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-920,921) - ityetayostu nivṛttyarthaḥ sa nopapadyate; tatra hrokasya lugvikaraṇatvādeva na bhaviṣyati, aparasya tu lākṣaṇikatvāt||ayamapi hrasvāpavādaḥ| `īccābhyāgasya` [[7.4.4]] iti nivṛttam| śtipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛttyartha eva - atāsthapaditi||eṣo'pi hrasvāpavādaḥ| atrāpi śtipā nirdeśasya tadeva prayojanam - ajāghrapaditi||atra ṛkāraḥ sthānitvenopāttaḥ, tasya cāntaraṅgatvādirarāra eva prāpnuvanti, na hi bahiraṅgo hrasvaḥ, tasmāt? teṣāmapavādau vijñāyata ityata āha - `irarārāmapavādaḥ` iti| `upaghāyāśca` [[7.1.101]] itīkāraḥ, `pugantalaghūpaghasya` [[7.3.86]] iti guṇo'kāraḥ, `mṛjerbṛddhiḥ` [[7.2.114]] ityākāraḥ - ityete ca ṛkārasya sthāne `uraṇraparaḥ` [[1.1.50]] iti raparā bhavanto yatākramamirarāro bhavanti, teṣāmapavādaḥ| `acīkṛtat` iti| `kṛta saṃśabdene` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1653), curādiḥ, ṇic| `avīvṛtat` iti| `vṛtu vartane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-758) `amīmṛjat` iti| `mṛjū śuddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1066) hetumaṇṇic| nanu cāntaraṅgatvādirarārbhireva bhavitavyam, antaraṅgatvaṃ tu punasteṣāṃ ṇjmātrāśrayatvāt| ṛkārastu caṅparaṃ ṇicamāśritya bhavatīti bahiraṅgaḥ| tatkathaṃ tenerarāro bādhyante? ityata āha - `vacanasāmarthyāt` ityādi| yadyantaraṅgatvādirarāraḥ syuḥ, vacanasya tadā vaiyathrya syāt; anavakāśatvāt| tasmādantaraṅgā api te bādhyante| `taparakaraṇam` ityādi| asati hi taparakaraṇe yatra dīrghaḥ sthānī, tatrāntaratamyāddīrghaḥ prasajyeta tasmā ddīrghe'pi sthānini hrasva eva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taparakaraṇam| nanu `bhāṣyamāno'ṇ? savarṇānna grṛhṇāti` (vyā|pa|35) iti dīrghasyāpi sthānino hrasva eva bhaviṣyati, na dīrghaḥ? ityata āha - `na cāyaṃ bhāvyamānaḥ` ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇam? ityata āha - `ādeśāntaranivṛttyartham` iti| iti| ādeśāntaramirarārādi; tasya nivṛttyarthamīkārasyāsmīyarūpeṇaivābhyanujñāyate, na tvapūrva eva ṛkāro vidhīyate, tatkuto'sya bhāvyamānatā!||`avīvṛdhat` iti| `vṛdhu vṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-759) hetumāṇṇic, tato luṅādiḥ| nityagrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre vetyetadanuvṛttervijñāpanārtham; anyathā hi tatrāpyasyānanuvṛttirvijñāyeta||`avadigye` ityādi| `deṅ? rakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-962), liṭ, ṅittvādātmanepadam, prathapuruṣaḥ, <> [[3.4.81]] ityeśirecau, eranekācaḥ` [[6.4.82]] ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| `dayateriti deṅo grahaṇam, na tu daya dāna ityasya` iti| nanu ca `daya dānagatirakṣaṇahiṃsādāneṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-481) ityetasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha - `tasya hi` ityādi| liṭītyucyate, na ca `daya dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-481) - ityetasyānantaro liḍasti; yasmāt? tasya <> [[3.1.37]] ityanenām? vihitaḥ| nanu ca `amantre` iti tatrānuvartate, tato mantra āmo'bhāvāt? syādevānantaryam? evaṃ manyate - yathādṛṣṭānuvidhiśchandasīti| na ca `daya dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-481) ityetasya mantre digyādeśo dṛśyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| ihāvadigye - ityanavakāśātvād? digyādese kṛte paścād? dvirvacanena bhavitavyam, yathā cakhyāvityatra `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ` [[2.4.54]] iti khyāñādeśasyānavakāśatvāt? tatra kṛte paścāddvirvacanam, tathāvadigye ityatrāpi digyādeśe kṛte paścād? dvirvacana kena bādhyeta? iti yaścodayet - taṃ pratyāha - `digyādeśena dvirvacanasya bādhanamiṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi labhyate? nityagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| iha pūrvasūtrānnityagrahaṇamanuvartate, na cātra vibhāṣā prāpnoti, yannivṛttyartha nityagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tasmādanyalliṭi yat? kāryaṃ prāpnoti, tannivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate; tenaivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate - `liṭi prāpnuvatāṃ kāryāṇāṃ digyādeśa eva nityaṃ bhavati, nānyatkāryam`| ityevaṃ dvirvacananivartanaṃ bhavati| yaṇādeśastu liṭityucyāyaṃ na vidhīyata iti <<eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya>> [[6.4.82]] ityaci bhavati||`sasvaratuḥ, sasvaruḥ` iti| `svṛ śabdopatāpayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-932), `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityabhyāsasyāttvam, raparatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ| `dadhvaratuḥ, dadhvaruḥ` iti| `dhvṛ hūcrchane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-939)| `sasmaratuḥ, sasmaruḥ` iti| `smṛ ādhyāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-807)| nanu ca sarvatraiva sābhyāsamaṅgam, na ca tat? saṃyogādi? naiṣa doṣaḥ, `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam` ityeṣo'tra pakṣaḥ, tatra parasyāpyaṅgasaṃjñā bhavatyeva| athāpi `sthāne dvirvacanam` ityapyadoṣaḥ; sarvatraiva hi liṭabhyāsaḥ saṃyogāditvaṃ vihanti, ucyate cedaṃ vacanam, tatraivaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ - prāgdvirvacanāt? saṃyogāditvamasti, iha ca dvirvacanāt? prāk saṃyogāditvamasti| `cikṣipatuḥ, cikṣipuḥ` iti| `kṣi kṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-236), iyaṅādeśaḥ| `pratiṣedhaviṣaye'pi` ityādi| yaḥ `kṅiti ca` (1|15) ityasya pratiṣedhasya viṣayo na bhavati thalādiḥ, tatra <> [[7.3.84]] ityevaṃ guṇaḥ siddhaḥ| tasmādguṇapratiṣedhaviṣaye'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ vṛddhiviṣaye'pi paratvādguṇena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākartumāha - `vṛddhiviṣaye tu` ityādi| guṇasyāvakāśaḥ - sasvaratuḥ, sasvaruriti; ñṇiti vṛddheravakāśaḥ - svārakaḥ, dhvāraka iti; sattvāra, dadhvāretyatrobhayaprasaṅge pūrvavipratiṣedhena vṛddhireva bhavati| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, dīrghasyāpi mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ cet? naitadasti; bhavitavyameva hi dīrghasyottarasūtreṇa - `stṛñ? ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1484), ātastaratuḥ, ātastaruriti| nanu caitasmāt? taparakaraṇānna prāpnota, sāvakāśaṃ cottaravacanamasaṃyogādau - `kṛ? vikṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1409) nicakaratuḥ, nikaruriti? yadyevam, eve tarhi na cedaṃ taparakaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi tasināyaṃ nirdeśaḥ| `saṃyogādeḥ` ityādi| ihāṅgaprakaraṇādaṅgaṃ saṃyogāditvena viśiṣyate| na ca karoteḥ saṃyogādyaṅgamiti na prāpnoti, tasmāt? saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti karoterapi yathā syādguṇaḥ| `sañcaskaratuḥ, sañcaskaruḥ` iti| <> [[6.1.137]] iti suṭ, sa ca <<aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi>> [[6.1.136]] iti vacanādabhyāsavyavāye'pi bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamiha guṇo na sidhyati, yāvatā suṭi kṛte `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhrate` (vyā|pa|21) iti karotiḥ saṃyogādarbhavati? ityata āha - `atra hi` ityādi| anena suṭo bahiraṅgatāṃ pratipādayati| bahiraṅgatve hi tasya `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) ityantaraṅge guṇe kartavye bahiraṅgasya suṭo'siddhatvāt? saṃyogāditvaṃ karoternopapadyate| pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate paścāt? sādhanena` (jai|pa|vṛ|98) ityasmindarśane dhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgamiti suṭo'pi dhātūpasaryayoḥ kāryatvādantaraṅgatā syāt| `pūrva dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate paścādupasargeṇa` (sī|pa|128) ityasmin? darśane suḍbahiraṅgo bhavati| tathā hi - asmin? darśane nirupasargasyaiva dhātorarthaḥ sādhanena yujyata iti sādhanābhidhāyī pūrva tāvalliṭ? kartavyaḥ; tatra kṛte tadāśraye dvirvacane kṛte paścādupasargayoge `aḍabhyāsavayavāye'pi` [[6.1.136]] iti suṭ? kriyate| evañca kriyamāṇe hranekapadāśritatvāt, bahvapekṣatvācca suṭo bahiraṅgatā pratipādyate| guṇastu liḍutpattisamanantarakālameva prāpnoti, nāparaṃ kiñcidapekṣate; ekapadāpekṣatvādalpāpekṣatvāccāntaraṅgaḥ, tataśca tasmin? kartavye suṭo'siddhatvāt? karotiḥ saṃyogādyaṅgaṃ na bhavati| tasmādasau na prāpnoti| `evañca kṛtvā` ityādi| yata evaṃ suḍbahiraṅgaḥ, evañca kṛtvā'ntaraṅga iṭi kartavye tasyāsiddhatvādasaṃyogāditvāt? karoterupaskṛṣīṣṭa, saṃskṛṣīṣṭa - ityatara <<ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ>> [[7.2.43]] itīḍāgamo na bhavati| etena bahiraṅgataiva suṭaḥ pratipāditā| nanu cāṅgādhikārāt? pratyāsatteraṅgāvayava eva saṃyogo gṛhrate, kātpūrvagrahaṇena tatra jñāpitamabhaktatvaṃ suṭaḥ, tataścābhaktatvādevāsaṃyogāditvāt? karoteriṇna bhaviṣyati, kimatra bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatvenopanyastena? satyametat; evaṃ manyate - bhavatu nāma karotibhaktatvaṃ suṭaḥ, tathāpyasiddhatvāt? tasya saṃskṛṣīṣṭa - ityatreṭprasaṅgo na bhaviṣyatīti saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti| asyāyamarthaḥ - saṃyogopadhaḥ karotiraṅgaṃ gṛhrate yena tat? saṃyogopadhagrahaṇavyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kartavyam - cakāro'tra kriyate, sa ca karoteḥ saṃyogopadhasya samuccayārthaḥ| tena tasyāpi suṭi kṛte saṃyogopadhasya guṇo bhaviṣyatīti||`ṛccha gatīndriyapralayamūrttibhāveṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1296)| arterapyatra praśleṣaḥ; bahuvacananirdeśāt| ata evāha - `ṛcchateraṅgasya, ṛ ityetasya, ṛkārāntānāṃ ca` iti| ṛkārāntāḥ - `kṝ vikṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1409), `gṝ? nigaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1410) ityemādayaḥ| `ānarcchatuḥ, ānarcchuḥ` ityādi| atususau, guṇaḥ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryaṃ pūrvavat, <> [[7.4.70]] iti dīrghaḥ, `tasmānnuḍ? dvihalaḥ` [[7.4.71]] iti nuṭ| `āratuḥ` āruḥ` iti| pūrvavadabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ, tataḥ pūrvasavarṇeneti| `ṛcchateralaghūpadhatvāt` ityādi| alaghūpaghatvaṃ tu tasyāntaraṅgatvāt| `che ca` [[6.1.71]] iti tuki kṛte <> [[1.4.11]] iti gurusaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ gurūpadhatvānna prāpnotīti veditavyam| `ṛtāṃ tu` ityādi| ṛ ṛtāṃ tu pratiṣiddha eveti guṇo vidhīyata ityapekṣyate| guṇapratiṣedhastu teṣāṃ `asaṃyogāsliṭ? kit` [[1.2.5]] iti kittve sati <> [[1.1.5]] ityanena veditavyaḥ| `vṛddhiviṣaye tu` ityādi| yathā `ṛtaśca saṃyogāveḥ` [[7.4.10]] iti vṛddhiviṣaye pūrvavipratiṣedhena vṛddhirevedhyate, tathā ṛṛtāmapīti| guṇasyāvakāśaḥ - nicakaratuḥ, nicakaruriti; vṛddheravakāśaḥ - kārakaḥ, hāraka iti; nicakāra, nijagāretyatra vṛddhiviṣaye pūrvavipratiṣedhena vṛddhirevedhyate||`śṛ? hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1488) `dṛ? vidāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1490) `pṛ? pālanapūraṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1489) - eṣāṃ pūrvasūtreṇa nityo guṇo bhavatyeva| `viśaśratuḥ` iti| hrasvatve kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ| `hrasvavacanam` ityādi| asati hrasvagrahaṇe vāścanena vikalpite yasmin? pakṣe guṇo nāsti tasmin? pakṣe `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttvaṃ prasajyeta, `udīṣṭhapūrvasya` [[7.1.102]] ityuttvañca| tasmāt? tannivṛttyartha hrasva ityucyate? ṛditi kartavye hrasvagrahaṇamuttarārtham| kecit? ityādi| kathaṃ punarasya pratyācyamāne viśaśratuḥ - ityevamādīni rūpāṇi sidhyanti? ityāha - `śrā pāke` ityādi| yadyapi <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityakaralope kṛte śrādīnāṃ viśaśraturityevamādīni rūpāṇi sidhyantīti, tathāpyarthamevo bhavati; tadā'yutttamasya pratyākhyānamityāśaṅkyānekārthatvāddhātūnāmityuktam| `tathā ca sati` ityādinā pratyādinā pratyākhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe| yadi sūtrasya pratyākhyānaṃ kriyate, kvāsau kṛte viśaśṛṣāniti rūpaṃ na sidhyati, tathā hi - yadi śṛṇātehryasvo na kriyate, tadā viśaśarvāniti rūpaṃ syāt| atha śrāteḥ, viśaśrivāniti| tasmādayukatamasya pratyākhyānam||aṇiti pūrvema ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam; anyathā `ke'caḥ` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| atha vā - aca ityetadapi na brāūyāt, aca eva hi harasvadīrghalputā bhavanti| `jñakā` iti| jānātīti jñā, <> [[3.1.135]] , tadantāṭṭāpa| ajñātā jñeti `prāgivās? kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] | atha vā - anukampitā jñeti <> [[5.3.76]] iti kan? kani kṛte tadantāṭṭāp| atheha kasmānna bhavati - `kṛdādhārārcikalabhyaḥ kan` (da|u|3|18) iti rāterdadhāteśca kan, tadantāṭṭāp - `rākā, dhākā` ityādi| subodham| niranubandhasyeha grahaṇānniranubandhakaparibhāṣayā kano grahaṇena na [nāsti - mudrite] bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `na kapi` ityādi| yadyeṣā paribhāṣopatiṣṭate, tadā `na kapi` [[7.4.14]] iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| sānubandhakatvādeva kapo grahaṇaṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ||`bahukumārīkaḥ` iti| bahvyaḥ kumāryo yasya saḥ| <> [[5.4.153]] iti kap; anubandhalopaḥ| athātrāsmin? hrasvatve pratiṣiddha upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ata #eva pratiṣedhānna bhaviṣyatīti cet? na; `anantarasya vidhirāvā pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) ityanantarasyaiva hrasvasya hrayaṃ pratiṣedho na sarvasya| kapīti vacanasāmarthyādupasarjanahrasvatvamiti na bhaviṣyatīti cet? yatra hrupasarjanahrasvatvasya prāptirasti, <> [[1.2.48]] iti hrasvaśāsane strīśabdena stryadhikāravihitānāṃ pratyayānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ grahaṇāt| tasmādbahukumārīka ityatropasarjanasya hrasvatvena bhavitavyamityata āha - `gostriyorupasarjanasya` ityādi| kasmānna bhavati? ityāha - `samāsārthe hi` ityādi| upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ hi strīpratyayāntasya samāsaprātipadikasaya vidhīyate, taddhidhāne `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] ityataḥ prātipadikagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ samāsaprātipadikasyaiva strīpratyayāntasyopasarjanahrasvaḥ syāt| na ca bahukumārīka ityādau strīpratyayāntaṃ samāsaprātipadisaṃ bhavati; yasmāt? <> [[5.4.68]] ityadhikāra evāyāṃ kabvidhīyate| `samāsāntāḥ` ityatrāntagrahaṇasyaitat? prayojanam - samāsasyānto'vacayo yathā syāditi, sa ca kathaṃ samāsasyāvayavo bhavati? yadi tena saha samāsasaṃjñā bhavati| kathañca tena samāsasaṃjñā bhavati? yadyakṛte samāse samāsārthāduttarapadāt? kabbhavati, paścāt? kadantena samāso bhavati, nānyathā| tasmāt? samāsāntādhikāre kapo vidhānāt? samāsārthāduttarapadāt? kapi kṛte paścāt? samāsena bhavitavyam| tataśca strīparatyayāntamiha samāsaparātapadekaṃ na bhavatīti na bhavatyupasarjanahrasvatvam|`bahukhaṭvākaḥ` iti| <<śeṣādvibhāṣā>> [[5.4.154]] iti kap||<> [[1.1.5]] iti pratiṣedhe prāpte'yaṃ guṇo vidhīyate| `akarat` iti| kṛño luḍ, cliḥ, `tip, <> [[3.1.59]] iti cleraṅa| `asarat` iti| `sṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-935)| `ārat` iti| `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-936), `sarttiśāstyarttibhyaśca` [[3.1.56]] iti cleraṅ, arterajāditvādāṭi kṛte `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `adarśat` ita <> [[3.1.57]] ityaṅ| atha guṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham| akāra eva nocyeta? naivaṃ śakyam; akāra ityucyamāne duśerantyasya syāt| guṇagrahaṇe tu sati saṃjñāvidhāne niyama itīka eva sthāne bhavati||`āsthat` iti| `asu kṣepaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1209) `asyativaktikhakyātibhyo'ṅ` [[3.1.52]] iti cleraṅādeśaḥ||`aāt` iti| `ṭu oiā gativṛddhyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1010)| `jṛstambhubhrucu` [[3.2.58]] ityādināṅ dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpatvam||`apaptat` iti| `śala hula patlṛ gatau (dhātupāṭhaḥ-843,844,845), puṣādināṅa| makāro deśavidhyarthaḥ||`avocat` iti| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1842), `asyatiktikhyātibhyaḥ` [[3.1.52]] ityādināṅ| makārasaya tadeva prayojanam||aprāptaviṣayatvādguṇavidhānasya ṅiti sārvadhātuka etadvidhānam| piti tu sāmānyalakṣaṇainaiva guṇaḥ siddhaḥ| loṭ, <<āḍuttamasya picca>> [[3.4.92]] ityāṭi - śayai, śayāvaha ita| tasmādyatra guṇo na prāpnoti tatra vidhīyate| `śerate` iti| adāditvācchapo luk? `tmanepadeṣvanataḥ` [[7.1.5]] iti jhakārasyādādeśaḥ| atra <<śīṅo ruṭ>> [[7.1.6]] ruḍāgamo bhavati| `śiśye` iti| liṭ, `liṭ? ca` [[3.4.115]] ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā, uttamapuruṣasyaikavacanam, prathamapuruṣasyaikavacanaṃ vā| yadā prathamapurusyaikavacanaṃ tadaiś, pūrvavadeva dvirvacanam, <<eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya>> [[6.4.82]] iti yaṇādeśaḥ; anyadeṭ, ṭerettvam| atha guṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke eta` ityeṃvocyeta? siddham? iti| etadāgamavākyena draḍhayitumāha - `devatrātaḥ` ityādi| `traiṅ? pālane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-965), ktaḥ| `nudavidondatrāghrahyībhyo'nyatarasyām` [[8.2.56]] iti saṃjñāviṣaye natvaṃ na bhavatyeva - devaistrāto devatrātaḥ, devaśabdo'tra saṃjñopalakṣaṇārthaḥ| kevalasyāpi trātaśabdasya saṃjñāyāṃ na natvaṃ pratipadyate| evaṃ sajñāyā anyatrobhayaṃ bhavati - trāṇaḥ, prāta iti| `galaḥ` iti| girateḥ pacādyac| <> [[8.2.20]] , <> [[8.2.21]] iti prāṇyaṅge nityaṃ latvam - gala iti| viṣe tu bhavatyeva - gara iti| `grāhaḥ` iti| grāheḥ <> [[3.1.143]] iti ṇapratyayaḥ| jalacare nakre nityaṃ ṇapratyayo bhavati - grāha iti| ādityasomādiṣu pacādyajbhavatyeva - graha iti| `itiyoge ca sadvidhirna bhavati` iti| varṣatīti dhāvati, hantīti palāyate iti - <> [[3.2.126]] iti satsaṃjñakau śatṛśānacāvitiyoge na bhavata eva, vyavasthitavibhāṣayā| tatra <> [[3.2.121]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate - arjayan? sphoṭāyanasya` [[6.1.123]] iti vātāyane nityamavaṅ? bhavati, prāṇyaṅgo tu go'kṣamityatra na bhavati; anyatrobhayam - gavākṣam, go'kṣamiti| `saṃśitavrataḥ` iti| vrate nitayamittvam| anyatra vikalpena - niśitam, niśātaṃ śastram| tīkṣṇamityarthaḥ| tadetat? sarvaṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣayā labhyate| kvacidvidhireva, kvacit? pratiṣedha eva, kvacidubhayamapītyevaṃvidhā vividhārthe sthitāṃ vibhāṣā vyavasthitavibhāṣā| etacca vividhamavasthānamākṛtau padārthe veditavyam| tatra hi sarva lakṣyarāśimekīkṛtyābhisaṃkṣipya tadubhayamupadiśyate| vidhiḥ pratiṣedhaśca jātau padārtha ubhayamapi bhavatītyetāvato'rthasya pratipādane śāstrasya vyāpāraḥ| yastu kvacidarthe vidhireva, kvicit? pratiṣedha eva, kvacidubhayamityasaṅkareṇa vyavasthānam, etaccāvicchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśāllabhyate||dhumāsthā` [[6.4.66]] iti sūtreṇettve prāpte dadhāterhirādeśo vidhīyate| śtipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ| tena yaṅlugantasya hirādeśo na bhavati - dādhītaḥ, dādhītavān, dādhītveti||pūrvavadīttve prāpte ktvāpratyaye hirādeśo vidhīyate| yadyapi `hi gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1257) ityasyāpi hitveti sidhyati, tathāpi jahāterikāranivṛttyartha vacanam| atha kimarthaṃ jahāteriti śtipā nirdeśaḥ, na `haḥ` evocyate? ityāha - `jahāteḥ` ityādi| etena `ohāṅ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1089) ityasya nivṛttye nirdeśaḥ kriyata iti darśayati| yadi hi `haḥ` iti nirdeśaḥ syāt, tadā tasya sādhāraṇatvājjihāterapi syāt| jahāteriti śtipā nirdeśe tu na bhavati| anena jahātireva nirdiśyate, na jihātiḥ| na hi tasyaivaṃvidho nirdeśe yaṅlugantasya na bhavati - jāhātveti| ītvamapyatra na bhavati; tadvidhāvapi śtipā nirdeśāt| atra ceṭi kṛte <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ||cakāreṇa chandasītyanukṛṣyate| `iḍāgamo vā` iti| yadeḍāgamastadā <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ| `sudhitam` iti, <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| `vasudhitam` iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ| `nemadhitam` iti| `sāmi` [[2.1.26]] iti dvitīyāsamāsaḥ| sāmīti tatrārthagrahaṇamityuktam| nemaśabdaścāyaṃ sāmiśabdaparyāyaḥ| `dhiṣva` iti| `thāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] , <> [[3.4.91]] iti vakāraḥ| `dvirvacanābhāvaḥ` iti| `ślau` [[6.4.112]] ityakāralopaḥ; ghakārasya `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - takāraḥ, <> [[8.2.38]] ityabhyāsasya bhaṣbhāvena dhakāraḥ| `dhiṣīya` iti| āśiṣi liṅ, `iṭo't` [[3.4.106]] ityattvam||chandasīti nivṛttam; pūrvasūtre cakāreṇānukṛṣṭatvāt| `dattaḥ dattavān` iti| ktaktavatū| `dattiḥ` iti| ktin| `dhītaḥ, dhītavān` iti| pūrvavadīttvam| atha <> [[7.4.42]] iti hirādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha - `gheṭa etadrūpam` ityādi| `dheṭ? pāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-902) ityasya rūpam, na dadhāteḥ| tena hirādeśo na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `dātam` iti| `dāp? lavane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1059) ityetasyaitadrūpam; tasya ghusaṃjñā nāsti; `adāp` [[1.1.19]] iti pratiṣedhāt| `do dadghoḥ` iti jaśtvenāyaṃ nrdeśaḥ, tatra na jñāyate - kiṃ takakārānto'yamādeśaḥ? āhosviddakārāntaḥ? uta dhakārāntaḥ? atha thakārānta iti vā - iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `ayamādeśaḥ` ityādi| kathaṃ jñāyate? ityāha - `evaṃ hruktam` ityādi| yadyayamādeśastakārāntaḥ syāt, sudattetyatra <> [[6.3.123]] ityanuvartamāne `dāsti` [[6.3.123]] itī dīrghatvaṃ syāt| atha dakārāntaḥ, tadā `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] iti niṣṭhānatvaṃ syāt| atha dhakārāntaḥ, tadā `jhaṣastathorgho'dhaḥ` [[8.2.40]] iti jhaṣantāddhatvamāpadyeta niṣṭhātakārasya| `thānte'doṣaḥ` iti| naño'tra praśleṣaḥ| thānte doṣo nāstotyarthaḥ| `tasmāt` ityādi| yasmāt? triṣu pūrṣakeṣu pakṣeṣu doṣaḥ, tasmātthānto'yamādeśaḥ| udāharaṇe dattaḥ, dattavāniti `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvama - thasya taḥ| `yadi tu` ityādi| dvau pakṣau bhādhye `dasti` [[6.3.123]] ityatra darśitau - `dā` ityetasmastakārādau, takārānte veti| tatra yadi takārānte `dā` ityetasmin? dīrghatvaṃ bhavatīti - eṣa pakṣa āśrīyate, tadaiva dīrghatvaprāptidoṣaḥ| yadi tu takārādau `dā` ityetasmin? dīrghatvaṃ bhavatīti - eṣa pakṣa āśrīyate, tadā tānte'pyadoṣaḥ| yatra takārāditvam, `dā` ityetasya, tatra dīrghatvaṃ bhavata - nīttam, vīttamityādau, na tu sudattādau| tasmāt? pākṣiko dīrghaprāptidoṣaḥ| `dāntadhāntayorapi` ityādi| takārādisanniyogena hi dāntadhāntāvādeśāvimau vihitau notsahete tadvighātanimittatāmupagantum| tasmāddāntadhāntayorapyadoṣaḥ| `avadattam` ityādi| ādikarmaṇi=kriyārambhe| ādibhūtakriyākṣaṇa ityarthaḥ| atra <> [[7.4.47]] iti takārādeśe prāpta ete'vadattādayo nipātyante| `ādikarmaṇi` iti ca sarveṣāṃ viśeṣaṇam, na tu pradattamityasyaiva| ādikarmaṇo'nyatra `aca upagargāttaḥ` [[7.4.47]] iti takārādeśo bhavati, na tu dadbhāvaḥ - avattam, vīttam, sūttam, anūttamiti| `anupasargāḥ` ityādi| atha vā - avādayo dadātiṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñakā eva na bhavanti; tadvācyāyāḥ kriyayā anyā yā kriyā gamirvācyā tadviṣayatvāt - avagataṃ dattamavadattamityevamanyatrāvagantavyam| tasmād? gamiṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñakā ete, na dadātiṃ prati| tathā hruktam - yaṃ prati kriyāyṛktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñakā bhavantīti| tasmādupasargasaṃjñāyā abhāvānnaivātra takāraḥ prasajediti kiṃ nipātanena!||dadādeśasyāyamapavādaḥ| `ta ityayamādeśo bhavati` iti| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| prattamityādāvākārasya takāre kṛte dakārasya cartvam - takāraḥ `nīttam` iti| `dasti` [[6.3.123]] iti dīrghatvam| `avadāttam` iti| `daip? śodhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-924) ityetasyaitadrūpam| `āderalaḥ prāpnoti` iti| <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti vacanāt| `aca ityetaddvirāvartayitavyam` iti| `acaḥ` ityetasya dvirāvṛttāvaco'ceti dve śabdarūpe bhavataḥ| tatraikaṃ pañcamyantam; aparaṃ ṣaṣṭhantam| tatraikenopasargo viśiṣyate - ajantādupasargāditi| itareṇāpi sthānī nirdiśyata ityevamākārasyāyamādeśo bhavati| `dvitakāro vā` iti| atha vā - `aca upasargāttaḥ` iti| dvitakāra eva saṃyogādeśo nirdiśyate, tenāsyānekāstvāt? sarvasyaiva bhavati, yadi tarhi dvitakārako'yaṃ nirdeśastadā `apo bhi` [[7.4.48]] ityanenāpi sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti, nekāltvādityāha - `aṣo bhi` ityādi| `apo bhi` ityatra pañcamyantamaca ityanuvartate, tena satyapyanekāltve <> [[1.1.67]] iti pakāramātrasya bhaviṣyati, na sarvasyeti| `dyateḥ` ityādi| dyaterityasyāvakāśaḥ - yatrājanta upasargo na bhavati - nirditam, durditamiti; asyādeśasyāvakāśaḥ - ajantādupasargāt? paro yo'nyo ghusaṃjñakaḥ - `ḍudāñ? dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1091), avattam, parīttamiti; ajantādupasargāduttarasya dyaterubhayaprasaṅge sati takāra eva bhavati vipratiṣedhena - avattam, prattamiti||`adbhiḥ` iti| <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti jaśtvam - takārasya dakāraḥ| `dvitakārapakṣe tu pūrvasyāpi <> [[8.4.53]] iti jaśtvam - dakāraḥ| <> [[8.4.65]] iti pūrvadakāralopaḥ| `suvaḥ` [`svavaḥ` iti| kāśikā] ityādi| suvas, svatavas, māsa, uvas - ityeteṣāṃ ca bhakārādau paratasta ityayamādeśa iṣyate cchandasi viṣaye| sa ca <> [[3.1.85]] ityanenaiva labhyata iti veditavyam||atrāpi dvitakārapakṣe'nekāltvāt? sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti, tasmāt? `acaḥ` iti| pañcamyantamanuvartanīyamiti| atha vā - `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti` (vyā|pa|106) iti sakārasyaiva bhaviṣyati| `vatsyati` iti| `vasanivāse` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1942)| `jighatsati` iti| adeḥ san, `luṅsanorghaslṛ` [[2.4.37]] iti tasya ghaslādeśaḥ| `vakṣyati` iti| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1842), <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam| `ghāsaḥ, vāsaḥ` iti| bhāve ghañ, <> [[2.4.38]] ityaderghaslādeśaḥ| `āsse, vasse` iti| `āsa upaveśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1021), `vasa ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1023), anudāttettvādātmanepadam, `cāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] , adāditvācchapo luk| atha `saḥ syatiṅ` iti kasmānnoktam? naivaṃ śakyam; ihāpi na syāt - vyativatsīṣṭhā iti||<> [[3.3.15]] tāsiḥ, sip| `kartāse` iti| `thāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] | `tvamasi` iti| `sa bhuvi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1065), pūrvavacchapo luk| `vyatise` iti| `kartari karmavyatīhāre` [[1.3.14]] ityātmanepadaṃ bhavati| `thāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] , <<śnasorallopaḥ>> [[6.4.111]] ityakāralopaḥ| atha <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha - `asterakārasakārayoḥ` ityādi| akārasakārayorhi luptayoḥ pratyayamātramavaśiṣyate, tadeva padama, ataḥ <> [[8.3.111]] iti pratiṣedhāt? ṣatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ||`kartārau, kartāraḥ` iti| luṭ, tas, jhiḥ, <> [[2.4.85]] iti taso jheśca yathākramaṃ raurasau bhavataḥ| `adhyetārau, adhyetāraḥ` iti| iṅo ṅittvādatmanepadam? ātām, jhaḥ tayośca pūrvavadraurasau| aste rephādipratyayo na sambhavatīti nāstyudāharaṇam| kecittu - `vyatire` ityudāharaṇaṃ darśayanti; etacca cchabdasyevaṃ prayogo yadyasati tato yuktam, atha tu nāstyevaṃ satyayuktam| <> [[6.4.76]] iti rebhāvaśchandasi vidhīyate, `yathādṛṣṭānuvidhiśchandasi` (vyā|pa|68) iti| cakāraḥ pūrvāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ||`kartāhe` iti| kṛño luṭ, ātmanepedam, uttamapuruṣaikavacanam, iṭ, ṭe#ettvam| atra sakārasyānena haḥ| `vyatihe` iti| asteḥ <> [[1.3.14]] ityātmanepadam, pūrvavadakāralopaḥ| `eti` iti| taparakaraṇaṃ saptamyāmayādeśaparīhārārtham| ayādeśe hi sati sandehaḥ syāt - kasyāyaṃ nirdeśa iti - kimayādeśasya? athaikārasya||svaritatvāllopo'nuvartate, na tvanantaro hakāraḥ, tasyāsvaritatvāpratijñānāt| yakāre tvikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| yiśca ivurṇaśca tau yovarṇau tayoḥ parataḥ `dīdhīṅ? dīptidevanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1076) `vevīṅ? vetināṃ tulye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1077) - ityanayorlopo bhavati, sa ca <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityantyasya| yakārādau śravaṇe prāpta ivarṇādau `eranekācaḥ` [[6.4.82]] iti yaṇādeśe prāpte lopavacanamidam| `ādīdhya, āvevya` iti| lyap| `ādīdhyata, āvevita` iti| <> [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam, <> [[3.1.67]] | `ādīdhita, āvevita` iti| <> [[1.3.13]] ityātmanepadam, <> [[3.1.67]] | `ādīdhita, āvevita` iti| tṛc| `ādīdhyanamādevyanam` iti| lyuṭ, `daudhīvevīṭām` [[1.1.6]] iti guṇaniṣedhādyaṇādeśaḥ| atra yadyapi nimittyoḥ kāryiṇoḥ samānatvam, tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati; asvaratatvāt| varṇagrahaṇamivarṇe śrūyamāṇe yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt - ādīdhayateḥ, āvevayaterṇijantāṇṇavul, ādīdhyakaḥ, ādevyakaḥ| atra hi nityatvāṇṇilope kṛte pratyayalopalakṣaṇana [[1.1.61]] prāpnoti, ato varṇagrahaṇānna bhavati||`saḥ syārdhadhātuke` [[7.4.49]] ityataḥ sītyanuvartate, tacca sona viśeṣaṇam| `mīti mīnātiminatyoḥ` iti| `mīñ? hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1476), `ḍumiñ? prakṣepaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1250) - ityetayoḥ| nanu ca `mī` ityetasminnuccāryamāṇe minotegrrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate? naivam; asyāpi <> [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghatve kṛte mītyevaṃ rūpaṃ bhavati| evamapi lakṣaṇapratipadoktapibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|3) tasya grahaṇaṃ nopapadyate? naitadasti; atra hi ghusaṃjñakatvāt? `ghu` ityasya pūrvanipātamakurvataitat? sūcitam - yathā pūrvanipāta iha nāpekṣyate, tathānyadapi kiñcicchāstrīyaṃ vacanamiti| teneyaṃ paribhāṣā nāpekṣyata iti yuktaṃ minoterapi grahaṇam| `mā hi gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ` iti| meṅaprabhṛtīnāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ trayāṇāṃ grahaṇam| `ghu` iti ghusaṃjñakau `dā` `dhā` - ityatau gṛhrate| `rabha rābhasye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-974), `ḍulabhaṣ? prāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-975), `śaklṛ śaktau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1261), `śala hula patlṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-843,844,845), `pada gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1169) - eṣāmacaḥ sthāne sakārādau pratyaye sanīs? bhavati| aca ityasya grahaṇaṃ sarvādeśo mā bhūdityevamartham| asati hi tasminnanekāltvāt? sarvādeśaḥ syāt| `pramitsani` iti| `atra lopo'byāsasya` [[7.4.58]] ityabhyāsalopaḥ, `saḥ syārdhadhātuke` [[7.4.49]] iti tasya saḥ| `apamitsate` iti| `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityātmanepadam| evaṃ āripsate` `ālipsate` ityatrāpi| `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - bhakārasya pakāraḥ, `tkoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca` [[8.2.29]] iti salopaḥ||`īpsati` iti| `āplṛ vyāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1260)| `jñīpsati` iti| `jñā avabodhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1507), ṇic, `artti` [[7.3.36]] ityādinā puk, `māraṇatopaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-811) `micca` iti mitsaṃjñāyāṃ hrasvaḥ, <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti ṇilopaḥ| `ītrsati` iti| `ṛdhu vṛddhau` (dhā|1271), īkāraḥ, raparatvaṃ ca, śrakārasya `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam - takāraḥ| iha ca jñāpināṅgenājviśeṣayitavyaḥ, na tvacā jñāpiḥ, vyabhicārābhāvāt| na hi jñaparajantatāṃ vyabhicarati| aci tu jñapināṅgena viśiṣyamāṇe sarvasya jñapisambandhino'ca īttvena bhavitavyam, tathā ca ṇerapīttve kṛte jñīpsatīti na sidhyedityetaccodyamāśaṅkyāha - `jñapedrvāvacau` ityādi| tatrettvāsyāvakāśo'jādyaḥ, ṇilopasyāvakāśaḥ - kāraṇā, hāraṇā; dvitīyasyāca ubhayaprasaṅge ṇilopa eva bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena - jñīpsatīti| `itarasya` iti| akārasya| `ardidhiṣati` iti| laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, raparatvam, <> [[6.1.2]] iti `dhi` ityetaddvirucyate| rephasya tu dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati; <> [[6.1.3]] iti pratiṣedhāt| abhyāsasya jaśtvam - jakāraḥ| takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ||`mokṣate` iti| `muclū mokṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1430)| <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam; `iṇkoḥ` [[8.3.57]] iti ṣatvam, `karmavatkarmaṇā` [[3.1.87]] ityadinā karmavadatideśādātmanepadam| `svayameva` iti vacanaṃ karmakarttṛtvapradarśanārtham| vatsaṃ moktumicchati, sa moktumiṣyamāṇo muktikriyāṃ pratyānukūlyaṃ yadā pratipadyate tadā svatantratvādasmin? karmaṇi karttṛtvena vivakṣite mucirakarmako bhavati| atha guṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, nodityevocyeta? namu caidaṃ satyokāraścakārasya sthāne <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] prāpnoti, guṇagrahaṇādika eva bhavati, saṃjñāvidhāne niyamāt? naitadasti; aca ityanuvartate| tenāntyasya na bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tahrretajjñāpayati - aceti nivṛttamiti| tena <<atra lopo'bhyāsasya>> [[7.4.58]] ityatrāto'bhyāsasya lopo na bhavati| sati tvajadhikāre, mā bhūt? tasyānuvṛttirapārthiketyaca eva lopaḥ syāt||atretyanena yannirdiśyate taddarśayitumāha - `yadetat` ityādi| athātragrahaṇaṃ kimartham? `sani mīmā` [[7.4.54]] ityādau prakaraṇe yathā syāt; dadau, dadaturityādau mā bhūditi cet? na; yadi hretat? prayojanamabhimataṃ syāt? `sani mīmādhurabhalabhaśakapatapadāmaca isabhyāsalopaśca` ityevamuddiśyeta, evamihaiva prakaraṇe bhadiṣyati, nānyatra, tato niṣprayojanamatragrahaṇamityata āha - `sani mīmādhurabhalabha` ityādi| `viṣayāvadhāraṇārtham` iti| abhyāsalopaviṣayasya niyamārthamityarthaḥ| tāmeva tasya viṣayaniyamārthatāṃ darśayitumāha - `atraiva` ityādi| atretyanenesādiviṣayo nirdiśyate| isādiviṣaya evābhyāsalopo yathā syāditi niyamena yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayitumāha - `sanvadbhāvaviṣaye na bhavati` iti| `amīmapat` iti| `bhīñ? hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1476) <> [[6.1.50]] ityāttvam, ṇic, pūrvavat? puk, luṅaḥ, cleścaṅ, ṇilopaḥ, upadhāhrasvatvam, dvirvacanam, aṭ, `sanvallaghuni caṅpare` [[7.4.93]] ityādinā sanvadbhāve `sanyataḥ` [[7.4.79]] itīttvam, <> [[7.4.94]] iti dīrghaḥ| `adīdapat` iti| `ḍudāñ? dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1091) pūrvavaṇṇijādiḥ| atragrahaṇādihābhyāsalopo na bhavati| kathaṃ punaḥ sanyabhyāsalopa ucyamāna iha prāpnoti, yannivṛttyarthamatragrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha - `sanvallaghuni` ityādi| yathaiva hi sanvadbhāvātideśādittvaṃ bhavati, evamabhyāsalopaḥ syāt| ihālontyaparibhāṣayā <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] lopena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākartuṃmāha - `sarvasya` ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ sarvasya labhyate? ityata āha - `tadarthameva` ityādi| etenaivakāreṇa viṣayāvadhāraṇārthatāṃ nirasyati| yadyevam, sanvadbhāvaviṣaye'pi prāpnoti? evaṃ manyate - sanvadbhāvaviṣaye'pyabhyāsalopaprasaṅgaḥ parihartu śakyate| tatra sanvaditi sanāśrayakāryamatidiśyate| na cābhyāsalopaḥ sanamevāpekṣate, kiṃ tarhi? isbhāvādikamapi| tadabhāvādasatyapyatragrahaṇe'mīmapadityādiṣvabhyāsalopo na bhaviṣyati| tasmādatiricyata evātragrahaṇamiti na kartavyameva| tat? kriyate - sarvasyābhyāsalopo yathā syāditi| kathaṃ punaḥ kriyamāṇe'pyatragrahaṇe sarvasya lopo labhyate? granthādhikyādarthādhikyamityeke| atragrahaṇena mahat? sūtraṃ prayaṇataitat? sūcitam - mahataḥ sthānino'yaṃ lopaḥ kartavyaḥ| evañcāyaṃ mahataḥ sthāninaḥ kṛto bhavati yadi sarvasyābhyāsalopaḥ kriyate, nānyathetyanye| `nānārthake'lontyavidhirityapare` iti| ke punaste? ye viṣayāvadhāraṇārthatāmatragrahaṇasya varṇayanti te veditavyāḥ| anarthakatvamabhyāsasya sthāne dvirvacanapakṣe veditavyam| atra hi yasya sthāne yacchabdāntaraṃ vidhīyate tat? samastamevārthavat| ekadeśastvabhyāso'narthaka eva| dviṣprayogadvirvacanapakṣe'pyanarthāntaravācitvādanarthāntaravācitvādanarthakatābhyāsasya||`ḍuḍhaukiṣate, tutraukiṣate` iti| ḍhaukṛ, traukṛ - ityetābhyāmanudāttettvādātmanepadibhyāṃ san, `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityātmanepadam| `aḍuḍhaukat, atutraukat` iti| ābhyāmeva ṇyantābhyāṃ luṅ, pūrvavaccaṅādikāryam| `ḍuḍhauke, tutrauke` iti| liṭa, ekavacanam, tasyaiś| `abhyāsasyānaci` ityādi| abhyāsasya yat? kāryaṃ vidhīyate tadanacipare bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - `vā caricalipatidadonāmacyākyābhyāsasya` (vā|658) ityāgamavighānasāmarthyāddhalādiśeṣeṇa na bhavitavyam| halādiśeṣe hi satyādeśasyāgamasya ca kaiādviśeṣo nāstītyādeśameva vidadhyāt| evañca - abhyāsalopābhāvāt? pāriśedhyādaco'nyatraiva bhaviṣyati||`halādiḥ` iti| hal? cāsāvādiśceti halādiḥ - karmadhārayo'yam, na tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ - halāmādirhalādiḥ| yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāt, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt - abhyāsasya yai halasteṣāmādiḥ śiṣyata iti| tathā ca - ānakṣatuḥ, ānakṣurityatra `akṣū vyāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-654) ityasyājāditvāddvitīyasyaikāco'bhāvāt? prathamasyaikāco dvirvacane kṛte yadyapyabhyāsādiḥ kakāro na bhavati, tathāpi halādirbhavati, tasya śeṣaḥ prasajyeta| karmadhāraye tu na doṣaḥ, tatrābhyāsāpekṣaṃ halāditvaṃ vidhīyate, na cātra kakāro'bhyāsādiḥ| tasmāt? karmadhārayo'yam| `jaglau` `mamlau` iti| `glai harvakṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-903), `mlai gātravināme` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-904), <<ādeca upadeśe'śiti>> [[6.1.45]] ityāttvam, <<āta au ṇalaḥ>> [[7.1.34]] ityauttvam| `āṭatuḥ` āṭuḥ` iti| <> [[7.4.70]] ityabhyāsasya dīrghatve kṛte savarṇadīrghatvam| nanu ca śeṣo'vasthānam, taccāneḥ siddhameva, tatkimartha vidhīyate? ityāha - `ādiśeṣanimitto'yam` ityādi| ādiśaṣo nimittaṃ yasya lopasya sa tathoktaḥ| na hyatrādeḥ śeṣo vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? tannimitto'yamanāderlopo vidhīyate| siddha eva hrāderavasthāne halādiśeṣa itīdaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ niyamārthaṃ vijñāyate - ādereva halo'vasthānaṃ bhavati, tvanāderiti evamādiśeṣanimittamanāderadarśanaṃ vihitaṃ bhavati| yadi tahrrādiśeṣanimitto'yamanāderlopo vidhīyate, evaṃ satyāduturāṭurityatra lopo na bhavati; nimittābhāvāt, abhyāsasya haleva tāvadādirnāsti, kutaḥ punastasya śeṣaḥ? ityata āha - `tatra` ityādi| anādilope kartavye'bhyāsajātirāśrīyate, nābhyāsavyaktiḥ| tena yadyapi sarvāsvabhyāsavyaktiṣu halādirna vartate, tathāpi kvacidapi papācetyādau vartamāno halādiranādeḥ sarvatrāṭatuḥ, āṭurityevamādāvapi nivṛtiṃta karoti; abhyāsajāterabhinnatvāt| yaiva hi papācetyādāvabhyāsajātiḥ, saivāṭatuḥ āṭurityādāvapi| `apare tu` ityādi| āṭatuḥ, āṭurityādāvanāderlopaṃ pratipādayitumapare brāuvata iti| śeṣaśabdo'yaṃ nāvasthānamātramāha, kiṃ tarhi? nivṛttyā viśiṣṭamavasthānam, yadyevam, avasthānasya viśeṣyatvāt? prādhānyam, nivṛttestu viśeṣaṇāvādaprādhānyam| tathā ca - paradhānānuyāyitvādaprādhānyaṃ guṇānām| yatraivābhyāsasya halāderavasthānaṃ papācetyādau, tatraidānāderhalo nivṛttyā bhavitavyam; tataḥ sa eva doṣaḥ - āṭatuḥ, āṭurityādāvanāderhalo nivṛttirna prāpnotīti? ata āha - `tadavasthānam` ityādi| yadyapi niśeṣyabhūtaṃ tadavasthānaṃ śeṣaśabdenābhidhīyata ityuktitaḥ pradhānam? tathāpyavidheyatvādapradhānam| avidheyatvaṃ tu tasya siddhatvāt| nivṛttareva viśeṣaṇabhūtāpi vidheyatvāt? pradhānam| tathā coktam - siddhamupakārakaṃ parārthamaṅgam, sādhyo'nupakārakastvaṅgīti kṛtvā pradhānam| tatra nivṛttau vidheyatvāt? pradhānabhūtāyāmayamasya sūtrasyārtho jāyate - `abhyāsasyānāderhalo nivṛttirbhavati` iti| tataścāsau vidheyatvāt? prādhānyamāpannā satī kimityāderavidheyāmapradhānabhūtāmanivṛttimapekṣidhyate| kena kāraṇenāpekṣiṣyate? na kenacidityarthaḥ| na hi pradhānasya guṇānuya#āyitvaṃ yuktam| tasmādasatyapi halāderavasthāne'vāderlopena bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ||pūrveṇa śarāṃ seṣe prāpte khayāṃ śeṣa ārabhyate| anādiśeṣaścāyamādiśeṣaṃ bādhate| na hi śarāmavasthāne khayāṃ śeṣaśabdo viśeṣaṇamupapadyate| sa hi nivṛttyā viśiṣṭamavasthānamāha - ityuktam| na cobhayoravasthāne nivṛttyā viśiṣṭamavasthānaṃ bhavati| tasmādādiśeṣasyāyamanādiśeṣo'pavādaḥ| `cuścotiṣati` iti| `ścutikrṣaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-41), san, iṭ| `tiṣṭhāsati` iti| `ṣaṣṭhā gatinivṛttau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-928)| `pispandiṣate` iti| `spadi kiñciccalane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-14), anudāttet, iditvānnum, <> [[1.3.62]] ityātmanepadam| `sasnau` iti| `ṣṇā śauce` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1052)| pūrvevaṇṇala autvam| `kharpūrvāḥ` ityādi| `ucicchivati` iti| `ucchī vivāse` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-216), san? uchiṣ? iti sthite dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, tuk? ca; tatra varṇāśrayeṇāntaraṅgatvāt? tuk| tasmān? kṛte, dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, cutvañca, tatara paratvāt dvirvacane kartavye cutvasyāsiddhatvāddvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti chiṣśabdasya| tatra chakārasya śeṣo na prāpnoti; aśarpūrvatvāt| na hraṃ takāraḥ arbhavati, tataśca pūrveṇa halādiśeṣe kṛte satyabhāse takāraḥ śrūryata| athāpīdamasti - `pūrvatrāsiddhoyamadvirvacane` (jai|pa|vṛ|70) iti cutvaṃ paścāddvirvacanaṃ kriyate, tathāpi halādiśeṣeṇa chakāre nivṛtte `nimittāpāye naimittikasyāpyapāyaḥ` (vyā|pa|47) iti cutve nivṛtte ucicchiṣatītyatara takāra evābhyāse śrūyeta| tasmāt? kharpūrvāḥ khaya iti vaktavyan| evaṃ hi sati cchakārasya śeṣe kṛte takāro nivartata iti na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ||`cakhāna` iti| `khanu avadāraṇe` (dha|pā|878), dvirvacanam, tasya cutvam - chakāraḥ, <> [[8.4.54]] iti chakārasya cakāraḥ| `jaghāti` iti| `liṭanyatarasyām` [[2.4.40]] ityaderghaslādeśaḥ, abhyāsasya cutvam| nādavato mahāprāṇasya sthāne tādṛśa eva jhakāraḥ, tasyāpi jaśtvam - jakāraḥ| `jahāra` iti| `hmañ? haraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-899)| `jihīrṣati` iti| <> [[1.2.9]] iti sanaḥ kittvam, `ajjhanagamāṃ [[6.4.16]] iti dīrghatvam, `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itottvam, raparatvam, `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghatvam, hīrṣa-ityasya dvirvacanam||pūrveṇa prāptasya cutvasyāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ| `kokūyate` iti| `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ, <> [[7.4.82]] ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| atha vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na `koḥ` ityevocyeta? ityata āha - `kavateḥ` ityādi| `kuṅ? śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1401) iti taudādikaḥ, `ku śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1042) ityādādikaḥ, `kuṅ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-151) iti maudādikaḥ śabdārtha eva; tatra bhauvādikasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, itarayormā bhūdityevamartho vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ| nanu cānayornivṛtteretat? phalam - cokūyata ityetadapi rūpaṃ yathā syāditi, etacca `koḥ` ityapi nirdeśe niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā kautereva niranuvandhakasya grahaṇe sati sidhyatyeva, tasmāt? `koḥ` ityevaṃ nirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ? naitadevam; satyapi hi śabdārthatve bhidyata evaiṣāmabhidheyam| tathā hi - kavatistāvadavyaktaśabde vartate - uṣṭraḥ kokūyata iti; kuvatirapyārtasvare vartate - cokūyate bṛṣala iti, poḍita ityarthaḥ; kautistu śabadamātre| tasmādviśiṣyaṭārthasya parigraho yathā syādityevamartho vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ| nanu lugvikaraṇaparibhāṣayā kauterna bhaviṣyatīti, tatkimarthaṃ tannivṛttayarthatā vikaraṇasyopapadyate? evaṃ manyate - kuvatinivṛttyartho'vaśyaṃ vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ, so'nyārthaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ kauternivṛttyartho'pi bhavati, tena lugvikaraṇaparibhāṣā (vyā|pa|50) atra kauternivṛttyarthamāśrayitavyā na bhavati| `cukuve` iti| pūrvavat? taśabdasyaic? `aci śnudhātu` [[6.4.77]] ityādinovaṅ||`karīkṛṣyate` iti| `kṛṣa vilekhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-990) `rīgṛhupadhasya` [[7.4.90]] iti rīgāgamaḥ||cakāraśchandasītyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `dhārayateḥ` iti| `dhṛñ? dhāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-900) `dhṛṅ? avasthāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1412) `dhṛṅ? avadhvaṃsane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-960) - ityetāṣāṃ ṇyantānāṃ grahaṇam, `dhṛṅo vā` iti| anantaroktayoraṇyantayoḥ| `ślau yaṅluki vā` iti| tatra tāvat? `dādharttīti - yadā dhārayateḥ ślau nipātyate, tadā ṇilopo'bhyāsasya dīrghatvaṃ nipātyate| yadā tu yaṅluki, tadā'nekāctvādyaṅ? na prāpnoti, so'pi nipātyate, upadhāhrasvatvañca| ṇilopastvārdhadhātukatvādeva yaṅaḥ <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] ityevaṃ siddhaḥ| bhyāsasya dīrghatvamapi <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] ityevaṃ siddham| `dardharti, dardharṣi` iti| atrāpi yadā dhārayateḥ ślau tadā'bhyāsasya rugāgamo ṇilopaśca| ślustu sarvatra <> [[7.4.78]] ityanenaiva veditavyaḥ| yadā tu yaṅluki, tadā <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] ityanena dīrghatve prāpte tadabhāvaśca nipātyate| yadā dhṛṅaḥ - dādhartīti ślau nipātyate, tadā dvirvacane kṛte'bhyāsasya dīrghatvaṃ nipātyate| yadā tu tasyaiva dhṛṅo yaṅluki tadā'syāsasya `ṛtaśca` [[7.4.92]] iti prāptasya rugāderabhāvo nipātyate| `dargharti, dargharṣi` iti| atrāpi yadā dha#ṛṅ, ślau, tadābhyāsasya rugāgamo nipātyate; yadā tu yaṅaluki, tadā pūrvavat? prāptasya dīrghasyābhāvo nipātyate, na tu rugāgamaḥ; tasya hi <> [[7.4.91]] ityevaṃ siddhatvāt? parasmaipadaṃ ca vyatyayo bahulam` [[3.1.85]] iti| `bobhūtu` iti| `anyatra` iti| loṭprathamapuruṣasyaikavacanāpekṣamanyatvaṃ veditavyam| `bobhavīti` iti| adāditvācchapo luk? <> [[7.4.78]] iti bahulavacanatvādbhavati; `yaṅo vā` [[7.3.94]] iti pakṣe īṭ| `tetiṣate` iti| `tijeḥ` iti| `tija niśāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-971) ityetasya| nanu ca yaṅo ṅittvāt? pratyayalakṣaṇenātmanepadaṃ [[1.1.61]] siddham, etat? kimarthaṃ nipātyate? ityāha - `yaṅo ṅittvāt` ityādi| jñāpanārthamātmanepadaṃ siddham| jñāpanārthamātmanepadaṃ nipātyata iti darśayati| jñāpanasya tu prayojanam - anyatra yaṅlugantādātmanepadaṃ na bhavatīti - bhāvaḥ, bobhavītīti| `alarṣi` iti| `ṛ sṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1098,1099) - ityasya jauhotyādikasya `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattve kṛte raparatve ca halādiśeṣaḥ prāpnoti, tadapavādau rephasya latvaṃ nipātyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sipā nirdeśo'yamatantramityevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha - `tipyapi` ityādi| `phaṇateḥ` iti| `phaṇa gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-821) - ityetasya| `syandeḥ` iti| `syandū praruāvaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-761) - ityetasya| kimarthaṃ punaḥ sampūrvasyātantratvaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha - `atrāpi hi` ityādi| `karikrat` iti| `ḍukṛñ? karaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1472)| yaṇādeśe kṛte'nṛkārāntatvāt? `ṛtaśca` [[7.4.92]] ityabhyāsasya rigāgamo na prāpnoti, sa nipātyate| `krandeḥ` iti| `kadi kradi kladi āhvāne rodane ca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-772,773,774) ityetasya| kathaṃ punajrñāyate luṅītyetannipātanam? ityāha - `asya hi` ityādi| yasmālluṅantena krandaterartho nirdiśyate, tato jñāyate - luṅayetannipātanamiti| atra cābhyāsasya rīgāgamo nipātyata eva| `vibhartteḥ` iti| `ḍubhṛñ? dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1087) ityasya| `dhvarateḥ` iti| `dhvṛ hūcrchane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-939)| `dyuteḥ` iti| `dyuta dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-741) ityasya| `samprasāraṇābhāvaḥ` iti| <> [[7.4.67]] iti samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti, atastadabhāvo nipātyate| `tarateḥ` iti| `tṛ? plavanataraṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-969) ityasya| `sṛpeḥ` iti| `gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-982,983) ityasya| `vṛjeḥ` iti| `vṛjo varjane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1812) ityetasya| `marmṛjya` ti| `mṛjū śuddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1066) ityetasya ṇali rūpam| `āganīganti` iti| etadapi saṭi tipi| itikaraṇasya prakārārthatāṃ darśayitumāha - `evamprakārāṇām` ityādi| dādharttiprabhṛtīnāmiva yeṣāṃ chandasyalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ dṛśyate ta evamprakārā dādharttisadṛśā ityarthaḥ| ke punaste? galagartītyevamādayaḥ| `gṛ? nigaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1410) ityetasya yaṅluki ślau vā galagartīti rūpam, abhyāsasya carttvāmāvaḥ, halādiśeṣāpavādaḥ, rephasya latvaṃ ca nipātyate||chandasīti nivṛttam; pūrvasūtre ca kārānukṛṣṭatvāt| `vavṛte, vavṛdhe, śaśṛdhe` iti| `vṛtu vartane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-758), `vṛdhu vṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-759), `śṛdhu śabdakutsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-760), liṭ; tatrādyayoranudāttettvādātmanepadam, itaratra svaritettvāt; pūrvavadeva dvirvacanam, halādiśeṣe ca kṛta ṛvarṇāntatayāmupajātāyāmadbhāvaḥ, raparatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ|`narnartti, narinartti, narīnartti` ityevamādau `ṛdupadhasya ca` [[7.4.90]] iti, <> [[7.4.91]] iti vā paratvādapavādeṣu kṛteṣu rīgādiṣu ṛvarṇāntābhāvādanena na bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākartumāha - `narnarti` iti||halādiśeṣe prāpte tasyāpavādau dyutisvāpyoḥ samprasāraṇamārabhyate| `vididyute` iti| `dyuta dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-741), liṭ, anudāttettvādātmanepadam; tatra samprasaraṇamanena, <> [[6.1.108]] iti parapūrvatvam| `vyadyutat` ti| ṇyantālluṅa; śleścaṅ, ṇilopaḥ upadhāhrasvatvam, dvirvacanam, aḍāgamaḥ| `vididyutiṣate, vididyotiṣate` iti| san, `ralo vyupadhāt` [[1.2.26]] ityādinā vikalpena kittvam| yadā kittvaṃ nāsti, tadā laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, `pūrvavatsanaḥ` [[1.3.62]] ityātmanepadam| `susvāpayiṣati` iti| `ñiṣvap? śaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1068), ṇic, tadantāt? san| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ṇyantasyodāharaṇamupanyastam? ityata āha - `svapiṇryanto gṛhrate` iti| tena ṇyantasyodāharaṇamupadarśitamityabhiprāyaḥ| ṇyantasya grahaṇaṃ svāperiti nirdeśādeva vijñāyate| na hraṇyāntasyaivaṃvidho nirdeśa upapadyate| api ca - aṇyantasya yo'byāsastasyānenaiva śāstreṇa sampsāraṇaṃ siddham| tathā hi - liṭi tāvat? `liṭabhyāsasyobhayeṣām` [[6.1.17]] ityanenaiva siddham, sani tu `rudavida` [[1.2.8]] ityādinā sanaḥ kittve sati vacyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.15]] kṛtasamprasāraṇa eva supibhūto dvirucyeta, yaṅyapi <> [[6.1.19]] iti kṛtasamprasāraṇa evāsau dvirucyate| tasmādaṇyantasyānena śāstreṇa samprasāraṇasya siddhatvāt? svāpiṇryanto gṛhrate|yadi svāpiṇryanto gṛhrate| tadā svāpayaterṇvul - svāpakaḥ, svāpakamicchatīti kyac, svāpakīya iti sthite svāpakīyitumicchatīti san - sidhvāpakīyiṣati, atrāpi samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti? ityāha - `tasya` ityādi| tasya svāperabhyāsasya ni mattaṃ yaḥ pratyayastenānantarye satyavyavadhāna idaṃ samprasāraṇamiṣyate, tena sidhvāpakīyiṣatītyatra na bhavati| na hrabhyāsanimittaṃ yaḥ pratyayaḥ iha sa svāperanantaraḥ; ṇvulā kyacā ca vyavadhānāt| kathaṃ punarabhyāsanimittena pratyayenānantarye sati samprasāraṇaṃ labhyate, yāvatā nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ sūtropāttaḥ? evaṃ manyate - abhyāsenābhyāsanimittaṃ yaḥ pratyayaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ, tasya pratyayaviśeṣaṇimittatvāt; tatra lenābhyāsanimittena pratyayena svāpiraṅgaṃ viśiṣyate - abhyāsanimitte pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ svāpiriti| evañca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāve sakyabhyāsanimitte pratyaye'nantare sati svāperaṅgasya yo'bhyāsastasyaiva samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam| na tu vyavahitena pratyayāntareṇa hi yo vyavahitaḥ pratyayaḥ sannabhyāse nimitta tadapekṣayā svāpiraṅgaṃ bhavati, na ca sidhvāpavyavahitena pratyayāntareṇa hi yo vyavahitaḥ pratyayaḥ sannabhyate nimittaṃ tadapekṣayā svāpiraṅgaṃ bhavati, na ca sidhvāpakauyiṣatatyabhyāsanimittaṃ yaḥ pratyayaḥ sa svāreraṅgasyānantaraḥ, yastu svāperanantaro ṇvul? tadapekṣayā svāpiraṅga bhavati, na cāsāvabhyāsanimittaṃ bhavati| iha tarhi kasmānna bhavati - svapanaṃ svāpo ghañ, svāpaṃ karotati ṇic, svāpayitumicachatīti san? siṣvāpayiṣatīti? ucyate; akāralopaśya sthānivadbhāvāt? svāperyo'bhyāsastasya samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam| na cākāralopasya sthānivadbhāve sati svāperabhyāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi śabdāntarasya svāpa ityetasya||`vivyathe` iti| `vyatha bhayacalanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-764), anudāttettvādātmanepadam| atha yakārasya halādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttyā bhavitavyam, vakārasya samprasāraṇena? iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha - `yakārasya` ityādi| `vāvyathyate` iti| yaṅ||iṇo hrasvasyaiva śravaṇe prāpte dīrghatvaṃ vidhīyate| `īyatuḥ īyuḥ` iti| nanu ca paratvāt? <> [[6.4.81]] iti yaṇādeśe satyanackatvāt? dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnotītyata āha - `iṇo yaṇ` ityādi| sthānivadbhāvastu <<dvirvacane'ci>> [[1.1.59]] ityanana| sa ca niyatakāle dvirvacana eva kartavye kṛte ca tasminnādeśarūpa evāvatiṣṭhate| `iyāya, iyayitha` iti| ṇali thali ceti yathākramaṃ vṛddhiguṇayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sthānivadbhāvāddvirvacanamikāraḥ, tasya `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe, [[6.4.78]] itīyaṅ||liṭītyanuvartate| kidgrahaṇaṃ tu nivṛttam| <> [[6.1.97]] iti pararūpatve prāpte dīrghatvamārabhyate| taparakaraṇaṃ svabhāvata eva yo hrasvastasya dīrgho yathā tenopadeśe vo dīrghastasya hrasvatve kṛte'pi dīrgho na bhavati - `ācchi āyāme` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-209), āccha, ācchatuḥ, āccuriti| liṭ, tipo ṇal, taso'tum, jherus, dvirvacane halādiśeṣe `hrasvaḥ` [[7.4.59]] | kiñca syād? yadyatra dīrghaḥ syāt? `tasmāruāuḍdvihalaḥ` [[7.4.71]] iti nuṭ? syāt| `ādeḥ` iti vacanādihāntasya dīrgho na bhavati - papācetyādau||dvau halau yasya taddvihal| `ānaṅga, ānaṅgatuḥ, ānaṅguḥ` iti| `agi ragi lagi gatyarthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-146,144,145), idittvānnum| `ānañja, ānañjatuḥ, ānañjuḥ` iti| `anjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1458)| `aiauc` (mā|sū|4) ityatra `pratyāhāre varṇeṣu ye varṇaikadeśā varṇāntarasamānākṛtayaḥ, teṣu tatkāryaṃ na bhavati, tacchāyānukāriṇo hi te, na punasta eva; pṛthakprayatnanirvarttyaṃ hi varṇamicchantyācāryāḥ` ityuktvā `nuḍvidhilādeśavināmeṣvṛkāre pratividhātavyam` ityuktam| tatrāvasaraprāptyā ṛkāre nuṅvidhau pratividhānamāha - `ṛkāraikadeśo rephau halgrahaṇena gṛhrate` iti| `ānudhatuḥ, ānṛdhuḥ` iti| `ṛdhu vṛddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1271)| kathaṃ punarvarmāatmakānāṃ halā grahaṇenāvarṇātmaka ṛkāraikādeśo repho gṛhrate? dvihalgrahaṇasāmamathryāditi bhāvaḥ| atra `tasmānnuṭ` ityevaṃ vaktvyam| na caivaṃ satyāṭatuḥ, āṭurityādau nuṭprasaṅgo bhavati; aśnoterityasya niyamārthatvāt - advihalo yadi bhavati nuṭ? tadāśnotereva, nānyasyeti| aśnāti nivṛttyarthaṃ tadetannāśaṅkanīyam; yadyetāvat? prayojanaṃ syāt? `nāśnaḥ` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| tasmānniyama evāsya prayojanam| tadevamantareṇāpi dvihalgrahaṇaṃ siddhe yato dvihalgrahaṇaṃ karoti tasyaitat? prayojanam - dvihalsamānākṛterapi yathā syāt| yasyāpyeko hal? mukhyo'vayavo dvitīyastvamukhyastacchāyānukāritvādupacāreṇa halavyapadeśārhaḥ, tasyāpi yathā syādityevamartham| etasya kathaṃ lyate? yadyatra dvihala ityevaṃśrutistacchāyānukāriṇyapi ṛkārāvayave rephe vartate, nānyathā| tasmāddvihalgrahaṇasāmarthyādatra halgrahaṇena ṛkāraikadeśo repho gṛhrate; anyathā dvihalgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt||advihalārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `vyāna śe` iti| `aśū vyāptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1264), anudāttettvādātmanepadam, ta, eś| aśnoteriti vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ `aśa bhojane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1523) ityetasya kraiyādikasya nivṛttaye| cakāro nuḍāgamānukarṣaṇārthaḥ||`babhūva` iti| <> [[6.4.88]] iti vṛk| `anubabhūve` iti| karmaṇyātmanepadam| śtipā nirdeśī yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ - vobhāveti||`sūteḥ` iti| `ṣūṅ? yakārapakārābhyāmanyeṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva| `pāpaciṣate` iti| <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ, <> [[6.4.49]] iti yakārasya| `tutāvayiṣati` [`avatutāvayiṣati` iti kāśikāpadamañjaryoḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| `tu` iti saudho dhātuḥ; `turustuśamyamaḥ` [[7.3.95]] ityādau sūtre pāṭhāt| `juhāvayiṣati` iti| `hu dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1083) ṇyantāt? tasmāt? san| `bubhūṣati` iti| pūrvavadiṅguṇayorabhāvaḥ||`su ruāu gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-940) `śru śravaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-942) `du dru gatau` (dā|pā|944,945)`pruṅpluṅ cyuṅ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-957,958,956) `siruāāvayiṣati` ityādi| ebhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ sarvatra san| nanu ca sakārādinā varṇenātra yaṇo vyavadhānam, atrāvarṇapare yaṇi parata ittvamucyamānaṃ vyavadhāne kathaṃ bhavati? ityāha - `vacanasāmarthyāt` iti| savatraiva hi sakārādinaikavarṇena vyavadhānam, ucyate cedaṃ vacanam, tasmādatra vacanasāmarthyādekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrīyate; anyathā hi vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt| `pūrvasūtreṇa` ityādenā'prāptavibhāṣeyamiti darśayati| `śuśruṣati` [śuśrūyate - kāśikā] iti| pūrvavadiṅguṇayorabhāvaḥ| śtipaḥ nirdeśo dhātunirdeśārthaḥ, na yaṅalagnivṛttyarthaḥ| atra guṇe kṛta ukārāntatābhāvādittvaṃ na bhavatīti| `soruāviṣati`||[nāsti - kīśikā]abhyasasya guṇo'yaṃ vidhīyate| tena yadyapyatra lukśabdo'yaṃ sāmānyaḥ, tathāpi yaṅluka eva sampratyayo bhavati| na hyatra lukyabhyāsaḥ sambhavatīti matvā''ha - `yaṅi yaṅluki ca` ityādi| `caukruśīti` `kruśa āhvāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-856) yaṅ, tasya <<yaṅo'ci ca>> [[2.4.74]] iti lṛk, `yaṅo vā` [[7.3.94]] itīṭ, <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇaniṣedhādyaṅo luki kṛte guṇo na prāpnotīti luggrahaṇam| `pugantalaghupadhasya ca` [[7.3.86]] iti prāpto'pi guṇaḥ <> [[7.3.87]] iti niṣidhyate||`yaṃyamyate` iti| `yama uparame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-984), <<nugato'nunāsikāntasya>> [[7.4.85]] iti nuk| `nanu ca` ityādinā'kita ityetatpratyācaṣṭe| yaṃyamyata ityatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ `akitaḥ` ityucyate| atra hrapavādatvānnuki kṛte'najantatvādeva dīrgho na bhaviṣyatīti nārtho'kita ityanena| `evaṃ tarhi` ityādinā `abhyāsavikāreṣvapavādā notsargān? vidhīn? bādhante` (vyā|pa|23) ityetāṃ paribhāṣāṃ jñāpayituṃ `akitaḥ` ityetaducyata iti darśayati| `ḍoḍhaukyate` iti| `ḍhaukṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-98) ityasya yaṅi kṛte halādiśeṣe ca `hrasvaḥ` [[7.4.59]] iti hrasvatvam, pūrvasūtreṇa guṇaḥ| tatrāsatyasmin? jñāpake pipāsatītyevamādau sāvakāśaṃ hrasvatvaṃ <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] ityenena sandhyakṣare dīrghatvena bādhyeta| dīrghasya dīrghavidhāne prayojanābhāvāddīrgho na bhaviṣyatīti cet? naitat; asti hi dīrghasya dīrghavidhāne prayojanam, kiṃ tat? hrasvo mā bhūditi| evaṃ cāsatyasmin? jñāpake `acīkarat` ityatrāpyacikṣaṇadityādau sāvakāśamittvam? `dorgho laghoḥ` [[7.4.94]] iti dīrghatvena bādhyeta| `mīmāṃsate` ityādāvasatyasmin? jñāpake pipakṣatītyādau sāvakāśaṃ `sanyataḥ` [[7.4.79]] itīttvaṃ mānbadhādisūtreṇa [[3.1.6]] vihitena dīrghatvena bādhyate| `ajīgaṇat` ityatrāpyasatyāsmen? jñāpake papāṭhetyādau sāvakāśo halādiśeṣaḥ <<ī ca gaṇaḥ>> [[7.4.97]] itīttvena bādhyate| asmastu sati tarvametanna bādhyate| nanu cāsati prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati; asti cāsya prayojanam, kiṃ tat? dhātukittvamapekṣya jahātermā bhūt - jāhāti, jāhetīti? naitadasti; yadi hretat? prayojanaṃ syāt, tadā `ahākaḥ` iti pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt| kiñca `akitaḥ` ityabhyāsasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavitumarhati, yadyabhyāsāvasthāyāṃ kittvamupajāyate| na ca jahāteḥ kittvamabhyāsamapekṣate, pūrvameva hi tadabhyāsādbhavati| tasmājjahāteḥ - jāhāti, jāhetīti rūpeṇa bhavitavyam| tataśca `akitaḥ` iti vacanaṃ jñāpakameva| kitkaraṇaṃ tu jahāteḥ <> [[3.1.148]] ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārtham| atha dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kimartham; ādityeva noyeta/ naivaṃ śakyam, `akitaḥ` ityasya jñāpakatā nopapadyate| sati hi dīrghagrahaṇe nuki kṛte'najantatvādeva hi dīrghasya prāptirnāstīti `akitaḥ` iti pratiṣedhasya jñāpakatvamupapadyate| ākārastu vidhīyamāno'jantasyābhyāsasya syāditi `akitaḥ` ityasya jñāpakatvaṃ na syāt| tasmāddīrghagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam||<<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] ityanena dīrghatve prāpte vacanamidamārabhyate| `tantanyate` ityādīni tamigamiyamiramīṇāṃ rūpāṇi| yadi nuk? kriyate, yamyamyate ityādau <> [[8.3.24]] iti jhalyucyamāno'nusvāro na sidhyati, ajhalparatvāt? ityata āha - `nugitye tat` ityādi| kathaṃ punarnugityetadanusvāropalakṣaṇārthaṃ śakyate draṣṭum? ityāha - `sthāninā hi` ityādi| nukā hi sthāninā'trādeśo'nusvāra upalakṣyate| tasmādanusvāra evāgamo'tra vidhīyate, na tu nuk| yamyamyata ityādau yadyapyajhalparatā'sti, tathāpyanusvāraḥ sidhyati| evaṃ <> [[8.4.58]] prāpnoti, iṣyate ca pakṣe'nusvārasya śravaṇam, tanna sidhyati, apavāntatvāt? ityata āha - `padāntavacca` ityādi| padāntavadanusvāro bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - tadantavidhirnavānunāsikāntasyānusvāro bhavatīti nārtho'ntagrahaṇena, tatkriyate - padāntasyānutvārasya yo dharmā sa nuko'pi syādityevamartham; tenānusvārasya pakṣe śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `tetimyate` iti| `tima ṣṭima ādrrībhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1123,1124)| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā nāsti kiñcidanyadasya vyāvatryamiti sarvatra hrasvābhāvāt? ityata āha - `taparakaraṇam` ityādi| vartamānasya dīrghasyābhāvādbhūtapūrvasyāpi dīrghasya nivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `bābhāmyate` iti| `bhāma krodhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-441)||anunāsikārto'yamārambhaḥ| `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-397,398), `jabhi jṛbhī gātravināme` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-388,389) `daha bhasmīkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-991), `danśa daśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-989) `bhavjo āmardane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1453), `paśiḥ` sautro dhātuḥ| `jañjapyate` ityādiṣu `daṃdaśyate` iti paryanteṣu `lupasada` [[3.1.24]] ityādinā yaṅ| itaratra sāmānyalakṣaṇena` [[3.1.22]] ||`cara gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-559)| `ñi phalā viśaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-516), `phala niṣyattau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-530)-dvayorapi grahaṇam| niṣyattyarthasyākāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, nānubandhaḥ, prayojanābhāvāt, tataśca niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|53) niranubandhasya niṣpattyarthasyaivāsya grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, na viśaraṇārthasya? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa ca viśaraṇārthasya samuccayārtho bhaviṣyati| `cañcūryate` iti| `lupasada` [[3.1.24]] ityādinā yaṅa| uttarasūtreṇākārasyokāre kṛte `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghaḥ| yogabhāga uttarārthaḥ||`abhyāsasya mā bhūt` iti| asati paragrahaṇe'bhyāsādhikārādabhyāsasyaiva syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `alo'ntyasya mā bhūt` iti| yadi `ataḥ` iti nocyeta, tato'lo'ntya [[1.1.52]] paribhāṣayā'bhyāsātparasya dhāturūpasya yo'ntyo'l? tasya syāditi manyate| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā mātrikasya sthāna āntaratamyādvidhīyamāno mātrika eva bhaviṣyati? ityata āha - `taparakaraṇam` ityādi| asati taparakaraṇa ukāre kṛte cañcūrti, pamphultītyatra `pugantalaghūpadhasya` [[7.3.86]] iti guṇaḥ syāt, sa mā bhūdityevamrathaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate| nanu cañcūrtītyatra dīrghatvameva guṇasya bādhako bhaviṣyati, tatkimetannivṛttyarthena taparakaraṇena? ityata āha - `dīrghatvam` ityādi| asiddhatvaṃ tu <> [[8.2.1]] ityanena| yadi tarhi lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāpto guṇastaparakaraṇena nivartate, guṇavaddīrghatvamapi na syāt/ naiṣa doṣaḥ; taparakaraṇe hi dīrghatvamapi siddhamiti| tena dīrghasya nivṛttirna śakyate vaktum| tathā ca - `ata ut? sārvadhātuke` [[6.4.110]] iti taparakaraṇena dīrghatvamaśakyaṃ nivartayitumiti manyamānena `na bhakurcchurām` [[8.2.79]] iti karoterdīrghatvapratiṣedha ārabhyate| ata iti taparakaraṇamiha mā bhūt - phalantaṃ prayuṅkte phālayati, phālayateḥ kvip, tadantāt? `ācāre punaḥ sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ` (vā|186) iti kvip, tadantādyaṅ - panphālyate, pamphāloti| kathañca prāpnoti? ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt||ayaṅalugartho'yamārambhaḥ| `cūrttiḥ` iti| <> [[3.3.94]] pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| `prakṛltāḥ` iti| `niṣṭhā, tadantāṭṭāp; jas| `vacanasāmarthyādiha nābhisambadhyate` iti| yadīha yaṅluggrahaṇamabhyāsagrahaṇañcābhisambadhyeta, tato vacanasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt| pūrveṇaiva yaṅayaṅlukorabhyāsasya siddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ||`varīvṛtyate` ityādīni vṛtivṛdhinṛtīnāṃ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-758,759|1116) rūpāṇi| `rīgṛtvata iti vaktavyam` iti| ṛdupadhādanyasyāpi ṛtvato rīgādayo yathā syurityevamartho vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam - cakāro'tra kriyate, sa ca ṛdupadhādanyasyāpi ṛtvataḥ samuccayārthaḥ, tena vṛścatiprabhṛtīnāmapi ṛtvatāṃ rīgādayo bhavantīti| `rīgṛtvataḥ` iti sūtraṃ na kṛtam; vaicitryātham| `ṛdupadhasya` iti taparakaraṇamasandehārtham| ukāre parato yaṇādeśe kṛte sandehaḥ syāt - kimṛkāropadhasya? atha vā rephopadhasyeti||lukītyeva| cakāreṇa rīgādayo'nukṛṣyante| `carkarti` iti| `ḍukṛñ? karaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1472) `jarhati` iti| `hmañ? haraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-899)| `kirateścākarti` iti| `kṛ? vikṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1409), ityasya| `kiratim` ityādi| kiratigrahaṇamupalakṣaṇārtham| tena `gṛ nigaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1410) ityevamāderapi ṛkārāntasya grahaṇaṃ veditavyam| `carkarītāntam` iti| yaṅlugantamityarthaḥ| yaṅluka eva pūrvācāryapraṇītaiṣā saṃjñā `carkarītam| iti| `pacati` iti| laṭprathamapuruṣasyaikavacanam| etadapyupalakṣaṇārthameva| vacanāntarāṇāmapi hyatra grahaṇam| tena `kṛ` ityevamādikamṛkārāntaṃ yo laṭprathamapuruṣaikavacanādau naye=cākartītyevamādīni rūpāṇi prāpayet, sampādayeditayrathaḥ| `prāptijñaṃ tamahaṃ manye` iti| prāpta jānātīti prāptijñaḥ| iha tu rugādīnāṃ prakṛtatvāt? tatprāpta yo jānāti sa prāptijño veditavyaḥ| manyaṃ=avagacchā| `prārabdhastena saṃgrahaṇaḥ` iti| anena prāptitāyāṃ hetumāha| samyaggṛhrate jñāpaye lakṣaṇamaneneti saṃgrahaḥ=vyākaraṇaśāstram| prakarṣeṇārabdhaḥ prārabdhaḥ; bahubhyo bahuśaḥ śravaṇāt| kā punarasāṃ prāptiryatparijñānāya prāptijñamavagacchāmītyāha - `tatreyam` ityādi| dvayamiha prakṛtam - aṅgam? abhyāsaśceti| ṛta iti viśeṣaṇamupāttam; tatra yadyapyumayaṃ prakṛtaṃ tathāpyṛta ityetadaṅgasyaiva viśeṣaṇam, nābhyāsasya| kutaḥ? taparakaraṇasāmarthyāt| sarvatraiva hrabhyāsasya `hrasvaḥ` [[7.4.59]] iti hrasvatvena bhavitavyam; ato dīrghasyāmyāsasyābhāvāt| yadi `ṛtaḥ` ityedabhyāsasya viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, tadā taparakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāt? taparakaraṇasāmarthyādaṅgasyaiva viśeṣaṇamṛta ityetat, nābhyāsasya| evañca sati kirateraprāptiḥ; rugādīnāṃ taparakaraṇena vyāvarttitatvāt| ādiśabdena rigādīnāṃ parigrahaḥ| `tathā cāprāptiḥ kirate rugādīnām` iti brāuvartataduktaṃ bhavati - karotiprabhṛtīnāmeva hrasvāntānāṃ pariśeṣyāt? prāptiriti||`sanyataḥ` [[7.4.79]] ityādinā sūtratrayeṇa yadabhyāsasya sani kāryaṃ bhavati tallaghuni caṅpara ityatidiśyate| `laghuni` `caṅpare` iti| vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau - caṅapare ṇau parato yat? pūrvaṃ laghu tasmin? parato yo'bhyāsastasya sanvadbhavatīti| `caṅapare` iti bahuvrīhiḥ - caṅ? paro yasmāditi taccaṅparam; na tu caṅ? cāsau paraśceti tatpuruṣa| tena sāmarthyāṇṇyantasyaivāyamatideśo vijñāyate; anyathā hi yadi prakṛtyantasyāyamatideśaḥ syāt, tadā `sanvaccaṅi` ityevaṃ brāūyāt| `ananlope` iti| `caṅpare` ityasyaitadviśeṣaṇam| agiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam| ako lopo'glopaḥ, sa yasya nāsti tadanaglopam| `apīpacat` iti| pacerṇit, luṅ, cleścaṅ, upadhāhrasvatvam, dvirvacanamabhyāsakāryam, halādiśeṣe ca kṛte'nena sanvadbhāvaḥ, `sanyataḥ` [[7.4.79]] itīttvam, uttarasūtreṇa [[7.4.94]] dīrghatvam| `atatakṣat, ararakṣat` iti| ata rephatakārayoḥ saṃyogaparatvād?
