evaṃ manyate -yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ, tiṅaḥ parāṇi gotrādīnyanudāttāni bhavanti; tataḥ `kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoḥ`, gotrādīnītyeva| na cātra dvitīyeyoge vidheyamanyadastīti gotrādīnyeva kutsanābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇena viśiṣyante| atha vā -ubhayathā sūtramācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratipāditāḥ, ubhayañcaitat? pramāṇam, ata ubhayaṃ grahīṣyantīti| vṛttigranthastu tiṅantāt? padāduttarāṇi gotrādīnītyādiko vākyabhedenaiva neyaḥ -gotrādīni kutsane cāmīkṣṇye ca bhavanti, tānyeva tiṅantāt? padāduttarāṇyanudāttāni bhavantīti| nanu ca gotrādayaḥ śabdā gotrādāvevānarthāntare vartante, te kathaṃ kutsanābhīkṣṇyayorvartaran? tameva svārthaṃ yadā tu kutsanābhīkṣṇyaviśiṣṭamācakṣate tadā tayorvartanta ityadoṣaḥ||`nīlamutpalam` iti| utpalamityetat? `navviṣayasyānisantasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttaṃ bhavati| `bhavati pacati` iti| pacatikriyā bhavatītyayamasyārthaḥ| pacatiśabde śaptipāvanudāttau, akāro dhātusvareṇodāttaḥ, <> [[8.4.66]] iti śabakāraḥ svaritaḥ| nanu ca samāsavākye nighātādaya ucyante, idañca vākyameva na bhavati, tat? kimetannivṛttyarthenātiṅagrahaṇena? kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇametadvākyaṃ na bhavati? akhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyam` ityatra vākyalakṣaṇa ekatvasya vivakṣitatvāt, iha cākhyātasya dvitvāt? naiṣa dodhaḥ; atrāpyākhyātaṃ yadakārakaṃ tadvivakṣitam| taccāsminnekameva bhavatiśabdaḥ, pacatītyetattu kārakam| tathā hi bhāṣye uktam -`pacatyādayaḥ kriyāḥ [`kriyāḥ bhavanti` nāsti kā| mudrite] bhavanti, kriyāyāḥ kartryo bhavanti` iti| yadapīdamuktam -`ekatiṅ? padasamūho vākyam` iti, atrāpi pradhānaṃ yat? tiṅ? tadadhikṛtyaikatiṅityuktam| atra caikameva tiṅantaṃ pradhānam| yadyetat, kiṃ tarhi atra tiṅantaṃ tat? bhavatīti| pacatītyetat? punaḥ sādhanatvādapradhānam||`āḥ kartā` iti| karoterluṭ, tāsiḥ, <> [[2.4.85]] ityekavacanasya ḍādeśaḥ, ḍiti ṭilopaḥ| `tāseḥ parasya` ityādi| āgamaḥ pratyayasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| tasya yatra ṭilopo nāsti -irtāro, kartāra ityādau, tatra `nāsyanudāttenṅita` [[6.1.180]] ityādinā lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatve kṛte tāserevodāttatvaṃ bhavati| yatra tu ṭilopastatra `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ [[6.1.155]] iti lasārvadhātukamevodāttaṃ bhavati||yadyapi nipātairityetadapekṣamāṇāvāṃ yadādīnāṃ sāmarthyam, tathāpi gamakatvādyuktaśabdena samāsa eṣāṃ yukta eva| atha vā -matra na samāsaḥ, vibhaktistvavyayatvādeṣāṃ luptete na śrūyate| yuktagrahaṇaṃ tvihāpi sākṣādyogapratipattyartham, tena yuktayukte pratiṣedho na bhavati| etacca prayudāharaṇe'pi spaṣṭīkariṣyāmaḥ| atra yadyatrayogrrahaṇamābhyāṃ pūrvasyāpi tadyuktasya pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamartham| yaddhi tataḥ paraṃ tiṅaktaṃ tasya `yadvṛttānnityam` [[8.1.66]] ityevaṃ siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, pūrvasya tu tena na sidhyati| tadā hi yadvṛttādibhiḥ pañcamī <> [[1.1.67]] iti parasyaiva nighātapratiṣedhaṃ pratipādayati, netarasya| `yatkaroti` iti| karotiśabda ukārapratyayasyodāttatvānmadhyodāttaḥ| `nejjihrāyanto narakaṃ patāma` [`nojjihrāyanto` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] iti| paterlaṭ, mas, śap, <> [[7.3.101]] iti dīrghaḥ| ṅidadupadeśatvāllasārvadhātukatvādanudāttatve [[6.1.180]] kṛte dhātutvareṇādyudāttametat| `sa ceṭbhuṅakte` iti| <<bhujo'navane>> [[1.3.66]] ityātmanepadam, rudhāditvātvāt? śnam| pūrvavallasārvadhātukānudāttatvam; `inasorallopaḥ` [[6.4.111]] , <> [[6.1.161]] ityudāttatve kṛte bhuṅkta ityetadantodāttam| `sa cedadhīte` iti| iṅ? dhātusvareṇodāttaḥ| ṅita iti lasārvadhātukamevānudāttam| ādiśabdāpekṣayā nighāte prāpte na pratipadoktaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate (vyā|pa|3), sāhacaryañca vyavasthākāraṇaṃ na bhavatīti| tena <> [[8.1.36]] iti yathāśabdasāhacaryādyāvacchabdo'pi nāvyayameva parigṛhrate, kiṃ tarhi? parimāṇaśabdo'pi lākṣaṇikaḥ| yāvato'davān? pratigṛhṇīyādityatrāpi nighātaprativedho bhavati| `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatum` [[5.2.39]] iti vatubanto'tra yāvacchabdaḥ| `yatra kva ca te mano dakṣaṃ dadhasa uttaram` iti| `dadha dhāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-8) laṭ, dhās, `dhāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] | atra yatretyanenaidhikaraṇapradhāne uttaramityetadādheyaṃ yuktam, tena yuktaṃ tiṅantam, ataḥ sākṣādyogo nāstīti pratiṣedho na bhavati||nahetyayaṃ nipātasamudāyaḥ pratiṣedhe vartate| tena yuktaṃ tiṅantaṃ pratyārambhaviṣaye na nihanyate| punarārambhaḥ=pratyārambhaḥ| sa ca yatra viṣaye kriyate taddarśayitumāha -`coditasya` ityādi| bhuṅakṣyādhīṣvetyevaṃ coditaṃ vihitaṃ yat? kartavyatayopanyastaṃ bhojanādau yadā tat? karttuṃ na pravartate nādriyate, avadhīryata iti yāvat; tadā tasyādadhīraṇe'dajñāne sati tamavadhīrayitāramupālabdhuṃ yā icchā tathopālipsayaitasyaiva bhojanāderavadhīritasya pratiṣedhena sambandhaḥ pratyārambhaḥ| `pratyārambhaḥ kriyate` iti| pratiṣedhasambaddhasya punarupanyāsaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| `naha bhokṣyase, nahādhyedhyase` iti| bhujeriṅaśca lṛṭ, `thāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] , adupadeśatvāt? ṅittvācca tayordhātvorlasārvadhātukamanudāttam| syaḥ pratyayasvareṇodāttaḥ| `icchanti` iti| `iṣu icchāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-135), tudāditvāccha, `ḍaṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ` [[7.3.77]] ||satyaśabdo'yamudāharaṇe praśne vartate| pratyudāharaṇe tu ṛtaśabdasyārthe||prātilobhyam=prātakūlyam, anabhimatakāritvamityarthaḥ| tato'nyadaprātilobhyamnukūlatvam, abhimatakāritvamiti yāvat| tasmin? gamyamāne'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `aṅga kuru, ṅga paca` iti| aṅgaśabdo'yaṃ nipāta ihānujñāyāṃ vartamāno'prātilobhyaṃ gamayati| karoterloṭi sip, `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] , dhātorguṇe kṛte `ata utsārvadhātuke` [[6.4.110]] ityuttvam, `uttaśca pratyayāt` (6.4.1-6) iti herluk| atrokāraḥ pratyayasvareṇodāttaḥ| `paca` iti| <> [[6.4.105]] iti luk| dhātusvareṇādyudāttametat| pratyudāharaṇe'ṅga śabdo'mardhe vartate| `ānulabhye` iti vaktavye'prātilomye iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham||kimarthaṃ punaridamārabhyate? na `yadvṛttānnityam` [[8.1.66]] ityeva siddhamiti yaścodayet, taṃ prati -`devadattaḥ pacati yāvat`, `devadattaḥ pacati yathā` -ityetadudāharaṇadvayamupanyastam| eṣo'bhiprāyaḥ -yadvṛttāditi pañcamīnirdeśāt? <> [[1.1.67]] iti yatraiva yāvadyathābhyāṃ paraṃ tiṅantaṃ tatraiva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| yatra tu tābhyāṃ pūrvaṃ tatra na syāt| iha tu tṛtīyanirdeśāt? tatrāpi bhavatīti||`pūjāyāṃ viṣaye` iti| viṣayagrahaṇe pūjāyāmiti viṣayasaptamīti darśayati| `kiṃ tahrramudāttameva` iti| dvau pratiṣedho prakṛtamarthaṃ gamayata iti kṛtvā| `yāvat? pacati śobhanam` iti| stutiratra pūjā, sā ca kriyāyāḥ sādhanasya vā||`upasargavyapetam` iti| upasargavyavahitam| cakāreṇa `pūjāyām` ityanukṛṣyate; anantaramiti cānuvartate| tatropasargeṇa vyavadhānamāśrīyata iti| sāmarthyāt? anantaragrahaṇaṃ śabdāntaravyavadhānanirāsārthaṃ vijñāyate||nanu <> [[8.1.37]] iti pūjāgrahaṇamanuvartata eva, tatkimarthaṃ pūjāyāmityucyate? ityāha -`pūjāyāmityanuvartate` ityādi| syādetat -tadeva pūjāgrahaṇamihānuvartamānaṃ nighātapratiṣedhārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti? atāaha -`taddhi` ityādi| taddhi pūrvatra pūjāgrahaṇaṃ nighātaprahatiṣedhasya pratiṣedhena sambaddham| tadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| evañca teṣāṃ nighātapratiṣedhaḥ| luḍādīnāṃ teṣāṃ tuprabhṛtibhiryoge nighātapratiṣedhasya pratiṣedho vijñāyeta| tasmānnighātasya pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaḥ pūjāgrahaṇam| atrāhagrahayaṇaṃ kimartham, canādiṣu [[8.1.57]] cetyeva siddham? na sidhyati; `canacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍitevaṣgateḥ` [[8.1.57]] ityato gateriti tatrānuvṛtteḥ| tathā ca-devadattaḥ prapacatyahetyatra pratiṣedho na syāt| parabhūteṣu vā sa pratiṣedha iti pūrvabhūte'baśabde ca na syāt -devadatto'ha pacatīti#ī||cakāreṇa pujāyāmityanukṛṣyate| atha yogavibhāgaḥ kimartham? pūrvasūtra evāhograhaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha -`pṛthak#ṃ` ityādi| pṛthagyoge <<śeṣe vibhāṣā>> [[8.1.50]] iti ahetyanenaiva yoge yathā syāt, tuprabhṛtīnāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogakaraṇam||`kariṣyasi` ityādi| lṛḍantaṃ syasvareṇa madhyodāttam| nanu ca pūjāgrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭam| tatra cānukṛṣṭasyehānuvṛtteraviśeṣe bhaviṣyati, tat? kiṃ śeṣagrahaṇena? ityata āha -`pūjāyāmityasya` ityādi||cakāro vibhāṣetyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `parīpsāyāmarthe` iti| gamyamāna iti śeṣaḥ| `parīpsā tvarā` iti| sambhramaḥ=aśupravṛttirityarthaḥ| `adhīṣva māṇavaka` ityādi| tvaritamadhīṣvetyedho'rtho gamyate| tathā hyatra purā vidyotate vidyut, purā stanayati staniyuritatyetadubhayamapyadhyayanadiṣayayostvarāyāḥ kāraṇatvenopātam| vidyuddyotanādau hi na paṭhitavyaṃ parvadivaseṣviva| etaduktaṃ bhavati -yasmādacirakālabhāvi vidyuddyotanaṃ stanayitnustananaṃ vā'dhyayanantarāyo'to'dhīṣyeti| `purā vidhīyate` iti| `yāvatpurānipātayorlaṭ, [[3.3.4]] , anudāttettvādātmanepadam| adupadeśāllasārvadhātukānudāttatve [[6.1.180]] kṛte dhātusvareṇādyudāttametat| `purā stanayati` iti| `stana gadī devaśabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1859,1860) curādiṇic| adantatvādbṛddhyabhāvuḥ| etadapi pūrvavanmadhyodāttam| `purāśabdo'tra bhaviṣyadāsatiṃta dyotayati` iti| bhaviṣyadvidyuddyotanādiradhyayanāntarāyo yastasya pratyāsatiṃta sāmīpyarmācarakālabhāditvaṃ dyotayati| tena tvarā gamyata ityabhiprāyaḥ||`anujñāyā etaṇā prārthanā` iti| kiñit? kartu svayamevodyatasyaivaṃ kriyatāmityanujñānamanujñā| prārthanāyāṃ mūlodāharaṇayoḥ <> [[3.2.123]] iti laṭ| pratyudāharaṇe tu bhūte <> [[3.2.120]] ityanena| itikaraṇa ekanipāto'yamiti pradarśanārthaḥ| nanvanujñeṣaṇāyāmiti hrucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt -kimayamekanipātaḥ? utta nipātadvayamiti? yathā -<> [[3.2.121]] ityatraḥ itikaraṇena tvavacchidyamānamekamevevaṃ śabdarūpamiti gamyate||`apratiṣiddham` iti| pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣiddham| bhāve niṣṭhā| nāsya pratiṣiddhamastītyapratiṣiddham| atha vā -karmaṇi niṣṭhā, nividdhaṃ pratiṣiddhamapratiṣiddham| arthadvārakañcaitat? tiṅo viśeṣaṇam| `pūrvaṃ kiṃyuktam` iti| tatsamīpe kimaḥ śrūyamāṇatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| `uttaraṃ tu na kiṃyuktam` iti| tasyāsamīpe śrūyamāṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `apare tvāhuḥ` ityādi| na hi samīpe śruyamāṇatvaṃ kiṃśabdasya śabdāntareṇa sambandhe hetuḥ api tu saṃśayaviṣayatvam| yathā cātra pūrvasyākhyātasya, tathā tatparasyāpītyasti tasya yogaḥ kiṃśabdenetyubhayatra pratiṣedhaḥ||kiṃśabdasya prakṛtatvāt? tasyaiva lopo vijñāyate, ityāha -kimo lope iti| kiṃśabdasya śāstre na kvacillopo vihitaḥ, ityataḥ pṛcchati -`kva cāsya lopaḥ` iti| adarśanamātrasya `lopaḥ` [[1.1.59]] iti saṃjñā kṛtā na tu śāstrakṛtasyaivādarśanasyetyabhiprāyeṇāha -`yatra` ityādi| `gamyate cārthaḥ` iti| kutaścidarthaprakaraṇādeḥ| `na ca prayujyate` iti| gamyamānārthatvāt| `devadattaḥ pacatyāhosvit? paṭhati` iti| atrāyamāhosvicchabdaḥ pakṣāntare vartate| pakṣāntaropanyasanaṃ kimartham? praśnaṃ na vyabhicaratauti| atrāprayujyamānasyāpi tasyārtho gamyate| pañatiśabdo'yaṃ pakṣe pacatiśabdena tulyasvaraḥ||`ehimanya ityanena` iti| samudāyasyaikatvāt? tadapekṣayaikavacanam, anyathā hi dve ete ākhyāte iti dvitvāddvivacanaṃ syāt| `prahāsaḥ` iti| prakṛṣṭo hāsaḥ; parihāsa ityarthaḥ| `ehi manya odanaṃ bhokṣyase` iti| <> [[1.4.106]] iti puruṣavyatyayaḥ| bhujerasmadyupapade madhyamaḥ, manyateryuṣmadyupapade uttamaḥ| `evama ehi manye rathena yāsyasi` ityatrāpi puruṣavyatyayo veditavyaḥ| dve api caite lṛṅante syapratyayasvareṇa madhyodātte| `prahāsa iti kim? ehi manyasa odanaṃ bhokṣye` iti| atra manyateḥ <> [[1.4.105]] ityādinā madhyamaḥ| bhujestu <> [[1.4.107]] ityuttamaḥ| suṣṭhu manyase, sādhu manyase` iti| anena yathābhūtaṃ darśayat? prahāsābhāvaṃ darśayati|nanu ca `gatyarthaloṭā lṛṭ` [[8.1.51]] ityādinaiva siddham, tat? kimartho'yamārambhaḥ? ityata āha -`gatyarthaloṭā` ityādi| `ehimanyeyukte` ityādinā niyamārthatāmasya vyaktīkaroti| kathaṃ punarehimanya ityenena yogena niyamaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ `ehi manyase odanaṃ bhokṣye` ityatra nivṛtti karoti, na hratara pahītyaneva lṛḍantaṃ yuktam, kiṃ tarhi? ehi manyasa ityanena? ityata āha -`ehi manya ityuttmopādānamatantram` iti| atantratvaṃ tu tasyopalakṣaṇārthatvāt| nanu ca `manyateruttamaḥ` [[1.4.105]] iti vacanādyuṣmadyupapade manyateruttamenaiva bhavitavyam, evañca `ehi eva hi manyatiruttamaḥ` iti| gatārtham||`apūrvam` iti| avidyamānaṃ pūrvaṃ yasmāt? tadapūrvam| atra ca dvayaṃ sambhāvyate -tiṅantasya cedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, jātuśabdasya veti| tatra yadi tiṅantasya syāt? `āhoutāho jānantaran` [[8.1.49]] ityatrānantara grahaṇaṃ na kuryāt| asyaiva hrapūrvagrahaṇasya tatrānuvṛttestiṅantasyānantarya labhyate; tasmājjātuśabdasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇam, ityālocyāha -`jātvityetat` ityādi||`ciduttaram` iti| cidityetaduttaraṃ yasmāt? tat? tathoktam| pūrvoktayā notyaitadapi kivṛttasyaiva viśeṣaṇam| `kiṃvṛttagrahaṇena tadvibhaktyantam` ityādi| `kivṛtte lipsāyām` [[3.3.6]] ityatraitaduktārtham| `bhojayati` iti| pūrvavanmadhyodāttamevaitat| `kasmaiciddadāti` iti| <> [[6.1.189]] ityādyudāttametat| `kataraḥ` iti| `kiṃyattadornirdhāraṇe` [[5.3.92]] iti ḍataraca| `katamaḥ` iti| `vā bahūnāṃ jātiparipraśne` [[5.3.93]] iti ḍatamac||avidyamānamantaraṃ vyavadhānaṃ yasya tadanantaram| avyavahitamityarthaḥ| tiṅantaviśeṣaṇametat| ānantaryañcāho, utāho -ityetayoḥ śrutatvāt? tadapekṣayaiva veditavyam|?trāpi cakāro'pūrvamityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ||śeṣaḥ sannihitāpekṣaḥ| śeṣatrayañca pūrvasūtre sannihataṃ nighātakāraṇam -āho utāhośabdau, anantara mityetat, apūrvamityetacca| tatra na jñāyate -kiṃ kāraṇabhāvāpekṣaḥ śeṣa iti| kimāhoutāhośabdāpekṣaḥ? utānantarabhāvāpekṣaḥ? āhosvidapūrvabhāvāpekṣaḥ -ityataḥ pṛcchati -`kaśca śeṣaḥ` iti| iha nighātamicchatā tatkāraṇamavaśyamevāpekṣaṇīyam| `āho udāho` iti| apūrvamityetadapi, dviścakāreṇānukṛṣṭatvāt| tasya hi dvayoryogayoścakāro'nukarṣaṇārtha eva kṛtaḥ| kathaṃ nāmātrāpi tadapekṣā syāditi! anyathā hi samanantarātīti eva sūtre tadanukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ kriyate| kiṃvṛttādisūtre [[8.1.48]] hi svaritatvādeva tadanuvartata iti| tasmāt? pāriśeṣyādanantarabhāvapekṣaḥ śeṣo vijñāyate? ityata āha -`yadanyadanantarāta` iti||`gaminā samānārthā gatyarthāḥ` iti| arthapradarśanamevaitat| evaṃ tu vigrahaḥ kartavyaḥ -gatirartho yeṣāmiti| `gatyarthaloṭā yuktam` iti| yogaḥ punanimittanimittarūpaḥ| tayornimittamiti bhāvaḥ| `na cetkārakam` ityāderarthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha -`yatraiva` ityādi| anena loḍantavācyaṃ lṛḍantavācyārthaṃ yat? kārakaṃ tasyaivānanyatvamāśritam; na śabdātantaravācyasyeti darśayati, evacca pratyāsatterlabhyate| tiṅantasya hi tadeva pratyāsannaṃ kārakaṃ yat? tenaivābhidhīyate na śabdāntareṇa; tena śabdāntaravācye bhidyamāne'pi bhavatyeva bhidhātapratiṣedhaḥ| `āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ drakṣyasyenam` iti| āgaccheti gatyarthaloṭa, drakṣyasīti lṛḍantam; tayoścaikamevātra kārakaṃ devadattaḥ kartā| `drakṣyasi` iti| <> [[6.1.58]] ityamāgamaḥ; vraścādi sūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvam, <<ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si>> [[8.2.41]] iti katvam| syapratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttametat| evamuttaratrāpi yatra nighātapratiṣedhastatra lṛḍantasya madhyodāttatā veditavyā| `āgaccha devadatta grāmamodanaṃ bhokṣyase` iti| atrāpi tadevābhinnamubhayalakāravācyaṃ karttukārakam| karma tu yadyapi bhidyate, tathāpa#i tacchabdāntaravācyamiti satyapi tbhede bhavatyeva nighātapratiṣedhaḥ| `uhrantāṃ devadattena śālayo yajñadattena bhokṣyante` iti| athātra śālaya ityubhayalakāravācyamabhinnaṃ karmaṃ kārakam, kartā tu yadyapi bhidyate, tathāpi sa śabdāntaravācya iti tadbhede'pi nighātapratiṣedho bhavatyeva| `uhrantām` iti| vaheḥ karmaṇi loṭ, ātmanepadam, jhasyāntādeśaḥ, <> [[3.1.67]] vacyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.15]] samprasāraṇam, ṭeretvam? [[3.4.79]] , `āmetaḥ` [[3.4.90]] ityāmbhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punarihābhinnaṃ kārakam, yāvatā śaktiḥ kārakam, sā ca pratikriyaṃ bhidyata eva śaktiśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvādekaṃ kārakaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `āgaccherdevadatta grāmaṃ drakṣyasyanam` iti| atra gatyarthaliṅā lṛṅantaṃ yuktam, na gattayarthaloṭā| `āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ paśyasyenam` iti| atra gatyarthaloṭā laṅantaṃ yuktam, na tu luṅantam| `āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ pitā ta odanaṃ bhokṣyate` iti| atra loṅantasya devadattaḥ kartā, lṛḍantasya tu piteti bhidyate kārakam| `āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca` ityādi| yathā pūrvopanyasteṣu mūlodāharaṇeṣu yalloḍantasya karttrādi kārakaṃ vācyaṃ tanmātrameva lṛṅantasyāpi, iha tu na tathā| atrāpi [`tatrāpi -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] loṅantasya devadatto yuṣmadartha evapa kartā vācyaḥ, lṛṅantasya tu sa cāsmadarthaśca; tatrāsati sarvagrahaṇa iha nighātapratiṣedho na syāt| ata ihāpi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇam| atha satyapi sarvagrahaṇe nighātapratiṣedhaḥ kathamevātra bhavati, yāvātā bhidyate loṅantavācyāt? kārakāllṛṅantavācyo yo'rthaḥ kārakaṃ kartāta? ityata āha -`lṛṅantavācye hi` ityādi| sarvagrahaṇe sati loḍantavācyaṃ yatkārakaṃ tasmāllṛṅantasya yadi sarvamanyadbhavati, tathāpyevaṃ na nighātapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam, anyathā tu sati bhavatyeva| yadi hi yatrāpi loṅantasya kiñcit? tadeva kārakaṃ vācyam, lṛṅantasya kiñcit? tato'nyatrāpi nighātapratiṣedho na syāt, sarvagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāt sarvagrahaṇādbhavatyevātra nighātapratiṣedhaḥ| tatraivaṃ syāt -asminnapyudāharaṇe lṛṅantasya vācyaṃ yat? kārakamanyadeva talloṅantavācyāt| ataḥ satyapi sarvagrahaṇe na bhavitavyaṃ nighātapratiṣedheṇa? ityata āha -`iha tu` ityādi| gatārtham||cakāraḥ pūrvāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ| `paśya` iti| antodāttam -<> [[8.2.5]] <> [[6.1.97]] iti guṇagrahaṇe pararūpasyevodāttatvāt| `śādhi` iti| `śāsu anuśiṣṭau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1075), `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] iti sipo hirādeśaḥ, adāditvācchapo luk; `śā hau` [[6.4.35]] iti dhātoḥ śādeśaḥ, <> [[6.4.101]] iti herdhibhāva-| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttametat| evaṃ dṛśyatāmityedapi; `vikaraṇasvarāt? sārvadhātukasvaro balīyān` iti vacanāt| atha pṛthagyogakaraṇaṃ kimartham, na pūrvasūtra eva loṅgrahaṇamapi kriyeta? ityata āha -`pṛthak` ityādi| uttaratra loṭa eva kāryaṃ yathā syāt, lṛṭo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogakaraṇam||pūrveṇa nitye pratiṣedhe prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam? vibhāṣitaśabdaścāyaṃ vibhāvāśabdena samānārthaḥ| <> [[3.3.114]] | `praviśāni` iti| mipaḥ `meniḥ` [[3.4.89]] , <<āḍuttamasya picca>> [[3.4.92]] ityād||cakāraḥ `vibhāṣitaṃ sopasargamanuttamamu` [[8.1.53]] ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `kuru` iti| karoterguṇe kṛte `ata ḍatsārvadhātuke [[6.4.110]] ityuttvam, `utaśca pratyayāt` [[6.4.106]] ityādinā herluk| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttametat|`hanta prabhuñjāvahai` [`prabhunajāvahai` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] iti| bhujerloṭ, vahiḥ, ṭerettvam, <<āḍuttamasya picca>> [[3.4.92]] , śnam| atrāpi `nipātairyadyadi` [[8.1.30]] ityādinā nighātapratiṣedhaḥ| adupadeśāllasārvadhātukasyānudāttatve [[6.1.180]] kṛte vikaraṇasvareṇa madhyodāttametat||`ekāntaram` iti| antarayatītyantaram| vyavadhāyakamityarthaḥ| ekaṃ padamantaraṃ yasya tattathoktam| ekena nipātena vyavahitamityarthaḥ| `ām? pacasi devadattātri iti| nighāte pratiṣiddhe `āmantritasya` [[6.1.192]] iti dhāṣṭhikamāmantritādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| <> [[8.2.84]] iti plutaḥ| `āma bho devadattātri` iti| bhavadbhagavadaghavatāmoccāvasya` (8.3.1|vā|2) iti bhavacchabdāvayavasyāvaśabdasyauttvam; dakārasya rutvam, tasya `bhobhagoadhoapūrvasya` [[8.3.17]] ityādinā yakāraḥ, tasya <> [[8.3.22]] iti lopaḥ|nanu cātra bhoḥśabdasya `āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat` [[8.1.72]] ityavidyamānatvādekāntaratā nopapadyate? ityata āha -`bho ityāmantritāntamapi` ityādi| `bhoḥ` iti sāmānyavacanam| atra `bhoḥ` iti yadyapyāmantritam, tathāpi nāvidyamānavat, `nāmantrite` [[8.1.73]] ityādinā'vidyamānavadbhāvasya pratiṣedhāt| `tadubhayamapyanena kriyate` [tadubhayamanena -kāśikā] iti| kathaṃ punarubhayamapyanena kartuṃ śakyam, yāvatānudāttādhikārādanudāttasyaivānena yujyate pratiṣedhaḥ? na śakyate kartumaprakṛtāyā asaṃśabditāyā ekaśruteḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `anantike` [[8.1.55]] iti nañatra virodhe vartate, adharmānṛtādivat| antikaviruddhamanantikam| dūramityarthaḥ| dūrāt? sambuddhau cakaśrutirucyate;`ekaśruti dūrāt? sambuddhau` [[1.2.33]] iti vacanāt| evaṃ hi prapacasi devadattetyevamādiṣvāmantritanighātaṃ kṛtārthaṃ bādhitvā yatrāma ekāntaramāmantritamanantikam, tacaikaśrutireva bhavati; yadidaṃ nārabhyeta| ato nāprāptāyāmekaśrutau ivamārabhyata iti tāṃ tāvadbādhate, tatastasyāñca bādhitāyāṃ bādhakābhāvāt? prāpnuvat? taṃ nighātamapi bādhata eva| kutaḥ? nighātapratiṣedhādhikāre vacanāt| ekaśrutipratiṣedhe hi vidhitsite satyekaśrutiprakaraṇa eva (1.2.33-40) pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt, nāma ekāntaramiti; tatrāpyayamarthaḥ -`āmantritamanantike` [[8.1.55]] iti vaktavyaṃ na bhavati| tasmānnighātapratiṣedhādhikāre vacanānnighātamapi bādhata iti yuktam -tadubhayamanena kriyata iti| naiṣa doṣo yadi tahrraprakaraṇāpannāśabditāpyekaśrutiranena pratiṣidhyate| iha `dūrāddhūte ca` tadubhayamanena kriyata iti| naiṣa doṣo yadi tahrraprakaraṇāpannāśabditāpyekaśrutiranena pratiṣidhyate| iha <> [[8.2.84]] iti yaḥ plutodāttaḥ prāpnoti; so'pi pratiṣidhyate? ityata āha -`plṛtodāttaḥ punaḥ` ityādi| tasmin? kartavye'siddhatvāt? plutodātto nāstyeva, sa kathaṃ pratiṣidhyeta![`pratiṣidhyate` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] asiddhatvaṃ tu <> [[8.2.1]] iti vacanāt|yaddhitavaḥ pare yasmāt? tattathoktam| `udasṛjo'yam` iti| atra hi tiṅantamaṭsvareṇādyudāttam| `sṛja visarge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1178), laṅ? sip, tudāditvācchaḥ, `haśi ca` [[6.1.110]] ityuttvam, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | `uśanti hi` iti| `vaśa kāntau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1080) jherantādeśaḥ [[7.1.3]] , pūrvavacchapo luk, grahajyādisūtreṇa [[6.1.16]] samprasāraṇam| pratyasvareṇa madhyodāttametat|`ākhyasyāmitu` iti| `khyā prakathane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1060), cakṣiṅādeśo vā, lṛṅ| syapratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttametat| `nipātairyadyavihanta` [[8.1.30]] ityādinā niyamasya kāraṇaṃ darśayi| `vacanam` ityādināpyasya vacanasya niyamārthatvam| `ebhireva` ityādināpi niyamasaya svarūpam| `nānyaiḥ` iti| anenāpi niyamasya vyavacchedyam| `iha` ityādināpi vyavacchedyasya viṣayam| `svo hohāvaihi` iti| `ruha bījajanmani prādurbhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-859), loṭ, vas, śap, <<āḍuttamasya picca>> [[3.4.92]] , <> [[3.4.98]] iti sakaralopaḥ| rohāvetyetasmin? parabhūte svarityasya `ro ri` [[8.3.14]] iti rephasya lopo na bhavati; chāndasatvāt| tasminnasati pūrvavaduttvam| <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] iti hi guṇe, lomaṇyadhyamapuruṣaikavacane rūpam| kvacit - `jāye svo rohārvaihītyehītyanena gatyarthaloṭā yuktasya` iti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāṅpūrvasyeṇaḥ prayogo veditavyaḥ| atha paragrahaṇaṃ krimartham, na `yaddhituṣveva` naivaṃ śakyam; saptamīnirdeśe hi nirdiṣyaṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvādanantareṣvevākyavādiṣu bhavatīti niyamo vijñāyate| tato'nantareṣveva padadiṣu bhaviṣyati, na vyavahiteṣviti| tathā cāvyayoganivṛtteniyamenākṛtatvāt? svo rohāvaihītyatra syādeva pratiṣedhaḥ||`ihāpi gotrādayaḥ kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoreva gṛhyante` iti| na kevalaṃ `tiṅo gotrādīni` [[8.1.27]] ityādo sūtra ityapiśabdārthaḥ| yathā cātrāpi kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoreva gotrādīni gṛhyante, tathā tatraivopapāditam| `pacatikalpam` iti| `īṣadasamāptau kalpap` [[5.3.67]] | tatra hi `tiṅaśca` [[5.3.56]] ityanuvartate, `anudāttastaddhita ihodāharaṇamiti kasmānna bhavati? iti praśnāvasare āha -`anyatra taddhitasvareṇa tiṅsvaro vācye, iti taddhitasyodāttatve sati `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam? [[6.1.152]] iti cānudāttatvāpatattiḥ| evañcānyatra nighātaḥ siddha eveti| anudātta eva taddhita ihodāharaṇam| `atra ityādi| kathaṃ punarupasargagrahaṇaṃ śakyaṃ draṣṭum? uttarasūtre <> [[8.1.58]] iti caśabdenāsya sūtrasya dvitadīyo vyāpāra ucyate, sa ānantaryādgaterityasya viśeṣaṇārtho bhaviṣyati -cādiṣu yo gatiriti| cādiṣviti sāmīpyalakṣaṇamadhikaraṇam| kaścādiṣu gatiḥ? cādisamīpe ya uditaḥ| tenāyaṃ prādīnāmevepasargasaṃjñānāṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate| evaṃ tāvadasmin? sūtre gatigrahaṇenopasargasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| `sagatirapi tiṅ` iti| atrāpi <> [[8.1.63]] iti sūtrāt? maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vibhāvetyanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenopasargasaṃjñena gatinā yo gatiḥ saḥ| tasyaivānudāttatvena bhavitavya mityupasarga9syaiva gategrrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| atha vā -dvayorapyetayorbogayoḥ `vibhāṣitaṃ sopasargamanuttamam` [[8.1.53]] ityata upasargagrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvartate, gatigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; upasargagrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhatvāt| nānarthakam; vispaṣṭārthatvāt| <> [[5.1.118]] ityatra hrupasargagrahaṇaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇārtham| tatrāsati gatigrahaṇe, ihāpyusargagrahaṇaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇārthamiti kasyacit? sandehaḥ syāt| prādyupalakṣaṇe ca sati ko doṣaḥ? anupasargāṇāmapi prādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāyeta| tataḥ śuklaukarotītyatra nighātapratiṣedho bhavatyeva| `abhūtatadbhāve` (5.4.50|vā|1) ityādineha cdiḥ, tasya <<ūryādicviḍācaśca>> [[1.4.61]] iti gatisaṃjñā, <> [[7.4.32]] itīttvam| `yat? kāṣṭhaṃ śuklīkaroti` iti| atra `sagatirape tiṅaḥ` [[8.1.68]] iti nighāto na vartate| tena `nipātairyadyadi` [[8.1.30]] ityādinā nighātapratiṣedha eva bhavati||dvividhāścādayaḥ -gaṇaparipaṭhitāśca, yāvaṅgīkṛtyaitaduktam -`cādayo'sattve [[1.4.57]] iti; sūtrapaṭhitāśca -`na cavāhāhaivāyukte` [[8.1.24]] iti; tatra pratyāsatterya iha prakaraṇe paṭhitāsteṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ yuktam? iti matvā''ha -`cādayo na cadāhāhaiva` ityādi| khādatiśabdaḥ pacatiśabdena tulyasvaraḥ| `prathamasyātra tiṅantasya` ityādinā dvitīyamiha gaterityasya pratyudāharaṇamiti darśayati| caśbado gaterityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| anyaccāsya prayojanamuktameva||`prathamā tiṅavibhaktiḥ` iti| etena prathameti strīliṅganirdeśo vibhaktyapekṣaḥ sūtre kṛta iti darśayati| prathamātvaṃ tasya punaḥ prathamamuccāraṇādveditavyam? `gardaṃbhā~śca kālayati` iti| `kala vila kṣepe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1604-1605) curādiṇic| citsvareṇa lakāre'kāra udātta iti madhyodāttametat| dvitadīyaṃ tu nihanyata eva| atha yogagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na ca vayorityeva saptamyā nirdeśaḥ kriyeta, yathā `cādiṣa ca` [[8.1.58]] ? ityata āha -`yogagrahaṇam` ityādi| yathā <> [[8.1.58]] iti saptamyā nirdeśe sati paraireva cādiniryoge pratiṣedho bhavati, na pūrvai; tathehāpi parābhyāmeva cavābhyāṃ yoge syāt, na pūrvābhyām| tābhyāmapi yoge yathā syādityevamarthaṃ yogagrahaṇam| yadi tu cavābhyāmiti tṛtīyayā nirdeśaḥ kriyate, vināpi yogagrahaṇena pūrvābhyāmapi yoge syādeva pratiṣedhaḥ? sandehaparihārārthaṃ tu tathā na kṛtam, cavābhyāmityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt -kimayaṃ tṛtīyayā nirdeśaḥ? uta pañcamyeti? pañcamyā nirdeśe ko doṣaḥ syāt? paramatābhyāṃ yoge na syāt| kathaṃ punardvitīyāditiṅantasya cavābhyāṃ yogaḥ, yattannivṛttyarthaṃ prathamāgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta? ityata āha -`cavāyogo hi` ityādi| iha cayogaḥ samuccaye bhavati, vāyogastu vikalpe| sa ca samuccayo vapikalpaścānekasya dharmaḥ, dvitvādivat| ato yatra tau samuccayavikalpau, tatrāvaśyamanekasya dvitīyādeḥ sannidhānena bhavitavyam| tasmāt? tannivṛttyarthaṃ prathamāgrahaṇam||`ācārabhedaḥ` iti| śiṣṭācāravyatikrama ityarthaḥ| `yāti` iti| dhātusvareṇādyudāttaḥ| itikaraṇena haśabdamātralasya nighātakāraṇatvamākhyāyate| asati hi tasmin? kṣiyā haśabdasyopādhirvijñāyeta tiṅantasya vā| tathā ca yadā haśabdastiṅantaṃ vā kṣiyāyāṃ na prayujyate, tadā nighātapratiṣedho na syāt| itikaraṇe tu sati svarūpamātrapradhāno haśabdo nighātasya kāraṇa bhavatīti asatyāmapi haśabdasya tiṅantasya vā kṣiyāyāṃ vṛttau nighātapratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati||cakāreṇa kṣiyāyāmityetadanukṛṣyate| `nānāprayojanaḥ` iti| anekaprayojana ityarthaḥ| `niyogaḥ` iti| preṣaṇam, vyāpāraṇamityarthaḥ| itikaraṇamasya pūrvavadeva prayojanam||`kva cāsya lopaḥ` iti| <> [[8.1.45]] ityatra yo'bhiprāya praṣṭuruktaḥ sa ihāpi veditavyaḥ| `yatrārtho gamyate` ityādi| atrāpi yastatrābhiprāya itarasyābhihitaḥ sa eva draṣṭavyaḥ| kaḥ punararthastayoḥ prayuktayorapi gamyate? ityāha -`tatra` ityādi| kya punardiṣaye calopaḥ? kva vāhalopaḥ? ityāha -`samānakarttṛke` ityādi| yasmin? vyāpāraviśeṣe samāsa ekaḥ kartā sa samānakartakaḥ| `samānakarttṛke calopaḥ, nānakarttṛke'halopaḥ` iti| nānā kartā yasmin? sa nānākarttukaḥ|`devadatta eva grāmaṃ gacchatu, sa devadatta evāraṇyaṃ gacchatu` iti| atra grāmakarmakamaraṇyakarmakañca gamanaṃ yat? tasya devadatta eva kartati tat? samānakartṛkam| cārthaṃ ca darśayitumāha -`grāmaṃ ca` ityādi| atra hi devadatta evāraṇyaṃ gacchatu devadatta eva grāmaṃ gacchatviti devadattasyaiva niyojyasya gantugrrāma eva gantavyatayopadiśyate, yajñadattasya tvaraṇyameva kevalam| tenāsatyapyahaśabdasya prayoge tadartho gamyate -grāmaṃ kevalaṃ devadatto gacchatu, araṇyaṃ kevalaṃ yajñadatto gacchatviti| `anavakḷptau` iti| asambhāvanāyāmityarthaḥ| yo hi devadattasya bhojanaṃ na kvacitsambhāvayati sa eva prayuṅakte -devadatta tadeva bhokṣyase` iti| pararūpatvam||`sūtranirdiṣṭā gahrante` iti| pūrvataḥ pratyāsatteḥ| atra cavālope <> [[8.1.59]] iti prāpte vibhāṣā, pariśeṣāṇāmaprāpte| `bhavanti` iti| pakṣe pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ| `yajeta` iti| atra pakṣe'dupadeśāllasārvadhātukasyānudāttatve kṛte dhātokadāttatve satyādyudāttatvam||`āsīt` iti| `asa bhuvi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1065), laṅ? adāditvācchayo luk, <<astisico'pṛkte>> [[7.3.96]] iti āṭ, sa codātta ityādyudāttametat| itikaraṇasya pūrvoktameva prayojanam| cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| yā dviḥ pacatviha tasyāḥ saṃvatsarasya sasyaṃ pacyate dvirityanena yuktā prathamā tiṅvibhaktiḥ pacatviti vā na nihanyate||`samarthābhyām` iti| nāyamasyārthaḥ -tiṅantena saṃgatābhyāmiti; anyathā hrasyopādānamanarthakameva syāt, `cadāyoge prathamā` [[8.1.59]] ityato yogagrahaṇānuvṛtterevāsyārthasya labdhatvāt| tasmāt? samānārthābhyāmityasyāyamarthaḥ| sā ca samānārthatā tiṅantāpekṣayā bhavatīti parasparāpekṣayā veditavyā| `ekā jinvati` iti| jayaterlaṭ, <> [[3.1.85]] iti śnuḥ, <> [[7.4.78]] iti jheradādeśaḥ, <> [[6.4.87]] iti yaṇādeśaḥ| anighātapakṣe sārvadhātukasvareṇa madhyodāttametat| satiśiṣṭādapi hi vikaraṇasvarāt? sārvadhātukasvaro balīyāniṣyate| `atti` [`anti` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] iti| adeḥ `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam| anighātapakṣe dhātusvareṇādādyuttametat| `cākaśīti` iti| `kāśṛ dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-647), asya yaṅlugantasya rūpametat| `upātiṣṭhat` iti| tiṣṭhaterlaṅa pādhrādisūtreṇa [[7.3.78]] tiṣṭhādeśaḥ| `eka iti saṃkhyāpadametat` iti| anena pratyudāharaṇa ekaśabdasyānyaśabdenāsamānārthatāṃ darśayati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamanyaśabdenāsamānārthena yogena pratyudāharaṇaṃ na darśitam? ityāha -`ekaśabdasya vyavasthārthaṃ ca` ityādi| caśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| anekārthasambhave'rahthāntarādvyavacchisyaikatraivārthe vyavasthānaṃ vyavasthā| ekaśabdasya vyavasthārthameva samarthagrahaṇam; nānyaśabdasya vyavasthārtham| na hi tasyānekārthaḥ sambhavati| tasmādekaśabdasya vyavasthārthaṃ samarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| tenaivaikaśabdenāsamarthena yoge yuktaṃ pratyudaharaṇamupadarśayitum, nānyaśabdenetyabhiprāyaḥ| kasmāt? punarekaśabdavyavasthārthameva samarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam? ityāha -`vyabhicāritvāt? tasya` iti| ekaśabdo hi yatrārthe'nyatrādau vṛṣṭastaṃ vyabhicarati? tathā hi -sa kvacidanyaśabdasyārthe dṛśyate, kvacitprāthamye, kvacit? saṃkhyāyām, tasmādasau vyabhicārī| anavasthita ityarthaḥ| tadvyavasthārthaṃ samarthagrahaṇaṃ yuktam, nānyaśabdavyavasthārtham; tasyākhyabhicāritvāt| na hranyaśabdo yatrārthe dṛṣṭastato'nyatra vartate| nana#u ca vyavasthāyā etatphalam -anyaśabdasamānārthasyaikaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāditi, etaccāntareṇāpi vyavasthākāraṇaṃ samarthagrahaṇamanyaśabdasāhacaryādeva labhyate, tadanarthakaṃ samarthagrahaṇam? naitadasti; `nipātairyadyadi` [[8.1.30]] ityādau sūtre nipātagrahaṇena jñāpitam -sāhacaryamiha prakaraṇe vyavasthākāraṇaṃ na bhavatīti||`prathamā chandasīti ca nivṛttam` iti| tayorvibhāṣāgrahaṇena sambaddhatvāt| tasya ceha nityagrahaṇena nivarttitatvāt| atastannivattau tatsambaddhayorapi nivṛttirbhavati| vṛttaśabdo'yamihādhikaraṇasādhanam -vartate tasminniti vṛttam; vṛterakarmakatvāt? `kto'dhikaraṇe ca` [[3.4.76]] ityātadinā'dhikaraṇe ktaḥ| tatpunaradhikaraṇaṃ padādhikārāt? padameva vijñāyate, ityāha -`yatra pade yacchabdo vartate` ityādi| yadi yadvṛttamityadhikaraṇe ktaḥ, tarhi <> [[2.2.13]] iti pratiṣedhāt? ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na pravartate? ata eva nipātanāt? samāsa ityadoṣaḥ| `etannāśrīyate` iti| yadyetadāśrīyeta, `yatkāmāste juhumaḥ` ityādau na syāditi bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra paribhāṣā śakyā nāśrayitum? vaktavyamevaitat -iha paribhāṣā na bhavatīti| `dadāti juhumaḥ` iti| abhyastānāmādiḥ` [[6.1.183]] ityubhayamapyetadādyudāttam| `yatkāmāḥ` iti| yasmin? kāma eṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `yadraṅ` iti padam? yadañcatīti `ṛtvik` [[3.2.59]] ityādinā kvin, `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityanunāsikalopaḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ, `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti tum, saṃyogāntalopaḥ, viṣvagdevayoḥ` [[6.3.91]] ityadraādeśaḥ, kvinpratyayasya kuḥ` [[8.2.62]] | `vāti` iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1050), adāditvācchapo luk| dhātusvareṇādyudāttametat| `pavate` iti| `pūṅa pavane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-966) etadapi pūrvavadādyudāttam| ata ṅittvāllasārvadhātukasyānudāttatve kṛte dhātusvara eva bhavati| nanu ca yadvṛttāditi pañcamīnirdeśo'yam, yatkāmaste juhamaḥ -ityādiṣu codāharaṇeṣu ta ityādinā padena vyavadhānam, ato nirdeṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvādiha nighātapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam? ityāha -`pañcamīnirdeśe'ptra vyavahite'pi kāryamiṣyate` [`vyavahite` ityeva -kāśikā] ici etaccottarasūtre jñāpayiṣyate||`pūjanāt` iti| supāṃ supo bhavantīti (7.1.39|vā) bahuvacanasya sthāna ekavacanam, ata evāha -`pūjanavacanebhyaḥ` iti| `uttarapadam` iti| subantaṃ veditavyam| nanu tiṅiti vartate? satyametat; uttaratra [[8.1.68]] tiṅiti vacanādiha subantasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| api ca vakṣyatyetat -ihaiva samāse caitadanudāttatvamiti| samāsaśca kāṣṭhādīnāṃ subantenaiva sambhavati, na tiṅanteneti yuktamiha subantasyaiva padasya garahaṇam| sarva ete kāṣṭhādayo'dbhutaparyāyāḥ pūjanavacanā bhavanti| adbhutaṃ yo'dhīte sa kāṣṭhādhyāyaka ityucyate| evaṃ dāruṇādiṣu veditavyam| iha sarva evaite kāṣṭhādayaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇabhūtāḥ samasyante, na ca kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ samāsaḥ kvacidvihitaḥ, tatkathamatra samāsaḥ? ityāha -`mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt? samāsaḥ` iti| `samāse caitat` ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| samāsa evetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ samāsa evaitallabhyate? <> [[8.1.63]] ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| sā vyavasthitavibhāṣeti vijñānācca| yadyevam, kathaṃ vārttikakāreṇoktam -malopaśceti, kāṣṭhādiṣu hi yo'kārāntāsteṣāṃ vibhakterambhāve kṛte makāraḥ sambhavati, samāse caitadanudāttatvena bhavitavyam, tatra vibhakterabhāvānmakāro na sambhavatīti malopavacanamayuktaṃ syāt? ityata āha -`malopaścetyanenāpi` ityādi| evamasmābhiranudāttatvasya viṣaya ākhyātaḥ| malopa ścetyanenāpi sa evākhyāyate; yasmāt? samāse malopo na bhavati; vibhakterluptatvāt| asamāse vibhakterambhāve kṛte makārasya śravaṇameva bhavati, na tu lopaḥ| athāsamāse malopārthamityetaduktamityeva kasmānna vijñāyate? ityāha -`asamāse[`athāsamāse` - kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] hi ityādi|atha pūjitagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pūjanaśabdo'yaṃ pūjitāpekṣatvāt? sambandhiśabdaḥ, tena sambandhiśabdatvāt? pūjitamarthādupasthāpayati, tantrāntareṇāpi pūjitagrahaṇaṃ pūjitasyaiva parigraho bhaviṣyati? ityata āha -`pūjanādeva` ityādi| pūjanagrahaṇādeva pūjitagrahaṇe labdhe pūjitagrahaṇaṃ yat? kriyate tasyaitat? prayojanam -viśiṣṭasyāvyavahitasya pratyāsannasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| tenottarasūtre [[8.1.68]] yat? kāṣṭhaṃ devadattaḥ pacatītyatra vyavahitasya na bhaviṣyati| nanu pañcamīnirdeśādeva vyavahitasya na bhaviṣyati? ityata āha -`etadeva` ityādi| yādṛśamidaṃ jñāpakaṃ tadanurūpam? `yadvṛttānnityam` [[8.1.66]] ityatra yatkāmāste juhumaḥ, yadraṅ? vāyurvātītyevamādyudāhṛta mityarthaḥ| etena jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśitam| athānudāttagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā <> [[8.1.18]] ityato'nudāttagrahaṇamanuvartata [`anuvarteta ityāha` - kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] eva? ityāha -`anudātta iti vartamāne` [`anudāttamiti` -kāśikā] ityādi| taddhyanudāttagrahaṇaṃ `na luṭ` [[8.1.29]] iti pratiṣedhena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau so'pyanuvartate| tathā ca sati yasyāmantritādeḥ pūjitasya nighātaprāptirasti tasyāyaṃ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ parasya nighātapratiṣedho vijñāyeta| tasmāt? pratiṣedhanivṛttyarthamanyadihānudāttagrahaṇaṃ kriyate||`sagatigrahaṇācca gatirapi nihanyate` iti| tulyayoge'tra sahaśabdaḥ| tatrobhayorapi vidhīyamānena kāryeṇa sambandho bhavati| tathā hi saputro bhojyatāmityukte dvayorapi pitāputrayorbhojanena sambandho bhavati| tasmādihāpyagatestiṅantasya ca nighāte ca sambandho vijñāyate| `gatigrahaṇena cātropasargagrahaṇamiṣyate` iti| yathā caitallabhyate tathā pūrvamevākhyātam| tiṅgrahaṇaṃ pūrvo nighātaḥ subantaviṣayo yathā vijñāyetetyevamartham||`pacati pūti` iti| patiśabdasaya kriyādiviśeṣaṇatvāt? `svamornapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] iti vibhakterluk| `pacati, kliśnāti` iti| `kliśū vibādhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1522), kryāditvāt? śnā| atra kliśnātītyetat? kutsanaṃ bhavati, yo yasya bādhanaṃ karoti tena sa kutsyate| sambandho'pyanayostiṅantayorastyeva| yasmāt? pacati tasmāt? kliśnātīti| subantaṃ tu kliśnātītyetanna bhavati, asya na bhavati nighātaḥ| `kriyākutsane` ityādi| tiṅante dvayamasti -sādhanam, kriyā ca| tatra kriyāyāḥ kutsane'nudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyetadarthamidaṃ vyākhyeyam, karttuḥ kutsane mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ca| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -`cādilope vibhāṣā` vibhāṣā` [[8.1.63]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca sā, tena kriyākutsana eva bhaviṣyati, na karttuḥ kutsana iti| nanu ca kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, sādhanaṃ tu tatrāpradhānam, tasya kriyāṅgatvāt, atra prādhānyādeva patītyevamādinā viśeṣaṇena kriyāyā eva sambandho bhaviṣyati, na guṇabhūtasya kartuḥ, tatkimucyate kriyākutsanamiti? evaṃ manyate -yathaiva kṛdanteṣu dāruṇādhyāyakādiṣu kriyāyāḥ pradhānabhūtāyā api viśeṣaṇena sambandho bhavati, tathā'khyāteṣvaprādhānye'pi sādhanasya viśeṣaṇena sambandhena bhavitavyamiti| `pūtiścānubandhaḥ` ityādi| pūtiśabdaścakārānubandho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -cakāro'tra krayate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena pūtiścānubandho bhaviṣyatīti| nanu ca pūtiśabdasya prātipadikatvādapratiṣiddhamevāntodāttatvam, kasmāt? sa cānubandhaḥ kriyate? na cāyaṃ ktinnantaḥ, pūtirayamiti puṃsā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| tahrranena cakārānubandhakaraṇenaivaitaddarśayati -yatra sagatestiṅo'nudāttatvaṃ tatra pūterantodāttatvam, anyatrāyamādyudātta eva; tena kriyākutsane'ntodāttaḥ kartavyaḥ, kutsana ādyudātta iti| `tenāyam` ityātadinā cānubanadhakatvasya phalaṃ darśayati| `vibhāṣitam` ityādi| bahvartha yat? tiṅantaṃ tadvibhāṣā'nudāttaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tena vyavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ caśritya kartavyam| `supi kutsane` ityādi| athamuktārthasaṃgrahaślokaḥ| tatrādyena pādena yaduktaṃ kriyākutsana iti varaktavyamiti tasya saṃgrahaḥ| `malopaḥ` ityādi| nāsmin? tiṅ? vidyata ityatiṅiti| sa punaḥ prastāvāt? [prastādān -prā|kāṃudritapāṭhau] kāṣṭhādīnāṃ samāso vijñāyate| tatrātiṅi kāṣṭhādisamāse malopa iṣṭaḥ| etacca malopaścetyanenāyameva viṣaya ākhyāyata ityādinā tūktārtham, tadanena samāsa caitadanudāttatvamityādinā yaduktaṃ tatasarvaṃ grahītum| atha vā malopa ityanena malopaścetyetadvacanamupalakṣayati| asya coktārthamityanena sambandhaḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati -malopaśceti yat? kāryaṃ vacanaṃ tanmalopaścetyanenaipityādinā pūrvamevoktaprayojanamiti| `atiṅi` iti| anudāttamityetadvaktavyamiti vṛttabhaṅgabhayānnoktam| anuktamapi tasya ślokasya pūrvoktārthasaṃgrahārthatvāt? kāṣṭhādīnāma ca pūrvamanudāttasya coktatvādgamyata eva| atiṅīti cānena bahuvrīhiṇā samāsaḥ| tenaitaduktaṃ bhavati -kāṣṭhādīnāṃ samāse'nudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti| śeṣaṃ sugamam||`abhyuddharati` iti| abhiśabdasya prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatve prāpta ucchabde gatau parato'nudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `samudānayati` iti| atrāpi `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80), `upasargāścābhivarjam` (phi|sū|4|81) iti sama ādyudāttatve prāpte'nudāttatvaṃ bhavati| kathaṃ punaratrāha -samaśca gatisaṃjñeti yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ pratyeva gatyupasargasajñe bhavata ityuktam? (jai|pa|vṛ|99), na cocchabdasya kriyāvācitvam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; kriyāviśeṣavācino hi prādayaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaśca kriyaiva| kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyetyuktam| upasaga'pi kārakapravṛttiviśiṣyata eva| na [na hruddharatīti] hruttaratīti haratyartha eva kevalaṃ karttṛvyāpāraṃ vyavacchinati| kiṃ tarhi? upasargārtho'pi| atha vā haraṇādarthāntaramevoddharaṇam, tasyābhirviśeṣaṇamiti nānupapannā gatisaṃjñā| `devadattaḥ prapacati` iti| devairdāsīṣṭeti <> [[3.3.174]] iti ktaḥ; `do daddhoḥ` [[7.4.46]] iti dadādeśaḥ| <> [[6.2.48]] ityādyudāttatve prāpte <> [[6.2.148]] iti devadattaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `āmandraiḥ` ityādi| atra sarvamasti, na tu mandrogatiriti| tasmin? parata āṅo'nudāttatvaṃ na bhavati| asati canudāttatve `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ` (phi|sū|4|80) `upasargaścābhivarjam` (phi sū 4|81) ityādyudāttatvameva bhavati| kathaṃ punarāṅo gatisaṃjñā, kriyāyoge hi sati vihitā sā, na cātrāsti kriyāyogaḥ, mandaraśabdasyākriyāvācitvāt? ityata āha -`yāhītyetat? prati kriyāyogādāṅitveṣa gatiḥ` iti| satyapi vyavadhāne vyavahitāśca [[1.4.81]] iti gatisaṃjñāvidhānāditi bhavāḥ| syādetat, yadyapi yāhītyetat? pratyāṅo gatitvam, tathāpi mandraśabdaṃ prati nāsyeva tasya gatisaṃjñā, tena yadyapi gatāvityetannocyeta, tathāpi naivehānudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āha -`tasya` ityādi| atrāsyānudāttatvaṃ syādeveti| asya `anāśritapanimittakam` ityanena heturuktaḥ| tasyānāśritaparanimittakasyāpi gatāvityasminnasatyenena gatigrahaṇasyābhāvo heturabhihitaḥ| yadi gatāvityennocyeta, tato'nāśritaparanimittamevānudāttatvamuktaṃ syāt| na hrasati saptamīnirdiṣṭe gatigrahaṇe paranimittatāśrīyate| tataśca gatirityetāvatyucyamāne yadyapi mandraśabdo gatirna bhavati, tathāpi tasyāṅāśritaparanimittamanudāttatvamiha syādeva| gatāvityasmastu sati na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ; gateḥ paranimittasyāśrayaṇāt? tasya cehābhāvāt||`tasmin? sati` ityādinā'vidyamānavadbhavatītyasyārthamācaṣṭe| `avidyamānavat` iti| vatinā nirdeśo'yam, avidyamānena tulyaṃ vartata ityavidyamānavat| vatiśca sādśye bhavati, evañca tasyāvidyamānena sādṛśyaṃ bhavati yadi satyapi tasmastannibandhanaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavati| asati ca tasmin? yat? kāryaṃ tadattānibandhanaṃ tat? satyapi tasmin? bhavati| `āmantritanighātena` [āmantritatiṅanighāta -kāśikā -padamaṃjarī ca] ityādinā tasmin? sati yatkāryaṃ prāpnoti tadabhāvamavidyamānavadbhāvasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `devadatt yajñadatta` iti| atra pūrvasyāvidyamānatvādasati nighāte yajñadattaśabdasya ṣāṣṭikamevāmantri [[6.1.192]] tādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `devadatta mama grāmaḥ svam` ti| <> [[7.2.96]] iti tadamamādeśau sāptikau| `ityevamādiṣu` iti| ādiśabdena `devadatta tubhyaṃ dīyate` ityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam, `yuṣmadasmadādeśā na bhavanti` iti| <> [[8.1.22]] ityevamādayaḥ| `pūjāyāmanantarapratiṣedhaḥ prayojanam` ityādinā tasminnāmantrite'sati yatkāryaṃ prāpnoti tasya satyapi tasmin? bhāve'vidyamānavadbhāvasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `yāvaddevadatta pacasītyatrāpi` ityādi| yatrāpyāmantritaṃ vyavadhāyakamityeṣo'piśabdasyārtho veditavyaḥ| `devadattaḥ pacati` iti| atrāvidyamānatvābhāvat? tiṅanighāto bhavatyeva| `pūrvam` iti| kiṃ devadatta iti pūrvaṃ paramapi khalu bhavati? na ceha paramastīti nāsti devadattetyasya pūrvatvam| tenāmantritādyudāttatve kartavye nāvidyamānavadbhavati| `devadatta pacasi` iti| atra pacasītyetadapekṣayā devadattaśabdasya pūrvatvamastītyavidyamānavadbhāvena tasya bhavitavyam, tataścāmantritādyudāttatva tasya na syāt| `imaṃ me gaṅge yamune` -ityatra ca gaṅgeśabdasya yamuneśabdenānantaryamapanayan? sa nighātanimittabhāvaṃ pratibadhnīyāditi yamuneśabdasya nighāto na syādityetaccodyadvayamāśaṅkyāha -`pūrvatvaṃ ca` ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇe, bhinnakramaśca| parāpekṣamevetyevaṃ draṣṭavyam| itikaraṇo hetau| yeṣāṃ yadbhāvo yadapekṣavadbhavati teṣāṃ tadbhāvenānūdyamānānāṃ vidhīyamāno dharmastadviṣaya eva pratīyate| tadyathā -putraḥ kāryeṣvavahita iti putrasya putrabhāvaḥ putrāpekṣa iti tasya putrabhāvenānūdyamānasya vidhīyamānaṃ kāryeṣvavahitatvaṃ yadapekṣaṃ putratvaṃ tatkāryeṣvavagamyate, nānyakāryeṣu| pūrvatvaṃ cedaṃ parāpekṣameva| tasmāt? tadanūdyāmantritasyāvidyamānavadbhāvo yadapekṣaṃ tatpūrvatvaṃ tasyaiva parasya kārye kartavye bhavati, nānyasya| kiṃviśiṣṭe kārye? svānimitte, anyanimitte yā| svaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tat? svanimittam, āmantritamityarthaḥ| tasmādanyacchabdāntaraṃ nimittaṃ yasya tadantanimittam| yata evaṃ parasyaiva kārye kartavye tadāmantritamavidyamānavadbhavati, na tu svakārye kartavye, tena devadatta pacasautyatrāmantritādyudāttatvaṃ na parasya kāryam; kiṃ tarhi? āmantritasyaiva| yataḥ parasya kāryamanudāttatvam, tasmastvavidyamānavdabhavatyeva|evaṃ prathamacodyaṃ nirākṛtya dvitīyaṃ nirākarttumāha -`imaṃ me gaṅge yamune` ityādi| atrāpi pūrvatvaṃ ca parāpekṣaṃ bhavatītyeṣa eva hetuḥ| gaṅgeśabdaḥ pūrvamāmantritāntaḥ svayamavidyamānavattvānnimittaṃ na bhavatīti sambandhanīyam| kva viṣaye nimittaṃ na bhavati? parasyaiva sumuneśabdasyānudāttatve kartavye| meśabdasya ca nimittabhāvaṃ na pratibadhyātīti gaṅgeśabdaḥ pūrvamāmantrito yamuneśabdasyānudāttatve kartavye vidyamānavattvāditi sarvamapekṣate| iha pūrvaśapabdasya sambandhiśabdatvāt? parasya kārye kartavye pūrvasyāmantritasyāvidyamānavadbhāvo vidhīyate| `imaṃ me gaṅge yamune` ittayatra ca yadyapi gaṅgeśabdādanyacchabdāntaraṃ `me` ityetadyamuneśabdasyānudāttasya nimittam, tathāpi tadanudāttatvaṃ pasyaivāmantritasya kāryamiti tasminnapi kartavye gaṅgeśabdo'vidyamānavadbhavati| ata eva prāguktam -anyanimitte vaitenāvidyaṭacamānatvānmeśabdasya nighātaṃ prati yo nimittabhāvaḥ taṃ na pratibadhnāti| vatkaraṇaṃ kimartham? svāśrayamapi yathā syāt -ām? bho devadattatri| `āma ekagāntaramāmantritamanantike` [[8.1.55]] ityekāntaratānibandhano nighātapratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati| bahuvacanāntañcaitadvijñeyam; ekavacanānte hi <> [[8.1.73]] iti pratiṣedhānnaivāvidyamānavattvamasti| bahuvacanānte tu <> [[8.1.74]] iti pakṣe vidyate| nanu ca parārthe prayujyamānāḥ śabdā atideśaṃ gamayanti, yathā -`gaurvāhīka iti, tatra vidyamānasyāvidyamānamiti vacanādatideśo gamyate| atideśadharmaśca svāśrayā nivṛttiriti nārtho vatinā? satyametat; evaṃ tu manyate -vatimantareṇa prayogavyavasthārthamivaṃ syāt, kutaścidāmantritaṃ pūrvaṃ na bhavatīti| tathā cāmantritasyāmantritena pūrveṇaikāntarātā na syāditi||`samānādhikaraṇam` [samānādhikaraṇe -kāśikā] iti| samānābhidheyamityarthaḥ| `agne gṛhapate` iti| agniśabdo'trāgnimātrābhidhāyitvāt? sāmānyavacano'pi gṛhapatiśabdena viśeṣābhidhāyinā vyavacchidyamānastadvācye gārhapatyākhye'gniviśeṣe evāvatiṣṭhata iti gṛhapatiśabdastena samānādhikaraṇaḥ| evaṃ `māṇavaka jaṭilādhyāpaka` ityatrāpi samānādhikaraṇātā vijñeyā| atra jaṭilakaśabdasyāpekṣābhedāt? sāmānye viśeṣatvaṃ na; kiṃ tarhi? māṇavakāpekṣayā viśeṣatvam, adhyāpakāpekṣayā sāmānyabhāvaḥ| atra jaṭilake samānādhikaraṇe parato māṇavakasyāvidyamānavattvaṃ na bhavati, adhyāpake tu jaṭilakaśabdasya| pūrvasya` ityādinā pratiṣedhasya phalaṃ darśayati| `devadatta pacasi` iti| tatra devadattasya yo'bhidheyo'rthastatraiva kartari lakāro vihita iti bhavati pacasītyetaddevadattaśabdena samānādhikaraṇam| āmantritaṃ tu na bhavati -devadatta yajñadatteti| devadattaśabdo'tra na saṃjñāśabdo gṛhrate, kiṃ tarhi? kriyānimittakaḥ; anyathā saṃjñaśabdasyaikavastuniṣṭhatvāt? sāmānyavacanaḥ, sa na syāt| `ete paryāyāḥ` iti| etena sāmānyavacanatvābhāvaṃ darśayati| viśeṣāpekṣaṃ sāmānyam| na cātra kasyacidviśeṣo vācyo yadapekṣayā sāmānyaṃ syāt, sarveṣāmatyantābhinnārthatvāt, anyathā paryāyā evaṃ na syuḥ| kathaṃ punajrñāyante paryāyā ete? ityāha -`evaṃ hruktam` ityādi||pūrveṇa nityaṃ vidyamānavattve prāpti vikalpārthamidaṃ vacanam| `devāḥ śaraṇyāḥ` iti| yadā'vidyamānavattvaṃ tadā śaranyā ityasyāmantritādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati; anyathā nighātaḥ| evaṃ `brāāhṛṇā vaiyākaraṇāḥ` ityātrāpi vaiyākaraṇaśabdasyādyudāttatvam, pākṣikanighātaśca veditavyaḥ| atha viśeṣavacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `sāmānyavacanam` ityanuvartate, sāmānyañca viśaṣāpekṣam, tatrāntareṇāpi viśeṣavacanaṃ viśeṣavacanaṃ vijñāsyate? ityata āba -`sāmānyavacanādhikārādeva` ityādi| ya evaṃ na śaknoti mandadhīḥ pratipattum, taṃ prati vispaṣṭārtha viśeṣavacanagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| yadi tarhi sāmānyasya viśeṣāpekṣatvāt? sāmānyavacanagrahaṇādviśeṣavacane kāryaṃ vijñāyate, tatra pūrvasūtre'pi [[8.1.73]] tatraiva kāryaṃ vijñāyate, tathā ca devadatta yajñavatteti pratyudāharaṇaṃ dvayaṅgavikalaṃ syāt; tathā hi yathā yajñadattaśabdo na samānādhikaraṇo bhavati, tathā viśeṣavacano'pi| athāsau viśeṣavacanaḥ? evaṃ sati yathā'gne gṛhapata ityatrāgniśabdaḥ sāmānyavacano'pi gṛhapatiśabhdena viśeṣābhidhāyinā vyavacchidyamānastadagni viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati gṛhapatiśabdastena samānādhikaraṇaḥ, evaṃ devadattaśabdo viśeṣābhidhāyinā yajñadattaśapabdena vyavacchidyamānastadvacya eva viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhata iti yajñadattaśabdastena samādhikaraṇa iti cintyametat|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāmaṣṭamādhyāyasyaprathamaḥ pādaḥ- - -athāṣṭamā'dhyāyaḥdvitīyaḥ pādaḥeṣa yogaḥ paribhāṣā vā syāt? adhikāro veti pakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyate| tatra yadyayaṃ paribhāṣā syāt? sarvasyāmaṣṭādhyāyyāmpūrvasminnuttaramasiddhaṃ syāt, tataśca <> [[7.1.9]] ityatra tyadādyatvasyāsiddhatvāt? taiḥ, yaiḥ -ityatraisbhāvo na syāditīmaṃ paribhāṣāpakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā svaritatvenādhikāratvam [[1.3.11]] asyeti niścityāha -'pūrvatrāsiddhamityadhikāro'yam' iti| `adhyāyaparisamāpteḥ` iti| avadhipradarśanārthametat| `tatra` iti vākyopanyāse| 'sapādā' iti| saha pādenānantaraṃ prakrāntena vartata iti sapādā| `saptādhyāyī` iti| saptānāmadhyāyānāṃ samāhāraḥ, <> [[4.1.21]] iti ṅīp| kvacit? `sapādasaptādhyāyī` iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra sapādā cāsau saptādhyāyī ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `ayam` iti| vakṣyamāṇaḥ| `pādono'dhyāyaḥ` iti| anantaroktena pādenono'paripūrṇaḥ pādono'dhyāyaḥ| `asiddho bhavati` ityādi| pādonādhyāyagrahaṇenottarottarayogagrahaṇena ca śāstrāsiddhatvamihāśrīyata iti darśayati| kāryāsiddhatvāśrayaṇe hi yathā devadattasya hantari hate na punarvevadattasya prādurbhāvo bhavati, tathā kāryasyāsiddhatve tipādite na pa#unaḥ prakṛteḥ pratyāpattirbhavati| [`prādurbhāvo` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] tataścāmuddhatve tusmaibhāvaśāstrameva pravartate, na tvaśāstramasiddhatavāmiti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| api ca śāstrasya mukhyatvaṃ pūrvatvaṃ kāryasyaupacārikatvam| yasya kāryasya śāstraṃ pūrvaṃ tadapyupacāreṇa pūrvamityucyate, na svata eva tasaya pūrvatvam; sanniveśaviśeṣābhāvāt| kāryaṃ hi lakṣyagatam, tatra yathā lakṣyasya sanniveśo nāsti tathā tadgatasyāpi kāryasya| na ca mukhye pūrvatve sati gauṇatvasya parigrahaṇaṃ muktam| tasmācchāstraṃ [tasmācchāstrapūrvagrahaṇena -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] pūrvagrahaṇena gṛhrate| tasya ca pūrvatvaṃ paraśāstramevāpekṣya bhavati| ato yadapekṣaṃ tasya pūrvatvaṃ tataḥ parasya śāstrasyaivāsiddhatvamanena karttuṃ yuktam| śāstrasyāsiddhau ca kṛtāyāmarthataḥ kāryāsiddhatvaṃ kṛtameva bhavati; tasya tannibandhanatvāt| siddhaśabdo niṣpannavacanaḥ| siddhaṃ niṣpannamityarthaḥ| na siddhamasiddham, aniṣpannamityucyate| parañca śāstraṃ yacca niṣpannaṃ tanna śakyaṃ vacanaśatenāpyaniṣpannasattāyāmāpādayitum| anyathā na kaścidduḥkhavivaśāṃ daśāmanubhavetu; asiddhavacanenaiva na du#ḥkhasyāniṣpannatāpādānāt| tasmādyathā brāhṛdatto'brāhṛdatto'yamityukte'katideśo'yaṃ gamyate, tathehāpyasiddhatvamityukte'tideśo'yaṃ gamyata ityāha -`asiddhavadbhavati` iti| etadeva spaṣṭīkartumāha -`siddhakāryam` ityādi| evaṃ hi tadasiddhavadbhavakati yadi siddhasya yatkāryaṃ tanna karoti| `tadetat` ityādi| taditi heto, yasmādanantarokto'siddhaśabdasyārthaḥ, tasmādetadasiddhavacanamādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhārtham| ādeśo lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tadādeśalakṣaṇam, tasya pratiṣedhaḥ| so'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattathoktam| `utsargalakṣaṇabhāvavārthaṃ ca` iti| utsṛjyate nivatryata ityutsargaḥ=sthānilakṣaṇam, utsargau lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tadutsargalakṣaṇaṃ kāryam, tasya bhāva upajananamutsargalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ, so'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattathoktam| `asmā uddhara` ityādi| asmai itodaṃśabdāccaturthī, uddharetyasmin? parata āyādeśaḥ, <> [[8.3.19]] iti vakāralopaḥ| tatra kṛte'kaḥ savarṇedīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti; vakāralopasyāsiddhatvānna bhavati| `vyalopasyāsiddhatvāt` iti| tādathryādvyalopaśāstraṃ vyalopaśabdenoktam| atha vā -vyalopaśastrasyāsiddhatvādvyalopasyāsiddhatvamityucyate| evūdāharaṇeṣvādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedho'siddhatvāvacanasya prayojanam| idānīṃ yeṣūdāharaṇeṣūtsargalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ prayojanam, tāni darśayitumāha -`amudhmai` ityādi| adasaścaturthīpañcamīsaptamyaikavacanāni| tyadādyatvam? [[7.2.102]] | atrāsatyapyasiddhatve paratvāt? <<adaso'serdādu do maḥ>> [[8.2.80]] ityutvam, tataścākārāntasyābhāvāt? tannibandhanāḥ `sarvavāmnaḥ smai` [[7.1.14]] , <<ṅasiṅyoḥ smātsminau>> [[7.1.15]] iti smāyādayo na syuḥ| asiddhatve sati śāstrasya te bhavanti| `utvasyāsiddhatvāt` iti| atrāpi tādadhryādutvaśabdenotvaśāstramuktam| `śuṣkikā` ityādiślokaḥ| atra `nidarśanam` ityetat? śuṣkiketyādibhiḥ pratyakamabhisambadhyate| `jhalāṃ caśtve` iti| atrāpyasiddha iti vṛttabhaṅgabhayānnoktam| anuktamapi prakaraṇena jñāyate| `śuṣkikā` iti| `śuṣa śoṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1183) ityetasmāt? ktapratyayaḥ, <<śuṣaḥ kaḥ>> [[8.2.51]] iti kādeśaḥ, ṭāp, ajñātārthe `prāgivāt? kaḥ` [[5.3.70]] , `ke'ṇaḥ` [[7.4.13]] ti hrasvatvam, tataṣṭāp, `pratyayasyāt? kāt` [[7.3.44]] ityādinā nityamittvaṃ bhavati, na tu `udīcām` [[7.3.46]] ityādinā pākṣikam; <<śuṣaḥ kaḥ>> [[8.2.51]] ityasyāsiddhatvāt| `śuṣkajaṅghā` iti| śuṣke jaṅghe asyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ, <> [[6.3.37]] ici puṃvadbhāvaniṣedho na bhavati| <<śuṣaḥ kaḥ>> [[8.2.51]] ityasyāsiddhatvāditi prakṛtena sambandhanoyam| nanu ca satyapyasiddhatve naivātra pūrvadbhāvapratiṣedho na prāpnoti, `kopadhapratiṣede taddhitavugrahaṇaṃ kartavy` (dhā|733) iti vacanāt? na; vākyakāramatametat, sūtrakāramatena tu ślokavārttikakāreṇa ca na cātraitat? prayojanamupanyastam| etayorhi sāmānyena kopadhapratiṣedho'bhimataḥ| `kṣāmimān` iti| `kṣai jai ṣai kṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-913,914,915), <<ādeca upadeśe'śiti>> [[6.1.45]] ityāttvam, <> [[8.2.53]] iti niṣṭhātakārasya makāraḥ -kṣāma iti sthite `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] itīñaṃ kṛtvā <> [[5.2.115]] itīnipratyayaṃ vā kṛtvā matup? kartavyaḥ| `vaheḥ` ityādi| `vaha prāpaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1004) ityetasmānniṣṭhā, samprasāraṇam? [[6.1.15]] , `ho ḍaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam, <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti dhatvam, <<ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ>> [[8.4.41]] iti ṣṭutvam, <<ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ>> [[8.3.13]] iti ḍhalopaḥ, <<ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ>> [[6.3.111]] iti dīrghaḥ, ūḍha iti sthite, tamācaṣṭa iti ṇic, `ṇāviṣṭhavat? kārya prātipadikasya` (vā|813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvāṭṭilopaḥ, tadantālluṅ, `ṇiśri` [[3.1.48]] ityādinā caṅ| atra dhatvaṣṭutvādīnāmasiddhatvādyo'sau ṇo ṭilopalastasya ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivadbhavatīti (cāṃpa|pā|21) sthānivadbhāvāt? `caṅi` [[6.1.11]] iti <> [[6.1.2]] iti hta ityetasya dvirvacanam, <> [[7.4.62]] iti cutvam -mahāprāṇasya hakārasya sthāne mahāprāṇa eva jhakāraḥ, <> [[8.4.54]] iti jhakārasya sthāne jakāraḥ, <<āḍajādīnām>> [[6.4.72]] ityāṭ, `āṭaśca` [[6.1.87]] iti vṛddhiḥ| atha `sasvalladhuni caṅpare` [[7.4.93]] iti sanvadbhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`anaglope` ityādi| yadi tahrranaglopa iti pratiṣedhāt? sanvadbhāvo na bhavati tadaujiḍhaditi [`tadojaḍhaditi` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] na sa#idhyati? ityāha -`aujiḍhat` [`aujaḍhat` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| guḍaliṇmān` iti| guḍaṃ leḍhīti kvip, tadantānmatup, pūrvavaṅaḍhatvam, <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti jaśtvam -ḍhakārasya ḍakāraḥ! matorvatve kartavya ḍhatvajaśatvayorasiddhatvāt? `jhayaḥ` [[8.2.10]] iti vatvaṃ na bhavati| kārikāyāṃ jhalāṃ jaśtvagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇārthaṃ nidarśanamiti| anenaitat? darśayati -nidarśanametacchuṣkikādīnām, na tu parigaṇanamiti| yadi hi sapādāyāṃ saptādhyāyyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ pādono'dhyāyo'siddha ityucyate tadā ya iha ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasapmīnirdeśa-pañcamīnirdeśāḥ kriyante te'pyasiddhaḥ syuḥ, tataśca <> [[8.2.23]] ityatra ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasyāsiddhatvāt? <<ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā>> [[1.1.49]] ityeṣā nopatiṣṭhena, evañca sāmīpyayogāpyeṣā ṣaṣṭhī syātaḥ tataḥ saṃyogāntasamīpo yastasyāpi lopa āpadyeta; <> [[8.2.26]] ityatrāpi sapmīnirdeśasyāsiddhatvāt? `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya [[1.1.65]] ityeṣā paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭheta, tathā ca pūrvasyaivānantare bhavitavyamiti niyamasyābhāvāt? sāmānyena pūrvasya parasya vānantare vyavahite jhali lopaḥ; `hrasvādaṅgāt? [[8.2.27]] ityādāvapi pañcamīnirdeśasyāsiddhatvāt? <> [[1.1.67]] ityasyopasthānaṃ na syāt, tataścāniyamāt? pūrvasya parasya vānantarasya vyavahitasya ca lopaḥ prasajyetetyata āha -`ye'tra ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśāḥ` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasiddhatvaṃ na bhavati? ityāha -`kāryakālaṃ hi` ityādi| yadi hi `yathodrdaśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam` (vyā|pa|59) syāt, evamāsāṃ paribhāṣāṇāṃ pūrvatve sati ṣaṣṭhonirdeśādīnāmasiddhatvaṃ na syāt, na tu yathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāvam, kiṃ tarhi? `kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam` (vyā|pā|58), kāryakālāḥ kāryaprayuktā hi saṃjñāḥ paribhāṣāśca| tasmādyatra kāryaṃ tatraiva tāḥ prayujyante, tena tā upadeśa eva| ato nirdeśairabhinnadeśatvāt? paribhāṣāṇāmatra pūrvatvaṃ nāsti, tataḥ kutastāsu kartavyāsu teṣāmasiddhatvaprasaṅgaḥ! yadi kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam, <> [[1.4.2]] ityeṣā'tropatiṣṭheta? tatra ko dovaḥ? `sphura sphula sañcalane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1389), 1390), `gurī udyamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1396) -ābhyāṃ `ṛhalovryat` [[3.1.124]] iti ṇyati kṛte disphoyam, avagoryamiti na sidhyet| asyā hi paribhāṣāyā upasthāne, guṇaṃ paratvādbādhitvā `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnotītyata āha -`vipratiṣedhe paramityeṣā tu` ityādi| `vipratiṣedhe param` [[1.4.2]] ityeṣā paribhāṣā'tra na pravartata iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| kasmānna pravartate? ityāha -`yena` ityādi| dvayorhi tulyabalayorvipratiṣedho bhavati| iha tu yena pūrveṇa lakṣaṇena `pugantasya` [[7.3.86]] ityādinā saha paraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ spardhate tadapyabhibhavitumicchati| para#ṃ lakṣaṇaṃ `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] ityādikam, tat? pūrvaṃ prati tasyāsiddhatvam| ato'tulyabalatvādvipratiṣedho nāstīti `vipratiṣedhe param` [[1.4.2]] ityeṣā paribhāṣā na pravartate| `tathā ca` ityādi| evamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā apravṛttau satyāmityarthaḥ| yadi tarhi pūrvasmin? kārye kartavye paramasiddhaṃ bhavati, evaṃ satyutsarge kartavye parasyāpavādasyāsiddhatvāṃ sāyat| tataśca dogdhā, dogdhṛmityatra `dāderghātorghaḥ` [[8.2.32]] iti dhasyāsiddhatvāṅaḍhatvaṃ syāt? ityata āha -`apavādasarya tu` ityādi| yadyapyapavādaviṣayasyāpi parasyotsarge kartvye'siddhatva syāt, nirviṣayatvāccāpavādavacanasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt| ato'pavādasya parasyāpi vacanaprāmāṇyādasiddhatvaṃ na bhavati| nanu ca vacanaprāmāṇyāt? paryāyeṇa tayorbhāvaḥ syāt, tatkuto vaiyathrya prasaṅga? naitadasti; yadyapavādasya paryāyatā syāt, `vā druhamuha` [[8.2.33]] iti vikalpena dhatvavidhānanamanarthakaṃ syāt||kṛtotyetadanantaroktena tuggrahaṇenaiva sambadhyate, na tu sarveḥ subādibhiḥ; anyathā yathā vidhiśabdasya pratyekaṃ vidhisambandho darśitaḥ, tathā'syāpi sambandhaṃ darśayet| ihāyaṃ vidhiśabdaḥ subādibhiḥsambadhyamāno bhāvasādhano vā sambadhyeta? karmasādhano vā? tatrādye pakṣa āśrīyamāṇe -rājabhiḥ, takṣabhirityatraisbhāve kartavye nalopasyāsiddhatvaṃ na prāpnoti, bhāvasādhane hi yatrāsato vidhānaṃ tatrāsiddhatvena bhavitavyam, na tu sataḥ| na cātrāsataḥ supo vidhānam; kiṃ tarhi? sata eva, yatastasya sthāna aisbhāvasya rājabhyāṃ rājabhya ityatrāpi `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghatve `bahuvacane jhalyet` [[7.3.103]] ityettve ca kartavye naivāsiddhatvaṃ prāpnoti; yasmādiha supi parato dīrghatvasyaittvasya ca vidhānam, tvasataḥ supaḥ| itarasmastu pakṣe svarasaṃjñātukāmasatāmeva vidhānena lopasyāsiddhatvamiṣyate, etacca na sidhyati; karmasādhane hi vidhiśabde taiḥ sambādhyamāne satāmeva teṣāmanyasmin? kārye vidhīyamāne satyasiddhatvena bhavitavyam, na tu teṣāmasatāṃ vidhānena [`vidhānena tu` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] śakyate vaktum -supā karmasādhanaḥ sambadhyate, svarādibhiśca bhāvasādhana iti| eko hraya#ṃ vidhiśabdaḥ sūtropāttaḥ, sa ca bhāvasādhano vā syāt, karmasādhano veti; na tūbhayasādhanaḥ, na hrekasyobhayasādhanatvamupapadyata iti? -etaccodyamapākartamāha -`vidhiśabdo'yam` ityādi| yadyeva vidhiśabdaḥ supsvarādibhiḥ samudāyena sambadhyate, tadā syādayaṃ doṣaḥ| na ca samudāyena sambadhyate, kiṃ tarhi? subādibhiḥ pratyekam| pratyekañcāsmin? sambadhyamāne yāvadbhiḥ sahāyaṃ sambadhyate tāvantyeva svarādididhau malopo'siddho bhavatītyevamādīni vākyāni bhavanti| nalopaḥ supsvarasaṃjñātugvidhiṣvetadgrahaṇakavākyaṃ teṣāmeva| nibandhanam| teṣu ca bhinneṣu vākyeṣu vidhiśabdo'pi bhinna eva| tatra kaścidbhāvasādhanaḥ, kaścitkarmasādhanaḥ| tatra svarasaṃjñātukāmasatāmeva vidhāne kartavye nalopasyāsiddhatvamucyate, tena ca te vidhīyamānatvāt? karmabhāvamāpadyante| tato bhāvasādhanena vidhiśabdena karmaṇo'nabhihitatvādeṣu `karttṛkarmaṇo kṛti` [[2.3.65]] iti ṣaṣṭhaā bhavitavyam| tena taiḥ karmaṣaṣṭhīyuktairbhāvasādhano'bhisambadhyate, supā ca sambandhasāmānyavacanaṣaṣṭhantena| `karmasādhanaḥ` iti| supo vidhīyamānena kāryeṇa sambandhamātram| sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī tu yatra `śeṣe` [[2.3.50]] iti ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate tatra veditavyam| sambandhasāmānyasya vacanīti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, sā cāsau ṣaṣṭhī ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ sambandhasāmānyavacanaṣaṣṭhī ante yasya supaḥ sa tathoktaḥ| karmaṣaṣṭhīyuktena supā karmasādhanasya vidhiśabdasya sambandho nopapadyate; karmaṣaṣṭhanupapatteḥ| yadi hi sup? karma syāt? tatra karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt, na cāsau sup? karma; supo vidhīyamānatvāt| tattu tatsambandhikāryam| vidhīyamānatvāt? karma tadvidhiśabdenoktam| atastatrāpi tāvat? karmaṣaṣṭo na sambhavati, kiṃ punarakarmaṇi supi! [`sup` -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] `tena` ityādi| yasmāt? sambandhamātrābhidhāyinī yā ṣaṣṭhī tadantena supā karmasādhano vidhiśabdaḥ sambadhyate, tena hetunā supaḥ sthāne yo vidhirbhisa aisbhāvaḥ, supi parataḥ yo vidhirdīrghatvādiryasya subnimittaṃ sarvo'sau supsambandhī bhavatīti sarvatrāpyasiddhatvaṃ bhavati| nanu ca `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyoyā` [[1.1.49]] iti vacanāt? sambandhaviśeṣe ṣaṣṭhaā bhavitavyam, na tu sambandhasāmānye| tataśca supa eva sthāne yat? kāryaṃ tatraivāsiddhatvaṃ syāt, nānyatra? naitadasti; yatra hrādeśo vidhīyate -<> [[2.4.52]] ityevamādau tatrāsyāḥ paribhāṣāyā vyāpāraḥ, na tu yatra lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihitaṃ kāryaṃ kāryāntarārtha mupādīyate tatrāpi; anyathā `udīkārastasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati| nanu ceha supāmādeśo na vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? lakṣaṇāntaravihitasyāpi siddhatvam| tasmānnānna sthāneyogaparibhāṣāyā [[1.1.48]] vyāpāraḥ| `rājavatī` ityādi| rājaśabdādmatup, <> [[6.3.45]] iti ṅīpi kṛte anto'batyā` [[6.1.214]] ityantodāttatvaṃ prāpnoti| nalopasyāsiddhatavānnāyamavatīśabda iti na bhavati| tasminnasati `kaninyuvṛvitakṣirājidhanvidyupratidivaḥ` (da|u|6|51) iti rājaśabdasya kaninpratyayāntasya nitsvareṇādyudāttatvāt? rājavatīśabda ādyudātta eva bhavati| `pañcārbham, daśārmam` iti| <> [[2.1.50]] iti māsaḥ| atra nalope kṛte'varṇāntaṃ pūrvapada jātamiti `arbhe cāvarṇam` [[6.2.90]] ityādinā sūtreṇa tasyādyudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti, asiddhatvānna bhavati, samāsāntodāttatvameva [[6.1.217]] bhavati| `pañcadaṇḍi` [pañcadaṇḍī -kāśikā] iti| pañcānāṃ daṇāḍināṃ samāhāra iti `taddhitārtha` [[2.1.50]] ityādinā samāsaḥ, samāhāhe dviguḥ, `sa napuṃsakam` [[2.4.17]] iti napuṃsakatvam| nalope kṛta igantatā jāteti <> [[6.2.29]] iti pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvaraḥ prāpnoti, nalopasyāsiddhatvānna bhavakati, samāsāntodāttatvameva [[6.1.217]] bhavati|`tadetat` ityādi| iha keṣāñcidekayaiva saṃjñayā'nekasaṃjñākāryaṃ kriyate -`yāvanti saṃjñākāryāṇi tatraikaiva saṃjñā pravartate` iti| darśanam| anyeṣāṃ tu `yathā saṃjñayaikakāryaṃ kriyate tayaivānyam, ato yāvanti saṃjñākāryāṇi tāvasya eva saṃjñāḥ pravartante iti darśanam| tatra pūrvasmin? darśane nedaṃ prayojanam; yayaiva hi pākpravṛttyā saṃjñayā `ṣaṅbhyo luk` [[7.1.22]] iti jaśśasorlukkāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tayaiva hi ṭāppratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| tasmāditarasmin? darśane tat? prayojanaṃ bhavati| atrāpi kathametat? prayojanaṃ bhavati? ityāha -`yā hi` ityādi| hiśabdo yasmādarthe| itikaraṇastasmādarte| yasmājjaśśasorlugarthā yā ṣaṭsaṃjñā pravṛttā tayā strīpratyayapratiṣedho na bhavati, tasmāt? punaḥ sā pravartayitavyā| yasmāt? sā pravartayitavyā tasmādetat? prayojanamityarthaḥ| `vṛtrahābhyām, vṛtrahabhiḥ` iti| vṛtraṃ hatavāniti `brāhṛbhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvipa` [[3.2.87]] tadantāt? bhyāmbhisau, tatara nalope kṛte <> [[6.1.71]] syāt, asiddhatvānna bhavati| `atra kecit` ityādi| sannipātaḥ=ānantaryam, tallakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya na tathoktaḥ| supaḥ sannipātena nalopaḥ| sa yadi tukaṃ pravartayet? tat? sannipātaṃ vihanyāt| animittañca `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya` (vyā|pā|12) iti| tasmānnalopastukaṃ na pravartayatīti tuggrahaṇamanarthakam| nanu ca tukaḥ pūrvāntatvāt? tuk? prātapadikagrahaṇenaiva guhrate, tat? kutastasya sannipātasya vighātaḥ, na hi svāvayavenaiva svasya vyavadhānamupapadyate? naitadasti; hrasvo hrāgamī tukaḥ, na tadantaḥ samudāyaḥ, tatkutastasya prātipadikagrahaṇena grahaṇam? bahiraṅgalakṣaṇena vāsiddhatvāt? tukaṃ prati nalopasya, tugvidhigrahaṇamanarthakam| padasya bāhṛvibhaktipratyayamāśritya nalopo vidhīyata iti tasya bahiraṅgatvam, antarvartinaṃ padamāśritya varṇasya tugvidhīyata iti tasyāntaraṅgatvamiti -`asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) iti| yadyevam, yuktameveti pratipannā#ḥ, tatkimarthaṃ tuggrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha -`tat? kriyate` ityādi| anityatvajñāpane tu sannipātalakṣaṇaparibhāṣāyāḥ prayojanam -`dṛkṣāya` ityatra `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti dīrghatvasiddhiḥ| akārāntatāsannipāte hi ṅeryo [[7.1.13]] vidhīyata iti; tannimittatvāditi dīrghatvanimittabhāvopagamanadvāreṇa tadvighātaṃ na kuryāt| anityatvātt? karoti| anyaccātra prayojanamuttaratraiva vakṣyate| bahiraṅgalakṣaṇaparibhāṣayā supyanitvasya jñāpane -eṣā, dve itayatra ṭāpsiddhiḥ| atra hi tyādadyatvasya vibhaktyāśrayatvādbahiraṅgatvam, prātipadikāśrayatvāṭṭābantaraṅgaḥ| tatra ṭāpa kartavye tyadādyatvasyāsiddhatvaṃ syāt, tataṣṭāp? na siddhyet| anityatvāttu sidhyati| pratidībnetyatra `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghatvasiddhiḥ prayojanam| asati tasyānityatve `hali ca` iti dīrghatve kartavye bahiraṅgasyāllopasyāsiddhatvād? hali parato vakārānto dhāturnaṃ bhavatīti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt| anityatvāttu siddhyati| `rājīyati` iti| <> [[3.1.8]] iti kyac, <> [[7.4.33]] itīttvam| `rājāyate` iti| `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca` [[3.1.11]] iti kyaṅ `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ` [[7.4.25]] iti dīrghaḥ| `rājaśyaḥ` iti| <> [[6.1.101]] ||`mu` ityavibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ| `amunā` iti| adasastyadādyatvam, `adaso'derdādu do maḥ` [[8.2.80]] ityutvamatve, <> [[7.3.119]] ityataḥ `gheḥ` ityanuvartamāna <<āṅo nā'striyām>> [[7.3.120]] iti nābhāvaḥ| yadi mubhāvo nābhāve kartavye nāsiddho bhavati -ityeva sūtrārthaḥ syāt, evaṃ sati nābhāve kṛte yat? kāryaṃ prāpnoti tatra tasyāsiddhatvaṃ na syāt, tataścāmunetyatrākārāntasyāṅgasya `supi ca` [[7.3.102]] iti vidhīyamānaṃ dīrghatvaṃ prasajyeta? ityata āha -`kṛte tu nābhāve` ityādi| hrasvasannipātena hi nābhāvo hrasvasya vighātaṃ prati nimittaṃ na bhavatīti satyapyasiddhatve na bhavati dīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ| `atha vā` ityādi| yathaikena hi ka ito dhāvatīti pṛṣṭo'pareṇāpi kiṃvarṇo dhāvatīti praśne kaścinnipuṇamatistantreṇa vākyadvayamuttarayati -oto dhāvatīti, tathehāpi yogadvayametat? tantreṇoccaritam| tatra dvitīyasya yogasya na parato yat? prāpnoti tasmin? kartavyaṃ bhubhāvo nāsiddha ityeva sūtrārthaḥ| tena dīrghatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati|ekasminneva yoge dīrghatvaprāptimapākarttumāha -`atha vā` ityādi| nanu cāsmin? sūtrārthe ne kartvye mubhāvasya yat? siddhatvaṃ tat? sūtreṇa saṃgṛhītaṃ syāt, tataśca nābhāva eva tāvanna prāpnoti, kutaḥ punastasmin? parato yat? prāpnoti tasmin? kartavye mubhāvasyāsiddhatvam? ityāha -`ne tu kartavye` ityādi| yathā putrā me bahukṣīraghṛtamodanaṃ suvarṇāpātryāṃ bhuñjoranniti varaṃ prārthayamānayā vṛddhakumāryā arthataḥ patiḥ putrā gāvo dhanaṃ saṃgṛhītam, evamihāpi ne parato yat? kāryaṃ prāpnoti tasmin? kartavye mubhāvasya siddhatvaṃ brāuvatā ne kartavye mubhāvasyāsiddhatvaṃ nāśritam| `tena` ityaṣdi| yasmādeva eva vākyārthaḥ -ne kartavye mubhāvasya yat? siddhatvaṃ tadarthato gṛhītam, tena hetunā nābhāvaśca bhavati, dīrghatvañca na bhavatīti| `ekadeśa` iti| `prātipadikāntasaptamyekavacanayorudāttānudāttayoḥ` iti| vṛkṣaśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodātta iti tasyānto yo'kāraḥ sa udāttaḥ| saptamyekavacanam, `anudāttau suptitau` [[3.1.4]] ityanudāttam, tayoḥ <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] ityekādeśa āntaratamyāt? svarite prāpte `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ` asiddhatve hi sati tasya sa ekādeśaḥ svarita evāyādeśe kartavye syāditi tasya sthāne'yādeśa āntaryataḥ svarita eva prasajyeta| antaraṅgatvaṃ punarekādeśasyāntaraśritatvāt| ādguṇo hravāntaraṅgaḥ; ekapadāśritatvāt| ayādeśastu bahiraṅgaḥ; tadviparvayāt| `kumāryā idam` iti| kumāraśabdo vṛkṣaśabdavadantodāttaḥ| tasmāt?
