pūrvaṃ dvirvacane kṛte satyuttaratra kāle vikalpavidhitvādayamarthaḥ pravartamāno yathā pūrvatra vartate, tathā niyogātaḥ paratrāpi na pravartata [`pravarteta` -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ityaniyogo labhyate; niyamakāraṇābhāvāt| tataścāniṣṭo vikalpaḥ syāt -pūrvaparayorekatra pravṛtteḥ, aparatrāpyapravṛtteḥ| neṣeṭo'niṣṭo vikalpaḥ| tathā sati garo galaḥ, galo gara ityevamādyaniṣṭamāpadyate| tatra `na` ityetāvadaniṣṭaviṣaye sūtraṃ kartavyam| kimartham? aniṣṭaviṣaye pūrvatrāsiddhatvasya pratiṣedhārtham| yatra pūrvatrāsiddhatvasyāniṣṭaviṣayaḥ| tataḥ `bhu ne` ityetaddhyatra vacane'nuvartate| yadyedam, kimarthamidam, pūrvasūtreṇaiva siddhā pratiṣedhaḥ? sarvatra tat? sūtraṃ nāstīti jñāpanārtham| tena yatrāsiddhatvamiṣyate tatraidāsau pravartate| tadanyatra viparyayastu na bhavati; yogavibhāgādasmin? sūtre||`udāttayaṇaḥ, svaritayaṇaśca` iti| udāttasthāne yo yaṇa sa udāttayaṇa; svaritasthāne yo yaṇ? sa svaritayaṇityarthaḥ| `kumāryau, kumāryaḥ` iti| atra `anudāttau suptitau` [[3.1.4]] ityaujasāvanudāttau, tayorudāttayaṇoḥ parayoḥ svarito bhavati| `udāttanivṛttisvareṇa` iti| udāttalopanimittasvaraḥ pūrvamudāttasya lopo yasmāt, sa punarudāttanivṛttisvaraḥ <> [[6.1.161]] ityatra yo vihisaḥ sa [nāsti -kāṃu| pāṭhe] veditavyaḥ| `kṛtsvareṇāntodāttau` iti| `lvyā pvyā` iti| lūpūbhyāṃ dhātusvareṇāntodāttābhyāṃ kvip, <> [[2.2.19]] iti samāsaḥ| <> [[6.2.139]] iti kṛdantasyottarapadasya prakṛtibhāvadidhānādetau kṛtsvareṇāntodāttau bhavataḥ| `udāttayaṇāadeśaśca` iti| ihanena sūtreṇānudāttayodāttayaṇaḥ parasya svarito vidhīyate, svaritayaṇaśca parasaya saptamyekavacanasya pūrveṇa prakāreṇa svarito vidhīyata iti darśayati| `tasya yo yaṇ` iti| tasyetyanena saptamyekavacanasya parāmarśaḥ| `āśāśabdākārasyānudāttasya` iti| `āśāyā adigāravyā cet` (phi|sū|1|18) ityāśāśabda ādyudāttaḥ, tena <> [[6.1.158]] ityākārasyānudāttatvam| `nanu ca` ityādi| saptamyekavacanasya `udāttayaṇaḥ` ityevamanena sutreṇa yat? svaritatvaṃ vihitaṃ tat? ṣāṣṭhikayaṇādeśe kartavye'siddham, tataśca naivāyaṃ svaritasya sthāne yaṇādeśa iti sakṛllvyāśā khalapvyaśetyatra svaritatvaṃ na bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `āśrayāt` ityādi| āhāyam -svaritayaṇa iti; na kvacit? siddhaḥ svaritaḥ| tatrāśrayāt? siddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, yathā `ato roraplutādaplute` ityatra rutvasya| `yadyevam` ityādi| etenāśrayāt? siddhatve samāśroyamāṇe'tiprasaṅgamudbhāvayati| `dadhyāśā` iti| dadhiśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasyānisantasya` (phi|sū|2|26) ityādyudāttaḥ, śeṣa syānudāttatvam, <> [[8.4.66]] iti dhakārātparasyekārasya svaritatvam| tasyāśrayāt? siddhatve tatsthānikādyaṇa uttarasyāśāśabdākārasya svaritatvaṃ syāt| `tasmāt` ityādi| yata evamāśrayāt? siddhatva āśrīyamāṇe'yamatiprasaṅgo bhavati; tasmādayameva yaṇsvaro yo'nena sūtreṇa [[8.2.4]] vidhīyate, tasya yaṇādeśe kartavye siddhatvaṃ vaktvyam| vaktavya mityasya vyākhyānamarthaḥ| tattu pūrvavadeva yogādibhāgamāśritya kartavyam| `kecittu` ityādi| yadyevamityādinā yo'tiprasaṅgadoṣa udbhāvitaḥ, taṃ keṣāñcinmatena pariharati| aniṣṭe'pi viṣaye pravṛttiratiprasaṅgaḥ| na ca <> [[8.4.66]] ityanenodāttāt? paro yaḥ svarito vidhīyate tasyāśrayāt? siddhatvamāniṣṭam; yasmādudāttāt? paro yaḥ svaritayaṇ? tatparasyānudāttasya svaritatvam, tataḥ sthānitvādyaṇaḥ parasyāśāśabdākārasya svaritatvaṃ taittirīyake śākhāntare paṭhate| tadanudāttatvaṃ punaragniśabdasayākārasya; tasya prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatvāt| `tathā brāāhṛṇe'pi iti| [iti-nasti -prāṃu|pāṭhe] tadekadeśaviśeṣo brāāhṛṇaśabdeneha vivakṣitaḥ| `dadhyāśayati` iti| aśnoterṇijantasya dhātusvareṇa citsvareṇa vāntodāttādakāro'nudāttaḥ| tasya svaritayaṇaḥ parasya brāāhṇe svaritatvaṃ paṭhate| `yathā tu` ityādi| etena tamevātiprasaṅghaṃ samarthayate| vārtikakāreṇoktam -`ākṣayāt? siddhamiti cedudāttāt? svarite doṣaḥ` iti| asyāyamarthaḥ -yadyāśrayāt? svāratasya siddhatvamudāttāt? paro yaḥ svaritastasya yo yaṇ? tataḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritatvamiṣṭaṃ syāt, tatra doṣaḥ| tenānena sūtreṇa svaritatvaṃ na bhavatīti sthitam| anena hi vārttikena -udāttāt? paro yaḥ svaritayaṇ? tasmātparasyānudāttasya svaratī bhavatītyeṣo'rtho na pratīyate| tasmādetacca na| yathā bhāvyaṃ tathodāttasyānena svaritayaṇaḥ parasyānudāttasya svarito na bhavatīti siddhaṃ bhavatīti| `tathā` ityādinānantaramevārthaṃ draḍhayati| bhāṣye hi `svaritagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate` ityādinā yanthena svaritagrahaṇāsiddhatve sūtre pratyācyāte| evañca tatpratyālyānamupapadyate, yadyudāttāt? svaritayaṇaḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritatvaṃ neṣyate; anyathā tannimittasya svaritasyeṣṭau satyāṃ pratyākhyānamupapannameva na syāt| kiṃ [`ki` nāsti -prāṃu|pāṭheḥ] punarbhāṣye svaritayaṇo grahaṇaṃ pratyākhyāyate, yāvatā tasmin? pratyākhyāte sakullvyāśethyevamādāvanudāttasya svarito na sidhyati? ityata āha -`sakṛllvyāśetyemādau` ityādi| udāttayaṇ? punaratrokāravakāreko yakāraḥ| nanu ca yo'sau saptamyekavacanasya sthāne jāyate tena vyavadhānānna sidhyati? ityata āha -`svaritayaṇ` ityādi| atraiva kāraṇamāha -`svaravidhau` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yadi svaritagrahaṇantareṇāpi sidhyati, kasmāt? sūtre tadgrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha -`tattu kriyate` ityādi| <> [[1.1.57]] ityasya hi -pūrvasmādvidhau kartavye'jādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavatītyeṣo'rtho'bhimataḥ| udāttayaṇaḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritavidhau kartavya saptamyekavacanasthāne yo yaṇādeśastasya sthānivadbhāvādikāreṇa vyavadhānamasti; vyañjanasya svaravidhāvavidyamānavadbhāvāt? (vyā|pa|37)| tena vyavadhānaṃ sati sakṛllvyāśetyatra `udāttayaṇaḥ` ityeva na sidhyatīti svaritagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| nanu ca `napadāntaradvirvacana` [[1.1.57]] ityādinā svaravidhau pratiṣidhyate sthānivadbhāvaḥ| tatkuto vyavadhānam? ityata āha -`svaradīrghayalopeṣu` ityādi| aco hi lopādeśasya svaravidhau [ayaṃ bhāgaḥ kāṃudrite nāsti] sthānivadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate| tathā hi tatroktam -`svaradīrghayalopeṣu[ayaṃ bhāgaḥ kāṃudrite nāsti] lopājādeśo [lopādeśo -kāṃudritapaṭhiḥ] na sthānivadbhavatīti vaktavyam` (1.1.59|vā|1) ti| na cātrāco lopādeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? yaṇādeśaḥ tasmānnāsti sthāvidbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ| `vaidyāśā` iti| vidasyāyatyamiti `anṛṣyānantarye [[4.1.104]] ityādinā vidāditvādañ, tadantāt? `śāṅgaravādyaño ṅīn` [[4.1.73]] iti ṅīn| atra nittvādādyudāttatve kṛte śeṣasyānudāttatvamiti baidyāśāśabde'cānudāttasthāne yaṇ, nodāttasya, nāpi svaritasya| `atra` iti| `ayamādyudātto litsvareṇa` iti| <> [[5.3.10]] iti tralpratyayāntatvāt| `hali loḥ` [[7.2.113]] itīdrūpasya lopaḥ||`anudattasya` iti| udāttena sahānudāttasya yasminnekādeśaḥ sa udāttaḥ syāt, na tu svaritaḥ| svarite prāpta idamārabhyate| udāharaṇeṣvagniprabhṛtayaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttāḥ (phi|sū|1|1) vibhaktistu `anudāttau suptitau` [[3.1.4]] ityanudāttā| `agnī, vāyū` iti| <> [[6.1.102]] iti dīrghaḥ| `vṛkṣī, plakṣau iti| <> [[6.1.88]] iti vṛddhiḥ| `pacanti, yajanti` iti| <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatvam| `dvayoranudāttayorayamekādeśaḥ` iti| nanu ca <> [[8.4.66]] iti śabakārasya svaritatve kṛte svaritānudāttayorayamekādeśaḥ, tatkathaṃ dvayoranudāttayoriti? evamāha -`pararūpe kartavye svaritasyāsiddhatvāt`||`sūtthitaḥ` iti| <> [[2.2.18]] iti samāsaḥ| `atra suśabdaḥ karmapravacanīyaḥ` iti| anena suśabdasya gatitvamapanayati| gatitve hi sati <> [[8.1.70]] iti nighātaḥ syāt, tataścodāttenānudāttasyāyamekādeśo na syāt| `prādisamāse` ityādi| suśabda ādyudāttaḥ| tatra hi prādisamāse kṛte `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha` [[6.2.2]] ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvādādyūdāttatvaṃ bhavati| atastena prakṛtisvaratvena hetunāyamādeśaḥ, yato'kaḥ savarṇadīrghatvamanudātte padādau bhavati| suśabdasya hrādyudāttasya prakṛtisvaratve sati śeṣasyānudāttabhāvopapatteḥ| nanu `prādisamāse [`prādiprasaṅge` iti vātikapāṭhaḥ] karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ` (vā|96) ityuktam, tatkathamiha prādisamāsaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tasya pratidhedhasyānityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu suśabdasya suṣāmādiṣu [[8.3.98]] prayogādvijñaiyam| tasya hi tatra `upasargātsunoti` (8.3.65 ityādinaiva siddhe'nupasargārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| anupasargatvaṃ ca soḥ <> [[1.4.94]] iti karmapravacanīyatvāt| atha vā svatibhyāmanye ye prādayastatrāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| tathā hi tatra `svatī pūjāyām` (kā|2.2.18) iti pūjāyāṃ svatiśabdayoḥ prātisamāsa uktaḥ pūjāyāṃ ca tayoḥ karmapravacanīyatvaṃ vivakṣitam| `dīkṣate` iti| viśabdo niparātasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| atrāpi `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ` [[8.1.28]] ti nighāte kṛta ekādeśa ityanudātte padādau bhavatīti sambandhanīyam| `vasuko'si` iti| vasuśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tataḥ supranyayāntatvāt? kasya hrasiśabde parataḥ <> [[6.1.113]] ityutvam, tasya sthānivadbhāvena suptvādanudāttatvamam, pūrveṇa saha <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] sa ca pūrvasūtre [[8.2.5]] ṇāntodāttaḥ| `asi` iti| `tāyastyorlopaḥ` [[7.4.50]] iti sakāralope kṛte laṭi sipi rūpam| atra `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ` [[8.1.28]] iti nighātenākāro'nudāttaḥ, tasayākāreṇa saha <> [[6.1.109]] iti parapūrvatvam| `svaritagrahaṇam` ityādi| kathaṃ punarasati svaritagrahaṇe svarita ādeśo bhavati, punaḥ svaritagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham; na punaḥ pakṣe svaritavidhānārtham? ityata āha -`udātte hi` ityādi| udātte hi vikalpite yasmin? pakṣe sa na bhavati tasminnudāttānudāttayorantaratamo yastenaiva bhavitavyam, sa ca svarita eva| ato'ntareṇāpi svaritagrahaṇaṃ svarita eva bhaviṣyati|`prātipadikasya` iti, `padasya` iti samānādhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| `ahannahim` iti| hanterlaṅ, tip, halṅyādilopaḥ` [[6.1.66]] adāditvācchapo luk| `adhātuḥ` [[1.2.45]] iti pratiṣedhādiha prātipadikatvaṃ nāsti| `rājā, rājānau, rājānaḥ` iti| asarvanāmasthāne padasaṃjñāpratiṣedhādiha [[1.4.17]] prātipadikasyāvayavo'nto nakāro bhavati| `prātipadikāntasya` iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe'trottarapadapradhānatvādasyaiva padasya tadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam, na tu guṇabhūtasya| prātipadikenāntaśabdena cātra nakāro viśeṣitaḥ, sa ca nakāraḥ prātipadikasyāntarbhūtaḥ| `padasya` iti| aniṣṭayorapi vyadhikaraṇayoḥ padaprātipadikāntaryorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena bhavitavyam -prātipadikāntasyeti, padasyeti| padasya yo'vayavaḥ so'pi prātipadikasyetyarthaḥ| evañca sati kriyamāṇe'pyantagrahaṇe rājānau, rājāna ityatra prāpnotyeva nalopaḥ, bhavati hyatrāpi padāvayavaḥ prātipadikasyānto nakāraḥ -ityetaccodyamapākartumāha -`prātipadikagrahaṇamasamastameva` iti| tataśca tasya `padasya` ityetat? samānādhikaraṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamevetyabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tahrrasamastameva prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaāśrayaṇaṃ prāpnotītyabhiprāyaḥ? ityata āha -`supāṃ sulak` iti| anena yat? ṣaṣṭhaāṃ luk? tena la#ukā nirdiṣṭaṃ prātiprārtipadikagrahaṇam, ato na bhavati ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prasaṅgaḥ| `ahaḥ` iti| `svamīrvapuṃsakāt` [[7.1.23]] iti sorluk, <<ro'supi>> [[8.2.69]] iti nakārasya rephaḥ| pratyayalakṣaṇenāhnaḥ [[1.1.61]] supparatā nāsti; `lumatā lupte pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti` [[1.1.62]] iti vacanāt| `ahobhyām, ahobhiḥ` iti| `ahan` [[8.2.68]] iti rutvam, `haśi ca` [[6.1.110]] ityutvam, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | nanu ca prāptipūrvakaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati; iha ca repharutvayoḥ kṛtayornalopasya prāptireva nāsti, nakārābhāvāt? tatka pratiṣedhena? ityata āha -`ahan` [[8.2.68]] `ro'supi` iti ādiśyete| tadrepho rutpañca dvayamapyetadanavakāśam, ato lope na bhavati; anyathā hi tayorvidhānamanarthakaṃ syādityata āha -`sāvakāśam` ityādi| sambuddhau hi lopa na; <> [[8.2.8]] iti pratiṣedhāt| atastatrobhayamapyetat? sāvakāśam| `he dīrghāho nidāgha` iti| dīrghāṇyahāni yasminnidāgha iti bahuvrīhiḥ, tatsambuddhiḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] | satyapi lope pratyayalakṣaṇena supparatāstī ti <<ro'supi>> [[8.2.69]] ityetanna pravartate, `ahan` [[8.2.68]] iti rutvameva bhavati| `ahan` iti| `prathamaikavacanāntam` ityādi| tatra `ahan` [[8.2.68]] iti rutvavidhau yadupādīyate tadāvartate -ityetāvati vaktavye `ahan` ityanena sūtreṇa kevalaṃ rutvamādeśo na vidhīyate, api tvāvṛttinyāyādahannityetacchabdarūpamanvākhyāyate -ityatropapattipradarśanārtham? `prathamaikavacanāntamakṛtanalopam` ityuktam| yadi hrādeśanātramahannityanena vidhīyate, tadādeśasambandhe ṣaṣṭhaā bhavitavyamiti ṣaṣṭhyupādīyeta, na prathamā| prathamayā hrupādīyamānaṃ kṛtanakāralopamupādīyeta, nakāralopalakṣaṇasya bhāvāt; na caiva kṛtam; tasmāt? prathamāntasyākṛtanakāralopasyopādānadavasīyate -ahanniti rūpasyānvākhyānaṃ kriyata iti| anvākhyāyate -sādhutvena pratipādyata ityarthaḥ| kimartham? nalopābhāvārtham| <> [[8.2.7]] ityanena lopo mā bhūdityevamartham||`carman` iti| `supāṃ sulṛk` [[7.1.39]] iti ṅerluk| nanu ca surājanniti prātipadikasaṃjñā hi vidyate, pratyayalakṣaṇena [[1.1.61]] `apratyayaḥ` [[1.2.45]] iti na pratiṣedhāt| `ādrre carman` iti| atra tu na kevala prātipadikasaṃjñā pūravoktādeva hetornāsti; pratyayalakṣaṇena pravṛttayā bhasaṃjñayā bādhitatvāt| ato nalopaprāptirmāstyevetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ? ityata āha -`etasmādeva` ityādi| `bhasaṃjñā ca na bhavati` iti| atrāpyetasmādeva pratiṣedhavacanāt? pratyayalakṣaṇena ca jñāpyata iti sambadhyate| `tathā ca` ityādinā jñāpanaprayojanaṃ darśayati tadevametasmāt? pratiṣedhādarthadvayaṃ jñāpyate| evañca kṛtvā -rājapuruṣa ityatra prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ nalopaśca bhavati| bhasaṃjñāyāmasatyāṃ <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] ityalopaśca na bhavati| na bhasaṃjñābhāvancetyasyeha `yathodderśa saṃjñāparibhāṣam` (vyā|pa|59) ityasmin? darśane prayojanaṃ veditavyam| `kāryakālaṃ hi saṃjñāparibhāṣam` (vyā|pa|58) ityasmin? darśane bhasaṃjñāyāmaṅgakāryaṃ bhavatīti <> [[1.1.63]] iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhādeva bhasaṃjñā na bhavatīti nārthastatra bhasaṃjñāyā abhāvajñāpanena| `ṅāvuttarapade` ityādināyaṃ ṅau parato nalopapratiṣedhasya pratiṣedha uktaḥ| tasyottarapade parato yo ṅistatra pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| `vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -`svarito dānudāttaṃ padādau` [[8.2.6]] ityataḥ `vā` ityanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena ṅāvuttarapade na bhaviṣyatauti| `carmaṇi tilā asya carmatilaḥ` iti| vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi gamakatvāt? samāsaḥ| nanu cātyalpamidamucyate -ṅāvuttarapade pratiṣedho vaktavya [ayaṃ bhāgaḥ kā| mudritapūstake nāsti] iti| sambuddhāvapi hruttarapade pratiṣadho [ayaṃ bhāgaḥ kā| mudritapūstake nāsti] vaktavya eva; anyathā hi he rājan? vṛndāraketi vigṛhra `vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ` [[2.1.62]] iti samāse kṛte herājan? vṛndāraketyatra nalopo na syāt? ityata āha -`he rājan? vṛndāraketyatra tu` ityādi| samānārthena vākyena samāsena bhavitavyam, evaṃ hi sāmarthyaṃ bhavati, nānyathā| tathā coktam -grahaṇavākyārthābhidhāne yaḥ śaktaḥ sa samartho veditavya iti| yaścehārtho he rājan? vṛndāraketi vākyena gamyate, sa na jñāyate -he rājavṛndāraketi samāsena| vākyena hrekārthībhāvābhāvāt? sambodhanaṃ gamyate, samāse tu viparyayāt? samudāyārthaḥ sambodhanam| tasmādrājā cāsau vṛndārakaścetyevameva vigṛhra samāsaḥ kartavyaḥ, tataḥ sambuddhiḥ, evañca sambuddhyantaṃ pūrvapadam| he rājan? vṛndāraketyatra samāso bhaviṣyatyeva; tataścottarapade parataḥ sambuddherabhāvānnalopapratiṣedhasya prāptireva nāstīti nārthastatapratiṣedhena| `vā napuṃsakānām` ityādi| napuṃsakaliṅgānāṃ vā nalopapratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamiti| atra vyākhyānaṃ tu -ihāpi vāgrahaṇānuvṛtiṃta vyavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ cāśritya kartavyam||makārāntānmakāropadhādavarṇāntādavarṇopadhāccottarasya matupo makārasaya `ca` ityayamādeśo bhavatītyayamartho'bhimataḥ| sa eva yathā sampadyate, tathā darśayitumāha -`matoriha` ityādi| atra matupa kāryitvenīpāttaḥ| sa ca nāstyantareṇa prātipadikatvam; tadvidhau prātipadikādhikārāt? [[4.1.1]] | tasmānmatupaḥ pūrvaṃ sāmarthyalabhyaṃ prātipadikam, tanmakārāvarṇābhyāṃ māditi viśiṣyate -makāro'nto yasyaṃ, avarṇo'nto yasyeti| makārāvarṇaviśiṣṭā yā copadheti sāmarthyam| katham? pūrvaṃ prātipadikāntaṃ viśiṣyate iti sambandhanīyam| makāreṇa viśeṣaṇena, avarṇena viśeṣaṇena ca viśiṣṭā yopadhā sā ca viśiṣyate -makāra upadhā yasya, avarṇa upadhā yasyeti| makārāvarṇaviśiṣṭasyeti matupo viśeṣaṇe `upadhāyāśca` ityatra mā bhūditi? asyāpekṣitasvallabhyata ityayamartho bhavatīti| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt? sāmarthyaprāptaṃ prātipadikameva viśiṣyate, tasmādayaṃ vakṣyamāṇo'rthaḥ sūtrasyāpi bhaviṣyatīti| `kiṃvān` iti| kimasyāstīti matup; `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] ityādinā num, halaṅyādisaṃyogāntalau (6.1.70; 8.2.23), <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ|`nārmatam` iti| naro'sya santīti nṛmān, nṛmata idamiti <> [[4.3.120]] ityaṇ, tatra vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ dārmatamityatrāvarṇopadhamatup? prātipadikaṃ jātamiti vatvaṃ prāpnīti, tat? kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`iha` ityādi| nārmatamityatra hravarṇopadhamatuptvaṃ vṛddhireva, sā ca bāhṛtaddhitanimittā| ato'varṇaupadhatvasya bahiraṅgatvam, vatvaṃ tu pravṛttinimittamiti tasyāntaraṅgatvam, asiddhaṃ ca bahiraṅgamantaraṅge (vyā|pa|42) iti, tena nārmata mityatra vatvaṃ na bhavati||`agnicitvān` iti| <> [[1.4.19]] iti bhasaṃjñā| tena padasaṃjñānibandhanaṃ <<jhalāṃ jaśo'nte>> [[8.2.39]] iti jaśtvaṃ na bhavati||`ahīvatī` iti| <> [[4.2.85]] iti cāturarthiko bhatup, <<śarādīnāṃ ca>> [[6.3.120]] dīrghaḥ||`udadhāvarthe` iti| yasminnudakaṃ dhīyate tasminnarthaṃ ityarthaḥ| tathā hrudake karmaṇyupapade <> [[3.3.93]] iti kipratyaye kṛte <> [[6.3.58]] ityudakasyodabhāve kṛta udadhiśabdo vyutpādyate| cakāreṇa <> [[8.2.11]] ityanukṛṣyata iti darśayati| `saṃjñāyāṃ ca` ityādi| `udadhāvarthe` ityādi| udadhigrahaṇañca saṃjñārtham| `udandān` iti| ḍadakaṃ dheyamāsminnastītyarthavivakṣāyāṃ matup| `sa eva mucyate` iti| na tu gaṅgādiḥ| yadi yasminnudakaṃ dhīyate [nāsti -kāṃu|pustake] sa eva mucyate -udakavān? ghaṭa ityabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, ghaṭe'pyudakaṃ dhīyata ityata āha -`udakavān? ghaṭaḥ` ityādi| iha vivakṣā śabdavyutpatteḥ pradhānaṃ kāraṇam, na vastunaḥ sattā| sa ca yena dadhātyarthenodadhirityucyate, so'smin? prayoge ghaṭe na vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? udakasattāyāḥ sambandhamātram| udakamasminnastītyevanmātraṃ vivakṣitam| ato dadhātyarthasyāvivakṣitatvādghaṭasyodadhitvaṃ vidyamānamapyasaṅkalpyameveti nāyaṃ nipātanasya viṣayaḥ| tena ghaṭa udakavānityucyate| yadā tu dadhātyartho vivakṣyate tadodanvānityevaṃ vaktavyam|| bāla-manoramāsaṃjñāyām 1874, 8.2.13 saṃjñāyām| `ahīvatī`tyādi nadīviśeṣasya, nagarīviśeṣasya vā saṃjñā| śarāditvāditi| `śarādīnāṃ ce`ti dīrgha ityarthaḥ| bāla-manoramāudanvānudadhau ca 1876, 8.2.13 udanvānudadhau ca| udadhau saṃjñāyāṃ ceti| vastutastu udanvāṃścetyeva sūtrayitumucitaṃ, saṃjñāyāmityanuvṛttyaiva samudre'pi udanvacchabdasya siddhatvāt|`rājanvāniti nipātyate` iti| kimanna nipātyate? nalopābhāvaḥ, nuṅvā| `saurājyam` iti| śaubhano rājā yasmin? deśe sa surājā, tadbhāvaḥ saurājyam, brāāhṛṇāditvāt? vyañ, <> [[6.4.144]] iti nalopaḥ| tatpunaḥ saurājyaṃ yatra śobhanena rājñā deśasya sambandhaḥ| `samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānam` (sī|pā|130) iti vacanādrājanvānityasya śabdasya deśa eva vācyaḥ, na saurājyam| sa tu deśa śabdāt? pratīyamānaḥ; saurājyenāvinābhāvitvāt| tacca gamayatītyāha -`gamyamāne` iti| `rājanvān` iti puṃlliṅgam| tasyātantratāṃ darśayitum -`rājanvatī pṛthivī` ityasyodāharaṇasyopanyāsaḥ||`harivo medinam` iti| <> [[8.2.3]] ityatraitadvyutpāditam| `ārevānetu mā viśat` iti| rayiśabdasya `rayermatau bahulam` (dā|665) iti samprasāraṇam, parapūrvatvam, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | atheha kasmānna bhavati -saptarṣimantaṃ dyāvāpṛthivīmantam? ityāha -dyauśca pṛthivī ceti dvandve kṛte <> [[6.3.30]] iti divo dyāvādeśaḥ| `gorvān, dhūrvān, āśīrvān` iti| `gṛ? śabde` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1498), `dhurvī hiṃsārthaḥ (dhātupāṭhaḥ-573), `āṅa śāsu ścchāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1022), eṣāṃ sampadāditvāt? kvip| gṛṇāteḥ `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttvam, dhurveḥ <> [[6.4.21]] iti vakāralopaḥ, <<śāsa idaṅhaloḥ>> [[6.4.34]] , ityatra śāsa ittve `āśāsaḥ kvāvupasaṃkhyānam` (vā|781) ityāṅpūrvasya śāsa ittvam, matupi kṛte `sasajuvo ruḥ` [[8.2.66]] iti rutvam||`akṣaṇyantaḥ` iti| <> [[7.1.75]] , ` chandasyāpi dṛśyate` [[7.1.76]] ityāṅ; nuṭ, anaṅī nakārasya lopaḥ numo ṇatvam| `asthanvantam` iti| asthiśabdasya ṇatvavarja pūrvavadanaṅādi kartavyam| `śīrṣaṇvatī` iti| <<śīrṣaṃśchandasi>> [[6.1.60]] nipātitam| nanu ca nuṭo'nantaratvāt? tasyaiva vatvena bhavituṃ yuktam, na tu tadvyavahitasya makārasya, tatkathamiha nuṭo vatvaṃ na bhavati, tatastu parasya na bhavati? ityāha -`nuṭo'siddhatvāt` ityādi| athāyaṃ nuṭ? paratvādapavāda eva kasmānna bhavati? bhinnajātīyatvāt| samānajātīyakāryapanno hi viśeṣaḥ sāmānyasya bādhako bhavati, iha kāryabhedo'sti; vatvasyādeśatvānnuṭasthvāgamatvāditi nāsti vādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, nuṭaḥ parādikaraṇaṃ ṇatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham; anyathā hi <> [[8.4.37]] iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt||`supathintaraḥ` iti| śobhanaḥ panthā iti prādisamāsaḥ -supanthāḥ, suśabdāt? `na pūjanāt` [[5.4.69]] iti pratiṣedhāt? `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ` [[5.4.74]] ityādinā samāsānto na bhavati, tarap| `dalyuhantamaḥ`| dasyuṃ hatavāniti kvip, tadantāt? tamap| `bhūridāvattaraḥ` iti| bhūri vadātīti `āto manin` [[3.2.74]] ityādinā vanip, tadantāduttarapadasya tuṭ| `rathītaraḥ` iti| rathinnityetasmānmatvarthīyenipratyayāntāt? tarap, nakārasya lopaḥ, īkāraḥ atha vā -nakārasyaivekāraḥ, savarṇadīrghatvam||iha ra iti varṇa upādīyate, la ityasyādeśastādṛśa eva; tataśca kevalo yo rephavaraṇo nāvayavabhūtastasyaiva tathābhūta eva lakārādeśaḥ syāt, ṛkārasya tu lakāro na syāt; tayoḥ sthānyādeśabhāvena sūtro'nupādānāt| tataśca kḷptaḥ, kḷptavānityādi na sidhyediti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha -`ra iti sāmānyamupādīyate` iti| varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtaṃ bhedamutsṛjya yat? sāmānya varṇātmikāyāmavarṇātmikāyāṃ ca rephavyaktau vartate yatastayorvarṇatvāvarṇatvādibhedabhinnayodrvayorapi ra ityabhidhānapratyayāvabhinnau bhavatastadupādīyate, na tu varṇātmakaḥ -evaṃ viśeṣaḥ| `tena` iti| sāmānyopādānena dvayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti| tasya sāmānyasya dvayorapi bhāvāt? `la ityapi sāmānyameva` iti| upadīyata ityapekṣate| atrāpi tena yaścakevalo lakāro yaśca ḷkārasthaḥ, tayodrvayorapi grahaṇamityetadvācyam? pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānārthatvānnoktam| `tato'yam` ityādi| yata evaṃ dvayorapi rephayolakārayośca grahaṇam, tasmāt? kevalasya rephasya kevalo lakāra ādeśo vidhīyate| āntaratamyādṛkārasyāpi ḷkāraḥ| nanu ca satyapi dvayorapi grahaṇe ṛkārasya sthāna ṛkāro vidhīyata ityetanna labhyeta, na hi ṛkārastho repha ṛkāro bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? tadavayavaḥ; tatra dvayorapi grahaṇe sati ṛkārasthasyāpi rephasya ḷkārastho lakārasta tsadṛśa evāntaratanyādbhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyate, na tu ṛkārasyāpi sthāne ḷkāro bhavatītyeṣo'rtho'pi? ityetasya codyasya nirākaraṇārthaṃ `ekadeśavikārahadvāreṇa` ityuktam| ekadeśa ṛkārasyāvayavo rephastasya vikāra ḷkārāvayavo lakāraḥ| atha vā -ekadeśa ḷkārasyāvayavo lakāraḥ, sa eva vikāraḥ| ṛkārasya rephasyaikadeśavikāraḥ| dvāram -mukham, upāya iti yāvat| tena ṛkārasya sthāna ḷkārādeśo vidhīyate| yadi ṛkāraḷkārasthayo rephalakārayorṛkāraḷkārābhyāṃ pṛthagbhāvaḥ sambhavati| tasmānnāntarīyakatvādekadeśavikāradvāreṇa samastasyaiva ṛkārasya samasta eva ḷkārādeśo vidhīyate| asyaivārthasya draḍhīkaraṇāyāha -`evaṃ ca` ityādi| yata evamekadeśavikādvāreṇa ṛkārasya sthāne ḷkāro vidhīyate, evañca `luṭi ca kḷpaḥ` ityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam| tadevaṃ codyaṃ pariharatā yaduktam -`nuṅvidhilādeśavināmeṣvṛkāraḥ [`ṛkāre` -kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] pratividhātavyaḥ` [vidhātavyam -kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] (vā|1) iti, tatrāvasare prāpte lādeśe prativihitam| `kalptā, kalptārau, kalptāraḥ` iti| tṛc, atha vā luṭ| `cikḷpsati` iti| san, <> [[1.2.10]] iti kitvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `kḷptaḥ, kḷptavān` iti| ktaktavat| `kṛpā` iti| etatkathaṃ sidhyati? yāvatā'trāpi latvena bhavitavyam? ityata āha -`kṛpetyetat` ityādi| etena `krapa kṛpāyāṃ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-771) ityasmāt? `ṣidbhidādibhyo||'ṅ` [[3.3.104]] ityaṅi tatsanniyogena ca samprasāraṇe kṛte kṛpetyetadbhavatīti darśayan? kṛpetyasya rūpasya lākṣaṇikatvaṃ darśayati| yadyevam, tataḥ kimatyatra latvaṃ na bhavati? ityāha -`tasya hi` ityādi| yatasatasya kṛtasamprasāraṇasya krapeḥ kṛpetyetadrūpaṃ bhavati, tasmāllākṣaṇikatvam| ato lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayaiva (vyā|pa|3) na gṛhrate iti bhavati laprasaṅgaḥ|kṛpaṇa, kṛpīṭa, karpūrādiṣu hraupadeśikameva kṛpetyesadrūpam, na lākṣaṇikam| tathā hi `rañje kvun` [`rajaḥ kyun` iti da|u|pāṭhaḥ `rajeḥ, rañjeḥ` iti pāṭhāntare] (da|u|5|24) iti yaḥ kvun? vihitaḥ, tasmin? bahulavacanāt? kṛpereva vihite kṛpaṇa iti bhavati; `kṛtṛkṛpibhyaḥ kīṭan` [`kṛtṛkṛpikampibhyaḥ kīṭan` iti da|u|pāṭhaḥ `kapikampibhyaḥ` iti pāṭhāntaram] (da|u|5|3) iti kṛpereta koṭani vihite kṛpīṭa iti bhavata; `kharjipiñjādibhya ūrolacau` (da|u|10|10) ityurapratyaye kṛte karpūra iti bhavatītyāha -`kṛpaṇakṛpīṭa` ityādi| evaṃ manyate -bahulavacanāt? krapereva kyun? [kvun? prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] bhavati, tatra cāsya samprasāraṇaṃ kṛtam, `kṛ-tṛkṛpibhyaḥ kīṭan` (da|u|5|3) ityatrāpi kṛpigrahaṇamapanīya kḷpigrahaṇaṃ kariṣyate, samprasāraṇaṃ tu bahulavacanādeva bhaviṣyati; `kharjipiñjādibhya ūrolacau` ityatrāpi ādigrahaṇe kṛpireva grahīṣyate, samprasāraṇaṃ ca pūrvavadeva bhaviṣyatīti| yadyapi kṛpaṇakṛpāṇetyevamādīni rūpāṇi syuḥ, tadāsya doṣa iti darśayitumāha -`jaṇādayo bahulamiti vā` ityādi|atyantabhinnarūpayorabhinnasvabhāvatvamasambhāvayan? pṛcchati -`kimidam` ityādi| `samānaviṣayatvam` iti| abhinnaviṣayatvamekaśabdenātra vivakṣitam, na tvabhinnasvabhāvatvamiti darśayati| kimarthaṃ punaḥ kṛpimuddiśya lādeśo vidhīyate, na kṛpirevoddiśyeta? gu sthāne latvamātraṃ kartavyam, taccāvaśyamukartavyamupalkārīyatītyevamartham| tathā ca -`ṛdupadhāccakḷpi cṛteḥ [[3.1.110]] ityatra kḷpipratiṣedho na kartavyo jāyate| tenaivaṃ śakyam -iha hracokḷpaditi ṛkāraḷkārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñādidhānādṛkārasya vidhīyamānamurattvaṃ ḷkārasyāpi syāt| tathā ca ḷkārasyāpa ṛvarṇaḥ prasajyate; ṛkārāntaṃ tūpadiśya latve vidhīyamāne tasyāpi ḷkārasya latvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati||iha dvau pakṣau sambhavataḥ -ayatigrahaṇaṃ rephaviśeṣaṇamityekaḥ pakṣaḥ, upasargasya viśeṣaṇamiti dvitīyaḥ| tatrādye pakṣe'yatau parata ityevāmādiko vṛttigrantha evaṃ neyaḥ -ayatau parato yo repha upasargasthastasya lakārādeśo bhavatīti| dvitīye hrevaṃ neyaḥ -ayatau parato ma upasargastasyopasargasya yo rephastasya lakārādeśo bhavatīti| `plāyate` palāyate` iti| `aya ṇya` ityasmādanudāttettvādātmanepadam| kathamatrādye pakṣe latvaṃ bhavati, yāvatā tasmin? kartavye <> [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadbhāvena bhavitavyam, tataśca prakṛtyupasargayornimāge satyavarṇena vyavadhānadrephasyāyatiparatā na sambhavati? ityāha -`atra yo'yam` ityādi| vibhāge viśleṣa ityarthaḥ| ekagrahaṇaṃ pratyaya ityatra saṅghāte vyavadhāne latvaṃ na bhavatīti pradarśanārtham| yena hi vyavadhānameva nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavadhāne vacanāprāmāṇyāllatvena bhavitavyam| kena vyavadhānamevam? ekena varṇena| saṅghātena punavryavadhānamasti nāsti ceti, tena vyavadhāne bhavati| `tathā ca` ityādi| evamādye pakṣa ekena varṇena vyavadhāne latvaṃ bhavati| na kevala palyayata ityatra pravartate yatra syānivadbhāvadvāreṇāśāstrīyaṃ vyavadhānam; yatrāpi tu śrūyamāṇenaiva varṇena laukikaṃ vyavadhānam, tatrāpi pravarttta ityeṣo'piśabdasyārthaḥ|nanu ca niraḥ kuṣaḥ` [[7.2.46]] ityatra nira iti nirdeśena jñāpitametat -niriti rephāntamupasargāntara mastīti, tataśca nilaya ityatra vacanasyāvakāśe sati kathaṃ `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt` (vyā|pā|46) ityuktam? evaṃ manyate -naikamudāharaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ prayojayati, yadi hretāvat? prayojanaṃ syāt, nira eva grahaṇaṃ kuryāditi| evaṃ prathame pakṣe sarvasya siddhatāṃ pratipādya dvitīye pakṣe pratipādayitumāha -`upasargaviśeṣaṇe tu` ityādi| tuśabdo'yamapiśabdasyārthe vartate| na kevalaṃ rephaviśeṣaṇe'yatigrahaṇe palyayata ityādi sarvaṃ siddham, api tūpasargaviśeṣaṇe'pi tasmin? sarvametat? siddham| atha vā -tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmātpakṣādasya viśeṣaṃ dyotayati| tatra hi vayavadhānāllatvaṃ prāpnotītyetaccodyamavatarati| ato yadetat? pratipādyametat? sarvam| iha tvasya codyasyāvatāra eva nāstīti siddhamevaitat, na yatnasādhyamityarthaḥ| praterapi prāpnotīti codakaḥ| tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmādviśeṣaṇārthaḥ, pūrvatra praterna prāpnoti; saṅghātena vyavadhānāt; iha tu nāsti kenacidvyavadhānam, ataḥ praterapi prāpnotīti manyante| `apare` iti| dvitīyapakṣābhiniviṣṭānāmamyatame| `nisdusityetayoḥ` iti| yadyayatigrahaṇaṃ rephasya viśeṣaṇam, athāpyupasargasya viśeṣaṇam, sarvathāḥ ratve kṛte latvaṃ prāpnoti? iti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha -`nisdus` ityādi| gatārtham||`girati` iti| nigaraṇārthasya rūpam| `nigaraṇam` iti| lyuṭ| `nigārakaḥ` iti| ṇvul| nigāryate` iti| atra hi ṇilope kṛte vikalpo na sidhyatyacaḥ parasyābhāvāt? ityetaccodyamapākarttumāha -`nigāryate` nigālyate` iti| sthānivadbhāvastu pūrvavat| syādetat| nāstyevātra sthānivadbhāvaḥ; `pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat` (jai|pa|vṛ|48) iti pratiṣedhāt? ityata āha -`pūrvatrāsiddhe` ityādi| apavādaḥ=doṣaḥ, saha tena vartata iti sāpavādam| doṣa evāyamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā ityarthaḥ| apiśabdaḥ samuccaye| na kevalaṃ taccodyaṃ sāpavādam, api tu `pūrvatrāsiddhaṃ na sthānivat` (jai|pa|vṛ 48) ityetadapi vacanaṃ sāpavādameva| tadeva sāpavādatvamāptavacanena pratipādayitumāha -`tasya` ityādi| tatra saṃyogādilopavidhāvayaṃ doṣaḥ -kākyarthaḥ, vāsyartha iti; atrāsati yaṇādeśasya sthānivadabhāve `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ` [[8.2.29]] iti kakārasakārayorlopaḥ prasajyeta| latvavidhau -nigāryate, nigālyata iti; ṇilopasya sati sthānivadbhāve vikalpena latvaṃ na syāt| ṇatvavidhau -prahiṇoti pramīṇīna iti; atra guṇettvayorasati sthānivadbhāve <> [[8.4.15]] iti ṇatvaṃ na prāpnoti| `antaraṅgatvādvā` ityādi| parihārantaram| antaraṅgatvaṃ tu latvavikalpasya varṇāśrayatvāt| ṇilopasya tu bahiraṅgatvam; ārdhadhātukāśrayatvāt| atha girau, giraḥ -ityatra latvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`girau, giraḥ` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| dhātoḥ svarupeṇa grahaṇe sati tatpratyaye dhātorityeva yaḥ pratyayo vihitastatra tatkāryaṃ vijñāyate| tasmādagiro, gira ityatra na bhavati| na hyatra śrāto [[3.1.91]] rityeva girateḥ kvibantādaujasau vihitau, kiṃ tarhi? prātipadikādhikārāt? [[4.1.1]] ||`saṃyogāntasya` iti| saṃyogo'nto yasya tattathoktam| antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| `padasya` [[8.1.16]] iti hi vartate, tatra saṃyogena pade viśiṣyamāṇe <> [[1.1.72]] ityeva saṃyogāntatā padasya labhyate| `gomān` iti| halṅyādilope kṛte'lo'ntyasya lopaḥ [[1.1.51]] , <> [[6.4.14]] iti dīrghaḥ| `kṣeyān, bhūyān` iti| atra saṃyogāntalope na prāpnoti; paratvādrutvena bādhyata iti yo manyeta, taṃ pratyāha -`śreyān, bhūyān` ityādi|yadi tarhi paramapi rutvamasiddhatvāt? saṃyogāntasaya bādhakaṃ na bhavati, evaṃ satyata eva hetorjaśtvasyāpi bādhakaṃ na syāt, tataśca yaśaḥ, paya iti jaśatvameva syāt, na rutvam? ityata āha -`jaśtve tu` ityādi| saṃyogāntalope hi prāpte cāprāpte ca rutvamārabhyate| śreyānityādau prāpte, paya ityatra tvaprāpta iti yuvataṃ yadrutva na bādhate| jaśtve tu sarvatra prāpta eva tadārabhyate| śreyānityādau prāpte, paya ityatra tvaprāpta iti yuktaṃ yadrūtva na bādhate| jaśtve tu sarvatra prāpta eva tadārabhyate| tasmādbādhakalakṣaṇayogādrutvaṃ jaśtavasya bādhakaṃ bhavatyeva| śreyāniti -<> [[5.3.60]] ) itīyasuni śrabhāvaḥ, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] , `sāntamahataḥ` [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ| bhūyāniti -<> [[6.4.158]] itīyasuni īkārasya lopaḥ, bahośca bhūbhāvaḥ| atha dadhyatra, madhvatretyatra saṃyogāntalopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`dadhyātra` ityādi| bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu yaṇādeśasya dvipadāśrayatvāt| saṃyogāntalopasya tvekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅgatvam| padasyeti kim? gomantau, gomantaḥ||`saṃyogāntasya padasya` ityādi| atra saṃyogāntaṃ padaṃ rephasya viśeṣaṇam, repho'pi sakārasya| saṃyogāntasya padasya yo'vayavo rephastasmāduttaro yaḥ sakārastasyālo'ntyasya lopo bhavati| `akṣāḥ, atsāḥ` iti| `kṣara sañcalane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-851), `tsara cchadmagatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-554), laṅ, <> [[7.2.2]] iti vṛddhiḥ, tipo halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] , sicaḥ sakārasyāpyanena, aḍāgamaḥ, rephasya visarjanīyaḥ [[8.3.15]] | nanu caitat? pūrveṇaiva siddham, tatkimarthamidamārabhyate? ityāha -`siddhe` ityādi| `rāt? sasyaiva` iti niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati| rādeva sasya -ityeṣa tu viparītaniyamo'tra nāśaṅkanīyaḥ, uraḥ prabhṛtiṣu [[5.4.151]] pumāniti kṛtasaṃyogāntalopasya [`kṛtasaṃyogāntasya lopasya` -iti prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] pumsśabdasya pāṭhāt| na hi viparītaniyame tasya saṃyogāntalopa upapadyate| `ūrk` iti| `ūrja balaprāṇanayoḥ` [urja -prāṃupāṭhaḥ] (dā|pā|1549), `bhrājabhrāsa` [[3.2.177]] ityādinā kvip| atra niyamājjakārasya lopo na bhavati, tasminnasati <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam -jakārasya gakāraḥ, `vāvasāne` [[8.4.55]] iti cartvam -kakāraḥ| `nyamārṭ`māṭai -kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `mṛjū śuddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1066), adāditvācchapo luk, tipo halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] <> [[7.2.114]] , `vraśca` [[8.2.36]] ityādinā ṣatvam, tasya jaśtvam -ḍakāraḥ, tasyāpi cartvam-ṭakāraḥ||`alavidhvam, alaviḍhvam` iti| luṅ, sic? [[3.1.44]] sasya `dhi ca` iti lopaḥ, <> [[8.3.79]] iti pakṣe bhū rdhanyaḥ| `yadyatra` ityādinā sati sakāralope yadiṣṭaṃ prāpnoti taddarśayati| asati hi sakāralope sicaḥ <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatve kṛte <> [[8.4.53]] iti jaśtve ca ḍakāre <<ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ>> [[8.4.41]] iti dhakārasya ṣṭutve ḍhakāreṇa bhavitavyam, tataśca mūdhanyābhāvapakṣe'pi dhakāro na śrūyate| vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tu siddhaṃ liḍarthaṃ liṅarthaṃ ca syāt| tasmādamūrdhanyapakṣe dhakārasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syāditi lopo vidhīyate| `itaḥ prabhṛti sicaḥ sakārasya lopa iṣyate` iti| sa ca <> [[8.2.21]] ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇāanuvṛttevryavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| `cakāddhi` iti| `cakāsṛ dīpsau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1074), loṭ, sip, `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] iti hirādeśaḥ, <> [[6.4.101]] iti herdhibhāvaḥ, pūrvavacchapo luk, pūrvavajjaśtvam -sakārasya dakāraḥ| `payo dhāvati` iti| payaḥ śabdasya rutvam, `haśi ca` [[6.1.110]] ityuttvam, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | yadītaḥ prabhṛti sico lopa iṣyate, sagdhiḥ, babdhāyityatra <> [[8.2.26]] iti sakārasya lopo na prāpnotauti codyamāśaṅkyāha-sagdhirbabdhām` ityādi| `ada bhakṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1011), striyāṃ ktin? [[3.3.94]] <> [[7.4.78]] iti ghaslādeśaḥ, <> [[6.4.100]] ityupadhālopaḥ, sakārasya `bahulaṃ chandasi` iti cchāndaso lopaḥ| kvacidanyadevocyate eṣo'pi bahulasyārthaḥ| iṣyate <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti takārasya dhatvam, pūrvavajjaśtvam -ghakārasya gakāraḥ| samānā gdhiriti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, `samānasya cchandasi` [[6.3.83]] iti sabhāvaḥ| babdhāmiti -`bhasa bhatrsanaddīptyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1100), loṭ? tasya `loṭo laṅvat` [[3.4.85]] ityatideśāt? tasastām, juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau` [[6.1.10]] iti dvirvacanam, pūrvavadupadhāsalopau, pūrvavadeva takārasya datvañca, bhakārasya dakāraḥ <> [[8.4.54]] iti jaśtvam| evamidaṃ tāvat? ślokavārttikakārasyābhimataṃ darśitam| idānīṃ bhāṣyakārasya mataṃ darśayitumāha -`bhāṣyakārastvāha ityādi| etenāviśeṣeṇaiva sakāramātrasya bhāṣyakāśe lopamicchatīti darśayati| `tena` ityādi| aviśeṣeṇa hi sakāramātrasya yo lopamicchati tasya payo dhāvatītyatrāpi prāpnoti| tasmādiha mā bhūditi yatnāntaramāstheyam| yatnāntaraṃ tu vyavasthitavibhāṣāśrayaṇameva pūrvadhat| ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ -pūrvatra vyavasthitavibhāṣayā dhi caiva sico bhaviṣyati, nānyasya; iha tu yatra samānapadasthau nimittanimittinau tatraivāviśeṣeṇa sakāramātrasya lopo bhavati| atra tu bhinnapadasthau payodhāvatautyādau, tatra na bhavanyeveti| etāvatā viśeṣeṇa vyavasthitabhāṣā yatnāntaramityucyate|saṃkṣiptametamarthaṃ vistareṇa sacodyapariharaṃ vaktumāha -`dhi sakāre sico lopaḥ` ityādi| dhītyetadyatra parabhūte sakāralopa ityataḥ prabhṛti vidhātavyaḥ, tadupalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam| kuta etat? ita prabhṛti sicaḥ sakārasyalopa iṣyata iti prāgvacanāt| lopaṃ prati sakārasyādhikaraṇatvena vivakṣatatvāt? saptamyā nirdeśaḥ| kiṃ prayojanam? ityāha -`cakāddhi` ityādi| yadi sico lopaḥ, āśādhvaṃ tu katham? āṅaḥ śāsu icchāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1022), loṭ, dhvam, ṭeretvam, <> [[3.4.91]] ityamādeśaḥ, pūrvavacchapo luk| atra sakārasya lopa iṣyate, sa na prāpnoti; yadi sica eva sakārasya lopo vidhīyate? `jaśtvaṃ sakārasya bhaviṣyati` iti| <> [[8.4.53]] ityanena jaśtvam -sakārasya dakāro bhaviṣyatīti siddham -āśābdamityetat| itaḥ sakāralopaśāstraṃ pratyākhyātumāha -`sarvamevaṃ prasiddhaṃ syāt` iti| yadi sakārasya bhavati, evaṃ sati tenaida jaśtvena sarvaṃ lakṣyaṃ prasiddhaṃ syāt| tataśca sakāralopaśāstrametanna kartavyamevetyabhiprāyaḥ| tatraitatsyāt -jaśtve sati śrutibhedo bhavati, tathā hi `anaci ca` [[8.4.46]] iti sakarasya dvirvacane kṛte sakārayośca jaśtve dakāradvayasya śravaṇaṃ prasajatītyāha -`śrutiścāpi na bhidyate` iti| na hi vyañjanaparasyaikasyānekasya vā halaḥ śrutiṃ prati viśeṣo'stīti bhāvaḥ| `luṅaścāpi na mūrdhanye grahaṇam` iti| kartavyaṃ bhavatīti śeṣaḥ| ayaṃ cānyo jaśtve sati guṇaḥ| `iṇaḥ ṣīdhvaṃluṅliṭāṃ dho'ṅgāt` [[8.3.78]] ityatra mūrdhanye kartavye luṅa upādānaṃ kartavyaṃ na bhavatīti; accoḍhvam, aploḍhvamityādau ṣatvajaśtvaṣṭutvaireva mūrdhanyasya siddhatvāt| `cyuṅ? chyuṅ? [ayaṃ dhāturdhātupāṭhe nopalabhyate] jyuṅ? [na staḥ -prāṃu|pustake] pruṅpluṅa gatau` [na staḥ -prāṃu|pustake] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-955,956,957,958), luṅ? dhvam, sic, <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam, <> [[8.4.53]] ityanena ṣakārasya jaśatvam -ikāraḥ, dhakārasya ṣṭutvam -ḍhakāraḥ| evaṃ ṣatvādikāryakrameṇa luṅi ghakārasya mūrdhanyaḥ sidadha iti, kiṃ luṅgrahaṇena? evaṃ luṅ? pratyākhyāyate| salope pare luṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti yasyābhimatam; sa āha -`seṭi duṣyati` iti| yadi mūrdhanyavidau laraṅgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tataḥ `vibhākeṭaḥ` [[8.3.79]] ityatra mūrdhanyo na prāpnoti, tataśca pūrvavat? ṣatvādiṣu kṛteṣvalavidhvamittheva nityaṃ syā, na tu kadācidapayalaviḍhvamiti| tasmāduttarārthaṃ luṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `dhi ca` [[8.2.25]] iti sakāralopovaktavyaḥ -alaviḍhvamityasya siddhyartham| na hretadasati sakāralope sidhyati, tataśca yaduktam -`sarvamevaṃ prasiddhaṃ syāt` iti, tadayuktam| `śri ca` [[8.2.25]] ityetasmiśca kriyamāṇe cakāddhoti mā bhūditi sicgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, evaṃ ślokabārttikakāramatena sijgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti sthitam|itarastasmin? kriyamāṇe'paraṃ doṣaṃ darśayitumāha -`ghasibhasonaṃ `sidhyeta`[sidhyet? tvikṣyādi -kāṃudritaḥpāṭhaḥ] ityādi| tuśabdo hetau| yasmāt? sijgrahaṇasya hi dhasibhasoḥ sakāralopaḥ sagdhirbabdhāmityatra na sidhyatītyeṣa heturuktaḥ sa cāyamahetuḥ; yasmādyadyapi sijgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe dhasibhasoḥ <> [[8.2.26]] ityanena lopo na bhaviṣyati, tathāpi cchābdaso varṇalopo bhaviṣyati; tenāpi sagdhiḥ, babdhāmityetadubhayaṃ sidhyatyeva| kva yathā cchāndaso varṇalopaḥ? ityāha`yathā` ityādi| yathādhvaraviṣaye prayoge iṣkattarimadhvarasyetyatra cchāndaso varṇalopo bhavati, tathā sāgdhiḥ, babdhāmityatrāpi ghasibhayorbhaviṣyati| vāśabdo'traivopapattyantaraṃ sūcayati| tatredamupapattyantaram -sagdhiriti naitadghase rūpam, kiṃ tarhi? `ṣagha hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1268) ityasya| nanu cārthabhedo bhavati, svarabhedaśca; pūrvasyāṃ vyutpattau samānāvanamityeṣo'rtho bhavati, tasāsasvareṇāntodāttatvañca; ṣadhistu ktini vihite hiṃsārtho bhavati, nitsvareṇādyudāttaśca? anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ ṣaghiśca samānāvanamityasminnarthe varttidhyate, svaravyatyayena cāntodāttatvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| bandhāma#iti ca naitadbhase rūpam, kiṃ tarhi? `badha bandhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-973) ityasmālloṭi tasmām, <> [[3.1.85]] iti dhatve takārasya <> [[3.1.85]] iti dhātudhakārasya bakāre ca kṛte babdhāmiti bhavati| evaṃ ca sijgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe ghasibhasoryadi na sidhyati nāma, tathāpi naiva kiñcidaniṣṭam; yasmādanayāpi vyutpattyā tadapākṛtaṃ bhavati| taduktam -`ghasibhasorna sidhyettu [`sidhyeta` -kāśikā] tasmāt? sijgrahaṇaṃ na tat` (kā| 8.2.25)| tataśca `ghi sakāre sico lopaścakāddhīti prayojanam` (kā| 8.2.25) ityetadavasthitaṃ ślokavārttikakārasya matam||`abhitta, abhitthāḥ` iti| bhiderluṅi svaritettvādātmanepadam; tathāso, dakārasya `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cattrvam -takāraḥ| `avāttām` iti| daserluṅi tasastām| `adātta` iti| thasya taḥ, `vadavraja` [[7.2.3]] ityādinā vṛddhiḥ| atra sakāralope kṛte `saḥ syārdhadhātuke` [[7.4.49]] iti takāro na prāpnotīti yasya bhrāntiḥ syāt, taṃ pratyāha -`avāttām` ityadi| `amaṃsta, amaṃsthāḥ` iti| `mana jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1176), anudāttettvādātmanepadam| `abhitsātām` iti| bhiderātām| `abhitsata` iti| <<ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ>> [[7.1.5]] iti jhasyādādeśaḥ||`alāviṣṭām` iti| tasastām, sici vṛddhiḥ| atra śrutikṛte paurvāpaye sati hrasvādiṅaḥ paraḥ sakāro bhavati, na tvaṅgāt; iḍāgamaḥ pratyayabhaktatvenānaṅgatvāta| `alāviṣuḥ` iti| `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca` [[3.4.109]] iti jherjus| `akṛṣātām` iti| `uśca` [[1.2.12]] iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `dviṣṭacām` iti| `dvitricatubhryaḥ suc` [[5.4.18]] tadantādatiśāyane tarap; `kimettiṅ` [[5.4.11]] ityādināmuḥ, <> [[8.3.101]] iti sakārasya mūrdhanyaḥ||`adevīt` iti| `neṭi` [[7.2.4]] iti vṛddhipratiṣedhe kṛte laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, <<astisico'pṛkte>> [[7.3.96]] itīṭ||jhaloti vartate| `saṃyogādyoḥ` iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atra yadyapi saṃyoga uttarapadārtho guṇabhūtaḥ, tathāpi saṃyogādyoḥ skorantagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na bhavatīti guṇabhūto'pi tena saṃyoga eva viśiṣyata iti vijñāyate, ityāha -`padasyānte yaḥ saṃyogaḥ` iti| `ante` iti| avasāna ityarthaḥ| `jhali parataḥ` iti| padasyetyapekṣate| `tadādyoḥ` iti| tasyaivambhūtasya saṃyogasyādibhūtayorityarthaḥ| `lagnaḥ` iti| `olajo olasjīvrīḍe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1290, 1291), niṣṭhā| atra jakāre jhali parataḥ sakārajakārayoryaḥ saṃyogaḥ padasyādayavastadādeḥ sakārasya lopaḥ, <> [[8.2.45]] iti natvam, `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām` [[7.2.14]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, <> [[8.2.30]] iti kutvam -gakāraḥ| `sādhulak` iti| sādhu lajjāta iti kvip| atra padasyādasāne saṃyogaḥ| [[7.1.60]] iti num, sa ca bhavat? `masjerantyāt? pūrvo numanuṣaṅgasaṃyogādilopārtham` (vā| 7) iti vacanādantyājjakārāt? pūrvo bhavati, tasya ca `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `taṣṭaḥ` iti| `takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-655,656) ūdittvāt, svaratyādisūtreṇa [[7.2.44]] vibhāṣiteṭ; tena niṣṭhāyāṃ <> [[7.2.15]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `kāṣṭhaśavasthātā` iti| kāṣṭhaṃ śaknotīti kvip; kāṣṭhaśaki sthāteti `saptamī` [[2.1.39]] iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ|`tadatra` ityādinā `jhali saṅīti vaktavyam` (vā 917) iti yaduktam, tat? pratyācaṣṭe| taditi vākyopanyāsārthaḥ| `śakeḥ kvibantasya prayoga eva nāsti` iti| śakeḥ <<anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate>> [[3.3.130]] iti kvip? syāt, iha ca `dṛśyate` ityasya grahaṇa evāyamarthaḥ -yatra laukike prayoge kvibantasya prayogo dṛśyate tatra yathā syāditi, na ca loke kāṣṭhaśagityevaṃvidhaḥ śakeḥ kvibantasya prayogo dṛśyate| tataḥ śakeḥ kvibantasya prayoga eva nāsti, ato hetoḥ `jhali saṅīti vaktavyam` (vā|917) ityetat? pratyākhyātumāha bhāvyakāraḥ -`kāṣṭhāśageva nāsti; kuto'yaṃ kāṣṭhaśaki tiṣṭhet` iti| ādhāraparatanva udghanādāvasya vṛttiḥ, ato yatra kāṣṭhaśagādhāra eva nāsti, tatra tadādheyaḥ sthātā sutarāmeva nāsti tasmānna jhali saṅīti vaktavyam; vyāvarttyābhāvāt| iha kasmānna bhavati -vāksthāteti? saṃyogādilope kutvamyāsiddhatvāt| atheha kasmānna bhavati -vāsyārtham? kākyartham? ityāha -`dāsyartham, kākyartham` ityādi| atha skoriti kimartham? narnartītyatra mā bhūt| nṛteryaṅlugantasya <> [[7.4.91]] ityabhyāsasya ruki kṛte rūpametat| `saṃyogādyoriti kim? `payaḥśak` iti| kvibantametat| sopapadasya hi śakeḥ kvibantasya prayoga eva nāsti| kevalasya tu syādeva| ante ceti kim? takṣitā, takṣakaḥ||`jhali padānte ca` iti| `parataḥ` iti pratyekamabhisambadhyate| nanu ca pūrvasūtre cakāreṇa jhalanukṛṣṭa iti tasyehānuvṛttirayuktā? naitadasti; na hi tatra cakāreṇa jhalanukṛṣṭaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? svaritatvādevānuvartamānasyāntagrahaṇaṃ na bādhakamityatādaccakāreṇa vyākhyātam| `vāk` iti| vaceḥ `kvibvaci` (vā|288) ityādinā jvip, dīrghaśca| `kruñca` iti| iha kecit? `kuñca kauṭisyālpībhādayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-186) iti sarephaṃ akāropadhaṃ dhātuṃ paṭhanti, `kuñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-185) ityarekaṃ nakāropadhaṃ pare| tatra pūrvapāṭhaṃ gṛhītvā yaścodayet -atha kruñcetyatra kasmān bhavatīti? taṃ pratyāha -`ṝñca` ityādi| anena `jhali saṅīti na vaktavyam` iti yat? pūrvaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ tasyehārthatāṃ darśayati| `yujikruñcāñca` [[3.2.59]] iti nipātanādveti| `kruñcetyatra ñakārasya cakāre kutvaṃ na bhavatīti sambandhaḥ| `ñakāropadhasya [ñakāripadasya -kāṃudritapāṭhaḥ] sarephasya pāṭhamabhyupetya prāptau tasyāmevaṃ parihāradvayamuktam| ipānīṃ kutvasya prāptireva nāsti; yasmānnāyaṃ ñakaropadhaḥ paṭhate, kiṃ tarhi? nakāropadha iti darśayitumāha -`nakāropadho vā` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ nakāropadhaḥ paṭhate? kiṃ tarhi? nakāropadha iti darśayitumāha -`nakāropadho vā` ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ nakāropadhaḥ paṭhate? ityāha -`nakāralope hi`[`sakāralope hi` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| nikucita ityeṣa prayogo'styeva| dhātorniṣṭhāntasya <<śnānnalopaḥ>> [[6.4.23]] ityanuvartamāne-`aniditām` [[6.4.24]] iti nalopādiha nakāralopasya darśanānnakāropadho'yaṃ paṭhate; anyathā hreṣa prayogo nopapadyate| na hi ñakāralopasya kiñcillakṣaṇamasti| yadi tarhi kuñceti repharahito nakāropadhaḥ paṭhate, evaṃ sati kruṅa, kruñcau, kruñcaḥ -iti na sidhyati; ṛtvigityādinā [[3.2.59]] sūtreṇa hi kvini kṛte `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] iti nalope kuka, kucau, kucaḥ -ityevaṃ prāpnotītyata āha -`yujikruñcām` ityādi| syādetat -yadyapi nakāralopābhāvo nipātyate, tathāpi nakārasyānusvāre tasya yayi parasavarṇe [[8.4.58]] ñakāre syādeva kutvam? ityata āha -`tatra` ityādi| gatārtham||`soḍhā` iti| `ho ḍhaḥ` iti ḍhatve kṛte <<jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ>> [[8.2.40]] iti tṛcatakārasya dhatvam, ṣṭutvam, <<ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ>> [[8.3.13]] <> [[6.3.112]] ityottvam| `jalāṣāṭ` iti| jalaṃ sahata iti <> [[3.2.62]] , <> [[3.2.63]] iti ṇviḥ, upadhāvṛddhiḥ upapadasamāsaḥ, <> [[6.3.137]] iti pūrvapadasya dīrgha, ḍhakārasya jaśtvam -ḍakāraḥ, tasya cattrvam -ṭakāraḥ, <> [[8.3.56]] iti mūrghanyaḥ| `praṣṭhavāṭ` iti| `vahaśca` [[3.2.64]] iti ṇviḥ| `cuhoḥ kuḍhau` ityekayoga eva kartavye pṛthagyogakaraṇaṃ samasaṃkhyātvapratiṣedhārtham| ekayoge tu samasaṃkhyatvājjhalādau kutva padānte ḍhatvaṃ syāt||`dagdhā, dagdhum` iti| pūrvavaddhatvam, ghakārasya jhaśi jhaśatvam -gakāraḥ| `kāṣṭhadhak` iti| kvibantametat| `ekāco baśo bhaṣa` [[8.2.37]] ityādinā dakārasya bhaṣ -dhakāraḥ, ghakārasya jaśtvam -gakāraḥ, tasya cattrvam -kakāraḥ| `dādeḥ` ityucyate, tenādhogityatra ghatvaṃ na sidhyati, adakārāditve'syāvihitatvādityata āha -`dhātoḥ` ityādi| `taddhiśeṣaṇam` iti| dāderviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭam? avayavaṣaṣṭhantamiti| avayavasambandhinī yā ṣaṣṭhī tadantamityarthaḥ| `kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? iti| evaṃ sati kimiṣṭhaṃ sādhitaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| `adhogityatrāpi ghakāraḥ siddho bhavati` iti| atrāpi dhātoravayavo yo dādiśabdastadavayavatvādhakārasya| duherlaṅ, tip, adāditvācchapo luk, halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] , pūrdhavadbhaṣbhāvaḥ, aṭ| `katham` ityādi| dhātoravayavo yo dādiśabdastadavayavasaya hakārasya ghatvaṃ bhavati| evaṃ sati dagdhā, dagdhumityatra ghatvaṃ na kathañcidityarthaḥ| tathā hyatra dhātoravayavo yo dādiśabdo na tasyāvayavo hakāraḥ| yasya tu samudāyasya hakāro'vayavaḥ sa dhātureva, na hakārāvayavaḥ| atrottaramāha -`vyapadeśivadbhāvāt` iti| eṣo'pi vyapadeśivadbhāvena dhātorvādiravayavo bhavati| abhede'pi vyapadeśivadvyavahāro loke dṛśyate| tathā hi -śilāpu trakasya śarīram, rāhoḥ śira iti ca|`atha vā` ityādi| dhātūpadeśo dhātupāṭhaḥ| tatra yo dādirityevaṃ vijñāyate| kathaṃ punardhātupāṭhe dakārāditvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ labhyate, dhātugrahaṇasāmarthyāt| tasya hīdaṃ prayojanaṃ syāt -adhātormā bhūditi| etaccāprayojanam, na hradhātordhakārāderjhali vā padānte ca hakāro'vayavaḥ sambhavati, yannivṛttyarthaṃ dhātugrahaṇam| tadatiricyamānaṃ dhātūpadeśa eva dakārāditvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyamumarthaṃ gamayati| evaṃ vijñāyamāne yadyapi `dhātoḥ` ityasya `dādeḥ` ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tathāpyadhogityatra ghatvaṃ pravartata eva; dhātupāṭhe duherdakārāditvāt| `tathā ca` ityādi| evañca vijñāyamāne yadyapi dāmalihraterdakārāditvam, tathāpi dāmaliḍityatra na bhavati dhatvam`; dhātūpadeśe tasyādakārāditvāt| dhātutvaṃ tasya <> [[3.1.32]] iti| na kevalamadhogitvatra dhatvaṃ bhavati, api tu dāmaliherapi bhavatītyapiśabdo dyotayati| dāma leḍhoti dāmaliḍiti kvip, tadantād? dāmalihamilchatīti `supa ātmanaḥ kyac; [[3.1.8]] iti kyac, kyajantāt? kvip, <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralopaḥ, <> [[6.4.50]] iti yakārasya ca, `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam, ḍhakārasya jaśtvam||`drūheḥ` iti| `druha jighāṃsāyam` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1197) ityasya| `itarevām` iti| `muha vaicittye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1198), `ṣṇuha udgiraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1199), `ṣṇiha prītau` (dhā|pa|1200)-ityeṣāmaprāpteḥ| punareṣaṃ ghatvaṃ syāt, adakārāditvāt||`o vraścū chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1292), `bhrasjo pāke` [`bhrasja` ityeva dhātupāṭhaḥ] (dā|pā|1284), `sṛja visarge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1178), mṛjū śuddhau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1066), `yaja devapūjāsaṅgatikaraṇadāneṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1002), `rājū dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-822), `ṭu bhrājṛ ṭṛbhrāśṛ ṭubhlāśṛ dīptau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-823,824,825)| cha iti cchakārāntāvāṃ grahaṇam; śa iti śakārāntānām| atra ca śakārasya jaśtve prāpte, itareṣāṃ tu katve tadapavādaḥ ṣakāro vidhīyate| `vraṣṭā` iti| `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ` [[8.2.29]] iti sakāralopaḥ, ūdittvāt? pakṣa iḍabhāvaḥ| `mīlabṛṭ, dhānābhṛṭ? iti| `grahijyā` [[6.1.16]] iti sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam| `ruāṣṭā` iti| <> [[6.1.58]] ityamāgamaḥ| `mārṣṭā` [mārṣṭīti kā| mudritapāṭha] iti| <> [[7.2.114]] | `upayaṭ` ti| yadeḥ <> [[3.2.73]] iti vic| `samrāṭ` iti| <> [[8.3.25]] iti samo makārasya makārādeśaḥ|kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ rājabhrājorjhalyudāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitam? ityāha -`rājabhrājoḥ` ityādi| jhalatvaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha -`jhalādirābhyām` ityādi| ābhyāṃ paro yo jhalādiḥ sa iṭā paryavapadyata itīṅvidhīyate; seṭtvādanayoḥ| itareṣvādyacaturthe| vibhāṣiteṭau, svaratītyādisūtrema [[7.2.44]] śeṣāstvāniṭaḥ; `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] itīṭṛpratiṣedhāt| tasmāt? teṣāmubhayārthameva grahaṇam| `rāṣṭiḥ bhrāṣṭiḥ` iti| `kvitannābādibhyaśca` (vā|307) iti ktinpratyayaḥ, `titutra` [[7.2.9]] ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `śabdaprāṭ` iti| śabdaṃ pṛcchatīti `kvivvaci` (vā|288) ityādinā kvip, dīrghaśca|atha kimarthaṃ chagrahaṇam, yāvatā `cchvoḥ śūḍanūmāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] iti cchakārasya śakāre kṛte śakārāntatvādeva pṛṣṭa ityādau ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha -`cchadoḥ śūṭ` ityādi| `atra` ityādi| itikaraṇau hetau| tatra hi <> [[6.4.15]] ityanuvartate, tena cchagrahaṇaṃ kriyate; anyathā pṛṣṭaḥ, pṛṣṭavānityādyeva sidhyat; na tu praṣṭā, praṣṭumityādi; tṛjādāvakṅiti śatvābhāvāt| etacca sūtrakāramatenottam| kecidācāryāḥ chagrahaṇamiha sūtre pratyācakṣata eva| tathā hi -`cchravo śūḍanunāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] ityatroktam -`kecidiha kṅitītyetannānuvarattayanti| kathaṃ dyubhyām, dyubhirityūṭhi kṛte? <> [[6.1.131]] iti taparakaraṇānmātrākālo bhaviṣyatīti| `chaśāṃ ṣaḥ` [[8.2.36]] ityatra cchagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, anenaiva hi sarvatra śakāro vidhīyate` iti|`leṣṭā` iti| `liśa alpībhāve` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1179) `veṣṭā` iti| `viśa praveśane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1424)||`dhātoḥ` [[8.2.32]] iti yadīhānuvartate tadavayavaṣaṣṭhantamekāco viśeṣaṇam| `jhaṣantasya` ityetadapi samānādhikaraṇaṃ tasyaiva viśeṣaṇam| `ekācaḥ` ityetadavayavaṣaṣṭhantaṃ baśaḥ| `tadavayavasya` iti| tasyāvayavastadavayavaḥ| yo'sau dhātoravayava ekāj? jhaṣantastasya, tadityanenābhisambadhyate| `jhali parataḥ` ityanena jhalītyanuvartate [[8.2.26]] , tasya sakāro viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| kimarthaṃ panarjhalītyanuvartate? padāntasyetyanuvṛttiryathā syāt; anyathā jhalītyasmin? nivartamāne tatsambaddhaṃ padāntagrahaṇamapi nivartata, tataśca padānte na sidhyet| nanu ca svaritatvāt? padāntasyesyānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati? tahrranenāpi prakāreṇākhyāyate mandadhiyāṃ sukhapratipattye| `dhvaśabde ca` iti| atra jhalītyetannāpekṣate, asambhavāt| na hi kaścit? jhal? dhvaśabdo'sti; tasya pratyāhāreṣvasanniveśāt| `bhotsyate` [`bhotsyante` -kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `budha avagamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-858), lṛṭ, syaḥ, `khari ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cattrvam -takāraḥ, anudāttettvādātmanepadam| atra budherdhātovryapadeśivadbhāvena svarūpamevaikājavayavo jhaṣantaḥ, tadavayavo bakāro baśa, asyāntaratamyādoṣṭhasya sthāna oṣṭhya eva bhakāro bhaviṣyati| evamanyatrāpi vijñeyam| `abhudhvam` [`abuddha` iti prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] <<ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si>> [[8.2.41]] iti katvam, <<ādeśapratyayayoḥ>> [[8.3.59]] iti ṣatvam| `nyaghūḍhvam` iti| <<ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ>> [[6.3.111]] | `dhokṣyate` iti| duho lṛṭ, `dāderdhātordhaḥ` [[8.2.32]] , tasya `khali ca` [[8.4.54]] iti cartvam -kakāraḥ|`ajarghāḥ` iti| `gudhu abhikāṅkṣāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1246), yaṅ, dvirvacanam, halādiśeṣaḥ, `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityatvam, <> [[7.4.62]] iti cutvam, <<yaṅo'ci ca>> [[2.4.74]] yaṅluk, <> [[7.4.91]] iti ruk| jagṛdha iti sthite iṅādayo vidheyāḥ| atra mukhya eva gṛdha ityayaṃ dhātorjhaṣanto'vayavaḥ| `gardabhayateḥ` iti| gardabhaśabdāt? tadācaṣṭa iti ṇic, `ṇāviṣṭhavat? prātipadikasya` (vā|813) iti ṭilopaḥ| atra garvabhītyayaṃ mukhya eva dhātorjhaṣanto'vayavaḥ| `apratyayaḥ` iti| aśrāvipratyayaḥ kvibādirapratyaya ityucyate| `dāmaliṭ` iti| atra `hoḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatve kṛte jhaṣantatāyāmupajātāyāmekājgrahaṇādbhaṣbhāṣo na bhavati| nanu cātra dvāvekājavayavau -dakārādirmakārāntaḥ, lakārādirjhaṣantaśca; tayoścāsatyapyekājgrahaṇe naiva bhaṣbhāvaḥ prasajyate| tathā hi-yo jhaṣantastasya vaś? na vidyate, yastu dakārādirmakārāntastasya vaś? vidyate, jhaṣantatā tu nāsti, tadanarthamekājgrahaṇam? ityata āha -`asatyekājagrahaṇe` ityādi| vaśo viśeṣaṇaṃ vyavacchedārtham| vyavacchedo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattatho ktam| yadyekājgrahaṇaṃ na syāt, tato'nyasyehāśrutatvāt, baśastu śrutatvācca sa eva dhātorityanena viśeṣyate na dhātoravayavo vaśiti| evaṃ ca baśo jhaṣantatā na sambhavatīti jhaṣantasyetyanena dhātureva viśeṣyate; anyasyehāsambhavāt| tathā cāyaṃ sūtrārthaḥ syāt -jhaṣantasya dhātoryo'vayavo baśa tasya jhali sakāre ṣve ca parataḥ padānte ca bhav? bhavatīti| asmaśca sūtrārthaṃ dāmaliḍityatrāpi prasajyeta| bhavati dakāro'tra baś? jhaṣantasya dhātoravayavaḥ| ekāca ityetasmin? sati dhātorjhaṣantasyetyetadubhayāntasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, tadapi baśaḥ| tena vṛttikāropadarśita eva sūtrārtho jāyate; tataśca na kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| dāmaliḍityatra hi yo jhaṣanta ekājavayavo lakārādinaṃ tasya baś? vidyate, yasya tu vidyate dakārādirmāntasya sa jhaṣanto na bhavati|`krotsyati` iti| `krudha kope` (dhāpā|1189)| `dādadvi` iti| <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] ityabhyāsasya dīrghatvam| antagrahaṇamasandehārtham| asati hi tasmin? sandehaḥ syāt -kimatra baśaḥ sthānitvam? atha jhaṣaḥ? iti||dadhāterapyetat? kṛtadvirvacanasya rūpamasti| `dadha dhāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-8) -ityasya cākṛtadvirvacanasya rūpam, tatra tu śapā vyavahitatvādanantarau tatho na sambhavataḥ; tasmāddadhātereva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha -`dadha iti kṛtadvirvacano dadhātiḥ parigṛhrate` iti| `dhattaḥ, iti| laṭastasthasau, śapaḥ [śapaḥ ślulupi dvirvacanam -prāṃudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] śluḥ `ślau` [[6.1.10]] (iti) dvirvacanam, <> [[8.4.54]] iti jaśtvam -dakāraḥ, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ` [[6.4.112]] ityākāralopaḥ, abhyāsadakārasya bhaṣ? dhakāraḥ| dhātudhakārasya cartvam -takāraḥ| `dhatse` iti| `thāsaḥ se` [[3.4.80]] `dhadhve` iti| ṭerettvam| `dhadhvam` iti| loṭi <> [[3.4.91]] ityamādeśaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra bhaṣbhāvaḥ; yāvatā dadhāterjhaṣantasya yo daś? tasya bhaṣ? bhavatītyucyate, atra nāpi jhaṣantatāsti; ākāralopasya <> [[1.1.57]] iti sthānivadbhāvāt; nāpi baś, abhyāsajaśatvasyāsiddhatvāt? ityata āha -`vacanasāmarthyāt` ityādi| `abhyāsajaśtvasyāsiddhatvam` iti vacanasāmarthyānna bhavatītya pekṣate| yadyākāralopasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ syādabhyāsajaśtvasyāsiddhatvam| evaṃ satyapārthakataivāsya vacanasya syāt, na hi dadhāterākāralopena vinā baś? syāt| tasmādvacanaprāmāṇyādubhayaṃ na bhavati| iha jhalotyanuvartate, jhaṣantasyeti ca, takārathakārābhyāmanyaḥ sa jhalasti yatra dadhāterjhaṣantasya bhaṣbhāvo neṣyate| tasmāt? `tathoḥ` iti vacanamantareṇāpisiddhamiṣṭamityabhiprāyeṇāha -`tathoriti kim` iti| `ānantaryāt` ityādi| anantarasūtre hi `sdhvoḥ` [[8.2.37]] ityuktam, tataśca `anantaralasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā` (vyā|pa|19) iti sdhvoreva bhaṣbhāvo vijñāyate, na tathoḥ; ataḥ `tathoḥ` ityucyate| yadyevam, nimittāntaropā dāne pūrvasya nimittasya nivṛttyā bhavitavyam, tataśca tathoreva syāt, na sdhvoḥ? ityata āha -`cakāraḥ` ityādi| parihāraḥ||`āliṭ` iti| ḍhatve kṛte jaśtvam| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, nanu <> [[8.2.29]] ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvartata eva? ityata āha -`antagrahaṇam` ityādi| taddhyantagrahaṇaṃ jhalītyanena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau jhalītyetadapyanuvartata, tasmādetannivṛttyarthamanyadevāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tena ca vasateḥ -vastā, vastumityatra na bhavati||`athaḥ` iti| anena dhātupratiṣedho'yaṃ na dhakārapratiṣedha iti darśayati| yadi hi dhakārapratiṣedhaḥ syāt, dhakārāt? parayostathordhakāro na bhavatīti| tataḥ `matibuddhipūnārthebhyaśca` [[3.2.188]] , <> [[1.1.73]] ityevamādayo nirdeśā nopapadyeran| `alabdha, alabdhāḥ` iti| luṅ, tasya tathāsau, <> [[8.2.26]] iti sakāralopaḥ| `alīḍha, alīḍhāḥ` iti| ḍhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopadīrghatvāni kartavyāni||`pekṣyati` iti| `piṣlṛ sañcūrṇane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1452), lṛṭ| `apekṣyat` iti| lṛṅ| `pipikṣati` iti| san, <> [[1.2.10]] iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ|`pinaṣṭi` iti| rūdhāditvāt? śnam| `leḍhi` iti| adāditvācchaparo luk||`āstīrṇam` iti| `stṛñ? ācchādane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1484)| `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttvam, `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghaḥ| `viśīrṇam` iti| `śṛhiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1488)| `nigīrṇam` iti| `gṛ? nigaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1410)| eṣu `śrayukaḥ kiti` [[7.2.11]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `avagūrṇam` iti| `gurī udyamane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1396)| `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām` [[7.2.14]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| atha yathā <> [[8.2.18]] ityatra `ra` iti varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtaṃ bhedamutsṛjya sāmānyasyopādānam, tathehāpi, asti ca ṛkāre rephaḥ; tataśca kṛtaḥ kṛtavānityatra bhavitavyameva natveneti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha -`ra ityatra` ityādi| yadyatra `ra` iti sāmānyamupādīyeta tasmādevaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, na tu raśrutisāmānyamupādīyate, kiṃ tarhi? vyañjanamardhamātrātmakam| na ca samānākāro'stīti kuto natvaprasaṅgaḥ? bhavatu nāma sāmānyasyopādānam, tathāpi naivātra natvaṃ prasajyata iti darśayitumāha -`sāmānyanirdeśe'pi` ityādi| ṛkāro'tra ye bhāgāstanmadhyavartī repho mātrācaturbhāgātmakaḥ, tatra yo'sau rephātparastṛtīyo bhāgastena vyavadhānānna bhavati|`caritam, muditam` iti| `cara gatyarthaḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-559),`muda harṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-16)| asati hi `ta` iti grahaṇe `radābhyām` ityanena niṣṭhā viśeṣyate -radābhyāṃ parā yā niṣṭheti, tataścaritamityādau <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] iti iṭa eva natvaṃ syāt; tasya niṣṭhābhaktatvāt| atha `ta` ityucyamāne caritamityādau takārasya kasmānna bhavati? iṭā vyavahitatvāt| sa hi pratyayabhaktatvāt? pratyayameva na vyavadadhyāt| tadavayavatvaṃ tu vyavadadhyādeva| `parasya mā bhūt` iti| asati hi pūrvagrahaṇe yadi hi sannihitayā niṣṭhayā dakāro viśeṣyeta -niṣṭhāyā yo dakāra iti, tato jaśatve kṛte parasyaiva syāt -bhinnavadbhyām, bhinnavadbhirityādau| atha na viśeṣyeta, tato viśeṣānupādānādyathāpūrvasya bhavati, tathā parasyāpi| tasmāt? parasya mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| atha kṛtasyāpatyam, `ata iñ` [[4.1.95]] kārttirityatra kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`iha` ityādi| vṛddhirhi taddhitaṃ nimittamāśritya bhavatīti bahiraṅgā, natvaṃ tu na kiñcidbāhraṃ nimittamāśritya bhaviṣyatītyatastadantaraṅgam| tasmādvṛddherbahiraṅgatvānnatve kartavye rephasyāsiddhatvam| nanu ca yadi tarhi bahiraṅgalakṣaṇā sā, tasyā evāsiddhatvena bhavituṃ yuktam, na tu rephasyāpi, na hi repho vṛddhirbhavati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vṛddhyāśrito hi rephaḥ, tato vṛddherbahiraṅgatvādrephasyāpi bahiraṅgatvena bhāvyam||`pradrāṇaḥ` iti| `drā kutsāyāṃ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1054)| <> [[8.4.29]] iti ṇatvam| `mlānaḥ` iti| `mlai gātravināme` [`mlai harṣakṣaye` -iti dhātupāṭhaḥ] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-904)| `cyutaḥ, plutaḥ` iti| `cyuṅ? pluṅ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-955,958)| `niryātaḥ` iti| `yā prāpaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1049)| `nirvātaḥ` iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1050)| atra ryā, rvā-ityetayordhātutvaṃ na bhavati| `ryā` ityayaṃ hi samudāyaḥ saṃyogādiḥ, na cāyaṃ dhātuḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `yā` ityayam| evaṃ `rvā` ityayaṃ saṃyogādiḥ, na caiṣa dhātuḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `vā` ityayam| nanu ca bahiraṅgamatra saṃyogāditvam, dvipadāśrayatvāt, natvaṃ tu viparyayādantaraṅgam; `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) ityasiddhatvādeva saṃyogāditvasya natvaṃ na bhavatīti kiṃ dhātugrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhi etajjñāpayati -upasargasambandhena yo dharma upajāyate dhātūpasargasamudāyasya sa dhātorataddharmavato'pi kāryāṇi prāpayatīti| tenopāstate guruḥ, abhibhūyate śatruriti karmaṇi lakāraḥ siddho bhavati| atra hru pasargasambandhena sakarmakatvadharmo jātaḥ| sa ca dhātūpasargasamudāyasya, na dhātumātrasya| tatra yadyayamartho na jñāpyeta, karmaṇi lakāro na syāt; dhātorakarmakatvāt| asmaścārthe jñāpite tu bhavati| `snātaḥ` iti| `ṣṇā śauce` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1052)||`jīnaḥ` iti| `jyā vayohānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1499), `grahijyā` [[6.1.16]] ityādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇam, `halaḥ` [[6.4.2]] iti dīrghaḥ| `ṛkāralpādibhyaḥ` ityādi| ṛkārāntebhyo lvādibhyaśca paro yaḥ ktin? sa niṣṭhā bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ nu <> [[8.2.45]] ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt| yathā ṛkāralpādibhyo niṣṭhātakārasya natvaṃ bhavati, tathā ktino'pi takārasya natvaṃ bhavatīti|`dugvoḥ` iti| `du upatāpe` [`ṭu ṭu upatāpe` -dhātupāṭhaḥ, padamañjaryāṃ tu-`du gatau(944)ityayaṃ dhāturupāttaḥ, na `ṭu ṭu upatāpe` iti] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1256)| `gu purīṣotsarge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1399)| `pūnāḥ` iti vinaṣṭā ityarthaḥ| `pūtaṃ dhānyam` iti| vidhūtamityarthaḥ| `sinoteḥ` iti| `viñ? bandhane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1248) ityetasya| `grāsakarmakarttṛkasya` iti| grāsaḥ karmakartā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| arthadvārakañcedam| tasya grāsakarmakarttṛkatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam| yathā sino grāso bandhanakriyāyāṃ vyañjanaviśeṣayogādānukūlyaṃ pratipadyate, tathā karmaṇo'pi satastasya karttṛtvaṃ vivakṣitamiti karmakartāsau bhavati| `sino grāsaḥ` ti| svayameva baddha ityarthaḥ| `sitā pāśena sūkarī` iti| samudāyapratyudāharaṇametat| avayavapratyudāharaṇaṃ darśayitumāha -`grāso'pi` ityādi| grāso'pi yadi karmaiva bhavati na karmakartā, tadāpi na bhavati; grāsakarmakarttṛkatvamasya tadābhāvāt| grāsakarmato hi sa tadānīṃ bhavati grāsakarmakarttṛkaḥ||`āpīnaḥ` iti| <> [[6.1.28]] iti pībhāvaḥ| `svādaya oditaḥ` iti| te punaḥ `ṣūṅa prāṇiprasave` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1132) ityādayaḥ `vrīṅ? prīṇātyarthe` [vṛṇotyarthe-dhātupāṭhaḥ] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1140) ityevamantā divādiṣu paṭhante||`kṣiyaḥ` iti| `kṣi kṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-236), `kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1407) iti dvayorapi grahaṇam; viśeṣānupādānāt| `kṣīṇāaḥ kleśāḥ` iti| `kto'dhikaraṇe` ca` [[3.4.76]] ityādinā'karmakatvāt? kartari niṣṭhā, `niṣṭhāyāmaṇyadarthe` [[6.4.60]] iti dīrghaḥ| `kṣīṇo jālmaḥ, kṣīṇastapasvī` ityādi| `vā''krośadaibhyayoḥ` [[6.4.61]] iti| nanu ca `kṣiyaḥ` iti nirdeśādeva dīrghasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, tat? kiṃ dīrghagrahaṇena? yadi hrasvasyevaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, evaṃ sati paratvāt? <> [[7.3.111]] iti guṇe kṛte kṣeriti nirdeśaḥ syāt? ityata āha -`hrasvasyāpi hi` ityādi| yadi niyogato dīrghasyaiva dhātvanukaraṇasyeyaṅā nirdeśaḥ syāt, tato'smānnirdeśāddīrghasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti vijñāyate| na ca dīrghasyaiveyaṅā nirveśo bhavati| tathā hi hrasvāntasyāsau dṛṣṭaḥ kṣiyaḥ| `niṣṭhāyāmaṇyadarthe` [[6.4.60]] ityatrāvasitaṃ hrasvāntasthedamanukarṇam, na dīrghāntasyeti? ucyate; yathābhūtasyaivānukartuyuktam| hrasvāntasya ca dīrghatvaṃ vidheyam| atastasyaivānukaraṇamidamiti vijñāyate| yadi tarhi hrasvāntasyāpi dhātvanukaraṇasyeyaṅā nirdeśo bhavati, <> [[1.3.19]] , <> [[7.3.58]] ityevamādāvapi kasmānna bhavati? iha `viparābhyāṃ jerityevamādau` ityādi| atrāsaṅkalpamityatadadhyāhāryam| dhātvanukaraṇasya hi `prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati` (vyā|pa|113) itīyaṅā nirdeśo bhavati| dhātvanukaraṇaṃ ca kiṃ bhavitumarhati yena dhātāvanukāryeva sthitam? dhātutvaṃ kriyāvācitvalakṣaṇaṃ vivakṣyate| <> [[1.3.19]] ityevamādau tvanukāryagataṃ dhātutvaṃ sadapyavavakṣitatvādasaṅkalpam| tasmānnātra dhātvanukaraṇam| api tu ṅīprabhṛteḥ kriyāvācinaśca tatsādṛśyaśabdāntarasya ṅītyevamāderyadrūpasāmānyamarthaśūnyaṃ tadanukaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| tasmādadhātvanukaraṇatvānna bhavatīyaṅādeśa ityabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tarhi dhātvanukaraṇa syāt, prakṛtivadanukaraṇa bhavatīti, evaṃ satyadhāto [[1.2.45]] iti prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedho'pi syāt, tataśca vibhaktirnopapadyate? vatkaraṇenānukāryeṇārtheṇārthanārthavattvasyāśrayāt? prātipadikasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ||`śīnam` iti| `śyaiṅ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-963), `dravamūrttisparśayoḥ śyaḥ` [[6.1.24]] iti samprasāraṇam, `halaḥ` [[6.4.2]] iti dīrghaḥ| `śotaṃ vartate` iti| bhāve niṣṭhā| pūrvatra tu kartari| evaṃ `śīto vādhuḥ` ityādau| `śītamudakamityatra` ityādi| `guṇabhūto'pi` iti| apradhānabhūto'pītyarthaḥ| nanu ca pradhāne kāryasampratyayādapradhānasya natvapratiṣedhādikāryaṃ prati nimittabhāvo nopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `asparśe` iti hi yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt, evaṃ sati śīto vāyurityādau sparśādanyaddravyamastīti natvaṃ syāt; na tvayaṃ paryudāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ| tena yatra lparśanagandho'sti tatra tadāśrayeṇa natvapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam| asti ceha guṇabhūtaḥ sparśaḥ, tena tadāśrayo natvapratiṣedho bhavatyeva| bhavatvevaṃ natvapratiṣedhaḥ, samprasāraṇasya tu guṇabhūtaḥ sparśaḥ kathaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavati? niyamasya tyāgāt| iha `alpāctaram` [[2.2.34]] iti niyamaḥ -alpāctaraṃ dvandve pūrvameva prayoktavyamiti; <> [[6.1.24]] ityatra sparśaśabdasyālpāctarasya paranipātaṃ kurvatā'sya niyamasya tvāgaḥ kṛtaḥ| sa kimarthaṃ kṛtaḥ? sparśo'trāniyamena pradhānabhūta upasarjanabhūto vā samprasāraṇasya kāraṇamityasyārthasya sūcanārthaḥ| tena guṇabhūto'pi sparśaḥ samprasāraṇasya nimittaṃ bhavati| sparśaśabdo'yamasti guṇavacanaḥ, asti ca rogavacanaḥ; tadiha viśeṣānupādānādubhayorapi grahaṇam| tato roge'pi prāpnotīti pratiśīna ityetanna sidhyediti codyamāśahkyāha -`guṇe ca` ityādi| guṇa evetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarguṇa eva pratiṣedho labhyate? jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ `dravamūrttisparśavoḥ śya-` [[6.1.24]] ityatra samprasāraṇaṃ vidhāya punaḥ <> [[6.1.25]] iti vidhatte, tajjñāpayati -śyāyateryatra grahaṇaṃ tatra sparśa upādīyamāno rogaṃ na pratyāyayatīti| yadi hi pratyāyayet, punarvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt; pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| pratipūrvo hi roga eva śyāyatirvattete, nānyatra||`na cedapādānaṃ tatra bhavati` iti| tatretyanenāñcatiḥ parāmṛśyate| śabdadvāreṇāñcatyarthaṃ evāyamapādānasya pratiṣedhasāmarthyādvijñāyate| na hrañcatāvapādānatvaṃ sambhavati, kiṃ tarhi? tadarthe kriyāviṣayatvāt? kārakāṇām| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati -na cedañcatyarthe viṣayabhūte'pādānaṃ na bhavatīti| `samaknau` iti| saṅgatāvityarthaḥ| `ancu gatipūjanayoḥ` [`ancū` iti kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ](dhātupāṭhaḥ-188) ityudittvādvibhāṣiteṭ| [ityūdittvāt -kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] tena <> [[7.2.15]] iti niṣṭhāyāmiṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `udaktamudakam` iti| uddhṛtamudakamityarthaḥ| atha vyaktamityatra natavaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`vyaktamityetat` ityādi| `añjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu` [`ancū` iti| kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1458) ityetasyaitadrūpam,ityetadrūpam -kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] nāñcateḥ; tato natvamiha na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||`ādyūnaḥ, paridyūnaḥ` iti| avijigīṣurityarthaḥ| `cchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca` [[6.4.19]] iti ūṭh| `dyūtaṃ vartate` iti| vijigīṣārtho'tra vivakṣita iti natvaṃ na pravartate| kathaṃ punariha vijigīṣārthaḥ, yāvatā akṣapātanalakṣaṇakroḍā na pratīyate? ityāha -vijigīṣāyāṃ hi`[ityetadrūpam -kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| vijetumicchā vijigīṣā, tasyām| tatra kroḍāyāmakṣapātanādi kriyate| tasmādvijigīṣārthe'vatiṣṭhata iti bhāvaḥ| ādiśabdena śalākāpātādegrrahaṇam||`dāteruttarasya` iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1050) ityetasmāt| `na ca` ityādi| dhātamacikaraṇamādhāro yasya sa tathoktaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati -dhāterdhātoryo'rthaḥ sa yadi dhātena samaveto bhavatītyarthaḥ| `nirvāṇo'gniḥ, nirvāṇaḥ pradīpaḥ` iti| atra svarūpasya yaḥ praśama uparatilakṣaṇaḥ sa dhātvarthaḥ| `eṣa nirvāṇo bhikṣuḥ` iti| atrāpi| atha vā -rāgādiprahāṇaṃ dhātvarthaḥ| `nirvāto vātaḥ` iti| akarmakatvāt? kartari niṣṭhā| `nirvātaṃ vātena` iti| atra bhāve| ubhayatrāpyatra gatinirodho dhātvartha-| `nirvāṇaḥ pradīpī vātena` iti| atra vāteneti kartri tṛtīyā| tasmādvāta eva dātyarthasyādhāraḥ, tataśca natvena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidvyāmohaḥ syāt, atastānnirākaraṇāyāha -`niryāṇaḥ pradīpaḥ` ityādi| atra nirvāṇaṃdhātvarthaḥ, tacca pradapādhāram, na vātādhāram| vātādhāre hi tasminnirvāṇa iti yadi kartari niṣṭhā, tadā tayaivābhihitatvāt? kartturvātāt? tṛtīyā na syāt| atha <> [[3.3.114]] iti bhāve? evaṃ sasi nirvāṇa iti puṃlliṅgaṃ na syāt| tasmāt? pradīpa eva kartā dhātvardhasyādhāraḥ| yadyevam, kathaṃ vātenetyatra tṛtīyā? ityata āha -`vātastu` ityādi| etenaiṣā tṛtīyā na kartarīti darśayati||`śuṣa śoṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1183) ityasmāt? parasya niṣṭhātakārasya ṣṭutve prāpte kakāro vidhīyate| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `śuṣkaḥ, śuṣkavān` iti| yuktaṃ śuṣvānityetadudāharaṇam, śuṣka ityetattvayuktam; na hretadarthe'sya sūtrasyārambho yujyate, <<śuṣkadhṛṣṭau>> [[6.1.206]] iti nipātanenaiva siddhatvāt? naitadasti; nipātanena hi kakāre sati śuṣkiketyatra <> [[7.3.46]] iti vibhāṣetvaṃ syāt, śuṣkajaṅghetyatra ca <> [[6.3.37]] iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ syāt; iha tu kakārasya vidhāne sati tasyāsiddhatvādetadubhayaṃ na bhavati| tasmācchuṣka ityetadartho'pyasyārambho yuktaḥ||`pakvaḥ, pakvavān` iti| `ḍupaṭacaṣ? pāke` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-996)| yadyevam, pakva ityatat? <> [[2.1.41]] iti nipātanādapi hi sidhyati; tathāpi pakvavānityetadarthamidamavaśyamārabdhavyam| anyārthaṃ cārabhyamāṇaṃ pakva ityetadartharūpamapi bhavatīti pasvaśabdo'syodāharaṇamupanyastam| nipātanadvāreṇa hi tadvyutpattau pratipattigauravaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ||`kṣai jai vai kṣaye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-913-915)||`prastīmaḥ` iti| `ṣṭaai styai saṅghātaśabdayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-911,910)| <> [[6.1.23]] iti samprasāraṇam; pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| iha yadā matvaṃ na bhavati| tadā <<ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ>> [[7.2.43]] ityanena natvena bhavitavyam; tataśca prastīnaḥ, prastīnavānitīṣṭaṃ syāt -iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha -`yadā matvaṃ nāsti` ityādi| kṛte tarhi prathamaṃ samprasāraṇe natvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`tatra kṛte` ityādi||`phullaḥ` iti| `ñiphalā viśaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-516), <<āditaśca>> [[7.2.16]] itīṭpratiṣedhathaḥ, `utparasyātaḥ` [[7.4.88]] ityuttvam| `ktavatvantasyāpyetallatvamiṣyate` iti| kathaṃ punariṣyayāṇamapi labhyate, na hi ktavatvantaḥ śabdaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ? ucyate; iha niṣṭhāyāstakārāntaṃ yacchabdarūpaṃ tasya `phulla` ityetannipātyate, ktavatośca [`ktaktavatośca` iti kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] tat? tulyam| parastu yadi ktavato'rtho vā viśeṣyate? viśeṣyatām, na hi tena samānenāsamānena vā parayojanamasti| tasmāt? ktavatvantasyāpyetallatvaṃ bhavati| evamanayaiva yuktyā kṣībakṛśollāghādiṣvapi yannipātyate, tadapi ktavatvantasya prasajyate[`prasajyeta` -iti kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyamāṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca na jñāyate, tenātiprasaṅgo na bhaviṣyatīti|`kṣīvikṛśibhyām` iti| `kṣībṛ made` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-382), `kṛśa tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-382), `kṛśa tanūkaraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1227)| `iḍabhāvaśca nipātyate` iti| ktalopasyāsiddhatvādvalādirārdhadhātuko bhavatītīṭ? prāpnoti; atastadabhāvaśca nipātyate| `kṛte vā iṭi icchabdalopaḥ` iti| nipātyata iti sambandhaḥ| iḍabhāvāpekṣo vikalpaḥ| atha vā -neḍabhāvo nipātyate| kiṃ tarhi? kṛta iṭīcchabdalopaḥ| `lāgherudo'nya upasargaḥ pratiṣidhyate` iti| utpūrvasya grahaṇasāmarthāyat| anyathā hrutpūrvasyopādānamanarthakaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| anupasargādityucyate, tatra parikṛśa iti na sidhyati? ityata āha -`parikṛśa ityatra` ityādi| tanūkaraṇalakṣaṇakriyāyā anyakriyā gamanalakṣaṇā kriyāntaram, tena yogo'yam, na pariśabdaḥ, atara kṛśiṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñā bhavatīti kṛtvā| `parigataḥ kṛśaḥ` iti| anena taṃ kriyāntarayogaṃ darśayati| atha kimarthaṃ nipātanam; yāvatā phulla iti `phulla vikasane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-532) ityasmāt? pacādyaci sidhyati, kṣīberigupadhalakṣaṇe ke -kṣauva iti, kṛśa ityapi kṛśeracaiva, ullarāgha iti -lāgha ityeva pacādyaci siddhyatyeva? satyamevaitat; niṣṭhāyāṃ tu phalatiprabhṛtīnāmasatyasminnaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prāpnoti| atastannivṛttyarthamārabdhadhyametat||`samunnaḥ, samuttaḥ` iti| `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] iti nalopaḥ| `hrītyasya` [`hyī` ityatasya -kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `hrī lajjāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-108530 ityasya| `aprāptraḥ` iti| kenacidavidhānāt| `itareṣām` iti| tatra `nuda preraṇe` [`ṇuda preraṇe` -dhātupāṭhaḥ] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1426), `undī kledane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1457) -tayoḥ `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] iti nityaṃ prāpsam| `traiṅ? pālane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-965), `ghrā gandhopādāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-926) -etayoḥ <<ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ>> [[7.2.43]] ityādinā| `vida vicāraṇe` ityasya videriha grahaṇamidhyate` iti| kathaṃ punarasya grahaṇamiṣyate, śluvikaraṇena hyītyanena [`hyīṇā` -prāṃu pāṭhaḥ] sāhacāryāt? naitadasti; śavikaraṇena nudinā sāhacaryāllābhārthasya videgrrahaṇaprasaṅgāt? evaṃ tahrranyatarasyāmityeṣā vyavasthitavibāṣā, tena vicāraṇārthasyaiva bhavitavyam, nānyasya; yasyaivaṃ bhavitavyaṃ tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti sa eva gṛhrate| kathaṃ punajrñāyate -vicāraṇārthasya videryahaṇamiṣyate? ityāha -`evaṃ hi` ityādi| iṣyata iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| `niṣṭhā` ityanena niṣṭhāntamupalakṣayatiḥ `vetteḥ` ityādi| `vida jñāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1064) ityasya `viditaḥ` ityetadrūpamiṣyate; nityeṭtvāt, tasyeṭā niṣṭhātakārasya vyavadhāne sati natvasyāsambhavāt| `vidyateḥ` iti| `vida sattāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1171) ityasya śyanvikaratasya [nāsti -kāṃupāṭhe] niṣṭhāntasya `vinnaḥ` ityetadrūpamidhyate; `ekācaḥ` [[7.2.10]] itīṭpratiṣedhāt; `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] ityādinā ca nityaṃ natvavidhānāt| `vintevinnaśca vittaśca` iti| `vida vicāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1450) ityasya niṣṭhāntasyaitadrūpadvyamiṣyate; pūrvavadiṭpratiṣedhāt, anena ca sūtreṇa [[8.2.56]] pakṣe natvavidhānāt| `bhogivittaśca vindateḥ` iti| vibdaterityanena lābhārthavidiṃ darśayati| tasya hi <<śe mucādīnām>> [[7.1.59]] iti numi kṛte vindatītyetadrūpaṃ bhavati| bhogavitta iti -bhoge vitto bhogavittaḥ, `saptamī` [[2.1.40]] iti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ| bhogagrahaṇaṃ copalakṣaṇamātram| pratyayo'yi gṛhrate| `vidlṛ lābhe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1432) ityasya bhoge pratyaye cārthe vitta ityetadrūpaṃ niṣṭhāyāmiṣyate; `vito bhogapratyayayoḥ` [[8.2.58]] iti natvābhāvasya nipātanāt, <> [[7.2.15]] iti niṣṭhāyāmiṭpratiṣedhācca| vindaterhi kvasau <> [[7.2.68]] itīṅvibhāṣitaḥ; `bhogavittaśca vindateḥ` iti brāuvatā'rthatau bhogapratyayābhyāmanyatra vinna ityetadrūpamiṣyata ityuktaṃ bhavati||`dhyai cintāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-908), `khyā prakathane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1060), `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ` [[2.4.54]] iti ca -dvayorapi grahaṇam| nanu ca cakṣiṅādeśasya sānubandhakatvānniranubandhakagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā|pa|53) na prāpnotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha hi niṣṭhātakārasya paratvapratipādane pañcamī yuktā, yathā -`radābhyām? [[8.2.42]] iti| tatra pañcamīnirdeśe kartavye yaḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ kriyate, sa sambandhasāmānyaṃ pratipādayitum| na ca sambandhina mantareṇa sambandhasāmānyamupapadyate| na ca sānubandhake parityajyamāne sambandhibhedaḥ sambhavatīti yuktaṃ tasyāpi grahaṇam, `pṛ? pālanapūraṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1489), `mucrchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-212), `madī harṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1208)| eṣu dhyākhyāprabhṛtiṣu -ādyayoḥ <<ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ>> [[7.2.43]] ityādinā natde prāpte, itareṣāmapi `radābhyām` [[8.2.42]] ityādinā, pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate| `pūrttaḥ` iti| `śrayukaḥ kiti` [[7.2.11]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `udoṣṭhapūrvasya` [[7.1.102]] ityuttvam, pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| `mūrttaḥ` iti <> [[6.4.21]] iti cchakāralopaḥ, <<āditaśca>> [[7.2.16]] itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `mattaḥ` iti| atrāpi `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām` [[7.2.14]] iti||`dhanamasya bahavityarthaḥ` iti| kathaṃ punarbhoge vyatpāditasya dhane vṛttirartho bhavati? ityāha -`ghanaṃ hi` ityādi| anena karmasādhanatvaṃ bhogaśabdasya darśayan? dhane'sya vṛtiṃta darśayati| `pratīta ityarthaḥ` iti| etena pratyayaśabdasya karmasādhanatāmācaṣṭe| pratīta iti karmaṇi niṣṭhā| pratīta ākhyāta ityarthaḥ| sa cāyamarthaḥ pratyaye vyutpādyamāne'sya kathaṃ [nāsti -kāṃu|pāṭhe] bhavati, yadi pratyaśabdo'pi karmasādhano bhavati -pratīyata iti pratyayaḥ| tena pratyayaśabdasya karmasādhanatā veditavyā||`bhittamiti nipātyate` iti| kiṃ nipātyate? radābhyāmiti [[8.2.42]] natve prāpte tadabhāva iti| `śakalaṃ cettadbhavati` iti| śakalaśabdasya yo'rthaḥ, khamaṇḍa iti yasyāparamabhidhānam, bhittaśabdasyāpi yadi sa evārtho bhavatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarbhittaśabdasya śakalamartho bhavati? ityāha -`śakalaparyāyo'yam` iti| bhittaśabdaḥ śakalasyaiva paryāyaḥ| tasmādyathā śakalaśabdasya śakalamabhidheyaṃ bhavati, evaṃ bhittaśabdasyāpi| nanu ca śakalaśabdo'yaṃ jātiśabdaḥ; jātiprava-ttinimittamupādāya svābhideye pravṛttatvāt; bhittaśabdastu kriyāśabdaḥ, kriyāpravṛttinimittatvāt; tathā hi -bhidervidāraṇārthāt? kte vihite bhittamiti nipātyate, na ca kriyāśabdo jātiśabdaparyāya upapadyate? ityāha -`atra` ityādi| śabdavyutpattiḥ=śabdasaṃskāraḥ, tasyā evātra bhittaśabde bhidikriyānimittatvām; na tu tatpravṛtteḥ; asattvāt| jātireva tu tatpravṛtti prati nimittam; tasyā vidyamānatvāt| tasmācchakalaśabdavadbhittaśabdo'pi jātiśabda eva; na kriyāśabda iti yuktā tasya tatparyāyatā| yadi tahrrasatyevātra bhidikriyā, śabdasaṃskāratvasyāpi sā nimittaṃ nopapadyate? naitadasti; na hrayaṃ niyogo'bhidhīyate -vidyamānaiva kriyā śabdasaṃskārasya nimittaṃ bhavatīti| tathā hi tailapāyikāśabdo yatra prāṇiviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ, tatra tailapānakriyāśabdo'pi nāsti; tathāpi tailapānakriyā tatsaṃskāranimittatvenāśrīyate| kathaṃ punarbhittaśabdo bhidikriyāpravṛttinimittaṃ na bhavati? ityāha -`bhidikriyāvivakṣāyāṃ hi` ityādi| atra bhinnamityasya ca bhittaśakalaśabdābhyāṃ pratyekamabhisambandhaḥ| tena `bhinnaṃ bhittamityeva bhavati` iti| etat? prayogadvayamapi bhidikriyādivakṣāyāṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| vidīrṇe hi śakale tasya vidīrṇatāṃ pratipādayituṃ bhinnam, bhittamityeṣa prayogo bhidikriyāvivakṣāyāṃ kriyate| yadi ca bhittaśabda kriyāpravṛttinimittaṃ syāt, tato bhittaśabdenaiva bhidikriyānimittakena vidīrṇatā śakalasya pratipādyata ityeṣa prayogo nopapadyate, na hi tadasti yasya bhittaśabdenāpratipāditasya bhinnaśabdayogo bhavet| bhinnaṃ śakalamityeṣa ca prayogo nopapadyate; śakalavyutpāditena bhittaśabdena bhidikriyānimittakena bhinnaśabdasya bādhitatvāt| asti cāyaṃ dvividho'pi prayogaḥ, tasgādbhittaśabdasya bhidikriyānimittatvaṃ na gamyate||`ṛ ityetasmāt` iti| `ṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1098) ityetasmāt, `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-936) ityetasmādvā| `adhama ṛṇe'dhamarṇaḥ` iti| kena punaratra samāsa iti? yāvatā nātra kiñcit? samāsalakṣaṇamasti; `saptamiti yogavibhāgāt? samāsaḥ` ityetacca na vaktavyam, saptamyāḥ pūrvanipātaprasaṅgat? ityata āha -`etasmādeva` ityādi| `tadbhāva ādhamaṇryam` iti| tat? pratidāsyatīti grahaṇakriyābhisambandhaḥ| tadyogādbhāve'sāvadhamarṇa ityucyate| `kālāntara` ityādi| yasmin? kāle'dhamarṇo gṛhṇāti tasmāt? kālādanya āgāmī kālaḥ kālāntaram, tatra yaddeyaṃ tat? kālāntaradeyam, tena yo vinimayaḥ= viparivartanam, tadupalakṣaṇārthamevādhamarṇagrahaṇamevamupāttam, na ca svārthaparatipādanārthameva| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha -`uttamarṇa ityapi bhavati` iti| ṛṇe hreko'dhamarṇo bhavati, yo gṛhītvā pratidāsyatīti; yastu datvā grahauṣyati sa uttamarṇaḥ| tatra yadyādhamaṇryagrahaṇaṃ svārthapratipādanārthamevopāttam, tadottamarṇa iti na sidhyet, na hyatrādhamaṇryaṃ vivakṣitam| tattarhīdaṃ cottamaryarṇe'pi kālāntaradeyavinimayopalakṣaṇārthatvādādhamaṇryagrahaṇe satyetadapi sidhyati, asti hyatra kālāntaradvayavinimayaḥ| tathā hruttamarṇo'pi prayacchan? kālāntare yaddeyaṃ tena vinimayaṃ karoti||`sadeḥ` iti| `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-854) ityetasmāt| `niṣattaḥ` iti| `sadirapratteḥ` [[8.3.66]] itiṣatvam| `anuttam` iti| `undī kledane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1457), `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] iti nalopaḥ| `pratūrtam` iti| yadā `ñitvarā sambhrame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-775) ityasya nipātyate, tadā `jvaratvara` [[6.4.20]] ityādinā vakārasyopathāyāścotvam| yadā `urvī turvī thurvī hiṃsārthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-569,570,571) ityasya, tadā <> [[6.4.21]] iti rakāralopaḥ, pūrvavaddīrghaḥ|`sūrtam` iti| `sṛ gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-935) utvasanniyoge raparatvam, pūrvaddīrghaḥ| `gūrtam` iti| `gurī udyamāne` [`gūrī` -prāṃu|pāṭha] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1396)|`ghṛtaspṛk` iti| atra śakārasya vivṛttakaraṇasya āāsānupradānasyāghoṣasya tādṛśa eva khakāraḥ, tasya jaśtvam -gakāraḥ| gakārasyāpi cartvam -kakāraḥ|atha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na kvina ityevocyeta, na hi kvin? pratyayatvaṃ vyabhicarati| evamucyamāne lopāpavādaḥ kvina eva kutvaṃ syādityetacca nāśaṅkanīyam, tathā hi -kvinniti pratyayagrahaṇaṃ yatra pratyayagrahaṇaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho|pa|sū|7) kvinnanta upasthāpite kvino lope kartavye kutvasyāsiddhatvāt? pūrvaṃ lopenaiva bhavitavyam| tasmin? sati paścādbhavatkutvaṃ pariśiṣṭasya dhātoreva bhaviṣyiti? ityata āha -`kvinaḥ kuriti vaktavye` ityādi| asati hi pratyayagrahaṇe kvinpratyayāntasyaiva padāntasya syāt, mānyapratyayāntasya, tasyāpi ceṣyate| tasmāt? pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| pratyayagrahaṇe sati bahuvrīhirlabhyate| tena bahuvrīhiṇā yasmādvihitaḥ sa dhāturūpalakṣyata iti sarvasya sidhyati| `māno aruāāk, māno adrāk` iti| `sṛja visarge` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1414) `dṛkṣir? prekṣaṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-988), luṅ, cleḥ sic? [[3.1.44]] , tip, <> [[6.1.58]] ityamāgamaḥ, `vadavraja` [[7.2.3]] ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] , aḍāgamaḥ, anena kṛtvam| `sṛjidṛśibhyāṃ kvinvihitaḥ` iti| `ṛtvik` [[3.2.59]] ityādinā sṛjeḥ kvinvihitaḥ| dṛśerapi `tyavādiṣu duśeranālocane kañca` [[3.2.60]] ityanena| kathaṃ punaratrāḍāgamaḥ, yāvatā `na māṅayoge` [[6.4.74]] iti pratiṣiddho'so?
