ityāha-īṭ? ca na bhavati` ityādi|pratyayagrahaṇādyathā kvinpratyayasya lugantasya kṛtvaṃ bhavati, dṛgbhyāmityā daudṛśeḥ kvibantasyāpi| `evam` ityādi| pratyayagrahaṇāt? kvinpratyayo yasmādvihitaḥ, tasyānyapratyayāntasyāpi kutvaṃ bhavatītyasminnarthe vyavasthite rajjusṛṅbhyāmityatrāpi brāścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatvaṃ yat? prāpnoti tadbādhitvā kṛtvena bhavitavyam| `atha tu neṣyate, pratividhānaṃ kartavyam` iti| [nāsti -prāṃu|pāṭhe] pratividhānamuttarasūtre vāgrahaṇaṃ yat? tadubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca, teneha na bhaviṣyatīti| evañca sati rajjusṛbhyām, rajjusṛṅbhya iti bhavitavyam||`jīvanaṅāhutiḥ` iti| atrākutvapakṣe vraścādisūtreṇa [[8.2.36]] ṣatve kṛte jaśtvam -ḍakāraḥ||`padasya` iti vartate| tacca dhātusamānādhikaraṇaṃ makāreṇa viśeṣyate -makārāntasya padasya dhātoriti| `praśān, pratān? iti| `śamu upaśame` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1201), `tamu kāṅkṣāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1202), kvip, <> [[6.4.15]] ityupadhādīrghatvam, halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] | atheha <> [[8.2.7]] ti nakāralopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`natvasya` ityādi||`aganma` iti| <> [[3.4.98]] iti sakāralopaḥ| `jaganvān` iti| gamerliṭ, kvasuḥ, halṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogāntalaupau [[8.2.23]] , `sāntamahataḥ` [[6.4.10]] iti dīrghaḥ, `gamahana` [[6.4.98]] ityādinopadhālopaḥ| <> [[6.4.86]] iti sārvadhātukatvaṃ na bhavati| cakāraḥ `dhātauḥ` ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ||`sajūḥ` iti| `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1288), saha jaṣata iti kvip, upapadasamāsaḥ, <> [[6.3.78]] iti sabhāvaḥ| rutve kṛte `rvorupadhāyāḥ` [[8.2.76]] iti dīrghaḥ| sajuvo grahaṇamasakārāntārtham| yogaścāyaṃ jaśtvāpavādaḥ||`dāśeḥ` [`dāśateḥ` -kāśikā] iti| `dāśṛ dāne` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-882) ityasmāṇṇvini kṛta iti| vahidāśibhyāṃ `mantre otavahokthaśaspuroḍāśo ṇvin` [[3.2.71]] ityanena, yajeśca `āve yajaḥ` [[3.2.72]] iti ṇvinpratyayāntebhyaḥ sambuddhiḥ, tasyā halaṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] , tataḥ `otavāhādīnāṃ ḍaspadasya` (vā|263) iti ḍaspradasya` ṭilopaḥ| kimarthamete nipātyante, yāvatā otavobhyām, otavobhirityevamādyartham? `otavāhādīnāṃ ḍaspadasya` ityadaśyamidaṃ vaktavyam, ḍasi ca kṛte <> [[8.2.66]] ityeva siddham? ityāha -`otavāhādīnām` ityādi| naite rutvārtha nipātyante, kiṃ tarhi? sambuddhau dīrghatvārtham| nanu ca drīrghatvamapyeṣāṃ <> [[6.4.14]] ityeva siddham? ityata āha -`atvasantasya ca` ityādi| tatra hi <> [[6.4.8]] ityataḥ `asambuddhau` ityetadanuvartate, tena sambuddhau dīrghatvaṃ prāpnotīti, tadarthamete nipātyante| `puroḍāḥ` iti| `mantre otavahokthaśas` [[3.2.71]] ityādinaiva sūtadreṇa dakārasya ḍakāro nipātyate| `ukthaśāḥ` iti| `śansu stutau` (dā|pā|728)| ukthāni śaṃsatīti `mantre otavaha` [[3.2.71]] ityādinaiva ṇvin, tataḥ pūrvavat? sambuddhyādiḥ||<> [[8.2.7]] iti nalope prāpte vidhīyate| ` ahobhyām, ahobhiḥ` iti| `haśi ca` [[6.1.110]] ityutvam, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | `dīrghāho nidāghaḥ` [`darghāhā` -kāśikā, prācīnamudritanyāsapāṭhaśca] iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ [[6.1.66]] , rutvasyāsiddhatvāt? `sarvanāmasthāne ca` [[6.4.8]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ, `bhobhagoadho` [[8.3.7]] ityādinā rephasya yakāraḥ, tasya <> [[8.3.22]] iti lopaḥ| `he dīrghāho'tri` iti| <> [[6.1.113]] ityutvam; <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] , <> [[6.1.109]] iti parapūrvatvam| hanterlaṅi tipā halṅyādilope [[6.1.66]] kṛte tipaśca lukyaḍāgame cāhannityetadrūpaṃ sampadyate, tasmāttasya rutvena bhavitavyam? iti kasayacidbhāntiḥ syāt, atastannirāsāyāha -`ahan` ityādi|upasaṃkhyānaśabdo'tra pratipādane vartate| ahno rūvidhau kartavye rūpādiṣu rutvasya pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam -pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāhro rūpādiṣu rutvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `ahorūpam` iti| ahno rūpamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| kathaṃ punā rātriśabda ucyamānaṃ rutvaṃ rātraśabde bhavati? sthānivadbhāvāt, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādvā| rātraśabdāsya tu grahaṇaṃ na kṛtam, rātriśabdasyāpi yathā syāt -gatamaho rātrirāgateti| `aho rathantaram` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atha vā -asamāsa eva| `ro'supi` ityasyāpavādo rutvam` ityādi| ahorūpamityādi yadi samāsaḥ, yadyasamāso vā, sarvathā vibhakterlukā bhavitavyam| luki satyahno ravidhau lumatā lupte [[1.1.62]] pratyayalakṣaṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ| tena supparatvasyābhāvāt? <<ro'supi>> [[8.2.69]] ityetat? prāpnotīti rutvaṃ vidhīyate| kimartham? `haśi ca` [[6.1.110]] ityutvaṃ yathā syāt| yadi rurudutpannasya syāt, utvavidhau `roḥ` ityukārānubandhaviśiṣṭasya rephasyānuvṛtteḥ||bhuvaḥśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭha tapratirūpakamavyayam, tasya nityaṃ rutve prāpte pakṣe repho yatā syādityevamarthamidam| cakāra ubhayathetyasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tenottaratrānuvṛttirna bhavati| `bhuvo viāsya` iti| mūśabdasya ṣaṣṭhantasya pañcamyantasya vā prayogaḥ| yadyevam, lākṣaṇikatvādevāsya [`lākṣaṇikatvādināsya` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] na bhaviṣyati, tatkimennivṛttyarthena mahāvyāhmatigrahaṇena? evaṃ tahrretajjñāpayati -anityalakṣaṇā pratipadoktaparibhāṣeti| tena krāpayatītyatara pugāgamaḥ siddho bhavati, nityatve tu tasya na syāt, asyākārāntasya lākṣaṇikatvāt| kīdṛśī bhuvaḥśabdo mahāvyāhmatirbhavati? ityāha -`bhuvasityetat` ityādi| antarikṣaṃ hi mahat, tasya vyāhmatiḥ=uktitaryasmāt; tasmānmahāvyāhmatirbhavati||`vidvadbhyām` iti| <> [[7.1.36]] iti vasurādeśaḥ| `papivadbhyām, papivadbhiḥ` iti| pivateḥ pātervā liṭ, kvasuḥ, `vasvekājādghāsām` [[7.2.67]] itīṭ, <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ, sthānivadbhāvena `pā` ityetaddvirucyate| `ukhāruāt, parṇadhvat` iti ruāṃsidhvaṃsibhyām -ukhāyāḥ ruāṃsate, parṇāni dhvaṃsata iti kvip, `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] iti nalopaḥ| ihedaṃ vasordatvamanavakāśam, sarvasya viṣayasya vidhyantareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvāt; tathāpi vidvānityādau saṃyogāntalopaḥ prāpnoti, vidvadbhyāmityādau tu rutvam| atastadanavakāśatvādyadā rutvaṃ bādhate tadā saṃyogāntalopo'pi tena bādhitavyaḥ, tataśca vidvāniti na sidhyatīti tasya vyāmohaḥ syāt, taṃ pratyāha-`rutve nāprāpte` ityādi| `yasminnāprāpte yo vidhirārabhyate sa tasya bādhako bhavati` (vyā|pa|49), na cāprāpte rutva idamārabhyate, atastadeva datvena bādhyate| `saṃyogāntalopastu naivam` iti| tuśabdo rutvādviśeṣaṃ darśayati| itikaraṇo hetau| yathā rutvaṃ sarvatra prāpnoti naivaṃ syogāntalopaḥ| sa hi vidvānityādāveva prāpnoti, na vidvadbhacāmityādau| tasmāt? tenaiva datvaṃ bādhyate, na tvasau datvena; saṃyogāntalope kartavye dattvasyāsiddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| ata yathā `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] ityasya dakāro'trāpavādaḥ, tathā sa [`sa tathā` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] <> [[7.1.82]] ityasyāpi kasmānna bhavati, yatā hravakāśatvāddakāro ḍhatvasya bādhakastathā numo'pi bādhaka eva yuktaḥ? ityata āha -`numastu vidhānasāmarthyānna bhavati` iti| pratipadaṃ hi `sāvanaḍuhaḥ` num? vidhīyate, tasya yadyayaṃ dakāro'pavādaḥ syāt, numvadhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| `anaḍvān` iti| <> [[7.1.98]] ityām, yaṇādeśaḥ, halṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogānta [[8.2.23]] lopau| `he anaḍvan` iti| <> [[7.1.99]] ityam| seṣaṃ pūrvavat||rvorupadhāyāḥ| rca, v ca rvau, tayoriti vigrahaḥ| `sipi dhāto rurvā` ityato dhātorityanuvartate| rvoriti tadviśeṣaṇaṃ, tatastadantavidhiḥ| `padasye`tyadhikṛtam| `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ` ityato'nte ityanuvartate| tadāha -rephetyādinā| pipaṭhīriti| ṭhakārādikārasya dīrghe rephasya visarga iti bhāvaḥ| pipaṭhībhryāmiti| `svādiṣu` iti padatvāt `rvorupadhāyāḥ` iti bhyāmādau padāntatvalakṣaṇe dīrgha iti bhāvaḥ| supi viśeṣamāha -vā śarīti| pipaṭhiṣ-su iti sthite ṣatvasyā'siddhatvādrutve, dīrghe, visarjanīye, tasya satvaṃ bādhitvaṃ `vā śarī`ti vikalpena visarjanīyaḥ| tadabhāvapakṣe visarjanīyasya satvamityarthaḥ| tatra visarjanīyapakṣe pipaṭhīḥ-su iti sthite,iṇkavargābhyāṃ paratvā'bhāvāt `ādeśapratyayayoḥ` iti ṣatve aprāpte-|`acakāstvam` iti| rutve kṛte tasya visarjanīyaḥ, tasya <> [[8.3.34]] iti sakāraḥ| `tvam` iti anuprayogaḥ sipo'bhivyaktaye| atha dhātugrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā sakārāntasyāpi rephadakārāvucyete, na ca sipi sakārāntāddhātoranyadasti? ityata āha -`dhātugrahaṇam` ityādi| uttarārthatā cāsva `rvorupadhāyāḥ` [[8.2.76]] ityatra darśayiṣyate| kriyatāmuttarārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇam, rugrahaṇaṃ tu na kartavyam; anarthakatvāt; dakāre hi vikalpite yathāprāptaṃ rutvaṃ pakṣe labhyata eva? ityata āha -`rugrahaṇaṃ ca` iti| uttarārthamityapakṣate| `daśca` [[8.2.75]] iti vakṣyati, tatra pakṣe rutvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| asati hi tasmin? yadā datvaṃ na bhavati, tadā yathāprāptaṃ catvaṃ na syāt||cakāreṇa `daḥ` [[8.2.72]] ityanukṛṣyate, tenottaratra tasyānuvṛttirna bhavati| `abhinastvam` iti| laṅ, rudhāritvāt? śnam||padasyetyeva, dhātoriti ca, tadubhayamiha samānādhikaraṇaṃ rephavakārābhyāṃ viśeṣyate, viśe ṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha -`rephavakārāntasya` iti| vakārasyodāharaṇaṃ kasamānna pradarśitam? catur -ityubhayaṃ prātipadikamatra, tena na bhavati| `smeryate` iti| bhāve yak, `guṇorttisaṃyogādyoḥ` [[7.4.29]] iti guṇaḥ| `bhavyam` iti| `aco yat` [[3.1.97]] guṇaḥ; <> [[6.1.80]] ityavādeśaḥ||pūrvaṃ rephavakārāntasya ghātordīrghatvavidhānādarephavakārāntārthamidam| upadhāyāmiti subvyatyayena ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanasya sthāne saptamyekavacanam| `upadhābhūtau` iti| upadhātvaṃ prāptāvityarthaḥ| alo'ntyāt? pūrvau iti yāvat| `halparo` iti| hal? para ābhyāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| sa punarhal? dhātvavayava eva veditavyaḥ| yatra hi pratyayāvayavo rephavakārābhyāṃ halparastatra pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ| `hūrchitā` iti| `hucrcha kauṭilye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-211)| `mūcchatā` iti| `mucrchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-212)| nanu ca <> [[8.4.46]] iti dvirvacane kṛte repho'tropadhā na bhavati? naitadasti; dīrghatve kartavye dvirvacanasyāsiddhatvācchakāro'traika eva haliti bhavatyevopadhātvaṃ rephasya| `ciriṇoti, jiriṇoti` iti| `ri kṣi ciri jiri dāśa dṛ hiṃsāyām` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1275-1280) svāditvātśnuḥ`|iha `rī gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1500), `dhī gatiprajanādiṣu` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1048)-etābhyāṃ liṭ, atusi, usi ca, `eranekācaḥ` [[6.4.82]] iti yaṇādeśaḥ; tasya sthānivadbhāvāddvirvacane kṛte `riryatuḥ, riryuḥ; vivyatuḥ vivyu` iti sthite'bhyāsekārasya dīrghasya prāpnoti, halparayo rephavakārayorupadhābhūtatvāt| etatkasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`riryatuḥ, riryaḥ` ityādi| sthānivadbhāvaḥ <> [[1.1.57]] ityādinā| nanu ca `na padānta` [[1.1.57]] ityādinā dīrghavidhau pratiṣidhyate sthānivadbhāvaḥ, tat? kutastasyeha sambhavaḥ? naitadasti; parigaṇanaṃ hi tatra kriyate -`svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivat` (kā|vṛ|1.1.59) itiḥ `asiddhatvādvā` ityādi| atra bahiraṅgatvaṃ yaṇādeśasya; aṅgādhikāre vidhīyamānasya pratyayāśritatvāt| dīrghatvasya tvantaraṅgatvam; prakṛtyāśrayatvāt| `asiddhañca bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) iti dīrghatve kartavye yaṇādeśa syāsiddhatvādrephavakārau halparau na bhavatiḥ, tatkuto dīrghatvasya prāptiḥ| iha tarhi caturyiteti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati, atra hi `caturya` ityasya kyajantasya dhātostṛci parataḥ <> [[6.4.48]] ityakāralope kṛta upadhābhūto repho halparo bhavatītyasti dīrghatvasya prāptiḥ, ityāha -`caturyitetyatrāpi` ityādi| bahiraṅgatvamato lopasyārthadhātukāśraya syāt| dīrghasyāntaraṅgatvaṃ pūrvavat| tarhi pratidīvnetyatrāpi dīrghatvaṃ na syāt| yathaiva hi caturyitetyatra dhātorupadhā repho na bhavati, tathā pratidīvnetyatrāpi vakāraḥ| tathā hi -dīvyetyetāvān? dhātuḥ, nakārastu pratyaya sambandhī; na ca diverdhātorvakara upadhābhūtaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? antabhūtaḥ? ityata āha -`pratidīvnetyatra` ityādi| pratipūrvāddivaḥ `kanin? yuvuṣitakṣi` (da|u|6|51) ityādinā kavin, <<allopo'naḥ>> [[6.4.134]] ityakāralopaḥ| nanu ca <> [[1.1.57]] ityallopasya sthāvivadbhāvāddhali parato vakārānto'tra dhāturna bhavati| tatkathaṃ `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghatvam? ityāha -`dīrghavidhau` ityādi| sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhastu `na padānta` [[1.1.57]] ityādinā| nanvevamapi bahiraṅgalakṣaṇasiddhatvādallopasya naivātra hali parato vakārānto dhāturupapadyate? ityāha -`asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam` ityādi| anāśrayaṇasya tu heturanityatvamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ| anityatvaṃ tu `nalopaḥ supsvara` [[8.2.2]] ityādau sūtre tugvidhigrahaṇājjñāpitam| atha jivriḥ, kiryorityādau `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati jivriśabdo'pyayame vaṃ vyutpādyate, `jīryateḥ krin? raśca vaḥ` (da|u|1-80) iti| `jṛṣ? [`jṛṣa`-dhātupāṭhaḥ-] jhṛṣ? [`jhṛṣa` -dhātupāṭhaḥ-] vayohānau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1130,1131) ityasmāt? krinpratyayaḥ; `ṛta iddhātoḥ` [[7.1.100]] itīttvam, raparatvam, rephasya vakāra ādeśaḥ -ityevaṃ vyutpattau jivrirityetasya vakārāntasya dhāto rephe hali parataḥ `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] ityasti dīrghatvasya prāptiḥ| kiriḥ girirityevamādīnāmapi śabdānāmevaṃ vyutpattiḥ kriyate| `aca iḥ` (da|u| 1-67) ityata ipratyaye'nuvartamāne `bhujeḥ kicca` (da|u| 1-71) iti ca `kṛgṛśṛpṛkuṭibhidicchidibhyaśca` (da|u| 1-72) itikiratiprabhṛtibhyo dhātubhya ipratyayaṃ vidhāya vyutpādyanta ete| evaṃ hi vyutpattāvosi yaṇādeśe kṛte yakāre hali parato rephāntānāṃ kiriprabhṛtīnāṃ `hali ca` [[8.2.77]] iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āha -`uṇādayo'vyutpannāni` ityādi| nanu ca kiryoḥ, giryorityatra vyutpattipakṣe'pi dīrghatvaṃ na prasajati, na hyatra hali parataḥ kiratigiratī rephāntau, dīrghatve kartavye yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāt? svarāvilopeṣu hi lopājādeśo na sthānivat, anyastu sthānivadeva? satyametat; abhyupagamyevaṃ parihāra uktaḥ| evaṃ manyate -bhavatyaviśeṣeṇa sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, tathāpi naivātra dīrghatvaṃ prasajyeta; avyutpannatvāduṇādīnāmiti| yadyuṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikānīti, na hi tatraiva sūtre vyutpattipakṣaścāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ, yo'pi `āto maninkvanibvaniyaśca` [[3.2.74]] iti `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante` (3|2 75) iti kvanippratyayānta pratidivañśabdaṃ vyutpādayeta tasyāpi naiva dīrghatvaṃ sidhyati, `lopovyorvali` [[6.1.66]] iti vakāralope kṛte dhātoravakārāntatvāditi? kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ| eva kriyate-`hali ca` [[8.2.77]] ityatra `vyāktaḥ padārthaḥ` ityetaddarśanamāśrīyate| asmaśca darśane pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇabhedo bhavatīti yāvanti lakṣyāṇi tāvantyeva lakṣaṇāmyupadiśanti, tatra bhinneṣu lakṣyānurodhāt? kvacit? pratidīvnetyādau vyutpattipakṣa āśrīyate; kvacit? punarjivriḥ, kiryoḥ, giryorityādāvavyutpattipakṣa iti| cakāro halotyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ||`hāli ca` [[8.2.70]] iti dīrghatve prāpte pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate| `dhuryaḥ` iti| `dhuraṃ vahatīti `dhurī yaṅḍhakau` [[4.4.77]] iti yat| `kuryāt` iti| karoteliṅ, `tanādikṛñbhya u` [[3.1.79]] , dhātorguṇaḥ, raparatvam, `ata ut? sārvadhātuke` [[6.4.110]] ityuttvam, `ye ca` [[6.4.109]] ityukāralopaḥ| `kuryāt` iti| āśiṣi liṅ| karotervikaraṇena nirdeśaścikīrṣatītyatra pratiṣedho mā bhūvityevamarthaḥ||`aseḥ` itīkāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| avidyamānaḥ sakāro yasya sa tathoktaḥ| yaścaivaṃvidhaḥ sa sakārānto na bhavatītyāha -`asakārāntasya` ityādi| `amum` ityādi| adaso'mādiṣu tyadādyatve <> [[6.1.97]] pararūpatve ca kṛte'si [[6.1.103]] pūrvatvam| auṭi, <> [[6.1.88]] iti vaddhiḥ| śasi prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam| atra sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.49]] ekavacane mātrikasya mātrika eva bhavati, anyatra dvimātrikasya dvimātrikaḥ nanu ca mātrikaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ, tatkathaṃ dvimātriko labhyate? `aṇudit? savarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ` [[1.1.69]] iti savaraṇagrahaṇāditi cet? na; `bhāvyamāno'ṇ? savarṇān? na gṛhṇāti` (vyā|pa|35) iti pratiṣedhādityata āha -`bhāvyamāno'pi` ityādi| etacca `ṛta ut` [[6.1.107]] ityatra taparakaraṇena jñāpitam|`adasyati` iti| `supa kṣātmanaḥ kyac` [[3.1.8]] |`adaso'noruā iti vaktavyam` iti| okārasakārarephāṇāṃ dvandvaḥ, avidyamānnā oruāo'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ| ado'treti napuṃsakatvāt? `svamornapuṃsakāpta` [[7.1.23]] iti sorluk, sakārasya rutve <> [[6.1.113]] iti rorutvam, <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] , <> [[6.1.109]] iti parapūrvatvam| idamīkārapratiṣedhasya pratyudāharaṇam| `adaḥ` iti| etattu rephapratiṣedhasya| rutve kṛte visarjanīyaḥ| `tadartham` iti| sakārarephayorapi pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamartham| `aḥ seryasya` iti| sakāra [nāsti-kāṃu|pāṭhe] uccāraṇārthaḥ| akāraḥ sakārasya yasyetyarthaḥ| `katham` ityādi| yadā'daso'draādeśaḥ kriyate, tadedamadaso'dreśca pṛthaṅmutvaṃ bhavati? utāntyasadeśasya? āhosvidadraādeśaviṣaye na bhavatyeva? ityetat? pṛcchati| `adaso'draḥ` ityādi| maśca uśca muḥ, tasya bhāvo mutvam| adaso'dreścobhayorapi kecinmutvamicchantītyarthaḥ| vināpi hi cakāreṇa tadartho gamyate| tadyathā -aharaharnayamāno gāmaāṃ puruṣaṃ paśumityādau vākye| katham? yathetyāha -`lattvavata` iti| yathā calīkḷpyata ityatra <> [[8.2.18]] iti dhāto rephasya rīśabdasya cobhayorapi latvamicchanti, tadvadadaśaḥ, adreśca mutvam| `kecidantyasadeśasya` iti| adraādeśa ikārāntaḥ, tasya kecidutvamicchanti| sa punaradraādeśasambhandhī dakāro rephaśca| `netyeke` iti| apare tu -yadā'daso'draādeśaḥ kriyate tadā na bhavitavyameva mutvenetīcchanti| atraiva kāraṇamāha -`aserhi dṛśyate` iti| aḥ seryasya so'yamasiḥ, tasyāseḥ| hiśabdo yasyādarthe| yasmāt? sakārasya sthāne yasyādaso'kāro bhavati tasya pajḍitairmutvaṃ dṛśyate| na ca kṛtādraādeśasyādasaḥ sakārasya sthāne'tvaṃ bhavati; vibhakteḥ parahasya nimittasyānāvāt| tasmāt? na tasya mutvena bhavitavyamiti|`yaiḥ` ityādinā ślokasya pūrvārdha vyācaṣṭe| aserati sakārasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate-nāsya sirvidyata ityevaṃ vyācakṣāṇaiḥ| `ubhayorapi` iti| adasaḥ, adreśca| `amumuyaṅ` ityādi| adoñcatīti ṛtvigityādinā (32|59) sūtreṇāñcateḥ kvin, `aniditām` [[6.4.24]] iti nalopaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ, `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num, halṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogānta [[8.2.23]] lopau| ekavacane `kvingratyayasya kuḥ` [[8.2.62]] iti kutvam -nakārasya ṅkāraḥ| anyatra `na ścāpadāntasya jhali` [[8.3.24]] ityanusvāraḥ, <> [[8.4.58]] iti parasavarṇo ñakāraḥ, [`ṅakāraḥ` -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] <<ā sarvanāmnaḥ>> [[6.3.91]] ityataḥ `sarvanāmnaḥ` ityamuvartamāne <> [[6.3.92]] ityadaḥ śabdasya ṭeradraādeśaḥ, pūrvasmāddakārāduttarasyotvam, dakārasya matvam, dvitīyasmādapi dakārādraphasyotvam, dakarasya matvam -amumuyaṅ, amumuyañcāviti bhavati| `yathā` ityādinā latvavadityasthārthamācaṣṭe| `calīkḷpyate` iti| `kṛpū sāmarthye` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-762)| atyantaṃ kalpata iti yaṅ, dvirvacanam, `urat` [[7.4.66]] ityattvam, <> [[7.4.60]] , `rīgṛdapadhasya ca` [[7.4.90]] iti rīk, `kuhoścaḥ` [[7.4.62]] iti cutvam, `kupo ro laḥ` [[8.2.18]] ityubhayorapi latvam; `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya` (vyā|pa|63) iti paribhāṣānāśrayaṇāt| `ye tu` ityādinā `kecidantyasadeśasya` ityasyārtha kathayanti| `adamuyaṅ, adamuyañcau` iti| atrādridakārāderuttarasyotvam, adridakārasyaiva ca matvam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| `yeṣāṃ tu`[`teṣāṃ tu` -prāṃu|pāṭhe] ityādinā `eke` ityādevryākhyānam| keṣāṃ punastyadādyatvaviṣaya eva mutvena bhavitavyam? ye `aḥ seyaṃsya so'yamasistasyāseḥ` ityevaṃ varṇayanti teṣām| `atra` iti| adraādeśaviṣaye naiva bhavitavyamiti;tyadādyatvābhāvāt| adadraṅa, adadraāñcau, adadrañcaḥ` iti| pūrvavat| mubhāvastu viśeṣaḥ| `amuyā, amuyoḥ` iti| adasastṛtīyaikavacana osi ca paratastyadādyatvam, [[7.2.102]] ṭāp, ekādeśaḥ, tasya <> [[6.1.85]] iti pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvo dādudograhaṇenaiva grahaṇam| atra yadi dāditi nocyeta tadā <<āṅi cāpaḥ>> [[7.3.105]] , `osi ca` [[7.3.104]] iti ṅityetve kṛte tasya cāyādeśe'lontyaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.51]] yakārasyaivotvaṃ syāt| dāditi vacanānna bhavati| uditi taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham||`bahuvacana ityarthavirdeśo'yam` iti| anvarthanirdeśa ityarthaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati -nedaṃ pāribhāṣikasya bahuvacanasya grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? anvarthasya grahaṇam -bahunāmarthānāmuktiḥ bahuvacanamiti| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyātam? ityāha -`pāribhāṣikasya hi` ityādi| yadi pāribhāṣikasya bahuvacanasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, amī ityatra na syāt| na hyatraikārāt? paraṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ bahuvacanamasti| anvarthagrahaṇe tvatrāpi bahunāmaryānāmabhidhānamastīti sidhyati| anvarthagrahaṇaṃ tu vyāptinyāyāllabhyate -eva iti ekārasya sthānivattvaṃ yathā vijñāyeta| `eḥ` ityucyamāne, ikārasyāpi sthānitvamāśaṅkyeta| kiñca syāt? adraādeśe kṛte tadavayava syekārasya yaṇādeśo bādhitaḥ syāt| īditi takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ||`vākyagrahaṇam` ityādi| asati hi vākyagrahaṇe vākye yāvanti padāni teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva plutaḥ prasajyeta| vākyagrahaṇe tvantyasyaiva bhaviṣyati, nānantyasya| antyasyaiva hi padasya yaṣṭiḥ sa vākyaṭirbhavati, na tvitarasya| tasmādanantyasya padasya plutau mā bhūt, antyasyaiva yatā syādityevamartham| anantyasya kasmānna bhavati? aniṣṭatvāt| na hi padādhikārasya nivṛttiriṣyate, tathā hi prāguktam -padādhikāraḥ prāgapadāntādhikārāditi| asatyatvācca; na hi vākyagrahaṇena vākye yāvanti padānti teṣāṃ sarveṣām| eka eva hi vākyasya ṭiḥ, sa niyogataḥ padasyāpi bhavati, ato na yuktā vākyasya padādhikāranivṛttyarthatā| atha ṭigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'lo'ntyaparibhāṣayaiva [[1.1.52]] āyuṣmānedhi devadatta3 ityatra ṭeḥ pluto bhaviṣyati? ityatra āha -`ṭigrahaṇam` ityādi| asati hi ṭigrahaṇe yathā `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya` [[1.2.47]] iti hrasvagrahaṇegha samurtthāpite `acaḥ` [[1.2.28]] ityetasminnacā prātipadike viśeṣite tasyājantasyaiva hrasvatvaṃ bhavati, nānajantasya -suvāg? brāāhṛṇakulamiti; tathehāpi plutagrahaṇena `acaḥ` ityetasminnupasthāpite satyacā vākye viśeṣite'jantasyaiva plutaḥ syāt, na vyañjanāntasya| ṭigrahaṇe tu sati ṭisaṃjñakenājviśeṣyate, na tvacā ṭisaṃjñakaḥ| yadi hracā ṭisajñako viśeṣyeta, tato'janto yaṣṭistasya plutaḥ syāt; tathā cānarthakaṃ hi ṭigrahaṇaṃ syat| vināpi tenācā vākye viśeṣite tasyājantasya pluto bhavannalo'ntyaparibhāṣayā [[1.1.51]] 'ntyasyācaḥ sidhyati| tasmāṭṭigrahaṇasya nānarthakyamiti| ṭisaṃjñakenājviśeṣa,yate -ṭisaṃjñako yo'jiti| evaṃ ca sati vyañjanasyāpi ṭeryo'c? tasyāpi plutaḥ sidhyati| `agnici3tta` iti| avyañjanāntasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena -devadatta3 iti| tasmādvyañjanāntasyāpi ṭeracaḥ pluto yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ṭigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam|udāttagrahaṇaṃ tu svarāntaranivṛttyartham, taccānantodāttaṃ prayojayati; yohrantodāttastatra sthānivadbhāvādevāncodātto bhavati||`yadabhivādyamāno guruḥ` ityādi| atra sāmānyopakrameṇa viśeṣasyānabhidhānād? yaditi napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ| `āyuṣmānedhi devadatta3` iti| idamatrodāharaṇam; pratyabhivādavākyatvāt| atra `abhivādaye devadatto'ham` ityetattu gurorabhivādyamānatāṃ darśayitumupanyastam| abhivādyamāno gururyāmāśiṣaṃ prayuṅkte sa pratyabhivādaḥ| tatrāvaśyaṃ gurorabhivādyamānatā darśayitavyā; anyathā pratyabhivādo na gamyeta| `edhi` iti| bhavetyarthaḥ| `asa bhuvi` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1065), loṭ, madhyamapuruṣaikavacanam, `sehrrapicca` [[3.4.87]] , dhvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca` [[6.4.119]] ityettvam, <<śnasorallopaḥ>> [[6.4.111]] ityakāralopaḥ, <> [[6.4.101]] iti dhirādeśaḥ| `vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -<> [[8.2.74]] ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vetyanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena striyāṃ na bhaviṣyatīti| `asūyake'pi` iti| asūyatītyasūyakaḥ| yo gurumasādhbyā pravṛttyā sāmarṣa karoti sa ucyate'sūyaka iti| `tasmin` ityādinā pratiṣedha iṣyamāṇo'pi na vaktavya iti darśayati| yadā hrasāvabhivādayitā'sūyakatvena na nijrñāyate, tadā tenābhivādyo guruḥ pratyabhivādane tasya plutaṃ karotyeva| yadā tu `asūyako'yaṃ māṃ viheḍayitukāmaḥ` ityevaṃ vijñāto bhavati, tadātra pratyabhivādanā nāstyeveti kiṃ pratiṣedhena! kathaṃ punajrñāyate -tatrāsūyakatvena nijrñāte pratyabhivādo nāsti? ityāha -`tathā ca` ityādi| kenāpyavinītenopagamyāvidhinābhiprāyeṇābhivādaye'yaṃ bhoḥ sthālītyevamabhivādite gurustasyāsūyakatvamajñātvā sthāliñśabdo'yamasya saṃjñeti matvā pratyabhivādayan? plutaṃ prayuktavān -`āyuṣmānedhi sthāli3n` iti| atha so'vinīta uktavān -naiṣa mama saṃjñā, mayā daṇḍinyāyo vivakṣitaḥ| tato guruḥ plutarahitaṃ pratyabhivādanaṃ kṛtavān -`āyuṣmānedhi sthālinniti| punaḥ sa uktavān -na na mayā daṇḍinyāyo vivakṣitaḥ, saṃjñā mamaiṣeti; atha sa gururasūyakatvamasya vijñāyonatavān -`asūyakastvaṃ jālma, na tvaṃ pratyabhivādamarhasi, bhidyatvaṃ vṛṣala sthālin` iti|athābhivādyamāno yadā devadatta kuśalyasi, devadattāyuṣmānedhītyevaṃ pratyabhivādaṃ prayuṅkte tadā kasmāt? pluto na bhavati? ityāha -`abhivādanavānye` ityādi| abhivādyate'nenetyabhivādanam, abhivādanañca tadvākyañcetyabhivādanavākyam| tatra tāvat? saṅkorttitaṃ saṃśabditaṃ nāma devadatto'hamityevam, gotram -vātsyo'hamityevam| yadyatra pratyabhivādavākyasyānte=avasāne prayujyate tatrāyaṃ pluta iṣyate| devadatta kuśalyasītyādau tu yadabhivādanavākye saṅkīrtitaṃ nāma devadattaśabdaḥ, tat? pratyabhivādanavākyasyādau prayuktam, nāvasāne| tasmāt? pluto na bhavati| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate? vetyanuvṛtteḥ, vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca, prādhānyādvā| iha hi pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt? pradhānasya vākyasyānte vartamānasya ṭeḥ plutena bhavitavyam| prādhānyañca padasyārthadvārakam| pradhānasyārthasya yadvācakaṃ padaṃ tat? pradhānaṃ [`pradhāne` -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] cārtho'bhivādayitā, tadanugrahārthatvāt? pratyabhivādasya| tathā hrabhivādayituranuguhītāryaṃ guruḥ pratyabhivādaṃ prayuṅakte| tasmādabhivādayitā saṃskāryaḥ, kuśalitā''yuṣmattādīni tasyaiva saṃskārakāṇi| ato'bhivādayitā saṃskāryatvāt? pradhānam, tasya vācakaṃ padaṃ saṃjñāśabdo gotraśabdaśceti tasyaiva vākyānte vartamānasya ṭeḥ pluto bhavati| yadyapi tiṅantavācyo'rthaḥ sādhyaḥ, na tu tasya sādhyatvamiha prādhānyenāśritam, kiṃ tarhi? saṃskārakatvameva, tasmānna tasyāpi prādhānyam| `bhorājanyaviśām` ityādi| bho iti -svarūpagrahaṇam, rājanya iti -kṣatriyanāmnaḥ, viśa iti -vaiśyanāmnaḥ| atra bhoḥśabdasyāprāpte vibhāṣā, asaṃjñāgotraśabdatvāt| itareṣāṃ tu prāpte; saṃjñāśabdatvāt||`dūrāt` iti| ārāt| `dūrāntikebhyo dvitīyā ca` [[2.3.35]] iti pañcamī| hvānaṃ hūtam| bhāve niṣṭhā| dūrādityucyate, dūrañcānavasthitam| yavevālasyāpahataṃ prati dūraṃ bhavati tadevotsāhasampannaṃ pratyantikam| evaṃ hi kaścit? kañcidāha -ya eṣa pār(ātaḥ karakastamānayeti| sa āha-utthāya gṛhāṇa, dūraṃ gantuṃ na śakṣyāmīti| ato dūrasyānavasthitatvānna jñāyate -kasyāmavasthāyāṃ plutyā bhavitavyamiti| ata āha -`dūram` ityādi| hūtaṃ hvānam| tadapekṣaṃ yaddūraṃ tadihāśrīyate| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāddhūtāpekṣamiha dūramākṣīyate tasmāt? prākṛtāt? prakṛtau bhavāt? prayatnādyaḥ pratyatnaviśeṣaḥ prākṛtayatnādadhikastasyinnāśrīyamāṇe yatra śabdāhvānaṃ tat? śrūyate taddūram| tato na bhavati dūrasyānavasthitatvamitvabhiprāyaḥ| atheha kathaṃ plutaḥ syāt -saktūn? piva devadatta3 iti? na śabdamātraṃ hūtam, api tu śabdaviśedhaḥ, yena parata āgamane niyujyate sa śabdaviśeṣo hūtam, na ca tadihāsti? ityata āha -`hūtagrahaṇaṃ ca` ityādi| sambodhanaṃ śabdasādhanaṃ hūtam| caśabdastasmādityarthe| tena tatsādhyaṃ sambodhanaṃ lakṣyata iti hūtagrahaṇaṃ sambodhanamātropalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam| ihāyaṃ pluto'pi dūrāt? sambodhane vidhīyate; ekaśrutirapi; `ekaśruti dūrāt? sambuddhau` [[1.2.33]] iti; tatraivamekatra prāpnuvatāmanekeṣāṃ bādhāvikalpasamuccayānāmanyatamena bhavitavyam, atra na jñāyate -kimetayoḥ samuccayo bhavati? uta vikalpaḥ? āhosvidanyatarasya bādheti? tatparijñānāyāha -`asyāśca` [`asyāṃ ca` -prāṃu| nyāsapāṭhaḥ`] ityādi| bādhayā tāvanna bhavitavyam; samānaviṣayatvāt| viṣayabhede hi sati bādhyabādhakabhāvo bhavati, tadyathā -`karmaṇyaṇ`[`tattathā` -prāṃuṃyāsapāṭhaḥ] [[3.2.1]] , <<āto'nupasarge kaḥ>> [[3.2.3]] iti; atra hrekasya viśeṣo viṣayaḥ; aparasya sāmānyamityasti viṣayabhedaḥ| anayostu viśeṣo nāstītyayuktā [`nāstītyuktā -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] bādhā| vikalpo'pyayuktaḥ; asahaprāpteḥ| sahaprāptayorhi vikalpo bhavati, yathā -tacyadādīnām| na caikaśrutyapekṣyeha sahaprāptirasti; plutasyāsiddhatvāt| tasmātpāriśeṣyāt? samādeśa eva bhavati| samāveśaḥ punaratraikasmin? vākye pravṛttiḥ, na tvekasminnavayave; diruddhayorekasmin? pravṛtterasambhavāt| vākyasya tvenekāvayavātmakatvāt| ṭeracaḥ plṛto bhavati| avaśiṣṭasya tvekaśrutiriti yujyate samāveśaḥ||pūrvasūtreṇa prādhānyād? hūyamānasyaiva pluto vihitaḥ| prādhānyaṃ tu tasya tadabhimukhīkaraṇāya vākyaprayogāt| ato haihayorna prāpnoti, etadartho'yamārambhaḥ| atha punarhaihayogrrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā vināpi tena śrutatvāt? tayoreva bhaviṣyati? ityāha -`punaḥ` [`punastvityādi` -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| `haiheprayoge` ityucyamāne <> [[8.2.82]] ityadhikārādantyayoreva syāt, nānantyayoḥ; tayorapi yatā syādityevamarthaṃ punarhaihegrahaṇam, haihegrahaṇe prayogagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakayorapi yathā syāt| tadā caitāvanarthako yadā''mantritāntam| tenaivāmantritārthasyāvagamitatvādarthāntasya dyotyasyābhāvāt? tāvanarthakau bhavataḥ| anye tvāhuḥ -nipātasamāhārāvapi tau sto hanta haiha iti| tatrāsati prayogagrahaṇe tayorna syāt; lākṣaṇikatvāt| tasmāt? prayogamātre lākṣaṇikayorapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ prayogagrahaṇamiti||pratyabhivādādiṣu vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udāttaḥ| sa eva tu ṛkāravarjitasya guroranantyasya pluta ucyate| `avtyasyāpi ṭeḥ` iti| anenāpiśabdaṣṭeḥ tamuccayaṃ karotīti darśayati| yadi hrapiśabdena guroḥ samuccayaḥ kriyate, anantyasyāpi,gurorantyasyāpīti, tadānena gurāvanantye plutaḥ| laghurantyaḥ pūrveṇa pluta eva| tataśca dvayoḥ plutayoḥ śravaṇaṃ yugapat? prasajyeta| na ca <> [[6.1.158]] iti vacanānna bhaviṣyatīti śakyaṃ vaktum; tasmin? kartavye plutasyāsiddhatvāt| yadā ṭisaṃjñako'piśabdena samuccīyate tadānenaiva sūtreṇāntyasya[sūtreṇānantyasya -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] guroranantyasya ca ṭeḥ pluto vidhīyate| tatraikaikasyeti vacanādyathānantyasya paryāyo na bhavati, tathāntyasyāpīti na bhavati yaugapadyaprasaṅgaḥ| `ekaikagrahaṇam` ityādi| yadyekaikagrahaṇaṃ na kriyata, tadā pakṣe yugapadeva sarveṣāṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt? paryāyeṇa yathā syādityenamarthamekaikagrahaṇam| etacca `yathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam` (vyā|pa|59) ityāśritya kṛtamiti veditavyam| darśanāntare <> [[6.1.158]] ityasyopasthāne sati na plutayodrvayoryaugapadyaprasaṅgaḥ| atha prācāmiti kima; yāvataikaikagrahaṇādeva vibhāṣā sidhyet? ityata āha -`prācām` iti| sarvasya plutasyetyabhiprāyaḥ| ata evāha -`tadanena` ityādi| apāyahetumavimṛśya pravṛttiḥ=sāhasam||`prārambhaḥ` iti| kasya prārambhe? svādhyāyādeḥ||`yejñakarmaṇi` iti| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī| yajñakriyāyāmityarthaḥ| `ye3 yajāmahe` ityatraivāyaṃ pluta iṣyata ityetacca `prācām` ityasyānuvṛtteḥ, vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyata iti veditavyam||`ka eṣa praṇavo nāma` iti| iha śāstre praṇavasyāparibhāṣitatvālloke cāprasiddhatvāt? praśnaḥ| `pādasya vā` [`pādasya celyādinā` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ityādinā śāstrāntaraparimāṣayā praṇavasvarūpaṃ darśayati| `vāntyamakṣaram` iti| svaro'trākṣaraśabdena vivakṣitaḥ| antyatvaṃ punastasyetarasvarāpekṣayaḥ| `upasaṃgṛhra` iti| gṛhītvetyarthaḥ| tadantyamakṣaramādau yasyākṣaraśeṣasya tat? tadādi| akṣarañca śeṣañceti [iti -nāsti prāṃu|pāṭhe] samāhāre dvandvaḥ| akṣaraṃ svaraḥ, tasya śeṣaḥ vyañjanam, tadāci ca tadakṣaraśeṣañca, tadakṣaraśeṣaṃ yatrāntyāt? svarāt? paraṃ vyañjanaṃ nāsti tatra sa eva| tadādi tasya bahuvrīheranyapadārthaḥ| vyapadeśivadbhāvena tatrāpi tadādivyapadeśo bhavati| yatrāntyāt? svarāt? paraṃ vyañjanamasti tatra saha svareṇa vyañjanamanyapadārthaḥ; tadguṇasaṃvijñānasya bahuvrīherihāśritatvāt| yo'yamanena granthena ṭisaṃjñaka evokto bhavati tadvyakṣaraśeṣasya lthāne yat? trimātranokāram, oṅkāraṃ vā vidavāti tat? praṇavaṃ kathayanti| `jinvato3m` iti| jayateḥ parasya laṭ, tasya śatrādeśaḥ, vyatyayena śnupratyayaḥ, yaṇādeśaḥ; jinvanniti sthite'nśabdasyāntyākṣarādeḥ praṇavaḥ| `sumnayo3m` iti| sumnaśabdāt? kyac, `kyācchabdasi` [[3.2.170]] iti upratyayaḥ, <> [[7.4.38]] iti ābhāvaḥ, sumnāayus? iti sthite usityasyāntyākṣarādeḥ praṇavaḥ|nanu ca ṭisthānikayoreva trimātrayorokāraukārayoḥ praṇava iti paribhāṣā kṛtā| tatrāntareṇāpi ṭigrahaṇaṃ ṭereva bhaviṣyati, tat? kiṃ ṭigrahaṇena? ityata āha -`ṭigrahaṇam` ityādi| asatyatra ṭigrahaṇe vyañjanānteṣvalo'ntyaparibhāṣayā' [[1.1.51]] ntyasyaiva syāt| ataṣṭigrahaṇaṃ kriyate -sarvasyaiva ṭeryathā syāditi| `antyasya mā bhūt` iti| oṅkārasyānekāltvāt? sarvādeśo bhaviṣyatītyokārārthaṃ ṭigrahaṇam||ihāntagrahaṇaṃ ṭerityetasya nivartakaṃ vā syāt? viśeṣaṇaṃ vā? pūrvasmin? pakṣe'cānte viśeṣite'jantāyā eva yājyāyā plutaḥ syāt| itarasmastvantagrahaṇamanarthakam, na hranantyaṣṭiḥ sambhavati; <<aco'ntyādi ṭi>> [[1.1.64]] ityasyaiva ṭiśabdarūpaviśaṣasaṃjñāvidhānādityabhiprāyeṇāha -`antagrahaṇaṃ kim` iti| itaro'pi viditābhiprāyo'nyadevāntagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayitumāha -`yājyā nāma` ityādi| gatārtham||śrauṣaṭ, vauṣaḍiti nipātau; itarāṇi loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanāni| kecittu āvahaśabdo'pi nipāta ityāhuḥ| `preṣya` iti| `īṣu gatau` [divādiṣu `iṣa gatau` ityeva paṭhate] (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1127), divāditvācchyan, upasargākāreṇa saha <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | atheha kasmānna bhavati -`āvaha devān? yajamānāya` (vā|saṃ|5|12), `āvaha jātavedaḥ` (ā|śrau|sū|1.3.22), `suyajā yaja`? ityāha -`āvaha devān` ityādi| ādigrahaṇaṃ vākyādermā bhūditi||agnimintre ityasminnarthe'gnīṭṛtvigviśeṣaḥ, tasya preṣaṇaṃ niyojanamagnītpreṣaṇamityarthaḥ| ādeḥ sannihitatvāt? tadapekṣayaiva paro'pi jñāyata ityāha -`tasmādevādeḥ` ityādi| `atraiva` iti| anantarokta udāharaṇadvaya evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayitumāha -`agnīdagnīn? vihara barhistṛṇīhi` iti| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? ityāha -`tadartham` ityādi| yathā ca sarvatra pluto vibhāṣā śakyo vijñātum, tathā `guroranṛto'nantyasya` [[8.2.86]] ityādau sūtre pratipāditam| yadi tarhi sarvatra pluto vibhāṣā vijñāyeta, uttaratra vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanartham? na; prapañcārthatvāt| atheha kathaṃ plutaḥ -`uddhara3 uddhara, abhihara3 abhihara` iti; svādhyāyakāle hrayaṃplutaḥ, nāgnītpreṣaṇe, na cāyamādeḥ, nāpi <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] , kiṃ tarhi? tato'nyasyaiva? ityata āha-deḥ sannihitatvāt? tadapekṣayaiva parorapi jñāyata ityāha -`tasmādevādeḥ` ityādi| `atraiva` iti| anantarokta udāharaṇadvaya evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayitumāha -`agnīdagnīn? vihara barhistṛṇīhi` iti| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? ityāha -`tadartham` ityādi| yathā ca sarvatra pluto vibhāṣā vijñāyeta, uttaratra vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakam? na; prapañcārthatvāt| atheha kathaṃ plutaḥ -`uddhara3 uddhara, abhihara3 abhiraha` iti; svādhyāyakāle hrayaṃ plutaḥ, nāgnītpreṣaṇe, na cāyamādeḥ, nāpi <<ādeḥ parasya>> [[1.1.54]] , kiṃ tarhi? tato'nyasyaiva? ityata āha -`iha tu` ityādi| vispaṣṭārtham||`pṛṣṭaprativacanam` iti| pṛṣṭasya prativacanamākhyānaṃ pṛṣṭaprativacanam| prativacanaśabdo'yaṃ viruddhe'pi vacane pravartate -viruddhaṃ vacanaṃ prativacanamiti, pratiśabdo hyatra virodhaṃ dyotayati, yathā -pratimallaḥ, pratigaja iti; vīpsāyāmapi vartate -vacanaṃ vacanaṃ pratīti prativacanam, `yathārthe yadavyayam` [[2.1.6]] iti dīpsāyāmavyayobhāvaḥ; samādhāne'pi vartate -yadanenābhihitaṃ tasya mayā prativacanaṃ vihinamiti, samādhirvihita iti gamyate; tatra `prativacane` ityucyamāne sarvatra prasajyeta| tasmāt? prativacanaviśeṣārthaṃ pṛṣṭagrahaṇam| pṛṣṭasya yat? prativacanamrthākhyānaṃ tatraiva yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi||`nigṛhra` iti| lyabantametat| `svatāt` iti| svāvagamāt| `prācyāvanam`[`pracyācanam` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] iti| apanayanam| `āviṣkaraṇam` iti| prakāśanam| `śrāddham` iti| karmaviśeṣaḥ| `evamanuyujyate` iti| evamādiṣkṛtasvamataḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| cakāro vibhāṣetyasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tenottaravidhirnityo bhavati||`caura caura3` iti| `vākyāderāmantritasya` [[8.1.8]] ityādinā bhatrsane dvirvacanam| yadyapi vākyagrahaṇametadantyasya padasya plutanivṛttyartham, tathāpīha vacanasāmarthyādanantyasyāpi bhavati| na hi vākyānte bhatrsana āmreḍitaṃ sambhavati, vākyādereva padasya bhatrsane dvirvacanavidhānāt| `tadartham` iti| paryāyeṇa pūrvottarayoḥ padayoryathā syādityevamartham; dviruktopalakṣaṇārthañca| āmreḍitasya bhatrsanagrahaṇādvijñāyate -taddviruktasya hi yat? paraṃ tadāmreḍitam| na ca tāvatā bhatrsane pravṛttiḥ sambhavati; bhatrsanasya dviruktidyotyatvāt| tasmāddviruktopalakṣaṇārthamāmreḍitagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| taddviruktiśca pūrvottaraviṣaye'pīti dvayorapi pluto bhavati| sa ca paryāyeṇa bhavati, na yaugapadyena; bhatrsanadyotanaphalatvāt? pluteḥ| anyataraplutyaiva ca tadbhatrsanasya dyotitatvāt||`ākāṅkṣam` iti| ākāṅkṣati apekṣata ityākāṅkṣam, pacādyac| `aṅga kūja3` ityādi| aṅgakūja 3, aṅga vyāhara 3 -ityetadubhayamapi `idānīṃ jñāsyati jālma` ityetadapekṣate| `aṅga devadatta` ityetadapi `midhyā vadasi` ityetat| `adhīṣva` ityetadapi `odanaṃ te dāsyāmi` ityetat| `naitadaparamākāṅkṣati` iti| vivakṣitārthasya parisamāptatvāt| atha yuktagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā padavidhitvādeva yogo vijñāsyate| evaṃ tarhi yuktagrahaṇaṃ kurdannetajjñāpayati -<> [[2.1.1]] ityeṣā paribhāṣā'nityā| tenā'sūryampaśyāni mukhānīti naño'satyapi sūryaśabahdena sāmarthye samāsaḥ siddho bhavati||`pramāṇena vastuparīkṣaṇaṃ vicāraḥ| tena viṣayīkriyamāṇāni vicāryamāṇāni| bahuvacananirdeśo yeṣāmarthagata eva vicāro na svarūpagataḥ, teṣāmapi yathā syādityevamarthaḥ; itarathā hi yeṣāṃ svarūpagato vicārasteṣāmeva syāt| na hi mukhye vākye vicāryamāṇe satyarthadvārakaṃ gauṇaṃ yasya vicāryamāṇatvaṃ tasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam| `gṛhā3i` iti| gṛha ityatra ekāraḥ, tasya `eco'pragṛhrasya` [[8.2.107]] ityādinā pūrvārthasyākāraḥ, uttarārdhasya tvikāraḥ| tasyākārasyānena plute bhavati||pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthametat| tuśabdastviṣṭato'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| asati hi tasmin? viparīto'pi niyamo vijñāyeta -bhāṣāyāmeva pūrvamiti| pūrvatvaṃ ca prayogāpekṣam| ahirnu3, rajjurnu3 -ityetayorvākyāyoryat? pūrvaṃ prayujyate tasyaiva ṭeḥ pluto bhavati| iha tu bhāvāgrahaṇāt? pūrvayogāśchandasīti vijñāyate||pratiśrutiḥ pratiśravaṇam| pratipūrvācchṛṇoterbhāve lyuṭ, `kugati` [[2.2.18]] ityādinā tatpuruṣaḥ| pratipūrvasya śaṇotiryadā parānugraho vivakṣyate, tadābhyupagame vartate| atha tvavivakṣā parānugrahasya, tadā pratijñāne| yadā śritiḥ -śravaṇamiti bhāvasādhanena śravaṇaśabdena pratiśabdasya <> [[2.1.14]] ityavyayībhāvaḥ kriyate, tadā śravaṇābhimukhye śravaṇaṃ prati pravṛtta ityarthaḥ| tadiha viśeṣānabhidhānāt? sarvasmin? pratiśravaṇe vākyasya ṭeḥ pluto bhavati| `devadatta bhoḥ kimāttha3` iti| etacchravaṇābhimukhya udāharaṇam| `devatatta bhoḥ` ityāmantritam| tapra śravaṇārthamevamāha -`kimāttha3` iti| ekatra śravaṇamuddiśya pravṛttatvādabhimukhaṃ bhavati| abhyupagame tūdāharaṇam -`gāṃ me dehi bhoḥ, ahaṃ te dadāmi3` iti| pratijñāne -`nityaḥ śabdo bhavitumarmati` iti| cakāro bhāṣāyāmityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ||agama3` iti| gamerluṅ? puvadisūtreṇa [[3.1.55]] lṛdittvādaṅ, sip| `agnibhūtā3i` iti, `paṭā3u` iti| sambuddhau parataḥ `hrasvasya guṇaḥ` [[7.3.108]] iti guṇaḥ, `eco'pragṛhrasya` [[8.2.107]] ityādinā'kāraḥ, idutau ca| udāharaṇavākye pūrvapadānāmetenaiva plutaḥ, kṛta iti gṛhītvā yaścodayet -atha kathamihānantyasyāpi pluto bhavati, yāvatā vākyasya ṭerityanuvartate iti? taṃ pratyāha -`agnibhūte, paṭo ityetayoḥ` ityādi||`ciditi` iti| itikaraṇaḥ prayujyamāna ityetacchabdasya viśeṣaṇamityasyārthasya dyotanāva| asati hretadarthaṃ itikaraṇe hrupamārthe'nyasmin? prayujyamāne cicchabdaḥ plavata iti vijñāyeta| tatprajyamānatayātra tasmin? viśeṣite vākyasya ṭeḥ plataḥ siddho bhavati| `katathañcidāhaḥ` iti| atra kṛcchre cicchabdo vartate| `agnirmāṇavako bhāyāt` iti| agniriva māṇavako dīpyetetyarthaḥ astīhopamārthaḥ, tathāpi cicchabdasya prayogo nāstīti na pluto bhavati| asati tu prayujyamānagrahaṇe ihopamānagatau satyāṃ yadapyanyeṣāmapi sarveṣāmupamānārthānāṃ prayogo gamyate, tathāpi yo'tra cicchabdasya prayogastadāśrayaḥ plutaḥ syādeva| cakārosyaiva plutasya samuccayārthaḥ| samuccayaśca bhedādhiṣṭhāna iti plutānantaramevedamākhyātaṃ bhavati; anyathā pūrvadhveva plutanimitteṣvetasmin? viṣaye'nudāttatvamātraṃ vidhīyata iti vijñāyeta||itikaraṇaḥ kāryiṇo nirdeśārthaḥ| kāryaṃ hi vidhātumavaśyaṃ ṣaṣṭhaāsau nirdeṣṭavyaḥ| itikaraṇena veti vārthaḥ pratyavamuśyate| śabdapradhānastvihoparisvidādiśabdaḥ kāryaṃ iṣyata itītikaraṇena nirdiṣṭaḥ pluto yathā vijñāyeta| `adhaḥsvidāsīdityatra` ityādi| atrādhaḥsvidāsīt, utoparisvidāsīvityetadvicāryate; tatra pūrvasmin? vākye <> [[8.2.97]] ityādinodāttaḥ plutaḥ, itarasmastvanenānudāttaḥ, tasyaivāpavādaḥ| cakārasya pūrvavadeva prayojanam||asūyādiśabdānāṃ `vākyāderāmantrita` [[8.1.8]] ityādau sūtre'yaṃ ākhyātaḥ| `māṇavaka3 māṇavaka` ityādau dvirvacanaṃ tenaiva sūtreṇa veditavyam| `vāvacanaṃ kartavyam` iti| vetyetadvikalpopalakṣaṇam| vacanaṃ vyākhyānamityarthaḥ| atraitaduktaṃ bhavati -vikalpavyākhyānaṃ kartavyamiti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -`vibhāṣā pṛṣṭapratitivacane heḥ` [[8.2.93]] ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vibhāṣāgrahaṇanuvartate, tena vikalpo bhaviṣyatīti||kṣiyā=ācārabhedaḥ| iṣṭāśaṃsanamāśīḥ| niyogaḥ=praiṣaḥ| ākāṅkṣatyaparaṃ tiṅantameva| kuta etat? ākāṅkṣāgrahaṇādeva| subante hi sādhanādāyinī tiṅantasyāvaśyambhāvinī apekṣeti| `dhanaṃ ca tāta` iti| atra lapsīṣṭetyetadapekṣate| `vyākaraṇaṃ ca` iti| atrāpyadhyeṣīṣṭetyetat| `lunīhi3` iti| `ī halyadhoḥ` [[6.4.113]] itītvam| `piba` iti| pādhrādisūtreṇa [[7.3.78]] pibādeśaḥ| `astu` iti| asterloṭ, `eruḥ` [[3.4.86]] ityutvam, adāditvācchapo luk, etaccāparaṃ tiṅantaṃ nāpekṣate| evaṃ `vihara` ityetadapi||`antyasya tu` ityādi| tuśabdaḥ padāntarebhyo viśeṣaṃ darśayati| antyasyetyanenāpi svaritaḥ, <> [[8.2.100]] ityanenāpyanudāttaḥ; tayoścaikatra yaugapadyaṃ na sambhavati| tatra vacanaprāmāṇyādanudātto'pi pakṣe na bhavati, svarito'pi||<> [[8.2.84]] ityevamāvibhirlakṣaṇaiḥ pluto vidhīyamānaḥ `acaśca` [[1.2.28]] ityasyopasthāne sati yatraiva pluta uktaḥ, tatra tasyaivaicaḥ samudāyātmanaḥ syāt, tadavayavayoreveṣyate| sa ca vacanamantareṇa na sidhyatītīdamārabhyate| tasya tu plutasya nimittaṃ dūrāddhūtādevaicaḥ prasaṅga iti pūrveṇa prakaraṇena plutasya prāptau satyāmityarthaḥ| `ai3tikāyan, au3pamanyava` iti| atra `guroranṛtīḥ` [[8.2.86]] ityādinā ecaḥ plute prāpte'nena tadavayavayoridutoḥ plutaḥ kriyate| ai3tikāyana, au3pamanyavetyatra yadyaicoravayavayoridutoḥ plutaḥ kriyate, tatraikārīkārau caturmātrau sādrdhatrimātro vā prāpnutaḥ| iha hraucau samāhāravarṇau; mātrā'varṇasya mātrevarṇovarṇayoḥ| apare tvāhuḥ -ardhamātrā'varṇasya, adhyardhamātrevarṇovarṇayoriti| atra parvasmin? darśane'nena plute kṛte sati idutostiruāo mātrāḥ, avarṇasya caikamātreti catumatriḥ prāpnoti; itaratra tu darśane'varṇasyārdhamātrā, idutīstu tā eva tinna iti sārdhatrimātraḥ prāpnotītyata āha -`atra yadā` ityādi|nanu ca trimātrasya `pluta iti saṃjñā kṛtā, tatkathaṃ dvitrimātrāvapi plṛtau śakyāvanena karttum? ityata āha -`plutāvaviti hi` ityādinā| etena laukikasyātra plutasya grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate? punaḥ plutagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, loke hi ca pluto vṛddhimānuṣyate| ata evāha -`iduttau vṛdiṃdha gacchata ityarthaḥ` iti| anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ plavatirvṛddhāvapi vartate| nanvevamapyaniyamena vṛddhiḥ prasajyate; iyattānabhidhānāt; tataśca yāvatī vṛddhiḥ syāt, yāktyā caturmātrārvacau sampadyeyātāmiti? ata [`atrāha` -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| plutirvṛddhirityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarayaṃ niyamo labhyate? evaṃ manyate -aiceti plutāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| idutau tathā plavete yathā sa pluta eṅorbhavati; evañcaṃcorbhavati yadi tāvatī vṛddhirbhavati yāvatyā tāvaicau trimātrau sampadyete| akṛtāyāṃ hi vṛddhau aictvameva syāt; yuktaparimāṇatvādaicām, tataścaicsambandhī pluto na syāditi| `ardhatṛtīyamātrau` iti| ardhatṛtīyaṃ yayormātrayoste'rdhatṛtayamātre, te yayostāvardhatṛtayamātrau| idaṃ tāvadvārttikakāramatamāśritya samādhānamuktam| bhāṣyakārasya tviṣṭaiva caturmātratā plutasyeti darśayannāha -`bhāṣye tūktam` ityādi| `tatkatham` iti| yadi tat? bhāvyakārasya mataṃ tat? kena prakāreṇa sampadyeta? ityetat? pṛcchati| `samparavibhāgapakṣe` ityādinā yathā tat? sampadyate tathā darśayati| samapravibhāgapakṣe hranena sūtreṇedutostrimātraḥ plutaḥ kriyate, tataśca tatsambandhinyo yāsmiruāo mātrā yā ca pūrvākāramātrā tāḥ sarvāḥ samāhmatāścataruāo mātrā bhavanti| evañca caturmātraḥ pluto bhavati| atra bhāṣyakāradarśane punaḥ plutagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra plutopasaṃgrahārtham; anyathā svaritaprakaraṇāt? tasyaiva prasaṅge satyevedutorivaṃ plutiḥ syāt| punaḥ plutagrahaṇe tūdāttānudāttayorapi bhavati| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhamukhārtham||ecaḥ samāhāravarṇāḥ tatra ekārasya okārasya ca pūrveṇa prakaraṇena samudāyasyaiṣa plutaḥ, ecoḥ punaravayavayoridutoḥ| anantarasūtreṇedamārabhyate `viṣayaparigaṇanaṃ kartavyam` iti| etadgrahaṇavākyam| asya `praśnāntābhipūjita` ityādinā vivaraṇaṃ karoti `kartavyam` [vaktavyam -kāśikā] iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -<> [[8.2.100]] ityādayo yogā ihānuvartante, tenānyatra na bhavati| `yathāviṣayam` iti| yo yasya viṣayo yathāviṣayam -`yathā'sādṛśye` [[2.1.7]] ityavyayībhāvaḥ, `praśnāntābhipūjitayoḥ` [[8.2.100]] anudāttaḥ plutaḥ| praśne tu <> [[8.2.105]] iti svaritaḥ, śeṣepūdāttaḥ| `itutau punarudāttāvetau` iti| `ṭerudāttaḥ` [[8.2.82]] iti cādhikārāt| `viṣṇubhūte viṣṇubhūte3` iti| atra `āmreḍitaṃ bhatrsane` [[8.2.95]] iti plutaḥ| `āgaccha bho māṇavaka viṣṇubhūte3` iti| atra `dūrādghate ca` [[8.2.84]] iti| nanu cāsatyapi parigaṇane naiva plutaḥ prāpnoti; `adūrāddhate` iti vacanāt, tatkimarthamidaṃ parigaṇanasya pratyudāharaṇityāha -`parigaṇane ca` ityādi| asati parigaṇane, adūrāddhūta [`adūrāddhūtena bhaviṣyatīti` ityeva -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ityucyate| asmastu satyetanna vaktavyam| parigaṇanādeva hi dūrāddhūte na bhaviṣyatīti| `kartavyam` iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -`yājyāntaḥ` [[8.2.90]] ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvartate, tenāntasyaiva bhaviṣyatīti| `bhadraṃ karoṣi gauḥ` iti| `abhipūjite` [[8.2.100]] iti plutaḥ| antagrahaṇānuvṛtteratrāyaṃ vidhirna bhavati, na hyatraitacchabdo'śte, kiṃ tarhi? vyañjanam| `śobhane khal? staḥ khaṭve3` iti| atrāpi `abhipūjite` [[8.2.100]] ityeva plutaḥ| `āmantrite `ca` [`ca` nāsti -kāśikā padamañjarī ca] ityādi| plutaścāsau vikāraśceti plutavikāraḥ| plutavyapadeśastvidutoḥ plutasāhacaryāddheditavyaḥ| idutogrrahaṇamaicaḥ pūrvasyottarasya caita ādeśā mā bhūvannityevamartham| taparakaraṇamihāpi mukhasukhārtham||`tayoḥ` iti| anantaravihitāvidutau pratyavamṛśyete| `agnā3yāśā, paṭā3vāśā` iti| agne āśā, paṭo āśā iti sthite `pradnāntābhipūjitadicāryamāṇapratyabhivākhyājyānteṣu` (vā|932) ityeteṣāmanyatamasmin? vivakṣite, ecaḥ pūrvasyārthasyākāraḥ plutaḥ, uttarasyārthasyedutau, tayoranena yvau| kimarthaṃ punaretadārabhyate? etau <> [[6.1.77]] ityeva sidhyata? ityata āha - `idutorasiddhatvāt` ityādi| nanu ca siddhā plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu| yaṇādeśādiṣu yadayam? <> [[6.1.125]] iti plutasya prakṛtibhāvamāha; sato hi kāryema bhavitavyam, nāsataḥ; plutasya cekaḥ, atastāvapi svaramandhiṣu siddhāveṣa? ityata āha - `athāpi` ityādi| yadīdaṃ nocyeta, tadā `agnā3 i indram, paṭā3 u udakam? ti sthite ṣāṣṭhikaṃ yaṇādeśaṃ bādhitvā'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ [[6.1.97]] syāt| iha cāgnā3 iti āśā iti sthite <<iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca>> [[6.1.127]] iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt| tasmādyathānayoḥ siddhatvaṃ syāt, tathāpi dīrghatvaṃ śākalaviṣiśca mā bhūdityevamarthamidaṃ vaktavyameva| nanu cānyadeva tannivṛttyartha yatnāntaramasti, kiṃ punastaditi cet? ucyate; `śko yaṇaci` [[6.1.77]] ityatropasaṃkhyāyate - `ikaḥ plutapūrvasya yaṇādeśo vaktavyaḥ śākaladīrghanivṛttyartham` (vā|673) iti| tasyopasaṃkhyānamavaśyaṃ kartavyam| ya ik? bhoḥśabdasya plutaḥ| atra bhoḥśabdāt? para ikāro nipātaḥ, na plutavikāraḥ| tasya yaṇādeśa iṣyate, so'sati tasminnupasaṃkhyāne na syāt| tasmādavaśyaṃ tat? kartavyam| yasmaśca kriyamāṇe plutavikārayorapīdutostenaiva bhavitavyam, tato nedaṃ vaktavyamityata āha - `tathāpi` ityādi| agnā3 iti āśā iti sthite yadi tena ṣāṣṭhikopasaṃkhakyānena yaṇādeśa ihodāttalyekārasya sthāne kriyeta, tasyodāttayaṇsvare kartavye siddhatvādāśāśabdākārasyānudāttasya <<udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya>> [[8.2.4]] iti svaritaḥ prasajyeta| āśāśabdaḥ `āśāyā adigākhyā cet` (phi|sū|1-18) ityantodāttaḥ| śeṣamapi `anudāttam` [[6.1.152]] ityākāro'nudāttaḥ| tasmādasti svaritatvaparasaṅga iti tannivṛttyarthamidamucyate| `kinta yaṇā` ityādi| saṃgrahaślokadvayam| kimiti praśne| tu iti vitarke| <> [[6.1.77]] iti yaṇādeśena kiṃ na siddhaṃ bhavatīhāgnā3 yāśetyevamādāvudāharaṇe yadācārya idutīryvau vidadhāti! sarvameva siddhamityabhiprāyaḥ| syādetat - yaṇādeśo na prāpnoti, tasmin? kartavye idutorasiddhatvādityata āha - `tau ca` ityādi| tuśabdo hetau| yadā ik? plutapūrvo bhavati tadā tasya syāt| tasmāt? `ikaḥ plutapūrvasya yaṇādeśo vaktavyaḥ śākaladīrghanivṛttyartham` (vā|673) ityupasaṃkhyāne yaṇādeśamapavādaṃ karoti śākaladorghavidhyoḥ| tena hetunā tayoridutoḥ śākaladīrghavidhī na bhaviṣyataḥ| caśabdaḥ samuccaye; bhinnakramaśca pratiṣedhānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| `tau ca mama svarasandhiṣu siddhau`| na ca śākaladīrghavidhī prayojayataḥ| evamapavādaḥ| teṣāṃ śākaladīrghanivṛtteḥ prayojanatve prayojanāntaramāha - `yaṇasvarabādhanameva tu hetuḥ` iti| yaṇādeśāśrayaḥ svaro yaṇasvaraḥ, tasya bādhanaṃ hetuḥ kāraṇam| kasya? prakaraṇāt? sūtārambhasyaiti gamyate| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| yaṇsvabādhanameva tu sūtrārambhasya heturityarthaḥ|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāmaṣṭamādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ- - - athāṣṭamā'dhyāyaḥtṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ`yudhoḥ` [[7.1.1]] ityatra dveṣyaparīhārāyoktaṃ tat? `matuvasoḥ` ityatrāpi draṣṭavyam| `indramarutva` iti| marucchabdānmatup, `jhayaḥ` [[8.2.10]] iti yatvam, `ugidacām` [[7.1.70]] iti num, halṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogānta [[8.2.23]] lopau, nakārasya rutvam, tasya `bhobhago` [[8.3.17]] ityādinā yakāraḥ, tasyāpi <> [[8.3.19]] iti lopaḥ| `hariṣo medinaṃ tvā` iti| hariśabdānmatup, <> [[8.2.15]] iti vatvam, pūrvavannumādi| ayaṃ tvatra viśeṣaḥ -`haśi ca` [[6.1.110]] iti rorutvam, pūrveṇa sa ha <<ādguṇaḥ>> [[6.1.87]] | `mīḍhvastokāya` iti| `miha secane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-992) liṭaḥ kvasuḥ, `dāāān? sahvān? mīḍhvāṃśca` [[6.1.12]] ityadvitvam, aniṭtvam? upadhādīrghatvañca nipātyate, `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam, rorvisarjanīye kṛte tasya <> [[8.3.34]] ti sakāraḥ| śatrādeśasya vasoḥ sambuddhau chandasi diṣaye prayogo nāstīti tasyānudāharam| ata eva `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya` (vyā|pa|52) ityeṣā paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate; ekānubandhakasya sambuddhiparasya cchandasi vasoḥ prayogādarśasāt|`vidvān` iti| <> [[7.1.36]] | `he papivan` iti| pāteḥ pibatervā parasya kvasoḥ <> [[7.2.67]] itīṭ, <<āto lopa iṭi ca>> [[6.4.64]] ityākāralopaḥ sthānivadbhāvāddvirvacanam| `vana upasaṃkhyānam` iti| ananubandhakasya vano'sambavātsāmānyena kvanibbanipogrrahaṇam| yaśca matvarthe `kvanibvanipau chandasi vaktavyau` (vā|582) ityaupasaṃkhyānikaḥ, tasyāpi grahaṇam| `prātaritva` iti| `iṇ? gatau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1045) prātāpūrvaḥ, āto maninkvanibdhanipaśca` [[3.2.74]] ityanuvartamāne <<anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante>> [[3.2.75]] iti kvanip, <> [[6.1.71]] | idaṃ tu sampadāditvādinā kvipi tuki tadantanmatupi `jhayaḥ` [[8.2.10]] iti vatve matvantādeva sidhyatīti nopasaṃkhyānaṃ prayojayati| `vibhāṣā` ityādi| bhavacchabdaḥ `bhāterḍavatuḥ` [`bhāterḍavatup` -paṃ|u|1-64] iti ḍavatupratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ| avyutpannaṃ vokārānubandhaṃ prātipadikam; itarau tu matvantau| `he bhoḥ` iti| numo rutve kṛte'vaśabdasya sarvasyaiva sthāna okāraḥ kriyate, nālo'ntyasya, `nānrthake'lontyavidhiḥ` (vyā|pa|62) iti kṛtvā| `nupātavijñānāt? siddham` iti| etadgrahaṇakavākyam| `atha vā` iti| asyaiva vivaraṇam| `asambaddhāvapi` ityādi| etena nipātatve hetuṃ darśayati| yadyupasaṃkhyānādeva bho ityevamādikaṃ syāt, dvivacanabahuvacanayorna syāt; sambuddhyabhāvāt| striyāñca sambuddhāvapi na syāt -bho brāāhṛṇīti; atra strīliṅgaviśiṣṭānāmanupādānāt| `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam` (vyā|pa|29) iti cet, na; vibhkatau tatpratiṣedhāt -vibhaktau yatkāryaṃ viṣīyate tatreyaṃ paribhāṣā pratiṣidhyate; `vibhaktau liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāgrahaṇam` (vyā|pa|30) iti vacanāt| athāpi na pratiṣidhyate? evamapi bhavatīti sthite ikārasya[`īkārasya` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] rutve kṛte'vaśabdasya caukāre kṛte rutvasyāsiddhatvāt? saṃyogāntalopābhāve sati visarjanīye kṛteniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| tasmādasambuddhau, striyāñca darśanānnipātā evaite veditavyāḥ| nipātatvaṃ punareṣāṃ vibhaktipratirūpakatvāt, `vibhaktisvarapratirūpakāśca` (ga|sū|16) iti cādiṣu pāṭhāt| pavañca bhoḥ śabdasya nipātatvaṃ syāt; bhavatervici kṛte guṇe ca vibhaktyante bhoḥśabdasyaiva vidyamānatvāt, itarayostu na syāt| na hrasatyasmiśupasaṃkhyāne bhagośabdaḥ, aghoḥśabdasca vibhaktyanto'sti, yatpratirūpakau nipātau syātām| tasmāt? sautrā evaite nipātā veditavyāḥ; `bhobhagoadhoapūrvasya` [[8.3.17]] ityatra sūtre eṣāṃ pāṭhāt| atha vā -upasargavibhaktitvarapratirūpakāśceti cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvānnipātatvameṣāṃ veditvayam| yadi tarhi nipātatvameṣāmāśrityopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyākhyāyate, tadā bhoḥśabdaprayoge samostatobhostatrabho ityatra <<itarābhyo'pi dṛśyante>> [[5.3.14]] ti bhavadādiyoge vidhīyamānāstasilādayo na sidhyanti? aniṣṭasvādadoṣaḥ| yo hi nipātatvādupasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe sa bhoḥśabdaprayoge tasilādīnnecchatyeva||pūrvatvamidamāpekṣikam, ruścehānuvartate| na ca tadapekṣaṃ pūrvatvamasya vijñāttuṃ śakyate; ita uttaraṃ hranunāsiko ruśca samanuvṛtterekakālaṃ vidhauyata ityanunāsikavidhānakāle roraniṣpannatvam| atastadapekṣayā pūrvatvamidamaśakyaṃ vijñātum| tasmādyasya sthāne rutvaṃ vidhīyate tadapekṣayā pūrvatvaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha -`yasya sthāne rurvidhīyate tataḥ pūrvasya` iti| tuśabdaḥ parasmāta kāryiṇaḥ pūrvasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati| parasya rutvakāryam, pūrvasya tvanunāsika iti| atha vā -rutvādananāsikasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati| rutvaṃ nityam? anunāsikastu vibhāṣeti| achāckadkagaṇaṃ kimartham? atra ruprakaraṇe yathā syāditi cenna; adhikārādevaitat? siddham| yathā hi `anunāsikaḥ pūrvasya` ityadhikṛtamuttaratrānuvartate, tathā rurityetadapi| tatrāntareṇāpyatreti vacanaṃ ruprakaraṇe bhaviṣyatītyata āha -`atra` ityāgadi| sanniyogaḥ -yaugapadyam| yaugapadyam| ruṇā saha kathaṃ nāma sa pratīyetetyevamarthamatragrahaṇam| avadhāraṇañcātra draṣṭavyam -ruṇaiveti| sanniyogamātraṃ hi rutvānunāsikayoḥ; uttaratra dvayorapyanuvṛtteḥ| sthāniūbhedena virodhābhāvādvināpyatragrahaṇena labhyata eva| nanu ruprakaraṇādūdhrvamanunāsikasyāsvaritatvādeva sanniyogo na vijñāsyate, tatka tadarthenātragrahaṇena? ityata āha -`adhikāraparimāṇāparigrahe hi` ityādi| adhikārasya parimāṇamiyattā, tasya parigrahaḥ=parijñānam, niścayaḥ| tasminnasati mandadhībhiḥ pratipattṛbhiḥ kimuttaratrānunāsikasya svaritatvamasti? ahosvinnāsti? iti jātasandehaiḥ `ḍhoḍhe lopaḥ` [[8.3.13]] ityādāvapi yasya sthāne ḍhalopadikāryaṃ vidhīyate tasmāt? pūrvasyānunāsika āśaṅkyeta| atha vāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatottarasūtre nityagrahaṇādeva vikalpo'sya vijñāsyate? naitadasti; evaṃ hi pūrvasatre vikalpo vijñāyeta| tasmādveti vaktavyam? na vaktavyam; ācāryapravṛttijrñāpayati -vikalpenāyaṃ vidhirbhavatīti, yadayamuttarasūtre yasyānunāsiko na kṛtastasmādroḥ pūrvasmāt? paramanusvārāgamaṃ śāsti| na hi nitye'smin? vidhau tat? sambhavati, roḥ pūrvasya yasyānunāsiko na kṛta iti| evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthaṃ vāgrahaṇam||`devaṃ acchādīvyat` iti| atra yo'kārastasminnaṭi parato `dūrghādadi samānapāde` [[8.3.9]] iti na kārasya rutve kṛte tasmāt? pūrvasyākārasyānenānunāsikatvam, pūrvavadroryakāraḥ, tasya pūrvadeva lopaḥ| yadi mahāṃ indro ma ojaseti `kecidanusvāramadhīyate` iti vaktavyam, tarhi tadyathāsau sidhyatītyata āha -`saḥ` ityādi| vyatyayo bahulam` [[3.1.85]] ityanena boddhavyaḥ| `yo vā vanaspatīṃ ranu` iti| vanaspatīn? anviti sthite <> [[8.3.9]] iti nakārasya rutve kṛte `anunāsikāt? paro'nusvāraḥ` [[8.3.4]] itīkārāt? paro'nusvāraḥ `bhavāṃśascarati` iti| `naśchavyapraśāt` [[8.3.7]] iti nakārasya rutvam, tasya visarjanīyasya sakāraḥ, tasya <> [[8.4.40]] iti ścutvam| nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham|[`spaṣṭārtham` -prāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] pūrveṇaiva vikalpe siddhe satyārambhasāmarthyādeva nityo'yaṃ vidhirvijñāsyate| nanu cāta evāṭi, atha vā'ṭaevātaḥ -ityeva niyamo yathā syādityevamarthaḥ siddhe satyārambhaḥ syāt? naitadasti; asati hi vidheye niyamo bhavati| iha tvasti videyam, kiṃ tat? nityo'nunāsikaḥ| tasmādvidhireva yuktaḥ; na niyamaḥ| tathā coktam -`vidhiniyamasambhave vidhireva vyāyān` (vyā|pa|130) iti| `ātaḥ` iti takāro'sabdehārthaḥ| `ā ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt -kimarthaṃ ṣaṣṭhantasyākārasya kāryino nirdeśaḥ? uttādeśāntasya pthamāntasya? iti||`anyaśabdo'trādhyāhāryaḥ` iti| asati hranyaśabdasyādhyāhare paraśabdasya dhutatvāt? tadapekṣayaivānunāsikādityeṣā pañcamī syāt; anyasyeha pañcamīhetorasambhavāt| nanu <> [[1.1.67]] upasthāne uttaraśabdāpekṣayaiva pañcamau syāt? naitadasti; yadi hralyāḥ paribhāṣāyā ihopasthānaṃ syāt? paragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāt? paraśabdāpekṣayaiva pañcamyā bhavitavyam| sā bhavantī ca `anyārāditararte` [[2.3.29]] ityādivā sūtreṇa paraśabdayoge digbṛttigā vā syāt, anyārthavṛttinā vā? tatra pūrvasmin? pakṣe roḥ pūrvasmādanunāsikādeva paro'nusvāro vijñāyeta, na ca tasmāt? para iṣyate| itarasmastvayamarthaṃ āpadyeta -anunāsikāt? paro bhavatadi, anunāsikādanyo'nuscāro bhavatītyarthaḥ| evañca paragrahaṇanarthakaṃ syāt; na hranunāsikāpekṣayānusvaro'nyatvaṃ vyabhirati| kiñca -śrutatvāt? tasyaivānunāsikasyānusvāro vijñāyeta, prakṛtattvādrorvāḥ; aniṣṭañcaitat? anyaśabdādhyāhāre tu vasyānunāsiko na kṛtasyasmādeva para iti vijñāyate| tasmādanyaśabdo'trādhyāhāryaḥ| satyapyanyaśabdādhyāhāre tu yasyānunāsiko na kṛtasyasmādeva para ita#i vijñāyate| tasmādanyaśabdo'trādhyāhāryaḥ| satyapyanyaśābdādhyāhāre yadi paraśabdāpekṣayaiva `anunāsikāt` ityeṣā pañcamī syāt, sa doṣastadavastha eva syāditi matvā''ha -`tadapekṣayā ceyam` ityādi| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe| anyaśabdāpekṣayaiva, na paraśabhdāpekṣayetyarthaḥ| `anunāsikadanyo yaḥ` ityanena tadevānyaśabdāpekṣatvaṃ pañcamyā darśayati| `roḥ pūrvaḥ` ityanenāpi pūrvagrahaṇānuvṛttim| pūrvatvañca rutvāpekṣam| `yasyānunāsiko na kṛtaḥ` ityanenāpyanyaśabdābhidheyamarthaṃ darśayati| `tataḥ` ityanenāpi pūrvagrahaṇasyārthādiha pañcamyantatayā vipariṇāamam| anyaśabdasya cāvyāhmatasya pañcamyantatāṃ para ityanenāpi| tasyā anyaśabdasya sambandhinyāḥ pañcamyāḥ paraśabdāpekṣatām| `āgamaḥ` ityanenāpyādeśābhāvam| paragrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| anyaśabdasya pañcamyantasyādhyāhare sati pūrvagrahaṇasya cārthāt? prathamāntatayā vipariṇāme satyevaṃ vijñāsyate -anunāsikādyo'nyastasmāduttaro yo rustataḥ pūrvo'nusvārāgamo bhavati| evañca vijñāyamāne'satyapi paragrahayaṇe saṃskartetyādi sidhyatyeva, kiṃ paragrahaṇena? etat? kriyate vispaṣṭārtham||<<mo'nusvāraḥ>> [[8.3.23]] ityanusvāre prāpte vacanam| `sa~skartā`[`saṃskarteti` -nyāse, padamañjaryāṃ ca mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| karoteḥ sampūrvāt? tṛjādayaḥ, <> [[6.1.137]] (iti) suṭ, samo makārasya <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] ityanena rutve tataḥ pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ, rorvisarjanīyaḥ| tasya `vā śari` [[8.3.36]] iti vikalpena sakāre prāpte visarjanīye ca yathā nityaṃ sakāro bhavati, tathā vṛttau darśitam| kathaṃ punarasmin? sūtre sakāro nirddiśyate? ityāha -`samaḥ ssuṭi` ityādi| yasmin? pakṣe vibhaktisakārasya visarjanīye kṛte `vā śari` [[8.3.36]] iti sakāro na kriyate, saṃ pakṣamāśrityedamuktam; anyathā hi trisakārako'yaṃ nirdeśa iti vaktavyaṃ syāt; trayāṇāṃ sakārāṇāṃ sannipātāt| eko hi vibhaktisambandhī sakāraḥ, dvitīyastvādeśasambandhī, tṛtīyaḥ suṭasambandhī| yadā tu trisakāraṃ kṛtvā sūtraṃ paṭhate, tadā dviśabdo'dhikasakāropalaṇārtho draṣṭavyaḥ| yadi tarhi sakāra ādeśo vidhīyate, `saṃskartā` ityatrānunāsiko na prāpnoti; yasmādatrātragrahaṇaṃ ruṇaiva saha sanniyogapratipattyarthamuktam| rugrahaṇasyāsmin? prakaraṇe yadvidhīyate tadupalakṣaṇārthatvādadoṣaḥ| `ruṇā saha` iti| ruprakaraṇe yadvidhīyate tena sahetyarthaḥ| yadapi pūrvasmin? sūtre vṛtto `roḥ pūrvaḥ` ityuktam, tatrāpi rugrahaṇasyāsmin? prakaraṇe yadvidhīyate tadupalakṣaṇārthaṃ veditavyam; anyathā hi `saṃskartā` iti pakṣe'nusvāro na syāt||`pumaḥ` iti| puṃsaḥ sakārādavaśiṣṭo yo bhāgastasyāyaṃ nirdaśaḥ, sakārasya saṃyogāntalope kṛte tasyaiva kāryitvāt| `ampare` iti| am? paro yasmāt? sa tathoktaḥ| amiti pratyāhārasya grahaṇam, na dvitīyaikavacanasya| kuta etat? vyāptinyāyāt? `khayi` iti pratyāhāreṇa sāhacaryācca| `puṃścalī` iti| calaḍiti pacādau paṭhate| tena `cala kampane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-832) ityasmāt? pacādyac? ṭidbhavati, `ṭiḍḍhaṇañ` [[4.1.15]] iti ṅīp| puṃścalīti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `puṃskāmā` iti| puṃsi kāmo'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| atha vā -pumāṃsaṃ kāmayata iti `śīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇo vaktavyaḥ` (vā|229) iti ṇaḥ; tataṣṭāp| atra puṃskāmetyatrodāharaṇe| `sakāra evādeśaḥ` iti| visarjanīyasyetyapekṣate| `vaktavyaḥ` iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam -`kupvoḥ ka pau ca` [[8.3.37]] ityatra `vā śari` [[8.3.36]] ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenātrāpi visarjanīyasya sakāra eva bhaviṣyati, na visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyāviti| idaṃ tāvat? pūrvasūtre yadā dvisakārapakṣo nāśrīyate, tadā pratividhānamuktam| yadā tu tatra `dvisakārako nirdeśaḥ` ityeṣa pakṣa āśrīyate, tadā pratividhātumāha -`dvisakārakanirdeśapakṣe tu` ityādi| nanu ca rurapyanuvarattata eva, tatra yathā sakāro'nuvartamāno bhavati tathā rurapi pakṣe syāt, tataśca rutvapakṣe visarjanīye kṛte jihvāmūloyaḥ syādeva? ityata āha -`rutvaṃ tvanuvartamānam` ityādi| tatraiva kāraṇamāha -`sambandhānuvṛttistasya` ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau, sa hi `matuvaso ru sambuddhau` [[8.3.1]] ityataḥ svena sambandhinā matupā vasunā ca sambaddha ihānuvartate| tasmānnotsahate sambandhyantareṇa sambandhamanubhavitum| `puṃdāsaḥ` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ -puṃso dāsa iti| karmadhārayo vā| evaṃ `pugavaḥ` iti| atra tu <> [[5.4.92]] iti ṭac? samāsāntaḥ| `puṃkṣīram, puṃkṣuram` iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `khayyami` iti| vaktavye paraghaṇaṃ viparītakalpanānirāsārtham| asati paragrahaṇe -ami khayi para iti vijñāyeta, tataśca `pumākhyaḥ, pumācāraḥ` ityatrāpi syāt| ataḥ paragrahaṇam||`sa` iti| nivṛttam, rurevānuvartate; so'pi matuvasubhyāmasambaddha eva; tayorapi nivṛttatvāt| `na` iti varṇagrahaṇam, tacca prakṛtasya padasya viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha - `nakārāntasya padasya` ityādi| `bhavāṃśchādayati` iti| `jhada apavāraṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1833), curādiṇic| `bhavāṃṣṭīkate` iti| `ṭikṛ ṭīkṛ radhi laghi gatyarthāḥ` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-103,104,107,108)| anudāttattvādātmanepadam| `praśān` iti| prapūrvācchameḥ kvip? `anunāsikasya vivajhaloḥ kṅiti` [[6.4.15]] iti dīrghaḥ, <> [[8.2.64]] iti makārasya nakāraḥ, tasyāsiddhatvānnalopābhāvaḥ| `bhavān? tsarukaḥ` iti| tsarau kuśalaḥ, <<ākarṣādibhyaḥ kan>> [[5.2.64]] iti kanpratyayaḥ||pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpārtha vacanam||`samānapāde` iti| karmadhārayāt? saptamī| samānaśabdaścāyamekārthe vartamā iha gṛhrate| samāne=ekasmin? pāde nimittanimittanorādhārabhata ityarthaḥ| tatraikagrahaṇe kartavye kvacidasamānapāde'pi yathā syāditi samānagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| tenehāpi rurbhavati -yajāmahai yajñiyā indradevāṃ ilāmahai īkṣāṃ anājyaiti| atra bhinnayoḥ pādayornimittanimittinau vartate| atha vā -sādṛśye vartamānaḥ samānaśabdo gṛhrate, anyathā hrekagrahaṇaṃ kuryāt| iha ca sādṛśyamubhayorasti pādayoḥ, kriyāpadayostulyārthatvāt| yathā yajāmahāyityetat, kriyāpadaṃ pūjāyāṃ vartate, tathelāmahāyityetadapi| `īḍa stutau` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1019), loṭ, ṭeretttavam, <<vaito'nyatra>> [[3.4.96]] itīkārasyaikārahaḥ| dhātorvarṇavyatyayena ḍakārasya lakāraḥ| chāndasatvād? hrasvatvam||`nṛn?` iti| `supāṃ suluk` [[7.1.39]] ityādinā ṣaṣṭhaā lukaṃ kṛtva nirdeśaḥ| atha vā - vibhaktirevātra notpadyate, anukāryānukaraṇayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt| yathā-gavityayamāhetyādi| `pe` iti pakāramātrameva nimittatvenopāttam; na samudāyaḥ| akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ, anyathā hi yadyakārasamudāyo nimittatyenāśrīyate, tadā nṛ#ḥ pacatītyevamādāveva syāt, na tu nṛn? prīṇīhītyādau| `aṭi` iti ceha nivṛttam; nimittāntaro pādānāt| atha tasyaiva nimittasyaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate -aṭi parato yaḥ pakāra iti? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum; iha na syāt -nṛ#ḥ psāti, nṛ#ḥ plāvayatīti| tasmādasya nivṛttiraṅgrahaṇasya yuktā||svatavāniti pūrvavannirdeśau veditavyaḥ| tathā `kān` [[8.3.12]] iti parasūtre'pi| `svatavāḥ, pāyuragne` iti| `dṛksvaḥsavatavasāñchandasi` [[7.1.83]] numa, halṅyādi [[6.1.66]] saṃyogānta [[8.2.23]] lopau||`kāṃskān` iti| kimaḥ śasi <> [[7.2.103]] iti katvam, prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ` [[6.1.98]] iti dīrghaḥ, <> [[6.1.103]] iti sakārasya nakāraḥ, vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam, rutvam? visarjanīyaḥ, tasaya <> [[8.3.34]] iti saḥ| kathaṃ punaratra sakāraḥ, yāvatā `kupvoḥ ka pau ca` [[8.3.37]] iti visarjanoyajihvāmūlīyābhyāṃ bhavitavyam? ata āha -`asya` ityādi| tatra yadyapi na paṭhate, tathāpi bhavatyevāniṣṭaprasaṅga iti darśayitumāha -`samaḥ suṭi` ityādi| yadi sakāro'trānuvarttiṣyate, pūrvayoge'pi sarvatraitasmādanuvartamānāt? sakāraḥ prasajyeta? ityāha -`pūrvayogeṣu` ityādi| pūrvayogeṣu hi <> [[8.3.5]] iti svena sambandhinā samā suṭā ca sambaddhasyaiva tasyānuvṛttiḥ, tato na tasya sambandhyantareṇā sambandho bhavati| kān? kāniti vaktavye, āmreḍitagrahaṇam -yatra dvirvacanaṃ tatra yathā syāt| teneha na bhavati -kān? kān paśyatīti| eko'tra kiṃ śabdaḥ praśne, dvitīyastu kutsāyām| kān? kutsitān? paśyatītyarthaḥ||`ḍhe` iti varṇamātraṃ nimittatvenāśrīyate; na varṇasamudāyaḥ| kuta etat? vyāptyā| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| varṇagrahaṇe tu sati līḍhvā, mīḍhvetyādāvapi bhavati; anyathā hi yadi varṇasamudāyo nimittatvenādhīyate tadā lauḍham, mīḍhamityādāveva syāt, na tu līḍhavetyādau| `līḍham` ityādi| `liha āsvādane` (dhāpā|1016) `miha secane` (dā|pā|992), `guhū saṃvarṇe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-896) -ebhyaḥ [ebhyaḥ `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ` iti ṣṭutvam -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ktaḥ, `ho ḍhaḥ` [[8.2.31]] iti ḍhatvam, `jhavastathordho'dhaḥ` 98.2.40) iti dhatvam| <<ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ>> [[8.4.41]] iti ṣṭutvam, ḍhalopaḥ, ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ` [[6.3.110]] iti dīrghaḥ| kathaṃ punarlīḍhamityādyudāhaṇamupapadyate, yāvatā ḍhakāro'tra paranimittaṃ nāstyeva ḍhalope kartavye ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatvāt? ityata -`ṣṭutvasya` iti| ḍhakāro'tra ḍhalopanimittanāśrīyate, na cāsau kvacit? siddhaḥ sambhavati yatrānena ḍhalopaḥ kartavyaḥ| tasmād? ḍhakārasya nimittatvenāśrayaṇādeva ṣṭutvasya siddhatvaṃ veditavyam; anyathā hrasya vacanasya vaiyathryaṃ syāt; anavakāśatvāt| syādetat| ālīṅḍhaukata ityanena ḍhalopo bhaviṣyati, siddho hyatra ḍhakāraḥ, tat? kuto vacanasya vaiyathryām? ityāha`āliṅḍhaukte` ityādi| yadyapyatra nimittaṃ ḍhakāraḥ siddhaḥ, tathāpi naiva ḍhalopa upapadyate; jaśtve kṛte kāryiṇo ḍhakārasyābhāvāt| nanu ca nirviṣayatvāṅḍhalopo jaśtvāpavādo bhaviṣyati? ityāha -`na ca` ityādi| kuta etat? ityāha -`tasya hi` ityādi| yadi hi tasya viṣayo na sambhāvyeta, tato jaśatvāpavādaḥ sakyate vijñātam| sambhavati cāsya viṣayo līḍhāṭiḥ, tasmānna śakyau'sau jaśatvāpadāda iti vijñātum| kathaṃ punarlīḍhādirasya viṣayaḥ pāvatā yathā āliṅḍhaukata ityatra jaśtve kṛte kāryiṇo'sambhavāṅaḍhalopasyā viṣayaḥ, tathā loḍhādāvapavi ṣṭutavasyāsiddhatve sati nimittasyābhāvāt| athātra vacanasamāthryāḍaḍhalopena ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ bādhyate? itaratrāpi jaśtvaṃ kasmānna bādhyate; tasmādyadi punarlīḍhāviḍhaṃlopasya viṣaya ittareṇāpi tadviṣayeṇa bhavitavyam, na tu līḍhādinaivetaratrāpītyata āha -`tatra hi` ityādi| iha `ḍhe` iti saptamīnirdeśā dānantaryamāśritam; na tu līḍhādinaivetaratrāpītyata āha -`tatra hi` ityādi| iha `ḍhe` iti saptamīnirdeśā tadviṣayeṇa bhavitadhyam, na tu līḍhādinaivetaratrāpītyata āha -`tatra hi` ityādi| iha `ḍhe` iti saptamīnirdeśā dānantaryamāśritam; nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāt| tataścānantarye sati ḍhalopena bhavitavyam| asti ca loḍhādo śrutikṛtamānantaryam, ubhayornimittakāryiṇorḍhakārayoḥ śrayamāṇatvāt| tasmādeṣa eva ḍhalopasya viṣayaḥ? satyamihāsatyānantaryaṃ śrutikṛtam; anānantaryamapyasti śāstrakṛtam; śāstreṇa ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatvopādānāt| sati ca tasmin? so'pi na ḍhalopasya viṣaya ityata āha -`śāstrakṛtam; śāstreṇa ṣṭatvasyāsiddhatvopādānāt| sati ca tasmina so'pi na ḍhalopasya viṣaya ityata āha -`śāstrakṛtam` ityādi| vidyamānamapi śāstrakṛtamanāntaryaṃ ḍhalopena bādhyate; anyathā hi vacanavaiyadhryaṃ syāt| yathā śāstrakṛtamanānantaryaṃ vacanasāmarthyādbādhitvā ḍhalopo bhavati, tathā śyaliṅḍhaukata ityatrāpi śrutikṛtamānānantaryaṃ bādhitvā ḍhalopaḥ syādityāha -`āliṅḍhaukata ityatra tu` ityatra tu` ityādi| tuśabdo lauḍhāderasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati| atra līḍhādau hi yadyapi śāstrakṛtamānantaryaṃ nāsti, śrutikṛtaṃ tvasti| iha tu nāpi śrutikṛtamānantaryaṃ dvayorḍhakārayoraśrūyamāṇatvāt, nāpi śāstrakṛtam, śāstreṇa jaśatvasyāsiddhatvānupāyanāt| tasmānnaiva ḍhalopasya viṣayaḥ||kiṃ punaridaṃ sānubandhakārasya rephasya grahaṇam? utta niranubandhakasya? kiñcātra yadi sānubandhakasya grahaṇam? siddham -agnīrathaḥ, indūratha iti; nīraktaṃ dūraktamiti tu na sidhyati| atha niranubandhakarasya grahaṇam? tadā sidhyati -nīraktam, dūraktamiti; agnīrathaḥ, indūratha iti na sidhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha tanteṇācāryaḥ `ro ri` iti dve sūtre uccāritavān, tatraikatra sānubandhakasya grahaṇam, aparatra niranubandhakasyeti| nīraktamityādau <<ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ>> [[6.3.111]] iti dīrghatvam| iha yadi padasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī syāt, tataḥ <<alo'ntyasya>> [[1.1.52]] iti padāntasyaiva [`padāntasya` -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] rephasya [ayaṃ bhāgaḥ kāṃu|pāṭhe nāsti]lopaḥ syāt -nīraktamityādau| ajardhā ityādau tvapadāntasya[ayaṃ bhāgaḥ kāṃu|pāṭhe nāsti] na syāt; viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhaāṃ tvasyāmihāpi bhavatītyetaccetasi kṛtvā''ha -`padsya` ityādi| viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhaāṃ hi padasyetyasyaivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate -padasyāvayavo yo rephastasya rephe parato lopo bhavatīti| tenāpadāntasyāpi bhavati| `ajardhāḥ` iti| `ekāco baśo bhav` [[8.2.37]] ityādau sūtra ivaṃ vyutpāditam| `apāspāḥ` iti| `spadrdha saṅgharṣe` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-3) asamādyaṅ, dvirvacanam, <<śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ>> [[7.4.61]] iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ, <<dīrgho'kitaḥ>> [[7.4.83]] iti dīrghatvam, <<yaṅo'ci ca>> [[2.4.74]] iti yaṅo luk; pāspadrdha iti sthite laṅ aḍāpamaḥ, sip, `carkarautañca` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1081) ityādiṣu pāṭhācchapo luk, sipo ilṅyādinā [[6.1.66]] lopaḥ, jaśtvena dhakārasya dakāraḥ, `daśca` [[8.2.75]] iti tasyaiva dakārasya rutvam, tatrānena rephasya lopaḥ, pūrvavaddīrdhatvam| yogavibhāgakaraṇamuttarārtham, uttarasūtre rephasyānuvṛttiryathā syādityevamartham; itarathā hi ḍhakārasyāpi tatarānuvṛttiḥ syāt, tataśca tasyāpi visarjanīyaḥ prasajyeta||yadyatra padasyeti viśeṣaṇavaṣṭhī syāt -padasyāvayavo yo repha iti, tadā `arkaḥ` ityādānapyapadāntasya rephasyāpi visarjanīyaḥ syāt| sthānaṣaṣṭhaā na doṣaḥ; atra hi padaṃ repheṇa viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavati, tena rephāntasaya kāryamucyamānamalo'ntyasyaiva bhavatītyetadālaucca padasayetyeṣā sthāne ṣaṣṭhī; tacca padaṃ repheṇa veśeṣyata ityataddarśayannāha -`rephāntasya padasya` iti| `khari parato'vasāne ca` iti| `pataḥ` ityetat? pūrveṇaiva sambadhyate, na pareṇāvasānena,[`pareṇa avasāne -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] tasya paurvāparyābhāvāt| tathā hi yena varṇena viramyate so'vasānaṃ syāt| viratirvā virāmaḥ=varṇasyānuccāraṇam| tena rephāntāt? padādyena varṇena virabhyate sa tāvadavasānasaṃjñakaḥ paro na sambhavati; tanmātrasyāprayogāt| aprayogastu nirarthakatvāt| itaratra tu punaravasānamabhāvarūpam| abhāve ca paurvāparyaṃ na sambhavati; tasya varṇadharmatvāt| tasmāt? tadapi naiva rephāntāt? padāt? paramupapadyate| kecittu buddhikalpitaṃ paurvāparyamāśritya `avasāne ca` ityānenāpi saha `parataḥ` ityetatsambandhanti| tatra yadi vuddhikalpitaṃ paurvāpagrraṃ nāśrīyate, tadā `kharavasānayoḥ` ityekāpyeṣā saptamyadhikaraṇabhedādbhidyate; kharyaupaśleṣike'ñikaraṇe saptamī bhavati -khari parata iti, avasāne tu vaiṣayike'dhikaraṇe saptamī bhavati -avasāne viṣaya iti| yadā tu vṛddhikalpitamabhāve'pi paurvāpayamavasāne'pyāśrīyate, tadobhatrāpi parasaptamyeva| udāharaṇeṣu khari visarjanīye kṛte <> [[8.3.34]] iti sakāraḥ, tasya cavarge parataḥ ścutvam| ñadheha nṛkuṭaāṃ bhavaḥ, <> [[4.3.53]] ityaṇi -nārkuṭaḥ, nṛpaterapatyam? `dityādityādityapatyuttarapadāṇṇyaḥ` [[4.1.85]] iti nārpatya ityatra visarjanīyaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha -`iha` ityādi| vṛddhihiṃ bhavādāvarthe vihitaṃ taddhitamāśritya bhavantī bahiraṅgā, tasyāśca bahiraṅgatvāt? tadāśrayasyāpi rephasya bahiraṅgatvam; vṛddhyāśritatvāt, punā rephasya tadbhaktātvāt? tannimittātvācca| visarjanīyaktu kharmādhamāśritya bhavatītyantaraṅgaḥ| `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge` (vyā|pa|42) iti visarjanīye kartavye repho'siddhaḥ, ata iha visarjanīyo na bhavati| nanu ca bṛddhau kartavyāyāṃ visarjanīyoḍabhimato'ntaraṅgo'saddhaḥ, tadasati tasmin? `vṛddherbahiraṅgavyapadeśo nopapadyate, tasyāntaraṅgāpekṣakatvāt; asati tasmin? vṛddherbahiraṅgavyapadeśe rephasyāpi sa na syāt| vṛddherbahiraṅgadvārakaṃ hi rephasya bahiraṅgatvam; tataścomayāṅgavikalatvāt? bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā (vyā|pa|42) nopatiṣṭhata iti yaduktatam -`bṛddherbahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt` iti, tannopapadyate? naitat; <> [[8.2.3]] iti kāryāntarārtham? `na` iti yogāvibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ| tena vṛddhau kartavyāyāṃ visarjanīyasyāsiddhatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati| ata eva bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyāmapi visarjanīyasyāsiddhatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti veditavyam| `kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam` (vyā|pa|58) ityasya darśanasyehāśritatvācca| yuktañcaitat, kāryaprayuktatvāddhi saṃjñāparibhāṣasya taddeśataiva nyāyyā| yatra hranayā'siddhatvaṃ kriyate so'syāḥ kāryadeśaḥ| kva cānayā'siddhatvam? visarjanīyavidhau| tasmāt? taddeśaiveyam; na tu yatropasaṃkhyātā -<> [[1.4.2]] iti, taddeśā; nāpi yatra jñāpitā -`vāha ūru` [[6.4.132]] ityatra, taddeśā||`payaḥsu, yaśaḥsu` iti| kvacit? sakāradvayaṃ paṭhate| tatra `vā śari` [[8.3.36]] iti visarjanīyasya sakāraḥ| `sarpiḥṣu` iti| yatra visarjanīyaḥ paṭhate tatra `numvisarjanīyaśavryavāye'pi` [[8.3.58]] iti pratyayasakārasya ṣatvam| yatra sarpiṣṣviti ṣakāradvayaṃ paṭhate, tatra pūrvavadeva visarjanīyasya sakāre kṛte pūrvavadeva pratyayasakārasya vatvam, pūrvasya ṣṭutvam? [[8.4.40]] | supīti pratyāhāragrahaṇaśaṅkānirāsāyāha -`supi` ityādi| etacca `khari` ityanuvartanāllabhyate, na hi saptamībahuvacanadanyaḥ sup? kṣarādirasti| mā bhūt; kharītyanuvṛtteḥ| saptamyāḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatīti? sambhavati [`na sambhavati -kāṃu|pāṭha] tatra kharādiḥ sup| yadi syāt? kiñca syāt? agīḥkaḥ, adhaḥka ityatra niyamādvisarjanīyo na syāt| tasmādvyākhyānameva śaraṇam| kimarthaṃ punaridam, yāvatā nanu siddhaḥ pūrveṇaiva visarjanīyaḥ? ityāha -`siddhe sati` ityādi| viparītaniyamo nāśaṅkanīyaḥ, <> [[5.4.70]] ityādau visarjanīyanirdeśāt| `gīrṇu`, dhūrṣu` iti| `rthorupadhāyāḥ` [[8.2.76]] ityādinā dīrghaḥ||`bho atra` ityādau `oto gāgryasya` [[8.3.20]] iti nityo yalopaḥ| gāgryagrahaṇaṃ tatra pūjārtham| `bho dadāti` ityādāvapi <> [[8.3.22]] iti nitya eva yalopaḥ| athāśgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'śo'myaḥ kharyo bhavati tatra kharavasānayorvisargeṇa bhavitavyam, kṛte visarṇanīye tasya sthānivadbhāvādrugrahaṇena grahaṇe sati syāditi cet? na; jñāpakāt| yadayam? `atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu dhā` [[8.3.2]] ityatra visarjanīyayakāramakṛtvā nirdeśaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati -visarjanīyasya khari yakāro na bhavati| avasāne tarhi syāditi cet? na; <> [[6.3.114]] ityadhikārāt| tasmādantareṇāpyaācanamaśyeṇa bhavati, ityata āha -`adagrahaṇamuttarārtham` iti| <> [[8.3.22]] ityādinā tāmevottarārthatāṃ darśayati| `dṛkṣavṛṭ` iti| `ovraścū chedane` (dhātupāṭhaḥ-1292), kvip, grahrādinā [[6.1.16]] samprasāraṇam, <> [[8.2.29]] iti sakāralopaḥ, cakārasya vraścādinā [[8.2.36]] cakāraḥ, tasya jaśtvena ḍakāraḥ, tasyāpi cartvam -ṭakāraḥ, vṛkṣavṛṭ, tamācaṣṭa iti ṇic, `ṇāviṣṭhavat? prātipadikasya` (dhā|813) itīṣṭhavadbhāḥ, `ṭeḥ` [[6.4.155]] iti ṭilopaḥ, vṛkṣavayateṇryantātkvip, <<ṇeraniṭi>> [[6.4.51]] iti ṇilopaḥ| `vṛkṣav? karoti` iti| atrāśgrahaṇādvakarasya kakāre parato lopo na bhavati| ata evāśghrahaṇāt? <> [[6.1.66]] iti lopo na bhavatyeva| anyathādagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| yadyuttarārthamaśgrahaṇaṃ syāt? tarhi tatraiva kartavyam, evaṃ hranuvṛttyartha svaritatvaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha -`atha` ityādi| `uttarārtham` iti| <> [[8.3.22]] ityasmāt? sūtrāduttarasūtre'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat? tathoktam| <<mo'nusvāraḥ>> [[8.3.23]] ityādinā tadevottarārthatvaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| yadi hi <> [[8.3.22]] ityatrāśgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta, tataḥ <<mo'nusvāraḥ>> [[8.3.23]] ityatra yathā halgrahaṇasyānuvṛttiḥ, tathāśgrahaṇasyāpi syāt| tataścāśyeva hali mo'nusvāraḥ syāt, na halmātre| yadā tu tatrāśgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadottaratra halmātre'nusvāraḥ sidhyati| punaruttarārthatāmaśgrahaṇasya darśayati -`vyorladhupratyatnataraḥ` ityādi| gatārtham||`laghuprayatnataraḥ` iti| prayatnaḥ prayatanam| `yajayāca` [[3.3.90]] ityādinā naṅ| laghuḥ prayatno yasya sa laghuprayatnaḥ, atiśayena laghuprayatno laghuprayatnataraḥ| kiṃ punaridaṃ laghuprayatnataratvam, yadyogāllaghuprayatnataro bhavatītyāha -`laghuprayatnataratvam` ityādi| sthānam -tālvādi, karaṇam -jhvāmūlādi, tayoruccāraṇe śaithilyaṃ laghuprayatnataratvam` ityādi| sthānam -tālvādi, karaṇam -jihvāmūlādi, tayoruccāraṇe śaithilyaṃ ladhuprayatnataratvam| udāharameṣvāntaratamyādvakārasya vakāra eva bhavati, yakārasya yakāra eva|śākaṭāyanagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham| anena hi vyorlaghuprayatnataratvaṃ vidhīyate, uttarasūtreṇāpi lopaḥ; tatrobhayovidhānasāmarthyādeva pakṣe vidhirvijñāsyate||otaḥ parayovryorlopo nityaṃ vakṣyati| tasmādavarṇapūrvayorayaṃ vidhirvajñāyata ityāha -`avarṇapūrvayoḥ` ityādi| `śākalyagrahaṇaṃ vibhāṣārtham` (iti)| nanu ca śākaṭāyanasya matena laghuprayatnataro vihitaḥ| tatrānta reṇāpi śākalyagrahaṇaṃ pākṣika eva vidhirvijñāsyate; anyathā hi[`hi` -nāsti kāṃu|pāṭhe] laghuprayatvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, tatkaśākalyagrahaṇena? ityata āha -`tene` ityādi| asati hi śākalyagrahaṇe vibhāṣārthe laghuprayatnatareṇa mukte nityo lopaḥ syāt, tataścālaghuprayatnatarayorvyoḥ pakṣe śravaṇaṃ na syāt| śākalyagrahaṇe tu sati lopo vikalpyate| tena tayorapi pakṣe śravaṇaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| evañca trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti -ekaṃ laghuprayatnatarapakṣe, dvitīyaṃ lopapakṣe, tṛtīyaṃ tūbhayorabhāvapakṣe||okārāduttaro vakāro nāsti, padānta iti yakārasyaivāyaṃ vidhirvijñāsyata ityāha -`okārāduttarasya yakārasya` iti| nanu ca pūrvasūtreṇaivaukārāduttarasya yakāralopaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkimarthamidamārabhyate? ityāha -`mityārtho'yamārambhaḥ` iti| gāgryagrahaṇaṃ tarhi kimartham? ityāha -`gāgryagrahaṇam` ityādi| vyoriha prakaraṇe laghuprayatnatarapakṣevihito lopo'pi, tatkasyārya nityo lopo bādhakaḥ? ityāha -`yo'yam` ityādi| atha vā -yadi nityārtho'yamārambhaḥ, pakṣe laghupratyatnataro na syādityata āha -`yo'yam` ityādi| lopavikalpasyānantaratvāt? tasyaiva nivṛttiryuktā kartumiti bhāvaḥ|`kecittu` ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi laghuprayatnatarasya bādhanaṃ bhavati, yāvatānantaratvāllopavikalpasyānena bādhā yuktā? vyoḥ kāryasamudāyasyāpekṣitatvādadoṣaḥ| yadi lopaviphalpamātramapekṣate, tataḥ sa eva bādhyate, na laghuprayatnataraḥ; lopena vyavahitatvāt| yadā tu vyoryavasmin? prakaraṇe kāryaṃ vihitaṃ tatsamudāyo'pekṣyate, tadā tasyānantaryāt? sa eva nivarttyate| taparakaraṇamasandehārtham| yato hi `oḥ` ityukte sandehaḥ syāt -kimayamokarasya nirdeśaḥ? āhosvidukārasyeti? maivam; `bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya` [[8.3.17]] ityanuvartate, na bhoḥprabhṛtīnāmukāro'sti, tatkutaḥ sandeṅaḥ? evaṃ tarhi mukhasukhārtham||<> [[8.3.19]] iti siddhe niyamārtham -uñi pada eva, nānyatreti| `avarñapūrvayoḥ` iti| okārapūrvasya vakārasyāsambhavādyakārasya pūrveṇaiva siddhatvādavarṇapūrvayorevāyaṃ lopo vijñāyata ityavarṇapūrvayorityuktam| `sa u` iti| tacchabt? suḥ, tyadādyatvam, <> [[7.2.106]] iti saḥ, rutvām, tasya yakāraḥ, tasyānena lopaḥ| `tantrayutam` iti| `tantre` ityetasya saptamyantasya utaśabde niṣṭhānte parato'yādeśaḥ| nanu ca `uñi` [`uñ` -kāṃu|pāṭhaḥ] ityucyate, na cāyamuñ, ñakārābhāvāt? tatkimetannivṛttyarthena padagrahaṇena? ityata āha -`veñaḥ samprasāraṇe` ityādi| samprasāraṇaṃ tu `vacisvapi` [[6.1.15]] ityādinā| evaṃ tāvaduño nipātasya pratipadoktasyāstitvamanapekṣya padagrahaṇaprayojanaṃ darśitam| yadā tu tasyāstitvamapekṣyate, tadā prayojanāntaraṃ darśayitumāha -`uttarārtham` iti| `ṅamo hrasvādaci ṅamuṇ? nityam` [[8.3.32]] ityeṣa vidhirajādau pade yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt -paramadaṇḍineti| yadyuttarārtham, tatraiva kasmānna kṛtam, kaḥ punarevaṃ siti lābhaḥ? svaritatvaṃ na pratijñāyata ityeṣa lābhaḥ| ihāpi kriyamāṇe lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā (vyā|pa|3) nāśrayaṇīyā bhavatīti samānam| cakāro'varṇapūrvasyānukarvaṇārthaḥ; kṣanyathā hroto'nantaratvāt? tataḥ parasya yakārasya lopo vijñāyeta? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne nirarthakamevedaṃ sūtraṃ syāt, pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| nānarthakam, niyamārthatvāt -uṅi pada eva yathā syāt -bho u padaśyatīti| asati hrasminniyamārthe bho yutam, bhago yutamityatrāpi nityo lopaḥ syāt| yadi tu nipātasyedamuño grahaṇam, tadā niyamārthasya vyāvatryatvaṃ nāstīti pūrvāpekṣayā cakāraḥ samuccayārtho draṣṭavapyaḥ|uñīti ñakāro'sandehārthaḥ| asati hi tasmin? saptamyā au iti nirdeśaḥ syāt| tataśca kimayamukārasya nirdeśaḥ? uttekārasyeti? sandehaḥ syāt| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi tasmin? kimuñīti nipātasya grahaṇam? āhosvidukārādārabhya jhabhañ` (mā|sū|8) iti ñakārasyeti sandehaḥ syādeva? naivam; idaṃ tāvadbhavān? praṣṭavyaḥ -kimuñiti pratyāhare ye'ntargatā halasteṣveva nityo lopaḥ? utānyeṣvapīti? kimatra vaktavyam -`anyeṣvapi` iti? tathā hi vakṣyati -<> [[8.3.22]] iti| evaṃ tarhi yadyatra pratyāhāragrahaṇabhimataṃ syāt? `eauc` (mā|sū|4) iti cakāreṇa pratyāharaṃ gṛhṇīyāt -uci ca pada iti| halyapi `hali sarveṣām` ityanena bhaviṣyatīti| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ -sandehaḥ parihmato bhavati| atha vā yadyatrokārādīnāmuñā pragatyāharagrahaṇabhimataṃ syāddhalīti lakāreṇa pratyāharaṃ gṛhītvaikamevemaṃ yogaṃ kuryāt -`uli ca pade sarveṣām` iti| na hi yogavibhāgasya kiñcit? prayojanaṃ paśyāmaḥ| tasmānnātrokārādīnāṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇamiṣṭam| tataścoño nipātasyaiva grahaṇamityasandigdhametat||`bhobhagoaghoapūrvasva` iti| bhobhagoaghopūrvasya vakārasyāsambhavāt| avarṇapūrnastu vakāraḥ sambhavati| tasya tu pūrvameva `hali sarveṣām` ityanena lopo na bhavatīti darśitam| teneha yakārasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na vakārasya, tasya lopo na bhavatīti darśitam -`bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya` [[8.3.17]] ityādau sūtre| tatrāśgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? hali sarveṣāmityayaṃ lopo'śi hali yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt -vṛkṣa vṛścatīti vṛkṣavṛṭ, tamācaṣṭa iti ṇic, vṛkṣavavati, vṛkṣavayaterapratyayaḥ vṛkṣav -`vakṣav? karoti` iti| evamaśgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayatāmena sūtreṇāśi hali vakārasyāvarṇapūrvasya lopo na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| nanu cāvarṇapūrvasyetyasyānuvṛttirayuktā; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt, tatkathamavarṇapūrvasya lopo bhavatīti? naitadasti; `cānukṛṣṭamuttaratrnānuvartate` (vyā|pa|76) iti prāyikametat| kathaṃ jñāyate? <> [[8.4.12]] ityatra `ṇaḥ` iti prakṛte punarṇagrahaṇam, <> [[8.4.10]] ityatra `vā` iti yadanuvṛttaṃ tannivṛttyrtha kṛtam| yadi cedaṃ prāyikaṃ na syāt, punarṇagrahaṇamanartham; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvādeva hi vāgrahaṇasyānuvṛttirna bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ punarṇagrahaṇena?
